````typescript
import { PathSegment } from './address-bar.types';
import { ArchiveFrame, buildArchiveDisplayPath, isArchive } from '../services/archive.service';
import { REGISTRY_ROOT } from '../services/registry.service';

// ─── Path utilities ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface SearchAliasQuery {
  path: string;
  pattern: string;
  recursive: boolean;
}

const SEARCH_SCHEME = 'search://';

function canonicalDriveReference(p: string): string | null {
  const normalized = (p || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  const driveRef = /^filesystem:\/\/([a-z])(\/.*)?$/i.exec(normalized);
  if (driveRef) {
    const drive = driveRef[1].toLowerCase();
    const rest = (driveRef[2] || '').replace(/^\/+/, '').replace(/\/+/, '/');
    return rest ? `filesystem://${drive}/${rest}` : `filesystem://${drive}`;
  }
  const windowsRef = /^([a-z]):(\/.*)?$/i.exec(normalized);
  if (windowsRef) {
    const drive = windowsRef[1].toLowerCase();
    const rest = (windowsRef[2] || '').replace(/^\/+/, '').replace(/\/+/g, '/');
    return rest ? `filesystem://${drive}/${rest}` : `filesystem://${drive}`;
  }
  return null;
}

function isDriveReference(p: string): boolean {
  return canonicalDriveReference(p) !== null;
}

function toShortDriveDisplayPath(p: string): string {
  const canonical = canonicalDriveReference(p);
  if (!canonical) return p;
  const rest = canonical.slice('filesystem://'.length);
  const drive = rest.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase();
  const suffix = rest.slice(1).replace(/^\/+/, '');
  return suffix ? `${drive}:/${suffix}` : `${drive}:/`;
}

function aliasSchemeFor(p: string): string | null {
  const normalized = (p || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase();
  const match = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(normalized);
  if (!match) return null;
  const scheme = `${match[1].toLowerCase()}://`;
  if (scheme === 'filesystem://') return null;
  return scheme;
}

function webHostRootFor(p: string): string | null {
  const normalized = (p || '').trim();
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(normalized);
    const scheme = parsed.protocol.toLowerCase();
    if (scheme !== 'http:' && scheme !== 'https:') {
      return null;
    }
    return `${scheme}//${parsed.host.toLowerCase()}`;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function normalizeAliasReference(p: string, scheme: string): string {
  const normalized = (p || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (scheme === SEARCH_SCHEME && normalized.slice(scheme.length).startsWith('?')) {
    return normalizeSearchAliasReference(normalized);
  }
  const rest = normalized.slice(scheme.length).replace(/^\/+/, '').replace(/\/+/g, '/').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  return rest ? `${scheme}${rest}` : scheme;
}

function normalizeSearchAliasReference(p: string): string {
  const normalized = (p || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  const raw = normalized.slice(SEARCH_SCHEME.length);
  if (!raw || raw === '?') return SEARCH_SCHEME;
  if (!raw.startsWith('?')) return normalized;

  const params = new URLSearchParams(raw.slice(1));
  const path = normalizePath(params.get('path') || '/');
  const pattern = (params.get('pattern') || '').trim();
  const recursiveRaw = (params.get('recursive') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const recursive = recursiveRaw === '' || recursiveRaw === '1' || recursiveRaw === 'true';

  if (!pattern) {
    return SEARCH_SCHEME;
  }

  return buildReadableSearchAlias(path, pattern, recursive);
}

function buildReadableSearchAlias(path: string, pattern: string, recursive: boolean): string {
  const parts = [
    `path=${readableSearchValue(path)}`,
    `pattern=${readableSearchValue(pattern)}`,
    `recursive=${recursive ? 'true' : 'false'}`,
  ];
  return `search://?${parts.join('&')}`;
}

function readableSearchValue(value: string): string {
  return encodeURIComponent(value)
    .replace(/%2F/gi, '/')
    .replace(/%3A/gi, ':')
    .replace(/%2A/gi, '*');
}

function unquoteSearchToken(value: string): string {
  const trimmed = (value || '').trim();
  if (trimmed.length >= 2) {
    const first = trimmed[0];
    const last = trimmed[trimmed.length - 1];
    if ((first === '"' || first === "'") && first === last) {
      return trimmed.slice(1, -1).trim();
    }
  }
  return trimmed;
}

function parseSearchAddressBody(rawBody: string, fallbackPath?: string): SearchAliasQuery | null {
  const body = (rawBody || '').trim();
  if (!body) return null;

  if (body.startsWith('?')) {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(body.slice(1));
    const pattern = unquoteSearchToken(params.get('pattern') || '');
    const rawPath = unquoteSearchToken(params.get('path') || fallbackPath || '');
    const recursiveRaw = (params.get('recursive') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const recursive = recursiveRaw === '' || recursiveRaw === '1' || recursiveRaw === 'true';
    if (!pattern || !rawPath) return null;
    return {
      path: normalizePath(rawPath),
      pattern,
      recursive,
    };
  }

  const explicitNonRecursiveIndex = body.lastIndexOf(' @@ ');
  const explicitRecursiveIndex = body.lastIndexOf(' @ ');
  let separatorIndex = -1;
  let separatorLength = 0;
  let recursive = true;

  if (explicitNonRecursiveIndex >= 0 && explicitNonRecursiveIndex >= explicitRecursiveIndex) {
    separatorIndex = explicitNonRecursiveIndex;
    separatorLength = 4;
    recursive = false;
  } else if (explicitRecursiveIndex >= 0) {
    separatorIndex = explicitRecursiveIndex;
    separatorLength = 3;
    recursive = true;
  }

  let pattern = body;
  let rawPath = fallbackPath || '';
  if (separatorIndex >= 0) {
    pattern = body.slice(0, separatorIndex);
    rawPath = body.slice(separatorIndex + separatorLength);
  }

  pattern = unquoteSearchToken(pattern);
  rawPath = unquoteSearchToken(rawPath);
  if (!pattern || !rawPath) return null;

  return {
    path: normalizePath(rawPath),
    pattern,
    recursive,
  };
}

export function parseSearchAddressInput(input: string, fallbackPath?: string): SearchAliasQuery | null {
  const normalized = (input || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (!normalized.toLowerCase().startsWith(SEARCH_SCHEME)) {
    return null;
  }

  const fallbackQuery = fallbackPath ? parseSearchAliasQuery(fallbackPath) : null;
  const resolvedFallback = fallbackQuery?.path ?? fallbackPath;
  return parseSearchAddressBody(normalized.slice(SEARCH_SCHEME.length), resolvedFallback);
}

export function normalizeAddressBarPathInput(input: string, fallbackPath?: string): string {
  const searchQuery = parseSearchAddressInput(input, fallbackPath);
  if (searchQuery) {
    return buildReadableSearchAlias(searchQuery.path, searchQuery.pattern, searchQuery.recursive);
  }
  return normalizePath(input);
}

export function formatSearchAliasForEdit(path: string): string | null {
  const query = parseSearchAliasQuery(path);
  if (!query) return null;
  const separator = query.recursive ? ' @ ' : ' @@ ';
  return `${SEARCH_SCHEME}${query.pattern}${separator}${formatPathForDisplay(query.path)}`;
}

export function parseSearchAliasQuery(p: string): SearchAliasQuery | null {
  const normalized = normalizePath(p);
  if (!normalized.toLowerCase().startsWith(`${SEARCH_SCHEME}?`)) {
    return null;
  }

  const params = new URLSearchParams(normalized.slice(`${SEARCH_SCHEME}?`.length));
  const path = params.get('path');
  const pattern = params.get('pattern');
  if (!path || !pattern) {
    return null;
  }

  const recursiveRaw = (params.get('recursive') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return {
    path: normalizePath(path),
    pattern,
    recursive: recursiveRaw === '' || recursiveRaw === '1' || recursiveRaw === 'true',
  };
}

export function isAliasPath(p: string): boolean {
  return aliasSchemeFor(p) !== null;
}

function isRegistryReference(p: string): boolean {
  return /^registry:\/\//i.test((p || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/'));
}

function normalizeRegistryReference(p: string): string {
  const normalized = (p || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  const match = /^registry:\/\/(.*)?$/i.exec(normalized);
  if (!match) return normalized;
  const rest = (match[1] || '').replace(/^\/+/, '').replace(/\/+/g, '/').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  return rest ? `${REGISTRY_ROOT}${rest}` : REGISTRY_ROOT;
}

export function canonicalizePathReference(p: string): string {
  if (!p) return p;

  const driveReference = canonicalDriveReference(p);
  if (driveReference) {
    return driveReference;
  }

  let n = p.replace(/\\/g, '/');

  // Convert UNC paths (//host/share/...) to smb:// scheme
  const uncMatch = /^\/\/([^/]+)(\/.*)?$/.exec(n);
  if (uncMatch) {
    const host = uncMatch[1];
    const rest = uncMatch[2] || '';
    n = `smb://${host}${rest}`;
  }

  const registryMatch = /^registry:\/\/(.*)?$/i.exec(n);
  if (registryMatch) {
    const rest = (registryMatch[1] || '').replace(/^\/+/, '').replace(/\/+/g, '/').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    return rest ? `${REGISTRY_ROOT}${rest}` : REGISTRY_ROOT;
  }

  const aliasScheme = aliasSchemeFor(n);
  if (aliasScheme) {
    return normalizeAliasReference(n, aliasScheme);
  }

  return n;
}

export function isWindowsPath(p: string): boolean {
  return isDriveReference(canonicalizePathReference(p));
}

export function normalizePath(p: string): string {
  if (!p) return '/';
  let n = canonicalizePathReference(p);
  if (isRegistryReference(n)) {
    return normalizeRegistryReference(n);
  }
  const aliasScheme = aliasSchemeFor(n);
  if (aliasScheme) {
    return normalizeAliasReference(n, aliasScheme);
  }
  if (isDriveReference(n)) {
    return canonicalDriveReference(n) || n;
  } else {
    n = n.replace(/\/+/g, '/');
  }
  if (n.length > 1 && n.endsWith('/')) {
    n = n.slice(0, -1);
  }
  return n || '/';
}

export function pathIdentityKey(p: string): string {
  const normalized = normalizePath(p);
  const searchQuery = parseSearchAliasQuery(normalized);
  if (searchQuery) {
    return buildReadableSearchAlias(pathIdentityKey(searchQuery.path), searchQuery.pattern, searchQuery.recursive);
  }
  if (isRegistryReference(normalized)) {
    return normalized.toLowerCase();
  }
  if (isDriveReference(normalized) || normalized.startsWith('//')) {
    return normalized.toLowerCase();
  }
  return normalized;
}

export function samePath(left: string | null | undefined, right: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!left && !right) {
    return true;
  }
  if (!left || !right) {
    return false;
  }
  return pathIdentityKey(left) === pathIdentityKey(right);
}

export function parentPath(p: string): string {
  const n = normalizePath(p);
  const searchQuery = parseSearchAliasQuery(n);
  if (searchQuery) {
    return searchQuery.path;
  }
  if (isRegistryReference(n)) {
    if (n === REGISTRY_ROOT) return n;
    const rel = n.slice(REGISTRY_ROOT.length);
    const idx = rel.lastIndexOf('/');
    return idx < 0 ? REGISTRY_ROOT : `${REGISTRY_ROOT}${rel.slice(0, idx)}`;
  }
  const aliasScheme = aliasSchemeFor(n);
  if (aliasScheme) {
    const webRoot = webHostRootFor(n);
    if (webRoot) {
      if (n === webRoot) return webRoot;
      const remainder = n.slice(webRoot.length).replace(/^\/+/, '');
      if (!remainder) return webRoot;
      const idx = remainder.lastIndexOf('/');
      return idx < 0 ? webRoot : `${webRoot}/${remainder.slice(0, idx)}`;
    }
    const rel = n.slice(aliasScheme.length);
    if (!rel) return aliasScheme;
    const idx = rel.lastIndexOf('/');
    return idx < 0 ? aliasScheme : `${aliasScheme}${rel.slice(0, idx)}`;
  }
  const driveReference = canonicalDriveReference(n);
  if (driveReference) {
    const rest = driveReference.slice('filesystem://'.length);
    const drive = rest.slice(0, 1).toLowerCase();
    const rel = rest.slice(1).replace(/^\/+/, '');
    if (!rel) return `filesystem://${drive}`;
    const idx = rel.lastIndexOf('/');
    return idx < 0 ? `filesystem://${drive}` : `filesystem://${drive}/${rel.slice(0, idx)}`;
  }
  if (n === '/') return '/';
  const parts = n.split('/').filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length <= 1) {
    return isWindowsPath(n) ? parts[0] + '/' : '/';
  }
  parts.pop();
  if (isWindowsPath(n)) {
    const drive = parts[0];
    const rest = parts.slice(1);
    return rest.length ? drive + '/' + rest.join('/') : drive + '/';
  }
  return '/' + parts.join('/');
}

export function shortenPath(p: string): string {
  p = normalizePath(p);
  const searchQuery = parseSearchAliasQuery(p);
  if (searchQuery) {
    return `search://${searchQuery.pattern} @ ${shortenPath(searchQuery.path)}`;
  }
  if (isRegistryReference(p)) {
    const rel = p.slice(REGISTRY_ROOT.length);
    if (!rel) return 'registry:';
    if (rel.length <= 28) return rel;
    const parts = rel.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    if (parts.length <= 2) return rel;
    return '…/' + parts.slice(-2).join('/');
  }
  const aliasScheme = aliasSchemeFor(p);
  if (aliasScheme) {
    const rel = p.slice(aliasScheme.length);
    if (!rel) return aliasScheme.slice(0, -2);
    if (rel.length <= 28) return `${aliasScheme}${rel}`;
    const parts = rel.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    if (parts.length <= 2) return `${aliasScheme}${rel}`;
    return `${aliasScheme}…/${parts.slice(-2).join('/')}`;
  }
  const driveReference = canonicalDriveReference(p);
  if (driveReference) {
    return toShortDriveDisplayPath(driveReference);
  }
  if (p.length <= 28) return p;
  const parts = p.split('/').filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length <= 2) return p;
  return '…/' + parts.slice(-2).join('/');
}

export function formatPathForDisplay(path: string): string {
  const normalized = normalizePath(path);
  const driveReference = canonicalDriveReference(normalized);
  if (driveReference) {
    return toShortDriveDisplayPath(driveReference);
  }
  return normalized;
}

export function formatPathsInText(text: string): string {
  if (!text) return text;

  return text.replace(/filesystem:\/\/[a-z](?:\/[^:\n\r]*)?/gi, (match) => formatPathForDisplay(match));
}

// ─── Segment builders ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function buildSegments(p: string): PathSegment[] {
  p = normalizePath(p);
  if (!p) return [];

  const searchQuery = parseSearchAliasQuery(p);
  if (searchQuery) {
    return [
      {
        label: 'search:',
        fullPath: 'search://',
        isRoot: true,
        rootLabel: 'search:',
      },
      {
        label: searchQuery.pattern,
        fullPath: p,
        isRoot: false,
      },
    ];
  }

  if (isRegistryReference(p)) {
    const rel = p.slice(REGISTRY_ROOT.length);
    const parts = rel ? rel.split('/').filter(Boolean) : [];
    const segs: PathSegment[] = [{
      label: 'registry:',
      fullPath: REGISTRY_ROOT,
      isRoot: true,
      rootLabel: 'registry:',
    }];

    parts.forEach((part, i) => {
      segs.push({
        label: part,
        fullPath: `${REGISTRY_ROOT}${parts.slice(0, i + 1).join('/')}`,
        isRoot: false,
      });
    });
    return segs;
  }

  const aliasScheme = aliasSchemeFor(p);
  if (aliasScheme) {
    const rel = p.slice(aliasScheme.length);
    const parts = rel ? rel.split('/').filter(Boolean) : [];
    const rootLabel = aliasScheme.slice(0, -2);
    const segs: PathSegment[] = [{
      label: rootLabel,
      fullPath: aliasScheme,
      isRoot: true,
      rootLabel,
    }];

    parts.forEach((part, i) => {
      segs.push({
        label: part,
        fullPath: `${aliasScheme}${parts.slice(0, i + 1).join('/')}`,
        isRoot: false,
      });
    });
    return segs;
  }

  const driveReference = canonicalDriveReference(p);
  if (driveReference) {
    const rest = driveReference.slice('filesystem://'.length);
    const drive = rest.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase() + ':';
    const rel = rest.slice(1).replace(/^\/+/, '');
    const parts = rel ? rel.split('/').filter(Boolean) : [];

    const segs: PathSegment[] = [{
      label: drive,
      fullPath: `filesystem://${drive[0].toLowerCase()}`,
      isRoot: true,
      rootLabel: drive,
    }];

    parts.forEach((part, i) => {
      segs.push({
        label: part,
        fullPath: `filesystem://${drive[0].toLowerCase()}/${parts.slice(0, i + 1).join('/')}`,
        isRoot: false,
      });
    });
    return segs;
  }

  if (isWindowsPath(p)) {
    const drive = p.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
    const rest = p.slice(3);
    const parts = rest ? rest.split('/').filter(Boolean) : [];

    const segs: PathSegment[] = [{
      label: drive,
      fullPath: drive + '/',
      isRoot: true,
      rootLabel: drive,
    }];

    parts.forEach((part, i) => {
      segs.push({
        label: part,
        fullPath: drive + '/' + parts.slice(0, i + 1).join('/'),
        isRoot: false,
      });
    });
    return segs;
  }

  const parts = p.split('/').filter(Boolean);
  const segs: PathSegment[] = [{
    label: '/',
    fullPath: '/',
    isRoot: true,
    rootLabel: '/',
  }];
  parts.forEach((part, i) => {
    segs.push({
      label: part,
      fullPath: '/' + parts.slice(0, i + 1).join('/'),
      isRoot: false,
    });
  });
  return segs;
}

export function buildArchiveSegments(fsDirPath: string, stack: ArchiveFrame[]): PathSegment[] {
  if (stack.length === 0) return buildSegments(fsDirPath);

  const virtualPath = buildArchiveDisplayPath(fsDirPath, stack);
  const allSegs = buildSegments(virtualPath);
  const fsDepth = buildSegments(fsDirPath).length;

  allSegs.forEach((seg, i) => {
    if (i === fsDepth) {
      // This is the archive file segment itself
      seg.isArchiveRoot = true;
    } else if (i > fsDepth) {
    const label = seg.label.toLowerCase();
    if (label.endsWith('.zip') || label.endsWith('.tar') || label.endsWith('.tgz') ||
        label.endsWith('.tar.gz') || label.endsWith('.tar.bz2') || label.endsWith('.tar.xz') ||
        label.endsWith('.rar') || label.endsWith('.7z')) {
      seg.isArchiveRoot = true;
      seg.isArchiveInner = true;
    } else {
        seg.isArchiveInner = true;
      }
    }
    // i < fsDepth → plain FS segment, no archive flags
  });

  return allSegs;
}

// ─── Highlight match for autocomplete ────────────────────────────────────────

export function highlightMatch(text: string, query: string): string {
  const t = text ?? '';
  const q = query ?? '';
  if (!q) return escapeHtml(t);

  const idx = t.toLowerCase().indexOf(q.toLowerCase());
  if (idx < 0) return escapeHtml(t);

  const before = escapeHtml(t.slice(0, idx));
  const match = escapeHtml(t.slice(idx, idx + q.length));
  const after = escapeHtml(t.slice(idx + q.length));
  return before + '<span class="ab-ac-match">' + match + '</span>' + after;
}

function escapeHtml(s: string): string {
  return (s ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

/**
 * Splits a path into (fsDirPath, archiveSegments) by detecting the first
 * archive extension boundary, enabling the address bar to self-parse any
 * virtual path without needing an externally-provided archiveStack.
 *
 * Examples:
 *   /home/user/archive.zip/folder/nested.tar/deep
 *   → { fsDirPath: '/home/user/archive.zip', archiveInnerParts: ['folder','nested.tar','deep'] }
 *
 *   /home/user/docs
 *   → { fsDirPath: '/home/user/docs', archiveInnerParts: [] }
 */
export function parsePathWithArchives(path: string): {
  fsDirPath: string;
  archiveInnerParts: string[];
} {
  path = normalizePath(path);
  const ARCHIVE_RE = /\.(zip|tar|tgz|tar\.gz|tar\.bz2|tar\.xz|gz|bz2|xz|rar|7z)$/i;
  const driveReference = canonicalDriveReference(path);
  const withoutDrive = driveReference ? driveReference.slice('filesystem://'.length) : '';
  const driveLetter = driveReference ? withoutDrive.slice(0, 1).toLowerCase() : '';
  const driveRemainder = driveReference ? withoutDrive.slice(1).replace(/^\/+/, '') : '';
  const parts = driveReference
    ? (driveRemainder ? driveRemainder.split('/').filter(Boolean) : [])
    : path.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter(Boolean);

  const isWin = !!driveReference || path.startsWith('//') || path.startsWith('\\');

  let archiveBoundary = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
    if (ARCHIVE_RE.test(parts[i])) { archiveBoundary = i; break; }
  }

  if (archiveBoundary === -1) {
    return { fsDirPath: path, archiveInnerParts: [] };
  }

  const fsParts = parts.slice(0, archiveBoundary + 1);
  const innerParts = parts.slice(archiveBoundary + 1);

  // Reconstruct the FS prefix correctly for Windows vs POSIX
  let fsDirPath: string;
  if (driveReference) {
    fsDirPath = `filesystem://${driveLetter}` + (fsParts.length ? `/${fsParts.join('/')}` : '');
  } else if (isWin && /^[A-Za-z]:/.test(parts[0])) {
    fsDirPath = fsParts.join('/');
  } else if (path.startsWith('//') || path.startsWith('\\\\')) {
    fsDirPath = '//' + fsParts.join('/');
  } else {
    fsDirPath = '/' + fsParts.join('/');
  }

  return { fsDirPath, archiveInnerParts: innerParts };
}

/**
 * Builds PathSegment[] for any path, archive-aware, without needing
 * an ArchiveFrame stack. Used as fallback in address-bar when no
 * external archiveStack is provided but the path itself contains archives.
 */
export function buildSegmentsFromParsedPath(
  fsDirPath: string,
  archiveInnerParts: string[]
): PathSegment[] {
  const segments: PathSegment[] = [];
  
  // Build the filesystem path segments first
  const fsSegments = buildSegments(fsDirPath);
  segments.push(...fsSegments);
  
  // Track the cumulative path
  let cumulativePath = fsDirPath;
  
  // Add archive inner parts, marking EVERY archive file in the path
  for (let i = 0; i < archiveInnerParts.length; i++) {
    const part = archiveInnerParts[i];
    cumulativePath += '/' + part;
    
    // Check if this part is an archive file
    const isArchiveFile = isArchive(part);
    const isLast = i === archiveInnerParts.length - 1;
    
    segments.push({
      label: part,
      fullPath: cumulativePath,
      isRoot: false,
      isLast,
      // Mark as archive root if it's an archive file
      isArchiveRoot: isArchiveFile,
      // Mark as archive inner only if it's NOT an archive file AND we're inside an archive
      isArchiveInner: !isArchiveFile
    });
  }
  
  return segments;
}
````

````typescript
export class DiskPieChartComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  /** Entries for the CURRENT level — parent controls which level this is. */
  @Input({ required: true }) entries: DiskUsageEntry[] = [];
  /**
   * Total size denominator for percentages.
   * At root level: the directory total.
   * At sub-levels: parent passes the sum of the Other bucket it drilled into.
   */
  @Input({ required: true }) totalSize = 0;
  @Input() innerR  = 42;
  @Input() outerR  = 100;
  /** Entries below this % of totalSize are grouped into the Other bucket. */
  @Input() minPct  = 10;
  @Input() isTraversing = false;
  @Input() selectedPath: string | null = null;
  @Output() select     = new EventEmitter<DiskUsageEntry | null>();
  @Output() activate   = new EventEmitter<DiskUsageEntry>();
  /** Emits the bucketed "Other" entries — parent pushes a new nav frame. */
  @Output() otherDrill = new EventEmitter<DiskUsageEntry[]>();
  @Output() drillDown  = new EventEmitter<DiskUsageEntry>();

  // ── Derived state (rebuilt whenever inputs change) ────────────────────────

  displayEntries: DiskUsageEntry[] = [];
  otherEntries:   DiskUsageEntry[] = [];
  otherSize = 0;
  otherPct  = '';
  readonly otherColor = '#555566';
  readonly folderBarColor = '#7fba7a';

  slices: PieSlice[]   = [];
  selectedIndex: number | null = null;
  hoveredIndex:  number | null = null;
  private selectedKey: string | null = null;

  tooltip: TooltipState = { visible: false, x: 0, y: 0, name: '', size: '', pct: '', side: 1 };
  tooltipWidth = 120;

  animatedBarPct = 0;
  barTransition  = 'none';

  readonly palette = [
    '#3794ff', '#4ec9b0', '#ce9178', '#c586c0',
    '#dcdcaa', '#569cd6', '#b5cea8', '#d7ba7d',
  ];

  private destroyed = false;

  constructor(readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef) {}

  // ── Lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['entries'] || changes['totalSize'] || changes['minPct'] || changes['isTraversing']) {
      this.hoveredIndex   = null;
      this.tooltip        = { ...this.tooltip, visible: false };
      this.animatedBarPct = 0;
      this.barTransition  = 'none';
      this.partition();
      this.buildSlices();
      this.reconcileSelection();
      return;
    }

    if (changes['selectedPath']) {
      this.applyExternalSelection();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void { this.destroyed = true; }

  // ── Computed getters ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  get selectedEntry(): DiskUsageEntry | null {
    return this.selectedIndex !== null ? (this.displayEntries[this.selectedIndex] ?? null) : null;
  }

  get folderSummaryLabel(): string {
    const childCount = this.entries.length;
    const label = childCount === 1 ? '1 child in this view' : `${childCount} children in this view`;
    if (this.otherEntries.length === 0) {
      return label;
    }
    const hiddenLabel = this.otherEntries.length === 1
      ? '1 child grouped into Other'
      : `${this.otherEntries.length} children grouped into Other`;
    return `${label} • ${hiddenLabel}`;
  }

  get centerName(): string {
    if (this.selectedIndex === null) return '';
    const e = this.displayEntries[this.selectedIndex];
    return e ? (e.name.length > 10 ? e.name.slice(0, 9) + '…' : e.name) : '';
  }

  get centerPct(): string {
    if (this.selectedIndex === null) return '';
    return this.pctStr(this.displayEntries[this.selectedIndex]);
  }

  get tooltipTransform(): string {
    const PAD = 8;
    const x = this.tooltip.side === 1
      ? this.tooltip.x + PAD
      : this.tooltip.x - this.tooltipWidth - PAD;
    return `translate(${x.toFixed(1)},${(this.tooltip.y - 16).toFixed(1)})`;
  }

  // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  getColor(i: number): string { return this.palette[i % this.palette.length]; }

  pctStr(e: DiskUsageEntry): string {
    if (!this.totalSize) return '—';
    const p = (e.size / this.totalSize) * 100;
    return p < 0.1 ? '<0.1%' : p.toFixed(1) + '%';
  }

  formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
    if (!bytes) return '0 B';
    const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
    const i = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), 4);
    const v = bytes / Math.pow(1024, i);
    return (i === 0 ? v : v.toFixed(1)) + ' ' + units[i];
  }

  trackSlice(_: number, s: PieSlice): number { return s.index; }

  trackLegendEntry(_: number, entry: DiskUsageEntry): string {
    return entry.path || entry.name;
  }

  isFullCircle(s: PieSlice): boolean {
    return s.endAngle - s.startAngle >= Math.PI * 2 - 0.001;
  }

  // ── Slice path ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  getSlicePath(s: PieSlice): string {
    if (this.isFullCircle(s)) return '';
    const o = this.outerR, ir = this.innerR;
    const pt = (a: number, r: number) =>
      ({ x: +(r * Math.cos(a)).toFixed(3), y: +(r * Math.sin(a)).toFixed(3) });
    const os = pt(s.startAngle, o), oe = pt(s.endAngle, o);
    const is_ = pt(s.startAngle, ir), ie = pt(s.endAngle, ir);
    const large = s.endAngle - s.startAngle > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
    return [
      `M ${os.x} ${os.y}`,
      `A ${o} ${o} 0 ${large} 1 ${oe.x} ${oe.y}`,
      `L ${ie.x} ${ie.y}`,
      `A ${ir} ${ir} 0 ${large} 0 ${is_.x} ${is_.y}`,
      'Z',
    ].join(' ');
  }

  // ── Event handlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  onSvgMouseMove(event: MouseEvent): void {
    const svgP = this.toSvgCoords(event);
    if (!svgP) return;
    const idx = this.hitTest(svgP.x, svgP.y);
    if (idx !== this.hoveredIndex) this.hoveredIndex = idx;

    if (idx !== null) {
      const isOther = idx === -1;
      const name  = isOther ? `Other (${this.otherEntries.length})` : (this.displayEntries[idx]?.name ?? '');
      const size  = isOther ? this.formatBytes(this.otherSize) : this.formatBytes(this.displayEntries[idx]?.size ?? 0);
      const pct   = isOther ? this.otherPct : this.pctStr(this.displayEntries[idx]);
      this.tooltipWidth = Math.ceil(Math.max(name.length * 6.5 + 18, (size.length + pct.length + 3) * 6 + 18, 90));
      this.tooltip = { visible: true, x: +svgP.x.toFixed(1), y: +svgP.y.toFixed(1), name, size, pct, side: svgP.x < 0 ? 1 : -1 };
    } else {
      this.tooltip = { ...this.tooltip, visible: false };
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onSvgMouseLeave(): void {
    this.hoveredIndex = null;
    this.tooltip = { ...this.tooltip, visible: false };
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onSvgClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    const svgP = this.toSvgCoords(event);
    if (!svgP) return;
    const idx = this.hitTest(svgP.x, svgP.y);
    if (idx === -1)             { this.onOtherClick(); return; }
    if (idx !== null && idx >= 0) {
      const e = this.displayEntries[idx];
      if (this.selectedIndex === idx && !e?.isDir) {
        this.clearSelection();
        return;
      }
      if (e?.isDir) {
        if (this.selectedIndex === idx) {
          this.drillDown.emit(e);
        } else {
          this.selectSlice(idx, false);
        }
        return;
      }
      this.selectSlice(idx, true);
    }
  }

  selectSlice(i: number, activate: boolean = false): void {
    this.selectedIndex = i;
    this.selectedKey = this.displayEntries[i]?.path ?? null;
    this.triggerBarAnimation();
    const e = this.displayEntries[i];
    if (e) {
      this.select.emit(e);
      if (activate) {
        this.activate.emit(e);
      }
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  clearSelection(): void {
    this.selectedIndex = null;
    this.selectedKey = null;
    this.animatedBarPct = 100;
    this.barTransition = 'none';
    this.select.emit(null);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private selectOtherBucket(): void {
    this.selectedIndex = -1;
    this.selectedKey = OTHER_BUCKET_SELECTION_KEY;
    this.triggerBarAnimation();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onOtherClick(): void {
    if (!this.otherEntries.length) return;
    if (this.selectedIndex === -1) {
      this.otherDrill.emit(this.otherEntries);
      return;
    }
    this.selectOtherBucket();
  }

  onLegendClick(e: DiskUsageEntry, index: number): void {
    if (this.selectedIndex === index) {
      if (e.isDir) {
        this.drillDown.emit(e);
      }
    } else {
      this.selectSlice(index, false);
    }
  }

  // ── Private ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /**
   * Split entries into displayEntries (≥ minPct) and otherEntries (< minPct).
   * If nothing clears the threshold, show only the largest few items and bucket the rest.
   */
  private partition(): void {
    const total = this.totalSize;
    const sortedEntries = [...this.entries].sort((left, right) => right.size - left.size);

    if (!sortedEntries.length || !total) {
      this.displayEntries = sortedEntries.slice(0, PIE_DISTRIBUTION_VISIBLE_LIMIT);
      this.otherEntries   = sortedEntries.slice(PIE_DISTRIBUTION_VISIBLE_LIMIT);
      this.otherSize      = this.otherEntries.reduce((s, e) => s + e.size, 0);
      this.otherPct       = '';
      return;
    }

    const threshold = this.minPct / 100;
    const main: DiskUsageEntry[] = [];
    const rest: DiskUsageEntry[] = [];
    for (const e of sortedEntries) {
      (e.size / total >= threshold ? main : rest).push(e);
    }

    const visible = main.length > 0
      ? main
      : sortedEntries.slice(0, PIE_DISTRIBUTION_FALLBACK_VISIBLE_LIMIT);
    const leftover = main.length > 0
      ? rest
      : sortedEntries.slice(PIE_DISTRIBUTION_FALLBACK_VISIBLE_LIMIT);

    this.displayEntries = visible.slice(0, PIE_DISTRIBUTION_VISIBLE_LIMIT);
    const overflow      = visible.slice(PIE_DISTRIBUTION_VISIBLE_LIMIT);
    this.otherEntries   = [...overflow, ...leftover];

    this.otherSize = this.otherEntries.reduce((s, e) => s + e.size, 0);
    this.otherPct  = this.otherSize
      ? ((this.otherSize / total) * 100).toFixed(1) + '%'
      : '';
  }

  private applyExternalSelection(): void {
    if (!this.selectedPath) {
      this.selectedKey = null;
      this.selectedIndex = null;
      this.animatedBarPct = 100;
      this.barTransition = 'none';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const selectedIndex = this.displayEntries.findIndex((entry) => entry.path === this.selectedPath);
    if (selectedIndex === -1) {
      this.selectedKey = null;
      this.selectedIndex = null;
      this.animatedBarPct = 100;
      this.barTransition = 'none';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.selectedKey = this.selectedPath;
    this.selectedIndex = selectedIndex;
    this.triggerBarAnimation();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private reconcileSelection(): void {
    if (this.selectedPath !== null) {
      this.applyExternalSelection();
      return;
    }

    if (this.selectedKey === OTHER_BUCKET_SELECTION_KEY) {
      if (this.otherEntries.length > 0) {
        this.selectedIndex = -1;
        this.triggerBarAnimation();
      } else {
        this.selectedKey = null;
        this.selectedIndex = null;
        this.animatedBarPct = 100;
        this.barTransition = 'none';
      }
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    if (!this.selectedKey) {
      this.selectedIndex = null;
      this.animatedBarPct = 100;
      this.barTransition = 'none';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const selectedIndex = this.displayEntries.findIndex((entry) => entry.path === this.selectedKey);
    if (selectedIndex === -1) {
      this.selectedKey = null;
      this.selectedIndex = null;
      this.animatedBarPct = 100;
      this.barTransition = 'none';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.selectedIndex = selectedIndex;
    this.triggerBarAnimation();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private buildSlices(): void {
    this.slices = [];
    const drawnTotal = this.displayEntries.reduce((s, e) => s + e.size, 0) + this.otherSize;
    if (!drawnTotal) return;

    let angle = -Math.PI / 2;
    const push = (index: number, size: number, color: string) => {
      const sweep = (size / drawnTotal) * Math.PI * 2;
      const start = angle, end = angle + sweep, mid = start + sweep / 2;
      angle = end;
      this.slices.push({
        index, startAngle: start, endAngle: end, midAngle: mid,
        tx: +Math.cos(mid).toFixed(4),
        ty: +Math.sin(mid).toFixed(4),
        color,
      });
    };

    this.displayEntries.forEach((e, i) => push(i, e.size, this.getColor(i)));
    if (this.otherSize > 0) push(-1, this.otherSize, this.otherColor);
  }

  private hitTest(x: number, y: number): number | null {
    const dist = Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y);
    if (dist < this.innerR || dist > this.outerR + 8) return null;
    let a = Math.atan2(y, x);
    if (a < -Math.PI / 2) a += Math.PI * 2;
    for (const s of this.slices) {
      let sa = s.startAngle, ea = s.endAngle;
      if (sa < -Math.PI / 2) sa += Math.PI * 2;
      if (ea < -Math.PI / 2) ea += Math.PI * 2;
      if (ea < sa) ea += Math.PI * 2;
      const norm = a < sa ? a + Math.PI * 2 : a;
      if (norm >= sa && norm <= ea) return s.index;
    }
    return null;
  }

  private toSvgCoords(event: MouseEvent): { x: number; y: number } | null {
    const svg = event.currentTarget as SVGSVGElement;
    const pt  = svg.createSVGPoint();
    pt.x = event.clientX; pt.y = event.clientY;
    const inv = svg.getScreenCTM()?.inverse();
    if (!inv) return null;
    const r = pt.matrixTransform(inv);
    return { x: r.x, y: r.y };
  }

  private triggerBarAnimation(): void {
    if (this.isTraversing) {
      this.barTransition = 'none';
      if (this.selectedIndex === -1 && this.totalSize) {
        this.animatedBarPct = (this.otherSize / this.totalSize) * 100;
      } else if (this.selectedIndex !== null && this.totalSize) {
        this.animatedBarPct = (this.displayEntries[this.selectedIndex].size / this.totalSize) * 100;
      } else {
        this.animatedBarPct = 0;
      }
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.barTransition = 'none'; this.animatedBarPct = 0;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (this.destroyed) return;
      this.barTransition = 'width 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)';
      if (this.selectedIndex === -1 && this.totalSize) {
        this.animatedBarPct = (this.otherSize / this.totalSize) * 100;
      } else if (this.selectedIndex !== null && this.totalSize) {
        this.animatedBarPct = (this.displayEntries[this.selectedIndex].size / this.totalSize) * 100;
      }
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
  }
}
````

````typescript
// dropdown-container.component.ts
import { Component, Input, Output, EventEmitter, ViewChild, ContentChild, ElementRef, OnChanges, SimpleChanges, AfterViewInit, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { DropdownDirective, DropdownTriggerDirective, DropdownMenuDirective } from '../directives/dropdown.directive';
import { NativeOverlayFreezeService } from '../services/native-overlay-freeze.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-dropdown-container',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, DropdownDirective],
  template: `
    <div 
      class="dropdown-wrapper" 
      [appDropdown]="isOpen" 
      (isOpenChange)="onToggle($event)"
      #dropdownRef="appDropdown"
    >
      <!-- Trigger slot — always rendered, never inside *ngIf -->
      <ng-content select="[appDropdownTrigger]"></ng-content>

      <!-- Backdrop - captures clicks outside the menu -->
      <div 
        *ngIf="isOpen" 
        class="dropdown-backdrop" 
        (click)="onBackdropClick($event)"
        aria-hidden="true">
      </div>

      <!-- Menu content wrapper - stops click propagation -->
      <div 
        *ngIf="isOpen" 
        class="dropdown-menu-wrapper"
        appDropdownMenu
        tabindex="-1"
        (click)="$event.stopPropagation()">
        <ng-content></ng-content>
      </div>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: [`
    .dropdown-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .dropdown-backdrop {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
      background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
      z-index: calc(var(--vsc-z-dropdown) - 1);
      cursor: default;
    }

    .dropdown-menu-wrapper {
      position: fixed;
      z-index: var(--vsc-z-dropdown);
      animation: dropdown-appear 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    @keyframes dropdown-appear {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px) scale(0.98); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0)   scale(1); }
    }
  `]
})
export class DropdownContainerComponent implements AfterViewInit, OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input() isOpen = false;
  /** Fallback anchor for when the trigger element is outside the container (e.g. right-click menus). */
  @Input() anchorEl: HTMLElement | null = null;
  @Output() isOpenChange = new EventEmitter<boolean>();

  @ViewChild('dropdownRef', { static: true }) dropdownRef?: DropdownDirective;
  @ContentChild(DropdownTriggerDirective, { static: false }) triggerDir?: DropdownTriggerDirective;
  private readonly overlayFreezeKey = `dropdown:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
  private overlayFreezeHeld = false;

  constructor(
    private _el: ElementRef<HTMLElement>,
    private overlayFreeze: NativeOverlayFreezeService,
  ) {}

  onToggle(state: boolean) {
    this.isOpen = state;
    this.isOpenChange.emit(state);
    this.syncOverlayFreeze();
  }

  onBackdropClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.close();
  }

  close() {
    this.isOpen = false;
    this.isOpenChange.emit(false);
    this.syncOverlayFreeze();
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {}

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['isOpen']) {
      this.syncOverlayFreeze();
    }
    if (changes['isOpen']?.currentValue === true) {
      // Use requestAnimationFrame to ensure DOM is ready
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        setTimeout(() => {
          this.positionMenu();
          this.focusMenu();
        }, 0);
      });
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    if (!this.overlayFreezeHeld) {
      return;
    }
    this.overlayFreeze.release(this.overlayFreezeKey);
    this.overlayFreezeHeld = false;
  }

  private focusMenu(): void {
    if (!this.isOpen) return;
    const wrapperEl = this._el.nativeElement.querySelector('.dropdown-menu-wrapper') as HTMLElement | null;
    const focusTarget = wrapperEl?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
      '.ab-quick-access-drop, [role="menu"], [role="dialog"], [role="listbox"]'
    ) ?? wrapperEl;
    focusTarget?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  private positionMenu(): void {
    if (!this.isOpen) return;
    const anchor = (this.triggerDir?.el.nativeElement ?? this.anchorEl) as HTMLElement | null;
    if (!anchor) return;
    const wrapperEl = this._el.nativeElement.querySelector('.dropdown-menu-wrapper') as HTMLElement | null;
    if (!wrapperEl) return;
    const rect  = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
    const menuW = wrapperEl.offsetWidth  || 200;
    const menuH = wrapperEl.offsetHeight || 100;
    const vw = window.innerWidth;
    const vh = window.innerHeight;
    let left = rect.left;
    let top  = rect.bottom + 4;
    if (left + menuW > vw) left = Math.max(0, vw - menuW - 8);
    if (top  + menuH > vh) top  = Math.max(0, rect.top - menuH - 4);
    if (left < 0) left = 8;
    wrapperEl.style.position = 'fixed';
    wrapperEl.style.left     = `${Math.round(left)}px`;
    wrapperEl.style.top      = `${Math.round(top)}px`;
    wrapperEl.style.zIndex   = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement)
      .getPropertyValue('--vsc-z-dropdown')
      .trim() || '1000';
  }

  private syncOverlayFreeze(): void {
    if (this.isOpen) {
      if (!this.overlayFreezeHeld) {
        this.overlayFreeze.acquire(this.overlayFreezeKey);
        this.overlayFreezeHeld = true;
      }
      return;
    }

    if (!this.overlayFreezeHeld) {
      return;
    }
    this.overlayFreeze.release(this.overlayFreezeKey);
    this.overlayFreezeHeld = false;
  }
}
````

````typescript
// elevation-status-pill.component.ts
// Status-bar pill that surfaces the persistent elevated service session.
// Shows whether the helper process is: not started, starting, active, or failed.
// Clicking the pill starts or stops the session.
import {
  Component,
  OnInit,
  OnDestroy,
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
  ChangeDetectorRef,
  Input,
  signal,
  computed,
} from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { EventsOn, EventsOff } from 'wailsjs/runtime';
import { ApiService, ElevatedSessionStatus } from '../services/api.service';

type PillState = 'idle' | 'starting' | 'active' | 'stopping' | 'error';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-elevation-status-pill',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <div class="elev-pill-host">
      <!-- Only render when there is something worth showing -->
      <button
        class="elev-pill"
        [class.idle]="pillState() === 'idle'"
        [class.starting]="pillState() === 'starting'"
        [class.active]="pillState() === 'active'"
        [class.stopping]="pillState() === 'stopping'"
        [class.error]="pillState() === 'error'"
        [class.flash-ok]="flashOk()"
        [class.flash-err]="flashErr()"
        [class.blink-op]="blinkOp() && pillState() === 'active'"
        [disabled]="monitorOnly || pillState() === 'starting' || pillState() === 'stopping'"
        (click)="onClick()"
        [title]="tooltip()"
      >
        <!-- Shield icon -->
        <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="13" height="13"
             stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" fill="none"
             stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
          <path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z"/>
        </svg>

        <span class="label">{{ label() }}</span>

        <!-- Op-count badge, visible only when active -->
        <span class="badge" *ngIf="pillState() === 'active' && opCount() > 0">
          {{ opCount() }}
        </span>

        <!-- Spinner while starting / stopping -->
        <span class="spinner" *ngIf="pillState() === 'starting' || pillState() === 'stopping'"></span>
      </button>

  `,

export class ElevationStatusPillComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @Input() monitorOnly = false;
  // Reactive state (Angular signals)
  private _state = signal<PillState>('idle');
  private _opCount = signal(0);
  private _errorMsg = signal('');
  private _flashOk = signal(false);
  private _flashErr = signal(false);
  private _blinkOp  = signal(false);

  readonly pillState = computed(() => this._state());
  readonly opCount   = computed(() => this._opCount());
  readonly flashOk   = computed(() => this._flashOk());
  readonly flashErr  = computed(() => this._flashErr());
  readonly blinkOp   = computed(() => this._blinkOp());

  readonly label = computed(() => {
    switch (this._state()) {
      case 'starting':  return 'Starting...';
      case 'stopping':  return 'Stopping...';
      case 'active':    return 'Elevated';
      case 'error':     return 'Elev. Error';
      default:          return 'Elevate';
    }
  });

  readonly tooltip = computed(() => {
    switch (this._state()) {
      case 'active':
        return this.monitorOnly
          ? `Elevated session active (${this._opCount()} ops dispatched).`
          : `Elevated session active (${this._opCount()} ops dispatched). Click to stop.`;
      case 'error':
        return this.monitorOnly
          ? `Elevated session error: ${this._errorMsg()}.`
          : `Elevated session error: ${this._errorMsg()}. Click to retry.`;
      case 'starting':
        return 'Starting elevated session...';
      case 'stopping':
        return 'Stopping elevated session...';
      default:
        return this.monitorOnly ? 'Monitors hidden elevated helper activity.' : 'Start an elevated service session (one UAC/sudo prompt, then reuse).';
    }
  });

  constructor(private api: ApiService, private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef) {}

  // Lifecycle

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // Sync initial state from backend safely, in case the Wails runtime
    // hasn't registered the method yet (stale bindings before wails dev restart).
    this.api.getElevatedSessionStatus()
      .then(s => { this.applyStatus(s); this.cdr.markForCheck(); })
      .catch(() => { /* method not yet available in runtime - ignore */ });

    // Backend events
    EventsOn('elevation:uac-requested', () => {
      this._errorMsg.set('');
      this._state.set('starting');
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
    EventsOn('elevation:session-starting', () => {
      // Auto-start triggered by a permission-denied operation; show UAC is pending.
      this._errorMsg.set('');
      this._state.set('starting');
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
    EventsOn('elevation:session-started', (status: ElevatedSessionStatus) => {
      this.applyStatus(status);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
    EventsOn('elevation:session-stopped', () => {
      this._state.set('idle');
      this._opCount.set(0);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
    EventsOn('elevation:auto-started', () => {
      this._opCount.update(n => n + 1);
      if (this._state() !== 'active') {
        this._state.set('idle');
        this.triggerFlash('ok');
      }
      this.triggerBlinkOp();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
    EventsOn('elevation:auto-failed', (ev: { error?: string }) => {
      this._errorMsg.set(ev?.error ?? 'Unknown error');
      this._state.set('error');
      this.triggerFlash('err');
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    EventsOff(
      'elevation:uac-requested',
      'elevation:session-starting',
      'elevation:session-started',
      'elevation:session-stopped',
      'elevation:auto-started',
      'elevation:auto-failed',
    );
  }

  // User interaction

  async toggle(): Promise<void> {
    const current = this._state();

    if (current === 'active') {
      this._state.set('stopping');
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      await this.api.stopElevatedSession().catch(() => {});
      this._state.set('idle');
      this._opCount.set(0);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    // idle / error -> start session
    this._state.set('starting');
    this._errorMsg.set('');
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    try {
      const status = await this.api.startElevatedSession();
      this.applyStatus(status);
    } catch (err: any) {
      this._state.set('error');
      this._errorMsg.set(err?.message ?? String(err));
      this.triggerFlash('err');
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onClick(): void {
    if (this.monitorOnly) return;
    void this.toggle();
  }

  // Helpers

  private applyStatus(s: ElevatedSessionStatus): void {
    if (!s) {
      this._state.set('idle');
      return;
    }
    this._opCount.set(s.opCount ?? 0);
    if (s.active) {
      this._state.set('active');
      this._errorMsg.set('');
    } else if (s.error) {
      this._state.set('error');
      this._errorMsg.set(s.error);
    } else {
      this._state.set('idle');
    }
  }

  private triggerBlinkOp(): void {
    this._blinkOp.set(false);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    // force reflow so animation restarts
    setTimeout(() => {
      this._blinkOp.set(true);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      // 3 cycles x 300ms = 900ms
      setTimeout(() => { this._blinkOp.set(false); this.cdr.markForCheck(); }, 950);
    }, 16);
  }

  private triggerFlash(kind: 'ok' | 'err'): void {
    if (kind === 'ok') {
      this._flashOk.set(true);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      setTimeout(() => { this._flashOk.set(false); this.cdr.markForCheck(); }, 450);
    } else {
      this._flashErr.set(true);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      setTimeout(() => { this._flashErr.set(false); this.cdr.markForCheck(); }, 550);
    }
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { ApiService } from '../services/api.service';

export class FileBrowserPathHelper {
  constructor(private readonly apiService: ApiService) {}

  async buildDestinationPath(sourcePath: string, targetDir: string): Promise<string> {
    const fileName = await this.getFileName(sourcePath);
    return await this.apiService.joinPaths([targetDir, fileName]);
  }

  private async getFileName(path: string): Promise<string> {
    try {
      const splitResult = await this.apiService.splitPath(path);
      if (splitResult.base) {
        return splitResult.base;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('Error splitting path via API, falling back to manual split:', error);
    }

    const normalized = path.replace(/\\/g, '/');
    const parts = normalized.split('/').filter(part => part.length > 0);
    return parts.length > 0 ? parts[parts.length - 1] : 'file';
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { WorkspaceService } from '../services/workspace.service';
import type { TabInfo, ViewerFileListItem } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import type { FilePaneBrowserCommands } from './file-pane-browser-commands.factory';
import type { ViewerArchiveContext } from '../viewers/viewer-archive-context';

export interface FileBrowserPreviewPane {
  currentTabId: string;
  currentPath: string;
  browserCommands: Pick<FilePaneBrowserCommands, 'preview'>;
}

interface FileBrowserPreviewRequest {
	path: string;
	fileList: ViewerFileListItem[];
	archiveContext: ViewerArchiveContext | null;
}

export interface FileBrowserPreviewHost {
  workspaceService: WorkspaceService;
  getActivePaneId(): 'left' | 'right';
  setActivePaneId(paneId: 'left' | 'right'): void;
  getActivePane(): FileBrowserPreviewPane | undefined;
  getLeftPane(): FileBrowserPreviewPane | undefined;
  getRightPane(): FileBrowserPreviewPane | undefined;
}

export class FileBrowserPreviewController {
  private lastCrossPreviewTarget: string | null = null;
  private lastPreviewTabFocus: string | null = null;
  private restoringFromPreview = false;

  async openFrozenPreviewInOtherPane(host: FileBrowserPreviewHost): Promise<void> {
    const fromPane = host.getActivePane();
    if (!fromPane) {
      return;
    }

    const request = fromPane.browserCommands.preview.getTargetRequest() as FileBrowserPreviewRequest | null;
    if (!request?.path) {
      return;
    }

    const toPaneId: 'left' | 'right' = host.getActivePaneId() === 'left' ? 'right' : 'left';
    const toPane = toPaneId === 'left' ? host.getLeftPane() : host.getRightPane();
    if (!toPane) {
      return;
    }

    await toPane.browserCommands.preview.openFrozenPreviewTab(request.path, {
      sourcePane: host.getActivePaneId(),
      sourceTabId: fromPane.currentTabId,
      sourceDir: fromPane.currentPath,
      autoFollow: true,
      fileList: request.fileList,
      archiveContext: request.archiveContext,
    });
  }

  switchActivePane(host: FileBrowserPreviewHost): void {
    host.setActivePaneId(host.getActivePaneId() === 'left' ? 'right' : 'left');
  }

  onPanePreviewTarget(host: FileBrowserPreviewHost, fromPane: 'left' | 'right', targetPath: string): void {
    if (fromPane !== host.getActivePaneId()) {
      return;
    }

    const otherPane: 'left' | 'right' = fromPane === 'left' ? 'right' : 'left';
    const next = targetPath || '';

    const sourcePane = fromPane === 'left' ? host.getLeftPane() : host.getRightPane();
    const sourceTabId = sourcePane?.currentTabId ?? '';
    const sourceDir = sourcePane?.currentPath ?? '';
    const fileList = this.getSourceFileList(sourcePane, next);

    // If the active tab in the same pane is a viewer and set to auto-follow,
    // update it directly so the viewer reloads when the cursor moves.
    const sameActive = host.workspaceService.getActiveTab(fromPane);
    const sameSourceTabId = sourcePane?.currentTabId ?? '';
    const sameDedupeKey = `${fromPane}:${next}:${fromPane}:${sameSourceTabId}`;
    if (sameActive && (sameActive.kind ?? 'dir') === 'viewer' && sameActive.viewer?.autoFollow) {
      if (this.lastCrossPreviewTarget === sameDedupeKey) return;
      this.lastCrossPreviewTarget = sameDedupeKey;

      host.workspaceService.updateViewerTabTargetPath(fromPane, sameActive.id, next, {
        sourcePane: fromPane,
        sourceTabId: sameSourceTabId,
        sourceDir,
        fileList,
      });
      return;
    }

    const dedupeKey = `${otherPane}:${next}:${fromPane}:${sourceTabId}`;
    if (this.lastCrossPreviewTarget === dedupeKey) {
      return;
    }
    this.lastCrossPreviewTarget = dedupeKey;

    const active = host.workspaceService.getActiveTab(otherPane);
    if (!active || (active.kind ?? 'dir') !== 'viewer' || !active.viewer?.autoFollow) {
      return;
    }

    host.workspaceService.updateViewerTabTargetPath(otherPane, active.id, next, {
      sourcePane: fromPane,
      sourceTabId,
      sourceDir,
      fileList,
    });
  }

  private getSourceFileList(sourcePane: FileBrowserPreviewPane | undefined, targetPath: string): ViewerFileListItem[] {
    if (!sourcePane || !targetPath) {
      return [];
    }
    const request = sourcePane.browserCommands.preview.getTargetRequest() as FileBrowserPreviewRequest | null;
    if (!request?.path || request.path !== targetPath) {
      return [];
    }
    return request.fileList ?? [];
  }

  onPaneActiveTabChanged(host: FileBrowserPreviewHost, fromPane: 'left' | 'right', tab: TabInfo): void {
    if (!tab || (tab.kind ?? 'dir') !== 'viewer') {
      return;
    }

    const target = tab.viewer?.targetPath ?? '';
    if (!target) {
      return;
    }

    const sourcePane = tab.viewer?.sourcePane;
    const sourceTabId = tab.viewer?.sourceTabId;

    if (sourcePane && sourceTabId) {
      const key = `${sourcePane}:${sourceTabId}:${target}`;
      if (this.lastPreviewTabFocus === key) {
        return;
      }
      this.lastPreviewTabFocus = key;

      const pane = sourcePane === 'left' ? host.getLeftPane() : host.getRightPane();
      if (!pane || this.restoringFromPreview) {
        return;
      }

      this.restoringFromPreview = true;
      pane.browserCommands.preview.activateDirTabAndFocusPath(sourceTabId, target).finally(() => {
        this.restoringFromPreview = false;
      });
      return;
    }

    const otherPane: 'left' | 'right' = fromPane === 'left' ? 'right' : 'left';
    const key = `${otherPane}:${target}`;
    if (this.lastPreviewTabFocus === key) {
      return;
    }
    this.lastPreviewTabFocus = key;

    const pane = otherPane === 'left' ? host.getLeftPane() : host.getRightPane();
    pane?.browserCommands.preview.focusCursorPath(target);
  }
}
````

## File: frontend/src/app/components/file-browser-runtime.controller.ts
````typescript
import { EventsOff, EventsOn, OnFileDrop, OnFileDropOff } from 'wailsjs/runtime';
import type { ApiService } from '../services/api.service';
import type { ConfirmDialogService } from '../services/confirm-dialog.service';

export interface FileBrowserRuntimeHost {
  apiService: ApiService;
  confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService;
  getElevationActive(): boolean;
  getElevationBusy(): boolean;
  setElevationActive(active: boolean): void;
  setElevationBusy(busy: boolean): void;
  handleNativeFileDrop(x: number, y: number, paths: string[]): Promise<void>;
}

export class FileBrowserRuntimeController {
  async initialize(host: FileBrowserRuntimeHost): Promise<void> {
    await this.checkServerConnection(host);
    await this.syncElevationState(host);

    EventsOn('elevation:uac-requested', () => {
      host.setElevationBusy(true);
    });
    EventsOn('elevation:session-starting', () => {
      host.setElevationBusy(true);
    });
    EventsOn('elevation:session-started', () => {
      host.setElevationActive(true);
      host.setElevationBusy(false);
    });
    EventsOn('elevation:session-stopped', () => {
      host.setElevationActive(false);
      host.setElevationBusy(false);
    });
    EventsOn('elevation:auto-started', () => {
      host.setElevationBusy(false);
    });
    EventsOn('elevation:auto-failed', () => {
      host.setElevationBusy(false);
    });

    OnFileDrop((x: number, y: number, paths: string[]) => {
      console.log('[FileBrowser] 🎯🎯🎯 wails:file-drop received! x:', x, 'y:', y, 'paths:', paths);
      void host.handleNativeFileDrop(x, y, paths);
    }, false);
  }

  dispose(): void {
    EventsOff('elevation:uac-requested', 'elevation:session-starting', 'elevation:session-started', 'elevation:session-stopped', 'elevation:auto-started', 'elevation:auto-failed');
    OnFileDropOff();
  }

  async toggleElevation(host: FileBrowserRuntimeHost): Promise<void> {
    if (host.getElevationBusy()) {
      return;
    }

    host.setElevationBusy(true);
    try {
      if (host.getElevationActive()) {
        await host.apiService.stopElevatedSession();
        host.setElevationActive(false);
        return;
      }

      const status = await host.apiService.startElevatedSession();
      host.setElevationActive(!!status?.active);
    } catch (error: any) {
      console.error('Elevation toggle failed:', error);
      host.confirmDialog.alert(`Elevation Error\n${error?.message ?? String(error)}`);
    } finally {
      host.setElevationBusy(false);
    }
  }

  private async checkServerConnection(host: FileBrowserRuntimeHost): Promise<void> {
    const isHealthy = await host.apiService.checkHealth();
    if (!isHealthy) {
      console.error('Cannot connect to server');
    }
  }

  private async syncElevationState(host: FileBrowserRuntimeHost): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const status = await host.apiService.getElevatedSessionStatus();
      host.setElevationActive(!!status?.active);
    } catch {
      host.setElevationActive(false);
    } finally {
      host.setElevationBusy(false);
    }
  }
}
````

````typescript
export type FileMimeColorKind =

  | 'video'
  | 'fonts'
  | 'markdown'
  | 'scripts'
  | '3d'
  | 'design';

const EXECUTABLE_EXT_SET = new Set([
  'apk', 'appimage', 'bat', 'cmd', 'com', 'dll', 'exe', 'jar', 'msi', 'scr',
]);

function getNormalizedExtension(name: string | null | undefined): string {
  const value = (name ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const lastDot = value.lastIndexOf('.');
  return lastDot >= 0 ? value.slice(lastDot + 1) : '';
}

function getCategoryFromExtension(name: string | null | undefined): FileMimeColorKind | null {
  const ext = getNormalizedExtension(name);
  if (!ext) return null;
  if (EXECUTABLE_EXT_SET.has(ext)) return 'executable';
  return (getPrimaryFileCategoryForExtension(ext)?.id as FileMimeColorKind | undefined) ?? null;
}

export function getResolvedCategory(entry: FileInfo, resolvedCategoryId?: string | null): FileMimeColorKind | null {
  if (resolvedCategoryId) {
    return resolvedCategoryId as FileMimeColorKind;
  }

  const extKind = getCategoryFromExtension(entry.name);
  return extKind;
}

export function getFileMimeColorKind(entry: FileInfo, colorizeByMime: boolean, resolvedCategoryId?: string | null): FileMimeColorKind {
  if (!entry) return 'default';
  if (!colorizeByMime) return 'default';
  if (entry.type === FileType.SYMLINK || entry.isSymlink) return 'symlink';
  if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) return 'directory';
  if (entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE) return 'archive';

  const kind = getResolvedCategory(entry, resolvedCategoryId);
  if (kind) return kind;

  return 'default';
}
````

````typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, ChangeDetectorRef, Component, EventEmitter, Input, OnChanges, OnDestroy, Output, SimpleChanges } from '@angular/core';

/** Smart truncate file names while preserving extension. */
function truncateFileName(name: string, maxLength: number): string {
  if (!name || name.length <= maxLength) {
    return name;
  }

  // Find the last dot to separate name from extension
  const lastDotIndex = name.lastIndexOf('.');
  const hasExtension = lastDotIndex > 0 && lastDotIndex < name.length - 1;

  if (!hasExtension || lastDotIndex < 3) {
    // No extension or very short base name, just truncate at end
    return name.slice(0, Math.max(1, maxLength - 1)) + '…';
  }

  const baseName = name.slice(0, lastDotIndex);
  const extension = name.slice(lastDotIndex);
  const maxBaseLength = Math.max(1, maxLength - extension.length - 1); // -1 for ellipsis

  if (maxBaseLength < 3) {
    // Not enough space to show meaningful base + extension
    return name.slice(0, maxLength - 1) + '…';
  }

  // Truncate base name and add ellipsis in the middle to hint at full length
  const keep = Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxBaseLength / 2) - 1);
  return baseName.slice(0, keep) + '…' + extension;
}

  @Output() navigate = new EventEmitter<void>();

    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,

  ngOnChanges(_changes: SimpleChanges): void {

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.unwatchResolvedCategory?.();

    return getFileEntryPresentation(this.entry, this.colorizeByMime, this.resolvedCategoryId ?? null).isParent;
  }

  get isSymlink(): boolean {
    return getFileEntryPresentation(this.entry, this.colorizeByMime, this.resolvedCategoryId ?? null).isSymlink;
  }

  get displayName(): string {
    const fullName = this.displayNameOverride?.trim() || this.entry?.name || '';
    if (fullName && !this.isParent) {
      return truncateFileName(fullName, 70); // Inline variant allows more space
    }
    return fullName;
  }

  get fullName(): string {
    return this.displayNameOverride?.trim() || this.entry?.name || '';
  }

  get mimeColorKind(): string {
    return getFileEntryPresentation(this.entry, this.colorizeByMime, this.resolvedCategoryId ?? null).mimeColorKind;
  }

  get showDirectorySizeSpinner(): boolean {
    return this.directorySizePending && !this.isParent && this.entry?.type === FileType.DIRECTORY;
  }

  get iconEmoji(): string {
    return getFileEntryPresentation(this.entry, this.colorizeByMime, this.resolvedCategoryId ?? null).iconEmoji;
  }

  private bindResolvedCategory(): void {
    this.unwatchResolvedCategory?.();
    this.unwatchResolvedCategory = null;
    this.resolvedCategoryId = undefined;

    const path = this.entry?.path;
    if (!path || !this.colorizeByMime) return;

    this.resolvedCategoryId = this.categoryResolver.getResolvedCategory(path);
    this.unwatchResolvedCategory = this.categoryResolver.watch(path, () => {
      this.resolvedCategoryId = this.categoryResolver.getResolvedCategory(path);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
    this.categoryResolver.ensureResolved(this.entry);
  }
````

````typescript
import { FileType, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { getFileMimeColorKind, type FileMimeColorKind } from './file-entry-color.util';
import { FILE_CATEGORY_BY_ID, getPrimaryFileCategoryForExtension } from '../shared/file-categories';

export interface FileEntryPresentation {
  iconEmoji: string;
  mimeColorKind: FileMimeColorKind;
  isSymlink: boolean;
  isParent: boolean;
}

const presentationCache = new Map<string, FileEntryPresentation>();

export function getFileEntryPresentation(
  entry: FileInfo | undefined,
  colorizeByMime: boolean,
  resolvedCategoryId?: string | null,
): FileEntryPresentation {
  if (!entry) {
    return {
      iconEmoji: '📄',
      mimeColorKind: 'default',
      isSymlink: false,
      isParent: false,
    };
  }

  const isParent = entry.path === '__parent__';
  const isSymlink = entry.type === FileType.SYMLINK || !!entry.isSymlink;
  const cacheKey = [
    colorizeByMime ? '1' : '0',
    isParent ? '1' : '0',
    isSymlink ? '1' : '0',
    entry.type,
    entry.name ?? '',
    resolvedCategoryId ?? '',
    entry.registryKind ?? '',
    entry.path.startsWith('registry://') ? 'registry' : '',
    entry.path === 'registry://' ? 'root' : '',
  ].join('|');

  const cached = presentationCache.get(cacheKey);
  if (cached) return cached;

  const presentation: FileEntryPresentation = {
    iconEmoji: resolveIconEmoji(entry, isParent, resolvedCategoryId),
    mimeColorKind: getFileMimeColorKind(entry, colorizeByMime, resolvedCategoryId),
    isSymlink,
    isParent,
  };
  presentationCache.set(cacheKey, presentation);
  return presentation;
}

function resolveIconEmoji(entry: FileInfo, isParent: boolean, resolvedCategoryId?: string | null): string {
  if (isParent) return '📄';
  if (entry.path.startsWith('registry://')) {
    const kind = (entry.registryKind || '').toLowerCase();
    if (entry.path === 'registry://' || kind === 'registry') return '🧭';
    if (kind === 'key' || entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) return '🗂️';
    return '📝';
  }

  switch (entry.type) {
    case FileType.DIRECTORY:
      return '📁';
    case FileType.SYMLINK:
      return '📄';
    default:
      return fileIcon(entry, resolvedCategoryId);
  }
}

function extIcon(name: string): string {
  const ext = name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase();
  if (!ext) return '📄';
  const category = getPrimaryFileCategoryForExtension(ext);
  return category?.icon || '📄';
}

function fileIcon(entry: FileInfo, resolvedCategoryId?: string | null): string {
  const ext = entry.name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase();
  if (!ext) return '📄';

  if (resolvedCategoryId) {
    return FILE_CATEGORY_BY_ID.get(resolvedCategoryId)?.icon ?? extIcon(entry.name);
  }

  return extIcon(entry.name);
}
````
