````typescript
import { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { TabInfo } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import {
  ArchiveFrame,
  ArchiveService,
  buildArchiveDisplayPath,
  buildArchiveTabTitle,
  isArchive,
  parseArchivePath,
} from '../services/archive.service';
import { WorkspaceService } from '../services/workspace.service';
import { ConfirmDialogService } from '../services/confirm-dialog.service';
import type { FileViewDirectorySource } from '../services/directory-source.service';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { parentPath, normalizePath } from './address-bar.utils';

export interface FilePaneArchiveHost {
  get paneId(): 'left' | 'right';
  get currentTabId(): string;
  get currentPath(): string;
  set currentPath(value: string);
  get fsParentDir(): string;
  set fsParentDir(value: string);
  get archiveStack(): ArchiveFrame[];
  set archiveStack(value: ArchiveFrame[]);
  get entries(): FileInfo[];
  set entries(value: FileInfo[]);
  get selectedFiles(): Set<string>;
  set selectedFiles(value: Set<string>);
  get loading(): boolean;
  set loading(value: boolean);
  get error(): string | null;
  set error(value: string | null);
  get tabs(): TabInfo[];
  set tabs(value: TabInfo[]);
  get archiveMoveWarning(): boolean;
  set archiveMoveWarning(value: boolean);
  get archivePendingMoveEntries(): string[];
  set archivePendingMoveEntries(value: string[]);
  get archivePendingMoveDestDir(): string;
  set archivePendingMoveDestDir(value: string);
  archiveService: ArchiveService;
  directorySource: FileViewDirectorySource;
  workspaceService: WorkspaceService;
  confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService;
  withParentEntry(raw: FileInfo[], inArchive: boolean, fsPath: string): FileInfo[];
  applyFilter(): void;
  loadDirectory(path: string, opts?: { preserveUI?: boolean; focusPath?: string }): Promise<void>;
  clearArchiveState(): void;
  focusTreeNode(path: string): void;
}

export class FilePaneArchiveController {
  isInArchive(host: FilePaneArchiveHost): boolean {
    return host.archiveStack?.length > 0;
  }

  async restoreArchiveFromPath(host: FilePaneArchiveHost, path: string): Promise<void> {
    host.loading = true;
    host.error = null;
    try {
      const { fsPath, nestedChain, innerPath } = parseArchivePath(path);
      host.fsParentDir = parentPath(normalizePath(fsPath));

      let frame = await host.directorySource.getArchiveFrame(fsPath);
      const stack: ArchiveFrame[] = [frame];

      for (let index = 0; index < nestedChain.length; index += 1) {
        frame = await host.directorySource.openNestedArchive(frame, nestedChain.slice(0, index + 1));
        stack.push(frame);
      }

      if (innerPath) {
        frame = await host.directorySource.navigateArchive(frame, innerPath);
        stack[stack.length - 1] = frame;
      }

      host.archiveStack = stack;
      this.renderArchiveFrame(host, stack[stack.length - 1]);
      setTimeout(() => host.focusTreeNode(host.currentPath), 0);
    } catch (err: any) {
      host.error = err.message || 'Failed to restore archive tab';
    } finally {
      host.loading = false;
    }
  }

  async onArchiveSegmentClick(host: FilePaneArchiveHost, virtualPath: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.isInArchive(host)) {
      host.currentPath = virtualPath;
      host.clearArchiveState();
      await this.restoreArchiveFromPath(host, virtualPath);
      return;
    }

    const fsNorm = (host.archiveStack[0]?.fsPath ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
    const vNorm = virtualPath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
    const afterFs = vNorm.startsWith(fsNorm) ? vNorm.slice(fsNorm.length).replace(/^\//, '') : '';

    if (!afterFs) {
      const rootFrame = host.archiveStack[0];
      host.loading = true;
      try {
        const frame = await host.directorySource.navigateArchive(rootFrame, '');
        host.archiveStack = [{ ...frame, innerPath: '' }];
        this.renderArchiveFrame(host, { ...frame, innerPath: '' });
      } catch (err: any) {
        host.error = err.message;
      } finally {
        host.loading = false;
      }
      return;
    }

    const parts = afterFs.split('/').filter(Boolean);
    host.loading = true;
    try {
      let frame = await host.directorySource.navigateArchive(host.archiveStack[0], '');
      let stack: ArchiveFrame[] = [{ ...frame, innerPath: '' }];

      for (const part of parts) {
        const isNested = frame.listing.entries.some(
          entry => entry.name === part && (entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE || isArchive(entry.name)),
        );
        if (isNested) {
          const nestedChain = [...frame.nestedChain, part];
          frame = await host.directorySource.openNestedArchive(frame, nestedChain);
          stack.push(frame);
        } else {
          const innerPath = frame.innerPath ? `${frame.innerPath}/${part}` : part;
          frame = await host.directorySource.navigateArchive(stack[stack.length - 1], innerPath);
          stack = [...stack.slice(0, -1), frame];
        }
      }

      host.archiveStack = stack;
      this.renderArchiveFrame(host, stack[stack.length - 1]);
    } catch (err: any) {
      host.error = err.message || 'Failed to navigate to archive segment';
    } finally {
      host.loading = false;
    }
  }

  async openRootArchive(host: FilePaneArchiveHost, fsPath: string): Promise<void> {
    host.loading = true;
    host.error = null;
    const exitPath = host.currentPath;
    try {
      const frame = await host.directorySource.getArchiveFrame(fsPath);
      host.archiveStack = [frame];
      host.fsParentDir = exitPath;
      this.renderArchiveFrame(host, frame);
    } catch (err: any) {
      host.error = err.message || 'Failed to open archive';
    } finally {
      host.loading = false;
    }
  }

  async archiveNavigateInto(host: FilePaneArchiveHost, folderInnerPath: string): Promise<void> {
    const currentFrame = host.archiveStack[host.archiveStack.length - 1];
    host.loading = true;
    host.error = null;
    try {
      const newFrame = await host.directorySource.navigateArchive(currentFrame, folderInnerPath);
      host.archiveStack = [...host.archiveStack.slice(0, -1), newFrame];
      this.renderArchiveFrame(host, newFrame);
    } catch (err: any) {
      host.error = err.message || 'Failed to navigate into folder';
    } finally {
      host.loading = false;
    }
  }

  async openNestedArchive(host: FilePaneArchiveHost, nestedChain: string[]): Promise<void> {
    const currentFrame = host.archiveStack[host.archiveStack.length - 1];
    host.loading = true;
    host.error = null;
    try {
      const newFrame = await host.directorySource.openNestedArchive(currentFrame, nestedChain);
      host.archiveStack = [...host.archiveStack, newFrame];
      this.renderArchiveFrame(host, newFrame);
    } catch (err: any) {
      host.error = err.message || 'Failed to open nested archive';
    } finally {
      host.loading = false;
    }
  }

  async navigateArchiveUp(host: FilePaneArchiveHost): Promise<void> {
    const currentFrame = host.archiveStack[host.archiveStack.length - 1];
    host.loading = true;
    host.error = null;
    try {
      const parentFrame = await host.directorySource.navigateArchiveUp(currentFrame);
      if (parentFrame !== null) {
        host.archiveStack = [...host.archiveStack.slice(0, -1), parentFrame];
        this.renderArchiveFrame(host, parentFrame);
        return;
      }

      const poppedStack = host.archiveStack.slice(0, -1);
      if (poppedStack.length === 0) {
        const exitPath = host.fsParentDir || host.currentPath;
        const archivePath = host.archiveStack[0]?.fsPath ?? '';
        host.clearArchiveState();
        await host.loadDirectory(exitPath, { focusPath: archivePath });
        return;
      }

      host.archiveStack = poppedStack;
      this.renderArchiveFrame(host, poppedStack[poppedStack.length - 1]);
    } catch (err: any) {
      host.error = err.message || 'Failed to navigate up';
    } finally {
      host.loading = false;
    }
  }

  exitArchive(host: FilePaneArchiveHost): void {
    if (this.isInArchive(host) && host.currentTabId) {
      host.workspaceService.saveArchiveState(host.paneId, host.currentTabId, {
        path: host.currentPath,
        archiveStack: host.archiveStack,
        fsDirPath: host.archiveStack[0]?.fsPath ?? '',
        fsParentDir: host.fsParentDir,
      });
    }
    host.archiveStack = [];
  }

  async refreshArchive(host: FilePaneArchiveHost): Promise<void> {
    const frame = host.archiveStack[host.archiveStack.length - 1];
    host.loading = true;
    host.error = null;
    try {
      const refreshed = await host.directorySource.refreshArchive(frame);
      host.archiveStack = [...host.archiveStack.slice(0, -1), refreshed];
      this.renderArchiveFrame(host, refreshed);
    } catch (err: any) {
      host.error = err.message || 'Failed to refresh archive';
    } finally {
      host.loading = false;
    }
  }

  renderArchiveFrame(host: FilePaneArchiveHost, frame: ArchiveFrame): void {
    const rawEntries = host.directorySource.archiveListingToFileInfos(frame.listing);
    host.entries = host.withParentEntry(rawEntries, true, '');
    host.selectedFiles = new Set<string>();
    host.applyFilter();

    const fsPath = host.archiveStack[0]?.fsPath ?? '';
    const virtualPath = buildArchiveDisplayPath(fsPath, host.archiveStack);
    host.currentPath = virtualPath;

    const title = buildArchiveTabTitle(fsPath, host.archiveStack);
    host.workspaceService.updateTabPathAndTitle(host.paneId, host.currentTabId, virtualPath, title);
    host.tabs = host.workspaceService.getTabs(host.paneId);
  }

  initiatePendingMove(host: FilePaneArchiveHost, entries: string[], destDir: string): void {
    host.archivePendingMoveEntries = entries;
    host.archivePendingMoveDestDir = destDir;
    host.archiveMoveWarning = true;
  }

  async extractSelected(host: FilePaneArchiveHost, flattenPaths: boolean, destDir: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.isInArchive(host) || host.selectedFiles.size === 0) return;

    const frame = host.archiveStack[host.archiveStack.length - 1];
    const entries = Array.from(host.selectedFiles);

    try {
      const result = await host.archiveService.extractEntries(frame, entries, destDir, flattenPaths);
      if (result.failed > 0) {
        host.confirmDialog.alert(
          'Extract Failed\n' + (result.errors ?? []).map((error: any) => error.error).join('\n'),
        );
        return;
      }

      host.confirmDialog.alert(
        `Extraction Complete\n${result.succeeded} file(s) extracted to destination.`,
      );
    } catch (err: any) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert(`Extract Failed\n${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  async executePendingMove(host: FilePaneArchiveHost): Promise<void> {
    host.archiveMoveWarning = false;
    const frame = host.archiveStack[host.archiveStack.length - 1];
    const entries = host.archivePendingMoveEntries;
    const destDir = host.archivePendingMoveDestDir;
    host.archivePendingMoveEntries = [];
    host.archivePendingMoveDestDir = '';

    try {
      const result = await host.archiveService.move(frame, entries, destDir);

      if (!result.sourceRemoved) {
        const softMsg = (result.errors ?? []).find((error: any) =>
          error.error.includes('NOT removed'),
        );
        host.confirmDialog.alert(
          `Move Partially Complete\n` +
          `${result.succeeded} file(s) extracted, but source NOT removed:\n` +
          (softMsg?.error ?? 'Nested archive deletion is not supported.'),
        );
        return;
      }

      if (result.failed > 0) {
        host.confirmDialog.alert('Move Errors\n' + (result.errors ?? []).map((error: any) => error.error).join('\n'));
      }

      await this.refreshArchive(host);
    } catch (err: any) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert(`Move Failed\n${err.message}`);
    }
  }

  async deleteSelectedFromArchive(host: FilePaneArchiveHost, effective: Set<string>): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!this.isInArchive(host)) {
      return false;
    }

    const frame = host.archiveStack[host.archiveStack.length - 1];
    const entries = Array.from(effective);

    if (frame.nestedChain.length > 0) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert(
        'Nested Archive Limitation\n' +
        'Exit back to the top-level archive first.',
      );
      return true;
    }

    const archiveDeleteConfirmed = await host.confirmDialog.confirm({
      title: 'Delete from Archive',
      message:
        `Delete ${entries.length} item(s) from the archive?\n` +
        `This rewrites the archive file on disk and cannot be undone.`,
      confirmText: 'Delete',
      danger: true,
    });
    if (!archiveDeleteConfirmed) {
      return true;
    }

    try {
      const result = await host.archiveService.delete(frame, entries);
      if (result.failed > 0) {
        host.confirmDialog.alert('Delete Failed\n' + (result.errors ?? []).map((error: any) => error.error).join('\n'));
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert(`Delete Error\n${err.message}`);
      return true;
    }

    await this.refreshArchive(host);
    return true;
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { pathIdentityKey } from './address-bar.utils';
import type { TabInfo } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

export interface FilePaneFocusHost {
  get currentTabId(): string;
  get paneId(): 'left' | 'right';
  get selectionCursorPath(): string | null;
  set selectionCursorPath(value: string | null);
  get selectionAnchorPath(): string | null;
  set selectionAnchorPath(value: string | null);
  get selectedFiles(): Set<string>;
  getSelectableEntries(): Array<{ path: string }>;
  scrollToCursorPath(path: string): void;
  emitPreviewTargetFromState(): void;
  getWorkspaceTabs(): TabInfo[];
  onTabChange(tab: TabInfo): Promise<void>;
  focusAddressBar(): void;
  openFindWidget(): void;
  toggleFindWidget(): void;
  closeFindWidget(): void;
}

export class FilePaneFocusController {
  ensureCursorVisibleOnActivation(host: FilePaneFocusHost): void {
    if (host.selectedFiles.size > 0 || host.selectionCursorPath) {
      return;
    }

    const selectable = host.getSelectableEntries();
    if (!selectable.length) {
      return;
    }

    host.selectionCursorPath = selectable[0].path;
    host.selectionAnchorPath = selectable[0].path;
    host.scrollToCursorPath(selectable[0].path);
    host.emitPreviewTargetFromState();
  }

  focusCursorPath(host: FilePaneFocusHost, path: string): void {
    if (!path) return;

    const normalized = pathIdentityKey(path);
    const selectable = host.getSelectableEntries();
    const index = selectable.findIndex(entry => pathIdentityKey(entry.path) === normalized);
    if (index < 0) return;

    host.selectionCursorPath = selectable[index].path;
    host.selectionAnchorPath = host.selectionCursorPath;
    host.scrollToCursorPath(host.selectionCursorPath);
    host.emitPreviewTargetFromState();
  }

  async activateDirTabAndFocusPath(host: FilePaneFocusHost, tabId: string, focusPath: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!tabId) return;

    const tabs = host.getWorkspaceTabs();
    const tab = tabs.find(candidate => candidate.id === tabId);
    if (!tab || (tab.kind ?? 'dir') !== 'dir') {
      return;
    }

    await host.onTabChange(tab);
    this.focusCursorPath(host, focusPath);
  }

  focusAddressBar(host: FilePaneFocusHost): void {
    host.focusAddressBar();
  }

  focusFind(host: FilePaneFocusHost): void {
    host.openFindWidget();
  }

  focusFilter(host: FilePaneFocusHost): void {
    host.toggleFindWidget();
  }

  clearFilter(host: FilePaneFocusHost): void {
    host.closeFindWidget();
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { FileType, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { ArchiveFrame } from '../services/archive.service';
import type { FileViewDirectorySource } from '../services/directory-source.service';
import { PARENT_ENTRY_PATH } from './file-entry.component';

export interface FilePanePathHost {
  get currentPath(): string;
  get archiveStack(): ArchiveFrame[];
  directorySource: FileViewDirectorySource;
  isInArchive(): boolean;
  loadDirectory(path: string, opts?: { preserveUI?: boolean; focusPath?: string }): Promise<void>;
  restoreArchiveFromPath(path: string): Promise<void>;
  renderArchiveFrame(frame: ArchiveFrame): void;
}

export class FilePanePathController {
  withParentEntry(raw: FileInfo[], inArchive: boolean, fsPath: string, directorySource: FileViewDirectorySource): FileInfo[] {
    if (raw.some(entry => entry.path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH)) {
      return raw;
    }
    if (inArchive || !directorySource.isRootPath(fsPath)) {
      return [this.makeParentEntry(), ...raw];
    }
    return raw;
  }

  async loadPathTransparently(host: FilePanePathHost, path: string): Promise<void> {
    if (host.directorySource.isPathInsideArchive(path)) {
      await host.restoreArchiveFromPath(path);
      return;
    }

    await host.loadDirectory(path);
  }

  async refreshCurrentPathTransparently(host: FilePanePathHost): Promise<void> {
    if (!host.currentPath) {
      return;
    }

    if (host.isInArchive()) {
      const currentFrame = host.archiveStack[host.archiveStack.length - 1];
      if (currentFrame) {
        host.renderArchiveFrame(currentFrame);
        return;
      }
    }

    if (host.directorySource.isPathInsideArchive(host.currentPath)) {
      await host.restoreArchiveFromPath(host.currentPath);
      return;
    }

    await host.loadDirectory(host.currentPath, { preserveUI: true });
  }

  private makeParentEntry(): FileInfo {
    return {
      name: '..',
      path: PARENT_ENTRY_PATH,
      type: FileType.DIRECTORY,
      size: 0,
      modified: 0,
    } as FileInfo;
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';

export interface FilePaneStateRuntimeAdapter {

  emitPreviewTargetFromState(): void;

  scrollToCursorPath(path: string): void;
````

## File: frontend/src/app/components/file-pane-state.controller.ts
````typescript
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { FilterQuery } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import type { FindWidgetState } from './filter-widget.component';
import type { ViewLayout } from './file-view-container.component';

export interface FilePaneStateHost {
  entries: FileInfo[];
  filteredEntries: FileInfo[];
  selectedFiles: Set<string>;
  selectionCursorPath: string | null;
  selectionAnchorPath: string | null;
  filterQuery: FilterQuery;
  currentView: ViewLayout;
  lastPreviewTargetEmitted: string | null;

  isInArchive(): boolean;
  getSelectableEntries(): FileInfo[];
  getCursorEntries(): FileInfo[];
  getOptimisticHiddenPaths(): string[];
  setOptimisticHiddenPaths(paths: string[]): void;
  parseFilterText(text: string): FilterQuery;
  filterEntries(entries: FileInfo[], query: FilterQuery): FileInfo[];
  findEntry(path: string): FileInfo | undefined;
  emitPreviewTarget(path: string): void;
  setFindMatchCount(count: number): void;
  promptForMask(mode: 'select' | 'unselect'): Promise<string | null>;
  scrollToCursorPath(path: string): void;
  getGridColumns(): number;
  getApproxPageSize(): number;
  persistDirTabState(): void;
}

export class FilePaneStateController {
  constructor(
    private readonly parentEntryPath: string,
    private readonly fileTypeFile: FileType,
    private readonly fileTypeSymlink: FileType,
  ) {}

  applyFilter(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    const optimisticHiddenPaths = new Set(host.getOptimisticHiddenPaths());
    if (optimisticHiddenPaths.size > 0) {
      const present = new Set(host.entries.map(entry => entry.path));
      for (const path of Array.from(optimisticHiddenPaths)) {
        if (!present.has(path)) optimisticHiddenPaths.delete(path);
      }
      host.setOptimisticHiddenPaths(Array.from(optimisticHiddenPaths));
    }

    const hiddenPaths = new Set(host.getOptimisticHiddenPaths());
    const baseEntries = hiddenPaths.size > 0
      ? host.entries.filter(entry => entry.path === this.parentEntryPath || !hiddenPaths.has(entry.path))
      : host.entries;

    const query = host.filterQuery;
    if (!query?.text?.trim() && !query?.criteria?.length) {
      host.filteredEntries = baseEntries;
      return;
    }

    const parentEntry = baseEntries.filter(entry => entry.path === this.parentEntryPath);
    const filtered = host.filterEntries(
      baseEntries.filter(entry => entry.path !== this.parentEntryPath),
      query,
    );
    host.filteredEntries = [...parentEntry, ...filtered];
  }

  onFindStateChange(host: FilePaneStateHost, state: FindWidgetState | null): void {
    if (!state) {
      host.filterQuery = { text: '', criteria: [] };
    } else {
      const query = host.parseFilterText(state.text);
      (query as any).matchCase = state.matchCase;
      (query as any).wholeWord = state.wholeWord;
      (query as any).useRegex = state.useRegex;
      host.filterQuery = query;
    }

    this.applyFilter(host);
    host.setFindMatchCount(host.filteredEntries.length);
    host.persistDirTabState();
  }

  onSelectionChange(host: FilePaneStateHost, entries: FileInfo[]): void {
    const cursorPaths = entries.map(entry => entry.path);
    const selectedPaths = cursorPaths.filter(path => path !== this.parentEntryPath);
    host.selectedFiles = new Set(selectedPaths);
    if (cursorPaths.length > 0) {
      host.selectionCursorPath = cursorPaths[cursorPaths.length - 1];
      if (cursorPaths.length === 1) {
        host.selectionAnchorPath = host.selectionCursorPath;
      } else if (!host.selectionAnchorPath) {
        host.selectionAnchorPath = host.selectionCursorPath;
      }
    }

    this.emitPreviewTargetFromState(host);
    host.persistDirTabState();
  }

  onFindNext(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    this.moveToAdjacentMatch(host, 1);
  }

  onFindPrev(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    this.moveToAdjacentMatch(host, -1);
  }

  getPreviewTargetPath(host: FilePaneStateHost): string {
    if (host.isInArchive()) return '';

    const path = this.getPreviewCandidatePath(host);
    if (!path) return '';

    const entry = host.findEntry(path);
    if (!entry) return '';
    if (entry.type !== this.fileTypeFile && entry.type !== this.fileTypeSymlink) return '';
    return entry.path;
  }

  emitPreviewTargetFromState(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    const next = this.getPreviewTargetPath(host);
    if (host.lastPreviewTargetEmitted === next) return;
    host.lastPreviewTargetEmitted = next;
    host.emitPreviewTarget(next);
  }

  onSelectAll(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    const selectable = host.getSelectableEntries();
    host.selectedFiles = new Set(selectable.map(entry => entry.path));
    host.selectionCursorPath = selectable.length ? selectable[selectable.length - 1].path : null;
    host.selectionAnchorPath = host.selectionCursorPath;
    this.emitPreviewTargetFromState(host);
    host.persistDirTabState();
  }

  onDeselectAll(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    host.selectedFiles = new Set();
    this.emitPreviewTargetFromState(host);
    host.persistDirTabState();
  }

  getEffectiveSelection(host: FilePaneStateHost): Set<string> {
    if (host.selectedFiles.size > 0) return host.selectedFiles;
    if (host.selectionCursorPath) return new Set([host.selectionCursorPath]);
    return new Set();
  }

  private getPreviewCandidatePath(host: FilePaneStateHost): string | null {
    const cursorPath = host.selectionCursorPath;
    if (cursorPath && cursorPath !== this.parentEntryPath) {
      return cursorPath;
    }

    const selected = Array.from(this.getEffectiveSelection(host)).filter(path => path && path !== this.parentEntryPath);
    return selected.length === 1 ? selected[0] : null;
  }

  onToggleCurrentAndMoveDown(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    const selectable = host.getSelectableEntries();
    const index = this.getCursorIndex(host, selectable);
    if (index < 0) return;

    const current = selectable[index];
    const path = current.path;
    const next = new Set(host.selectedFiles);

    if (current.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      next.add(path);
    } else if (next.has(path)) {
      next.delete(path);
    } else {
      next.add(path);
    }

    host.selectedFiles = next;

    const nextIndex = Math.min(index + 1, selectable.length - 1);
    host.selectionCursorPath = selectable[nextIndex]?.path ?? path;
    host.selectionAnchorPath = host.selectionAnchorPath ?? path;
    this.emitPreviewTargetFromState(host);
  }

  onSelectCurrentAndMoveDown(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    const selectable = host.getSelectableEntries();
    const index = this.getCursorIndex(host, selectable);
    if (index < 0) return;

    const path = selectable[index].path;
    const next = new Set(host.selectedFiles);
    next.add(path);
    host.selectedFiles = next;

    const nextIndex = Math.min(index + 1, selectable.length - 1);
    host.selectionCursorPath = selectable[nextIndex]?.path ?? path;
    host.selectionAnchorPath = path;
    this.emitPreviewTargetFromState(host);
  }

  onMarkCurrentItem(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    if (!host.selectionCursorPath) return;

    const path = host.selectionCursorPath;
    const current = host.findEntry(path);
    const next = new Set(host.selectedFiles);

    if (current?.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      next.add(path);
    } else if (next.has(path)) {
      next.delete(path);
    } else {
      next.add(path);
    }

    host.selectedFiles = next;

    const selectable = host.getSelectableEntries();
    const index = this.getCursorIndex(host, selectable);
    if (index >= 0 && index < selectable.length - 1) {
      host.selectionCursorPath = selectable[index + 1].path;
      host.scrollToCursorPath(host.selectionCursorPath);
    }

    this.emitPreviewTargetFromState(host);
  }

  onExtendSelection(host: FilePaneStateHost, delta: -1 | 1): void {
    const selectable = host.getSelectableEntries();
    const index = this.getCursorIndex(host, selectable);
    if (index < 0) return;

    const targetIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(selectable.length - 1, index + delta));
    const anchorPath = host.selectionAnchorPath ?? selectable[index].path;
    const anchorIndex = selectable.findIndex(entry => entry.path === anchorPath);
    const start = Math.min(anchorIndex === -1 ? index : anchorIndex, targetIndex);
    const end = Math.max(anchorIndex === -1 ? index : anchorIndex, targetIndex);

    host.selectedFiles = new Set(selectable.slice(start, end + 1).map(entry => entry.path));
    host.selectionCursorPath = selectable[targetIndex].path;
    host.selectionAnchorPath = anchorPath;
    this.emitPreviewTargetFromState(host);
  }

  onMoveCursorUp(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    const cols = host.getGridColumns();
    const cursorEntries = host.getCursorEntries();
    this.moveCursorTo(host, this.getCursorIndex(host, cursorEntries) - cols);
  }

  onMoveCursorDown(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    const cols = host.getGridColumns();
    const cursorEntries = host.getCursorEntries();
    this.moveCursorTo(host, this.getCursorIndex(host, cursorEntries) + cols);
  }

  onMoveCursorLeft(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    const cursorEntries = host.getCursorEntries();
    if (host.currentView === 'grid' || host.currentView === 'list' || host.currentView === 'details') {
      this.moveCursorTo(host, this.getCursorIndex(host, cursorEntries) - 1);
    }
  }

  onMoveCursorRight(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    const cursorEntries = host.getCursorEntries();
    if (host.currentView === 'grid' || host.currentView === 'list' || host.currentView === 'details') {
      this.moveCursorTo(host, this.getCursorIndex(host, cursorEntries) + 1);
    }
  }

  onMoveCursorHome(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    this.moveCursorTo(host, 0);
  }

  onMoveCursorEnd(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    const cursorEntries = host.getCursorEntries();
    this.moveCursorTo(host, cursorEntries.length - 1);
  }

  onMoveCursorPageUp(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    const pageSize = host.getApproxPageSize();
    const cursorEntries = host.getCursorEntries();
    this.moveCursorTo(host, this.getCursorIndex(host, cursorEntries) - pageSize);
  }

  onMoveCursorPageDown(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    const pageSize = host.getApproxPageSize();
    const cursorEntries = host.getCursorEntries();
    this.moveCursorTo(host, this.getCursorIndex(host, cursorEntries) + pageSize);
  }

  onSelectByMask(host: FilePaneStateHost, mask: string): void {
    const matcher = this.createMaskMatcher(mask);
    const next = new Set(host.selectedFiles);
    for (const entry of host.getSelectableEntries()) {
      if (matcher(entry.name)) next.add(entry.path);
    }
    host.selectedFiles = next;
    this.syncCursorFromSelection(host);
  }

  async onSelectByMaskWithPrompt(host: FilePaneStateHost): Promise<void> {
    const mask = (await host.promptForMask('select'))?.trim();
    if (!mask) return;
    this.onSelectByMask(host, mask);
  }

  onUnselectByMask(host: FilePaneStateHost, mask: string): void {
    const matcher = this.createMaskMatcher(mask);
    const next = new Set(host.selectedFiles);
    for (const entry of host.getSelectableEntries()) {
      if (matcher(entry.name)) next.delete(entry.path);
    }
    host.selectedFiles = next;
    this.syncCursorFromSelection(host);
  }

  async onUnselectByMaskWithPrompt(host: FilePaneStateHost): Promise<void> {
    const mask = (await host.promptForMask('unselect'))?.trim();
    if (!mask) return;
    this.onUnselectByMask(host, mask);
  }

  onInvertSelection(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    const selectable = host.getSelectableEntries();
    const next = new Set<string>();
    for (const entry of selectable) {
      if (!host.selectedFiles.has(entry.path)) {
        next.add(entry.path);
      }
    }
    host.selectedFiles = next;
    this.syncCursorFromSelection(host);
  }

  onSelectSameExtension(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    const current = this.getCurrentCursorEntry(host);
    if (!current) return;

    const extension = this.getExtension(current.name);
    if (!extension) return;

    const next = new Set(host.selectedFiles);
    for (const entry of host.getSelectableEntries()) {
      if (this.getExtension(entry.name) === extension) {
        next.add(entry.path);
      }
    }
    host.selectedFiles = next;
    this.syncCursorFromSelection(host);
  }

  private moveCursorTo(host: FilePaneStateHost, index: number): void {
    const cursorEntries = host.getCursorEntries();
    if (!cursorEntries.length) return;
    const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(cursorEntries.length - 1, index));
    host.selectionCursorPath = cursorEntries[clamped].path;
    host.selectionAnchorPath = host.selectionCursorPath;
    host.scrollToCursorPath(host.selectionCursorPath);
    this.emitPreviewTargetFromState(host);
    host.persistDirTabState();
  }

  private moveToAdjacentMatch(host: FilePaneStateHost, delta: -1 | 1): void {
    const cursorEntries = host.getCursorEntries();
    if (!cursorEntries.length) return;

    const currentIndex = this.getCursorIndex(host, cursorEntries);
    const nextIndex = currentIndex < 0
      ? 0
      : (currentIndex + delta + cursorEntries.length) % cursorEntries.length;

    this.moveCursorTo(host, nextIndex);
  }

  private syncCursorFromSelection(host: FilePaneStateHost): void {
    const selectable = host.getSelectableEntries();
    if (!selectable.length || host.selectedFiles.size === 0) {
      host.selectionCursorPath = selectable.length ? selectable[0].path : null;
      host.selectionAnchorPath = host.selectionCursorPath;
      this.emitPreviewTargetFromState(host);
      return;
    }

    const firstSelected = selectable.find(entry => host.selectedFiles.has(entry.path));
    if (firstSelected) {
      host.selectionCursorPath = firstSelected.path;
      host.selectionAnchorPath = host.selectionAnchorPath ?? firstSelected.path;
    }
    this.emitPreviewTargetFromState(host);
  }

  private getCursorIndex(host: FilePaneStateHost, entries: FileInfo[]): number {
    if (!entries.length) return -1;

    if (host.selectionCursorPath) {
      const index = entries.findIndex(entry => entry.path === host.selectionCursorPath);
      if (index !== -1) return index;
    }

    const firstSelected = entries.findIndex(entry => host.selectedFiles.has(entry.path));
    if (firstSelected !== -1) {
      host.selectionCursorPath = entries[firstSelected].path;
      return firstSelected;
    }

    host.selectionCursorPath = entries[0].path;
    return 0;
  }

  private getCurrentCursorEntry(host: FilePaneStateHost): FileInfo | null {
    const entries = host.getCursorEntries();
    const index = this.getCursorIndex(host, entries);
    return index >= 0 ? entries[index] : null;
  }

  private createMaskMatcher(mask: string): (value: string) => boolean {
    const escaped = mask
      .replace(/[.+^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')
      .replace(/\*/g, '.*')
      .replace(/\?/g, '.');
    const regex = new RegExp(`^${escaped}$`, 'i');
    return (value: string) => regex.test(value);
  }

  private getExtension(name: string): string {
    const index = name.lastIndexOf('.');
    if (index <= 0 || index === name.length - 1) return '';
    return name.slice(index + 1).toLowerCase();
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { EventEmitter } from '@angular/core';
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { TreeNode } from './file-tree.component';
import { PARENT_ENTRY_PATH } from './file-entry.component';

export interface FileViewEventsHost {
  selectionChange: EventEmitter<FileInfo[]>;
  navigate: EventEmitter<FileInfo>;
  openInNewTab: EventEmitter<FileInfo>;
  contextMenu: EventEmitter<{ event: MouseEvent; entry: FileInfo }>;
  nodeDoubleClick: EventEmitter<FileInfo>;
  rename: EventEmitter<{ entry: FileInfo; newName: string }>;
  setSelectedPaths(paths: string[]): void;
  setCursorPath(path: string | null): void;
}

export class FileViewEventsController {
  onSelectionChange(host: FileViewEventsHost, entries: FileInfo[]): void {
    host.setSelectedPaths(
      entries
        .map((entry) => entry.path)
        .filter((path) => path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH),
    );
    host.setCursorPath(entries.length > 0 ? entries[entries.length - 1].path : null);
    host.selectionChange.emit(entries);
  }

  onNavigate(host: FileViewEventsHost, entry: FileInfo | TreeNode | Event): void {
    const payload = this.toFileInfo(entry);
    if (!payload) return;
    host.navigate.emit(payload);
  }

  onContextMenu(host: FileViewEventsHost, event: { event: MouseEvent; entry: FileInfo }): void {
    host.contextMenu.emit(event);
  }

  onOpenInNewTab(host: FileViewEventsHost, entry: FileInfo): void {
    host.openInNewTab.emit(entry);
  }

  onTreeSelectionChange(host: FileViewEventsHost, nodes: TreeNode[]): void {
    const files = nodes.map((node) => this.treeNodeToFileInfo(node));
    host.setSelectedPaths(nodes.map((node) => node.path));
    host.setCursorPath(nodes.length > 0 ? nodes[nodes.length - 1].path : null);
    host.selectionChange.emit(files);
  }

  onTreeContextMenu(host: FileViewEventsHost, event: { event: MouseEvent; node: TreeNode }): void {
    host.contextMenu.emit({ event: event.event, entry: this.treeNodeToFileInfo(event.node) });
  }

  onTreeRename(host: FileViewEventsHost, event: { node: TreeNode; newName: string }): void {
    host.rename.emit({
      entry: this.treeNodeToFileInfo(event.node),
      newName: event.newName,
    });
  }

  onTreeOpenInNewTab(host: FileViewEventsHost, node: TreeNode): void {
    host.openInNewTab.emit(this.treeNodeToFileInfo(node));
  }

  onTreeNodeDoubleClick(host: FileViewEventsHost, node: TreeNode): void {
    const file = this.treeNodeToFileInfo(node);
    if (!file) return;

    if (node.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      host.navigate.emit(file);
      return;
    }

    host.nodeDoubleClick.emit(file);
  }

  treeNodeToFileInfo(node: TreeNode): FileInfo {
    return {
      name: node.name,
      path: node.path,
      type: node.type,
      size: node.size,
      modified: node.modified,
      created: node.created,
    } as FileInfo;
  }

  private toFileInfo(entry: FileInfo | TreeNode | Event): FileInfo | null {
    if (!entry || entry instanceof Event) return null;
    const candidate = entry as any;
    if (!candidate.path) return null;

    const payload: any = {
      name: candidate.name,
      path: candidate.path,
      type: candidate.type,
      size: candidate.size,
      modified: candidate.modified,
      created: candidate.created,
    };
    if (Array.isArray(candidate.nestedChain)) {
      payload.nestedChain = [...candidate.nestedChain];
    }
    return payload as FileInfo;
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { EventEmitter } from '@angular/core';
import { FileType, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { parentPath } from './address-bar.utils';
import { PARENT_ENTRY_PATH } from './file-entry.component';
import type { TreeNode, DropTarget } from './file-tree.component';
import type { ViewLayout } from './file-view-container.component';

export interface FileViewInteractionHost {
  get paneId(): 'left' | 'right';
  get currentPath(): string;
  get currentView(): ViewLayout;
  set currentView(value: ViewLayout);
  dragStart: EventEmitter<{ event: DragEvent; entries: FileInfo[] }>;
  dragDrop: EventEmitter<{ event: DragEvent; source: FileInfo[]; targetPath: string }>;
  viewChange: EventEmitter<ViewLayout>;
  persistViewMode(view: ViewLayout): void;
  syncTreeToCurrentPath(): void;
  enqueueTreeLoad(node: TreeNode): void;
}

export class FileViewInteractionController {
  onTreeDragStart(
    host: FileViewInteractionHost,
    event: { event: DragEvent; nodes: TreeNode[] },
    treeNodeToFileInfo: (node: TreeNode) => FileInfo,
  ): void {
    this.setPaneId(event.event, host.paneId);
    host.dragStart.emit({
      event: event.event,
      entries: event.nodes.map((node) => treeNodeToFileInfo(node)),
    });
  }

  onTreeDragDrop(
    host: FileViewInteractionHost,
    event: { event: DragEvent; source: TreeNode[]; target: DropTarget },
    treeNodeToFileInfo: (node: TreeNode) => FileInfo,
  ): void {
    const targetPath = event.target.position === 'inside'
      ? event.target.node.path
      : parentPath(event.target.node.path);

    host.dragDrop.emit({
      event: event.event,
      source: event.source.map((node) => treeNodeToFileInfo(node)),
      targetPath,
    });
  }

  onViewDragStart(
    host: FileViewInteractionHost,
    event: { event: DragEvent; entries: FileInfo[] },
  ): void {
    this.setPaneId(event.event, host.paneId);
    host.dragStart.emit(event);
  }

  onViewDragDrop(
    host: FileViewInteractionHost,
    event: { event: DragEvent; source: FileInfo[]; target: FileInfo },
  ): void {
    let targetPath = event.target.path;
    if (event.target.path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) {
      targetPath = parentPath(host.currentPath);
    } else if (event.target.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      targetPath = parentPath(event.target.path);
    }

    if (!targetPath) {
      targetPath = host.currentPath;
    }

    host.dragDrop.emit({
      event: event.event,
      source: event.source,
      targetPath,
    });
  }

  onViewChange(host: FileViewInteractionHost, view: ViewLayout): void {
    host.currentView = view;
    host.viewChange.emit(view);
    host.persistViewMode(view);
    if (view === 'tree') {
      host.syncTreeToCurrentPath();
    }
  }

  onLoadChildren(host: FileViewInteractionHost, node: TreeNode): void {
    host.enqueueTreeLoad(node);
  }

  private setPaneId(event: DragEvent, paneId: 'left' | 'right'): void {
    try {
      event.dataTransfer?.setData('application/x-wails-pane-id', paneId);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { ChangeDetectorRef, SimpleChanges } from '@angular/core';
import type { ViewLayout } from './file-view-container.component';

export interface FileViewLifecycleHost {
  get currentView(): ViewLayout;
  sortEntries(): void;
  syncTreeToCurrentPath(): void;
  refreshCurrentTreePath(): void;
  resortTreeNodes(): void;
  markTreeNodesChanged(): void;
  markForCheck(): void;
}

export class FileViewLifecycleController {
  onChanges(host: FileViewLifecycleHost, changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    host.sortEntries();

    const switchedToTree = !!changes['currentView'] && host.currentView === 'tree';
    const treeRelevantChange = switchedToTree || !!changes['currentPath'] || !!changes['showHidden'];
    const treeEntriesChanged = host.currentView === 'tree' && !!changes['entries'];
    const treeSortChanged = host.currentView === 'tree' &&
      (!!changes['sortField'] || !!changes['sortDirection'] || !!changes['directoriesFirst']);

    if (host.currentView === 'tree' && treeRelevantChange) {
      host.syncTreeToCurrentPath();
      return;
    }

    if (treeEntriesChanged) {
      host.refreshCurrentTreePath();
      return;
    }

    if (treeSortChanged) {
      host.resortTreeNodes();
      host.markTreeNodesChanged();
      host.markForCheck();
    }
  }
}
````

````typescript
        return;

        host.scrollDetailsToPath(path);
        return;

        return;
      case 'tree':
        host.focusTreeNode(path);
        return;
      default:
        return;

      return host.getVisibleTreeNodes()
        .filter((node) => node.path !== parentEntryPath && (node.level ?? 0) >= 0)
        .map((node) => this.treeNodeToFileInfo(node));
    }

  getApproxPageSize(host: FileViewRuntimeHost): number {

      case 'details':
````

````typescript
import { FileType, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { TreeNode } from './file-tree.component';

export interface FileViewSortHost {
  get entries(): FileInfo[];
  get sortField(): string;
  get sortDirection(): 'asc' | 'desc';
  get directoriesFirst(): boolean;
  setSortedEntries(entries: FileInfo[]): void;
}

export class FileViewSortController {
  sortEntries(host: FileViewSortHost, parentEntryPath: string): void {
    const sorted = [...host.entries];
    const multiplier = host.sortDirection === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;

    sorted.sort((left, right) => {
      if (left.path === parentEntryPath) return -1;
      if (right.path === parentEntryPath) return 1;

      if (host.directoriesFirst) {
        if (left.type === FileType.DIRECTORY && right.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) return -1;
        if (right.type === FileType.DIRECTORY && left.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) return 1;
      }

      return this.compareEntries(host.sortField, multiplier, left, right);
    });

    host.setSortedEntries(sorted);
  }

  sortTreeNodes(host: FileViewSortHost, nodes: TreeNode[]): TreeNode[] {
    const multiplier = host.sortDirection === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
    return [...nodes].sort((left, right) => {
      if (host.directoriesFirst) {
        const leftIsDir = left.type === FileType.DIRECTORY || left.type === FileType.ARCHIVE;
        const rightIsDir = right.type === FileType.DIRECTORY || right.type === FileType.ARCHIVE;
        if (leftIsDir && !rightIsDir) return -1;
        if (!leftIsDir && rightIsDir) return 1;
      }

      return this.compareByField(host.sortField, multiplier, left, right);
    });
  }

  resortAllLoadedTreeNodes(host: FileViewSortHost, nodes: TreeNode[]): void {
    for (const node of nodes) {
      if (!node.children?.length) continue;
      node.children = this.sortTreeNodes(host, node.children);
      this.resortAllLoadedTreeNodes(host, node.children);
    }
  }

  private compareEntries(
    sortField: string,
    multiplier: number,
    left: FileInfo,
    right: FileInfo,
  ): number {
    return this.compareByField(sortField, multiplier, left, right);
  }

  private compareByField(
    sortField: string,
    multiplier: number,
    left: Pick<FileInfo, 'name' | 'type' | 'size' | 'modified' | 'registryKind' | 'registryValueType' | 'registryPreview' | 'searchParentPath'>,
    right: Pick<FileInfo, 'name' | 'type' | 'size' | 'modified' | 'registryKind' | 'registryValueType' | 'registryPreview' | 'searchParentPath'>,
  ): number {
    let comparison = 0;
    switch (sortField) {
      case 'name':
        comparison = left.name.localeCompare(right.name);
        break;
      case 'size':
        comparison = (left.size || 0) - (right.size || 0);
        break;
      case 'modified':
        comparison = (left.modified || 0) - (right.modified || 0);
        break;
      case 'type': {
        const leftType = this.sortTypeLabel(left);
        const rightType = this.sortTypeLabel(right);
        comparison = leftType.localeCompare(rightType);
        break;
      }
      case 'registryKind':
        comparison = (left.registryKind || '').localeCompare(right.registryKind || '');
        break;
      case 'registryValueType':
        comparison = (left.registryValueType || '').localeCompare(right.registryValueType || '');
        break;
      case 'registryPreview':
        comparison = (left.registryPreview || '').localeCompare(right.registryPreview || '');
        break;
      case 'searchParentPath':
        comparison = (left.searchParentPath || '').localeCompare(right.searchParentPath || '');
        break;
      default:
        comparison = left.name.localeCompare(right.name);
    }
    return comparison * multiplier;
  }

  private sortTypeLabel(entry: Pick<FileInfo, 'name' | 'type'>): string {
    return entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY || entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE
      ? 'folder'
      : (entry.name.split('.').pop() || '');
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { buildArchivePath, parseArchivePath } from '../services/archive.service';
import { normalizePath as normalizePathReference } from './address-bar.utils';
import type { FileViewDirectorySource } from '../services/directory-source.service';
import { FileType, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { PARENT_ENTRY_PATH } from './file-entry.component';
import type { TreeNode } from './file-tree.component';
import type { ViewLayout } from './file-view-container.component';

export interface FileViewTreeHost {
  get currentPath(): string;
  get currentView(): ViewLayout;
  get showHidden(): boolean;
  get entries(): FileInfo[];
  get treeNodes(): TreeNode[];
  set treeNodes(value: TreeNode[]);
  directorySource: FileViewDirectorySource;
  markForCheck(): void;
  sortTreeNodes(nodes: TreeNode[]): TreeNode[];
  expandTreeNode(path: string): void;
  centerTreeNode(path: string): void;
}

export class FileViewTreeController {
  private readonly nodeLoadPromises = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();
  private syncToken = 0;

  reset(): void {
    this.nodeLoadPromises.clear();
    this.syncToken += 1;
  }

  async syncToCurrentPath(host: FileViewTreeHost): Promise<void> {
    if (host.currentView !== 'tree') return;
    this.buildTreeNodes(host);

    const rootNode = host.treeNodes[0];
    if (!rootNode) return;

    const token = ++this.syncToken;
    const chain = this.buildPathChain(rootNode.path, host.currentPath);
    if (chain.length === 0) return;

    let current = rootNode;
    const expandedNodes: TreeNode[] = [rootNode];
    await this.ensureNodeChildrenLoaded(host, current);
    if (token !== this.syncToken) return;

    for (let index = 1; index < chain.length; index += 1) {
      const expected = this.normalizePath(chain[index]);
      const next = current.children?.find((child) => this.normalizePath(child.path) === expected);
      if (!next || (next.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY && next.type !== FileType.ARCHIVE)) break;
      current = next;
      expandedNodes.push(current);
      await this.ensureNodeChildrenLoaded(host, current);
      if (token !== this.syncToken) return;
    }

    setTimeout(() => {
      if (token !== this.syncToken || host.currentView !== 'tree') return;
      for (const node of expandedNodes) {
        host.expandTreeNode(node.path);
      }
      host.centerTreeNode(current.path);
    }, 0);
  }

  buildTreeNodes(host: FileViewTreeHost): void {
    const rootPath = this.getRootPath(host);
    if (!rootPath) {
      host.treeNodes = [];
      return;
    }

    const currentRoot = host.treeNodes[0];
    if (currentRoot && this.normalizePath(currentRoot.path) === this.normalizePath(rootPath)) {
      return;
    }

    this.nodeLoadPromises.clear();
    host.treeNodes = [this.createRootNode(rootPath)];
    host.markForCheck();
  }

  async ensureNodeChildrenLoaded(host: FileViewTreeHost, node: TreeNode): Promise<void> {
    if (node.loaded) return;

    const existingPromise = this.nodeLoadPromises.get(node.path);
    if (existingPromise) {
      await existingPromise;
      return;
    }

    const loadPromise = this.populateNodeChildren(host, node);
    this.nodeLoadPromises.set(node.path, loadPromise);
    try {
      await loadPromise;
    } finally {
      this.nodeLoadPromises.delete(node.path);
    }
  }

  refreshTreeNode(host: FileViewTreeHost, path: string): void {
    const target = this.normalizePath(path);
    const node = this.findTreeNodeByPath(host.treeNodes, target);
    if (!node || !node.loaded) return;
    node.loaded = false;
    host.treeNodes = [...host.treeNodes];
    host.markForCheck();
    void this.ensureNodeChildrenLoaded(host, node);
  }

  normalizePath(path: string): string {
    return normalizePathReference(path || '/');
  }

  private async populateNodeChildren(host: FileViewTreeHost, node: TreeNode): Promise<void> {
    node.loading = true;
    node.children = node.children?.length ? node.children : [];
    host.markForCheck();

    try {
      const context = node.archivePath ? parseArchivePath(node.archivePath) : null;
      const listing = context
        ? await host.directorySource.browseArchive(context.fsPath, context.nestedChain, context.innerPath)
        : await host.directorySource.listDirectory(node.path, host.showHidden);
      const childLevel = (node.level ?? 0) + 1;
      const existingChildren = new Map<string, TreeNode>();
      for (const child of node.children ?? []) {
        existingChildren.set(this.normalizePath(child.path), child);
      }

      const rawChildren: TreeNode[] = (listing.entries || [])
        .filter((entry) => entry.path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH)
        .map((entry) => this.toChildNode(host, entry as FileInfo, node, context, childLevel, existingChildren));

      node.children = host.sortTreeNodes(rawChildren);
      node.loaded = true;
      node.loading = false;
      host.treeNodes = [...host.treeNodes];
      host.markForCheck();
    } catch {
      node.children = [];
      node.loading = false;
      node.loaded = true;
      host.treeNodes = [...host.treeNodes];
      host.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  private toChildNode(
    host: FileViewTreeHost,
    entry: FileInfo,
    node: TreeNode,
    context: ReturnType<typeof parseArchivePath> | null,
    childLevel: number,
    existingChildren: Map<string, TreeNode>,
  ): TreeNode {
    const entryNestedChain = (entry as any).nestedChain as string[] | undefined;
    const isArchiveEntry = entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE;

    let childArchivePath: string | undefined;
    if (context) {
      if (isArchiveEntry) {
        const newChain = entryNestedChain?.length ? entryNestedChain : [...context.nestedChain, entry.path];
        childArchivePath = buildArchivePath(context.fsPath, newChain, '');
      } else {
        childArchivePath = buildArchivePath(context.fsPath, context.nestedChain, entry.path);
      }
    } else {
      childArchivePath = isArchiveEntry ? entry.path : undefined;
    }

    const childPath = context
      ? host.directorySource.joinChildPath(node.path, entry.name)
      : entry.path;

    const existing = existingChildren.get(this.normalizePath(childPath));
    return {
      ...entry,
      path: childPath,
      level: childLevel,
      expandable: entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY || entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE,
      expanded: existing?.expanded ?? false,
      children: existing?.children ?? ((entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY || entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE) ? [] : undefined),
      loaded: existing?.loaded ?? false,
      loading: false,
      renaming: existing?.renaming ?? false,
      editingName: existing?.editingName,
      parent: node,
      archivePath: childArchivePath,
    } as TreeNode;
  }

  private createRootNode(rootPath: string, archivePath?: string): TreeNode {
    const isWindowsRoot = /^filesystem:\/\/[a-z]$/i.test(rootPath);
    const isRegistryRoot = rootPath === 'registry://';
    const rootName = archivePath
      ? rootPath.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() || rootPath
      : (isRegistryRoot ? 'Registry' : (rootPath === '/' ? '/' : (isWindowsRoot ? `${rootPath.slice(-1).toUpperCase()}:` : rootPath)));
    return {
      name: rootName,
      path: rootPath,
      type: FileType.DIRECTORY,
      size: 0,
      modified: 0,
      created: 0,
      accessed: 0,
      permissions: '',
      isHidden: false,
      registryKind: isRegistryRoot ? 'Registry' : undefined,
      level: -1,
      syntheticRoot: rootPath,
      expandable: true,
      expanded: true,
      children: [],
      loaded: false,
      loading: false,
      parent: undefined,
      archivePath,
    } as TreeNode;
  }

  private getRootPath(host: FileViewTreeHost): string {
    return host.directorySource.getRootPath(this.normalizePath(host.currentPath || '/'), host.entries) ?? '/';
  }

  private buildPathChain(rootPath: string, targetPath: string): string[] {
    const root = this.normalizePath(rootPath);
    const target = this.normalizePath(targetPath || rootPath);

    const chain = [root];
    if (root === 'registry://') {
      if (target === root) return chain;
      const relative = target.slice(root.length).replace(/^\/+/, '');
      if (!relative) return chain;

      let current = root;
      for (const segment of relative.split('/').filter(Boolean)) {
        current = `${current}${segment}`;
        chain.push(this.normalizePath(current));
        current = `${current}/`;
      }
      return chain;
    }

    const rootForPrefix = root.endsWith('/') ? root : `${root}/`;
    const startsAtRoot = target === root || this.normalizePath(target).startsWith(rootForPrefix);
    if (!startsAtRoot) return chain;
    if (target === root) return chain;

    const relative = target.slice(root.length).replace(/^\/+/, '');
    if (!relative) return chain;

    let current = root;
    for (const segment of relative.split('/').filter(Boolean)) {
      current = current === '/' ? `/${segment}` : `${current.replace(/\/$/, '')}/${segment}`;
      chain.push(this.normalizePath(current));
    }
    return chain;
  }

  private findTreeNodeByPath(nodes: TreeNode[], target: string): TreeNode | undefined {
    for (const node of nodes) {
      if (this.normalizePath(node.path) === target) return node;
      if (node.children) {
        const found = this.findTreeNodeByPath(node.children, target);
        if (found) return found;
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { DEFAULT_FILE_CATEGORIES, FILE_CATEGORY_EXTENSIONS, type FileCategory } from '../shared/file-categories';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';

export { DEFAULT_FILE_CATEGORIES, type FileCategory } from '../shared/file-categories';

export interface FilterPreset {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** Filter string understood by FilterService.parseFilterText() */
  filter: string;
  icon?: string;
  description?: string;
  group?: string;
  isDynamic?: boolean;
  /** Real match count from the current dataset */
  count?: number;
}

export interface FilterGroup {
  name: string;
  presets: FilterPreset[];
}

export interface FilterCategory {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: string;
  pattern?: string;
  isCustom?: boolean;
  predicate?: (entry: FileInfo) => boolean;
}

export interface CustomCategoryData {
  label: string;
  icon: string;
  pattern: string;
}

export const FILTER_PRESETS_KEY = 'filter-bar-presets';
export const GROUP_ORDER = ['Basic', 'Extensions', 'Special', 'Date', 'Size', 'Other'];

export const GROUP_MODES: Record<string, 'AND' | 'OR'> = {
  Basic: 'OR',
  Extensions: 'OR',
  Other: 'OR',
  Special: 'AND',
  Date: 'AND',
  Size: 'AND',
};

// Kept for any legacy imports.
export const BUILT_IN_CATEGORIES: FilterCategory[] = [];

/**
 * Analyze a dataset and return FilterPresets with real match counts.
 * Presets with count === 0 are omitted so only categories present in the folder are shown.
 *
 * Filter strings are compatible with FilterService.parseFilterText().
 */
export function buildPresetsFromDataset(dataset: FileInfo[]): FilterPreset[] {
  if (!dataset?.length) return [];

  const now = Date.now();
  const DAY = 86_400_000;

  let files = 0;
  let dirs = 0;
  let symlinks = 0;
  let hidden = 0;
  const dateCounts = { today: 0, thisWeek: 0, thisMonth: 0 };
  const sizeCounts = { small: 0, medium: 0, large: 0, huge: 0 };
  const extMap = new Map<string, number>();

  for (const f of dataset) {
    if (f.type === FileType.FILE) {
      files++;
    } else if (f.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      dirs++;
    }

    if (f.type === FileType.SYMLINK || (f as any).isSymlink) symlinks++;
    if (f.name.startsWith('.')) hidden++;

    const age = now - f.modified * 1000;
    if (age < DAY) dateCounts.today++;
    if (age < 7 * DAY) dateCounts.thisWeek++;
    if (age < 30 * DAY) dateCounts.thisMonth++;

    if (f.type !== FileType.FILE) continue;

    const sz = f.size ?? 0;
    if (sz < 102_400) {
      sizeCounts.small++;
    } else if (sz < 10_485_760) {
      sizeCounts.medium++;
    } else if (sz < 1_073_741_824) {
      sizeCounts.large++;
    } else {
      sizeCounts.huge++;
    }

    const dot = f.name.lastIndexOf('.');
    if (dot > 0) {
      const ext = f.name.slice(dot + 1).toLowerCase();
      extMap.set(ext, (extMap.get(ext) ?? 0) + 1);
    }
  }

  const catCounts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const cat of DEFAULT_FILE_CATEGORIES) {
    let count = 0;
    for (const ext of cat.extensions) count += extMap.get(ext) ?? 0;
    if (count > 0) catCounts.set(cat.id, count);
  }

  const out: FilterPreset[] = [];

  if (files) {
    out.push({ id: 'files', name: 'Files', filter: 'type:file', icon: '📄', group: 'Basic', count: files });
  }
  if (dirs) {
    out.push({ id: 'dirs', name: 'Folders', filter: 'type:dir', icon: '📁', group: 'Basic', count: dirs });
  }
  if (symlinks) {
    out.push({ id: 'symlinks', name: 'Symlinks', filter: 'type:symlink', icon: '🔗', group: 'Basic', count: symlinks });
  }

  for (const cat of DEFAULT_FILE_CATEGORIES) {
    const count = catCounts.get(cat.id);
    if (!count) continue;

    out.push({
      id: `ext-${cat.id}`,
      name: cat.name,
      filter: cat.extensions.map((ext) => `ext:${ext}`).join(' '),
      icon: cat.icon,
      group: 'Extensions',
      isDynamic: true,
      count,
    });
  }

  Array.from(extMap.entries())
    .filter(([ext, count]) => count >= 2 && !FILE_CATEGORY_EXTENSIONS.has(ext))
    .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
    .slice(0, 5)
    .forEach(([ext, count]) => {
      out.push({
        id: `ext-raw-${ext}`,
        name: `.${ext}`,
        filter: `ext:${ext}`,
        icon: '📎',
        group: 'Extensions',
        isDynamic: true,
        count,
      });
    });

  if (hidden) {
    out.push({ id: 'hidden', name: 'Hidden', filter: 'hidden:true', icon: '👻', group: 'Special', count: hidden });
  }

  if (dateCounts.today) {
    out.push({ id: 'today', name: 'Today', filter: 'modified:today', icon: '⚡', group: 'Date', isDynamic: true, count: dateCounts.today });
  }
  if (dateCounts.thisWeek) {
    out.push({ id: 'this-week', name: 'This week', filter: 'modified:week', icon: '🗓', group: 'Date', isDynamic: true, count: dateCounts.thisWeek });
  }
  if (dateCounts.thisMonth) {
    out.push({ id: 'this-month', name: 'This month', filter: 'modified:month', icon: '🗓️', group: 'Date', isDynamic: true, count: dateCounts.thisMonth });
  }

  if (sizeCounts.small) {
    out.push({ id: 'size-small', name: '< 100 KB', filter: 'size<102400', icon: '🔹', group: 'Size', count: sizeCounts.small });
  }
  if (sizeCounts.medium) {
    out.push({ id: 'size-medium', name: '100 KB – 10 MB', filter: 'size>102400 size<10485760', icon: '🔸', group: 'Size', count: sizeCounts.medium });
  }
  if (sizeCounts.large) {
    out.push({ id: 'size-large', name: '> 10 MB', filter: 'size>10485760', icon: '🔶', group: 'Size', count: sizeCounts.large });
  }
  if (sizeCounts.huge) {
    out.push({ id: 'size-huge', name: '> 1 GB', filter: 'size>1073741824', icon: '🔴', group: 'Size', count: sizeCounts.huge });
  }

  return out;
}
````

````typescript
export class FilterDropdownComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy, OnInit {

  @Input() presets:    FilterPreset[] = [];
  @Input() selected:   FilterPreset[] = [];
  @Input() hasDynamic = false;
  @Input() contextId = 'overlay.filter.category';

  @Output() itemToggle      = new EventEmitter<FilterPreset>();
  @Output() clearAll        = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() refresh         = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() groupModeChange = new EventEmitter<{ group: string; mode: 'AND' | 'OR' }>();
  @Output() closeRequested  = new EventEmitter<void>();

  groups: FilterGroup[] = [];
  private groupModes = new Map<string, 'AND' | 'OR'>();
  private focusedGroupName: string | null = null;
  private focusedPresetId: string | null = null;
  private readonly commandOwner = `filterDropdown:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
  private releaseOverlayContext: (() => void) | null = null;

  // Define which groups are OR vs AND
  private readonly orGroups = new Set(['Basic', 'Extensions', 'Other']);
  private readonly andGroups = new Set(['Date', 'Size', 'Special']);

  constructor(
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.initializeGroupModes();
    this.registerInputCommands();
    this.releaseOverlayContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire(this.contextId);
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['presets']) {
      this.buildGroups();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.releaseOverlayContext?.();
    this.releaseOverlayContext = null;
    this.unregisterInputCommands();
  }

  private initializeGroupModes(): void {
    // OR groups
    this.orGroups.forEach(group => this.groupModes.set(group, 'OR'));
    // AND groups
    this.andGroups.forEach(group => this.groupModes.set(group, 'AND'));
  }

  isSelected(preset: FilterPreset): boolean {
    return this.selected.some(p => p.id === preset.id);
  }

  getGroupMode(group: string): 'AND' | 'OR' {
    return this.groupModes.get(group) ?? 'OR';
  }

  onItemClick(preset: FilterPreset, event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.itemToggle.emit(preset);
  }

  onClearAllClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.clearAll.emit();
  }

  onRefreshClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.refresh.emit();
  }

  isFocused(groupName: string, presetId: string): boolean {
    return this.focusedGroupName === groupName && this.focusedPresetId === presetId;
  }

  setFocusedItem(groupName: string, presetId: string): void {
    this.focusedGroupName = groupName;
    this.focusedPresetId = presetId;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.focusFocusedItem();
  }

  private buildGroups(): void {
    const map = new Map<string, FilterPreset[]>();
    
    for (const p of this.presets) {
      const g = p.group || 'Other';
      if (!map.has(g)) map.set(g, []);
      map.get(g)!.push(p);
    }

    this.groups = Array.from(map.entries())
      .sort((a, b) => {
        const groupA = a[0];
        const groupB = b[0];
        
        const aIsOr = this.orGroups.has(groupA);
        const bIsOr = this.orGroups.has(groupB);
        
        if (aIsOr && !bIsOr) return -1;
        if (!aIsOr && bIsOr) return 1;
        
        const ia = GROUP_ORDER.indexOf(groupA);
        const ib = GROUP_ORDER.indexOf(groupB);
        return (ia === -1 ? 999 : ia) - (ib === -1 ? 999 : ib);
      })
      .map(([name, presets]) => ({ 
        name, 
        presets: this.sortPresetsByCount(presets)
      }));

    const firstPreset = this.groups[0]?.presets[0] ?? null;
    if (firstPreset) {
      this.focusedGroupName ??= this.groups[0].name;
      this.focusedPresetId ??= firstPreset.id;
    } else {
      this.focusedGroupName = null;
      this.focusedPresetId = null;
    }
    
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.focusFocusedItem();
  }

  private sortPresetsByCount(presets: FilterPreset[]): FilterPreset[] {
    return [...presets].sort((a, b) => {
      const countA = a.count ?? 0;
      const countB = b.count ?? 0;
      if (countA !== countB) return countB - countA;
      return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
    });
  }

  private moveFocus(delta: number): void {
    const items = this.groups.flatMap(group => group.presets.map(preset => ({ groupName: group.name, preset })));
    if (items.length === 0) return;

    const currentIndex = items.findIndex(item => this.isFocused(item.groupName, item.preset.id));
    const baseIndex = currentIndex >= 0 ? currentIndex : 0;
    const nextIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, baseIndex + delta));
    this.focusedGroupName = items[nextIndex].groupName;
    this.focusedPresetId = items[nextIndex].preset.id;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.focusFocusedItem();
  }

  private toggleFocused(): void {
    const preset = this.groups
      .flatMap(group => group.presets)
      .find(item => item.id === this.focusedPresetId);
    if (!preset) return;
    this.itemToggle.emit(preset);
  }

  private registerInputCommands(): void {
    const prefix = this.contextId === 'overlay.filter.presets' ? 'overlay.filter.presets' : 'overlay.filter.category';

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand(`${prefix}.close`, () => {
      this.closeRequested.emit();
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand(`${prefix}.prevItem`, () => {
      this.moveFocus(-1);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand(`${prefix}.nextItem`, () => {
      this.moveFocus(1);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand(`${prefix}.select`, () => {
      this.toggleFocused();
    }, this.commandOwner);
  }

  private unregisterInputCommands(): void {
    const prefix = this.contextId === 'overlay.filter.presets' ? 'overlay.filter.presets' : 'overlay.filter.category';
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand(`${prefix}.close`, this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand(`${prefix}.prevItem`, this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand(`${prefix}.nextItem`, this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand(`${prefix}.select`, this.commandOwner);
  }

  private focusFocusedItem(): void {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const item = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.fd-item.fd-item--focused');
      item?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  }
}
````

````typescript
export class FindWidgetComponent implements OnDestroy {

  @ViewChild('inputEl') inputEl?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;

  @Output() stateChange = new EventEmitter<FindWidgetState | null>();
  @Output() nextMatch   = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() prevMatch   = new EventEmitter<void>();

  visible     = false;
  searchText  = '';
  matchCase   = false;
  wholeWord   = false;
  useRegex    = false;
  matchCount: number | null = null;
  currentMatch = 0;
  hasRegexError = false;

  private _focusTimer: any;
  private readonly commandOwner = `widget.filterInline:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
  private releaseWidgetContext: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor(
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
    private overlayFreeze: NativeOverlayFreezeService,
  ) {
    this.registerInputCommands();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    clearTimeout(this._focusTimer);
    this.releaseWidgetContext?.();
    this.releaseWidgetContext = null;
    this.overlayFreeze.release('filter-widget');
    this.unregisterInputCommands();
  }

  // ── Open / close ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  open(): void {
    this.visible = true;
    this.hasRegexError = false;
    this.overlayFreeze.acquire('filter-widget');
    this.releaseWidgetContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('widget.filterInline');
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    // Defer focus so the CSS transition has started
    clearTimeout(this._focusTimer);
    this._focusTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.inputEl?.nativeElement.focus();
      this.inputEl?.nativeElement.select();
    }, 60);
    this.emit();
  }

  close(): void {
    this.visible = false;
    this.searchText = '';
    this.matchCount = null;
    this.currentMatch = 0;
    this.hasRegexError = false;
    this.overlayFreeze.release('filter-widget');
    this.releaseWidgetContext?.();
    this.releaseWidgetContext = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.stateChange.emit(null);  // null = no filter
  }

  toggle(): void { this.visible ? this.close() : this.open(); }

  // ── Input events ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  onTextChange(): void {
    this.hasRegexError = false;
    if (this.useRegex && this.searchText) {
      try { new RegExp(this.searchText); } catch { this.hasRegexError = true; }
    }
    this.currentMatch = 1;
    this.emit();
  }

  onInputKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    switch (e.key) {
      case 'Escape':    e.preventDefault(); this.close(); break;
      case 'Enter':     e.preventDefault(); e.shiftKey ? this.onPrev() : this.onNext(); break;
      case 'F3':        e.preventDefault(); e.shiftKey ? this.onPrev() : this.onNext(); break;
    }
  }

  onNext(): void { if (this.matchCount) { this.currentMatch = (this.currentMatch % this.matchCount) + 1; this.nextMatch.emit(); this.cdr.markForCheck(); } }
  onPrev(): void { if (this.matchCount) { this.currentMatch = ((this.currentMatch - 2 + this.matchCount) % this.matchCount) + 1; this.prevMatch.emit(); this.cdr.markForCheck(); } }

  /** Called by the parent to update the match count badge. */
  setMatchCount(count: number): void {
    this.matchCount = count;
    if (this.currentMatch > count) this.currentMatch = count || 0;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  // ── Emit state ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private emit(): void {
    if (!this.visible || !this.searchText || this.hasRegexError) {
      this.stateChange.emit(null);
      return;
    }
    this.stateChange.emit({
      text:      this.searchText,
      matchCase: this.matchCase,
      wholeWord: this.wholeWord,
      useRegex:  this.useRegex,
    });
  }

  private registerInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('widget.filterInline.close', () => {
      if (!this.visible) return;
      this.close();
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('widget.filterInline.nextMatch', () => {
      if (!this.visible) return;
      this.onNext();
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('widget.filterInline.prevMatch', () => {
      if (!this.visible) return;
      this.onPrev();
    }, this.commandOwner);
  }

  private unregisterInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('widget.filterInline.close', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('widget.filterInline.nextMatch', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('widget.filterInline.prevMatch', this.commandOwner);
  }
}
````

````html
              <path d="M2 8 C2 5 5 3 8 2" stroke="var(--vsc-icon-symlink,#5dade2)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
              <path d="M6 1.2 L8.8 1.2 L8.8 4" stroke="var(--vsc-icon-symlink,#5dade2)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
            </svg>
          </div>

          <div class="result-info">
            <div class="result-name" [innerHTML]="result.highlightedName"></div>
            <div class="result-path">{{ result.file.path }}</div>
          </div>

          <div class="result-meta">
            <span class="result-match-type" [class]="'match-' + result.matchType">
              {{ result.matchType }}
            </span>
            <span class="result-score">{{ result.score.toFixed(0) }}%</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>

<!-- Search Settings Modal -->
<div class="settings-overlay" *ngIf="showSettingsModal" (click)="hideSettings()">
  <div #settingsPanel class="settings-modal" [appTrapFocus]="true" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" tabindex="-1" (click)="$event.stopPropagation()">
    <div class="settings-header">
      <h3>Search Settings</h3>
      <button (click)="hideSettings()" class="btn-close">✕</button>
    </div>

    <div class="settings-content" appVscodeScrollbar>
      <div class="setting-group">
        <label class="setting-label">
          <input
            data-dialog-initial-focus
            type="checkbox"
            [(ngModel)]="searchConfig.enableTypoTolerance"
            (change)="updateSearchConfig()"
          />
          Enable typo tolerance
        </label>
        <p class="setting-description">
          Find results even with minor spelling errors
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="setting-group">
        <label class="setting-label">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            [(ngModel)]="searchConfig.searchHidden"
            (change)="updateSearchConfig()"
          />
          Search hidden files
        </label>
        <p class="setting-description">
          Include hidden files and folders in results
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="setting-group">
        <label class="setting-label">
          Max results:
          <input
            type="number"
            [(ngModel)]="searchConfig.maxResults"
            (change)="updateSearchConfig()"
            min="10"
            max="200"
            class="setting-input"
          />
        </label>
        <p class="setting-description">
          Maximum number of results to display
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="setting-group">
        <label class="setting-label">
          Fuzzy threshold:
          <input
            type="range"
            [(ngModel)]="searchConfig.fuzzyThreshold"
            (change)="updateSearchConfig()"
            min="0"
            max="1"
            step="0.1"
            class="setting-slider"
          />
          <span class="setting-value">{{ searchConfig.fuzzyThreshold }}</span>
        </label>
        <p class="setting-description">
          How strict fuzzy matching should be (0 = loose, 1 = strict)
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="settings-footer">
      <button (click)="resetSettings()" class="btn-secondary">Reset to Defaults</button>
      <button (click)="hideSettings()" class="btn-primary">Done</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
````

## File: frontend/src/app/components/operation-stack.component.ts
````typescript
import { Component, OnInit, OnDestroy, Input, ElementRef } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { OperationService, OperationState } from '../services/operation.service';
import { OperationToastComponent } from './operation-toast.component';
import { createSubject, takeUntil } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-operation-toast-stack',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, OperationToastComponent],
  template: `
<div class="stack" *ngIf="!collapsed && ops.length">
<app-operation-toast
*ngFor="let op of ops;trackBy:track"
[operation]="op"
(cancel)="svc.cancel($event)"
(dismiss)="svc.dismiss($event)"
(resolve)="svc.resolveConflict($event.conflictId,$event.resolution,$event.applyToAll)">
</app-operation-toast>
</div>
`,
  styles: [`
:host{
position:fixed;
right:16px;
bottom:30px;
z-index:1000;
}

.stack{
display:flex;
flex-direction:column;
gap:8px;
}
`]
})
export class OperationToastStackComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {

  @Input() collapsed = false;
  ops: OperationState[] = [];
  destroy$ = createSubject<void>();

  constructor(public svc: OperationService, public elementRef: ElementRef) { }

  ngOnInit() {
    this.svc.visibleOperations$
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(o => this.ops = o);
  }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  track(_: number, o: OperationState) { return o.id; }
}
````

````typescript
// operation-status-bar.component.ts - Updated with stack toggle
import { Component, OnInit, OnDestroy, Input, Output, EventEmitter } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { 
  createSubject,
  takeUntil 
} from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { OperationService, OperationState } from '../services/operation.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-operation-status-bar',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  template: `
    <div class="status-operations" *ngIf="hasOperations">
      <div 
        class="status-pill"
        [class.has-active]="hasActive"
        [class.has-conflict]="hasConflict"
        [class.is-expanded]="!toastCollapsed"
        (click)="onPillClick()"
      >
        <div class="pill-indicator" [class.pulse]="hasActive" [class.warning]="hasConflict"></div>
        
        <span class="pill-label">{{ count }} operation{{ count !== 1 ? 's' : '' }}</span>
        
        <div class="pill-progress" *ngIf="hasActive && !hasConflict && overallProgress > 0">
          <div class="pill-progress-fill" [style.width.%]="overallProgress"></div>
        </div>

        <span class="conflict-badge" *ngIf="hasConflict">⚠️ Conflict</span>

        <svg 
          class="expand-icon"
          [class.expanded]="!toastCollapsed"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24" 
          width="12" 
          height="12" 
          stroke="currentColor" 
          stroke-width="2" 
          fill="none"
        >
          <polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline>
        </svg>
      </div>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host { display: contents; }
    
    .status-operations { position: relative; }
    
    .status-pill {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--vsc-padding-sm);
      height: calc(var(--vsc-statusbar-height) - 4px);
      padding: 0 var(--vsc-padding-md);
      background: var(--vsc-badge-background);
      border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--vsc-transition-fast);
      font-size: var(--vsc-font-size-small);
      color: var(--vsc-badge-foreground);
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      user-select: none;
    }

    .status-pill:hover {
      background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background);
      border-color: var(--vsc-border-bright);
    }

    .status-pill.has-active {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue) 15%, var(--vsc-badge-background));
    }

    .status-pill.has-conflict {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-warning) 20%, var(--vsc-badge-background));
````
