````typescript
export class OperationStatusBarComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @Input() toastCollapsed = false;
  @Input() stackElement?: Element;
  @Output() toastCollapsedChange = new EventEmitter<boolean>();
  
  operations: OperationState[] = [];
  hasOperations = false;
  hasActive = false;
  hasConflict = false;
  count = 0;
  overallProgress = 0;

  private destroy$ = createSubject<void>();
  private _hideTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private _toastDismissTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private _mutationSub: { unsubscribe(): void } | null = null;

  constructor(private operationService: OperationService) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.operationService.operations$.pipe(
      takeUntil(this.destroy$)
    ).subscribe(ops => {
      this.operations = Array.from(ops.values());
      this.hasOperations = this.operations.length > 0;
      this.count = this.operations.length;
      
      const activeOps = this.operations.filter(op => op.status === 'running');
      this.hasActive = activeOps.length > 0;
      
      if (activeOps.length > 0) {
        const sum = activeOps.reduce((acc, op) => acc + op.percentComplete, 0);
        this.overallProgress = sum / activeOps.length;
      } else {
        this.overallProgress = 0;
      }

      const conflictOp = this.operations.find(
        op => op.status === 'paused' && !!op.conflictData
      );
      const newHasConflict = !!conflictOp;
      
      if (newHasConflict && !this.hasConflict && this.toastCollapsed) {
        this.toastCollapsed = false;
        this.toastCollapsedChange.emit(false);
      }
      
      this.hasConflict = newHasConflict;
    });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  onPillClick(): void {
    this.toastCollapsed = !this.toastCollapsed;
    this.toastCollapsedChange.emit(this.toastCollapsed);
  }
}
````

````typescript
export class OperationToastComponent implements OnChanges, OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @Input() operation!: OperationState;

  @Output() cancel  = new EventEmitter<string>();
  @Output() dismiss = new EventEmitter<string>();
  @Output() resolve = new EventEmitter<{ conflictId: string; resolution: ConflictResolution; applyToAll: boolean }>();

  applyToAll  = false;
  isResolving = false;

  private destroy$ = createSubject<void>();
  private timer: any;

  constructor(public svc: OperationService) {}

  ngOnInit()    { this.setupAutoDismiss(); }
  ngOnChanges() { this.setupAutoDismiss(); }

  ngOnDestroy() {
    this.clearTimer();
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  private setupAutoDismiss() {
    this.clearTimer();
    if (this.isCompleted && !this.hasConflict) {
      this.timer = setTimeout(() => this.dismiss.emit(this.operation.id), 800);
    }
  }

  private clearTimer() {
    if (this.timer) { clearTimeout(this.timer); this.timer = null; }
  }

  get hasConflict() {
    return this.operation.status === 'paused' && !!this.operation.conflictData;
  }

  get isCompleted() {
    return ['completed', 'error', 'cancelled'].includes(this.operation.status);
  }

  get canKeepBoth() {
    if (this.operation?.config?.kind !== 'move') return true;

    const src = this.operation.conflictData?.sourcePath;
    const dst = this.operation.conflictData?.destPath;
    if (!src || !dst) return true; // fallback: allow if uncertain

    const srcDir = this.parentDir(src);
    const dstDir = this.parentDir(dst);
    return srcDir !== dstDir; // allow keep-both when moving into a different folder
  }

  get currentFileName() {
    const p = this.operation.metrics.currentFile || '';
    return p.split(/[\\/]/).pop() || p;
  }

  conflictTitle(): string {
    return this.operation.conflictData?.isDirectory ? 'Folder already exists' : 'File already exists';
  }

  conflictSourceFileName(): string {
    if (this.isSameDirectoryRenameConflict()) {
      return this.conflictFileName(this.operation.conflictData?.destPath);
    }
    return this.conflictFileName(this.operation.conflictData?.sourcePath);
  }

  conflictFileName(path?: string): string {
    if (!path) return '';
    return path.split(/[\\/]/).pop() || path;
  }

  conflictDir(path?: string): string {
    if (!path) return '';
    const parts = path.split(/[\\/]/);
    return parts.slice(0, -1).join('/') || '/';
  }

  private parentDir(path: string): string {
    const parts = path.split(/[\\/]/);
    parts.pop();
    return parts.join('/') || '/';
  }

  private isSameDirectoryRenameConflict(): boolean {
    if (this.operation?.config?.kind !== 'move') return false;

    const src = this.operation.conflictData?.sourcePath;
    const dst = this.operation.conflictData?.destPath;
    if (!src || !dst) return false;

    return this.parentDir(src) === this.parentDir(dst);
  }

  onCancel(e: Event)  { e.stopPropagation(); this.cancel.emit(this.operation.id); }
  onDismiss(e: Event) { e.stopPropagation(); this.clearTimer(); this.dismiss.emit(this.operation.id); }

  async resolveConflict(resolution: ConflictResolution) {
    if (this.isResolving) return;
    if (resolution === 'rename' && !this.canKeepBoth) return;
    this.isResolving = true;
    this.resolve.emit({
      conflictId: this.operation.conflictData?.conflictId || this.operation.id,
      resolution,
      applyToAll: this.applyToAll,
    });
    setTimeout(() => this.isResolving = false, 400);
  }
}
````

````typescript
          [disabled]="loading || atRoot"
          (click)="navigateUp()"
          aria-label="Parent directory"
          title="Parent directory (Backspace)">

          type="button"

          [disabled]="loading"

        </button>

export class ReassemblyDirectoryPaneComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  readonly FileType = FileType;

  path = '';
  entries: FileInfo[] = [];
  cursorPath: string | null = null;
  selectedPaths = new Set<string>();
  loading = false;
  error: string | null = null;
  lastAction = 'startup';

  private anchorPath: string | null = null;
  private loadGeneration = 0;

  constructor(
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly directorySource: DirectorySourceService,
    private readonly input: InputEngineService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  get cursorEntry(): FileInfo | null {
    if (!this.cursorPath) return null;
    return this.entries.find(entry => entry.path === this.cursorPath) ?? null;
  }

  get atRoot(): boolean {
    return !this.path || this.directorySource.isRootPath(this.path);
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.installInput();
    void this.initialize();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.input.deactivateContext(CONTEXT_ID);

    for (const binding of BINDINGS) {
      this.input.unregisterBinding(binding.id);
    }

    for (const commandId of Object.values(COMMAND)) {
      this.input.unregisterCommandDescriptor(commandId, OWNER_ID);
    }
  }

  activate(): void {
    this.input.activateContext(CONTEXT_ID);
  }

  async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.path) return;
    this.lastAction = 'refresh';
    await this.load(this.path, { preserveCursor: true });
  }

  async navigateUp(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.path || this.atRoot) return;
    const parent = this.directorySource.getParentPath(this.path);
    if (!parent || parent === this.path) return;
    this.lastAction = 'parent directory';
    await this.load(parent);
  }

  openEntry(entry: FileInfo): void {
    this.setSingleSelection(entry);

    if (entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      this.lastAction = `selected file: ${entry.name}`;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.lastAction = `open directory: ${entry.name}`;
    void this.load(entry.path);
  }

  selectFromPointer(entry: FileInfo, event: MouseEvent): void {
    this.cursorPath = entry.path;

    if (event.shiftKey && this.anchorPath) {
      this.selectRange(this.anchorPath, entry.path);
    } else if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) {
      const next = new Set(this.selectedPaths);
      if (next.has(entry.path)) {
        next.delete(entry.path);
      } else {
        next.add(entry.path);
      }
      this.selectedPaths = next;
      this.anchorPath = entry.path;
    } else {
      this.setSingleSelection(entry);
    }

    this.lastAction = `select: ${entry.name}`;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  trackEntry(_index: number, entry: FileInfo): string {
    return entry.path;
  }

  formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return bytes === 0 ? '0 B' : '';
    const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
    let value = bytes;
    let unit = 0;
    while (value >= 1024 && unit < units.length - 1) {
      value /= 1024;
      unit += 1;
    }
    return unit === 0 ? `${value} ${units[unit]}` : `${value.toFixed(value >= 10 ? 1 : 2)} ${units[unit]}`;
  }

  private installInput(): void {
    this.input.registerContext({
      id: CONTEXT_ID,
      kind: 'pane',
      priority: 100,
      parentId: 'global',
      description: 'Reassembly directory pane',
    });

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.cursorUp,
      title: 'Move Cursor Up',
      category: 'Navigation',
      execute: () => this.moveCursor(-1),
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.cursorDown,
      title: 'Move Cursor Down',
      category: 'Navigation',
      execute: () => this.moveCursor(1),
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.open,
      title: 'Open Selected Directory',
      category: 'Navigation',
      execute: () => {
        const entry = this.cursorEntry;
        if (entry) this.openEntry(entry);
      },
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.up,
      title: 'Go to Parent Directory',
      category: 'Navigation',
      execute: () => this.navigateUp(),
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.selectAll,
      title: 'Select All',
      category: 'Selection',
      execute: () => {
        this.selectedPaths = new Set(this.entries.map(entry => entry.path));
        this.lastAction = 'select all';
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      },
    }, OWNER_ID);

    this.input.registerCommandDescriptor({
      id: COMMAND.refresh,
      title: 'Refresh Directory',
      category: 'Navigation',
      execute: () => this.refresh(),
    }, OWNER_ID);

    for (const binding of BINDINGS) {
      this.input.registerBinding(binding);
    }

    this.input.activateContext(CONTEXT_ID);
  }

  private async initialize(): Promise<void> {
    this.loading = true;
    this.error = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    try {
      const drives = await this.api.listDrives();
      const initialPath = drives[0]?.path || '/';
      await this.load(initialPath);
    } catch (error) {
      // '/' is the universal final fallback for non-Windows/local filesystem roots.
      try {
        await this.load('/');
      } catch {
        // load() already records the visible error state.
      }
    }
  }

  private async load(
    requestedPath: string,
    options: { preserveCursor?: boolean } = {},
  ): Promise<void> {
    const generation = ++this.loadGeneration;
    const previousCursor = options.preserveCursor ? this.cursorPath : null;

    this.loading = true;
    this.error = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    try {
      const listing = await this.directorySource.listDirectory(requestedPath, false);
      if (generation !== this.loadGeneration) return;

      this.path = listing.path || requestedPath;
      this.entries = [...(listing.entries || [])].sort((left, right) => {
        const leftDirectory = left.type === FileType.DIRECTORY;
        const rightDirectory = right.type === FileType.DIRECTORY;
        if (leftDirectory !== rightDirectory) return leftDirectory ? -1 : 1;
        return left.name.localeCompare(right.name, undefined, {
          numeric: true,
          sensitivity: 'base',
        });
      });

      const preserved = previousCursor
        ? this.entries.find(entry => entry.path === previousCursor)
        : null;
      const nextCursor = preserved ?? this.entries[0] ?? null;

      this.cursorPath = nextCursor?.path ?? null;
      this.selectedPaths = nextCursor ? new Set([nextCursor.path]) : new Set();
      this.anchorPath = nextCursor?.path ?? null;
      this.error = null;
    } catch (error) {
      if (generation !== this.loadGeneration) return;
      this.entries = [];
      this.cursorPath = null;
      this.selectedPaths = new Set();
      this.anchorPath = null;
      this.error = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    } finally {
      if (generation === this.loadGeneration) {
        this.loading = false;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      }
    }
  }

  private moveCursor(delta: -1 | 1): void {
    if (this.entries.length === 0) return;

    const currentIndex = this.cursorPath
      ? this.entries.findIndex(entry => entry.path === this.cursorPath)
      : -1;

    const nextIndex = currentIndex < 0
      ? 0
      : Math.max(0, Math.min(this.entries.length - 1, currentIndex + delta));

    const entry = this.entries[nextIndex];
    this.setSingleSelection(entry);
    this.lastAction = delta < 0 ? 'cursor up' : 'cursor down';
    this.ensureCursorVisible();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private setSingleSelection(entry: FileInfo): void {
    this.cursorPath = entry.path;
    this.selectedPaths = new Set([entry.path]);
    this.anchorPath = entry.path;
  }

  private selectRange(anchorPath: string, targetPath: string): void {
    const start = this.entries.findIndex(entry => entry.path === anchorPath);
    const end = this.entries.findIndex(entry => entry.path === targetPath);

    if (start < 0 || end < 0) {
      const target = this.entries.find(entry => entry.path === targetPath);
      if (target) this.setSingleSelection(target);
      return;
    }

    const from = Math.min(start, end);
    const to = Math.max(start, end);
    this.selectedPaths = new Set(
      this.entries.slice(from, to + 1).map(entry => entry.path),
    );
  }

  private ensureCursorVisible(): void {
    if (!this.cursorPath || typeof document === 'undefined') return;

    const escaped = typeof CSS !== 'undefined' && typeof CSS.escape === 'function'
      ? CSS.escape(this.cursorPath)
      : this.cursorPath.replace(/["\\]/g, '\\$&');

    queueMicrotask(() => {
      document
        .querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-file-entry="${escaped}"]`)
        ?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
    });
  }
}
````

````typescript
interface PendingChordLike {

}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-shortcut-debug-overlay',

        <span class="label">action</span>
        <span class="value">{{ lastAction || '-' }}</span>
      </div>

      <div class="pending" *ngIf="input.pendingChord$ | async as chord">
        chord pending · {{ pendingChordStepCount(chord) }} step{{ pendingChordStepCount(chord) === 1 ? '' : 's' }}
      </div>

      <div class="bindings">
        <div><kbd>Up</kbd><kbd>Down</kbd><span>cursor</span></div>
        <div><kbd>Enter</kbd><span>open folder</span></div>
        <div><kbd>Backspace</kbd><span>parent</span></div>
        <div><kbd>Ctrl</kbd><span>+</span><kbd>A</kbd><span>select all</span></div>
        <div><kbd>Ctrl</kbd><span>+</span><kbd>R</kbd><span>refresh</span></div>

      <footer>

      </footer>
    </aside>
  `,
  styles: [`

    }

    header span,
    footer,

      color: var(--vsc-description-foreground, #969696);

    .state {

    }

    }

    }
  `],
})
export class ShortcutDebugOverlayComponent {
  @Input() path = '';
  @Input() cursorName: string | null = null;
  @Input() selectedCount = 0;
  @Input() lastAction = '';

  constructor(public readonly input: InputEngineService) {}

  protected pendingChordStepCount(value: unknown): number {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
      return 0;
    }

    const chord = value as Partial<PendingChordLike>;
    return Array.isArray(chord.steps) ? chord.steps.length : 0;
  }
}
````

````typescript
export class StatusBarComponent {
  @Input() filteredEntries: FileInfo[] = [];
  @Input() selectedPaths: Set<string> = new Set();
  @Input() allEntries: FileInfo[] = [];

  get selectedCount(): number { return this.selectedPaths.size; }

  get fileCount(): number {
    return this.filteredEntries.filter(e => e.type === FileType.FILE || e.type === FileType.SYMLINK).length;
  }

  get dirCount(): number {
    return this.filteredEntries.filter(e => e.type === FileType.DIRECTORY).length;
  }

  /** Sum of sizes of selected entries (files only — dirs typically report 0) */
  get selectionSize(): number {
    if (this.selectedCount === 0) return 0;
    return this.allEntries
      .filter(e => this.selectedPaths.has(e.path))
      .reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.size ?? 0), 0);
  }

  /** Sum of all file sizes in the filtered listing */
  get dirTotalSize(): number {
    return this.filteredEntries
      .filter(e => e.type === FileType.FILE || e.type === FileType.SYMLINK)
      .reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.size ?? 0), 0);
  }

  formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';
    if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
    return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} GB`;
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Component, Input, Output, EventEmitter, ElementRef, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { TabComponent } from './tab.component';
import { TabInfo } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

export type PaneId = 'left' | 'right';

export interface TabDropEvent {
  tabId: string;
  fromPaneId: PaneId;
  toPaneId: PaneId;
  toIndex: number;
}

interface TabDragPayload {
  source?: 'tab';
  tabId: string;
  fromPaneId: PaneId;
}

@Component({

          <!-- New Tab Button -->

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `,

export class TabBarComponent {
  @ViewChild('scrollViewport', { static: true }) scrollViewport?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;
  @ViewChild('tabsList', { static: true }) tabsList?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  /** The pane that owns this tab bar. Required for cross-pane drag/drop. */
  @Input() paneId: PaneId = 'left';
  @Input() tabs: TabInfo[] = [];
  @Input() activeTabId = '';
  @Input() isCompact = false;
  /** Forwarded from FilePaneComponent — true when browsing inside an archive. */
  @Input() inArchive = false;

  @Output() tabChange = new EventEmitter<TabInfo>();
  @Output() tabClose = new EventEmitter<TabInfo>();
  @Output() tabPin = new EventEmitter<TabInfo>();
  @Output() newTab = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() tabDragStart = new EventEmitter<TabInfo>();

  /** Fired when a tab is dropped into this tab bar (reorder or cross-pane move). */
  @Output() tabDrop = new EventEmitter<TabDropEvent>();

  dropIndicatorX: number | null = null;
  private dropIndex: number | null = null;

  trackByTabId(index: number, tab: TabInfo): string {
    return tab.id;
  }

  onTabClick(tab: TabInfo) { this.tabChange.emit(tab); }
  onTabClose(tab: TabInfo) { this.tabClose.emit(tab); }
  onTabPin(tab: TabInfo) { this.tabPin.emit(tab); }
  onNewTab() { this.newTab.emit(); }

  onDragStart(event: DragEvent, tab: TabInfo): void {
    // Avoid starting a drag when interacting with tab action buttons.
    const target = event.target as HTMLElement | null;
    if (target?.closest('.tab-actions')) {
      event.preventDefault();
      return;
    }

    if (!event.dataTransfer) return;

    this.tabDragStart.emit(tab);
    event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';

    const payload: TabDragPayload = { source: 'tab', tabId: tab.id, fromPaneId: this.paneId };
    // IMPORTANT: Some embedded engines (notably WebView2) can be quirky with
    // custom MIME types and/or hiding getData() during dragover.
    // Mirror the internal app DnD convention used by FileListComponent.
    const payloadStr = JSON.stringify(payload);
    try { event.dataTransfer.setData('application/json', payloadStr); } catch {}
    try { event.dataTransfer.setData('application/x-wails-tab', payloadStr); } catch {}
    try { event.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', payloadStr); } catch {}

    this.dropIndicatorX = null;
    this.dropIndex = null;
  }

  onDragEnd(_event: DragEvent): void {
    this.dropIndicatorX = null;
    this.dropIndex = null;
  }

  onDragOver(event: DragEvent): void {
    if (!this.isSupportedTabDrag(event)) return;

    // Prevent default to allow drop; otherwise cursor shows "not allowed".
    event.preventDefault();
    if (event.dataTransfer) event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';

    const computed = this.computeDropPosition(event.clientX);
    if (!computed) {
      this.dropIndicatorX = null;
      this.dropIndex = null;
      return;
    }
    this.dropIndicatorX = computed.indicatorX;
    this.dropIndex = computed.index;
  }

  onDragLeave(event: DragEvent): void {
    const related = (event.relatedTarget as HTMLElement | null);
    const viewport = this.scrollViewport?.nativeElement;
    if (!viewport) return;
    if (related && viewport.contains(related)) return;
    this.dropIndicatorX = null;
    this.dropIndex = null;
  }

  onDrop(event: DragEvent): void {
    if (this.isSupportedTabDrag(event)) {
      event.preventDefault();
    }

    const payload = this.readPayload(event);
    if (!payload) {
      this.dropIndicatorX = null;
      this.dropIndex = null;
      return;
    }

    const toIndex = this.dropIndex ?? this.tabs.length;
    this.tabDrop.emit({
      tabId: payload.tabId,
      fromPaneId: payload.fromPaneId,
      toPaneId: this.paneId,
      toIndex,
    });

    this.dropIndicatorX = null;
    this.dropIndex = null;
  }

  private readPayload(event: DragEvent): TabDragPayload | null {
    const dt = event.dataTransfer;
    if (!dt) return null;
    const raw = dt.getData('application/json') || dt.getData('application/x-wails-tab') || dt.getData('text/plain');
    if (!raw) return null;
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as TabDragPayload;
      if (parsed?.source && parsed.source !== 'tab') return null;
      if (!parsed?.tabId) return null;
      if (parsed.fromPaneId !== 'left' && parsed.fromPaneId !== 'right') return null;
      return parsed;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  private isSupportedTabDrag(event: DragEvent): boolean {
    const dt = event.dataTransfer;
    if (!dt) return false;
    const types = Array.from(dt.types ?? []);
    // Only accept our internal drags; avoid interfering with external OS drags.
    if (types.length === 0) {
      return dt.effectAllowed === 'move' || dt.effectAllowed === 'copyMove';
    }
    return types.includes('application/json') || types.includes('application/x-wails-tab');
  }

  private computeDropPosition(clientX: number): { index: number; indicatorX: number } | null {
    const viewport = this.scrollViewport?.nativeElement;
    const listEl = this.tabsList?.nativeElement;
    if (!viewport || !listEl) return null;

    const tabEls = Array.from(listEl.querySelectorAll('app-tab')) as HTMLElement[];
    const listRect = listEl.getBoundingClientRect();

    if (tabEls.length === 0) {
      const indicatorX = (clientX - listRect.left) + viewport.scrollLeft;
      return { index: 0, indicatorX: Math.max(0, indicatorX) };
    }

    let index = tabEls.length;
    let indicatorClientX = tabEls[tabEls.length - 1].getBoundingClientRect().right;

    for (let i = 0; i < tabEls.length; i++) {
      const r = tabEls[i].getBoundingClientRect();
      const mid = r.left + r.width / 2;
      if (clientX < mid) {
        index = i;
        indicatorClientX = r.left;
        break;
      }
    }

    const indicatorX = (indicatorClientX - listRect.left) + viewport.scrollLeft;
    return { index, indicatorX: Math.max(0, indicatorX) };
  }
}
````

````typescript
      if (!this.showMenu) return;

    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.workspaceSelector.close', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.workspaceSelector.prevItem', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.workspaceSelector.nextItem', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.workspaceSelector.activateSelected', this.commandOwner);

  onRename(): void { this.rename.emit(); }

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const item = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.ws-item.ws-item--selected');
      item?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  }
````

````typescript
import { AfterViewInit, Directive, ElementRef, HostListener, Input, NgZone, OnChanges, OnDestroy, inject, Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { focusInitialElement, isFocusableElement, trapFocusWithin } from './focus-trap.utils';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
class DialogFocusTrapStackService {
  private stack: HTMLElement[] = [];

  push(container: HTMLElement): () => void {
    this.stack = this.stack.filter(item => item !== container);
    this.stack.push(container);
    return () => {
      this.stack = this.stack.filter(item => item !== container);
    };
  }

  isTop(container: HTMLElement): boolean {
    return this.stack[this.stack.length - 1] === container;
  }
}

@Directive({
  selector: '[appTrapFocus]',
  standalone: true,
})
export class DialogFocusTrapDirective implements AfterViewInit, OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  private readonly host = inject<ElementRef<HTMLElement>>(ElementRef);
  private readonly zone = inject(NgZone);
  private readonly stack = inject(DialogFocusTrapStackService);

  @Input('appTrapFocus') enabled = true;
  @Input() appTrapFocusInitial?: string | null;
  @Input() appTrapFocusRestoreFocus = true;

  private active = false;
  private releaseStack: (() => void) | null = null;
  private cleanupFocusListener: (() => void) | null = null;
  private previousFocus: HTMLElement | null = null;
  private focusTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private viewReady = false;

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    this.viewReady = true;
    this.syncTrapState();
  }

  ngOnChanges(): void {
    this.syncTrapState();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.deactivate();
    this.viewReady = false;
  }

  @HostListener('keydown', ['$event'])
  onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (!this.active || !this.stack.isTop(this.host.nativeElement)) {
      return;
    }

    trapFocusWithin(this.host.nativeElement, event);
  }

  private syncTrapState(): void {
    if (!this.viewReady) {
      return;
    }

    if (this.enabled) {
      this.activate();
      return;
    }

    this.deactivate();
  }

  private activate(): void {
    if (this.active) {
      return;
    }

    this.active = true;
    const activeElement = this.host.nativeElement.ownerDocument.activeElement;
    if (activeElement instanceof HTMLElement && !this.host.nativeElement.contains(activeElement)) {
      this.previousFocus = activeElement;
    }

    this.releaseStack = this.stack.push(this.host.nativeElement);
    this.installFocusListener();
    this.scheduleInitialFocus();
  }

  private deactivate(): void {
    if (!this.active) {
      return;
    }

    this.active = false;
    this.clearScheduledFocus();
    this.cleanupFocusListener?.();
    this.cleanupFocusListener = null;
    this.releaseStack?.();
    this.releaseStack = null;

    if (!this.appTrapFocusRestoreFocus) {
      this.previousFocus = null;
      return;
    }

    const target = this.previousFocus;
    this.previousFocus = null;
    if (!target) {
      return;
    }

    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (target.isConnected && isFocusableElement(target)) {
          target.focus();
        }
      }, 0);
    });
  }

  private installFocusListener(): void {
    const ownerDocument = this.host.nativeElement.ownerDocument;
    const handleFocusIn = (event: FocusEvent) => {
      if (!this.active || !this.stack.isTop(this.host.nativeElement)) {
        return;
      }

      const target = event.target;
      if (target instanceof Node && this.host.nativeElement.contains(target)) {
        return;
      }

      this.scheduleInitialFocus();
    };

    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      ownerDocument.addEventListener('focusin', handleFocusIn, true);
    });

    this.cleanupFocusListener = () => {
      ownerDocument.removeEventListener('focusin', handleFocusIn, true);
    };
  }

  private scheduleInitialFocus(): void {
    this.clearScheduledFocus();
    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      this.focusTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.focusTimer = null;
        if (!this.active || !this.stack.isTop(this.host.nativeElement)) {
          return;
        }

        focusInitialElement(this.host.nativeElement, this.appTrapFocusInitial);
      }, 0);
    });
  }

  private clearScheduledFocus(): void {
    if (this.focusTimer === null) {
      return;
    }

    clearTimeout(this.focusTimer);
    this.focusTimer = null;
  }
}
````

import {
  Directive,
  ElementRef,
  Input,
  OnDestroy,
  OnInit,
  Output,
  EventEmitter,
  ContentChild,
  AfterContentInit,
  AfterContentChecked,
} from '@angular/core';
import { DropdownService } from '../services/dropdown.service';

/**
 * DropdownTriggerDirective — marks the trigger element of a dropdown.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   <button appDropdownTrigger>Open</button>
 */
@Directive({ selector: '[appDropdownTrigger]', standalone: true })
export class DropdownTriggerDirective {
  constructor(public el: ElementRef<HTMLElement>) {}
}

/**
 * DropdownMenuDirective — marks the menu panel of a dropdown.
 * Works with *ngIf — the directive re-registers whenever the element
 * appears or disappears in the DOM.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   <div appDropdownMenu *ngIf="isOpen">...</div>
 */
@Directive({ selector: '[appDropdownMenu]', standalone: true })
export class DropdownMenuDirective {
  constructor(public el: ElementRef<HTMLElement>) {}
}

/**
 * DropdownDirective — the host directive that wires everything together.
 *
 * USAGE:
 *
 * ```html
 * <div appDropdown [(isOpen)]="menuOpen">
 *   <button appDropdownTrigger (click)="menuOpen = !menuOpen">Filter ▾</button>
 *   <div appDropdownMenu *ngIf="menuOpen">
 *     <div class="item" (click)="selectItem(x)">Item</div>
 *   </div>
 * </div>
 * ```
 *
 * Handles:
 *  - Registering/updating with DropdownService (including after *ngIf re-creates the menu)
 *  - Closing on outside click (via DropdownService)
 *  - NOT closing when clicking inside — no race conditions
 *  - Closing other open dropdowns when this one opens
 *  - Escape key closes
 *  - Cleanup on destroy
 */
@Directive({
  selector: '[appDropdown]',
  standalone: true,
  host: {
    '(keydown.escape)': 'close()',
  },
  exportAs: 'appDropdown',
})
export class DropdownDirective implements OnInit, AfterContentInit, AfterContentChecked, OnDestroy {
  // Bind to the host attribute name so templates can use `[appDropdown]`.
  @Input('appDropdown') isOpen = false;
  @Output() isOpenChange = new EventEmitter<boolean>();
  @Output() closed = new EventEmitter<void>();

  @ContentChild(DropdownTriggerDirective) triggerDir?: DropdownTriggerDirective;
  @ContentChild(DropdownMenuDirective) menuDir?: DropdownMenuDirective;

  private dropdownId!: string;
  private lastMenuEl: HTMLElement | null = null;

  constructor(
    private el: ElementRef<HTMLElement>,
    private dropdownService: DropdownService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.dropdownId = this.dropdownService.register(
      this.el.nativeElement,
      this.el.nativeElement,
      () => this.close(),
    );
  }

  ngAfterContentInit(): void {
    this.syncRegistration();
  }

  ngAfterContentChecked(): void {
    // Re-sync whenever *ngIf creates or destroys the menu element
    const currentMenuEl = this.menuDir?.el.nativeElement ?? null;
    if (currentMenuEl !== this.lastMenuEl) {
      this.syncRegistration();
      this.lastMenuEl = currentMenuEl;
    }
  }

  private syncRegistration(): void {
    const trigger = this.triggerDir?.el.nativeElement ?? this.el.nativeElement;
    const menu    = this.menuDir?.el.nativeElement    ?? this.el.nativeElement;
    this.dropdownService.update(this.dropdownId, trigger, menu);
  }

  open(): void {
    this.dropdownService.closeOthers(this.dropdownId);
    this.isOpen = true;
    this.isOpenChange.emit(true);
  }

  close(): void {
    if (!this.isOpen) return;
    if (this.dropdownService.isInteractionPending(this.dropdownId)) return;
    this.isOpen = false;
    this.isOpenChange.emit(false);
    this.closed.emit();
  }

  toggle(): void {
    this.isOpen ? this.close() : this.open();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.dropdownService.unregister(this.dropdownId);
  }
}

````typescript
const FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR = [
  'a[href]',
  'area[href]',
  'button:not([disabled])',
  'input:not([disabled]):not([type="hidden"])',
  'select:not([disabled])',
  'textarea:not([disabled])',
  'iframe',
  'object',
  'embed',
  '[contenteditable="true"]',
  '[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])',
].join(', ');

function isHiddenByAncestor(element: HTMLElement): boolean {
  return element.closest('[hidden], [inert], [aria-hidden="true"]') !== null;
}

function isRadioTabStop(element: HTMLElement): boolean {
  if (!(element instanceof HTMLInputElement) || element.type !== 'radio' || !element.name || element.checked) {
    return true;
  }

  const ownerDocument = element.ownerDocument;
  const escapedName = typeof CSS !== 'undefined' && typeof CSS.escape === 'function'
    ? CSS.escape(element.name)
    : element.name.replace(/([\\"'\[\]#.:])/g, '\\$1');
  const group = Array.from(ownerDocument.querySelectorAll<HTMLInputElement>(`input[type="radio"][name="${escapedName}"]`))
    .filter(radio => radio.form === element.form);

  return !group.some(radio => radio.checked);
}

export function isFocusableElement(element: HTMLElement): boolean {
  if (!element.isConnected) {
    return false;
  }

  if (element.hasAttribute('disabled') || element.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') {
    return false;
  }

  if (isHiddenByAncestor(element)) {
    return false;
  }

  if (element.tabIndex < 0) {
    return false;
  }

  const style = getComputedStyle(element);
  if (style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden' || style.visibility === 'collapse') {
    return false;
  }

  if (!isRadioTabStop(element)) {
    return false;
  }

  return element.getClientRects().length > 0;
}

export function getFocusableElements(container: HTMLElement): HTMLElement[] {
  return Array.from(container.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR))
    .filter(isFocusableElement);
}

export function focusInitialElement(container: HTMLElement, preferredSelector?: string | null): void {
  const selectorCandidates = [preferredSelector, '[data-dialog-initial-focus]', '[autofocus]']
    .filter((selector): selector is string => typeof selector === 'string' && selector.trim().length > 0);

  for (const selector of selectorCandidates) {
    const candidate = container.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector);
    if (candidate && isFocusableElement(candidate)) {
      candidate.focus();
      return;
    }
  }

  const firstFocusable = getFocusableElements(container)[0];
  if (firstFocusable) {
    firstFocusable.focus();
    return;
  }

  container.focus();
}

export function moveFocusWithin(container: HTMLElement, delta: number, selector?: string): boolean {
  const focusable = selector
    ? Array.from(container.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(selector)).filter(isFocusableElement)
    : getFocusableElements(container);
  if (focusable.length === 0) {
    container.focus();
    return false;
  }

  const activeElement = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null;
  const currentIndex = activeElement && container.contains(activeElement)
    ? focusable.indexOf(activeElement)
    : -1;

  const nextIndex = currentIndex >= 0
    ? (currentIndex + delta + focusable.length) % focusable.length
    : (delta >= 0 ? 0 : focusable.length - 1);

  focusable[nextIndex]?.focus();
  return true;
}

export function trapFocusWithin(container: HTMLElement, event: KeyboardEvent): void {
  if (event.key !== 'Tab') {
    return;
  }

  const focusable = getFocusableElements(container);
  if (focusable.length === 0) {
    event.preventDefault();
    container.focus();
    return;
  }

  const first = focusable[0];
  const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
  const activeElement = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null;
  const activeInside = activeElement ? container.contains(activeElement) : false;

  if (event.shiftKey) {
    if (!activeInside || activeElement === first) {
      event.preventDefault();
      last.focus();
    }
    return;
  }

  if (!activeInside || activeElement === last) {
    event.preventDefault();
    first.focus();
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Directive, ElementRef, Input, NgZone, OnDestroy, OnInit, Renderer2 } from '@angular/core';

export class VscodeScrollbarController {
  private readonly host: HTMLElement;
  private readonly anchor: HTMLElement;
  private scrollbarEl: HTMLElement | null = null;
  private thumbEl: HTMLElement | null = null;
  private resizeObserver: ResizeObserver | null = null;
  private mutationObserver: MutationObserver | null = null;
  private removeScrollListener: (() => void) | null = null;
  private removeMouseEnterListener: (() => void) | null = null;
  private removeMouseLeaveListener: (() => void) | null = null;
  private removeThumbPointerDownListener: (() => void) | null = null;
  private removeTrackPointerDownListener: (() => void) | null = null;
  private removeWindowPointerMoveListener: (() => void) | null = null;
  private removeWindowPointerUpListener: (() => void) | null = null;

  private dragStartY = 0;
  private dragStartScrollTop = 0;

  constructor(
    host: HTMLElement,
    private readonly renderer: Renderer2,
    private readonly ngZone: NgZone,
    anchor?: HTMLElement,
  ) {
    this.host = host;
    this.anchor = anchor ?? host.parentElement ?? host;
  }

    this.renderer.addClass(this.host, 'vsc-scroll-host');
    this.renderer.addClass(this.anchor, 'vsc-scroll-anchor');
    this.createScrollbar();
    this.bindEvents();
    this.updateScrollbar();
  }

  destroy(): void {
    this.clearShowTimeout();
    this.resizeObserver?.disconnect();
    this.mutationObserver?.disconnect();
    this.removeScrollListener?.();
    this.removeMouseEnterListener?.();
    this.removeMouseLeaveListener?.();
    this.removeThumbPointerDownListener?.();
    this.removeTrackPointerDownListener?.();
    this.removeWindowPointerMoveListener?.();
    this.removeWindowPointerUpListener?.();
    if (this.scrollbarEl) {
      this.renderer.removeChild(this.anchor, this.scrollbarEl);
      this.scrollbarEl = null;
      this.thumbEl = null;
    }
    this.renderer.removeClass(this.host, 'vsc-scroll-host');
    this.renderer.removeClass(this.anchor, 'vsc-scroll-anchor');
    this.renderer.removeClass(this.anchor, 'vsc-scroll-anchor--hover');
    this.renderer.removeClass(this.anchor, 'vsc-scroll-anchor--visible');
    this.renderer.removeClass(this.anchor, 'vsc-scroll-anchor--dragging');
  }

  update(): void {
    this.updateScrollbar();
  }

  private createScrollbar(): void {
    const scrollbar = this.renderer.createElement('div');
    const thumb = this.renderer.createElement('div');

    this.renderer.addClass(scrollbar, 'vsc-scrollbar');
    this.renderer.addClass(thumb, 'vsc-scrollbar-thumb');
    this.renderer.appendChild(scrollbar, thumb);
    this.renderer.appendChild(this.anchor, scrollbar);

    this.scrollbarEl = scrollbar;

        this.updateScrollbar();

      this.removeMouseEnterListener = this.renderer.listen(this.host, 'mouseenter', () => {
        this.renderer.addClass(this.anchor, 'vsc-scroll-anchor--hover');
        this.updateScrollbar();
        this.showScrollbarTemporarily();

        this.mutationObserver.observe(this.host, {
          childList: true,
          subtree: true,
          characterData: true,
          attributes: true,
        });
      }
    });
  }

  private updateScrollbar(): void {
    if (!this.scrollbarEl || !this.thumbEl) return;

    const clientHeight = this.host.clientHeight;
    const scrollHeight = this.host.scrollHeight;
    const maxScroll = Math.max(0, scrollHeight - clientHeight);

    if (clientHeight <= 0 || maxScroll <= 0) {
      this.renderer.setStyle(this.scrollbarEl, 'display', 'none');
      return;
    }

    this.renderer.setStyle(this.scrollbarEl, 'display', 'block');

    const hostRect = this.host.getBoundingClientRect();
    const anchorRect = this.anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
    const scrollbarWidth = 12;
    const top = Math.max(0, hostRect.top - anchorRect.top);
    const left = Math.max(0, hostRect.left - anchorRect.left + hostRect.width - scrollbarWidth);
    const height = Math.max(0, hostRect.height);

    this.renderer.setStyle(this.scrollbarEl, 'top', `${Math.round(top)}px`);
    this.renderer.setStyle(this.scrollbarEl, 'left', `${Math.round(left)}px`);
    this.renderer.setStyle(this.scrollbarEl, 'height', `${Math.round(height)}px`);
    this.renderer.removeStyle(this.scrollbarEl, 'right');
    this.renderer.removeStyle(this.scrollbarEl, 'bottom');

    const trackHeight = this.scrollbarEl.clientHeight;
    const thumbHeight = Math.max(20, Math.round((clientHeight / scrollHeight) * trackHeight));
    const maxThumbOffset = Math.max(0, trackHeight - thumbHeight);
    const thumbOffset = maxScroll > 0 ? (this.host.scrollTop / maxScroll) * maxThumbOffset : 0;

    this.renderer.setStyle(this.thumbEl, 'height', `${thumbHeight}px`);
    this.renderer.setStyle(this.thumbEl, 'transform', `translateY(${Math.round(thumbOffset)}px)`);
  }

  private showScrollbarTemporarily(): void {
    this.renderer.addClass(this.anchor, 'vsc-scroll-anchor--visible');
    this.clearShowTimeout();
    this.showTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      if (!this.dragging) this.renderer.removeClass(this.anchor, 'vsc-scroll-anchor--visible');
    }, 700);
  }

  private clearShowTimeout(): void {
    if (this.showTimeout) {
      clearTimeout(this.showTimeout);
      this.showTimeout = null;
    }
  }
}

@Directive({
  selector: '[appVscodeScrollbar]',
  standalone: true,
})
export class VscodeScrollbarDirective implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  private readonly host: HTMLElement;
  private controller: VscodeScrollbarController | null = null;

  @Input() appVscodeScrollbarAnchor: 'parent' | 'self' = 'parent';

  constructor(
    elementRef: ElementRef<HTMLElement>,
    private renderer: Renderer2,
    private ngZone: NgZone,
  ) {
    this.host = elementRef.nativeElement;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.controller = new VscodeScrollbarController(
      this.host,
      this.renderer,
      this.ngZone,
      this.appVscodeScrollbarAnchor === 'self' ? this.host : undefined,
    );
    this.controller.init();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.controller?.destroy();
    this.controller = null;
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { ArchiveListing } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { PARENT_ENTRY_PATH } from '../components/file-entry.component';

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   TYPES
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

export interface ArchiveFrame {
  fsPath: string;
  nestedChain: string[];
  innerPath: string;
  listing: ArchiveListing;
}

export interface ArchiveBrowseTarget {
  frame: ArchiveFrame;
  browseChain: string[];
  browseInnerPath: string;
}

export interface ArchiveEntriesRequest {
  fsPath: string;
  nestedChain: string[];
  entries: string[];
  stripPrefix?: string;
  destinationDir: string;
  flattenPaths: boolean;
}

export interface ArchiveEntriesResult {
  operationId: string;
  total: number;
  succeeded: number;
  failed: number;
  sourceRemoved: boolean;
  errors?: Array<{ source: string; error: string }>;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   HELPERS
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

// FIX: added .tbz2 and .txz which the tar handler registers but were missing,
// causing those files to be treated as plain files and nested-chain parsing to
// break for paths containing them.
export function isArchive(name: string): boolean {
  const l = name.toLowerCase();
  return (
    l.endsWith('.zip') ||
    l.endsWith('.tar') ||
    l.endsWith('.tgz') ||
    l.endsWith('.tar.gz') ||
    l.endsWith('.tar.bz2') ||
    l.endsWith('.tbz2') ||    // added
    l.endsWith('.tar.xz') ||
    l.endsWith('.txz') ||     // added
    l.endsWith('.gz') ||
    l.endsWith('.bz2') ||
    l.endsWith('.xz') ||
    l.endsWith('.rar') ||
    l.endsWith('.7z')
  );
}

export function buildArchiveDisplayPath(
  rootFsPath: string,
  stack: ArchiveFrame[]
): string {
  if (stack.length === 0) return rootFsPath;

  const frame = stack[stack.length - 1];
  const archiveFsPath = stack[0].fsPath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
  const parts = [archiveFsPath, ...frame.nestedChain];

  if (frame.innerPath)
    parts.push(frame.innerPath);

  return parts.join('/').replace(/\/+/g, '/');
}

export function buildArchiveTabTitle(
  rootFsPath: string,
  stack: ArchiveFrame[]
): string {

  if (stack.length === 0)
    return rootFsPath.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() ?? rootFsPath;

  const frame = stack[stack.length - 1];

  if (frame.innerPath)
    return frame.innerPath.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() ?? frame.innerPath;

  if (frame.nestedChain.length > 0)
    return frame.nestedChain[frame.nestedChain.length - 1];

  return rootFsPath.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() ?? rootFsPath;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   WAILS BRIDGE
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

declare const window: any;

async function goBrowse(
  fsPath: string,
  nestedChain: string[],
  innerPath: string
): Promise<ArchiveListing> {

  const app = window.go?.app?.App;
  if (!app) throw new Error('Wails bridge not available');

  return app.ArchiveBrowse(fsPath, nestedChain, innerPath);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   PATH UTILITIES
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * Decomposes a global archive path like
 *   "filesystem://c/foo/bar.zip/nested.zip/dir/file.txt"
 * into the three components expected by the backend:
 *   fsPath      = "filesystem://c/foo/bar.zip"
 *   nestedChain = ["nested.zip"]
 *   innerPath   = "dir/file.txt"
 */
export function parseArchivePath(globalPath: string): { fsPath: string; nestedChain: string[]; innerPath: string } {
  const norm = globalPath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
  const parts = norm.split('/');

  const firstIdx = parts.findIndex(p => isArchive(p));
  if (firstIdx === -1) return { fsPath: globalPath, nestedChain: [], innerPath: '' };

  const fsPath = parts.slice(0, firstIdx + 1).join('/');
  const rest = parts.slice(firstIdx + 1);

  // Accumulate segments; each time we hit an archive name it closes a nestedChain entry.
  const nestedChain: string[] = [];
  const accum: string[] = [];
  for (const seg of rest) {
    accum.push(seg);
    if (isArchive(seg)) {
      nestedChain.push(accum.join('/'));
      accum.length = 0;
    }
  }
  return { fsPath, nestedChain, innerPath: accum.join('/') };
}

/**
 * Builds a global archive path from its three components.
 * Empty parts are omitted so trailing slashes are avoided.
 */
export function buildArchivePath(fsPath: string, nestedChain: string[], innerPath: string): string {
  return [fsPath.replace(/\\/g, '/'), ...nestedChain, innerPath]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join('/')
    .replace(/\/+/g, '/');
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   SERVICE
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ArchiveService {
  /**
   * Extracts entries from an archive. If the user selects all top-level entries (the root),
   * it uses BatchExtract for efficiency. Otherwise, it uses BatchSelectiveExtract for a subset.
   * @param frame The current archive frame
   * @param entries The selected entry paths (relative to the archive root)
   * @param destDir The destination directory for extraction
   * @param flattenPaths Whether to flatten extracted paths
   */
  async extractEntries(
    frame: ArchiveFrame,
    entries: string[],
    destDir: string,
    flattenPaths = false
  ): Promise<any> {
    // 1. Filter out the ".." parent entry
    const filteredEntries = entries.filter(e => e !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH);
    
    // 2. Get all entries currently visible in this frame
    const allInView = frame.listing.entries
      .map(e => e.path)
      .filter(e => e !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH);

    // 3. Check if we are at the true root of the physical archive
    const isAtArchiveRoot = frame.nestedChain.length === 0 && !frame.innerPath;

    // 4. Check if everything in the current view is selected
    const isAllSelected = 
      filteredEntries.length > 0 &&
      filteredEntries.length === allInView.length &&
      filteredEntries.every(e => allInView.includes(e));

    // Fallback to BatchExtract ONLY if at the root and everything is selected
    if (isAtArchiveRoot && isAllSelected) {
      return window.go.app.App.BatchExtract({
        archives: [frame.fsPath],
        destinationDir: destDir,
        createSubdirectory: false,
        expandNestedArchives: false,
        flattenSingleRoot: flattenPaths,
      });
    } 
    
    // Otherwise, use Selective Extraction to ensure only the 
    // contents of the current folder/selection are processed
    return window.go.app.App.BatchSelectiveExtract({
      items: [
        {
          archivePath: frame.fsPath,
          nestedChain: frame.nestedChain,
          entries: filteredEntries,
          stripPrefix: frame.innerPath || '',
          destinationDir: destDir,
          flattenPaths,
        },
      ],
      destinationDir: destDir,
    });
  }

  /* ─────────────── OPEN ─────────────── */

  async openRootArchive(fsPath: string): Promise<ArchiveFrame> {
    const listing = await goBrowse(fsPath, [], '');
    return { fsPath, nestedChain: [], innerPath: '', listing };
  }

  async openNestedArchive(
    frame: ArchiveFrame,
    entryNestedChain: string[]
  ): Promise<ArchiveFrame> {

    const listing = await goBrowse(
      frame.fsPath,
      entryNestedChain,
      ''
    );

    return {
      fsPath: frame.fsPath,
      nestedChain: entryNestedChain,
      innerPath: '',
      listing
    };
  }

  /* ─────────────── NAVIGATION ─────────────── */

  async navigateInto(
    frame: ArchiveFrame,
    folderInnerPath: string
  ): Promise<ArchiveFrame> {

    const listing = await goBrowse(
      frame.fsPath,
      frame.nestedChain,
      folderInnerPath
    );

    return { ...frame, innerPath: folderInnerPath, listing };
  }

  async navigateUp(frame: ArchiveFrame): Promise<ArchiveFrame | null> {

    if (!frame.innerPath)
      return null;

    const parentInnerPath = frame.innerPath.includes('/')
      ? frame.innerPath.replace(/\/[^/]+$/, '')
      : '';

    const listing = await goBrowse(
      frame.fsPath,
      frame.nestedChain,
      parentInnerPath
    );

    return { ...frame, innerPath: parentInnerPath, listing };
  }

  /* ─────────────── UNIVERSAL RESOLVER ─────────────── */

  resolveBrowseTarget(
    seg: { name: string; fullPath: string },
    stack: ArchiveFrame[]
  ): ArchiveBrowseTarget | null {

    if (!stack?.length)
      return null;

    const archiveBase = stack[0].fsPath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
    const vNorm = seg.fullPath.replace(/\\/g, '/');

    const afterArchive = vNorm.startsWith(archiveBase)
      ? vNorm.slice(archiveBase.length).replace(/^\/+/, '')
      : '';

    const parts = afterArchive.split('/').filter(Boolean);

    let owningFrame = stack[0];

    for (const frame of stack) {

      const chain = frame.nestedChain;

      const matches =
        chain.length <= parts.length &&
        chain.every((c, i) => c === parts[i]);

      if (matches && chain.length >= owningFrame.nestedChain.length)
        owningFrame = frame;
    }

    const chain = owningFrame.nestedChain;
    let innerParts = parts.slice(chain.length);

    if (isArchive(seg.name))
      innerParts = innerParts.slice(1);

    return {
      frame: owningFrame,
      browseChain: chain,
      browseInnerPath: innerParts.join('/')
    };
  }

  /* ─────────────── OPERATIONS ─────────────── */

  copy(
    frame: ArchiveFrame,
    entries: string[],
    destDir: string,
    flattenPaths = false,
  ): Promise<ArchiveEntriesResult> {

    const req: ArchiveEntriesRequest = {
      fsPath: frame.fsPath,
      nestedChain: frame.nestedChain,
      entries,
      stripPrefix: frame.innerPath || '',
      destinationDir: destDir,
      flattenPaths,
    };

    return window.go.app.App.ArchiveCopyEntries(req);
  }

  move(
    frame: ArchiveFrame,
    entries: string[],
    destDir: string,
    flattenPaths = false,
  ): Promise<ArchiveEntriesResult> {

    const req: ArchiveEntriesRequest = {
      fsPath: frame.fsPath,
      nestedChain: frame.nestedChain,
      entries,
      stripPrefix: frame.innerPath || '',
      destinationDir: destDir,
      flattenPaths,
    };

    return window.go.app.App.ArchiveMoveEntries(req);
  }

  delete(
    frame: ArchiveFrame,
    entries: string[],
  ): Promise<ArchiveEntriesResult> {

    if (frame.nestedChain.length > 0) {
      return Promise.reject(new Error(
        'Deleting entries from nested archives is not supported. ' +
        'Navigate to the top-level archive first.'
      ));
    }

    const req: ArchiveEntriesRequest = {
      fsPath: frame.fsPath,
      nestedChain: [],
      entries,
      destinationDir: '',
      flattenPaths: false,
    };

    return window.go.app.App.ArchiveDeleteEntries(req);
  }

  copyByContext(
    archivePath: string,
    innerPaths: string[],
    destDir: string,
  ): Promise<ArchiveEntriesResult> {
    const { fsPath, nestedChain } = parseArchivePath(archivePath);
    const req: ArchiveEntriesRequest = {
      fsPath,
      nestedChain,
      entries: innerPaths,
      stripPrefix: '',
      destinationDir: destDir,
      flattenPaths: false,
    };
    return window.go.app.App.ArchiveCopyEntries(req);
  }

  moveByContext(
    archivePath: string,
    innerPaths: string[],
    destDir: string,
  ): Promise<ArchiveEntriesResult> {
    const { fsPath, nestedChain } = parseArchivePath(archivePath);
    const req: ArchiveEntriesRequest = {
      fsPath,
      nestedChain,
      entries: innerPaths,
      stripPrefix: '',
      destinationDir: destDir,
      flattenPaths: false,
    };
    return window.go.app.App.ArchiveMoveEntries(req);
  }

  /* ─────────────── UTILITIES ─────────────── */

  async refreshFrame(frame: ArchiveFrame): Promise<ArchiveFrame> {

    const listing = await goBrowse(
      frame.fsPath,
      frame.nestedChain,
      frame.innerPath
    );

    return { ...frame, listing };
  }

  listingToFileInfos(listing: ArchiveListing): FileInfo[] {

    const dotdot: FileInfo = {
      name: '..',
      path: PARENT_ENTRY_PATH,
      type: FileType.DIRECTORY,
      size: 0,
      modified: 0,
      created: 0,
      accessed: 0,
      permissions: 'drwxr-xr-x',
      isHidden: false,
    };

    const entries: FileInfo[] =
      listing.entries.map(e => ({
        name: e.name,
        path: e.path,
        type: e.type as FileType,
        size: e.size,
        modified: e.modified, // already UnixMilli from backend
        created: e.modified,
        accessed: e.modified,
        permissions:
          e.type === FileType.DIRECTORY
            ? 'drwxr-xr-x'
            : '-rw-r--r--',
        isHidden: e.name.startsWith('.'),
        // FIX: nestedChain is now populated for archive entries by the backend
        // (convertVFSInfoWithChain / vfsEntryToFileInfo) for all formats.
        nestedChain: (e as any).nestedChain ?? undefined,
      }));

    return [dotdot, ...entries];
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

import { FileType, type ArchiveListing, type FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import type { PathSegment } from '../components/address-bar.types';
import { buildSegments as buildBasicSegments, buildSegmentsFromParsedPath, isAliasPath, normalizePath, parentPath, parsePathWithArchives } from '../components/address-bar.utils';
import { ArchiveService, type ArchiveBrowseTarget, type ArchiveFrame, isArchive } from './archive.service';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import { REGISTRY_ROOT, RegistryService, isRegistryPath, type RegistryFrame } from './registry.service';

export interface DirectorySourceListing {
  path: string;
  entries: FileInfo[];
}

export type DirectorySourceKind = 'filesystem' | 'registry';

interface DirectoryListingProvider {
  readonly kind: DirectorySourceKind;
  canHandlePath(path: string): boolean;
  canHandleEntries(entries: FileInfo[]): boolean;
  listDirectory(path: string, showHidden: boolean): Promise<DirectorySourceListing>;
  getRootPath(path: string): string | null;
  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string;
  supportsStreaming(path: string): boolean;
}

export interface FileViewDirectorySource {
  listDirectory(path: string, showHidden?: boolean): Promise<DirectorySourceListing>;
  browseArchive(fsPath: string, nestedChain?: string[], innerPath?: string): Promise<ArchiveListing>;
  getArchiveFrame(fsPath: string, nestedChain?: string[], innerPath?: string): Promise<ArchiveFrame>;
  openNestedArchive(frame: ArchiveFrame, nestedChain: string[]): Promise<ArchiveFrame>;
  navigateArchive(frame: ArchiveFrame, folderInnerPath: string): Promise<ArchiveFrame>;
  navigateArchiveUp(frame: ArchiveFrame): Promise<ArchiveFrame | null>;
  refreshArchive(frame: ArchiveFrame): Promise<ArchiveFrame>;
  resolveArchiveBrowseTarget(seg: { name: string; fullPath: string }, stack: ArchiveFrame[]): ArchiveBrowseTarget | null;
  archiveListingToFileInfos(listing: ArchiveListing): FileInfo[];
  getPathKind(path: string, entries?: FileInfo[]): DirectorySourceKind;
  getRootPath(path: string, entries?: FileInfo[]): string | null;
  getParentPath(path: string): string;
  isRootPath(path: string): boolean;
  isPathInsideArchive(path: string): boolean;
  buildPathSegments(path: string): PathSegment[];
  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string;
  supportsStreaming(path: string): boolean;
}

function isWebHttpPath(path: string): boolean {
  const normalized = normalizePath(path);
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(normalized);
    return (parsed.protocol === 'http:' || parsed.protocol === 'https:') && parsed.host.length > 0;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function looksLikeHtmlDocument(content: string): boolean {
  const sample = (content || '').trimStart().slice(0, 512).toLowerCase();
  return sample.startsWith('<!doctype html') ||
    sample.startsWith('<html') ||
    sample.includes('<head') ||
    sample.includes('<body');
}

function canonicalizeWebUrl(raw: string): string {
  const parsed = new URL(raw);
  parsed.protocol = parsed.protocol.toLowerCase();
  parsed.host = parsed.host.toLowerCase();
  parsed.hash = '';
  parsed.pathname = parsed.pathname.replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (parsed.pathname === '/') {
    parsed.pathname = '';
  } else {
    parsed.pathname = parsed.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '');
  }
  return parsed.toString();
}

function isLikelyWebPage(pathname: string): boolean {
  if (!pathname || pathname.endsWith('/')) {
    return true;
  }

  const match = /\.([^.\/]+)$/.exec(pathname);
  const ext = match?.[1]?.toLowerCase() || '';
  return ext === '' || [
    'html', 'htm', 'xhtml', 'shtml', 'php', 'asp', 'aspx', 'jsp', 'jspx', 'cfm',
  ].includes(ext);
}

function webEntryDisplayName(target: URL): string {
  const trimmedPath = target.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '').replace(/^\/+/, '');
  if (!trimmedPath) {
    return target.search ? `${target.host}${target.search}` : target.host;
  }

  const segments = trimmedPath.split('/');
  const base = segments[segments.length - 1] || target.host;
  return target.search ? `${base}${target.search}` : base;
}

function parseSrcset(value: string | null): string[] {
  if (!value) return [];
  return value
    .split(',')
    .map((part) => part.trim().split(/\s+/)[0] || '')
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function resolveWebReference(baseUrl: URL, rawRef: string | null): URL | null {
  const ref = (rawRef || '').trim();
  if (!ref) return null;

  const lower = ref.toLowerCase();
  if (
    lower.startsWith('#') ||
    lower.startsWith('javascript:') ||
    lower.startsWith('mailto:') ||
    lower.startsWith('tel:') ||
    lower.startsWith('data:')
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const resolved = new URL(ref, baseUrl);
    if (resolved.protocol !== 'http:' && resolved.protocol !== 'https:') {
      return null;
    }
    resolved.hash = '';
    return resolved;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function makeWebEntry(path: string, type: FileType): FileInfo {
  const target = new URL(path);
  return {
    name: webEntryDisplayName(target),
    path,
    type,
    size: 0,
    modified: 0,
    mimeType: '',
    isHidden: false,
  } as FileInfo;
}

function discoverWebEntriesFromHtml(content: string, pageUrl: string): FileInfo[] {
  let currentUrl: URL;
  try {
    currentUrl = new URL(canonicalizeWebUrl(pageUrl));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }

  const parser = new DOMParser();
  const document = parser.parseFromString(content, 'text/html');

  const baseHref = document.querySelector('base[href]')?.getAttribute('href') || null;
  const baseUrl = resolveWebReference(currentUrl, baseHref) || currentUrl;

  const entries = new Map<string, FileInfo>();
  const addEntry = (rawRef: string | null, navigable: boolean): void => {
    const resolved = resolveWebReference(baseUrl, rawRef);
    if (!resolved) return;

    if (resolved.search) {
      return;
    }

    const normalized = canonicalizeWebUrl(resolved.toString());
    if (normalized === currentUrl.toString() || entries.has(normalized)) {
      return;
    }

    const type = navigable && isLikelyWebPage(resolved.pathname)
      ? FileType.DIRECTORY
      : FileType.FILE;
    entries.set(normalized, makeWebEntry(normalized, type));
  };

  document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach((node) => addEntry(node.getAttribute('href'), true));

  return Array.from(entries.values()).sort((left, right) => left.path.localeCompare(right.path));
}

function trimPathForChild(basePath: string): string {
  const normalized = normalizePath(basePath || '/');
  return /^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\/$/i.test(normalized)
    ? normalized
    : normalized.replace(/\/+$/, '');
}

class FilesystemDirectoryProvider implements DirectoryListingProvider {
  readonly kind: DirectorySourceKind = 'filesystem';

  constructor(private readonly apiService: ApiService) {}

  canHandlePath(_path: string): boolean {
    return true;
  }

  canHandleEntries(_entries: FileInfo[]): boolean {
    return false;
  }

  listDirectory(path: string, showHidden: boolean): Promise<DirectorySourceListing> {
    return this.apiService.listDirectory(path, showHidden);
  }

  getRootPath(path: string): string | null {
    const normalized = normalizePath(path || '/');
    const driveMatch = /^(?:filesystem|drive):\/\/([a-z])(?:\/.*)?$/i.exec(normalized);
    if (driveMatch) return `filesystem://${driveMatch[1].toLowerCase()}`;
    const aliasMatch = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(normalized);
    if (aliasMatch) return `${aliasMatch[1].toLowerCase()}://`;
    return '/';
  }

  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    const trimmedBase = trimPathForChild(basePath);
    return `${trimmedBase}/${childName}`;
  }

  supportsStreaming(_path: string): boolean {
    return true;
  }
}

class AliasDirectoryProvider implements DirectoryListingProvider {
  readonly kind: DirectorySourceKind = 'filesystem';

  constructor(private readonly apiService: ApiService) {}

  canHandlePath(path: string): boolean {
    return isAliasPath(path) && !isRegistryPath(path);
  }

  canHandleEntries(_entries: FileInfo[]): boolean {
    return false;
  }

  listDirectory(path: string, showHidden: boolean): Promise<DirectorySourceListing> {
    return this.apiService.listDirectory(path, showHidden);
  }

  getRootPath(path: string): string | null {
    const normalized = normalizePath(path);
    if (/^search:\/\//i.test(normalized) && normalized.toLowerCase() !== 'search://') {
      return normalized;
    }
    if (isWebHttpPath(normalized)) {
      try {
        const parsed = new URL(normalized);
        return `${parsed.protocol.toLowerCase()}//${parsed.host.toLowerCase()}`;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    }
    const aliasMatch = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(normalized);
    return aliasMatch ? `${aliasMatch[1].toLowerCase()}://` : null;
  }

  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    const normalizedBase = trimPathForChild(basePath);
    return `${normalizedBase}/${childName}`;
  }

  supportsStreaming(_path: string): boolean {
    return /^search:\/\//i.test(_path);
  }
}

class RegistryDirectoryProvider implements DirectoryListingProvider {
  readonly kind: DirectorySourceKind = 'registry';

  constructor(private readonly registryService: RegistryService) {}

  canHandlePath(path: string): boolean {
    return isRegistryPath(path);
  }

  canHandleEntries(entries: FileInfo[]): boolean {
    return entries.some((entry) =>
      entry.path !== '__parent__' &&
      (isRegistryPath(entry.path) || !!entry.registryKind || !!entry.registryValueType || !!entry.registryPreview),
    );
  }

  async listDirectory(path: string, _showHidden: boolean): Promise<DirectorySourceListing> {
    const frame: RegistryFrame = path === REGISTRY_ROOT
      ? await this.registryService.openRoot()
      : await this.registryService.navigateInto(path);

    return {
      path: frame.path,
      entries: frame.entries,
    };
  }

  getRootPath(_path: string): string | null {
    return REGISTRY_ROOT;
  }

  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    if (basePath === REGISTRY_ROOT) {
      return `${REGISTRY_ROOT}${childName}`;
    }
    return `${trimPathForChild(basePath)}/${childName}`;
  }

  supportsStreaming(_path: string): boolean {
    return false;
  }
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class DirectorySourceService implements FileViewDirectorySource {
  private readonly providers: DirectoryListingProvider[];

  constructor(
    private readonly apiService: ApiService,
    private readonly archiveService: ArchiveService,
    private readonly registryService: RegistryService,
  ) {
    this.providers = [
      new RegistryDirectoryProvider(this.registryService),
      new AliasDirectoryProvider(this.apiService),
      new FilesystemDirectoryProvider(this.apiService),
    ];
  }

  async listDirectory(path: string, showHidden: boolean = false): Promise<DirectorySourceListing> {
    return this.providerForPath(path).listDirectory(path, showHidden);
  }

  async browseArchive(fsPath: string, nestedChain: string[] = [], innerPath: string = ''): Promise<ArchiveListing> {
    return this.apiService.archiveBrowse(fsPath, nestedChain, innerPath);
  }

  async getArchiveFrame(fsPath: string, nestedChain: string[] = [], innerPath: string = ''): Promise<ArchiveFrame> {
    let frame = await this.archiveService.openRootArchive(fsPath);

    for (let index = 0; index < nestedChain.length; index += 1) {
      frame = await this.archiveService.openNestedArchive(frame, nestedChain.slice(0, index + 1));
    }

    if (innerPath) {
      frame = await this.archiveService.navigateInto(frame, innerPath);
    }

    return frame;
  }

  openNestedArchive(frame: ArchiveFrame, nestedChain: string[]): Promise<ArchiveFrame> {
    return this.archiveService.openNestedArchive(frame, nestedChain);
  }

  navigateArchive(frame: ArchiveFrame, folderInnerPath: string): Promise<ArchiveFrame> {
    return this.archiveService.navigateInto(frame, folderInnerPath);
  }

  navigateArchiveUp(frame: ArchiveFrame): Promise<ArchiveFrame | null> {
    return this.archiveService.navigateUp(frame);
  }

  refreshArchive(frame: ArchiveFrame): Promise<ArchiveFrame> {
    return this.archiveService.refreshFrame(frame);
  }

  resolveArchiveBrowseTarget(seg: { name: string; fullPath: string }, stack: ArchiveFrame[]): ArchiveBrowseTarget | null {
    return this.archiveService.resolveBrowseTarget(seg, stack);
  }

  archiveListingToFileInfos(listing: ArchiveListing): FileInfo[] {
    return this.archiveService.listingToFileInfos(listing);
  }

  getPathKind(path: string, entries: FileInfo[] = []): DirectorySourceKind {
    return this.providerFor(path, entries).kind;
  }

  getRootPath(path: string, entries: FileInfo[] = []): string | null {
    return this.providerFor(path, entries).getRootPath(path);
  }

  getParentPath(path: string): string {
    const normalized = normalizePath(path);
    const { fsDirPath, archiveInnerParts } = parsePathWithArchives(normalized);

    if (archiveInnerParts.length > 0) {
      const parentInnerParts = archiveInnerParts.slice(0, -1);
      return parentInnerParts.length > 0
        ? normalizePath(`${fsDirPath}/${parentInnerParts.join('/')}`)
        : fsDirPath;
    }

    return parentPath(normalized);
  }

  isRootPath(path: string): boolean {
    const normalized = normalizePath(path);
    if (this.isPathInsideArchive(normalized)) {
      return false;
    }

    const rootPath = this.getRootPath(normalized);
    return !!rootPath && normalized === normalizePath(rootPath);
  }

  isPathInsideArchive(path: string): boolean {
    const normalized = normalizePath(path);
    if (isRegistryPath(normalized)) {
      return false;
    }

    const { fsDirPath } = parsePathWithArchives(normalized);
    const leafName = fsDirPath.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() ?? '';
    return isArchive(leafName);
  }

  buildPathSegments(path: string): PathSegment[] {
    const normalized = normalizePath(path);
    const { fsDirPath, archiveInnerParts } = parsePathWithArchives(normalized);
    const baseSegments = archiveInnerParts.length > 0
      ? buildSegmentsFromParsedPath(fsDirPath, archiveInnerParts)
      : buildBasicSegments(normalized);

    let insideArchive = false;
    return baseSegments.map((segment) => {
      const isArchiveRoot = isArchive(segment.label);
      const nextSegment: PathSegment = {
        ...segment,
        isArchiveRoot,
        isArchiveInner: insideArchive,
      };
      if (isArchiveRoot) {
        insideArchive = true;
      }
      return nextSegment;
    });
  }

  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    return this.providerForPath(basePath).joinChildPath(basePath, childName);
  }

  supportsStreaming(path: string): boolean {
    return this.providerForPath(path).supportsStreaming(path);
  }

  private providerFor(path: string, entries: FileInfo[] = []): DirectoryListingProvider {
    const entryMatch = this.providers.find((provider) => provider.canHandleEntries(entries));
    if (entryMatch) return entryMatch;
    return this.providerForPath(path);
  }

  private providerForPath(path: string): DirectoryListingProvider {
    return this.providers.find((provider) => provider.canHandlePath(path)) ?? this.providers[this.providers.length - 1];
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';

/**
 * DropdownService — centralized manager for all dropdown open/close logic.
 *
 * ROOT CAUSE IT SOLVES:
 *   The classic race condition:
 *   1. User clicks a menu item
 *   2. `document:click` fires and closes the dropdown (isOpen = false)
 *   3. `*ngIf="isOpen"` destroys the DOM
 *   4. The item's `(click)` handler never fires — element is gone
 *
 * HOW IT WORKS:
 *   - Uses a `mousedown` listener on `document` (fires BEFORE click, blur, focus)
 *   - When mousedown fires, checks if the target is inside any registered dropdown
 *   - If inside → marks that dropdown as "interaction pending" (do NOT close)
 *   - The dropdown's own close logic checks this flag before closing
 *   - After the click fully resolves, the flag is cleared
 *
 * USAGE:
 *   1. Inject DropdownService into your component
 *   2. In your open logic: this.dropdownService.register(this.triggerEl, this.menuEl, () => this.close())
 *   3. In your close logic: if (this.dropdownService.isInteractionPending(id)) return;
 *   4. On destroy: this.dropdownService.unregister(id)
 *
 *   OR use the companion `appDropdown` directive for zero-boilerplate usage.
 */
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class DropdownService implements OnDestroy {
  private dropdowns = new Map<string, {
    trigger: Element;
    menu: Element;
    close: () => void;
  }>();

  private pendingId: string | null = null;
  private idCounter = 0;

  constructor() {
    // Use capture: true + mousedown so we run BEFORE any component sees the event
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', this.onGlobalMousedown, { capture: true });
    document.addEventListener('click', this.onGlobalClick, { capture: true });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    document.removeEventListener('mousedown', this.onGlobalMousedown, { capture: true } as any);
    document.removeEventListener('click', this.onGlobalClick, { capture: true } as any);
  }

  /**
   * Register a dropdown. Returns a unique ID for this registration.
   *
   * @param trigger  The button/anchor that opens the dropdown
   * @param menu     The dropdown panel element
   * @param close    Callback to close this dropdown
   */
  register(trigger: Element, menu: Element, close: () => void): string {
    const id = `dd-${++this.idCounter}`;
    this.dropdowns.set(id, { trigger, menu, close });
    return id;
  }

  /** Update references after DOM changes (e.g. after *ngIf re-creates menu) */
  update(id: string, trigger: Element, menu: Element): void {
    const entry = this.dropdowns.get(id);
    if (entry) {
      entry.trigger = trigger;
      entry.menu = menu;
    }
  }

  unregister(id: string): void {
    this.dropdowns.delete(id);
    if (this.pendingId === id) this.pendingId = null;
  }

  /**
   * True if the user is currently clicking INSIDE this dropdown's menu.
   * Your close() logic should bail out if this returns true.
   */
  isInteractionPending(id: string): boolean {
    return this.pendingId === id;
  }

  /**
   * Close all other open dropdowns (pass the id of the one being opened).
   * Call this when opening a dropdown so others close.
   */
  closeOthers(exceptId: string): void {
    this.dropdowns.forEach((entry, id) => {
      if (id !== exceptId) entry.close();
    });
  }

  private onGlobalMousedown = (event: MouseEvent): void => {
    const target = event.target as Node;
    this.pendingId = null;

    for (const [id, { trigger, menu, close }] of this.dropdowns) {
      const inTrigger = trigger.contains(target);
      const inMenu = menu.contains(target);

      if (inMenu) {
        // User is clicking inside a menu — mark as pending so close() skips
        this.pendingId = id;
        return; // don't close anything
      }

      if (!inTrigger && !inMenu) {
        // Click is fully outside this dropdown — close it
        close();
      }
    }
  };

  private onGlobalClick = (_event: MouseEvent): void => {
    // Clear the pending flag after the full click cycle completes
    // Use a microtask so item (click) handlers still fire first
    Promise.resolve().then(() => { this.pendingId = null; });
  };
}
````
