````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { FileInfo, FileProbe, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';

type ResolvedCategoryId = 'code' | 'video';
type CollisionExtension = 'ts' | 'mts';

interface CollisionResolutionContext {
  entry: FileInfo;
  probe(): Promise<FileProbe>;
}

interface CollisionSpec {
  fallback: ResolvedCategoryId;
  resolve: (ctx: CollisionResolutionContext) => Promise<ResolvedCategoryId>;
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class FileCategoryResolverService {
  private readonly resolvedByPath = new Map<string, ResolvedCategoryId>();
  private readonly pendingPaths = new Set<string>();
  private readonly listenersByPath = new Map<string, Set<() => void>>();
  private readonly collisionSpecs: Record<CollisionExtension, CollisionSpec> = {
    ts: {
      fallback: 'code',
      resolve: (ctx) => this.resolveTypeScriptOrTransportStream(ctx),
    },
    mts: {
      fallback: 'code',
      resolve: (ctx) => this.resolveTypeScriptOrTransportStream(ctx),
    },
  };

  constructor(private readonly api: ApiService) {}

  getResolvedCategory(path: string): ResolvedCategoryId | undefined {
    return this.resolvedByPath.get(path);
  }

  watch(path: string, listener: () => void): () => void {
    let listeners = this.listenersByPath.get(path);
    if (!listeners) {
      listeners = new Set();
      this.listenersByPath.set(path, listeners);
    }
    listeners.add(listener);

    return () => {
      const current = this.listenersByPath.get(path);
      if (!current) return;
      current.delete(listener);
      if (!current.size) {
        this.listenersByPath.delete(path);
      }
    };
  }

  ensureResolved(entry: FileInfo | null | undefined): void {
    const extension = this.getCollisionExtension(entry);
    if (!entry || !extension) return;
    if (this.resolvedByPath.has(entry.path)) return;

    const immediate = this.getImmediateResolution(entry, extension);
    if (immediate) {
      this.resolvedByPath.set(entry.path, immediate);
      this.notify(entry.path);
      return;
    }

    if (this.pendingPaths.has(entry.path)) return;

    this.pendingPaths.add(entry.path);
    void this.resolveAndCache(entry, extension);
  }

  private getCollisionExtension(entry: FileInfo | null | undefined): CollisionExtension | null {
    if (!entry || entry.type !== FileType.FILE || !entry.path) return null;
    const extension = this.getExtension(entry.name);
    return extension === 'ts' || extension === 'mts' ? extension : null;
  }

  private async resolveAndCache(entry: FileInfo, extension: CollisionExtension): Promise<void> {
    const spec = this.collisionSpecs[extension];
    let resolved = spec.fallback;

    try {
      const context = this.createResolutionContext(entry, extension);
      resolved = await spec.resolve(context);
    } catch {
      resolved = spec.fallback;
    } finally {
      this.pendingPaths.delete(entry.path);
      this.resolvedByPath.set(entry.path, resolved);
      this.notify(entry.path);
    }
  }

  private createResolutionContext(entry: FileInfo, extension: CollisionExtension): CollisionResolutionContext {
    let probePromise: Promise<FileProbe> | null = null;

    return {
      entry,
      probe: () => {
        probePromise ??= this.api.probeFile(entry.path);
        return probePromise;
      },
    };
  }

  private getImmediateResolution(entry: FileInfo, extension: CollisionExtension): ResolvedCategoryId | null {
    const fromMimeType = this.getResolutionFromMimeType(entry.mimeType);
    if (fromMimeType) {
      return fromMimeType;
    }

    if (this.isWebHttpPath(entry.path)) {
      return this.collisionSpecs[extension].fallback;
    }

    return null;
  }

  private getResolutionFromMimeType(mimeType: string | null | undefined): ResolvedCategoryId | null {
    const mime = (mimeType ?? '').split(';', 1)[0].trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!mime) {
      return null;
    }
    if (mime === 'video/mp2t' || mime === 'application/mp2t') {
      return 'video';
    }
    if (
      mime.startsWith('text/') ||
      mime.includes('typescript') ||
      mime.includes('javascript') ||
      mime === 'application/json' ||
      mime === 'application/xml'
    ) {
      return 'code';
    }
    return null;
  }

  private async resolveTypeScriptOrTransportStream(ctx: CollisionResolutionContext): Promise<ResolvedCategoryId> {
    const probe = await ctx.probe();
    return this.looksLikeTransportStream(probe) ? 'video' : 'code';
  }

  private looksLikeTransportStream(probe: FileProbe): boolean {
    const mime = (probe.mimeType ?? '').split(';', 1)[0].trim().toLowerCase();
    return mime === 'video/mp2t' || mime === 'application/mp2t' || !probe.isText;
  }

  private getExtension(name: string | null | undefined): string {
    const value = (name ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const lastDot = value.lastIndexOf('.');
    return lastDot >= 0 ? value.slice(lastDot + 1) : '';
  }

  private isWebHttpPath(path: string | null | undefined): boolean {
    if (!path) {
      return false;
    }
    try {
      const parsed = new URL(path);
      return parsed.protocol === 'http:' || parsed.protocol === 'https:';
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  private notify(path: string): void {
    const listeners = this.listenersByPath.get(path);
    if (!listeners) return;
    for (const listener of listeners) {
      listener();
    }
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { FilterQuery, FilterCriteria, FilterType } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

/**
 * A CriteriaGroup is one "segment" separated by OR in the filter string.
 * Within a group, same-type criteria (e.g. multiple EXTENSIONs) are OR-ed;
 * different types are AND-ed.
 * Between groups, the entry only needs to satisfy ONE group (OR semantics).
 */
export interface CriteriaGroup {
  criteria: FilterCriteria[];
  text?: string;
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class FilterService {

  /**
   * Filter file entries based on query.
   *
   * query.groups (new): OR-separated groups of criteria. Within each group,
   *   same-type criteria are OR-ed, different types are AND-ed.
   * query.criteria (legacy): flat list, all AND-ed (kept for back-compat).
   * query.text: plain text match, AND-ed on top of whichever group matched.
   */
  filterEntries(entries: FileInfo[], query: FilterQuery & { groups?: CriteriaGroup[] }): FileInfo[] {
    const groups: CriteriaGroup[] = query.groups ?? [];
    const hasGroups = groups.length > 0;
    const hasLegacyCriteria = !hasGroups && query.criteria && query.criteria.length > 0;

    if (!query.text && !hasGroups && !hasLegacyCriteria) {
      return entries;
    }

    return entries.filter(entry => {
      // ── Text filter (AND'd globally) ───────────────────────────────────
      if (query.text) {
        if (!this.matchesTextFilter(entry, query.text, query.caseSensitive)) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      // ── Group-based evaluation (new path) ─────────────────────────────
      if (hasGroups) {
        // Entry must satisfy AT LEAST ONE group (OR between groups)
        return groups.some(group => this.matchesGroup(entry, group, query.caseSensitive));
      }

      // ── Legacy flat criteria (all AND-ed, kept for back-compat) ───────
      if (hasLegacyCriteria) {
        for (const criterion of query.criteria!) {
          if (!this.matchesCriterion(entry, criterion, query.caseSensitive)) {
            return false;
          }
        }
      }

      return true;
    });
  }

  /**
   * Test whether an entry satisfies a single CriteriaGroup.
   *
   * Rules:
   *  - Same FilterType criteria → OR  (e.g. ext:jpg OR ext:png)
   *  - Different FilterType criteria → AND (e.g. ext:jpg AND size>1mb)
   *  - Group-level text → AND with the above
   */
  private matchesGroup(entry: FileInfo, group: CriteriaGroup, caseSensitive?: boolean): boolean {
    // Optional per-group text filter
    if (group.text) {
      if (!this.matchesTextFilter(entry, group.text, caseSensitive)) return false;
    }

    // Bucket criteria by type
    const buckets = new Map<FilterType, FilterCriteria[]>();
    for (const c of group.criteria) {
      if (!buckets.has(c.type)) buckets.set(c.type, []);
      buckets.get(c.type)!.push(c);
    }

    // Every bucket must be satisfied; within each bucket any one match suffices
    for (const [, bucket] of buckets) {
      const bucketMatch = bucket.some(c => this.matchesCriterion(entry, c, caseSensitive));
      if (!bucketMatch) return false;
    }

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Parse filter text into a structured query with OR groups.
   *
   * Supports:
   * - OR separator:       "ext:pdf OR ext:png"     → two groups (any match)
   * - Plain text:         "document"
   * - Extension filter:   "ext:pdf"
   * - Type filter:        "type:file" or "type:dir"
   * - Size filter:        "size>1mb" or "size<100kb"
   * - Modified filter:    "modified:today" or "modified>2024-01-01"
   * - Glob pattern:       "*.pdf" or "doc*"
   *
   * Category presets emit e.g.:
   *   "ext:jpg ext:jpeg ext:png"          (single preset, OR within extensions)
   *   "ext:jpg ext:jpeg OR ext:js ext:ts" (two presets joined with OR)
   */
  parseFilterText(text: string): FilterQuery & { groups: CriteriaGroup[] } {
    const emptyQuery = (): FilterQuery & { groups: CriteriaGroup[] } => ({
      text: '',
      criteria: [],
      groups: [],
      caseSensitive: false,
    });

    if (!text || text.trim() === '') return emptyQuery();

    // Split on " OR " (case-insensitive, surrounded by whitespace)
    const segments = text.trim().split(/\s+OR\s+/i);

    if (segments.length === 1) {
      // No OR — parse as a single group, expose via both groups[] and legacy fields
      const group = this.parseSegment(segments[0]);
      return {
        text: group.text ?? '',
        criteria: group.criteria,   // legacy compat
        groups: [group],
        caseSensitive: false,
      };
    }

    // Multiple OR segments
    const groups = segments.map(seg => this.parseSegment(seg));
    return {
      text: '',       // per-group text lives inside each group
      criteria: [],   // legacy field unused when groups present
      groups,
      caseSensitive: false,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Parse one whitespace-separated segment into a CriteriaGroup.
   * Multiple ext: tokens within the segment become sibling EXTENSION criteria
   * that are OR-ed at evaluation time (same bucket logic in matchesGroup).
   */
  private parseSegment(segment: string): CriteriaGroup {
    const group: CriteriaGroup = { criteria: [] };
    const plainTextTokens: string[] = [];

    const tokens = segment.trim().split(/\s+/);

    for (const token of tokens) {
      if (!token) continue;

      if (token.includes(':')) {
        const colonIdx = token.indexOf(':');
        const prefix = token.slice(0, colonIdx);
        const value  = token.slice(colonIdx + 1);
        const criterion = this.parseFilterToken(prefix, value);
        if (criterion) {
          group.criteria.push(criterion);
          continue;
        }
      }

      // Size comparisons: size>1mb
      const sizeMatch = token.match(/^size([><=]+)(.+)$/i);
      if (sizeMatch) {
        const criterion = this.parseSizeFilter(sizeMatch[1], sizeMatch[2]);
        if (criterion) { group.criteria.push(criterion); continue; }
      }

      // Date comparisons: modified>2024-01-01
      const dateMatch = token.match(/^modified([><=]+)(.+)$/i);
      if (dateMatch) {
        const criterion = this.parseDateFilter(dateMatch[1], dateMatch[2]);
        if (criterion) { group.criteria.push(criterion); continue; }
      }

      // Glob pattern
      if (token.includes('*') || token.includes('?')) {
        group.criteria.push({ type: FilterType.GLOB, value: token, operator: 'contains' });
        continue;
      }

      plainTextTokens.push(token);
    }

    if (plainTextTokens.length > 0) {
      group.text = plainTextTokens.join(' ');
    }

    return group;
  }

  /**
   * Parse a filter token (prefix:value format)
   */
  private parseFilterToken(prefix: string, value: string): FilterCriteria | null {
    switch (prefix.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'ext':
      case 'extension':
        return {
          type: FilterType.EXTENSION,
          value: value.startsWith('.') ? value : `.${value}`,
          operator: 'equals',
        };

      case 'type': {
        const fileType = this.parseFileType(value);
        if (fileType) return { type: FilterType.TYPE, value: fileType, operator: 'equals' };
        break;
      }

      case 'name':
        return { type: FilterType.NAME, value, operator: 'contains' };

      case 'modified':
        return this.parseDateFilter('=', value);
    }

    return null;
  }

  private parseFileType(value: string): string | null {
    const lower = value.toLowerCase();
    if (lower === 'file' || lower === 'f') return FileType.FILE;
    if (lower === 'directory' || lower === 'dir' || lower === 'd' || lower === 'folder') return FileType.DIRECTORY;
    if (lower === 'symlink' || lower === 'link' || lower === 'l') return FileType.SYMLINK;
    return null;
  }

  private parseSizeFilter(operator: string, value: string): FilterCriteria | null {
    const sizeBytes = this.parseSizeValue(value);
    if (sizeBytes === null) return null;
    return { type: FilterType.SIZE, value: sizeBytes.toString(), operator: this.normalizeOperator(operator) };
  }

  private parseDateFilter(operator: string, value: string): FilterCriteria | null {
    const timestamp = this.parseDateValue(value);
    if (timestamp === null) return null;
    return { type: FilterType.MODIFIED, value: timestamp.toString(), operator: this.normalizeOperator(operator) };
  }

  private parseSizeValue(value: string): number | null {
    const match = value.match(/^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(b|kb|mb|gb)?$/i);
    if (!match) return null;
    const numValue = parseFloat(match[1]);
    switch ((match[2] || 'b').toLowerCase()) {
      case 'b':  return numValue;
      case 'kb': return numValue * 1024;
      case 'mb': return numValue * 1024 * 1024;
      case 'gb': return numValue * 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
      default:   return numValue;
    }
  }

  private parseDateValue(value: string): number | null {
    const lower = value.toLowerCase();
    const now = Date.now();
    const day = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

    if (lower === 'today')     return now - day;
    if (lower === 'yesterday') return now - (2 * day);
    if (lower === 'week' || lower === 'thisweek') return now - (7 * day);
    if (lower === 'month' || lower === 'thismonth') return now - (30 * day);

    const date = new Date(value);
    return isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date.getTime();
  }

  private normalizeOperator(operator: string): FilterCriteria['operator'] {
    switch (operator) {
      case '>':  return 'gt';
      case '<':  return 'lt';
      case '>=': return 'gte';
      case '<=': return 'lte';
      case '=':
      case '==': return 'equals';
      default:   return 'equals';
    }
  }

  private matchesTextFilter(entry: FileInfo, text: string, caseSensitive?: boolean): boolean {
    const searchText = caseSensitive ? text : text.toLowerCase();
    const entryName  = caseSensitive ? entry.name : entry.name.toLowerCase();
    return entryName.includes(searchText);
  }

  private matchesCriterion(entry: FileInfo, criterion: FilterCriteria, caseSensitive?: boolean): boolean {
    switch (criterion.type) {
      case FilterType.NAME:      return this.matchesNameCriterion(entry, criterion, caseSensitive);
      case FilterType.EXTENSION: return this.matchesExtensionCriterion(entry, criterion);
      case FilterType.TYPE:
        // type:symlink matches both file-symlinks (SYMLINK) and
        // dir-symlinks (DIRECTORY + isSymlink).
        if (criterion.value === FileType.SYMLINK) {
          return entry.type === FileType.SYMLINK || !!(entry as any).isSymlink;
        }
        return entry.type === criterion.value;
      case FilterType.SIZE:      return this.matchesSizeCriterion(entry, criterion);
      case FilterType.MODIFIED:  return this.matchesModifiedCriterion(entry, criterion);
      case FilterType.GLOB:      return this.matchesGlobPattern(entry.name, criterion.value);
      default:                   return true;
    }
  }

  private matchesNameCriterion(entry: FileInfo, criterion: FilterCriteria, caseSensitive?: boolean): boolean {
    const name  = caseSensitive ? entry.name : entry.name.toLowerCase();
    const value = caseSensitive ? criterion.value : criterion.value.toLowerCase();
    switch (criterion.operator) {
      case 'equals':     return name === value;
      case 'contains':   return name.includes(value);
      case 'startsWith': return name.startsWith(value);
      case 'endsWith':   return name.endsWith(value);
      default:           return name.includes(value);
    }
  }

  private matchesExtensionCriterion(entry: FileInfo, criterion: FilterCriteria): boolean {
    if (entry.type !== FileType.FILE) return false;
    return this.getFileExtension(entry.name) === criterion.value;
  }

  private matchesSizeCriterion(entry: FileInfo, criterion: FilterCriteria): boolean {
    const targetSize = parseInt(criterion.value, 10);
    const entrySize  = entry.size;
    switch (criterion.operator) {
      case 'equals': return entrySize === targetSize;
      case 'gt':     return entrySize >  targetSize;
      case 'lt':     return entrySize <  targetSize;
      case 'gte':    return entrySize >= targetSize;
      case 'lte':    return entrySize <= targetSize;
      default:       return entrySize === targetSize;
    }
  }

  private matchesModifiedCriterion(entry: FileInfo, criterion: FilterCriteria): boolean {
    const targetTime = parseInt(criterion.value, 10);
    const entryTime  = entry.modified * 1000;
    switch (criterion.operator) {
      case 'equals': return this.isSameDay(entryTime, targetTime);
      case 'gt':     return entryTime >  targetTime;
      case 'lt':     return entryTime <  targetTime;
      case 'gte':    return entryTime >= targetTime;
      case 'lte':    return entryTime <= targetTime;
      default:       return this.isSameDay(entryTime, targetTime);
    }
  }

  private matchesGlobPattern(name: string, pattern: string): boolean {
    const regexPattern = pattern
      .replace(/\./g, '\\.')
      .replace(/\*/g, '.*')
      .replace(/\?/g, '.');
    return new RegExp(`^${regexPattern}$`, 'i').test(name);
  }

  private getFileExtension(filename: string): string {
    const lastDot = filename.lastIndexOf('.');
    if (lastDot === -1 || lastDot === 0) return '';
    return filename.substring(lastDot);
  }

  private isSameDay(time1: number, time2: number): boolean {
    const d1 = new Date(time1), d2 = new Date(time2);
    return d1.getFullYear() === d2.getFullYear() &&
           d1.getMonth()    === d2.getMonth()    &&
           d1.getDate()     === d2.getDate();
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject, type Stream, createSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { debounce, distinctUntilChanged } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';

/**
 * Search result with relevance scoring
 */
export interface SearchResultItem {
  file: FileInfo;
  score: number;
  matchType: 'exact' | 'prefix' | 'fuzzy' | 'content';
  highlightedName: string;
}

/**
 * Search index entry
 */
interface IndexEntry {
  path: string;
  name: string;
  normalizedName: string;
  type: FileType;
  size: number;
  modified: number;
  parentPath: string;
}

/**
 * Index statistics
 */
export interface IndexStats {
  totalFiles: number;
  totalDirectories: number;
  indexedPaths: string[];
  lastIndexTime: number;
  isIndexing: boolean;
}

/**
 * Search configuration
 */
export interface SearchConfig {
  maxResults: number;
  fuzzyThreshold: number;
  enableTypoTolerance: boolean;
  searchHidden: boolean;
  fileTypes: FileType[];
}

/**
 * Global search service with background indexing
 * Phase 2 Feature: Smart Global Search
 */
@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class GlobalSearchService {
  // Search index (in-memory for MVP, could be moved to IndexedDB)
  private index: Map<string, IndexEntry> = new Map();
  private indexingInProgress$ = createBehaviorSubject<boolean>(false);
  private indexStats$ = createBehaviorSubject<IndexStats>({
    totalFiles: 0,
    totalDirectories: 0,
    indexedPaths: [],
    lastIndexTime: 0,
    isIndexing: false,
  });

  // Search configuration
  private config: SearchConfig = {
    maxResults: 50,
    fuzzyThreshold: 0.7,
    enableTypoTolerance: true,
    searchHidden: false,
    fileTypes: [FileType.FILE, FileType.DIRECTORY],
  };

  // Protected/System folders to skip (OS-specific)
  private protectedPaths: Set<string> = new Set([
    // Windows system folders
    '/PerfLogs',
    '/Recovery',
    '/System Volume Information',
    '/$Recycle.Bin',
    '/Windows/System32',
    '/Windows/WinSxS',
    '/Program Files/WindowsApps',
    // macOS system folders
    '/.Spotlight-V100',
    '/.Trashes',
    '/.fseventsd',
    '/System',
    '/private/var/db',
    // Linux system folders
    '/proc',
    '/sys',
    '/dev',
    '/run',
    '/tmp',
  ]);

  constructor(private apiService: ApiService) {
    // Start background indexing
    this.startBackgroundIndexing();
  }

  /**
   * Observable for indexing status
   */
  get isIndexing$(): Stream<boolean> {
    return this.indexingInProgress$;
  }

  /**
   * Observable for index statistics
   */
  get stats$(): Stream<IndexStats> {
    return this.indexStats$;
  }

  /**
   * Start background indexing of common paths
   */
  private async startBackgroundIndexing(): Promise<void> {
    // Index common root paths
    const rootPaths = ['/'];
    
    for (const path of rootPaths) {
      await this.indexPath(path, 2); // Depth of 2 for initial index
    }
  }

  /**
   * Index a path recursively
   */
  async indexPath(path: string, maxDepth: number = 3, currentDepth: number = 0): Promise<void> {
    if (currentDepth >= maxDepth) return;
    
    // Skip protected/system folders
    if (this.isProtectedPath(path)) {
      console.log(`Skipping protected path: ${path}`);
      return;
    }
    
    this.indexingInProgress$.next(true);
    const stats = this.indexStats$.value;
    stats.isIndexing = true;
    this.indexStats$.next(stats);

    try {
      const listing = await this.apiService.listDirectory(path, this.config.searchHidden);
      
      for (const entry of listing.entries) {
        // Skip protected folders
        if (this.isProtectedPath(entry.path)) {
          continue;
        }

        // Add to index
        const indexEntry: IndexEntry = {
          path: entry.path,
          name: entry.name,
          normalizedName: this.normalizeString(entry.name),
          type: entry.type,
          size: entry.size,
          modified: entry.modified,
          parentPath: path,
        };
        
        this.index.set(entry.path, indexEntry);
        
        // Update stats
        if (entry.type === FileType.FILE) {
          stats.totalFiles++;
        } else if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
          stats.totalDirectories++;
        }
        
        // Recursively index directories
        if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
          await this.indexPath(entry.path, maxDepth, currentDepth + 1);
        }
      }
      
      if (currentDepth === 0) {
        if (!stats.indexedPaths.includes(path)) {
          stats.indexedPaths.push(path);
        }
        stats.lastIndexTime = Date.now();
      }
      
      this.indexStats$.next(stats);
    } catch (error: any) {
      // Only log non-permission errors
      if (!error.message?.includes('Access is denied') && 
          !error.message?.includes('Permission denied') &&
          !error.message?.includes('EACCES')) {
        console.error('Failed to index path:', path, error);
      }
      // Silently skip permission errors
    } finally {
      if (currentDepth === 0) {
        this.indexingInProgress$.next(false);
        const updatedStats = this.indexStats$.value;
        updatedStats.isIndexing = false;
        this.indexStats$.next(updatedStats);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Check if a path is protected/system folder
   */
  private isProtectedPath(path: string): boolean {
    // Check exact matches
    if (this.protectedPaths.has(path)) {
      return true;
    }

    // Check if path starts with any protected path
    for (const protectedPath of this.protectedPaths) {
      if (path.startsWith(protectedPath + '/') || path.startsWith(protectedPath + '\\')) {
        return true;
      }
    }

    // Check for common protected patterns
    const protectedPatterns = [
      /\/\$[A-Z]/,           // Windows special folders like $Recycle.Bin
      /\/\.[A-Z]/,           // Hidden system folders like .Spotlight-V100
      /System Volume/i,      // System Volume Information
      /WindowsApps/i,        // Windows Store apps
      /WinSxS/i,             // Windows side-by-side
    ];

    return protectedPatterns.some(pattern => pattern.test(path));
  }

  /**
   * Search the index
   */
  search(query: string, config?: Partial<SearchConfig>): SearchResultItem[] {
    if (!query || query.trim() === '') {
      return [];
    }

    const searchConfig = { ...this.config, ...config };
    const normalizedQuery = this.normalizeString(query);
    const results: SearchResultItem[] = [];

    for (const entry of this.index.values()) {
      // Filter by type
      if (!searchConfig.fileTypes.includes(entry.type)) {
        continue;
      }

      // Calculate relevance score
      const score = this.calculateRelevance(
        query,
        normalizedQuery,
        entry,
        searchConfig
      );

      if (score > 0) {
        results.push({
          file: this.indexEntryToFileInfo(entry),
          score,
          matchType: this.getMatchType(normalizedQuery, entry.normalizedName, score),
          highlightedName: this.highlightMatch(entry.name, query),
        });
      }
    }

    // Sort by score (descending)
    results.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

    // Limit results
    return results.slice(0, searchConfig.maxResults);
  }

  /**
   * Calculate relevance score for a search result
   */
  private calculateRelevance(
    query: string,
    normalizedQuery: string,
    entry: IndexEntry,
    config: SearchConfig
  ): number {
    let score = 0;

    // Exact match
    if (entry.normalizedName === normalizedQuery) {
      score = 100;
    }
    // Exact case-sensitive match (bonus)
    else if (entry.name === query) {
      score = 95;
    }
    // Prefix match
    else if (entry.normalizedName.startsWith(normalizedQuery)) {
      score = 80;
    }
    // Contains match
    else if (entry.normalizedName.includes(normalizedQuery)) {
      score = 60;
    }
    // Fuzzy match
    else if (config.enableTypoTolerance) {
      const fuzzyScore = this.fuzzyMatch(normalizedQuery, entry.normalizedName);
      if (fuzzyScore >= config.fuzzyThreshold) {
        score = fuzzyScore * 50; // Scale to 0-50 range
      }
    }

    // Bonus for file name vs full path
    if (score > 0 && entry.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())) {
      score += 10;
    }

    // Bonus for recent files
    const daysSinceModified = (Date.now() - entry.modified * 1000) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
    if (daysSinceModified < 7) {
      score += 5;
    }

    // Penalty for deep paths
    const pathDepth = entry.path.split('/').length;
    score -= Math.min(pathDepth * 0.5, 10);

    return Math.max(0, score);
  }

  /**
   * Fuzzy string matching (Levenshtein-based)
   */
  private fuzzyMatch(query: string, target: string): number {
    const distance = this.levenshteinDistance(query, target);
    const maxLength = Math.max(query.length, target.length);
    return 1 - (distance / maxLength);
  }

  /**
   * Calculate Levenshtein distance
   */
  private levenshteinDistance(a: string, b: string): number {
    const matrix: number[][] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i <= b.length; i++) {
      matrix[i] = [i];
    }

    for (let j = 0; j <= a.length; j++) {
      matrix[0][j] = j;
    }

    for (let i = 1; i <= b.length; i++) {
      for (let j = 1; j <= a.length; j++) {
        if (b.charAt(i - 1) === a.charAt(j - 1)) {
          matrix[i][j] = matrix[i - 1][j - 1];
        } else {
          matrix[i][j] = Math.min(
            matrix[i - 1][j - 1] + 1, // substitution
            matrix[i][j - 1] + 1,     // insertion
            matrix[i - 1][j] + 1      // deletion
          );
        }
      }
    }

    return matrix[b.length][a.length];
  }

  /**
   * Determine match type based on score and pattern
   */
  private getMatchType(
    normalizedQuery: string,
    normalizedName: string,
    score: number
  ): 'exact' | 'prefix' | 'fuzzy' | 'content' {
    if (score >= 95) return 'exact';
    if (normalizedName.startsWith(normalizedQuery)) return 'prefix';
    if (score < 60) return 'fuzzy';
    return 'content';
  }

  /**
   * Highlight matching parts of the name
   */
  private highlightMatch(name: string, query: string): string {
    const lowerName = name.toLowerCase();
    const lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase();
    const index = lowerName.indexOf(lowerQuery);

    if (index === -1) {
      return name;
    }

    return name.substring(0, index) +
           '<mark>' + name.substring(index, index + query.length) + '</mark>' +
           name.substring(index + query.length);
  }

  /**
   * Normalize string for comparison
   */
  private normalizeString(str: string): string {
    return str
      .toLowerCase()
      .trim()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''); // Remove special characters
  }

  /**
   * Convert index entry to FileInfo
   */
  private indexEntryToFileInfo(entry: IndexEntry): FileInfo {
    return {
      name: entry.name,
      path: entry.path,
      type: entry.type,
      size: entry.size,
      created: entry.modified, // We don't store created separately
      modified: entry.modified,
      accessed: entry.modified,
      permissions: '', // Not stored in index
      isHidden: entry.name.startsWith('.'),
    };
  }

  /**
   * Clear the index
   */
  clearIndex(): void {
    this.index.clear();
    const stats = this.indexStats$.value;
    stats.totalFiles = 0;
    stats.totalDirectories = 0;
    stats.indexedPaths = [];
    stats.lastIndexTime = 0;
    this.indexStats$.next(stats);
  }

  /**
   * Refresh the index
   */
  async refreshIndex(): Promise<void> {
    const stats = this.indexStats$.value;
    const paths = [...stats.indexedPaths];
    
    this.clearIndex();
    
    for (const path of paths) {
      await this.indexPath(path, 3);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get current configuration
   */
  getConfig(): SearchConfig {
    return { ...this.config };
  }

  /**
   * Update configuration
   */
  updateConfig(updates: Partial<SearchConfig>): void {
    this.config = { ...this.config, ...updates };
  }

  /**
   * Add a path to the protected paths list
   */
  addProtectedPath(path: string): void {
    this.protectedPaths.add(path);
  }

  /**
   * Remove a path from the protected paths list
   */
  removeProtectedPath(path: string): void {
    this.protectedPaths.delete(path);
  }

  /**
   * Get all protected paths
   */
  getProtectedPaths(): string[] {
    return Array.from(this.protectedPaths);
  }

  /**
   * Clear all protected paths (use with caution)
   */
  clearProtectedPaths(): void {
    this.protectedPaths.clear();
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { InputEngineService } from './input-engine.service';

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class InputContextService {
  private readonly leaseCounts = new Map<string, number>();

  constructor(private inputEngine: InputEngineService) {}

  acquire(contextId: string): () => void {
    const nextCount = (this.leaseCounts.get(contextId) ?? 0) + 1;
    this.leaseCounts.set(contextId, nextCount);
    if (nextCount === 1) {
      this.inputEngine.activateContext(contextId);
    }

    let released = false;
    return () => {
      if (released) return;
      released = true;
      this.release(contextId);
    };
  }

  private release(contextId: string): void {
    const currentCount = this.leaseCounts.get(contextId);
    if (!currentCount) return;

    if (currentCount <= 1) {
      this.leaseCounts.delete(contextId);
      this.inputEngine.deactivateContext(contextId);
      return;
    }

    this.leaseCounts.set(contextId, currentCount - 1);
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';

/**
 * Ref-counted freeze for native browser overlays.
 *
 * Any component that needs to draw HTML on top of the native Win32 browser
 * pane (dialogs, dropdowns, filter widgets, etc.) should acquire a freeze
 * before showing and release it on close.  While at least one freeze is
 * held the body gets a `native-overlay-frozen` class which tells
 * `FileViewContainerComponent` to replace the live overlay with a canvas
 * screenshot.
 */
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class NativeOverlayFreezeService {
  private holders = new Set<string>();

  get frozen(): boolean {
    return this.holders.size > 0;
  }

  acquire(key: string): void {
    if (this.holders.has(key)) {
      return;
    }
    this.holders.add(key);
    this.sync();
  }

  release(key: string): void {
    if (!this.holders.delete(key)) {
      return;
    }
    this.sync();
  }

  private sync(): void {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined' || typeof window === 'undefined') {
      return;
    }
    if (this.holders.size > 0) {
      document.body.classList.add('native-overlay-frozen');
    } else {
      document.body.classList.remove('native-overlay-frozen');
    }
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('native-overlay-freeze-change'));
  }
}
````

## File: frontend/src/app/services/registry.service.ts
````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { PARENT_ENTRY_PATH } from '../components/file-entry.component';

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   TYPES
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/** The VFS root the backend mounts the registry under. */
export const REGISTRY_ROOT = 'registry://';
export const REGISTRY_VFS_ROOT = '/registry';

/** Registry path separator (always forward slash in the VFS). */
const SEP = '/';

export interface RegistryFrame {
  /** Current public registry path, e.g. "registry://HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE/SOFTWARE/Microsoft" */
  path: string;
  entries: FileInfo[];
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   WAILS BRIDGE
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

declare const window: any;

function app(): any {
  const a = window.go?.app?.App;
  if (!a) throw new Error('Wails bridge not available');
  return a;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   PATH HELPERS
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

function normalizeRegistryPath(path: string): string {
  const normalized = (path || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  const match = /^registry:\/\/(.*)?$/i.exec(normalized);
  if (!match) return normalized;
  const rest = (match[1] || '').replace(/^\/+/, '').replace(/\/+/g, '/');
  return rest ? `${REGISTRY_ROOT}${rest}` : REGISTRY_ROOT;
}

export function registryToVfsPath(path: string): string {
  const normalized = normalizeRegistryPath(path);
  if (!isRegistryPath(normalized)) return normalized;
  const rest = normalized.slice(REGISTRY_ROOT.length).replace(/^\/+/, '');
  return rest ? `${REGISTRY_VFS_ROOT}/${rest}` : REGISTRY_VFS_ROOT;
}

export function registryFromVfsPath(path: string): string {
  const normalized = (path || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
  if (normalized === REGISTRY_VFS_ROOT) return REGISTRY_ROOT;
  if (normalized.startsWith(REGISTRY_VFS_ROOT + SEP)) {
    return `${REGISTRY_ROOT}${normalized.slice(REGISTRY_VFS_ROOT.length + 1)}`;
  }
  return normalizeRegistryPath(normalized);
}

/** True if the given public path is inside the registry root. */
export function isRegistryPath(path: string): boolean {
  const normalized = normalizeRegistryPath(path);
  return normalized === REGISTRY_ROOT || normalized.startsWith(REGISTRY_ROOT);
}

/**
 * Returns the display path shown in the pane breadcrumb.
 * Strips the "/registry" prefix so users see "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\…".
 */
export function registryDisplayPath(path: string): string {
  const normalized = normalizeRegistryPath(path);
  const rel = normalized.startsWith(REGISTRY_ROOT)
    ? normalized.slice(REGISTRY_ROOT.length)
    : normalized === REGISTRY_ROOT
    ? ''
    : normalized;
  return rel.replace(/\//g, '\\') || 'Registry';
}

/**
 * Builds a human-readable breadcrumb trail for a registry path.
 * e.g. ["Registry", "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE", "SOFTWARE", "Microsoft"]
 */
export function registryBreadcrumbs(path: string): string[] {
  const normalized = normalizeRegistryPath(path);
  if (normalized === REGISTRY_ROOT) return ['Registry'];
  const rel = normalized.slice(REGISTRY_ROOT.length);
  return ['Registry', ...rel.split(SEP).filter(Boolean)];
}

/** Parent public path, or null if already at the registry root. */
export function registryParentPath(path: string): string | null {
  const normalized = normalizeRegistryPath(path);
  if (normalized === REGISTRY_ROOT) return null;
  const rel = normalized.slice(REGISTRY_ROOT.length);
  const idx = rel.lastIndexOf(SEP);
  if (idx < 0) return REGISTRY_ROOT;
  return `${REGISTRY_ROOT}${rel.slice(0, idx)}`;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   ENTRY CONVERSION
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/**
 * Converts a raw VFSListDir entry for display in the file pane.
 * Keys appear as directories; values appear as files.
 */
function toFileInfo(raw: any): FileInfo {
  return {
    name:        raw.name,
    path:        registryFromVfsPath(raw.path),
    type:        raw.type as FileType,
    size:        raw.size ?? 0,
    modified:    raw.modified ?? 0,
    created:     raw.modified ?? 0,
    accessed:    raw.modified ?? 0,
    permissions: raw.type === FileType.DIRECTORY ? 'drwxr-xr-x' : '-r--r--r--',
    isHidden:    false,
    registryKind: raw.registryKind,
    registryValueType: raw.registryValueType,
    registryPreview: raw.registryPreview,
  };
}

/** Prepends the ".." parent row to a list of entries. */
function withParent(entries: FileInfo[], hasParent: boolean): FileInfo[] {
  if (!hasParent) return entries;
  const dotdot: FileInfo = {
    name:        '..',
    path:        PARENT_ENTRY_PATH,
    type:        FileType.DIRECTORY,
    size:        0,
    modified:    0,
    created:     0,
    accessed:    0,
    permissions: 'drwxr-xr-x',
    isHidden:    false,
  };
  return [dotdot, ...entries];
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   SERVICE
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class RegistryService {

  /* ─────────────── NAVIGATION ─────────────── */

  /** Load the registry root (list of hives). */
  async openRoot(): Promise<RegistryFrame> {
    return this.load(REGISTRY_ROOT);
  }

  /** Navigate into a subkey or stay at the frame root. */
  async navigateInto(path: string): Promise<RegistryFrame> {
    return this.load(path);
  }

  /** Navigate up one level; returns null if already at the registry root. */
  async navigateUp(current: RegistryFrame): Promise<RegistryFrame | null> {
    const parent = registryParentPath(current.path);
    if (!parent) return null;
    return this.load(parent);
  }

  /** Reload the current frame (after a write operation). */
  async refresh(frame: RegistryFrame): Promise<RegistryFrame> {
    return this.load(frame.path);
  }

  /* ─────────────── READ VALUE ─────────────── */

  /**
   * Reads the content of a registry value (a "file" in the VFS).
   * Returns the serialised string — the backend formats it based on value type:
   *   REG_SZ / REG_EXPAND_SZ  → the string
   *   REG_DWORD / REG_QWORD   → "4294967295 (0xFFFFFFFF)"
   *   REG_MULTI_SZ            → newline-separated strings
   *   REG_BINARY              → space-separated hex pairs
   */
  async readValue(path: string): Promise<string> {
    const result = await app().VFSReadFile(path);
    return typeof result === 'string' ? result : new TextDecoder().decode(result);
  }

  /* ─────────────── WRITE OPERATIONS ─────────────── */

  /** Create a new subkey (like mkdir). */
  async createKey(parentPath: string, keyName: string): Promise<void> {
    const newPath = `${normalizeRegistryPath(parentPath)}${SEP}${keyName}`;
    await app().VFSMkdir(newPath);
  }

  /**
   * Set a REG_SZ value.  Creates or overwrites.
   * For other types, write the serialised form — the backend stores as REG_SZ.
   */
  async setValue(keyPath: string, valueName: string, data: string): Promise<void> {
    const valuePath = `${normalizeRegistryPath(keyPath)}${SEP}${valueName || '(default)'}`;
    await app().VFSWriteFile(valuePath, data);
  }

  /** Delete a key or value at the given VFS path. */
  async delete(path: string): Promise<void> {
    await app().VFSRemove(normalizeRegistryPath(path));
  }

  /** Rename is not supported by the registry; always rejects. */
  rename(_oldPath: string, _newName: string): Promise<void> {
    return Promise.reject(new Error('Registry keys and values cannot be renamed.'));
  }

  /* ─────────────── INTERNAL ─────────────── */

  private async load(path: string): Promise<RegistryFrame> {
    const currentPath = normalizeRegistryPath(path);
    const listing = await app().VFSListDir(currentPath);
    const hasParent = currentPath !== REGISTRY_ROOT;
    const entries = withParent(
      (listing?.entries ?? []).map(toFileInfo),
      hasParent,
    );
    return { path: currentPath, entries };
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { DirectorySourceService } from './directory-source.service';
import { PathSuggestion } from './path-history.service';
import { normalizePath } from '../components/address-bar.utils';
import { FileType, FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';

/**
 * Provider interface for scheme-specific autocompletion.
 * Each scheme (drive, smb, search, registry, etc.) can implement custom logic.
 */
export interface SchemeAutocompleteProvider {
  readonly scheme: string;

  /**
   * Determine if this provider should handle the given query.
   */
  canHandle(query: string): boolean;

  /**
   * Determine if the given path should fetch children for autocompletion.
   */
  shouldFetch(query: string): boolean;

  /**
   * Split a query into context (directory path) and prefix to match.
   */
  splitContext(query: string): { dirPath: string; prefix: string };

  /**
   * Fetch suggestions for the given directory and prefix.
   */
  fetchSuggestions(dirPath: string, prefix: string): Promise<PathSuggestion[]>;

  /**
   * Stream suggestions with batching support.
   */
  streamSuggestions(
    dirPath: string,
    prefix: string,
    onBatch: (suggestions: PathSuggestion[]) => void,
  ): Promise<PathSuggestion[]>;

  /**
   * Check if this provider supports streaming.
   */
  supportsStreaming(path: string): boolean;

  /**
   * Get the root path.
   */
  getRootPath(path: string): string | null;

  /**
   * Join a directory path and child name.
   */
  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string;
}

/**
 * Default filesystem provider (covers filesystem://, local paths, Windows paths).
 */
class FilesystemAutocompleteProvider implements SchemeAutocompleteProvider {
  scheme = 'filesystem';

  constructor(private readonly directorySource: DirectorySourceService) {}

  canHandle(query: string): boolean {
    const scheme = this.extractScheme(query);
    // Handle only filesystem and local (no explicit scheme)
    return !scheme || scheme === 'filesystem';
  }

  shouldFetch(query: string): boolean {
    const q = (query || '').trim();
    if (!q) return false;

    const n = normalizePath(q);
    if (!n) return false;

    // Avoid listing the full filesystem root on short inputs.
    if (n === '/') return false;
    if (n.toLowerCase() === 'filesystem://') return false;

    // Any slash-based path, or Windows drive prefix
    if (n.includes('/')) return true;
    if (/^[A-Za-z]:/.test(n)) return true;

    return false;
  }

  splitContext(query: string): { dirPath: string; prefix: string } {
    const q = normalizePath((query || '').replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    if (!q) return { dirPath: '/', prefix: '' };

    // Handle drive roots (e.g., "C:", "filesystem://X")
    const driveRootMatch = /^filesystem:\/\/[a-z]$/i.exec(q);
    if (driveRootMatch) return { dirPath: `${q}/`, prefix: '' };

    // If path ends with slash, it's a directory
    if (q.endsWith('/')) return { dirPath: q, prefix: '' };

    // Find the last slash to split directory and prefix
    const lastSlash = q.lastIndexOf('/');
    if (lastSlash >= 0) {
      return { dirPath: q.slice(0, lastSlash + 1), prefix: q.slice(lastSlash + 1) };
    }

    // Handle bare Windows drive letter (e.g., "C:")
    if (/^[A-Za-z]:$/.test(q)) return { dirPath: `${q}/`, prefix: '' };

    // Single path component РІР‚вЂњ root context
    return { dirPath: '/', prefix: q };
  }

  async fetchSuggestions(dirPath: string, prefix: string): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    try {
      const listing = await this.directorySource.listDirectory(dirPath, false);
      return this.filterAndFormatSuggestions(listing.entries, prefix);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  async streamSuggestions(
    dirPath: string,
    prefix: string,
    onBatch: (suggestions: PathSuggestion[]) => void,
  ): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    const suggestions = await this.fetchSuggestions(dirPath, prefix);
    onBatch(suggestions);
    return suggestions;
  }

  supportsStreaming(path: string): boolean {
    return this.directorySource.supportsStreaming(path);
  }

  getRootPath(path: string): string | null {
    return this.directorySource.getRootPath(path);
  }

  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    const trimmed = (basePath || '/').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    const joined = `${trimmed}/${childName}`.replace(/\\/g, '/');
    if (joined.startsWith('//')) {
      return `//${joined.slice(2).replace(/\/{2,}/g, '/')}`;
    }
    return joined.replace(/\/{2,}/g, '/');
  }

  private filterAndFormatSuggestions(entries: FileInfo[] = [], prefix: string): PathSuggestion[] {
    const prefixLower = prefix.toLowerCase();
    const accumulated: PathSuggestion[] = [];
    const seenNames = new Set<string>();

    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) continue;
      if (prefixLower && !entry.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefixLower)) continue;
      if (seenNames.has(entry.name)) continue;
      seenNames.add(entry.name);

      accumulated.push({
        path: normalizePath(entry.path),
        displayName: entry.name,
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 100,
        exists: true,
      });
    }

    accumulated.sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
    return accumulated;
  }

  private extractScheme(query: string): string | null {
    const normalized = normalizePath((query || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    const schemeMatch = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(normalized);
    return schemeMatch ? schemeMatch[1].toLowerCase() : null;
  }
}

/**
 * Search scheme provider: supports comprehensive search queries via URL parameters.
 * Replaces need for custom search dialogs by encoding all filters in the URL.
 *
 * Supported parameters:
 * - path: Base directory to search from
 * - pattern: Search pattern (glob-style or regex)
 * - recursive: Whether to search recursively (default: true)
 * - regex: Use regex pattern matching (default: false)
 * - caseSensitive: Case-sensitive matching (default: false)
 * - fileTypes: Comma-separated file types to include (file,directory,symlink)
 * - minSize: Minimum file size in bytes
 * - maxSize: Maximum file size in bytes
 * - modifiedAfter: ISO 8601 date string (inclusive)
 * - modifiedBefore: ISO 8601 date string (inclusive)
 * - searchHidden: Include hidden files (default: false)
 * - contentSearch: Search inside file contents (default: false)
 * - extensions: Comma-separated file extensions to match (.txt,.md)
 *
 * Example: search://?path=filesystem://c&pattern=*.log&minSize=1000&modifiedAfter=2024-01-01
 */
class SearchAutocompleteProvider implements SchemeAutocompleteProvider {
  scheme = 'search';

  canHandle(query: string): boolean {
    const normalized = normalizePath((query || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    return /^search:\/\//i.test(normalized);
  }

  shouldFetch(query: string): boolean {
    const q = (query || '').trim();
    if (!q) return false;
    const n = normalizePath(q);
    // Don't fetch just for "search://" - need actual search params
    return /^search:\/\/\?/.test(n);
  }

  splitContext(query: string): { dirPath: string; prefix: string } {
    const q = normalizePath((query || '').replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    if (!q || q.toLowerCase() === 'search://') {
      return { dirPath: 'search://', prefix: '' };
    }

    // Validate search query parameters when present.
    try {
      const urlPart = q.slice('search://'.length);
      if (!urlPart.startsWith('?')) {
        return { dirPath: 'search://', prefix: '' };
      }

      void new URLSearchParams(urlPart.slice(1));
      
      // For search://?, we don't really have a "prefix" like filesystem
      // The entire query is the "context"
      return { dirPath: q, prefix: '' };
    } catch {
      return { dirPath: 'search://', prefix: '' };
    }
  }

  async fetchSuggestions(dirPath: string, _prefix: string): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    // Search scheme doesn't provide directory listings in the traditional sense.
    // Suggestions could include:
    // 1. Common search filters (by extension, by size, etc.)
    // 2. Previously used search patterns
    // 3. Saved searches
    return this.getSearchFilterSuggestions(dirPath);
  }

  async streamSuggestions(
    dirPath: string,
    prefix: string,
    onBatch: (suggestions: PathSuggestion[]) => void,
  ): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    const suggestions = await this.fetchSuggestions(dirPath, prefix);
    onBatch(suggestions);
    return suggestions;
  }

  supportsStreaming(_path: string): boolean {
    return true;
  }

  getRootPath(_path: string): string | null {
    return 'search://';
  }

  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    const value = (childName || '').trim();
    if (!value) return basePath || 'search://';

    const normalized = normalizePath((basePath || 'search://').replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    if (!normalized.toLowerCase().startsWith('search://')) {
      return normalized;
    }

    const urlPart = normalized.slice('search://'.length);
    const params = new URLSearchParams(urlPart.startsWith('?') ? urlPart.slice(1) : '');
    params.set('pattern', value);
    return `search://?${params.toString()}`;
  }

  /**
   * Parse search:// URL parameters into a structured object.
   */
  private parseSearchParams(urlPath: string): Record<string, string | null> {
    try {
      const urlPart = urlPath.slice('search://'.length);
      if (!urlPart.startsWith('?')) return {};
      const params = new URLSearchParams(urlPart.slice(1));
      const result: Record<string, string | null> = {};
      params.forEach((value, key) => {
        result[key] = value;
      });
      return result;
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  }

  /**
   * Build search query with filters for suggestion purposes.
   * Could suggest common filter combinations or saved searches.
   */
  private getSearchFilterSuggestions(dirPath: string): PathSuggestion[] {
    const suggestions: PathSuggestion[] = [];

    // Parse current query if provided
    const params = this.parseSearchParams(dirPath);
    const hasPattern = !!params['pattern'];
    const currentUrl = dirPath;

    // 1. Suggest search parameters if user is typing them
    if (currentUrl.endsWith('&') || currentUrl.endsWith('?')) {
      const paramSuggestions = [
        { key: 'pattern=', label: 'pattern (glob/regex)', score: 95 },
        { key: 'path=', label: 'path (base directory)', score: 90 },
        { key: 'minSize=', label: 'minSize (bytes)', score: 85 },
        { key: 'maxSize=', label: 'maxSize (bytes)', score: 85 },
        { key: 'extensions=', label: 'extensions (.txt,.md)', score: 80 },
        { key: 'modifiedAfter=', label: 'modifiedAfter (YYYY-MM-DD)', score: 75 },
        { key: 'fileTypes=', label: 'fileTypes (file,directory)', score: 70 },
        { key: 'recursive=', label: 'recursive (true/false)', score: 65 },
        { key: 'regex=', label: 'regex (true/false)', score: 60 },
      ];

      for (const p of paramSuggestions) {
        suggestions.push({
          path: currentUrl + p.key,
          displayName: `Param: ${p.label}`,
          matchType: 'directory',
          score: p.score,
          exists: true,
        });
      }
    }

    // Suggest common values for specific parameters being typed
    if (currentUrl.endsWith('fileTypes=')) {
      const types = ['file', 'directory', 'file,directory', 'symlink'];
      types.forEach((t, i) => {
        suggestions.push({
          path: currentUrl + t,
          displayName: `Type: ${t}`,
          matchType: 'directory',
          score: 100 - i,
          exists: true,
        });
      });
    }

    if (currentUrl.endsWith('recursive=') || currentUrl.endsWith('regex=') || currentUrl.endsWith('caseSensitive=') || currentUrl.endsWith('searchHidden=') || currentUrl.endsWith('contentSearch=')) {
      ['true', 'false'].forEach((v, i) => {
        suggestions.push({
          path: currentUrl + v,
          displayName: v,
          matchType: 'directory',
          score: 100 - i,
          exists: true,
        });
      });
    }

    // 2. Original filter logic
    // Suggest common filter combinations if user hasn't added them yet
    if (hasPattern && !params['extensions']) {
      suggestions.push({
        path: this.buildSearchURL(params, { extensions: '.log,.txt,.md' }),
        displayName: 'Common docs (.log, .txt, .md)',
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 80,
        exists: true,
      });

      suggestions.push({
        path: this.buildSearchURL(params, { extensions: '.exe,.dll,.sys' }),
        displayName: 'Binary files (.exe, .dll, .sys)',
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 75,
        exists: true,
      });

      suggestions.push({
        path: this.buildSearchURL(params, { extensions: '.jpg,.png,.gif,.bmp' }),
        displayName: 'Images (.jpg, .png, .gif, .bmp)',
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 75,
        exists: true,
      });
    }

    // Suggest size filters if not present
    if (hasPattern && !params['minSize'] && !params['maxSize']) {
      suggestions.push({
        path: this.buildSearchURL(params, { minSize: '1048576' }), // 1MB
        displayName: 'Larger than 1MB',
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 70,
        exists: true,
      });

      suggestions.push({
        path: this.buildSearchURL(params, { maxSize: '1024' }), // 1KB
        displayName: 'Smaller than 1KB',
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 70,
        exists: true,
      });
    }

    return suggestions;
  }

  /**
   * Build a search:// URL with merged parameters.
   */
  private buildSearchURL(
    currentParams: Record<string, any>,
    updates: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null>,
  ): string {
    const merged = { ...currentParams, ...updates };
    const params = new URLSearchParams();

    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(merged)) {
      if (value !== null && value !== undefined) {
        params.append(key, String(value));
      }
    }

    return `search://?${params.toString()}`;
  }
}

/**
 * Registry scheme provider: Windows registry paths.

class RegistryAutocompleteProvider implements SchemeAutocompleteProvider {
  scheme = 'registry';

  constructor(private readonly directorySource: DirectorySourceService) {}

  canHandle(query: string): boolean {
    const normalized = normalizePath((query || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    return /^registry:\/\//i.test(normalized);
  }

    const q = (query || '').trim();
    if (!q) return false;
    const n = normalizePath(q);
    return /^registry:\/\/(?:\/.*)?$/i.test(n) && n !== 'registry://';
  }

    const q = normalizePath((query || '').replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    if (!q || q.toLowerCase() === 'registry://') {
      return { dirPath: 'registry://', prefix: '' };
    }

    if (q.endsWith('/')) {
      return { dirPath: q, prefix: '' };
    }

    const lastSlash = q.lastIndexOf('/');
    if (lastSlash > 'registry://'.length - 1) {
      return { dirPath: q.slice(0, lastSlash + 1), prefix: q.slice(lastSlash + 1) };
    }

    return { dirPath: 'registry://', prefix: q.slice('registry://'.length) };
  }

    onBatch(suggestions);
    return suggestions;
  }

    return false;
  }

    return 'registry://';
  }

  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    const trimmed = (basePath || 'registry://').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    if (trimmed === 'registry://') {
      return `${trimmed}${childName}`;
    }
    return `${trimmed}/${childName}`;
  }

  private async getRegistrySuggestions(dirPath: string, prefix: string): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    try {
      const listing = await this.directorySource.listDirectory(dirPath, false);
      return this.filterAndFormatSuggestions(listing.entries, prefix);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  private filterAndFormatSuggestions(entries: FileInfo[] = [], prefix: string): PathSuggestion[] {
    const prefixLower = prefix.toLowerCase();
    const accumulated: PathSuggestion[] = [];
    const seenNames = new Set<string>();

    for (const entry of entries) {
      // For registry, include both keys and values that are "directory-like"
      if (entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) continue;
      if (prefixLower && !entry.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefixLower)) continue;
      if (seenNames.has(entry.name)) continue;
      seenNames.add(entry.name);

      accumulated.push({
        path: normalizePath(entry.path),
        displayName: entry.name,
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 100,
        exists: true,
      });
    }

    accumulated.sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
    return accumulated;
  }
}

  private filterAndFormatSuggestions(entries: FileInfo[] = [], prefix: string): PathSuggestion[] {
    const prefixLower = prefix.toLowerCase();
    const accumulated: PathSuggestion[] = [];
    const seenNames = new Set<string>();

    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) continue;
      if (prefixLower && !entry.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefixLower)) continue;
      if (seenNames.has(entry.name)) continue;
      seenNames.add(entry.name);

      accumulated.push({
        path: normalizePath(entry.path),
        displayName: entry.name,
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 100,
        exists: true,
      });
    }

    accumulated.sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
    return accumulated;
  }
}

/**
 * Generic fallback provider for unknown schemes.
 */
class GenericSchemeAutocompleteProvider implements SchemeAutocompleteProvider {
  scheme: string;

  constructor(private readonly directorySource: DirectorySourceService, scheme: string) {
    this.scheme = scheme;
  }

  canHandle(query: string): boolean {
    const normalized = normalizePath((query || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    const schemeMatch = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(normalized);
    return schemeMatch ? schemeMatch[1].toLowerCase() === this.scheme : false;
  }

  shouldFetch(query: string): boolean {
    const q = (query || '').trim();
    if (!q) return false;
    const n = normalizePath(q);
    return n.includes('/') || n.endsWith('://');
  }

  splitContext(query: string): { dirPath: string; prefix: string } {
    const q = normalizePath((query || '').replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    if (!q) return { dirPath: `${this.scheme}://`, prefix: '' };

    // Scheme-only (e.g., "smb://")
    const schemeOnlyMatch = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\/$/.exec(q);
    if (schemeOnlyMatch) {
      return { dirPath: q, prefix: '' };
    }

    // Path ends with slash
    if (q.endsWith('/')) return { dirPath: q, prefix: '' };

    // Split on last slash
    const lastSlash = q.lastIndexOf('/');
    if (lastSlash >= 0) {
      return { dirPath: q.slice(0, lastSlash + 1), prefix: q.slice(lastSlash + 1) };
    }

    return { dirPath: `${this.scheme}://`, prefix: q.slice(`${this.scheme}://`.length) };
  }

  async fetchSuggestions(dirPath: string, prefix: string): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    try {
      const listing = await this.directorySource.listDirectory(dirPath, false);
      return this.filterAndFormatSuggestions(listing.entries, prefix);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  async streamSuggestions(
    dirPath: string,
    prefix: string,
    onBatch: (suggestions: PathSuggestion[]) => void,
  ): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    const suggestions = await this.fetchSuggestions(dirPath, prefix);
    onBatch(suggestions);
    return suggestions;
  }

  supportsStreaming(path: string): boolean {
    return this.directorySource.supportsStreaming(path);
  }

  getRootPath(path: string): string | null {
    return this.directorySource.getRootPath(path);
  }

  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    const trimmed = (basePath || `${this.scheme}://`).replace(/\/+$/, '');
    return `${trimmed}/${childName}`;
  }

  private filterAndFormatSuggestions(entries: FileInfo[] = [], prefix: string): PathSuggestion[] {
    const prefixLower = prefix.toLowerCase();
    const accumulated: PathSuggestion[] = [];
    const seenNames = new Set<string>();

    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) continue;
      if (prefixLower && !entry.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefixLower)) continue;
      if (seenNames.has(entry.name)) continue;
      seenNames.add(entry.name);

      accumulated.push({
        path: normalizePath(entry.path),
        displayName: entry.name,
        matchType: 'directory',
        score: 100,
        exists: true,
      });
    }

    accumulated.sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
    return accumulated;
  }
}

/**
 * Scheme-oriented autocompletion service.
 * Routes autocompletion to scheme-specific providers.
 */
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SchemeAutocompleteService {
  private readonly providers: SchemeAutocompleteProvider[];
  private readonly filesystemProvider: SchemeAutocompleteProvider;
  private readonly providerCache = new Map<string, SchemeAutocompleteProvider>();

  constructor(
    private readonly directorySource: DirectorySourceService,
  ) {
    this.filesystemProvider = new FilesystemAutocompleteProvider(directorySource);
    this.providers = [
      // Specialized providers for specific schemes (order matters for canHandle matching)
      new SearchAutocompleteProvider(),
      new RegistryAutocompleteProvider(directorySource),
      new SmbAutocompleteProvider(directorySource),
      new ArchiveAutocompleteProvider(directorySource),
      // Generic filesystem provider (catch-all for filesystem://, local paths, etc.)
      this.filesystemProvider,
    ];
  }

  /**
   * Extract the scheme from a path.
   * Returns the scheme portion (e.g., "drive", "smb", "search") or null.
   */
  getScheme(path: string): string | null {
    const normalized = normalizePath((path || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    const schemeMatch = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(normalized);
    return schemeMatch ? schemeMatch[1].toLowerCase() : null;
  }

  /**
   * Get or create the appropriate provider for a query.
   */
  private getProvider(query: string): SchemeAutocompleteProvider {
    // Try registered providers first
    for (const provider of this.providers) {
      if (provider.canHandle(query)) {
        return provider;
      }
    }

    // For unknown schemes, create or reuse a generic provider
    const scheme = this.getScheme(query);
    if (scheme) {
      if (!this.providerCache.has(scheme)) {
        this.providerCache.set(
          scheme,
          new GenericSchemeAutocompleteProvider(this.directorySource, scheme),
        );
      }
      return this.providerCache.get(scheme)!;
    }

    // Fallback to filesystem provider for no-scheme address bar values.
    return this.filesystemProvider;
  }

  /**
   * Determine if the given path should fetch children for autocompletion.
   */
  shouldFetchSuggestions(query: string): boolean {
    const provider = this.getProvider(query);
    return provider.shouldFetch(query);
  }

  /**
   * Split a query into the directory context and the prefix to match.
   */
  splitQueryContext(query: string): { dirPath: string; prefix: string } {
    const provider = this.getProvider(query);
    return provider.splitContext(query);
  }

  /**
   * Fetch suggestions for a directory and prefix.
   */
  async fetchSuggestions(dirPath: string, prefix: string): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    const provider = this.getProvider(dirPath);
    return provider.fetchSuggestions(dirPath, prefix);
  }

  /**
   * Stream suggestions with batching support.
   */
  async streamSuggestions(
    dirPath: string,
    prefix: string,
    onBatch: (suggestions: PathSuggestion[]) => void,
  ): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    const provider = this.getProvider(dirPath);
    return provider.streamSuggestions(dirPath, prefix, onBatch);
  }

  /**
   * Check if a given scheme supports streaming suggestions.
   */
  supportsStreaming(path: string): boolean {
    const provider = this.getProvider(path);
    return provider.supportsStreaming(path);
  }

  /**
   * Get the root path for a given path.
   */
  getRootPath(path: string): string | null {
    const provider = this.getProvider(path);
    return provider.getRootPath(path);
  }

  /**
   * Join a directory path and child name.
   */
  joinChildPath(basePath: string, childName: string): string {
    const provider = this.getProvider(basePath);
    return provider.joinChildPath(basePath, childName);
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { normalizePath } from '../components/address-bar.utils';

/**
 * Comprehensive search query parameters.
 * Replaces the need for custom search dialogs by encoding everything in the URL.
 */
export interface SearchQueryParams {
  /** Base directory to search from */
  path?: string;

  /** Search pattern (glob-style by default, regex if regex=true) */
  pattern?: string;

  /** Whether to search recursively (default: true) */
  recursive?: boolean;

  /** Use regex pattern matching instead of glob (default: false) */
  regex?: boolean;

  /** Case-sensitive pattern matching (default: false) */
  caseSensitive?: boolean;

  /** Comma-separated file types to include: file, directory, symlink (default: file,directory) */
  fileTypes?: string;

  /** Minimum file size in bytes */
  minSize?: number;

  /** Maximum file size in bytes */
  maxSize?: number;

  /** Modified date (inclusive), ISO 8601 format: 2024-01-01 or 2024-01-01T12:00:00Z */
  modifiedAfter?: string;

  /** Modified date (inclusive), ISO 8601 format: 2024-12-31 or 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z */
  modifiedBefore?: string;

  /** Include hidden files (default: false) */
  searchHidden?: boolean;

  /** Search inside file contents (requires backend support) (default: false) */
  contentSearch?: boolean;

  /** Comma-separated file extensions to match: .txt,.md,.log */
  extensions?: string;

  /** Custom metadata filter (backend-specific) */
  metadata?: string;
}

const BOOLEAN_KEYS: ReadonlySet<keyof SearchQueryParams> = new Set([
  'recursive',
  'regex',
  'caseSensitive',
  'searchHidden',
  'contentSearch',
]);

const NUMBER_KEYS: ReadonlySet<keyof SearchQueryParams> = new Set([
  'minSize',
  'maxSize',
]);

/**
 * Per-use fluent builder for constructing search:// URLs with complex filters.
 */
export class SearchQueryBuilder {
  private params: Partial<SearchQueryParams>;

  constructor(initial: Partial<SearchQueryParams> = {}) {
    this.params = { ...initial };
  }

  /** Create a new builder state. */
  reset(): SearchQueryBuilder {
    this.params = {};
    return this;
  }

  /** Set the base search path. */
  setPath(path: string): SearchQueryBuilder {
    if (path) {
      this.params.path = normalizePath(path);
    }
    return this;
  }

  /** Set the search pattern (glob-style or regex). */
  setPattern(pattern: string): SearchQueryBuilder {
    if (pattern) {
      this.params.pattern = pattern;
    }
    return this;
  }

  /** Set whether to search recursively. */
  setRecursive(recursive: boolean): SearchQueryBuilder {
    this.params.recursive = recursive;
    return this;
  }

  /** Enable regex pattern matching. */
  setRegex(useRegex: boolean): SearchQueryBuilder {
    this.params.regex = useRegex;
    return this;
  }

  /** Set case sensitivity. */
  setCaseSensitive(caseSensitive: boolean): SearchQueryBuilder {
    this.params.caseSensitive = caseSensitive;
    return this;
  }

  /** Set file types to include (file, directory, symlink). */
  setFileTypes(types: string): SearchQueryBuilder {
    if (types) {
      this.params.fileTypes = types;
    }
    return this;
  }

  /** Set minimum file size in bytes. */
  setMinSize(bytes: number): SearchQueryBuilder {
    if (bytes > 0) {
      this.params.minSize = bytes;
    }
    return this;
  }

  /** Set maximum file size in bytes. */
  setMaxSize(bytes: number): SearchQueryBuilder {
    if (bytes > 0) {
      this.params.maxSize = bytes;
    }
    return this;
  }

  /** Set modified date lower bound (inclusive). */
  setModifiedAfter(date: string | Date): SearchQueryBuilder {
    if (date) {
      this.params.modifiedAfter = this.formatDate(date);
    }
    return this;
  }

  /** Set modified date upper bound (inclusive). */
  setModifiedBefore(date: string | Date): SearchQueryBuilder {
    if (date) {
      this.params.modifiedBefore = this.formatDate(date);
    }
    return this;
  }

  /** Include hidden files in search. */
  setSearchHidden(hidden: boolean): SearchQueryBuilder {
    this.params.searchHidden = hidden;
    return this;
  }

  /** Enable content search (search inside file contents). */
  setContentSearch(enabled: boolean): SearchQueryBuilder {
    this.params.contentSearch = enabled;
    return this;
  }

  /** Set file extensions to match (e.g., '.txt,.md,.log'). */
  setExtensions(extensions: string): SearchQueryBuilder {
    if (extensions) {
      this.params.extensions = extensions;
    }
    return this;
  }

  /** Set custom metadata filter (backend-specific). */
  setMetadata(metadata: string): SearchQueryBuilder {
    if (metadata) {
      this.params.metadata = metadata;
    }
    return this;
  }

  /** Build the search:// URL. */
  build(): string {
    if (!this.params.pattern) {
      return 'search://';
    }

    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(this.params)) {
      if (value !== null && value !== undefined) {
        params.append(key, String(value));
      }
    }

    return `search://?${params.toString()}`;
  }

  /** Load parameters from an existing search:// URL. */
  fromUrl(url: string): SearchQueryBuilder {
    this.reset();
    const parsed = SearchQueryBuilder.parseParams(url);
    this.params = parsed;
    return this;
  }

  /** Convert current state to human-readable description. */
  toDescription(): string {
    return SearchQueryBuilder.describeParams(this.params);
  }

  /** Get current parameters. */
  getParams(): Readonly<Partial<SearchQueryParams>> {
    return { ...this.params };
  }

  static parseParams(url: string): Partial<SearchQueryParams> {
    try {
      const normalized = normalizePath((url || '').trim().replace(/\\/g, '/'));
      if (!normalized.startsWith('search://')) {
        return {};
      }

      const urlPart = normalized.slice('search://'.length);
      if (!urlPart.startsWith('?')) {
        return {};
      }

      const parsed = new URLSearchParams(urlPart.slice(1));
      const params: Partial<SearchQueryParams> = {};

      parsed.forEach((value, key) => {
        const typedKey = key as keyof SearchQueryParams;

        if (BOOLEAN_KEYS.has(typedKey)) {
          (params[typedKey] as boolean | undefined) = value.toLowerCase() === 'true';
          return;
        }

        if (NUMBER_KEYS.has(typedKey)) {
          const numberValue = Number.parseInt(value, 10);
          if (Number.isFinite(numberValue)) {
            (params[typedKey] as number | undefined) = numberValue;
          }
          return;
        }

        (params[typedKey] as string | undefined) = value;
      });

      return params;
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  }

  static describeParams(params: Partial<SearchQueryParams>): string {
    const parts: string[] = [];

    if (params.pattern) parts.push(`Pattern: ${params.pattern}`);
    if (params.path) parts.push(`In: ${params.path}`);
    if (params.recursive === false) parts.push('Non-recursive');
    if (params.regex) parts.push('Regex mode');
    if (params.caseSensitive) parts.push('Case-sensitive');
    if (params.fileTypes) parts.push(`Types: ${params.fileTypes}`);
    if (params.extensions) parts.push(`Extensions: ${params.extensions}`);
    if (params.minSize) parts.push(`Min size: ${SearchQueryBuilder.formatBytes(params.minSize)}`);
    if (params.maxSize) parts.push(`Max size: ${SearchQueryBuilder.formatBytes(params.maxSize)}`);
    if (params.modifiedAfter) parts.push(`Modified after: ${params.modifiedAfter}`);
    if (params.modifiedBefore) parts.push(`Modified before: ${params.modifiedBefore}`);
    if (params.searchHidden) parts.push('Include hidden');
    if (params.contentSearch) parts.push('Search content');

    return parts.join(' | ');
  }

  private formatDate(date: string | Date): string {
    if (typeof date === 'string') {
      return date;
    }
    return date.toISOString().split('T')[0];
  }

  private static formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
    if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes}B`;
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)}KB`;
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)}MB`;
    return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)}GB`;
  }
}

/**
 * Stateless service facade that creates isolated builder instances.
 */
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SearchQueryBuilderService {
  create(initial: Partial<SearchQueryParams> = {}): SearchQueryBuilder {
    return new SearchQueryBuilder(initial);
  }

  fromUrl(url: string): SearchQueryBuilder {
    return new SearchQueryBuilder().fromUrl(url);
  }

  build(params: Partial<SearchQueryParams>): string {
    return new SearchQueryBuilder(params).build();
  }

  parse(url: string): Partial<SearchQueryParams> {
    return SearchQueryBuilder.parseParams(url);
  }

  toDescription(params: Partial<SearchQueryParams>): string {
    return SearchQueryBuilder.describeParams(params);
  }
}
````

````typescript
function normalizeExtension(extension: string | null | undefined): string {
  return (extension ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^\./, '');
}

export const FILE_CATEGORY_BY_ID = new Map<string, FileCategory>(
  DEFAULT_FILE_CATEGORIES.map((category) => [category.id, category] as const),
);

export const FILE_CATEGORIES_BY_EXTENSION = new Map<string, FileCategory[]>();
export const FILE_CATEGORY_EXTENSIONS = new Set<string>();

for (const category of DEFAULT_FILE_CATEGORIES) {
  for (const extension of category.extensions) {
    const normalized = normalizeExtension(extension);
    if (!normalized) continue;

    FILE_CATEGORY_EXTENSIONS.add(normalized);

    const matches = FILE_CATEGORIES_BY_EXTENSION.get(normalized);
    if (matches) {
      matches.push(category);
    } else {
      FILE_CATEGORIES_BY_EXTENSION.set(normalized, [category]);
    }
  }
}

export function getFileCategoriesForExtension(extension: string | null | undefined): FileCategory[] {
  return FILE_CATEGORIES_BY_EXTENSION.get(normalizeExtension(extension)) ?? [];
}

export function getPrimaryFileCategoryForExtension(extension: string | null | undefined): FileCategory | null {
  return getFileCategoriesForExtension(extension)[0] ?? null;
}

export function hasCollidingFileCategories(extension: string | null | undefined): boolean {
  return getFileCategoriesForExtension(extension).length > 1;
}
````

````typescript
 * Shared protocol definitions between client and server.
 * These types define the command structure and responses.

// ============================================================================
// OS Info
// ============================================================================

export enum OSType {
  WINDOWS = 'windows',
  LINUX = 'linux',
  MACOS = 'macos',
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown',
}

export interface OSInfoResponse {
  /** e.g. "windows", "linux", "macos" */
  os: OSType;
  /** e.g. "10.0.22621", "22.04 LTS", "14.3" */
  version: string;
  /** e.g. "x86_64", "aarch64" */
  arch: string;
  /** Machine hostname */
  hostname: string;
  /**
   * On Windows: the system drive root reference, exposed as a public path
  * token such as "filesystem://c". null on non-Windows platforms.
   */
  systemDrive: string | null;
}

// ============================================================================
// Schemes
// ============================================================================

export type SchemeType =
  | 'fixed'
  | 'removable'
  | 'network'
  | 'cdrom'
  | 'ramdisk'
  | 'memory'
  | 'registry'
  | 'search'
  | 'http'
````
