````typescript
import {
  DemuxedAudioTrackSource,
  DemuxedPacketCursor,
  DemuxedVideoSource,
  ExtendedVideoDecoderConfig,
  SampleInfo,
  VideoMetadata,
  loadMp4DemuxedSourceFromBuffer,
} from '../../services/canvas-video-player.service';
import { createSubject, distinctUntilChanged } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

interface SegmentedVideoManifestItem {
  index: number;
  startTime: number;
  durationSeconds: number;
  url: string;
}

interface SegmentedVideoManifest {
  mode: 'segmented';
  format: string;
  durationSeconds: number;
  segmentDuration: number;
  totalSegments: number;
  initSegmentUrl: string;
  segments: SegmentedVideoManifestItem[];
}

interface LoadedSegment {
  index: number;
  videoPackets: SampleInfo[];
  audioPackets: SampleInfo[];
}

interface PacketToken {
  segmentIndex: number;
  packetIndex: number;
}

const SEGMENT_PREFETCH_AHEAD = 3;
const SEGMENT_RETENTION_BEHIND = 6;
const SEGMENT_RETENTION_AHEAD = 6;

export class SegmentVideoLoader {
  private manifest: SegmentedVideoManifest | null = null;
  private initSegment: ArrayBuffer | null = null;
  private readonly loadedSegments = new Map<number, LoadedSegment>();
  private readonly pendingSegments = new Map<number, Promise<LoadedSegment>>();
  private readonly pendingSegmentControllers = new Map<number, AbortController>();
  private readonly anchorRequests$ = createSubject<number>();
  private readonly segmentFetches$ = createSubject<number>();
  private metadata: VideoMetadata | null = null;
  private decoderConfig: ExtendedVideoDecoderConfig | null = null;
  private audioMeta: Omit<DemuxedAudioTrackSource, 'getFirstPacket' | 'getPacketForTime' | 'getNextPacket'> | null = null;
  private activeWindowGeneration = 0;
  private currentAnchorIndex = 0;
  private disposed = false;
  private loadController: AbortController | null = null;
  // Segments that recently failed to load — keyed to the failure timestamp.
  // Prevents the render loop from hammering the server on permanent errors.
  private readonly failedSegments = new Map<number, number>();
  private static readonly SEGMENT_FAILURE_COOLDOWN_MS = 5000;

  constructor() {
    // Anchor changes cancel stale prefetch work and update window
    this.anchorRequests$
      .pipe(distinctUntilChanged())
      .subscribe((anchorIndex: number) => {
        this.currentAnchorIndex = anchorIndex;
        this.activeWindowGeneration += 1;
        this.abortPendingOutsideWindow(anchorIndex);
        this.pruneLoadedSegments(anchorIndex);
      });

    // Track segment fetch attempts for concurrency management
    // Deduplicate rapid successive requests for same segment
    this.segmentFetches$
      .pipe(distinctUntilChanged())
      .subscribe();
  }

  async load(manifestUrl: string): Promise<DemuxedVideoSource> {
    this.dispose();
    this.disposed = false;
    this.loadController = new AbortController();

    const manifestResponse = await fetch(manifestUrl, { signal: this.loadController.signal });
    if (!manifestResponse.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load segment manifest: ${manifestResponse.status}`);
    }

    this.manifest = await manifestResponse.json() as SegmentedVideoManifest;

    const initResponse = await fetch(this.manifest.initSegmentUrl, { signal: this.loadController.signal });
    if (!initResponse.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load init segment: ${initResponse.status}`);
    }
    this.initSegment = await initResponse.arrayBuffer();

    const initialWindowGeneration = this.activateWindow(0);
    const firstSegment = await this.ensureSegmentLoaded(0, initialWindowGeneration);
    this.prefetchAround(0, initialWindowGeneration);
    if (!this.metadata || !this.decoderConfig) {
      throw new Error('Segmented preview did not provide video metadata.');
    }

    return {
      metadata: this.metadata,
      decoderConfig: this.decoderConfig,
      audio: this.audioMeta ? {
        ...this.audioMeta,
        getFirstPacket: async () => this.getFirstAudioPacket(),
        getPacketForTime: async (timeMs: number) => this.getAudioPacketForTime(timeMs),
        getNextPacket: async (cursor: DemuxedPacketCursor) => this.getNextAudioPacket(cursor),
      } : undefined,
      supportsRandomAccess: true,
      getFirstPacket: async () => firstSegment.videoPackets.length > 0 ? this.makeCursor(0, 0, firstSegment.videoPackets) : null,
      getPacketForTime: async (timeMs: number, options?: { keyframe?: boolean }) => this.getPacketForTime(timeMs, options),
      getNextPacket: async (cursor: DemuxedPacketCursor) => this.getNextPacket(cursor),
      destroy: () => this.dispose(),
    };
  }

  private async ensureSegmentLoaded(index: number, windowGeneration = this.activeWindowGeneration): Promise<LoadedSegment> {
    const existing = this.loadedSegments.get(index);
    if (existing) {
      return existing;
    }

    // Refuse to retry a recently-failed segment so the render loop
    // cannot hammer the server at 60 fps on a permanent 500 error.
    const failedAt = this.failedSegments.get(index);
    if (failedAt !== undefined) {
      if (Date.now() - failedAt < SegmentVideoLoader.SEGMENT_FAILURE_COOLDOWN_MS) {
        throw new Error(`Segment ${index} failed to load recently`);
      }
      this.failedSegments.delete(index);
    }

    const pending = this.pendingSegments.get(index);
    if (pending) {
      return pending;
    }

    // Create and store promise synchronously to prevent duplicate fetches
    // Multiple concurrent requesters will share this same promise
    const loadPromise = this.loadSegment(index);
    this.pendingSegments.set(index, loadPromise);

    this.segmentFetches$.next(index);

    try {
      const segment = await loadPromise;
      this.loadedSegments.set(index, segment);
      return segment;
    } catch (err) {
      // Cache the failure unless it was an intentional abort (seek/dispose).
      if (!(err instanceof DOMException && err.name === 'AbortError')) {
        this.failedSegments.set(index, Date.now());
      }
      throw err;
    } finally {
      this.pendingSegments.delete(index);
    }
  }

  private async loadSegment(index: number): Promise<LoadedSegment> {
    if (!this.manifest || !this.initSegment) {
      throw new Error('Segment loader not initialized.');
    }
    if (this.disposed) {
      throw new DOMException('Segment loader disposed', 'AbortError');
    }

    const segment = this.manifest.segments[index];
    if (!segment) {
      throw new Error(`Segment ${index} is not available.`);
    }

    const controller = new AbortController();
    this.pendingSegmentControllers.set(index, controller);

    try {
      const segmentResponse = await fetch(segment.url, { signal: controller.signal });
      if (!segmentResponse.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to load segment ${index}: ${segmentResponse.status}`);
      }

      const segmentBytes = await segmentResponse.arrayBuffer();
      const combined = concatenateBuffers(this.initSegment, segmentBytes);
      const source = await loadMp4DemuxedSourceFromBuffer(combined);

      if (!this.metadata) {
        const manifestDurationMs = this.manifest.durationSeconds > 0 ? this.manifest.durationSeconds * 1000 : 0;
        this.metadata = {
          ...source.metadata,
          duration: manifestDurationMs > 0 ? manifestDurationMs : source.metadata.duration,
          format: this.manifest.format || source.metadata.format,
        };
        this.decoderConfig = source.decoderConfig;
        if (source.audio) {
          this.audioMeta = {
            decoderConfig: source.audio.decoderConfig,
            codec: source.audio.codec,
            sampleRate: source.audio.sampleRate,
            numberOfChannels: source.audio.numberOfChannels,
          };
        }
      }

      const startOffsetMs = segment.startTime * 1000;
      const videoPackets = await collectPackets(
        () => source.getFirstPacket(),
        (cursor) => source.getNextPacket(cursor),
        startOffsetMs,
      );
      const audioPackets = source.audio
        ? await collectPackets(
            () => source.audio!.getFirstPacket(),
            (cursor) => source.audio!.getNextPacket(cursor),
            startOffsetMs,
          )
        : [];
      source.destroy?.();

      return { index, videoPackets, audioPackets };
    } finally {
      this.pendingSegmentControllers.delete(index);
    }
  }

  private async getPacketForTime(timeMs: number, options?: { keyframe?: boolean }): Promise<DemuxedPacketCursor | null> {
    if (!this.manifest) {
      return null;
    }

    let segmentIndex = this.findSegmentIndex(timeMs);
    const windowGeneration = this.activateWindow(segmentIndex);
    const maxBackwardSegments = options?.keyframe ? 5 : 1;
    let backwardAttempts = 0;

    while (segmentIndex >= 0 && backwardAttempts <= maxBackwardSegments) {
      let segment: LoadedSegment;
      try {
        segment = await this.ensureSegmentLoaded(segmentIndex, windowGeneration);
      } catch {
        // Segment failed to load — if we're searching for a keyframe walk
        // backward to the previous segment rather than propagating the error.
        if (!options?.keyframe) {
          break;
        }
        segmentIndex -= 1;
        backwardAttempts += 1;
        continue;
      }
      const packetIndex = findPacketIndex(segment.videoPackets, timeMs, options?.keyframe === true);
      if (packetIndex >= 0) {
        if (this.isActiveWindow(windowGeneration)) {
          this.prefetchAround(segmentIndex, windowGeneration);
        }
        return this.makeCursor(segmentIndex, packetIndex, segment.videoPackets);
      }

      if (!options?.keyframe) {
        break;
      }

      segmentIndex -= 1;
      backwardAttempts += 1;
    }
    return null;
  }

  private async getNextPacket(cursor: DemuxedPacketCursor): Promise<DemuxedPacketCursor | null> {
    const token = cursor.token as PacketToken;
    const windowGeneration = this.activeWindowGeneration;
    const segment = await this.ensureSegmentLoaded(token.segmentIndex, windowGeneration);
    const nextPacketIndex = token.packetIndex + 1;
    if (nextPacketIndex < segment.videoPackets.length) {
      return this.makeCursor(token.segmentIndex, nextPacketIndex, segment.videoPackets);
    }

    if (!this.manifest || token.segmentIndex + 1 >= this.manifest.totalSegments) {
      return null;
    }

    const nextSegmentIndex = token.segmentIndex + 1;
    const nextWindowGeneration = this.activateWindow(nextSegmentIndex);
    const nextSegment = await this.ensureSegmentLoaded(nextSegmentIndex, nextWindowGeneration);
    if (this.isActiveWindow(nextWindowGeneration)) {
      this.prefetchAround(nextSegmentIndex, nextWindowGeneration);
      }
    return nextSegment.videoPackets.length > 0
      ? this.makeCursor(nextSegmentIndex, 0, nextSegment.videoPackets)
      : null;
  }

  private async getFirstAudioPacket(): Promise<DemuxedPacketCursor | null> {
      const segment = await this.ensureSegmentLoaded(0, this.activeWindowGeneration);
    return segment.audioPackets.length > 0 ? this.makeCursor(0, 0, segment.audioPackets) : null;
  }

  private async getAudioPacketForTime(timeMs: number): Promise<DemuxedPacketCursor | null> {
    if (!this.manifest) {
      return null;
    }

    const segmentIndex = this.findSegmentIndex(timeMs);
      const windowGeneration = this.activeWindowGeneration;
      const segment = await this.ensureSegmentLoaded(segmentIndex, windowGeneration);
    const packetIndex = findPacketIndex(segment.audioPackets, timeMs, false);
      if (packetIndex >= 0 && this.isActiveWindow(windowGeneration)) {
        this.prefetchAround(segmentIndex, windowGeneration);
      }
    return packetIndex >= 0 ? this.makeCursor(segmentIndex, packetIndex, segment.audioPackets) : null;
  }

  private async getNextAudioPacket(cursor: DemuxedPacketCursor): Promise<DemuxedPacketCursor | null> {
    const token = cursor.token as PacketToken;
      const windowGeneration = this.activeWindowGeneration;
      const segment = await this.ensureSegmentLoaded(token.segmentIndex, windowGeneration);
    const nextPacketIndex = token.packetIndex + 1;
    if (nextPacketIndex < segment.audioPackets.length) {
      return this.makeCursor(token.segmentIndex, nextPacketIndex, segment.audioPackets);
    }

    if (!this.manifest || token.segmentIndex + 1 >= this.manifest.totalSegments) {
      return null;
    }

    const nextSegmentIndex = token.segmentIndex + 1;
    const nextWindowGeneration = this.activateWindow(nextSegmentIndex);
    const nextSegment = await this.ensureSegmentLoaded(nextSegmentIndex, nextWindowGeneration);
    if (this.isActiveWindow(nextWindowGeneration)) {
      this.prefetchAround(nextSegmentIndex, nextWindowGeneration);
      }
    return nextSegment.audioPackets.length > 0
      ? this.makeCursor(nextSegmentIndex, 0, nextSegment.audioPackets)
      : null;
  }

  private prefetchAround(anchorIndex: number, windowGeneration: number): void {
    if (!this.manifest) {
      return;
    }

    if (!this.isActiveWindow(windowGeneration)) {
      return;
    }

    // Prefetch forward
    for (let offset = 1; offset <= SEGMENT_PREFETCH_AHEAD; offset += 1) {
      const nextIndex = anchorIndex + offset;
      if (nextIndex >= this.manifest.totalSegments) {
        break;
      }
      if (this.loadedSegments.has(nextIndex) || this.pendingSegments.has(nextIndex)) {
        continue;
      }
      void this.ensureSegmentLoaded(nextIndex, windowGeneration).catch(() => {});
    }
    
    // Also prefetch backward when we're in the middle of the video
    if (anchorIndex > SEGMENT_PREFETCH_AHEAD) {
      for (let offset = 1; offset <= SEGMENT_PREFETCH_AHEAD; offset += 1) {
        const prevIndex = anchorIndex - offset;
        if (prevIndex < 0) {
          break;
        }
        if (this.loadedSegments.has(prevIndex) || this.pendingSegments.has(prevIndex)) {
          continue;
        }
        void this.ensureSegmentLoaded(prevIndex, windowGeneration).catch(() => {});
      }
    }
  }

  private pruneLoadedSegments(anchorIndex: number): void {
    const minIndex = Math.max(0, anchorIndex - SEGMENT_RETENTION_BEHIND);
    const maxIndex = anchorIndex + SEGMENT_RETENTION_AHEAD;
    for (const index of Array.from(this.loadedSegments.keys())) {
      if (index < minIndex || index > maxIndex) {
        this.loadedSegments.delete(index);
      }
    }
  }

  private findSegmentIndex(timeMs: number): number {
    if (!this.manifest) {
      return 0;
    }

    for (let index = 0; index < this.manifest.segments.length; index += 1) {
      const segment = this.manifest.segments[index];
      const startMs = segment.startTime * 1000;
      const endMs = startMs + (segment.durationSeconds * 1000);
      if (timeMs < endMs) {
        return index;
      }
    }

    return Math.max(0, this.manifest.segments.length - 1);
  }

  private makeCursor(segmentIndex: number, packetIndex: number, packets: SampleInfo[]): DemuxedPacketCursor | null {
    const packet = packets[packetIndex];
    if (!packet) {
      return null;
    }

    return {
      token: { segmentIndex, packetIndex },
      packet,
    };
  }

  private activateWindow(anchorIndex: number): number {
    if (this.activeWindowGeneration == 0 || this.currentAnchorIndex !== anchorIndex) {
      this.anchorRequests$.next(anchorIndex);
    }
    return this.activeWindowGeneration;
  }

  private isActiveWindow(windowGeneration: number): boolean {
    return windowGeneration === this.activeWindowGeneration;
  }

  private abortPendingOutsideWindow(anchorIndex: number): void {
    const minIndex = Math.max(0, anchorIndex - SEGMENT_RETENTION_BEHIND);
    const maxIndex = anchorIndex + SEGMENT_RETENTION_AHEAD + SEGMENT_PREFETCH_AHEAD;
    for (const [index, controller] of this.pendingSegmentControllers.entries()) {
      if (index < minIndex || index > maxIndex) {
        controller.abort();
      }
    }
  }

  private dispose(): void {
    if (this.loadController) {
      this.loadController.abort();
      this.loadController = null;
    }
    this.disposed = true;
    this.activeWindowGeneration += 1;
    for (const controller of this.pendingSegmentControllers.values()) {
      controller.abort();
    }
    this.pendingSegmentControllers.clear();
    this.pendingSegments.clear();
    this.loadedSegments.clear();
    this.failedSegments.clear();
    this.currentAnchorIndex = 0;
    this.manifest = null;
    this.initSegment = null;
    this.metadata = null;
    this.decoderConfig = null;
    this.audioMeta = null;
  }
}

async function collectPackets(
  getFirstPacket: () => Promise<DemuxedPacketCursor | null>,
  getNextPacket: (cursor: DemuxedPacketCursor) => Promise<DemuxedPacketCursor | null>,
  timeOffsetMs: number,
): Promise<SampleInfo[]> {
  const packets: SampleInfo[] = [];
  let cursor = await getFirstPacket();
  while (cursor) {
    packets.push({
      ...cursor.packet,
      timestampMs: cursor.packet.timestampMs + timeOffsetMs,
    });
    cursor = await getNextPacket(cursor);
  }
  return packets;
}

function findPacketIndex(packets: SampleInfo[], timeMs: number, requireKeyframe: boolean): number {
  let bestIndex = -1;
  
  if (requireKeyframe) {
    // Find the keyframe with timestamp <= timeMs (for backward seeks)
    for (let index = 0; index < packets.length; index += 1) {
      const packet = packets[index];
      if (packet.isRap && packet.timestampMs <= timeMs) {
        bestIndex = index;
      } else if (packet.timestampMs > timeMs && bestIndex >= 0) {
        break;
      }
    }
    
    if (bestIndex >= 0) {
      return bestIndex;
    }
    
    // If no keyframe before, find first keyframe
    return packets.findIndex(packet => packet.isRap);
  }
  
  // Regular forward seek - find first packet >= timeMs
  for (let index = 0; index < packets.length; index += 1) {
    if (packets[index].timestampMs >= timeMs) {
      return index;
    }
  }
  
  return packets.length > 0 ? packets.length - 1 : -1;
}

function concatenateBuffers(first: ArrayBuffer, second: ArrayBuffer): ArrayBuffer {
  const combined = new Uint8Array(first.byteLength + second.byteLength);
  combined.set(new Uint8Array(first), 0);
  combined.set(new Uint8Array(second), first.byteLength);
  return combined.buffer;
}
````

````typescript
      color: #195f98;
    }

    .resolution-badge {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, #218a66 10%, transparent);
      border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #218a66 24%, transparent);
      color: #1b6f53;
    }

    .viewer-body {
      flex: 1 1 0%;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow: auto;
      position: relative;
    }

    .state-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      height: 100%;
      min-height: 160px;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 24px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .state-icon {
      font-size: 36px;
      line-height: 1;
      opacity: 0.55;
    }

    .state-label {
      font-size: 13px;
      opacity: 0.65;
    }

    .state-error .state-icon {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .state-error .state-label {
      color: #ff7070;
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .error-detail {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-family: var(--vsc-font-family-mono, ui-monospace, monospace);
      color: color-mix(in srgb, #ff7070 70%, var(--vsc-foreground, #ccc));
      background: rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.07);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 112, 112, 0.2);
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      max-width: 480px;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
      word-break: break-word;
    }

    .spinner {
      width: 26px;
      height: 26px;
      border: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue, #0078d4) 25%, transparent);
      border-top-color: var(--vsc-accent-blue, #0078d4);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 0.65s linear infinite;
    }

    @keyframes spin {
      to {
        transform: rotate(360deg);
      }
    }

    .video-player-wrapper {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      background: #000;
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif;
    }

    .video-stage {
      position: relative;
      flex: 1;
      min-height: 300px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #000;
    }

    .canvas-video-container {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0a0a 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
      overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: filter 0.2s ease;
    }

    .video-stage:hover .canvas-video-container {
      filter: brightness(1.12);
    }

    .canvas-video-container ::ng-deep canvas {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: contain;
      display: block;
    }

    /* Professional Video Navigation Styles */
    .video-nav-hotspot {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 320px;
      padding: 0;
      border: 0;
      background: transparent;
      color: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
      z-index: 70;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.4, 1.1);
      appearance: none;
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      border-radius: 0;
      outline: none;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }

    .video-nav-hotspot--prev {
      z-index: 70;
    }

    .video-nav-hotspot--next {
      z-index: 71;
    }

    .video-nav-hotspot--prev {
      left: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.96) 0%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.56) 52%,
        transparent 100%
      );
    }

    .video-nav-hotspot--next {
      right: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(
        270deg,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.96) 0%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.56) 52%,
        transparent 100%
      );
    }

    .video-stage:hover .video-nav-hotspot {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .video-nav-hotspot--prev:hover,
    .video-nav-hotspot--prev:focus-visible {
      background: linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.82) 0%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32) 50%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 100%
      );
    }

    .video-nav-hotspot--next:hover,
    .video-nav-hotspot--next:focus-visible {
      background: linear-gradient(
        270deg,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.82) 0%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32) 50%,
        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 100%
      );
      
    }
    .video-nav-hotspot:hover,
    .video-nav-hotspot:focus,
    .video-nav-hotspot:focus-visible {
      z-index: 74;
    }

    .video-nav-card {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 260px;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.4, 1.1);
    }

    .video-nav-hotspot--prev .video-nav-card {
      left: 24px;
      transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(-20px);
    }

    .video-nav-hotspot--next .video-nav-card {
      right: 24px;
      transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(20px);
    }

    .video-stage:hover .video-nav-hotspot--prev .video-nav-card {
      transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(0);
    }

    .video-stage:hover .video-nav-hotspot--next .video-nav-card {
      transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(0);
    }

    .video-nav-thumb-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--vsc-widget-shadow, 0 5px 8px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36));
      border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-border, #454545) 55%, transparent);
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.4, 1.1);
    }

    .video-nav-thumb {
      position: relative;
      width: 260px;
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
      background: linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-editorWidget-background, #252526) 94%, black) 0%,
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-editorWidget-background, #252526) 74%, black) 100%
      );
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .video-nav-thumb img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: block;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    .video-nav-thumb--empty {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-editorWidget-background, #252526) 94%, black) 0%,
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-editorWidget-background, #252526) 74%, black) 100%
      );
    }

    .video-nav-fallback {
      font-size: 48px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--vsc-foreground, #cccccc);
      opacity: 0.5;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .video-nav-info {
      margin-top: 12px;
      padding: 0 8px;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .video-nav-hotspot--next .video-nav-info {
      text-align: right;
    }

    .video-nav-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.56);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .video-nav-name {
      display: block;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      line-height: 1.3;
      word-break: break-word;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24);
    }

    /* Loading State */
    .video-loading {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 16px;
      z-index: 100;
    }

    .video-loading .spinner {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border: 3px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      border-top-color: var(--vsc-accent-blue, #0078d4);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
    }

    .loading-text {
      color: #aaa;
      font-size: 13px;
      letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    }

    /* Play Overlay */
    .play-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      cursor: pointer;
      z-index: 50;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .play-overlay:hover {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }

    .play-icon {
      width: 80px;
      height: 80px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: var(--vsc-accent-blue, #0078d4);
      border-radius: 50%;
      font-size: 32px;
      color: white;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 120, 212, 0.4);
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.4, 1.1);
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    .play-overlay:hover .play-icon {
      background: #1084d7;
      transform: scale(1.1);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 48px rgba(0, 120, 212, 0.6);
    }

    /* Video Controls */
    .video-control-bar {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) 80%, transparent 100%);
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .video-control-bar.show {
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .video-stage:hover ~ .video-control-bar,
    .video-control-bar:hover {
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .progress-section {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      height: 24px;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .progress-container {
      flex: 1;
      position: relative;
      height: 4px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      border-radius: 2px;
      cursor: pointer;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .progress-fill {
      position: absolute;
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--vsc-accent-blue, #0078d4), #00a4ef);
      border-radius: 2px;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: width 0.05s linear;
    }

    .seek-slider {
      position: absolute;
      width: 100%;
      height: 24px;
      cursor: pointer;
      appearance: none;
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      background: transparent;
      outline: none;
      margin: -10px 0;
      z-index: 10;
    }

    .seek-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
      appearance: none;
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      background: white;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .seek-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 120, 212, 0.8);
    }

    .seek-slider::-moz-range-thumb {
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      background: white;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .seek-slider::-moz-range-thumb:hover {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 120, 212, 0.8);
    }

    .seek-slider:disabled {
      opacity: 0.5;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .controls-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 0 4px;
    }

    .control-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      padding: 0 8px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      color: white;
      border-radius: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 16px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      font-weight: 600;
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    }

    .control-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }

    .control-btn:active:not(:disabled) {
      transform: scale(0.95);
    }

    .control-btn:disabled {
      opacity: 0.4;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .control-btn .icon {
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .play-pause-btn {
      min-width: 44px;
      background: var(--vsc-accent-blue, #0078d4);
      border: 1px solid rgba(0, 120, 212, 0.3);
    }

    .play-pause-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
      background: #1084d7;
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0, 120, 212, 0.5);
    }

    .time-display {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #ccc;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      font-family: 'Monaco', 'Menlo', 'Ubuntu Mono', monospace;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
      border-radius: 4px;
      min-width: 90px;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .current-time {
      color: white;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .separator {
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    .spacer {
      flex: 1;
    }

    .volume-control {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 0 4px;
    }

    .volume-icon {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .volume-slider {
      width: 80px;
      height: 4px;
      cursor: pointer;
      appearance: none;
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      border-radius: 2px;
      outline: none;
    }

    .volume-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
      appearance: none;
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      background: white;
      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    }

    .volume-slider::-moz-range-thumb {
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      background: white;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    }

    .volume-slider:disabled {
      opacity: 0.5;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    /* Responsive adjustments */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .video-nav-hotspot {
        width: 200px;
      }
      
      .video-nav-card {
        width: 160px;
      }
      
      .video-nav-thumb {
        width: 160px;
      }
      
      .video-nav-name {
        font-size: 12px;
      }
    }
  `],
})
export class VideoViewerComponent implements OnChanges, AfterViewInit, OnDestroy {
  private static readonly WINDOWED_VIDEO_STREAM_SECONDS = 90;
  private static readonly AMBIGUOUS_VIDEO_EXTENSIONS = new Set(['ts']);
  private static readonly VIDEO_EXTENSIONS = new Set([
    'mp4', 'm4v', 'mov', 'qt', 'avi', 'divx', 'xvid', 'mkv', 'wmv', 'asf', 'flv', 'f4v',
    'webm', 'ogv', 'ts', 'mts', 'm2ts', 'mpg', 'mpeg', 'mpe', 'mpv', 'mp2', 'm2p', 'm2v',
    'vob', 'evo', 'mjpeg', 'mjpg', '3gp', '3g2', 'rm', 'rmvb',
  ]);

  @Input() targetPath = '';
  @Input() fileList: ViewerFileListItem[] = [];
  @Input() archiveContext: ViewerArchiveContext | null = null;
  @Input() viewerId: string | null = null;
  @Input() probe: FileProbe | null = null;

  @ViewChild('videoContainer')
  set videoContainerRef(value: ElementRef<HTMLDivElement> | undefined) {
    this._videoContainerRef = value;
    this.requestSegmentedPlaybackInitialization();
    this.requestUrlPlaybackInitialization();
  }

  get videoContainerRef(): ElementRef<HTMLDivElement> | undefined {
    return this._videoContainerRef;
  }

  useLegacySurface = false;
  loading = false;
  error: string | null = null;
  canvasPlayer: CanvasVideoPlayer | null = null;
  videoReady = false;
  videoIsPlaying = false;
  videoLoading = false;
  videoShowControls = true;
  videoCurrentTime = 0;
  videoDuration = 0;
  videoCodecInfo = '';
  videoResolution = '';
  videoVolume = 100;
  videoIsSeeking = false;
  videoSeekTarget = 0;
  fileSize = 0;
  previousVideo: VideoNavItem | null = null;
  nextVideo: VideoNavItem | null = null;

  private pendingManifestUrl: string | null = null;
  private pendingStreamUrl: string | null = null;
  private _videoContainerRef?: ElementRef<HTMLDivElement>;
  private initializingManifestUrl: string | null = null;
  private seekGeneration = 0;
  private initializingStreamUrl: string | null = null;
  private currentStreamUrl: string | null = null;
  private loadingStreamUrl: string | null = null;
  private videoTimelineOffsetSeconds = 0;
  private videoControlsTimeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private seekDragActive = false;
  private seekPending = false;
  private seekOriginSeconds = 0;
  private seekRequestGeneration = 0;
  private navThumbnailGeneration = 0;
  private initGeneration = 0;
  private playerSubscriptions: Unsubscribable[] = [];
  playbackMode = '';

  constructor(
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private readonly videoPlayerService: CanvasVideoPlayerService,
    private readonly workspaceService: WorkspaceService,
  ) { }

  get displayName(): string {
    const normalized = (this.targetPath ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
    return normalized.split('/').pop() ?? normalized;
  }

  get typeBadge(): string {
    const ext = (this.targetPath.split('.').pop() ?? 'video').toUpperCase();
    return ext || 'VIDEO';
  }

  get displayedCurrentTime(): number {
    return this.seekDragActive ? this.videoSeekTarget : this.videoCurrentTime;
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    this.requestSegmentedPlaybackInitialization();
    this.requestUrlPlaybackInitialization();
  }

  async ngOnChanges(): Promise<void> {
    this.resetState();

    const path = (this.targetPath ?? '').trim();
    if (!path && !this.archiveContext) {
      this.previousVideo = null;
      this.nextVideo = null;
      this.useLegacySurface = true;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    await this.refreshSiblingNavigation();

    this.loading = true;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    try {
      let rawPlan: any;
      if (this.archiveContext) {
        rawPlan = await this.api.getArchiveVideoPlaybackPlan(
          this.archiveContext.fsPath,
          this.archiveContext.nestedChain,
          this.archiveContext.entryPath,
        );
      } else {
        const info = await this.api.getFileInfo(path);
        this.fileSize = info.size ?? 0;
        rawPlan = await this.api.getVideoPlaybackPlan(path);
      }
      const mode = String(rawPlan?.mode ?? rawPlan?.Mode ?? '').toLowerCase();
      const url = String(rawPlan?.url ?? rawPlan?.URL ?? '');
      this.playbackMode = mode || 'video';
      if (!url) {
        this.useLegacySurface = true;
      } else if (mode === 'segmented') {
        this.pendingManifestUrl = url;
        this.requestSegmentedPlaybackInitialization();
      } else {
        this.pendingStreamUrl = url;
        this.requestUrlPlaybackInitialization();
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      this.error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    } finally {
      this.loading = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.clearPlayerSubscriptions();
    if (this.canvasPlayer) {
      this.canvasPlayer.destroy();
      this.canvasPlayer = null;
    }
    if (this.videoControlsTimeout) {
      clearTimeout(this.videoControlsTimeout);
      this.videoControlsTimeout = null;
    }
  }

  async videoPlayPause(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canvasPlayer) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      if (this.videoIsPlaying) {
        this.canvasPlayer.pause();
      } else {
        this.videoLoading = true;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
        await this.canvasPlayer.play();
        this.videoLoading = false;
      }
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      this.error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Playback error';
      this.videoLoading = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  onVideoSeekStart(): void {
    if (!this.videoReady) {
      return;
    }
    this.seekDragActive = true;
    if (!this.videoLoading) {
      this.seekOriginSeconds = this.videoCurrentTime;
    }
    this.updateVideoSeekingState();
    this.videoSeekTarget = this.videoCurrentTime;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onVideoSeekInput(event: Event): void {
    if (!this.videoReady) {
      return;
    }
    const seekSeconds = parseFloat((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
    this.videoSeekTarget = seekSeconds;
    this.videoCurrentTime = seekSeconds;
    this.updateVideoSeekingState();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onVideoSeekCommit(event: Event): void {
    if (!this.videoReady) {
      return;
    }

    const seekSeconds = parseFloat((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value);
    this.seekDragActive = false;
    this.videoSeekTarget = seekSeconds;
    this.videoCurrentTime = seekSeconds;

    const isBackwardSeek = seekSeconds < this.videoCurrentTime;
    if (isBackwardSeek && this.canvasPlayer) {
      // Try to show buffered frame immediately for backward seek
      const currentFrame = this.canvasPlayer['findBufferedFrameForTime']?.(seekSeconds * 1000);
      if (currentFrame) {
        // Visual feedback already provided by displayedCurrentTime
      }
    }

    void this.performSeek(seekSeconds);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private async performSeek(seekSeconds: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canvasPlayer || !this.videoReady) {
      return;
    }

    const generation = ++this.seekRequestGeneration;
    const shouldResumePlayback = this.canvasPlayer.isPlaying() || this.videoIsPlaying;
    const currentTimeMs = this.videoCurrentTime * 1000;
    const targetTimeMs = seekSeconds * 1000;
    const isSeekingBackward = targetTimeMs < currentTimeMs;

    const needsRestart = this.shouldRestartStreamOnSeek(seekSeconds) && !isSeekingBackward;

    this.seekPending = true;
    this.videoLoading = needsRestart;
    this.updateVideoSeekingState();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    try {
      if (needsRestart) {
        await this.restartVideoAt(seekSeconds, { autoplay: shouldResumePlayback, generation });
      } else {
        const playerSeekSeconds = this.shouldUseWindowedVideoStreaming()
          ? Math.max(0, seekSeconds - this.videoTimelineOffsetSeconds)
          : seekSeconds;
        await this.canvasPlayer.seek(playerSeekSeconds * 1000);
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (generation === this.seekRequestGeneration) {
        this.error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Seek failed';
      }
    } finally {
      if (generation === this.seekRequestGeneration) {
        this.seekPending = false;
        if (!needsRestart) {
          this.videoLoading = false;
        }
        this.updateVideoSeekingState();
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      }
    }
  }

  private updateVideoSeekingState(): void {
    this.videoIsSeeking = this.seekDragActive || this.seekPending || this.videoLoading;
  }

  private shouldUseWindowedVideoStreaming(): boolean {
    return this.playbackMode === 'transcode';
  }

  private shouldRestartStreamOnSeek(seekSeconds: number): boolean {
    if (!this.shouldUseWindowedVideoStreaming()) {
      return false;
    }

    const windowStart = this.videoTimelineOffsetSeconds;
    const windowEnd = windowStart + VideoViewerComponent.WINDOWED_VIDEO_STREAM_SECONDS;
    const isSeekingBackward = seekSeconds < this.videoCurrentTime;

    if (isSeekingBackward) {
      const seekDistance = this.videoCurrentTime - seekSeconds;
      if (seekDistance <= 30) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    return seekSeconds < windowStart || seekSeconds >= windowEnd;
  }

  private buildSeekUrl(startSeconds: number): string | null {
    const sourceUrl = this.pendingStreamUrl;
    if (!sourceUrl) {
      return null;
    }

    try {
      const resolved = new URL(sourceUrl, window.location.href);
      if (startSeconds > 0) {
        resolved.searchParams.set('start', startSeconds.toFixed(3));
      } else {
        resolved.searchParams.delete('start');
      }
      resolved.searchParams.set('window', VideoViewerComponent.WINDOWED_VIDEO_STREAM_SECONDS.toFixed(3));
      return resolved.toString();
    } catch {
      return sourceUrl;
    }
  }

  private parseVideoStartOffsetSeconds(url: string): number {
    try {
      const resolved = new URL(url, window.location.href);
      const rawStart = Number(resolved.searchParams.get('start') ?? '0');
      return Number.isFinite(rawStart) && rawStart > 0 ? rawStart : 0;
    } catch {
      return 0;
    }
  }

  private async restartVideoAt(seekSeconds: number, options?: { autoplay?: boolean; generation?: number }): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canvasPlayer) {
      return;
    }

    const nextUrl = this.buildSeekUrl(seekSeconds);
    if (!nextUrl) {
      return;
    }
    if (this.loadingStreamUrl === nextUrl) {
      return;
    }

    const shouldResumePlayback = options?.autoplay ?? this.canvasPlayer.isPlaying();
    this.error = null;
    this.videoLoading = true;
    this.loadingStreamUrl = nextUrl;
    this.videoTimelineOffsetSeconds = seekSeconds;
    this.videoCurrentTime = seekSeconds;
    this.videoSeekTarget = seekSeconds;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    try {
      await this.canvasPlayer.loadFromUrl(nextUrl);
      if (options?.generation === undefined || options.generation === this.seekRequestGeneration) {
        this.currentStreamUrl = nextUrl;
        this.videoReady = true;
      }
      if (shouldResumePlayback && (options?.generation === undefined || options.generation === this.seekRequestGeneration)) {
        await this.canvasPlayer.play();
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      if (options?.generation === undefined || options.generation === this.seekRequestGeneration) {
        this.error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Seek failed';
      }
    } finally {
      if (this.loadingStreamUrl === nextUrl) {
        this.loadingStreamUrl = null;
      }
      if (options?.generation === undefined || options.generation === this.seekRequestGeneration) {
        this.videoLoading = false;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      }
    }
  }

  onVideoVolumeChange(event: Event): void {
    const nextVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value)));
    this.videoVolume = nextVolume;
    this.canvasPlayer?.setVolume(nextVolume / 100);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onVideoMouseMove(): void {
    this.videoShowControls = true;
    if (this.videoControlsTimeout) {
      clearTimeout(this.videoControlsTimeout);
    }
    if (this.videoIsPlaying) {
      this.videoControlsTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        this.videoShowControls = false;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      }, 3000);
    }
  }

  onVideoMouseLeave(): void {
    if (!this.videoIsPlaying) {
      return;
    }
    this.videoShowControls = false;
    if (this.videoControlsTimeout) {
      clearTimeout(this.videoControlsTimeout);
      this.videoControlsTimeout = null;
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  formatTime(seconds: number): string {
    if (!seconds || seconds < 0) {
      return '0:00';
    }
    const totalSecs = Math.floor(seconds);
    const mins = Math.floor(totalSecs / 60);
    const secs = totalSecs % 60;
    const hours = Math.floor(mins / 60);
    const displayMins = mins % 60;
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}:${displayMins.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }
    return `${displayMins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }

  formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    if (!bytes || bytes <= 0) {
      return '';
    }
    const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
    const unitIndex = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
    const value = bytes / Math.pow(1024, unitIndex);
    return `${unitIndex === 0 ? value : value.toFixed(1)} ${units[unitIndex]}`;
  }

  thumbnailFallback(name: string): string {
    const source = (name ?? '').trim();
    const first = source.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
    return first || 'V';
  }

  navigateToSibling(item: VideoNavItem, event?: Event): void {
    event?.preventDefault();
    event?.stopPropagation();
    if (!item.path || this.archiveContext) {
      return;
    }

    const workspace = this.workspaceService.getActiveWorkspace();
    if (!workspace) {
      return;
    }

    const current = this.findViewerTab(workspace, this.targetPath);
    if (!current) {
      return;
    }

    this.workspaceService.updateViewerTabTargetPath(current.paneId, current.tab.id, item.path, {
      sourcePane: current.tab.viewer?.sourcePane ?? current.paneId,
      sourceTabId: current.tab.viewer?.sourceTabId ?? '',
      sourceDir: current.tab.viewer?.sourceDir ?? '',
      fileList: this.fileList,
    });
  }

  private async createAndAttachCanvasPlayer(generation: number): Promise<CanvasVideoPlayer> {
    if (!this.videoContainerRef?.nativeElement) {
      throw new Error('Video container is not available.');
    }
    this.clearPlayerSubscriptions();
    if (this.canvasPlayer) {
      this.canvasPlayer.destroy();
      this.canvasPlayer = null;
    }
    const player = await this.videoPlayerService.createPlayer(this.videoContainerRef.nativeElement);
    this.canvasPlayer = player;
    player.setVolume(this.videoVolume / 100);
    this.playerSubscriptions.push(player.stateChanged$.subscribe((state) => {
      if (generation !== this.initGeneration || this.canvasPlayer !== player) return;
      this.videoIsPlaying = state === 'playing';
      if (state !== 'playing') {
        this.videoShowControls = true;
      }
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }));
    this.playerSubscriptions.push(player.metadataReady$.subscribe((metadata: VideoMetadata) => {
      if (generation !== this.initGeneration || this.canvasPlayer !== player) return;
      this.videoDuration = this.shouldUseWindowedVideoStreaming()
        ? Math.max(this.videoDuration, this.videoTimelineOffsetSeconds + metadata.duration / 1000)
        : metadata.duration / 1000;
      this.videoCodecInfo = metadata.videoCodec || '';
      this.videoResolution = `${metadata.width}\u00d7${metadata.height}`;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }));
    this.playerSubscriptions.push(player.currentTime$.subscribe((seconds: number) => {
      if (generation !== this.initGeneration || this.canvasPlayer !== player) return;
      if (this.seekDragActive) {
        return;
      }
      this.videoCurrentTime = this.shouldUseWindowedVideoStreaming()
        ? this.videoTimelineOffsetSeconds + seconds
        : seconds;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }));
    this.playerSubscriptions.push(player.error$.subscribe((message: string) => {
      if (generation !== this.initGeneration || this.canvasPlayer !== player) return;
      this.error = message;
      this.videoLoading = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }));
    return player;
  }

  private async initializeSegmentedPlayback(manifestUrl: string, generation: number): Promise<void> {
    if (generation !== this.initGeneration) return;
    if (!this.videoContainerRef?.nativeElement) {
      return;
    }
    this.videoLoading = true;
    this.error = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    const loader = new SegmentVideoLoader();
    const source = await loader.load(manifestUrl);
    if (generation !== this.initGeneration) return;
    const player = await this.createAndAttachCanvasPlayer(generation);
    if (generation !== this.initGeneration || this.canvasPlayer !== player) return;
    await player.loadFromDemuxedSource(source);
    if (generation !== this.initGeneration || this.canvasPlayer !== player) return;
    this.videoReady = true;
    try {
      await player.play();
    } catch {
      // Ignore autoplay errors; user can manually start playback
    }
    this.videoLoading = false;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private async initializeUrlPlayback(streamUrl: string, generation: number): Promise<void> {
    if (generation !== this.initGeneration) return;
    if (!this.videoContainerRef?.nativeElement) {
      return;
    }
    this.videoLoading = true;
    this.loadingStreamUrl = streamUrl;
    this.videoTimelineOffsetSeconds = this.parseVideoStartOffsetSeconds(streamUrl);
    this.error = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    const player = await this.createAndAttachCanvasPlayer(generation);
    try {
      if (generation !== this.initGeneration || this.canvasPlayer !== player) return;
      await player.loadFromUrl(streamUrl);
      if (generation !== this.initGeneration || this.canvasPlayer !== player) return;
      this.currentStreamUrl = streamUrl;
      this.videoReady = true;
      try {
        await player.play();
      } catch {
        // Ignore autoplay errors
      }
    } finally {
      if (this.loadingStreamUrl === streamUrl) {
        this.loadingStreamUrl = null;
      }
      this.videoLoading = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  private requestSegmentedPlaybackInitialization(): void {
    const manifestUrl = this.pendingManifestUrl;
    if (!manifestUrl || this.useLegacySurface || !this.videoContainerRef?.nativeElement) {
      return;
    }
    if (this.initializingManifestUrl === manifestUrl || this.canvasPlayer) {
      return;
    }

    this.initializingManifestUrl = manifestUrl;
    const generation = this.initGeneration;
    void this.initializeSegmentedPlayback(manifestUrl, generation)
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        if (generation !== this.initGeneration) return;
        this.error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
        this.videoLoading = false;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (this.initializingManifestUrl === manifestUrl) {
          this.initializingManifestUrl = null;
        }
      });
  }

  private requestUrlPlaybackInitialization(): void {
    const streamUrl = this.pendingStreamUrl;
    if (!streamUrl || this.useLegacySurface || !this.videoContainerRef?.nativeElement) {
      return;
    }
    if (this.initializingStreamUrl === streamUrl || this.canvasPlayer) {
      return;
    }

    this.initializingStreamUrl = streamUrl;
    const generation = this.initGeneration;
    void this.initializeUrlPlayback(streamUrl, generation)
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        if (generation !== this.initGeneration) return;
        this.error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
        this.videoLoading = false;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (this.initializingStreamUrl === streamUrl) {
          this.initializingStreamUrl = null;
        }
      });
  }

  private resetState(): void {
    this.initGeneration += 1;
    this.useLegacySurface = false;
    this.loading = false;
    this.error = null;
    this.pendingManifestUrl = null;
    this.pendingStreamUrl = null;
    this.initializingManifestUrl = null;
    this.initializingStreamUrl = null;
    this.currentStreamUrl = null;
    this.loadingStreamUrl = null;
    this.playbackMode = '';
    this.fileSize = 0;
    this.videoReady = false;
    this.videoIsPlaying = false;
    this.videoLoading = false;
    this.videoShowControls = true;
    this.videoCurrentTime = 0;
    this.videoDuration = 0;
    this.videoTimelineOffsetSeconds = 0;
    this.videoCodecInfo = '';
    this.videoResolution = '';
    this.videoIsSeeking = false;
    this.videoSeekTarget = 0;
    this.seekPending = false;
    this.seekOriginSeconds = 0;
    this.seekRequestGeneration = 0;
    this.seekGeneration++;
    this.clearPlayerSubscriptions();
    if (this.canvasPlayer) {
      this.canvasPlayer.destroy();
      this.canvasPlayer = null;
    }
  }

  private clearPlayerSubscriptions(): void {
    for (const sub of this.playerSubscriptions) {
      try {
        sub.unsubscribe();
      } catch {
        // no-op
      }
    }
    this.playerSubscriptions = [];
  }

  private async refreshSiblingNavigation(): Promise<void> {
    const generation = ++this.navThumbnailGeneration;
    this.previousVideo = null;
    this.nextVideo = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    if (this.archiveContext) {
      return;
    }

    let siblings = await this.buildVideoNavItems(this.fileList, generation);

    if (!siblings.length && this.targetPath) {
      siblings = await this.loadSiblingVideosFromDirectory(generation);
    }

    if (!siblings.length) {
      return;
    }

    const currentIndex = siblings.findIndex(item => this.samePath(item.path, this.targetPath));
    if (currentIndex < 0) {
      return;
    }

    this.previousVideo = currentIndex > 0 ? siblings[currentIndex - 1] : null;
    this.nextVideo = currentIndex < siblings.length - 1 ? siblings[currentIndex + 1] : null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    void this.hydrateNavThumbnail(this.previousVideo, generation);
    void this.hydrateNavThumbnail(this.nextVideo, generation);
  }

  private async loadSiblingVideosFromDirectory(generation: number): Promise<VideoNavItem[]> {
    try {
      const parentPath = await this.api.getParentPath(this.targetPath);
      if (!parentPath || generation !== this.navThumbnailGeneration) {
        return [];
      }

      const listing = await this.api.listDirectory(parentPath, false);
      if (generation !== this.navThumbnailGeneration) {
        return [];
      }

      return await this.buildVideoNavItems((listing.entries ?? []).map(entry => ({
          path: entry.path,
          name: entry.name || this.baseName(entry.path),
        })), generation);
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  private async buildVideoNavItems(items: Array<{ path: string; name: string }>, generation: number): Promise<VideoNavItem[]> {
    const resolved = await Promise.all(items.map(async item => {
      if (!item.path || generation !== this.navThumbnailGeneration) {
        return null;
      }
      return await this.isVideoNavCandidate(item.path)
        ? this.makeNavItem(item)
        : null;
    }));

    if (generation !== this.navThumbnailGeneration) {
      return [];
    }

    return resolved.filter((item): item is VideoNavItem => !!item);
  }

  private makeNavItem(item: ViewerFileListItem): VideoNavItem {
    return {
      path: item.path,
      name: item.name || this.baseName(item.path),
      thumbSrc: null,
      thumbLoading: false,
      thumbFailed: false,
    };
  }

  private async hydrateNavThumbnail(item: VideoNavItem | null, generation: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!item || item.thumbLoading || item.thumbSrc || item.thumbFailed) {
      return;
    }

    item.thumbLoading = true;
    try {
      if (generation !== this.navThumbnailGeneration) {
        return;
      }
      item.thumbSrc = await this.api.getVideoPreviewURL(item.path);
      item.thumbFailed = !item.thumbSrc;
    } catch {
      item.thumbFailed = true;
      item.thumbSrc = null;
    } finally {
      item.thumbLoading = false;
      if (generation === this.navThumbnailGeneration) {
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      }
    }
  }

  private isVideoPath(path: string): boolean {
    return VideoViewerComponent.VIDEO_EXTENSIONS.has(this.extractExt(path));
  }

  private async isVideoNavCandidate(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const ext = this.extractExt(path);
    if (!VideoViewerComponent.VIDEO_EXTENSIONS.has(ext)) {
      return false;
    }

    if (!VideoViewerComponent.AMBIGUOUS_VIDEO_EXTENSIONS.has(ext)) {
      return true;
    }

    try {
      const probe = this.samePath(path, this.targetPath) && this.probe
        ? this.probe
        : await this.api.probeFile(path);
      const mime = (probe?.mimeType ?? '').toLowerCase();
      return mime.startsWith('video/') || mime === 'application/mp2t';
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  private extractExt(path: string): string {
    const normalized = (path ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
    const idx = normalized.lastIndexOf('.');
    return idx >= 0 ? normalized.slice(idx + 1).toLowerCase() : '';
  }

  private baseName(path: string): string {
    const normalized = (path ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
    return normalized.split('/').pop() ?? normalized;
  }

  private samePath(left: string, right: string): boolean {
    return left.trim().replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase() === right.trim().replace(/\\/g, '/').toLowerCase();
  }

  private findViewerTab(workspace: ReturnType<WorkspaceService['getActiveWorkspace']>, targetPath: string): { paneId: 'left' | 'right'; tab: NonNullable<typeof workspace>['leftPane']['tabs'][number] } | null {
    if (!workspace) {
      return null;
    }

    const leftTab = workspace.leftPane.tabs.find(tab =>
      (tab.kind ?? 'dir') === 'viewer' && this.samePath(tab.viewer?.targetPath ?? '', targetPath)
    );
    if (leftTab) {
      return { paneId: 'left', tab: leftTab };
    }

    const rightTab = workspace.rightPane.tabs.find(tab =>
      (tab.kind ?? 'dir') === 'viewer' && this.samePath(tab.viewer?.targetPath ?? '', targetPath)
    );
    if (rightTab) {
      return { paneId: 'right', tab: rightTab };
    }

    return null;
  }
}
````

````typescript
export interface ViewerArchiveContext {
  /** Outermost archive on disk, e.g. "filesystem://c/foo/archive.zip" */
  fsPath: string;
  /** Nested archive chain, e.g. ["inner.tar.gz"] — empty for flat archives. */
  nestedChain: string[];
  /** Entry path inside the innermost archive, e.g. "src/main.go" */
  entryPath: string;
}
````

````typescript
import type { Type } from '@angular/core';
import type { FileProbe } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { ViewerArchiveContext } from './viewer-archive-context';

export interface ViewerRequest {
  targetPath: string;
  fileList?: { path: string; name: string }[];
  probe?: FileProbe | null;
  archiveContext?: ViewerArchiveContext | null;
  /** Optional explicit viewer id (from tab metadata). */
  viewerId?: string | null;
}

export interface ViewerContribution {
  /** Stable id, used in tab metadata and diagnostics. */
  id: string;
  /** Human label (optional). */
  title?: string;
  /**
   * Return a score: 0 = cannot handle; higher wins.
   * Keep it cheap; do not read file bytes here.
   */
  score(req: ViewerRequest): number;
  /** Lazy-load the viewer surface component (standalone Angular component). */
  load(): Promise<Type<unknown>> | Type<unknown>;
}
````

````typescript
import { CommonModule, NgComponentOutlet } from '@angular/common';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, ChangeDetectorRef, Component, Input, OnChanges, Type, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { ApiService } from '../services/api.service';
import { ViewerRegistryService } from './viewer-registry.service';
import { ViewerArchiveContext } from './viewer-archive-context';
import type { FileProbe } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { ViewerFileListItem } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

function extLower(path: string): string {
  const p = (path ?? '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
  const i = p.lastIndexOf('.');
  if (i < 0) return '';
  return p.slice(i + 1).toLowerCase();
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-viewer-host-surface',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <ng-container *ngIf="component; else empty">
      <ng-container *ngComponentOutlet="component; inputs: outletInputs"></ng-container>
    </ng-container>

    <ng-template #empty>
      <div class="viewer-host-empty">
        <div class="title">Preview</div>
        <div class="sub">Select a file to preview</div>
      </div>
    </ng-template>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      flex: 1 1 0%;
      min-height: 0;
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .viewer-host-empty {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      flex: 1 1 0%;
      min-height: 0;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--vsc-foreground, #ccc);
      opacity: 0.8;
      gap: 6px;
      user-select: none;
    }
    .viewer-host-empty .title { font-weight: 600; }
    .viewer-host-empty .sub { font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.8; }
  `],
})
export class ViewerHostSurfaceComponent implements OnChanges {
  @Input() targetPath = '';
  @Input() fileList: ViewerFileListItem[] = [];
  @Input() archiveContext: ViewerArchiveContext | null = null;
  /** Optional explicit viewer id (from tab metadata) */
  @Input() viewerId: string | null = null;

  component: Type<unknown> | null = null;
  outletInputs: Record<string, unknown> = {};

  @ViewChild(NgComponentOutlet) private outlet?: NgComponentOutlet;

  private resolveSeq = 0;
  private resolvedViewerKey: string | null = null;
  private renderedInputSignature = '';

  constructor(
    private registry: ViewerRegistryService,
    private api: ApiService,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnChanges(): void {
    void this.refresh();
  }

  private async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    const req = {
      targetPath: this.targetPath ?? '',
      fileList: this.fileList ?? [],
      archiveContext: this.archiveContext ?? null,
      viewerId: this.viewerId ?? null,
      probe: null as FileProbe | null,
    };
    const seq = ++this.resolveSeq;

    if (!req.targetPath) {
      this.resolvedViewerKey = null;
      this.renderedInputSignature = '';
      this.component = null;
      this.outletInputs = {};
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const ext = extLower(req.targetPath);
    if (ext || req.targetPath) {
      try {
        req.probe = req.archiveContext
          ? await this.api.probeArchiveFile(req.archiveContext.fsPath, req.archiveContext.nestedChain, req.archiveContext.entryPath)
          : await this.api.probeFile(req.targetPath);
      } catch {
        req.probe = null;
      }
    }

    if (seq !== this.resolveSeq) return;

    const inputSignature = JSON.stringify(req);

    this.outletInputs = {
      targetPath: req.targetPath,
      fileList: req.fileList,
      archiveContext: req.archiveContext,
      viewerId: req.viewerId,
      probe: req.probe,
    };

    const viewerKey = this.registry.resolveId(req);
    const preserveMountedViewer = this.shouldPreserveMountedViewer(viewerKey);
    if (this.component && this.resolvedViewerKey === viewerKey) {
      if (this.renderedInputSignature !== inputSignature) {
        this.renderedInputSignature = inputSignature;
        if (!preserveMountedViewer) {
          this.component = null;
          this.cdr.detectChanges();
        }
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
        if (preserveMountedViewer) {
          return;
        }
      }

      if (preserveMountedViewer) {
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
        return;
      }
    }

    this.resolvedViewerKey = viewerKey;
    this.renderedInputSignature = inputSignature;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    // Async resolve so we can lazy-load contributions.
    void this.registry.resolve(req).then(({ component }) => {
      if (seq !== this.resolveSeq) return;
      this.component = component;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }).catch(() => {
      if (seq !== this.resolveSeq) return;
      this.resolvedViewerKey = null;
      this.renderedInputSignature = '';
      this.component = null;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
  }

  get mountedViewer(): any {
    return (this.outlet as any)?.componentInstance ?? null;
  }

  private shouldPreserveMountedViewer(viewerKey: string): boolean {
    return viewerKey === 'image' || viewerKey === 'video' || viewerKey === 'audio';
  }
}
````

````go
package app

import (
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	internalfilesystem "wails-app/internal/filesystem"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	internalruntime "wails-app/internal/runtime"
	vfslib "wails-app/vfs"
)

func TestStateCopyBatchPathFromMountedSMBSource(t *testing.T) {
	memoryRoot := t.TempDir()
	resetMemoryResolverForTest(t, memoryRoot)

	memoryFS, err := getMemoryFS()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("getMemoryFS returned error: %v", err)
	}

	vfs, err := internalruntime.InitVFS(memoryFS)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("InitVFS returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := vfs.Mount("/remote/smb/example.com:445", memoryFS, false, "SMB Example", vfslib.VolumeRemote); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("mount smb test fs: %v", err)
	}

	sourcePath, err := resolveMemoryAlias("memory://pub/readme.txt")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolve memory source path: %v", err)
	}
	const content = "copied from mounted smb"
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(sourcePath), 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create source dir: %v", err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(sourcePath, []byte(content), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("write source file: %v", err)
	}

	state := &State{vfs: vfs}
	destNative := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "downloaded.txt")
	destPublic := pathref.FromNativePath(destNative)
	streamToFile := func(reader io.Reader, destination string, _ int64, _ string) (int64, error) {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destination), 0o755); err != nil {
			return 0, err
		}
		file, err := os.Create(destination)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, err
		}
		defer file.Close()
		return io.Copy(file, reader)
	}

	if err := state.copyBatchPath("smb://example.com/pub/readme.txt", destPublic, false, streamToFile); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("copyBatchPath returned error: %v", err)
	}

	data, err := os.ReadFile(destNative)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read destination: %v", err)
	}
	if string(data) != content {
		t.Fatalf("destination content mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", content, string(data))
	}
}

func TestStateCopyBatchPathFromHTTPSource(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.URL.Path != "/MPEG4%20by%20philips.mp4" && r.URL.Path != "/MPEG4 by philips.mp4" {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected request path: %s", r.URL.Path)
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "video/mp4")
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte("http tab sample"))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	filesystem := internalfilesystem.NewService(internalfilesystem.ServiceConfig{
		Raw:      rawFilesystemOps,
		Metadata: rawFilesystemMetadataCallbacks(),
	})

	state := &State{Filesystem: filesystem}
	destNative := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "downloaded.mp4")
	destPublic := pathref.FromNativePath(destNative)
	streamToFile := func(reader io.Reader, destination string, _ int64, _ string) (int64, error) {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destination), 0o755); err != nil {
			return 0, err
		}
		file, err := os.Create(destination)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, err
		}
		defer file.Close()
		return io.Copy(file, reader)
	}

	source := server.URL + "/MPEG4%20by%20philips.mp4"
	if err := state.copyBatchPath(source, destPublic, false, streamToFile); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("copyBatchPath returned error: %v", err)
	}

	data, err := os.ReadFile(destNative)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read destination: %v", err)
	}
	if string(data) != "http tab sample" {
		t.Fatalf("destination content mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", "http tab sample", string(data))
	}
}
````

## File: internal/app/bindings_utility.go
````go
package app

import (
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	internalplatform "wails-app/internal/platform"
	internalutility "wails-app/internal/utility"
)

type ResolvedLink = internalutility.ResolvedLink

func (a *App) Ping() int64 {
	return time.Now().UnixMilli()
}

func (a *App) OpenFile(path string) error {
	return a.Utility.OpenFile(path)
}

func (a *App) ResolveLink(path string) (*ResolvedLink, error) {
	return a.Utility.ResolveLink(path)
}

func (a *App) IsAbsPath(path string) bool {
	if pathref.IsDrive(pathref.Normalize(path)) {
		return true
	}
	return filepath.IsAbs(path)
}

func (a *App) JoinPaths(parts []string) string {
	if joined, ok := joinAliasParts(parts); ok {
		return joined
	}
	return internalplatform.Join(parts...)
}

func joinAliasParts(parts []string) (string, bool) {
	if len(parts) == 0 {
		return "", false
	}

	first := pathref.Normalize(parts[0])
	if !pathref.IsAlias(first) && !pathref.IsDrive(first) {
		return "", false
	}

	joined := first
	for _, part := range parts[1:] {
		normalizedPart := strings.Trim(strings.ReplaceAll(part, "\\", "/"), "/")
		if normalizedPart == "" {
			continue
		}
		joined = trimAliasChildBase(joined) + "/" + normalizedPart
	}

	return pathref.Normalize(joined), true
}

var aliasRootPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://$`)

func trimAliasChildBase(path string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
	if aliasRootPattern.MatchString(strings.ToLower(trimmed)) {
		return trimmed
	}
	return strings.TrimRight(trimmed, "/")
}

func (a *App) SplitPath(path string) map[string]string {
	if dir, base, name, ext, ok := splitAliasPath(path); ok {
		return map[string]string{
			"dir":  dir,
			"base": base,
			"name": name,
			"ext":  ext,
		}
	}
	resolvedPath, err := resolveMemoryAlias(path)
	if err != nil {
		resolvedPath = pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(path))
	}
	dir, file, name, ext := internalplatform.SplitPath(resolvedPath)
	return map[string]string{
		"dir":  toPublicMemoryPath(dir),
		"base": file,
		"name": name,
		"ext":  ext,
	}
}

func (a *App) GetParentPath(path string) string {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if parent, ok := pathref.Parent(normalized); ok {
		return parent
	}
	resolvedPath, err := resolveMemoryAlias(path)
	if err != nil {
		resolvedPath = pathref.ToNativePath(normalized)
	}
	return toPublicMemoryPath(internalplatform.ParentPath(resolvedPath))
}

func (a *App) PathExists(path string) bool {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if pathref.IsWeb(normalized) {
		_, err := a.State.GetFileInfo(normalized)
		return err == nil
	}
	resolvedPath, err := resolveMemoryAlias(path)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	_, err = os.Lstat(resolvedPath)
	return err == nil
}

func (a *App) IsDirectory(path string) bool {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if pathref.IsWeb(normalized) {
		info, err := a.State.GetFileInfo(normalized)
		return err == nil && info != nil && info.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	}
	resolvedPath, err := resolveMemoryAlias(path)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(resolvedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return info.IsDir()
}

func (a *App) IsRoot(path string) bool {
	return filepath.Dir(path) == path
}

func (a *App) Breadcrumbs(path string) []map[string]string {
	return internalplatform.Breadcrumbs(path)
}

func (a *App) GetSpecialFolders() contracts.SpecialFoldersResponse {
	return internalplatform.GetSpecialFolders()
}

func splitAliasPath(path string) (dir string, base string, name string, ext string, ok bool) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if !pathref.IsAlias(normalized) && !pathref.IsDrive(normalized) {
		return "", "", "", "", false
	}

	dir = normalized
	if parent, hasParent := pathref.Parent(normalized); hasParent {
		dir = parent
	}

	trimmed := strings.TrimRight(normalized, "/")
	if trimmed == strings.TrimRight(dir, "/") {
		return dir, "", "", "", true
	}

	slashIndex := strings.LastIndex(trimmed, "/")
	if slashIndex >= 0 {
		base = trimmed[slashIndex+1:]
	} else {
		base = trimmed
	}
	if pathref.IsWeb(normalized) {
		if decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(base); err == nil && decoded != "" {
			base = decoded
		}
	}
	ext = filepath.Ext(base)
	name = strings.TrimSuffix(base, ext)
	return dir, base, name, ext, true
}
````

````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"os"

	"github.com/mholt/archiver/v3"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	internalelevation "wails-app/internal/elevation"
)

type BuildConfig struct {
	SetContext func(context.Context)

	InitVFS        func()
	HandleFileDrop func(int, int, []string) error

	BuildFileInfo func(name, fullPath string, info os.FileInfo, hidden bool) contracts.FileInfo
	IsHidden      func(name, fullPath string) bool

	ClassifyError                  func(error) contracts.AppErrorCode
	IsPermissionDenied             func(error) bool
	ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation func(error) bool
	CalculateSize                  func(path string) (items, bytes int64)
	Normalize                      func(string) string
	ArchiveEntryPath               func(archiver.File) string
	IsArchive                      func(string) bool
}

func BuildState(core *Core, filesystem Filesystem, elevation *internalelevation.Service, config BuildConfig) *State {
	state := NewState(core)
	state.Elevation = elevation
	state.Filesystem = filesystem
	state.Runtime = NewRuntimeService(RuntimeConfig{
		SetContext:           config.SetContext,
		SetOperationEmitter:  state.Operations.SetEmitter,
		CreatePaneWatch:      state.CreatePaneWatch,
		InitVFS:              config.InitVFS,
		HandleFileDrop:       config.HandleFileDrop,
		ClosePaneWatch:       state.ClosePaneWatch,
		CancelDirStreams:     state.CancelDirStreams,
		StopElevationSession: state.StopElevationSession,
		CloseArchiveCache:    state.CloseArchiveCache,
	})

	services := NewServices(ServiceConfig{
		Core:                           core,
		Elevation:                      elevation,
		EmitEvent:                      func(name string, data interface{}) { state.Runtime.EmitEvent(state.Ctx, name, data) },
		ElevatedList:                   filesystem.ElevatedList,
		BuildFileInfo:                  config.BuildFileInfo,
		IsHidden:                       config.IsHidden,
		ListDirectory:                  state.ListDirectory,
		StartOperation:                 state.StartOperation,
		PromptConflict:                 state.PromptConflict,
		ClassifyError:                  config.ClassifyError,
		IsPermissionDenied:             config.IsPermissionDenied,
		ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation: config.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation,
		RunElevatedCopy:                filesystem.RunElevatedCopy,
		RunElevatedMove:                filesystem.RunElevatedMove,
		RunElevatedDelete:              filesystem.RunElevatedDelete,
		CalculateSize:                  config.CalculateSize,
		GetFileInfo:                    filesystem.GetFileInfo,
		CopyBatchPath: func(source, destination string, recursive bool, streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error)) error {
			return state.copyBatchPath(source, destination, recursive, streamToFile)
		},
		ExtractNestedArchive: state.ExtractNestedArchive,
		Normalize:            config.Normalize,
		ArchiveEntryPath:     config.ArchiveEntryPath,
		IsArchive:            config.IsArchive,
	})

	state.Archive = services.Archive
	state.Batch = services.Batch
	state.Converter = services.Converter
	state.OfficeConverter = core.OfficeConverter
	state.DirStream = services.DirStream
	state.Utility = services.Utility
	state.Navigation = services.Navigation
	state.Workspace = services.Workspace
	return state
}
````

## File: internal/app/filter.go
````go
package app

import (
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func filterEntries(entries []contracts.FileInfo, filter contracts.FilterQuery) []contracts.FileInfo {
	if filter.Text == "" && len(filter.Criteria) == 0 {
		return entries
	}

	result := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if matchesFilter(entry, filter) {
			result = append(result, entry)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func matchesFilter(entry contracts.FileInfo, filter contracts.FilterQuery) bool {
	if filter.Text != "" {
		name := entry.Name
		text := filter.Text
		if !filter.CaseSensitive {
			name = strings.ToLower(name)
			text = strings.ToLower(text)
		}
		if !strings.Contains(name, text) {
			return false
		}
	}

	for _, criteria := range filter.Criteria {
		if !matchesCriteria(entry, criteria, filter.CaseSensitive) {
			return false
		}
	}

	return true
}

func matchesCriteria(entry contracts.FileInfo, criteria contracts.FilterCriteria, caseSensitive bool) bool {
	switch criteria.Type {
	case contracts.FilterName:
		return compareStrings(entry.Name, criteria.Value, criteria.Operator, caseSensitive)
	case contracts.FilterExtension:
		ext := strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.Ext(entry.Name), ".")
		return compareStrings(ext, criteria.Value, criteria.Operator, caseSensitive)
	case contracts.FilterGlob:
		matched, _ := filepath.Match(criteria.Value, entry.Name)
		return matched
	case contracts.FilterType_:
		return strings.EqualFold(string(entry.Type), criteria.Value)
	}
	return true
}

func compareStrings(a, b, operator string, caseSensitive bool) bool {
	if !caseSensitive {
		a = strings.ToLower(a)
		b = strings.ToLower(b)
	}
	switch operator {
	case "equals":
		return a == b
	case "startsWith":
		return strings.HasPrefix(a, b)
	case "endsWith":
		return strings.HasSuffix(a, b)
	case "contains", "":
		return strings.Contains(a, b)
	}
	return strings.Contains(a, b)
}
````
