## File: internal/app/proxy.go
````go
package app

import (
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httputil"
	"net/url"
	"time"

	"wails-app/vfs/archive/cache"
)

// StartDevProxy starts a reverse proxy on localhost for development.
// It routes /wails-stream/* to the stream server and everything else to Angular dev server.
func StartDevProxy(streamBaseURL, angularDevURL string, archCache *cache.Cache) (*http.Server, string, error) {
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("start dev proxy: %w", err)
	}

	proxyPort := listener.Addr().String()

	// Parse URLs for proxying
	streamURL, err := url.Parse(streamBaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("invalid stream base URL: %w", err)
	}

	angularURL, err := url.Parse(angularDevURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("invalid angular dev URL: %w", err)
	}

	// Create reverse proxies
	streamProxy := httputil.NewSingleHostReverseProxy(streamURL)
	angularProxy := httputil.NewSingleHostReverseProxy(angularURL)

	// Main proxy handler
	handler := http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.URL.Path == "/wails-stream" || len(r.URL.Path) > len("/wails-stream") && r.URL.Path[:len("/wails-stream")] == "/wails-stream" {
			// Stream requests go to stream server
			streamProxy.ServeHTTP(w, r)
			return
		}
		// Everything else goes to Angular dev server
		angularProxy.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})

	server := &http.Server{
		Handler:           handler,
		ReadHeaderTimeout: 30 * time.Second,
	}

	go func() {
		if err := server.Serve(listener); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
			println("dev proxy error:", err.Error())
		}
	}()

	return server, "http://" + proxyPort, nil
}
````

## File: internal/app/remote_listing.go
````go
package app

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/url"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

// ListDirectory is the pane-facing directory entrypoint. It can expose remote
// scheme roots and auto-mount SMB locations on first navigation.
func (s *State) ListDirectory(path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if listing, ok := s.listRemoteRoot(normalized); ok {
		return listing, nil
	}
	if err := s.ensureRemoteMount(normalized); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.Filesystem.ListDirectory(normalized, showHidden)
}

func (s *State) GetFileInfo(path string) (*contracts.FileInfo, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if protocol, ok := remoteProtocolRoot(normalized); ok {
		return &contracts.FileInfo{
			Name: pathref.FromVFS(remoteRootMountPoint(protocol)),
			Path: normalized,
			Type: contracts.FileTypeDirectory,
		}, nil
	}
	if err := s.ensureRemoteMount(normalized); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.Filesystem.GetFileInfo(normalized)
}

func (s *State) ProbeFile(path string) (*contracts.FileProbe, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if _, ok := remoteProtocolRoot(normalized); ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot probe remote root")
	}
	if err := s.ensureRemoteMount(normalized); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.Filesystem.ProbeFile(normalized)
}

func (s *State) ensureRemoteMount(path string) error {
	if s.vfs == nil {
		return nil
	}

	cfg, ok, err := remoteConfigFromPublicPath(path)
	if err != nil || !ok {
		return err
	}

	mountPath := remoteMountPath(cfg)
	if mountPath == "" || s.vfs.IsMounted(mountPath) {
		return nil
	}

	if cfg.Protocol != contracts.ProtocolSMB {
		return nil
	}

	_, err = s.RemoteConnect(cfg)
	return err
}

func (s *State) listRemoteRoot(path string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, bool) {
	protocol, ok := remoteProtocolRoot(path)
	if !ok {
		return nil, false
	}

	s.remotesMu.Lock()
	defer s.remotesMu.Unlock()

	entries := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(s.remotes))
	for _, mount := range s.remotes {
		if mount.Protocol != protocol {
			continue
		}

		name := strings.TrimPrefix(mount.PublicPath, path)
		if name == "" || name == mount.PublicPath {
			name = mount.Host
		}

		entries = append(entries, contracts.FileInfo{
			Name: name,
			Path: mount.PublicPath,
			Type: contracts.FileTypeDirectory,
		})
	}

	sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
		return strings.ToLower(entries[i].Path) < strings.ToLower(entries[j].Path)
	})

	return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
		Path:      path,
		Entries:   entries,
		TotalSize: 0,
	}, true
}

func remoteProtocolRoot(path string) (contracts.RemoteProtocol, bool) {
	switch strings.ToLower(path) {
	case pathref.SMBScheme:
		return contracts.ProtocolSMB, true
	case pathref.S3Scheme:
		return contracts.ProtocolS3, true
	default:
		return "", false
	}
}

func remoteRootMountPoint(protocol contracts.RemoteProtocol) string {
	switch protocol {
	case contracts.ProtocolSMB:
		return "/remote/smb"
	case contracts.ProtocolS3:
		return "/remote/s3"
	default:
		return ""
	}
}

func remoteConfigFromPublicPath(path string) (contracts.RemoteConfig, bool, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	parsed, err := url.Parse(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.RemoteConfig{}, false, fmt.Errorf("invalid remote path %q: %w", path, err)
	}

	if parsed.Host == "" {
		return contracts.RemoteConfig{}, false, nil
	}

	switch strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme) {
	case string(contracts.ProtocolSMB):
		port := 445
		if rawPort := parsed.Port(); rawPort != "" {
			parsedPort, convErr := strconv.Atoi(rawPort)
			if convErr != nil {
				return contracts.RemoteConfig{}, false, fmt.Errorf("invalid SMB port %q", rawPort)
			}
			port = parsedPort
		}

		username := ""
		password := ""
		if parsed.User != nil {
			if user := parsed.User.Username(); user != "" {
				username = user
				if pass, ok := parsed.User.Password(); ok {
					password = pass
				} else {
					password = ""
				}
			}
		}

		share := ""
		if pathSegments := strings.Split(strings.Trim(parsed.Path, "/"), "/"); len(pathSegments) > 0 {
			share = strings.TrimSpace(pathSegments[0])
		}

		return contracts.RemoteConfig{
			Protocol: contracts.ProtocolSMB,
			Host:     parsed.Hostname(),
			Port:     port,
			Username: username,
			Password: password,
			Share:    share,
		}, true, nil
	case string(contracts.ProtocolS3):
		alias := strings.TrimSpace(parsed.Hostname())
		if alias == "" {
			return contracts.RemoteConfig{}, false, nil
		}

		return contracts.RemoteConfig{
			Protocol: contracts.ProtocolS3,
			Name:     alias,
		}, true, nil

	default:
		return contracts.RemoteConfig{}, false, nil
	}
}
````

````go
package app

import (

	internalruntime "wails-app/internal/runtime"
)

type RuntimeConfig struct {
	SetContext            func(context.Context)
	SetOperationEmitter   func(func(string, interface{}))
	CreatePaneWatch       func()
	InitVFS               func()
	HandleFileDrop        func(int, int, []string) error
	ClosePaneWatch        func()
	CancelDirStreams      func()
	StopElevationSession  func()
	CloseArchiveCache     func()
}

type RuntimeService struct {
	config RuntimeConfig
}

func NewRuntimeService(config RuntimeConfig) *RuntimeService {
	return &RuntimeService{config: config}
}

func (s *RuntimeService) Startup(ctx context.Context) {
	if s.config.SetContext != nil {
		s.config.SetContext(ctx)
	}
	if s.config.SetOperationEmitter != nil {
		s.config.SetOperationEmitter(func(name string, data interface{}) {
			s.EmitEvent(ctx, name, data)
		})
	}
	if s.config.CreatePaneWatch != nil {
		s.config.CreatePaneWatch()
	}
	if s.config.InitVFS != nil {
		s.config.InitVFS()
	}
	internalruntime.BindNativeFileDrop(ctx, func(x, y int, paths []string) {
		if s.config.HandleFileDrop == nil {
			return
		}
		if err := s.config.HandleFileDrop(x, y, paths); err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("[wails:file-drop] HandleFileDrop error: %v\n", err)
		}
	})
}

func (s *RuntimeService) Shutdown() {
	if s.config.ClosePaneWatch != nil {
		s.config.ClosePaneWatch()
	}
	if s.config.CancelDirStreams != nil {
		s.config.CancelDirStreams()
	}
	if s.config.StopElevationSession != nil {
		s.config.StopElevationSession()
	}
	if s.config.CloseArchiveCache != nil {
		s.config.CloseArchiveCache()
	}
}

func (s *RuntimeService) EmitEvent(ctx context.Context, name string, data interface{}) {
	if ctx != nil {
		runtime.EventsEmit(ctx, name, data)
	}
}
````

````go
package app

import "testing"

func TestBuildSegmentRangesFromKeyframes(t *testing.T) {
	ranges := buildSegmentRangesFromKeyframes([]float64{0, 5.873, 11.745, 18.952}, 21.955)
	if len(ranges) != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 4 ranges, got %d", len(ranges))
	}

	assertRange := func(index int, wantStart float64, wantDuration float64) {
		t.Helper()
		got := ranges[index]
		if diff := absFloat(got.StartSeconds - wantStart); diff > 0.001 {
			t.Fatalf("range %d start mismatch: got %.3f want %.3f", index, got.StartSeconds, wantStart)
		}
		if diff := absFloat(got.DurationSeconds - wantDuration); diff > 0.001 {
			t.Fatalf("range %d duration mismatch: got %.3f want %.3f", index, got.DurationSeconds, wantDuration)
		}
	}

	assertRange(0, 0, 5.873)
	assertRange(1, 5.873, 5.872)
	assertRange(2, 11.745, 7.207)
	assertRange(3, 18.952, 3.003)
}

func TestBuildSegmentRangesFromKeyframesPrependsZeroStart(t *testing.T) {
	ranges := buildSegmentRangesFromKeyframes([]float64{5.873, 11.745}, 12)
	if len(ranges) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 3 ranges, got %d", len(ranges))
	}
	if ranges[0].StartSeconds != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected first range to start at zero, got %.3f", ranges[0].StartSeconds)
	}
}

		"sample.mp4":  false,
		"sample.m4v":  false,
		"sample.webm": false,
		"sample.mkv":  true,
		"sample.flv":  true,
		"sample.avi":  true,
		"sample.divx": true,
		"sample.xvid": true,
		"sample.mov":  true,
		"sample.ts":   true,
		"sample.mpg":  true,
		"sample.wmv":  true,
		"sample.asf":  true,
		"sample.ogv":  true,
		"sample.mxf":  true,
	}

	for path, want := range cases {
		if got := shouldUseKeyframeAlignedSegments(path); got != want {
			t.Fatalf("shouldUseKeyframeAlignedSegments(%q) = %v, want %v", path, got, want)
		}
	}
}

	}
````

## File: internal/archive/extract_helpers.go
````go
package archive

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"compress/bzip2"
	"compress/gzip"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func wrapTarReader(src *os.File, fsPath string) (*tar.Reader, func(), error) {
	lower := strings.ToLower(fsPath)
	switch {
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.gz"), strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tgz"):
		gr, err := gzip.NewReader(src)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, err
		}
		return tar.NewReader(gr), func() { gr.Close() }, nil
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.bz2"):
		return tar.NewReader(bzip2.NewReader(src)), nil, nil
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.xz"):
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("tar.xz extraction is handled via archiver.Walk, not wrapTarReader")
	default:
		return tar.NewReader(src), nil, nil
	}
}

func extractWriteFile(destPath string, reader io.Reader) (int64, error) {
	f, err := os.OpenFile(destPath, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_TRUNC, 0644)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	n, copyErr := io.Copy(f, reader)
	closeErr := f.Close()
	if copyErr != nil {
		return n, copyErr
	}
	return n, closeErr
}

func extractDestPath(entryName, destDir string, flatten bool) string {
	entryName = normalizeArchiveEntryPath(entryName)
	if flatten {
		return filepath.Join(destDir, filepath.Base(entryName))
	}
	return filepath.Join(destDir, filepath.FromSlash(entryName))
}

func matchesEntriesForExtract(innerPath string, entries []string) bool {
	cleanInner := normalizePath(innerPath)
	isDirHeader := strings.HasSuffix(strings.ReplaceAll(innerPath, "\\", "/"), "/")
	for _, entry := range entries {
		entry = normalizePath(entry)
		if entry == "" {
			return true
		}
		if cleanInner == entry {
			if isDirHeader {
				return false
			}
			return true
		}
		if entry == "" || cleanInner == entry || strings.HasPrefix(cleanInner, entry+"/") {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func rebaseExtractPath(entryName, stripPrefix string) (string, bool) {
	entry := normalizePath(entryName)
	if entry == "" {
		return "", false
	}
	prefix := normalizePath(stripPrefix)
	if prefix == "" {
		return entry, true
	}
	if entry == prefix {
		return "", false
	}
	prefixWithSep := prefix + "/"
	if strings.HasPrefix(entry, prefixWithSep) {
		rel := strings.TrimPrefix(entry, prefixWithSep)
		if rel == "" {
			return "", false
		}
		return rel, true
	}
	return entry, true
}
````

## File: internal/archive/extract.go
````go
package archive

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"archive/zip"
	"bytes"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"

	"github.com/mholt/archiver/v3"
)

var errCancelled = errors.New("cancelled")

func (s *Service) extractZipSync(fsPath string, entries []string, stripPrefix string, destDir string, flatten bool, op Operation) (succeeded, failed int, errs []contracts.BatchItemError, fatalErr error) {
	r, err := zip.OpenReader(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, nil, err
	}
	defer r.Close()
	var matches []*zip.File
	for _, f := range r.File {
		if matchesEntriesForExtract(normalizeArchiveEntryPath(f.Name), entries) {
			matches = append(matches, f)
		}
	}
	op.SetTotal(int64(len(matches)), 0)
	var processed int64
	for _, f := range matches {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: f.Name, Error: errCancelled.Error()})
			failed++
			continue
		}
		if f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		relPath, ok := rebaseExtractPath(f.Name, stripPrefix)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		destPath := extractDestPath(relPath, destDir, flatten)
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destPath), 0755); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: f.Name, Error: err.Error()})
			failed++
			continue
		}
		rc, err := f.Open()
		if err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: f.Name, Error: err.Error()})
			failed++
			continue
		}
		n, writeErr := extractWriteFile(destPath, rc)
		rc.Close()
		if writeErr != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: f.Name, Error: writeErr.Error()})
			failed++
			continue
		}
		succeeded++
		processed++
		op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, f.Name, n)
	}
	return
}

func (s *Service) extractTarSync(fsPath string, entries []string, stripPrefix string, destDir string, flatten bool, op Operation) (succeeded, failed int, errs []contracts.BatchItemError, fatalErr error) {
	lower := strings.ToLower(fsPath)
	if strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.xz") {
		return s.extractTarXzViaArchiver(fsPath, entries, stripPrefix, destDir, flatten, op)
	}
	src, err := os.Open(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, nil, err
	}
	defer src.Close()
	tr, closeExtra, err := wrapTarReader(src, fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, nil, err
	}
	if closeExtra != nil {
		defer closeExtra()
	}
	op.SetTotal(0, 0)
	var processed int64
	for {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			break
		}
		hdr, err := tr.Next()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return succeeded, failed, errs, err
		}
		if hdr.FileInfo().IsDir() || !matchesEntriesForExtract(normalizeArchiveEntryPath(hdr.Name), entries) {
			continue
		}
		relPath, ok := rebaseExtractPath(hdr.Name, stripPrefix)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		destPath := extractDestPath(relPath, destDir, flatten)
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destPath), 0755); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: hdr.Name, Error: err.Error()})
			failed++
			continue
		}
		n, writeErr := extractWriteFile(destPath, tr)
		if writeErr != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: hdr.Name, Error: writeErr.Error()})
			failed++
			continue
		}
		succeeded++
		processed++
		op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, hdr.Name, n)
	}
	return
}

func (s *Service) extractTarXzViaArchiver(fsPath string, entries []string, stripPrefix, destDir string, flatten bool, op Operation) (succeeded, failed int, errs []contracts.BatchItemError, fatalErr error) {
	op.SetTotal(0, 0)
	var processed int64
	walkErr := archiver.Walk(fsPath, func(f archiver.File) error {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			return errCancelled
		}
		hdr, ok := f.Header.(*tar.Header)
		if !ok || f.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		if !matchesEntriesForExtract(normalizeArchiveEntryPath(hdr.Name), entries) {
			return nil
		}
		relPath, ok := rebaseExtractPath(hdr.Name, stripPrefix)
		if !ok {
			return nil
		}
		destPath := extractDestPath(relPath, destDir, flatten)
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destPath), 0755); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: hdr.Name, Error: err.Error()})
			failed++
			return nil
		}
		n, writeErr := extractWriteFile(destPath, f)
		if writeErr != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: hdr.Name, Error: writeErr.Error()})
			failed++
			return nil
		}
		succeeded++
		processed++
		op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, hdr.Name, n)
		return nil
	})
	if walkErr != nil && !errors.Is(walkErr, errCancelled) {
		fatalErr = walkErr
	}
	return
}

func (s *Service) extractArchiveReaderSync(fsPath string, entries []string, stripPrefix, destDir string, flatten bool, op Operation) (succeeded, failed int, errs []contracts.BatchItemError, fatalErr error) {
	f, err := os.Open(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, nil, err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	fi, err := f.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, nil, err
	}
	aIface, err := archiver.ByExtension(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("extractArchiveReaderSync: %w", err)
	}
	reader, ok := aIface.(archiver.Reader)
	if !ok {
		return 0, 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("extractArchiveReaderSync: format %q is not readable", fsPath)
	}
	if err := reader.Open(f, fi.Size()); err != nil {
		return 0, 0, nil, err
	}
	defer reader.Close()
	op.SetTotal(0, 0)
	var processed int64
	for {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			break
		}
		entry, err := reader.Read()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return succeeded, failed, errs, err
		}
		entryName := archiveEntryPath(entry)
		if entry.IsDir() || !matchesEntriesForExtract(normalizeArchiveEntryPath(entryName), entries) {
			entry.Close()
			continue
		}
		relPath, ok := rebaseExtractPath(entryName, stripPrefix)
		if !ok {
			entry.Close()
			continue
		}
		destPath := extractDestPath(relPath, destDir, flatten)
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destPath), 0755); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: entryName, Error: err.Error()})
			failed++
			entry.Close()
			continue
		}
		n, writeErr := extractWriteFile(destPath, entry)
		entry.Close()
		if writeErr != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: entryName, Error: writeErr.Error()})
			failed++
			continue
		}
		succeeded++
		processed++
		op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, entryName, n)
	}
	return
}

func (s *Service) extractEntriesFromBytes(data []byte, archiveName string, entries []string, stripPrefix string, destDir string, flatten bool, op Operation) (succeeded, failed int, errs []contracts.BatchItemError, fatalErr error) {
	if !isZipMagic(data) && needsArchiveReader(archiveName) {
		reader, err := openArchiveReader(archiveName, data)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, 0, nil, err
		}
		defer reader.Close()
		op.SetTotal(0, 0)
		var processed int64
		for {
			if op.IsCancelled() {
				break
			}
			f, err := reader.Read()
			if err == io.EOF {
				break
			}
			if err != nil {
				return succeeded, failed, errs, err
			}
			entryName := archiveEntryPath(f)
			if f.IsDir() || !matchesEntriesForExtract(normalizeArchiveEntryPath(entryName), entries) {
				f.Close()
				continue
			}
			relPath, ok := rebaseExtractPath(entryName, stripPrefix)
			if !ok {
				f.Close()
				continue
			}
			destPath := extractDestPath(relPath, destDir, flatten)
			if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destPath), 0755); err != nil {
				errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: entryName, Error: err.Error()})
				failed++
				f.Close()
				continue
			}
			n, writeErr := extractWriteFile(destPath, f)
			f.Close()
			if writeErr != nil {
				errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: entryName, Error: writeErr.Error()})
				failed++
				continue
			}
			succeeded++
			processed++
			op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, entryName, n)
		}
		return
	}
	if isZipMagic(data) {
		r, err := zip.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data), int64(len(data)))
		if err != nil {
			return 0, 0, nil, err
		}
		var matches []*zip.File
		for _, f := range r.File {
			if matchesEntriesForExtract(normalizeArchiveEntryPath(f.Name), entries) {
				matches = append(matches, f)
			}
		}
		op.SetTotal(int64(len(matches)), 0)
		var processed int64
		for _, f := range matches {
			if op.IsCancelled() {
				errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: f.Name, Error: errCancelled.Error()})
				failed++
				continue
			}
			if f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
				continue
			}
			relPath, ok := rebaseExtractPath(f.Name, stripPrefix)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			destPath := extractDestPath(relPath, destDir, flatten)
			if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destPath), 0755); err != nil {
				errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: f.Name, Error: err.Error()})
				failed++
				continue
			}
			rc, err := f.Open()
			if err != nil {
				errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: f.Name, Error: err.Error()})
				failed++
				continue
			}
			n, writeErr := extractWriteFile(destPath, rc)
			rc.Close()
			if writeErr != nil {
				errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: f.Name, Error: writeErr.Error()})
				failed++
				continue
			}
			succeeded++
			processed++
			op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, f.Name, n)
		}
		return
	}
	tr := tar.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data))
	op.SetTotal(0, 0)
	var processed int64
	for {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			break
		}
		hdr, err := tr.Next()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return succeeded, failed, errs, err
		}
		if hdr.FileInfo().IsDir() || !matchesEntriesForExtract(normalizeArchiveEntryPath(hdr.Name), entries) {
			continue
		}
		relPath, ok := rebaseExtractPath(hdr.Name, stripPrefix)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		destPath := extractDestPath(relPath, destDir, flatten)
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destPath), 0755); err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: hdr.Name, Error: err.Error()})
			failed++
			continue
		}
		n, writeErr := extractWriteFile(destPath, tr)
		if writeErr != nil {
			errs = append(errs, contracts.BatchItemError{Source: hdr.Name, Error: writeErr.Error()})
			failed++
			continue
		}
		succeeded++
		processed++
		op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, hdr.Name, n)
	}
	return
````

## File: internal/archive/helpers.go
````go
package archive

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"archive/zip"
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/mholt/archiver/v3"
)

var archiveStdlibSuffixes = []string{".tar", ".tar.gz", ".tgz", ".tar.bz2", ".tar.xz", ".gz", ".bz2", ".xz", ".zip"}

func isZipMagic(data []byte) bool {
	return len(data) >= 4 &&
		data[0] == 'P' && data[1] == 'K' &&
		((data[2] == 0x03 && data[3] == 0x04) ||
			(data[2] == 0x05 && data[3] == 0x06))
}

func IsZipMagic(data []byte) bool {
	return isZipMagic(data)
}

func needsArchiveReader(name string) bool {
	if name == "" {
		return false
	}
	return !usesStdlibArchiveHandling(name)
}

func NeedsArchiveReader(name string) bool {
	return needsArchiveReader(name)
}

func isRarArchiveName(name string) bool {
	if name == "" {
		return false
	}
	return strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(name), ".rar")
}

func IsRarArchiveName(name string) bool {
	return isRarArchiveName(name)
}

func isZipArchiveName(name string) bool {
	if name == "" {
		return false
	}
	return strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(name), ".zip")
}

func usesStdlibArchiveHandling(name string) bool {
	lower := strings.ToLower(name)
	for _, sfx := range archiveStdlibSuffixes {
		if strings.HasSuffix(lower, sfx) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func openArchiveReader(archiveName string, data []byte) (archiver.Reader, error) {
	if archiveName == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive name required to read from bytes")
	}
	aIface, err := archiver.ByExtension(archiveName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	reader, ok := aIface.(archiver.Reader)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive format %q cannot be read from bytes", archiveName)
	}
	if err := reader.Open(bytes.NewReader(data), int64(len(data))); err != nil {
		reader.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	return reader, nil
}

func OpenArchiveReader(archiveName string, data []byte) (archiver.Reader, error) {
	return openArchiveReader(archiveName, data)
}

func ArchiveEntryPath(f archiver.File) string {
	return archiveEntryPath(f)
}

func archiveEntryPath(f archiver.File) string {
	switch hdr := f.Header.(type) {
	case *zip.FileHeader:
		return strings.TrimSuffix(hdr.Name, "/")
	case *tar.Header:
		return strings.TrimSuffix(hdr.Name, "/")
	}
	return f.Name()
}

func normalizeArchiveEntryPath(path string) string {
	path = strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/")
	return strings.TrimPrefix(path, "/")
}

func matchesEntries(innerPath string, entries []string) bool {
	cleanInner := normalizePath(innerPath)
	for _, entry := range entries {
		entry = normalizePath(entry)
		if entry == "" || cleanInner == entry || strings.HasPrefix(cleanInner, entry+"/") {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
````

## File: internal/archive/rewrite.go
````go
package archive

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"archive/zip"
	"bytes"
	"compress/bzip2"
	"compress/gzip"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/mholt/archiver/v3"
)

func rewriteZip(fsPath string, entries []string, op Operation) (removed, kept int, err error) {
	r, err := zip.OpenReader(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	defer r.Close()

	op.SetTotal(int64(len(r.File)), 0)

	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(fsPath), ".archive-rewrite-*.zip")
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	tmpPath := tmp.Name()
	defer func() {
		tmp.Close()
		if err != nil {
			os.Remove(tmpPath)
		}
	}()

	w := zip.NewWriter(tmp)
	defer w.Close()

	var processed int64
	for _, f := range r.File {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			return removed, kept, fmt.Errorf("cancelled")
		}

		innerPath := normalizeArchiveEntryPath(f.Name)
		if matchesEntries(innerPath, entries) {
			removed++
			processed++
			op.UpdateProgress(processed, 0, f.Name, 0)
			continue
		}

		rc, openErr := f.Open()
		if openErr != nil {
			return removed, kept, fmt.Errorf("open %q: %w", f.Name, openErr)
		}

		hdr, _ := zip.FileInfoHeader(f.FileInfo())
		hdr.Name = f.Name
		hdr.Method = f.Method
		fw, writeErr := w.CreateHeader(hdr)
		if writeErr != nil {
			rc.Close()
			return removed, kept, writeErr
		}

		n, copyErr := io.Copy(fw, rc)
		rc.Close()
		if copyErr != nil {
			return removed, kept, fmt.Errorf("copy %q: %w", f.Name, copyErr)
		}

		kept++
		processed++
		op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, f.Name, n)
	}

	if err = w.Close(); err != nil {
		return removed, kept, err
	}
	tmp.Close()
	return removed, kept, os.Rename(tmpPath, fsPath)
}

func rewriteTar(fsPath string, entries []string, compression string, op Operation) (removed, kept int, err error) {
	srcFile, err := os.Open(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	defer srcFile.Close()

	var tarReader *tar.Reader
	switch compression {
	case "gz":
		gr, gzErr := gzip.NewReader(srcFile)
		if gzErr != nil {
			return 0, 0, gzErr
		}
		defer gr.Close()
		tarReader = tar.NewReader(gr)
	case "bz2":
		tarReader = tar.NewReader(bzip2.NewReader(srcFile))
	default:
		tarReader = tar.NewReader(srcFile)
	}

	if compression == "xz" {
		return rewriteTarXzViaArchiver(fsPath, entries, op)
	}

	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(fsPath), ".archive-rewrite-*")
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	tmpPath := tmp.Name()
	defer func() {
		tmp.Close()
		if err != nil {
			os.Remove(tmpPath)
		}
	}()

	var tarWriter *tar.Writer
	var gzWriter *gzip.Writer
	if compression == "gz" || compression == "bz2" {
		gzWriter = gzip.NewWriter(tmp)
		tarWriter = tar.NewWriter(gzWriter)
	} else {
		tarWriter = tar.NewWriter(tmp)
	}

	var processed int64
	for {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			if gzWriter != nil {
				tarWriter.Close()
				gzWriter.Close()
			} else {
				tarWriter.Close()
			}
			return removed, kept, fmt.Errorf("cancelled")
		}

		hdr, tarErr := tarReader.Next()
		if tarErr == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if tarErr != nil {
			return removed, kept, tarErr
		}

		innerPath := normalizeArchiveEntryPath(hdr.Name)
		if matchesEntries(innerPath, entries) {
			removed++
			processed++
			op.UpdateProgress(processed, 0, hdr.Name, 0)
			continue
		}

		if writeErr := tarWriter.WriteHeader(hdr); writeErr != nil {
			return removed, kept, writeErr
		}
		n, copyErr := io.Copy(tarWriter, tarReader)
		if copyErr != nil {
			return removed, kept, copyErr
		}
		kept++
		processed++
		op.UpdateProgress(processed, n, hdr.Name, n)
	}

	if gzWriter != nil {
		if e := tarWriter.Close(); e != nil {
			return removed, kept, e
		}
		if e := gzWriter.Close(); e != nil {
			return removed, kept, e
		}
	} else {
		if e := tarWriter.Close(); e != nil {
			return removed, kept, e
		}
	}
	tmp.Close()
	return removed, kept, os.Rename(tmpPath, fsPath)
}

func rewriteTarXzViaArchiver(fsPath string, entries []string, op Operation) (removed, kept int, err error) {
	type keptEntry struct {
		hdr  *tar.Header
		data []byte
	}
	var keptEntries []keptEntry

	walkErr := archiver.Walk(fsPath, func(f archiver.File) error {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			return fmt.Errorf("cancelled")
		}
		hdr, ok := f.Header.(*tar.Header)
		if !ok {
			return nil
		}
		innerPath := normalizeArchiveEntryPath(hdr.Name)
		if matchesEntries(innerPath, entries) {
			removed++
			return nil
		}
		data, rerr := io.ReadAll(f)
		if rerr != nil {
			return rerr
		}
		keptEntries = append(keptEntries, keptEntry{hdr: hdr, data: data})
		kept++
		return nil
	})
	if walkErr != nil {
		return removed, kept, walkErr
	}

	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(fsPath), ".archive-rewrite-*.tar.xz")
	if err != nil {
		return removed, kept, err
	}
	tmpPath := tmp.Name()
	defer func() {
		tmp.Close()
		if err != nil {
			os.Remove(tmpPath)
		}
	}()

	txz := archiver.NewTarXz()
	if e := txz.Create(tmp); e != nil {
		return removed, kept, fmt.Errorf("create tar.xz: %w", e)
	}

	var processed int64
	for _, ke := range keptEntries {
		if err = txz.Write(archiver.File{
			FileInfo: archiver.FileInfo{
				FileInfo:   ke.hdr.FileInfo(),
				CustomName: ke.hdr.Name,
			},
			ReadCloser: io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(ke.data)),
		}); err != nil {
			txz.Close()
			return removed, kept, fmt.Errorf("write %q: %w", ke.hdr.Name, err)
		}
		processed++
		op.UpdateProgress(processed, int64(len(ke.data)), ke.hdr.Name, int64(len(ke.data)))
	}

	if err = txz.Close(); err != nil {
		return removed, kept, err
	}
	tmp.Close()
	return removed, kept, os.Rename(tmpPath, fsPath)
}
````

## File: internal/batch/conflicts.go
````go
package batch

import (
	"fmt"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

// ConflictManager coordinates paused batch operations waiting on a user
// conflict resolution from the frontend.
type ConflictManager struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	pending map[string]chan contracts.ConflictResolutionRequest
	counter int64
}

func NewConflictManager() *ConflictManager {
	return &ConflictManager{pending: make(map[string]chan contracts.ConflictResolutionRequest)}
}

func (m *ConflictManager) NextID(opID string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s-conflict-%d", opID, atomic.AddInt64(&m.counter, 1))
}

func (m *ConflictManager) Register(id string) <-chan contracts.ConflictResolutionRequest {
	response := make(chan contracts.ConflictResolutionRequest, 1)
	m.mu.Lock()
	m.pending[id] = response
	m.mu.Unlock()
	return response
}

func (m *ConflictManager) Resolve(id string, req contracts.ConflictResolutionRequest) bool {
	m.mu.Lock()
	response, ok := m.pending[id]
	if ok {
		delete(m.pending, id)
	}
	m.mu.Unlock()
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	response <- req
	return true
}

func (m *ConflictManager) CancelAll() {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	for id, response := range m.pending {
		response <- contracts.ConflictResolutionRequest{Resolution: contracts.ConflictCancel}
		delete(m.pending, id)
	}
}
````

````go
package batch

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"archive/zip"
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/mholt/archiver/v3"

	internalarchive "wails-app/internal/archive"
	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

type ExtractCallbacks struct {
	IsCancelled      func() bool
	CheckConflict    func(srcLabel, dst string, blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution) (string, bool, error)
	StreamToFile     func(r io.Reader, dst string, size int64, label string) (int64, error)
	ArchiveEntryPath func(archiver.File) string
	Normalize        func(string) string
	IsArchive        func(string) bool
}

type ArchiveExtractor struct {
	callbacks ExtractCallbacks
}

func NewArchiveExtractor(callbacks ExtractCallbacks) *ArchiveExtractor {
	return &ArchiveExtractor{callbacks: callbacks}
}

func (e *ArchiveExtractor) ExtractOnDisk(archivePath string, req *contracts.BatchExtractRequest, destRoot string, blanket *contracts.ConflictResolution) (int64, int64, *contracts.ConflictResolution, error) {
	ctx := extractCtx{callbacks: e.callbacks, req: req, blanket: blanket, destRoot: destRoot, depth: 0}
	files, bytes, err := ctx.extractOnDisk(archivePath)
	return files, bytes, ctx.blanket, err
}

type extractCtx struct {
	callbacks ExtractCallbacks
	req       *contracts.BatchExtractRequest
	blanket   *contracts.ConflictResolution
	destRoot  string
	depth     int
}

func (ec *extractCtx) cancelled() bool {
	return ec.callbacks.IsCancelled != nil && ec.callbacks.IsCancelled()
}

func (ec *extractCtx) tooDeep() bool {
	if !ec.req.ExpandNestedArchives {
		return true
	}
	if ec.req.MaxNestDepth < 0 {
		return false
	}
	return ec.depth >= ec.req.MaxNestDepth
}

func (ec *extractCtx) extractOnDisk(archivePath string) (int64, int64, error) {
	if strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(archivePath), ".zip") {
		return ec.extractZipOnDisk(archivePath)
	}
	return ec.extractTarOnDisk(archivePath)
}

func (ec *extractCtx) extractZipOnDisk(archivePath string) (int64, int64, error) {
	r, err := zip.OpenReader(archivePath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	defer r.Close()

	rootStrip := zipRootPrefix(r.File, ec.req.FlattenSingleRoot, ec.callbacks.Normalize)
	var totalFiles, totalBytes int64

	for _, f := range r.File {
		if ec.cancelled() {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
		}

		ep := ec.callbacks.Normalize(f.Name)
		if rootStrip != "" {
			if ep = strings.TrimPrefix(ep, rootStrip); ep == "" {
				continue
			}
		}
		destPath := filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, filepath.FromSlash(ep))

		if f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			os.MkdirAll(destPath, 0755)
			continue
		}

		if ec.callbacks.IsArchive(f.Name) && !ec.tooDeep() {
			rc, err := f.Open()
			if err != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
			}
			data, err := io.ReadAll(rc)
			rc.Close()
			if err != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
			}
			child := ec.child(filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, ArchiveBaseName(f.Name)))
			nf, nb, nerr := child.extractNestedFromBytes(data, f.Name)
			ec.blanket = child.blanket
			totalFiles += nf
			totalBytes += nb
			if nerr != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, nerr
			}
			continue
		}

		rc, err := f.Open()
		if err != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
		}
		finalDst, skip, cerr := ec.callbacks.CheckConflict(f.Name, destPath, &ec.blanket)
		if cerr != nil {
			rc.Close()
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, cerr
		}
		if skip {
			rc.Close()
			continue
		}
		written, werr := ec.callbacks.StreamToFile(rc, finalDst, int64(f.UncompressedSize64), f.Name)
		rc.Close()
		if werr != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, werr
		}
		totalFiles++
		totalBytes += written
	}
	return totalFiles, totalBytes, nil
}

func (ec *extractCtx) extractTarOnDisk(archivePath string) (int64, int64, error) {
	var rootStrip string
	if ec.req.FlattenSingleRoot {
		var tops []string
		_ = archiver.Walk(archivePath, func(f archiver.File) error {
			parts := strings.SplitN(ec.callbacks.Normalize(ec.callbacks.ArchiveEntryPath(f)), "/", 2)
			tops = appendUnique(tops, parts[0])
			return nil
		})
		if len(tops) == 1 {
			rootStrip = tops[0] + "/"
		}
	}

	var totalFiles, totalBytes int64
	err := archiver.Walk(archivePath, func(f archiver.File) error {
		if ec.cancelled() {
			return fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
		}
		ep := ec.callbacks.Normalize(ec.callbacks.ArchiveEntryPath(f))
		if rootStrip != "" {
			if ep = strings.TrimPrefix(ep, rootStrip); ep == "" {
				return nil
			}
		}
		destPath := filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, filepath.FromSlash(ep))

		if f.IsDir() {
			return os.MkdirAll(destPath, 0755)
		}
		if ec.callbacks.IsArchive(f.Name()) && !ec.tooDeep() {
			data, err := io.ReadAll(f)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			child := ec.child(filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, ArchiveBaseName(f.Name())))
			nf, nb, nerr := child.extractNestedFromBytes(data, f.Name())
			ec.blanket = child.blanket
			totalFiles += nf
			totalBytes += nb
			return nerr
		}

		finalDst, skip, err := ec.callbacks.CheckConflict(f.Name(), destPath, &ec.blanket)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if skip {
			return nil
		}
		written, err := ec.callbacks.StreamToFile(f, finalDst, f.Size(), f.Name())
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		totalFiles++
		totalBytes += written
		return nil
	})
	return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
}

func (ec *extractCtx) extractNestedFromBytes(data []byte, archiveName string) (int64, int64, error) {
	if internalarchive.IsZipMagic(data) {
		return ec.extractZipBytes(data)
	}
	if internalarchive.IsRarArchiveName(archiveName) {
		return ec.extractRarBytes(data, archiveName)
	}
	return ec.extractTarBytes(data)
}

func (ec *extractCtx) extractZipBytes(data []byte) (int64, int64, error) {
	r, err := zip.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data), int64(len(data)))
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	var totalFiles, totalBytes int64
	for _, f := range r.File {
		if ec.cancelled() {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
		}
		ep := ec.callbacks.Normalize(f.Name)
		destPath := filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, filepath.FromSlash(ep))
		if f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			os.MkdirAll(destPath, 0755)
			continue
		}
		if ec.callbacks.IsArchive(f.Name) && !ec.tooDeep() {
			rc, err := f.Open()
			if err != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
			}
			nested, err := io.ReadAll(rc)
			rc.Close()
			if err != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
			}
			child := ec.child(filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, ArchiveBaseName(f.Name)))
			nf, nb, nerr := child.extractNestedFromBytes(nested, f.Name)
			ec.blanket = child.blanket
			totalFiles += nf
			totalBytes += nb
			if nerr != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, nerr
			}
			continue
		}
		rc, err := f.Open()
		if err != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
		}
		finalDst, skip, cerr := ec.callbacks.CheckConflict(f.Name, destPath, &ec.blanket)
		if cerr != nil {
			rc.Close()
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, cerr
		}
		if skip {
			rc.Close()
			continue
		}
		written, werr := ec.callbacks.StreamToFile(rc, finalDst, int64(f.UncompressedSize64), f.Name)
		rc.Close()
		if werr != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, werr
		}
		totalFiles++
		totalBytes += written
	}
	return totalFiles, totalBytes, nil
}

func (ec *extractCtx) extractTarBytes(data []byte) (int64, int64, error) {
	tr := tar.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data))
	var totalFiles, totalBytes int64
	for {
		h, err := tr.Next()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
		}
		if ec.cancelled() {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
		}
		ep := ec.callbacks.Normalize(h.Name)
		destPath := filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, filepath.FromSlash(ep))
		if h.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			os.MkdirAll(destPath, 0755)
			continue
		}
		if ec.callbacks.IsArchive(h.Name) && !ec.tooDeep() {
			nested, err := io.ReadAll(tr)
			if err != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
			}
			child := ec.child(filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, ArchiveBaseName(h.Name)))
			nf, nb, nerr := child.extractNestedFromBytes(nested, h.Name)
			ec.blanket = child.blanket
			totalFiles += nf
			totalBytes += nb
			if nerr != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, nerr
			}
			continue
		}
		finalDst, skip, cerr := ec.callbacks.CheckConflict(h.Name, destPath, &ec.blanket)
		if cerr != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, cerr
		}
		if skip {
			continue
		}
		written, werr := ec.callbacks.StreamToFile(tr, finalDst, h.Size, h.Name)
		if werr != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, werr
		}
		totalFiles++
		totalBytes += written
	}
	return totalFiles, totalBytes, nil
}

func (ec *extractCtx) extractRarBytes(data []byte, archiveName string) (int64, int64, error) {
	reader, err := internalarchive.OpenArchiveReader(archiveName, data)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, err
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	var totalFiles, totalBytes int64
	for {
		f, err := reader.Read()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
		}
		if ec.cancelled() {
			f.Close()
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
		}
		ep := ec.callbacks.Normalize(ec.callbacks.ArchiveEntryPath(f))
		destPath := filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, filepath.FromSlash(ep))
		if f.IsDir() {
			f.Close()
			os.MkdirAll(destPath, 0755)
			continue
		}
		if ec.callbacks.IsArchive(f.Name()) && !ec.tooDeep() {
			nested, err := io.ReadAll(f)
			f.Close()
			if err != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
			}
			child := ec.child(filepath.Join(ec.destRoot, ArchiveBaseName(f.Name())))
			nf, nb, nerr := child.extractNestedFromBytes(nested, f.Name())
			ec.blanket = child.blanket
			totalFiles += nf
			totalBytes += nb
			if nerr != nil {
				return totalFiles, totalBytes, nerr
			}
			continue
		}
		finalDst, skip, cerr := ec.callbacks.CheckConflict(f.Name(), destPath, &ec.blanket)
		if cerr != nil {
			f.Close()
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, cerr
		}
		if skip {
			f.Close()
			continue
		}
		written, werr := ec.callbacks.StreamToFile(f, finalDst, f.Size(), f.Name())
		f.Close()
		if werr != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, werr
		}
		totalFiles++
		totalBytes += written
	}
	return totalFiles, totalBytes, nil
}

func (ec *extractCtx) child(destRoot string) *extractCtx {
	return &extractCtx{
		callbacks: ec.callbacks,
		req:       ec.req,
		blanket:   ec.blanket,
		destRoot:  destRoot,
		depth:     ec.depth + 1,
	}
}

func ArchiveBaseName(name string) string {
	base := filepath.Base(name)
	for _, suffix := range []string{".tar.gz", ".tar.bz2", ".tar.xz"} {
		if strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(base), suffix) {
			return base[:len(base)-len(suffix)]
		}
	}
	if ext := filepath.Ext(base); ext != "" {
		return base[:len(base)-len(ext)]
	}
	return base
}

func zipRootPrefix(files []*zip.File, flatten bool, normalize func(string) string) string {
	if !flatten {
		return ""
	}
	var tops []string
	for _, f := range files {
		parts := strings.SplitN(normalize(f.Name), "/", 2)
		tops = appendUnique(tops, parts[0])
	}
	if len(tops) == 1 {
		return tops[0] + "/"
	}
	return ""
}

func appendUnique(slice []string, s string) []string {
	for _, v := range slice {
		if v == s {
			return slice
		}
	}
	return append(slice, s)
}
````

````go
package batch

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

type FileOperator struct {
	isCancelled func() bool
	progress    *ProgressTracker
}

func NewFileOperator(isCancelled func() bool, progress *ProgressTracker) *FileOperator {
	return &FileOperator{isCancelled: isCancelled, progress: progress}
}

func SameDir(a, b string) bool {
	cleanA := filepath.Clean(a)
	cleanB := filepath.Clean(b)
	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
		return strings.EqualFold(cleanA, cleanB)
	}
	return cleanA == cleanB
}

func SamePath(a, b string) bool {
	cleanA := filepath.Clean(a)
	cleanB := filepath.Clean(b)
	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
		return strings.EqualFold(cleanA, cleanB)
	}
	return cleanA == cleanB
}

func ApplyResolution(res contracts.ConflictResolution, dst string) (string, bool, error) {
	switch res {
	case contracts.ConflictSkip:
		return dst, true, nil
	case contracts.ConflictOverwrite:
		return dst, false, nil
	case contracts.ConflictRename:
		renamed, err := uniqueDestination(dst)
		return renamed, false, err
	case contracts.ConflictCancel:
		return "", true, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled by user")
	default:
		return dst, true, nil
	}
}

func (f *FileOperator) StreamToFile(r io.Reader, dst string, size int64, label string) (int64, error) {
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dst), 0755); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	out, err := os.Create(dst)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	defer out.Close()

	baseItems, baseBytes := f.progress.Snapshot()
	f.progress.Set(baseItems, baseBytes, label, size, false)

	buf := make([]byte, 32*1024)
	var written int64
	for {
		if f.isCancelled != nil && f.isCancelled() {
			out.Close()
			os.Remove(dst)
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
		}
		nr, readErr := r.Read(buf)
		if nr > 0 {
			nw, writeErr := out.Write(buf[:nr])
			if writeErr != nil {
				return written, writeErr
			}
			written += int64(nw)
			f.progress.Set(baseItems, baseBytes+written, label, size, false)
		}
		if readErr == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if readErr != nil {
			return written, readErr
		}
	}

	f.progress.Set(baseItems+1, baseBytes+written, "", 0, false)
	return written, nil
}

func (f *FileOperator) CopyPath(src, dst string, recursive bool) error {
	info, err := os.Stat(src)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if info.IsDir() {
		if !recursive {
			return fmt.Errorf("source is a directory; use recursive=true")
		}
		return walkDirOrdered(src, func(path string, isDir bool, size int64) error {
			if f.isCancelled != nil && f.isCancelled() {
				return fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
			}
			rel, _ := filepath.Rel(src, path)
			target := filepath.Join(dst, rel)
			if isDir {
				return os.MkdirAll(target, 0755)
			}
			file, err := os.Open(path)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			defer file.Close()
			_, err = f.StreamToFile(file, target, size, filepath.Base(path))
			return err
		})
	}
	file, err := os.Open(src)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer file.Close()
	_, err = f.StreamToFile(file, dst, info.Size(), filepath.Base(src))
	return err
}

func (f *FileOperator) DeleteDir(path string) error {
	var files, dirs []string
	walkDirOrdered(path, func(current string, isDir bool, _ int64) error {
		if current == path {
			return nil
		}
		if isDir {
			dirs = append(dirs, current)
		} else {
			files = append(files, current)
		}
		return nil
	})

	for _, file := range files {
		if f.isCancelled != nil && f.isCancelled() {
			return fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
		}
		var size int64
		if info, err := os.Stat(file); err == nil {
			size = info.Size()
		}
		os.Remove(file)
		f.progress.Advance(1, size, filepath.Base(file), size, false)
	}
	for index := len(dirs) - 1; index >= 0; index-- {
		os.Remove(dirs[index])
	}
	return os.Remove(path)
}

func uniqueDestination(dst string) (string, error) {
	ext := filepath.Ext(dst)
	base := dst[:len(dst)-len(ext)]
	if candidate := fmt.Sprintf("%s_copy%s", base, ext); pathAvailable(candidate) {
		return candidate, nil
	}
	for index := 2; index <= 999; index++ {
		candidate := fmt.Sprintf("%s_copy%d%s", base, index, ext)
		if pathAvailable(candidate) {
			return candidate, nil
		}
	}
	return "", fmt.Errorf("could not find a free name for %q", dst)
}

func pathAvailable(path string) bool {
	_, err := os.Lstat(path)
	return os.IsNotExist(err)
}

func walkDirOrdered(root string, visit func(path string, isDir bool, size int64) error) error {
	return filepath.Walk(root, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return nil
		}
		return visit(path, info.IsDir(), info.Size())
	})
}
````

## File: internal/batch/progress.go
````go
package batch

import (
	"sync"
	"time"

	internalops "wails-app/internal/ops"
)

// ProgressTracker batches frequent progress updates before forwarding them to
// the shared operations runtime.
type ProgressTracker struct {
	op       *internalops.ActiveOperation
	throttle time.Duration
	lastEmit time.Time

	mu             sync.Mutex
	processedItems int64
	processedBytes int64
	currentFile    string
	currentSize    int64
}

func NewProgressTracker(op *internalops.ActiveOperation) *ProgressTracker {
	return &ProgressTracker{
		op:       op,
		throttle: 100 * time.Millisecond,
		lastEmit: time.Now(),
	}
}

func (p *ProgressTracker) Set(items, bytes int64, file string, fileSize int64, force bool) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	p.processedItems = items
	p.processedBytes = bytes
	p.currentFile = file
	p.currentSize = fileSize
	now := time.Now()
	emit := force || now.Sub(p.lastEmit) >= p.throttle
	if emit {
		p.lastEmit = now
	}
	i, b, f, s := p.processedItems, p.processedBytes, p.currentFile, p.currentSize
	p.mu.Unlock()
	if emit {
		p.op.UpdateProgress(i, b, f, s)
	}
}

func (p *ProgressTracker) Flush() {
	p.mu.Lock()
	i, b, f, s := p.processedItems, p.processedBytes, p.currentFile, p.currentSize
	p.mu.Unlock()
	p.op.UpdateProgress(i, b, f, s)
}

func (p *ProgressTracker) Snapshot() (int64, int64) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	return p.processedItems, p.processedBytes
}

func (p *ProgressTracker) Advance(itemDelta, byteDelta int64, file string, fileSize int64, force bool) (int64, int64) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	p.processedItems += itemDelta
	p.processedBytes += byteDelta
	i, b := p.processedItems, p.processedBytes
	p.mu.Unlock()
	p.Set(i, b, file, fileSize, force)
	return i, b
}
````

## File: internal/batch/selective_extract.go
````go
package batch

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"archive/zip"
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/mholt/archiver/v3"

	internalarchive "wails-app/internal/archive"
	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

type SelectiveExtractCallbacks struct {
	IsCancelled          func() bool
	CheckConflict        func(srcLabel, dst string, blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution) (string, bool, error)
	ExtractNestedArchive func(archivePath string, nestedChain []string) ([]byte, error)
	Normalize            func(string) string
	ArchiveEntryPath     func(archiver.File) string
}

type SelectiveExtractor struct {
	callbacks     SelectiveExtractCallbacks
	progress      *ProgressTracker
	addTotalBytes func(int64)
}

type archiveEntry struct {
	innerPath string
	data      []byte
	size      int64
	mtime     int64
}

func NewSelectiveExtractor(callbacks SelectiveExtractCallbacks, progress *ProgressTracker, addTotalBytes func(int64)) *SelectiveExtractor {
	return &SelectiveExtractor{callbacks: callbacks, progress: progress, addTotalBytes: addTotalBytes}
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) ExtractItem(item contracts.SelectiveExtractItem, defaultDest string, blanket *contracts.ConflictResolution) (int64, int64, *contracts.ConflictResolution, error) {
	if e.callbacks.IsCancelled != nil && e.callbacks.IsCancelled() {
		return 0, 0, blanket, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
	}

	destRoot := item.DestinationDir
	if destRoot == "" {
		destRoot = defaultDest
	}

	var collected []archiveEntry
	var err error
	if len(item.NestedChain) == 0 {
		collected, err = e.collectFromDisk(item.ArchivePath, item.Entries)
	} else {
		collected, err = e.collectFromNested(item.ArchivePath, item.NestedChain, item.Entries)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return 0, 0, blanket, err
	}
	if len(collected) == 0 {
		return 0, 0, blanket, nil
	}

	var totalSize int64
	for _, entry := range collected {
		totalSize += entry.size
	}
	if e.addTotalBytes != nil {
		e.addTotalBytes(totalSize)
	}

	files, bytes, err := e.writeEntries(collected, destRoot, item.StripPrefix, item.FlattenPaths, &blanket)
	return files, bytes, blanket, err
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) collectFromDisk(archivePath string, entries []string) ([]archiveEntry, error) {
	if strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(archivePath), ".zip") {
		return e.collectZipFile(archivePath, entries)
	}
	return e.collectTarFile(archivePath, entries)
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) collectZipFile(archivePath string, entries []string) ([]archiveEntry, error) {
	r, err := zip.OpenReader(archivePath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer r.Close()

	var out []archiveEntry
	for _, f := range r.File {
		if f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		ep := e.callbacks.Normalize(f.Name)
		if !wantEntry(ep, entries, e.callbacks.Normalize) {
			continue
		}
		rc, err := f.Open()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("open %q: %w", f.Name, err)
		}
		data, err := io.ReadAll(rc)
		rc.Close()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read %q: %w", f.Name, err)
		}
		out = append(out, archiveEntry{ep, data, int64(f.UncompressedSize64), f.Modified.Unix()})
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) collectTarFile(archivePath string, entries []string) ([]archiveEntry, error) {
	var out []archiveEntry
	err := archiver.Walk(archivePath, func(f archiver.File) error {
		if f.IsDir() {
			return nil
		}
		ep := e.callbacks.Normalize(e.callbacks.ArchiveEntryPath(f))
		if !wantEntry(ep, entries, e.callbacks.Normalize) {
			return nil
		}
		data, err := io.ReadAll(f)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("read %q: %w", ep, err)
		}
		var mtime int64
		if hdr, ok := f.Header.(*tar.Header); ok {
			mtime = hdr.ModTime.Unix()
		}
		out = append(out, archiveEntry{ep, data, f.Size(), mtime})
		return nil
	})
	return out, err
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) collectFromNested(archivePath string, nestedChain []string, entries []string) ([]archiveEntry, error) {
	data, err := e.callbacks.ExtractNestedArchive(archivePath, nestedChain)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolve nested chain: %w", err)
	}
	return e.collectFromBytes(data, nestedChain[len(nestedChain)-1], entries)
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) collectFromBytes(data []byte, archiveName string, entries []string) ([]archiveEntry, error) {
	if internalarchive.IsZipMagic(data) {
		return e.collectZipBytes(data, entries)
	}
	if internalarchive.IsRarArchiveName(archiveName) {
		return e.collectRarBytes(data, archiveName, entries)
	}
	return e.collectTarBytes(data, entries)
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) collectZipBytes(data []byte, entries []string) ([]archiveEntry, error) {
	r, err := zip.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data), int64(len(data)))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var out []archiveEntry
	for _, f := range r.File {
		if f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		ep := e.callbacks.Normalize(f.Name)
		if !wantEntry(ep, entries, e.callbacks.Normalize) {
			continue
		}
		rc, err := f.Open()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("open %q: %w", f.Name, err)
		}
		buf, err := io.ReadAll(rc)
		rc.Close()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read %q: %w", f.Name, err)
		}
		out = append(out, archiveEntry{ep, buf, int64(f.UncompressedSize64), f.Modified.Unix()})
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) collectTarBytes(data []byte, entries []string) ([]archiveEntry, error) {
	tr := tar.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data))
	var out []archiveEntry
	for {
		h, err := tr.Next()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if h.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			io.Copy(io.Discard, tr)
			continue
		}
		ep := e.callbacks.Normalize(h.Name)
		if !wantEntry(ep, entries, e.callbacks.Normalize) {
			io.Copy(io.Discard, tr)
			continue
		}
		buf, err := io.ReadAll(tr)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read %q: %w", h.Name, err)
		}
		out = append(out, archiveEntry{ep, buf, h.Size, h.ModTime.Unix()})
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) collectRarBytes(data []byte, archiveName string, entries []string) ([]archiveEntry, error) {
	reader, err := internalarchive.OpenArchiveReader(archiveName, data)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	var out []archiveEntry
	for {
		f, err := reader.Read()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		ep := e.callbacks.Normalize(e.callbacks.ArchiveEntryPath(f))
		if f.IsDir() || !wantEntry(ep, entries, e.callbacks.Normalize) {
			f.Close()
			continue
		}
		buf, err := io.ReadAll(f)
		f.Close()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read %q: %w", ep, err)
		}
		out = append(out, archiveEntry{ep, buf, f.Size(), f.ModTime().Unix()})
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (e *SelectiveExtractor) writeEntries(collected []archiveEntry, destRoot string, stripPrefix string, flatten bool, blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution) (int64, int64, error) {
	var totalFiles, totalBytes int64
	rebasePrefix := e.callbacks.Normalize(stripPrefix)

	for _, entry := range collected {
		if e.callbacks.IsCancelled != nil && e.callbacks.IsCancelled() {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
		}

		relPath := e.callbacks.Normalize(entry.innerPath)
		if rebasePrefix != "" {
			if relPath == rebasePrefix {
				continue
			}
			prefixWithSep := rebasePrefix + "/"
			relPath = strings.TrimPrefix(relPath, prefixWithSep)
		}
		if relPath == "" {
			continue
		}

		var destPath string
		if flatten {
			destPath = filepath.Join(destRoot, filepath.Base(filepath.FromSlash(relPath)))
		} else {
			destPath = filepath.Join(destRoot, filepath.FromSlash(relPath))
		}

		finalDst, skip, err := e.callbacks.CheckConflict(entry.innerPath, destPath, blanket)
		if err != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
		}
		if skip {
			continue
		}

		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(finalDst), 0755); err != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, err
		}

		baseItems, baseBytes := e.progress.Snapshot()
		e.progress.Set(baseItems, baseBytes, filepath.Base(entry.innerPath), entry.size, false)

		if err := os.WriteFile(finalDst, entry.data, 0644); err != nil {
			return totalFiles, totalBytes, fmt.Errorf("write %q: %w", finalDst, err)
		}

		written := int64(len(entry.data))
		e.progress.Set(baseItems+1, baseBytes+written, "", 0, false)

		totalFiles++
		totalBytes += written
	}
	return totalFiles, totalBytes, nil
}

func wantEntry(innerPath string, entries []string, normalize func(string) string) bool {
	if len(entries) == 0 {
		return true
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		entry = normalize(entry)
		if entry == "" || entry == "." {
			return true
		}
		if innerPath == entry || strings.HasPrefix(innerPath, entry+"/") {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
````

````go
package batch

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/mholt/archiver/v3"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	internalops "wails-app/internal/ops"
)

type ConflictPrompter interface {
	PromptConflict(event contracts.ConflictEvent)
}

type ConflictPrompterFunc func(event contracts.ConflictEvent)

func (fn ConflictPrompterFunc) PromptConflict(event contracts.ConflictEvent) {
	if fn != nil {
		fn(event)
	}
}

type ServiceConfig struct {
	StartOperation                 func(kind contracts.OperationType, title, source, dest string) *internalops.ActiveOperation
	ConflictPrompter               ConflictPrompter
	BatchErr                       func(source, destination string, err error) contracts.BatchItemError
	IsPermissionDenied             func(error) bool
	ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation func(error) bool
	RunElevatedCopy                func(src, dst string, recursive bool) (bool, error)
	RunElevatedMove                func(src, dst string) (bool, error)
	RunElevatedDelete              func(path string, recursive bool, useTrash *bool) (bool, error)
	MoveToTrash                    func(path string) error
	CalculateSize                  func(path string) (int64, int64)
	ResolvePath                    func(path string) (string, error)
	ToPublicPath                   func(path string) string
	GetFileInfo                    func(path string) (*contracts.FileInfo, error)
	CopyPath                       func(source, destination string, recursive bool, streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error)) error
	ExtractNestedArchive           func(archivePath string, nestedChain []string) ([]byte, error)
	Normalize                      func(string) string
	ArchiveEntryPath               func(archiver.File) string
	IsArchive                      func(string) bool
}

type Service struct {
	config    ServiceConfig
	conflicts *ConflictManager
}

func NewService(config ServiceConfig) *Service {
	return &Service{config: config, conflicts: NewConflictManager()}
}

func (s *Service) resolvePath(path string) (string, error) {
	if s.config.ResolvePath == nil {
		return path, nil
	}
	return s.config.ResolvePath(path)
}

func (s *Service) toPublicPath(path string) string {
	if s.config.ToPublicPath == nil {
		return path
	}
	return s.config.ToPublicPath(path)
}

func (s *Service) checkConflict(
	op *internalops.ActiveOperation,
	srcLabel, dst string,
	blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution,
) (finalDst string, skip bool, err error) {
	resolvedDst, err := s.resolvePath(dst)
	if err != nil {
		return "", false, err
	}

	dstInfo, statErr := os.Lstat(resolvedDst)
	if os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
		return resolvedDst, false, nil
	}
	if statErr != nil {
		return "", false, statErr
	}

	if *blanket != nil {
		return ApplyResolution(**blanket, resolvedDst)
	}

	var srcSize, srcMtime int64
	resolvedSrc, resolveErr := s.resolvePath(srcLabel)
	if resolveErr == nil {
		if info, sourceErr := os.Lstat(resolvedSrc); sourceErr == nil {
			srcSize = info.Size()
			srcMtime = info.ModTime().Unix()
		}
	} else if info, sourceErr := os.Lstat(srcLabel); sourceErr == nil {
		srcSize = info.Size()
		srcMtime = info.ModTime().Unix()
	}

	conflictID := s.conflicts.NextID(op.ID)
	response := s.conflicts.Register(conflictID)
	if s.config.ConflictPrompter != nil {
		s.config.ConflictPrompter.PromptConflict(contracts.ConflictEvent{
			OperationID: op.ID,
			ConflictID:  conflictID,
			SourcePath:  srcLabel,
			DestPath:    dst,
			SourceSize:  srcSize,
			DestSize:    dstInfo.Size(),
			SourceMtime: srcMtime,
			DestMtime:   dstInfo.ModTime().Unix(),
			IsDirectory: dstInfo.IsDir(),
		})
	}

	select {
	case res := <-response:
		if res.ApplyToAll {
			r := res.Resolution
			*blanket = &r
		}
		return ApplyResolution(res.Resolution, resolvedDst)
	case <-op.CancelSignal():
		s.conflicts.CancelAll()
		return "", true, fmt.Errorf("operation cancelled")
	}
}

func (s *Service) newTransferRunner(op *internalops.ActiveOperation) *TransferRunner {
	return NewTransferRunner(TransferCallbacks{
		CheckConflict: func(srcLabel, dst string, blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution) (string, bool, error) {
			return s.checkConflict(op, srcLabel, dst, blanket)
		},
		BatchErr:                       s.config.BatchErr,
		IsPermissionDenied:             s.config.IsPermissionDenied,
		ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation: s.config.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation,
		RunElevatedCopy:                s.config.RunElevatedCopy,
		RunElevatedMove:                s.config.RunElevatedMove,
		RunElevatedDelete:              s.config.RunElevatedDelete,
		MoveToTrash:                    s.config.MoveToTrash,
		CalculateSize:                  s.config.CalculateSize,
		ResolvePath:                    s.config.ResolvePath,
		ToPublicPath:                   s.config.ToPublicPath,
		GetFileInfo:                    s.config.GetFileInfo,
		CopyPath:                       s.config.CopyPath,
	})
}

func (s *Service) BatchCopy(req contracts.BatchRequest) (*contracts.BatchResult, error) {
	op := s.config.StartOperation(contracts.OpCopy, "Batch copy", "", "")
	return s.newTransferRunner(op).Copy(op, req)
}

func (s *Service) BatchMove(req contracts.BatchRequest) (*contracts.BatchResult, error) {
	op := s.config.StartOperation(contracts.OpMove, "Batch move", "", "")
	return s.newTransferRunner(op).Move(op, req)
}

func (s *Service) BatchDelete(req contracts.BatchDeleteRequest) (*contracts.BatchResult, error) {
	op := s.config.StartOperation(contracts.OpDelete, "Batch delete", "", "")
	return s.newTransferRunner(op).Delete(op, req)
}

func (s *Service) BatchExtract(req contracts.BatchExtractRequest) (*contracts.BatchExtractResult, error) {
	op := s.config.StartOperation(contracts.OpExtract, "Batch extract", "", req.DestinationDir)
	op.SetTotal(int64(len(req.Archives)), 0)

	progress := NewProgressTracker(op)
	fileOps := NewFileOperator(op.IsCancelled, progress)
	extractor := NewArchiveExtractor(ExtractCallbacks{
		IsCancelled: op.IsCancelled,
		CheckConflict: func(srcLabel, dst string, blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution) (string, bool, error) {
			return s.checkConflict(op, srcLabel, dst, blanket)
		},
		StreamToFile: func(r io.Reader, dst string, size int64, label string) (int64, error) {
			return fileOps.StreamToFile(r, dst, size, label)
		},
		ArchiveEntryPath: s.config.ArchiveEntryPath,
		Normalize:        s.config.Normalize,
		IsArchive:        s.config.IsArchive,
	})
	result := &contracts.BatchExtractResult{OperationID: op.ID, Total: len(req.Archives)}
	var blanket *contracts.ConflictResolution

	for _, archivePath := range req.Archives {
		if op.IsCancelled() || (blanket != nil && *blanket == contracts.ConflictCancel) {
			break
		}

		destRoot := req.DestinationDir
		if req.CreateSubdirectory {
			destRoot = filepath.Join(req.DestinationDir, ArchiveBaseName(archivePath))
		}

		files, bytes, nextBlanket, err := extractor.ExtractOnDisk(archivePath, &req, destRoot, blanket)
		blanket = nextBlanket
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, s.config.BatchErr(archivePath, destRoot, err))
			continue
		}

		result.Succeeded++
		result.ExtractedFiles += files
		result.ExtractedBytes += bytes
		progress.Advance(1, 0, filepath.Base(archivePath), 0, false)
	}

	progress.Flush()
	op.Complete()
	return result, nil
}

func (s *Service) BatchSelectiveExtract(req contracts.BatchSelectiveExtractRequest) (*contracts.BatchSelectiveExtractResult, error) {
	op := s.config.StartOperation(contracts.OpExtract, "Selective extract", "", req.DestinationDir)
	op.SetTotal(int64(len(req.Items)), 0)

	progress := NewProgressTracker(op)
	extractor := NewSelectiveExtractor(
		SelectiveExtractCallbacks{
			IsCancelled: op.IsCancelled,
			CheckConflict: func(srcLabel, dst string, blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution) (string, bool, error) {
				return s.checkConflict(op, srcLabel, dst, blanket)
			},
			ExtractNestedArchive: s.config.ExtractNestedArchive,
			Normalize:            s.config.Normalize,
			ArchiveEntryPath:     s.config.ArchiveEntryPath,
		},
		progress,
		op.AddTotalBytes,
	)
	result := &contracts.BatchSelectiveExtractResult{OperationID: op.ID, Total: len(req.Items)}
	var blanket *contracts.ConflictResolution

	for _, item := range req.Items {
		if op.IsCancelled() || (blanket != nil && *blanket == contracts.ConflictCancel) {
			break
		}

		files, bytes, nextBlanket, err := extractor.ExtractItem(item, req.DestinationDir, blanket)
		blanket = nextBlanket
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, s.config.BatchErr(item.ArchivePath, "", err))
		} else {
			result.Succeeded++
			result.ExtractedFiles += files
			result.ExtractedBytes += bytes
		}

		progress.Advance(1, 0, filepath.Base(item.ArchivePath), 0, false)
	}

	progress.Flush()
	op.Complete()
	return result, nil
}

func (s *Service) ResolveConflict(conflictID string, resolution contracts.ConflictResolution, applyToAll bool) bool {
	return s.conflicts.Resolve(conflictID, contracts.ConflictResolutionRequest{
		Resolution: resolution,
		ApplyToAll: applyToAll,
	})
}
````

````go
package batch

import (

func TestNormalizeItemDestinationKeepsExactDestination(t *testing.T) {
	tempDir := t.TempDir()
	sourcePath := filepath.Join(tempDir, "New Folder")
	destPath := filepath.Join(tempDir, "Existing")

	if err := os.Mkdir(sourcePath, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create source dir: %v", err)
	}
	if err := os.Mkdir(destPath, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create destination dir: %v", err)
	}

	runner := NewTransferRunner(TransferCallbacks{
		ResolvePath:  func(path string) (string, error) { return path, nil },
		ToPublicPath: func(path string) string { return path },
	})

	normalized, err := runner.normalizeItemDestination(contracts.BatchItem{
		Source:           sourcePath,
		Destination:      destPath,
		ExactDestination: true,
	}, sourcePath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("normalizeItemDestination returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if normalized != destPath {
		t.Fatalf("exact destination mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", destPath, normalized)
	}
}

func TestBatchMoveExactDestinationReportsConflict(t *testing.T) {
	tempDir := t.TempDir()
	sourcePath := filepath.Join(tempDir, "New Folder")
	destPath := filepath.Join(tempDir, "Existing")

	if err := os.Mkdir(sourcePath, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create source dir: %v", err)
	}
	if err := os.Mkdir(destPath, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create destination dir: %v", err)
	}

	manager := internalops.NewManager()
	var service *Service
	service = NewService(ServiceConfig{
		StartOperation: func(kind contracts.OperationType, title, source, dest string) *internalops.ActiveOperation {
			return manager.StartOperation(kind, title, source, dest)
		},
		BatchErr: func(source, destination string, err error) contracts.BatchItemError {
			return contracts.BatchItemError{Source: source, Destination: destination, Error: err.Error(), Code: "unknown"}
		},
		CalculateSize: func(path string) (int64, int64) { return 1, 0 },
		ResolvePath:   func(path string) (string, error) { return path, nil },
		ToPublicPath:  func(path string) string { return path },
		ConflictPrompter: ConflictPrompterFunc(func(event contracts.ConflictEvent) {
			service.ResolveConflict(event.ConflictID, contracts.ConflictSkip, false)
		}),
	})

	result, err := service.BatchMove(contracts.BatchRequest{
		Items: []contracts.BatchItem{{
			Source:           sourcePath,
			Destination:      destPath,
			ExactDestination: true,
		}},
		Recursive: true,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("BatchMove returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Skipped != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected conflict skip result, got %+v", result)
	}
	if _, err := os.Stat(sourcePath); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("source should remain after skipped conflict: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestBatchCopyUsesCallbackForVirtualSource(t *testing.T) {
	tempDir := t.TempDir()
	destPath := filepath.Join(tempDir, "downloaded.txt")
	const sourcePath = "smb://example.com/share/readme.txt"
	const content = "hello from smb"

	manager := internalops.NewManager()
	service := NewService(ServiceConfig{
		StartOperation: manager.StartOperation,
		BatchErr: func(source, destination string, err error) contracts.BatchItemError {
			return contracts.BatchItemError{Source: source, Destination: destination, Error: err.Error(), Code: "unknown"}
		},

		ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation: func(error) bool { return false },
		RunElevatedCopy:                func(src, dst string, recursive bool) (bool, error) { return false, nil },
		RunElevatedMove:                func(src, dst string) (bool, error) { return false, nil },
		RunElevatedDelete:              func(path string, recursive bool, useTrash *bool) (bool, error) { return false, nil },
		MoveToTrash:                    func(path string) error { return nil },
		GetFileInfo: func(path string) (*contracts.FileInfo, error) {
			if path != sourcePath {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected getFileInfo path: %s", path)
			}
			return &contracts.FileInfo{
				Name: "readme.txt",
				Path: path,
				Type: contracts.FileTypeFile,
				Size: int64(len(content)),
			}, nil
		},
		CopyPath: func(source, destination string, recursive bool, streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error)) error {
			if source != sourcePath {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected source: %s", source)
			}
			if destination != destPath {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected destination: %s", destination)
			}
			if recursive {
				t.Fatalf("recursive should be false for file copy")
			}
			_, err := streamToFile(strings.NewReader(content), destination, int64(len(content)), "readme.txt")
			return err
		},
	})

	result, err := service.BatchCopy(contracts.BatchRequest{
		Items: []contracts.BatchItem{{
			Source:      sourcePath,
			Destination: destPath,
		}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("BatchCopy returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Failed != 0 || result.Succeeded != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected batch result: %+v", result)
	}

	data, err := os.ReadFile(destPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read destination: %v", err)
	}
	if string(data) != content {
		t.Fatalf("destination content mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", content, string(data))
	}
}
````
