````go
package batch

import (
	"io"
	"os"
	pathpkg "path"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	internalops "wails-app/internal/ops"
)

type TransferCallbacks struct {
	CheckConflict                  func(srcLabel, dst string, blanket **contracts.ConflictResolution) (string, bool, error)
	BatchErr                       func(source, destination string, err error) contracts.BatchItemError
	IsPermissionDenied             func(error) bool
	ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation func(error) bool
	RunElevatedCopy                func(src, dst string, recursive bool) (bool, error)
	RunElevatedMove                func(src, dst string) (bool, error)
	RunElevatedDelete              func(path string, recursive bool, useTrash *bool) (bool, error)
	MoveToTrash                    func(path string) error
	CalculateSize                  func(path string) (int64, int64)
	ResolvePath                    func(path string) (string, error)
	ToPublicPath                   func(path string) string
	GetFileInfo                    func(path string) (*contracts.FileInfo, error)
	CopyPath                       func(source, destination string, recursive bool, streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error)) error
}

type TransferRunner struct {
	callbacks TransferCallbacks
}

func NewTransferRunner(callbacks TransferCallbacks) *TransferRunner {
	return &TransferRunner{callbacks: callbacks}
}

func (r *TransferRunner) resolvePath(path string) (string, error) {
	if r.callbacks.ResolvePath == nil {
		return path, nil
	}
	return r.callbacks.ResolvePath(path)
}

func (r *TransferRunner) toPublicPath(path string) string {
	if r.callbacks.ToPublicPath == nil {
		return path
	}
	return r.callbacks.ToPublicPath(path)
}

func (r *TransferRunner) getFileInfo(path string) (*contracts.FileInfo, error) {
	if r.callbacks.GetFileInfo == nil {
		return nil, os.ErrNotExist
	}
	return r.callbacks.GetFileInfo(path)
}

func (r *TransferRunner) sourceMetrics(path string) (items, bytes int64) {
	resolvedPath, err := r.resolvePath(path)
	if err == nil {
		if info, statErr := os.Stat(resolvedPath); statErr == nil {
			if info.IsDir() {
				return r.callbacks.CalculateSize(resolvedPath)
			}
			return 1, info.Size()
		}
	}

	info, infoErr := r.getFileInfo(path)
	if infoErr != nil || info == nil {
		return 0, 0
	}
	if info.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
		return 1, 0
	}
	return 1, info.Size
}

type sourceDescriptor struct {
	name       string
	size       int64
	isDir      bool
	customCopy bool
}

func (r *TransferRunner) describeSource(publicPath, resolvedPath string) (sourceDescriptor, error) {
	info, err := os.Stat(resolvedPath)
	if err == nil {
		return sourceDescriptor{
			name:  filepath.Base(resolvedPath),
			size:  info.Size(),
			isDir: info.IsDir(),
		}, nil
	}

	fileInfo, infoErr := r.getFileInfo(publicPath)
	if infoErr != nil || fileInfo == nil {
		return sourceDescriptor{}, err
	}

	name := fileInfo.Name
	if name == "" {
		name = pathBase(publicPath)
	}

	return sourceDescriptor{
		name:       name,
		size:       fileInfo.Size,
		isDir:      fileInfo.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory,
		customCopy: true,
	}, nil
}

func pathBase(path string) string {
	normalized := strings.TrimRight(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"), "/")
	if normalized == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return pathpkg.Base(normalized)
}

func (r *TransferRunner) normalizeItemDestination(item contracts.BatchItem, sourceName string) (string, error) {
	destinationLabel := item.Destination
	resolvedDestination, err := r.resolvePath(destinationLabel)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	if item.ExactDestination {
		return destinationLabel, nil
	}

	info, statErr := os.Stat(resolvedDestination)
	if statErr == nil && info.IsDir() {
		normalized := r.toPublicPath(filepath.Join(resolvedDestination, sourceName))
		return normalized, nil
	}

	if statErr != nil && !os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
		return "", statErr
	}

	return destinationLabel, nil
}

func (r *TransferRunner) Copy(op *internalops.ActiveOperation, req contracts.BatchRequest) (*contracts.BatchResult, error) {
	var totalItems, totalBytes int64
	for _, item := range req.Items {
		n, b := r.sourceMetrics(item.Source)
		totalItems += n
		totalBytes += b
	}
	op.SetTotal(totalItems, totalBytes)

	progress := NewProgressTracker(op)
	fileOps := NewFileOperator(op.IsCancelled, progress)
	result := &contracts.BatchResult{OperationID: op.ID, Total: len(req.Items)}
	var blanket *contracts.ConflictResolution

	for _, item := range req.Items {
		if op.IsCancelled() || (blanket != nil && *blanket == contracts.ConflictCancel) {
			break
		}

		resolvedSource, err := r.resolvePath(item.Source)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, item.Destination, err))
			continue
		}

		source, err := r.describeSource(item.Source, resolvedSource)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, "", err))
			continue
		}

		destinationLabel, err := r.normalizeItemDestination(item, source.name)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, item.Destination, err))
			continue
		}

		finalDst, skip, err := r.callbacks.CheckConflict(item.Source, destinationLabel, &blanket)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, destinationLabel, err))
			continue
		}
		if skip {
			result.Skipped++
			continue
		}
		publicDst := r.toPublicPath(finalDst)

		copyErr := error(nil)
		if source.customCopy && r.callbacks.CopyPath != nil {
			copyErr = r.callbacks.CopyPath(item.Source, publicDst, req.Recursive, fileOps.StreamToFile)
		} else {
			copyErr = fileOps.CopyPath(resolvedSource, finalDst, req.Recursive)
		}
		if copyErr != nil {
			if r.callbacks.IsPermissionDenied(copyErr) {
				success, elevErr := r.callbacks.RunElevatedCopy(resolvedSource, finalDst, req.Recursive)
				if elevErr == nil && success {
					result.Succeeded++
					continue
				}
			}
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, publicDst, copyErr))
			continue
		}
		result.Succeeded++
	}

	progress.Flush()
	op.Complete()
	return result, nil
}

func (r *TransferRunner) Move(op *internalops.ActiveOperation, req contracts.BatchRequest) (*contracts.BatchResult, error) {
	allNoOp := true
	for _, item := range req.Items {
		resolvedSource, srcErr := r.resolvePath(item.Source)
		resolvedDestination, dstErr := r.resolvePath(item.Destination)
		if srcErr != nil || dstErr != nil || !SamePath(resolvedSource, resolvedDestination) {
			allNoOp = false
			break
		}
	}
	if allNoOp {
		op.Complete()
		return &contracts.BatchResult{OperationID: op.ID, Total: len(req.Items), Skipped: len(req.Items)}, nil
	}

	var totalItems, totalBytes int64
	for _, item := range req.Items {
		resolvedSource, err := r.resolvePath(item.Source)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		n, b := r.callbacks.CalculateSize(resolvedSource)
		totalItems += n
		totalBytes += b
	}
	op.SetTotal(totalItems, totalBytes)

	progress := NewProgressTracker(op)
	fileOps := NewFileOperator(op.IsCancelled, progress)
	result := &contracts.BatchResult{OperationID: op.ID, Total: len(req.Items)}
	var blanket *contracts.ConflictResolution

	for _, item := range req.Items {
		if op.IsCancelled() || (blanket != nil && *blanket == contracts.ConflictCancel) {
			break
		}

		resolvedSource, err := r.resolvePath(item.Source)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, item.Destination, err))
			continue
		}
		destinationLabel, err := r.normalizeItemDestination(item, pathBase(item.Source))
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, item.Destination, err))
			continue
		}
		resolvedDestination, err := r.resolvePath(destinationLabel)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, destinationLabel, err))
			continue
		}

		if SamePath(resolvedSource, resolvedDestination) {
			result.Skipped++
			continue
		}

		srcInfo, err := os.Stat(resolvedSource)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, "", err))
			continue
		}

		finalDst, skip, err := r.callbacks.CheckConflict(item.Source, destinationLabel, &blanket)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, destinationLabel, err))
			continue
		}
		if skip {
			result.Skipped++
			continue
		}
		publicDst := r.toPublicPath(finalDst)

		if err = os.Rename(resolvedSource, finalDst); err != nil {
			if r.callbacks.IsPermissionDenied(err) {
				success, elevErr := r.callbacks.RunElevatedMove(resolvedSource, finalDst)
				if elevErr == nil && success {
					result.Succeeded++
					continue
				}
			}
			if err2 := fileOps.CopyPath(resolvedSource, finalDst, true); err2 != nil {
				if r.callbacks.IsPermissionDenied(err2) {
					success, elevErr := r.callbacks.RunElevatedMove(resolvedSource, finalDst)
					if elevErr == nil && success {
						result.Succeeded++
						continue
					}
				}
				result.Failed++
				result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, publicDst, err2))
				continue
			}
			if err2 := os.RemoveAll(resolvedSource); err2 != nil {
				if r.callbacks.IsPermissionDenied(err2) {
					useTrash := false
					success, elevErr := r.callbacks.RunElevatedDelete(resolvedSource, true, &useTrash)
					if elevErr == nil && success {
						result.Succeeded++
						continue
					}
				}
				result.Failed++
				result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(item.Source, "", err2))
				continue
			}
		} else {
			progress.Advance(1, srcInfo.Size(), filepath.Base(item.Source), srcInfo.Size(), false)
		}
		result.Succeeded++
	}

	progress.Flush()
	op.Complete()
	return result, nil
}

func (r *TransferRunner) Delete(op *internalops.ActiveOperation, req contracts.BatchDeleteRequest) (*contracts.BatchResult, error) {
	var totalItems, totalBytes int64
	for _, path := range req.Paths {
		resolvedPath, err := r.resolvePath(path)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		n, b := r.callbacks.CalculateSize(resolvedPath)
		totalItems += n
		totalBytes += b
	}
	op.SetTotal(totalItems, totalBytes)

	progress := NewProgressTracker(op)
	fileOps := NewFileOperator(op.IsCancelled, progress)
	result := &contracts.BatchResult{OperationID: op.ID, Total: len(req.Paths)}

	for _, path := range req.Paths {
		if op.IsCancelled() {
			break
		}

		resolvedPath, err := r.resolvePath(path)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(path, "", err))
			continue
		}

		useTrash := req.UseTrash == nil || *req.UseTrash
		if useTrash {
			if err := r.callbacks.MoveToTrash(resolvedPath); err != nil {
				if r.callbacks.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation(err) {
					useTrashElev := true
					success, elevErr := r.callbacks.RunElevatedDelete(resolvedPath, false, &useTrashElev)
					if elevErr == nil && success {
						progress.Advance(1, 0, filepath.Base(path), 0, false)
						result.Succeeded++
						continue
					}
					if elevErr != nil {
						err = elevErr
					}
				}
				result.Failed++
				result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(path, "", err))
				continue
			}
			progress.Advance(1, 0, filepath.Base(path), 0, false)
			result.Succeeded++
			continue
		}

		info, err := os.Lstat(resolvedPath)
		if err != nil {
			result.Failed++
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(path, "", err))
			continue
		}

		if info.IsDir() && req.Recursive {
			if err := fileOps.DeleteDir(resolvedPath); err != nil {
				if r.callbacks.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation(err) {
					useTrashElev := false
					success, elevErr := r.callbacks.RunElevatedDelete(resolvedPath, true, &useTrashElev)
					if elevErr == nil && success {
						result.Succeeded++
						continue
					}
				}
				result.Failed++
				result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(path, "", err))
				continue
			}
		} else {
			size := info.Size()
			if err := os.Remove(resolvedPath); err != nil {
				if r.callbacks.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation(err) {
					useTrashElev := false
					success, elevErr := r.callbacks.RunElevatedDelete(resolvedPath, req.Recursive, &useTrashElev)
					if elevErr == nil && success {
						progress.Advance(1, size, filepath.Base(path), size, false)
						result.Succeeded++
						continue
					}
				}
				result.Failed++
				result.Errors = append(result.Errors, r.callbacks.BatchErr(path, "", err))
				continue
			}
			progress.Advance(1, size, filepath.Base(path), size, false)
		}
		result.Succeeded++
	}

	progress.Flush()
	op.Complete()
	return result, nil
}
````

## File: internal/contentprobe/probe_test.go
````go
package contentprobe

import (
	"bytes"
	"testing"
)

func TestProbeBytesDetectsMPEGTS(t *testing.T) {
	sample := make([]byte, 188*4)
	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
		sample[i*188] = 0x47
	}

	probe := ProbeBytes(sample)
	if probe.MimeType != "video/mp2t" {
		t.Fatalf("expected video/mp2t, got %q", probe.MimeType)
	}
	if probe.IsText {
		t.Fatalf("expected MPEG-TS probe to be binary")
	}
}

func TestProbeBytesDetectsZipArchive(t *testing.T) {
	sample := append([]byte("PK\x03\x04"), make([]byte, 32)...)

	probe := ProbeBytes(sample)
	if !probe.IsArchive {
		t.Fatalf("expected zip probe to be archive")
	}
	if probe.MimeType != "application/zip" {
		t.Fatalf("expected application/zip, got %q", probe.MimeType)
	}
}

func TestDecodeUTF16LE(t *testing.T) {
	data := append([]byte{0xFF, 0xFE}, []byte("h\x00i\x00")...)
	out, err := Decode(data, "utf16le")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode failed: %v", err)
	}
	if out != "hi" {
		t.Fatalf("expected hi, got %q", out)
	}
}

func TestProbeReaderDetectsTextEncoding(t *testing.T) {
	data := []byte("hello, world\n")
	_, probe, err := ProbeReader(bytes.NewReader(data))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("probe failed: %v", err)
	}
	if !probe.IsText {
		t.Fatalf("expected text probe")
	}
	if probe.Encoding != "utf8" {
		t.Fatalf("expected utf8, got %q", probe.Encoding)
	}
}

func TestDetectEncodingUTF16LEWithoutBOM(t *testing.T) {
	data := []byte("h\x00e\x00l\x00l\x00o\x00 \x00w\x00o\x00r\x00l\x00d\x00")
	if got := DetectEncoding(data); got != "utf16le" {
		t.Fatalf("expected utf16le, got %q", got)
	}
}

func TestDetectEncodingPrefersWindows1252ForSmartQuotes(t *testing.T) {
	data := []byte{0x93, 'H', 'e', 'l', 'l', 'o', 0x94}
	if got := DetectEncoding(data); got != "windows-1252" {
		t.Fatalf("expected windows-1252, got %q", got)
	}
}

func TestDetectEncodingReturnsISO88591ForLatinTextWithoutCP1252OnlyBytes(t *testing.T) {
	data := []byte("caf\xe9 avec cr\xe8me")
	if got := DetectEncoding(data); got != "iso-8859-1" {
		t.Fatalf("expected iso-8859-1, got %q", got)
	}
}
````

## File: internal/contentprobe/probe.go
````go
package contentprobe

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/base64"
	"io"
	"math"
	"strings"
	"unicode"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/wailsapp/mimetype"
	"golang.org/x/text/encoding/charmap"
	xunicode "golang.org/x/text/encoding/unicode"
	"golang.org/x/text/transform"
)

const SampleLimit = 64 * 1024

type Result struct {
	MimeType string `json:"mimeType"`
	Encoding string `json:"encoding,omitempty"`
	IsText   bool   `json:"isText"`
	IsArchive bool  `json:"isArchive"`
}

func ProbeReader(r io.Reader) ([]byte, Result, error) {
	sample, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r, SampleLimit))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, Result{}, err
	}
	return sample, ProbeBytes(sample), nil
}

func ProbeBytes(sample []byte) Result {
	mimeType := detectMime(sample)
	res := Result{
		MimeType: mimeType,
		IsText:   isTextMime(mimeType) || looksLikeText(sample),
	}
	res.IsArchive = isArchiveMime(mimeType) || looksLikeArchive(sample)
	if res.IsText {
		res.Encoding = detectEncoding(sample)
	}
	return res
}

func DetectEncoding(sample []byte) string {
	return detectEncoding(sample)
}

func Decode(sample []byte, encoding string) (string, error) {
	normalized := normalizeEncoding(encoding)
	if normalized == "" || normalized == "utf8" {
		return string(stripBOM(sample)), nil
	}
	if normalized == "base64" {
		return base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(sample), nil
	}

	reader := bytes.NewReader(stripBOM(sample))
	switch normalized {
	case "utf16", "utf16le":
		return decodeReader(reader, xunicode.UTF16(xunicode.LittleEndian, xunicode.IgnoreBOM).NewDecoder())
	case "utf16be":
		return decodeReader(reader, xunicode.UTF16(xunicode.BigEndian, xunicode.IgnoreBOM).NewDecoder())
	case "windows-1252", "cp1252":
		return decodeReader(reader, charmap.Windows1252.NewDecoder())
	case "iso-8859-1", "latin1", "latin-1":
		return decodeReader(reader, charmap.ISO8859_1.NewDecoder())
	default:
		return string(sample), nil
	}
}

func normalizeEncoding(raw string) string {
	enc := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(raw))
	enc = strings.ReplaceAll(enc, "_", "-")
	switch enc {
	case "utf-8":
		return "utf8"
	case "utf16", "utf-16":
		return "utf16"
	case "utf-16le":
		return "utf16le"
	case "utf-16be":
		return "utf16be"
	case "windows1252":
		return "windows-1252"
	case "iso8859-1":
		return "iso-8859-1"
	case "latin-1":
		return "latin1"
	}
	return enc
}

func detectMime(sample []byte) string {
	if mimeType := detectArchiveMime(sample); mimeType != "" {
		return mimeType
	}
	if looksLikeMPEGTS(sample) {
		return "video/mp2t"
	}

	detected := mimetype.Detect(sample)
	if detected != nil {
		mimeType := normalizeMime(detected.String())
		if mimeType != "" && mimeType != "application/octet-stream" {
			return mimeType
		}
	}

	if looksLikeText(sample) {
		return "text/plain"
	}
	return "application/octet-stream"
}

func detectArchiveMime(sample []byte) string {
	switch {
	case hasPrefix(sample, []byte("PK\x03\x04")), hasPrefix(sample, []byte("PK\x05\x06")), hasPrefix(sample, []byte("PK\x07\x08")):
		return "application/zip"
	case hasPrefix(sample, []byte("Rar!\x1A\x07\x00")), hasPrefix(sample, []byte("Rar!\x1A\x07\x01\x00")):
		return "application/vnd.rar"
	case hasPrefix(sample, []byte("7z\xBC\xAF'\x1C")):
		return "application/x-7z-compressed"
	case hasPrefix(sample, []byte{0x1F, 0x8B}):
		return "application/gzip"
	case hasPrefix(sample, []byte{0xFD, 0x37, 0x7A, 0x58, 0x5A, 0x00}):
		return "application/x-xz"
	case hasPrefix(sample, []byte("BZh")):
		return "application/x-bzip2"
	case looksLikeTar(sample):
		return "application/x-tar"
	default:
		return ""
	}
}

func isArchiveMime(mimeType string) bool {
	switch normalizeMime(mimeType) {
	case "application/zip",
		"application/vnd.rar",
		"application/x-7z-compressed",
		"application/gzip",
		"application/x-xz",
		"application/x-bzip2",
		"application/x-tar":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func looksLikeArchive(sample []byte) bool {
	return detectArchiveMime(sample) != ""
}

func looksLikeTar(sample []byte) bool {
	if len(sample) < 512 {
		return false
	}
	return bytes.Contains(sample[:512], []byte("ustar"))
}

func hasPrefix(sample []byte, prefix []byte) bool {
	return len(sample) >= len(prefix) && bytes.Equal(sample[:len(prefix)], prefix)
}

func normalizeMime(raw string) string {
	if raw == "" {
		return ""
	}
	if i := strings.Index(raw, ";"); i >= 0 {
		raw = raw[:i]
	}
	return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(raw))
}

func isTextMime(mimeType string) bool {
	mimeType = normalizeMime(mimeType)
	switch {
	case strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "text/"):
		return true
	case strings.HasSuffix(mimeType, "+json"), strings.HasSuffix(mimeType, "+xml"):
		return true
	case mimeType == "application/json",
		mimeType == "application/xml",
		mimeType == "application/javascript",
		mimeType == "application/ecmascript",
		mimeType == "application/x-javascript",
		mimeType == "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
		mimeType == "application/yaml",
		mimeType == "application/x-yaml":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func detectEncoding(sample []byte) string {
	if len(sample) == 0 {
		return "utf8"
	}

	switch {
	case bytes.HasPrefix(sample, []byte{0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF}):
		return "utf8"
	case bytes.HasPrefix(sample, []byte{0xFF, 0xFE}):
		return "utf16le"
	case bytes.HasPrefix(sample, []byte{0xFE, 0xFF}):
		return "utf16be"
	}

	if looksLikeUTF16LE(sample) && decodedLooksReasonable(sample, xunicode.UTF16(xunicode.LittleEndian, xunicode.IgnoreBOM).NewDecoder()) {
		return "utf16le"
	}
	if looksLikeUTF16BE(sample) && decodedLooksReasonable(sample, xunicode.UTF16(xunicode.BigEndian, xunicode.IgnoreBOM).NewDecoder()) {
		return "utf16be"
	}
	if utf8.Valid(sample) {
		return "utf8"
	}
	if looksLikeText(sample) {
		return detectSingleByteEncoding(sample)
	}
	return "utf8"
}

func looksLikeText(sample []byte) bool {
	if len(sample) == 0 {
		return true
	}

	ctrl := 0
	printable := 0
	for _, b := range sample {
		switch {
		case b == 0:
			return false
		case b == '\n', b == '\r', b == '\t', b >= 0x20:
			printable++
		default:
			ctrl++
		}
	}

	if printable == 0 {
		return false
	}
	return float64(ctrl)/float64(len(sample)) < 0.15
}

func looksLikeMPEGTS(sample []byte) bool {
	if len(sample) < 188*3 {
		return false
	}

	limit := len(sample) / 188
	if limit > 12 {
		limit = 12
	}

	matches := 0
	for i := 0; i < limit; i++ {
		if sample[i*188] == 0x47 {
			matches++
		}
	}

	return matches >= 3 && float64(matches)/float64(limit) >= 0.6
}

func looksLikeUTF16LE(sample []byte) bool {
	if len(sample) < 4 {
		return false
	}

	zerosEven := 0
	zerosOdd := 0
	for i, b := range sample {
		if b != 0 {
			continue
		}
		if i%2 == 0 {
			zerosEven++
		} else {
			zerosOdd++
		}
	}

	return zerosOdd > zerosEven*2 && zerosOdd >= len(sample)/8
}

func looksLikeUTF16BE(sample []byte) bool {
	if len(sample) < 4 {
		return false
	}

	zerosEven := 0
	zerosOdd := 0
	for i, b := range sample {
		if b != 0 {
			continue
		}
		if i%2 == 0 {
			zerosEven++
		} else {
			zerosOdd++
		}
	}

	return zerosEven > zerosOdd*2 && zerosEven >= len(sample)/8
}

func decodeReader(r io.Reader, decoder transform.Transformer) (string, error) {
	decoded, err := io.ReadAll(transform.NewReader(r, decoder))
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if utf8.Valid(decoded) {
		return string(decoded), nil
	}
	return string(decoded), nil
}

func detectSingleByteEncoding(sample []byte) string {
	cp1252, cp1252OK := tryDecode(sample, charmap.Windows1252.NewDecoder())
	latin1, latin1OK := tryDecode(sample, charmap.ISO8859_1.NewDecoder())

	if !hasCP1252OnlyBytes(sample) {
		if latin1OK {
			return "iso-8859-1"
		}
		return "windows-1252"
	}

	if cp1252OK && decodedTextScore(cp1252) >= decodedTextScore(latin1)-0.05 {
		return "windows-1252"
	}

	if latin1OK && decodedTextScore(latin1) > decodedTextScore(cp1252)+0.2 {
		return "iso-8859-1"
	}

	return "windows-1252"
}

func decodedLooksReasonable(sample []byte, decoder transform.Transformer) bool {
	decoded, ok := tryDecode(sample, decoder)
	return ok && decodedTextScore(decoded) > 0.6
}

func tryDecode(sample []byte, decoder transform.Transformer) (string, bool) {
	decoded, err := io.ReadAll(transform.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(stripBOM(sample)), decoder))
	if err != nil {
		return "", false
	}
	if !utf8.Valid(decoded) {
		return "", false
	}
	return string(decoded), true
}

func hasCP1252OnlyBytes(sample []byte) bool {
	for _, b := range sample {
		if b >= 0x80 && b <= 0x9F {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func decodedTextScore(s string) float64 {
	if s == "" {
		return 1
	}

	printable := 0
	letters := 0
	controls := 0
	replacement := 0
	total := 0

	for _, r := range s {
		total++
		switch {
		case r == utf8.RuneError:
			replacement++
		case r == '\n' || r == '\r' || r == '\t':
			printable++
		case unicode.IsPrint(r):
			printable++
			if unicode.IsLetter(r) || unicode.IsNumber(r) {
				letters++
			}
		case unicode.IsControl(r):
			controls++
		}
	}

	if total == 0 {
		return 1
	}

	printableRatio := float64(printable) / float64(total)
	letterRatio := float64(letters) / float64(total)
	controlRatio := float64(controls) / float64(total)
	replacementRatio := float64(replacement) / float64(total)

	score := printableRatio + math.Min(letterRatio, 0.35) - (controlRatio * 2.0) - (replacementRatio * 3.0)
	if score < 0 {
		return 0
	}
	if score > 1 {
		return 1
	}
	return score
}

func stripBOM(sample []byte) []byte {
	switch {
	case bytes.HasPrefix(sample, []byte{0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF}):
		return sample[3:]
	case bytes.HasPrefix(sample, []byte{0xFF, 0xFE}), bytes.HasPrefix(sample, []byte{0xFE, 0xFF}):
		return sample[2:]
	default:
		return sample
	}
}
````

## File: internal/contracts/errors.go
````go
package contracts

import (
	"errors"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

// AppErrorCode is a stable machine-readable string sent with every BatchItemError.
type AppErrorCode = string

const (
	ErrCodePermissionDenied AppErrorCode = "permission_denied"
	ErrCodeNotFound         AppErrorCode = "not_found"
	ErrCodeDiskFull         AppErrorCode = "disk_full"
	ErrCodeReadOnly         AppErrorCode = "read_only"
	ErrCodeAlreadyExists    AppErrorCode = "already_exists"
	ErrCodeInvalidPath      AppErrorCode = "invalid_path"
	ErrCodeCancelled        AppErrorCode = "cancelled"
	ErrCodeUnknown          AppErrorCode = "unknown"
)

type BatchItemError struct {
	Source      string       `json:"source"`
	Destination string       `json:"destination,omitempty"`
	Error       string       `json:"error"`
	Code        AppErrorCode `json:"code"`
}

func ClassifyError(err error) AppErrorCode {
	if err == nil {
		return ErrCodeUnknown
	}

	message := err.Error()
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist), errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
		return ErrCodeNotFound
	case errors.Is(err, os.ErrPermission), errors.Is(err, fs.ErrPermission):
		return ErrCodePermissionDenied
	case errors.Is(err, os.ErrExist), errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist):
		return ErrCodeAlreadyExists
	case errors.Is(err, os.ErrInvalid), errors.Is(err, fs.ErrInvalid):
		return ErrCodeInvalidPath
	}

	for _, sub := range []string{"no space left", "disk full", "not enough space"} {
		if containsFold(message, sub) {
			return ErrCodeDiskFull
		}
	}
	for _, sub := range []string{"read-only", "read only", "write-protected"} {
		if containsFold(message, sub) {
			return ErrCodeReadOnly
		}
	}
	for _, sub := range []string{"cancelled", "canceled"} {
		if containsFold(message, sub) {
			return ErrCodeCancelled
		}
	}
	return ErrCodeUnknown
}

func containsFold(s, substr string) bool {
	return strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(s), strings.ToLower(substr))
}
````

## File: internal/elevation/errors.go
````go
package elevation

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
)

func IsPermissionDenied(err error) bool {
	if err == nil {
		return false
	}
	if os.IsPermission(err) {
		return true
	}
	msg := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
	return strings.Contains(msg, "permission denied") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "access is denied") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "operation not permitted") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "eacces") ||
		strings.Contains(msg, "eperm")
}

func ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation(err error) bool {
	if IsPermissionDenied(err) {
		return true
	}
	if err == nil {
		return false
	}
	msg := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
	return strings.Contains(msg, "shfileoperationw returned error code 0x78")
}
````

## File: internal/elevation/ipc.go
````go
package elevation

import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v5"
)

const HelperFlag = "--elevated-helper"
const ServiceFlag = "--elevated-service"

type Handler func(Request) Response

type LaunchServiceFunc func(exePath string, port int, secretB64 string) (int, error)

type LaunchProcessFunc func(exePath, reqB64, resultPath string) error

type ExecutablePathFunc func() (string, error)

type serviceClaims struct {
	SessionID string `json:"sid"`
	jwt.RegisteredClaims
}

type ipcRequest struct {
	Token   string  `json:"token"`
	Request Request `json:"req"`
}

type ipcResponse struct {
	Response Response `json:"resp"`
}

type IPCClient struct {
	mu        sync.Mutex
	conn      net.Conn
	scanner   *bufio.Scanner
	secret    []byte
	sessionID string
	token     string
	tokenExp  time.Time
	startedAt time.Time
	port      int
	pid       int
	opCount   int
	stopCtx   context.Context
	stopFn    context.CancelFunc
}

func RunService(port string, secretB64 string, handler Handler) error {
	secret, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(secretB64)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("elevated-service: bad secret: %w", err)
	}

	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:"+port)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("elevated-service: listen: %w", err)
	}
	defer ln.Close()

	conn, err := ln.Accept()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("elevated-service: accept: %w", err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	ln.Close()

	scanner := newScanner(conn)
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(conn)

	for scanner.Scan() {
		var req ipcRequest
		if err := json.Unmarshal(scanner.Bytes(), &req); err != nil {
			_ = encoder.Encode(ipcResponse{Response: Response{Success: false, Error: "malformed request: " + err.Error()}})
			continue
		}
		if err := validateJWT(req.Token, secret); err != nil {
			_ = encoder.Encode(ipcResponse{Response: Response{Success: false, Error: "unauthorized: " + err.Error()}})
			continue
		}
		if err := encoder.Encode(ipcResponse{Response: handler(req.Request)}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	return scanner.Err()
}

func StartClient(exePath string, launch LaunchServiceFunc) (*IPCClient, error) {
	secret := make([]byte, 32)
	if _, err := rand.Read(secret); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("generate secret: %w", err)
	}
	sidBytes := make([]byte, 12)
	if _, err := rand.Read(sidBytes); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("generate session id: %w", err)
	}
	sid := base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(sidBytes)

	freeListener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("allocate port: %w", err)
	}
	port := freeListener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port
	freeListener.Close()

	secretB64 := base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(secret)
	pid, err := launch(exePath, port, secretB64)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("launch elevated service: %w", err)
	}

	addr := fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", port)
	var conn net.Conn
	for attempt := 0; attempt < 25; attempt++ {
		conn, err = net.DialTimeout("tcp", addr, 400*time.Millisecond)
		if err == nil {
			break
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Duration(40+attempt*30) * time.Millisecond)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("connect to elevated service on :%d: %w", port, err)
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	client := &IPCClient{
		conn:      conn,
		scanner:   newScanner(conn),
		secret:    secret,
		sessionID: sid,
		startedAt: time.Now(),
		port:      port,
		pid:       pid,
		stopCtx:   ctx,
		stopFn:    cancel,
	}

	tok, exp, err := client.mintJWT()
	if err != nil {
		conn.Close()
		cancel()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("initial jwt: %w", err)
	}
	client.token = tok
	client.tokenExp = exp

	go func() {
		ticker := time.NewTicker(4 * time.Minute)
		defer ticker.Stop()
		for {
			select {
			case <-ticker.C:
				client.mu.Lock()
				_ = client.refreshTokenLocked()
				client.mu.Unlock()
			case <-ctx.Done():
				return
			}
		}
	}()

	return client, nil
}

func MaybeRunService(args []string, handler Handler) (bool, error) {
	if !containsArg(args, ServiceFlag) {
		return false, nil
	}
	port := argValue(args, "--port")
	secret := argValue(args, "--secret")
	if port == "" || secret == "" {
		return true, errors.New("elevated-service: missing --port or --secret")
	}
	return true, RunService(port, secret, handler)
}

func MaybeRunHelper(args []string, handler Handler) (bool, error) {
	if len(args) < 2 || args[1] != HelperFlag {
		return false, nil
	}
	reqB64, resultPath, err := parseHelperArgs(args[2:])
	if err != nil {
		return true, err
	}
	reqData, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(reqB64)
	if err != nil {
		return true, err
	}
	var req Request
	if err := json.Unmarshal(reqData, &req); err != nil {
		return true, err
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(handler(req))
	if err != nil {
		return true, err
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(resultPath, out, 0600); err != nil {
		return true, err
	}
	return true, nil
}

func RunRequest(req Request, executablePath ExecutablePathFunc, launch LaunchProcessFunc) (Response, error) {
	reqBytes, err := json.Marshal(req)
	if err != nil {
		return Response{}, err
	}
	reqB64 := base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(reqBytes)

	resultPath := filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), fmt.Sprintf("wails-elev-%d.json", time.Now().UnixNano()))
	defer os.Remove(resultPath)

	exePath, err := executablePath()
	if err != nil {
		return Response{}, err
	}
	if err := launch(exePath, reqB64, resultPath); err != nil {
		return Response{}, err
	}

	data, err := os.ReadFile(resultPath)
	if err != nil {
		return Response{}, err
	}

	var resp Response
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &resp); err != nil {
		return Response{}, err
	}
	if !resp.Success {
		if resp.Error == "" {
			return Response{}, errors.New("elevated operation failed")
		}
		return Response{}, errors.New(resp.Error)
	}
	return resp, nil
}

func (c *IPCClient) Alive() bool {
	if c == nil {
		return false
	}
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	return c.conn != nil
}

func (c *IPCClient) Dispatch(req Request) (Response, error) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()

	if c.conn == nil {
		return Response{}, errors.New("elevated service not connected")
	}
	if err := c.refreshTokenLocked(); err != nil {
		return Response{}, fmt.Errorf("token refresh: %w", err)
	}

	frame, err := json.Marshal(ipcRequest{Token: c.token, Request: req})
	if err != nil {
		return Response{}, err
	}
	frame = append(frame, '\n')

	if _, err := c.conn.Write(frame); err != nil {
		c.teardownLocked()
		return Response{}, fmt.Errorf("write: %w", err)
	}
	if !c.scanner.Scan() {
		c.teardownLocked()
		if err := c.scanner.Err(); err != nil {
			return Response{}, fmt.Errorf("read: %w", err)
		}
		return Response{}, errors.New("elevated service closed connection")
	}
	var resp ipcResponse
	if err := json.Unmarshal(c.scanner.Bytes(), &resp); err != nil {
		return Response{}, fmt.Errorf("decode: %w", err)
	}
	c.opCount++
	if !resp.Response.Success {
		return Response{}, errors.New(resp.Response.Error)
	}
	return resp.Response, nil
}

func (c *IPCClient) Status() SessionStatus {
	if c == nil {
		return SessionStatus{}
	}
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if c.conn == nil {
		return SessionStatus{}
	}
	return SessionStatus{Active: true, PID: c.pid, StartedAt: c.startedAt.Unix(), Port: c.port, OpCount: c.opCount}
}

func (c *IPCClient) Stop() {
	if c == nil {
		return
	}
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.teardownLocked()
	if c.stopFn != nil {
		c.stopFn()
	}
}

func (c *IPCClient) teardownLocked() {
	if c.conn != nil {
		_ = c.conn.Close()
		c.conn = nil
	}
}

func (c *IPCClient) mintJWT() (string, time.Time, error) {
	now := time.Now()
	exp := now.Add(5 * time.Minute)
	claims := &serviceClaims{
		SessionID: c.sessionID,
		RegisteredClaims: jwt.RegisteredClaims{
			Issuer:    "wails-elev-svc",
			Audience:  jwt.ClaimStrings{"wails-elev-helper"},
			IssuedAt:  jwt.NewNumericDate(now),
			NotBefore: jwt.NewNumericDate(now),
			ExpiresAt: jwt.NewNumericDate(exp),
		},
	}
	tok := jwt.NewWithClaims(jwt.SigningMethodHS256, claims)
	signed, err := tok.SignedString(c.secret)
	if err != nil {
		return "", time.Time{}, err
	}
	return signed, exp, nil
}

func (c *IPCClient) refreshTokenLocked() error {
	if time.Until(c.tokenExp) > time.Minute {
		return nil
	}
	tok, exp, err := c.mintJWT()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	c.token = tok
	c.tokenExp = exp
	return nil
}

func newScanner(conn net.Conn) *bufio.Scanner {
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(conn)
	scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 4*1024*1024), 4*1024*1024)
	return scanner
}

func validateJWT(tokenStr string, secret []byte) error {
	claims := &serviceClaims{}
	tok, err := jwt.ParseWithClaims(tokenStr, claims, func(t *jwt.Token) (interface{}, error) {
		if _, ok := t.Method.(*jwt.SigningMethodHMAC); !ok {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unexpected signing method")
		}
		return secret, nil
	}, jwt.WithIssuer("wails-elev-svc"), jwt.WithAudience("wails-elev-helper"))
	if err != nil || !tok.Valid {
		return errors.New("invalid or expired token")
	}
	return nil
}

func parseHelperArgs(args []string) (requestB64 string, resultPath string, err error) {
	for i := 0; i < len(args); i++ {
		switch args[i] {
		case "--request":
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				requestB64 = args[i+1]
				i++
			}
		case "--result":
			if i+1 < len(args) {
				resultPath = args[i+1]
				i++
			}
		}
	}
	if requestB64 == "" || resultPath == "" {
		return "", "", errors.New("missing --request/--result for elevated helper")
	}
	return requestB64, resultPath, nil
}

func containsArg(args []string, value string) bool {
	for _, arg := range args {
		if arg == value {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func argValue(args []string, flag string) string {
	for i := 0; i < len(args)-1; i++ {
		if args[i] == flag {
			return args[i+1]
		}
	}
	return ""
}
````

## File: internal/elevation/platform_unix.go
````go
//go:build linux || darwin

package elevation

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

func IsProcessElevated() bool {
	return os.Getuid() == 0
}

func LaunchService(exePath string, port int, secretB64 string) (int, error) {
	args := []string{
		ServiceFlag,
		"--port", strconv.Itoa(port),
		"--secret", secretB64,
	}

	if runtime.GOOS == "linux" {
		script := detachedCommandScript(exePath, args)
		if out, err := exec.Command("pkexec", "sh", "-c", script).CombinedOutput(); err == nil {
			if pid, parseErr := parseLaunchedPID(out); parseErr == nil {
				return pid, nil
			}
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("elevation failed: could not parse elevated PID")
		}

		out, err := exec.Command("sudo", "sh", "-c", script).CombinedOutput()
		if err != nil {
			msg := strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
			if msg == "" {
				msg = err.Error()
			}
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("elevation failed (pkexec/sudo): %s", msg)
		}
		pid, parseErr := parseLaunchedPID(out)
		if parseErr != nil {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("elevation failed: could not parse elevated PID")
		}
		return pid, nil
	}

	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		command := detachedCommandScript(exePath, args)
		script := fmt.Sprintf(`do shell script %q with administrator privileges without altering line endings`, command)
		out, err := exec.Command("osascript", "-e", script).CombinedOutput()
		if err != nil {
			msg := strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
			if msg == "" {
				msg = err.Error()
			}
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("elevation failed: %s", msg)
		}
		pid, parseErr := parseLaunchedPID(out)
		if parseErr != nil {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("elevation failed: could not parse elevated PID")
		}
		return pid, nil
	}

	return 0, fmt.Errorf("launchElevatedService: unsupported platform %q", runtime.GOOS)
}

func LaunchProcess(exePath, reqB64, resultPath string) error {
	args := []string{HelperFlag, "--request", reqB64, "--result", resultPath}

	if runtime.GOOS == "linux" {
		if out, err := exec.Command("pkexec", append([]string{exePath}, args...)...).CombinedOutput(); err == nil {
			return nil
		} else {
			_, _ = out, err
		}

		out, err := exec.Command("sudo", append([]string{exePath}, args...)...).CombinedOutput()
		if err != nil {
			msg := strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
			if msg == "" {
				msg = err.Error()
			}
			return fmt.Errorf("elevation failed: %s", msg)
		}
		return nil
	}

	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		command := shellEscape(exePath)
		for _, arg := range args {
			command += " " + shellEscape(arg)
		}

		script := fmt.Sprintf(`do shell script %q with administrator privileges`, command)
		out, err := exec.Command("osascript", "-e", script).CombinedOutput()
		if err != nil {
			msg := strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
			if msg == "" {
				msg = err.Error()
			}
			return fmt.Errorf("elevation failed: %s", msg)
		}
		return nil
	}

	return fmt.Errorf("unsupported platform for elevation")
}

func shellEscape(s string) string {
	return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", "'\\''") + "'"
}

func detachedCommandScript(exePath string, args []string) string {
	command := shellEscape(exePath)
	for _, arg := range args {
		command += " " + shellEscape(arg)
	}
	return command + " >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $!"
}

func parseLaunchedPID(out []byte) (int, error) {
	txt := strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
	if txt == "" {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("empty output")
	}
	lines := strings.Split(txt, "\n")
	last := strings.TrimSpace(lines[len(lines)-1])
	pid, err := strconv.Atoi(last)
	if err != nil || pid <= 0 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid pid output: %q", last)
	}
	return pid, nil
}
````

## File: internal/elevation/platform_windows.go
````go
//go:build windows

package elevation

import (
	"fmt"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
	"syscall"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

func IsProcessElevated() bool {
	return windows.GetCurrentProcessToken().IsElevated()
}

func LaunchProcess(exePath, reqB64, resultPath string) error {
	return launchElevatedArgs(exePath, []string{
		HelperFlag,
		"--request", reqB64,
		"--result", resultPath,
	})
}

func launchElevatedArgs(exePath string, args []string) error {
	exePath = strings.TrimSpace(exePath)
	if exePath == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("elevation failed: executable path is empty")
	}

	quoted := make([]string, 0, len(args))
	for _, arg := range args {
		quoted = append(quoted, quoteWindowsArg(arg))
	}
	argLine := strings.Join(quoted, " ")

	psCommand := fmt.Sprintf(
		`$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $p = Start-Process -FilePath %s -ArgumentList %s -Verb RunAs -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru -Wait; exit $p.ExitCode`,
		quotePowerShellLiteral(exePath),
		quotePowerShellLiteral(argLine),
	)

	cmd := exec.Command("powershell", "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-Command", psCommand)
	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{HideWindow: true}
	out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		msg := strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
		if msg == "" {
			msg = err.Error()
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("elevation failed: %s", msg)
	}
	return nil
}

func LaunchService(exePath string, port int, secretB64 string) (int, error) {
	exePath = strings.TrimSpace(exePath)
	if exePath == "" {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("elevation failed: executable path is empty")
	}

	args := []string{
		ServiceFlag,
		"--port", fmt.Sprintf("%d", port),
		"--secret", secretB64,
	}
	quoted := make([]string, 0, len(args))
	for _, arg := range args {
		quoted = append(quoted, quoteWindowsArg(arg))
	}
	argLine := strings.Join(quoted, " ")

	psCommand := fmt.Sprintf(
		`$p = Start-Process -FilePath %s -ArgumentList %s -Verb RunAs -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru; Write-Output $p.Id`,
		quotePowerShellLiteral(exePath),
		quotePowerShellLiteral(argLine),
	)

	cmd := exec.Command("powershell", "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-Command", psCommand)
	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{HideWindow: true}
	out, err := cmd.Output()
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("elevation failed: %w", err)
	}

	pid := 0
	fmt.Sscanf(strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), "%d", &pid)
	return pid, nil
}

func quotePowerShellLiteral(s string) string {
	return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", "''") + "'"
}

func quoteWindowsArg(s string) string {
	if s == "" {
		return `""`
	}
	needsQuotes := strings.ContainsAny(s, " \t\n\"")
	if !needsQuotes {
		return s
	}

	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteByte('"')
	backslashes := 0
	for _, r := range s {
		if r == '\\' {
			backslashes++
			continue
		}
		if r == '"' {
			b.WriteString(strings.Repeat(`\`, backslashes*2+1))
			b.WriteRune(r)
			backslashes = 0
			continue
		}
		if backslashes > 0 {
			b.WriteString(strings.Repeat(`\`, backslashes))
			backslashes = 0
		}
		b.WriteRune(r)
	}
	if backslashes > 0 {
		b.WriteString(strings.Repeat(`\`, backslashes*2))
	}
	b.WriteByte('"')
	return b.String()
}
````

## File: internal/elevation/service.go
````go
package elevation

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"sync"
	"time"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

type Request struct {
	Op          string `json:"op"`
	Path        string `json:"path,omitempty"`
	ShowHidden  bool   `json:"showHidden,omitempty"`
	Encoding    string `json:"encoding,omitempty"`
	Content     string `json:"content,omitempty"`
	Recursive   bool   `json:"recursive,omitempty"`
	UseTrash    *bool  `json:"useTrash,omitempty"`
	Source      string `json:"source,omitempty"`
	Destination string `json:"destination,omitempty"`
}

type Response struct {
	Success    bool                        `json:"success"`
	Error      string                      `json:"error,omitempty"`
	DirListing *contracts.DirectoryListing `json:"dirListing,omitempty"`
	File       *contracts.FileContent      `json:"file,omitempty"`
	Operation  *contracts.OperationResult  `json:"operation,omitempty"`
}

type SessionStatus struct {
	Active    bool   `json:"active"`
	PID       int    `json:"pid,omitempty"`
	StartedAt int64  `json:"startedAt,omitempty"`
	Port      int    `json:"port,omitempty"`
	OpCount   int    `json:"opCount"`
	Error     string `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type Client interface {
	Alive() bool
	Dispatch(Request) (Response, error)
	Status() SessionStatus
	Stop()
}

type Service struct {
	mu             sync.Mutex
	wait           map[string]chan bool
	client         Client
	emitEvent      func(string, interface{})
	resolveExePath func() (string, error)
	startClient    func(exePath string) (Client, error)
}

func NewService(emitEvent func(string, interface{}), startClient func(exePath string) (Client, error)) *Service {
	return &Service{
		wait:           make(map[string]chan bool),
		emitEvent:      emitEvent,
		resolveExePath: os.Executable,
		startClient:    startClient,
	}
}

func (s *Service) StartSession() (*SessionStatus, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()

	if s.client != nil && s.client.Alive() {
		status := s.client.Status()
		s.emit("elevation:session-started", status)
		return &status, nil
	}

	exePath, err := s.resolveExePath()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolve executable: %w", err)
	}

	s.emit("elevation:uac-requested", map[string]string{
		"phase":     "requested",
		"operation": "session-start",
		"target":    "elevated-service",
		"message":   "Administrative privileges requested to start elevated service session.",
	})

	client, err := s.startClient(exePath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	s.client = client
	status := client.Status()
	s.emit("elevation:session-started", status)
	return &status, nil
}

func (s *Service) StopSession() {
	s.mu.Lock()
	client := s.client
	s.client = nil
	s.mu.Unlock()

	if client != nil {
		client.Stop()
	}
	s.emit("elevation:session-stopped", map[string]bool{"active": false})
}

func (s *Service) Status() SessionStatus {
	s.mu.Lock()
	client := s.client
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if client == nil {
		return SessionStatus{}
	}
	return client.Status()
}

func (s *Service) Client() Client {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.client
}

func (s *Service) Confirm(requestID string, approve bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	ch, ok := s.wait[requestID]
	if ok {
		delete(s.wait, requestID)
	}
	s.mu.Unlock()

	if ok {
		select {
		case ch <- approve:
		default:
		}
	}
}

func (s *Service) WaitForApproval(requestID string, timeout time.Duration) (bool, error) {
	ch := make(chan bool, 1)
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.wait[requestID] = ch
	s.mu.Unlock()

	defer func() {
		s.mu.Lock()
		delete(s.wait, requestID)
		s.mu.Unlock()
	}()

	select {
	case approve := <-ch:
		return approve, nil
	case <-time.After(timeout):
		return false, fmt.Errorf("elevation approval timed out")
	}
}

func (s *Service) emit(name string, data interface{}) {
	if s.emitEvent != nil {
		s.emitEvent(name, data)
	}
}
````

## File: internal/filesystem/disk_usage_cache.go
````go
package filesystem

import (
	"container/list"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

const DefaultDiskUsageCacheCapacity = 500

type DiskUsageCacheEntry struct {
	path   string
	result *contracts.DiskUsageResult
	elem   *list.Element
}

type DiskUsageCache struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	entries map[string]*DiskUsageCacheEntry
	lru     *list.List
	limit   int
}

func NewDiskUsageCache(limit int) *DiskUsageCache {
	if limit < 1 {
		limit = DefaultDiskUsageCacheCapacity
	}
	return &DiskUsageCache{
		entries: make(map[string]*DiskUsageCacheEntry, limit),
		lru:     list.New(),
		limit:   limit,
	}
}

func (c *DiskUsageCache) Get(path string) (*contracts.DiskUsageResult, bool) {
	key := diskUsageCacheKey(path)

	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()

	entry, ok := c.entries[key]
	if !ok {
		return nil, false
	}
	c.lru.MoveToFront(entry.elem)
	return entry.result, true
}

func (c *DiskUsageCache) Set(result *contracts.DiskUsageResult) {
	if result == nil {
		return
	}
	key := diskUsageCacheKey(result.Path)

	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()

	if entry, ok := c.entries[key]; ok {
		entry.result = result
		c.lru.MoveToFront(entry.elem)
		return
	}

	if c.lru.Len() >= c.limit {
		c.evict(c.lru.Back().Value.(*DiskUsageCacheEntry))
	}

	entry := &DiskUsageCacheEntry{path: key, result: result}
	entry.elem = c.lru.PushFront(entry)
	c.entries[key] = entry
}

func (c *DiskUsageCache) InvalidateSubtree(path string) {
	root := diskUsageCacheKey(path)

	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()

	for key, entry := range c.entries {
		if key == root || strings.HasPrefix(key, root+"/") {
			c.evict(entry)
		}
	}
}

func (c *DiskUsageCache) evict(entry *DiskUsageCacheEntry) {
	delete(c.entries, entry.path)
	c.lru.Remove(entry.elem)
}

func diskUsageCacheKey(path string) string {
	return filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path))
}
````

````go
//go:build windows

package filesystem

import (
	"os"
	"syscall"
)

func isLink(entry os.DirEntry) bool {
	if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return true
	}
	info, err := entry.Info()
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	sys, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Win32FileAttributeData)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	const fileAttributeReparsePoint = 0x400
	return sys.FileAttributes&fileAttributeReparsePoint != 0
}
````

## File: internal/filesystem/elevated_handler.go
````go
package filesystem

import (
	"fmt"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	elevation "wails-app/internal/elevation"
)

type RawOperations struct {
	ListDirectory   func(path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error)
	ReadFile        func(path string, encoding string) (*contracts.FileContent, error)
	WriteFile       func(path string, content string, encoding string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error)
	DeleteFile      func(path string, recursive bool, useTrash *bool) (*contracts.OperationResult, error)
	CreateDirectory func(path string, recursive bool) (*contracts.OperationResult, error)
	MoveFile        func(source, destination string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error)
	CopyFile        func(source, destination string, recursive bool) (*contracts.OperationResult, error)
}

func NewElevatedHandler(ops RawOperations) elevation.Handler {
	return func(req elevation.Request) elevation.Response {
		switch req.Op {
		case "list":
			listing, err := ops.ListDirectory(req.Path, req.ShowHidden)
			if err != nil {
				return elevation.Response{Success: false, Error: err.Error()}
			}
			return elevation.Response{Success: true, DirListing: listing}
		case "read":
			file, err := ops.ReadFile(req.Path, req.Encoding)
			if err != nil {
				return elevation.Response{Success: false, Error: err.Error()}
			}
			return elevation.Response{Success: true, File: file}
		case "write":
			op, err := ops.WriteFile(req.Path, req.Content, req.Encoding)
			if err != nil {
				return elevation.Response{Success: false, Error: err.Error()}
			}
			return elevation.Response{Success: true, Operation: op}
		case "delete":
			op, err := ops.DeleteFile(req.Path, req.Recursive, req.UseTrash)
			if err != nil {
				return elevation.Response{Success: false, Error: err.Error()}
			}
			return elevation.Response{Success: true, Operation: op}
		case "mkdir":
			op, err := ops.CreateDirectory(req.Path, req.Recursive)
			if err != nil {
				return elevation.Response{Success: false, Error: err.Error()}
			}
			return elevation.Response{Success: true, Operation: op}
		case "move":
			op, err := ops.MoveFile(req.Source, req.Destination)
			if err != nil {
				return elevation.Response{Success: false, Error: err.Error()}
			}
			return elevation.Response{Success: true, Operation: op}
		case "copy":
			op, err := ops.CopyFile(req.Source, req.Destination, req.Recursive)
			if err != nil {
				return elevation.Response{Success: false, Error: err.Error()}
			}
			return elevation.Response{Success: true, Operation: op}
		default:
			return elevation.Response{Success: false, Error: fmt.Sprintf("unknown elevated op: %s", req.Op)}
		}
	}
}
````

````go
package filesystem

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"mime"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

	"wails-app/internal/contentprobe"
	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

type MetadataCallbacks struct {
	ToSlash                      func(string) string
	IsHiddenFile                 func(name, path string) bool
	IsArchive                    func(name string) bool
	SymlinkPointsToDir           func(path string) bool
	IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction func(path string) bool
	GetCreatedTime               func(os.FileInfo) int64
	GetAccessedTime              func(os.FileInfo) int64
	FormatPermissions            func(os.FileInfo) string
}

type RawCallbacks struct {
	Metadata    MetadataCallbacks
	MoveToTrash func(path string) error
}

type RawService struct {
	callbacks RawCallbacks
}

func NewRawService(callbacks RawCallbacks) *RawService {
	return &RawService{callbacks: callbacks}
}

func (s *RawService) ListDirectory(path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	path = resolveRawPath(path)
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(path)
	if err != nil {
		if resolved, readLinkErr := os.Readlink(path); readLinkErr == nil {
			if resolvedEntries, retryErr := os.ReadDir(resolved); retryErr == nil {
				entries = resolvedEntries
				path = s.toSlash(resolved)
				err = nil
			}
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	files := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(entries))
	var totalSize int64
	for _, entry := range entries {
		name := entry.Name()
		fullPath := s.toSlash(filepath.Join(path, name))
		hidden := s.isHiddenFile(name, fullPath)
		if !showHidden && hidden {
			continue
		}

		info, statErr := os.Lstat(fullPath)
		if statErr != nil {
			if fallback, ok := BuildFallbackLinkInfo(s.callbacks.Metadata, name, fullPath, entry, hidden); ok {
				files = append(files, fallback)
				totalSize += fallback.Size
			}
			continue
		}

		fi := BuildFileInfoWithHidden(s.callbacks.Metadata, name, fullPath, info, hidden)
		files = append(files, fi)
		totalSize += fi.Size
	}

	return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
		Path:      s.toSlash(path),
		Entries:   files,
		TotalSize: totalSize,
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) ReadFile(path string, encoding string) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	path = resolveRawPath(path)
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	info, err := os.Stat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	probe := contentprobe.ProbeBytes(data)
	if encoding == "" {
		encoding = "utf8"
		if probe.IsText && probe.Encoding != "" {
			encoding = probe.Encoding
		}
	}

	content, err := contentprobe.Decode(data, encoding)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.FileContent{
		Path:     path,
		Content:  content,
		Encoding: encoding,
		Size:     info.Size(),
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) ReadFileRange(path string, offset int64, length int) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	path = resolveRawPath(path)
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	info, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	fileSize := info.Size()

	if offset < 0 {
		offset = 0
	}
	if offset > fileSize {
		offset = fileSize
	}
	available := fileSize - offset
	if int64(length) > available {
		length = int(available)
	}
	if length <= 0 {
		return &contracts.FileContent{
			Path:     path,
			Content:  "",
			Encoding: "base64",
			Size:     fileSize,
		}, nil
	}

	buf := make([]byte, length)
	n, err := file.ReadAt(buf, offset)
	if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.FileContent{
		Path:     path,
		Content:  base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(buf[:n]),
		Encoding: "base64",
		Size:     fileSize,
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) ProbeFile(path string) (*contracts.FileProbe, error) {
	path = resolveRawPath(path)
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	_, probe, err := contentprobe.ProbeReader(file)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.FileProbe{
		MimeType:  probe.MimeType,
		Encoding:  probe.Encoding,
		IsText:    probe.IsText,
		IsArchive: probe.IsArchive,
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) WriteFile(path string, content string, encoding string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	path = resolveRawPath(path)
	var data []byte
	var err error
	if encoding == "base64" {
		data, err = base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(content)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	} else {
		data = []byte(content)
	}

	if err := os.WriteFile(path, data, 0644); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "File written successfully",
		AffectedPaths: []string{path},
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) DeleteFile(path string, recursive bool, useTrash *bool) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	path = resolveRawPath(path)
	trash := useTrash == nil || *useTrash
	if trash {
		if err := s.moveToTrash(path); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return &contracts.OperationResult{
			Success:       true,
			Message:       "Moved to trash successfully",
			AffectedPaths: []string{path},
		}, nil
	}

	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if info.IsDir() {
		if recursive {
			err = os.RemoveAll(path)
		} else {
			err = os.Remove(path)
		}
	} else {
		err = os.Remove(path)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "Deleted successfully",
		AffectedPaths: []string{path},
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) CreateDirectory(path string, recursive bool) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	path = resolveRawPath(path)
	var err error
	if recursive {
		err = os.MkdirAll(path, 0755)
	} else {
		err = os.Mkdir(path, 0755)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "Directory created",
		AffectedPaths: []string{path},
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) MoveFile(source, destination string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	source = resolveRawPath(source)
	destination = resolveRawPath(destination)
	if err := os.Rename(source, destination); err != nil {
		if copyErr := s.CopyPath(source, destination); copyErr != nil {
			return nil, copyErr
		}
		if removeErr := os.RemoveAll(source); removeErr != nil {
			return nil, removeErr
		}
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "Moved successfully",
		AffectedPaths: []string{source, destination},
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) CopyFile(source, destination string, recursive bool) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	source = resolveRawPath(source)
	destination = resolveRawPath(destination)
	info, err := os.Stat(source)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if info.IsDir() && !recursive {
		return &contracts.OperationResult{
			Success: false,
			Message: "Source is a directory; set recursive=true to copy directories",
		}, nil
	}

	if err := s.CopyPath(source, destination); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "Copied successfully",
		AffectedPaths: []string{source, destination},
	}, nil
}

func (s *RawService) CopyPath(src, dst string) error {
	src = resolveRawPath(src)
	dst = resolveRawPath(dst)
	info, err := os.Stat(src)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if info.IsDir() {
		return s.copyDir(src, dst)
	}
	return s.copyFile(src, dst)
}

func (s *RawService) copyFile(src, dst string) error {
	in, err := os.Open(src)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer in.Close()

	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dst), 0755); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	out, err := os.Create(dst)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer out.Close()

	_, err = io.Copy(out, in)
	return err
}

func (s *RawService) copyDir(src, dst string) error {
	return filepath.WalkDir(src, func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel, err := filepath.Rel(src, path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		target := filepath.Join(dst, rel)
		if entry.IsDir() {
			return os.MkdirAll(target, 0755)
		}
		return s.copyFile(path, target)
	})
}

func BuildFileInfo(callbacks MetadataCallbacks, name, fullPath string, info os.FileInfo) contracts.FileInfo {
	return BuildFileInfoWithHidden(callbacks, name, fullPath, info, callHidden(callbacks, name, fullPath))
}

func BuildFileInfoWithHidden(callbacks MetadataCallbacks, name, fullPath string, info os.FileInfo, hidden bool) contracts.FileInfo {
	fileType := contracts.FileTypeFile
	isSymlink := false
	mode := info.Mode()
	if mode&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		isSymlink = true
		if callbacks.SymlinkPointsToDir != nil && callbacks.SymlinkPointsToDir(fullPath) {
			fileType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
		} else {
			fileType = contracts.FileTypeSymlink
		}
	} else if info.IsDir() {
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	} else if callbacks.IsArchive != nil && callbacks.IsArchive(name) {
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeArchive
	}

	if !info.IsDir() && mode&os.ModeSymlink == 0 && callbacks.IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction != nil && callbacks.IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction(fullPath) {
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
		isSymlink = true
	}

	return contracts.FileInfo{
		Name:        name,
		Path:        fullPath,
		Type:        fileType,
		MimeType:    inferMimeTypeFromName(name),
		Size:        info.Size(),
		Created:     callCreated(callbacks, info),
		Modified:    info.ModTime().Unix(),
		Accessed:    callAccessed(callbacks, info),
		Permissions: callPermissions(callbacks, info),
		IsHidden:    hidden,
		IsSymlink:   isSymlink,
	}
}

func BuildFallbackLinkInfo(callbacks MetadataCallbacks, name, fullPath string, entry fs.DirEntry, hidden bool) (contracts.FileInfo, bool) {
	mode := entry.Type()
	isSymlink := mode&os.ModeSymlink != 0
	isJunction := callbacks.IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction != nil && callbacks.IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction(fullPath)
	if !isSymlink && !isJunction {
		return contracts.FileInfo{}, false
	}

	fileType := contracts.FileTypeSymlink
	if entry.IsDir() || isJunction || (isSymlink && callbacks.SymlinkPointsToDir != nil && callbacks.SymlinkPointsToDir(fullPath)) {
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	}

	now := time.Now().Unix()
	return contracts.FileInfo{
		Name:        name,
		Path:        fullPath,
		Type:        fileType,
		MimeType:    inferMimeTypeFromName(name),
		Size:        0,
		Created:     now,
		Modified:    now,
		Accessed:    now,
		Permissions: "",
		IsHidden:    hidden,
		IsSymlink:   true,
	}, true
}

func (s *RawService) toSlash(path string) string {
	if s.callbacks.Metadata.ToSlash != nil {
		return s.callbacks.Metadata.ToSlash(path)
	}
	return filepath.ToSlash(path)
}

func (s *RawService) isHiddenFile(name, path string) bool {
	return callHidden(s.callbacks.Metadata, name, path)
}

func (s *RawService) moveToTrash(path string) error {
	path = resolveRawPath(path)
	if s.callbacks.MoveToTrash == nil {
		return os.RemoveAll(path)
	}
	return s.callbacks.MoveToTrash(path)
}

func resolveRawPath(path string) string {
	return pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(path))
}

func callHidden(callbacks MetadataCallbacks, name, path string) bool {
	if callbacks.IsHiddenFile == nil {
		return false
	}
	return callbacks.IsHiddenFile(name, path)
}

func callCreated(callbacks MetadataCallbacks, info os.FileInfo) int64 {
	if callbacks.GetCreatedTime == nil {
		return info.ModTime().Unix()
	}
	return callbacks.GetCreatedTime(info)
}

func callAccessed(callbacks MetadataCallbacks, info os.FileInfo) int64 {
	if callbacks.GetAccessedTime == nil {
		return info.ModTime().Unix()
	}
	return callbacks.GetAccessedTime(info)
}

func callPermissions(callbacks MetadataCallbacks, info os.FileInfo) string {
	if callbacks.FormatPermissions == nil {
		return info.Mode().Perm().String()
	}
	return callbacks.FormatPermissions(info)
}

func inferMimeTypeFromName(name string) string {
	return mime.TypeByExtension(filepath.Ext(name))
}
````

````go
package filesystem

import (
	"fmt"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

type stubMemoryResolver struct {
	called bool
}

func (s *stubMemoryResolver) ResolvePublicPath(path string) (string, bool, error) {
	s.called = true
	return fmt.Sprintf("resolver:%s", path), true, nil
}

func (s *stubMemoryResolver) ToPublicPath(path string) string {
	return path
}

func TestResolvePublicPathKeepsDrivePathsNative(t *testing.T) {
	resolver := &stubMemoryResolver{}
	service := NewService(ServiceConfig{MemoryResolver: resolver})

	got, err := service.resolvePublicPath("filesystem://c/New Folder")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolvePublicPath returned error: %v", err)
	}

	want := filepath.FromSlash("C:/New Folder")
	if got != want {
		t.Fatalf("resolvePublicPath mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", want, got)
	}
	if resolver.called {
		t.Fatal("memory resolver should not be called for drive paths")
	}
}

func TestResolvePublicPathUsesMemoryResolverForMemoryScheme(t *testing.T) {
	resolver := &stubMemoryResolver{}
	service := NewService(ServiceConfig{MemoryResolver: resolver})

	got, err := service.resolvePublicPath("memory://New Folder")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolvePublicPath returned error: %v", err)
	}

	if !resolver.called {
		t.Fatal("memory resolver should be called for memory paths")
	}
	if got == filepath.FromSlash("memory://New Folder") {
		t.Fatalf("expected memory resolver output, got unchanged path %q", got)
	}
}
````

````go
package filesystem

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/webresourcecache"
)

func TestWebAliasListDirectoryDiscoversLinkedEntries(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		switch r.URL.Path {
		case "/index.html":
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`<!doctype html><html><head><title>Index of /</title></head><body><h1>Index of /</h1><a href="/docs/page.html">Docs</a><a href="/assets/app.js">App</a><a href="/home?hl=en-US">Home</a><script src="/assets/app.js"></script></body></html>`))
		default:
			http.NotFound(w, r)
		}
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	service := newWebAliasService()
	listing, err := service.listDirectory(server.URL + "/index.html")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("listDirectory returned error: %v", err)
	}

	if listing.Path != server.URL+"/index.html" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected listing path: %q", listing.Path)
	}
	if len(listing.Entries) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 2 entries, got %d", len(listing.Entries))
	}

	expected := map[string]contracts.FileType{
		server.URL + "/assets/app.js":  contracts.FileTypeFile,
		server.URL + "/docs/page.html": contracts.FileTypeDirectory,
	}
	for _, entry := range listing.Entries {
		wantType, ok := expected[entry.Path]
		if !ok {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected entry path: %q", entry.Path)
		}
		if entry.Type != wantType {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected entry type for %q: want %q, got %q", entry.Path, wantType, entry.Type)
		}
	}
}

func TestWebAliasListDirectoryUsesCachedBrowserResourcesForRegularPages(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`<!doctype html><html><head><title>Google News</title></head><body><div>news</div></body></html>`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	webresourcecache.Store(server.URL, []webresourcecache.Resource{
		{URL: server.URL + "/static/app.js", Size: 1024, InitiatorType: "script", MimeType: "application/javascript"},
		{URL: server.URL + "/_/scs/mail-static/_/js/k=abc", Size: 4096, InitiatorType: "script", MimeType: "application/javascript"},
		{URL: server.URL + "/home?hl=en-US", Size: 2048, InitiatorType: "fetch"},
	})

	service := newWebAliasService()
	listing, err := service.listDirectory(server.URL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("listDirectory returned error: %v", err)
	}

	if len(listing.Entries) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 2 cached resource entries, got %d", len(listing.Entries))
	}
	seen := map[string]int64{}
	for _, entry := range listing.Entries {
		seen[entry.Path] = entry.Size
	}
	if seen[server.URL+"/static/app.js"] != 1024 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected cached resource size for app.js: %d", seen[server.URL+"/static/app.js"])
	}
	if seen[server.URL+"/_/scs/mail-static/_/js/k=abc"] != 4096 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected cached resource size for extensionless resource: %d", seen[server.URL+"/_/scs/mail-static/_/js/k=abc"])
	}
}

func TestWebAliasListDirectoryShortCircuitsRegularWebsitePages(t *testing.T) {
	var fullRequests atomic.Int32
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
		if r.Header.Get("Range") != "" {
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`<!doctype html><html><head><title>Gmail</title></head><body>mail</body></html>`))
			return
		}

		fullRequests.Add(1)
		time.Sleep(250 * time.Millisecond)
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`<!doctype html><html><head><title>Gmail</title></head><body>mail</body></html>`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	service := newWebAliasService()
	started := time.Now()
	listing, err := service.listDirectory(server.URL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("listDirectory returned error: %v", err)
	}

	if len(listing.Entries) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 0 entries for non-directory page, got %d", len(listing.Entries))
	}
	if fullRequests.Load() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected no full GET requests, got %d", fullRequests.Load())
	}
	if elapsed := time.Since(started); elapsed >= 200*time.Millisecond {
		t.Fatalf("expected regular website probe to return quickly, took %v", elapsed)
	}
}

	}
}

func TestWebAliasListDirectoryResolvesRelativeLinksFromSlashlessDirectoryAlias(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		switch r.URL.Path {
		case "/MPEG-4", "/MPEG-4/":
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
			_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`<!doctype html><html><head><title>Index of /MPEG-4</title></head><body><h1>Index of /MPEG-4</h1><a href="MPEG4%20by%20philips.mp4">MPEG4 by philips.mp4</a></body></html>`))
		default:
			http.NotFound(w, r)
		}
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	service := newWebAliasService()
	listing, err := service.listDirectory(server.URL + "/MPEG-4")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("listDirectory returned error: %v", err)
	}

	if len(listing.Entries) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 entry, got %d", len(listing.Entries))
	}
	if listing.Entries[0].Path != server.URL+"/MPEG-4/MPEG4%20by%20philips.mp4" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected entry path: %q", listing.Entries[0].Path)
	}
	if listing.Entries[0].Name != "MPEG4 by philips.mp4" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected entry name: %q", listing.Entries[0].Name)
	}
}
````
