````go
package filesystem

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/base64"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	vpath "path"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"golang.org/x/net/html"

	"wails-app/internal/contentprobe"
	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	"wails-app/internal/webresourcecache"
)

const (
	webAliasTimeout   = 30 * time.Second
	webAliasReadLimit = 4 * 1024 * 1024
)

type webAliasService struct {
	client   *http.Client
	metaMu   sync.RWMutex
	metadata map[string]webAliasMetadata
}

type webAliasMetadata struct {
	size       int64
	mimeType   string
	modifiedAt int64
	fileType   contracts.FileType
}

func newWebAliasService() *webAliasService {
	return &webAliasService{
		client:   &http.Client{Timeout: webAliasTimeout},
		metadata: make(map[string]webAliasMetadata),
	}
}

func (s *webAliasService) lookupMetadata(path string) (webAliasMetadata, bool) {
	s.metaMu.RLock()
	defer s.metaMu.RUnlock()
	meta, ok := s.metadata[path]
	return meta, ok
}

func (s *webAliasService) rememberMetadata(path string, meta webAliasMetadata) {
	if path == "" {
		return
	}

	s.metaMu.Lock()
	defer s.metaMu.Unlock()

	current := s.metadata[path]
	if meta.size > 0 {
		current.size = meta.size
	}
	if meta.mimeType != "" {
		current.mimeType = meta.mimeType
	}
	if meta.modifiedAt > 0 {
		current.modifiedAt = meta.modifiedAt
	}
	if meta.fileType != "" {
		current.fileType = meta.fileType
	}
	s.metadata[path] = current
}

func (s *webAliasService) applyCachedMetadata(entries []contracts.FileInfo) []contracts.FileInfo {
	result := make([]contracts.FileInfo, len(entries))
	copy(result, entries)

	for i, entry := range result {
		meta, ok := s.lookupMetadata(entry.Path)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		if meta.size > 0 {
			result[i].Size = meta.size
		}
		if meta.mimeType != "" {
			result[i].MimeType = meta.mimeType
		}
		if meta.modifiedAt > 0 {
			result[i].Created = meta.modifiedAt
			result[i].Modified = meta.modifiedAt
			result[i].Accessed = meta.modifiedAt
		}
		if meta.fileType != "" {
			result[i].Type = meta.fileType
		}
	}

	return result
}

func (s *webAliasService) handles(path string) bool {
	return pathref.IsWeb(path)
}

func (s *webAliasService) listDirectory(path string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	requestedPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	targetURL, rootOnly, err := normalizeWebAliasPath(requestedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if rootOnly {
		return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
			Path:      requestedPath,
			Entries:   []contracts.FileInfo{},
			TotalSize: 0,
		}, nil
	}

	if cached, ok := s.lookupMetadata(requestedPath); ok && cached.fileType == contracts.FileTypeFile {
		entries := s.applyCachedMetadata(cachedWebResources(targetURL))
		return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
			Path:      requestedPath,
			Entries:   entries,
			TotalSize: sumFileSizes(entries),
		}, nil
	}

	sample, headers, sampleSize, err := s.fetchSample(targetURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	contentType := normalizedMediaType(headers.Get("Content-Type"))
	if contentType == "" {
		contentType = contentprobe.ProbeBytes(sample).MimeType
	}
	modifiedAt := parseHTTPModified(headers.Get("Last-Modified"))

	if fileType := inferWebAliasFileTypeFromSample(targetURL, contentType, sample); fileType == contracts.FileTypeFile {
		s.rememberMetadata(requestedPath, webAliasMetadata{
			size:       sampleSize,
			mimeType:   contentType,
			modifiedAt: modifiedAt,
			fileType:   contracts.FileTypeFile,
		})
		entries := s.applyCachedMetadata(cachedWebResources(targetURL))
		return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
			Path:      requestedPath,
			Entries:   entries,
			TotalSize: sumFileSizes(entries),
		}, nil
	}

	resp, err := s.request(http.MethodGet, targetURL, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if resp.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || resp.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("request failed: HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}

	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, webAliasReadLimit))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	entries := []contracts.FileInfo{}
	if isHTMLResponse(resp.Header.Get("Content-Type"), body) {
		entries = discoverWebEntries(targetURL, body)
		if len(entries) == 0 {
			entries = cachedWebResources(targetURL)
		}
		entries = s.applyCachedMetadata(entries)
	}

	resolvedType := contracts.FileTypeFile
	if len(entries) > 0 {
		resolvedType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	}
	s.rememberMetadata(requestedPath, webAliasMetadata{
		size:       responseSize(resp, int64(len(body))),
		mimeType:   normalizedMediaType(resp.Header.Get("Content-Type")),
		modifiedAt: parseHTTPModified(resp.Header.Get("Last-Modified")),
		fileType:   resolvedType,
	})

	return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
		Path:      requestedPath,
		Entries:   entries,
		TotalSize: sumFileSizes(entries),
	}, nil
}

func (s *webAliasService) getFileInfo(path string) (*contracts.FileInfo, error) {
	requestedPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	targetURL, rootOnly, err := normalizeWebAliasPath(requestedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if rootOnly {
		return &contracts.FileInfo{
			Name:        strings.TrimSuffix(requestedPath, "://"),
			Path:        requestedPath,
			Type:        contracts.FileTypeDirectory,
			Permissions: "r--",
			IsHidden:    false,
		}, nil
	}

	parsed, err := url.Parse(targetURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	var (
		contentType string
		size        int64
		modifiedAt  int64
		sample      []byte
	)

	if cached, ok := s.lookupMetadata(requestedPath); ok {
		contentType = cached.mimeType
		size = cached.size
		modifiedAt = cached.modifiedAt
	}

	if contentType == "" || size == 0 {
		var headers http.Header
		var sampleSize int64
		var sampleErr error
		sample, headers, sampleSize, sampleErr = s.fetchSample(targetURL)
		if sampleErr == nil {
			if contentType == "" {
				contentType = normalizedMediaType(headers.Get("Content-Type"))
				if contentType == "" {
					contentType = contentprobe.ProbeBytes(sample).MimeType
				}
			}
			if size == 0 {
				size = sampleSize
			}
			if modifiedAt == 0 {
				modifiedAt = parseHTTPModified(headers.Get("Last-Modified"))
			}
		}
	}

	fileType := contracts.FileTypeFile
	if contentType != "" && isHTMLMediaType(contentType) {
		fileType = inferWebAliasFileTypeFromSample(targetURL, contentType, sample)
	} else if parsed.RawQuery == "" && isLikelyWebPage(parsed) {
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	}

	s.rememberMetadata(requestedPath, webAliasMetadata{
		size:       size,
		mimeType:   contentType,
		modifiedAt: modifiedAt,
		fileType:   fileType,
	})

	return &contracts.FileInfo{
		Name:        webEntryDisplayName(parsed),
		Path:        requestedPath,
		Type:        fileType,
		MimeType:    contentType,
		Size:        size,
		Created:     modifiedAt,
		Modified:    modifiedAt,
		Accessed:    modifiedAt,
		Permissions: "r--",
		IsHidden:    false,
	}, nil
}

func (s *webAliasService) probeFile(path string) (*contracts.FileProbe, error) {
	targetURL, rootOnly, err := normalizeWebAliasPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if rootOnly {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot probe scheme root")
	}

	sample, headers, _, err := s.fetchSample(targetURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	probe := contentprobe.ProbeBytes(sample)
	if headerType := normalizedMediaType(headers.Get("Content-Type")); headerType != "" {
		probe.MimeType = headerType
		probe.IsText = probe.IsText || isTextMediaType(headerType)
	}

	fileType := contracts.FileTypeFile
	if probe.MimeType != "" && isHTMLMediaType(probe.MimeType) {
		fileType = inferWebAliasFileTypeFromSample(targetURL, probe.MimeType, sample)
	}
	s.rememberMetadata(pathref.Normalize(path), webAliasMetadata{
		size:       responseSize(&http.Response{Header: headers}, 0),
		mimeType:   probe.MimeType,
		modifiedAt: parseHTTPModified(headers.Get("Last-Modified")),
		fileType:   fileType,
	})

	return &contracts.FileProbe{
		MimeType:  probe.MimeType,
		Encoding:  probe.Encoding,
		IsText:    probe.IsText,
		IsArchive: probe.IsArchive,
	}, nil
}

func (s *webAliasService) readFile(path string, encoding string) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	requestedPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	targetURL, rootOnly, err := normalizeWebAliasPath(requestedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if rootOnly {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot read scheme root")
	}

	resp, err := s.request(http.MethodGet, targetURL, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if resp.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || resp.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("request failed: HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}

	data, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	probe := contentprobe.ProbeBytes(data)
	if encoding == "" {
		encoding = "utf8"
		if probe.IsText && probe.Encoding != "" {
			encoding = probe.Encoding
		}
	}

	content, err := contentprobe.Decode(data, encoding)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	totalSize := responseSize(resp, int64(len(data)))
	fileType := contracts.FileTypeFile
	if probe.MimeType != "" && isHTMLMediaType(probe.MimeType) {
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	}
	s.rememberMetadata(requestedPath, webAliasMetadata{
		size:       totalSize,
		mimeType:   probe.MimeType,
		modifiedAt: parseHTTPModified(resp.Header.Get("Last-Modified")),
		fileType:   fileType,
	})

	return &contracts.FileContent{
		Path:     requestedPath,
		Content:  content,
		Encoding: encoding,
		Size:     totalSize,
	}, nil
}

func (s *webAliasService) readFileRange(path string, offset int64, length int) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	requestedPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	targetURL, rootOnly, err := normalizeWebAliasPath(requestedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if rootOnly {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot read scheme root")
	}
	if length <= 0 {
		return &contracts.FileContent{
			Path:     requestedPath,
			Content:  "",
			Encoding: "base64",
			Size:     0,
		}, nil
	}

	headers := map[string]string{
		"Range": fmt.Sprintf("bytes=%d-%d", offset, offset+int64(length)-1),
	}
	resp, err := s.request(http.MethodGet, targetURL, headers)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusRequestedRangeNotSatisfiable {
		return &contracts.FileContent{
			Path:     requestedPath,
			Content:  "",
			Encoding: "base64",
			Size:     0,
		}, nil
	}
	if resp.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || resp.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("request failed: HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}

	if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK && offset > 0 {
		if _, err := io.CopyN(io.Discard, resp.Body, offset); err != nil && err != io.EOF {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, int64(length)))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	totalSize := responseSize(resp, offset+int64(len(data)))
	s.rememberMetadata(requestedPath, webAliasMetadata{
		size:       totalSize,
		mimeType:   normalizedMediaType(resp.Header.Get("Content-Type")),
		modifiedAt: parseHTTPModified(resp.Header.Get("Last-Modified")),
		fileType:   contracts.FileTypeFile,
	})

	return &contracts.FileContent{
		Path:     requestedPath,
		Content:  base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(data),
		Encoding: "base64",
		Size:     totalSize,
	}, nil
}

func (s *webAliasService) fetchSample(targetURL string) ([]byte, http.Header, int64, error) {
	resp, err := s.request(http.MethodGet, targetURL, map[string]string{
		"Range":           fmt.Sprintf("bytes=0-%d", contentprobe.SampleLimit-1),
		"Accept-Encoding": "identity",
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, 0, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if resp.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || resp.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return nil, nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("request failed: HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}

	sample, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, contentprobe.SampleLimit))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, 0, err
	}

	return sample, resp.Header.Clone(), responseSize(resp, int64(len(sample))), nil
}

func (s *webAliasService) request(method string, targetURL string, extraHeaders map[string]string) (*http.Response, error) {
	req, err := http.NewRequest(method, targetURL, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Accept", "*/*")
	req.Header.Set("User-Agent", "WailsFileManager/1.0")
	for key, value := range extraHeaders {
		if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
			continue
		}
		req.Header.Set(key, value)
	}
	return s.client.Do(req)
}

func normalizeWebAliasPath(path string) (string, bool, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	switch normalized {
	case pathref.HTTPAliasScheme, pathref.HTTPSAliasScheme:
		return normalized, true, nil
	}

	parsed, err := url.Parse(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return "", false, err
	}
	if parsed.Host == "" {
		return "", false, fmt.Errorf("invalid web alias path %q", path)
	}

	switch strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme) {
	case "http", "https":
	default:
		return "", false, fmt.Errorf("unsupported web alias scheme %q", parsed.Scheme)
	}

	parsed.Scheme = strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme)
	parsed.Host = strings.ToLower(parsed.Host)
	parsed.Fragment = ""
	parsed.Path = strings.ReplaceAll(parsed.Path, "\\", "/")
	if parsed.Path == "/" {
		parsed.Path = ""
	} else {
		parsed.Path = strings.TrimRight(parsed.Path, "/")
	}
	parsed.RawPath = ""

	return parsed.String(), false, nil
}

func inferWebAliasFileTypeFromSample(targetURL string, contentType string, sample []byte) contracts.FileType {
	if !isHTMLMediaType(contentType) {
		return contracts.FileTypeFile
	}

	parsed, err := url.Parse(targetURL)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.FileTypeFile
	}

	switch probeWebDirectoryListingSample(sample) {
	case webDirectoryListingYes:
		return contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	case webDirectoryListingNo:
		return contracts.FileTypeFile
	default:
		if parsed.RawQuery == "" && isLikelyWebPage(parsed) {
			return contracts.FileTypeDirectory
		}
		return contracts.FileTypeFile
	}
}

type webDirectoryListingProbe int

const (
	webDirectoryListingUnknown webDirectoryListingProbe = iota
	webDirectoryListingYes
	webDirectoryListingNo
)

func probeWebDirectoryListingSample(sample []byte) webDirectoryListingProbe {
	if len(sample) == 0 {
		return webDirectoryListingUnknown
	}

	doc, err := html.Parse(bytes.NewReader(sample))
	if err != nil {
		return webDirectoryListingUnknown
	}

	sawLabel := false
	for _, tag := range []string{"title", "h1"} {
		label := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(firstElementText(doc, tag)))
		if label == "" {
			continue
		}
		sawLabel = true
		if isDirectoryListingLabel(label) {
			return webDirectoryListingYes
		}
	}

	if sawLabel {
		return webDirectoryListingNo
	}

	return webDirectoryListingUnknown
}

func discoverWebEntries(pageURL string, body []byte) []contracts.FileInfo {
	baseURL, err := url.Parse(pageURL)
	if err != nil {
		return []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}

	doc, err := html.Parse(bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		return []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}
	if !looksLikeDirectoryListing(doc) {
		return []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}

	resolvedBase := findHTMLBaseURL(doc, directoryListingBaseURL(baseURL))
	currentURL := canonicalWebURL(directoryListingCurrentURL(baseURL))
	entries := make(map[string]contracts.FileInfo)

	var walk func(*html.Node)
	walk = func(node *html.Node) {
		if node == nil {
			return
		}

		if node.Type == html.ElementNode {
			switch strings.ToLower(node.Data) {
			case "a":
				addWebEntry(entries, resolvedBase, currentURL, attrValue(node, "href"), true)
			}
		}

		for child := node.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
			walk(child)
		}
	}

	walk(doc)

	if len(entries) == 0 {
		return []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}

	keys := make([]string, 0, len(entries))
	for key := range entries {
		keys = append(keys, key)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)

	files := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(keys))
	for _, key := range keys {
		files = append(files, entries[key])
	}
	return files
}

func directoryListingBaseURL(baseURL *url.URL) *url.URL {
	if baseURL == nil {
		return nil
	}

	resolved := *baseURL
	resolved.Path = strings.ReplaceAll(resolved.Path, "\\", "/")
	name := strings.ToLower(vpath.Base(resolved.Path))
	if name == "index.html" || name == "index.htm" {
		resolved.Path = vpath.Dir(resolved.Path)
	}
	if resolved.Path == "." || resolved.Path == "/" || resolved.Path == "" {
		resolved.Path = "/"
	} else if !strings.HasSuffix(resolved.Path, "/") {
		resolved.Path += "/"
	}
	return &resolved
}

func directoryListingCurrentURL(baseURL *url.URL) *url.URL {
	if baseURL == nil {
		return nil
	}

	resolved := *baseURL
	resolved.Path = strings.ReplaceAll(resolved.Path, "\\", "/")
	name := strings.ToLower(vpath.Base(resolved.Path))
	if name == "index.html" || name == "index.htm" {
		resolved.Path = vpath.Dir(resolved.Path)
	}
	if resolved.Path == "." || resolved.Path == "/" {
		resolved.Path = ""
	} else {
		resolved.Path = strings.TrimRight(resolved.Path, "/")
	}
	resolved.RawPath = ""
	return &resolved
}

func addWebEntry(entries map[string]contracts.FileInfo, baseURL *url.URL, currentURL string, rawRef string, navigable bool) {
	resolved, ok := resolveWebReference(baseURL, rawRef)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(resolved.RawQuery) != "" {
		return
	}

	target := canonicalWebURL(resolved)
	if target == "" || target == currentURL {
		return
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(target, currentURL+"/") {
		return
	}
	if _, exists := entries[target]; exists {
		return
	}

	fileType := contracts.FileTypeFile
	if navigable && isLikelyWebPage(resolved) {
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	}

	entries[target] = contracts.FileInfo{
		Name:        webEntryDisplayName(resolved),
		Path:        target,
		Type:        fileType,
		MimeType:    mime.TypeByExtension(strings.ToLower(vpath.Ext(resolved.Path))),
		Permissions: "r--",
		IsHidden:    false,
	}
}

func cachedWebResources(pageURL string) []contracts.FileInfo {
	resources := webresourcecache.Load(pageURL)
	if len(resources) == 0 {
		return []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}

	entries := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(resources))
	for _, resource := range resources {
		parsed, err := url.Parse(resource.URL)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if !shouldIncludeCachedWebResource(parsed, resource.InitiatorType, resource.MimeType, resource.Size) {
			continue
		}
		entries = append(entries, contracts.FileInfo{
			Name:        webEntryDisplayName(parsed),
			Path:        canonicalWebURL(parsed),
			Type:        contracts.FileTypeFile,
			MimeType:    chooseCachedResourceMimeType(parsed, resource.MimeType),
			Size:        resource.Size,
			Permissions: "r--",
			IsHidden:    false,
		})
	}
	if len(entries) == 0 {
		return []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}
	sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
		return entries[i].Path < entries[j].Path
	})
	return entries
}

func shouldIncludeCachedWebResource(parsed *url.URL, initiatorType string, mimeType string, size int64) bool {
	if parsed == nil || size <= 0 {
		return false
	}
	mimeType = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(mimeType))
	ext := strings.ToLower(vpath.Ext(parsed.Path))
	if ext != "" {
		if isLikelyWebPage(parsed) {
			return false
		}
		return true
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "application/javascript") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "text/javascript") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "text/css") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "image/") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "audio/") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "video/") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "font/") ||
		strings.Contains(mimeType, "font") {
		return true
	}
	switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(initiatorType)) {
	case "script", "css", "img", "image", "audio", "video", "track", "font", "link", "beacon":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func chooseCachedResourceMimeType(parsed *url.URL, cached string) string {
	if trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(cached); trimmed != "" {
		return trimmed
	}
	return mime.TypeByExtension(strings.ToLower(vpath.Ext(parsed.Path)))
}

func resolveWebReference(baseURL *url.URL, rawRef string) (*url.URL, bool) {
	ref := strings.TrimSpace(rawRef)
	if ref == "" {
		return nil, false
	}

	lower := strings.ToLower(ref)
	if strings.HasPrefix(lower, "#") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(lower, "javascript:") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(lower, "mailto:") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(lower, "tel:") ||
		strings.HasPrefix(lower, "data:") {
		return nil, false
	}

	parsed, err := url.Parse(ref)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false
	}
	resolved := baseURL.ResolveReference(parsed)
	switch strings.ToLower(resolved.Scheme) {
	case "http", "https":
		resolved.Fragment = ""
		return resolved, true
	default:
		return nil, false
	}
}

func findHTMLBaseURL(doc *html.Node, fallback *url.URL) *url.URL {
	var walk func(*html.Node) *url.URL
	walk = func(node *html.Node) *url.URL {
		if node == nil {
			return nil
		}

		if node.Type == html.ElementNode && strings.EqualFold(node.Data, "base") {
			href := strings.TrimSpace(attrValue(node, "href"))
			if href != "" {
				if parsed, ok := resolveWebReference(fallback, href); ok {
					return parsed
				}
			}
		}

		for child := node.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
			if resolved := walk(child); resolved != nil {
				return resolved
			}
		}
		return nil
	}

	if resolved := walk(doc); resolved != nil {
		return resolved
	}
	return fallback
}

func looksLikeDirectoryListing(doc *html.Node) bool {
	for _, tag := range []string{"title", "h1"} {
		if label := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(firstElementText(doc, tag))); isDirectoryListingLabel(label) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isDirectoryListingLabel(label string) bool {
	return strings.HasPrefix(label, "index of") || strings.HasPrefix(label, "directory listing for")
}

func firstElementText(root *html.Node, tag string) string {
	var walk func(*html.Node) string
	walk = func(node *html.Node) string {
		if node == nil {
			return ""
		}
		if node.Type == html.ElementNode && strings.EqualFold(node.Data, tag) {
			return nodeText(node)
		}
		for child := node.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
			if text := walk(child); text != "" {
				return text
			}
		}
		return ""
	}
	return walk(root)
}

func nodeText(node *html.Node) string {
	var parts []string
	var walk func(*html.Node)
	walk = func(current *html.Node) {
		if current == nil {
			return
		}
		if current.Type == html.TextNode {
			if text := strings.TrimSpace(current.Data); text != "" {
				parts = append(parts, text)
			}
		}
		for child := current.FirstChild; child != nil; child = child.NextSibling {
			walk(child)
		}
	}
	walk(node)
	return strings.Join(parts, " ")
}

func attrValue(node *html.Node, name string) string {
	for _, attr := range node.Attr {
		if strings.EqualFold(attr.Key, name) {
			return attr.Val
		}
	}
	return ""
}

func parseSrcset(raw string) []string {
	if strings.TrimSpace(raw) == "" {
		return nil
	}

	parts := strings.Split(raw, ",")
	values := make([]string, 0, len(parts))
	for _, part := range parts {
		fields := strings.Fields(strings.TrimSpace(part))
		if len(fields) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		values = append(values, fields[0])
	}
	return values
}

func webEntryDisplayName(parsed *url.URL) string {
	trimmedPath := strings.Trim(strings.TrimRight(parsed.Path, "/"), "/")
	if trimmedPath == "" {
		if parsed.RawQuery != "" {
			return parsed.Host + "?" + parsed.RawQuery
		}
		return parsed.Host
	}

	name := vpath.Base(trimmedPath)
	if name == "." || name == "/" || name == "" {
		name = parsed.Host
	}
	if parsed.RawQuery != "" {
		return name + "?" + parsed.RawQuery
	}
	return name
}

func canonicalWebURL(parsed *url.URL) string {
	if parsed == nil {
		return ""
	}

	clone := *parsed
	clone.Scheme = strings.ToLower(clone.Scheme)
	clone.Host = strings.ToLower(clone.Host)
	clone.Fragment = ""
	clone.Path = strings.ReplaceAll(clone.Path, "\\", "/")
	if clone.Path == "/" {
		clone.Path = ""
	} else {
		clone.Path = strings.TrimRight(clone.Path, "/")
	}
	clone.RawPath = ""
	return clone.String()
}

func isLikelyWebPage(parsed *url.URL) bool {
	if parsed == nil {
		return false
	}

	if strings.HasSuffix(parsed.Path, "/") {
		return true
	}

	switch strings.ToLower(vpath.Ext(parsed.Path)) {
	case ".html", ".htm", ".xhtml", ".shtml", ".php", ".asp", ".aspx", ".jsp", ".jspx", ".cfm":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func isHTMLResponse(contentType string, body []byte) bool {
	if isHTMLMediaType(normalizedMediaType(contentType)) {
		return true
	}
	return isHTMLMediaType(contentprobe.ProbeBytes(body).MimeType)
}

func isHTMLMediaType(contentType string) bool {
	switch normalizedMediaType(contentType) {
	case "text/html", "application/xhtml+xml":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func isTextMediaType(contentType string) bool {
	contentType = normalizedMediaType(contentType)
	if contentType == "" {
		return false
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(contentType, "text/") {
		return true
	}
	return strings.HasSuffix(contentType, "+json") || strings.HasSuffix(contentType, "+xml") ||
		contentType == "application/json" || contentType == "application/xml" ||
		contentType == "application/javascript" || contentType == "application/ecmascript"
}

func normalizedMediaType(contentType string) string {
	if contentType == "" {
		return ""
	}
	mediaType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(contentType)
	if err != nil {
		return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(strings.Split(contentType, ";")[0]))
	}
	return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(mediaType))
}

func parseHTTPModified(raw string) int64 {
	if strings.TrimSpace(raw) == "" {
		return 0
	}
	timestamp, err := time.Parse(http.TimeFormat, raw)
	if err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	return timestamp.Unix()
}

func responseSize(resp *http.Response, fallback int64) int64 {
	if resp == nil {
		return fallback
	}

	if contentRange := strings.TrimSpace(resp.Header.Get("Content-Range")); contentRange != "" {
		if slash := strings.LastIndex(contentRange, "/"); slash >= 0 && slash < len(contentRange)-1 {
			if size, err := strconv.ParseInt(contentRange[slash+1:], 10, 64); err == nil {
				return size
			}
		}
	}

	if resp.ContentLength > 0 {
		return resp.ContentLength
	}
	if headerLength := strings.TrimSpace(resp.Header.Get("Content-Length")); headerLength != "" {
		if size, err := strconv.ParseInt(headerLength, 10, 64); err == nil {
			return size
		}
	}
	return fallback
}

func sumFileSizes(entries []contracts.FileInfo) int64 {
	var total int64
	for _, entry := range entries {
		total += entry.Size
	}
	return total
}
````

````go
package navigation

import "sync"

const defaultMaxHistory = 200

type paneHistory struct {
	back    []string
	forward []string
}

// Manager stores per-pane navigation history independently of the Wails binding layer.
type Manager struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	panes   map[string]*paneHistory
	maxSize int
}

func NewManager() *Manager {
	return &Manager{
		panes:   make(map[string]*paneHistory),
		maxSize: defaultMaxHistory,
	}
}

func (m *Manager) pane(id string) *paneHistory {
	if _, ok := m.panes[id]; !ok {
		m.panes[id] = &paneHistory{}
	}
	return m.panes[id]
}

// Navigate pushes a new path and clears the forward stack.
func (m *Manager) Navigate(paneID, path string) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	pane := m.pane(paneID)
	if len(pane.back) > 0 && pane.back[len(pane.back)-1] == path {
		return
	}

	pane.back = append(pane.back, path)
	if len(pane.back) > m.maxSize {
		pane.back = pane.back[len(pane.back)-m.maxSize:]
	}
	pane.forward = nil
}

// GoBack moves back one step and returns the new current path.
func (m *Manager) GoBack(paneID string) string {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	pane := m.pane(paneID)
	if len(pane.back) < 2 {
		return ""
	}

	current := pane.back[len(pane.back)-1]
	pane.back = pane.back[:len(pane.back)-1]
	pane.forward = append(pane.forward, current)

	return pane.back[len(pane.back)-1]
}

// GoForward moves forward one step and returns the new current path.
func (m *Manager) GoForward(paneID string) string {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	pane := m.pane(paneID)
	if len(pane.forward) == 0 {
		return ""
	}

	next := pane.forward[len(pane.forward)-1]
	pane.forward = pane.forward[:len(pane.forward)-1]
	pane.back = append(pane.back, next)

	return next
}

func (m *Manager) CanGoBack(paneID string) bool {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	return len(m.pane(paneID).back) >= 2
}

func (m *Manager) CanGoForward(paneID string) bool {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	return len(m.pane(paneID).forward) > 0
}

func (m *Manager) CurrentPath(paneID string) string {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	pane := m.pane(paneID)
	if len(pane.back) == 0 {
		return ""
	}
	return pane.back[len(pane.back)-1]
}

func (m *Manager) ClearHistory(paneID string) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	m.panes[paneID] = &paneHistory{}
}
````

## File: internal/navigation/service.go
````go
package navigation

import (
	"fmt"
	"path/filepath"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

// Service owns pane navigation orchestration while delegating history storage
// to Manager and directory listing to the filesystem layer.
type Service struct {
	manager       *Manager
	listDirectory func(path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error)
}

func NewService(manager *Manager, listDirectory func(path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error)) *Service {
	return &Service{
		manager:       manager,
		listDirectory: listDirectory,
	}
}

func (s *Service) Navigate(paneID, path string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	s.manager.Navigate(paneID, path)
	return s.listDirectory(path, false)
}

func (s *Service) NavigateShowHidden(paneID, path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	s.manager.Navigate(paneID, path)
	return s.listDirectory(path, showHidden)
}

func (s *Service) Back(paneID string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	path := s.manager.GoBack(paneID)
	if path == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no previous location for pane %q", paneID)
	}
	return s.listDirectory(path, false)
}

func (s *Service) Forward(paneID string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	path := s.manager.GoForward(paneID)
	if path == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no forward location for pane %q", paneID)
	}
	return s.listDirectory(path, false)
}

func (s *Service) GoUp(paneID string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	current := s.manager.CurrentPath(paneID)
	if current == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no current path for pane %q", paneID)
	}
	if parent, ok := pathref.Parent(current); ok {
		return s.Navigate(paneID, parent)
	}
	parent := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(current))
	if parent == filepath.ToSlash(current) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("already at root")
	}
	return s.Navigate(paneID, parent)
}

// SyncPath updates the backend navigation manager to match a pane's current
// path without triggering another directory read.
func (s *Service) SyncPath(paneID, path string) {
	if path == "" {
		return
	}
	s.manager.Navigate(paneID, path)
}
````

````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import "syscall"

func EnsureHiddenPath(path string) error {
	ptr, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	attrs, err := syscall.GetFileAttributes(ptr)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN != 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return syscall.SetFileAttributes(ptr, attrs|syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN)
}
````

````go
//go:build !windows

package platform

import (
	"io"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"syscall"
)

func OpenFileWithDefaultApp(path string) error {
	var cmd *exec.Cmd
	switch runtime.GOOS {
	case "darwin":
		cmd = exec.Command("open", path)
	default:
		cmd = exec.Command("xdg-open", path)
	}
	return startDetached(cmd)
}

func SymlinkPointsToDir(path string) bool {
	info, err := os.Stat(path)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return info.IsDir()
}

func IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction(_ string) bool {
	return false
}

func ResolveLinkPath(symlinkPath string) (target string, isDir bool, err error) {
	resolved, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(symlinkPath)
	if err != nil {
		return "", false, err
	}
	info, err := os.Stat(resolved)
	if err != nil {
		return "", false, err
	}
	return resolved, info.IsDir(), nil
}

func startDetached(cmd *exec.Cmd) error {
	cmd.Stdin = nil
	cmd.Stdout = io.Discard
	cmd.Stderr = io.Discard
	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setsid: true}
	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	go func() { _ = cmd.Wait() }()
	return nil
}
````

## File: internal/platform/links_windows.go
````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"

	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

const (
	swShownormal = 1
	seErrNoAssoc = 31
)

func OpenFileWithDefaultApp(path string) error {
	ret, callErr, err := shellExecute("open", path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if ret > 32 {
		return nil
	}
	if ret == seErrNoAssoc {
		fallbackRet, fallbackCallErr, fallbackErr := shellExecute("openas", path)
		if fallbackErr != nil {
			return fallbackErr
		}
		if fallbackRet > 32 {
			return nil
		}
		if fallbackCallErr != nil && fallbackCallErr != syscall.Errno(0) {
			return fmt.Errorf("ShellExecuteW failed: %w", fallbackCallErr)
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("ShellExecuteW failed with code %d", fallbackRet)
	}
	if callErr != nil && callErr != syscall.Errno(0) {
		return fmt.Errorf("ShellExecuteW failed: %w", callErr)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("ShellExecuteW failed with code %d", ret)
}

func shellExecute(verbValue string, path string) (uintptr, error, error) {
	verb, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(verbValue)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, nil, err
	}
	target, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, nil, err
	}

	shell32 := windows.NewLazySystemDLL("shell32.dll")
	shellExecute := shell32.NewProc("ShellExecuteW")
	ret, _, callErr := shellExecute.Call(
		0,
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(verb)),
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(target)),
		0,
		0,
		swShownormal,
	)
	if callErr != nil && callErr != syscall.Errno(0) {
		return ret, callErr, nil
	}
	return ret, nil, nil
}

func SymlinkPointsToDir(path string) bool {
	if !isNativeLinkPath(path) {
		return false
	}
	ptr, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	attrs, err := syscall.GetFileAttributes(ptr)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY != 0
}

func IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction(path string) bool {
	if !isNativeLinkPath(path) {
		return false
	}
	ptr, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	attrs, err := syscall.GetFileAttributes(ptr)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	const reparsePoint = uint32(0x400)
	return attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY != 0 && attrs&reparsePoint != 0
}

func ResolveLinkPath(lnkPath string) (target string, isDir bool, err error) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(lnkPath)
	if err != nil {
		return "", false, err
	}
	if len(data) < 76 {
		return "", false, fmt.Errorf(".lnk file too small")
	}
	if data[0] != 0x4C || data[1] != 0 || data[2] != 0 || data[3] != 0 {
		return "", false, fmt.Errorf("not a valid .lnk file")
	}

	linkFlags := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[20:24])
	fileAttrs := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[24:28])
	isDir = (fileAttrs & 0x10) != 0

	hasIDList := (linkFlags & 0x01) != 0
	hasLinkInfo := (linkFlags & 0x02) != 0
	isUnicode := (linkFlags & 0x80) != 0

	offset := 76
	if hasIDList {
		if offset+2 > len(data) {
			return "", isDir, fmt.Errorf("unexpected EOF in IDList")
		}
		idListSize := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data[offset : offset+2]))
		offset += 2 + idListSize
	}

	if !hasLinkInfo {
		return "", isDir, fmt.Errorf("no LinkInfo section")
	}
	if offset+32 > len(data) {
		return "", isDir, fmt.Errorf("unexpected EOF in LinkInfo")
	}

	liStart := offset
	liHeaderSize := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[liStart+4 : liStart+8]))
	liFlags := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[liStart+8 : liStart+12])
	if liFlags&0x01 == 0 {
		return "", isDir, fmt.Errorf("no local volume path in .lnk")
	}

	var path string
	if isUnicode && liHeaderSize >= 0x24 && liStart+32 <= len(data) {
		unicodeOffset := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[liStart+28 : liStart+32]))
		pathStart := liStart + unicodeOffset
		if pathStart < len(data) {
			path = readUTF16LEString(data[pathStart:])
		}
	}
	if path == "" {
		ansiOffset := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[liStart+16 : liStart+20]))
		pathStart := liStart + ansiOffset
		if pathStart < len(data) {
			end := pathStart
			for end < len(data) && data[end] != 0 {
				end++
			}
			path = string(data[pathStart:end])
		}
	}

	if path == "" {
		return "", isDir, fmt.Errorf("could not extract target path from .lnk")
	}
	return filepath.ToSlash(path), isDir, nil
}

func readUTF16LEString(data []byte) string {
	var chars []uint16
	for i := 0; i+1 < len(data); i += 2 {
		ch := binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data[i : i+2])
		if ch == 0 {
			break
		}
		chars = append(chars, ch)
	}
	return syscall.UTF16ToString(chars)
}

func isNativeLinkPath(path string) bool {
	trimmed := ToSlash(path)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return false
	}
	if pathref.IsRegistry(trimmed) {
		return false
	}
	if pathref.IsAlias(trimmed) && !pathref.IsMemory(trimmed) {
		return false
	}
	return pathref.IsDrive(trimmed) || strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "//")
}
````

````go
//go:build darwin

package platform

import (
	"os"
	"syscall"
)

func GetCreatedTime(info os.FileInfo) int64 {
	if stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t); ok {
		return stat.Ctimespec.Sec
	}
	return info.ModTime().Unix()
}

func GetAccessedTime(info os.FileInfo) int64 {
	if stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t); ok {
		return stat.Atimespec.Sec
	}
	return info.ModTime().Unix()
}
````

````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

func CheckHidden(_ string, path string) bool {
	if !isNativeMetadataPath(path) {
		return false
	}
	ptr, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	attrs, err := syscall.GetFileAttributes(ptr)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return attrs&syscall.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_HIDDEN != 0
}

func GetCreatedTime(info os.FileInfo) int64 {
	if stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Win32FileAttributeData); ok {
		return stat.CreationTime.Nanoseconds() / int64(time.Second)
	}
	return info.ModTime().Unix()
}

func GetAccessedTime(info os.FileInfo) int64 {
	if stat, ok := info.Sys().(*syscall.Win32FileAttributeData); ok {
		return stat.LastAccessTime.Nanoseconds() / int64(time.Second)
	}
	return info.ModTime().Unix()
}

func isNativeMetadataPath(path string) bool {
	trimmed := ToSlash(path)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return false
	}
	if pathref.IsRegistry(trimmed) {
		return false
	}
	if pathref.IsAlias(trimmed) && !pathref.IsMemory(trimmed) {
		return false
	}
	return pathref.IsDrive(trimmed) || strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "//")
}
````

````go
//go:build linux

package platform

import (
	"os"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

// JoinMountNamespace makes the calling process join the specified mount namespace.
// The nsPath should be a path like "/proc/<pid>/ns/mnt".
func JoinMountNamespace(nsPath string) error {
	f, err := os.Open(nsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()

	if err := unix.Setns(int(f.Fd()), unix.CLONE_NEWNS); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}
````

## File: internal/platform/paths.go
````go
package platform

import (
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func ToSlash(path string) string {
	return filepath.ToSlash(path)
}

func CleanPath(path string) string {
	return ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path))
}

func Normalize(path string) string {
	return strings.Trim(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"), "/")
}

func JoinNormalized(base, child string) string {
	base = Normalize(base)
	child = Normalize(child)
	if base == "" {
		return child
	}
	return base + "/" + child
}

func Join(parts ...string) string {
	if len(parts) == 0 {
		return ""
	}
	return ToSlash(filepath.Join(parts...))
}

func ParentPath(path string) string {
	parent := filepath.Dir(path)
	if parent == path {
		return ToSlash(path)
	}
	return ToSlash(parent)
}

func SplitPath(path string) (dir, base, name, ext string) {
	dir, base = filepath.Split(path)
	ext = filepath.Ext(base)
	name = strings.TrimSuffix(base, ext)
	return CleanPath(dir), base, name, ext
}

func Breadcrumbs(path string) []map[string]string {
	path = filepath.Clean(path)

	type segment struct {
		label string
		path  string
	}
	segments := make([]segment, 0)
	current := path
	for {
		parent := filepath.Dir(current)
		isRoot := parent == current

		label := filepath.Base(current)
		if isRoot {
			label = current
		}

		segments = append(segments, segment{label: label, path: current})
		if isRoot {
			break
		}
		current = parent
	}

	for left, right := 0, len(segments)-1; left < right; left, right = left+1, right-1 {
		segments[left], segments[right] = segments[right], segments[left]
	}

	crumbs := make([]map[string]string, len(segments))
	for index, seg := range segments {
		crumbs[index] = map[string]string{
			"label": seg.label,
			"path":  ToSlash(seg.path),
		}
	}
	return crumbs
}
````

````go
//go:build !windows

package platform

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func getSpecialFoldersPlatform() []contracts.SpecialFolder {
	home := getHomeDir()
	if home == "" {
		return nil
	}

	folders := []contracts.SpecialFolder{
		{Name: "Home", Path: home, Icon: "home"},
	}

	xdgDirs := []struct {
		name string
		icon string
		env  string
		def  string
	}{
		{name: "Desktop", icon: "desktop", env: "XDG_DESKTOP_DIR", def: "Desktop"},
		{name: "Documents", icon: "documents", env: "XDG_DOCUMENTS_DIR", def: "Documents"},
		{name: "Downloads", icon: "downloads", env: "XDG_DOWNLOAD_DIR", def: "Downloads"},
		{name: "Music", icon: "music", env: "XDG_MUSIC_DIR", def: "Music"},
		{name: "Pictures", icon: "pictures", env: "XDG_PICTURES_DIR", def: "Pictures"},
		{name: "Videos", icon: "videos", env: "XDG_VIDEOS_DIR", def: "Videos"},
	}

	for _, dir := range xdgDirs {
		path := os.Getenv(dir.env)
		if path == "" {
			path = filepath.Join(home, dir.def)
		}
		if stat, err := os.Stat(path); err == nil && stat.IsDir() {
			folders = append(folders, contracts.SpecialFolder{
				Name: dir.name,
				Path: filepath.ToSlash(path),
				Icon: dir.icon,
			})
		}
	}

	return folders
}
````

````go
var (

	folderDocuments       = windows.GUID{Data1: 0xFDD39AD0, Data2: 0x238F, Data3: 0x46AF, Data4: [8]byte{0xAD, 0xB4, 0x6C, 0x85, 0x48, 0x03, 0x69, 0xC7}}
	folderDownloads       = windows.GUID{Data1: 0x374DE290, Data2: 0x123F, Data3: 0x4565, Data4: [8]byte{0x91, 0x64, 0x39, 0xC4, 0x92, 0x5E, 0x46, 0x7B}}
	folderMusic           = windows.GUID{Data1: 0x4BD8D571, Data2: 0x6D19, Data3: 0x48D3, Data4: [8]byte{0xBE, 0x97, 0x42, 0x22, 0x20, 0x08, 0x0E, 0x43}}
	folderPictures        = windows.GUID{Data1: 0x33E28130, Data2: 0x4E1E, Data3: 0x4676, Data4: [8]byte{0x83, 0x5A, 0x98, 0x39, 0x5C, 0x3B, 0xC3, 0xBB}}
	folderVideos          = windows.GUID{Data1: 0x18989B1D, Data2: 0x99B5, Data3: 0x455B, Data4: [8]byte{0x84, 0x1C, 0xAB, 0x7C, 0x74, 0xE4, 0xDD, 0xFC}}
	specialFoldersShell32 = syscall.NewLazyDLL("shell32.dll")
)

var procSHGetKnownFolderPath = specialFoldersShell32.NewProc("SHGetKnownFolderPath")

func getSpecialFoldersPlatform() []contracts.SpecialFolder {
	folders := make([]contracts.SpecialFolder, 0, 7)

	appendIfPresent := func(name, path, icon string) {
		if path != "" {
			folders = append(folders, contracts.SpecialFolder{Name: name, Path: path, Icon: icon})
		}
	}

	appendIfPresent("Home", getHomeDir(), "home")
	appendIfPresent("Desktop", getKnownFolderPath(&folderDesktop), "desktop")
	appendIfPresent("Documents", getKnownFolderPath(&folderDocuments), "documents")
	appendIfPresent("Downloads", getKnownFolderPath(&folderDownloads), "downloads")
	appendIfPresent("Music", getKnownFolderPath(&folderMusic), "music")
	appendIfPresent("Pictures", getKnownFolderPath(&folderPictures), "pictures")
	appendIfPresent("Videos", getKnownFolderPath(&folderVideos), "videos")

	return folders
}

func getKnownFolderPath(folderID *windows.GUID) string {
	var path *uint16
	ret, _, _ := procSHGetKnownFolderPath.Call(
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(folderID)),
		0,
		0,
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&path)),
	)
	if ret != 0 {
		return ""
	}
	defer windows.CoTaskMemFree(unsafe.Pointer(path))

	result := syscall.UTF16ToString((*[1 << 16]uint16)(unsafe.Pointer(path))[:])
	return filepath.ToSlash(result)
}
````

## File: internal/platform/system_unix.go
````go
//go:build !windows

package platform

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"syscall"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func getOSTypeAndVersion() (contracts.OSType, string) {
	switch runtime.GOOS {
	case "linux":
		return contracts.OSLinux, readLinuxVersion()
	case "darwin":
		return contracts.OSDarwin, readDarwinVersion()
	default:
		return contracts.OSUnknown, "unknown"
	}
}

func readLinuxVersion() string {
	file, err := os.Open("/etc/os-release")
	if err == nil {
		defer file.Close()
		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(file)
		for scanner.Scan() {
			line := scanner.Text()
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "VERSION_ID=") {
				return strings.Trim(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "VERSION_ID="), `"`)
			}
		}
	}

	out, err := exec.Command("uname", "-r").Output()
	if err == nil {
		return strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
	}
	return "unknown"
}

func readDarwinVersion() string {
	out, err := exec.Command("sw_vers", "-productVersion").Output()
	if err == nil {
		return strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
	}
	return "unknown"
}

func getSystemDrive() string {
	return "/"
}

func listDrivesPlatform() []contracts.DriveInfo {
	if runtime.GOOS == "darwin" {
		return listDrivesDarwin()
	}
	return listDrivesLinux()
}

func listDrivesLinux() []contracts.DriveInfo {
	var drives []contracts.DriveInfo

	file, err := os.Open("/proc/mounts")
	if err != nil {
		return drives
	}
	defer file.Close()

	realFS := map[string]bool{
		"ext2": true, "ext3": true, "ext4": true,
		"xfs": true, "btrfs": true, "zfs": true,
		"vfat": true, "ntfs": true, "exfat": true,
		"fuseblk": true, "fuse": true,
	}

	seen := map[string]bool{}
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(file)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		fields := strings.Fields(scanner.Text())
		if len(fields) < 3 {
			continue
		}
		device, mount, fsType := fields[0], fields[1], fields[2]
		if !realFS[strings.ToLower(fsType)] || seen[mount] {
			continue
		}
		seen[mount] = true

		var stat syscall.Statfs_t
		if err := syscall.Statfs(mount, &stat); err != nil {
			continue
		}

		total := int64(stat.Blocks) * int64(stat.Bsize)
		free := int64(stat.Bfree) * int64(stat.Bsize)
		name := filepath.Base(device)
		if name == "." || name == string(filepath.Separator) {
			name = device
		}
		fs := fsType

		drives = append(drives, contracts.DriveInfo{
			Name:       name,
			Path:       mount,
			SchemeType: guessSchemeTypeLinux(device),
			TotalSpace: total,
			FreeSpace:  free,
			FileSystem: &fs,
		})
	}

	return drives
}

func guessSchemeTypeLinux(device string) contracts.SchemeType {
	if strings.Contains(device, ":") || strings.HasPrefix(device, "//") {
		return contracts.SchemeNetwork
	}
	if strings.Contains(device, "sr") || strings.Contains(device, "cdrom") {
		return contracts.SchemeCDROM
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(device, "tmpfs") || strings.HasPrefix(device, "ramfs") {
		return contracts.SchemeRAMDisk
	}

	name := filepath.Base(device)
	for _, candidate := range linuxBlockDeviceCandidates(name) {
		removablePath := fmt.Sprintf("/sys/block/%s/removable", candidate)
		data, err := os.ReadFile(removablePath)
		if err == nil && strings.TrimSpace(string(data)) == "1" {
			return contracts.SchemeRemovable
		}
	}
	return contracts.SchemeFixed
}

func linuxBlockDeviceCandidates(name string) []string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(name)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return nil
	}

	candidates := []string{trimmed}
	if prefix, ok := trimLinuxPSuffix(trimmed); ok {
		candidates = append(candidates, prefix)
	}
	if prefix := strings.TrimRight(trimmed, "0123456789"); prefix != "" && prefix != trimmed {
		candidates = append(candidates, prefix)
	}

	unique := make([]string, 0, len(candidates))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(candidates))
	for _, candidate := range candidates {
		if candidate == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := seen[candidate]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[candidate] = struct{}{}
		unique = append(unique, candidate)
	}
	return unique
}

func trimLinuxPSuffix(name string) (string, bool) {
	idx := strings.LastIndex(name, "p")
	if idx <= 0 || idx >= len(name)-1 {
		return "", false
	}
	suffix := name[idx+1:]
	if strings.Trim(suffix, "0123456789") != "" {
		return "", false
	}
	prefix := name[:idx]
	if !strings.ContainsAny(prefix, "0123456789") {
		return "", false
	}
	return prefix, true
}

func listDrivesDarwin() []contracts.DriveInfo {
	var drives []contracts.DriveInfo

	out, err := exec.Command("df", "-k").Output()
	if err != nil {
		return drives
	}

	lines := strings.Split(string(out), "\n")
	for i, line := range lines {
		if i == 0 || strings.TrimSpace(line) == "" {
			continue
		}
		fields := strings.Fields(line)
		if len(fields) < 9 {
			continue
		}
		device := fields[0]
		mount := strings.Join(fields[8:], " ")
		if !strings.HasPrefix(device, "/dev/") && !strings.HasPrefix(device, "//") {
			continue
		}

		var stat syscall.Statfs_t
		if err := syscall.Statfs(mount, &stat); err != nil {
			continue
		}

		total := int64(stat.Blocks) * int64(stat.Bsize)
		free := int64(stat.Bfree) * int64(stat.Bsize)
		name := filepath.Base(device)
		fsType := getFSTypeDarwin(mount)

		drives = append(drives, contracts.DriveInfo{
			Name:       name,
			Path:       mount,
			SchemeType: guessSchemeTypeDarwin(device),
			TotalSpace: total,
			FreeSpace:  free,
			FileSystem: &fsType,
		})
	}

	return drives
}

func getFSTypeDarwin(mount string) string {
	out, err := exec.Command("stat", "-f", "%T", mount).Output()
	if err != nil {
		return "unknown"
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
}

func guessSchemeTypeDarwin(device string) contracts.SchemeType {
	if strings.Contains(device, ":") || strings.HasPrefix(device, "//") {
		return contracts.SchemeNetwork
	}
	if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(device), "disk") {
		return contracts.SchemeFixed
	}
	return contracts.SchemeUnknown
}
````

## File: internal/platform/system_windows.go
````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
	"golang.org/x/sys/windows/registry"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func getOSTypeAndVersion() (contracts.OSType, string) {
	key, err := registry.OpenKey(registry.LOCAL_MACHINE,
		`SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion`, registry.QUERY_VALUE)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.OSWindows, "unknown"
	}
	defer key.Close()

	major, _, _ := key.GetIntegerValue("CurrentMajorVersionNumber")
	minor, _, _ := key.GetIntegerValue("CurrentMinorVersionNumber")
	build, _, _ := key.GetStringValue("CurrentBuildNumber")
	ubr, _, _ := key.GetIntegerValue("UBR")

	version := ""
	if ubr > 0 {
		version = strings.Join([]string{
			intToStr(int(major)), intToStr(int(minor)), build, intToStr(int(ubr)),
		}, ".")
	} else {
		version = strings.Join([]string{intToStr(int(major)), intToStr(int(minor)), build}, ".")
	}

	return contracts.OSWindows, version
}

func getSystemDrive() string {
	if drive := os.Getenv("SystemDrive"); drive != "" {
		return driveRootReference(drive)
	}
	return "filesystem://c"
}

func listDrivesPlatform() []contracts.DriveInfo {
	var drives []contracts.DriveInfo

	buf := make([]uint16, 256)
	n, err := windows.GetLogicalDriveStrings(uint32(len(buf)), &buf[0])
	if err == nil && n > 0 {
		roots := strings.Split(syscall.UTF16ToString(buf[:n]), "\x00")
		for _, root := range roots {
			root = strings.TrimSpace(root)
			if root == "" {
				continue
			}
			// Build drive info and skip virtual/WinFsp mounts so they are hidden from the UI.
			// Some WinFSP-backed filesystems expose a filesystem name or volume name
			// containing "winfsp"; detect and skip those drives here.
			info := buildDriveInfo(root)
			fsName := ""
			if info.FileSystem != nil {
				fsName = strings.ToLower(*info.FileSystem)
			}
			if strings.Contains(fsName, "winfsp") || strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(info.Name), "winfsp") {
				// skip this drive
				continue
			}
			drives = append(drives, info)
		}
	}

	return drives
}

func buildDriveInfo(root string) contracts.DriveInfo {
	rootPtr, _ := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(root)
	schemeType := toSchemeType(windows.GetDriveType(rootPtr))
	name := strings.TrimSuffix(root, `\`)

	var freeBytesAvailable, totalBytes, totalFreeBytes uint64
	_ = windows.GetDiskFreeSpaceEx(rootPtr,
		(*uint64)(unsafe.Pointer(&freeBytesAvailable)),
		(*uint64)(unsafe.Pointer(&totalBytes)),
		(*uint64)(unsafe.Pointer(&totalFreeBytes)))

	var fsNameBuf [256]uint16
	var volNameBuf [256]uint16
	err := windows.GetVolumeInformation(rootPtr,
		&volNameBuf[0], uint32(len(volNameBuf)),
		nil, nil, nil,
		&fsNameBuf[0], uint32(len(fsNameBuf)))

	var fsName *string
	if err == nil {
		fs := syscall.UTF16ToString(fsNameBuf[:])
		if fs != "" {
			fsName = &fs
		}
		vol := syscall.UTF16ToString(volNameBuf[:])
		if vol != "" {
			name = vol + " (" + name + ")"
		}
	}

	return contracts.DriveInfo{
		Name:       name,
		Path:       driveRootReference(root),
		SchemeType: schemeType,
		TotalSpace: int64(totalBytes),
		FreeSpace:  int64(totalFreeBytes),
		FileSystem: fsName,
	}
}

func driveRootReference(root string) string {
	normalized := strings.TrimSpace(filepath.ToSlash(root))
	if len(normalized) >= 2 && normalized[1] == ':' {
		return "filesystem://" + strings.ToLower(normalized[:1])
	}
	return normalized
}

func toSchemeType(kind uint32) contracts.SchemeType {
	const (
		driveRemovable = 2
		driveFixed     = 3
		driveRemote    = 4
		driveCDROM     = 5
		driveRAMDisk   = 6
	)
	switch kind {
	case driveRemovable:
		return contracts.SchemeRemovable
	case driveFixed:
		return contracts.SchemeFixed
	case driveRemote:
		return contracts.SchemeNetwork
	case driveCDROM:
		return contracts.SchemeCDROM
	case driveRAMDisk:
		return contracts.SchemeRAMDisk
	default:
		return contracts.SchemeUnknown
	}
}

func intToStr(n int) string {
	if n == 0 {
		return "0"
	}
	neg := n < 0
	if neg {
		n = -n
	}
	buf := make([]byte, 0, 20)
	for n > 0 {
		buf = append([]byte{byte('0' + n%10)}, buf...)
		n /= 10
	}
	if neg {
		buf = append([]byte{'-'}, buf...)
	}
	return string(buf)
}

// JoinMountNamespace is not supported on Windows. Return an informative error.
func JoinMountNamespace(nsPath string) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("join mount namespace not supported on Windows: %s", nsPath)
}
````

## File: internal/platform/trash_unix.go
````go
//go:build !windows

package platform

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

func MoveToTrash(path string) error {
	abs, err := filepath.Abs(path)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: cannot resolve path %q: %w", path, err)
	}
	if _, err := os.Lstat(abs); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: %w", err)
	}

	switch runtime.GOOS {
	case "darwin":
		return moveToTrashDarwin(abs)
	default:
		return moveToTrashFreedesktop(abs)
	}
}

func moveToTrashDarwin(abs string) error {
	home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: cannot determine home directory: %w", err)
	}
	trashDir := filepath.Join(home, ".Trash")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(trashDir, 0700); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: cannot create ~/.Trash: %w", err)
	}

	dst := uniqueTrashPath(trashDir, filepath.Base(abs))
	if err := renameCrossDevice(abs, dst); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func moveToTrashFreedesktop(abs string) error {
	home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: cannot determine home directory: %w", err)
	}

	trashFilesDir := filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share", "Trash", "files")
	trashInfoDir := filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share", "Trash", "info")

	for _, dir := range []string{trashFilesDir, trashInfoDir} {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0700); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("trash: cannot create trash directory %s: %w", dir, err)
		}
	}

	baseName := uniqueTrashBaseName(trashFilesDir, trashInfoDir, filepath.Base(abs))
	dst := filepath.Join(trashFilesDir, baseName)
	infoPath := filepath.Join(trashInfoDir, baseName+".trashinfo")

	infoContent := fmt.Sprintf(
		"[Trash Info]\nPath=%s\nDeletionDate=%s\n",
		abs,
		time.Now().Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05"),
	)
	if err := os.WriteFile(infoPath, []byte(infoContent), 0600); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: cannot write .trashinfo: %w", err)
	}

	if err := renameCrossDevice(abs, dst); err != nil {
		_ = os.Remove(infoPath)
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func renameCrossDevice(src, dst string) error {
	err := os.Rename(src, dst)
	if err == nil {
		return nil
	}

	linkErr := &os.LinkError{}
	if errors.As(err, &linkErr) && errors.Is(linkErr.Err, syscall.EXDEV) {
		return crossDeviceMoveToTrash(src, dst)
	}
	return err
}

func crossDeviceMoveToTrash(src, dst string) error {
	info, err := os.Lstat(src)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if info.IsDir() {
		if err := copyDirAll(src, dst); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("cross-device copy failed: %w", err)
		}
	} else if err := copyFileData(src, dst, info.Mode()); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("cross-device copy failed: %w", err)
	}
	return os.RemoveAll(src)
}

func copyDirAll(src, dst string) error {
	return filepath.Walk(src, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel, _ := filepath.Rel(src, path)
		target := filepath.Join(dst, rel)
		if info.IsDir() {
			return os.MkdirAll(target, info.Mode())
		}
		return copyFileData(path, target, info.Mode())
	})
}

func copyFileData(src, dst string, mode os.FileMode) error {
	in, err := os.Open(src)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer in.Close()

	out, err := os.OpenFile(dst, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_TRUNC, mode)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer out.Close()

	if _, err := io.Copy(out, in); err != nil {
		_ = os.Remove(dst)
		return err
	}
	return out.Close()
}

func uniqueTrashPath(dir, baseName string) string {
	candidate := filepath.Join(dir, baseName)
	if _, err := os.Lstat(candidate); os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return candidate
	}
	ext := filepath.Ext(baseName)
	stem := strings.TrimSuffix(baseName, ext)
	for i := 2; ; i++ {
		candidate = filepath.Join(dir, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%d)%s", stem, i, ext))
		if _, err := os.Lstat(candidate); os.IsNotExist(err) {
			return candidate
		}
	}
}

func uniqueTrashBaseName(filesDir, infoDir, baseName string) string {
	ext := filepath.Ext(baseName)
	stem := strings.TrimSuffix(baseName, ext)

	candidate := baseName
	for i := 2; ; i++ {
		_, errFiles := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(filesDir, candidate))
		_, errInfo := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(infoDir, candidate+".trashinfo"))
		if os.IsNotExist(errFiles) && os.IsNotExist(errInfo) {
			return candidate
		}
		candidate = fmt.Sprintf("%s (%d)%s", stem, i, ext)
	}
}
````

## File: internal/platform/trash_windows.go
````go
//go:build windows

package platform

import (
	"fmt"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"
)

var (
	shell32         = syscall.NewLazyDLL("shell32.dll")
	shFileOperation = shell32.NewProc("SHFileOperationW")
)

type shFileOpStruct struct {
	hwnd                  uintptr
	wFunc                 uint32
	_                     [4]byte
	pFrom                 uintptr
	pTo                   uintptr
	fFlags                uint16
	_                     [2]byte
	fAnyOperationsAborted int32
	hNameMappings         uintptr
	lpszProgressTitle     uintptr
}

const (
	foDelete        uint32 = 0x0003
	fofSilent       uint16 = 0x0004
	fofNoConfirm    uint16 = 0x0010
	fofAllowUndo    uint16 = 0x0040
	fofNoErrorUI    uint16 = 0x0400
	fofWantNukeWarn uint16 = 0x4000
)

func MoveToTrash(path string) error {
	path = normalizeShellTrashPath(path)
	if path == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: empty path")
	}

	from, err := syscall.UTF16FromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: invalid path %q: %w", path, err)
	}
	from = append(from, 0)

	op := shFileOpStruct{
		wFunc:  foDelete,
		pFrom:  uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&from[0])),
		fFlags: fofAllowUndo | fofNoConfirm | fofSilent | fofNoErrorUI | fofWantNukeWarn,
	}

	ret, _, _ := shFileOperation.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&op)))
	if ret != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: SHFileOperationW returned error code 0x%X (path=%q)", ret, path)
	}
	if op.fAnyOperationsAborted != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("trash: operation was aborted by the user or system")
	}
	return nil
}

func normalizeShellTrashPath(path string) string {
	p := strings.TrimSpace(path)
	if p == "" {
		return ""
	}
	p = filepath.FromSlash(p)
	p = filepath.Clean(p)
	return strings.TrimPrefix(p, `\\?\`)
}
````

````go
package runtime

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	internalplatform "wails-app/internal/platform"
)

const dirStreamBatchSize = 256

type dirStreamMetaEvent struct {
	StreamID   string `json:"streamId"`
	PaneID     string `json:"paneId"`
	Path       string `json:"path"`
	ShowHidden bool   `json:"showHidden"`
}

type dirStreamBatchEvent struct {
	StreamID string               `json:"streamId"`
	PaneID   string               `json:"paneId"`
	Path     string               `json:"path"`
	Entries  []contracts.FileInfo `json:"entries"`
}

type dirStreamDoneEvent struct {
	StreamID    string `json:"streamId"`
	PaneID      string `json:"paneId"`
	Path        string `json:"path"`
	EntryCount  int    `json:"entryCount"`
	TotalSize   int64  `json:"totalSize"`
	DurationMS  int64  `json:"durationMs"`
	FromElevate bool   `json:"fromElevate"`
}

type dirStreamErrorEvent struct {
	StreamID string `json:"streamId"`
	PaneID   string `json:"paneId"`
	Path     string `json:"path"`
	Error    string `json:"error"`
}

type ElevatedListFunc func(path string, showHidden bool) ([]contracts.FileInfo, error)
type BuildFileInfoFunc func(name, fullPath string, info os.FileInfo, hidden bool) contracts.FileInfo
type IsHiddenFunc func(name, fullPath string) bool
type ResolvePublicPathFunc func(path string) (string, error)
type VFSListDirFunc func(path string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error)
type IsVFSPathFunc func(path string) bool

type DirStreamService struct {
	mu           sync.Mutex
	streams      map[string]context.CancelFunc
	emitEvent    func(string, interface{})
	elevatedList ElevatedListFunc
	buildFile    BuildFileInfoFunc
	isHidden     IsHiddenFunc
	resolvePath  ResolvePublicPathFunc
	vfsListDir   VFSListDirFunc
	isVFSPath    IsVFSPathFunc
}

func NewDirStreamService(
	emitEvent func(string, interface{}),
	elevatedList ElevatedListFunc,
	buildFile BuildFileInfoFunc,
	isHidden IsHiddenFunc,
	resolvePath ResolvePublicPathFunc,
) *DirStreamService {
	return &DirStreamService{
		streams:      make(map[string]context.CancelFunc),
		emitEvent:    emitEvent,
		elevatedList: elevatedList,
		buildFile:    buildFile,
		isHidden:     isHidden,
		resolvePath:  resolvePath,
	}
}

func (s *DirStreamService) SetVFS(listDir VFSListDirFunc, isVFS IsVFSPathFunc) {
	s.vfsListDir = listDir
	s.isVFSPath = isVFS
}

func (s *DirStreamService) Emit(name string, data interface{}) {
	if s.emitEvent != nil {
		s.emitEvent(name, data)
	}
}

func (s *DirStreamService) Register(streamID string, cancel context.CancelFunc) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.streams[streamID] = cancel
	s.mu.Unlock()
}

func (s *DirStreamService) Unregister(streamID string) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	delete(s.streams, streamID)
	s.mu.Unlock()
}

func (s *DirStreamService) Start(paneID, path string, showHidden bool) (string, error) {
	if path == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("path is required")
	}
	streamID := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d", paneID, time.Now().UnixNano())
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	s.Register(streamID, cancel)
	go s.run(ctx, streamID, paneID, internalplatform.ToSlash(path), showHidden)
	return streamID, nil
}

func (s *DirStreamService) Cancel(streamID string) {
	if streamID == "" {
		return
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	cancel := s.streams[streamID]
	delete(s.streams, streamID)
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if cancel != nil {
		cancel()
	}
}

func (s *DirStreamService) CancelAll() {
	s.mu.Lock()
	cancels := make([]context.CancelFunc, 0, len(s.streams))
	for id, cancel := range s.streams {
		delete(s.streams, id)
		if cancel != nil {
			cancels = append(cancels, cancel)
		}
	}
	s.mu.Unlock()
	for _, cancel := range cancels {
		cancel()
	}
}

func (s *DirStreamService) run(ctx context.Context, streamID, paneID, path string, showHidden bool) {
	defer s.Unregister(streamID)

	started := time.Now()
	var entryCount int
	var totalSize int64

	s.Emit("fs:listStream:meta", dirStreamMetaEvent{
		StreamID:   streamID,
		PaneID:     paneID,
		Path:       path,
		ShowHidden: showHidden,
	})

	scan := s.scanDirectoryStream
	if pathref.IsSearch(path) {
		scan = s.scanSearchStream
	} else if s.isVFSPath != nil && s.isVFSPath(path) {
		scan = s.scanVFSStream
	}

	err := scan(ctx, path, showHidden, dirStreamBatchSize, func(batch []contracts.FileInfo, batchSize int64) {
		entryCount += len(batch)
		totalSize += batchSize
		s.Emit("fs:listStream:batch", dirStreamBatchEvent{
			StreamID: streamID,
			PaneID:   paneID,
			Path:     path,
			Entries:  batch,
		})
	})
	if err == nil {
		s.Emit("fs:listStream:done", dirStreamDoneEvent{
			StreamID:   streamID,
			PaneID:     paneID,
			Path:       path,
			EntryCount: entryCount,
			TotalSize:  totalSize,
			DurationMS: time.Since(started).Milliseconds(),
		})
		return
	}
	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		return
	}
	if s.elevatedList != nil {
		entries, elevErr := s.elevatedList(path, showHidden)
		if elevErr == nil {
			if entries == nil {
				entries = []contracts.FileInfo{}
			}
			size := int64(0)
			for _, fi := range entries {
				size += fi.Size
			}
			s.Emit("fs:listStream:batch", dirStreamBatchEvent{
				StreamID: streamID,
				PaneID:   paneID,
				Path:     path,
				Entries:  entries,
			})
			s.Emit("fs:listStream:done", dirStreamDoneEvent{
				StreamID:    streamID,
				PaneID:      paneID,
				Path:        path,
				EntryCount:  len(entries),
				TotalSize:   size,
				DurationMS:  time.Since(started).Milliseconds(),
				FromElevate: true,
			})
			return
		}
	}

	s.Emit("fs:listStream:error", dirStreamErrorEvent{
		StreamID: streamID,
		PaneID:   paneID,
		Path:     path,
		Error:    err.Error(),
	})
}

func (s *DirStreamService) scanVFSStream(
	ctx context.Context,
	path string,
	showHidden bool,
	chunkSize int,
	onBatch func(batch []contracts.FileInfo, batchSize int64),
) error {
	if s.vfsListDir == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("vfs listing not available")
	}
	listing, err := s.vfsListDir(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	batch := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, chunkSize)
	batchSize := int64(0)
	for _, fi := range listing.Entries {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return context.Canceled
		default:
		}
		if !showHidden && fi.IsHidden {
			continue
		}
		batch = append(batch, fi)
		batchSize += fi.Size
		if len(batch) >= chunkSize {
			onBatch(batch, batchSize)
			batch = make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, chunkSize)
			batchSize = 0
		}
	}
	if len(batch) > 0 {
		onBatch(batch, batchSize)
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *DirStreamService) scanDirectoryStream(
	ctx context.Context,
	path string,
	showHidden bool,
	chunkSize int,
	onBatch func(batch []contracts.FileInfo, batchSize int64),
) error {
	nativePath, err := s.resolveNativePath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	dir, err := os.Open(nativePath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer dir.Close()

	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return context.Canceled
		default:
		}

		infos, readErr := dir.Readdir(chunkSize)
		if len(infos) > 0 {
			batch := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(infos))
			batchSize := int64(0)
			for _, info := range infos {
				name := info.Name()
				nativeFullPath := internalplatform.ToSlash(filepath.Join(nativePath, name))
				publicFullPath := joinPublicPath(path, name)
				hidden := s.isHidden != nil && s.isHidden(name, nativeFullPath)
				if !showHidden && hidden {
					continue
				}
				fi := s.buildFile(name, nativeFullPath, info, hidden)
				fi.Path = publicFullPath
				batch = append(batch, fi)
				batchSize += fi.Size
			}
			if len(batch) > 0 {
				onBatch(batch, batchSize)
			}
		}
		if readErr != nil {
			if errors.Is(readErr, io.EOF) {
				return nil
			}
			return readErr
		}
	}
}

func (s *DirStreamService) scanSearchStream(
	ctx context.Context,
	path string,
	showHidden bool,
	chunkSize int,
	onBatch func(batch []contracts.FileInfo, batchSize int64),
) error {
	if path == pathref.SearchScheme {
		return nil
	}

	query, ok := pathref.ParseSearch(path)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid search alias path")
	}

	basePath := internalplatform.ToSlash(query.BasePath)
	nativeBasePath, err := s.resolveNativePath(query.BasePath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	batch := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, chunkSize)
	batchSize := int64(0)
	flush := func() {
		if len(batch) == 0 {
			return
		}
		out := append([]contracts.FileInfo(nil), batch...)
		onBatch(out, batchSize)
		batch = batch[:0]
		batchSize = 0
	}

	err = filepath.WalkDir(nativeBasePath, func(currentPath string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return context.Canceled
		default:
		}

		if walkErr != nil {
			if errors.Is(walkErr, fs.ErrPermission) || errors.Is(walkErr, os.ErrPermission) {
				if entry != nil && entry.IsDir() {
					return filepath.SkipDir
				}
				return nil
			}
			return nil
		}

		if currentPath == nativeBasePath {
			return nil
		}

		name := entry.Name()
		fullPath := internalplatform.ToSlash(currentPath)
		publicFullPath := pathref.FromNativePath(fullPath)
		hidden := s.isHidden != nil && s.isHidden(name, fullPath)
		if !showHidden && hidden {
			if entry.IsDir() {
				return filepath.SkipDir
			}
			return nil
		}

		matched, matchErr := pathref.MatchSearchPattern(query.Pattern, name)
		if matchErr != nil {
			return matchErr
		}
		if matched {
			info, infoErr := entry.Info()
			if infoErr == nil {
				fi := s.buildFile(name, fullPath, info, hidden)
				fi.Path = publicFullPath
				fi.SearchBasePath = basePath
				fi.SearchPattern = query.Pattern
				fi.SearchParentPath = pathref.FromNativePath(internalplatform.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(fullPath)))
				batch = append(batch, fi)
				batchSize += fi.Size
				if len(batch) >= chunkSize {
					flush()
				}
			}
		}

		if !query.Recursive && entry.IsDir() {
			return filepath.SkipDir
		}

		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	flush()
	return nil
}

func (s *DirStreamService) resolveNativePath(path string) (string, error) {
	if s.resolvePath != nil {
		return s.resolvePath(path)
	}
	return pathref.ToNativePath(path), nil
}

func joinPublicPath(basePath string, name string) string {
	trimmedBase := strings.TrimRight(internalplatform.ToSlash(basePath), "/")
	if trimmedBase == "" || trimmedBase == "/" {
		return "/" + name
	}
	return trimmedBase + "/" + name
}
````

## File: internal/runtime/native_filedrop.go
````go
package runtime

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	wailsruntime "github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/pkg/runtime"
)

func BindNativeFileDrop(ctx context.Context, onDrop func(x, y int, paths []string)) {
	wailsruntime.EventsOn(ctx, "wails:file-drop", func(optionalData ...interface{}) {
		fmt.Println("[wails:file-drop] Backend listener fired!")
		x, y, paths, ok := parseNativeFileDrop(optionalData)
		if !ok {
			return
		}

		fmt.Printf("[wails:file-drop] x=%d, y=%d, paths=%v\n", x, y, paths)
		onDrop(x, y, paths)
	})
}

func parseNativeFileDrop(optionalData []interface{}) (int, int, []string, bool) {
	if len(optionalData) == 0 {
		return 0, 0, nil, false
	}

	data, ok := optionalData[0].(map[string]interface{})
	if !ok {
		return 0, 0, nil, false
	}

	fmt.Printf("[wails:file-drop] Native event received: %+v\n", data)

	x := 0
	y := 0
	if xVal, ok := data["x"].(float64); ok {
		x = int(xVal)
	}
	if yVal, ok := data["y"].(float64); ok {
		y = int(yVal)
	}

	paths := make([]string, 0)
	if pathsVal, ok := data["paths"].([]interface{}); ok {
		for _, pathValue := range pathsVal {
			if path, ok := pathValue.(string); ok {
				paths = append(paths, path)
			}
		}
	}

	return x, y, paths, true
}
````

````go
package runtime

import (
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/fsnotify/fsnotify"

	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	internalplatform "wails-app/internal/platform"
)

type paneDirectoryChangedEvent struct {
	PaneID string `json:"paneId"`
	Path   string `json:"path"`
}

type PaneWatchManager struct {
	emitEvent    func(string, interface{})
	resolvePath  func(string) (string, error)
	toPublicPath func(string) string
	mu           sync.Mutex
	watcher      *fsnotify.Watcher
	panePaths    map[string]string
	panePublic   map[string]string
	pathRef      map[string]int
	paneDebounce map[string]*time.Timer
	closed       bool
}

func NewPaneWatchManager(emitEvent func(string, interface{}), resolvePath func(string) (string, error), toPublicPath func(string) string) *PaneWatchManager {
	w, err := fsnotify.NewWatcher()
	if err != nil {
		return &PaneWatchManager{
			emitEvent:    emitEvent,
			resolvePath:  resolvePath,
			toPublicPath: toPublicPath,
			panePaths:    make(map[string]string),
			panePublic:   make(map[string]string),
			pathRef:      make(map[string]int),
			paneDebounce: make(map[string]*time.Timer),
		}
	}

	manager := &PaneWatchManager{
		emitEvent:    emitEvent,
		resolvePath:  resolvePath,
		toPublicPath: toPublicPath,
		watcher:      w,
		panePaths:    make(map[string]string),
		panePublic:   make(map[string]string),
		pathRef:      make(map[string]int),
		paneDebounce: make(map[string]*time.Timer),
	}
	go manager.loop()
	return manager
}

func (m *PaneWatchManager) Close() {
	m.mu.Lock()
	if m.closed {
		m.mu.Unlock()
		return
	}
	m.closed = true
	for paneID, timer := range m.paneDebounce {
		timer.Stop()
		delete(m.paneDebounce, paneID)
	}
	w := m.watcher
	m.watcher = nil
	m.mu.Unlock()

	if w != nil {
		_ = w.Close()
	}
}

func (m *PaneWatchManager) SetPaneDirectory(paneID, path string) error {
	watchPath, err := m.normalizeWatchPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	publicPath := m.toEventPath(watchPath)

	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	if m.closed {
		return nil
	}

	prev := m.panePaths[paneID]
	if prev == watchPath && m.panePublic[paneID] == publicPath {
		return nil
	}
	if prev != "" {
		m.removeWatchLocked(prev)
	}
	if watchPath == "" {
		delete(m.panePaths, paneID)
		delete(m.panePublic, paneID)
		return nil
	}

	m.panePaths[paneID] = watchPath
	m.panePublic[paneID] = publicPath
	return m.addWatchLocked(watchPath)
}

func (m *PaneWatchManager) loop() {
	for {
		m.mu.Lock()
		w := m.watcher
		closed := m.closed || w == nil
		m.mu.Unlock()
		if closed {
			return
		}

		select {
		case evt, ok := <-w.Events:
			if !ok {
				return
			}
			if evt.Op&(fsnotify.Create|fsnotify.Write|fsnotify.Remove|fsnotify.Rename|fsnotify.Chmod) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			affectedDir := normalizeNativeWatchPath(filepath.Dir(evt.Name))
			if affectedDir == "" {
				continue
			}
			m.scheduleForAffectedDir(affectedDir)
		case _, ok := <-w.Errors:
			if !ok {
				return
			}
		}
	}
}

func (m *PaneWatchManager) scheduleForAffectedDir(dir string) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()

	if m.closed {
		return
	}

	for paneID, panePath := range m.panePaths {
		if panePath != dir {
			continue
		}
		if existing := m.paneDebounce[paneID]; existing != nil {
			existing.Stop()
		}
		id := paneID
		path := m.panePublic[paneID]
		m.paneDebounce[paneID] = time.AfterFunc(200*time.Millisecond, func() {
			if m.emitEvent != nil {
				m.emitEvent("fs:directoryChanged", paneDirectoryChangedEvent{
					PaneID: id,
					Path:   path,
				})
			}
		})
	}
}

func (m *PaneWatchManager) addWatchLocked(path string) error {
	if m.pathRef[path] > 0 {
		m.pathRef[path]++
		return nil
	}
	if m.watcher != nil {
		if err := m.watcher.Add(path); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	m.pathRef[path] = 1
	return nil
}

func (m *PaneWatchManager) removeWatchLocked(path string) {
	count := m.pathRef[path]
	if count <= 1 {
		delete(m.pathRef, path)
		if m.watcher != nil {
			_ = m.watcher.Remove(path)
		}
		return
	}
	m.pathRef[path] = count - 1
}

func (m *PaneWatchManager) normalizeWatchPath(path string) (string, error) {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(path)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return "", nil
	}
	if pathref.IsRegistry(trimmed) || (pathref.IsAlias(trimmed) && !pathref.IsMemory(trimmed)) {
		return "", nil
	}
	if m.resolvePath != nil {
		resolved, err := m.resolvePath(trimmed)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		trimmed = resolved
	}
	return normalizeNativeWatchPath(trimmed), nil
}

func (m *PaneWatchManager) toEventPath(path string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(path)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return ""
	}
	if m.toPublicPath != nil {
		if publicPath := strings.TrimSpace(m.toPublicPath(trimmed)); publicPath != "" {
			return pathref.Normalize(publicPath)
		}
	}
	return normalizeNativeWatchPath(trimmed)
}

func normalizeNativeWatchPath(path string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(path)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return ""
	}
	if pathref.IsRegistry(trimmed) || (pathref.IsAlias(trimmed) && !pathref.IsMemory(trimmed)) {
		return ""
	}
	return internalplatform.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(trimmed))
}
````

## File: internal/utility/clipboard_windows.go
````go
//go:build windows

package utility

import (
	"fmt"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"
)

var (
	user32           = syscall.NewLazyDLL("user32.dll")
	shell32          = syscall.NewLazyDLL("shell32.dll")
	openClipboard    = user32.NewProc("OpenClipboard")
	closeClipboard   = user32.NewProc("CloseClipboard")
	getClipboardData = user32.NewProc("GetClipboardData")
	dragQueryFile    = shell32.NewProc("DragQueryFileW")
)

func GetFilePaths() ([]string, error) {
	ret, _, err := openClipboard.Call()
	if ret == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open clipboard: %w", err)
	}
	defer closeClipboard.Call()

	const cfHdrop = 15
	ret, _, err = getClipboardData.Call(cfHdrop)
	hDrop := uintptr(ret)
	if hDrop == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no clipboard data in CF_HDROP format")
	}

	ret, _, _ = dragQueryFile.Call(hDrop, ^uintptr(0), 0, 0)
	fileCount := ret
	if fileCount == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no files in clipboard drag data")
	}

	paths := make([]string, 0, fileCount)
	for index := uintptr(0); index < fileCount; index++ {
		ret, _, _ = dragQueryFile.Call(hDrop, index, 0, 0)
		bufferSize := ret
		if bufferSize == 0 {
			continue
		}

		pathBuf := make([]uint16, bufferSize+1)
		dragQueryFile.Call(hDrop, index, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&pathBuf[0])), bufferSize+1)

		path := syscall.UTF16ToString(pathBuf)
		if path != "" {
			paths = append(paths, path)
		}
	}

	if len(paths) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("could not extract file paths from clipboard")
	}
	return paths, nil
}

func ReadText() (string, error) {
	ret, _, err := openClipboard.Call()
	if ret == 0 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to open clipboard: %w", err)
	}
	defer closeClipboard.Call()

	const cfUnicodeText = 13
	ret, _, err = getClipboardData.Call(cfUnicodeText)
	if ret == 0 {
		ret, _, _ = getClipboardData.Call(1)
		if ret == 0 {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("no text in clipboard")
		}
	}
	return "[clipboard text data available]", nil
}
````
