````markdown
# Webviewloader

Webviewloader is a port of [OpenWebView2Loader](https://github.com/jchv/OpenWebView2Loader) to Go.

It is intended to be feature-complete with the original WebView2Loader distributed with
the WebView2 NuGet package, but some features are intentionally not implemented.

## Status

- [x] CompareBrowserVersions
- [x] CreateCoreWebView2Environment
- [x] CreateCoreWebView2EnvironmentWithOptions
- [x] GetAvailableCoreWebView2BrowserVersionString

## Not implemented features

- Registry Overrides of Parameters
- Env Variable Overrides of Parameters
- Does not incorporate `GetCurrentPackageInfo` to search for an installed runtime
````

## File: third_party/go-webview2/webviewloader/syscall.go
````go
//go:build windows

package webviewloader

import (
	"fmt"
	"syscall"
	"unicode/utf16"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

var (
	modkernel32     = windows.NewLazySystemDLL("kernel32.dll")
	procGlobalAlloc = modkernel32.NewProc("GlobalAlloc")
	procGlobalFree  = modkernel32.NewProc("GlobalFree")

	modversion                 = windows.NewLazySystemDLL("version.dll")
	procGetFileVersionInfoSize = modversion.NewProc("GetFileVersionInfoSizeW")
	procGetFileVersionInfo     = modversion.NewProc("GetFileVersionInfoW")
	procVerQueryValue          = modversion.NewProc("VerQueryValueW")

	modole32           = windows.NewLazySystemDLL("ole32.dll")
	procCoTaskMemAlloc = modole32.NewProc("CoTaskMemAlloc")
)

func getFileVersionInfo(path string) ([]byte, error) {
	lptstrFilename, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	size, _, err := procGetFileVersionInfoSize.Call(
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(lptstrFilename)),
		0,
	)

	err = maskErrorSuccess(err)
	if size == 0 && err == nil {
		err = fmt.Errorf("GetFileVersionInfoSize failed")
	}

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	data := make([]byte, size)
	ret, _, err := procGetFileVersionInfo.Call(
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(lptstrFilename)),
		0,
		uintptr(size),
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&data[0])),
	)

	err = maskErrorSuccess(err)
	if ret == 0 && err == nil {
		err = fmt.Errorf("GetFileVersionInfo failed")
	}

	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return data, nil
}

func verQueryValueString(block []byte, subBlock string) (string, error) {
	// Allocate memory from native side to make sure the block doesn't get moved
	// because we get a pointer into that memory block from the native verQueryValue
	// call back.
	pBlock := globalAlloc(0, uint32(len(block)))
	defer globalFree(unsafe.Pointer(pBlock))

	// Copy the memory region into native side memory
	copy(unsafe.Slice((*byte)(pBlock), len(block)), block)

	lpSubBlock, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(subBlock)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	var lplpBuffer unsafe.Pointer
	var puLen uint
	ret, _, err := procVerQueryValue.Call(
		uintptr(pBlock),
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(lpSubBlock)),
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&lplpBuffer)),
		uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&puLen)),
	)

	err = maskErrorSuccess(err)
	if ret == 0 && err == nil {
		err = fmt.Errorf("VerQueryValue failed")
	}

	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	if puLen <= 1 {
		return "", nil
	}
	puLen -= 1 // Remove Null-Terminator

	wchar := unsafe.Slice((*uint16)(lplpBuffer), puLen)
	return string(utf16.Decode(wchar)), nil
}

func globalAlloc(uFlags uint, dwBytes uint32) unsafe.Pointer {
	ret, _, _ := procGlobalAlloc.Call(
		uintptr(uFlags),
		uintptr(dwBytes))

	if ret == 0 {
		panic("globalAlloc failed")
	}

	return unsafe.Pointer(ret)
}

func globalFree(data unsafe.Pointer) {
	ret, _, _ := procGlobalFree.Call(uintptr(data))
	if ret != 0 {
		panic("globalFree failed")
	}
}

func maskErrorSuccess(err error) error {
	if err == windows.ERROR_SUCCESS {
		return nil
	}
	return err
}

func coTaskMemAlloc(size int) unsafe.Pointer {
	ret, _, _ := procCoTaskMemAlloc.Call(
		uintptr(size))

	if ret == 0 {
		panic("coTaskMemAlloc failed")
	}
	return unsafe.Pointer(ret)
}
````

## File: third_party/go-webview2/webviewloader/version.go
````go
//go:build windows && !native_webview2loader

package webviewloader

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

// UsingGoWebview2Loader is set to true when the go webview2loader is used.
var UsingGoWebview2Loader bool

// CompareBrowserVersions will compare the 2 given versions and return:
//
//	-1 = v1 < v2
//	 0 = v1 == v2
//	 1 = v1 > v2
func CompareBrowserVersions(v1 string, v2 string) (int, error) {
	v, err := parseVersion(v1)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("v1 invalid: %w", err)
	}

	w, err := parseVersion(v2)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("v2 invalid: %w", err)
	}

	return v.compare(w), nil
}

// GetAvailableCoreWebView2BrowserVersionString get the browser version info including channel name
// if it is the WebView2 Runtime.
// Channel names are Beta, Dev, and Canary.
func GetAvailableCoreWebView2BrowserVersionString(browserExecutableFolder string) (string, error) {
	if browserExecutableFolder != "" {
		clientPath, err := findEmbeddedClientDll(browserExecutableFolder)
		if errors.Is(err, errNoClientDLLFound) {
			// WebView2 is not found
			return "", nil
		} else if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}

		return findEmbeddedBrowserVersion(clientPath)
	}

	_, version, err := findInstalledClientDll(false)
	if errors.Is(err, errNoClientDLLFound) {
		return "", nil
	} else if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	return version.String(), nil
}

type version struct {
	major int
	minor int
	patch int
	build int

	channel string
}

func (v version) String() string {
	vv := fmt.Sprintf("%d.%d.%d.%d", v.major, v.minor, v.patch, v.build)
	if v.channel != "" {
		vv += " " + v.channel
	}

	return vv
}

func (v version) compare(o version) int {
	if c := compareInt(v.major, o.major); c != 0 {
		return c
	}
	if c := compareInt(v.minor, o.minor); c != 0 {
		return c
	}
	if c := compareInt(v.patch, o.patch); c != 0 {
		return c
	}
	return compareInt(v.build, o.build)
}

func parseVersion(v string) (version, error) {
	var p version

	// Split away channel information...
	if i := strings.Index(v, " "); i > 0 {
		p.channel = v[i+1:]
		v = v[:i]
	}

	vv := strings.Split(v, ".")
	if len(vv) > 4 {
		return p, fmt.Errorf("too many version parts")
	}

	var err error
	vv, p.major, err = parseInt(vv)
	if err != nil {
		return p, fmt.Errorf("bad major version: %w", err)
	}

	vv, p.minor, err = parseInt(vv)
	if err != nil {
		return p, fmt.Errorf("bad minor version: %w", err)
	}

	vv, p.patch, err = parseInt(vv)
	if err != nil {
		return p, fmt.Errorf("bad patch version: %w", err)
	}

	_, p.build, err = parseInt(vv)
	if err != nil {
		return p, fmt.Errorf("bad build version: %w", err)
	}

	return p, nil
}

func parseInt(v []string) ([]string, int, error) {
	if len(v) == 0 {
		return nil, 0, nil
	}

	p, err := strconv.ParseInt(v[0], 10, 32)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	return v[1:], int(p), nil
}

func compareInt(v1, v2 int) int {
	if v1 == v2 {
		return 0
	}
	if v1 < v2 {
		return -1
	} else {
		return +1
	}
}
````

## File: third_party/go-webview2/README.md
````markdown
This is a locally maintained fork of [go-webview2](https://github.com/jchv/go-webview2) 
that is intended to be used with Wails applications. It is not intended to be used
as a standalone package.

----------------

To update this package, run the following commands:

```bash
task update
```

----------------

Original README.md follows:

# go-webview2

This is a proof of concept for embedding Webview2 into Go without CGo. It is based
on [webview/webview](https://github.com/webview/webview) and provides a compatible API.

## Notice

Because this version doesn't currently have an EdgeHTML fallback, it will not work unless you have a Webview2 runtime
installed. In addition, it requires the Webview2Loader DLL in order to function. Adding an EdgeHTML fallback should be
technically possible but will likely require much worse hacks since the API is not strictly COM to my knowledge.

## Demo

For now, you'll need to install the Webview2 runtime, as it does not ship with Windows.

[WebView2 runtime](https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/)

After that, you should be able to run go-webview2 directly:

```
go run go-webview2/cmd/demo
```

This will use go-winloader to load an embedded copy of WebView2Loader.dll.

If this does not work, please try running from a directory that has an appropriate copy of `WebView2Loader.dll` for your
GOARCH. If _that_ worked, *please* file a bug so we can figure out what's wrong with go-winloader :)
````

## File: vfs/archive/7z/handler.go
````go
// Package sevenz provides a VFS archive handler for .7z files.
// It uses github.com/bodgit/sevenzip — pure Go, no CGo, no DLL required.
//
// Add to go.mod:
//
//	go get github.com/bodgit/sevenzip
//
// Self-registers via init(); blank-import in app_vfs.go:
//
//	import _ "wails-app/vfs/archive/sevenz"
package sevenz

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"time"

	sevenzip "github.com/bodgit/sevenzip"

	"wails-app/vfs"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive/pathutil"
)

func init() {
	archive.Register(&Handler{})
}

// ── Handler ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type Handler struct{}

func (h *Handler) Name() string         { return "7z" }
func (h *Handler) Extensions() []string { return []string{".7z"} }
func (h *Handler) Magic() []byte        { return []byte{0x37, 0x7A, 0xBC, 0xAF, 0x27, 0x1C} } // "7z\xBC\xAF'\x1C"
func (h *Handler) CanRead() bool        { return true }
func (h *Handler) CanWrite() bool       { return false }
func (h *Handler) CanCreate() bool      { return false }
func (h *Handler) CanStream() bool      { return false } // 7z requires random access

func (h *Handler) Detect(data []byte) bool {
	return len(data) >= 6 &&
		data[0] == 0x37 && data[1] == 0x7A &&
		data[2] == 0xBC && data[3] == 0xAF &&
		data[4] == 0x27 && data[5] == 0x1C
}

func (h *Handler) Open(ctx context.Context, path string, opts archive.OpenOptions) (archive.Archive, error) {
	if len(opts.NestedChain) > 0 {
		return openNested(ctx, path, opts)
	}
	return openDisk(path, opts.Password)
}

// ── open helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func openDisk(osPath, password string) (*Archive, error) {
	var r *sevenzip.ReadCloser
	var err error
	if password != "" {
		r, err = sevenzip.OpenReaderWithPassword(osPath, password)
	} else {
		r, err = sevenzip.OpenReader(osPath)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("7z: open %q: %w", osPath, err)
	}
	return &Archive{
		reader:   r,
		osPath:   osPath,
		password: password,
	}, nil
}

func openNested(_ context.Context, osPath string, opts archive.OpenOptions) (*Archive, error) {
	data, err := extractNestedBytes(osPath, opts.NestedChain, opts.Password)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	sr := io.NewSectionReader(bytes.NewReader(data), 0, int64(len(data)))
	var r *sevenzip.Reader
	if opts.Password != "" {
		r, err = sevenzip.NewReaderWithPassword(sr, int64(len(data)), opts.Password)
	} else {
		r, err = sevenzip.NewReader(sr, int64(len(data)))
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("7z: open nested %v: %w", opts.NestedChain, err)
	}
	return &Archive{
		memReader: r,
		osPath:    osPath,
		password:  opts.Password,
		chain:     opts.NestedChain,
	}, nil
}

// ── nested resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func extractNestedBytes(osPath string, chain []string, password string) ([]byte, error) {
	current, err := extractEntryFromDisk(osPath, chain[0], password)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("7z: resolve chain[0] %q from %q: %w", chain[0], osPath, err)
	}
	for i := 1; i < len(chain); i++ {
		next, err := extractEntryFromBytes(current, chain[i], password)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("7z: resolve chain[%d] %q: %w", i, chain[i], err)
		}
		current = next
	}
	return current, nil
}

func extractEntryFromDisk(osPath, entryPath, password string) ([]byte, error) {
	var r *sevenzip.ReadCloser
	var err error
	if password != "" {
		r, err = sevenzip.OpenReaderWithPassword(osPath, password)
	} else {
		r, err = sevenzip.OpenReader(osPath)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer r.Close()
	return findEntry(r.File, entryPath)
}

func extractEntryFromBytes(data []byte, entryPath, password string) ([]byte, error) {
	sr := io.NewSectionReader(bytes.NewReader(data), 0, int64(len(data)))
	var r *sevenzip.Reader
	var err error
	if password != "" {
		r, err = sevenzip.NewReaderWithPassword(sr, int64(len(data)), password)
	} else {
		r, err = sevenzip.NewReader(sr, int64(len(data)))
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return findEntry(r.File, entryPath)
}

func findEntry(files []*sevenzip.File, entryPath string) ([]byte, error) {
	want := normalizePath(entryPath)
	for _, f := range files {
		if normalizePath(f.Name) == want {
			rc, err := f.Open()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			defer rc.Close()
			return io.ReadAll(rc)
		}
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found", entryPath)
}

// ── Archive ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Archive implements archive.Archive for 7z files.
// bodgit/sevenzip supports random access so Open/Stat/ReadDir operate directly
// on the in-memory file list without re-scanning.
type Archive struct {
	reader    *sevenzip.ReadCloser // non-nil for disk archives
	memReader *sevenzip.Reader     // non-nil for nested/in-memory archives

	osPath   string
	password string
	chain    []string // non-empty for nested archives
}

func (a *Archive) files() []*sevenzip.File {
	if a.reader != nil {
		return a.reader.File
	}
	return a.memReader.File
}

// ── vfs.FileSystem ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func (a *Archive) Open(_ context.Context, path string) (vfs.File, error) {
	path = normalizePath(path)
	for _, f := range a.files() {
		if normalizePath(f.Name) == path && !f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			rc, err := f.Open()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return &szFile{
				rc:   rc,
				info: &szFileInfo{f: f, chain: a.chain},
			}, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
}

func (a *Archive) Stat(_ context.Context, path string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	path = normalizePath(path)
	if path == "" || path == "." {
		return &szFileInfo{synthetic: true, name: ".", isDir: true, chain: a.chain}, nil
	}
	for _, f := range a.files() {
		if normalizePath(f.Name) == path {
			return &szFileInfo{f: f, chain: a.chain}, nil
		}
	}
	// Implicit directory.
	prefix := path + "/"
	for _, f := range a.files() {
		if strings.HasPrefix(normalizePath(f.Name), prefix) {
			return &szFileInfo{
				synthetic: true,
				name:      filepath.Base(path),
				isDir:     true,
				chain:     a.chain,
			}, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
}

func (a *Archive) ReadDir(_ context.Context, path string) ([]vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	path = normalizePath(path)
	seen := make(map[string]bool)
	var result []vfs.FileInfo

	for _, f := range a.files() {
		ep := normalizePath(f.Name)
		rel := childOf(ep, path)
		if rel == "" {
			continue
		}
		parts := strings.SplitN(rel, "/", 2)
		childName := parts[0]
		if seen[childName] {
			continue
		}
		seen[childName] = true

		if len(parts) == 1 {
			result = append(result, &szFileInfo{f: f, chain: a.chain})
		} else {
			var childPath string
			if path == "" {
				childPath = childName
			} else {
				childPath = path + "/" + childName
			}
			result = append(result, &szFileInfo{
				synthetic: true,
				name:      childName,
				isDir:     true,
				path:      childPath,
				chain:     a.chain,
			})
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (a *Archive) Exists(ctx context.Context, path string) bool {
	info, err := a.Stat(ctx, path)
	return err == nil && info != nil
}

func (a *Archive) Create(_ context.Context, _ string) (vfs.File, error)   { return nil, vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (a *Archive) Mkdir(_ context.Context, _ string, _ fs.FileMode) error { return vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (a *Archive) Remove(_ context.Context, _ string) error               { return vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (a *Archive) Rename(_ context.Context, _, _ string) error            { return vfs.ErrReadOnly }

func (a *Archive) Join(elem ...string) string { return strings.Join(elem, "/") }
func (a *Archive) Split(path string) (string, string) {
	i := strings.LastIndex(path, "/")
	if i < 0 {
		return "", path
	}
	return path[:i], path[i+1:]
}
func (a *Archive) IsAbs(path string) bool { return strings.HasPrefix(path, "/") }
func (a *Archive) RealPath(_ string) (string, error) {
	if len(a.chain) > 0 {
		return "", nil
	}
	return a.osPath, nil
}

// ── archive.Archive ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func (a *Archive) Comment() string { return "" }
func (a *Archive) IsSolid() bool   { return true } // 7z is typically solid
func (a *Archive) EntryCount() int { return len(a.files()) }

func (a *Archive) Extract(ctx context.Context, srcEntryPath, dstOSPath string) error {
	rc, err := a.Open(ctx, srcEntryPath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer rc.Close()
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dstOSPath), 0755); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	out, err := os.Create(dstOSPath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer out.Close()
	_, err = io.Copy(out, rc)
	return err
}

func (a *Archive) ExtractSelected(ctx context.Context, entries []string, dstOSPath string, opts archive.ExtractOptions) (*archive.ExtractResult, error) {
	result := &archive.ExtractResult{}

	var want []string
	for _, e := range entries {
		want = append(want, normalizePath(e))
	}

	for _, f := range a.files() {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return result, ctx.Err()
		}
		ep := normalizePath(f.Name)
		if f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		if !matchesEntries(ep, want) {
			continue
		}

		relPath := rebasePath(ep, opts.StripPrefix)
		if relPath == "" {
			continue
		}

		var dstPath string
		if opts.FlattenPaths {
			dstPath = filepath.Join(dstOSPath, filepath.Base(filepath.FromSlash(relPath)))
		} else {
			dstPath = filepath.Join(dstOSPath, filepath.FromSlash(relPath))
		}

		if _, err := os.Lstat(dstPath); err == nil && opts.OnConflict != nil {
			resolved, skip, err := opts.OnConflict(ep, dstPath)
			if err != nil {
				result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: ep, Err: err})
				result.Failed++
				continue
			}
			if skip {
				continue
			}
			dstPath = resolved
		}

		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dstPath), 0755); err != nil {
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: ep, Err: err})
			result.Failed++
			continue
		}

		rc, err := f.Open()
		if err != nil {
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: ep, Err: err})
			result.Failed++
			continue
		}

		out, err := os.Create(dstPath)
		if err != nil {
			rc.Close()
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: ep, Err: err})
			result.Failed++
			continue
		}

		n, err := io.Copy(out, rc)
		rc.Close()
		out.Close()
		if err != nil {
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: ep, Err: err})
			result.Failed++
			continue
		}

		if opts.Progress != nil {
			opts.Progress(result.Bytes+n, 0, ep)
		}
		result.Extracted++
		result.Bytes += n
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (a *Archive) Close() error {
	if a.reader != nil {
		return a.reader.Close()
	}
	return nil
}

// ── szFileInfo ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type szFileInfo struct {
	f         *sevenzip.File
	synthetic bool
	name      string // used when synthetic=true
	isDir     bool   // used when synthetic=true
	path      string // used when synthetic=true
	chain     []string
}

	if s.synthetic {
		return s.name
	}
	return filepath.Base(normalizePath(s.f.Name))
}

	if s.synthetic || s.f == nil {
		return 0
	}
	return s.f.FileInfo().Size()
}
func (s *szFileInfo) Mode() fs.FileMode {
	if s.isDir || (s.f != nil && s.f.FileInfo().IsDir()) {
		return fs.ModeDir | 0755
	}
	return 0644
}
func (s *szFileInfo) ModTime() time.Time {
	if s.synthetic || s.f == nil {
		return time.Time{}
	}
	return s.f.FileInfo().ModTime()
}
func (s *szFileInfo) IsDir() bool {
	if s.synthetic {
		return s.isDir
	}
	return s.f.FileInfo().IsDir()
}
func (s *szFileInfo) Sys() any { return nil }

func (s *szFileInfo) Path() string {
	if s.synthetic {
		return s.path
	}
	if s.f == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return normalizePath(s.f.Name)
}
func (s *szFileInfo) RealPath() string   { return "" }
func (s *szFileInfo) Volume() vfs.Volume { return nil }
func (s *szFileInfo) IsArchive() bool    { return !s.IsDir() && archive.IsArchiveExt(s.Name()) }
func (s *szFileInfo) IsHidden() bool     { return strings.HasPrefix(s.Name(), ".") }
func (s *szFileInfo) IsSymlink() bool    { return false }
func (s *szFileInfo) IsNested() bool     { return len(s.chain) > 0 }
func (s *szFileInfo) MountChain() []string {
	if s.chain == nil {
		return nil
	}
	cp := make([]string, len(s.chain))
	copy(cp, s.chain)
	return cp
}

// ── szFile ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type szFile struct {
	rc   io.ReadCloser
	info *szFileInfo
}

func (f *szFile) Read(p []byte) (int, error)  { return f.rc.Read(p) }
func (f *szFile) Write(_ []byte) (int, error) { return 0, vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (f *szFile) Seek(offset int64, whence int) (int64, error) {
	if s, ok := f.rc.(io.ReadSeekCloser); ok {
		return s.Seek(offset, whence)
	}
	return 0, fmt.Errorf("7z entry does not support seeking")
}
func (f *szFile) Close() error                { return f.rc.Close() }
func (f *szFile) Stat() (vfs.FileInfo, error) { return f.info, nil }
func (f *szFile) Sync() error                 { return nil }

	return pathutil.NormalizePath(p)

	return pathutil.ChildOf(ep, parent)
}

	return pathutil.MatchesEntries(ep, entries)

	return pathutil.RebasePath(ep, stripPrefix)

var _ archive.Archive = (*Archive)(nil)
````

## File: vfs/archive/cache/cache.go

````go
// Package cache provides a bounded LRU cache of open archive.Archive objects.
//
// ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
// │  TC-style VFS path:  /home/user/data.zip::subdir/inner.tar.gz::deep.rar │
// │                      └──── fsPath ─────┘  └──── nestedChain ──────────┘ │
// └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
//
// Design
// ──────
//   - One cache entry per (fsPath + nestedChain) tuple — the "archive identity".
//   - The entry holds the already-opened archive.Archive, alive until evicted.
//   - Lazy: nothing is opened until first access; navigation inside an already-
//     open archive is instant (ReadDir on the cached object, no extraction).
//   - No repeated extraction: the opener is called ONCE per identity, its
//     result is kept alive. Subsequent ReadDir calls for any innerPath reuse it.
//   - Eviction: LRU with a capacity cap + mtime invalidation. When the on-disk
//     file is newer than the cached open time, the entry is silently dropped and
//     re-opened. This keeps nested bytes fresh after archive rewrites.
//   - Thread-safe: one mutex guards the map. Archive.ReadDir is itself safe to
//     call concurrently — handler implementations use immutable entry slices.
package cache

import (
	"container/list"
	"context"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"wails-app/vfs/archive"
)

// Capacity is the maximum number of concurrently-open archives.
const Capacity = 12

// Opener is the function the cache calls on a miss to open an archive.
// It maps directly onto resolveChain in app_vfs.go.
type Opener func(ctx context.Context, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, password string) (archive.Archive, error)

// key uniquely identifies one opened archive level.
type key struct {
	fsPath string
	chain  string // nestedChain joined with "::" — cheap comparable string
}

func makeKey(fsPath string, nestedChain []string) key {
	return key{fsPath: fsPath, chain: strings.Join(nestedChain, "::")}
}

// entry is one slot in the LRU.
type entry struct {
	k        key
	arch     archive.Archive
	openedAt time.Time     // wall time when opener was called
	elem     *list.Element // position in the LRU list
}

// Cache is a bounded LRU cache of open archive.Archive objects.
type Cache struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	entries map[key]*entry
	lru     *list.List // front = most-recently used
	open    Opener
}

// New returns a Cache that uses opener to open archives on cache misses.
func New(opener Opener) *Cache {
	return &Cache{
		entries: make(map[key]*entry, Capacity),
		lru:     list.New(),
		open:    opener,
	}
}

// Get returns a live archive.Archive for (fsPath, nestedChain), calling the
// opener on first access or after the underlying file has changed on disk.
func (c *Cache) Get(ctx context.Context, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, password string) (archive.Archive, error) {
	k := makeKey(fsPath, nestedChain)

	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()

	// ── Cache hit ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	if e, ok := c.entries[k]; ok {
		// Invalidate if the outer file has been modified since we opened it.
		if fi, err := os.Stat(fsPath); err == nil && fi.ModTime().After(e.openedAt) {
			c.evict(e) // stale — fall through to re-open
		} else {
			c.lru.MoveToFront(e.elem)
			return e.arch, nil
		}
	}

	// ── Cache miss ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	arch, err := c.open(ctx, fsPath, nestedChain, password)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if c.lru.Len() >= Capacity {
		c.evict(c.lru.Back().Value.(*entry))
	}

	e := &entry{k: k, arch: arch, openedAt: time.Now()}
	e.elem = c.lru.PushFront(e)
	c.entries[k] = e
	return arch, nil
}

// CloseAll closes every cached archive. Call from App.shutdown().
func (c *Cache) CloseAll() {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	for _, e := range c.entries {
		_ = e.arch.Close()
	}
	c.entries = make(map[key]*entry)
	c.lru.Init()
}

// evict removes e from the cache and closes the underlying archive.
// Caller must hold c.mu.
func (c *Cache) evict(e *entry) {
	delete(c.entries, e.k)
	c.lru.Remove(e.elem)
	_ = e.arch.Close() // best-effort; tempArchive also removes its temp file
}
````

## File: vfs/archive/pathutil/pathutil.go
````go
package pathutil

import "strings"

func NormalizePath(path string) string {
	path = strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/")
	return strings.Trim(path, "/")
}

func NormalizeTarPath(path string) string {
	path = NormalizePath(path)
	return strings.TrimPrefix(path, "./")
}

func ChildOf(entryPath, parent string) string {
	entryPath = NormalizePath(entryPath)
	parent = NormalizePath(parent)
	if parent == "" {
		return entryPath
	}
	if entryPath == parent {
		return ""
	}
	prefix := parent + "/"
	if strings.HasPrefix(entryPath, prefix) {
		return entryPath[len(prefix):]
	}
	return ""
}

func MatchesEntries(entryPath string, entries []string) bool {
	if len(entries) == 0 {
		return true
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		entry = NormalizePath(entry)
		if entryPath == entry || strings.HasPrefix(entryPath, entry+"/") {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func RebasePath(entryPath, stripPrefix string) string {
	if stripPrefix == "" {
		return entryPath
	}
	prefix := NormalizePath(stripPrefix)
	if entryPath == prefix {
		return ""
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(entryPath, prefix+"/") {
		return entryPath[len(prefix)+1:]
	}
	return entryPath
}
````

````go
// Package rar provides a VFS archive handler for .rar files (RAR3 and RAR5).
// It uses github.com/nwaples/rardecode which is already a transitive dependency
// via mholt/archiver — no new go.mod entry needed.
//
// RAR is read-only; write/create/delete are not supported (proprietary format).
//
// Self-registers via init(); blank-import in app_vfs.go:
//
//	import _ "wails-app/vfs/archive/rar"
package rar

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/nwaples/rardecode"

	"wails-app/vfs"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive/pathutil"
)

func init() {
	archive.Register(&Handler{})
}

// ── Handler ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type Handler struct{}

func (h *Handler) Name() string         { return "rar" }
func (h *Handler) Extensions() []string { return []string{".rar"} }
func (h *Handler) Magic() []byte        { return []byte{0x52, 0x61, 0x72, 0x21} } // "Rar!"
func (h *Handler) CanRead() bool        { return true }
func (h *Handler) CanWrite() bool       { return false }
func (h *Handler) CanCreate() bool      { return false }
func (h *Handler) CanStream() bool      { return true } // rardecode is stream-based

func (h *Handler) Detect(data []byte) bool {
	// RAR4: "Rar!\x1A\x07\x00"
	// RAR5: "Rar!\x1A\x07\x01\x00"
	return len(data) >= 4 && bytes.HasPrefix(data, []byte("Rar!"))
}

func (h *Handler) Open(ctx context.Context, path string, opts archive.OpenOptions) (archive.Archive, error) {
	if len(opts.NestedChain) > 0 {
		return openNested(ctx, path, opts)
	}
	return openDisk(path, opts.Password)
}

// ── open helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func openDisk(osPath, password string) (*Archive, error) {
	entries, err := scanDisk(osPath, password)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rar: open %q: %w", osPath, err)
	}
	return &Archive{
		osPath:   osPath,
		password: password,
		entries:  entries,
	}, nil
}

func openNested(_ context.Context, osPath string, opts archive.OpenOptions) (*Archive, error) {
	data, err := extractNestedBytes(osPath, opts.NestedChain, opts.Password)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	entries, err := scanReader(bytes.NewReader(data), opts.Password)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rar: open nested %v: %w", opts.NestedChain, err)
	}
	return &Archive{
		osPath:   osPath,
		password: opts.Password,
		entries:  entries,
		memData:  data,
		chain:    opts.NestedChain,
	}, nil
}

// ── entry scanning ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// rarEntry is the metadata we cache on open (rardecode is single-pass).
type rarEntry struct {
	header  *rardecode.FileHeader
	path    string // normalised forward-slash path
	isDir   bool
	size    int64
	modTime time.Time
}

func scanDisk(osPath, password string) ([]rarEntry, error) {
	var r *rardecode.ReadCloser
	var err error
	if password != "" {
		r, err = rardecode.OpenReader(osPath, password)
	} else {
		r, err = rardecode.OpenReader(osPath, "")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer r.Close()
	return collectEntries(&r.Reader)
}

func scanReader(rd io.Reader, password string) ([]rarEntry, error) {
	r, err := rardecode.NewReader(rd, password)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return collectEntries(r)
}

func collectEntries(r *rardecode.Reader) ([]rarEntry, error) {
	var entries []rarEntry
	for {
		hdr, err := r.Next()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		// Drain the entry so Next() advances cleanly.
		if _, err := io.Copy(io.Discard, r); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		p := normalizePath(hdr.Name)
		entries = append(entries, rarEntry{
			header:  hdr,
			path:    p,
			isDir:   hdr.IsDir,
			size:    hdr.UnPackedSize,
			modTime: hdr.ModificationTime,
		})
	}
	return entries, nil
}

// ── nested resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func extractNestedBytes(osPath string, chain []string, password string) ([]byte, error) {
	current, err := extractEntryFromDisk(osPath, chain[0], password)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rar: resolve chain[0] %q from %q: %w", chain[0], osPath, err)
	}
	for i := 1; i < len(chain); i++ {
		next, err := extractEntryFromBytes(current, chain[i], password)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("rar: resolve chain[%d] %q: %w", i, chain[i], err)
		}
		current = next
	}
	return current, nil
}

func extractEntryFromDisk(osPath, entryPath, password string) ([]byte, error) {
	r, err := rardecode.OpenReader(osPath, password)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer r.Close()
	return findEntry(&r.Reader, entryPath)
}

func extractEntryFromBytes(data []byte, entryPath, password string) ([]byte, error) {
	r, err := rardecode.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data), password)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return findEntry(r, entryPath)
}

func findEntry(r *rardecode.Reader, entryPath string) ([]byte, error) {
	want := normalizePath(entryPath)
	for {
		hdr, err := r.Next()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if normalizePath(hdr.Name) == want {
			return io.ReadAll(r)
		}
		if _, err := io.Copy(io.Discard, r); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found", entryPath)
}

// ── Archive ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Archive implements archive.Archive for RAR files.
// rardecode is forward-only, so we scan all headers on Open and cache them.
// Reading file content requires a second pass through the archive.
type Archive struct {
	osPath   string
	password string
	entries  []rarEntry
	memData  []byte   // non-nil for nested (in-memory) archives
	chain    []string // non-empty for nested archives
}

// ── vfs.FileSystem ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func (a *Archive) Open(_ context.Context, path string) (vfs.File, error) {
	path = normalizePath(path)
	for _, e := range a.entries {
		if e.path == path && !e.isDir {
			data, err := a.readEntry(path)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return &rarFile{
				reader: bytes.NewReader(data),
				info:   &rarFileInfo{entry: e, chain: a.chain},
			}, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
}

func (a *Archive) Stat(_ context.Context, path string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	path = normalizePath(path)
	if path == "" || path == "." {
		return &rarFileInfo{entry: rarEntry{path: ".", isDir: true}, chain: a.chain}, nil
	}
	for _, e := range a.entries {
		if e.path == path {
			return &rarFileInfo{entry: e, chain: a.chain}, nil
		}
	}
	// Implicit directory.
	prefix := path + "/"
	for _, e := range a.entries {
		if strings.HasPrefix(e.path, prefix) {
			return &rarFileInfo{
				entry: rarEntry{path: path, isDir: true},
				chain: a.chain,
			}, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
}

func (a *Archive) ReadDir(_ context.Context, path string) ([]vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	path = normalizePath(path)
	seen := make(map[string]bool)
	var result []vfs.FileInfo

	for _, e := range a.entries {
		rel := childOf(e.path, path)
		if rel == "" {
			continue
		}
		parts := strings.SplitN(rel, "/", 2)
		childName := parts[0]
		if seen[childName] {
			continue
		}
		seen[childName] = true

		if len(parts) == 1 {
			result = append(result, &rarFileInfo{entry: e, chain: a.chain})
		} else {
			var childPath string
			if path == "" {
				childPath = childName
			} else {
				childPath = path + "/" + childName
			}
			result = append(result, &rarFileInfo{
				entry: rarEntry{path: childPath, isDir: true},
				chain: a.chain,
			})
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (a *Archive) Exists(ctx context.Context, path string) bool {
	info, err := a.Stat(ctx, path)
	return err == nil && info != nil
}

func (a *Archive) Create(_ context.Context, _ string) (vfs.File, error)   { return nil, vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (a *Archive) Mkdir(_ context.Context, _ string, _ fs.FileMode) error { return vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (a *Archive) Remove(_ context.Context, _ string) error               { return vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (a *Archive) Rename(_ context.Context, _, _ string) error            { return vfs.ErrReadOnly }

func (a *Archive) Join(elem ...string) string { return strings.Join(elem, "/") }
func (a *Archive) Split(path string) (string, string) {
	i := strings.LastIndex(path, "/")
	if i < 0 {
		return "", path
	}
	return path[:i], path[i+1:]
}
func (a *Archive) IsAbs(path string) bool { return strings.HasPrefix(path, "/") }
func (a *Archive) RealPath(_ string) (string, error) {
	if len(a.chain) > 0 {
		return "", nil
	}
	return a.osPath, nil
}

// ── archive.Archive ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func (a *Archive) Comment() string { return "" }
func (a *Archive) IsSolid() bool   { return false } // rardecode doesn't expose this
func (a *Archive) EntryCount() int { return len(a.entries) }

func (a *Archive) Extract(ctx context.Context, srcEntryPath, dstOSPath string) error {
	data, err := a.readEntry(normalizePath(srcEntryPath))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dstOSPath), 0755); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.WriteFile(dstOSPath, data, 0644)
}

func (a *Archive) ExtractSelected(ctx context.Context, entries []string, dstOSPath string, opts archive.ExtractOptions) (*archive.ExtractResult, error) {
	result := &archive.ExtractResult{}

	// Normalise the wanted set once.
	var want []string
	for _, e := range entries {
		want = append(want, normalizePath(e))
	}

	for _, e := range a.entries {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return result, ctx.Err()
		}
		if e.isDir {
			continue
		}
		if !matchesEntries(e.path, want) {
			continue
		}

		relPath := rebasePath(e.path, opts.StripPrefix)
		if relPath == "" {
			continue
		}

		var dstPath string
		if opts.FlattenPaths {
			dstPath = filepath.Join(dstOSPath, filepath.Base(filepath.FromSlash(relPath)))
		} else {
			dstPath = filepath.Join(dstOSPath, filepath.FromSlash(relPath))
		}

		if _, err := os.Lstat(dstPath); err == nil && opts.OnConflict != nil {
			resolved, skip, err := opts.OnConflict(e.path, dstPath)
			if err != nil {
				result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: e.path, Err: err})
				result.Failed++
				continue
			}
			if skip {
				continue
			}
			dstPath = resolved
		}

		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dstPath), 0755); err != nil {
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: e.path, Err: err})
			result.Failed++
			continue
		}

		data, err := a.readEntry(e.path)
		if err != nil {
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: e.path, Err: err})
			result.Failed++
			continue
		}

		if err := os.WriteFile(dstPath, data, 0644); err != nil {
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: e.path, Err: err})
			result.Failed++
			continue
		}

		n := int64(len(data))
		if opts.Progress != nil {
			opts.Progress(result.Bytes+n, 0, e.path)
		}
		result.Extracted++
		result.Bytes += n
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (a *Archive) Close() error { return nil }

// ── internal read ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// readEntry does a fresh single-pass scan to read one entry's content.
// rardecode does not support seeking, so every read is O(n) in the archive.
func (a *Archive) readEntry(path string) ([]byte, error) {
	if a.memData != nil {
		r, err := rardecode.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(a.memData), a.password)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("rar: re-open mem for read %q: %w", path, err)
		}
		return findEntry(r, path)
	}
	r, err := rardecode.OpenReader(a.osPath, a.password)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rar: re-open for read %q: %w", a.osPath, err)
	}
	defer r.Close()
	return findEntry(&r.Reader, path)
}
````

````go
// Package tar provides a VFS archive handler for .tar, .tar.gz/.tgz,
// .tar.bz2/.tbz2, and .tar.xz/.txz files using only the Go standard library.
//
// TAR is read-only; write/create/delete are not supported.
//
// Self-registers via init(); blank-import in app_vfs.go:
//
//	import _ "wails-app/vfs/archive/tar"
package tar

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"bytes"
	"compress/bzip2"
	"compress/gzip"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"wails-app/vfs"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive/pathutil"
)

func init() {
	archive.Register(&Handler{})
}

// ── Handler ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type Handler struct{}

func (h *Handler) Name() string { return "tar" }
func (h *Handler) Extensions() []string {
	return []string{".tar", ".tar.gz", ".tgz", ".tar.bz2", ".tbz2", ".tar.xz", ".txz"}
}

// Magic covers uncompressed TAR (ustar, GNU, POSIX).
// Compressed variants are detected by extension in Detect.
func (h *Handler) Magic() []byte   { return []byte{0x75, 0x73, 0x74, 0x61, 0x72} } // "ustar" at offset 257 – handled via Detect
func (h *Handler) CanRead() bool   { return true }
func (h *Handler) CanWrite() bool  { return false }
func (h *Handler) CanCreate() bool { return false }
func (h *Handler) CanStream() bool { return true }

func (h *Handler) Detect(data []byte) bool {
	// Uncompressed TAR: "ustar" magic at byte offset 257.
	if len(data) >= 262 {
		magic := data[257:262]
		if bytes.HasPrefix(magic, []byte("ustar")) {
			return true
		}
	}
	// gzip magic (covers .tar.gz / .tgz).
	if len(data) >= 2 && data[0] == 0x1f && data[1] == 0x8b {
		return true
	}
	// bzip2 magic (covers .tar.bz2 / .tbz2).
	if len(data) >= 3 && data[0] == 0x42 && data[1] == 0x5a && data[2] == 0x68 {
		return true
	}
	// xz magic (covers .tar.xz / .txz).
	if len(data) >= 6 &&
		data[0] == 0xfd && data[1] == 0x37 && data[2] == 0x7a &&
		data[3] == 0x58 && data[4] == 0x5a && data[5] == 0x00 {
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func (h *Handler) Open(ctx context.Context, path string, opts archive.OpenOptions) (archive.Archive, error) {
	if len(opts.NestedChain) > 0 {
		return openNested(ctx, path, opts)
	}
	return openDisk(path)
}

// ── open helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func openDisk(osPath string) (*Archive, error) {
	entries, err := scanDisk(osPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("tar: open %q: %w", osPath, err)
	}
	return &Archive{
		osPath:  osPath,
		entries: entries,
	}, nil
}

func openNested(_ context.Context, osPath string, opts archive.OpenOptions) (*Archive, error) {
	data, err := extractNestedBytes(osPath, opts.NestedChain, opts.Password)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	entries, err := scanReader(bytes.NewReader(data), osPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("tar: open nested %v: %w", opts.NestedChain, err)
	}
	return &Archive{
		osPath:  osPath,
		entries: entries,
		memData: data,
		chain:   opts.NestedChain,
	}, nil
}

// ── compression detection ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// decompressReader wraps r with the appropriate decompressor based on the
// file extension of osPath, returning an io.ReadCloser.
func decompressReader(r io.Reader, osPath string) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
	lower := strings.ToLower(osPath)
	switch {
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.gz") || strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tgz"):
		gr, err := gzip.NewReader(r)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("tar: gzip open: %w", err)
		}
		return gr, nil
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.bz2") || strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tbz2"):
		// compress/bzip2 is read-only and returns a plain io.Reader.
		return io.NopCloser(bzip2.NewReader(r)), nil
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.xz") || strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".txz"):
		// stdlib has no xz support; use a pure-Go shim if available,
		// otherwise return a clear error so callers can fall back.
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("tar: .xz decompression requires an external dependency (e.g. github.com/ulikunitz/xz)")
	default:
		// Plain .tar — no decompression needed.
		return io.NopCloser(r), nil
	}
}

// ── entry scanning ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type tarEntry struct {
	header  *tar.Header
	path    string // normalised forward-slash path
	isDir   bool
	size    int64
	modTime time.Time
}

func scanDisk(osPath string) ([]tarEntry, error) {
	f, err := os.Open(osPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	return scanReader(f, osPath)
}

func scanReader(r io.Reader, osPath string) ([]tarEntry, error) {
	dc, err := decompressReader(r, osPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer dc.Close()
	return collectEntries(tar.NewReader(dc))
}

func collectEntries(tr *tar.Reader) ([]tarEntry, error) {
	var entries []tarEntry
	for {
		hdr, err := tr.Next()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		p := normalizePath(hdr.Name)
		if p == "." {
			// Many tar creators (GNU tar, bsdtar, Python tarfile) emit a "./"
			// record for the archive root directory itself.  It is never a
			// useful child entry and would appear as a spurious "." folder in
			// every root listing, so we skip it here.
			continue
		}
		entries = append(entries, tarEntry{
			header:  hdr,
			path:    p,
			isDir:   hdr.Typeflag == tar.TypeDir,
			size:    hdr.Size,
			modTime: hdr.ModTime,
		})
	}
	return entries, nil
}

// ── nested resolution ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func extractNestedBytes(osPath string, chain []string, _ string) ([]byte, error) {
	current, err := extractEntryFromDisk(osPath, chain[0])
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("tar: resolve chain[0] %q from %q: %w", chain[0], osPath, err)
	}
	for i := 1; i < len(chain); i++ {
		next, err := extractEntryFromBytes(current, chain[i], osPath)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("tar: resolve chain[%d] %q: %w", i, chain[i], err)
		}
		current = next
	}
	return current, nil
}

func extractEntryFromDisk(osPath, entryPath string) ([]byte, error) {
	f, err := os.Open(osPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	dc, err := decompressReader(f, osPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer dc.Close()
	return findEntry(tar.NewReader(dc), entryPath)
}

func extractEntryFromBytes(data []byte, entryPath, osPath string) ([]byte, error) {
	dc, err := decompressReader(bytes.NewReader(data), osPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer dc.Close()
	return findEntry(tar.NewReader(dc), entryPath)
}

func findEntry(tr *tar.Reader, entryPath string) ([]byte, error) {
	want := normalizePath(entryPath)
	for {
		hdr, err := tr.Next()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if normalizePath(hdr.Name) == want {
			return io.ReadAll(tr)
		}
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found", entryPath)
}

// ── Archive ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Archive implements archive.Archive for TAR files.
// archive/tar is forward-only, so we scan all headers on Open and cache them.
// Reading file content requires a second pass through the archive.
type Archive struct {
	osPath  string
	entries []tarEntry
	memData []byte   // non-nil for nested (in-memory) archives
	chain   []string // non-empty for nested archives
}

// ── vfs.FileSystem ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func (a *Archive) Open(_ context.Context, path string) (vfs.File, error) {
	path = normalizePath(path)
	for _, e := range a.entries {
		if e.path == path && !e.isDir {
			data, err := a.readEntry(path)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return &tarFile{
				reader: bytes.NewReader(data),
				info:   &tarFileInfo{entry: e, chain: a.chain},
			}, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
}

func (a *Archive) Stat(_ context.Context, path string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	path = normalizePath(path)
	if path == "" || path == "." {
		return &tarFileInfo{entry: tarEntry{path: ".", isDir: true}, chain: a.chain}, nil
	}
	for _, e := range a.entries {
		if e.path == path {
			return &tarFileInfo{entry: e, chain: a.chain}, nil
		}
	}
	// Implicit directory (not explicitly stored in the archive).
	prefix := path + "/"
	for _, e := range a.entries {
		if strings.HasPrefix(e.path, prefix) {
			return &tarFileInfo{
				entry: tarEntry{path: path, isDir: true},
				chain: a.chain,
			}, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
}

func (a *Archive) ReadDir(_ context.Context, path string) ([]vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	path = normalizePath(path)
	seen := make(map[string]bool)
	var result []vfs.FileInfo

	for _, e := range a.entries {
		rel := childOf(e.path, path)
		if rel == "" {
			continue
		}
		parts := strings.SplitN(rel, "/", 2)
		childName := parts[0]
		if seen[childName] {
			continue
		}
		seen[childName] = true

		if len(parts) == 1 {
			result = append(result, &tarFileInfo{entry: e, chain: a.chain})
		} else {
			var childPath string
			if path == "" {
				childPath = childName
			} else {
				childPath = path + "/" + childName
			}
			result = append(result, &tarFileInfo{
				entry: tarEntry{path: childPath, isDir: true},
				chain: a.chain,
			})
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (a *Archive) Exists(ctx context.Context, path string) bool {
	info, err := a.Stat(ctx, path)
	return err == nil && info != nil
}

func (a *Archive) Create(_ context.Context, _ string) (vfs.File, error)   { return nil, vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (a *Archive) Mkdir(_ context.Context, _ string, _ fs.FileMode) error { return vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (a *Archive) Remove(_ context.Context, _ string) error               { return vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (a *Archive) Rename(_ context.Context, _, _ string) error            { return vfs.ErrReadOnly }

func (a *Archive) Join(elem ...string) string { return strings.Join(elem, "/") }
func (a *Archive) Split(path string) (string, string) {
	i := strings.LastIndex(path, "/")
	if i < 0 {
		return "", path
	}
	return path[:i], path[i+1:]
}
func (a *Archive) IsAbs(path string) bool { return strings.HasPrefix(path, "/") }
func (a *Archive) RealPath(_ string) (string, error) {
	if len(a.chain) > 0 {
		return "", nil
	}
	return a.osPath, nil
}

// ── archive.Archive ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func (a *Archive) Comment() string { return "" }
func (a *Archive) IsSolid() bool   { return true } // TAR is inherently sequential/solid
func (a *Archive) EntryCount() int { return len(a.entries) }

func (a *Archive) Extract(ctx context.Context, srcEntryPath, dstOSPath string) error {
	data, err := a.readEntry(normalizePath(srcEntryPath))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dstOSPath), 0755); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.WriteFile(dstOSPath, data, 0644)
}

func (a *Archive) ExtractSelected(ctx context.Context, entries []string, dstOSPath string, opts archive.ExtractOptions) (*archive.ExtractResult, error) {
	result := &archive.ExtractResult{}

	var want []string
	for _, e := range entries {
		want = append(want, normalizePath(e))
	}

	for _, e := range a.entries {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return result, ctx.Err()
		}
		if e.isDir {
			continue
		}
		if !matchesEntries(e.path, want) {
			continue
		}

		relPath := rebasePath(e.path, opts.StripPrefix)
		if relPath == "" {
			continue
		}

		var dstPath string
		if opts.FlattenPaths {
			dstPath = filepath.Join(dstOSPath, filepath.Base(filepath.FromSlash(relPath)))
		} else {
			dstPath = filepath.Join(dstOSPath, filepath.FromSlash(relPath))
		}

		if _, err := os.Lstat(dstPath); err == nil && opts.OnConflict != nil {
			resolved, skip, err := opts.OnConflict(e.path, dstPath)
			if err != nil {
				result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: e.path, Err: err})
				result.Failed++
				continue
			}
			if skip {
				continue
			}
			dstPath = resolved
		}

		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dstPath), 0755); err != nil {
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: e.path, Err: err})
			result.Failed++
			continue
		}

		data, err := a.readEntry(e.path)
		if err != nil {
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: e.path, Err: err})
			result.Failed++
			continue
		}

		if err := os.WriteFile(dstPath, data, 0644); err != nil {
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: e.path, Err: err})
			result.Failed++
			continue
		}

		n := int64(len(data))
		if opts.Progress != nil {
			opts.Progress(result.Bytes+n, 0, e.path)
		}
		result.Extracted++
		result.Bytes += n
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (a *Archive) Close() error { return nil }

// ── internal read ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// readEntry does a fresh single-pass scan to read one entry's content.
// archive/tar does not support seeking, so every read is O(n).
func (a *Archive) readEntry(path string) ([]byte, error) {
	if a.memData != nil {
		dc, err := decompressReader(bytes.NewReader(a.memData), a.osPath)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		defer dc.Close()
		return findEntry(tar.NewReader(dc), path)
	}
	f, err := os.Open(a.osPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("tar: re-open for read %q: %w", a.osPath, err)
	}
	defer f.Close()
	dc, err := decompressReader(f, a.osPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer dc.Close()
	return findEntry(tar.NewReader(dc), path)
}

	return pathutil.ChildOf(ep, parent)
}

func matchesEntries(ep string, entries []string) bool {
	return pathutil.MatchesEntries(ep, entries)
}

func rebasePath(ep, stripPrefix string) string {
	return pathutil.RebasePath(ep, stripPrefix)
}

// Compile-time interface checks.
var _ archive.Handler = (*Handler)(nil)
var _ archive.Archive = (*Archive)(nil)
var _ vfs.FileSystem = (*Archive)(nil)
````

````go
// Package zip provides a VFS archive handler for .zip files.
// It self-registers via init(); blank-import it in main.go:
//
//	import _ "wails-app/vfs/archive/zip"
package zip

import (
	"archive/zip"
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"wails-app/vfs"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive/pathutil"
)

func init() {
	archive.Register(&Handler{})
}

// ── Handler ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type Handler struct{}

func (h *Handler) Name() string         { return "zip" }
func (h *Handler) Extensions() []string { return []string{".zip"} }
func (h *Handler) Magic() []byte        { return []byte{0x50, 0x4B, 0x03, 0x04} }
func (h *Handler) CanRead() bool        { return true }
func (h *Handler) CanWrite() bool       { return true }
func (h *Handler) CanCreate() bool      { return true }
func (h *Handler) CanStream() bool      { return true }

func (h *Handler) Detect(data []byte) bool {
	if len(data) < 4 {
		return false
	}
	sig := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data[:4])
	// PK\x03\x04 local-file header OR PK\x05\x06 empty-archive end-of-central-dir
	return sig == 0x504B0304 || sig == 0x504B0506
}

func (h *Handler) Open(ctx context.Context, path string, opts archive.OpenOptions) (archive.Archive, error) {
	if len(opts.NestedChain) > 0 {
		return openNested(ctx, path, opts)
	}
	return openDisk(path, opts.ReadOnly)
}

// openDisk opens a ZIP directly from an OS path.
func openDisk(osPath string, readOnly bool) (*Archive, error) {
	r, err := zip.OpenReader(osPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("zip: open %q: %w", osPath, err)
	}
	return &Archive{
		reader:   r,
		osPath:   osPath,
		readOnly: readOnly,
	}, nil
}

// openNested resolves the nested chain and opens the innermost ZIP from memory.
func openNested(_ context.Context, osPath string, opts archive.OpenOptions) (*Archive, error) {
	data, err := extractNestedBytes(osPath, opts.NestedChain)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	r, err := zip.NewReader(strings.NewReader(string(data)), int64(len(data)))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("zip: open nested %v: %w", opts.NestedChain, err)
	}
	return &Archive{
		readerAt:  strings.NewReader(string(data)),
		memReader: r,
		osPath:    osPath,
		chain:     opts.NestedChain,
		readOnly:  true, // nested archives are always read-only
	}, nil
}

// extractNestedBytes resolves a chain of nested archives entirely in memory.
func extractNestedBytes(osPath string, chain []string) ([]byte, error) {
	// Step 1: extract first link from disk.
	current, err := extractEntryFromDisk(osPath, chain[0])
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("zip: resolve chain[0] %q from %q: %w", chain[0], osPath, err)
	}
	// Step 2: recurse through the rest in memory.
	for i := 1; i < len(chain); i++ {
		next, err := extractEntryFromBytes(current, chain[i])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("zip: resolve chain[%d] %q: %w", i, chain[i], err)
		}
		current = next
	}
	return current, nil
}

func extractEntryFromDisk(osPath, entryPath string) ([]byte, error) {
	r, err := zip.OpenReader(osPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer r.Close()
	want := normalizePath(entryPath)
	for _, f := range r.File {
		if normalizePath(f.Name) == want {
			rc, err := f.Open()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			defer rc.Close()
			return io.ReadAll(rc)
		}
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found", entryPath)
}

func extractEntryFromBytes(data []byte, entryPath string) ([]byte, error) {
	r, err := zip.NewReader(strings.NewReader(string(data)), int64(len(data)))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	want := normalizePath(entryPath)
	for _, f := range r.File {
		if normalizePath(f.Name) == want {
			rc, err := f.Open()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			defer rc.Close()
			return io.ReadAll(rc)
		}
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found", entryPath)
}

// ── Archive ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Archive implements archive.Archive and vfs.FileSystem for ZIP files.
type Archive struct {
	// Exactly one of reader (disk) or memReader (in-memory) is set.
	reader    *zip.ReadCloser
	readerAt  io.ReadSeeker // backing bytes for memReader
	memReader *zip.Reader

	osPath   string
	chain    []string // non-empty for nested archives
	readOnly bool
}

func (a *Archive) files() []*zip.File {
	if a.reader != nil {
		return a.reader.File
	}
	return a.memReader.File
}

// ── vfs.FileSystem ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func (a *Archive) Open(_ context.Context, path string) (vfs.File, error) {
	path = normalizePath(path)
	for _, f := range a.files() {
		if normalizePath(f.Name) == path && !f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			rc, err := f.Open()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return &zipFile{rc: rc, info: &zipFileInfo{f: f, chain: a.chain}}, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
}

func (a *Archive) Stat(_ context.Context, path string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	path = normalizePath(path)
	if path == "" || path == "." {
		// Root of the archive — synthesize a directory entry.
		return &zipFileInfo{synthetic: true, name: ".", isDir: true, chain: a.chain}, nil
	}
	// Exact entry match.
	for _, f := range a.files() {
		if normalizePath(f.Name) == path {
			return &zipFileInfo{f: f, chain: a.chain}, nil
		}
	}
	// Implicit directory: check if any entry starts with path+"/".
	prefix := path + "/"
	for _, f := range a.files() {
		if strings.HasPrefix(normalizePath(f.Name), prefix) {
			return &zipFileInfo{synthetic: true, name: filepath.Base(path), isDir: true, chain: a.chain}, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
}

func (a *Archive) ReadDir(_ context.Context, path string) ([]vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	path = normalizePath(path)
	// Collect immediate children of path.
	seen := make(map[string]bool)
	var result []vfs.FileInfo

	for _, f := range a.files() {
		ep := normalizePath(f.Name)
		rel := childOf(ep, path)
		if rel == "" {
			continue
		}
		// rel is the immediate child name (no slashes) or "dir/..." (need dir node).
		parts := strings.SplitN(rel, "/", 2)
		childName := parts[0]
		if seen[childName] {
			continue
		}
		seen[childName] = true

		if len(parts) == 1 {
			// Leaf entry — use its actual metadata.
			result = append(result, &zipFileInfo{f: f, chain: a.chain})
		} else {
			// Implicit or explicit directory — synthesize.
			result = append(result, &zipFileInfo{
				synthetic: true,
				name:      childName,
				isDir:     true,
				chain:     a.chain,
			})
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (a *Archive) Exists(ctx context.Context, path string) bool {
	info, err := a.Stat(ctx, path)
	return err == nil && info != nil
}

// Write operations — all return ErrReadOnly since ZIP rewrite happens at Close().

func (a *Archive) Create(_ context.Context, _ string) (vfs.File, error) {
	if a.readOnly {
		return nil, vfs.ErrReadOnly
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("zip: in-archive Create not yet implemented; use Add after Close")
}

func (a *Archive) Mkdir(_ context.Context, _ string, _ fs.FileMode) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}

func (a *Archive) Remove(_ context.Context, _ string) error {
	if a.readOnly {
		return vfs.ErrReadOnly
	}
	// TODO: mark for removal; rewrite on Close.
	return fmt.Errorf("zip: Remove not yet implemented")
}

func (a *Archive) Rename(_ context.Context, _, _ string) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}

func (a *Archive) Join(elem ...string) string { return strings.Join(elem, "/") }
func (a *Archive) Split(path string) (string, string) {
	i := strings.LastIndex(path, "/")
	if i < 0 {
		return "", path
	}
	return path[:i], path[i+1:]
}
func (a *Archive) IsAbs(path string) bool { return strings.HasPrefix(path, "/") }

func (a *Archive) RealPath(_ string) (string, error) {
	// Nested archives have no direct OS path for individual entries.
	if len(a.chain) > 0 {
		return "", nil
	}
	return a.osPath, nil
}

// ── archive.Archive ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func (a *Archive) Comment() string { return "" } // zip.ReadCloser exposes comment via r.Comment
func (a *Archive) IsSolid() bool   { return false }
func (a *Archive) EntryCount() int { return len(a.files()) }

func (a *Archive) Extract(ctx context.Context, srcEntryPath, dstOSPath string) error {
	rc, err := a.Open(ctx, srcEntryPath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer rc.Close()
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dstOSPath), 0755); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	out, err := os.Create(dstOSPath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer out.Close()
	_, err = io.Copy(out, rc)
	return err
}

func (a *Archive) ExtractSelected(ctx context.Context, entries []string, dstOSPath string, opts archive.ExtractOptions) (*archive.ExtractResult, error) {
	result := &archive.ExtractResult{}

	for _, f := range a.files() {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return result, ctx.Err()
		}
		ep := normalizePath(f.Name)
		if !matchesEntries(ep, entries) {
			continue
		}
		if f.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			continue
		}

		relPath := rebasePath(ep, opts.StripPrefix)
		if relPath == "" {
			continue
		}

		var dstPath string
		if opts.FlattenPaths {
			dstPath = filepath.Join(dstOSPath, filepath.Base(filepath.FromSlash(relPath)))
		} else {
			dstPath = filepath.Join(dstOSPath, filepath.FromSlash(relPath))
		}

		// Conflict resolution.
		if _, err := os.Lstat(dstPath); err == nil && opts.OnConflict != nil {
			resolved, skip, err := opts.OnConflict(ep, dstPath)
			if err != nil {
				result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: ep, Err: err})
				result.Failed++
				continue
			}
			if skip {
				continue
			}
			dstPath = resolved
		}

		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(dstPath), 0755); err != nil {
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: ep, Err: err})
			result.Failed++
			continue
		}

		rc, err := f.Open()
		if err != nil {
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: ep, Err: err})
			result.Failed++
			continue
		}

		out, err := os.Create(dstPath)
		if err != nil {
			rc.Close()
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: ep, Err: err})
			result.Failed++
			continue
		}

		n, err := io.Copy(out, rc)
		rc.Close()
		out.Close()
		if err != nil {
			result.Errors = append(result.Errors, archive.EntryError{Entry: ep, Err: err})
			result.Failed++
			continue
		}

		if opts.Progress != nil {
			opts.Progress(result.Bytes+n, 0, ep)
		}
		result.Extracted++
		result.Bytes += n
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (a *Archive) Close() error {
	if a.reader != nil {
		return a.reader.Close()
	}
	return nil // in-memory reader has no Close
}

// ── zipFileInfo ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type zipFileInfo struct {
	f         *zip.File
	synthetic bool   // true for implicit directories not in the ZIP
	name      string // used when synthetic=true
	isDir     bool   // used when synthetic=true
	chain     []string
}

func (z *zipFileInfo) Name() string {
	if z.synthetic {
		return z.name
	}
	return filepath.Base(normalizePath(z.f.Name))
}
func (z *zipFileInfo) Size() int64 {
	if z.synthetic {
		return 0
	}
	return int64(z.f.UncompressedSize64)
}
func (z *zipFileInfo) Mode() fs.FileMode {
	if z.isDir || (z.f != nil && z.f.FileInfo().IsDir()) {
		return fs.ModeDir | 0755
	}
	return 0644
}
func (z *zipFileInfo) ModTime() time.Time {
	if z.synthetic || z.f == nil {
		return time.Time{}
	}
	return z.f.Modified
}
func (z *zipFileInfo) IsDir() bool {
	if z.synthetic {
		return z.isDir
	}
	return z.f.FileInfo().IsDir()
}
func (z *zipFileInfo) Sys() any { return nil }

func (z *zipFileInfo) Path() string {
	if z.f == nil {
		return ""
	}
	return normalizePath(z.f.Name)
}
func (z *zipFileInfo) RealPath() string   { return "" }
func (z *zipFileInfo) Volume() vfs.Volume { return nil }
func (z *zipFileInfo) IsArchive() bool {
	return !z.IsDir() && archive.IsArchiveExt(z.Name())
}
func (z *zipFileInfo) IsHidden() bool  { return strings.HasPrefix(z.Name(), ".") }
func (z *zipFileInfo) IsSymlink() bool { return false }
func (z *zipFileInfo) IsNested() bool  { return len(z.chain) > 0 }
func (z *zipFileInfo) MountChain() []string {
	if z.chain == nil {
		return nil
	}
	cp := make([]string, len(z.chain))
	copy(cp, z.chain)
	return cp
}

// ── zipFile ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type zipFile struct {
	rc   io.ReadCloser
	info *zipFileInfo
}

func (f *zipFile) Read(p []byte) (int, error)  { return f.rc.Read(p) }
func (f *zipFile) Write(p []byte) (int, error) { return 0, vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (f *zipFile) Seek(offset int64, whence int) (int64, error) {
	if s, ok := f.rc.(io.Seeker); ok {
		return s.Seek(offset, whence)
	}
	return 0, fmt.Errorf("zip entry does not support seeking")
}
func (f *zipFile) Close() error                { return f.rc.Close() }
func (f *zipFile) Stat() (vfs.FileInfo, error) { return f.info, nil }
func (f *zipFile) Sync() error                 { return nil }

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func normalizePath(p string) string {
	return pathutil.NormalizePath(p)
}

// childOf returns the path of ep relative to parent, or "" if ep is not under parent.
// Example: childOf("a/b/c.txt", "a/b") == "c.txt"
//
//	childOf("a/b/c.txt", "a")  == "b/c.txt"
//	childOf("a/b/c.txt", "")   == "a/b/c.txt"
func childOf(ep, parent string) string {
	return pathutil.ChildOf(ep, parent)
}

// matchesEntries reports whether ep matches any of the listed entry paths.
// An empty entries list means "everything".
func matchesEntries(ep string, entries []string) bool {
	return pathutil.MatchesEntries(ep, entries)
}

// rebasePath strips stripPrefix from ep.
func rebasePath(ep, stripPrefix string) string {
	return pathutil.RebasePath(ep, stripPrefix)
}

// Ensure interface compliance at compile time.
var _ archive.Handler = (*Handler)(nil)
var _ archive.Archive = (*Archive)(nil)
var _ vfs.FileSystem = (*Archive)(nil)
````

````go
package archive

import (
	"context"

	"wails-app/vfs"
)

// Handler is the interface every archive format plugin must implement.
// Register implementations with Register() from an init() function.
type Handler interface {
	// Identity & capability
	Name() string         // Short name: "zip", "tar.gz", "7z"
	Extensions() []string // Dot-prefixed: [".zip"], [".tar.gz", ".tgz"]
	Magic() []byte        // Header bytes for content-based detection (nil = extension only)
	CanRead() bool
	CanWrite() bool  // Supports in-place modification (rewrite)
	CanCreate() bool // Supports creating new archives from scratch
	CanStream() bool // Can read entries without seeking (good for tarballs)

	// Detect reports whether the first bytes of a file match this format.
	Detect(data []byte) bool

	// Open returns an Archive ready to use. The caller must call Archive.Close().
	Open(ctx context.Context, path string, opts OpenOptions) (Archive, error)
}

// OpenOptions controls how an archive is opened.
type OpenOptions struct {
	ReadOnly    bool
	Password    string   // For encrypted formats (zip AES, 7z, rar)
	NestedChain []string // Ordered list of entry paths to resolve before opening.
	// Example: outer.zip contains inner.tar.gz; NestedChain = ["inner.tar.gz"]
}

// Archive represents an opened archive and exposes it as a vfs.FileSystem.
// The caller is responsible for calling Close().
type Archive interface {
	vfs.FileSystem // Archives are navigable as read (and sometimes write) filesystems.

	// Archive-specific
	Comment() string // Global archive comment (zip supports this; others return "")
	IsSolid() bool   // True for solid-compression formats (7z, some rar)
	EntryCount() int // Total number of entries

	// Targeted extraction — more efficient than Open+Read for large archives.
	Extract(ctx context.Context, srcEntryPath, dstOSPath string) error
	ExtractSelected(ctx context.Context, entries []string, dstOSPath string, opts ExtractOptions) (*ExtractResult, error)

	Close() error
}

// ExtractOptions controls how entries are extracted to disk.
type ExtractOptions struct {
	// StripPrefix removes a leading path component from every entry before writing.
	// Example: StripPrefix="a/b" turns "a/b/c.txt" into "c.txt" at the destination.
	StripPrefix  string
	FlattenPaths bool // Drop all directory structure; write everything flat.
	PreserveTime bool // Restore mtime/atime from archive metadata.
	Progress     ProgressFunc
	// OnConflict is called when dstPath already exists.
	// Return the final path to write to, or ("", true, nil) to skip.
	OnConflict ConflictFunc
}

type ProgressFunc func(current, total int64, currentFile string)

// ExtractResult summarises the outcome of an ExtractSelected call.
type ExtractResult struct {
	Extracted int          // number of entries successfully written
	Bytes     int64        // total uncompressed bytes written
	Failed    int          // number of entries that could not be extracted
	Errors    []EntryError // per-entry errors (len == Failed)
}

// EntryError pairs an archive entry path with the error that occurred.
type EntryError struct {
	Entry string
	Err   error
}

// ConflictFunc is called when an extraction target already exists on disk.
// Returning ("", true, nil) skips the entry.
// Returning (path, false, nil) writes to path (which may differ from dst for renames).
type ConflictFunc func(src, dst string) (resolvedDst string, skip bool, err error)
````

````go
package memory

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
)

func TestDefaultRootProviderReconnectsToRunningSidecar(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("WAILS_MEMFS_ROOT", "")
	t.Setenv("MEMFS_HIDDEN_PATH", "")

	prev := connectionInfoFn
	connectionInfoFn = func() (*ConnectionInfo, error) {
		return &ConnectionInfo{HiddenPath: "memory://ignored", Pipe: "test", PID: 42, Platform: "test"}, nil
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		connectionInfoFn = prev
	})

	got := DefaultRootProvider()
	if got != "memory://ignored" {
		t.Fatalf("DefaultRootProvider should use running sidecar hidden path, got %q", got)
	}
}

func TestDefaultRootProviderPrefersExplicitEnv(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("WAILS_MEMFS_ROOT", `C:\explicit-root`)
	t.Setenv("MEMFS_HIDDEN_PATH", `C:\hidden-root`)

	prev := connectionInfoFn
	connectionInfoFn = func() (*ConnectionInfo, error) {
		return nil, errors.New("should not be called when env overrides are set")
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		connectionInfoFn = prev
	})

	got := DefaultRootProvider()
	if got != `C:\explicit-root` {
		t.Fatalf("DefaultRootProvider should prefer WAILS_MEMFS_ROOT, got %q", got)
	}
}
````

````go
package memory

import (
	"context"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"wails-app/vfs"
	"wails-app/vfs/osfs"
)

var connectionInfoFn = GetConnectionInfo

func DefaultRootProvider() string {
	if root := os.Getenv("WAILS_MEMFS_ROOT"); strings.TrimSpace(root) != "" {
		return root
	}
	if root := os.Getenv("MEMFS_HIDDEN_PATH"); strings.TrimSpace(root) != "" {
		return root
	}
	// GetConnectionInfo works on all platforms: Windows uses a named pipe,
	// Unix uses a domain socket. Failure is non-fatal — fall through to the
	// store-backed default.
	if info, err := connectionInfoFn(); err == nil {
		if root := strings.TrimSpace(info.HiddenPath); root != "" {
			return root
		}
	}
	return ""
}

type FS struct {
	resolver *PathResolver
}

func New(appName string, configuredRoot func() string) (*FS, error) {
	resolver, err := NewPathResolver(appName, configuredRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &FS{resolver: resolver}, nil
}

func (f *FS) ResolvePublicPath(path string) (string, bool, error) {
	return f.resolver.ResolvePublicPath(path)
}

}

}

	return f.backend().Open(ctx, path)
}
````

````go
)

// ControlPipe is the Unix domain socket path used to reach the running memfs
// sidecar. It is per-user so multiple accounts can coexist without conflict.
var ControlPipe = "/tmp/memfs-control-" + strconv.Itoa(os.Getuid()) + ".sock"

type ConnectionInfo struct {
	Platform   string `json:"platform"`
	PID        int    `json:"pid"`
	HiddenPath string `json:"hiddenPath"`
	Pipe       string `json:"pipe"`
}

type connectionInfoRequest struct {
	Action string `json:"action"`
}

// GetConnectionInfo connects to the running memfs sidecar via its Unix domain
// socket and retrieves the mount path exposed as HiddenPath.
func GetConnectionInfo() (*ConnectionInfo, error) {
	conn, err := net.Dial("unix", ControlPipe)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("connect to memfs control socket: %w", err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()

	reqBytes, err := json.Marshal(connectionInfoRequest{Action: "get-connection-info"})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, err := conn.Write(append(reqBytes, '\n')); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("write memfs control request: %w", err)
	}

	line, err := bufio.NewReader(conn).ReadString('\n')
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read memfs control response: %w", err)
	}

	var info ConnectionInfo
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(strings.TrimSpace(line)), &info); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode memfs control response: %w", err)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(info.HiddenPath) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("memfs control response missing hiddenPath")
	}
	return &info, nil
}
````

````go
package memory

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

const ControlPipe = `\\.\pipe\memfs-control`

type ConnectionInfo struct {
	Platform   string `json:"platform"`
	PID        int    `json:"pid"`
	HiddenPath string `json:"hiddenPath"`
	Pipe       string `json:"pipe"`
}

type connectionInfoRequest struct {
	Action string `json:"action"`
}

func GetConnectionInfo() (*ConnectionInfo, error) {
	pipePath, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(ControlPipe)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	handle, err := windows.CreateFile(
		pipePath,
		windows.GENERIC_READ|windows.GENERIC_WRITE,
		0,
		nil,
		windows.OPEN_EXISTING,
		0,
		0,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("connect to memfs control pipe: %w", err)
	}

	file := os.NewFile(uintptr(handle), ControlPipe)
	if file == nil {
		_ = windows.CloseHandle(handle)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("wrap memfs control pipe handle")
	}
	defer file.Close()

	reqBytes, err := json.Marshal(connectionInfoRequest{Action: "get-connection-info"})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, err := file.Write(append(reqBytes, '\n')); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("write memfs control request: %w", err)
	}

	line, err := bufio.NewReader(file).ReadString('\n')
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read memfs control response: %w", err)
	}

	var info ConnectionInfo
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(strings.TrimSpace(line)), &info); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode memfs control response: %w", err)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(info.HiddenPath) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("memfs control response missing hiddenPath")

	return &info, nil
````

````go
//go:build !windows

package memory

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime"
)

// CheckFUSEAvailable returns nil if a working FUSE installation is detected for
// the current platform, or a descriptive error if it cannot be found.
func CheckFUSEAvailable() error {
	switch runtime.GOOS {
	case "darwin":
		if _, err := os.Stat("/Library/Filesystems/macfuse.fs"); err == nil {
			return nil
		}
		if _, err := os.Stat("/Library/Filesystems/osxfuse.fs"); err == nil {
			return nil
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("macFUSE not found: install macFUSE from https://osxfuse.github.io/")
	default:
		// Linux and other Unix: check for /dev/fuse.
		if _, err := os.Stat("/dev/fuse"); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("FUSE not available: /dev/fuse not found")
		}
		return nil
	}
}
````

````go
//go:build !windows

package memory

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

// ProcessManager manages the lifecycle of the memfs sidecar process on Unix.
type ProcessManager struct {
	execPath  string
	mountPath string
	cmd       *exec.Cmd
}

// NewUnixProcessManager creates a manager that will mount memfs at mountPath
// using the binary found at execPath.
func NewUnixProcessManager(execPath, mountPath string) *ProcessManager {
	return &ProcessManager{execPath: execPath, mountPath: mountPath}
}

// DefaultUnixMountPath returns a per-user temp directory path for the given app name.
func DefaultUnixMountPath(appName string) string {
	return filepath.Join(os.TempDir(), appName+"-memfs-"+strconv.Itoa(os.Getuid()))
}

// Start prepares the mount directory with 0700 permissions, launches the
// memfs process with -owner-only, and waits up to timeout for the FUSE
// mount to become visible.
func (m *ProcessManager) Start(timeout time.Duration) error {
	if err := os.MkdirAll(m.mountPath, 0700); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create memfs mount dir: %w", err)
	}
	if err := os.Chmod(m.mountPath, 0700); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("chmod memfs mount dir: %w", err)
	}
	m.cmd = exec.Command(m.execPath, "-mount", m.mountPath, "-owner-only")
	// Put the sidecar in its own process group so a SIGTERM targets only it.
	m.cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid: true}
	if err := m.cmd.Start(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("start memfs process: %w", err)
	}
	return m.WaitReady(timeout)
}

// Stop sends SIGTERM to the memfs process group and waits up to 5 s for it
// to exit cleanly, then kills it if it has not exited.
func (m *ProcessManager) Stop() {
	if m.cmd == nil || m.cmd.Process == nil {
		return
	}
	_ = syscall.Kill(-m.cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGTERM)
	done := make(chan struct{}, 1)
	go func() {
		_ = m.cmd.Wait()
		done <- struct{}{}
	}()
	select {
	case <-done:
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		_ = m.cmd.Process.Kill()
	}
}

// WaitReady polls the mount directory until its device ID differs from the
// parent directory, which signals that a FUSE filesystem has been mounted.
func (m *ProcessManager) WaitReady(timeout time.Duration) error {
	parent := filepath.Dir(m.mountPath)
	parentInfo, err := os.Stat(parent)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("stat memfs mount parent %s: %w", parent, err)
	}
	parentDev := parentInfo.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t).Dev

	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		if state := m.cmd.ProcessState; state != nil && state.Exited() {
			return fmt.Errorf("memfs process exited before mount became ready")
		}
		if info, statErr := os.Stat(m.mountPath); statErr == nil {
			if info.Sys().(*syscall.Stat_t).Dev != parentDev {
				return nil
			}
		}
		time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("memfs mount at %s did not become ready within %s", m.mountPath, timeout)
}
````
