## File: frontend/src/app/components/file-browser-clipboard.controller.ts
````typescript
import type { ApiService } from '../services/api.service';
import type { ConfirmDialogService } from '../services/confirm-dialog.service';
import { BatchItemError, operationErrorMessage } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import type { SourceCapabilities } from '../services/source-capabilities';
import { canReceiveTransfer, transferBlockedMessage } from '../services/transfer-capabilities';

export interface FileBrowserClipboardPane {
  currentPath: string;
  selectedFiles: Set<string>;
  sourceCapabilities: SourceCapabilities;
}

export interface FileBrowserClipboardHost {
  getActivePane(): FileBrowserClipboardPane | undefined;
  getActivePaneId(): 'left' | 'right';
  apiService: ApiService;
  confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService;
  buildDestinationPath(sourcePath: string, targetDir: string): Promise<string>;
  runCrossPaneCopy(sourceSide: 'left' | 'right', paths: string[]): Promise<void>;
  runCrossPaneMove(sourceSide: 'left' | 'right', paths: string[]): Promise<void>;
}

export class FileBrowserClipboardController {
  copySelectedToClipboard(host: FileBrowserClipboardHost): { operation: 'copy' | 'cut'; paths: string[] } | null {
    const pane = host.getActivePane();
    if (!pane?.selectedFiles.size) {
      return null;
    }
    return { operation: 'copy', paths: Array.from(pane.selectedFiles) };
  }

  cutSelectedToClipboard(host: FileBrowserClipboardHost): { operation: 'copy' | 'cut'; paths: string[] } | null {
    const pane = host.getActivePane();
    if (!pane?.selectedFiles.size) {
      return null;
    }
    return { operation: 'cut', paths: Array.from(pane.selectedFiles) };
  }

  async pasteFromClipboard(
    host: FileBrowserClipboardHost,
    clipboard: { operation: 'copy' | 'cut'; paths: string[] } | null,
  ): Promise<{ operation: 'copy' | 'cut'; paths: string[] } | null> {
    if (!clipboard) {
      return clipboard;
    }

    const targetPane = host.getActivePane();
    if (!targetPane) {
      return clipboard;
    }

    const operation = clipboard.operation === 'copy' ? 'copy' : 'move';
    const destinationDecision = canReceiveTransfer(targetPane.sourceCapabilities);
    if (!destinationDecision.allowed) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert(transferBlockedMessage(operation, destinationDecision));
      return clipboard;
    }

    try {
      const items = await Promise.all(clipboard.paths.map(async sourcePath => ({
        source: sourcePath,
        destination: await host.buildDestinationPath(sourcePath, targetPane.currentPath),
      })));

      const result = clipboard.operation === 'copy'
        ? await host.apiService.batchCopy(items, true)
        : await host.apiService.batchMove(items, true);

      if (result.failed > 0) {
        const errorMsg = (result.errors as BatchItemError[] ?? []).map(e =>
          `${e.source}: ${operationErrorMessage(e.code)}${e.code === 'unknown' && e.error ? ` (${e.error})` : ''}`
        ).join('\n');
        host.confirmDialog.alert(`Paste Completed with ${result.failed} Errors\n${errorMsg}`);
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert(`Paste Error\n${error.message}`);
    }

    return clipboard.operation === 'cut' ? null : clipboard;
  }

  async copyToOtherPaneCurrent(host: FileBrowserClipboardHost): Promise<void> {
    const pane = host.getActivePane();
    const paths = Array.from(pane?.selectedFiles || []);
    if (paths.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    await host.runCrossPaneCopy(host.getActivePaneId(), paths);
  }

  async moveToOtherPaneCurrent(host: FileBrowserClipboardHost): Promise<void> {
    const pane = host.getActivePane();
    const paths = Array.from(pane?.selectedFiles || []);
    if (paths.length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    await host.runCrossPaneMove(host.getActivePaneId(), paths);
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { ActionAvailability } from '../services/action-availability';
import { BC } from './file-browser-command-registry';

/**
 * Maps browser command IDs onto the capability-derived action state.
 * Unknown commands remain available; their own context/handler is responsible
 * for any additional applicability rules.
 */
export function isFileBrowserCommandAvailable(
  commandId: string,
  availability: ActionAvailability,
): boolean {
  switch (commandId) {
    case BC.copy: return availability.copySelected;
    case BC.cut: return availability.cutSelected;
    case BC.paste: return availability.paste;
    case BC.deleteSelected: return availability.deleteSelected;
    case BC.newFolder: return availability.createFolder;
    case BC.rename:
    case BC.batchRename: return availability.rename;
    case BC.copyToOtherPane: return availability.copyToOther;
    case BC.moveToOtherPane: return availability.moveToOther;
    default: return true;
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { ApiService } from '../services/api.service';
import type { ConfirmDialogService } from '../services/confirm-dialog.service';
import type { FilePaneBrowserCommands } from './file-pane-browser-commands.factory';
import type { SourceCapabilities } from '../services/source-capabilities';
import { canReceiveTransfer, transferBlockedMessage } from '../services/transfer-capabilities';

export interface FileBrowserDropPane {
  getDestinationDir(): string;
  isInArchive(): boolean;
  sourceCapabilities: SourceCapabilities;
  browserCommands: Pick<FilePaneBrowserCommands, 'navigation'>;
}

export interface FileBrowserDropHost {
  getActivePane(): FileBrowserDropPane | undefined;
  getLeftPane(): FileBrowserDropPane | undefined;
  getRightPane(): FileBrowserDropPane | undefined;
  getPanesContainer(): HTMLElement | undefined;
  getLeftPaneWidth(): number;
  apiService: ApiService;
  confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService;
  buildDestinationPath(sourcePath: string, targetDir: string): Promise<string>;
}

export class FileBrowserDropController {
  async handleNativeFileDrop(host: FileBrowserDropHost, x: number, y: number, paths: string[]): Promise<void> {
    if (!paths.length) {
      return;
    }

    const sourcePaths = paths
      .map(path => (path || '').trim())
      .filter(path => path.length > 0);
    if (!sourcePaths.length) {
      return;
    }

    const targetPane = this.resolveDropTargetPane(host, x, y);
    if (!targetPane) {
      return;
    }

    if (targetPane.isInArchive()) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert('Drag & Drop Not Supported In Archive\nDrop into a filesystem folder instead.');
      return;
    }

    const destinationDecision = canReceiveTransfer(targetPane.sourceCapabilities);
    if (!destinationDecision.allowed) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert(transferBlockedMessage('copy', destinationDecision));
      return;
    }

    const destinationDir = targetPane.getDestinationDir();
    if (!destinationDir) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const items = await Promise.all(
        sourcePaths.map(async sourcePath => ({
          source: sourcePath,
          destination: await host.buildDestinationPath(sourcePath, destinationDir),
        }))
      );

      await host.apiService.batchCopy(items, true);
      await targetPane.browserCommands.navigation.refresh();
    } catch (error: any) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert(`Drag & Drop Failed\n${error?.message ?? String(error)}`);
    }
  }

  private resolveDropTargetPane(host: FileBrowserDropHost, x: number, y: number): FileBrowserDropPane | undefined {
    const container = host.getPanesContainer();
    if (!container) {
      return host.getActivePane();
    }

    const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    const insideContainer = x >= rect.left && x <= rect.right && y >= rect.top && y <= rect.bottom;
    if (!insideContainer) {
      return host.getActivePane();
    }

    const splitX = rect.left + (rect.width * host.getLeftPaneWidth() / 100);
    return x <= splitX ? host.getLeftPane() : host.getRightPane();
  }
}
````

````typescript
export interface FileBrowserLayoutHost {
  getLeftPaneWidth(): number;
  getRightPaneWidth(): number;
  setPaneWidths(left: number, right: number): void;
  /** Returns the persisted split ratio for the active workspace, if any. */
  getWorkspaceSplitRatio?(): number | undefined;
  /** Persist the new split ratio on the active workspace. */
  saveWorkspaceSplitRatio?(leftWidth: number): void;
}

export class FileBrowserLayoutController {
  private readonly minPaneWidth = 20;
  private readonly maxPaneWidth = 80;

  loadPaneWidths(host: FileBrowserLayoutHost): void {
    const fromWorkspace = host.getWorkspaceSplitRatio?.();
    if (typeof fromWorkspace === 'number' && Number.isFinite(fromWorkspace) && fromWorkspace > 0) {
      this.setPanePosition(host, fromWorkspace, false);
      return;
    }

    const savedSplit = localStorage.getItem('split-pos');
    const savedLeftWidth = localStorage.getItem('fileManager_leftPaneWidth');
    const raw = savedSplit ?? savedLeftWidth;
    if (!raw) {
      return;
    }

    const parsed = parseFloat(raw);
    if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) {
      return;
    }

    this.setPanePosition(host, parsed, false);
  }

  syncPaneWidths(host: FileBrowserLayoutHost, leftWidth: number): void {
    this.setPanePosition(host, leftWidth, true);
  }

  nudgeDividerLeft(host: FileBrowserLayoutHost): void {
    this.setPanePosition(host, host.getLeftPaneWidth() - 5, true);
  }

  nudgeDividerRight(host: FileBrowserLayoutHost): void {
    this.setPanePosition(host, host.getLeftPaneWidth() + 5, true);
  }

  private savePaneWidths(host: FileBrowserLayoutHost): void {
    const left = host.getLeftPaneWidth();
    const right = host.getRightPaneWidth();
    localStorage.setItem('fileManager_leftPaneWidth', left.toString());
    localStorage.setItem('fileManager_rightPaneWidth', right.toString());
    localStorage.setItem('split-pos', left.toString());
    host.saveWorkspaceSplitRatio?.(left);
  }

  private clampWidth(width: number): number {
    return Math.max(this.minPaneWidth, Math.min(this.maxPaneWidth, width));
  }

  private setPanePosition(host: FileBrowserLayoutHost, leftWidth: number, persist: boolean): void {
    const left = this.clampWidth(leftWidth);
    host.setPaneWidths(left, 100 - left);
    if (persist) {
      this.savePaneWidths(host);
    }
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { PathHistoryService } from '../services/path-history.service';
import type { ApiService } from '../services/api.service';
import type { SearchResultItem } from '../services/global-search.service';
import { parentPath } from './address-bar.utils';

export interface FileBrowserSearchPane {
  currentPath: string;
  onPathChange(path: string): void;
  openSearchResult(result: SearchResultItem): Promise<void>;
  openSearchSurface(location: string, query: string): Promise<void>;
}

export interface FileBrowserSearchHost {
  pathHistoryService: PathHistoryService;
  apiService: ApiService;
  getActivePane(): FileBrowserSearchPane | undefined;
}

export class FileBrowserSearchController {
  onPanePathChange(host: FileBrowserSearchHost, paneId: string, path: string): void {
    host.pathHistoryService.addPath(path, paneId);
  }

  async openGlobalSearchAsFolder(host: FileBrowserSearchHost, query: string): Promise<void> {
    const pane = host.getActivePane();
    if (!pane) {
      return;
    }

    const trimmedQuery = query.trim();
    if (!trimmedQuery) {
      return;
    }

    const aliasPath = await host.apiService.buildSearchAlias(pane.currentPath, trimmedQuery, true);
    await pane.openSearchSurface(aliasPath, trimmedQuery);
  }

  async onGlobalSearchResult(host: FileBrowserSearchHost, result: SearchResultItem): Promise<void> {
    const pane = host.getActivePane();
    if (!pane) {
      return;
    }

    if (result.file.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      await pane.openSearchResult(result);
      return;
    }

    const targetDir = parentPath(result.file.path);
    if (targetDir === result.file.path) {
      pane.onPathChange(targetDir);
      return;
    }

    await pane.openSearchResult(result);
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { ConfirmDialogService } from '../services/confirm-dialog.service';
import type { WorkspaceService } from '../services/workspace.service';
import type { WorkspaceConfig } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

export interface FileBrowserWorkspaceHost {
  workspaceService: WorkspaceService;
  confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService;
  getActiveWorkspace(): WorkspaceConfig | null;
  getShowHidden(): boolean;
  getShowWorkspaceMenu(): boolean;
  setShowHidden(showHidden: boolean): void;
  setShowWorkspaceMenu(show: boolean): void;
  refreshPanes(): Promise<void>;
}

export class FileBrowserWorkspaceController {
  async createNewWorkspace(host: FileBrowserWorkspaceHost): Promise<void> {
    const name = (await host.confirmDialog.prompt({
      title: 'New Workspace',
      message: 'Enter workspace name.',
      confirmText: 'Create',
      cancelText: 'Cancel',
      placeholder: 'Workspace name',
      defaultValue: '',
      historyKey: 'workspace.name',
    }))?.trim();
    if (!name) {
      return;
    }

    const workspace = await host.workspaceService.createWorkspace(name);
    host.workspaceService.switchWorkspace(workspace.id);
    host.setShowWorkspaceMenu(false);
  }

  switchWorkspace(host: FileBrowserWorkspaceHost, workspaceId: string): void {
    host.workspaceService.switchWorkspace(workspaceId);
    host.setShowWorkspaceMenu(false);
  }

  toggleWorkspaceMenu(host: FileBrowserWorkspaceHost, event?: Event): void {
    event?.stopPropagation();
    host.setShowWorkspaceMenu(!host.getShowWorkspaceMenu());
  }

  closeWorkspaceMenu(host: FileBrowserWorkspaceHost): void {
    host.setShowWorkspaceMenu(false);
  }

  async deleteCurrentWorkspace(host: FileBrowserWorkspaceHost): Promise<void> {
    const activeWorkspace = host.getActiveWorkspace();
    if (!activeWorkspace) {
      return;
    }

    const confirmed = await host.confirmDialog.confirm({
      title: 'Delete Workspace',
      message: `Delete workspace "${activeWorkspace.name}"?`,
      confirmText: 'Delete',
      danger: true,
    });
    if (!confirmed) {
      return;
    }

    host.workspaceService.deleteWorkspace(activeWorkspace.id);
  }

  async renameCurrentWorkspace(host: FileBrowserWorkspaceHost): Promise<void> {
    const activeWorkspace = host.getActiveWorkspace();
    if (!activeWorkspace) {
      return;
    }

    const name = (await host.confirmDialog.prompt({
      title: 'Rename Workspace',
      message: 'Enter new workspace name.',
      confirmText: 'Rename',
      cancelText: 'Cancel',
      placeholder: 'Workspace name',
      defaultValue: activeWorkspace.name,
      historyKey: 'workspace.name',
    }))?.trim();
    if (!name) {
      return;
    }

    host.workspaceService.updateWorkspace(activeWorkspace.id, { name });
  }

  async toggleShowHidden(host: FileBrowserWorkspaceHost): Promise<void> {
    const nextShowHidden = !host.getShowHidden();
    host.setShowHidden(nextShowHidden);

    const activeWorkspace = host.getActiveWorkspace();
    if (activeWorkspace) {
      host.workspaceService.updateWorkspace(activeWorkspace.id, {
        showHidden: nextShowHidden,
      });
    }

    await host.refreshPanes();
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, ChangeDetectorRef, Component, ElementRef, EventEmitter, HostBinding, Input, OnChanges, OnDestroy, Output, SimpleChanges, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';

import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';

import { FileCategoryResolverService } from '../services/file-category-resolver.service';

export interface FileEntrySelectEvent {
  entry: FileInfo;
  mouseEvent: MouseEvent;

/** Sentinel path for the virtual ".." parent-directory entry. */
export const PARENT_ENTRY_PATH = '__parent__';

/** Smart truncate file names while preserving extension. */
function truncateFileName(name: string, maxLength: number): string {
  if (!name || name.length <= maxLength) {
    return name;
  }

  // Find the last dot to separate name from extension
  const lastDotIndex = name.lastIndexOf('.');
  const hasExtension = lastDotIndex > 0 && lastDotIndex < name.length - 1;

  if (!hasExtension || lastDotIndex < 3) {
    // No extension or very short base name, just truncate at end
    return name.slice(0, Math.max(1, maxLength - 1)) + '…';
  }

  const baseName = name.slice(0, lastDotIndex);
  const extension = name.slice(lastDotIndex);
  const maxBaseLength = Math.max(1, maxLength - extension.length - 1); // -1 for ellipsis

  if (maxBaseLength < 3) {
    // Not enough space to show meaningful base + extension
    return name.slice(0, maxLength - 1) + '…';
  }

  // Truncate base name and add ellipsis in the middle to hint at full length
  const keep = Math.max(1, Math.floor(maxBaseLength / 2) - 1);
  return baseName.slice(0, keep) + '…' + extension;
}

      flex-shrink: 0;
      position: relative;
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;

      --symlink-badge-bottom: -1px;

      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1;
      display: block;
    }

    .symlink-badge {
      position: absolute;
      right: var(--symlink-badge-right);
      bottom: var(--symlink-badge-bottom);
      width: var(--symlink-badge-size);
      height: var(--symlink-badge-size);
      pointer-events: none;
      transform: var(--symlink-badge-transform);

      filter:

    :host-context(.compact-mode) .file-entry {

      height: 16px;

      --symlink-badge-bottom: -1px;
      --symlink-badge-transform: translate(0%, 0%);
    }

    :host-context(.compact-mode) .icon-emoji {
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    /* ── Inline variant ─────────────────────────────────────── */
    :host(.variant-inline) .file-entry {
      min-height: auto;
      padding: 0;
      gap: 6px;
      border-left: none;
      border-radius: 0;

    :host(.variant-inline) .file-entry:hover,

      --symlink-badge-transform: translate(0%, 0%);

export class FileEntryComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input() entry!: FileInfo;
  @Input() selected = false;
  @Input() cursor = false;
  @Input() displayNameOverride: string | null = null;
  @Input() variant: 'row' | 'inline' | 'grid' = 'row';
  @Input() colorizeByMime = false;
  @Input() directorySizePending = false;
  @Input() showDirectorySizeSpinnerInName = false;

  @Output() select   = new EventEmitter<FileEntrySelectEvent>();
  @Output() navigate = new EventEmitter<FileInfo>();
  @Output() rename = new EventEmitter<{ entry: FileInfo; newName: string }>();

  @ViewChild('renameInput') renameInput?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;

  isRenaming = false;
  editingName = '';
  isParent = false;
  isSymlinkEntry = false;
  displayName = '';
  fullName = ''; // Store original name for tooltip
  mimeColorKind = 'default';
  iconEmoji = '📄';
  searchParentPath = '';
  showSearchBadgeInVariant = false;
  showSearchContextRow = false;
  showSearchContextGrid = false;
  showDirectorySizeSpinner = false;
  private resolvedCategoryId: string | null | undefined;
  private unwatchResolvedCategory: (() => void) | null = null;

  FileType = FileType;

  @HostBinding('class.variant-inline') get isInlineVariant(): boolean {
    return this.variant === 'inline';
  }

  @HostBinding('class.variant-grid') get isGridVariant(): boolean {
    return this.variant === 'grid';
  }

  @HostBinding('class.renaming') get isRenamingHost(): boolean {
    return this.isRenaming;
  }

  constructor(
    private readonly categoryResolver: FileCategoryResolverService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnChanges(_changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    this.bindResolvedCategory();
    this.rebuildRenderState();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.unwatchResolvedCategory?.();
  }

  isParentEntry(): boolean {
    return this.isParent;
  }

  /** True for file-symlinks (type === SYMLINK) and dir-symlinks (type === DIRECTORY, isSymlink === true). */
  isSymlink(): boolean {
    return this.isSymlinkEntry;
  }

  isSearchEntry(): boolean {
    return !!this.entry && !!(this.entry.searchParentPath || this.entry.searchPattern || this.entry.searchBasePath);
  }

  showSearchBadge(): boolean {
    return this.showSearchBadgeInVariant;
  }

  showSearchContextInRow(): boolean {
    return this.showSearchContextRow;
  }

  showSearchContextInGrid(): boolean {
    return this.showSearchContextGrid;
  }

  shouldShowDirectorySizeSpinner(): boolean {
    return this.showDirectorySizeSpinner;
  }

  getSearchParentPath(): string {
    return this.searchParentPath;
  }

  /**
   * Base emoji for the icon.
   * Symlinks show the icon of their target kind — the cyan badge
   * is the only indicator that distinguishes them from real entries.
   */
  getIconEmoji(): string {
    return this.iconEmoji;
  }

  private rebuildRenderState(): void {
    const entry = this.entry;
    const presentation = getFileEntryPresentation(entry, this.colorizeByMime, this.resolvedCategoryId ?? null);
    this.isParent = presentation.isParent;
    this.isSymlinkEntry = presentation.isSymlink;
    
    let displayName = this.displayNameOverride?.trim() || entry?.name || '';
    this.fullName = displayName; // Store original for tooltip
    
    // Apply smart truncation based on variant
    if (displayName && !this.isParent) {
      const maxLengthByVariant = this.variant === 'row' ? 85 : this.variant === 'inline' ? 65 : 55;
      displayName = truncateFileName(displayName, maxLengthByVariant);
    }
    this.displayName = displayName;
    
    this.mimeColorKind = presentation.mimeColorKind;
    this.searchParentPath = entry?.searchParentPath || '';
    const isSearchEntry = !!entry && !!(entry.searchParentPath || entry.searchPattern || entry.searchBasePath);
    this.showSearchBadgeInVariant = !this.isParent && this.variant !== 'inline' && isSearchEntry;
    this.showSearchContextRow = !this.isParent && this.variant === 'row' && isSearchEntry;
    this.showSearchContextGrid = !this.isParent && this.variant === 'grid' && isSearchEntry;
    this.showDirectorySizeSpinner = this.directorySizePending && !this.isParent && entry?.type === FileType.DIRECTORY;
    this.iconEmoji = presentation.iconEmoji;
  }

  private bindResolvedCategory(): void {
    this.unwatchResolvedCategory?.();
    this.unwatchResolvedCategory = null;
    this.resolvedCategoryId = undefined;

    const path = this.entry?.path;
    if (!path || !this.colorizeByMime) return;

    this.resolvedCategoryId = this.categoryResolver.getResolvedCategory(path);
    this.unwatchResolvedCategory = this.categoryResolver.watch(path, () => {
      this.resolvedCategoryId = this.categoryResolver.getResolvedCategory(path);
      this.rebuildRenderState();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
    this.categoryResolver.ensureResolved(this.entry);
  }

  onClick(mouseEvent: MouseEvent): void {
    if (this.isRenaming) return;
    this.select.emit({ entry: this.entry, mouseEvent });
  }

  onDoubleClick(): void {
    if (this.isRenaming) return;
    this.navigate.emit(this.entry);
  }

  /** Begin in-place rename. Parent components can call this (eg. for F2). */
  beginRename(): void {
    if (!this.entry || this.isParentEntry()) return;
    this.isRenaming = true;
    this.editingName = this.entry.name;
    setTimeout(() => {
      const input = this.renameInput?.nativeElement;
      if (!input) return;
      input.focus();
      input.select();
    }, 0);
  }

  private commitRename(): void {
    if (!this.isRenaming) return;
    const newName = (this.editingName ?? '').trim();
    this.isRenaming = false;
    if (!newName || newName === this.entry.name) return;
    this.rename.emit({ entry: this.entry, newName });
  }

  private cancelRename(): void {
    this.isRenaming = false;
    this.editingName = '';
  }

  onRenameInput(event: Event): void {
    const target = event.target as HTMLInputElement | null;
    this.editingName = target?.value ?? '';
  }

  onRenameBlur(): void {
    // Commit on blur to match common file manager UX.
    this.commitRename();
  }

  onRenameKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (event.key === 'Enter') {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      this.commitRename();
    } else if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      this.cancelRename();
    } else {
      event.stopPropagation();
    }
  }

  formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    if (bytes === 0) return '';
    const k = 1024, sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
    return `${parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2))} ${sizes[i]}`;
  }

  formatDate(timestamp: number): string {
    if (!Number.isFinite(timestamp) || timestamp <= 0) return '';
    const date = new Date(timestamp * 1000);
    return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? '' : date.toLocaleString();
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { EventsOff, EventsOn } from 'wailsjs/runtime';
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { normalizePath, pathIdentityKey, samePath } from './address-bar.utils';
import type { FileViewDirectorySource } from '../services/directory-source.service';
import type { DirListStreamController, DirStreamBatchEvent, DirStreamDoneEvent, DirStreamErrorEvent, DirStreamMetaEvent } from '../surfaces/dir/dir-list-stream.controller';
import type { WorkspaceService } from '../services/workspace.service';
import type { PathHistoryService } from '../services/path-history.service';

declare const window: any;

function describeDirectoryLoadError(error: unknown): string {
  if (typeof error === 'string') {
    const trimmed = error.trim();
    return trimmed || 'Failed to load directory';
  }

  if (error && typeof error === 'object') {
    const message = (error as { message?: unknown }).message;
    if (typeof message === 'string' && message.trim()) {
      return message.trim();
    }

    const name = (error as { name?: unknown }).name;
    if (typeof name === 'string' && name.trim()) {
      return name.trim();
    }
  }

  return 'Failed to load directory';
}

export interface FilePaneDirectoryHost {
  get paneId(): 'left' | 'right';
  get currentPath(): string;
  set currentPath(value: string);
  get fsParentDir(): string;
  set fsParentDir(value: string);
  get currentTabId(): string;
  get showHidden(): boolean;
  get entries(): FileInfo[];
  set entries(value: FileInfo[]);
  get filteredEntries(): FileInfo[];
  get selectedFiles(): Set<string>;
  set selectedFiles(value: Set<string>);
  get selectionCursorPath(): string | null;
  set selectionCursorPath(value: string | null);
  get selectionAnchorPath(): string | null;
  set selectionAnchorPath(value: string | null);
  get loading(): boolean;
  set loading(value: boolean);
  get error(): string | null;
  set error(value: string | null);
  workspaceService: WorkspaceService;
  pathHistoryService: PathHistoryService;
  directorySource: FileViewDirectorySource;
  dirStream: DirListStreamController;
  isInArchive(): boolean;
  exitArchive(): void;
  clearArchiveState(): void;
  withParentEntry(raw: FileInfo[], inArchive: boolean, fsPath: string): FileInfo[];
  applyFilter(): void;
  setShowHiddenLoaded(showHidden: boolean): void;
  emitPathChange(path: string): void;
  runInAngular(update: () => void): void;
  onRefresh(): void;
  hasSavedDirTabState(): boolean;
  restoreActiveDirTabState(): void;
  reapplyPendingDirTabRestore(): void;
  persistDirTabState(): void;
  scrollToCursorPath(path: string): void;
  focusTreeNode(path: string): void;
  shouldSuppressFsRefresh(): boolean;
}

export class FilePaneDirectoryController {
  private fsChangeDebounceTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private activeDirStreamPreserveUI = false;
  private pendingFocusPath: string | null = null;
  private loadRequestId = 0;

  bind(host: FilePaneDirectoryHost): void {
    EventsOn('fs:directoryChanged', (event: { paneId?: string; path?: string } | null) => {
      host.runInAngular(() => this.handleFsDirectoryChanged(host, event));
    });
    EventsOn('web:resourcesChanged', (event: { path?: string } | null) => {
      host.runInAngular(() => this.handleWebResourcesChanged(host, event));
    });

    host.dirStream.bind(host.paneId, {
      onMeta: (event, isFirst) => host.runInAngular(() => this.handleDirStreamMeta(host, event, isFirst)),
      onBatch: (event, baseEntries) => host.runInAngular(() => this.handleDirStreamBatch(host, event, baseEntries)),
      onDone: (event, baseEntries) => host.runInAngular(() => this.handleDirStreamDone(host, event, baseEntries)),
      onError: (event) => host.runInAngular(() => this.handleDirStreamError(host, event)),
    });
  }

  async unbind(host: FilePaneDirectoryHost): Promise<void> {
    if (this.fsChangeDebounceTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.fsChangeDebounceTimer);
      this.fsChangeDebounceTimer = null;
    }
    await host.dirStream.unbind();
    EventsOff('fs:directoryChanged', 'web:resourcesChanged');
  }

  async loadDirectory(host: FilePaneDirectoryHost, path: string, opts?: { preserveUI?: boolean; focusPath?: string }): Promise<void> {
    const requestId = ++this.loadRequestId;
    const requestTabId = host.currentTabId;
    await host.dirStream.cancelActive();
    host.exitArchive();
    host.clearArchiveState();
    this.activeDirStreamPreserveUI = !!opts?.preserveUI;
    this.pendingFocusPath = opts?.focusPath ?? null;
    host.loading = true;
    host.error = null;

    if (!this.activeDirStreamPreserveUI) {
      host.selectedFiles = new Set<string>();
      host.selectionCursorPath = null;
      host.selectionAnchorPath = null;
      host.entries = host.withParentEntry([], false, path);
      host.applyFilter();
    }

    try {
      if (!host.directorySource.supportsStreaming(path)) {
        const listing = await host.directorySource.listDirectory(path, host.showHidden);
        host.runInAngular(() => {
          if (!this.isActiveLoad(host, requestId, requestTabId)) return;
          this.handleDirectDirectoryLoad(host, listing.path, listing.entries);
        });
        return;
      }

      const streamId = await host.dirStream.start(path, host.showHidden);
      await host.dirStream.waitFor(streamId);
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (describeDirectoryLoadError(error) === 'Directory stream cancelled') {
        return;
      }
      console.warn('Directory load failed:', path, error);
      host.runInAngular(() => {
        if (!this.isActiveLoad(host, requestId, requestTabId)) return;
        host.error = describeDirectoryLoadError(error);
      });
    } finally {
      host.runInAngular(() => {
        if (!this.isActiveLoad(host, requestId, requestTabId)) return;
        this.activeDirStreamPreserveUI = false;
        this.pendingFocusPath = null;
        host.loading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  private isActiveLoad(host: FilePaneDirectoryHost, requestId: number, requestTabId: string): boolean {
    return requestId === this.loadRequestId && host.currentTabId === requestTabId;
  }

  private handleDirectDirectoryLoad(host: FilePaneDirectoryHost, path: string, entries: FileInfo[]): void {
    host.currentPath = path;
    host.fsParentDir = path;
    host.setShowHiddenLoaded(!!host.showHidden);
    host.workspaceService.updateTabPath(host.paneId, host.currentTabId, path);
    host.pathHistoryService.addPath(path, host.paneId);
    host.emitPathChange(path);

    const nextEntries = host.withParentEntry(entries, false, path);
    host.entries = nextEntries;

    if (host.selectedFiles.size > 0) {
      const present = new Set(nextEntries.map(entry => entry.path));
      const nextSelected = new Set(host.selectedFiles);
      for (const candidate of Array.from(nextSelected)) {
        if (!present.has(candidate)) nextSelected.delete(candidate);
      }
      host.selectedFiles = nextSelected;
    }

    host.applyFilter();

    if (this.pendingFocusPath) {
      const focusNorm = normalizePath(this.pendingFocusPath);
      const target = host.filteredEntries.find(entry => pathIdentityKey(entry.path) === pathIdentityKey(focusNorm));
      if (target) {
        host.selectionCursorPath = target.path;
        host.selectionAnchorPath = target.path;
        host.selectedFiles = new Set([target.path]);
        setTimeout(() => host.scrollToCursorPath(target.path), 0);
      }
      this.pendingFocusPath = null;
    } else if (host.hasSavedDirTabState()) {
      host.restoreActiveDirTabState();
    } else if (!host.selectionCursorPath) {
      const firstReal = host.filteredEntries.find(entry => entry.path !== '..');
      if (firstReal) {
        host.selectionCursorPath = firstReal.path;
        host.selectionAnchorPath = firstReal.path;
      }
    }

    host.persistDirTabState();
    setTimeout(() => host.focusTreeNode(path), 0);
    void window.go?.app?.App?.SetPaneDirectory?.(host.paneId, path);
  }

  private handleFsDirectoryChanged(host: FilePaneDirectoryHost, event: { paneId?: string; path?: string } | null): void {
    if (!event || event.paneId !== host.paneId) return;
    if (host.isInArchive()) return;
    if (host.shouldSuppressFsRefresh()) return;

    const current = (host.currentPath || '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
    const changed = (event.path || '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
    if (!current || !changed || !samePath(current, changed)) return;

    if (this.fsChangeDebounceTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.fsChangeDebounceTimer);
    }
    this.fsChangeDebounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.fsChangeDebounceTimer = null;
      if (host.shouldSuppressFsRefresh()) return;
      host.onRefresh();
    }, 150);
  }

  private handleWebResourcesChanged(host: FilePaneDirectoryHost, event: { path?: string } | null): void {
    if (!event) return;
    if (host.isInArchive()) return;
    if (host.shouldSuppressFsRefresh()) return;

    const current = (host.currentPath || '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
    const changed = (event.path || '').replace(/\\/g, '/');
    if (!current || !changed || !samePath(current, changed)) return;

    if (this.fsChangeDebounceTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.fsChangeDebounceTimer);
    }
    this.fsChangeDebounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.fsChangeDebounceTimer = null;
      if (host.shouldSuppressFsRefresh()) return;
      host.onRefresh();
    }, 150);
  }

  private handleDirStreamMeta(host: FilePaneDirectoryHost, event: DirStreamMetaEvent, isFirstMeta: boolean): void {
    host.currentPath = event.path;
    host.fsParentDir = event.path;
    host.setShowHiddenLoaded(!!event.showHidden);
    host.workspaceService.updateTabPath(host.paneId, host.currentTabId, event.path);
    host.pathHistoryService.addPath(event.path, host.paneId);
    if (isFirstMeta) {
      host.emitPathChange(event.path);
    }
    if (!this.activeDirStreamPreserveUI) {
      host.entries = host.withParentEntry([], false, event.path);
      host.applyFilter();
    }

    void window.go?.app?.App?.SetPaneDirectory?.(host.paneId, event.path);
  }

  private handleDirStreamBatch(host: FilePaneDirectoryHost, event: DirStreamBatchEvent, baseEntries: FileInfo[]): void {
    host.entries = host.withParentEntry(baseEntries, false, host.currentPath || event.path);
    host.applyFilter();
    host.reapplyPendingDirTabRestore();
  }

  private handleDirStreamDone(host: FilePaneDirectoryHost, event: DirStreamDoneEvent, baseEntries: FileInfo[]): void {
    host.entries = host.withParentEntry(baseEntries, false, event.path || host.currentPath);

    if (host.selectedFiles.size > 0) {
      const present = new Set(host.entries.map(entry => entry.path));
      const nextSelected = new Set(host.selectedFiles);
      for (const path of Array.from(nextSelected)) {
        if (!present.has(path)) nextSelected.delete(path);
      }
      host.selectedFiles = nextSelected;
    }

    host.applyFilter();

    if (this.pendingFocusPath) {
      const focusNorm = normalizePath(this.pendingFocusPath);
      const target = host.filteredEntries.find(entry => pathIdentityKey(entry.path) === pathIdentityKey(focusNorm));
      if (target) {
        host.selectionCursorPath = target.path;
        host.selectionAnchorPath = target.path;
        host.selectedFiles = new Set([target.path]);
        setTimeout(() => host.scrollToCursorPath(target.path), 0);
      }
      this.pendingFocusPath = null;
    } else if (host.hasSavedDirTabState()) {
      host.restoreActiveDirTabState();
    } else if (!host.selectionCursorPath) {
      const firstReal = host.filteredEntries.find(entry => entry.path !== '..');
      if (firstReal) {
        host.selectionCursorPath = firstReal.path;
        host.selectionAnchorPath = firstReal.path;
      }
    }

    host.persistDirTabState();
    setTimeout(() => host.focusTreeNode(event.path), 0);
  }

  private handleDirStreamError(host: FilePaneDirectoryHost, event: DirStreamErrorEvent): void {
    host.error = describeDirectoryLoadError(event.error);
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { FilePaneSurfaceContextFactory, type FilePaneSurfaceContextSource } from './file-pane-surface-context.factory';
import type { TabInfo } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

function tab(surfaceId: string, kind: TabInfo['kind'] = 'dir'): TabInfo {
  return {
    id: `tab-${surfaceId}`,
    title: surfaceId,
    path: '',
    kind,
    surfaceId,
    isActive: true,
    isPinned: false,
    createdAt: 1,
  };
}

function source(active: TabInfo): FilePaneSurfaceContextSource {
  return {
    paneId: 'left',
    currentTabId: active.id,
    tabs: [active],
    dirVm: {} as any,
    sizeManagerVm: {} as any,
  };
}

describe('FilePaneSurfaceContextFactory', () => {
  const factory = new FilePaneSurfaceContextFactory();

  it('creates a minimal extensible context for a foreign surface', () => {
    const ctx = factory.getSurfaceContextForTab(source(tab('console')), tab('console'));

    expect(ctx.surfaceId).toBe('console');
    expect(ctx.paneId).toBe('left');
    expect((ctx as any).dirVm).toBeUndefined();
    expect((ctx as any).viewer).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('keeps built-in dir context strongly populated', () => {
    const active = tab('dir');
    const host = source(active);
    const ctx = factory.getSurfaceContextForTab(host, active) as any;

    expect(ctx.surfaceId).toBe('dir');
    expect(ctx.kind).toBe('dir');
    expect(ctx.dirVm).toBe(host.dirVm);
  });

  it('uses surfaceId rather than legacy kind as the primary identity', () => {
    const active = tab('console', 'viewer');
    const ctx = factory.getSurfaceContextForTab(source(active), active);

    expect(ctx.surfaceId).toBe('console');
    expect((ctx as any).viewer).toBeUndefined();
  });
});
````

````typescript
import type { ViewLayout } from './file-view-container.component';
import { PARENT_ENTRY_PATH } from './file-entry.component';

export interface FilePaneUiHost {
  get paneId(): 'left' | 'right';
  get currentView(): ViewLayout;
  set currentView(value: ViewLayout);
  get sortField(): string;
  set sortField(value: string);
  get sortDirection(): 'asc' | 'desc';
  set sortDirection(value: 'asc' | 'desc');
  get directoriesFirst(): boolean;
  set directoriesFirst(value: boolean);
  get colorizeByMime(): boolean;
  set colorizeByMime(value: boolean);
  get selectedFiles(): Set<string>;
  set selectedFiles(value: Set<string>);
  getOptimisticHiddenPaths(): string[];
  setOptimisticHiddenPaths(paths: string[]): void;
  applyFilter(): void;
  persistDirTabState(): void;
  refreshCurrentPathTransparently(): Promise<void>;
}

export class FilePaneUiController {
  private optimisticHideListener?: (event: Event) => void;
  private optimisticRestoreListener?: (event: Event) => void;

  loadViewPreference(host: FilePaneUiHost): void {
    const savedView = localStorage.getItem('fileManager_viewMode') as ViewLayout | null;
    if (savedView === 'list' || savedView === 'grid' || savedView === 'tree' || savedView === 'details') {
      host.currentView = savedView;
    }

    const savedSortField = localStorage.getItem('fileManager_sortField');
    const savedSortDirection = localStorage.getItem('fileManager_sortDirection') as 'asc' | 'desc' | null;
    if (savedSortField) host.sortField = savedSortField;
    if (savedSortDirection === 'asc' || savedSortDirection === 'desc') host.sortDirection = savedSortDirection;

    const savedDirsFirst = localStorage.getItem('fileManager_directoriesFirst');
    if (savedDirsFirst === 'true' || savedDirsFirst === 'false') {
      host.directoriesFirst = savedDirsFirst === 'true';
    }

    const savedColorizeByMime = localStorage.getItem('fileManager_colorizeByMime');
    if (savedColorizeByMime === 'true' || savedColorizeByMime === 'false') {
      host.colorizeByMime = savedColorizeByMime === 'true';
    }
  }

  async onViewChange(host: FilePaneUiHost, view: ViewLayout): Promise<void> {
    const previousView = host.currentView;
    host.currentView = view;

    if (previousView === 'tree' && view !== 'tree') {
      await host.refreshCurrentPathTransparently();
      return;
    }

    host.applyFilter();
    host.persistDirTabState();
  }

  onSortChange(host: FilePaneUiHost, sort: { field: string; direction: 'asc' | 'desc' }): void {
    host.sortField = sort.field;
    host.sortDirection = sort.direction;
    host.applyFilter();
    host.persistDirTabState();
  }

  onDirectoriesFirstChange(host: FilePaneUiHost, value: boolean): void {
    host.directoriesFirst = value;
    host.applyFilter();
    host.persistDirTabState();
  }

  onColorizeByMimeChange(host: FilePaneUiHost, value: boolean): void {
    host.colorizeByMime = value;
    host.applyFilter();
    host.persistDirTabState();
  }

  bindOptimisticDnD(host: FilePaneUiHost): void {
    this.optimisticHideListener = (event: Event) => {
      const detail = (event as CustomEvent).detail as { paneId?: 'left' | 'right'; paths?: string[] } | undefined;
      if (!detail?.paneId || detail.paneId !== host.paneId) return;

      const paths = (detail.paths ?? []).filter(path => path && path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH);
      if (!paths.length) return;

      const hidden = new Set(host.getOptimisticHiddenPaths());
      for (const path of paths) hidden.add(path);
      host.setOptimisticHiddenPaths(Array.from(hidden));

      const nextSelected = new Set(host.selectedFiles);
      for (const path of paths) nextSelected.delete(path);
      host.selectedFiles = nextSelected;
      host.applyFilter();
    };

    this.optimisticRestoreListener = (event: Event) => {
      const detail = (event as CustomEvent).detail as { paneId?: 'left' | 'right'; paths?: string[] } | undefined;
      if (!detail?.paneId || detail.paneId !== host.paneId) return;

      const paths = (detail.paths ?? []).filter(path => path && path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH);
      if (!paths.length) return;

      const hidden = new Set(host.getOptimisticHiddenPaths());
      for (const path of paths) hidden.delete(path);
      host.setOptimisticHiddenPaths(Array.from(hidden));
      host.applyFilter();
    };

    window.addEventListener('pane:dnd-optimistic-hide', this.optimisticHideListener);
    window.addEventListener('pane:dnd-optimistic-restore', this.optimisticRestoreListener);
  }

  unbindOptimisticDnD(): void {
    if (this.optimisticHideListener) {
      window.removeEventListener('pane:dnd-optimistic-hide', this.optimisticHideListener);
      this.optimisticHideListener = undefined;
    }
    if (this.optimisticRestoreListener) {
      window.removeEventListener('pane:dnd-optimistic-restore', this.optimisticRestoreListener);
      this.optimisticRestoreListener = undefined;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Promotes the active pane's current view, sort, and grouping options to the
   * global "default for new tabs" slot. Called only from explicit user intent
   * (e.g. a "Set as default" action) — never from per-tab change handlers,
   * which previously caused per-tab tweaks to overwrite the global default.
   */
  promoteCurrentToDefault(host: FilePaneUiHost): void {
    localStorage.setItem('fileManager_viewMode', host.currentView);
    localStorage.setItem('fileManager_sortField', host.sortField);
    localStorage.setItem('fileManager_sortDirection', host.sortDirection);
    localStorage.setItem('fileManager_directoriesFirst', String(host.directoriesFirst));
    localStorage.setItem('fileManager_colorizeByMime', String(host.colorizeByMime));
  }
}
````
