    .tree-node-wrapper.drag-over-inside > .tree-node {
      background-color: var(--vsc-list-drop-background, rgba(0, 120, 212, 0.16));
      outline: 1px dashed var(--vsc-focus-border);
      outline-offset: -1px;
    }

    .indent-guide {
      display: inline-flex;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 20px;
      height: 22px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .indent-guide::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 7px;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 1px;
      background: var(--vsc-tree-indent-guide, rgba(255,255,255,0.06));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .indent-guide--active::before {
      background: var(--vsc-tree-indent-guide-active, rgba(255,255,255,0.12));
    }

    .indent-guide--skip::before,
    .indent-guide--skip::after {
      display: none;
    }

    .indent-guide--last::before {
      bottom: 50%;
    }

    .indent-guide--last::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 9px;
      top: calc(50% - 0.5px);
      width: 12px;
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--vsc-tree-indent-guide, rgba(255,255,255,0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .tree-twistie {
      width: 20px;
      height: 22px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
    }

    .tree-twistie--expandable { cursor: pointer; }
    .tree-twistie--expandable:hover { color: var(--vsc-foreground); }

    .tree-twistie svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .tree-twistie--expanded svg { transform: rotate(90deg); }

    .twistie-placeholder {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .tree-icon {
      width: 20px;
      height: 22px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .dir-symlink-icon {
      position: relative;
      &::after {
        content: '↗';
        position: absolute;
        bottom: -1px;
        right: -5px;
        font-size: 8px;
        line-height: 1;
        opacity: 0.8;
      }
    }

    .tree-entry {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
      margin-left: 3px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .tree-rename-input {
      flex: 1;
      height: 18px;
      margin: 0 4px;
      padding: 0 4px;
      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-focus-border);
      background: var(--vsc-input-background);
      color: var(--vsc-foreground);
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: inherit;
      outline: none;
    }

    .tree-empty, .tree-loading {
      padding: 20px;
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
      text-align: center;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .spinner {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      border: 2px solid var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
      border-bottom-color: transparent;
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
    }

    .selection-rect {
      position: absolute;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 20;
      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-focus-border);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-list-active-background) 45%, transparent);
    }

    @keyframes spin {
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }
  `]
})
export class FileTreeComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy, AfterViewInit {
  @Input() nodes: TreeNode[] = [];
  @Input() pendingDirectorySizePaths: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set();
  @Input() currentPath = '';
  @Input() paneActive = true;
  @Input() colorizeByMime = false;
  @Input() selectedFiles: Set<string> = new Set();
  @Input() loading = false;
  @Input() emptyMessage = 'No items';

  @Output() selectionChange = new EventEmitter<TreeNode[]>();
  @Output() inlineSize = new EventEmitter<TreeNode>();
  @Output() nodeDoubleClick = new EventEmitter<TreeNode>();
  @Output() navigate = new EventEmitter<TreeNode>();
  @Output() openInNewTab = new EventEmitter<TreeNode>();
  @Output() toggleExpand = new EventEmitter<TreeNode>();
  @Output() loadChildren = new EventEmitter<TreeNode>();
  @Output() contextMenu = new EventEmitter<{ event: MouseEvent; node: TreeNode }>();
  @Output() backgroundContextMenu = new EventEmitter<MouseEvent>();
  @Output() dragStart = new EventEmitter<{ event: DragEvent; nodes: TreeNode[] }>();
  @Output() dragDrop = new EventEmitter<{ event: DragEvent; source: TreeNode[]; target: DropTarget }>();
  @Output() rename = new EventEmitter<{ node: TreeNode; newName: string }>();

  @ViewChild('renameInput') renameInput?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;
  @ViewChild('treeContainer') treeContainer?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  private expansionState = new Map<string, boolean>();
  private desiredExpandedPaths = new Set<string>();
  private pendingRenameDisplayNames = new Map<string, string>();
  private suppressNextAutoExpand = false;
  private focusedNodePath: string | null = null;
  private anchorNodePath: string | null = null;
  private clickTimer: number | null = null;
  private isMouseDownSelecting = false;

  dragState = {
    isDragging: false,
    draggedNodes: [] as TreeNode[],
    dropTarget: null as DropTarget | null
  };

  isFocused = false;
  FileType = FileType;

  isDirectorySizePending(path: string): boolean {
    return this.pendingDirectorySizePaths.has(path);
  }

  // OPTIMIZED: Virtual scroll for massive trees
  private readonly VIRTUAL_THRESHOLD = 500;
  private readonly VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT = 22;
  private readonly VIRTUAL_OVERSCAN = 20;
  private scrollRAF: number | null = null;
  private boundScrollListener?: () => void;
  private resizeObserver?: ResizeObserver;
  
  private flatVisibleNodes: TreeNode[] = [];
  private virtualStart = 0;
  private virtualEnd = 0;
  private lastScrollTop = 0;
  private viewportHeight = 0;
  private visibleWindowNodesCache: TreeNode[] = [];
  private visibleNodeIndex = new Map<string, number>();

  constructor(
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private zone: NgZone,
    private categoryResolver: FileCategoryResolverService,
  ) {}

  // ── Marquee selection state ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  selectionRect = { active: false, left: 0, top: 0, width: 0, height: 0 };

  get showSelectionRect(): boolean {
    return this.selectionRect.active && this.marqueeButton !== 2;
  }

  private marqueeContainer: HTMLElement | null = null;
  private marqueeStartX = 0;
  private marqueeStartY = 0;
  private marqueeAppend = false;
  private marqueeButton: 0 | 2 | null = null;
  private hasMarqueeMoved = false;
  private pendingClearOnMove = false;
  private suppressContainerClick = false;
  private suppressContainerContextMenu = false;
  private suppressItemContextMenu = false;
  private windowMouseMove?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
  private windowMouseUp?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
  private windowContextMenu?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;

  get visibleNodeCount(): number {
    return this.flatVisibleNodes.length;
  }

  get virtualEnabled(): boolean {
    return this.visibleNodeCount >= this.VIRTUAL_THRESHOLD;
  }

  get visibleWindowNodes(): TreeNode[] {
    return this.visibleWindowNodesCache;
  }

  get totalContentHeight(): number {
    return this.visibleNodeCount * this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT;
  }

  get virtualWindowTransform(): string {
    if (!this.virtualEnabled) return '';
    return `translateY(${this.virtualStart * this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT}px)`;
  }

  get renderedNodes(): TreeNode[] {
    const root = this.nodes[0];
    if (this.nodes.length === 1 && typeof root?.syntheticRoot === 'string') {
      return root.children ?? [];
    }
    return this.nodes;
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    this.setupResizeObserver();
    this.setupScrollListener();
    this.refreshVisibleNodes();
    this.updateVirtualWindow(true);
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['nodes'] || changes['colorizeByMime']) {
      this.prewarmCollisionResolutions(this.nodes);
      if (changes['nodes']) {
        this.updateNodeHierarchy(this.nodes);
        this.applyDesiredExpansion();
      }
    }
    const shouldExpandToCurrentPath =
      this.desiredExpandedPaths.size === 0 &&
      (!!changes['currentPath'] || (!!changes['nodes'] && !this.suppressNextAutoExpand));
    if (shouldExpandToCurrentPath) {
      this.expandToCurrentPath();
    }
    if (changes['nodes'] && this.suppressNextAutoExpand) {
      this.suppressNextAutoExpand = false;
    }
    this.refreshVisibleNodes();
    this.updateVirtualWindow(true);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private prewarmCollisionResolutions(nodes: TreeNode[]): void {
    if (!this.colorizeByMime) {
      return;
    }
    for (const node of nodes) {
      this.categoryResolver.ensureResolved(node);
      if (node.children?.length) {
        this.prewarmCollisionResolutions(node.children);
      }
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.detachMarqueeListeners();
    this.cleanupResizeObserver();
    this.cleanupScrollListener();
    if (this.scrollRAF) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.scrollRAF);
    }
  }

  private setupResizeObserver(): void {
    const element = this.treeContainer?.nativeElement;
    if (!element) return;

    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      this.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
        let shouldMark = false;
        for (const entry of entries) {
          if (this.viewportHeight !== entry.contentRect.height) {
            this.viewportHeight = entry.contentRect.height;
            shouldMark = this.updateVirtualWindow() || shouldMark;
          }
        }
        if (shouldMark) {
          this.zone.run(() => this.cdr.markForCheck());
        }
      });

      this.resizeObserver.observe(element);
    });
  }

  private cleanupResizeObserver(): void {
    this.resizeObserver?.disconnect();
  }

  private setupScrollListener(): void {
    const element = this.treeContainer?.nativeElement;
    if (!element) return;
    this.boundScrollListener = () => this.onScroll();
    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      element.addEventListener('scroll', this.boundScrollListener!, { passive: true });
    });
  }

  private cleanupScrollListener(): void {
    const element = this.treeContainer?.nativeElement;
    if (!element || !this.boundScrollListener) return;
    element.removeEventListener('scroll', this.boundScrollListener);
    this.boundScrollListener = undefined;
  }

  private onScroll(): void {
    if (this.scrollRAF) return;
    this.scrollRAF = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      this.scrollRAF = null;
      if (this.updateVirtualWindow()) {
        this.zone.run(() => this.cdr.markForCheck());
      }
    });
  }

  private updateVirtualWindow(forceRebuild = false): boolean {
    let changed = forceRebuild;
    if (!this.virtualEnabled) {
      if (this.virtualStart !== 0 || this.virtualEnd !== this.flatVisibleNodes.length) {
        this.virtualStart = 0;
        this.virtualEnd = this.flatVisibleNodes.length;
        changed = true;
      }
      if (changed) {
        this.rebuildVisibleWindowNodes();
      }
      return changed;
    }

    const host = this.treeContainer?.nativeElement;
    const viewportHeight = Math.max(1, this.viewportHeight || host?.clientHeight || 1);
    const scrollTop = host?.scrollTop ?? 0;

    if (Math.abs(scrollTop - this.lastScrollTop) < this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT && this.virtualEnd > 0) {
      if (changed) {
        this.rebuildVisibleWindowNodes();
      }
      return changed;
    }
    
    this.lastScrollTop = scrollTop;

    const visibleRows = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(viewportHeight / this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT));
    const start = Math.max(0, Math.floor(scrollTop / this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT) - this.VIRTUAL_OVERSCAN);
    const end = Math.min(this.flatVisibleNodes.length, start + visibleRows + this.VIRTUAL_OVERSCAN * 2);

    if (start !== this.virtualStart || end !== this.virtualEnd) {
      this.virtualStart = start;
      this.virtualEnd = end;
      changed = true;
    }
    if (changed) {
      this.rebuildVisibleWindowNodes();
    }
    return changed;
  }

  private refreshVisibleNodes(): void {
    this.flatVisibleNodes = this.getVisibleNodes();
    this.visibleNodeIndex.clear();
    this.flatVisibleNodes.forEach((node, index) => this.visibleNodeIndex.set(node.path, index));
    if (!this.virtualEnabled) {
      this.virtualStart = 0;
      this.virtualEnd = this.flatVisibleNodes.length;
    }
    this.rebuildVisibleWindowNodes();
  }

  private rebuildVisibleWindowNodes(): void {
    this.visibleWindowNodesCache = this.virtualEnabled
      ? this.flatVisibleNodes.slice(this.virtualStart, this.virtualEnd)
      : this.flatVisibleNodes;
  }

  isExpanded(node: TreeNode): boolean {
    return this.expansionState.get(node.path) ?? false;
  }

  private setExpanded(node: TreeNode, expanded: boolean): void {
    this.expansionState.set(node.path, expanded);
    if (expanded) {
      this.desiredExpandedPaths.add(node.path);
    } else {
      this.desiredExpandedPaths.delete(node.path);
    }
    if (expanded && !node.loaded && node.expandable && !node.loading) {
      node.loading = true;
      this.loadChildren.emit(node);
    }
    this.refreshVisibleNodes();
    this.updateVirtualWindow(true);
  }

  toggleNode(node: TreeNode): void {
    if (node.loading) return;
    this.setExpanded(node, !this.isExpanded(node));
    this.toggleExpand.emit(node);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private updateNodeHierarchy(nodes: TreeNode[], parent?: TreeNode): void {
    for (const node of nodes) {
      node.parent = parent;
      if (node.children) {
        this.updateNodeHierarchy(node.children, node);
      }
    }
  }

  private applyDesiredExpansion(): void {
    if (this.desiredExpandedPaths.size === 0) {
      return;
    }

    const visit = (nodes: TreeNode[]) => {
      for (const node of nodes) {
        const shouldExpand = this.desiredExpandedPaths.has(node.path);
        this.expansionState.set(node.path, shouldExpand);
        if (shouldExpand && !node.loaded && node.expandable && !node.loading) {
          node.loading = true;
          this.loadChildren.emit(node);
        }
        if (node.children?.length) {
          visit(node.children);
        }
      }
    };

    visit(this.nodes);
  }

  getVisibleNodes(): TreeNode[] {
    const result: TreeNode[] = [];
    const traverse = (nodes: TreeNode[]) => {
      for (const node of nodes) {
        result.push(node);
        if (this.isExpanded(node) && node.children?.length) {
          traverse(node.children);
        }
      }
    };
    traverse(this.renderedNodes);
    return result;
  }

  isNodeExpanded(path: string): boolean {
    const node = this.findNodeByPath(this.nodes, path);
    return !!node && this.isExpanded(node);
  }

  getExpandedPaths(): string[] {
    return Array.from(this.expansionState.entries())
      .filter(([, expanded]) => expanded)
      .map(([path]) => path);
  }

  setExpandedPaths(paths: string[]): void {
    this.desiredExpandedPaths = new Set((paths ?? []).filter(Boolean));
    this.expansionState.clear();
    this.applyDesiredExpansion();
    this.refreshVisibleNodes();
    this.updateVirtualWindow(true);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  getScrollTop(): number {
    return this.treeContainer?.nativeElement?.scrollTop ?? 0;
  }

  setScrollTop(top: number): void {
    const element = this.treeContainer?.nativeElement;
    if (!element) return;
    element.scrollTop = Math.max(0, top);
  }

  suppressNextAutoExpandToCurrentPath(): void {
    this.suppressNextAutoExpand = true;
  }

  getGuides(node: TreeNode): { active: boolean; last: boolean; skip: boolean }[] {
    // Do not draw guide lines for top-level entries under a synthetic root.
    if (typeof node.parent?.syntheticRoot === 'string') {
      return [];
    }

    const chain: TreeNode[] = [];
    let cur: TreeNode | undefined = node;
    while (cur?.parent) {
      if (typeof cur.parent.syntheticRoot === 'string') {
        break;
      }
      chain.push(cur);
      cur = cur.parent;
    }
    chain.reverse();

    return chain.map((n, index, arr) => {
      const siblings = n.parent?.children ?? [];
      const isLast = siblings.length > 0 && siblings[siblings.length - 1].path === n.path;
      const isDeepest = index === arr.length - 1;
      
      // Skip rendering guide lines for ancestors that are last children (to avoid vertical continuation).
      // Only the deepest node should show an elbow if it's last.
      const skip = isLast && !isDeepest;
      const shouldMarkAsLast = isLast && isDeepest;
      
      return { active: this.isSelected(node), last: shouldMarkAsLast, skip };
    });
  }

  getCategoryIcon(filename: string): string {
    const ext = filename.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() || '';
    const cat = getPrimaryFileCategoryForExtension(ext);
    return cat ? cat.icon : '📄';
  }

  isSelected(node: TreeNode): boolean {
    return this.selectedFiles.has(node.path);
  }

  isFocusedNode(node: TreeNode): boolean {
    return this.focusedNodePath === node.path;
  }

  private selectNodeAndAdvance(node: TreeNode, visible: TreeNode[]): void {
    this.selectNode(node, false, false);

    const currentIdx = visible.findIndex(candidate => candidate.path === node.path);
    if (currentIdx === -1) return;

    const nextNode = visible[Math.min(currentIdx + 1, visible.length - 1)];
    if (!nextNode || nextNode.path === node.path) return;

    this.focusedNodePath = nextNode.path;
    this.ensureVisible(nextNode);
  }

  private selectNode(node: TreeNode, addToSelection = false, range = false): void {
    const visible = this.getVisibleNodes();
    let newSelection: TreeNode[];

    if (range && this.anchorNodePath) {
      const anchorIdx = visible.findIndex(n => n.path === this.anchorNodePath);
      const currentIdx = visible.findIndex(n => n.path === node.path);
      
      if (anchorIdx !== -1 && currentIdx !== -1) {
        const start = Math.min(anchorIdx, currentIdx);
        const end = Math.max(anchorIdx, currentIdx);
        newSelection = visible.slice(start, end + 1);
      } else {
        newSelection = [node];
      }
    } else if (addToSelection) {
      const currentSelection = this.getSelectedNodes();
      if (this.isSelected(node)) {
        newSelection = currentSelection.filter(n => n.path !== node.path);
      } else {
        newSelection = [...currentSelection, node];
      }
      this.anchorNodePath = node.path;
    } else {
      newSelection = [node];
      this.anchorNodePath = node.path;
    }

    this.focusedNodePath = node.path;
    this.selectionChange.emit(newSelection);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private getSelectedNodes(): TreeNode[] {
    const result: TreeNode[] = [];
    const traverse = (nodes: TreeNode[]) => {
      for (const node of nodes) {
        if (this.isSelected(node)) result.push(node);
        if (node.children) traverse(node.children);
      }
    };
    traverse(this.nodes);
    return result;
  }

  onFocus(): void {
    this.isFocused = true;
    if (!this.focusedNodePath && this.nodes.length > 0) {
      this.focusedNodePath = this.nodes[0].path;
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onBlur(): void {
    this.isFocused = false;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onNodeMouseDown(node: TreeNode, event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    
    const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
    if (target.closest('.tree-twistie')) return;

    // Do not change selection on mousedown; wait for click or keyboard.
    // This keeps drag initiation from altering selection when drawing the drop indicator.
    this.isMouseDownSelecting = false;
  }

  onNodeClick(node: TreeNode, event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.stopPropagation();

    if (this.clickTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.clickTimer);
      this.clickTimer = null;
    }

    const isCtrl = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;
    const isShift = event.shiftKey;
    this.selectNode(node, isCtrl, isShift);
    this.isMouseDownSelecting = false;

    this.clickTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      this.clickTimer = null;
    }, 250);
  }

  onNodeDoubleClick(node: TreeNode, event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.stopPropagation();

    if (this.clickTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.clickTimer);
      this.clickTimer = null;
    }

    this.isMouseDownSelecting = false;

    if (node.type === FileType.FILE || node.type === FileType.SYMLINK) {
      this.nodeDoubleClick.emit(node);
      return;
    }

    if ((node.type === FileType.DIRECTORY || node.type === FileType.ARCHIVE) && node.expandable) {
      this.toggleNode(node);
    } else {
      this.nodeDoubleClick.emit(node);
    }
  }

  onNodeAuxClick(node: TreeNode, event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (event.button !== 1) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.openInNewTab.emit(node);
  }

  onTwistieMouseDown(event: MouseEvent, node: TreeNode): void {
    event.stopPropagation();
  }

  onTwistieClick(event: MouseEvent, node: TreeNode): void {
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (!node.expandable) return;

    if (this.clickTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.clickTimer);
      this.clickTimer = null;
    }

    this.toggleNode(node);
  }

  onContextMenu(event: MouseEvent, node: TreeNode): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();

    if (!this.isSelected(node)) {
      this.selectNode(node, true, false);
    }
    
    this.focusedNodePath = node.path;
    this.contextMenu.emit({ event, node });
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  isDraggingNode(node: TreeNode): boolean {
    return this.dragState.isDragging && this.dragState.draggedNodes.some(n => n.path === node.path);
  }

  isDragOver(node: TreeNode, position?: 'before' | 'after' | 'inside'): boolean {
    if (!this.dragState.dropTarget) return false;
    if (this.dragState.dropTarget.node.path !== node.path) return false;
    if (!position) return true;
    return this.dragState.dropTarget.position === position;
  }

  onDragStart(event: DragEvent, node: TreeNode): void {
    if (event.button !== 0) {
      event.preventDefault();
      return;
    }

    // Do not alter selection when beginning a drag. Use existing selection set; if none, drag the node itself.
    const selectedNodes = this.getSelectedNodes();
    const dragNodes = selectedNodes.length ? selectedNodes : [node];
    this.dragState.isDragging = true;
    this.dragState.draggedNodes = dragNodes;

    if (event.dataTransfer) {
      event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
      event.dataTransfer.setData('application/json', JSON.stringify({
        entries: dragNodes.map(n => ({ path: n.path, type: n.type, name: n.name })),
        source: 'tree'
      }));
      
      if (dragNodes.length > 1) {
        const dragImage = document.createElement('div');
        dragImage.textContent = `${dragNodes.length} items`;
        dragImage.style.cssText = `
          background: var(--vsc-list-active-background);
          color: var(--vsc-foreground);
          padding: 4px 8px;
          border-radius: 3px;
          font-size: 12px;
          position: fixed;
          top: -1000px;
        `;
        document.body.appendChild(dragImage);
        event.dataTransfer.setDragImage(dragImage, 0, 0);
        setTimeout(() => document.body.removeChild(dragImage), 0);
      }
    }

    this.dragStart.emit({ event, nodes: selectedNodes });
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onDragEnd(event: DragEvent): void {
    this.dragState.isDragging = false;
    this.dragState.draggedNodes = [];
    this.dragState.dropTarget = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onDragOver(event: DragEvent, node: TreeNode): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    
    // Handle external files (from OS file manager)
    if (this.hasExternalFiles(event)) {
      if (event.dataTransfer) {
        event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey ? 'copy' : 'move';
      }
      // Set simple drop target for external files
      const position = node.type === FileType.DIRECTORY ? 'inside' : 'after';
      if (this.dragState.dropTarget?.node.path === node.path && this.dragState.dropTarget.position === position) {
        return;
      }
      this.dragState.dropTarget = { node, position };
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }
    
    // Internal drag: from tree itself, or cross-component (list/grid/details → tree)
    const isInternalDrag = this.dragState.isDragging || (event.dataTransfer?.types ?? []).includes('application/json');
    if (!isInternalDrag) return;

    const rect = (event.currentTarget as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect();
    const y = event.clientY - rect.top;
    const height = rect.height;
    
    let position: 'before' | 'after' | 'inside';
    
    if (node.expandable && y > height * 0.25 && y < height * 0.75) {
      position = 'inside';
    } else if (y < height / 2) {
      position = 'before';
    } else {
      position = 'after';
    }

    // For tree-internal drags, validate against dragged nodes to prevent dropping onto self
    if (this.dragState.isDragging) {
      const isValidDrop = !this.dragState.draggedNodes.some(dragged => 
        dragged.path === node.path || this.isDescendant(node, dragged)
      );
      if (!isValidDrop) return;
    }

    if (this.dragState.dropTarget?.node.path === node.path && this.dragState.dropTarget.position === position) {
      return;
    }
    this.dragState.dropTarget = { node, position };
    if (event.dataTransfer) {
      event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey ? 'copy' : 'move';
    }

    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onDragLeave(event: DragEvent, node: TreeNode): void {
    if (this.dragState.dropTarget?.node.path === node.path) {
      this.dragState.dropTarget = null;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  onDrop(event: DragEvent, node: TreeNode): void {
    event.preventDefault();

    // For external OS drops, don't stopPropagation - let Wails' window handler fire wails:file-drop
    if (this.hasExternalFiles(event)) {
      this.dragState.dropTarget = null;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    event.stopPropagation();

    if (!this.dragState.dropTarget) return;

    // Use draggedNodes when drag started within the tree; fall back to dataTransfer for cross-component drags
    let sourceNodes: TreeNode[] = this.dragState.draggedNodes;
    if (!sourceNodes.length) {
      const dragged = this.readDraggedEntries(event);
      sourceNodes = dragged.map(d => ({
        name: d.name,
        path: d.path,
        type: d.type as FileType,
        size: 0,
        created: 0,
        modified: 0,
        accessed: 0,
        permissions: '',
        isHidden: false,
        level: 0,
      } as TreeNode));
    }

    if (!sourceNodes.length) {
      this.dragState.dropTarget = null;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.dragDrop.emit({
      event,
      source: sourceNodes,
      target: this.dragState.dropTarget
    });

    this.dragState.dropTarget = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onContainerDragOver(event: DragEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
  }

  onContainerDrop(event: DragEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();

    // For external OS drops, don't stopPropagation - let Wails' window handler fire wails:file-drop
    if (this.hasExternalFiles(event)) {
      return;
    }

    event.stopPropagation();
  }

  private readDraggedEntries(event: DragEvent): { path: string; type: FileType; name: string }[] {
    try {
      const payload = event.dataTransfer?.getData('application/json');
      if (!payload) return [];
      const parsed = JSON.parse(payload);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed?.entries)) return parsed.entries;
      if (Array.isArray(parsed?.paths)) return parsed.paths.map((p: string) => ({ path: p, type: FileType.FILE, name: p.split(/[\/\\]/).pop() || p }));
      return [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  private hasExternalFiles(event: DragEvent): boolean {
    const types = event.dataTransfer?.types;
    if (!types) return false;
    if (types.includes('application/json')) return false;
    return types.includes('Files') || (event.dataTransfer?.files?.length ?? 0) > 0;
  }

  private extractExternalPaths(event: DragEvent): string[] {
    const dataTransfer = event.dataTransfer;
    if (!dataTransfer) return [];

    const paths = new Set<string>();

    const files = dataTransfer.files;
    for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
      const file = files[i];
      const filePath = (file as any).path as string | undefined;
      if (filePath) {
        paths.add(this.normalizePath(filePath));
      }
    }

    const uriPayload = dataTransfer.getData('text/uri-list') || dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
    if (uriPayload) {
      for (const rawLine of uriPayload.split(/\r?\n/)) {
        const line = rawLine.trim();
        if (!line || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
        const parsedPath = this.fileUriToPath(line);
        if (parsedPath) paths.add(parsedPath);
      }
    }

    return Array.from(paths);
  }

  private fileUriToPath(value: string): string | null {
    if (!value) return null;
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    if (!/^file:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) {
      if (/^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]/.test(trimmed)) return this.normalizePath(trimmed);
      if (/^\\\\/.test(trimmed)) return this.normalizePath(trimmed);
      if (trimmed.startsWith('/')) return this.normalizePath(trimmed);
      return null;
    }

    try {
      let decoded = decodeURIComponent(trimmed).replace(/^file:\/\//i, '');

      if (/^\/[A-Za-z]:\//.test(decoded)) {
        decoded = decoded.slice(1);
      }

      if (/^[A-Za-z]:\//.test(decoded)) {
        return this.normalizePath(decoded.replace(/\//g, '\\'));
      }

      if (!decoded.startsWith('/')) {
        return this.normalizePath(('//' + decoded).replace(/\//g, '\\'));
      }

      return this.normalizePath(decoded);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  onContainerMouseDown(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (event.button !== 0 && event.button !== 2) return;

    // Left-button on a node is handled by click/drag-and-drop — skip.
    // Right-button on a node should still start marquee selection (TC behaviour).
    const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
    if (event.button === 0 && target.closest('.tree-node')) return;

    const container = event.currentTarget as HTMLElement;
    this.marqueeContainer = container;
    this.marqueeAppend = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;
    this.marqueeButton = event.button as 0 | 2;
    this.hasMarqueeMoved = false;
    // Defer clear until marquee actually moves — plain click keeps cursor visible
    this.pendingClearOnMove = !this.marqueeAppend;

    const { x, y } = this.getRelativePoint(event, container);
    this.marqueeStartX = x;
    this.marqueeStartY = y;
    this.selectionRect = { active: true, left: x, top: y, width: 0, height: 0 };

    this.suppressContainerClick = true;
    this.suppressContainerContextMenu = event.button === 2;

    this.windowMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => this.zone.run(() => this.onMarqueeMouseMove(e));
    this.windowMouseUp = () => this.zone.run(() => this.finishMarqueeSelection());
    this.windowContextMenu = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (this.selectionRect.active && this.hasMarqueeMoved) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', this.windowMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', this.windowMouseUp);
    window.addEventListener('contextmenu', this.windowContextMenu, true);

    if (event.button === 0) {
      event.preventDefault();
    }
  }

  private onMarqueeMouseMove(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (!this.marqueeContainer || !this.selectionRect.active) return;

    const { x, y } = this.getRelativePoint(event, this.marqueeContainer);
    const left = Math.min(this.marqueeStartX, x);
    const top = Math.min(this.marqueeStartY, y);
    const width = Math.abs(x - this.marqueeStartX);
    const height = Math.abs(y - this.marqueeStartY);

    if (width > 10 || height > 10) {
      this.hasMarqueeMoved = true;
      if (this.pendingClearOnMove) {
        this.selectionChange.emit([]);
        this.pendingClearOnMove = false;
      }
    }

    this.selectionRect = { active: true, left, top, width, height };
    if (this.hasMarqueeMoved) {
      this.emitMarqueeSelection();
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private emitMarqueeSelection(): void {
    if (!this.marqueeContainer) return;
    const selectionPaths = new Set<string>();
    const selectionBottom = this.selectionRect.top + this.selectionRect.height;
    const startIndex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(this.selectionRect.top / this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT));
    const endIndex = Math.min(this.flatVisibleNodes.length - 1, Math.floor(Math.max(0, selectionBottom - 1) / this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT));

    for (let i = startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++) {
      const node = this.flatVisibleNodes[i];
      if (node) {
        selectionPaths.add(node.path);
      }
    }

    if (this.marqueeAppend) {
      for (const path of this.selectedFiles) selectionPaths.add(path);
    }

    const selectedNodes = this.flatVisibleNodes.filter(n => selectionPaths.has(n.path));
    this.selectionChange.emit(selectedNodes);
  }

  private finishMarqueeSelection(): void {
    this.detachMarqueeListeners();
    this.marqueeContainer = null;
    this.marqueeButton = null;
    this.hasMarqueeMoved = false;
    this.pendingClearOnMove = false;
    this.selectionRect = { active: false, left: 0, top: 0, width: 0, height: 0 };
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private detachMarqueeListeners(): void {
    if (this.windowMouseMove) {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', this.windowMouseMove);
      this.windowMouseMove = undefined;
    }
    if (this.windowMouseUp) {
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', this.windowMouseUp);
      this.windowMouseUp = undefined;
    }
    if (this.windowContextMenu) {
      window.removeEventListener('contextmenu', this.windowContextMenu, true);
      this.windowContextMenu = undefined;
    }
  }

  private getRelativePoint(event: MouseEvent, container: HTMLElement): { x: number; y: number } {
    const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: event.clientX - rect.left + container.scrollLeft,
      y: event.clientY - rect.top + container.scrollTop,
    };
  }

  // TC: background left-click — cursor stays, selection unchanged
  onContainerClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (this.suppressContainerClick) {
      this.suppressContainerClick = false;
      return;
    }
  }

  // TC: background right-click — open directory context menu, do NOT change selection
  onContainerContextMenu(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (this.suppressContainerContextMenu) {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.suppressContainerContextMenu = false;
      return;
    }

    const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
    if (!target.closest('.tree-node')) {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.backgroundContextMenu.emit(event);
    }
  }

  private isDescendant(potentialDescendant: TreeNode, ancestor: TreeNode): boolean {
    let current = potentialDescendant.parent;
    while (current) {
      if (current.path === ancestor.path) return true;
      current = current.parent;
    }
    return false;
  }

  startRename(node: TreeNode): void {
    node.renaming = true;
    node.editingName = node.name;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.renameInput?.nativeElement.focus();
      this.renameInput?.nativeElement.select();
    }, 0);
  }

  /** Public helper for parent components to trigger rename on the focused node (eg. global F2). */
  startRenameFocused(): void {
    const visible = this.getVisibleNodes();
    if (visible.length === 0) return;
    const currentIdx = visible.findIndex(n => n.path === this.focusedNodePath);
    const current = currentIdx >= 0 ? visible[currentIdx] : visible[0];
    if (current) this.startRename(current);
  }

  startRenamePath(path: string): void {
    if (!path) return;

    this.tryStartRenamePath(path, Date.now() + 3000);
  }

  setPendingRenameDisplayName(path: string, displayName: string | null): void {
    if (!path) return;
    if (displayName && displayName.trim()) {
      this.pendingRenameDisplayNames.set(path, displayName.trim());
    } else {
      this.pendingRenameDisplayNames.delete(path);
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  getDisplayNameOverride(path: string): string | null {
    return this.pendingRenameDisplayNames.get(path) ?? null;
  }

  hasPendingRenameState(): boolean {
    return this.pendingRenameDisplayNames.size > 0 || this.hasRenamingNode(this.nodes);
  }

  private tryStartRenamePath(path: string, deadline: number): void {
    this.focusNode(path);

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const target = this.getVisibleNodes().find((node) => node.path === path);
      if (target) {
        this.centerNode(path);
        this.startRename(target);
        return;
      }

      if (Date.now() < deadline) {
        setTimeout(() => this.tryStartRenamePath(path, deadline), 50);
      }
    });
  }

  onRenameBlur(node: TreeNode): void {
    this.commitRename(node);
  }

  onRenameKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent, node: TreeNode): void {
    event.stopPropagation();

    if (event.key === 'Enter') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.commitRename(node);
    } else if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.cancelRename(node);
    }
  }

  private commitRename(node: TreeNode): void {
    if (!node.renaming) return;
    
    const newName = node.editingName?.trim();
    if (newName && newName !== node.name) {
      this.rename.emit({ node, newName });
    }
    
    node.renaming = false;
    node.editingName = undefined;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private cancelRename(node: TreeNode): void {
    node.renaming = false;
    node.editingName = undefined;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
    const visible = this.getVisibleNodes();
    if (visible.length === 0) return;

    const currentIdx = visible.findIndex(n => n.path === this.focusedNodePath);
    const current = currentIdx >= 0 ? visible[currentIdx] : null;

    switch (event.key) {
      case 'ArrowDown':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (currentIdx < visible.length - 1) {
          this.focusedNodePath = visible[currentIdx + 1].path;
          if (event.shiftKey && this.anchorNodePath) {
            this.selectNode(visible[currentIdx + 1], false, true);
          } else {
            this.ensureVisible(visible[currentIdx + 1]);
          }
        }
        break;

      case 'ArrowUp':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (currentIdx > 0) {
          this.focusedNodePath = visible[currentIdx - 1].path;
          if (event.shiftKey && this.anchorNodePath) {
            this.selectNode(visible[currentIdx - 1], false, true);
          } else {
            this.ensureVisible(visible[currentIdx - 1]);
          }
        }
        break;

      case 'ArrowRight':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (current?.expandable) {
          if (!this.isExpanded(current)) {
            this.toggleNode(current);
          } else {
            const child = visible[currentIdx + 1];
            if (child && child.parent === current) {
              this.focusedNodePath = child.path;
            }
          }
        }
        break;

      case 'ArrowLeft':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (current) {
          if (current.expandable && this.isExpanded(current)) {
            this.toggleNode(current);
          } else if (current.parent) {
            this.focusedNodePath = current.parent.path;
            this.ensureVisible(current.parent);
          }
        }
        break;

      case 'Enter':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (current) {
          if (current.type === FileType.DIRECTORY && current.expandable) {
            this.toggleNode(current);
          } else {
            this.nodeDoubleClick.emit(current);
          }
        }
        break;

      case ' ':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (current) {
          if (!event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey && !event.shiftKey && !event.altKey) {
            if (current.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
              this.inlineSize.emit(current);
            }
            this.selectNodeAndAdvance(current, visible);
          } else {
            this.selectNode(current, event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey, event.shiftKey);
          }
        }
        break;

      case 'Insert':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (current) {
          if (!event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey && !event.shiftKey && !event.altKey) {
            this.selectNodeAndAdvance(current, visible);
          } else {
            this.selectNode(current, event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey, event.shiftKey);
          }
        }
        break;

      case 'F2':
        event.preventDefault();
        if (current) {
          this.startRename(current);
        }
        break;

      case 'Home':
        event.preventDefault();
        this.focusedNodePath = visible[0].path;
        this.ensureVisible(visible[0]);
        break;

      case 'End':
        event.preventDefault();
        this.focusedNodePath = visible[visible.length - 1].path;
        this.ensureVisible(visible[visible.length - 1]);
        break;

      case 'a':
      case 'A':
        if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) {
          event.preventDefault();
          this.selectionChange.emit(visible);
        }
        break;
    }

    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private ensureVisible(node: TreeNode): void {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const host = this.treeContainer?.nativeElement;
      if (!host) return;
      
      if (this.virtualEnabled) {
        const idx = this.visibleNodeIndex.get(node.path) ?? -1;
        if (idx >= 0) {
          const nodeTop = idx * this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT;
          const nodeBottom = nodeTop + this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT;
          const viewTop = host.scrollTop;
          const viewBottom = viewTop + host.clientHeight;
          
          if (nodeTop < viewTop) {
            host.scrollTop = nodeTop;
          } else if (nodeBottom > viewBottom) {
            host.scrollTop = nodeBottom - host.clientHeight;
          }
          this.updateVirtualWindow();
        }
        return;
      }
      
      const el = host.querySelector(`[data-path="${CSS.escape(node.path)}"]`);
      el?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' });
    });
  }

  trackByFn: TrackByFunction<TreeNode> = (_, node) => node.path;

  expandNode(path: string): void {
    const node = this.findNodeByPath(this.nodes, path);
    if (node?.expandable) {
      this.setExpanded(node, true);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  collapseNode(path: string): void {
    const node = this.findNodeByPath(this.nodes, path);
    if (node) {
      this.setExpanded(node, false);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  focusNode(path: string): void {
    this.focusedNodePath = path;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  centerNode(path: string): void {
    const node = this.findNodeByPath(this.nodes, path);
    const host = this.treeContainer?.nativeElement;
    if (!host) return;

    if (!node) {
      host.scrollTop = 0;
      return;
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (this.virtualEnabled) {
        const idx = this.visibleNodeIndex.get(node.path) ?? -1;
        if (idx >= 0) {
          const nodeTop = idx * this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT;
          const centerOffset = host.clientHeight / 2 - this.VIRTUAL_ROW_HEIGHT / 2;
          host.scrollTop = Math.max(0, nodeTop - centerOffset);
          this.updateVirtualWindow();
        }
        return;
      }
      
      const el = host.querySelector(`[data-path="${CSS.escape(node.path)}"]`);
      if (!el) return;
      el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', inline: 'nearest' });
    });
  }

  private findNodeByPath(nodes: TreeNode[], path: string): TreeNode | undefined {
    const target = this.normalizePath(path);
    for (const node of nodes) {
      if (this.normalizePath(node.path) === target) return node;
      if (node.children) {
        const found = this.findNodeByPath(node.children, target);
        if (found) return found;
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  private expandToCurrentPath(): void {
    if (!this.currentPath || this.nodes.length === 0) return;

    const target = this.findBestPathMatch(this.nodes, this.currentPath);
    if (!target) return;

    let current: TreeNode | undefined = target;
    while (current) {
      if (current.expandable) {
        this.setExpanded(current, true);
      }
      current = current.parent;
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private findBestPathMatch(nodes: TreeNode[], path: string): TreeNode | undefined {
    const target = this.normalizePath(path);
    let best: TreeNode | undefined;
    let bestLen = -1;

    const visit = (items: TreeNode[]) => {
      for (const node of items) {
        const nodePath = this.normalizePath(node.path);
        const isExact = nodePath === target;
        const isAncestor = target.startsWith(`${nodePath}/`);

        if ((isExact || isAncestor) && nodePath.length > bestLen) {
          best = node;
          bestLen = nodePath.length;
        }

        if (node.children?.length) {
          visit(node.children);
        }
      }
    };

    visit(nodes);
    return best;
  }

  private normalizePath(path: string): string {
    return normalizePathReference(path || '/');
  }

  private hasRenamingNode(nodes: TreeNode[]): boolean {
    for (const node of nodes) {
      if (node.renaming) {
        return true;
      }
      if (node.children?.length && this.hasRenamingNode(node.children)) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  notifyChildrenLoaded(node: TreeNode, children: TreeNode[]): void {
    node.children = children;
    node.loading = false;
    node.loaded = true;
    node.expandable = children.length > 0;
    this.updateNodeHierarchy(children, node);
    this.refreshVisibleNodes();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }
}

import '@angular/compiler';
import { SimpleChange } from '@angular/core';
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';

import { FileViewContainerComponent } from './file-view-container.component';

function createComponent(): FileViewContainerComponent {
  return new FileViewContainerComponent(
    {} as any,
    {} as any,
    { markForCheck: fn() } as any,
  );
}

function applyPathChanges(component: FileViewContainerComponent): void {
  component.ngOnChanges({
    browserPath: new SimpleChange('', component.browserPath, true),
    currentPath: new SimpleChange('', component.currentPath, true),
  });
}

function createLocalStorageMock(initial: Record<string, string> = {}) {
  const store = new Map(Object.entries(initial));

  return {
    getItem: fn((key: string) => store.get(key) ?? null),
    setItem: fn((key: string, value: string) => {
      store.set(key, value);
    }),
    removeItem: fn((key: string) => {
      store.delete(key);
    }),
    clear: fn(() => {
      store.clear();
    }),
  };
}

describe('FileViewContainerComponent', () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    restoreGlobals();
  });

  it('prefers the live current path over a stale browser path', () => {
    const component = createComponent();

    component.browserPath = 'https://old.example.com';
    component.currentPath = 'filesystem://c';
    applyPathChanges(component);

    expect(component.getBrowserPath()).toBe('filesystem://c');
    expect(component.showBrowserPane()).toBe(false);
  });

  it('updates the browser pane when a new web address is entered', () => {
    const component = createComponent();

    component.browserPath = 'https://old.example.com';
    component.currentPath = 'https://new.example.com/docs';
    applyPathChanges(component);

    expect(component.getBrowserPath()).toBe('https://new.example.com/docs');
    expect(component.showBrowserPane()).toBe(true);
  });

  it('loads and clamps the persisted browser pane split for the current pane', () => {
    stubGlobal('localStorage', createLocalStorageMock({
      'fileManager_browserPaneSplit:right': '90',
    }));

    const component = createComponent();
    component.paneId = 'right';
    component.ngOnChanges({
      paneId: new SimpleChange('left', 'right', true),
    });

    expect(component.browserPaneSplit).toBe(72);
  });
});

import {

  ChangeDetectorRef,

import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { createSubject, debounce, distinctUntilChanged, takeUntil } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

import { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { FilterQuery } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import { FilterService, CriteriaGroup } from '../services/filter.service';
import { ConfirmDialogService } from '../services/confirm-dialog.service';
import { InputContextService } from '../services/input-context.service';
import { InputEngineService } from '../services/input-engine.service';

import { DropdownDirective, DropdownTriggerDirective, DropdownMenuDirective } from '../directives/dropdown.directive';
import { DropdownContainerComponent } from './dropdown-container.component';
import { FilterDropdownComponent } from './filter-dropdown.component';
import { FilterChipComponent } from './filter-chip.component';
import {
  FilterPreset,
  FilterCategory,
  CustomCategoryData,
  FILTER_PRESETS_KEY,
  buildPresetsFromDataset,
} from './filter-bar.types';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-filter-bar',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DropdownTriggerDirective,
    DropdownMenuDirective,
    DropdownContainerComponent,
    FilterDropdownComponent,
    FilterChipComponent,
  ],
  template: `
<div class="fb-host" (keydown)="onHostKeyDown($event)">

  <div class="fb-bar" [class.fb-bar--compact]="compact">

    <!-- Left: filter icon + category dropdown -->
    <div class="fb-cluster fb-cluster--left">
      <button
        #categoryBtn
        appDropdownTrigger
        class="fb-btn fb-btn--category"
        [class.fb-btn--open]="showCategoryDropdown"
        [class.fb-btn--active]="selectedPresets.length > 0"
        (click)="toggleCategoryDropdown()"
        title="Filter by type, size, date…"
      >
        <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" class="fb-icon">
          <path d="M6 10.5a.5.5 0 0 1 .5-.5h3a.5.5 0 0 1 0 1h-3a.5.5 0 0 1-.5-.5zm-2-3a.5.5 0 0 1 .5-.5h7a.5.5 0 0 1 0 1h-7a.5.5 0 0 1-.5-.5zm-2-3a.5.5 0 0 1 .5-.5h11a.5.5 0 0 1 0 1h-11a.5.5 0 0 1-.5-.5z"/>
        </svg>
        <span class="fb-btn-chevron" [class.fb-btn-chevron--open]="showCategoryDropdown">›</span>
      </button>
      <app-dropdown-container class="fb-drop-anchor" [(isOpen)]="showCategoryDropdown" (isOpenChange)="onCategoryDropdownStateChange($event)" [anchorEl]="categoryBtnRef?.nativeElement ?? null">
        <app-filter-dropdown
          appDropdownMenu
          *ngIf="showCategoryDropdown"
          [contextId]="'overlay.filter.category'"
          [presets]="allPresets"
          [selected]="selectedPresets"
          [hasDynamic]="hasDynamic"
          (itemToggle)="onPresetToggle($event)"
          (clearAll)="clearPresets()"
          (refresh)="refreshPresets()"
          (groupModeChange)="onGroupModeChange($event)"
          (closeRequested)="onCategoryDropdownStateChange(false)"
        />
      </app-dropdown-container>
    </div>

    <!-- Search input -->
    <div class="fb-search">
      <svg class="fb-search-icon" width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
        <path d="M11.742 10.344a6.5 6.5 0 1 0-1.397 1.398h-.001c.03.04.062.078.098.115l3.85 3.85a1 1 0 0 0 1.415-1.414l-3.85-3.85a1.007 1.007 0 0 0-.115-.099zM12 6.5a5.5 5.5 0 1 1-11 0 5.5 5.5 0 0 1 11 0z"/>
      </svg>
      <input
        #searchInput
        type="text"
        class="fb-search-input"
        [placeholder]="placeholder"
        [(ngModel)]="searchText"
        (ngModelChange)="onSearchChange($event)"
        (keydown)="onSearchKeyDown($event)"
        [attr.aria-label]="placeholder"
      />
      <button *ngIf="searchText" class="fb-search-clear" (click)="clearSearch()" title="Clear search">×</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Right: saved presets dropdown + clear button -->
    <div class="fb-cluster fb-cluster--right">
    <button
        #presetBtn
        class="fb-btn fb-btn--icon"
        [class.fb-btn--open]="showPresetDropdown"
        (click)="togglePresetDropdown()"
        title="Saved presets"
      >
        <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
          <path d="M2 2a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h8a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v13.5a.5.5 0 0 1-.777.416L8 13.101l-5.223 2.815A.5.5 0 0 1 2 15.5V2zm2-1a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v12.566l4.723-2.482a.5.5 0 0 1 .554 0L13 14.566V2a1 1 0 0 0-1-1H4z"/>
        </svg>
      </button>
    <app-dropdown-container class="fb-drop-anchor" [(isOpen)]="showPresetDropdown" (isOpenChange)="onPresetDropdownStateChange($event)" [anchorEl]="presetBtnRef?.nativeElement ?? null">
        <div appDropdownMenu *ngIf="showPresetDropdown" class="fb-preset-dropdown">
          <div class="fb-preset-head">
            <span>Presets</span>
            <button
              class="fb-preset-save"
              (click)="onSavePreset()"
              [disabled]="!canSavePreset"
              title="Save current selection as preset"
            >+ Save</button>
          </div>
          <div class="fb-preset-list">
            <div *ngFor="let p of savedPresets; let i = index" class="fb-preset-item" [class.fb-preset-item--selected]="i === selectedPresetIndex" (mouseenter)="setSelectedPresetIndex(i)">
              <span class="fb-preset-name" (click)="applyPreset(p)">{{ p.name }}</span>
              <button class="fb-preset-delete" (click)="deletePreset(p)" title="Delete">×</button>
            </div>
            <div *ngIf="savedPresets.length === 0" class="fb-preset-empty">No saved presets</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </app-dropdown-container>

      <button
        class="fb-btn fb-btn--icon fb-btn--clear"
        [disabled]="!hasAnyFilter"
        (click)="clearAllFilters()"
        title="Clear all filters"
      >
        <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
          <path d="M4.646 4.646a.5.5 0 0 1 .708 0L8 7.293l2.646-2.647a.5.5 0 0 1 .708.708L8.707 8l2.647 2.646a.5.5 0 0 1-.708.708L8 8.707l-2.646 2.647a.5.5 0 0 1-.708-.708L7.293 8 4.646 5.354a.5.5 0 0 1 0-.708z"/>
        </svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Active chips -->
  <div class="fb-chips" *ngIf="selectedPresets.length > 0 || searchText">
    <div class="fb-chips-scroll">
      <!-- OR chips -->
      <ng-container *ngIf="orPresets.length > 0">
        <!-- OR badge (only if >1 OR item) -->
        <span
          *ngIf="orPresets.length > 1"
          class="fb-mode-badge fb-mode-badge--or"
          title="Any of these filters may match"
        >OR</span>

        <app-filter-chip
          *ngFor="let p of orPresets"
          [preset]="p"
          (remove)="onPresetToggle($event)"
        />
      </ng-container>

      <!-- AND chips -->
      <ng-container *ngIf="andPresets.length > 0">
        <!-- AND badge (only if OR exists + ≥1 AND) -->
        <span
          *ngIf="orPresets.length > 0"
          class="fb-mode-badge fb-mode-badge--and"
          title="All of these filters must match"
        >AND</span>

        <app-filter-chip
          *ngFor="let p of andPresets"
          [preset]="p"
          (remove)="onPresetToggle($event)"
        />
      </ng-container>

      <!-- Search chip -->
      <div *ngIf="searchText" class="fb-chip fb-chip--search" (click)="clearSearch()">
        <span class="fb-chip-label">"{{ searchText }}"</span>
        <button class="fb-chip-close" (click)="$event.stopPropagation(); clearSearch()">×</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    
    <!-- Filter count on the right -->
    <span class="fb-chip-count" *ngIf="dataset.length > 0">
      {{ filteredCount }} / {{ dataset.length }}
    </span>
  </div>

</div>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host {
      display: block;
      font-family: var(--vsc-font-family);
      font-size: var(--vsc-font-size);
      color: var(--vsc-foreground);
      background: var(--vsc-sidebar-background);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle);
    }

    .fb-host { position: relative; }

    /* ── Bar row ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .fb-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      height: 36px;
      padding: 0 var(--vsc-padding-sm);
      gap: var(--vsc-padding-sm);
      user-select: none;
    }
    .fb-bar--compact { height: 30px; }

    .fb-cluster {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--vsc-padding-xs);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .fb-cluster--left {
      padding-right: var(--vsc-padding-sm);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle);
    }
    .fb-cluster--right {
      padding-left: var(--vsc-padding-sm);
      border-left: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle);
    }

    .fb-icon {
      margin: 0 15px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
      svg { fill: currentColor; }
    }

    .fb-drop-anchor { position: relative; }

    /* ── Buttons ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .fb-btn {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--vsc-padding-xs);
      height: 28px; padding: 0 var(--vsc-padding-md);
      background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent;
      border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
      font-size: var(--vsc-font-size); font-family: var(--vsc-font-family);
      cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
      transition: background var(--vsc-transition-fast), color var(--vsc-transition-fast), border-color var(--vsc-transition-fast);
      svg { fill: currentColor; }

      &:hover { background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background); color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright); border-color: var(--vsc-border); }
      &:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--vsc-accent-blue); outline-offset: -1px; }
      &:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; &:hover { background: transparent; border-color: transparent; } }
      &.fb-btn--open { background: var(--vsc-list-active-background); color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright); border-color: var(--vsc-border); }
      &.fb-btn--active { color: var(--vsc-accent-blue); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue) 40%, transparent); }
      &.fb-btn--active:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue) 10%, transparent); }
    }
    .fb-btn--category { min-width: 80px; }
    .fb-btn--icon { padding: 0 var(--vsc-padding-sm); min-width: unset; }

    .fb-btn-label { flex: 1; }
    .fb-btn-chevron {
      font-size: 14px; opacity: 0.6; display: inline-block;
      transform: rotate(90deg);
      transition: transform var(--vsc-transition-fast);
    }
    .fb-btn-chevron--open { transform: rotate(270deg); }

    /* ── Search ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .fb-search {
      position: relative; flex: 1; min-width: 160px;
      display: flex; align-items: center;
    }
    .fb-search-icon {
      position: absolute; left: 8px;
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim); pointer-events: none; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .fb-search-input {
      width: 100%; height: 28px;
      padding: 0 28px 0 28px;
      background: var(--vsc-input-background);
      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-input-border);
      border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
      color: var(--vsc-foreground);
      font-size: var(--vsc-font-size); font-family: var(--vsc-font-family);
      &:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--vsc-input-focus-border); }
      &::placeholder { color: var(--vsc-input-placeholder); }
    }
    .fb-search-clear {
      position: absolute; right: 4px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0;
      background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 4px;
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim); font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer;
      &:hover { background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background); color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright); }
    }

    /* ── Saved preset dropdown ────────────────────────────────────── */
    .fb-preset-dropdown {
      min-width: 220px;
      background: var(--vsc-panel-background);
      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border);
      border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius);
      box-shadow: var(--vsc-widget-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .fb-preset-head {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      padding: var(--vsc-padding-sm) var(--vsc-padding-md);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle);
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
    }
    .fb-preset-save {
      padding: 2px var(--vsc-padding-sm);
      background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border);
      border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
      color: var(--vsc-foreground); font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--vsc-font-family);
      &:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background); }
      &:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }
    }
    .fb-preset-list { max-height: 200px; overflow-y: auto; padding: var(--vsc-padding-xs) 0; }
    .fb-preset-item {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      padding: var(--vsc-padding-sm) var(--vsc-padding-md);
      &:hover { background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background); }
    }
    .fb-preset-item--selected {
      background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background);
    }
    .fb-preset-name {
      flex: 1; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; font-size: var(--vsc-font-size);
    }
    .fb-preset-delete {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0;
      background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 4px;
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim); font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer;
      &:hover { background: var(--vsc-list-active-background); color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright); }
    }
    .fb-preset-empty {
      padding: var(--vsc-padding-md) var(--vsc-padding-lg);
      text-align: center; color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
      font-size: var(--vsc-font-size-small); font-style: italic;
    }

    /* ── AND/OR mode badges ───────────────────────────────────────── */
    .fb-mode-badge {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      height: 16px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 3px; margin: 0 5px;
      font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700;
      font-family: var(--vsc-font-family-mono);
      min-width: 28px; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .fb-mode-badge--or {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-green) 15%, transparent);
      border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-green) 45%, transparent);
      color: var(--vsc-accent-green);
    }
    .fb-mode-badge--and {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue) 15%, transparent);
      border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue) 45%, transparent);
      color: var(--vsc-accent-blue);
    }

    /* ── Chips row ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    .fb-chips {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: nowrap;
      padding: 0 var(--vsc-padding-sm) var(--vsc-padding-xs);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle);
    }
    
    .fb-chips-scroll {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--vsc-padding-xs);
      overflow-x: auto;
      overflow-y: hidden;
      padding: var(--vsc-padding-xs) 0;
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    /* Search chip — inline, no component */
    .fb-chip {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px;
      height: 18px; padding: 0 6px;
      background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent;
      border-radius: 2px; flex-shrink: 0;
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
      font-size: 11.5px; font-family: var(--vsc-font-family);
      transition: background var(--vsc-transition-fast), border-color var(--vsc-transition-fast), color var(--vsc-transition-fast);
      cursor: pointer;
      &:hover { background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background); border-color: var(--vsc-border); color: var(--vsc-foreground); }
    }
    .fb-chip--search { font-style: italic; }
    .fb-chip-label { white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1; }
    .fb-chip-close {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-left: 1px;
      background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 2px;
      color: currentColor; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; padding: 0;
      cursor: pointer; opacity: 0.55;
      transition: opacity var(--vsc-transition-fast), background var(--vsc-transition-fast);
      &:hover { opacity: 1; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-foreground) 15%, transparent); }
    }

    .fb-chip-count {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      padding: 0 var(--vsc-padding-sm);
      height: 18px;
      color: var(--vsc-badge-foreground);
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 500;
      white-space: nowrap;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
    }
  `],
})
export class FilterBarComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy, OnChanges {

  @ViewChild('searchInput') searchInput?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;
  @ViewChild('categoryBtn') categoryBtnRef?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;
  @ViewChild('presetBtn')   presetBtnRef?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  // ── Inputs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  @Input() dataset:           FileInfo[] = [];
  @Input() placeholder        = 'Search files…';
  @Input() compact            = false;
  @Input() initialSearch      = '';
  @Input() initialCategories: string[] = [];

  // ── Outputs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  @Output() filterChange = new EventEmitter<FilterQuery & { groups: CriteriaGroup[] }>();

  // ── State ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  allPresets:      FilterPreset[] = [];
  selectedPresets: FilterPreset[] = [];
  searchText       = '';

  showCategoryDropdown = false;
  showPresetDropdown   = false;
  selectedPresetIndex = -1;

  savedPresets: { id: string; name: string; presetIds: string[] }[] = [];

  showCustomDialog  = false;
  editingCategory: FilterCategory | null = null;

  private groupModes = new Map<string, 'AND' | 'OR'>();
  private destroy$   = createSubject<void>();
  private search$    = createSubject<string>();
  private readonly presetCommandOwner = `overlay.filter.presets:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
  private releasePresetOverlayContext: (() => void) | null = null;

  // Groups that combine with OR (any one match is enough)
  private readonly orGroups  = new Set(['Basic', 'Extensions', 'Other']);
  // Groups that combine with AND (all must match)
  private readonly andGroups = new Set(['Date', 'Size', 'Special']);

  // ── Computed ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  get hasDynamic():    boolean { return this.allPresets.some(p => p.isDynamic); }
  get hasAnyFilter():  boolean { return this.selectedPresets.length > 0 || !!this.searchText; }
  get canSavePreset(): boolean { return this.selectedPresets.length > 0 && this.savedPresets.length < 20; }
  get filteredCount(): number {
    if (!this.dataset.length) return 0;
    
    // Build a filter query from current state
    let query: FilterQuery & { groups: CriteriaGroup[] };
    
    if (!this.hasAnyFilter) {
      query = this.filterService.parseFilterText('');
    } else if (this.selectedPresets.length === 0) {
      query = this.filterService.parseFilterText(this.searchText);
    } else {
      // Build the query from selected presets
      const groupMap = new Map<string, FilterPreset[]>();
      for (const p of this.selectedPresets) {
        const g = p.group || 'Other';
        if (!groupMap.has(g)) groupMap.set(g, []);
        groupMap.get(g)!.push(p);
      }

      const segments: string[] = [];
      for (const [groupName, presets] of groupMap) {
        const mode = this.groupModes.get(groupName) ?? 'OR';
        const filters = presets.map(p => (p as any).filter).filter(Boolean) as string[];
        if (filters.length === 1) {
          segments.push(filters[0]);
        } else if (mode === 'OR') {
          segments.push(filters.join(' OR '));
        } else {
          segments.push(filters.join(' '));
        }
      }
      
      query = this.filterService.parseFilterText(segments.join(' OR '));
      query.text = this.searchText;
    }
    
    // Use filterEntries to get the filtered count
    return this.filterService.filterEntries(this.dataset, query).length;
  }

  private getGroupCounts(): Map<string, number> {
    const counts = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const p of this.selectedPresets) {
      const g = p.group || 'Other';
      counts.set(g, (counts.get(g) || 0) + 1);
    }
    return counts;
  }

  get orPresets(): FilterPreset[] {
    return this.selectedPresets.filter(p =>
      this.orGroups.has(p.group || 'Other')
    );
  }

  get andPresets(): FilterPreset[] {
    return this.selectedPresets.filter(p =>
      this.andGroups.has(p.group || 'Other')
    );
  }

  // ── Constructor ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  constructor(
    private filterService: FilterService,
    private elRef: ElementRef,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService,
    private inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
  ) {}

  // ── Lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.searchText = this.initialSearch;
    this.loadSavedPresets();
    this.rebuildPresets();
    this.registerPresetOverlayCommands();

    this.search$
      .pipe(debounce(200), distinctUntilChanged(), takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(() => this.emitFilterChange());
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['dataset'] && !changes['dataset'].firstChange) {
      this.rebuildPresets();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.releasePresetOverlayContext?.();
    this.releasePresetOverlayContext = null;
    this.unregisterPresetOverlayCommands();
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  // ── Preset generation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  rebuildPresets(): void {
    this.allPresets = buildPresetsFromDataset(this.dataset);

    const ids = new Set(this.allPresets.map(p => p.id));
    this.selectedPresets = this.selectedPresets.filter(p => ids.has(p.id));
    this.selectedPresets = this.selectedPresets.map(sel =>
      this.allPresets.find(p => p.id === sel.id) ?? sel,
    );

    this.cdr.detectChanges();
    if (this.hasAnyFilter) this.emitFilterChange();
  }

  refreshPresets(): void { this.rebuildPresets(); }

  // ── Dropdown ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  toggleCategoryDropdown(): void {
    this.onCategoryDropdownStateChange(!this.showCategoryDropdown);
  }

  onCategoryDropdownStateChange(show: boolean): void {
    this.showCategoryDropdown = show;
  }

  togglePresetDropdown(): void {
    this.onPresetDropdownStateChange(!this.showPresetDropdown);
  }

  onPresetDropdownStateChange(show: boolean): void {
    this.showPresetDropdown = show;
    if (show) {
      this.selectedPresetIndex = this.savedPresets.length > 0 ? 0 : -1;
      this.releasePresetOverlayContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('overlay.filter.presets');
      return;
    }

    this.releasePresetOverlayContext?.();
    this.releasePresetOverlayContext = null;
  }

  // ── Preset selection ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  onPresetToggle(preset: FilterPreset): void {
    const idx = this.selectedPresets.findIndex(p => p.id === preset.id);
    this.selectedPresets = idx >= 0
      ? this.selectedPresets.filter(p => p.id !== preset.id)
      : [...this.selectedPresets, preset];
    this.emitFilterChange();
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }

  clearPresets(): void {
    this.selectedPresets = [];
    this.emitFilterChange();
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }

  onGroupModeChange(ev: { group: string; mode: 'AND' | 'OR' }): void {
    this.groupModes.set(ev.group, ev.mode);
    if (this.selectedPresets.length > 0) this.emitFilterChange();
  }

  // ── Search ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  onSearchChange(value: string): void { this.searchText = value; this.search$.next(value); }
  onSearchKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent): void { if (e.key === 'Escape') this.clearSearch(); }

  clearSearch(): void {
    this.searchText = '';
    this.emitFilterChange();
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }

  clearAllFilters(): void {
    this.selectedPresets = [];
    this.searchText = '';
    this.emitFilterChange();
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }

  // ── Saved presets ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  loadSavedPresets(): void {
    try { this.savedPresets = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(FILTER_PRESETS_KEY) || '[]'); }
    catch { this.savedPresets = []; }
  }

  persistSavedPresets(): void {
    try { localStorage.setItem(FILTER_PRESETS_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.savedPresets)); } catch {}
  }

  async onSavePreset(): Promise<void> {
    const name = (await this.confirmDialog.prompt({
      title: 'Save Preset',
      message: 'Enter preset name.',
      confirmText: 'Save',
      cancelText: 'Cancel',
      placeholder: 'Preset name',
      defaultValue: '',
      historyKey: 'filter.presetName',
    }))?.trim();
    if (!name) return;
    this.savedPresets = [...this.savedPresets, {
      id: `preset-${Date.now()}`,
      name,
      presetIds: this.selectedPresets.map(p => p.id),
    }];
    this.persistSavedPresets();
    this.onPresetDropdownStateChange(false);
  }

  applyPreset(saved: { id: string; name: string; presetIds: string[] }): void {
    this.selectedPresets = saved.presetIds
      .map(id => this.allPresets.find(p => p.id === id))
      .filter(Boolean) as FilterPreset[];
    this.onPresetDropdownStateChange(false);
    this.emitFilterChange();
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }

  deletePreset(saved: { id: string; name: string; presetIds: string[] }): void {
    this.savedPresets = this.savedPresets.filter(p => p.id !== saved.id);
    this.persistSavedPresets();
  }

  // ── Custom categories ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  onCustomCategorySave(_data: CustomCategoryData): void { this.closeCustomDialog(); }
  closeCustomDialog(): void { this.showCustomDialog = false; this.editingCategory = null; }

  // ── Keyboard ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  onHostKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'f') {
      e.preventDefault();
      this.searchInput?.nativeElement.focus();
    }
  }

  onDocKey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      if (this.showCategoryDropdown) { this.onCategoryDropdownStateChange(false); e.preventDefault(); }
      if (this.showPresetDropdown)   { this.onPresetDropdownStateChange(false); e.preventDefault(); }
      if (this.showCustomDialog)     { this.closeCustomDialog();          e.preventDefault(); }
    }
  }

  setSelectedPresetIndex(index: number): void {
    if (index < 0 || index >= this.savedPresets.length) return;
    this.selectedPresetIndex = index;
  }

  private movePresetSelection(delta: number): void {
    if (this.savedPresets.length === 0) return;
    const baseIndex = this.selectedPresetIndex >= 0 ? this.selectedPresetIndex : 0;
    this.selectedPresetIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.savedPresets.length - 1, baseIndex + delta));
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private applySelectedPreset(): void {
    const preset = this.savedPresets[this.selectedPresetIndex];
    if (!preset) return;
    this.applyPreset(preset);
  }

  private registerPresetOverlayCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.filter.presets.close', () => {
      if (!this.showPresetDropdown) return;
      this.onPresetDropdownStateChange(false);
    }, this.presetCommandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.filter.presets.prevItem', () => {
      if (!this.showPresetDropdown) return;
      this.movePresetSelection(-1);
    }, this.presetCommandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.filter.presets.nextItem', () => {
      if (!this.showPresetDropdown) return;
      this.movePresetSelection(1);
    }, this.presetCommandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.filter.presets.select', () => {
      if (!this.showPresetDropdown) return;
      this.applySelectedPreset();
    }, this.presetCommandOwner);
  }

  private unregisterPresetOverlayCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.filter.presets.close', this.presetCommandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.filter.presets.prevItem', this.presetCommandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.filter.presets.nextItem', this.presetCommandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.filter.presets.select', this.presetCommandOwner);
  }

  // ── Emit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private emitFilterChange(): void {
    if (!this.hasAnyFilter) {
      this.filterChange.emit(this.filterService.parseFilterText(''));
      return;
    }
    if (this.selectedPresets.length === 0) {
      this.filterChange.emit(this.filterService.parseFilterText(this.searchText));
      return;
    }

    // Group presets → build combined filter string
    const groupMap = new Map<string, FilterPreset[]>();
    for (const p of this.selectedPresets) {
      const g = p.group || 'Other';
      if (!groupMap.has(g)) groupMap.set(g, []);
      groupMap.get(g)!.push(p);
    }

    const segments: string[] = [];
    for (const [groupName, presets] of groupMap) {
      const mode    = this.groupModes.get(groupName) ?? 'OR';
      const filters = presets.map(p => (p as any).filter).filter(Boolean) as string[];
      if (filters.length === 1) {
        segments.push(filters[0]);
      } else if (mode === 'OR') {
        segments.push(filters.join(' OR '));
      } else {
        segments.push(filters.join(' '));
      }
    }

    const query    = this.filterService.parseFilterText(segments.join(' OR '));
    query.text     = this.searchText;
    this.filterChange.emit(query);
  }
}
