````typescript
import { Component, OnInit, OnDestroy, ViewChild, ElementRef, Output, EventEmitter } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { createSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { takeUntil, debounce } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { GlobalSearchService, SearchResultItem, IndexStats, SearchConfig } from '../services/global-search.service';
import { InputContextService } from '../services/input-context.service';
import { InputEngineService } from '../services/input-engine.service';
import { NativeOverlayFreezeService } from '../services/native-overlay-freeze.service';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { getFileEntryPresentation } from './file-entry-presentation.util';
import { DialogFocusTrapDirective } from '../directives/dialog-focus-trap.directive';
import { moveFocusWithin } from '../directives/focus-trap.utils';
import { VscodeScrollbarDirective } from '../directives/vscode-scrollbar.directive';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-global-search',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, DialogFocusTrapDirective, VscodeScrollbarDirective],
  templateUrl: './global-search.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./global-search.component.scss']
})
export class GlobalSearchComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('searchInput') searchInput?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;
  @ViewChild('settingsPanel') settingsPanel?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;
  @Output() resultSelected = new EventEmitter<SearchResultItem>();
  @Output() searchFolderRequested = new EventEmitter<string>();

  isVisible = false;
  searchQuery = '';
  results: SearchResultItem[] = [];
  isSearching = false;
  selectedIndex = 0;
  indexStats: IndexStats | null = null;
  
  activeFilters = new Set<string>(['all']);
  showSettingsModal = false;
  
  searchConfig: SearchConfig = {
    maxResults: 50,
    fuzzyThreshold: 0.7,
    enableTypoTolerance: true,
    searchHidden: false,
    fileTypes: [FileType.FILE, FileType.DIRECTORY],
  };

  private destroy$ = createSubject<void>();
  private searchSubject = createSubject<string>();
  private releaseSearchContext: (() => void) | null = null;
  private releaseSearchSettingsContext: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor(
    private searchService: GlobalSearchService,
    private inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
    private overlayFreeze: NativeOverlayFreezeService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.registerInputCommands();

    // Subscribe to index stats
    this.searchService.stats$
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(stats => {
        this.indexStats = stats;
      });

    // Setup debounced search
    this.searchSubject
      .pipe(
        debounce(300),
        takeUntil(this.destroy$)
      )
      .subscribe(query => {
        this.performSearch(query);
      });

    // Load config
    this.searchConfig = this.searchService.getConfig();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.overlayFreeze.release('dialog.globalSearch');
    this.releaseSearchSettingsContext?.();
    this.releaseSearchSettingsContext = null;
    this.releaseSearchContext?.();
    this.releaseSearchContext = null;
    this.unregisterInputCommands();
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  /**
   * Show the global search modal
   */
  show(): void {
    this.isVisible = true;
    this.releaseSearchContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('dialog.globalSearch');
    this.overlayFreeze.acquire('dialog.globalSearch');
    this.searchQuery = '';
    this.results = [];
    this.selectedIndex = 0;
    this.activeFilters = new Set(['all']);
    setTimeout(() => this.searchInput?.nativeElement.focus(), 0);
  }

  /**
   * Hide the global search modal
   */
  hide(): void {
    this.isVisible = false;
    this.searchQuery = '';
    this.results = [];
    this.hideSettings();
    this.releaseSearchContext?.();
    this.releaseSearchContext = null;
    this.overlayFreeze.release('dialog.globalSearch');
  }

  /**
   * Handle search query change
   */
  onSearchChange(): void {
    if (!this.searchQuery || this.searchQuery.trim() === '') {
      this.results = [];
      this.isSearching = false;
      return;
    }

    this.isSearching = true;
    this.searchSubject.next(this.searchQuery);
  }

  /**
   * Perform the search
   */
  private performSearch(query: string): void {
    try {
      const config = this.getActiveSearchConfig();
      const rawResults = this.searchService.search(query, config);

      // Apply active filters
      this.results = this.applyFilters(rawResults);
      this.selectedIndex = 0;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Search error:', error);
      this.results = [];
    } finally {
      this.isSearching = false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Get search config based on active filters
   */
  private getActiveSearchConfig(): Partial<SearchConfig> {
    const config: Partial<SearchConfig> = { ...this.searchConfig };

    // File type filters
    if (this.activeFilters.has('files') && !this.activeFilters.has('folders')) {
      config.fileTypes = [FileType.FILE];
    } else if (this.activeFilters.has('folders') && !this.activeFilters.has('files')) {
      config.fileTypes = [FileType.DIRECTORY];
    } else {
      config.fileTypes = [FileType.FILE, FileType.DIRECTORY];
    }

    return config;
  }

  /**
   * Apply additional filters to results
   */
  private applyFilters(results: SearchResultItem[]): SearchResultItem[] {
    let filtered = results;

    // Recent filter (last 7 days)
    if (this.activeFilters.has('recent')) {
      const weekAgo = Date.now() / 1000 - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60);
      filtered = filtered.filter(r => r.file.modified >= weekAgo);
    }

    return filtered;
  }

  /**
   * Toggle a filter
   */
  toggleFilter(filter: string): void {
    if (filter === 'all') {
      this.activeFilters.clear();
      this.activeFilters.add('all');
    } else {
      this.activeFilters.delete('all');
      
      if (this.activeFilters.has(filter)) {
        this.activeFilters.delete(filter);
      } else {
        this.activeFilters.add(filter);
      }

      // If no filters, default to 'all'
      if (this.activeFilters.size === 0) {
        this.activeFilters.add('all');
      }
    }

    // Re-search with new filters
    if (this.searchQuery) {
      this.performSearch(this.searchQuery);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Clear search
   */
  clearSearch(): void {
    this.searchQuery = '';
    this.results = [];
    this.selectedIndex = 0;
    this.searchInput?.nativeElement.focus();
  }

  /**
   * Select a result
   */
  selectResult(result: SearchResultItem): void {
    this.resultSelected.emit(result);
    this.hide();
  }

  openSearchFolder(): void {
    const trimmedQuery = this.searchQuery.trim();
    if (!trimmedQuery) {
      return;
    }

    this.searchFolderRequested.emit(trimmedQuery);
    this.hide();
  }

  /**
   * Get file icon
   */
  getFileIcon(file: SearchResultItem['file']): string {
    return getFileEntryPresentation(file as any, false).iconEmoji;
  }

  isSymlink(file: SearchResultItem['file']): boolean {
    return getFileEntryPresentation(file as any, false).isSymlink;
  }

  /**
   * Refresh the search index
   */
  async refreshIndex(): Promise<void> {
    this.isSearching = true;
    try {
      await this.searchService.refreshIndex();
    } finally {
      this.isSearching = false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Show settings modal
   */
  showSettings(): void {
    this.showSettingsModal = true;
    this.releaseSearchSettingsContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('dialog.globalSearch.settings');
  }

  /**
   * Hide settings modal
   */
  hideSettings(): void {
    this.showSettingsModal = false;
    this.releaseSearchSettingsContext?.();
    this.releaseSearchSettingsContext = null;
  }

  /**
   * Update search configuration
   */
  updateSearchConfig(): void {
    this.searchService.updateConfig(this.searchConfig);
    
    // Re-search if there's an active query
    if (this.searchQuery) {
      this.performSearch(this.searchQuery);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Reset settings to defaults
   */
  resetSettings(): void {
    this.searchConfig = {
      maxResults: 50,
      fuzzyThreshold: 0.7,
      enableTypoTolerance: true,
      searchHidden: false,
      fileTypes: [FileType.FILE, FileType.DIRECTORY],
    };
    this.updateSearchConfig();
  }

  /**
   * Handle keyboard navigation
   */
  /**
   * Scroll to selected result
   */
  private scrollToSelected(): void {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const selected = document.querySelector('.result-item.selected');
      if (selected) {
        selected.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' });
      }
    }, 0);
  }

  private registerInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.globalSearch.close', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible) return;
      this.hide();
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.globalSearch.prevResult', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible || this.showSettingsModal || this.results.length === 0) return;
      this.selectedIndex = Math.max(this.selectedIndex - 1, 0);
      this.scrollToSelected();
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.globalSearch.nextResult', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible || this.showSettingsModal || this.results.length === 0) return;
      this.selectedIndex = Math.min(this.selectedIndex + 1, this.results.length - 1);
      this.scrollToSelected();
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.globalSearch.openSelected', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible || this.showSettingsModal) return;
      if (this.results.length === 0 || this.selectedIndex >= this.results.length) return;
      this.selectResult(this.results[this.selectedIndex]);
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.globalSearch.openFolder', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible || this.showSettingsModal) return;
      if (!this.searchQuery.trim()) return;
      this.openSearchFolder();
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.globalSearch.openSettings', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible) return;
      this.showSettings();
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.globalSearch.settings.close', () => {
      if (!this.showSettingsModal) return;
      this.hideSettings();
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.globalSearch.settings.apply', () => {
      if (!this.showSettingsModal) return;
      this.updateSearchConfig();
      this.hideSettings();
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.globalSearch.settings.focusNextArrow', () => {
      if (!this.showSettingsModal || !this.shouldUseSettingsArrowFocusNavigation()) return;
      this.moveSettingsFocus(1);
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.globalSearch.settings.focusPrevArrow', () => {
      if (!this.showSettingsModal || !this.shouldUseSettingsArrowFocusNavigation()) return;
      this.moveSettingsFocus(-1);
    });
  }

  private unregisterInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.globalSearch.close');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.globalSearch.prevResult');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.globalSearch.nextResult');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.globalSearch.openSelected');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.globalSearch.openFolder');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.globalSearch.openSettings');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.globalSearch.settings.close');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.globalSearch.settings.apply');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.globalSearch.settings.focusNextArrow');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.globalSearch.settings.focusPrevArrow');
  }

  private moveSettingsFocus(delta: number): void {
    const panel = this.settingsPanel?.nativeElement;
    if (!panel) {
      return;
    }

    moveFocusWithin(panel, delta, '.settings-footer button');
  }

  private shouldUseSettingsArrowFocusNavigation(): boolean {
    const panel = this.settingsPanel?.nativeElement;
    const activeElement = document.activeElement;
    if (!panel || !(activeElement instanceof HTMLElement) || !panel.contains(activeElement)) {
      return false;
    }

    return !!activeElement.closest('.settings-footer button');
  }
}
````

````html
<div class="keyboard-help-overlay" *ngIf="isVisible" (click)="hide()">
  <div #dialogPanel class="keyboard-help-modal" [appTrapFocus]="true" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" tabindex="-1" (click)="$event.stopPropagation()">
    <!-- Header -->
    <div class="modal-header">
      <div>
        <h2>Keyboard Shortcuts</h2>
        <p>Browse and toggle bindings. Press <kbd>?</kbd> or <kbd>Ctrl+/</kbd> to toggle this panel.</p>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="dialog-close-btn" aria-label="Close" (click)="hide()" title="Close (Esc)">
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 7.293l3.536-3.536.707.707L8.707 8l3.536 3.536-.707.707L8 8.707l-3.536 3.536-.707-.707L7.293 8 3.757 4.464l.707-.707L8 7.293z"/></svg>
      </button>
    </div>

    <!-- Search Bar -->
    <div class="search-bar">
      <input
        #searchInput
        data-dialog-initial-focus
        type="text"
        [(ngModel)]="searchText"
        (ngModelChange)="onSearchChange()"
        placeholder="Search shortcuts..."
        class="search-input"
        autofocus
      />
      <button
        *ngIf="searchText"
        (click)="clearSearch()"
        class="btn-clear"
        title="Clear search"
      >
        ✕
      </button>
    </div>

    <!-- Shortcuts List -->
    <div class="shortcuts-list" appVscodeScrollbar>
      <div *ngIf="filteredCategories.length === 0" class="no-results">
        No shortcuts found for "{{ searchText }}"
      </div>

      <div *ngFor="let category of filteredCategories" class="shortcut-category">
        <h3 class="category-name">{{ category.name }}</h3>
        
        <div class="shortcuts">
          <div 
            *ngFor="let binding of category.bindings"
            class="shortcut-item"
            [class.disabled]="binding.enabled === false"
          >
            <div class="shortcut-left">
              <span class="shortcut-key">{{ formatBinding(binding) }}</span>
              <span class="shortcut-description">{{ binding.description }}</span>
            </div>
            
            <div class="shortcut-right">
              <label class="toggle-switch">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  [checked]="binding.enabled !== false"
                  (change)="toggleBinding(binding)"
                />
                <span class="toggle-slider"></span>
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Footer -->
    <div class="modal-footer">
      <div class="footer-left">
        <button (click)="exportConfig()" class="btn-secondary">
          Export Config
        </button>
        <button (click)="fileInput.click()" class="btn-secondary">
          Import Config
        </button>
        <input
          #fileInput
          type="file"
          accept=".json"
          (change)="importConfig($event)"
          style="display: none"
        />
      </div>
      
      <div class="footer-right">
        <button (click)="resetToDefaults()" class="btn-secondary">
          Reset to Defaults
        </button>
        <button (click)="hide()" class="btn-primary">
          Close
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Hint -->
    <div class="modal-hint">
      Press <kbd>?</kbd> or <kbd>Ctrl+/</kbd> to toggle this help
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
````

````scss
      color var(--vsc-transition-fast);

    &:hover {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-foreground) 10%, transparent);
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright);
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      outline: 1px solid var(--vsc-input-focus-border);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// Search Bar
// ============================================================================

.search-bar {
  position: relative;
  padding: var(--vsc-padding-md) var(--vsc-padding-lg);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle);

  .search-input {
    width: 100%;
    padding: var(--vsc-padding-sm) var(--vsc-padding-md);
    padding-right: 2.4rem;
    background: var(--vsc-input-background);
    border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border);
    border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius);
    color: var(--vsc-input-foreground);
    font-size: var(--vsc-font-size);

    &:focus {
      outline: none;
      border-color: var(--vsc-input-focus-border);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--vsc-input-focus-border);
    }

    &::placeholder { color: var(--vsc-input-placeholder); }
  }

  .btn-clear {
    position: absolute;
    right: 1.6rem;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    padding: 0.18rem 0.4rem;
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 1rem;
    transition: color var(--vsc-transition-fast);

    &:hover { color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright); }
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// Shortcuts List
// ============================================================================

.shortcuts-list {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: var(--vsc-padding-md) 0;
}

.no-results {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem;
  color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
  font-size: var(--vsc-font-size);
}

.shortcut-category {
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;

  .category-name {
    margin: 0;
    padding: var(--vsc-padding-sm) var(--vsc-padding-lg);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
    background: var(--vsc-panel-background);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle);
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  }

  .shortcuts { padding: 0.4rem 0; }
}

.shortcut-item {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
  transition: background var(--vsc-transition-fast);
  background: transparent;

  &:hover { background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background); }

  &.disabled { opacity: 0.5; .shortcut-description { text-decoration: line-through; } }

  .shortcut-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--vsc-padding-lg); flex: 1; }

  .shortcut-key {
    font-family: var(--vsc-font-family-mono);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--vsc-success);
    background: var(--vsc-input-background);
    padding: 0.25rem 0.6rem;
    border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
    border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border);
    min-width: 120px;
    text-align: center;
    font-weight: 600;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .shortcut-description { color: var(--vsc-foreground); font-size: var(--vsc-font-size); }
  .shortcut-right { display: flex; align-items: center; }
}

// ============================================================================
// Toggle Switch
// ============================================================================

.toggle-switch { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 44px; height: 24px; }

.toggle-switch input { opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; }

.toggle-switch input:checked + .toggle-slider { background-color: var(--vsc-accent-blue); }
.toggle-switch input:checked + .toggle-slider:before { transform: translateX(20px); }
.toggle-switch input:focus + .toggle-slider { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--vsc-input-focus-border); }

.toggle-slider {
  position: absolute; cursor: pointer; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background-color: var(--vsc-border); transition: var(--vsc-transition-fast); border-radius: 24px;
}
.toggle-slider:before { position: absolute; content: ''; height: 18px; width: 18px; left: 3px; bottom: 3px; background-color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright); transition: var(--vsc-transition-fast); border-radius: 50%; }

// ============================================================================
// Footer
// ============================================================================

.modal-footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: var(--vsc-padding-md) var(--vsc-padding-lg); border-top: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle); gap: var(--vsc-padding-lg); .footer-left, .footer-right { display: flex; gap: var(--vsc-padding-sm); } }

.btn-primary, .btn-secondary { padding: var(--vsc-padding-sm) var(--vsc-padding-md); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm); cursor: pointer; font-size: var(--vsc-font-size); transition: background var(--vsc-transition-fast); white-space: nowrap; }
.btn-primary { background: var(--vsc-button-background); color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright); }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--vsc-button-hover); }
.btn-secondary { background: var(--vsc-button-secondary); color: var(--vsc-foreground); border-color: var(--vsc-border); }
.btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--vsc-button-secondary-hover); }

// ============================================================================
// Hint
// ============================================================================

.modal-hint { padding: var(--vsc-padding-sm) var(--vsc-padding-lg); text-align: center; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim); background: var(--vsc-panel-background); border-top: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle); }
.modal-hint kbd { display: inline-block; padding: 0.18rem 0.35rem; background: var(--vsc-input-background); border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border); border-bottom-width: 2px; border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm); font-family: var(--vsc-font-family-mono); font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--vsc-accent-blue); margin: 0 0.2rem; }

// ============================================================================
// Responsive
// ============================================================================

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .keyboard-help-modal {
    width: 95%;
    max-height: 90vh;
  }

  .shortcut-item {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.75rem;

    .shortcut-left {
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .shortcut-key {
      min-width: auto;
    }
  }

  .modal-footer {
    flex-direction: column;

    .footer-left,
    .footer-right {
      width: 100%;
      justify-content: center;
    }
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Component, OnInit, OnDestroy, ViewChild, ElementRef } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { createSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { ConfirmDialogService } from '../services/confirm-dialog.service';
import { InputContextService } from '../services/input-context.service';
import { InputEngineService } from '../services/input-engine.service';
import { InputBindingDefinition } from '../services/input-system.types';
import { KeybindingStorageService } from '../services/keybinding-storage.service';
import { NativeOverlayFreezeService } from '../services/native-overlay-freeze.service';
import { DialogFocusTrapDirective } from '../directives/dialog-focus-trap.directive';
import { moveFocusWithin } from '../directives/focus-trap.utils';
import { VscodeScrollbarDirective } from '../directives/vscode-scrollbar.directive';

interface BindingCategory {
  name: string;
  bindings: InputBindingDefinition[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-keyboard-help',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, DialogFocusTrapDirective, VscodeScrollbarDirective],
  templateUrl: './keyboard-help.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./keyboard-help.component.scss']
})
export class KeyboardHelpComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('dialogPanel') dialogPanel?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;
  @ViewChild('searchInput') searchInput?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;

  isVisible = false;
  categories: BindingCategory[] = [];
  searchText = '';
  filteredCategories: BindingCategory[] = [];

  private readonly modNames: Record<string, string> = {
    Control: 'Ctrl', Alt: 'Alt', Shift: 'Shift', Meta: 'Cmd',
  };
  private readonly keyNames: Record<string, string> = {
    ' ': 'Space', ArrowUp: '↑', ArrowDown: '↓', ArrowLeft: '←', ArrowRight: '→',
    Escape: 'Esc', Enter: 'Enter', Backspace: 'Backspace', Delete: 'Del',
    Tab: 'Tab', Home: 'Home', End: 'End', PageUp: 'PgUp', PageDown: 'PgDn',
    F1: 'F1', F2: 'F2', F3: 'F3', F4: 'F4', F5: 'F5', F6: 'F6',
    F7: 'F7', F8: 'F8', F9: 'F9', F10: 'F10', F11: 'F11', F12: 'F12',
  };

  private destroy$ = createSubject<void>();
  private releaseDialogContext: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor(
    private confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService,
    private inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
    private keybindingStorage: KeybindingStorageService,
    private overlayFreeze: NativeOverlayFreezeService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.registerInputCommands();
    this.loadShortcuts();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.overlayFreeze.release('dialog.keyboardHelp');
    this.releaseDialogContext?.();
    this.releaseDialogContext = null;
    this.unregisterInputCommands();
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  loadShortcuts(): void {
    const snapshot = this.keybindingStorage.mergeWithDefaults(this.inputEngine.getBindingSnapshot());
    const byCategory = new Map<string, InputBindingDefinition[]>();
    for (const b of snapshot) {
      if (!b.category || b.trigger.device !== 'keyboard') continue;
      if (!byCategory.has(b.category)) byCategory.set(b.category, []);
      byCategory.get(b.category)!.push(b);
    }
    this.categories = Array.from(byCategory.entries())
      .map(([name, bindings]) => ({ name, bindings }));
    this.filteredCategories = this.categories;
  }

  /**
   * Show help modal
   */
  show(): void {
    this.isVisible = true;
    this.releaseDialogContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('dialog.keyboardHelp');
    this.overlayFreeze.acquire('dialog.keyboardHelp');
    this.searchText = '';
    this.loadShortcuts();
  }

  /**
   * Hide help modal
   */
  hide(): void {
    this.isVisible = false;
    this.releaseDialogContext?.();
    this.releaseDialogContext = null;
    this.overlayFreeze.release('dialog.keyboardHelp');
  }

  onSearchChange(): void {
    const search = this.searchText.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!search) {
      this.filteredCategories = this.categories;
      return;
    }
    this.filteredCategories = this.categories
      .map(cat => ({
        name: cat.name,
        bindings: cat.bindings.filter(b => {
          const keyMatch = this.formatBinding(b).toLowerCase().includes(search);
          const descMatch = (b.description ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(search);
          return keyMatch || descMatch;
        }),
      }))
      .filter(cat => cat.bindings.length > 0);
  }

  /**
   * Clear search
   */
  clearSearch(): void {
    this.searchText = '';
    this.onSearchChange();
  }

  formatBinding(b: InputBindingDefinition): string {
    if (b.trigger.device !== 'keyboard') return '';
    return b.trigger.chord.steps.map(step => {
      const mods = (step.modifiers ?? []).map(m => this.modNames[m] ?? m).join('+');
      const key = this.keyNames[step.key] ?? step.key.toUpperCase();
      return mods ? `${mods}+${key}` : key;
    }).join(' → ');
  }

  toggleBinding(binding: InputBindingDefinition): void {
    this.inputEngine.setBindingEnabled(binding.id, binding.enabled === false);
    this.loadShortcuts();
  }

  exportConfig(): void {
    const snapshot = this.inputEngine.getBindingSnapshot();
    const config = {
      version: '2.0',
      bindings: snapshot.map(b => ({ id: b.id, enabled: b.enabled !== false })),
    };
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(config, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = 'keybindings.json';
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  importConfig(event: Event): void {
    const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    const file = input.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      try {
        const config = JSON.parse(e.target?.result as string);
        const entries: Array<{ id: string; enabled: boolean }> = config.bindings ?? [];
        for (const entry of entries) {
          this.inputEngine.setBindingEnabled(entry.id, entry.enabled);
        }
        this.loadShortcuts();
        this.confirmDialog.alert('Import Successful\nKeybindings have been imported.');
      } catch {
        this.confirmDialog.alert('Import Failed\nInvalid file format.');
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  }

  /**
   * Reset to default shortcuts
   */
  async resetToDefaults(): Promise<void> {
    const confirmed = await this.confirmDialog.confirm({
      title: 'Reset Shortcuts',
      message: 'Reset all shortcuts to defaults?',
      confirmText: 'Reset',
      danger: true,
    });
    if (confirmed) {
      for (const b of this.inputEngine.getBindingSnapshot()) {
        if (b.enabled === false) {
          this.inputEngine.setBindingEnabled(b.id, true);
        }
      }
      this.loadShortcuts();
    }
  }

  private registerInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.keyboardHelp.close', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible) return;
      this.hide();
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.keyboardHelp.focusSearch', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible) return;
      this.searchInput?.nativeElement.focus();
      this.searchInput?.nativeElement.select();
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.keyboardHelp.exportBindings', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible) return;
      this.exportConfig();
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.keyboardHelp.focusNextArrow', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible || !this.shouldUseArrowFocusNavigation()) return;
      this.moveDialogFocus(1);
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.keyboardHelp.focusPrevArrow', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible || !this.shouldUseArrowFocusNavigation()) return;
      this.moveDialogFocus(-1);
    });
  }

  private unregisterInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.keyboardHelp.close');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.keyboardHelp.focusSearch');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.keyboardHelp.exportBindings');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.keyboardHelp.focusNextArrow');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.keyboardHelp.focusPrevArrow');
  }

  private moveDialogFocus(delta: number): void {
    const panel = this.dialogPanel?.nativeElement;
    if (!panel) {
      return;
    }

    moveFocusWithin(panel, delta, '.modal-footer button');
  }

  private shouldUseArrowFocusNavigation(): boolean {
    const panel = this.dialogPanel?.nativeElement;
    const activeElement = document.activeElement;
    if (!panel || !(activeElement instanceof HTMLElement) || !panel.contains(activeElement)) {
      return false;
    }

    return !!activeElement.closest('.modal-footer button');
  }
}
````

import {
  Component, Input, OnChanges, OnDestroy, AfterViewInit,
  SimpleChanges, ViewChild, ElementRef, NgZone, HostBinding,
  ChangeDetectionStrategy,
} from '@angular/core';
import { NativeBrowserPaneService } from '../services/native-browser-pane.service';
import { NativeOverlayFreezeService } from '../services/native-overlay-freeze.service';

/**
 * Manages a native Win32 browser overlay that tracks its host element position.
 *
 * The overlay is automatically replaced with a canvas screenshot when:
 *  - The split-divider is hovered / dragged (`divider-hover`, `divider-dragging`)
 *  - A modal session is active (`native-overlay-frozen` on body)
 *
 * Usage:
 * ```html
 * <app-native-overlay
 *   [surfaceId]="surfaceId"
 *   [url]="currentPath"
 *   [active]="surfaceActive">
 * </app-native-overlay>
 * ```
 */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-native-overlay',
  standalone: true,
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <div #host class="native-overlay-host">
      <div #backdrop class="native-overlay-backdrop"></div>
      <canvas #screenshotCanvas class="native-overlay-canvas"></canvas>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      position: relative;
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .native-overlay-host {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      position: relative;
      z-index: var(--vsc-z-native-overlay);
    }

    .native-overlay-backdrop {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
    }

    .native-overlay-canvas {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: none;
      z-index: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
      image-rendering: auto;
    }
  `],
})
export class NativeOverlayComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy, AfterViewInit {
  @HostBinding('style.backgroundColor') hostBackgroundColor = '#ffffff';
  @ViewChild('host') private hostEl?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;
  @ViewChild('backdrop') private backdropEl?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;
  @ViewChild('screenshotCanvas') private canvasEl?: ElementRef<HTMLCanvasElement>;

  @Input() surfaceId = '';
  @Input() url = '';
  @Input() active = true;

  // ── Sync state ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  private syncTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private syncFrame: number | null = null;
  private syncInFlight = false;
  private syncQueued = false;
  private lastSyncKey = '';

  // ── Screenshot / freeze state ───────────────────────────────

  private wasFrozen = false;
  private capturingScreenshot = false;
  private screenshotVisible = false;
  private screenshotRequestId = 0;
  private lastScreenshotWidth = 0;
  private lastScreenshotHeight = 0;
  private lastScreenshotURL = '';
  private subpixelOffsetX = 0;
  private subpixelOffsetY = 0;
  private hoverFreezeActive = false;
  private documentBackgroundColor: string | null = null;
  private documentBackgroundRequestInFlight = false;
  private lastDocumentBackgroundURL = '';
  private lastDocumentBackgroundRequestAt = 0;
  private screenshotPending = false;
  private forceFreshScreenshot = false;
  private screenshotCooldownTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private lastScreenshotStartedAt = 0;
  private readonly screenshotMinInterval = 50;
  private readonly screenshotPrewarmDelayMs = 16;
  private readonly documentBackgroundRetryMs = 350;
  private readonly documentBackgroundRefreshMs = 2000;
  private readonly frozenCanvasBackground = '#ffffff';
  private liveBackgroundColor = '#ffffff';
  private documentBackgroundRequestToken = 0;
  private screenshotPrewarmTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  private measureHostBounds(host: HTMLElement): {
    rect: DOMRect;
    scale: number;
    x: number;
    y: number;
    width: number;
    height: number;
    cssWidth: number;
    cssHeight: number;
    subpixelOffsetX: number;
    subpixelOffsetY: number;
  } {
    const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
    const scale = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && Number.isFinite(window.devicePixelRatio) && window.devicePixelRatio > 0)
      ? window.devicePixelRatio
      : 1;
    const left = Math.round(rect.left * scale);
    const top = Math.round(rect.top * scale);
    const right = Math.round(rect.right * scale);
    const bottom = Math.round(rect.bottom * scale);
    const width = Math.max(0, right - left);
    const height = Math.max(0, bottom - top);

    return {
      rect,
      scale,
      x: left,
      y: top,
      width,
      height,

      // To make the captured image perfectly align back into CSS DOM space:
      cssWidth: width / scale,
      cssHeight: height / scale,
      subpixelOffsetX: (rect.left * scale - left) / scale,
      subpixelOffsetY: (rect.top * scale - top) / scale,
    };
  }

  // ── Event handlers ──────────────────────────────────────────

  private readonly onDividerStateChange = () => {
    this.updateHoverFreezeState();
    if (this.active && this.isFreezeRequested()) {
      this.revealCachedCanvasIfAvailable();
    }
    this.refreshTracking();
    this.requestSync();
  };

  private readonly onFreezeChange = () => {
    this.refreshTracking();
    this.requestSync();
  };

  private readonly onDividerMove = () => {
    if (!this.active || !document.body.classList.contains('divider-dragging')) {
      return;
    }
    this.scheduleFrameSync();
    this.requestScreenshotRefresh();
  };

  constructor(
    private nativeBrowserPane: NativeBrowserPaneService,
    private zone: NgZone,
    private overlayFreeze: NativeOverlayFreezeService,
  ) {}

  // ── Lifecycle ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    window.addEventListener('file-manager-divider-statechange', this.onDividerStateChange);
    window.addEventListener('file-manager-divider-move', this.onDividerMove);
    window.addEventListener('native-overlay-freeze-change', this.onFreezeChange);
    this.refresh();
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    const urlChanged = !!changes['url'];
    const surfaceChanged = !!changes['surfaceId'];

    if (urlChanged || surfaceChanged) {
      this.documentBackgroundRequestToken++;
      this.screenshotRequestId++;
      this.lastSyncKey = '';
      this.documentBackgroundColor = null;
      this.documentBackgroundRequestInFlight = false;
      this.lastDocumentBackgroundURL = '';
      this.lastDocumentBackgroundRequestAt = 0;

      const hasCachedScreenshot = this.screenshotVisible || this.hasCachedCanvas();
      const preserveScreenshotDuringSwap = urlChanged && !surfaceChanged && hasCachedScreenshot;

      if (preserveScreenshotDuringSwap) {
        this.wasFrozen = this.isFreezeRequested();
        this.revealCachedCanvasIfAvailable();
        this.screenshotPending = true;
        this.forceFreshScreenshot = true;
        this.lastScreenshotStartedAt = 0;
      } else {
        this.wasFrozen = false;
        this.hoverFreezeActive = false;
        this.hideCanvas(true);
      }
    }
    if (changes['active'] && this.active) {
      this.lastSyncKey = '';
      this.lastDocumentBackgroundRequestAt = 0;
    }
    if (urlChanged || changes['active'] || surfaceChanged) {
      this.refresh();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    window.removeEventListener('file-manager-divider-statechange', this.onDividerStateChange);
    window.removeEventListener('file-manager-divider-move', this.onDividerMove);
    window.removeEventListener('native-overlay-freeze-change', this.onFreezeChange);
    this.stopTracking();
    void this.nativeBrowserPane.dispose(this.surfaceId);
  }

  // ── Public ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

  /** The underlying host element (for external getBoundingClientRect, etc.). */
  get hostElement(): HTMLElement | undefined {
    return this.hostEl?.nativeElement;
  }

  // ── Internal: refresh / tracking ────────────────────────────

  private refresh(): void {
    if (!this.active) {
      this.documentBackgroundRequestToken++;
      this.screenshotRequestId++;
      this.wasFrozen = false;
      this.hoverFreezeActive = false;
      this.lastSyncKey = '';
      this.hideCanvas(true);
      this.stopTracking();
      this.requestSync();
      return;
    }
    this.refreshTracking();
    this.requestSync();
  }

  private refreshTracking(): void {
    if (!this.active) {
      this.stopTracking();
      return;
    }
    if (document.body.classList.contains('divider-dragging')) {
      this.stopTimer();
      return;
    }
    this.startTimer();
  }

  private startTimer(): void {
    if (this.syncTimer) {
      return;
    }
    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      this.syncTimer = setInterval(() => {
        this.requestSync();
      }, 100);
    });
  }

  private stopTracking(): void {
    this.stopTimer();
    this.clearScreenshotCooldown();
    this.clearScreenshotPrewarm();
    if (this.syncFrame !== null) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.syncFrame);
      this.syncFrame = null;
    }
    this.syncQueued = false;
  }

  private stopTimer(): void {
    if (!this.syncTimer) {
      return;
    }
    clearInterval(this.syncTimer);
    this.syncTimer = null;
  }

  private scheduleFrameSync(): void {
    if (this.syncFrame !== null) {
      return;
    }
    this.syncFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      this.syncFrame = null;
      this.requestSync();
    });
  }

  // ── Internal: sync loop ─────────────────────────────────────

  private requestSync(): void {
    if (this.syncInFlight) {
      this.syncQueued = true;
      return;
    }
    this.syncInFlight = true;
    void this.sync()
      .finally(() => {
        this.syncInFlight = false;
        if (this.syncQueued) {
          this.syncQueued = false;
          this.requestSync();
          return;
        }
        if (this.screenshotPending && this.isFreezeRequested()) {
          this.scheduleScreenshotCooldown(16);
        }
      });
  }

  private async sync(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.surfaceId) {
      return;
    }

    const theme = this.resolveTheme();
    const backgroundColor = this.documentBackgroundColor ?? this.resolveBackgroundColor(theme);
    this.liveBackgroundColor = backgroundColor;
    this.applyBackgroundColor(this.screenshotVisible ? this.frozenCanvasBackground : backgroundColor);

    // ── Freeze transitions ────────────────────────────────────
    const frozen = this.isFreezeRequested();

    if (frozen && !this.wasFrozen && this.active) {
      this.wasFrozen = true;
      void this.prepareScreenshot();
    }

    if (!frozen && this.wasFrozen) {
      this.wasFrozen = false;
      this.hoverFreezeActive = false;
      
      const expectedId = ++this.screenshotRequestId;
      // Delay hiding the canvas slightly so the native Win32 window has time
      // to paint on screen, eliminating the transparent flicker during unfreeze.
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (this.screenshotRequestId === expectedId && !this.wasFrozen) {
          this.hideCanvas(false);
        }
      }, 100);
    }

    // Hide native pane only after we have a screenshot to replace it.
    const freezeNativePane = this.shouldFreezeNativePane()
      && this.screenshotVisible;

    // ── Hidden ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (!this.active) {
      this.lastSyncKey = '';
      await this.nativeBrowserPane.sync({
        surfaceId: this.surfaceId,
        url: this.url,
        theme,
        backgroundColor,
        visible: false,
        x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0,
      });
      return;
    }

    // ── Measure host element ──────────────────────────────────
    const host = this.hostEl?.nativeElement;
    if (!host) {
      return;
    }

    const bounds = this.measureHostBounds(host);

    // Track sub-pixel offset between Win32 integer position and CSS element edge.
    this.subpixelOffsetX = bounds.subpixelOffsetX;
    this.subpixelOffsetY = bounds.subpixelOffsetY;
    if (bounds.width <= 0 || bounds.height <= 0) {
      return;
    }

    const request = {
      surfaceId: this.surfaceId,
      url: this.url,
      theme,
      backgroundColor,
      visible: !freezeNativePane,
      x: bounds.x,
      y: bounds.y,
      width: bounds.width,
      height: bounds.height,
    };
    const syncKey = JSON.stringify(request);
    if (syncKey === this.lastSyncKey) {
      this.scheduleScreenshotPrewarm();
      if (!frozen) {
        this.requestDocumentBackground(false, theme);
      }
      return;
    }

    try {
      if (await this.nativeBrowserPane.sync(request)) {
        this.lastSyncKey = syncKey;
        this.scheduleScreenshotPrewarm();
        if (!frozen) {
          this.requestDocumentBackground(false, theme);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      void error;
    }
  }

  // ── Internal: freeze detection ──────────────────────────────

  private isDividerInteracting(): boolean {
    return document.body.classList.contains('divider-hover')
      || document.body.classList.contains('divider-dragging');
  }

  private isFreezeRequested(): boolean {
    return this.isDividerInteracting()
      || this.overlayFreeze.frozen;
  }

  private shouldFreezeNativePane(): boolean {
    return this.isFreezeRequested()
      || this.hoverFreezeActive;
  }

  private updateHoverFreezeState(): void {
    if (document.body.classList.contains('divider-dragging')) {
      this.hoverFreezeActive = true;
      return;
    }
    if (document.body.classList.contains('divider-hover')) {
      return;
    }
    this.hoverFreezeActive = false;
  }

  // ── Internal: screenshot capture ────────────────────────────

  private async prepareScreenshot(): Promise<void> {
    this.screenshotPending = true;
    this.forceFreshScreenshot = true;
    if (this.isFreezeRequested()) {
      this.revealCachedCanvasIfAvailable();
    }
    if (this.syncInFlight) {
      this.scheduleScreenshotCooldown(16);
      return;
    }
    this.maybeStartScreenshotCapture();
  }

  private async captureScreenshot(forceRefresh: boolean, allowWithoutFreeze = false, reveal = true): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.surfaceId || !this.active || this.capturingScreenshot || (!forceRefresh && this.screenshotVisible)) {
      return;
    }

    const requestId = ++this.screenshotRequestId;
    this.capturingScreenshot = true;
    try {
      const data = await this.nativeBrowserPane.captureScreenshot(this.surfaceId);
      if (!data || requestId !== this.screenshotRequestId || (!allowWithoutFreeze && !this.isFreezeRequested())) {
        return;
      }
      const drawn = await this.drawOnCanvas(data, requestId, reveal, allowWithoutFreeze);
      if (!drawn || requestId !== this.screenshotRequestId || (!allowWithoutFreeze && !this.isFreezeRequested())) {
        return;
      }
      if (reveal && !document.body.classList.contains('divider-dragging') && document.body.classList.contains('divider-hover')) {
        this.hoverFreezeActive = true;
      }
      this.lastSyncKey = '';
      if (reveal) {
        this.requestSync();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      void e;
    } finally {
      this.capturingScreenshot = false;
      if (this.isFreezeRequested() && (this.screenshotPending || this.shouldRefreshScreenshot())) {
        this.requestScreenshotRefresh();
      }
    }
  }

  private requestScreenshotRefresh(): void {
    if (!this.isFreezeRequested()) {
      return;
    }
    this.clearScreenshotPrewarm();
    this.screenshotPending = true;
    this.maybeStartScreenshotCapture();
  }

  private scheduleScreenshotPrewarm(): void {
    if (!this.active || !this.surfaceId || !this.url || this.isFreezeRequested() || this.capturingScreenshot) {
      this.clearScreenshotPrewarm();
      return;
    }
    if (this.lastScreenshotURL === this.url && this.hasCachedCanvas()) {
      this.clearScreenshotPrewarm();
      return;
    }
    if (this.screenshotPrewarmTimer !== null) {
      return;
    }
    this.screenshotPrewarmTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.screenshotPrewarmTimer = null;
      if (!this.active || !this.surfaceId || !this.url || this.isFreezeRequested() || this.capturingScreenshot) {
        return;
      }
      void this.captureScreenshot(true, true, false);
    }, this.screenshotPrewarmDelayMs);
  }

  private clearScreenshotPrewarm(): void {
    if (this.screenshotPrewarmTimer === null) {
      return;
    }
    clearTimeout(this.screenshotPrewarmTimer);
    this.screenshotPrewarmTimer = null;
  }

  private maybeStartScreenshotCapture(): void {
    if (!this.screenshotPending || !this.isFreezeRequested() || this.capturingScreenshot) {
      return;
    }
    if (this.syncInFlight) {
      this.scheduleScreenshotCooldown(16);
      return;
    }
    const elapsed = Date.now() - this.lastScreenshotStartedAt;
    if (elapsed < this.screenshotMinInterval) {
      this.scheduleScreenshotCooldown(this.screenshotMinInterval - elapsed);
      return;
    }
    if (this.screenshotVisible && !this.forceFreshScreenshot && !this.shouldRefreshScreenshot()) {
      this.screenshotPending = false;
      return;
    }
    this.clearScreenshotCooldown();
    this.screenshotPending = false;
    this.forceFreshScreenshot = false;
    this.lastScreenshotStartedAt = Date.now();
    void this.captureScreenshot(true);
  }

  private scheduleScreenshotCooldown(delay: number): void {
    if (this.screenshotCooldownTimer !== null) {
      return;
    }
    this.screenshotCooldownTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.screenshotCooldownTimer = null;
      this.maybeStartScreenshotCapture();
    }, Math.max(0, delay));
  }

  private clearScreenshotCooldown(): void {
    if (this.screenshotCooldownTimer === null) {
      return;
    }
    clearTimeout(this.screenshotCooldownTimer);
    this.screenshotCooldownTimer = null;
  }

  private shouldRefreshScreenshot(): boolean {
    if (!document.body.classList.contains('divider-dragging')) {
      return false;
    }
    const host = this.hostEl?.nativeElement;
    if (!host) {
      return false;
    }
    const rect = host.getBoundingClientRect();
    return Math.abs(rect.width - this.lastScreenshotWidth) >= 8
      || Math.abs(rect.height - this.lastScreenshotHeight) >= 8;
  }

  // ── Internal: canvas rendering ──────────────────────────────

  private drawOnCanvas(base64Data: string, requestId: number, reveal: boolean, allowWithoutFreeze: boolean): Promise<boolean> {
    const host = this.hostEl?.nativeElement;
    const canvas = this.canvasEl?.nativeElement;
    if (!canvas || !host) {
      return Promise.resolve(false);
    }
    const bounds = this.measureHostBounds(host);
    return this.decodeBitmap(base64Data).then((bitmap) => {
      if (!bitmap) {
        return false;
      }
      return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
        if (requestId !== this.screenshotRequestId || (!allowWithoutFreeze && !this.isFreezeRequested())) {
          if ('close' in bitmap) {
            (bitmap as ImageBitmap).close();
          }
          resolve(false);
          return;
        }

        // Set backing-store to match the screenshot's native resolution.
        canvas.width = bitmap.width;
        canvas.height = bitmap.height;
        canvas.style.width = `${bounds.cssWidth}px`;
        canvas.style.height = `${bounds.cssHeight}px`;

        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
        if (!ctx) {
          if ('close' in bitmap) {
            (bitmap as ImageBitmap).close();
          }
          resolve(false);
          return;
        }
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
        ctx.fillStyle = this.frozenCanvasBackground;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        ctx.drawImage(bitmap, 0, 0);

        if ('close' in bitmap) {
          (bitmap as ImageBitmap).close();
        }

        if (reveal) {
          this.showCanvas();
          this.lastScreenshotWidth = bounds.rect.width;
          this.lastScreenshotHeight = bounds.rect.height;
          this.lastScreenshotURL = this.url;

          if (document.body.classList.contains('divider-dragging')) {
            this.screenshotVisible = true;
            resolve(true);
            return;
          }
          
          requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
              if (requestId === this.screenshotRequestId) {
                this.screenshotVisible = true;
                resolve(true);
              } else {
                resolve(false);
              }
            });
          });
        } else {
          this.hideCanvasElement(canvas);
          this.lastScreenshotWidth = bounds.rect.width;
          this.lastScreenshotHeight = bounds.rect.height;
          this.lastScreenshotURL = this.url;
          this.screenshotVisible = false;
          resolve(true);
        }
      });
    });
  }

  private hideCanvas(clearCache: boolean): void {
    this.screenshotVisible = false;
    this.lastScreenshotWidth = 0;
    this.lastScreenshotHeight = 0;
    this.screenshotPending = false;
    this.forceFreshScreenshot = false;
    this.lastScreenshotStartedAt = 0;
    this.clearScreenshotCooldown();
    const canvas = this.canvasEl?.nativeElement ?? null;
    if (canvas) {
      this.hideCanvasElement(canvas);
    }
    this.applyBackgroundColor(this.liveBackgroundColor);
    if (clearCache) {
      this.lastScreenshotURL = '';
      this.clearCanvasBitmap(canvas);
    }
  }

  private showCanvas(): void {
    const canvas = this.canvasEl?.nativeElement;
    if (!canvas) {
      return;
    }
    // Shift canvas by the sub-pixel offset so the screenshot content
    // aligns with the exact physical pixel position of the Win32 window.
    if (this.subpixelOffsetX !== 0 || this.subpixelOffsetY !== 0) {
      canvas.style.transform = `translate(${-this.subpixelOffsetX}px, ${-this.subpixelOffsetY}px)`;
    } else {
      canvas.style.transform = '';
    }
    // Use page background color so an empty canvas (before screenshot arrives)
    // matches the page rather than flashing white.
    const bg = this.documentBackgroundColor || this.liveBackgroundColor;
    canvas.style.background = bg;
    this.applyBackgroundColor(bg);
    canvas.style.zIndex = '2';
    canvas.style.display = 'block';
  }

  private hideCanvasElement(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement): void {
    canvas.style.display = 'none';
    canvas.style.transform = '';
    canvas.style.zIndex = '1';
    canvas.style.background = '';
  }

  private clearCanvasBitmap(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement | null): void {
    if (!canvas) {
      return;
    }
    canvas.width = 0;
    canvas.height = 0;
    canvas.style.width = '';
    canvas.style.height = '';
  }

  private revealCachedCanvasIfAvailable(): void {
    if (this.screenshotVisible) {
      return;
    }
    if (this.lastScreenshotURL !== this.url) {
      return;
    }
    if (!this.hasCachedCanvas()) {
      return;
    }
    this.showCanvas();
    if (document.body.classList.contains('divider-hover')) {
      this.hoverFreezeActive = true;
    }
    this.screenshotVisible = true;
    this.lastSyncKey = '';
    this.requestSync();
  }

  private hasCachedCanvas(): boolean {
    const canvas = this.canvasEl?.nativeElement;
    return !!canvas && canvas.width > 0 && canvas.height > 0;
  }

  private async decodeBitmap(base64Data: string): Promise<ImageBitmap | HTMLImageElement | null> {
    const dataUrl = `data:image/png;base64,${base64Data}`;
    if (typeof createImageBitmap === 'function') {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(dataUrl);
        const blob = await response.blob();
        return await createImageBitmap(blob);
      } catch {
        // Fall through to HTMLImageElement
      }
    }
    return await new Promise<HTMLImageElement | null>((resolve) => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => resolve(img);
      img.onerror = () => resolve(null);
      img.src = dataUrl;
    });
  }

  // ── Internal: color helpers ─────────────────────────────────

  private resolveTheme(): 'dark' | 'light' {
    return document.documentElement.classList.contains('vscode-light') ? 'light' : 'dark';
  }

  private resolveBackgroundColor(_theme: 'dark' | 'light'): string {
    return '#ffffff';
  }

  private parseColor(value: string): { r: number; g: number; b: number; a: number } | null {
    const normalized = (value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!normalized || normalized === 'transparent') {
      return null;
    }

    const clampByte = (input: number): number => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(input)));
    const clampAlpha = (input: number): number => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, input));

    const hex6 = normalized.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{6})$/i);
    if (hex6) {
      return {
        r: parseInt(hex6[1].slice(0, 2), 16),
        g: parseInt(hex6[1].slice(2, 4), 16),
        b: parseInt(hex6[1].slice(4, 6), 16),
        a: 1,
      };
    }

    const hex3 = normalized.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{3})$/i);
    if (hex3) {
      return {
        r: parseInt(`${hex3[1][0]}${hex3[1][0]}`, 16),
        g: parseInt(`${hex3[1][1]}${hex3[1][1]}`, 16),
        b: parseInt(`${hex3[1][2]}${hex3[1][2]}`, 16),
        a: 1,
      };
    }

    const hex8 = normalized.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{8})$/i);
    if (hex8) {
      return {
        r: parseInt(hex8[1].slice(0, 2), 16),
        g: parseInt(hex8[1].slice(2, 4), 16),
        b: parseInt(hex8[1].slice(4, 6), 16),
        a: parseInt(hex8[1].slice(6, 8), 16) / 255,
      };
    }

    const hex4 = normalized.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{4})$/i);
    if (hex4) {
      return {
        r: parseInt(`${hex4[1][0]}${hex4[1][0]}`, 16),
        g: parseInt(`${hex4[1][1]}${hex4[1][1]}`, 16),
        b: parseInt(`${hex4[1][2]}${hex4[1][2]}`, 16),
        a: parseInt(`${hex4[1][3]}${hex4[1][3]}`, 16) / 255,
      };
    }

    const rgb = normalized.match(/^rgba?\(\s*(\d{1,3})\s*,\s*(\d{1,3})\s*,\s*(\d{1,3})(?:\s*,\s*([\d.]+)\s*)?\)$/i);
    if (rgb) {
      return {
        r: clampByte(Number(rgb[1])),
        g: clampByte(Number(rgb[2])),
        b: clampByte(Number(rgb[3])),
        a: clampAlpha(rgb[4] !== undefined ? Number(rgb[4]) : 1),
      };
    }

    return null;
  }

  private toHex(color: { r: number; g: number; b: number }): string {
    const hex = (c: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(c))).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
    return `#${hex(color.r)}${hex(color.g)}${hex(color.b)}`;
  }

  private compositeColor(
    foreground: { r: number; g: number; b: number; a: number },
    background: { r: number; g: number; b: number; a: number },
  ): { r: number; g: number; b: number } {
    const alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, foreground.a));
    return {
      r: foreground.r * alpha + background.r * (1 - alpha),
      g: foreground.g * alpha + background.g * (1 - alpha),
      b: foreground.b * alpha + background.b * (1 - alpha),
    };
  }

  private normalizeColorToHex(value: string, fallback: string): string {
    const color = this.parseColor(value);
    if (!color) {
      return fallback;
    }
    if (color.a <= 0) {
      return fallback;
    }
    if (color.a >= 1) {
      return this.toHex(color);
    }
    const background = this.parseColor(fallback);
    if (!background) {
      return fallback;
    }
    return this.toHex(this.compositeColor(color, background));
  }

  private applyBackgroundColor(color: string): void {
    this.hostBackgroundColor = color;
    const host = this.hostEl?.nativeElement;
    if (host) {
      host.style.backgroundColor = color;
    }

    const backdrop = this.backdropEl?.nativeElement;
    if (backdrop) {
      backdrop.style.backgroundColor = color;
    }
  }

  private requestDocumentBackground(force: boolean, theme: 'dark' | 'light'): void {
    if (!this.active || !this.surfaceId || !this.url || this.documentBackgroundRequestInFlight) {
      return;
    }

    const now = Date.now();
    const sameURL = this.lastDocumentBackgroundURL === this.url;
    if (!force) {
      if (sameURL && this.documentBackgroundColor && (now - this.lastDocumentBackgroundRequestAt) < this.documentBackgroundRefreshMs) {
        return;
      }
      if (sameURL && (now - this.lastDocumentBackgroundRequestAt) < this.documentBackgroundRetryMs) {
        return;
      }
    }

    this.documentBackgroundRequestInFlight = true;
    const requestURL = this.url;
    const requestToken = ++this.documentBackgroundRequestToken;
    this.lastDocumentBackgroundURL = requestURL;
    this.lastDocumentBackgroundRequestAt = now;
    const fallback = this.resolveBackgroundColor(theme);

    void this.nativeBrowserPane.getDocumentBackground(this.surfaceId)
      .then((value) => {
        if (requestToken !== this.documentBackgroundRequestToken || requestURL !== this.url || !this.active) {
          return;
        }
        const normalized = this.normalizeColorToHex(value, fallback);
        if (!normalized || normalized === this.documentBackgroundColor) {
          return;
        }
        this.documentBackgroundColor = normalized;
        this.applyBackgroundColor(normalized);
        this.lastSyncKey = '';
        this.requestSync();
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (requestToken === this.documentBackgroundRequestToken && requestURL === this.url && this.active && !this.documentBackgroundColor) {
          this.applyBackgroundColor(fallback);
        }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        this.documentBackgroundRequestInFlight = false;
      });
  }

}

````typescript
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, OnDestroy, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { createSubject, takeUntil } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { NativeOverlayFreezeService } from '../services/native-overlay-freeze.service';
import { OperationHistoryEntry, OperationService, OperationState } from '../services/operation.service';

type OperationCenterFilter = 'all' | 'active' | 'history' | 'failed';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-operation-center',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  template: `
    <div *ngIf="visible" class="operation-center-backdrop" (mousedown)="hide()">
      <aside class="operation-center" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Operations" (mousedown)="$event.stopPropagation()">
        <header class="center-header">
          <div>
            <div class="eyebrow">Activity</div>
            <h2>Operations</h2>
          </div>
          <button class="icon-button" type="button" title="Close" (click)="hide()">×</button>
        </header>

        <div class="summary">
          <div><strong>{{ active.length }}</strong><span>Active</span></div>
          <div><strong>{{ failedCount }}</strong><span>Failed</span></div>
          <div><strong>{{ history.length }}</strong><span>History</span></div>
        </div>

        <nav class="filters" aria-label="Operation filters">
          <button *ngFor="let item of filterItems"
                  type="button"
                  [class.active]="filter === item.id"
                  (click)="filter = item.id">
            {{ item.label }}
          </button>
        </nav>

        <div class="operation-list">
          <div *ngIf="entries.length === 0" class="empty-state">
            <strong>No operations here</strong>
            <span>File operations and long-running tasks will appear here.</span>
          </div>

          <article *ngFor="let op of entries; trackBy: trackOperation" class="operation-row" [class.failed]="op.status === 'error'">
            <div class="operation-icon" aria-hidden="true">{{ iconFor(op) }}</div>
            <div class="operation-main">
              <div class="operation-title-line">
                <strong>{{ op.config.title }}</strong>
                <span class="status" [attr.data-status]="op.status">{{ statusLabel(op.status) }}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="operation-path" [title]="operationPath(op)">{{ operationPath(op) }}</div>

              <div *ngIf="isActive(op)" class="progress-track" aria-hidden="true">
                <span [style.width.%]="progressFor(op)"></span>
              </div>

              <div class="operation-meta">
                <span *ngIf="op.metrics.totalItems > 0">{{ op.metrics.processedItems }}/{{ op.metrics.totalItems }} items</span>
                <span *ngIf="op.metrics.processedBytes > 0 || op.metrics.totalBytes > 0">
                  {{ operationService.formatBytes(op.metrics.processedBytes) }}<ng-container *ngIf="op.metrics.totalBytes > 0"> / {{ operationService.formatBytes(op.metrics.totalBytes) }}</ng-container>
                </span>
                <span *ngIf="op.timing.speedBytesPerSecond > 0">{{ operationService.formatSpeed(op.timing.speedBytesPerSecond) }}</span>
                <span>{{ timeLabel(op) }}</span>
              </div>

              <div *ngIf="op.error" class="operation-error">{{ op.error }}</div>
            </div>

            <div class="operation-actions">
              <button *ngIf="isActive(op)" type="button" (click)="cancel(op.id)">Cancel</button>
            </div>
          </article>
        </div>

        <footer class="center-footer">
          <span>Recent operations are kept for this app session.</span>
          <button type="button" [disabled]="history.length === 0" (click)="clearHistory()">Clear History</button>
        </footer>
      </aside>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host { position: relative; z-index: calc(var(--vsc-z-modal) + 2); }
    .operation-center-backdrop {
      position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: calc(var(--vsc-z-modal) + 2);
      background: rgba(0,0,0,.28); display: flex; justify-content: flex-end;
    }

    .center-footer button:disabled { opacity:.45; cursor:default; }

export class OperationCenterComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  visible = false;
  filter: OperationCenterFilter = 'all';
  active: OperationState[] = [];
  history: OperationHistoryEntry[] = [];
  private readonly destroy$ = createSubject<void>();
  private readonly freezeKey = 'operation-center';

  readonly filterItems: Array<{ id: OperationCenterFilter; label: string }> = [
    { id: 'all', label: 'All' },
    { id: 'active', label: 'Active' },
    { id: 'history', label: 'History' },
    { id: 'failed', label: 'Failed' },
  ];

  constructor(
    public readonly operationService: OperationService,
    private readonly overlayFreeze: NativeOverlayFreezeService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.operationService.operations$.pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$)).subscribe((map: Map<string, OperationState>) => {
      this.active = Array.from(map.values()).filter(op => this.isActive(op));
    });
    this.operationService.history$.pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$)).subscribe((history: OperationHistoryEntry[]) => {
      this.history = history;
    });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
    this.overlayFreeze.release(this.freezeKey);
  }

  show(): void { this.visible = true; this.overlayFreeze.acquire(this.freezeKey); }
  hide(): void { this.visible = false; this.overlayFreeze.release(this.freezeKey); }
  toggle(): void { this.visible ? this.hide() : this.show(); }

  get entries(): Array<OperationState | OperationHistoryEntry> {
    const activeIds = new Set(this.active.map(op => op.id));
    const historical = this.history.filter(op => !activeIds.has(op.id));
    const all = [...this.active, ...historical];
    if (this.filter === 'active') return this.active;
    if (this.filter === 'history') return historical;
    if (this.filter === 'failed') return all.filter(op => op.status === 'error');
    return all;
  }

  get failedCount(): number { return this.history.filter(op => op.status === 'error').length; }

  trackOperation(_index: number, op: OperationState): string { return op.id; }
  isActive(op: OperationState): boolean { return op.status === 'running' || op.status === 'pending' || op.status === 'paused'; }
  progressFor(op: OperationState): number { return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, op.percentComplete || 0)); }
  iconFor(op: OperationState): string {
    const icons: Record<string, string> = { copy:'⧉', move:'↪', delete:'⌫', archive:'▣', extract:'⇲', search:'⌕', calculate:'∑' };
    return icons[op.config.kind] ?? '⚙';
  }
  statusLabel(status: string): string { return status === 'error' ? 'Failed' : status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + status.slice(1); }
  operationPath(op: OperationState): string {
    const source = op.sources?.filter(Boolean).join(', ') || op.metrics.currentFile || '';
    return op.destination ? `${source} → ${op.destination}` : source;
  }
  timeLabel(op: OperationState | OperationHistoryEntry): string {
    const when = 'completedAt' in op ? op.completedAt : op.timing.startedAt;
    if (!when) return '';
    const delta = Math.max(0, Date.now() - when);
    if (delta < 60_000) return 'just now';
    if (delta < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(delta / 60_000)}m ago`;
    return new Date(when).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  }
  async cancel(id: string): Promise<void> { await this.operationService.cancel(id); }
  clearHistory(): void { this.operationService.clearHistory(); }
}
````

````typescript
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, EventEmitter, Input, OnChanges, Output } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import type { PaneComparisonItem, PaneComparisonResult, PaneComparisonStatus } from '../services/pane-comparison.service';

export type PaneSyncDirection = 'skip' | 'left-to-right' | 'right-to-left';

export interface PaneSyncPlanItem {
  key: string;
  name: string;
  status: PaneComparisonStatus;
  direction: PaneSyncDirection;
  leftPath: string | null;
  rightPath: string | null;
}

export interface PaneSyncPlan {
  items: PaneSyncPlanItem[];
  leftToRight: string[];
  rightToLeft: string[];
}

type Filter = 'different' | PaneComparisonStatus;

@Component({
  selector: 'app-pane-sync-review',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <div class="review" *ngIf="visible">
      <div class="header">
        <div class="title">
          <strong>Synchronization Review</strong>
          <span>{{ approvedCount }} approved · {{ skippedCount }} skipped</span>
        </div>
        <div class="header-actions">
          <button type="button" (click)="applySafeSuggestions()">Safe defaults</button>
          <button type="button" class="primary" (click)="executePlan()" [disabled]="approvedCount === 0">Execute {{ approvedCount }}</button>
          <button type="button" class="close" (click)="close.emit()" title="Close review">×</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="filters">
        <button type="button" [class.active]="filter === 'different'" (click)="filter = 'different'">All differences</button>
        <button type="button" *ngFor="let option of filterOptions" [class.active]="filter === option.status" (click)="filter = option.status">
          {{ option.label }} <span>{{ option.count }}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div class="columns">
        <span>Name</span>
        <span>Status</span>
        <span>Decision</span>
      </div>

      <div class="rows">
        <div class="row" *ngFor="let item of visibleItems; trackBy: trackByKey">
          <div class="name" [title]="item.name">{{ item.name }}</div>
          <div class="status" [attr.data-status]="item.status">{{ statusLabel(item.status) }}</div>
          <div class="decision">
            <button type="button" [class.active]="item.direction === 'left-to-right'" [disabled]="!item.leftPath" (click)="setDirection(item, 'left-to-right')">Left → Right</button>
            <button type="button" [class.active]="item.direction === 'right-to-left'" [disabled]="!item.rightPath" (click)="setDirection(item, 'right-to-left')">Right → Left</button>
            <button type="button" [class.active]="item.direction === 'skip'" (click)="setDirection(item, 'skip')">Skip</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="empty" *ngIf="visibleItems.length === 0">No items in this filter.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host { display: block; flex: 0 0 auto; }
    .review {
      max-height: 320px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vsc-border, rgba(127,127,127,.25));
      background: var(--vsc-background, #1e1e1e);
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    .header, .filters, .columns, .row { display: grid; align-items: center; }
    .header { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vsc-border, rgba(127,127,127,.2)); }
    .title { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
    .title span { opacity: .65; }
    .header-actions, .filters, .decision { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; }
    button {
      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border, rgba(127,127,127,.35));
      background: var(--vsc-button-background, transparent);
      color: inherit;
      border-radius: 3px;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      font: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    button:hover:not(:disabled), button.active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue, #0078d4) 20%, transparent); }
    button.primary { background: var(--vsc-accent-blue, #0078d4); color: white; border-color: transparent; }
    button:disabled { opacity: .38; cursor: default; }
    .close { width: 25px; padding-inline: 0; font-size: 16px; }
    .filters { padding: 5px 10px; overflow-x: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vsc-border, rgba(127,127,127,.16)); }
    .filters button { white-space: nowrap; }
    .filters span { opacity: .65; margin-left: 3px; }
    .columns, .row { grid-template-columns: minmax(180px, 1fr) 150px minmax(270px, auto); gap: 10px; padding: 5px 10px; }
    .columns { opacity: .55; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .04em; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vsc-border, rgba(127,127,127,.16)); }
    .rows { overflow: auto; min-height: 0; }
    .row { min-height: 34px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-border, rgba(127,127,127,.25)) 55%, transparent); }
    .name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .status { opacity: .85; }
    .status[data-status="only-left"], .status[data-status="only-right"] { font-weight: 600; }
    .decision { justify-content: flex-end; }
    .empty { padding: 18px 10px; text-align: center; opacity: .6; }
  `],
})
export class PaneSyncReviewComponent implements OnChanges {
  @Input() visible = false;
  @Input({ required: true }) result!: PaneComparisonResult;
  @Output() execute = new EventEmitter<PaneSyncPlan>();
  @Output() close = new EventEmitter<void>();

  filter: Filter = 'different';
  items: PaneSyncPlanItem[] = [];

  readonly statuses: PaneComparisonStatus[] = [
    'only-left', 'only-right', 'left-newer', 'right-newer', 'size-different', 'type-different',
  ];

  ngOnChanges(): void {
    this.rebuildPlan();
  }

  get visibleItems(): PaneSyncPlanItem[] {
    return this.filter === 'different' ? this.items : this.items.filter(item => item.status === this.filter);
  }

  get approvedCount(): number {
    return this.items.filter(item => item.direction !== 'skip').length;
  }

  get skippedCount(): number {
    return this.items.length - this.approvedCount;
  }

  get filterOptions(): Array<{ status: PaneComparisonStatus; label: string; count: number }> {
    return this.statuses
      .map(status => ({ status, label: this.statusLabel(status), count: this.items.filter(item => item.status === status).length }))
      .filter(item => item.count > 0);
  }

  setDirection(item: PaneSyncPlanItem, direction: PaneSyncDirection): void {
    if (direction === 'left-to-right' && !item.leftPath) return;
    if (direction === 'right-to-left' && !item.rightPath) return;
    item.direction = direction;
  }

  applySafeSuggestions(): void {
    for (const item of this.items) item.direction = this.defaultDirection(item.status);
  }

  executePlan(): void {
    const approved = this.items.filter(item => item.direction !== 'skip');
    this.execute.emit({
      items: approved.map(item => ({ ...item })),
      leftToRight: approved.filter(item => item.direction === 'left-to-right' && item.leftPath).map(item => item.leftPath!),
      rightToLeft: approved.filter(item => item.direction === 'right-to-left' && item.rightPath).map(item => item.rightPath!),
    });
  }

  trackByKey(_index: number, item: PaneSyncPlanItem): string { return item.key; }

  statusLabel(status: PaneComparisonStatus): string {
    return ({
      'only-left': 'Left only',
      'only-right': 'Right only',
      'left-newer': 'Left newer',
      'right-newer': 'Right newer',
      'size-different': 'Different size',
      'type-different': 'Different type',
      'same': 'Same',
    } as Record<PaneComparisonStatus, string>)[status];
  }

  private rebuildPlan(): void {
    const previous = new Map(this.items.map(item => [item.key, item.direction] as const));
    this.items = (this.result?.items ?? [])
      .filter(item => item.status !== 'same')
      .map(item => this.toPlanItem(item, previous.get(item.key)));
  }

  private toPlanItem(item: PaneComparisonItem, previous?: PaneSyncDirection): PaneSyncPlanItem {
    return {
      key: item.key,
      name: item.name,
      status: item.status,
      direction: previous ?? this.defaultDirection(item.status),
      leftPath: item.left?.path ?? null,
      rightPath: item.right?.path ?? null,
    };
  }

  private defaultDirection(status: PaneComparisonStatus): PaneSyncDirection {
    if (status === 'only-left') return 'left-to-right';
    if (status === 'only-right') return 'right-to-left';
    return 'skip';
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { CommandState } from '../services/input-system.types';
import type { PresentedCommand } from './presented-command';

export interface PluginCommandPresentationHost {
  getCommandState(commandId: string): CommandState | undefined;
  dispatchCommandById(commandId: string): boolean;
}

export interface PluginCommandPresentationContribution<TContext> {
  id: string;
  label?: string;
  icon?: string;
  shortcut?: string;
  commandId?: string;
  execute?: (context: TContext) => void | Promise<void>;
}

export function presentPluginCommand<TContext>(
  contribution: PluginCommandPresentationContribution<TContext>,
  context: TContext,
  host: PluginCommandPresentationHost,
  options: { separatorBefore?: boolean } = {},
): PresentedCommand {
  const commandId = contribution.commandId?.trim() || undefined;
  const state = commandId ? host.getCommandState(commandId) : undefined;
  const enabled = commandId ? !!state?.registered && state.enabled : !!contribution.execute;

  return {
    id: `plugin:${contribution.id}`,
    label: contribution.label?.trim() || state?.title || contribution.id,
    icon: 'plugin',
    iconText: contribution.icon,
    shortcut: contribution.shortcut,
    enabled,
    source: 'plugin',
    commandId,
    separatorBefore: options.separatorBefore,
    execute: async () => {
      if (!enabled) return;
      if (commandId) {
        host.dispatchCommandById(commandId);
        return;
      }
      await contribution.execute?.(context);
    },
  };
}
````

````typescript
          <span *ngIf="isBusy(snapshot)" class="plugin-working">Working…</span>
        </footer>
      </article>
    </section>
````
