````typescript
export class PluginSettingsPanelComponent implements OnInit {
  snapshots: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot[] = [];
  pluginDirectory = '';
  error = '';
  refreshing = false;
  openingDirectory = false;
  private readonly busyIds = new Set<string>();

  constructor(
    private readonly coordinator: PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService,
    private readonly discovery: PluginDiscoveryService,
    private readonly api: ApiService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    void this.refresh();
    void this.loadPluginDirectory();
  }

  trackPlugin(_index: number, snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): string {
    return snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id || snapshot.plugin.discovered.path;
  }

  isBusy(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): boolean {
    return this.busyIds.has(snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id);
  }

  isTrustedForCurrentVersion(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): boolean {
    return snapshot.plugin.state.trusted &&
      snapshot.plugin.state.trustedVersion === snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.version;
  }

  permissionGranted(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot, permission: PluginPermission): boolean {
    return snapshot.plugin.effectiveGrantedPermissions.includes(permission);
  }

  async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.refreshing) return;
    this.refreshing = true;
    this.error = '';
    try {
      this.snapshots = await this.coordinator.sync();
    } catch (error) {
      this.error = errorMessage(error);
    } finally {
      this.refreshing = false;
    }
  }

  async openPluginDirectory(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.openingDirectory) return;
    this.openingDirectory = true;
    this.error = '';
    try {
      const directory = this.pluginDirectory || await this.discovery.getDirectory();
      this.pluginDirectory = directory;
      await this.api.openFile(directory);
    } catch (error) {
      this.error = errorMessage(error);
    } finally {
      this.openingDirectory = false;
    }
  }

  async toggleEnabled(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot, enabled: boolean): Promise<void> {
    await this.runFor(snapshot, () => this.coordinator.setEnabled(snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id, enabled));
  }

  async toggleTrusted(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): Promise<void> {
    const trusted = !this.isTrustedForCurrentVersion(snapshot);
    await this.runFor(snapshot, () => this.coordinator.setTrusted(snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id, trusted));
  }

  async togglePermission(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot, permission: PluginPermission, granted: boolean): Promise<void> {
    const current = new Set(snapshot.plugin.state.grantedPermissions);
    if (granted) current.add(permission); else current.delete(permission);
    await this.runFor(snapshot, () => this.coordinator.setGrantedPermissions(snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id, [...current]));
  }

  async clearQuarantine(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): Promise<void> {
    await this.runFor(snapshot, () => this.coordinator.clearQuarantine(snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id));
  }

  async activate(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): Promise<void> {
    await this.runFor(snapshot, () => this.coordinator.activate(snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id));
  }

  async deactivate(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): Promise<void> {
    await this.runFor(snapshot, () => this.coordinator.deactivate(snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id));
  }

  formatStatus(status: string): string {
    return status.replace(/-/g, ' ');
  }

  formatActivation(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot): string {
    const state = snapshot.plugin.state;
    if (state.lastActivationStatus === 'never') return 'Never';
    const suffix = state.lastActivatedAt ? ` · ${new Date(state.lastActivatedAt).toLocaleString()}` : '';
    return `${state.lastActivationStatus}${suffix}`;
  }

  private async loadPluginDirectory(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.pluginDirectory = await this.discovery.getDirectory();
    } catch {
      // Discovery refresh will surface actionable binding errors.
    }
  }

  private async runFor(snapshot: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot, action: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<void> {
    const id = snapshot.plugin.discovered.manifest.id;
    if (!id || this.busyIds.has(id)) return;
    this.busyIds.add(id);
    this.error = '';
    try {
      await action();
      this.snapshots = await this.coordinator.sync();
    } catch (error) {
      this.error = errorMessage(error);
      try { this.snapshots = await this.coordinator.sync(); } catch { /* keep original error */ }
    } finally {
      this.busyIds.delete(id);
    }
  }
}

function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}
````

````typescript
export class SelectionBasketComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  visible = false;
  entries: SelectionBasketEntry[] = [];
  private readonly destroy$ = createSubject<void>();
  private readonly freezeKey = 'selection-basket';

  @Output() copyTo = new EventEmitter<'left' | 'right'>();
  @Output() moveTo = new EventEmitter<'left' | 'right'>();
  @Output() deleteRequested = new EventEmitter<void>();

  constructor(
    public readonly basket: SelectionBasketService,
    private readonly overlayFreeze: NativeOverlayFreezeService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.basket.entries$.pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$)).subscribe(entries => this.entries = entries);
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
    this.overlayFreeze.release(this.freezeKey);
  }

  show(): void { this.visible = true; this.overlayFreeze.acquire(this.freezeKey); }
  hide(): void { this.visible = false; this.overlayFreeze.release(this.freezeKey); }
  toggle(): void { this.visible ? this.hide() : this.show(); }
  remove(id: string): void { this.basket.remove(id); }
  clear(): void { this.basket.clear(); }
  trackEntry(_index: number, entry: SelectionBasketEntry): string { return entry.id; }

  get sourceCount(): number {
    return new Set(this.entries.map(entry => entry.source).filter(Boolean)).size;
  }

  get knownSizeLabel(): string {
    const total = this.entries.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.size ?? 0), 0);
    return total > 0 ? this.formatBytes(total) : '—';
  }

  iconFor(entry: SelectionBasketEntry): string {
    if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) return '▰';
    if (entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE) return '▣';
    if (entry.type === FileType.SYMLINK) return '↗';
    return '·';
  }

  formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
    if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return '0 B';
    const units = ['B','KB','MB','GB','TB'];
    const index = Math.min(units.length - 1, Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)));
    const value = bytes / Math.pow(1024, index);
    return `${value >= 10 || index === 0 ? value.toFixed(0) : value.toFixed(1)} ${units[index]}`;
  }

  ageLabel(addedAt: number): string {
    const delta = Math.max(0, Date.now() - addedAt);
    if (delta < 60_000) return 'just added';
    if (delta < 3_600_000) return `${Math.floor(delta / 60_000)}m ago`;
    return new Date(addedAt).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  }
}
````

````typescript
export class SplitDividerComponent implements OnDestroy {
    private readonly hoverEnterDelayMs = 0;
    private readonly hoverLeaveDelayMs = 120;
    private readonly hoverOutsetPx = 12;
    private hoverEnterTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    private hoverLeaveTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
    private lastPointerX = 0;
    private lastPointerY = 0;
    private activePointerId: number | null = null;
    /* ---------------- INPUTS ---------------- */

    @Input() position = 50;
    @Output() positionChange = new EventEmitter<number>();

    @Input() orientation: 'vertical' | 'horizontal' = 'vertical';
    @Input() resetPosition = 50;

    @Input() min = 20;
    @Input() max = 80;

    @Input() snapPoints: number[] = [20, 25, 33.333, 50, 66.666, 75, 80];

    /* ---------------- STATE ---------------- */

    dragging = false;
    hovering = false;
    snapPreview = 50;
    private startPointerPosition = 0;
    private startPos = 50;

    /** Base snap threshold in %. Actual threshold per point is scaled by proximity to center. */
    readonly SNAP_THRESHOLD_MIN = 2;  // threshold at the edges (20%, 80%)
    readonly SNAP_THRESHOLD_MAX = 8;  // threshold at dead center (50%)

    constructor(private el: ElementRef<HTMLElement>) { }

    ngOnDestroy(): void {
        this.clearHoverTimers();
        this.hovering = false;
        this.setBodyInteractionClass('divider-hover', false);
        this.setBodyInteractionClass('divider-dragging', false);
    }

    /* ---------------- DRAG ---------------- */

    @HostListener('pointerdown', ['$event'])
    startDrag(e: PointerEvent) {
        e.preventDefault();

        this.clearHoverTimers();
        this.dragging = true;
        this.hovering = true;
        this.startPointerPosition = this.isHorizontal ? e.clientY : e.clientX;
        this.startPos = this.position;
        this.activePointerId = e.pointerId;

        try {
            this.el.nativeElement.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
        } catch {
            this.activePointerId = null;
        }

        this.setBodyInteractionClass('divider-hover', true);
        this.setBodyInteractionClass('divider-dragging', true);
    }

    @HostListener('pointerenter', ['$event'])
    onPointerEnter(event: PointerEvent) {
        this.lastPointerX = event.clientX;
        this.lastPointerY = event.clientY;
        if (this.hoverLeaveTimer !== null) {
            clearTimeout(this.hoverLeaveTimer);
            this.hoverLeaveTimer = null;
        }
        if (this.dragging || document.body.classList.contains('divider-hover')) {
            this.activateHover();
            return;
        }
        if (this.hoverEnterTimer !== null) {
            return;
        }
        this.hoverEnterTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            this.hoverEnterTimer = null;
            this.activateHover();
        }, this.hoverEnterDelayMs);
    }

    @HostListener('pointerleave', ['$event'])
    onPointerLeave(event?: PointerEvent) {
        if (event) {
            this.lastPointerX = event.clientX;
            this.lastPointerY = event.clientY;
        }
        if (this.hoverEnterTimer !== null) {
            clearTimeout(this.hoverEnterTimer);
            this.hoverEnterTimer = null;
        }
        if (this.dragging) {
            return;
        }
        if (this.isPointerWithinHoverZone(this.lastPointerX, this.lastPointerY)) {
            return;
        }
        if (this.hoverLeaveTimer !== null) {
            return;
        }
        this.hoverLeaveTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            this.hoverLeaveTimer = null;
            if (!this.el.nativeElement.matches(':hover') && !this.isPointerWithinHoverZone(this.lastPointerX, this.lastPointerY)) {
                this.deactivateHover();
            }
        }, this.hoverLeaveDelayMs);
    }

    @HostListener('document:pointermove', ['$event'])
    onMove(e: PointerEvent) {
        this.lastPointerX = e.clientX;
        this.lastPointerY = e.clientY;

        if (!this.dragging) {
            if (this.isPointerWithinHoverZone(e.clientX, e.clientY)) {
                if (this.hoverLeaveTimer !== null) {
                    clearTimeout(this.hoverLeaveTimer);
                    this.hoverLeaveTimer = null;
                }
                if (this.hovering) {
                    this.setBodyInteractionClass('divider-hover', true);
                }
            } else if (this.hovering && !this.el.nativeElement.matches(':hover')) {
                this.onPointerLeave(e);
            }
            return;
        }

        const container = this.el.nativeElement.parentElement!;
        const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
        const axisSize = this.isHorizontal ? rect.height : rect.width;
        if (axisSize <= 0) {
            return;
        }

        const pointerPosition = this.isHorizontal ? e.clientY : e.clientX;
        const delta = pointerPosition - this.startPointerPosition;
        const percent = Math.max(
            this.min,
            Math.min(this.max, this.startPos + (delta / axisSize) * 100),
        );

        // Raw 1:1 tracking during drag — no magnet, no pull.
        // Snapping only happens on release so the divider follows the cursor exactly.
        this.position = percent;
        this.snapPreview = this.snapToNearest(percent);
        this.positionChange.emit(percent);
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('file-manager-divider-move'));
    }

    @HostListener('document:pointerup')
    stopDrag() {
        if (!this.dragging) return;

        this.dragging = false;
        if (this.activePointerId !== null) {
            try {
                this.el.nativeElement.releasePointerCapture(this.activePointerId);
            } catch {
                // Ignore stale pointer capture state.
            }
            this.activePointerId = null;
        }
        this.setBodyInteractionClass('divider-dragging', false);
        if (this.el.nativeElement.matches(':hover')) {
            this.activateHover();
        } else {
            this.onPointerLeave();
        }

        const final = this.snapToNearest(this.position);
        this.position = final;
        this.positionChange.emit(final);
    }

    private clearHoverTimers(): void {
        if (this.hoverEnterTimer !== null) {
            clearTimeout(this.hoverEnterTimer);
            this.hoverEnterTimer = null;
        }
        if (this.hoverLeaveTimer !== null) {
            clearTimeout(this.hoverLeaveTimer);
            this.hoverLeaveTimer = null;
        }
    }

    private activateHover(): void {
        this.hovering = true;
        this.setBodyInteractionClass('divider-hover', true);
    }

    private deactivateHover(): void {
        this.hovering = false;
        this.setBodyInteractionClass('divider-hover', false);
    }

    private isPointerWithinHoverZone(clientX: number, clientY: number): boolean {
        const rect = this.el.nativeElement.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (this.isHorizontal) {
            return clientX >= rect.left
                && clientX <= rect.right
                && clientY >= rect.top - this.hoverOutsetPx
                && clientY <= rect.bottom + this.hoverOutsetPx;
        }

        return clientX >= rect.left - this.hoverOutsetPx
            && clientX <= rect.right + this.hoverOutsetPx
            && clientY >= rect.top
            && clientY <= rect.bottom;
    }

    private setBodyInteractionClass(className: string, active: boolean): void {
        const classList = document.body.classList;
        const scopedClassName = `${className}-${this.orientation}`;
        const changed = (active ? !classList.contains(className) : classList.contains(className))
            || (active ? !classList.contains(scopedClassName) : classList.contains(scopedClassName));
        classList.toggle(className, active);
        classList.toggle(scopedClassName, active);
        if (changed) {
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('file-manager-divider-statechange'));
        }
    }

    /* ---------------- DOUBLE CLICK RESET ---------------- */

    @HostListener('dblclick')
    reset() {
        const resetPosition = this.clampPosition(this.resetPosition);
        this.position = resetPosition;
        this.positionChange.emit(resetPosition);
    }

    /* ---------------- SNAP ENGINE ---------------- */

    /**
     * Returns the nearest snap point if the release falls within that point's
     * threshold, otherwise returns the value unchanged.
     *
     * Each snap point gets its own threshold that scales linearly with how
     * close the point is to the center (50%): center snaps are wider/more
     * magnetic, edge snaps are narrower/more precise.
     */
    private snapToNearest(value: number): number {
        let bestCandidate = value;
        let bestMargin = 0; // how far inside the threshold we are (higher = better)

        for (const p of this.snapPoints) {
            const threshold = this.thresholdForPoint(p);
            const dist = Math.abs(p - value);
            const margin = threshold - dist; // positive means we're inside the zone

            if (margin > 0 && margin > bestMargin) {
                bestMargin = margin;
                bestCandidate = p;
            }
        }

        return bestCandidate;
    }

    /**
     * Threshold for a given snap point, interpolated between MIN (at the
     * allowed edges) and MAX (at 50% center). Uses a smooth curve so the
     * transition doesn't feel abrupt.
     */
    private thresholdForPoint(point: number): number {
        const center = 50;
        const edgeDist = Math.max(Math.abs(this.min - center), Math.abs(this.max - center));
        const distFromCenter = Math.abs(point - center);
        // t = 0 at center, 1 at edge
        const t = Math.min(distFromCenter / edgeDist, 1);
        // ease-out curve so center zone feels noticeably wider
        const eased = t * t;
        return this.SNAP_THRESHOLD_MAX - eased * (this.SNAP_THRESHOLD_MAX - this.SNAP_THRESHOLD_MIN);
    }

    private clampPosition(value: number): number {
        return Math.max(this.min, Math.min(this.max, value));
    }

    /* ---------------- CLASS ---------------- */

    @HostBinding('class.dragging')
    get isDragging() {
        return this.dragging;
    }

    @HostBinding('class.hovering')
    get isHovering() {
        return this.hovering;
    }

    @HostBinding('class.horizontal')
    get isHorizontal(): boolean {
        return this.orientation === 'horizontal';
    }

    @HostBinding('class.vertical')
    get isVertical(): boolean {
        return !this.isHorizontal;
    }
}
````

````typescript
import {
  Directive,
  ElementRef,
  HostListener,
  Inject,
  Input,
  NgZone,
  OnChanges,
  OnDestroy,
  OnInit,
  Optional,
  Renderer2,
  SimpleChanges,
} from '@angular/core';
import { NgForm } from '@angular/forms';
import { InputHistoryService } from '../services/input-history.service';

let datalistCounter = 0;

/**
 * Wires a text input to the InputHistoryService so that previously entered
 * values are offered as a native `<datalist>` autocomplete and the most
 * recent value is committed to history when the field is committed
 * (blur / Enter / form submit).
 *
 * Usage:
 *   <input type="text" [appInputHistory]="'remote.host'" [(ngModel)]="host" />
 *
 * If no key is provided, the input's `name` or `id` attribute is used.
 */
@Directive({
  selector: 'input[appInputHistory], textarea[appInputHistory]',
  standalone: true,
  exportAs: 'inputHistory',
})
export class InputHistoryDirective implements OnInit, OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input('appInputHistory') key: string | null | undefined = null;

  /** When false the directive becomes a no-op without un-mounting it. */
  @Input() appInputHistoryEnabled = true;

  /** Minimum trimmed length required before a value is recorded. */
  @Input() appInputHistoryMinLength = 1;

  private readonly host: HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement;
  private datalistEl: HTMLDataListElement | null = null;
  private datalistId = '';
  private formSubmitUnsubscribe: { unsubscribe(): void } | null = null;

  constructor(
    elementRef: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement>,
    private readonly renderer: Renderer2,
    private readonly history: InputHistoryService,
    private readonly ngZone: NgZone,
    @Optional() @Inject(NgForm) private readonly parentForm: NgForm | null,
  ) {
    this.host = elementRef.nativeElement;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    if (!this.host.hasAttribute('autocomplete')) {
      this.renderer.setAttribute(this.host, 'autocomplete', 'off');
    }
    this.ensureDatalist();
    this.refreshOptions();

    if (this.parentForm) {
      this.formSubmitUnsubscribe = this.parentForm.ngSubmit.subscribe(() => this.commit());
    }
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['key'] || changes['appInputHistoryEnabled']) {
      this.refreshOptions();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.formSubmitUnsubscribe?.unsubscribe();
    this.formSubmitUnsubscribe = null;
    if (this.datalistEl?.parentNode) {
      this.datalistEl.parentNode.removeChild(this.datalistEl);
    }
    this.datalistEl = null;
  }

  /** Re-reads the stored values and rebuilds the datalist options. */
  refresh(): void {
    this.refreshOptions();
  }

  /** Manually push the current value to history (e.g. before programmatic submit). */
  commit(): void {
    const resolved = this.resolveKey();
    if (!resolved || !this.appInputHistoryEnabled) return;
    const value = (this.host.value ?? '').trim();
    if (value.length < this.appInputHistoryMinLength) return;
    this.history.push(resolved, value);
    this.refreshOptions();
  }

  @HostListener('change')
  onChange(): void {
    this.commit();
  }

  @HostListener('blur')
  onBlur(): void {
    this.commit();
  }

  @HostListener('keydown.enter')
  onEnter(): void {
    this.commit();
  }

  @HostListener('focus')
  onFocus(): void {
    this.refreshOptions();
  }

  private resolveKey(): string {
    if (this.key && this.key.trim()) return this.key.trim();
    return this.host.getAttribute('name') || this.host.id || '';
  }

  private ensureDatalist(): void {
    if (this.datalistEl) return;
    this.datalistId = `app-input-history-${++datalistCounter}`;
    const datalist = this.renderer.createElement('datalist') as HTMLDataListElement;
    datalist.id = this.datalistId;
    if (this.host.parentNode) {
      this.renderer.insertBefore(this.host.parentNode, datalist, this.host.nextSibling);
    } else {
      this.renderer.appendChild(document.body, datalist);
    }
    this.renderer.setAttribute(this.host, 'list', this.datalistId);
    this.datalistEl = datalist;
  }

  private refreshOptions(): void {
    if (!this.datalistEl) return;
    const resolved = this.resolveKey();
    const items = this.appInputHistoryEnabled && resolved ? this.history.get(resolved) : [];

    while (this.datalistEl.firstChild) {
      this.renderer.removeChild(this.datalistEl, this.datalistEl.firstChild);
    }
    this.ngZone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      for (const item of items) {
        const option = this.renderer.createElement('option') as HTMLOptionElement;
        option.value = item;
        this.renderer.appendChild(this.datalistEl!, option);
      }
    });
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Type } from '@angular/core';

/**
 * Generic contribution registry used by ViewerRegistryService,
 * SurfaceRegistryService, and future plugin-provided registries.
 *
 * T is the specific contribution type (e.g., ViewerContribution).
 */
export interface Contribution<TReq> {
  id: string;
  score(req: TReq): number;
  load(): Promise<Type<unknown>> | Type<unknown>;
}

export class ContributionRegistry<TContrib extends Contribution<TReq>, TReq> {
  private readonly contributions: TContrib[] = [];
  private readonly loaded = new Map<string, Type<unknown>>();

  register(c: TContrib): void {
    const i = this.contributions.findIndex(x => x.id === c.id);
    if (i >= 0) {
      this.contributions.splice(i, 1, c);
    } else {
      this.contributions.push(c);
    }
  }

  unregister(id: string): void {
    const i = this.contributions.findIndex(x => x.id === id);
    if (i >= 0) {
      this.contributions.splice(i, 1);
    }
    this.loaded.delete(id);
  }

  async resolve(req: TReq, forcedId?: string | null): Promise<{ id: string; component: Type<unknown> }> {
    const best = this.pick(req, forcedId);
    const component = await this.load(best);
    return { id: best.id, component };
  }

  pick(req: TReq, forcedId?: string | null): TContrib {
    const forced = (forcedId ?? '').trim();
    if (forced) {
      const c = this.contributions.find(x => x.id === forced);
      if (c) return c;
    }

    let best: TContrib | null = null;
    let bestScore = 0;
    for (const c of this.contributions) {
      const s = c.score(req);
      if (s > bestScore) {
        bestScore = s;
        best = c;
      }
    }
    if (!best) {
      // Should be unreachable when a fallback is registered.
      best = this.contributions[0];
    }
    return best!;
  }

  list(): readonly TContrib[] {
    return this.contributions;
  }

  private load(c: TContrib): Promise<Type<unknown>> {
    const cached = this.loaded.get(c.id);
    if (cached) {
      return Promise.resolve(cached);
    }
    const loaded = Promise.resolve(c.load()) as Promise<Type<unknown>>;
    return loaded.then(component => {
      this.loaded.set(c.id, component);
      return component;
    });
  }
}
````

## File: frontend/src/app/services/action-availability.ts
````typescript
import type { SourceCapabilities } from './source-capabilities';

export interface ActionAvailability {
  readonly createFolder: boolean;
  readonly deleteSelected: boolean;
  readonly copySelected: boolean;
  readonly cutSelected: boolean;
  readonly paste: boolean;
  readonly rename: boolean;
  readonly copyToOther: boolean;
  readonly moveToOther: boolean;
}

export function buildActionAvailability(input: {
  source: SourceCapabilities;
  destination?: SourceCapabilities | null;
  selectedCount: number;
  hasClipboard: boolean;
  clipboardOperation?: 'copy' | 'cut' | null;
}): ActionAvailability {
  const hasSelection = input.selectedCount > 0;
  const destinationWritable = !!input.destination?.create;
  return Object.freeze({
    createFolder: input.source.create,
    deleteSelected: hasSelection && input.source.delete,
    copySelected: hasSelection && input.source.read,
    cutSelected: hasSelection && input.source.read && input.source.delete,
    paste: input.hasClipboard && input.source.create,
    rename: hasSelection && input.source.rename,
    copyToOther: hasSelection && input.source.read && destinationWritable,
    moveToOther: hasSelection && input.source.read && input.source.delete && destinationWritable,
  });
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';

export interface BatchRenameItem {
  entry: FileInfo;
  newName: string;
}

export interface BatchRenameOptions {
  pattern: string;
  startAt: number;
  increment: number;
}

export interface BatchRenameRequest {
  items: BatchRenameItem[];
  currentPath: string;
  resolve: (value: BatchRenameItem[] | null) => void;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class BatchRenameDialogService {
  public readonly activeRequest$ = createBehaviorSubject<BatchRenameRequest | null>(null);

  private queue: BatchRenameRequest[] = [];

  openDialog(items: BatchRenameItem[], currentPath: string): Promise<BatchRenameItem[] | null> {
    return new Promise<BatchRenameItem[] | null>((resolve) => {
      this.queue.push({ items, currentPath, resolve });
      this.tryOpenNext();
    });
  }

  resolveActive(result: BatchRenameItem[] | null): void {
    const active = this.activeRequest$.value;
    if (!active) return;
    active.resolve(result);
    this.activeRequest$.next(null);
    this.tryOpenNext();
  }

  private tryOpenNext(): void {
    if (this.activeRequest$.value || this.queue.length === 0) return;
    this.activeRequest$.next(this.queue.shift()!);
  }
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Canvas video player backward seek tests
 * 
 * Tests to ensure:
 * 1. Buffered frame detection works properly for backward seeks
 * 2. Frame tolerance is correctly applied
 * 3. No discrepancies in decoded frames vs buffered frames
 */

interface MockDecodedFrame {
  timestampMs: number;
  frameId: string;
}

/**
 * Test: buffered frame detection tolerance for backward seeks
 */
describe('Buffered frame detection for backward seeks', () => {
  const decodedFrames: MockDecodedFrame[] = [
    { timestampMs: 1000, frameId: 'f1' },
    { timestampMs: 1033, frameId: 'f2' },
    { timestampMs: 1066, frameId: 'f3' },
    { timestampMs: 1099, frameId: 'f4' },
  ];

  function getFrameIntervalEstimateMs(): number {
    if (decodedFrames.length > 1) {
      const delta = decodedFrames[1].timestampMs - decodedFrames[0].timestampMs;
      if (delta > 0) {
        return Math.min(250, Math.max(16, delta));
      }
    }
    return 33.33;
  }

  function getPresentationToleranceMs(): number {
    return Math.min(12, getFrameIntervalEstimateMs() * 0.25);
  }

  function findBufferedFrameForTime(targetTimeMs: number, isSeekingBackward: boolean): MockDecodedFrame | undefined {
    if (decodedFrames.length === 0) {
      return undefined;
    }

    const presentationToleranceMs = getPresentationToleranceMs();
    const firstFrame = decodedFrames[0];
    const lastFrame = decodedFrames[decodedFrames.length - 1];
    const frameIntervalMs = getFrameIntervalEstimateMs();

    // Both backward and forward seeks use standard tolerance
    const effectiveTolerance = presentationToleranceMs;

    if (targetTimeMs < firstFrame.timestampMs - effectiveTolerance) {
      return undefined;
    }

    if (targetTimeMs > lastFrame.timestampMs + (frameIntervalMs * 0.25)) {
      return undefined;
    }

    // Find frame with timestamp closest to but not exceeding target
    let selectedFrame = firstFrame;
    for (const frame of decodedFrames) {
      if (frame.timestampMs <= targetTimeMs + effectiveTolerance) {
        selectedFrame = frame;
      } else {
        break;
      }
    }

    return selectedFrame;
  }

  it('should find buffered frame for backward seek within decoded range', () => {
    const frame = findBufferedFrameForTime(1050, true);
    expect(frame).toBeDefined();
    expect(frame?.frameId).toBe('f2');
  });

  it('should not find frame before decoded range', () => {
    const frame = findBufferedFrameForTime(500, true);
    expect(frame).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('should find buffered frames for backward and forward seeks', () => {
    // Both backward and forward seeks use the same tolerance logic
    const presentationToleranceMs = getPresentationToleranceMs();
    
    // Tolerance should be applied consistently
    expect(presentationToleranceMs).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    
    // Both should find valid frames at same target time
    const backwardFrame = findBufferedFrameForTime(1050, true);
    const forwardFrame = findBufferedFrameForTime(1050, false);
    
    expect(backwardFrame).toBeDefined();
    expect(forwardFrame).toBeDefined();
    // Since we removed the tolerance multiplier, both should find the same frame
    expect(backwardFrame?.frameId).toBe(forwardFrame?.frameId);
  });

  it('should return last decoded frame when target is near last', () => {
    const frameIntervalMs = getFrameIntervalEstimateMs();
    const lastFrame = decodedFrames[decodedFrames.length - 1];
    // Target within tolerance of last frame
    const targetTime = lastFrame.timestampMs + 5;

    const frame = findBufferedFrameForTime(targetTime, true);
    expect(frame?.frameId).toBe('f4');
  });
});

describe('Audio-clock playback sync', () => {
  type ScheduledAudioEntry = {
    startTime: number;
    endTime: number;
    mediaStartSec: number;
  };

  function getScheduledAudioPlaybackTimeMs(
    scheduledAudioNodes: ScheduledAudioEntry[],
    nowSec: number,
    playbackBaseMs: number,
  ): number | null {
    if (scheduledAudioNodes.length === 0) {
      return null;
    }

    const firstScheduledNode = scheduledAudioNodes[0];
    if (nowSec < firstScheduledNode.startTime) {
      return playbackBaseMs;
    }

    let anchor = firstScheduledNode;
    for (const entry of scheduledAudioNodes) {
      if (entry.startTime > nowSec) {
        break;
      }
      anchor = entry;
    }

    const elapsedSec = Math.max(0, Math.min(nowSec, anchor.endTime) - anchor.startTime);
    return (anchor.mediaStartSec + elapsedSec) * 1000;
  }

  it('keeps video at the playback base before the first scheduled audio chunk starts', () => {
    const scheduled = [
      { startTime: 10.05, endTime: 10.15, mediaStartSec: 5.0 },
    ];

    expect(getScheduledAudioPlaybackTimeMs(scheduled, 10.02, 5000)).toBe(5000);
  });

  it('follows actual scheduled audio timing when chunks start later than the ideal clock', () => {
    const scheduled = [
      { startTime: 10.05, endTime: 10.15, mediaStartSec: 5.0 },
      { startTime: 10.15, endTime: 10.25, mediaStartSec: 5.1 },
    ];

    expect(getScheduledAudioPlaybackTimeMs(scheduled, 10.20, 5000)).toBeCloseTo(5150, 6);
  });
});

  const demuxerBackedExtensions = new Set([
    'mp4', 'm4v', 'mov', 'mkv', 'webm', 'ogv', 'mxf',
    'avi', 'divx', 'xvid',
    'flv', 'ts', 'mts', 'm2ts',
    'mpg', 'mpeg', 'vob', 'm2p', 'm2v',
    'mjpeg', 'mjpg',

  });

    const allowedInBoth = new Set(['mov', 'qt']);
    const overlap = Array.from(demuxerBackedExtensions).filter(
      ext => ffmpegTranscodeExtensions.has(ext) && !allowedInBoth.has(ext)
    );
    
    // The overlap should only be formats that need transcoding fallback
    expect(overlap.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2);

/**
 * Test: segment window management
 */
describe('Segment window management consistency', () => {
  const SEGMENT_RETENTION_BEHIND = 6;
  const SEGMENT_RETENTION_AHEAD = 6;
  const SEGMENT_PREFETCH_AHEAD = 3;

  function calculateSegmentWindow(anchorIndex: number) {
    const minIndex = Math.max(0, anchorIndex - SEGMENT_RETENTION_BEHIND);
    const maxIndex = anchorIndex + SEGMENT_RETENTION_AHEAD;
    const maxPrefetch = anchorIndex + SEGMENT_RETENTION_AHEAD + SEGMENT_PREFETCH_AHEAD;
    return { minIndex, maxIndex, maxPrefetch };
  }

  it('should calculate symmetric window for mid-video anchor', () => {
    const totalSegments = 100;
    const anchor = 50;
    const window = calculateSegmentWindow(anchor);

    expect(window.minIndex).toBe(44);
    expect(window.maxIndex).toBe(56);
    expect(window.maxPrefetch).toBe(59);
  });

  it('should clamp window at start of video', () => {
    const window = calculateSegmentWindow(0);
    expect(window.minIndex).toBe(0);
    expect(window.maxIndex).toBe(6);
  });

  it('should maintain same prefetch ahead for backward and forward seek', () => {
    const anchor1 = 50;
    const anchor2 = 100;

    const window1 = calculateSegmentWindow(anchor1);
    const window2 = calculateSegmentWindow(anchor2);

    // Prefetch ahead should be consistent relative to anchor
    expect(window1.maxPrefetch - window1.maxIndex).toBe(window2.maxPrefetch - window2.maxIndex);
    expect(window1.maxPrefetch - anchor1).toBe(window2.maxPrefetch - anchor2);
  });

  it('should have equal retention behind and ahead', () => {
    const anchor = 50;
    const window = calculateSegmentWindow(anchor);
    
    const retentionBehind = anchor - window.minIndex;
    const retentionAhead = window.maxIndex - anchor;
    
    expect(retentionBehind).toBe(SEGMENT_RETENTION_BEHIND);
    expect(retentionAhead).toBe(SEGMENT_RETENTION_AHEAD);
  });
});

 */
describe('Segment load failure handling', () => {
  const SEGMENT_FAILURE_COOLDOWN_MS = 5000;

  function isSegmentRecentlyFailed(failedAt: number | undefined, now: number): boolean {
    if (failedAt === undefined) return false;
    return now - failedAt < SEGMENT_FAILURE_COOLDOWN_MS;
  }

  it('should block recently failed segments', () => {
    const failedAt = 1000;
    const now1 = 2000;  // 1000ms later
    const now2 = 6500;  // 5500ms later

    expect(isSegmentRecentlyFailed(failedAt, now1)).toBe(true);
    expect(isSegmentRecentlyFailed(failedAt, now2)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('should allow retry after cooldown', () => {
    const failedAt = 1000;
    const exactCooldown = 1000 + SEGMENT_FAILURE_COOLDOWN_MS;
    const afterCooldown = exactCooldown + 1;

    expect(isSegmentRecentlyFailed(failedAt, exactCooldown)).toBe(false);
    expect(isSegmentRecentlyFailed(failedAt, afterCooldown)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('should not block segments that never failed', () => {
    expect(isSegmentRecentlyFailed(undefined, 999_999_999)).toBe(false);
  });

 * Test: discrepancy detection for concurrent operations
 */
describe('Concurrent seek discrepancy detection', () => {
  it('should detect stale seek operations', () => {
    const seekGeneration1 = 1;
    const seekGeneration2 = 2;

    function isCurrentSeek(generation: number, currentGeneration: number): boolean {
      return generation === currentGeneration;
    }

    // Seek 1 starts
    expect(isCurrentSeek(seekGeneration1, 1)).toBe(true);
    
    // Seek 2 starts (increments generation)
    expect(isCurrentSeek(seekGeneration1, 2)).toBe(false);
    expect(isCurrentSeek(seekGeneration2, 2)).toBe(true);

    // Seek 1 should be abandoned
    expect(isCurrentSeek(seekGeneration1, 2)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('should prevent old seek results from overwriting new ones', () => {
    const generations = [1, 2, 3];
    const results = new Map<number, string>();

    // Simulate out-of-order completion
    const completionOrder = [2, 3, 1]; // Gen2 completes, then 3, then 1

    for (const gen of completionOrder) {
      const currentGen = 3; // This is the active generation
      if (gen === currentGen) {
        results.set(gen, `frame-${gen}`);
      }
    }

    // Only generation 3 results should be stored
    expect(results.has(3)).toBe(true);
    expect(results.has(1)).toBe(false);
````
