````typescript
// operation.service.ts - Add resolveConflict method

import { Injectable, NgZone, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
import { 
  createSubject, 
  createBehaviorSubject,
  map,
  takeUntil,
  distinctUntilChanged,
  shareReplay
} from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { EventsOn, EventsOff } from 'wailsjs/runtime';
import { CancelOperation, DismissOperation, GetActiveOperations, ResolveConflict } from 'wailsjs/go/app/App';
import {
  OperationKind,
  OperationStatus,
  OpStartEvent,
  OpProgressEvent,
  OpCompleteEvent,
  ConflictEvent,
  ConflictResolution
} from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import { OperationRegistryService, OperationConfig } from './operation-registry.service';

export interface OperationState {
  id: string;
  config: OperationConfig;
  status: OperationStatus;
  error?: string;
  // Add conflict data
  conflictData?: {
    conflictId: string;
    sourcePath: string;
    destPath: string;
    sourceSize: number;
    destSize: number;
    isDirectory: boolean;
  };
  metrics: {
    totalBytes: number;
    processedBytes: number;
    totalItems: number;
    processedItems: number;
    currentFile?: string;
    currentFileSize?: number;
  };
  percentComplete: number;
  timing: {
    startedAt: number;
    elapsedMs: number;
    estimatedRemainingMs: number;
    speedBytesPerSecond: number;
  };
  isMinimized: boolean;
  isCollapsed: boolean;
  stackIndex: number;
  /** Public source locations captured when the operation starts. */
  sources: string[];
  /** Public destination location when the operation has one. */
  destination?: string;
}

export interface OperationHistoryEntry extends OperationState {
  completedAt: number;
}

export function normalizeOperationKind(value: unknown): OperationKind {
  const kind = String(value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  switch (kind) {
    case 'copy': case 'move': case 'delete': case 'archive': case 'extract': case 'search': case 'calculate':
      return kind as OperationKind;
    default:
      return 'copy';
  }
}

export function normalizeOperationStatus(value: unknown): OperationStatus {
  const status = String(value ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
  switch (status) {
    case 'pending': case 'running': case 'paused': case 'completed': case 'error': case 'cancelled':
      return status as OperationStatus;
    default:
      return 'running';
  }
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class OperationService implements OnDestroy {
  // Core state streams
  private operationsMap = new Map<string, OperationState>();
  readonly operations$ = createBehaviorSubject<Map<string, OperationState>>(new Map<string, OperationState>());
  readonly history$ = createBehaviorSubject<OperationHistoryEntry[]>([]);
  private readonly HISTORY_LIMIT = 100;
  
  // Add conflicts stream
  private conflictsSubject = createSubject<ConflictEvent[]>();
  public conflicts$ = this.conflictsSubject.pipe(shareReplay(1));
  
  private pendingConflicts = new Map<string, ConflictEvent>();
  
  // Derived streams using Streamix
  public activeCount$ = this.operations$.pipe(
    map(ops => {
      let count = 0;
      ops.forEach(op => {
        if (op.status === 'running' || op.status === 'pending') count++;
      });
      return count;
    }),
    distinctUntilChanged(),
    shareReplay(1)
  );

  public visibleOperations$ = this.operations$.pipe(
    map(ops => {
      const visible: OperationState[] = [];
      ops.forEach(op => {
        if (!op.isCollapsed) visible.push(op);
      });
      return visible.sort((a, b) => a.stackIndex - b.stackIndex).slice(0, 3);
    }),
    shareReplay(1)
  );

  public collapsedOperations$ = this.operations$.pipe(
    map(ops => {
      const collapsed: OperationState[] = [];
      ops.forEach(op => {
        if (op.isCollapsed) collapsed.push(op);
      });
      return collapsed;
    }),
    shareReplay(1)
  );

  public hasActiveOperations$ = this.activeCount$.pipe(
    map(count => count > 0),
    distinctUntilChanged(),
    shareReplay(1)
  );

  // Cleanup
  private destroySubject = createSubject<void>();
  private autoCloseTimers = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
  private readonly AUTO_CLOSE_DELAY = 5000;

  // Flag to track if events are set up
  private eventsSetup = false;

  constructor(
    private zone: NgZone,
    private registry: OperationRegistryService
  ) {
    this.setupWailsEvents();
    void this.hydrateActiveOperations();
  }

  private setupWailsEvents(): void {
    if (this.eventsSetup) return;
    
    const handleStart = (event: OpStartEvent) => {
      this.zone.run(() => this.handleStart(event));
    };

    const handleProgress = (event: OpProgressEvent) => {
      this.zone.run(() => this.handleProgress(event));
    };

    const handleComplete = (event: OpCompleteEvent) => {
      this.zone.run(() => this.handleComplete(event));
    };

    const handleConflict = (event: ConflictEvent) => {
      this.zone.run(() => this.handleConflict(event));
    };

    // Register event listeners
    EventsOn('operation:start', handleStart);
    EventsOn('operation:progress', handleProgress);
    EventsOn('operation:complete', handleComplete);
    EventsOn('operation:conflict', handleConflict);

    this.eventsSetup = true;

    // Store handlers for cleanup
    (this as any)._eventHandlers = { 
      handleStart, 
      handleProgress, 
      handleComplete,
      handleConflict 
    };
  }

  private handleStart(event: OpStartEvent): void {
    const config = this.registry.get(event.kind as OperationKind);
    const now = Date.now();
    
    const state: OperationState = {
      id: event.id,
      config,
      status: 'running',
      metrics: {
        totalBytes: event.totalBytes,
        processedBytes: 0,
        totalItems: event.totalItems,
        processedItems: 0,
        currentFile: event.sources[0]
      },
      percentComplete: 0,
      timing: {
        startedAt: now,
        elapsedMs: 0,
        estimatedRemainingMs: 0,
        speedBytesPerSecond: 0
      },
      isMinimized: false,
      isCollapsed: false,
      stackIndex: this.operationsMap.size,
      sources: [...(event.sources ?? [])],
      destination: event.destination || undefined
    };

    this.operationsMap.set(event.id, state);
    this.emitOperations();
  }

  private handleProgress(event: OpProgressEvent): void {
    const existing = this.operationsMap.get(event.id);
    if (!existing) return;

    const totalBytes = existing.metrics.totalBytes;
    const processedBytes = event.processedBytes;
    
    const percentComplete = totalBytes > 0 
      ? Math.min(100, (processedBytes / totalBytes) * 100)
      : 0;

    const updated: OperationState = {
      ...existing,
      metrics: {
        ...existing.metrics,
        processedBytes: event.processedBytes,
        processedItems: event.processedItems,
        currentFile: event.currentFile,
        currentFileSize: event.currentFileSize
      },
      percentComplete,
      timing: {
        startedAt: existing.timing.startedAt,
        elapsedMs: event.elapsedMs,
        estimatedRemainingMs: event.remainingMs,
        speedBytesPerSecond: event.speedBps
      }
    };

    this.operationsMap.set(event.id, updated);
    this.emitOperations();
  }

  private handleComplete(event: OpCompleteEvent): void {
    const existing = this.operationsMap.get(event.id);
    if (!existing) return;

    const updated: OperationState = {
      ...existing,
      status: event.status as OperationStatus,
      metrics: {
        ...existing.metrics,
        processedBytes: event.finalMetrics.processedBytes,
        processedItems: event.finalMetrics.processedItems
      },
      percentComplete: 100,
      timing: event.timing,
      error: event.error
    };

    this.operationsMap.set(event.id, updated);
    this.recordHistory(updated);
    this.emitOperations();

    if (event.status === 'completed' || event.status === 'cancelled') {
      this.scheduleAutoClose(event.id);
    }
  }

  private handleConflict(event: ConflictEvent): void {
    // Store the conflict
    this.pendingConflicts.set(event.conflictId, event);
    this.conflictsSubject.next(Array.from(this.pendingConflicts.values()));

    // Update the operation state
    const existing = this.operationsMap.get(event.operationId);
    if (existing) {
      const updated: OperationState = {
        ...existing,
        status: 'paused',
        error: `Conflict: ${event.destPath} already exists`,
        conflictData: {
          conflictId: event.conflictId,
          sourcePath: event.sourcePath,
          destPath: event.destPath,
          sourceSize: event.sourceSize,
          destSize: event.destSize,
          isDirectory: event.isDirectory
        },
        metrics: {
          ...existing.metrics,
          currentFile: event.sourcePath
        }
      };
      this.operationsMap.set(event.operationId, updated);
      this.emitOperations();
    }
  }

  private emitOperations(): void {
    this.operations$.next(new Map(this.operationsMap));
  }

  private scheduleAutoClose(id: string): void {
    if (this.autoCloseTimers.has(id)) {
      clearTimeout(this.autoCloseTimers.get(id));
    }

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.dismiss(id);
    }, this.AUTO_CLOSE_DELAY);

    this.autoCloseTimers.set(id, timer);
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // Conflict Resolution
  // ============================================================================

  /**
   * Resolve a conflict by sending the user's decision to the backend
   */
  async resolveConflict(conflictId: string, resolution: ConflictResolution, applyToAll: boolean): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      const result = await ResolveConflict(conflictId, resolution as any, applyToAll);
      
      if (result) {
        // Remove from pending conflicts
        const conflict = this.pendingConflicts.get(conflictId);
        this.pendingConflicts.delete(conflictId);
        this.conflictsSubject.next(Array.from(this.pendingConflicts.values()));

        // Resume or hide the operation depending on the user's choice
        if (conflict && !this.hasPendingConflictsForOperation(conflict.operationId)) {
          const op = this.operationsMap.get(conflict.operationId);
          if (op) {
            op.error = undefined;
            op.conflictData = undefined;

            // Skip/Cancel: immediately dismiss the toast so no moving dialog is shown again
            if (resolution === 'skip' || resolution === 'cancel') {
              this.dismiss(conflict.operationId);
            } else if (op.status === 'paused') {
              // For overwrite/rename, let it continue
              op.status = 'running';
              this.emitOperations();
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to resolve conflict:', error);
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Check if an operation has any pending conflicts
   */
  private hasPendingConflictsForOperation(operationId: string): boolean {
    for (const conflict of this.pendingConflicts.values()) {
      if (conflict.operationId === operationId) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  /**
   * Get all pending conflicts
   */
  getPendingConflicts(): ConflictEvent[] {
    return Array.from(this.pendingConflicts.values());
  }

  async waitForOperationSettlement(
    operationId: string,
    appearanceTimeoutMs: number = 2000,
    overallTimeoutMs: number = 300000,
  ): Promise<OperationStatus | 'dismissed' | 'missing'> {
    return await new Promise<OperationStatus | 'dismissed' | 'missing'>((resolve) => {
      let settled = false;
      let seenOperation = false;
      let appearanceTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
      let overallTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
      let subscription: { unsubscribe(): void } | null = null;

      const finish = (status: OperationStatus | 'dismissed' | 'missing') => {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        if (appearanceTimer) clearTimeout(appearanceTimer);
        if (overallTimer) clearTimeout(overallTimer);
        try { subscription?.unsubscribe(); } catch {}
        resolve(status);
      };

      appearanceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        const op = this.operationsMap.get(operationId);
        if (!seenOperation && !op && !this.hasPendingConflictsForOperation(operationId)) {
          finish('missing');
        }
      }, appearanceTimeoutMs);

      overallTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        finish(seenOperation ? 'dismissed' : 'missing');
      }, overallTimeoutMs);

      subscription = this.operations$.subscribe((ops) => {
        const op = ops.get(operationId);
        if (op) {
          seenOperation = true;
          if (op.status === 'completed' || op.status === 'error' || op.status === 'cancelled') {
            finish(op.status);
          }
          return;
        }

        if (seenOperation && !this.hasPendingConflictsForOperation(operationId)) {
          finish('dismissed');
        }
      });
    });
  }

  /**
   * Get a specific pending conflict by ID
   */
  getConflict(conflictId: string): ConflictEvent | undefined {
    return this.pendingConflicts.get(conflictId);
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // Public API Methods
  // ============================================================================

  minimize(id: string): void {
    this.patchOperation(id, { isMinimized: true });
  }

  expand(id: string): void {
    this.patchOperation(id, { isMinimized: false });
  }

  collapse(id: string): void {
    this.patchOperation(id, { isCollapsed: true, isMinimized: false });
    this.reindexStack();
  }

  restore(id: string): void {
    this.patchOperation(id, { isCollapsed: false, isMinimized: false });
    this.reindexStack();
  }

  async cancel(id: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const result = await CancelOperation(id);
      if (!result) {
        console.warn('Cancel operation returned false');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to cancel operation:', e);
    }
  }

  dismiss(id: string): void {
    if (this.autoCloseTimers.has(id)) {
      clearTimeout(this.autoCloseTimers.get(id));
      this.autoCloseTimers.delete(id);
    }

    this.operationsMap.delete(id);
    void DismissOperation(id).catch(error => console.warn('Failed to dismiss backend operation:', error));
    this.emitOperations();
    this.reindexStack();
  }

  collapseAll(): void {
    this.operationsMap.forEach(op => {
      op.isCollapsed = true;
      op.isMinimized = false;
    });
    this.emitOperations();
  }

  restoreAll(): void {
    this.operationsMap.forEach(op => {
      op.isCollapsed = false;
      op.isMinimized = false;
    });
    this.emitOperations();
    this.reindexStack();
  }


  clearHistory(): void {
    this.history$.next([]);
  }

  private recordHistory(operation: OperationState): void {
    if (operation.status === 'running' || operation.status === 'pending' || operation.status === 'paused') return;
    const entry: OperationHistoryEntry = {
      ...operation,
      sources: [...operation.sources],
      metrics: { ...operation.metrics },
      timing: { ...operation.timing },
      completedAt: Date.now(),
    };
    const next = [entry, ...this.history$.value.filter((item: OperationHistoryEntry) => item.id !== entry.id)].slice(0, this.HISTORY_LIMIT);
    this.history$.next(next);
  }

  private async hydrateActiveOperations(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const backend = await GetActiveOperations();
      for (const raw of backend ?? []) {
        if (this.operationsMap.has(raw.id)) continue;
        const kind = normalizeOperationKind(raw.type);
        const status = normalizeOperationStatus(raw.status);
        const state: OperationState = {
          id: raw.id,
          config: this.registry.get(kind),
          status,
          error: raw.error || undefined,
          sources: raw.sourcePath ? [raw.sourcePath] : [],
          destination: raw.destinationPath || undefined,
          metrics: {
            totalBytes: raw.totalBytes ?? 0,
            processedBytes: raw.processedBytes ?? 0,
            totalItems: raw.totalItems ?? 0,
            processedItems: raw.processedItems ?? 0,
            currentFile: raw.currentFile || undefined,
            currentFileSize: raw.currentFileSize || undefined,
          },
          percentComplete: raw.percentComplete ?? 0,
          timing: {
            startedAt: raw.startTime ?? Date.now(),
            elapsedMs: (raw.elapsedSeconds ?? 0) * 1000,
            estimatedRemainingMs: (raw.etaSeconds ?? 0) * 1000,
            speedBytesPerSecond: raw.speedBytesPerSec ?? 0,
          },
          isMinimized: false,
          isCollapsed: false,
          stackIndex: this.operationsMap.size,
        };
        this.operationsMap.set(state.id, state);
      }
      this.emitOperations();
    } catch (error) {
      // Startup hydration is best effort; live Wails events remain authoritative.
      console.warn('Failed to hydrate active operations:', error);
    }
  }

  private patchOperation(id: string, patch: Partial<OperationState>): void {
    const current = this.operationsMap.get(id);
    if (!current) return;

    this.operationsMap.set(id, { ...current, ...patch });
    this.emitOperations();
  }

  private reindexStack(): void {
    let index = 0;
    const sorted = Array.from(this.operationsMap.values())
      .filter(o => !o.isCollapsed)
      .sort((a, b) => a.stackIndex - b.stackIndex);

    sorted.forEach(op => {
      const updated = { ...op, stackIndex: index++ };
      this.operationsMap.set(op.id, updated);
    });

    this.emitOperations();
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // Formatters
  // ============================================================================

  formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
    if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';
    const k = 1024;
    const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
    return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(1)) + ' ' + sizes[i];
  }

  formatSpeed(bps: number): string {
    return this.formatBytes(bps) + '/s';
  }

  formatDuration(ms: number): string {
    if (ms < 0 || !isFinite(ms)) return '--:--';
    const seconds = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
    const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
    
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}:${(minutes % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${(seconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }
    return `${minutes}:${(seconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // Cleanup
  // ============================================================================

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroySubject.next();
    this.destroySubject.complete();
    
    // Clean up event listeners
    EventsOff('operation:start');
    EventsOff('operation:progress');
    EventsOff('operation:complete');
    EventsOff('operation:conflict');
    
    this.autoCloseTimers.forEach(clearTimeout);
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import type { ApiService } from './api.service';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { PaneComparisonService, type PaneComparisonItem, type PaneComparisonResult } from './pane-comparison.service';

export interface RecursivePaneComparisonOptions {
  showHidden?: boolean;
  maxDepth?: number;
  maxItems?: number;
}

export interface RecursivePaneComparisonResult {
  comparison: PaneComparisonResult;
  directoriesScanned: number;
  truncated: boolean;
  warnings: string[];
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PaneRecursiveComparisonService {
  constructor(private readonly comparison: PaneComparisonService) {}

  async compare(
    api: ApiService,
    leftRoot: string,
    rightRoot: string,
    options: RecursivePaneComparisonOptions = {},
  ): Promise<RecursivePaneComparisonResult> {
    const maxDepth = Math.max(1, options.maxDepth ?? 64);
    const maxItems = Math.max(100, options.maxItems ?? 10000);
    const showHidden = options.showHidden ?? false;
    const items: PaneComparisonItem[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    let directoriesScanned = 0;
    let truncated = false;

    const walk = async (leftDir: string, rightDir: string, relativeDir: string, depth: number): Promise<void> => {
      if (truncated || depth > maxDepth) {
        truncated = true;
        return;
      }

      let leftEntries: FileInfo[] = [];
      let rightEntries: FileInfo[] = [];
      try {
        [leftEntries, rightEntries] = await Promise.all([
          api.listDirectory(leftDir, showHidden).then(r => r.entries ?? []),
          api.listDirectory(rightDir, showHidden).then(r => r.entries ?? []),
        ]);
        directoriesScanned++;
      } catch (error) {
        warnings.push(`${relativeDir || '.'}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
        return;
      }

      const level = this.comparison.compare(leftEntries, rightEntries);
      for (const item of level.items) {
        if (item.name === '..' || item.left?.path === '..' || item.right?.path === '..') continue;
        const relativePath = relativeDir ? `${relativeDir}/${item.name}` : item.name;
        items.push({ ...item, key: relativePath.toLocaleLowerCase(), name: relativePath });
        if (items.length >= maxItems) {
          truncated = true;
          return;
        }

        const bothDirectories = item.left?.type === FileType.DIRECTORY && item.right?.type === FileType.DIRECTORY;
        const followsSymlink = !!item.left?.isSymlink || !!item.right?.isSymlink;
        if (bothDirectories && !followsSymlink) {
          await walk(item.left!.path, item.right!.path, relativePath, depth + 1);
          if (truncated) return;
        }
      }
    };

    await walk(leftRoot, rightRoot, '', 0);
    return {
      comparison: this.comparison.fromItems(items),
      directoriesScanned,
      truncated,
      warnings,
    };
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject, type Stream } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import {
  canonicalizeLocation,
  describeLocation,
  locationIdentity,
  locationLabel,
  type LocationKind,
} from './location-reference';

export interface LocationHistoryEntry {
  location: string;
  scheme: string;
  kind: LocationKind;
  timestamp: number;
  accessCount: number;
  paneId: string;
}

/** @deprecated Prefer LocationHistoryEntry. */
export type PathHistoryEntry = LocationHistoryEntry;

export interface PathSuggestion {
  path: string;
  displayName: string;
  matchType: 'history' | 'directory' | 'fuzzy';
  score: number;
  exists: boolean;
}

interface LegacyPathHistoryEntry {
  path?: string;
  location?: string;
  timestamp?: number;
  accessCount?: number;
  paneId?: string;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PathHistoryService {
  private readonly STORAGE_KEY = 'filemanager:path-history';
  private readonly MAX_HISTORY_ENTRIES = 100;

  private history = new Map<string, LocationHistoryEntry>();
  private historySubject = createBehaviorSubject<LocationHistoryEntry[]>([]);

  constructor(private apiService: ApiService) {
    this.loadHistory();
  }

  get history$(): Stream<LocationHistoryEntry[]> {
    return this.historySubject;
  }

  addLocation(location: string, paneId: string): void {
    const descriptor = describeLocation(location);
    if (!descriptor) return;

    const id = locationIdentity(descriptor.location);
    const existing = this.history.get(id);
    if (existing) {
      existing.timestamp = Date.now();
      existing.accessCount++;
      existing.paneId = paneId || existing.paneId;
    } else {
      this.history.set(id, {
        ...descriptor,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        accessCount: 1,
        paneId,
      });
    }

    this.pruneHistory();
    this.saveHistory();
    this.emitHistory();
  }

  /** Compatibility alias while callers move from path to location terminology. */
  addPath(path: string, paneId: string): void {
    this.addLocation(path, paneId);
  }

  getRecentLocations(limit = 10): LocationHistoryEntry[] {
    return this.sortedHistory((a, b) => b.timestamp - a.timestamp).slice(0, limit);
  }

  getFrequentLocations(limit = 10, minimumAccessCount = 2): LocationHistoryEntry[] {
    return this.sortedHistory((a, b) =>
      b.accessCount - a.accessCount || b.timestamp - a.timestamp,
    ).filter(entry => entry.accessCount >= minimumAccessCount).slice(0, limit);
  }

  getRelatedLocations(location: string, limit = 10): LocationHistoryEntry[] {
    const descriptor = describeLocation(location);
    if (!descriptor || descriptor.scheme === 'filesystem') return [];
    const activeId = locationIdentity(descriptor.location);
    return this.getRecentLocations(this.MAX_HISTORY_ENTRIES)
      .filter(entry => entry.scheme === descriptor.scheme && locationIdentity(entry.location) !== activeId)
      .slice(0, limit);
  }

  async getSuggestions(query: string, currentPath: string): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    if (!query || query.trim() === '') {
      return this.getRecentLocations(10).map(entry => this.toHistorySuggestion(entry));
    }

    const suggestions: PathSuggestion[] = [];
    suggestions.push(...this.getHistoryMatches(query));

    if (this.canUseDirectoryAutocomplete(query)) {
      suggestions.push(...await this.getDirectorySuggestions(query));
    }

    suggestions.push(...this.getFuzzyMatches(query));

    const uniqueLocations = new Set<string>();
    const uniqueSuggestions = suggestions.filter(suggestion => {
      const id = locationIdentity(suggestion.path);
      if (!id || uniqueLocations.has(id)) return false;
      uniqueLocations.add(id);
      return true;
    });

    uniqueSuggestions.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
    return uniqueSuggestions.slice(0, 10);
  }

  private getHistoryMatches(query: string): PathSuggestion[] {
    const lowerQuery = query.toLowerCase();
    const matches: PathSuggestion[] = [];

    for (const entry of this.history.values()) {
      const lowerLocation = entry.location.toLowerCase();
      const lowerLabel = locationLabel(entry.location).toLowerCase();
      const prefix = lowerLocation.startsWith(lowerQuery) || lowerLabel.startsWith(lowerQuery);
      const contains = lowerLocation.includes(lowerQuery) || lowerLabel.includes(lowerQuery);
      if (!prefix && !contains) continue;

      matches.push({
        path: entry.location,
        displayName: locationLabel(entry.location),
        matchType: 'history',
        score: (prefix ? 100 : 80) + (entry.accessCount * (prefix ? 5 : 3)),
        exists: true,
      });
    }

    return matches;
  }

  private async getDirectorySuggestions(query: string): Promise<PathSuggestion[]> {
    try {
      const normalizedQuery = canonicalizeLocation(query);
      const lastSlash = normalizedQuery.lastIndexOf('/');
      if (lastSlash < 0) return [];

      const dirPath = normalizedQuery.substring(0, lastSlash + 1) || '/';
      const prefix = normalizedQuery.substring(lastSlash + 1);
      const listing = await this.apiService.listDirectory(dirPath, false);
      const suggestions: PathSuggestion[] = [];

      for (const entry of listing.entries) {
        if (entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) continue;
        if (!entry.name.toLowerCase().startsWith(prefix.toLowerCase())) continue;
        const fullPath = canonicalizeLocation(`${dirPath}${entry.name}`);
        suggestions.push({
          path: fullPath,
          displayName: entry.name,
          matchType: 'directory',
          score: 90,
          exists: true,
        });
      }

      return suggestions;
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  private canUseDirectoryAutocomplete(query: string): boolean {
    const normalized = canonicalizeLocation(query);
    return (
      normalized.startsWith('/') ||
      normalized.startsWith('./') ||
      normalized.startsWith('../') ||
      /^filesystem:\/\/[a-z](?:\/.*)?$/i.test(normalized) ||
      normalized.startsWith('//')
    );
  }

  private getFuzzyMatches(query: string): PathSuggestion[] {
    const matches: PathSuggestion[] = [];
    const queryTokens = query.toLowerCase().split(/[\s\-_\/]/).filter(Boolean);
    if (queryTokens.length === 0) return matches;

    for (const entry of this.history.values()) {
      const searchable = `${locationLabel(entry.location)} ${entry.location}`.toLowerCase();
      const locationTokens = searchable.split(/[\s\-_\/]/).filter(Boolean);
      let matchCount = 0;

      for (const queryToken of queryTokens) {
        if (locationTokens.some(token => token.includes(queryToken))) matchCount++;
      }

      if (matchCount === 0) continue;
      const score = (matchCount / queryTokens.length) * 50 + (entry.accessCount * 2);
      if (score <= 20) continue;
      matches.push({
        path: entry.location,
        displayName: locationLabel(entry.location),
        matchType: 'fuzzy',
        score,
        exists: true,
      });
    }

    return matches;
  }

  private toHistorySuggestion(entry: LocationHistoryEntry): PathSuggestion {
    return {
      path: entry.location,
      displayName: locationLabel(entry.location),
      matchType: 'history',
      score: 50 + (entry.accessCount * 5),
      exists: true,
    };
  }

  private pruneHistory(): void {
    if (this.history.size <= this.MAX_HISTORY_ENTRIES) return;
    const entries = this.sortedHistory((a, b) => a.timestamp - b.timestamp);
    const toRemove = entries.slice(0, this.history.size - this.MAX_HISTORY_ENTRIES);
    for (const entry of toRemove) this.history.delete(locationIdentity(entry.location));
  }

  private loadHistory(): void {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(this.STORAGE_KEY);
      if (!stored) return;
      const entries = JSON.parse(stored) as LegacyPathHistoryEntry[];
      for (const storedEntry of entries) {
        const rawLocation = storedEntry.location ?? storedEntry.path ?? '';
        const descriptor = describeLocation(rawLocation);
        if (!descriptor) continue;
        const id = locationIdentity(descriptor.location);
        const timestamp = Number(storedEntry.timestamp) || Date.now();
        const accessCount = Math.max(1, Number(storedEntry.accessCount) || 1);
        const paneId = storedEntry.paneId || 'left';
        const existing = this.history.get(id);

        if (existing) {
          if (timestamp >= existing.timestamp) {
            existing.timestamp = timestamp;
            existing.paneId = paneId;
          }
          existing.accessCount += accessCount;
        } else {
          this.history.set(id, { ...descriptor, timestamp, accessCount, paneId });
        }
      }
      this.pruneHistory();
      this.saveHistory(); // Persist the location-aware shape after legacy reads.
      this.emitHistory();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load location history:', error);
    }
  }

  private saveHistory(): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(this.STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.getRecentLocations(this.MAX_HISTORY_ENTRIES)));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to save location history:', error);
    }
  }

  private emitHistory(): void {
    this.historySubject.next(this.getRecentLocations(this.MAX_HISTORY_ENTRIES));
  }

  private sortedHistory(compare: (a: LocationHistoryEntry, b: LocationHistoryEntry) => number): LocationHistoryEntry[] {
    return Array.from(this.history.values()).sort(compare);
  }

  clearHistory(): void {
    this.history.clear();
    this.saveHistory();
    this.emitHistory();
  }

  getAllHistory(): LocationHistoryEntry[] {
    return this.getRecentLocations(this.MAX_HISTORY_ENTRIES);
  }

  removeLocation(location: string): void {
    const id = locationIdentity(location);
    if (!id) return;
    this.history.delete(id);
    this.saveHistory();
    this.emitHistory();
  }

  /** Compatibility alias while callers move from path to location terminology. */
  removePath(path: string): void {
    this.removeLocation(path);
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import type { PluginManifest } from '../plugin/plugin-manifest';

export interface DiscoveredPluginPackage {
  manifest: PluginManifest;
  path: string;
  manifestPath: string;
  valid: boolean;
  errors: string[];
  warnings: string[];
}

interface PluginDiscoveryBindings {
  GetPluginDirectory(): Promise<string>;
  DiscoverPluginPackages(): Promise<unknown[]>;
}

function appBindings(): PluginDiscoveryBindings {
  const bindings = (window as any)?.go?.app?.App as PluginDiscoveryBindings | undefined;
  if (!bindings?.GetPluginDirectory || !bindings?.DiscoverPluginPackages) {
    throw new Error('Plugin discovery bindings are unavailable. Regenerate Wails bindings and restart the application.');
  }
  return bindings;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PluginDiscoveryService {
  getDirectory(): Promise<string> {
    return appBindings().GetPluginDirectory();
  }

  async discover(): Promise<DiscoveredPluginPackage[]> {
    const raw = await appBindings().DiscoverPluginPackages();
    return (raw ?? []).map(normalizeDiscoveredPluginPackage);
  }
}

export function normalizeDiscoveredPluginPackage(value: unknown): DiscoveredPluginPackage {
  const raw = (value ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  return {
    manifest: (raw['manifest'] ?? {}) as PluginManifest,
    path: typeof raw['path'] === 'string' ? raw['path'] : '',
    manifestPath: typeof raw['manifestPath'] === 'string' ? raw['manifestPath'] : '',
    valid: raw['valid'] === true,
    errors: stringArray(raw['errors']),
    warnings: stringArray(raw['warnings']),
  };
}

function stringArray(value: unknown): string[] {
  return Array.isArray(value) ? value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string') : [];
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import type { PinnedLocation } from '../components/address-bar.types';
import { locationIdentity, schemeOfLocation } from './location-reference';
import { PinnedLocationService } from './pinned-location.service';
import type { RelatedLocationContext, RelatedLocationContribution } from './related-location.types';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class RelatedLocationService {
  private readonly contributions = new Map<string, RelatedLocationContribution>();

  constructor(private readonly pins: PinnedLocationService) {
    this.register({
      id: 'builtin.saved-search-context',
      score: (candidate, context) => this.scoreSavedSearch(candidate, context),
    });
  }

  register(contribution: RelatedLocationContribution): void {
    this.contributions.set(contribution.id, contribution);
  }

  unregister(id: string): void {
    this.contributions.delete(id);
  }

  list(): readonly RelatedLocationContribution[] {
    return Array.from(this.contributions.values());
  }

  resolve(
    candidates: readonly PinnedLocation[],
    currentLocation: string,
    currentSurfaceId = 'dir',
  ): PinnedLocation[] {
    const context: RelatedLocationContext = {
      currentLocation,
      currentSurfaceId,
      contextLocation: this.pins.contextLocation(currentLocation),
    };
    if (!context.contextLocation) return [];

    return candidates
      .map((candidate, index) => ({
        candidate,
        index,
        score: this.scoreCandidate(candidate, context),
      }))
      .filter(entry => entry.score > 0)
      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || b.candidate.addedAt - a.candidate.addedAt || a.index - b.index)
      .map(entry => entry.candidate);
  }

  private scoreCandidate(candidate: PinnedLocation, context: RelatedLocationContext): number {
    if (this.isCurrentPin(candidate, context)) return 0;

    let best = 0;
    for (const contribution of this.contributions.values()) {
      try {
        best = Math.max(best, Number(contribution.score(candidate, context)) || 0);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(`Related-location contribution ${contribution.id} failed:`, error);
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  private isCurrentPin(candidate: PinnedLocation, context: RelatedLocationContext): boolean {
    return candidate.surfaceId === context.currentSurfaceId
      && locationIdentity(candidate.location) === locationIdentity(context.currentLocation);
  }

  private scoreSavedSearch(candidate: PinnedLocation, context: RelatedLocationContext): number {
    if (candidate.scheme !== 'search' || !context.contextLocation) return 0;

    const candidateContext = this.pins.contextLocation(candidate.location);
    if (!candidateContext) return 0;

    const contextId = locationIdentity(context.contextLocation);
    const candidateId = locationIdentity(candidateContext);
    if (contextId && contextId === candidateId) return 1000;

    if (schemeOfLocation(context.contextLocation) !== 'filesystem' || schemeOfLocation(candidateContext) !== 'filesystem') {
      return 0;
    }

    const current = normalizeComparablePath(context.contextLocation);
    const saved = normalizeComparablePath(candidateContext);
    if (!current || !saved) return 0;

    if (saved.startsWith(`${current}/`)) return 760;
    if (current.startsWith(`${saved}/`)) return 700;
    return 0;
  }
}

function normalizeComparablePath(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/\/+$/, '').toLowerCase();
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject, distinctUntilChanged, map, shareReplay } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { canonicalizeLocation, locationIdentity, locationLabel } from './location-reference';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';

export interface SelectionBasketEntry {
  id: string;
  path: string;
  label: string;
  addedAt: number;
  source?: string;
  type?: FileType;
  size?: number;
  modified?: number;
  metadataResolved: boolean;
}

interface StoredBasketEntry {
  path: string;
  addedAt: number;
  source?: string;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SelectionBasketService {
  private readonly storageKey = 'filemanager:selection-basket-v1';
  private readonly entriesSubject = createBehaviorSubject<SelectionBasketEntry[]>(this.load());

  readonly entries$ = this.entriesSubject;
  readonly count$ = this.entries$.pipe(
    map(entries => entries.length),
    distinctUntilChanged(),
    shareReplay(1),
  );

  constructor(private readonly api: ApiService) {
    for (const entry of this.entriesSubject.value) {
      void this.resolveMetadata(entry.id, entry.path);
    }
  }

  get snapshot(): readonly SelectionBasketEntry[] {
    return this.entriesSubject.value;
  }

  get paths(): string[] {
    return this.entriesSubject.value.map(entry => entry.path);
  }

  add(paths: readonly string[], source?: string): number {
    const current = [...this.entriesSubject.value];
    const ids = new Set(current.map(entry => entry.id));
    const added: SelectionBasketEntry[] = [];

    for (const raw of paths) {
      const path = canonicalizeLocation(raw);
      if (!path) continue;
      const id = locationIdentity(path);
      if (!id || ids.has(id)) continue;
      ids.add(id);
      added.push({
        id,
        path,
        label: locationLabel(path) || this.baseName(path),
        addedAt: Date.now(),
        source,
        metadataResolved: false,
      });
    }

    if (added.length === 0) return 0;
    this.publish([...current, ...added]);
    for (const entry of added) void this.resolveMetadata(entry.id, entry.path);
    return added.length;
  }

  remove(idOrPath: string): boolean {
    const identity = idOrPath.includes(':') && !idOrPath.includes('://')
      ? idOrPath
      : locationIdentity(canonicalizeLocation(idOrPath));
    const current = this.entriesSubject.value;
    const next = current.filter(entry => entry.id !== identity);
    if (next.length === current.length) return false;
    this.publish(next);
    return true;
  }

  removePaths(paths: readonly string[]): number {
    const identities = new Set(paths.map(path => locationIdentity(canonicalizeLocation(path))).filter(Boolean));
    if (identities.size === 0) return 0;
    const current = this.entriesSubject.value;
    const next = current.filter(entry => !identities.has(entry.id));
    const removed = current.length - next.length;
    if (removed > 0) this.publish(next);
    return removed;
  }

  clear(): void {
    if (this.entriesSubject.value.length === 0) return;
    this.publish([]);
  }

  contains(path: string): boolean {
    const id = locationIdentity(canonicalizeLocation(path));
    return !!id && this.entriesSubject.value.some(entry => entry.id === id);
  }

  private async resolveMetadata(id: string, path: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const info = await this.api.getFileInfo(path);
      this.update(id, {
        label: info.name || locationLabel(path) || this.baseName(path),
        type: info.type,
        size: info.size,
        modified: info.modified,
        metadataResolved: true,
      });
    } catch {
      this.update(id, { metadataResolved: true });
    }
  }

  private update(id: string, patch: Partial<SelectionBasketEntry>): void {
    const current = this.entriesSubject.value;
    const index = current.findIndex(entry => entry.id === id);
    if (index < 0) return;
    const next = [...current];
    next[index] = { ...next[index], ...patch };
    this.entriesSubject.next(next);
  }

  private publish(entries: SelectionBasketEntry[]): void {
    this.entriesSubject.next(entries);
    this.persist(entries);
  }

  private load(): SelectionBasketEntry[] {
    try {
      const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(this.storageKey);
      if (!raw) return [];
      const stored = JSON.parse(raw) as StoredBasketEntry[];
      if (!Array.isArray(stored)) return [];
      const result: SelectionBasketEntry[] = [];
      const seen = new Set<string>();
      for (const item of stored) {
        const path = canonicalizeLocation(item?.path ?? '');
        const id = locationIdentity(path);
        if (!path || !id || seen.has(id)) continue;
        seen.add(id);
        result.push({
          id,
          path,
          label: locationLabel(path) || this.baseName(path),
          addedAt: Number.isFinite(item.addedAt) ? item.addedAt : Date.now(),
          source: item.source,
          metadataResolved: false,
        });
      }
      return result;
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  private persist(entries: readonly SelectionBasketEntry[]): void {
    try {
      const stored: StoredBasketEntry[] = entries.map(({ path, addedAt, source }) => ({ path, addedAt, source }));
      sessionStorage.setItem(this.storageKey, JSON.stringify(stored));
    } catch {
      // Basket persistence is a convenience; the in-memory working set remains authoritative.
    }
  }

  private baseName(path: string): string {
    return path.replace(/[\\/]+$/, '').split(/[\\/]/).pop() || path;
  }
}
````

## File: frontend/src/app/services/source-capabilities.ts
````typescript
export interface SourceCapabilities {
  readonly read: boolean;
  readonly create: boolean;
  readonly delete: boolean;
  readonly rename: boolean;
  readonly trash: boolean;
}

const READ_ONLY: SourceCapabilities = Object.freeze({
  read: true,
  create: false,
  delete: false,
  rename: false,
  trash: false,
});

const MUTABLE: SourceCapabilities = Object.freeze({
  read: true,
  create: true,
  delete: true,
  rename: true,
  trash: false,
});

const LOCAL: SourceCapabilities = Object.freeze({ ...MUTABLE, trash: true });
const REGISTRY: SourceCapabilities = Object.freeze({
  read: true,
  create: true,
  delete: true,
  rename: false,
  trash: false,
});

export function getSourceCapabilities(
  location: string,
  options?: { inArchive?: boolean },
): SourceCapabilities {
  // Archive mutation is handled by the archive operation layer rather than the
  // mounted VFS adapter, so keep those commands available while browsing it.
  if (options?.inArchive) return MUTABLE;

  const value = (location ?? '').trim();
  const match = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(value);
  if (!match) return LOCAL;

  switch (match[1].toLowerCase()) {
    case 'filesystem':
      return LOCAL;
    case 'memory':
    case 'smb':
      return MUTABLE;
    case 'registry':
      return REGISTRY;
    case 'gdrive':
    case 'dropbox':
    case 'onedrive':
    case 's3':
    case 'search':
    case 'http':
    case 'https':
      return READ_ONLY;
    default:
      // Unknown/plugin schemes are conservative until they advertise their own
      // source capabilities. Reading/copying out is safe; mutation is not.
      return READ_ONLY;
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';

export type Theme = 'dark' | 'light';
export type ThemePreference = Theme | 'system';

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class ThemeService {
  private readonly themePreference$ = createBehaviorSubject<ThemePreference>(this.readInitialThemePreference());
  private theme$ = createBehaviorSubject<Theme>(this.resolveTheme(this.themePreference$.value));
  private compact$ = createBehaviorSubject<boolean>(this.readInitialCompact());
  private readonly systemThemeMedia = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)') : null;

  constructor() {
    this.systemThemeMedia?.addEventListener?.('change', () => {
      if (this.themePreference$.value === 'system') {
        const resolved = this.resolveTheme('system');
        this.theme$.next(resolved);
        this.applyTheme(resolved);
      }
    });
    this.applyTheme(this.theme$.value);
    this.applyCompact(this.compact$.value);
  }

  setTheme(theme: Theme) {
    this.setThemePreference(theme);
  }

  setThemePreference(theme: ThemePreference) {
    const resolved = this.resolveTheme(theme);
    this.themePreference$.next(theme);
    this.theme$.next(resolved);
    this.applyTheme(resolved);
    try { localStorage.setItem('app-theme', theme); } catch {}
  }

  toggleTheme() {
    this.setThemePreference(this.theme$.value === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark');
  }

  getTheme$() {
    return this.theme$;
  }

  getThemePreference$() {
    return this.themePreference$;
  }

  setCompact(compact: boolean) {
    this.compact$.next(compact);
    this.applyCompact(compact);
    try { localStorage.setItem('app-compact', compact ? '1' : '0'); } catch {}
  }

  toggleCompact() {
    this.setCompact(!this.compact$.value);
  }

  getCompact$() {
    return this.compact$;
  }

  private applyTheme(theme: Theme) {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.classList.toggle('vscode-light', theme === 'light');
    root.classList.toggle('vscode-dark', theme === 'dark');
  }

  private applyCompact(compact: boolean) {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.classList.toggle('compact-mode', compact);
  }

  private readInitialThemePreference(): ThemePreference {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem('app-theme');
      if (stored === 'light' || stored === 'dark' || stored === 'system') return stored;
    } catch {}
    return 'system';
  }

  private resolveTheme(theme: ThemePreference): Theme {
    if (theme === 'light' || theme === 'dark') return theme;
    if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches) {
      return 'light';
    }
    return 'dark';
  }

  private readInitialCompact(): boolean {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('app-compact') === '1';
    } catch {}
    return false;
  }
}
````

````typescript
    return this.ctx?.tab?.path || this.ctx?.dirVm?.currentPath || '';
````

````typescript
  get querySummary(): string {

      const pattern = params.get('pattern') || params.get('q') || 'Search';
      const base = params.get('path');
      return base ? `${pattern} in ${base}` : pattern;
    } catch {
      return location || 'Search';
    }
  }

  get fileViewContainer() { return this.dir?.fileViewContainer; }
````

````typescript
import { CommonModule, NgComponentOutlet } from '@angular/common';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, ChangeDetectorRef, Component, EventEmitter, Input, OnChanges, Output, Type, ViewChild } from '@angular/core';
import { SurfaceRegistryService } from './surface-registry.service';
import { SurfaceContext } from './surface-context';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-surface-outlet',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <ng-container *ngIf="component; else empty">
      <ng-container *ngComponentOutlet="component; inputs: outletInputs"></ng-container>
    </ng-container>

    <ng-template #empty>
      <div class="surface-empty"></div>
    </ng-template>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      flex: 1 1 0%;
      min-height: 0;
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .surface-empty {
      flex: 1 1 0%;
      min-height: 0;
    }
  `],
})
export class SurfaceOutletComponent implements OnChanges {
  @Input({ required: true }) ctx!: SurfaceContext;
  @Input() active = false;
  /** Re-emits `firstEntryArrived` from dynamic surfaces so parents may react. */
  @Output() firstEntryArrived = new EventEmitter<void>();

  component: Type<unknown> | null = null;
  outletInputs: Record<string, unknown> = {};

  @ViewChild(NgComponentOutlet) private outlet?: NgComponentOutlet;

  private resolveSeq = 0;
  private resolvedSurfaceKey: string | null = null;
  private renderedInputSignature = '';
  private mountedSubscription: { unsubscribe: () => void } | null = null;

  constructor(
    private registry: SurfaceRegistryService,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  ngOnChanges(): void {
    const surfaceKey = this.ctx ? `${this.ctx.surfaceId}:${this.ctx.tab.id}` : 'dir';
    const inputSignature = JSON.stringify(this.ctx ?? null);

    // FilePaneComponent rebuilds the surface context object on every change
    // detection pass. Reload the dynamic surface only when the surface identity
    // or active tab actually changes; otherwise just push fresh inputs into the
    // mounted one so long-running viewers keep their runtime state.
    if (this.component && this.resolvedSurfaceKey === surfaceKey) {
      if (this.renderedInputSignature !== inputSignature) {
        this.outletInputs = { ctx: this.ctx, active: this.active };
        this.renderedInputSignature = inputSignature;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();

        return;
      }

      this.outletInputs = { ctx: this.ctx, active: this.active };
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const seq = ++this.resolveSeq;
    this.resolvedSurfaceKey = surfaceKey;
    const targetCtx = this.ctx;
    this.renderedInputSignature = inputSignature;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    void this.registry.resolve({ tab: targetCtx.tab, context: targetCtx }).then(({ component }) => {
      if (seq !== this.resolveSeq) return;
      this.outletInputs = { ctx: targetCtx, active: this.active };
      this.component = component;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      // Give Angular a tick to create the component instance, then wire outputs
      setTimeout(() => {
        const inst = this.mountedInstance;
        if (!inst) return;
        // Clean up previous subscription
        try { this.mountedSubscription?.unsubscribe(); } catch {}
        if (inst.firstEntryArrived && typeof inst.firstEntryArrived.subscribe === 'function') {
          const sub = inst.firstEntryArrived.subscribe(() => this.firstEntryArrived.emit());
          this.mountedSubscription = { unsubscribe: () => sub.unsubscribe() };
        }
      }, 0);
    }).catch(() => {
      if (seq !== this.resolveSeq) return;
      this.resolvedSurfaceKey = null;
      this.renderedInputSignature = '';
      this.component = null;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
  }

  // Proxy access used by FilePaneComponent for keyboard commands.
  private get mountedInstance(): any {
    return (this.outlet as any)?.componentInstance ?? null;
  }
  get addressBar() { return this.mountedInstance?.addressBar; }
  get fileViewContainer() { return this.mountedInstance?.fileViewContainer; }
  get findWidget() { return this.mountedInstance?.findWidget; }
  get viewerHost() { return this.mountedInstance?.viewerHost; }
  get viewer() { return this.viewerHost?.mountedViewer; }
}
````

````typescript
type AnyFunction = (...args: any[]) => any;

export type MockSpy<T extends AnyFunction = AnyFunction> = jasmine.Spy & T & {
  mockImplementation(impl: T): MockSpy<T>;
  mockResolvedValue(value: Awaited<ReturnType<T>>): MockSpy<T>;
  mockRejectedValue(error: unknown): MockSpy<T>;
};

const globalRestorers: Array<() => void> = [];

function enhanceSpy<T extends AnyFunction>(spy: jasmine.Spy): MockSpy<T> {
  const enhanced = spy as MockSpy<T>;

  enhanced.mockImplementation = (impl: T) => {
    spy.and.callFake(impl);
    return enhanced;
  };

  enhanced.mockResolvedValue = (value: Awaited<ReturnType<T>>) => {
    spy.and.returnValue(Promise.resolve(value));
    return enhanced;
  };

  enhanced.mockRejectedValue = (error: unknown) => {
    spy.and.returnValue(Promise.reject(error));
    return enhanced;
  };

  return enhanced;
}

export function fn<T extends AnyFunction = AnyFunction>(impl?: T): MockSpy<T> {
  const spy = jasmine.createSpy('fn');
  const enhanced = enhanceSpy<T>(spy);
  if (impl) {
    enhanced.mockImplementation(impl);
  }
  return enhanced;
}

export function spyOnFn<T extends Record<string, any>, K extends keyof T & string>(
  target: T,
  method: K,
): MockSpy<Extract<T[K], AnyFunction>> {
  return enhanceSpy<Extract<T[K], AnyFunction>>(spyOn(target, method));
}

export function stubGlobal(name: string, value: unknown): void {
  const hadOwn = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(globalThis, name);
  const descriptor = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(globalThis, name);
  const previousValue = (globalThis as Record<string, unknown>)[name];

  globalRestorers.push(() => {
    if (descriptor) {
      Object.defineProperty(globalThis, name, descriptor);
      return;
    }

    if (hadOwn) {
      Object.defineProperty(globalThis, name, {
        configurable: true,
        writable: true,
        value: previousValue,
      });
      return;
    }

    delete (globalThis as Record<string, unknown>)[name];
  });

  Object.defineProperty(globalThis, name, {
    configurable: true,
    writable: true,
    value,
  });
}

export function restoreGlobals(): void {
  while (globalRestorers.length > 0) {
    globalRestorers.pop()?.();
  }
}
````

````typescript
export class BinaryViewerComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input() targetPath = '';
  @Input() archiveContext: ViewerArchiveContext | null = null;
  @Input() viewerId: string | null = null;
  @Input() probe: FileProbe | null = null;

  @ViewChild('gridBody')
  set gridBodyRef(value: ElementRef<HTMLDivElement> | undefined) {
    if (this._scrollUnlisten) {
      this._scrollUnlisten();
      this._scrollUnlisten = null;
    }
    this._gridBody = value?.nativeElement ?? null;
    if (this._gridBody) {
      const el = this._gridBody;
      const handler = () => this.scheduleUpdate();
      el.addEventListener('scroll', handler, { passive: true });
      this._scrollUnlisten = () => el.removeEventListener('scroll', handler);
      this.scheduleUpdate();
    }
  }

  kind: BinaryViewerKind = 'empty';
  info: FileInfo | null = null;
  error = '';
  copiedPath = false;
  copiedHex = false;

  // viewport state
  readonly ROW_HEIGHT = ROW_HEIGHT;
  totalRows = 0;
  totalFileSize = 0;
  renderedStartRow = 0;
  renderedRows: BinaryRow[] = [];
  bytesPerRow: 8 | 16 | 32 = 16;
  offsetFormat: OffsetFormat = 'hex';
  gotoValue = '';

  get headerLabels(): string[] {
    return Array.from({ length: this.bytesPerRow }, (_, i) => i.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(2, '0'));
  }

  // internals
  private _gridBody: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  private _scrollUnlisten: (() => void) | null = null;
  private _rafId: number | null = null;

  private memBytes: Uint8Array | null = null;   // small files / archives: full bytes in memory
  private isRangeMode = false;                   // large disk files: fetch by range
  private streamUrl = '';                        // HTTP stream URL for disk files (range mode)
  private chunkCache = new Map<number, Uint8Array>();   // chunkIndex в†’ bytes
  private pendingChunks = new Set<number>();

  private loadId = 0;
  private copyResetTimer: number | null = null;
  private copyHexResetTimer: number | null = null;

  constructor(
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  // в”Ђв”Ђ getters в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  get displayName(): string {
    if (this.info?.name) return this.info.name;
    const source = this.archiveContext?.entryPath ?? this.targetPath;
    return source ? this.baseName(source) : '';
  }

  get displayPath(): string {
    return this.archiveContext
      ? `${this.archiveContext.fsPath} :: ${this.archiveContext.entryPath}`
      : this.targetPath;
  }

  get typeBadge(): string {
    const mime = (this.probe?.mimeType ?? '').trim();
    if (mime) return mime;
    const ext = this.extractExt(this.archiveContext?.entryPath ?? this.targetPath);
    return ext ? ext.toUpperCase() : 'BINARY';
  }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ lifecycle в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  ngOnChanges(): void { void this.reload(); }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    if (this._scrollUnlisten) this._scrollUnlisten();
    if (this._rafId !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(this._rafId);
    if (this.copyResetTimer !== null) clearTimeout(this.copyResetTimer);
    if (this.copyHexResetTimer !== null) clearTimeout(this.copyHexResetTimer);
  }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ toolbar actions в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  setBytesPerRow(n: 8 | 16 | 32): void {
    if (this.bytesPerRow === n) return;
    this.bytesPerRow = n;
    this.totalRows = Math.ceil(this.totalFileSize / n);
    this.renderedRows = [];
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.scheduleUpdate();
  }

  setOffsetFormat(fmt: OffsetFormat): void {
    if (this.offsetFormat === fmt) return;
    this.offsetFormat = fmt;
    this.scheduleUpdate();
  }

  gotoOffset(): void {
    const raw = this.gotoValue.trim();
    if (!raw || !this._gridBody) return;
    let offset: number;
    if (raw.startsWith('0x') || raw.startsWith('0X')) {
      offset = parseInt(raw.slice(2), 16);
    } else if (this.offsetFormat === 'hex' && /^[0-9a-fA-F]+$/.test(raw)) {
      offset = parseInt(raw, 16);
    } else {
      offset = parseInt(raw, 10);
      if (isNaN(offset)) offset = parseInt(raw, 16);
    }
    if (isNaN(offset) || offset < 0) return;
    const row = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.floor(offset / this.bytesPerRow), this.totalRows - 1));
    this._gridBody.scrollTop = row * ROW_HEIGHT;
  }

  async copyPath(): Promise<void> {
    const path = this.displayPath?.trim();
    if (!path) return;
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(path).catch(() => {});
    this.copiedPath = true;
    if (this.copyResetTimer !== null) clearTimeout(this.copyResetTimer);
    this.copyResetTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      this.copiedPath = false; this.copyResetTimer = null; this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }, 1200);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  async copyHexDump(): Promise<void> {
    const lines = this.renderedRows.map(row => {
      const hex = row.cells.map(c => c.hex).join(' ');
      return `${row.offsetStr}  ${hex}  ${row.ascii}`;
    });
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(lines.join('\n')).catch(() => {});
    this.copiedHex = true;
    if (this.copyHexResetTimer !== null) clearTimeout(this.copyHexResetTimer);
    this.copyHexResetTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      this.copiedHex = false; this.copyHexResetTimer = null; this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }, 1200);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  async openExternally(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.targetPath || this.archiveContext) return;
    await this.api.openFile(this.targetPath);
  }

  formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    if (!bytes || bytes <= 0) return '';
    const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
    const i = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
    const value = bytes / Math.pow(1024, i);
    return `${i === 0 ? value : value.toFixed(1)} ${units[i]}`;
  }

  trackRow(_: number, row: BinaryRow): string { return row.offsetStr; }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ virtual scroll в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  private scheduleUpdate(): void {
    if (this._rafId !== null) return;
    this._rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      this._rafId = null;
      const el = this._gridBody;
      if (el && el.clientHeight === 0) { this.scheduleUpdate(); return; } // layout not settled
      void this.updateViewport();
    });
  }

  private async updateViewport(): Promise<void> {
    const body = this._gridBody;
    if (!body || this.kind !== 'grid') return;

    const scrollTop = body.scrollTop;
    const height = body.clientHeight || 600;
    const firstVisible = Math.floor(scrollTop / ROW_HEIGHT);
    const visibleCount = Math.ceil(height / ROW_HEIGHT);
    const renderStart = Math.max(0, firstVisible - OVERSCAN_ROWS);
    const renderEnd = Math.min(this.totalRows, firstVisible + visibleCount + OVERSCAN_ROWS + 1);
    if (renderEnd <= renderStart) return;

    // в”Ђв”Ђ memory mode в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ
    if (!this.isRangeMode) {
      if (!this.memBytes) return;
      const byteStart = renderStart * this.bytesPerRow;
      const byteEnd = Math.min(renderEnd * this.bytesPerRow, this.totalFileSize);
      this.renderedStartRow = renderStart;
      this.renderedRows = this.buildRows(this.memBytes.subarray(byteStart, byteEnd), byteStart);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    // в”Ђв”Ђ range mode в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ
    const byteStart = renderStart * this.bytesPerRow;
    const byteEnd = Math.min(renderEnd * this.bytesPerRow, this.totalFileSize);
    const chunkStart = Math.floor(byteStart / CHUNK_BYTES);
    const chunkEnd = Math.floor((byteEnd - 1) / CHUNK_BYTES);
    const currentLoad = this.loadId;

    const missing: number[] = [];
    for (let ci = chunkStart; ci <= chunkEnd; ci++) {
      if (!this.chunkCache.has(ci) && !this.pendingChunks.has(ci)) missing.push(ci);
    }

    // Render immediately with whatever we have (missing chunks show as 00)
    this.renderedStartRow = renderStart;
    this.renderedRows = this.assembleRows(renderStart, renderEnd);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    if (missing.length === 0) return;

    // Fetch missing chunks (max 8 at a time)
    await Promise.all(missing.slice(0, 8).map(ci => this.fetchChunk(ci, currentLoad)));
    if (this.loadId !== currentLoad) return;

    this.renderedRows = this.assembleRows(renderStart, renderEnd);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private async fetchChunk(chunkIndex: number, loadId: number): Promise<void> {
    if (this.chunkCache.has(chunkIndex) || this.pendingChunks.has(chunkIndex)) return;
    this.pendingChunks.add(chunkIndex);
    try {
      const offset = chunkIndex * CHUNK_BYTES;
      const length = Math.min(CHUNK_BYTES, this.totalFileSize - offset);
      if (length <= 0) return;
      const resp = await fetch(this.streamUrl, {
        headers: { Range: `bytes=${offset}-${offset + length - 1}` },
      });
      if (!resp.ok && resp.status !== 206) throw new Error(`HTTP ${resp.status}`);
      const buf = await resp.arrayBuffer();
      if (this.loadId !== loadId) return;
      this.chunkCache.set(chunkIndex, new Uint8Array(buf));
    } finally {
      this.pendingChunks.delete(chunkIndex);
    }
  }

  /** Build rows from the chunk cache for a row range [startRow, endRow). */
  private assembleRows(startRow: number, endRow: number): BinaryRow[] {
    const dataStart = startRow * this.bytesPerRow;
    const dataEnd = Math.min(endRow * this.bytesPerRow, this.totalFileSize);
    const totalBytes = dataEnd - dataStart;
    if (totalBytes <= 0) return [];

    const combined = new Uint8Array(totalBytes); // zero-filled = '00' placeholder
    const firstChunk = Math.floor(dataStart / CHUNK_BYTES);
    const lastChunk = Math.floor((dataEnd - 1) / CHUNK_BYTES);

    for (let ci = firstChunk; ci <= lastChunk; ci++) {
      const chunk = this.chunkCache.get(ci);
      if (!chunk) continue;
      const chunkBase = ci * CHUNK_BYTES;
      const srcStart = Math.max(0, dataStart - chunkBase);
      const dstStart = Math.max(0, chunkBase - dataStart);
      const copyEnd = Math.min(chunkBase + chunk.length, dataEnd);
      const copyLen = copyEnd - Math.max(chunkBase, dataStart);
      if (copyLen > 0) combined.set(chunk.subarray(srcStart, srcStart + copyLen), dstStart);
    }

    return this.buildRows(combined, dataStart);
  }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ loading в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  private async reload(): Promise<void> {
    const path = (this.targetPath ?? '').trim();
    const currentLoad = ++this.loadId; // invalidate in-flight work

    this.error = '';
    this.info = null;
    this.memBytes = null;
    this.isRangeMode = false;
    this.streamUrl = '';
    this.chunkCache.clear();
    this.pendingChunks.clear();
    this.totalRows = 0;
    this.totalFileSize = 0;
    this.renderedStartRow = 0;
    this.renderedRows = [];

    if (!path && !this.archiveContext) {
      this.kind = 'empty';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.kind = 'loading';
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    try {
      if (this.archiveContext) {
        await this.loadFromArchive(this.archiveContext, currentLoad);
      } else {
        await this.loadFromDisk(path, currentLoad);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (currentLoad !== this.loadId) return;
      this.kind = 'error';
      this.error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  private async loadFromDisk(path: string, loadId: number): Promise<void> {
    const info = await this.api.getFileInfo(path);
    if (loadId !== this.loadId) return;
    this.info = info;

    if (info.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      this.kind = 'directory';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.totalFileSize = info.size;
    this.totalRows = Math.ceil(info.size / this.bytesPerRow);

    const url = await this.api.getStreamURL(path);
    if (loadId !== this.loadId) return;

    if (info.size <= MEMORY_THRESHOLD) {
      const resp = await fetch(url);
      if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${resp.status}: ${resp.statusText}`);
      const buf = await resp.arrayBuffer();
      if (loadId !== this.loadId) return;
      this.memBytes = new Uint8Array(buf);
      this.isRangeMode = false;
    } else {
      // Large file — use on-demand HTTP Range reads
      this.isRangeMode = true;
      this.streamUrl = url;
      // Pre-fetch the first chunk so the initial view renders immediately
      await this.fetchChunk(0, loadId);
      if (loadId !== this.loadId) return;
    }

    this.kind = 'grid';
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.scheduleUpdate();
  }

  private async loadFromArchive(ctx: ViewerArchiveContext, loadId: number): Promise<void> {
    const streamURL = await this.api.getArchiveStreamURL(ctx.fsPath, ctx.nestedChain, ctx.entryPath);
    const bytes = await this.api.fetchBytesFromURL(streamURL);
    if (loadId !== this.loadId) return;
    const size = bytes.byteLength;
    this.info = {
      name: this.baseName(ctx.entryPath), path: ctx.entryPath,
      type: FileType.FILE, size,
      created: 0, modified: 0, accessed: 0, permissions: '', isHidden: false,
    };
    this.totalFileSize = size;
    this.totalRows = Math.ceil(size / this.bytesPerRow);
    this.memBytes = bytes;
    this.isRangeMode = false;
    this.kind = 'grid';
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.scheduleUpdate();
  }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ helpers в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  private buildRows(bytes: Uint8Array, baseOffset: number): BinaryRow[] {
    const bpr = this.bytesPerRow;
    const rows: BinaryRow[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += bpr) {
      const offset = baseOffset + i;
      const slice = bytes.subarray(i, i + bpr);
      const cells: HexCell[] = Array.from(slice, v => ({
        hex: v.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(2, '0'),
        ascii: v >= 32 && v <= 126 ? String.fromCharCode(v) : '.',
        zero: v === 0,
        printable: v >= 32 && v <= 126,
      }));
      const offsetStr = this.offsetFormat === 'hex'
        ? offset.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(8, '0')
        : offset.toString(10).padStart(10, ' ');
      rows.push({ offsetStr, cells, ascii: cells.map(c => c.ascii).join('') });
    }
    return rows;
  }

  private baseName(path: string): string {
    return path.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').pop() || path;
  }

  private extractExt(path: string): string {
    const base = path.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').pop() || path;
    const idx = base.lastIndexOf('.');
    return idx >= 0 ? base.slice(idx + 1).toLowerCase() : '';
  }
}
````

````typescript
    }

    .meta-list {
      display: grid;

    }

    .meta-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 84px minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: start;
      font-size: 12px;

    .meta-label {
      color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-foreground, #ccc) 60%, transparent);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;

      .font-layout {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .font-hero {
        grid-column: auto;
      }
    }
  `],
})
export class FontViewerComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy {
  @Input() targetPath = '';
  @Input() archiveContext: ViewerArchiveContext | null = null;
  @Input() viewerId: string | null = null;
  @Input() probe: FileProbe | null = null;

  readonly previewSizes = PREVIEW_SIZES;
  readonly glyphRows = GLYPH_ROWS;

  kind: FontViewerKind = 'empty';
  info: FileInfo | null = null;
  error = '';
  previewSize = 72;
  sampleMode: SampleMode = 'sentence';
  fontStack = "var(--vsc-font-family, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif)";
  mimeLabel = '';

  private loadId = 0;
  private destroyed = false;
  private activeFontFace: FontFace | null = null;

  constructor(
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  get displayName(): string {
    return buildDisplayName(this.info, this.targetPath, this.archiveContext);
  }

  get displayPath(): string {
    if (this.archiveContext) {
      return `${this.archiveContext.fsPath} :: ${this.archiveContext.entryPath}`;
    }
    return this.targetPath;
  }

  get typeBadge(): string {
    const ext = extractExt(this.archiveContext?.entryPath ?? this.targetPath);
    if (ext) {
      return ext.toUpperCase();
    }
    const mime = (this.probe?.mimeType ?? '').split(';', 1)[0].trim().toLowerCase();
    if (mime.startsWith('font/')) {
      return mime.slice(5).toUpperCase();
    }
    return 'FONT';
  }

  get activeSample(): string {
    switch (this.sampleMode) {
      case 'alphabet':
        return 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';
      case 'symbols':
        return '0123456789 !@#$%^&*() []{} <>?/\\ +-=_';
      default:
        return 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog';
    }
  }

  get subtitleSample(): string {
    switch (this.sampleMode) {
      case 'alphabet':
        return 'Latin alphabet sample';
      case 'symbols':
        return 'Digits and punctuation sample';
      default:
        return 'Слава Україні • Ґґ Єє Її Іі • 1234567890';
    }
  }

  get glyphSize(): number {
    return Math.max(22, Math.round(this.previewSize * 0.42));
  }

  ngOnChanges(): void {
    void this.reload();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroyed = true;
    this.disposeFontFace();
  }

  setPreviewSize(size: number): void {
    this.previewSize = size;
  }

  setSampleMode(mode: SampleMode): void {
    this.sampleMode = mode;
  }

  formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    return formatSize(bytes);
  }

  private async reload(): Promise<void> {
    const path = (this.targetPath ?? '').trim();
    const currentLoad = ++this.loadId;

    this.disposeFontFace();
    this.error = '';
    this.info = null;
    this.mimeLabel = '';

    if (!path && !this.archiveContext) {
      this.kind = 'empty';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    this.kind = 'loading';
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    try {
      if (this.archiveContext) {
        await this.loadFromArchive(this.archiveContext, currentLoad);
      } else {
        await this.loadFromDisk(path, currentLoad);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (this.destroyed || currentLoad !== this.loadId) {
        return;
      }
      this.kind = 'error';
      this.error = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  private async loadFromDisk(path: string, loadId: number): Promise<void> {
    const info = await this.api.getFileInfo(path);
    if (this.destroyed || loadId !== this.loadId) {
      return;
    }

    this.info = info;
    if (info.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      this.kind = 'directory';
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const probe = this.probe ?? await this.api.probeFile(path).catch(() => null);
    if (this.destroyed || loadId !== this.loadId) {
      return;
    }

    this.mimeLabel = this.normalizeMime(probe?.mimeType);
    const streamURL = await this.api.getStreamURL(path);
    const bytes = await this.api.fetchBytesFromURL(streamURL);
    await this.installFont(bytes, baseName(path), loadId);
  }

  private async loadFromArchive(ctx: ViewerArchiveContext, loadId: number): Promise<void> {
    const probe = this.probe ?? await this.api.probeArchiveFile(ctx.fsPath, ctx.nestedChain, ctx.entryPath).catch(() => null);
    if (this.destroyed || loadId !== this.loadId) {
      return;
    }

    const streamURL = await this.api.getArchiveStreamURL(ctx.fsPath, ctx.nestedChain, ctx.entryPath);
    const bytes = await this.api.fetchBytesFromURL(streamURL);
    if (this.destroyed || loadId !== this.loadId) {
      return;
    }

    this.info = makeSyntheticInfo(baseName(ctx.entryPath), ctx.entryPath, bytes.byteLength);
    this.mimeLabel = this.normalizeMime(probe?.mimeType);
    await this.installFont(bytes, baseName(ctx.entryPath), loadId);
  }

  private async installFont(bytes: Uint8Array, sourceName: string, loadId: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!bytes.byteLength) {
      throw new Error('The selected font file is empty.');
    }

    const ext = extractExt(sourceName);
    if (ext && !FONT_EXTENSIONS.has(ext) && !this.mimeLabel.startsWith('font/')) {
      throw new Error('This file does not look like a supported font format.');
    }

    const family = `preview-font-${loadId}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
    const fontData = new Uint8Array(bytes.byteLength);
    fontData.set(bytes);
    const fontFace = new FontFace(family, fontData);
    await fontFace.load();

    if (this.destroyed || loadId !== this.loadId) {
      return;
    }

    this.getDocumentFonts().add(fontFace);
    this.activeFontFace = fontFace;
    this.fontStack = `'${family}', var(--vsc-font-family, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif)`;
    this.kind = 'ready';
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private disposeFontFace(): void {
    if (this.activeFontFace) {
      this.getDocumentFonts().delete(this.activeFontFace);
      this.activeFontFace = null;
    }
    this.fontStack = "var(--vsc-font-family, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif)";
  }

  private getDocumentFonts(): { add(face: FontFace): void; delete(face: FontFace): void } {
    return document.fonts as FontFaceSet & { add(face: FontFace): void; delete(face: FontFace): void };
  }

  private normalizeMime(mime: string | null | undefined): string {
    return (mime ?? '').split(';', 1)[0].trim().toLowerCase();
  }
}
````
