````typescript
import { SampleInfo } from '../../services/canvas-video-player.service';

/**
 * findPacketIndex tests — pure function for locating packets by timestamp
 */

// Export test utilities (these would be copy-pasted from segment-video-loader.ts for testing)
function findPacketIndex(packets: SampleInfo[], timeMs: number, requireKeyframe: boolean): number {
  let bestIndex = -1;
  
  if (requireKeyframe) {
    // Find the keyframe with timestamp <= timeMs (for backward seeks)
    for (let index = 0; index < packets.length; index += 1) {
      const packet = packets[index];
      if (packet.isRap && packet.timestampMs <= timeMs) {
        bestIndex = index;
      } else if (packet.timestampMs > timeMs && bestIndex >= 0) {
        break;
      }
    }
    
    if (bestIndex >= 0) {
      return bestIndex;
    }
    
    // If no keyframe before, find first keyframe
    return packets.findIndex(packet => packet.isRap);
  }
  
  // Regular forward seek - find first packet >= timeMs
  for (let index = 0; index < packets.length; index += 1) {
    if (packets[index].timestampMs >= timeMs) {
      return index;
    }
  }
  
  return packets.length > 0 ? packets.length - 1 : -1;
}

const mockPacket = (index: number, timestampMs: number, isRap: boolean): SampleInfo => ({
  index,
  timestampMs,
  durationMs: 33.33,
  isRap,
  data: new Uint8Array(0),
});

describe('findPacketIndex', () => {
  describe('forward seeks (requireKeyframe=false)', () => {
    it('should return -1 for empty packet list', () => {
      expect(findPacketIndex([], 500, false)).toBe(-1);
    });

    it('should return 0 for time before first packet', () => {
      const packets = [mockPacket(0, 100, true), mockPacket(1, 200, false)];
      expect(findPacketIndex(packets, 50, false)).toBe(0);
    });

    it('should find exact timestamp match', () => {
      const packets = [mockPacket(0, 100, true), mockPacket(1, 200, false), mockPacket(2, 300, true)];
      expect(findPacketIndex(packets, 200, false)).toBe(1);
    });

    it('should find first packet >= target time', () => {
      const packets = [mockPacket(0, 100, true), mockPacket(1, 200, false), mockPacket(2, 300, true)];
      // Target 150 should return packet at 200 (index 1)
      expect(findPacketIndex(packets, 150, false)).toBe(1);
    });

    it('should return last packet for time beyond all packets', () => {
      const packets = [mockPacket(0, 100, true), mockPacket(1, 200, false)];
      expect(findPacketIndex(packets, 500, false)).toBe(1);
    });

    it('should handle single packet', () => {
      const packets = [mockPacket(0, 100, true)];
      expect(findPacketIndex(packets, 150, false)).toBe(0);
    });
  });

  describe('backward seeks (requireKeyframe=true)', () => {
    it('should return -1 for empty packet list', () => {
      expect(findPacketIndex([], 500, true)).toBe(-1);
    });

    it('should find last keyframe <= target time', () => {
      const packets = [
        mockPacket(0, 100, true),
        mockPacket(1, 150, false),
        mockPacket(2, 200, true),
        mockPacket(3, 250, false),
        mockPacket(4, 300, true),

      // Seek to 250 should return keyframe at 200 (index 2)

    });

      const packets = [
        mockPacket(0, 100, true),
        mockPacket(1, 200, true),
        mockPacket(2, 300, true),
      ];
      expect(findPacketIndex(packets, 250, true)).toBe(1);
    });

    it('should handle no keyframes', () => {
      const packets = [
        mockPacket(0, 100, false),
        mockPacket(1, 200, false),

    });

    it('should return exact keyframe match', () => {
      const packets = [

        mockPacket(1, 150, false),
        mockPacket(2, 200, true),

        mockPacket(4, 200, true),

      // Seeking to 165 should return keyframe at 100, not 200
      expect(findPacketIndex(packets, 165, true)).toBe(0);
    });

/**
 * collectPackets simulation tests
 */
describe('collectPackets pattern', () => {
  it('should preserve packet offsets when collecting', () => {
    const source: SampleInfo[] = [
      mockPacket(0, 0, true),
      mockPacket(1, 33, false),
      mockPacket(2, 66, true),
    ];

    const collected: SampleInfo[] = [];
    let cursor: SampleInfo | null = source[0];
    const timeOffsetMs = 1000;

    while (cursor) {
      collected.push({
        ...cursor,
        timestampMs: cursor.timestampMs + timeOffsetMs,
      });
      const nextIndex: number = source.indexOf(cursor) + 1;
      cursor = nextIndex < source.length ? source[nextIndex] : null;
    }

    // Verify offset was applied
    expect(collected[0].timestampMs).toBe(1000);
    expect(collected[1].timestampMs).toBe(1033);
    expect(collected[2].timestampMs).toBe(1066);
  });
});

/**
 * Segment index calculation tests
 */
describe('segment timing calculations', () => {
  const SEGMENT_DURATION = 2.0; // seconds

  function findSegmentIndex(timeMs: number, totalSegments: number, segmentDuration = SEGMENT_DURATION): number {
    for (let index = 0; index < totalSegments; index += 1) {
      const startMs = Math.round(index * segmentDuration * 1000);
      const endMs = startMs + Math.round(segmentDuration * 1000);
      if (timeMs < endMs) {
        return index;
      }
    }
    return Math.max(0, totalSegments - 1);
  }

  it('should find correct segment for times within range', () => {
    const totalSegments = 10;
    expect(findSegmentIndex(0, totalSegments)).toBe(0);
    expect(findSegmentIndex(1000, totalSegments)).toBe(0);
    expect(findSegmentIndex(2000, totalSegments)).toBe(1);
    expect(findSegmentIndex(4000, totalSegments)).toBe(2);
  });

  it('should return last segment for times beyond duration', () => {
    const totalSegments = 10;
    const duration = totalSegments * SEGMENT_DURATION * 1000; // 20 seconds in ms
    expect(findSegmentIndex(duration + 1000, totalSegments)).toBe(totalSegments - 1);
  });

  it('should handle boundary between segments', () => {
    const totalSegments = 5;
    // Boundary is at 2000ms
    expect(findSegmentIndex(1999, totalSegments)).toBe(0);
    expect(findSegmentIndex(2000, totalSegments)).toBe(1);
    expect(findSegmentIndex(2001, totalSegments)).toBe(1);
  });
});

/**
 * Backward vs forward seek parity tests
 */
describe('backward vs forward seek consistency', () => {
  it('seeking backward then forward to same time should find same packet', () => {
    const packets = [
      mockPacket(0, 0, true),
      mockPacket(1, 100, false),
      mockPacket(2, 200, true),
      mockPacket(3, 300, false),
      mockPacket(4, 400, true),
    ];

    // Forward seek to 250: should find packet at 300 (index 3)
    const forwardIndex = findPacketIndex(packets, 250, false);
    // Backward seek to 250: should find keyframe at 200 (index 2)
    const backwardIndex = findPacketIndex(packets, 250, true);

    // They're different (forward finds next, backward finds last keyframe)
    // but both should be valid
    expect(forwardIndex).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(backwardIndex).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
    expect(packets[forwardIndex].timestampMs).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(250);
    expect(packets[backwardIndex].timestampMs).toBeLessThanOrEqual(250);
  });

  it('backward seek should not skip to future keyframes', () => {
    const packets = [
      mockPacket(0, 0, true),
      mockPacket(1, 100, false),
      mockPacket(2, 200, false),
      mockPacket(3, 300, true),
      mockPacket(4, 400, false),
    ];

    // Seeking backward to 250 should find keyframe at 0, not 300
    const index = findPacketIndex(packets, 250, true);
    expect(packets[index].timestampMs).toBeLessThanOrEqual(250);
  });
});
````

````html
  <script>
    (function () {
      var html = document.documentElement;
      var appearance = {};
      try {
        var raw = localStorage.getItem('app-appearance-v1');
        if (raw) appearance = JSON.parse(raw) || {};
      } catch (_) {}

      var theme = appearance.theme;
      var legacyTheme;
      try { legacyTheme = localStorage.getItem('app-theme'); } catch (_) {}
      if (theme !== 'dark' && theme !== 'light' && theme !== 'system') {
        theme = legacyTheme === 'dark' || legacyTheme === 'light' || legacyTheme === 'system' ? legacyTheme : 'system';
      }
      var prefersLight = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)').matches;
      var dark = theme === 'dark' || (theme === 'system' && !prefersLight);
      html.classList.add(dark ? 'vscode-dark' : 'vscode-light');
      html.style.background = dark ? '#1e1e1e' : '#ffffff';

      var compact;
      try { compact = appearance.compactMode === true || localStorage.getItem('app-compact') === '1'; } catch (_) {}
      if (compact) html.classList.add('compact-mode');

      var accent = typeof appearance.accentColor === 'string' ? appearance.accentColor.trim() : '';
      if (/^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6})$/.test(accent)) {
````

````scss
  background: var(--vsc-editor-background);
  color: var(--vsc-foreground);
  /* Native OS text rendering (ClearType on Windows, subpixel on macOS)
     gives sharper small text than forced grayscale anti-aliasing. */
}

code, pre {
  font-family: var(--vsc-font-family-mono);
}

/* VS Code-style pane scrollbars use an overlay thumb instead of the browser's
   native scrollbar chrome. Apply through the shared directive so pane scroll
   hosts stay DRY and visually consistent. */
.vsc-scroll-host {
  position: relative;
  scrollbar-width: none !important;
  -ms-overflow-style: none;
}

.vsc-scroll-anchor {
  position: relative;
}

.vsc-scroll-host::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 0 !important;
  height: 0 !important;
}

.vsc-scrollbar {
  position: absolute;
  width: 12px;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity var(--vsc-transition-fast, 0.1s ease);
  z-index: 3;
}

.vsc-scroll-anchor--hover > .vsc-scrollbar,
.vsc-scroll-anchor--visible > .vsc-scrollbar,
.vsc-scroll-anchor--dragging > .vsc-scrollbar {
  opacity: 1;
}

.vsc-scrollbar-thumb {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: 12px;
  min-height: 20px;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: var(--vsc-scrollbar-thumb);
  pointer-events: auto;
  transition: background-color var(--vsc-transition-fast, 0.1s ease);
}

.vsc-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: var(--vsc-scrollbar-thumb-hover);
}

.vsc-scroll-anchor--dragging .vsc-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--vsc-scrollbar-thumb-active, var(--vsc-scrollbar-thumb-hover));
}

/* === Focus Outline === */
:focus {
  outline: 1px solid var(--vsc-input-focus-border);
  outline-offset: -1px;
}

:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
  outline: none;
}

/* === Selection === */
::selection {
  background: var(--vsc-list-active-background);
  color: var(--vsc-list-active-foreground);
}

/* === Links === */
a {
  color: var(--vsc-text-link);
  text-decoration: none;
}

a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* === Buttons (VS Code Style) === */
button, .btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--vsc-padding-sm);
  padding: var(--vsc-padding-sm) var(--vsc-padding-md);
  background: var(--vsc-button-background);
  color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
  font-family: var(--vsc-font-family);
  font-size: var(--vsc-font-size);
  line-height: 1;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--vsc-transition-fast);
  
  &:hover:not(:disabled) {
    background: var(--vsc-button-hover);
  }
  
  &:active:not(:disabled) {
    transform: translateY(1px);
  }
  
  &:disabled {
    opacity: 0.5;
    cursor: not-allowed;
  }
  
  &.secondary {
    background: var(--vsc-button-secondary);
    
    &:hover:not(:disabled) {
      background: var(--vsc-button-secondary-hover);
    }
  }
  
  &.icon-only {
    padding: var(--vsc-padding-sm);
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
  }
}

/* === Input Fields (VS Code Style) === */
input[type="text"],
input[type="search"],
input[type="number"],
textarea {
  padding: var(--vsc-padding-sm) var(--vsc-padding-md);
  background: var(--vsc-input-background);
  color: var(--vsc-input-foreground);
  border: 1px solid var(--vsc-input-border);
  border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
  font-family: var(--vsc-font-family);
  font-size: var(--vsc-font-size);
  transition: border-color var(--vsc-transition-fast);
  
  &::placeholder {
    color: var(--vsc-input-placeholder);
  }
  
  &:focus {
    border-color: var(--vsc-input-focus-border);
    outline: none;
  }
}

/* === Badges === */
.badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: var(--vsc-padding-xs) var(--vsc-padding-sm);
  background: var(--vsc-badge-background);
  color: var(--vsc-badge-foreground);
  border-radius: 11px;
  font-size: var(--vsc-font-size-small);
  font-weight: 600;
  min-width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
}

/* === Kbd Styling === */
kbd {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: var(--vsc-padding-xs) var(--vsc-padding-sm);
  background: var(--vsc-input-background);
  border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border);
  border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
  font-family: var(--vsc-font-family-mono);
  font-size: var(--vsc-font-size-small);
  color: var(--vsc-foreground);
}

/* === Loading Spinner === */
@keyframes spin {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

.spinner {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border: 2px solid var(--vsc-border);
  border-top-color: var(--vsc-accent-blue);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
}

/* === Utility Classes === */
.text-muted {
  color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
}

.text-error {
  color: var(--vsc-error);
}

.text-warning {
  color: var(--vsc-warning);
}

.text-success {
  color: var(--vsc-success);
}

.text-mono {
  font-family: var(--vsc-font-family-mono);
}

/* === Compact Mode Adjustments === */
.compact-mode button,
.compact-mode .btn {
  padding: var(--vsc-padding-xs) var(--vsc-padding-sm);
  font-size: var(--vsc-font-size-small);
}

.compact-mode input,
.compact-mode textarea {
  padding: var(--vsc-padding-xs) var(--vsc-padding-sm);
  font-size: var(--vsc-font-size-small);
}
````

````go
func buildFixedSegmentRanges(durationSeconds float64) []segmentedVideoRange {
	totalSegments := int(durationSeconds / segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds)
	if durationSeconds > float64(totalSegments)*segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds {
		totalSegments++
	}
	if totalSegments <= 0 {
		totalSegments = 1
	}

	ranges := make([]segmentedVideoRange, 0, totalSegments)
	for index := 0; index < totalSegments; index++ {
		startSeconds := float64(index) * segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds
		segmentDuration := segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds
		if remaining := durationSeconds - startSeconds; remaining > 0 && remaining < segmentDuration {
			segmentDuration = remaining
		}
		if segmentDuration <= 0 {
			segmentDuration = segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds
		}

		ranges = append(ranges, segmentedVideoRange{
			StartSeconds:    startSeconds,
			DurationSeconds: segmentDuration,
		})
	}

	return ranges
}

func buildKeyframeAlignedSegmentRanges(ctx context.Context, nativePath string, durationSeconds float64) ([]segmentedVideoRange, error) {
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s", astiavUnavailableMessage)
}

func buildSegmentRangesFromKeyframes(keyframes []float64, durationSeconds float64) []segmentedVideoRange {
	if durationSeconds <= 0 {
		return buildFixedSegmentRanges(durationSeconds)
	}

	starts := make([]float64, 0, len(keyframes)+1)
	starts = append(starts, 0)
	for _, keyframeTime := range keyframes {
		if keyframeTime <= 0.001 || keyframeTime >= durationSeconds-0.001 {
			continue
		}
		if keyframeTime-starts[len(starts)-1] <= 0.001 {
			continue
		}
		starts = append(starts, keyframeTime)
	}

	ranges := make([]segmentedVideoRange, 0, len(starts))
	for index, startSeconds := range starts {
		endSeconds := durationSeconds
		if index+1 < len(starts) {
			endSeconds = starts[index+1]
		}
		segmentDuration := endSeconds - startSeconds
		if segmentDuration <= 0.001 {
			continue
		}

		ranges = append(ranges, segmentedVideoRange{
			StartSeconds:    startSeconds,
			DurationSeconds: segmentDuration,
		})
	}

	if len(ranges) == 0 {
		return buildFixedSegmentRanges(durationSeconds)
	}

	return ranges
}

func collectVideoKeyframeTimes(ctx context.Context, nativePath string) ([]float64, error) {
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s", astiavUnavailableMessage)
}

func estimateMediaDurationSeconds(ctx context.Context, nativePath string) (float64, error) {
	return 0, fmt.Errorf("%s", astiavUnavailableMessage)
}

func buildSegmentedVideoFragment(ctx context.Context, nativePath string, startSeconds float64, durationSeconds float64) ([]byte, []byte, error) {
	return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("%s", astiavUnavailableMessage)
}
````

````go
package app

import (
	"io"

	internalruntime "wails-app/internal/runtime"
	vfslib "wails-app/vfs"

func TestStateCopyBatchPathRejectsArchivePathsWhenNotMounted(t *testing.T) {
	// This test verifies that batch copy properly rejects archive paths
	// if they're not mounted in the VFS.
	// Archive entries must be extracted using the Archive service, not batch copy.

	memoryRoot := t.TempDir()
	resetMemoryResolverForTest(t, memoryRoot)

	memoryFS, err := getMemoryFS()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("getMemoryFS returned error: %v", err)
	}

	vfs, err := internalruntime.InitVFS(memoryFS)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("InitVFS returned error: %v", err)
	}

	state := &State{vfs: vfs}
	destNative := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "archive_copy.txt")
	destPublic := pathref.FromNativePath(destNative)

	// Try to copy from an archive path that's not accessible
	archivePath := "archive:///path/to/file.zip/entry.txt"
	streamToFile := func(reader io.Reader, destination string, _ int64, _ string) (int64, error) {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destination), 0o755); err != nil {
			return 0, err
		}
		file, err := os.Create(destination)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, err
		}
		defer file.Close()
		return io.Copy(file, reader)
	}

	err = state.copyBatchPath(archivePath, destPublic, false, streamToFile)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("copyBatchPath should have returned an error for archive path")
	}

	// Error should indicate source is not a mounted virtual path
	t.Logf("Expected error received: %v", err)
}

func TestStateCopyBatchPathWithMountedSource(t *testing.T) {
	// This test verifies that batch copy works correctly with VFS-mounted sources
	memoryRoot := t.TempDir()
	resetMemoryResolverForTest(t, memoryRoot)

	memoryFS, err := getMemoryFS()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("getMemoryFS returned error: %v", err)
	}

	vfs, err := internalruntime.InitVFS(memoryFS)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("InitVFS returned error: %v", err)
	}

	// Mount a VFS: this simulates a remote file source
	if _, err := vfs.Mount("/mnt/source", memoryFS, false, "Source Mount", vfslib.VolumeRemote); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("mount source fs: %v", err)
	}

	// Create a file in the mounted source
	sourcePath, err := resolveMemoryAlias("memory://mounted/file.txt")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolve memory source path: %v", err)
	}
	const content = "batch copy test content"
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(sourcePath), 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create source dir: %v", err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(sourcePath, []byte(content), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("write source file: %v", err)
	}

	state := &State{vfs: vfs}
	destNative := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "downloaded.txt")
	destPublic := pathref.FromNativePath(destNative)

	streamToFile := func(reader io.Reader, destination string, _ int64, _ string) (int64, error) {
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(destination), 0o755); err != nil {
			return 0, err
		}
		file, err := os.Create(destination)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, err
		}
		defer file.Close()
		return io.Copy(file, reader)
	}

	// This should work with the mounted source
	mountedSourcePath := "/mnt/source/mounted/file.txt"
	if err := state.copyBatchPath(mountedSourcePath, destPublic, false, streamToFile); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("copyBatchPath returned error: %v", err)
	}

	data, err := os.ReadFile(destNative)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read destination: %v", err)
	}
	if string(data) != content {
		t.Fatalf("destination content mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", content, string(data))
	}
}

func TestBatchCopyArchivesUsesCorrectService(t *testing.T) {
	// This test documents the CORRECT usage pattern:
	// Archive entries should NOT be copied via BatchCopy.
	// They must use ArchiveCopyEntries from the Archive service instead.

	// Expected flow:
	// 1. Frontend detects archive selection via getTreeArchiveSelectionContext()
	// 2. Frontend calls archiveService.copyByContext() instead of apiService.batchCopy()
	// 3. Backend uses ArchiveCopyEntries() which calls ExtractEntries()

	t.Logf("Archive copying flow:")
	t.Logf("- Frontend: archiveService.copyByContext(archivePath, innerPaths, destDir)")
	t.Logf("- Backend: App.ArchiveCopyEntries(req) → Archive.CopyEntries()")
	t.Logf("- Should NOT use: BatchCopy() or batch_copy.go functions")
	t.Logf("")
	t.Logf("Regular file copying flow:")
	t.Logf("- Frontend: apiService.batchCopy(items, recursive)")
	t.Logf("- Backend: App.BatchCopy(req) → Batch.BatchCopy()")
	t.Logf("- Uses: batch/service.go and batch_copy.go functions")
}
````

## File: internal/app/batch_copy.go
````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	pathpkg "path"
	"strings"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	internalruntime "wails-app/internal/runtime"
)

func (s *State) handlesBatchVFSPath(path string) bool {
	if s.vfs == nil {
		return false
	}
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if pathref.IsAlias(normalized) {
		return s.vfs.IsMounted(pathref.ToVFS(normalized))
	}
	return s.vfs.IsMounted(normalized)
}

func (s *State) copyBatchPath(
	source string,
	destination string,
	recursive bool,
	streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error),
) error {
	source = pathref.Normalize(source)
	destination = pathref.Normalize(destination)
	if pathref.IsWeb(source) {
		return s.copyBatchWebPath(source, destination, recursive, streamToFile)
	}

	if s.vfs == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("virtual filesystem is not available")
	}

	if !s.handlesBatchVFSPath(source) {
		return fmt.Errorf("source is not a mounted virtual path")
	}

	info, err := internalruntime.VFSGetFileInfo(context.Background(), s.vfs, source)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	ctx := context.Background()
	if info.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
		if !recursive {
			return fmt.Errorf("source is a directory; use recursive=true")
		}
		return s.copyBatchVFSDirectory(ctx, source, destination, streamToFile)
	}

	return s.copyBatchVFSFile(ctx, source, destination, info, streamToFile)
}

func (s *State) copyBatchWebPath(
	source string,
	destination string,
	recursive bool,
	streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error),
) error {
	if s.Filesystem == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("filesystem service is not available")
	}

	info, err := s.GetFileInfo(source)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	ctx := context.Background()
	if info.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
		if !recursive {
			return fmt.Errorf("source is a directory; use recursive=true")
		}
		return s.copyBatchWebDirectory(ctx, source, destination, streamToFile)
	}

	return s.copyBatchWebFile(ctx, source, destination, info, streamToFile)
}

func (s *State) copyBatchWebDirectory(
	ctx context.Context,
	source string,
	destination string,
	streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error),
) error {
	if err := s.ensureBatchDestinationDir(ctx, destination); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	listing, err := s.ListDirectory(source, false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	for _, entry := range listing.Entries {
		childDestination := joinBatchPath(destination, entry.Name)
		if entry.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
			if err := s.copyBatchWebDirectory(ctx, entry.Path, childDestination, streamToFile); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			continue
		}

		entryCopy := entry
		if err := s.copyBatchWebFile(ctx, entry.Path, childDestination, &entryCopy, streamToFile); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func (s *State) copyBatchWebFile(
	ctx context.Context,
	source string,
	destination string,
	info *contracts.FileInfo,
	streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error),
) error {
	reader, err := openBatchWebReader(ctx, source)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	if s.handlesBatchVFSPath(destination) {
		return s.writeBatchVFSFile(ctx, destination, reader)
	}

	if streamToFile == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("stream copy callback is not available")
	}

	_, err = streamToFile(reader, pathref.ToNativePath(destination), info.Size, info.Name)
	return err
}

func openBatchWebReader(ctx context.Context, source string) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, pathref.Normalize(source), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Accept", "*/*")
	req.Header.Set("User-Agent", "WailsFileManager/1.0")

	resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if resp.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || resp.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		defer resp.Body.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("request failed: HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}

	return resp.Body, nil
}

func (s *State) copyBatchVFSDirectory(
	ctx context.Context,
	source string,
	destination string,
	streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error),
) error {
	if err := s.ensureBatchDestinationDir(ctx, destination); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	listing, err := internalruntime.VFSListDir(context.Background(), s.vfs, source)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	for _, entry := range listing.Entries {
		childDestination := joinBatchPath(destination, entry.Name)
		if entry.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
			if err := s.copyBatchVFSDirectory(ctx, entry.Path, childDestination, streamToFile); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			continue
		}

		entryCopy := entry
		if err := s.copyBatchVFSFile(ctx, entry.Path, childDestination, &entryCopy, streamToFile); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func (s *State) copyBatchVFSFile(
	ctx context.Context,
	source string,
	destination string,
	info *contracts.FileInfo,
	streamToFile func(io.Reader, string, int64, string) (int64, error),
) error {
	reader, err := s.vfs.Open(ctx, pathref.ToVFS(source))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	if s.handlesBatchVFSPath(destination) {
		return s.writeBatchVFSFile(ctx, destination, reader)
	}

	if streamToFile == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("stream copy callback is not available")
	}

	_, err = streamToFile(reader, pathref.ToNativePath(destination), info.Size, info.Name)
	return err
}

func (s *State) writeBatchVFSFile(ctx context.Context, destination string, reader io.Reader) error {
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(destination)
	if err := s.ensureVFSDir(ctx, pathpkg.Dir(internalPath)); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	file, err := s.vfs.Create(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	if _, err := io.Copy(file, reader); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return file.Sync()
}

func (s *State) ensureBatchDestinationDir(ctx context.Context, destination string) error {
	if s.handlesBatchVFSPath(destination) {
		return s.ensureVFSDir(ctx, pathref.ToVFS(destination))
	}
	return os.MkdirAll(pathref.ToNativePath(destination), 0o755)
}

func (s *State) ensureVFSDir(ctx context.Context, internalPath string) error {
	clean := cleanBatchVFSPath(internalPath)
	if clean == "/" || clean == "." {
		return nil
	}
	if s.vfs.Exists(ctx, clean) {
		return nil
	}

	parent := pathpkg.Dir(clean)
	if parent != clean {
		if err := s.ensureVFSDir(ctx, parent); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	if err := s.vfs.Mkdir(ctx, clean, 0o755); err != nil && !s.vfs.Exists(ctx, clean) {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func cleanBatchVFSPath(path string) string {
	normalized := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
	if normalized == "" {
		return "/"
	}
	return pathpkg.Clean("/" + strings.TrimPrefix(normalized, "/"))
}

func joinBatchPath(base string, child string) string {
	trimmedBase := strings.TrimRight(pathref.Normalize(base), "/")
	trimmedChild := strings.TrimLeft(strings.ReplaceAll(child, "\\", "/"), "/")
	if trimmedChild == "" {
		return trimmedBase
	}
	return pathref.Normalize(trimmedBase + "/" + trimmedChild)
}
````

````go
func (a *App) BatchExtract(req contracts.BatchExtractRequest) (*contracts.BatchExtractResult, error) {
	req.DestinationDir = pathref.ToNativePath(req.DestinationDir)
	for i, arch := range req.Archives {
		req.Archives[i] = pathref.ToNativePath(arch)
	}
	return a.Batch.BatchExtract(req)
}

func (a *App) BatchSelectiveExtract(req contracts.BatchSelectiveExtractRequest) (*contracts.BatchSelectiveExtractResult, error) {
	req.DestinationDir = pathref.ToNativePath(req.DestinationDir)
	for i, item := range req.Items {
		req.Items[i].ArchivePath = pathref.ToNativePath(item.ArchivePath)
		if item.DestinationDir != "" {
			req.Items[i].DestinationDir = pathref.ToNativePath(item.DestinationDir)
		}
	}
	return a.Batch.BatchSelectiveExtract(req)
}
````

````go
package app

import (
	"fmt"

	pluginpackage "wails-app/internal/pluginpackage"
)

// ReadPluginFrontendModule returns the constrained declarative frontend module
// for a discovered package. It never evaluates code and never accepts arbitrary paths.
func (a *App) ReadPluginFrontendModule(pluginID string) (pluginpackage.FrontendModule, error) {
	root, err := a.GetPluginDirectory()
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.FrontendModule{}, err
	}
	packages, err := pluginpackage.Discover(root)
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.FrontendModule{}, err
	}
	for _, pkg := range packages {
		if pkg.Manifest.ID == pluginID {
			return pluginpackage.ReadFrontendModule(root, pkg)
		}
	}
	return pluginpackage.FrontendModule{}, fmt.Errorf("plugin %s is not installed", pluginID)
}
````

````go
package app

import (
	"context"

	"wails-app/internal/plugin"
)

// ListPlugins returns metadata for all registered plugins.
func (a *App) ListPlugins() []plugin.Info {
	if a.State == nil || a.State.PluginRegistry == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return a.State.PluginRegistry.List()
}

// GetPlugin returns metadata for a single plugin by ID.
func (a *App) GetPlugin(id string) *plugin.Info {
	if a.State == nil || a.State.PluginRegistry == nil {
		return nil
	}
	p := a.State.PluginRegistry.Get(id)
	if p == nil {
		return nil
	}
	info := p.Info()
	return &info
}

// InvokePluginCommand executes a command exposed by a plugin.
func (a *App) InvokePluginCommand(pluginID, commandID string, paths []string) error {
	if a.State == nil || a.State.PluginRegistry == nil {
		return nil
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	return a.State.PluginRegistry.InvokeCommand(ctx, pluginID, commandID, paths)
}
````

````go
func TestRawFilesystemCopyBetweenDiskAndMemory(t *testing.T) {

	}

	memoryDest, err := resolveMemoryAlias("memory://inbox/source.txt")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolve memory destination: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := rawFilesystemOps.CopyFile(source, memoryDest, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("copy disk -> memory: %v", err)

	memoryBytes, err := os.ReadFile(memoryDest)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read memory destination: %v", err)
	}
	if string(memoryBytes) != content {

	}

	diskDest := filepath.Join(diskRoot, "roundtrip.txt")
	if _, err := rawFilesystemOps.CopyFile(memoryDest, diskDest, false); err != nil {

	if string(roundtripBytes) != content {
		t.Fatalf("roundtrip content mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", content, string(roundtripBytes))
	}
}

func TestBatchMoveFromMemoryToDriveOverwriteUsesResolvedPath(t *testing.T) {
	memoryRoot := t.TempDir()
	resetMemoryResolverForTest(t, memoryRoot)

	sourcePublicPath := "memory://move-source.txt"
	sourceNativePath, err := resolveMemoryAlias(sourcePublicPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("resolve memory source path: %v", err)
	}
	const sourceContent = "updated-from-memory"
	if err := os.WriteFile(sourceNativePath, []byte(sourceContent), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("write memory source file: %v", err)
	}

	diskRoot := t.TempDir()
	destinationNativePath := filepath.Join(diskRoot, "move-source.txt")
	const oldContent = "existing-destination-content"
	if err := os.WriteFile(destinationNativePath, []byte(oldContent), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("write existing destination file: %v", err)
	}
	destinationPublicPath := pathref.FromNativePath(destinationNativePath)

	manager := internalops.NewManager()
	var service *internalbatch.Service
	service = internalbatch.NewService(internalbatch.ServiceConfig{
		StartOperation: manager.StartOperation,
		ConflictPrompter: internalbatch.ConflictPrompterFunc(func(event contracts.ConflictEvent) {
			service.ResolveConflict(event.ConflictID, contracts.ConflictOverwrite, false)
		}),
		BatchErr: func(source, destination string, err error) contracts.BatchItemError {
			return contracts.BatchItemError{
				Source:      source,
				Destination: destination,
				Error:       err.Error(),
				Code:        contracts.ClassifyError(err),
			}
		},
		IsPermissionDenied:             func(error) bool { return false },
		ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation: func(error) bool { return false },
		RunElevatedCopy:                func(src, dst string, recursive bool) (bool, error) { return false, nil },
		RunElevatedMove:                func(src, dst string) (bool, error) { return false, nil },
		RunElevatedDelete:              func(path string, recursive bool, useTrash *bool) (bool, error) { return false, nil },
		MoveToTrash:                    func(path string) error { return nil },
		CalculateSize:                  internalops.CalculateSize,
		ResolvePath:                    resolveMemoryAlias,
		ToPublicPath:                   toPublicMemoryPath,
	})

	result, err := service.BatchMove(contracts.BatchRequest{
		Items: []contracts.BatchItem{{
			Source:      sourcePublicPath,
			Destination: destinationPublicPath,
		}},
		Recursive: true,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("batch move memory -> drive overwrite returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Failed != 0 || result.Succeeded != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected memory -> drive overwrite move result: %+v", result)
	}

	destinationBytes, err := os.ReadFile(destinationNativePath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read overwritten destination file: %v", err)
	}
	if string(destinationBytes) != sourceContent {
		t.Fatalf("overwritten destination content mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", sourceContent, string(destinationBytes))
	}

	if _, err := os.Stat(sourceNativePath); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Fatalf("expected memory source to be removed after move, stat err=%v", err)
	}
}
````

````go
package app

import (
	internalarchive "wails-app/internal/archive"
	internalconverter "wails-app/internal/converter"
	internalnav "wails-app/internal/navigation"
	internalops "wails-app/internal/ops"
	internalworkspace "wails-app/internal/workspace"
	"wails-app/internal/plugin"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive/cache"
)

type Core struct {
	WorkspaceManager  *internalworkspace.Manager
	NavigationManager *internalnav.Manager
	Operations        *internalops.Manager
	ArchiveCache      *cache.Cache
	Converter         *internalconverter.Service
	OfficeConverter   *internalconverter.OfficeService
	PluginRegistry    *plugin.Registry
}

func NewCore() (*Core, error) {
	workspaceManager, err := internalworkspace.NewManager()
	if err != nil {
		workspaceManager = internalworkspace.NewTransientManager()
	}

	return &Core{
		WorkspaceManager:  workspaceManager,
		NavigationManager: internalnav.NewManager(),
		Operations:        internalops.NewManager(),
		Converter:         internalconverter.NewService(),
		OfficeConverter:   internalconverter.NewOfficeService(),
		ArchiveCache:      cache.New(internalarchive.ResolveChain),
		PluginRegistry:    plugin.NewRegistry(),
	}, err
}
````

````go
package app

import "context"

func (s *State) Startup(ctx context.Context) {
	if s.Runtime != nil {
		s.Runtime.Startup(ctx)
	}
}

func (s *State) Shutdown() {
	s.shutdownRemoteOAuthSessions()
	if s.Runtime != nil {
		s.Runtime.Shutdown()
	}
}

func (s *State) EmitEvent(name string, data interface{}) {
	if s.Runtime != nil {

	}
}
````

````go
package app

import (
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func TestBuildRemoteOAuthAuthURLGoogle(t *testing.T) {
	session := &remoteOAuthSession{
		protocol:     contracts.ProtocolGDrive,
		clientID:     "google-client",
		redirectURI:  "http://127.0.0.1:32123/oauth/callback",
		state:        "state-123",
		codeVerifier: "verifier-123",
		scopes:       []string{"https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly"},
	}

	rawURL, err := buildRemoteOAuthAuthURL(session)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("buildRemoteOAuthAuthURL() error = %v", err)
	}

	parsed, err := url.Parse(rawURL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("url.Parse() error = %v", err)
	}

	if parsed.Host != "accounts.google.com" {
		t.Fatalf("host = %q, want accounts.google.com", parsed.Host)
	}

	query := parsed.Query()
	if got := query.Get("client_id"); got != "google-client" {
		t.Fatalf("client_id = %q, want google-client", got)
	}
	if got := query.Get("redirect_uri"); got != session.redirectURI {
		t.Fatalf("redirect_uri = %q, want %q", got, session.redirectURI)
	}
	if got := query.Get("code_challenge_method"); got != "S256" {
		t.Fatalf("code_challenge_method = %q, want S256", got)
	}
	if got := query.Get("access_type"); got != "offline" {
		t.Fatalf("access_type = %q, want offline", got)
	}
	if got := query.Get("prompt"); got != "consent" {
		t.Fatalf("prompt = %q, want consent", got)
	}
	if got := query.Get("scope"); !strings.Contains(got, "drive.readonly") {
		t.Fatalf("scope = %q, want drive.readonly", got)
	}
}

func TestRemoteOAuthProviderOneDriveDefaultsTenant(t *testing.T) {
	config := remoteOAuthProvider(contracts.ProtocolOneDrive, "")
	if !strings.Contains(config.authURL, "/common/") {
		t.Fatalf("authURL = %q, want /common/", config.authURL)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(config.tokenURL, "/common/") {
		t.Fatalf("tokenURL = %q, want /common/", config.tokenURL)
	}
}

func TestNormalizeRemoteOAuthScopesUsesDefaults(t *testing.T) {
	scopes := normalizeRemoteOAuthScopes(contracts.ProtocolDropbox, nil)
	if len(scopes) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("expected default scopes")
	}
	if scopes[0] != "files.metadata.read" {
		t.Fatalf("first scope = %q, want files.metadata.read", scopes[0])
	}
}
````

````go
package app

import (
	"testing"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

func TestRemoteMountPathUsesCloudProviderRoots(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		cfg  contracts.RemoteConfig
		want string
	}{
		{
			name: "gdrive",
			cfg: contracts.RemoteConfig{
				Protocol: contracts.ProtocolGDrive,
				Name:     "team-drive",
			},
			want: "/remote/gdrive/team-drive",
		},
		{
			name: "dropbox",
			cfg: contracts.RemoteConfig{
				Protocol: contracts.ProtocolDropbox,
				Name:     "shared-workspace",
			},
			want: "/remote/dropbox/shared-workspace",
		},
		{
			name: "onedrive",
			cfg: contracts.RemoteConfig{
				Protocol: contracts.ProtocolOneDrive,
				Name:     "personal",
			},
			want: "/remote/onedrive/personal",
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			got := remoteMountPath(tt.cfg)
			if got != tt.want {
				t.Fatalf("remoteMountPath() mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", tt.want, got)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestRemoteDisplayNameUsesProviderDefaults(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		cfg  contracts.RemoteConfig
		want string
	}{
		{name: "gdrive", cfg: contracts.RemoteConfig{Protocol: contracts.ProtocolGDrive}, want: "Google Drive"},
		{name: "dropbox", cfg: contracts.RemoteConfig{Protocol: contracts.ProtocolDropbox}, want: "Dropbox"},
		{name: "onedrive", cfg: contracts.RemoteConfig{Protocol: contracts.ProtocolOneDrive}, want: "OneDrive"},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			got := remoteDisplayName(tt.cfg)
			if got != tt.want {
				t.Fatalf("remoteDisplayName() mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", tt.want, got)
			}
		})
	}
}
````

````go
package app

)

const streamPath = "/wails-stream"

const defaultPreviewWindowSeconds = 90.0

const defaultThumbnailSize = 256

const defaultVideoFramePreviewSeconds = 1.0

const remoteHTMLRewriteLimit = 8 * 1024 * 1024

var remoteStreamClient = &http.Client{}

// NewUnifiedHandler creates a server that handles:
// - Video streaming via /wails-stream (legacy)
// - Archive entry streaming (legacy)
// - Range requests for seeking
func NewUnifiedHandler(app *App, archCache *cache.Cache) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		// Handle OPTIONS requests for CORS
		if r.Method == http.MethodOptions {
			setCORSHeaders(w)
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
			return
		}

		// Route to legacy streaming
		if r.URL.Path == streamPath {
			serveStreamRequest(w, r, app, archCache)
			return
		}

		// Other paths return 404
		http.NotFound(w, r)
	})
}

func serveStreamRequest(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, app *App, archCache *cache.Cache) {
	q := r.URL.Query()
	transcodeFormat := strings.ToLower(q.Get("transcode"))
	playbackMode := strings.ToLower(q.Get("mode"))
	startSeconds := parseStartSeconds(q.Get("start"))
	windowSeconds := parseWindowSeconds(q.Get("window"))

	// ── Converted disk image ───────────────────────────────────────────────
	path := q.Get("path")
	if path != "" && q.Get("segmentManifest") == "1" {
		serveSegmentManifest(w, r, path)
		return
	}
	if segmentKey := q.Get("segmentKey"); segmentKey != "" {
		if q.Get("segmentManifest") == "1" {
			serveSegmentManifestByKey(w, r, segmentKey)
			return
		}
		if q.Get("segmentInit") == "1" {
			serveSegmentFile(w, r, segmentKey, "init.mp4")
			return
		}
		if rawIndex := q.Get("segmentIndex"); rawIndex != "" {
			segmentIndex, err := strconv.Atoi(rawIndex)
			if err != nil || segmentIndex < 0 {
				http.Error(w, "invalid segment index", http.StatusBadRequest)
				return
			}
			serveSegmentFile(w, r, segmentKey, segmentedVideoFileName(segmentIndex))
			return
		}
	}
	convertFormat := q.Get("convert")
	thumbnailFormat := q.Get("thumb")
	thumbnailWidth := parseThumbnailDimension(q.Get("thumbWidth"))
	thumbnailHeight := parseThumbnailDimension(q.Get("thumbHeight"))
	frameFormat := strings.ToLower(q.Get("frame"))
	frameSeconds := parseStartSeconds(q.Get("frameTime"))
	if path != "" && thumbnailFormat != "" {
		serveThumbnailPath(w, r, app, path, thumbnailFormat, thumbnailWidth, thumbnailHeight)
		return
	}
	if path != "" && frameFormat != "" {
		serveVideoFramePath(w, r, path, frameFormat, frameSeconds)
		return
	}
	if path != "" && convertFormat != "" {
		serveConvertedPath(w, r, app, path, convertFormat)
		return
	}
	if path != "" && transcodeFormat != "" {
		serveTranscodedPath(w, r, path, transcodeFormat, playbackMode, startSeconds, windowSeconds)
		return
	}

	// ── Archive entry ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	fsPath := q.Get("fsPath")
	entry := q.Get("entry")
	if fsPath != "" && entry != "" && transcodeFormat != "" {
		serveTranscodedArchiveEntry(w, r, archCache, fsPath, entry, q.Get("nested"), transcodeFormat, playbackMode, startSeconds)
		return
	}
	if fsPath != "" && entry != "" && thumbnailFormat != "" {
		serveThumbnailArchiveEntry(w, r, app, archCache, fsPath, entry, q.Get("nested"), thumbnailFormat, thumbnailWidth, thumbnailHeight)
		return
	}
	if fsPath != "" && entry != "" && frameFormat != "" {
		serveVideoFrameArchiveEntry(w, r, archCache, fsPath, entry, q.Get("nested"), frameFormat, frameSeconds)
		return
	}
	if fsPath != "" && entry != "" {
		serveArchiveEntry(w, r, archCache, fsPath, entry, q.Get("nested"))
		return
	}

	// ── Disk / VFS path ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
	path = q.Get("path")
	if path == "" {
		http.Error(w, "missing path parameter", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	servePath(w, r, app, path)
}

func serveConvertedPath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, app *App, publicPath string, targetFormat string) {
	if app == nil || app.State == nil || app.State.Converter == nil {
		http.Error(w, "converter unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}

	publicPath = pathref.Normalize(publicPath)
	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(publicPath)
	if strings.Contains(nativePath, "..") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid path", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	converted, err := app.State.Converter.ConvertFormat(nativePath, targetFormat)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "conversion failed: "+err.Error(), http.StatusUnsupportedMediaType)
		return
	}

	setCORSHeaders(w)
	setContentType(w, "preview."+targetFormat)
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	http.ServeContent(w, r, "preview."+targetFormat, time.Time{}, bytes.NewReader(converted))
}

func serveThumbnailArchiveEntry(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, app *App, archCache *cache.Cache, fsPath string, entryPath string, nestedRaw string, targetFormat string, maxWidth int, maxHeight int) {
	if app == nil || app.State == nil || app.State.Converter == nil {
		http.Error(w, "converter unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)

	}

	nativeFsPath := pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)
	if strings.Contains(nativeFsPath, "..") || strings.Contains(entryPath, "..") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid path", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	var nestedChain []string
	if nestedRaw != "" {
		nestedChain = strings.Split(nestedRaw, ",")
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 5*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()

	arch, err := archCache.Get(ctx, nativeFsPath, nestedChain, "")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "cannot open archive: "+err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return

	entryFile, err := arch.Open(ctx, entryPath)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "cannot open entry: "+err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	defer entryFile.Close()

	tempPattern := "wails-thumb-*" + filepath.Ext(entryPath)
	tempFile, err := os.CreateTemp("", tempPattern)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "failed to prepare thumbnail input", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return

	tempPath := tempFile.Name()

	if _, err := io.Copy(tempFile, entryFile); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "failed to read archive entry", http.StatusInternalServerError)

	if err := tempFile.Close(); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "failed to finalize thumbnail input", http.StatusInternalServerError)

	thumbnail, err := app.State.Converter.CreateThumbnail(tempPath, targetFormat, maxWidth, maxHeight)

	setCORSHeaders(w)
	setContentType(w, "thumbnail."+targetFormat)
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	http.ServeContent(w, r, "thumbnail."+targetFormat, time.Time{}, bytes.NewReader(thumbnail))

func serveTranscodedPath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, publicPath string, targetFormat string, playbackMode string, startSeconds float64, windowSeconds float64) {
	if strings.ToLower(targetFormat) != "mp4" {
		http.Error(w, "unsupported transcode target", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(publicPath))
	if strings.Contains(nativePath, "..") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid path", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	if _, err := os.Stat(nativePath); err != nil {
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, "cannot open file", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	stdout, err := startAstiavTranscode(r.Context(), nativePath, startSeconds, windowSeconds, normalizePlaybackMode(playbackMode))
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "failed to start transcoder: "+err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	defer stdout.Close()

	if durationSeconds := probeFileDurationSeconds(nativePath); durationSeconds > 0 {
		w.Header().Set("X-Video-Duration-Seconds", strconv.FormatFloat(durationSeconds, 'f', 3, 64))
	}

	streamTranscodedOutput(w, r, stdout)
}

func servePath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, app *App, publicPath string) {
	publicPath = pathref.Normalize(publicPath)
	if pathref.IsWeb(publicPath) {
		serveRemotePath(w, r, publicPath)
		return
	}
	if shouldServeViaVFS(app, publicPath) {
		serveVFSFile(w, r, app.State.vfs, publicPath)
		return
	}
	serveDiskFile(w, r, publicPath)
}

func shouldServeViaVFS(app *App, publicPath string) bool {
	if app == nil || app.State == nil || app.State.vfs == nil {
		return false
	}
	if pathref.IsAlias(publicPath) {
		return app.State.vfs.IsMounted(pathref.ToVFS(publicPath))
	}
	return app.State.vfs.IsMounted(publicPath)
}

func serveVFSFile(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, vfs *vfslib.Unified, publicPath string) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 5*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()

	internalPath := publicPath
	if pathref.IsAlias(publicPath) {
		internalPath = pathref.ToVFS(publicPath)
	}

	fi, err := vfs.Stat(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil || fi.IsDir() {
		http.Error(w, "not a file", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	f, err := vfs.Open(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "cannot open file", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	defer f.Close()

	setCORSHeaders(w)
	setContentType(w, fi.Name())
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.Header().Set("Accept-Ranges", "bytes")
	if _, err := f.Seek(0, io.SeekStart); err == nil {
		http.ServeContent(w, r, fi.Name(), fi.ModTime(), f)
		return
	}
	serveNonSeekableVFSFile(w, r, f, fi)
}

func serveNonSeekableVFSFile(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, f io.Reader, fi vfslib.FileInfo) {
	size := fi.Size()
	if size < 0 {
		size = 0
	}

	rangeHeader := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("Range"))
	if rangeHeader != "" && size > 0 {
		start, end, ok := parseSingleByteRange(rangeHeader, size)
		if !ok {
			w.Header().Set("Content-Range", fmt.Sprintf("bytes */%d", size))
			http.Error(w, "invalid range", http.StatusRequestedRangeNotSatisfiable)
			return
		}

		if start > 0 {
			if _, err := io.CopyN(io.Discard, f, start); err != nil {
				http.Error(w, "cannot read file", http.StatusInternalServerError)
				return
			}
		}

		length := end - start + 1
		w.Header().Set("Content-Range", fmt.Sprintf("bytes %d-%d/%d", start, end, size))
		w.Header().Set("Content-Length", strconv.FormatInt(length, 10))
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusPartialContent)
		if r.Method == http.MethodHead {
			return
		}
		if _, err := io.CopyN(w, f, length); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
			return
		}
		return
	}

	if size > 0 {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Length", strconv.FormatInt(size, 10))
	}
	if r.Method == http.MethodHead {
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
		return
	}
	if _, err := io.Copy(w, f); err != nil {
		return
	}
}

func parseSingleByteRange(header string, size int64) (int64, int64, bool) {
	if size <= 0 {
		return 0, 0, false
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(header), "bytes=") {
		return 0, 0, false
	}

	spec := strings.TrimSpace(header[len("bytes="):])
	if spec == "" || strings.Contains(spec, ",") {
		return 0, 0, false
	}

	dash := strings.IndexByte(spec, '-')
	if dash < 0 {
		return 0, 0, false
	}

	startRaw := strings.TrimSpace(spec[:dash])
	endRaw := strings.TrimSpace(spec[dash+1:])

	switch {
	case startRaw == "" && endRaw == "":
		return 0, 0, false
	case startRaw == "":
		suffix, err := strconv.ParseInt(endRaw, 10, 64)
		if err != nil || suffix <= 0 {
			return 0, 0, false
		}
		if suffix > size {
			suffix = size
		}
		return size - suffix, size - 1, true
	default:
		start, err := strconv.ParseInt(startRaw, 10, 64)
		if err != nil || start < 0 || start >= size {
			return 0, 0, false
		}
		if endRaw == "" {
			return start, size - 1, true
		}
		end, err := strconv.ParseInt(endRaw, 10, 64)
		if err != nil || end < start {
			return 0, 0, false
		}
		if end >= size {
			end = size - 1
		}
		return start, end, true
	}
}

// serveDiskFile resolves the public path (filesystem:// scheme) to a native OS path
// and lets http.ServeContent handle range requests.
func serveDiskFile(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, publicPath string) {
	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(publicPath)
	// Reject any path traversal attempts
	if strings.Contains(nativePath, "..") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid path", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	f, err := os.Open(nativePath)
	if err != nil {
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		} else {
			http.Error(w, "cannot open file", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		}
		return
	}
	defer f.Close()

	fi, err := f.Stat()
	if err != nil || fi.IsDir() {
		http.Error(w, "not a file", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	setCORSHeaders(w)
	setContentType(w, nativePath)
	http.ServeContent(w, r, fi.Name(), fi.ModTime(), f)
}

func serveRemotePath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, publicPath string) {
	targetURL, err := normalizeRemoteStreamURL(publicPath)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(r.Context(), r.Method, targetURL, nil)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid remote request", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	req.Header.Set("Accept", firstNonEmpty(r.Header.Get("Accept"), "*/*"))
	req.Header.Set("Accept-Language", firstNonEmpty(r.Header.Get("Accept-Language"), "en"))
	req.Header.Set("User-Agent", firstNonEmpty(r.Header.Get("User-Agent"), "WailsFileManager/1.0"))
	for _, name := range []string{"Range", "If-None-Match", "If-Modified-Since"} {
		if value := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get(name)); value != "" {
			req.Header.Set(name, value)
		}
	}

	resp, err := remoteStreamClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "cannot open remote resource", http.StatusBadGateway)
		return
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()

	if shouldRewriteRemoteHTML(resp, r.Method) {
		serveRewrittenRemoteHTML(w, r, resp)
		return
	}

	writeRemoteResponse(w, r, resp, false, nil)
}

// serveArchiveEntry opens the archive (or uses the LRU cache), then pipes the
// requested entry. Because archive entries are not seekable, range requests are
// not supported — but the full content is piped without buffering in JS.
func serveArchiveEntry(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, archCache *cache.Cache, fsPath, entryPath, nestedRaw string) {
	nativeFsPath := pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)
	if strings.Contains(nativeFsPath, "..") || strings.Contains(entryPath, "..") {
		http.Error(w, "invalid path", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}

	var nestedChain []string
	if nestedRaw != "" {
		nestedChain = strings.Split(nestedRaw, ",")
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 5*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()

	arch, err := archCache.Get(ctx, nativeFsPath, nestedChain, "")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "cannot open archive: "+err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	f, err := arch.Open(ctx, entryPath)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "cannot open entry: "+err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	defer f.Close()

	setCORSHeaders(w)
	setContentType(w, entryPath)
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	io.Copy(w, f) //nolint:errcheck — client disconnect is not an error
}

func shouldRewriteRemoteHTML(resp *http.Response, method string) bool {
	if resp == nil || strings.EqualFold(method, http.MethodHead) {
		return false
	}
	if resp.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || resp.StatusCode >= http.StatusMultipleChoices {
		return false
	}
	if resp.ContentLength > remoteHTMLRewriteLimit {
		return false
	}
	mediaType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(resp.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if err != nil {
		mediaType = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(strings.Split(resp.Header.Get("Content-Type"), ";")[0]))
	}
	switch strings.ToLower(mediaType) {
	case "text/html", "application/xhtml+xml":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func serveRewrittenRemoteHTML(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, resp *http.Response) {
	body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "cannot read remote document", http.StatusBadGateway)
		return
	}

	baseHref := ""
	if resp.Request != nil && resp.Request.URL != nil {
		baseHref = resp.Request.URL.String()
		if resp.Request.URL.Path == "" {
			baseHref += "/"
		}
	}
	rewritten := injectHTMLBaseTag(body, baseHref)
	writeRemoteResponse(w, r, resp, true, rewritten)
}

func writeRemoteResponse(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, resp *http.Response, rewritten bool, body []byte) {
	setCORSHeaders(w)
	copyRemoteHeaders(w.Header(), resp.Header, rewritten)
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.WriteHeader(resp.StatusCode)
	if strings.EqualFold(r.Method, http.MethodHead) {
		return
	}
	if rewritten {
		_, _ = w.Write(body)
		return
	}
	_, _ = io.Copy(w, resp.Body)
}

func copyRemoteHeaders(dst http.Header, src http.Header, rewritten bool) {
	skip := map[string]struct{}{
		"connection":                          {},
		"keep-alive":                          {},
		"proxy-authenticate":                  {},
		"proxy-authorization":                 {},
		"te":                                  {},
		"trailer":                             {},
		"transfer-encoding":                   {},
		"upgrade":                             {},
		"x-frame-options":                     {},
		"content-security-policy":             {},
		"content-security-policy-report-only": {},
		"cross-origin-embedder-policy":        {},
		"cross-origin-opener-policy":          {},
		"cross-origin-resource-policy":        {},
		"alt-svc":                             {},
	}
	if rewritten {
		skip["content-length"] = struct{}{}
		skip["content-encoding"] = struct{}{}
		skip["etag"] = struct{}{}
	}

	for key, values := range src {
		if _, blocked := skip[strings.ToLower(key)]; blocked {
			continue
		}
		dst.Del(key)
		for _, value := range values {
			dst.Add(key, value)
		}
	}
}

func normalizeRemoteStreamURL(publicPath string) (string, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(publicPath)
	if !pathref.IsWeb(normalized) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("unsupported remote scheme")
	}

	parsed, err := url.Parse(normalized)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if parsed.Host == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid remote URL")
	}

	parsed.Scheme = strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme)
	parsed.Host = strings.ToLower(parsed.Host)
	parsed.Fragment = ""
	parsed.Path = strings.ReplaceAll(parsed.Path, "\\", "/")
	return parsed.String(), nil
}

func injectHTMLBaseTag(document []byte, baseHref string) []byte {
	if len(document) == 0 || strings.TrimSpace(baseHref) == "" {
		return document
	}

	lowerDocument := strings.ToLower(string(document))
	if strings.Contains(lowerDocument, "<base ") {
		return document
	}

	baseTag := `<base href="` + htmlpkg.EscapeString(baseHref) + `">`
	if headStart := strings.Index(lowerDocument, "<head"); headStart >= 0 {
		if headEnd := strings.Index(lowerDocument[headStart:], ">"); headEnd >= 0 {
			insertAt := headStart + headEnd + 1
			return append(document[:insertAt], append([]byte(baseTag), document[insertAt:]...)...)
		}
	}
	if htmlStart := strings.Index(lowerDocument, "<html"); htmlStart >= 0 {
		if htmlEnd := strings.Index(lowerDocument[htmlStart:], ">"); htmlEnd >= 0 {
			insertAt := htmlStart + htmlEnd + 1
			headBlock := []byte("<head>" + baseTag + "</head>")
			return append(document[:insertAt], append(headBlock, document[insertAt:]...)...)
		}
	}
	return append([]byte("<head>"+baseTag+"</head>"), document...)
}

func streamTranscodedOutput(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, stdout io.ReadCloser) {
	firstChunk := make([]byte, 32*1024)
	n, readErr := stdout.Read(firstChunk)
	if n == 0 {
		if r.Context().Err() != nil {
			return
		}

		if readErr != nil && readErr != io.EOF {
			message := readErr.Error()
			http.Error(w, message, http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}

		http.Error(w, "media transcode produced no output", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	setCORSHeaders(w)
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "video/mp4")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)

	if _, err := w.Write(firstChunk[:n]); err != nil {
		return
	}

	_, _ = io.Copy(w, stdout)
}
````

````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type ffprobeOutput struct {
	Format struct {
		FormatName string `json:"format_name"`
		Duration   string `json:"duration"`
	} `json:"format"`
	Streams []struct {
		CodecType string `json:"codec_type"`
		CodecName string `json:"codec_name"`
	} `json:"streams"`
}

func extractProbeCodecs(probe *ffprobeOutput) (string, string) {
	if probe == nil {
		return "", ""
	}
	var videoCodec string
	var audioCodec string
	for _, stream := range probe.Streams {
		switch stream.CodecType {
		case "video":
			if videoCodec == "" {
				videoCodec = strings.ToLower(stream.CodecName)
			}
		case "audio":
			if audioCodec == "" {
				audioCodec = strings.ToLower(stream.CodecName)
			}
		}
	}
	return videoCodec, audioCodec
}

func parseProbeDuration(raw string) float64 {
	if raw == "" {
		return 0
	}
	seconds, err := strconv.ParseFloat(raw, 64)
	if err != nil || seconds < 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return seconds
}

func resolveVideoDurationSeconds(ctx context.Context, nativePath string, probe *ffprobeOutput) float64 {
	if probe != nil {
		if durationSeconds := parseProbeDuration(probe.Format.Duration); durationSeconds > 0 {
			return durationSeconds
		}
	}

	durationSeconds, err := estimateMediaDurationSeconds(ctx, nativePath)
	if err != nil || durationSeconds <= 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return durationSeconds
}

func probeFileDurationSeconds(nativePath string) float64 {
	probe, err := probeVideo(nativePath)
	if err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	return resolveVideoDurationSeconds(context.Background(), nativePath, probe)
}
````

````go
package app

const segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds = 2.0

const segmentedVideoCacheTTL = 5 * time.Minute

const segmentedVideoMaxResidentSegments = 24

type segmentedVideoManifest struct {
	Mode            string                       `json:"mode"`
	Format          string                       `json:"format"`
	DurationSeconds float64                      `json:"durationSeconds"`
	SegmentDuration float64                      `json:"segmentDuration"`
	TotalSegments   int                          `json:"totalSegments"`

}

}

type segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry struct {

	nativePath  string

	segments    map[int][]byte
	segmentSeen map[int]time.Time
	inflight    map[int]*segmentedVideoSegmentBuild
	createdAt   time.Time

}

type segmentedVideoPlaybackBuild struct {

}

type segmentedVideoSegmentBuild struct {

type segmentedVideoPlaybackCache struct {

var segmentedPlaybackCache = newSegmentedVideoPlaybackCache()

func serveSegmentManifest(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, publicPath string) {
	entry, err := ensureSegmentedVideoCacheEntry(r.Context(), publicPath)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}

	manifest := buildSegmentedVideoManifest(requestBaseURL(r), entry)
	setCORSHeaders(w)
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(manifest)
}

func serveSegmentManifestByKey(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, cacheKey string) {
	entry, ok := segmentedPlaybackCache.Get(cacheKey)
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "segment cache entry not found or expired", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	manifest := buildSegmentedVideoManifest(requestBaseURL(r), entry.manifest)
	setCORSHeaders(w)
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(manifest)
}

func serveSegmentFile(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, cacheKey string, fileName string) {
	content, modTime, ok, err := segmentedPlaybackCache.File(r.Context(), cacheKey, fileName)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return

	if !ok {

	}

	setCORSHeaders(w)
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
````
