````go
}

func segmentedVideoFileName(index int) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("segment_%05d.m4s", index+1)
}

func segmentManifestURLForFile(baseURL, publicPath string) string {
	return joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?path=" + urlEncode(publicPath) + "&segmentManifest=1"
}

func segmentManifestURLForKey(baseURL, cacheKey string) string {
	return joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?segmentKey=" + urlEncode(cacheKey) + "&segmentManifest=1"
}

func segmentInitURL(baseURL, cacheKey string) string {
	return joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?segmentKey=" + urlEncode(cacheKey) + "&segmentInit=1"
}

func segmentFileURL(baseURL, cacheKey string, index int) string {
	return joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?segmentKey=" + urlEncode(cacheKey) + "&segmentIndex=" + urlEncode(strconv.Itoa(index))
}

func buildSegmentedVideoManifest(baseURL string, entry segmentedVideoCacheEntry) segmentedVideoManifest {
	if len(entry.SegmentRanges) > 0 {
		segments := make([]segmentedVideoManifestItem, 0, len(entry.SegmentRanges))
		for index, segmentRange := range entry.SegmentRanges {
			segments = append(segments, segmentedVideoManifestItem{
				Index:           index,
				StartTime:       segmentRange.StartSeconds,
				DurationSeconds: segmentRange.DurationSeconds,
				URL:             segmentFileURL(baseURL, entry.CacheKey, index),
			})
		}

		return segmentedVideoManifest{
			Mode:            string(VideoPlaybackModeSegmented),
			Format:          entry.Format,
			DurationSeconds: entry.DurationSeconds,
			SegmentDuration: entry.SegmentDuration,
			TotalSegments:   len(entry.SegmentRanges),
			InitSegmentURL:  segmentInitURL(baseURL, entry.CacheKey),
			Segments:        segments,
		}
	}

	segments := make([]segmentedVideoManifestItem, 0, entry.TotalSegments)
	for index := 0; index < entry.TotalSegments; index++ {
		startTime := float64(index) * entry.SegmentDuration
		segmentDuration := entry.SegmentDuration
		if remaining := entry.DurationSeconds - startTime; remaining < segmentDuration {
			segmentDuration = remaining
		}
		if segmentDuration < 0 {
			segmentDuration = 0
		}
		segments = append(segments, segmentedVideoManifestItem{
			Index:           index,
			StartTime:       startTime,
			DurationSeconds: segmentDuration,
			URL:             segmentFileURL(baseURL, entry.CacheKey, index),
		})
	}

	return segmentedVideoManifest{
		Mode:            string(VideoPlaybackModeSegmented),
		Format:          entry.Format,
		DurationSeconds: entry.DurationSeconds,
		SegmentDuration: entry.SegmentDuration,
		TotalSegments:   entry.TotalSegments,
		InitSegmentURL:  segmentInitURL(baseURL, entry.CacheKey),
		Segments:        segments,
	}
}

func ensureSegmentedVideoCacheEntry(ctx context.Context, publicPath string) (segmentedVideoCacheEntry, error) {
	publicPath = pathref.Normalize(publicPath)
	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(publicPath)
	if strings.Contains(nativePath, "..") {
		return segmentedVideoCacheEntry{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid path")
	}

	fi, err := os.Stat(nativePath)
	if err != nil {
		return segmentedVideoCacheEntry{}, err
	}

	cacheKey := segmentedVideoCacheKey(nativePath, fi)
	entry, err := segmentedPlaybackCache.Ensure(ctx, cacheKey, func(buildCtx context.Context) (*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry, error) {
		return buildSegmentedVideoCache(buildCtx, nativePath, cacheKey)
	})
	if err != nil {
		return segmentedVideoCacheEntry{}, err
	}
	return entry.manifest, nil
}

func archiveSegmentedVideoCacheKey(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string) string {
	parts := make([]string, 0, 2+len(nestedChain))
	parts = append(parts, fsPath)
	parts = append(parts, nestedChain...)
	parts = append(parts, entryPath)
	hash := sha1.Sum([]byte(strings.Join(parts, "|")))
	return "arch-" + fmt.Sprintf("%x", hash)
}

func ensureArchiveSegmentedVideoCacheEntry(ctx context.Context, archCache *cache.Cache, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string) (segmentedVideoCacheEntry, error) {
	if archCache == nil {
		return segmentedVideoCacheEntry{}, fmt.Errorf("archive cache unavailable")
	}
	cacheKey := archiveSegmentedVideoCacheKey(fsPath, nestedChain, entryPath)
	entry, err := segmentedPlaybackCache.Ensure(ctx, cacheKey, func(buildCtx context.Context) (*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry, error) {
		return buildArchiveSegmentedVideoCache(buildCtx, archCache, fsPath, nestedChain, entryPath, cacheKey)
	})
	if err != nil {
		return segmentedVideoCacheEntry{}, err
	}
	return entry.manifest, nil
}

func buildArchiveSegmentedVideoCache(ctx context.Context, archCache *cache.Cache, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string, cacheKey string) (*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry, error) {
	nativeFsPath := pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)
	if strings.Contains(nativeFsPath, "..") || strings.Contains(entryPath, "..") {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid path")
	}

	extractCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()

	arch, err := archCache.Get(extractCtx, nativeFsPath, nestedChain, "")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot open archive: %w", err)
	}

	entryFile, err := arch.Open(extractCtx, entryPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot open entry: %w", err)
	}
	defer entryFile.Close()

	ext := filepath.Ext(entryPath)
	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp("", "wails-seg-*"+ext)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot create temp file: %w", err)
	}
	tmpPath := tmp.Name()

	if _, err := io.Copy(tmp, entryFile); err != nil {
		tmp.Close()
		os.Remove(tmpPath)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot extract entry: %w", err)
	}
	if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
		os.Remove(tmpPath)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot finalize temp file: %w", err)
	}

	result, err := buildSegmentedVideoCache(ctx, tmpPath, cacheKey)
	if err != nil {
		os.Remove(tmpPath)
		return nil, err
	}
	result.cleanup = func() { os.Remove(tmpPath) } //nolint:errcheck
	return result, nil
}

func buildSegmentedVideoCache(ctx context.Context, nativePath string, cacheKey string) (*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry, error) {

	probe, err := probeVideo(nativePath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	videoCodec, _ := extractProbeCodecs(probe)
	if !supportsSegmentedVideoCodec(videoCodec) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("segmented playback requires transcoding for video codec %q", videoCodec)
	}
	durationSeconds := resolveVideoDurationSeconds(ctx, nativePath, probe)
	segmentRanges := buildFixedSegmentRanges(durationSeconds)
	if shouldUseKeyframeAlignedSegments(nativePath) {
		if keyframeRanges, err := buildKeyframeAlignedSegmentRanges(ctx, nativePath, durationSeconds); err == nil && len(keyframeRanges) > 0 {
			segmentRanges = keyframeRanges
		}
	}

	manifest := segmentedVideoCacheEntry{
		CacheKey:        cacheKey,
		Format:          "mp4",
		DurationSeconds: durationSeconds,
		SegmentDuration: segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds,
		TotalSegments:   len(segmentRanges),
		SegmentRanges:   segmentRanges,
	}

	firstSegmentStart := 0.0
	firstSegmentDuration := segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds
	if len(segmentRanges) > 0 {
		firstSegmentStart = segmentRanges[0].StartSeconds
		firstSegmentDuration = segmentRanges[0].DurationSeconds
	}
	if firstSegmentDuration <= 0 {
		firstSegmentDuration = segmentedPreviewSegmentSeconds
	}

	initSegment, firstSegment, err := buildSegmentedVideoFragment(ctx, nativePath, firstSegmentStart, firstSegmentDuration)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	now := time.Now()
	return &segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry{
		manifest:    manifest,
		nativePath:  nativePath,
		initSegment: initSegment,
		segments: map[int][]byte{
			0: firstSegment,
		},
		segmentSeen: map[int]time.Time{
			0: now,
		},
		inflight:   make(map[int]*segmentedVideoSegmentBuild),
		createdAt:  now,
		lastAccess: now,
	}, nil
}

func shouldUseKeyframeAlignedSegments(nativePath string) bool {
	switch strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(nativePath)) {
	case ".mp4", ".m4v", ".webm":
		return false
	default:
		return shouldAttemptSegmentedDiskPlayback(nativePath, "", "")
	}
}

func requiresAccurateSegmentSeek(nativePath string) bool {
	switch strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(nativePath)) {
	case ".avi", ".divx", ".xvid":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func splitFragmentedMP4(data []byte) ([]byte, []byte, error) {
	if len(data) < 8 {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build segmented preview: fragmented mp4 output too small")
	}

	splitOffset := -1
	for offset := 0; offset+8 <= len(data); {
		boxSize := int(uint32(data[offset])<<24 | uint32(data[offset+1])<<16 | uint32(data[offset+2])<<8 | uint32(data[offset+3]))
		headerSize := 8
		if boxSize == 1 {
			if offset+16 > len(data) {
				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build segmented preview: invalid extended mp4 box")
			}
			largeSize := uint64(data[offset+8])<<56 | uint64(data[offset+9])<<48 | uint64(data[offset+10])<<40 | uint64(data[offset+11])<<32 |
				uint64(data[offset+12])<<24 | uint64(data[offset+13])<<16 | uint64(data[offset+14])<<8 | uint64(data[offset+15])
			if largeSize > uint64(len(data)-offset) || largeSize < 16 {
				return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build segmented preview: invalid extended mp4 size")
			}
			boxSize = int(largeSize)
			headerSize = 16
		} else if boxSize == 0 {
			boxSize = len(data) - offset
		}
		if boxSize < headerSize || offset+boxSize > len(data) {
			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build segmented preview: invalid mp4 box size")
		}

		boxType := string(data[offset+4 : offset+8])
		if boxType == "sidx" || boxType == "styp" || boxType == "moof" || boxType == "mdat" {
			splitOffset = offset
			break
		}
		offset += boxSize
	}

	if splitOffset <= 0 || splitOffset >= len(data) {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build segmented preview: could not split initialization segment")
	}

	initSegment := append([]byte(nil), data[:splitOffset]...)
	mediaSegment := append([]byte(nil), data[splitOffset:]...)
	if len(mediaSegment) == 0 {
		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to build segmented preview: empty media segment")
	}
	return initSegment, mediaSegment, nil
}

func segmentedVideoCacheKey(nativePath string, fi os.FileInfo) string {
	hash := sha1.Sum([]byte(strings.Join([]string{nativePath, strconv.FormatInt(fi.Size(), 10), strconv.FormatInt(fi.ModTime().UnixNano(), 10)}, "|")))
	return fmt.Sprintf("%x", hash)
}

func newSegmentedVideoPlaybackCache() *segmentedVideoPlaybackCache {
	return &segmentedVideoPlaybackCache{
		entries:  make(map[string]*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry),
		inflight: make(map[string]*segmentedVideoPlaybackBuild),
	}
}

func (c *segmentedVideoPlaybackCache) Ensure(ctx context.Context, cacheKey string, build func(context.Context) (*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry, error)) (*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry, error) {
	for {
		c.mu.Lock()
		c.evictExpiredLocked(time.Now())
		if entry, ok := c.entries[cacheKey]; ok {
			entry.lastAccess = time.Now()
			c.mu.Unlock()
			return entry, nil
		}
		pending, ok := c.inflight[cacheKey]
		if !ok {
			buildCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			pending = &segmentedVideoPlaybackBuild{done: make(chan struct{}), cancel: cancel}
			c.inflight[cacheKey] = pending
			go c.runPlaybackBuild(cacheKey, pending, buildCtx, build)
		}
		pending.waiters++
		c.mu.Unlock()

		select {
		case <-pending.done:
			if pending.err != nil {
				return nil, pending.err
			}
			if pending.entry != nil {
				return pending.entry, nil
			}
		case <-ctx.Done():
			c.releasePlaybackBuildWaiter(cacheKey, pending)
			return nil, ctx.Err()
		}
	}
}

func (c *segmentedVideoPlaybackCache) runPlaybackBuild(cacheKey string, pending *segmentedVideoPlaybackBuild, buildCtx context.Context, build func(context.Context) (*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry, error)) {
	entry, err := build(buildCtx)

	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if err == nil && entry != nil {
		entry.lastAccess = time.Now()
		c.entries[cacheKey] = entry
	}
	pending.entry = entry
	pending.err = err
	if current, ok := c.inflight[cacheKey]; ok && current == pending {
		delete(c.inflight, cacheKey)
	}
	close(pending.done)
}

func (c *segmentedVideoPlaybackCache) releasePlaybackBuildWaiter(cacheKey string, pending *segmentedVideoPlaybackBuild) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	current, ok := c.inflight[cacheKey]
	if !ok || current != pending {
		return
	}
	if pending.waiters > 0 {
		pending.waiters--
	}
	if pending.waiters == 0 && pending.cancel != nil {
		pending.cancel()
	}
}

func (c *segmentedVideoPlaybackCache) File(ctx context.Context, cacheKey string, fileName string) ([]byte, time.Time, bool, error) {
	now := time.Now()
	c.mu.Lock()
	c.evictExpiredLocked(now)
	entry, ok := c.entries[cacheKey]
	if ok {
		entry.lastAccess = now
	}
	c.mu.Unlock()
	if !ok {
		return nil, time.Time{}, false, nil
	}

	content, err := entry.file(ctx, fileName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, time.Time{}, false, err
	}
	if len(content) == 0 {
		return nil, time.Time{}, false, nil
	}

	c.mu.Lock()
	entry.lastAccess = time.Now()
	c.mu.Unlock()
	return content, entry.createdAt, true, nil
}

func (c *segmentedVideoPlaybackCache) Clear() {
	c.mu.Lock()
	for _, entry := range c.entries {
		if entry.cleanup != nil {
			go entry.cleanup()
		}
	}
	clear(c.entries)
	clear(c.inflight)
	c.mu.Unlock()
}

func (c *segmentedVideoPlaybackCache) Get(cacheKey string) (*segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry, bool) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	entry, ok := c.entries[cacheKey]
	if ok {
		entry.lastAccess = time.Now()
	}
	return entry, ok
}

func (c *segmentedVideoPlaybackCache) evictExpiredLocked(now time.Time) {
	for cacheKey, entry := range c.entries {
		if now.Sub(entry.lastAccess) > segmentedVideoCacheTTL {
			delete(c.entries, cacheKey)
			if entry.cleanup != nil {
				go entry.cleanup()
			}
		}
	}
}

func cleanupSegmentedVideoPlaybackCache() {
	segmentedPlaybackCache.Clear()
}

func (e *segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry) file(ctx context.Context, fileName string) ([]byte, error) {
	if fileName == "init.mp4" {
		initSegment, _, err := e.ensureSegment(ctx, 0)
		return initSegment, err
	}

	segmentIndex, ok := parseSegmentedVideoFileName(fileName)
	if !ok {
		return nil, nil
	}
	_, segment, err := e.ensureSegment(ctx, segmentIndex)
	return segment, err
}

func (e *segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry) ensureSegment(ctx context.Context, segmentIndex int) ([]byte, []byte, error) {
	if segmentIndex < 0 || segmentIndex >= e.manifest.TotalSegments {
		return nil, nil, nil
	}

	for {
		now := time.Now()
		e.mu.Lock()
		if len(e.initSegment) > 0 {
			if segment, ok := e.segments[segmentIndex]; ok {
				e.segmentSeen[segmentIndex] = now
				e.lastAccess = now
				initSegment := append([]byte(nil), e.initSegment...)
				mediaSegment := append([]byte(nil), segment...)
				e.mu.Unlock()
				return initSegment, mediaSegment, nil
			}
		}
		pending, ok := e.inflight[segmentIndex]
		if !ok {
			buildCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
			pending = &segmentedVideoSegmentBuild{done: make(chan struct{}), cancel: cancel}
			e.inflight[segmentIndex] = pending

			startSeconds, durationSeconds := e.segmentRange(segmentIndex)

			go e.runSegmentBuild(segmentIndex, pending, buildCtx, startSeconds, durationSeconds)
		}
		pending.waiters++
		e.mu.Unlock()

		select {
		case <-pending.done:
			if pending.err != nil {
				return nil, nil, pending.err
			}
			return pending.init, pending.segment, nil
		case <-ctx.Done():
			e.releaseSegmentBuildWaiter(segmentIndex, pending)
			return nil, nil, ctx.Err()
		}
	}
}

func (e *segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry) segmentRange(segmentIndex int) (float64, float64) {
	if segmentIndex >= 0 && segmentIndex < len(e.manifest.SegmentRanges) {
		segmentRange := e.manifest.SegmentRanges[segmentIndex]
		durationSeconds := segmentRange.DurationSeconds
		if durationSeconds <= 0 {
			durationSeconds = e.manifest.SegmentDuration
		}
		return segmentRange.StartSeconds, durationSeconds
	}

	startSeconds := float64(segmentIndex) * e.manifest.SegmentDuration
	durationSeconds := e.manifest.SegmentDuration
	if remaining := e.manifest.DurationSeconds - startSeconds; remaining > 0 && remaining < durationSeconds {
		durationSeconds = remaining
	}
	if durationSeconds <= 0 {
		durationSeconds = e.manifest.SegmentDuration
	}
	return startSeconds, durationSeconds
}

func (e *segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry) runSegmentBuild(segmentIndex int, pending *segmentedVideoSegmentBuild, buildCtx context.Context, startSeconds float64, durationSeconds float64) {
	initSegment, mediaSegment, err := buildSegmentedVideoFragment(buildCtx, e.nativePath, startSeconds, durationSeconds)

	e.mu.Lock()
	defer e.mu.Unlock()
	if err == nil {
		now := time.Now()
		if len(e.initSegment) == 0 {
			e.initSegment = initSegment
		}
		e.segments[segmentIndex] = mediaSegment
		e.segmentSeen[segmentIndex] = now
		e.lastAccess = now
		e.pruneSegmentsLocked()
	}
	pending.init = initSegment
	pending.segment = mediaSegment
	pending.err = err
	if current, ok := e.inflight[segmentIndex]; ok && current == pending {
		delete(e.inflight, segmentIndex)
	}
	close(pending.done)
}

func (e *segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry) releaseSegmentBuildWaiter(segmentIndex int, pending *segmentedVideoSegmentBuild) {
	e.mu.Lock()
	defer e.mu.Unlock()
	current, ok := e.inflight[segmentIndex]
	if !ok || current != pending {
		return
	}
	if pending.waiters > 0 {
		pending.waiters--
	}
	if pending.waiters == 0 && pending.cancel != nil {
		pending.cancel()
	}
}

func (e *segmentedVideoPlaybackCacheEntry) pruneSegmentsLocked() {
	if len(e.segments) <= segmentedVideoMaxResidentSegments {
		return
	}

	type residentSegment struct {
		index int
		seen  time.Time
	}
	resident := make([]residentSegment, 0, len(e.segments))
	for index, seenAt := range e.segmentSeen {
		resident = append(resident, residentSegment{index: index, seen: seenAt})
	}
	sort.Slice(resident, func(left int, right int) bool {
		return resident[left].seen.Before(resident[right].seen)
	})
	for len(resident) > segmentedVideoMaxResidentSegments {
		oldest := resident[0]
		delete(e.segments, oldest.index)
		delete(e.segmentSeen, oldest.index)
		resident = resident[1:]
	}
}

func parseSegmentedVideoFileName(fileName string) (int, bool) {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(fileName, "segment_") || !strings.HasSuffix(fileName, ".m4s") {
		return 0, false
	}
	rawIndex := strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(fileName, "segment_"), ".m4s")
	segmentNumber, err := strconv.Atoi(rawIndex)
	if err != nil || segmentNumber <= 0 {
		return 0, false
	}
	return segmentNumber - 1, true
}
````

````go
package app

import (
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

// StreamURLForFile builds the /wails-stream URL for a disk path.
// Called from the frontend via Wails binding.
func StreamURLForFile(baseURL, publicPath string) string {
	return joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?path=" + urlEncode(publicPath)
}

// StreamURLForEntry builds the /wails-stream URL for an archive entry.
func StreamURLForEntry(baseURL, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string) string {
	u := joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?fsPath=" + urlEncode(fsPath) + "&entry=" + urlEncode(entryPath)
	if len(nestedChain) > 0 {
		u += "&nested=" + urlEncode(strings.Join(nestedChain, ","))
	}
	return u
}

// ConvertedStreamURLForFile builds the /wails-stream URL for a disk path that should be converted on demand.
func ConvertedStreamURLForFile(baseURL, publicPath, targetFormat string) string {
	return joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?path=" + urlEncode(publicPath) + "&convert=" + urlEncode(targetFormat)
}

func ThumbnailStreamURLForFile(baseURL, publicPath, targetFormat string, maxWidth int, maxHeight int) string {
	return joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?path=" + urlEncode(publicPath) + "&thumb=" + urlEncode(targetFormat) + "&thumbWidth=" + strconv.Itoa(maxWidth) + "&thumbHeight=" + strconv.Itoa(maxHeight)
}

func ThumbnailStreamURLForEntry(baseURL, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string, targetFormat string, maxWidth int, maxHeight int) string {
	u := joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?fsPath=" + urlEncode(fsPath) + "&entry=" + urlEncode(entryPath) + "&thumb=" + urlEncode(targetFormat) + "&thumbWidth=" + strconv.Itoa(maxWidth) + "&thumbHeight=" + strconv.Itoa(maxHeight)
	if len(nestedChain) > 0 {
		u += "&nested=" + urlEncode(strings.Join(nestedChain, ","))
	}
	return u
}

func VideoFramePreviewURLForFile(baseURL, publicPath, targetFormat string, frameSeconds float64) string {
	u := joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?path=" + urlEncode(publicPath) + "&frame=" + urlEncode(targetFormat)
	if frameSeconds > 0 {
		u += "&frameTime=" + strconv.FormatFloat(frameSeconds, 'f', 3, 64)
	}
	return u
}

func VideoFramePreviewURLForEntry(baseURL, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string, targetFormat string, frameSeconds float64) string {
	u := joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?fsPath=" + urlEncode(fsPath) + "&entry=" + urlEncode(entryPath) + "&frame=" + urlEncode(targetFormat)
	if frameSeconds > 0 {
		u += "&frameTime=" + strconv.FormatFloat(frameSeconds, 'f', 3, 64)
	}
	if len(nestedChain) > 0 {
		u += "&nested=" + urlEncode(strings.Join(nestedChain, ","))
	}
	return u
}

func joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL string) string {
	return strings.TrimRight(baseURL, "/")
}

func urlEncode(s string) string {
	// Manual percent-encoding for path characters. We only need to encode the
	// characters that would break query-string parsing.
	var b strings.Builder
	for _, c := range []byte(s) {
		switch {
		case c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z', c >= 'a' && c <= 'z', c >= '0' && c <= '9':
			b.WriteByte(c)
		case c == '-', c == '_', c == '.', c == '~',
			c == '/', c == ':', c == '@':
			b.WriteByte(c)
		default:
			b.WriteString("%" + hexByte(c))
		}
	}
	return b.String()
}

func hexByte(b byte) string {
	const hex = "0123456789ABCDEF"
	return string([]byte{hex[b>>4], hex[b&0xf]})
}

// GetStreamURL is a Wails-bound method that returns the stream URL for any path.
// Exposed so the frontend can call App.GetStreamURL(path) to get a ready-to-use src.
func (a *App) GetStreamURL(publicPath string) string {
	return StreamURLForFile(a.StreamBaseURL(), publicPath)
}

// GetArchiveStreamURL is a Wails-bound method for archive entries.
func (a *App) GetArchiveStreamURL(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string) string {
	return StreamURLForEntry(a.StreamBaseURL(), fsPath, nestedChain, entryPath)
}

func (a *App) GetVideoPreviewURL(publicPath string) string {
	return VideoFramePreviewURLForFile(a.StreamBaseURL(), publicPath, "png", defaultVideoFramePreviewSeconds)
}

func (a *App) GetArchiveVideoPreviewURL(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string) string {
	return VideoFramePreviewURLForEntry(a.StreamBaseURL(), fsPath, nestedChain, entryPath, "png", defaultVideoFramePreviewSeconds)
}

func FFmpegPreviewURLForFile(baseURL, publicPath, targetFormat, playbackMode string, startSeconds float64, windowSeconds float64, durationSeconds float64) string {
	u := joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?path=" + urlEncode(publicPath) + "&transcode=" + urlEncode(targetFormat)
	if playbackMode != "" {
		u += "&mode=" + urlEncode(playbackMode)
	}
	if startSeconds > 0 {
		u += "&start=" + urlEncode(strconv.FormatFloat(startSeconds, 'f', 3, 64))
	}
	if windowSeconds > 0 {
		u += "&window=" + urlEncode(strconv.FormatFloat(windowSeconds, 'f', 3, 64))
	}
	if durationSeconds > 0 {
		u += "&duration=" + urlEncode(strconv.FormatFloat(durationSeconds, 'f', 3, 64))
	}
	return u
}

func FFmpegPreviewURLForEntry(baseURL, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string, targetFormat, playbackMode string, startSeconds float64, windowSeconds float64, durationSeconds float64) string {
	u := joinStreamBaseURL(baseURL) + streamPath + "?fsPath=" + urlEncode(fsPath) + "&entry=" + urlEncode(entryPath) + "&transcode=" + urlEncode(targetFormat)
	if playbackMode != "" {
		u += "&mode=" + urlEncode(playbackMode)
	}
	if startSeconds > 0 {
		u += "&start=" + urlEncode(strconv.FormatFloat(startSeconds, 'f', 3, 64))
	}
	if windowSeconds > 0 {
		u += "&window=" + urlEncode(strconv.FormatFloat(windowSeconds, 'f', 3, 64))
	}
	if durationSeconds > 0 {
		u += "&duration=" + urlEncode(strconv.FormatFloat(durationSeconds, 'f', 3, 64))
	}
	if len(nestedChain) > 0 {
		u += "&nested=" + urlEncode(strings.Join(nestedChain, ","))
	}
	return u
}
````

````go
package app

import (
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

func parseStartSeconds(raw string) float64 {
	if raw == "" {
		return 0
	}
	seconds, err := strconv.ParseFloat(raw, 64)
	if err != nil || seconds < 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return seconds
}

func parseWindowSeconds(raw string) float64 {
	if raw == "" {
		return 0
	}
	seconds, err := strconv.ParseFloat(raw, 64)
	if err != nil || seconds <= 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return seconds
}

func parseThumbnailDimension(raw string) int {
	if raw == "" {
		return defaultThumbnailSize
	}
	value, err := strconv.Atoi(raw)
	if err != nil || value <= 0 {
		return defaultThumbnailSize
	}
	if value > 2048 {
		return 2048
	}
	return value
}

func normalizePlaybackMode(raw string) VideoPlaybackMode {
	if strings.EqualFold(raw, string(VideoPlaybackModeSegmented)) {
		return VideoPlaybackModeSegmented
	}
	if strings.EqualFold(raw, string(VideoPlaybackModeRemux)) {
		return VideoPlaybackModeRemux
	}
	return VideoPlaybackModeTranscode
}

func requestBaseURL(r *http.Request) string {
	if r == nil {
		return ""
	}
	scheme := "http"
	if r.TLS != nil {
		scheme = "https"
	}
	return scheme + "://" + r.Host
}

func setCORSHeaders(w http.ResponseWriter) {
	w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
	w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, HEAD, OPTIONS")
	w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type, Range, Accept-Ranges")
	w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Expose-Headers", "Content-Length, Content-Range, Content-Type")
}

func setContentType(w http.ResponseWriter, name string) {
	ext := strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(name))
	ct := mime.TypeByExtension(ext)
	if ct == "" {
		ct = extMIME(ext)
	}
	if ct != "" {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", ct)
	}
}

// extMIME covers formats not in the stdlib mime database.
func extMIME(ext string) string {
	m := map[string]string{
		".mkv":   "video/x-matroska",
		".avi":   "video/x-msvideo",
		".divx":  "video/x-msvideo",
		".xvid":  "video/x-msvideo",
		".flv":   "video/x-flv",
		".wmv":   "video/x-ms-wmv",
		".mpg":   "video/mpeg",
		".mpeg":  "video/mpeg",
		".vob":   "video/mpeg",
		".m2v":   "video/mpeg",
		".m2p":   "video/mpeg",
		".ts":    "video/mp2t",
		".mts":   "video/mp2t",
		".m2ts":  "video/mp2t",
		".mjpeg": "video/x-motion-jpeg",
		".mjpg":  "video/x-motion-jpeg",
		".qt":    "video/quicktime",
		".m3u8":  "application/x-mpegURL",
		".mxf":   "application/mxf",
		".webp":  "image/webp",
		".avif":  "image/avif",
		".heic":  "image/heic",
		".heif":  "image/heif",
	}
	return m[ext]
}

func primaryFormatName(raw string) string {
	if raw == "" {
		return ""
	}
	parts := strings.Split(raw, ",")
	return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(parts[0]))
}

func firstNonEmpty(values ...string) string {
	for _, value := range values {
		if strings.TrimSpace(value) != "" {
			return value
		}
	}
	return ""
}
````

````go
package app

import (
	"context"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	internalruntime "wails-app/internal/runtime"
)

func (s *State) InitVFS() {
	memoryPlugin, err := getMemoryFS()
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	vfs, err := internalruntime.InitVFS(memoryPlugin)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	s.vfs = vfs
	if s.Filesystem != nil {
		s.Filesystem.SetVFS(s.vfs)
	}
	if s.Utility != nil {
		s.Utility.SetVFS(s.vfs)
	}
	if s.DirStream != nil {
		s.DirStream.SetVFS(
			func(path string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
				return internalruntime.VFSListDir(context.Background(), s.vfs, path)
			},
			func(path string) bool {
				normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
				if pathref.IsAlias(normalized) {
					return s.vfs.IsMounted(pathref.ToVFS(normalized))
				}
				return s.vfs.IsMounted(normalized)
			},
		)
	}
}

func (s *State) VFSListDir(path string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	if s.Filesystem != nil && pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
		return s.Filesystem.ListDirectory(path, false)
	}
	return internalruntime.VFSListDir(context.Background(), s.vfs, path)
}

func (s *State) VFSReadFile(path string, encoding string) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	if s.Filesystem != nil && pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
		return s.Filesystem.ReadFile(path, encoding)
	}
	return internalruntime.VFSReadFile(context.Background(), s.vfs, path, encoding)
}

func (s *State) VFSWriteFile(path string, content string, encoding string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	if s.Filesystem != nil && pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
		return s.Filesystem.WriteFile(path, content, encoding)
	}
	return internalruntime.VFSWriteFile(context.Background(), s.vfs, path, content, encoding)
}

func (s *State) VFSMkdir(path string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	if s.Filesystem != nil && pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
		return s.Filesystem.CreateDirectory(path, false)
	}
	return internalruntime.VFSMkdir(context.Background(), s.vfs, path)
}

func (s *State) VFSRemove(path string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	if s.Filesystem != nil && pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
		return s.Filesystem.DeleteFile(path, false, nil)
	}
	return internalruntime.VFSRemove(context.Background(), s.vfs, path)
}

func (s *State) VFSOpenArchive(path string, nested []string) (contracts.ArchiveListing, error) {
	return internalruntime.VFSOpenArchive(context.Background(), s.vfs, path, nested)
}

func (s *State) VFSMountArchive(path string) (string, error) {
	return internalruntime.VFSMountArchive(context.Background(), s.vfs, path)
}

func (s *State) VFSUnmount(mountPoint string) error {
	return internalruntime.VFSUnmount(context.Background(), s.vfs, mountPoint)
}
````

````go
package archive

import (
	"testing"
)

func TestIsZipMagic(t *testing.T) {
	if IsZipMagic(nil) {
		t.Fatal("expected false for nil")
	}
	if IsZipMagic([]byte{0x50, 0x4b}) {
		t.Fatal("expected false for too-short data")
	}
	// Valid ZIP local file header signature
	if !IsZipMagic([]byte{0x50, 0x4b, 0x03, 0x04}) {
		t.Fatal("expected true for valid ZIP magic")
	}
	// Empty archive signature
	if !IsZipMagic([]byte{0x50, 0x4b, 0x05, 0x06}) {
		t.Fatal("expected true for empty ZIP magic")
	}
	if IsZipMagic([]byte{0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00}) {
		t.Fatal("expected false for non-ZIP data")
	}
}

func TestIsRarArchiveName(t *testing.T) {
	if IsRarArchiveName("") {
		t.Fatal("expected false for empty")
	}
	if !IsRarArchiveName("file.rar") {
		t.Fatal("expected true for .rar")
	}
	if !IsRarArchiveName("FILE.RAR") {
		t.Fatal("expected true for .RAR")
	}
	if IsRarArchiveName("file.zip") {
		t.Fatal("expected false for .zip")
	}
}

func TestIsZipArchiveName(t *testing.T) {
	if isZipArchiveName("") {
		t.Fatal("expected false for empty")
	}
	if !isZipArchiveName("archive.zip") {
		t.Fatal("expected true for .zip")
	}
	if isZipArchiveName("archive.rar") {
		t.Fatal("expected false for .rar")
	}
}

		{"file.bz2", true},
		{"file.xz", true},

		{"archive.rar", false},
		{"archive.7z", false},
	}

		if got != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("usesStdlibArchiveHandling(%q) = %v, want %v", tc.name, got, tc.want)

}
````

## File: internal/archive/nested.go
````go
package archive

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"archive/zip"
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"

	"github.com/mholt/archiver/v3"

	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

func (s *Service) ExtractNestedArchive(fsPath string, nestedChain []string) ([]byte, error) {
	fsPath = pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)
	if len(nestedChain) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty nested chain")
	}

	current, err := s.extractFromFile(fsPath, nestedChain[0])
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("extracting %q from %q: %w", nestedChain[0], fsPath, err)
	}

	for index := 1; index < len(nestedChain); index++ {
		next, err := s.extractFromBytes(current, nestedChain[index], nestedChain[index])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("extracting %q (chain depth %d): %w", nestedChain[index], index, err)
		}
		current = next
	}
	return current, nil
}

func (s *Service) extractFromFile(fsPath, entryPath string) ([]byte, error) {
	want := normalizePath(entryPath)

	if isZipArchiveName(fsPath) {
		return s.extractFromFileZip(fsPath, want)
	}
	if needsArchiveReader(fsPath) {
		return s.extractFromFileArchiveReader(fsPath, want)
	}
	return s.extractFromFileViaArchiver(fsPath, want)
}

func (s *Service) extractFromFileZip(fsPath, want string) ([]byte, error) {
	r, err := zip.OpenReader(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer r.Close()

	for _, f := range r.File {
		if normalizePath(f.Name) == want {
			rc, err := f.Open()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			defer rc.Close()
			return io.ReadAll(rc)
		}
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found in %q", want, fsPath)
}

func (s *Service) extractFromFileViaArchiver(fsPath, want string) ([]byte, error) {
	var buf []byte
	err := archiver.Walk(fsPath, func(f archiver.File) error {
		if normalizePath(archiveEntryPath(f)) == want {
			var readErr error
			buf, readErr = io.ReadAll(f)
			if readErr != nil {
				return readErr
			}
			return archiver.ErrStopWalk
		}
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil && err != archiver.ErrStopWalk {
		return nil, err
	}
	if buf == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found in %q", want, fsPath)
	}
	return buf, nil
}

func (s *Service) extractFromFileArchiveReader(fsPath, want string) ([]byte, error) {
	f, err := os.Open(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer f.Close()

	fi, err := f.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	aIface, err := archiver.ByExtension(fsPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("extractFromFileArchiveReader: %w", err)
	}
	reader, ok := aIface.(archiver.Reader)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("extractFromFileArchiveReader: format %q is not readable", fsPath)
	}
	if err := reader.Open(f, fi.Size()); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	for {
		entry, err := reader.Read()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if normalizePath(archiveEntryPath(entry)) == want {
			buf, readErr := io.ReadAll(entry)
			entry.Close()
			if readErr != nil {
				return nil, readErr
			}
			return buf, nil
		}
		entry.Close()
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found in %q", want, fsPath)
}

func (s *Service) extractFromBytes(data []byte, entryPath string, archiveName string) ([]byte, error) {
	want := normalizePath(entryPath)

	if isZipMagic(data) {
		return s.extractFromZipBytes(data, want)
	}
	if archiveName != "" && needsArchiveReader(archiveName) {
		return s.extractFromArchiveReader(data, archiveName, want)
	}
	return s.extractFromTarBytes(data, want)
}

func (s *Service) extractFromZipBytes(data []byte, want string) ([]byte, error) {
	r, err := zip.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data), int64(len(data)))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, f := range r.File {
		if normalizePath(f.Name) == want {
			rc, err := f.Open()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			defer rc.Close()
			return io.ReadAll(rc)
		}
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found in ZIP", want)
}

func (s *Service) extractFromTarBytes(data []byte, want string) ([]byte, error) {
	tr := tar.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(data))
	for {
		h, err := tr.Next()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if normalizePath(h.Name) == want {
			return io.ReadAll(tr)
		}
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found in archive", want)
}

func (s *Service) extractFromArchiveReader(data []byte, archiveName, want string) ([]byte, error) {
	reader, err := openArchiveReader(archiveName, data)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	for {
		f, err := reader.Read()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if normalizePath(archiveEntryPath(f)) == want {
			buf, readErr := io.ReadAll(f)
			f.Close()
			if readErr != nil {
				return nil, readErr
			}
			return buf, nil
		}
		if err := f.Close(); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entry %q not found in %s", want, archiveName)
}
````

## File: internal/archive/resolve.go
````go
package archive

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	vfsarchive "wails-app/vfs/archive"
)

// ResolveChain opens a possibly nested archive chain and returns the innermost
// archive ready for browsing.
func ResolveChain(ctx context.Context, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, password string) (vfsarchive.Archive, error) {
	handler, ok := vfsarchive.ForPath(fsPath)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no archive handler for %q", fsPath)
	}

	if len(nestedChain) == 0 {
		return handler.Open(ctx, fsPath, vfsarchive.OpenOptions{ReadOnly: true, Password: password})
	}

	outer, err := handler.Open(ctx, fsPath, vfsarchive.OpenOptions{ReadOnly: true, Password: password})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open %q: %w", fsPath, err)
	}

	data, err := readArchiveEntryBytes(ctx, outer, nestedChain[0])
	outer.Close()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("extract %q from %q: %w", nestedChain[0], fsPath, err)
	}

	for index := 1; index < len(nestedChain); index++ {
		currentName := nestedChain[index-1]
		mid, err := openArchiveFromMemory(ctx, currentName, data, password)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("open level %d %q from bytes: %w", index, currentName, err)
		}
		next, err := readArchiveEntryBytes(ctx, mid, nestedChain[index])
		mid.Close()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("extract %q from level %d (%q): %w", nestedChain[index], index, currentName, err)
		}
		data = next
	}

	return openArchiveFromMemory(ctx, nestedChain[len(nestedChain)-1], data, password)
}

func openArchiveFromMemory(ctx context.Context, name string, data []byte, password string) (vfsarchive.Archive, error) {
	handler, ok := vfsarchive.ForPath(name)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no archive handler for %q", name)
	}

	ext := detectArchiveExt(name)
	if ext == "" {
		ext = ".tmp"
	}
	tempFile, err := os.CreateTemp("", "vfs-nested-*"+ext)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("temp file for %q: %w", name, err)
	}
	tempPath := tempFile.Name()

	if _, err := tempFile.Write(data); err != nil {
		tempFile.Close()
		os.Remove(tempPath)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("write temp %q: %w", name, err)
	}
	if err := tempFile.Close(); err != nil {
		os.Remove(tempPath)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("close temp %q: %w", name, err)
	}

	arch, err := handler.Open(ctx, tempPath, vfsarchive.OpenOptions{ReadOnly: true, Password: password})
	if err != nil {
		os.Remove(tempPath)
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open %q from temp: %w", name, err)
	}
	return &tempArchive{Archive: arch, tmp: tempPath}, nil
}

func readArchiveEntryBytes(ctx context.Context, arch vfsarchive.Archive, entryPath string) ([]byte, error) {
	file, err := arch.Open(ctx, normalizePath(entryPath))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open entry %q: %w", entryPath, err)
	}
	defer file.Close()
	return io.ReadAll(file)
}

type tempArchive struct {
	vfsarchive.Archive
	tmp string
}

func (t *tempArchive) Close() error {
	err := t.Archive.Close()
	os.Remove(t.tmp)
	return err
}

func detectArchiveExt(name string) string {
	lower := strings.ToLower(name)
	switch {
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.gz"):
		return ".tar.gz"
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.bz2"):
		return ".tar.bz2"
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.xz"):
		return ".tar.xz"
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tgz"):
		return ".tgz"
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tbz2"):
		return ".tbz2"
	default:
		return filepath.Ext(name)
	}
}
````

````go
	if err != nil {
````

````go
		{"light", "light"},
		{"LIGHT", "light"},
		{" Light ", "light"},
		{"dark", "dark"},
		{"DARK", "dark"},
		{"", "dark"},
		{"blue", "dark"},
	}

	for _, c := range cases {
		got := normalizeBrowserPaneTheme(c.input)
		if got != c.expected {
			t.Fatalf("normalizeBrowserPaneTheme(%q) = %q, want %q", c.input, got, c.expected)
		}
	}
}

func TestParseBrowserPaneColor(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		input       string
		wantR       uint8
		wantG       uint8
		wantB       uint8
		wantOk      bool
	}{
		{"#ff0000", 255, 0, 0, true},
		{"#FF0000", 255, 0, 0, true},
		{"#f00", 255, 0, 0, true},
		{"#123456", 18, 52, 86, true},
		{"#abc", 170, 187, 204, true},
		{"", 0, 0, 0, false},
		{"red", 0, 0, 0, false},
		{"#gg0000", 0, 0, 0, false},
		{"#12345", 0, 0, 0, false},
	}

	for _, c := range cases {
		r, g, b, ok := parseBrowserPaneColor(c.input)
		if r != c.wantR || g != c.wantG || b != c.wantB || ok != c.wantOk {
			t.Fatalf("parseBrowserPaneColor(%q) = (%d,%d,%d,%v), want (%d,%d,%d,%v)",
				c.input, r, g, b, ok, c.wantR, c.wantG, c.wantB, c.wantOk)
		}
	}
````

````go
	if !looksLikeUTF16LE(data) {

		t.Fatal("expected ASCII not to have CP1252-only bytes")
	}

func TestDecodedTextScore(t *testing.T) {
	score := decodedTextScore("hello world")
	if score <= 0 {
		t.Fatal("expected positive score for ASCII text")
	}
	bad := decodedTextScore("\x00\x01\x02\x03")
	if bad != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 0 score for garbage, got %f", bad)

func TestStripBOM(t *testing.T) {
	utf8BOM := []byte{0xef, 0xbb, 0xbf, 0x68, 0x69}

	if string(got) != "hi" {

	}
	noBOM := []byte("hello")
	if string(stripBOM(noBOM)) != "hello" {
		t.Fatal("expected unchanged without BOM")
	}
````

````go
package converter

import (
	"os/exec"
	"syscall"
)

// hideWindow suppresses the console window that would otherwise flash
// briefly on screen each time an external converter tool is spawned on Windows.
func hideWindow(cmd *exec.Cmd) {
	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{HideWindow: true}
}
````

## File: internal/converter/office.go
````go
package converter

import (
	"fmt"
	oslib "os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"wails-app/internal/utility"
)

// OfficeService handles conversion of supported documents to PDF.
type OfficeService struct {
	sofficeExePath   string
	mutoolExePath    string
	djvuLibreExePath string
	hasLibreOffice   bool
	hasMuPDF         bool
	hasDjVuLibre     bool
	detectOnce       sync.Once
}

// NewOfficeService creates a new document converter service.
func NewOfficeService() *OfficeService {
	return &OfficeService{}
}

func (s *OfficeService) ensureDetected() {
	s.detectOnce.Do(func() {
		s.detectLibreOffice()
		s.detectMuPDF()
		s.detectDjVuLibre()
	})
}

func (s *OfficeService) detectLibreOffice() {
	possiblePaths := []string{
		"soffice",
		"soffice.exe",
		`C:\Program Files\LibreOffice\program\soffice.exe`,
		`C:\Program Files (x86)\LibreOffice\program\soffice.exe`,
		"/usr/bin/soffice",
		"/usr/local/bin/soffice",
		"/Applications/LibreOffice.app/Contents/MacOS/soffice",
	}
	if path, ok := findExecutable(possiblePaths); ok {
		s.sofficeExePath = path
		s.hasLibreOffice = true
	}
}

func (s *OfficeService) detectMuPDF() {
	possiblePaths := []string{
		"mutool",
		"mutool.exe",
		`C:\Program Files\MuPDF\mutool.exe`,
		`C:\Program Files (x86)\MuPDF\mutool.exe`,
		"/usr/bin/mutool",
		"/usr/local/bin/mutool",
		"/Applications/MuPDF.app/Contents/MacOS/mutool",
	}
	if path, ok := findExecutable(possiblePaths); ok {
		s.mutoolExePath = path
		s.hasMuPDF = true
	}
}

func (s *OfficeService) detectDjVuLibre() {
	possiblePaths := []string{"ddjvu", "ddjvu.exe"}
	possiblePaths = append(possiblePaths, localDjVuLibrePaths("ddjvu.exe")...)
	if path, ok := findExecutable(possiblePaths); ok {
		s.djvuLibreExePath = path
		s.hasDjVuLibre = true
	}
}

func findExecutable(paths []string) (string, bool) {
	return utility.ResolveExecutable(paths...)
}

func localDjVuLibrePaths(executableName string) []string {
	paths := []string{}
	appendCandidate := func(base string) {
		if strings.TrimSpace(base) == "" {
			return
		}
		for _, relative := range []string{
			filepath.Join("DjVuLibre", executableName),
			filepath.Join("..", "DjVuLibre", executableName),
			filepath.Join("..", "..", "DjVuLibre", executableName),
			filepath.Join("..", "..", "..", "DjVuLibre", executableName),
		} {
			paths = append(paths, filepath.Join(base, relative))
		}
	}

	if cwd, err := oslib.Getwd(); err == nil {
		appendCandidate(cwd)
	}
	if exePath, err := oslib.Executable(); err == nil {
		appendCandidate(filepath.Dir(exePath))
	}

	return paths
}

func (s *OfficeService) IsAvailable() bool {
	s.ensureDetected()
	return s.hasLibreOffice || s.hasMuPDF || s.hasDjVuLibre
}

func (s *OfficeService) IsAvailableForFormat(ext string) bool {
	s.ensureDetected()
	switch classifyDocumentFormat(ext) {
	case documentFormatOffice:
		return s.hasLibreOffice
	case documentFormatEpub:
		return s.hasMuPDF
	case documentFormatDjvu:
		return s.hasDjVuLibre
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func (s *OfficeService) SupportedInputFormats() []string {
	return []string{
		"doc", "docx", "docm",
		"xls", "xlsx", "xlsm",
		"ppt", "pptx", "pptm",
		"odt", "ods", "odp",
		"rtf",
		"epub",
		"djvu", "djv",
	}
}

func (s *OfficeService) IsSupportedFormat(ext string) bool {
	ext = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimPrefix(ext, "."))
	for _, supported := range s.SupportedInputFormats() {
		if ext == supported {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func (s *OfficeService) AvailabilityInstructions(ext string) string {
	switch classifyDocumentFormat(ext) {
	case documentFormatOffice:
		return `LibreOffice is required for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, and RTF previews.

Install LibreOffice:
• Windows: https://www.libreoffice.org/download/download/
• macOS: brew install libreoffice
• Linux: sudo apt install libreoffice`
	case documentFormatEpub:
		return `MuPDF is required for EPUB previews.

Install MuPDF:
• Windows: https://mupdf.com/downloads/
• macOS: brew install mupdf
• Linux: sudo apt install mupdf-tools`
	case documentFormatDjvu:
		return `DjVuLibre is required for DjVu previews.

Recommended local install path: C:\Users\oleks\Desktop\file-manager\DjVuLibre

Install DjVuLibre:
• Windows: https://sourceforge.net/projects/djvu/files/latest/download
• The converter looks for ddjvu.exe on PATH and in nearby DjVuLibre folders.`
	default:
		return "No converter is available for this format."
	}
}

func (s *OfficeService) ConvertToPDF(inputPath string) (string, error) {
	s.ensureDetected()

	if _, err := oslib.Stat(inputPath); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("input file not found: %w", err)
	}

	ext := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.Ext(inputPath), "."))
	if !s.IsSupportedFormat(ext) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("unsupported document format: .%s", ext)
	}

	jobDir, err := createDocumentOutputDir()
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	outputPath := filepath.Join(jobDir, outputBaseName(inputPath)+".pdf")
	switch classifyDocumentFormat(ext) {
	case documentFormatOffice:
		if !s.hasLibreOffice {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("LibreOffice not found")
		}
		return s.convertWithLibreOffice(inputPath, jobDir)
	case documentFormatEpub:
		if !s.hasMuPDF {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("MuPDF not found")
		}
		return s.convertWithMuPDF(inputPath, outputPath)
	case documentFormatDjvu:
		if !s.hasDjVuLibre {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("DjVuLibre not found")
		}
		return s.convertWithDjVuLibre(inputPath, outputPath)
	default:
		return "", fmt.Errorf("unsupported document format: .%s", ext)
	}
}

func createDocumentOutputDir() (string, error) {
	root := filepath.Join(oslib.TempDir(), "wails-document-converter")
	if err := oslib.MkdirAll(root, 0755); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create temp directory: %w", err)
	}
	jobDir := filepath.Join(root, fmt.Sprintf("job-%d", time.Now().UnixNano()))
	if err := oslib.MkdirAll(jobDir, 0755); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create conversion directory: %w", err)
	}
	return jobDir, nil
}

func outputBaseName(inputPath string) string {
	baseName := filepath.Base(inputPath)
	return strings.TrimSuffix(baseName, filepath.Ext(baseName))
}

func (s *OfficeService) convertWithLibreOffice(inputPath, outputDir string) (string, error) {
	outputPath := filepath.Join(outputDir, outputBaseName(inputPath)+".pdf")
	cmd := exec.Command(
		s.sofficeExePath,
		"--headless",
		"--convert-to", "pdf",
		"--outdir", outputDir,
		inputPath,
	)
	hideWindow(cmd)
	if output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("LibreOffice conversion failed: %v%s", err, formatCommandOutput(output))
	}
	if _, err := oslib.Stat(outputPath); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("PDF output file not created: %w", err)
	}
	return outputPath, nil
}

func (s *OfficeService) convertWithMuPDF(inputPath, outputPath string) (string, error) {
	cmd := exec.Command(s.mutoolExePath, "convert", "-F", "pdf", "-o", outputPath, inputPath)
	hideWindow(cmd)
	if output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("MuPDF conversion failed: %v%s", err, formatCommandOutput(output))
	}
	if _, err := oslib.Stat(outputPath); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("PDF output file not created: %w", err)
	}
	return outputPath, nil
}

func (s *OfficeService) convertWithDjVuLibre(inputPath, outputPath string) (string, error) {
	cmd := exec.Command(s.djvuLibreExePath, "-format=pdf", inputPath, outputPath)
	hideWindow(cmd)
	if output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("DjVuLibre conversion failed: %v%s", err, formatCommandOutput(output))
	}
	if _, err := oslib.Stat(outputPath); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("PDF output file not created: %w", err)
	}
	return outputPath, nil
}

func formatCommandOutput(output []byte) string {
	text := strings.TrimSpace(string(output))
	if text == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return ": " + text
}

type documentFormatKind string

const (
	documentFormatUnknown documentFormatKind = "unknown"
	documentFormatOffice  documentFormatKind = "office"
	documentFormatEpub    documentFormatKind = "epub"
	documentFormatDjvu    documentFormatKind = "djvu"
)

func classifyDocumentFormat(ext string) documentFormatKind {
	ext = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimPrefix(ext, "."))
	switch ext {
	case "doc", "docx", "docm", "xls", "xlsx", "xlsm", "ppt", "pptx", "pptm", "odt", "ods", "odp", "rtf":
		return documentFormatOffice
	case "epub":
		return documentFormatEpub
	case "djvu", "djv":
		return documentFormatDjvu
	default:
		return documentFormatUnknown
	}
}

func (s *OfficeService) GetConversionError() string {
	return "Failed to convert document to PDF"
}
````

````go
// в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ
type testEvent struct {

	data interface{}

type mockClient struct {
	alive   bool
	status  SessionStatus
	stopped bool
}

func (m *mockClient) Alive() bool                 { return m.alive }
func (m *mockClient) Dispatch(r Request) (Response, error) { return Response{}, nil }
func (m *mockClient) Status() SessionStatus       { return m.status }
func (m *mockClient) Stop()                       { m.stopped = true }

func TestIsPermissionDenied(t *testing.T) {
	if IsPermissionDenied(nil) {
		t.Fatal("expected false for nil error")
	}
	if !IsPermissionDenied(os.ErrPermission) {
		t.Fatal("expected true for os.ErrPermission")
	}
	if !IsPermissionDenied(errors.New("permission denied")) {
		t.Fatal("expected true for 'permission denied' message")
	}
	if !IsPermissionDenied(errors.New("Access is denied")) {
		t.Fatal("expected true for 'Access is denied' message")
	}
	if !IsPermissionDenied(errors.New("operation not permitted")) {
		t.Fatal("expected true for 'operation not permitted' message")
	}
	if !IsPermissionDenied(errors.New("EACCES")) {
		t.Fatal("expected true for 'EACCES' message")
	}
	if IsPermissionDenied(errors.New("some random error")) {
		t.Fatal("expected false for unrelated error")
	}
}

func TestShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation(t *testing.T) {
	if !ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation(os.ErrPermission) {
		t.Fatal("expected true for permission denied")
	}
	if !ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation(errors.New("shfileoperationw returned error code 0x78")) {
		t.Fatal("expected true for SHFileOperation error")
	}
	if ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation(nil) {
		t.Fatal("expected false for nil error")
	}
	if ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation(errors.New("random")) {
		t.Fatal("expected false for unrelated error")
	}
}

func TestServiceStartSession(t *testing.T) {
	var events []testEvent
	s := NewService(
		func(name string, data interface{}) { events = append(events, testEvent{name, data}) },
		func(exePath string) (Client, error) {
			return &mockClient{alive: true, status: SessionStatus{Active: true, PID: 123}}, nil
		},
	)
	s.resolveExePath = func() (string, error) { return "/app", nil }

	status, err := s.StartSession()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if !status.Active || status.PID != 123 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected status: %+v", status)
	}

	// Second start should reuse existing client
	status2, err := s.StartSession()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error on re-start: %v", err)
	}
	if status2.PID != 123 {
		t.Fatalf("expected same session, got %+v", status2)
	}
}
````

## File: internal/filesystem/disk_usage.go
````go
package filesystem

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

func (s *Service) AnalyzeDiskUsage(path string) (*contracts.DiskUsageResult, error) {
	requestedPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if cached, ok := s.duCache.Get(requestedPath); ok {
		return cached, nil
	}
	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(requestedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	start := time.Now()
	children, err := readNonLinks(resolvedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	never := make(chan struct{})
	entries, _ := globalBFS(resolvedPath, children, never, nil, nil)

	result := s.mapDiskUsageResult(buildDiskUsageResult(resolvedPath, entries, start), requestedPath)
	s.duCache.Set(result)
	return result, nil
}

func (s *Service) StartDiskUsageStream(path string) (string, error) {
	requestedPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	s.duCache.InvalidateSubtree(requestedPath)
	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(requestedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	children, err := readNonLinks(resolvedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	scanID := fmt.Sprintf("du-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
	done := s.duStreams.register(scanID)

	go func() {
		start := time.Now()

		entries, _ := globalBFS(resolvedPath, children, done, func(_ int, entry contracts.DiskUsageEntry) {
			select {
			case <-done:
			default:
				s.emit("disk-usage:entry", map[string]interface{}{
					"scanId": scanID,
					"entry":  s.mapDiskUsageEntry(entry),
				})
			}
		}, func(progress contracts.DiskUsageProgress) {
			select {
			case <-done:
			default:
				s.emit("disk-usage:progress", map[string]interface{}{
					"scanId":   scanID,
					"progress": progress,
				})
			}
		})

		s.duStreams.unregister(scanID)

		result := s.mapDiskUsageResult(buildDiskUsageResult(resolvedPath, entries, start), requestedPath)
		s.duCache.Set(result)

		select {
		case <-done:
			return
		default:
			s.emit("disk-usage:done", map[string]interface{}{
				"scanId": scanID,
				"result": *result,
			})
		}
	}()

	return scanID, nil
}

func (s *Service) CancelDiskUsageStream(scanID string) {
	s.duStreams.cancel(scanID)
}

func (s *Service) mapDiskUsageEntry(entry contracts.DiskUsageEntry) contracts.DiskUsageEntry {
	entry.Path = s.toPublicPath(entry.Path)
	return entry
}

func (s *Service) mapDiskUsageResult(result *contracts.DiskUsageResult, requestedPath string) *contracts.DiskUsageResult {
	if result == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if requestedPath != "" {
		result.Path = pathref.Normalize(requestedPath)
	} else {
		result.Path = s.toPublicPath(result.Path)
	}
	for index := range result.Entries {
		result.Entries[index] = s.mapDiskUsageEntry(result.Entries[index])
	}
	return result
}

type duStreamRegistry struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	cancels map[string]func()
}

func newDuStreamRegistry() *duStreamRegistry {
	return &duStreamRegistry{cancels: make(map[string]func())}
}

func (r *duStreamRegistry) register(id string) <-chan struct{} {
	ch := make(chan struct{})
	var once sync.Once
	cancel := func() { once.Do(func() { close(ch) }) }
	r.mu.Lock()
	r.cancels[id] = cancel
	r.mu.Unlock()
	return ch
}

func (r *duStreamRegistry) unregister(id string) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	delete(r.cancels, id)
	r.mu.Unlock()
}

func (r *duStreamRegistry) cancel(id string) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	cancel, ok := r.cancels[id]
	if ok {
		delete(r.cancels, id)
	}
	r.mu.Unlock()
	if ok {
		cancel()
	}
}

func readNonLinks(path string) ([]os.DirEntry, error) {
	all, err := os.ReadDir(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := all[:0]
	for _, entry := range all {
		if !isLink(entry) {
			out = append(out, entry)
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

type scanJob struct {
	dir     string
	rootIdx int
}

func globalBFS(
	root string,
	children []os.DirEntry,
	done <-chan struct{},
	onChildUpdate func(idx int, entry contracts.DiskUsageEntry),
	onProgress func(progress contracts.DiskUsageProgress),
) ([]contracts.DiskUsageEntry, error) {
	n := len(children)
	entries := make([]contracts.DiskUsageEntry, n)
	start := time.Now()
	var progressSize atomic.Int64
	var progressFiles atomic.Int64
	var progressDirs atomic.Int64
	progressStop := make(chan struct{})

	type rootAccum struct {
		size     atomic.Int64
		files    atomic.Int64
		dirs     atomic.Int64
		inFlight atomic.Int32
		dirty    atomic.Bool
		typesMu  sync.Mutex
		types    map[string]contracts.DiskUsageTypeStat
	}
	accums := make([]rootAccum, n)

	buildChildSnapshot := func(idx int) contracts.DiskUsageEntry {
		snapshot := entries[idx]
		snapshot.Size = accums[idx].size.Load()
		snapshot.Files = accums[idx].files.Load()
		snapshot.Dirs = accums[idx].dirs.Load()
		snapshot.Types = cloneDiskUsageTypes(accums[idx].types, &accums[idx].typesMu)
		return snapshot
	}

	emitChildSnapshot := func(idx int) {
		if onChildUpdate != nil {
			onChildUpdate(idx, buildChildSnapshot(idx))
		}
	}

	var firstErr error
	var errMu sync.Mutex

	for i, child := range children {
		full := filepath.Join(root, child.Name())
		accums[i].types = make(map[string]contracts.DiskUsageTypeStat)
		entries[i] = contracts.DiskUsageEntry{
			Name:  child.Name(),
			Path:  filepath.ToSlash(full),
			IsDir: child.IsDir(),
		}
		if !child.IsDir() {
			if info, err := child.Info(); err == nil {
				entries[i].Size = info.Size()
				entries[i].Types = buildSingleFileTypes(child.Name(), info.Size())
				progressSize.Add(info.Size())
			} else {
				entries[i].Error = err.Error()
			}
			progressFiles.Add(1)
			if onChildUpdate != nil {
				onChildUpdate(i, entries[i])
			}
		} else {
			progressDirs.Add(1)
			accums[i].dirty.Store(true)
		}
	}

	if onProgress != nil || onChildUpdate != nil {
		emitProgress := func() {
			if onProgress != nil {
				onProgress(contracts.DiskUsageProgress{
					TotalSize:  progressSize.Load(),
					TotalFiles: progressFiles.Load(),
					TotalDirs:  progressDirs.Load(),
					ElapsedMs:  time.Since(start).Milliseconds(),
				})
			}
			if onChildUpdate != nil {
				for idx := range accums {
					if entries[idx].IsDir && accums[idx].inFlight.Load() > 0 && accums[idx].dirty.Swap(false) {
						emitChildSnapshot(idx)
					}
				}
			}
		}
		emitProgress()
		go func() {
			ticker := time.NewTicker(200 * time.Millisecond)
			defer ticker.Stop()
			for {
				select {
				case <-done:
					return
				case <-progressStop:
					return
				case <-ticker.C:
					emitProgress()
				}
			}
		}()
	}

	jobsIn := make(chan scanJob, 1024)
	jobsOut := make(chan scanJob, 1024)
	go func() {
		defer close(jobsOut)
		var buf []scanJob
		for {
			if len(buf) == 0 {
				job, ok := <-jobsIn
				if !ok {
					return
				}
				buf = append(buf, job)
			} else {
				select {
				case job, ok := <-jobsIn:
					if !ok {
						for _, buffered := range buf {
							jobsOut <- buffered
						}
						return
					}
					buf = append(buf, job)
				case jobsOut <- buf[0]:
					buf = buf[1:]
				}
			}
		}
	}()

	var inFlight atomic.Int64
	var closeJobsOnce sync.Once

	submit := func(job scanJob) {
		inFlight.Add(1)
		accums[job.rootIdx].inFlight.Add(1)
		select {
		case jobsIn <- job:
		case <-done:
			inFlight.Add(-1)
			accums[job.rootIdx].inFlight.Add(-1)
		}
	}

	for i, child := range children {
		if child.IsDir() {
			submit(scanJob{filepath.Join(root, child.Name()), i})
		}
	}

	numWorkers := runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0) * 2
	if numWorkers < 4 {
		numWorkers = 4
	}
	if numWorkers > 64 {
		numWorkers = 64
	}

	var workerWG sync.WaitGroup
	workerWG.Add(numWorkers)
	for w := 0; w < numWorkers; w++ {
		go func() {
			defer workerWG.Done()
			for job := range jobsOut {
				cancelled := false
				select {
				case <-done:
					cancelled = true
				default:
				}

				if !cancelled {
					dirEntries, err := os.ReadDir(job.dir)
					if err != nil {
						errMu.Lock()
						if firstErr == nil {
							firstErr = err
						}
						errMu.Unlock()
					} else {
						for _, entry := range dirEntries {
							if isLink(entry) {
								continue
							}
							full := filepath.Join(job.dir, entry.Name())
							if entry.IsDir() {
								accums[job.rootIdx].dirs.Add(1)
								accums[job.rootIdx].dirty.Store(true)
								progressDirs.Add(1)
								submit(scanJob{full, job.rootIdx})
							} else {
								accums[job.rootIdx].files.Add(1)
								accums[job.rootIdx].dirty.Store(true)
								progressFiles.Add(1)
								if info, err := entry.Info(); err == nil {
									accums[job.rootIdx].size.Add(info.Size())
									progressSize.Add(info.Size())
									addDiskUsageType(accums[job.rootIdx].types, &accums[job.rootIdx].typesMu, entry.Name(), info.Size())
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}

				if accums[job.rootIdx].inFlight.Add(-1) == 0 {
					idx := job.rootIdx
					accums[idx].dirty.Store(false)
					entries[idx] = buildChildSnapshot(idx)
					emitChildSnapshot(idx)
				}
				if inFlight.Add(-1) == 0 {
					closeJobsOnce.Do(func() { close(jobsIn) })
				}
			}
		}()
	}

	workerWG.Wait()
	close(progressStop)
	if onProgress != nil {
		onProgress(contracts.DiskUsageProgress{
			TotalSize:  progressSize.Load(),
			TotalFiles: progressFiles.Load(),
			TotalDirs:  progressDirs.Load(),
			ElapsedMs:  time.Since(start).Milliseconds(),
		})
	}
	return entries, firstErr
}

func buildSingleFileTypes(name string, size int64) map[string]contracts.DiskUsageTypeStat {
	ext := diskUsageExt(name)
	if ext == "" {
		return nil
	}
	return map[string]contracts.DiskUsageTypeStat{
		ext: {Count: 1, Size: size},
	}
}

func addDiskUsageType(target map[string]contracts.DiskUsageTypeStat, mu *sync.Mutex, name string, size int64) {
	ext := diskUsageExt(name)
	if ext == "" {
		return
	}
	mu.Lock()
	stat := target[ext]
	stat.Count++
	stat.Size += size
	target[ext] = stat
	mu.Unlock()
}

func cloneDiskUsageTypes(source map[string]contracts.DiskUsageTypeStat, mu *sync.Mutex) map[string]contracts.DiskUsageTypeStat {
	mu.Lock()
	defer mu.Unlock()
	if len(source) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	cloned := make(map[string]contracts.DiskUsageTypeStat, len(source))
	for ext, stat := range source {
		cloned[ext] = stat
	}
	return cloned
}

func mergeDiskUsageTypes(entries []contracts.DiskUsageEntry) map[string]contracts.DiskUsageTypeStat {
	merged := make(map[string]contracts.DiskUsageTypeStat)
	for _, entry := range entries {
		for ext, stat := range entry.Types {
			current := merged[ext]
			current.Count += stat.Count
			current.Size += stat.Size
			merged[ext] = current
		}
	}
	if len(merged) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return merged
}

func diskUsageExt(name string) string {
	ext := filepath.Ext(name)
	if len(ext) <= 1 {
		return ""
	}
	return strings.ToLower(ext[1:])
}

func buildDiskUsageResult(path string, entries []contracts.DiskUsageEntry, start time.Time) *contracts.DiskUsageResult {
	sort.Slice(entries, func(i, j int) bool {
		return entries[i].Size > entries[j].Size
	})

	var totalSize, totalFiles, totalDirs int64
	for _, entry := range entries {
		totalSize += entry.Size
		if entry.IsDir {
			totalDirs += 1 + entry.Dirs
			totalFiles += entry.Files
		} else {
			totalFiles++
		}
	}

	return &contracts.DiskUsageResult{
		Path:       filepath.ToSlash(path),
		TotalSize:  totalSize,
		TotalFiles: totalFiles,
		TotalDirs:  totalDirs,
		Types:      mergeDiskUsageTypes(entries),
		Entries:    entries,
		ElapsedMs:  time.Since(start).Milliseconds(),
	}
}
````

````go
package platform

import (
	"testing"
)

func TestToSlash(t *testing.T) {
	if got := ToSlash(`C:\Users\name`); got != "C:/Users/name" {
		t.Fatalf("ToSlash failed: %q", got)
	}
	if got := ToSlash("/home/user"); got != "/home/user" {
		t.Fatalf("ToSlash failed: %q", got)
	}
}

func TestCleanPath(t *testing.T) {
	if got := CleanPath("/a/b/../c"); got != "/a/c" {
		t.Fatalf("CleanPath failed: %q", got)
	}
}

func TestNormalize(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		input string
		want  string
	}{
		{`C:\Users\name`, "C:/Users/name"},
		{"/home/user/", "home/user"},
		{"///a///b///", "a///b"},
		{"", ""},
		{"no-separators", "no-separators"},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		got := Normalize(tc.input)
		if got != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("Normalize(%q) = %q, want %q", tc.input, got, tc.want)
		}
	}
}

func TestJoinNormalized(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		base  string
		child string
		want  string
	}{
		{"/home", "docs", "home/docs"},
		{"", "docs", "docs"},
		{"/home/", "/docs/", "home/docs"},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		got := JoinNormalized(tc.base, tc.child)
		if got != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("JoinNormalized(%q, %q) = %q, want %q", tc.base, tc.child, got, tc.want)
		}
	}
}

func TestJoin(t *testing.T) {
	if got := Join("a", "b", "c"); got != "a/b/c" {
		t.Fatalf("Join failed: %q", got)
	}
	if got := Join(); got != "" {
		t.Fatalf("Join() with no args failed: %q", got)
	}
}

func TestParentPath(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		input string
		want  string
	}{
		{"/home/user/docs", "/home/user"},
		{"/home/user", "/home"},
		{"/home", "/"},
		{"/", "/"},
		{"C:/Users", "C:/"},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		got := ParentPath(tc.input)
		if got != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("ParentPath(%q) = %q, want %q", tc.input, got, tc.want)
		}
	}
}

func TestSplitPath(t *testing.T) {
	dir, base, name, ext := SplitPath("/home/user/file.txt")
	if dir != "/home/user" || base != "file.txt" || name != "file" || ext != ".txt" {
		t.Fatalf("SplitPath failed: dir=%q base=%q name=%q ext=%q", dir, base, name, ext)
	}

	dir, base, name, ext = SplitPath("/home/user/.gitignore")
	// filepath.Ext(".gitignore") returns ".gitignore"; name becomes ""
	if name != "" || ext != ".gitignore" {
		t.Fatalf("SplitPath dotfile failed: name=%q ext=%q", name, ext)
	}
}

func TestBreadcrumbs(t *testing.T) {
	crumbs := Breadcrumbs("/home/user/docs")
	if len(crumbs) != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 4 crumbs, got %d", len(crumbs))
	}
	// Root label is platform-dependent ("/" on Unix, "\" on Windows)
	if crumbs[1]["label"] != "home" || crumbs[2]["label"] != "user" || crumbs[3]["label"] != "docs" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected labels: %+v", crumbs)
	}
	if crumbs[3]["path"] != "/home/user/docs" {
		t.Fatalf("expected last path to be /home/user/docs, got %s", crumbs[3]["path"])
	}
}

func TestCloudSchemeType(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		scheme string
		want   string
	}{
		{"onedrive://", "cloud-onedrive"},
		{"gdrive://", "cloud-google"},
		{"dropbox://", "cloud-dropbox"},
		{"unknown", "unknown"},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		got := cloudSchemeType(tc.scheme)
		if string(got) != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("cloudSchemeType(%q) = %q, want %q", tc.scheme, got, tc.want)
		}
	}
}
````

````go
package platform

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

func GetOSInfo() contracts.OSInfoResponse {
	hostname, _ := os.Hostname()
	arch := runtime.GOARCH

	switch arch {
	case "amd64":
		arch = "x86_64"
	case "arm64":
		arch = "aarch64"
	}

	osType, version := getOSTypeAndVersion()
	var systemDrive *string
	if osType == contracts.OSWindows {
		drive := getSystemDrive()
		systemDrive = &drive
	}

	return contracts.OSInfoResponse{
		OS:          osType,
		Version:     version,
		Arch:        arch,
		Hostname:    hostname,
		SystemDrive: systemDrive,
	}
}

func ListDrives() contracts.DrivesList {
	return contracts.DrivesList{Schemes: append(listDrivesPlatform(), syntheticDrives()...)}
}

func GetSpecialFolders() contracts.SpecialFoldersResponse {
	return contracts.SpecialFoldersResponse{Folders: getSpecialFoldersPlatform()}
}

func getHomeDir() string {
	home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return filepath.ToSlash(home)
}

func syntheticDrives() []contracts.DriveInfo {
	drives := []contracts.DriveInfo{
		{
			Name:       "Memory",
			Path:       pathref.MemoryScheme,
			SchemeType: contracts.SchemeMemory,
		},
		{
			Name:       "Registry",
			Path:       pathref.RegistryScheme,
			SchemeType: contracts.SchemeRegistry,
		},
		{
			Name:       "Search",
			Path:       pathref.SearchScheme,
			SchemeType: contracts.SchemeSearch,
		},
		{
			Name:       "HTTP",
			Path:       pathref.HTTPAliasScheme,
			SchemeType: contracts.SchemeHTTP,
		},
		{
			Name:       "HTTPS",
			Path:       pathref.HTTPSAliasScheme,
			SchemeType: contracts.SchemeHTTPS,
		},
		{
			Name:       "SMB",
			Path:       pathref.SMBScheme,
			SchemeType: contracts.SchemeSMB,
		},
		{
			Name:       "S3",
			Path:       pathref.S3Scheme,
			SchemeType: contracts.SchemeS3,
		},
	}

	for _, provider := range pathref.AvailableLocalCloudProviders() {
		drives = append(drives, contracts.DriveInfo{
			Name:       provider.Name,
			Path:       provider.Scheme,
			SchemeType: cloudSchemeType(provider.Scheme),
		})
	}

	return drives
}

func cloudSchemeType(scheme string) contracts.SchemeType {
	switch scheme {
	case pathref.OneDriveScheme:
		return contracts.SchemeCloudOneDrive
	case pathref.GDriveScheme:
		return contracts.SchemeCloudGoogle
	case pathref.DropboxScheme:
		return contracts.SchemeCloudDropbox
	default:
		return contracts.SchemeUnknown
	}
}
````

````go
package plugin

import (
	"context"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

// CommandPlugin allows plugins to register custom commands that appear in the
// toolbar and context menu.
type CommandPlugin interface {
	Plugin
	// Commands returns the list of commands this plugin provides.
	Commands() []CommandInfo
	// IsApplicable returns true if the command can act on the given paths.
	IsApplicable(commandID string, paths []string) bool
	// Execute runs the command.
	Execute(ctx context.Context, commandID string, paths []string) error
}

// CommandResult is the standard result shape for command execution.
type CommandResult struct {
	Success bool   `json:"success"`
	Message string `json:"message,omitempty"`
}

// ToOperationResult converts a CommandResult to the standard operation result.
func (r CommandResult) ToOperationResult(paths ...string) contracts.OperationResult {
	return contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       r.Success,
		Message:       r.Message,
		AffectedPaths: paths,
	}
}
````

````go
package plugin

import (
	"context"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

// OperationHook allows plugins to intercept and extend file operations.
// Hooks run in registration order. A Before* method returning an error
// cancels the operation.
type OperationHook interface {
	Plugin

	BeforeCopy(ctx context.Context, src, dst string) error
	AfterCopy(ctx context.Context, src, dst string)

	BeforeMove(ctx context.Context, src, dst string) error
	AfterMove(ctx context.Context, src, dst string)

	BeforeDelete(ctx context.Context, path string) error
	AfterDelete(ctx context.Context, path string)

	BeforeMkdir(ctx context.Context, path string) error
	AfterMkdir(ctx context.Context, path string)
}

// NoOpOperationHook is an embeddable helper for plugins that only want to
// override a subset of hooks.
type NoOpOperationHook struct{}

func (NoOpOperationHook) BeforeCopy(ctx context.Context, src, dst string) error { return nil }
func (NoOpOperationHook) AfterCopy(ctx context.Context, src, dst string)         {}
func (NoOpOperationHook) BeforeMove(ctx context.Context, src, dst string) error { return nil }
func (NoOpOperationHook) AfterMove(ctx context.Context, src, dst string)         {}
func (NoOpOperationHook) BeforeDelete(ctx context.Context, path string) error   { return nil }
func (NoOpOperationHook) AfterDelete(ctx context.Context, path string)           {}
func (NoOpOperationHook) BeforeMkdir(ctx context.Context, path string) error    { return nil }
func (NoOpOperationHook) AfterMkdir(ctx context.Context, path string)            {}

// NoOpOperationHook is designed to be embedded into a struct that already
// implements Plugin. It does not satisfy OperationHook on its own because
// OperationHook embeds Plugin.

// CompositeOperationHook runs a list of hooks in order.
type CompositeOperationHook []OperationHook

func (c CompositeOperationHook) runBefore(ctx context.Context, fn func(OperationHook) error) error {
	for _, h := range c {
		if err := fn(h); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (c CompositeOperationHook) runAfter(ctx context.Context, fn func(OperationHook)) {
	for _, h := range c {
		fn(h)
	}
}

func (c CompositeOperationHook) BeforeCopy(ctx context.Context, src, dst string) error {
	return c.runBefore(ctx, func(h OperationHook) error { return h.BeforeCopy(ctx, src, dst) })
}
func (c CompositeOperationHook) AfterCopy(ctx context.Context, src, dst string) {
	c.runAfter(ctx, func(h OperationHook) { h.AfterCopy(ctx, src, dst) })
}
func (c CompositeOperationHook) BeforeMove(ctx context.Context, src, dst string) error {
	return c.runBefore(ctx, func(h OperationHook) error { return h.BeforeMove(ctx, src, dst) })
}
func (c CompositeOperationHook) AfterMove(ctx context.Context, src, dst string) {
	c.runAfter(ctx, func(h OperationHook) { h.AfterMove(ctx, src, dst) })
}
func (c CompositeOperationHook) BeforeDelete(ctx context.Context, path string) error {
	return c.runBefore(ctx, func(h OperationHook) error { return h.BeforeDelete(ctx, path) })
}
func (c CompositeOperationHook) AfterDelete(ctx context.Context, path string) {
	c.runAfter(ctx, func(h OperationHook) { h.AfterDelete(ctx, path) })
}
func (c CompositeOperationHook) BeforeMkdir(ctx context.Context, path string) error {
	return c.runBefore(ctx, func(h OperationHook) error { return h.BeforeMkdir(ctx, path) })
}
func (c CompositeOperationHook) AfterMkdir(ctx context.Context, path string) {
	c.runAfter(ctx, func(h OperationHook) { h.AfterMkdir(ctx, path) })
}

// OperationResultAdapter adapts the hook signature to contracts.OperationResult.
func OperationResultAdapter(success bool, msg string, paths ...string) contracts.OperationResult {
	return contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       success,
		Message:       msg,
		AffectedPaths: paths,
	}
}
````

## File: internal/plugin/preview.go
````go
package plugin

import (
	"context"
)

// PreviewPlugin allows plugins to provide custom file preview and thumbnail
// generation for file types not handled by the built-in converter.
type PreviewPlugin interface {
	Plugin
	// CanPreview returns true if this plugin can generate a preview for the
	// given MIME type and file extension.
	CanPreview(mimeType, ext string) bool
	// Priority returns the plugin priority. Higher values win over lower ones.
	Priority() int
	// GenerateThumbnail creates a thumbnail image for the given file path.
	// The returned bytes should be a valid image (PNG, WebP, JPEG).
	GenerateThumbnail(ctx context.Context, path string) ([]byte, error)
	// Convert converts the file at path to the target format.
	// Supported targets depend on the plugin (e.g., "pdf", "html", "txt").
	Convert(ctx context.Context, path string, targetFormat string) ([]byte, error)
}

// PreviewPicker selects the best preview plugin for a given file.
type PreviewPicker struct {
	plugins []PreviewPlugin
}

// NewPreviewPicker creates a picker from the registered plugins.
func NewPreviewPicker(plugins []PreviewPlugin) *PreviewPicker {
	return &PreviewPicker{plugins: plugins}
}

// Pick returns the highest-priority plugin that can handle the file, or nil.
func (p *PreviewPicker) Pick(mimeType, ext string) PreviewPlugin {
	var best PreviewPlugin
	var bestPriority int
	for _, plugin := range p.plugins {
		if !plugin.CanPreview(mimeType, ext) {
			continue
		}
		if prio := plugin.Priority(); prio > bestPriority {
			bestPriority = prio
			best = plugin
		}
	}
	return best
}
````

````go
package pluginpackage

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func TestDiscoverRejectsDuplicatePluginIDs(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	manifest := []byte(`{"schemaVersion":1,"id":"duplicate.plugin","name":"Duplicate","version":"1.0.0"}`)
	for _, dir := range []string{"one", "two"} {
		pkgDir := filepath.Join(root, dir)
		if err := os.Mkdir(pkgDir, 0o755); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(pkgDir, ManifestFileName), manifest, 0o644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	packages, err := Discover(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(packages) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("got %d packages", len(packages))
	}
	for _, pkg := range packages {
		if pkg.Valid {
			t.Fatalf("duplicate package unexpectedly valid: %#v", pkg)
		}
	}
}
````

````go
package pluginpackage

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func TestDiscoverValidAndInvalidPackages(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	validDir := filepath.Join(root, "epikode.hash-tools")
	invalidDir := filepath.Join(root, "broken")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(validDir, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(invalidDir, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(validDir, ManifestFileName), []byte(`{"schemaVersion":1,"id":"epikode.hash-tools","name":"Hash Tools","version":"1.0.0","apiVersion":"^1.0.0"}`), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(invalidDir, ManifestFileName), []byte(`{"schemaVersion":1,"id":"BAD","name":"","version":"nope"}`), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	packages, err := Discover(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(packages) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("got %d packages, want 2", len(packages))
	}
	var valid, invalid *DiscoveredPackage
	for i := range packages {
		if packages[i].Manifest.ID == "epikode.hash-tools" {
			valid = &packages[i]
		} else {
			invalid = &packages[i]
		}
	}
	if valid == nil || !valid.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("valid package not discovered correctly: %#v", valid)
	}
	if invalid == nil || invalid.Valid || len(invalid.Errors) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("invalid package not reported: %#v", invalid)
	}
}

func TestDiscoverIgnoresSymlinkPackageDirectories(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	outside := t.TempDir()
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(outside, ManifestFileName), []byte(`{"schemaVersion":1,"id":"outside","name":"Outside","version":"1.0.0"}`), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.Symlink(outside, filepath.Join(root, "linked")); err != nil {
		t.Skipf("symlinks unavailable: %v", err)
	}
	packages, err := Discover(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(packages) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("symlink package should be ignored: %#v", packages)
	}
}

func TestDiscoverRejectsOversizedManifest(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	dir := filepath.Join(root, "large")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	data := make([]byte, MaxManifestBytes+1)
	for i := range data {
		data[i] = ' '
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, ManifestFileName), data, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	packages, err := Discover(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(packages) != 1 || packages[0].Valid || len(packages[0].Errors) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("oversized manifest was not rejected: %#v", packages)
	}
}
````
