## File: frontend/src/app/components/file-browser-clipboard.controller.spec.ts
````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';

import { FileBrowserClipboardController, type FileBrowserClipboardHost, type FileBrowserClipboardPane } from './file-browser-clipboard.controller';
import type { SourceCapabilities } from '../services/source-capabilities';

const mutable: SourceCapabilities = { read: true, create: true, delete: true, rename: true, trash: true };
const readOnly: SourceCapabilities = { read: true, create: false, delete: false, rename: false, trash: false };

function pane(capabilities: SourceCapabilities): FileBrowserClipboardPane {
  return {
    currentPath: 'filesystem://target',
    selectedFiles: new Set<string>(),
    sourceCapabilities: capabilities,
  };
}

function host(target: FileBrowserClipboardPane): FileBrowserClipboardHost {
  return {
    getActivePane: () => target,
    getActivePaneId: () => 'left',
    apiService: {
      batchCopy: fn().mockResolvedValue({ failed: 0 }),
      batchMove: fn().mockResolvedValue({ failed: 0 }),
    } as unknown as FileBrowserClipboardHost['apiService'],
    confirmDialog: { alert: fn() } as unknown as FileBrowserClipboardHost['confirmDialog'],
    buildDestinationPath: fn(async (source: string, destination: string) => `${destination}/${source.split('/').pop()}`),
    runCrossPaneCopy: fn(),
    runCrossPaneMove: fn(),
  };
}

describe('FileBrowserClipboardController paste capabilities', () => {
  it('pastes into a writable destination', async () => {
    const target = host(pane(mutable));
    const clipboard = { operation: 'copy' as const, paths: ['filesystem://source/file.txt'] };

    const result = await new FileBrowserClipboardController().pasteFromClipboard(target, clipboard);

    expect(target.apiService.batchCopy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(result).toBe(clipboard);
  });

  it('blocks paste into a read-only destination and preserves a cut clipboard', async () => {
    const target = host(pane(readOnly));
    const clipboard = { operation: 'cut' as const, paths: ['filesystem://source/file.txt'] };

    const result = await new FileBrowserClipboardController().pasteFromClipboard(target, clipboard);

    expect(target.apiService.batchMove).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(target.confirmDialog.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Move Not Available\nThe destination is read-only.');
    expect(result).toBe(clipboard);
  });
});
````

## File: frontend/src/app/components/file-browser-command-availability.spec.ts
````typescript
import type { ActionAvailability } from '../services/action-availability';
import { BC } from './file-browser-command-registry';
import { isFileBrowserCommandAvailable } from './file-browser-command-availability';

const availability: ActionAvailability = {
  createFolder: false,
  deleteSelected: false,
  copySelected: true,
  cutSelected: false,
  paste: false,
  rename: false,
  copyToOther: true,
  moveToOther: false,
};

describe('isFileBrowserCommandAvailable', () => {
  it('maps capability-sensitive browser commands', () => {
    expect(isFileBrowserCommandAvailable(BC.copy, availability)).toBe(true);
    expect(isFileBrowserCommandAvailable(BC.cut, availability)).toBe(false);
    expect(isFileBrowserCommandAvailable(BC.newFolder, availability)).toBe(false);
    expect(isFileBrowserCommandAvailable(BC.copyToOtherPane, availability)).toBe(true);
    expect(isFileBrowserCommandAvailable(BC.moveToOtherPane, availability)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('leaves unrelated commands available', () => {
    expect(isFileBrowserCommandAvailable(BC.refresh, availability)).toBe(true);
    expect(isFileBrowserCommandAvailable('plugin.example.command', availability)).toBe(true);
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';

import { FileBrowserDropController, type FileBrowserDropHost, type FileBrowserDropPane } from './file-browser-drop.controller';
import type { SourceCapabilities } from '../services/source-capabilities';

const mutable: SourceCapabilities = { read: true, create: true, delete: true, rename: true, trash: true };
const readOnly: SourceCapabilities = { read: true, create: false, delete: false, rename: false, trash: false };

function pane(capabilities: SourceCapabilities): FileBrowserDropPane {

  };
}

function host(target: FileBrowserDropPane): FileBrowserDropHost {
  return {
    getActivePane: () => target,
    getLeftPane: () => target,
    getRightPane: () => target,
    getPanesContainer: () => undefined,
    getLeftPaneWidth: () => 50,
    apiService: { batchCopy: fn().mockResolvedValue({ failed: 0 }) } as unknown as FileBrowserDropHost['apiService'],
    confirmDialog: { alert: fn() } as unknown as FileBrowserDropHost['confirmDialog'],
    buildDestinationPath: fn(async (source: string, destination: string) => `${destination}/${source.split('/').pop()}`),
  };
}

describe('FileBrowserDropController destination capabilities', () => {
  it('copies native drops into writable destinations', async () => {
    const targetPane = pane(mutable);
    const targetHost = host(targetPane);

    await new FileBrowserDropController().handleNativeFileDrop(targetHost, 0, 0, ['C:/source/file.txt']);

    expect(targetHost.apiService.batchCopy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(targetPane.browserCommands.navigation.refresh).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('rejects native drops into read-only destinations', async () => {
    const targetHost = host(pane(readOnly));

    await new FileBrowserDropController().handleNativeFileDrop(targetHost, 0, 0, ['C:/source/file.txt']);

    expect(targetHost.apiService.batchCopy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(targetHost.confirmDialog.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Copy Not Available\nThe destination is read-only.');
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, EventEmitter, HostListener, Input, Output } from '@angular/core';
import type { PresentedCommand } from './presented-command';

export interface FileContextMenuState {
  readonly x: number;
  readonly y: number;
  readonly items: readonly PresentedCommand[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-file-context-menu',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule],
  template: `
    <div
      *ngIf="state"
      class="context-menu"
      role="menu"
      [style.left.px]="state.x"
      [style.top.px]="state.y"
      (mousedown)="$event.stopPropagation()"
      (contextmenu)="$event.preventDefault(); $event.stopPropagation()">
      <ng-container *ngFor="let item of state.items; trackBy: trackItem">
        <div *ngIf="item.separatorBefore" class="context-menu-separator" role="separator"></div>
        <button
          type="button"
          class="context-menu-item"
          role="menuitem"
          [disabled]="!item.enabled"
          [attr.aria-disabled]="!item.enabled"
          (click)="run(item)">
          <span class="context-menu-icon">{{ item.icon || '' }}</span>
          <span class="context-menu-label">{{ item.label }}</span>
          <span *ngIf="item.shortcut" class="context-menu-shortcut">{{ item.shortcut }}</span>
        </button>
      </ng-container>
    </div>
  `,
  styles: [`
    .context-menu {
      position: fixed;
      z-index: 20000;
      min-width: 220px;
      max-width: min(320px, calc(100vw - 16px));
      padding: 4px 0;
      background: var(--vsc-menu-background, var(--vsc-editor-background));
      color: var(--vsc-menu-foreground, var(--vsc-foreground));
      border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border);
      border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
      box-shadow: var(--vsc-widget-shadow);
      user-select: none;
    }

    .context-menu-item {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 28px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 18px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border: 0;
      background: transparent;
      color: inherit;
      text-align: left;
      font: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .context-menu-item:hover:not(:disabled),
    .context-menu-item:focus-visible:not(:disabled) {
      outline: none;
      background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background);
      color: var(--vsc-list-hover-foreground, var(--vsc-foreground));
    }

    .context-menu-item:disabled {
      opacity: 0.42;
      cursor: default;
    }

    .context-menu-icon {
      width: 18px;
      text-align: center;
      opacity: 0.85;
    }

    .context-menu-label {
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .context-menu-shortcut {
      margin-left: 18px;
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
      font-size: 11px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .context-menu-separator {
      height: 1px;
      margin: 4px 0;
      background: var(--vsc-border-subtle, var(--vsc-border));
    }
  `],
})
export class FileContextMenuComponent {
  @Input() state: FileContextMenuState | null = null;
  @Output() closed = new EventEmitter<void>();

  trackItem(_index: number, item: PresentedCommand): string {
    return item.id;
  }

  run(item: PresentedCommand): void {
    if (!item.enabled) return;
    this.closed.emit();
    Promise.resolve(item.execute()).catch(error => {
      console.error(`Context menu action ${item.id} failed:`, error);
    });
  }

  @HostListener('document:mousedown')
  onDocumentMouseDown(): void {
    if (this.state) this.closed.emit();
  }

  @HostListener('document:keydown.escape')
  onEscape(): void {
    if (this.state) this.closed.emit();
  }

  @HostListener('window:blur')
  onWindowBlur(): void {
    if (this.state) this.closed.emit();
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { buildBackgroundFileContextMenu, buildBuiltinFileContextMenu } from './file-context-menu.model';
import type { ActionAvailability } from '../services/action-availability';

const enabled: ActionAvailability = {
  createFolder: true,
  deleteSelected: true,
  copySelected: true,
  cutSelected: true,
  paste: true,
  rename: true,
  copyToOther: true,
  moveToOther: true,
};

describe('buildBuiltinFileContextMenu', () => {
  it('keeps read actions available while disabling unavailable mutations', () => {
    const items = buildBuiltinFileContextMenu({
      availability: { ...enabled, cutSelected: false, deleteSelected: false, rename: false, moveToOther: false },
      selectedCount: 1,
      isDirectory: false,
    });
    const byId = new Map(items.map(item => [item.id, item]));

    expect(byId.get('open')?.enabled).toBe(true);
    expect(byId.get('copy')?.enabled).toBe(true);
    expect(byId.get('cut')?.enabled).toBe(false);
    expect(byId.get('delete')?.enabled).toBe(false);
    expect(byId.get('rename')?.enabled).toBe(false);
    expect(byId.get('moveToOther')?.enabled).toBe(false);
  });

  it('offers directory navigation without file-only preview/external actions', () => {
    const items = buildBuiltinFileContextMenu({ availability: enabled, selectedCount: 1, isDirectory: true });
    const byId = new Map(items.map(item => [item.id, item]));

    expect(byId.get('open')?.enabled).toBe(true);
    expect(byId.get('openInNewTab')?.enabled).toBe(true);
    expect(byId.get('quickView')?.enabled).toBe(false);
    expect(byId.get('openWithExternal')?.enabled).toBe(false);
  });

  it('requires a single selection for rename', () => {
    const items = buildBuiltinFileContextMenu({ availability: enabled, selectedCount: 2, isDirectory: false });
    expect(items.find(item => item.id === 'rename')?.enabled).toBe(false);
  });

  it('builds background actions from create/paste availability', () => {
    const items = buildBackgroundFileContextMenu({ ...enabled, createFolder: false, paste: false });
    const byId = new Map(items.map(item => [item.id, item]));
    expect(byId.get('newFolder')?.enabled).toBe(false);
    expect(byId.get('paste')?.enabled).toBe(false);
    expect(byId.get('refresh')?.enabled).toBe(true);
  });

});
````

````typescript
import type { ActionAvailability } from '../services/action-availability';
import type { CommandPresentation } from './presented-command';

export type BuiltinFileContextAction =
  | 'open'
  | 'quickView'
  | 'openInNewTab'
  | 'copyPath'
  | 'openWithExternal'
  | 'copy'
  | 'cut'
  | 'delete'
  | 'rename'
  | 'copyToOther'
  | 'moveToOther';

export type FileContextMenuDescriptor = CommandPresentation<BuiltinFileContextAction>;

export function buildBuiltinFileContextMenu(input: {
  availability: ActionAvailability;
  selectedCount: number;
  isDirectory: boolean;
}): FileContextMenuDescriptor[] {
  const a = input.availability;
  return [
    { id: 'open', label: 'Open', shortcut: 'Enter', enabled: true, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.open' },
    { id: 'quickView', label: 'Quick View', shortcut: 'F3', enabled: !input.isDirectory, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.quickView' },
    { id: 'openInNewTab', label: 'Open in New Tab', enabled: true, source: 'builtin' },
    { id: 'openWithExternal', label: 'Open with External App', enabled: !input.isDirectory, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.openWithExternal' },
    { id: 'copyPath', label: 'Copy Path', shortcut: 'Ctrl+Shift+Enter', enabled: true, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.copyCursorPath' },
    { id: 'copy', label: 'Copy', shortcut: 'Ctrl+C', enabled: a.copySelected, separatorBefore: true, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.copy' },
    { id: 'cut', label: 'Cut', shortcut: 'Ctrl+X', enabled: a.cutSelected, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.cut' },
    { id: 'delete', label: 'Delete', shortcut: 'Del', enabled: a.deleteSelected, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.delete' },
    { id: 'rename', label: 'Rename', shortcut: 'F2', enabled: input.selectedCount === 1 && a.rename, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.rename' },
    { id: 'copyToOther', label: 'Copy to Other Pane', shortcut: 'F5', enabled: a.copyToOther, separatorBefore: true, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.ctrl.copyToOther' },
    { id: 'moveToOther', label: 'Move to Other Pane', shortcut: 'F6', enabled: a.moveToOther, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.ctrl.moveToOther' },
  ];
}

export type BackgroundFileContextAction = 'newFolder' | 'paste' | 'refresh';

export function buildBackgroundFileContextMenu(
  availability: ActionAvailability,
): CommandPresentation<BackgroundFileContextAction>[] {
  return [
    { id: 'newFolder', label: 'New Folder', shortcut: 'F7', enabled: availability.createFolder, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.newFolder' },
    { id: 'paste', label: 'Paste', shortcut: 'Ctrl+V', enabled: availability.paste, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.files.paste' },
    { id: 'refresh', label: 'Refresh', shortcut: 'Ctrl+R', enabled: true, separatorBefore: true, source: 'builtin', commandId: 'pane.nav.refresh' },
  ];
}
````

````typescript
import type { FilePaneFocusController, FilePaneFocusHost } from './file-pane-focus.controller';
import type { FilePaneNavigationController, FilePaneNavigationHost } from './file-pane-navigation.controller';
import type { FilePaneOpenController, FilePaneOpenHost } from './file-pane-open.controller';
import type { FilePaneOperationsController, FilePaneOperationsHost } from './file-pane-operations.controller';
import type { FilePanePreviewController, FilePanePreviewHost } from './file-pane-preview.controller';
import type { FilePanePreviewRequest } from './file-pane-preview.controller';
import type { FilePaneStateRuntimeAdapter } from './file-pane-state-runtime.factory';
import type { ViewerFileListItem } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import type { SurfaceCapability } from '../surfaces/surface-contribution';
import type { SourceCapabilities } from '../services/source-capabilities';

export interface FilePaneBrowserCommands {
  navigation: {
    navigateUp(): Promise<void>;
    refresh(): void;
    openSelectedItem(): void;
  };
  selection: {
    createFolder(): Promise<void>;
    deleteSelected(): Promise<void>;
    renameSelected(): Promise<void>;
    copyToOther(): void;
    moveToOther(): void;
  };
  preview: {
    getTargetPath(): string;
    getTargetRequest(): FilePanePreviewRequest | null;
    focusCursorPath(path: string): void;
    activateDirTabAndFocusPath(tabId: string, focusPath: string): Promise<void>;
    openQuickView(): Promise<void>;
    zoomInActiveViewer(): void;
    zoomOutActiveViewer(): void;
    resetActiveViewerZoom(): void;
    openFrozenPreviewTab(
      targetPath: string,
      options?: { sourcePane: 'left' | 'right'; sourceTabId: string; sourceDir: string; autoFollow?: boolean; fileList?: ViewerFileListItem[]; archiveContext?: import('../viewers/viewer-archive-context').ViewerArchiveContext | null },
    ): Promise<void>;
  };
}

export interface FilePaneBrowserCommandsSource {
  surfaceCapabilities: ReadonlySet<SurfaceCapability>;
  sourceCapabilities: SourceCapabilities;
  navigationController: FilePaneNavigationController;
  navigationHost: FilePaneNavigationHost;
  openController: FilePaneOpenController;
  openHost: FilePaneOpenHost;
  operationsController: FilePaneOperationsController;
  operationsHost: FilePaneOperationsHost;
  previewController: FilePanePreviewController;
  previewHost: FilePanePreviewHost;
  focusController: FilePaneFocusController;
  focusHost: FilePaneFocusHost;
  stateRuntime: FilePaneStateRuntimeAdapter;
  zoomInActiveViewer(): void;
  zoomOutActiveViewer(): void;
  resetActiveViewerZoom(): void;
}

export class FilePaneBrowserCommandsFactory {
  create(source: FilePaneBrowserCommandsSource): FilePaneBrowserCommands {
    const supports = (capability: SurfaceCapability) => source.surfaceCapabilities.has(capability);
    const canMutate = (capability: 'create' | 'delete' | 'rename') => source.sourceCapabilities[capability];
    const navigateUp = () => supports('navigate')
      ? source.navigationController.onNavigateUp(source.navigationHost)
      : Promise.resolve();

    return {
      navigation: {
        navigateUp,
        refresh: () => { if (supports('navigate')) source.navigationController.onRefresh(source.navigationHost); },
        openSelectedItem: () => { if (supports('selection')) source.openController.onOpenSelectedItem(source.openHost, navigateUp); },
      },
      selection: {
        createFolder: () => supports('fileOperations') && canMutate('create') ? source.operationsController.onCreateFolder(source.operationsHost) : Promise.resolve(),
        deleteSelected: () => supports('fileOperations') && canMutate('delete') ? source.operationsController.onDeleteSelected(source.operationsHost) : Promise.resolve(),
        renameSelected: () => supports('fileOperations') && canMutate('rename') ? source.operationsController.onRenameSelected(source.operationsHost) : Promise.resolve(),
        copyToOther: () => { if (supports('fileOperations')) source.operationsController.onCopyToOther(source.operationsHost); },
        moveToOther: () => { if (supports('fileOperations') && canMutate('delete')) source.operationsController.onMoveToOther(source.operationsHost); },
      },
      preview: {
        getTargetPath: () => supports('preview') ? source.stateRuntime.getPreviewTargetPath() : '',
        getTargetRequest: () => supports('preview') ? source.previewController.getPreviewRequest(source.previewHost) : null,
        focusCursorPath: (path: string) => {
          if (!supports('preview')) {
            return;
          }
          source.focusController.focusCursorPath(source.focusHost, path);
        },
        activateDirTabAndFocusPath: (tabId: string, focusPath: string) =>
          source.focusController.activateDirTabAndFocusPath(source.focusHost, tabId, focusPath),
        openQuickView: () => supports('preview') ? source.previewController.openQuickView(source.previewHost) : Promise.resolve(),
        zoomInActiveViewer: () => { if (supports('viewerControls')) source.zoomInActiveViewer(); },
        zoomOutActiveViewer: () => { if (supports('viewerControls')) source.zoomOutActiveViewer(); },
        resetActiveViewerZoom: () => { if (supports('viewerControls')) source.resetActiveViewerZoom(); },
        openFrozenPreviewTab: (targetPath: string, options?: { sourcePane: 'left' | 'right'; sourceTabId: string; sourceDir: string; autoFollow?: boolean }) =>
          source.previewController.openFrozenPreviewTab(source.previewHost, targetPath, options),
      },
    };
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { DirTabRestoreTarget, DirTabSessionState, DirTabStateController, DirTabUiRuntime } from '../surfaces/dir/dir-tab-state-controller';
import { DirSurfaceSession } from '../surfaces/dir/dir-surface-session';
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { TabInfo } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import type { ViewLayout } from './file-view-container.component';

export interface FilePaneDirSessionHost {
  get currentTabId(): string;
  get activeDirTabId(): string | null;
  set activeDirTabId(value: string | null);
  get tabs(): TabInfo[];
  dirTabStateController: DirTabStateController;
  getDirSession(tabId: string): DirSurfaceSession | undefined;
  setDirSession(session: DirSurfaceSession): void;
  isInArchive(): boolean;
  getSelectableEntriesPaths(): string[];
  applyFilter(): void;
  scrollToCursorPath(path: string): void;
  emitPreviewTargetFromState(): void;
  getExpandedPaths(): string[];
  setExpandedPaths(paths: string[]): void;
  getScrollTop(): number;
  setScrollTop(top: number): void;
}

export class FilePaneDirSessionController {
  getActiveSession(host: FilePaneDirSessionHost): DirSurfaceSession {
    const id = host.activeDirTabId ?? host.currentTabId;
    let session = id ? host.getDirSession(id) : undefined;
    if (!session) {
      session = this.createSession(host, id || 'default');
      host.setDirSession(session);
    }

    const activeTab = host.tabs.find(tab => tab.id === host.currentTabId);
    if ((activeTab?.kind ?? 'dir') === 'dir') {
      host.activeDirTabId = session.tabId;
    }

    return session;
  }

  getActiveRestoreTarget(host: FilePaneDirSessionHost): DirTabRestoreTarget {
    return this.createRestoreTarget(host, this.getActiveSession(host));
  }

  restoreActiveState(host: FilePaneDirSessionHost): void {
    const tabId = host.activeDirTabId ?? host.currentTabId;
    const activeTab = host.tabs.find(tab => tab.id === host.currentTabId);
    if (!tabId || (activeTab?.kind ?? 'dir') !== 'dir' || host.isInArchive()) {
      return;
    }

    const savedState = host.dirTabStateController.load(tabId);
    if (!savedState) {
      return;
    }

    host.dirTabStateController.finalizeAfterLoad(savedState, this.getActiveRestoreTarget(host));
  }

  /**
   * Re-attempt resolution of any pending selection / cursor / scroll restore
   * against the active session's currently visible entries. Called after each
   * stream batch and after refreshes so partial restoration lands as soon as
   * matching rows appear, instead of only at stream done.
   */
  reapplyPendingRestoreToActive(host: FilePaneDirSessionHost): void {
    const tabId = host.activeDirTabId ?? host.currentTabId;
    const activeTab = host.tabs.find(tab => tab.id === host.currentTabId);
    if (!tabId || (activeTab?.kind ?? 'dir') !== 'dir' || host.isInArchive()) {
      return;
    }
    const session = host.getDirSession(tabId);
    if (!session || !session.pendingRestore) return;
    host.dirTabStateController.applyPendingRestore(this.getActiveRestoreTarget(host));
  }

  private createSession(host: FilePaneDirSessionHost, tabId: string): DirSurfaceSession {
    const session = new DirSurfaceSession(tabId);
    session.currentView = this.currentViewPrefFromStorage();

    const savedSortField = localStorage.getItem('fileManager_sortField');
    const savedSortDirection = localStorage.getItem('fileManager_sortDirection') as ('asc' | 'desc' | null);
    if (savedSortField) session.sortField = savedSortField;
    if (savedSortDirection === 'asc' || savedSortDirection === 'desc') session.sortDirection = savedSortDirection;

    const savedDirsFirst = localStorage.getItem('fileManager_directoriesFirst');
    if (savedDirsFirst === 'true' || savedDirsFirst === 'false') {
      session.directoriesFirst = savedDirsFirst === 'true';
    }

    const savedColorizeByMime = localStorage.getItem('fileManager_colorizeByMime');
    if (savedColorizeByMime === 'true' || savedColorizeByMime === 'false') {
      session.colorizeByMime = savedColorizeByMime === 'true';
    }

    const savedState = host.dirTabStateController.load(session.tabId);
    if (savedState) {
      host.dirTabStateController.applyBeforeLoad(savedState, this.createSessionState(session));
      session.showHiddenLoaded = savedState.showHidden;
    }

    return session;
  }

  private createRestoreTarget(host: FilePaneDirSessionHost, session: DirSurfaceSession): DirTabRestoreTarget {
    return {
      session: this.createSessionState(session),
      ui: this.createUiRuntime(host),
    };
  }

  private createSessionState(session: DirSurfaceSession): DirTabSessionState {
    return {
      getEntriesPaths: () => session.getEntriesPaths(),
      getOptimisticHiddenPaths: () => session.getOptimisticHiddenPaths(),
      setOptimisticHiddenPaths: (paths: string[]) => session.setOptimisticHiddenPaths(paths),
      get currentPath() { return session.currentPath; },
      set currentPath(value: string) { session.currentPath = value; },
      get showHidden() { return !!session.showHiddenLoaded; },
      set showHidden(_value: boolean) {},
      get entries() { return session.entries; },
      set entries(value: FileInfo[]) { session.entries = value; },
      get currentView() { return session.currentView; },
      set currentView(value: ViewLayout) { session.currentView = value; },
      get sortField() { return session.sortField; },
      set sortField(value: string) { session.sortField = value; },
      get sortDirection() { return session.sortDirection; },
      set sortDirection(value: 'asc' | 'desc') { session.sortDirection = value; },
      get directoriesFirst() { return session.directoriesFirst; },
      set directoriesFirst(value: boolean) { session.directoriesFirst = value; },
      get colorizeByMime() { return session.colorizeByMime; },
      set colorizeByMime(value: boolean) { session.colorizeByMime = value; },
      get filterQuery() { return session.filterQuery; },
      set filterQuery(value) { session.filterQuery = value; },
      get selectedFiles() { return session.selectedFiles; },
      set selectedFiles(value: Set<string>) { session.selectedFiles = value; },
      get selectionCursorPath() { return session.selectionCursorPath; },
      set selectionCursorPath(value: string | null) { session.selectionCursorPath = value; },
      get selectionAnchorPath() { return session.selectionAnchorPath; },
      set selectionAnchorPath(value: string | null) { session.selectionAnchorPath = value; },
      get pendingRestore() { return session.pendingRestore; },
      set pendingRestore(value) { session.pendingRestore = value; },
      get userInteractedSinceLoad() { return session.userInteractedSinceLoad; },
      set userInteractedSinceLoad(value: boolean) { session.userInteractedSinceLoad = value; },
    };
  }

  private createUiRuntime(host: FilePaneDirSessionHost): DirTabUiRuntime {
    return {
      isInArchive: () => host.isInArchive(),
      getSelectableEntriesPaths: () => host.getSelectableEntriesPaths(),
      applyFilter: () => host.applyFilter(),
      scrollToCursorPath: (path: string) => host.scrollToCursorPath(path),
      emitPreviewTargetFromState: () => host.emitPreviewTargetFromState(),
      getExpandedPaths: () => host.getExpandedPaths(),
      setExpandedPaths: (paths: string[]) => host.setExpandedPaths(paths),
      getScrollTop: () => host.getScrollTop(),
      setScrollTop: (top: number) => host.setScrollTop(top),
    };
  }

  private currentViewPrefFromStorage(): ViewLayout {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('fileManager_viewMode') as ViewLayout | null;
    return saved === 'list' || saved === 'grid' || saved === 'details' || saved === 'tree' ? saved : 'list';
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { ApiService } from '../services/api.service';
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { ViewLayout } from './file-view-container.component';
import { PARENT_ENTRY_PATH } from './file-entry.component';
import { parentPath } from './address-bar.utils';
import { isArchive } from '../services/archive.service';

export interface FilePaneOpenHost {
  currentPath: string;
  currentView: ViewLayout;
  defaultOpenAction: 'edit' | 'external';
  entries: FileInfo[];
  apiService: ApiService;
  selectionCursorPath: string | null;
  isInArchive(): boolean;
  exitArchive(): void;
  clearArchiveState(): void;
  archiveNavigateInto(path: string): Promise<void>;
  openNestedArchive(chain: string[]): Promise<void>;
  loadDirectory(path: string): Promise<void>;
  openRootArchive(path: string): Promise<void>;
  emitPathChange(path: string): void;
  getEffectiveSelection(): Set<string>;
  openPathInNewTab(path: string): Promise<void>;
  openPreviewPath(path: string): Promise<void>;
  openEditorPath(path: string): Promise<void>;
}

export class FilePaneOpenController {
  private openExternalFile(host: FilePaneOpenHost, path: string): void {
    host.apiService.openFile(path).catch(err =>
      console.error('Failed to open file:', err)
    );
  }

  private async openByPreference(host: FilePaneOpenHost, path: string): Promise<void> {
    switch (host.defaultOpenAction) {
      case 'edit':
        await host.openEditorPath(path);
        return;
      case 'external':
      default:
        this.openExternalFile(host, path);
        return;
    }
  }

  private async openArchiveEntry(host: FilePaneOpenHost, path: string): Promise<void> {
    if (host.defaultOpenAction === 'edit') {
      await host.openEditorPath(path);
      return;
    }

    await host.openPreviewPath(path);
  }

  private async openDetectedArchiveOrFile(host: FilePaneOpenHost, path: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const probe = await host.apiService.probeFile(path);
      if (probe?.isArchive) {
        await host.openRootArchive(path);
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      // fall back to the extension-based path below
    }

    await this.openByPreference(host, path);
  }

  onNodeDoubleClick(host: FilePaneOpenHost, entry: FileInfo, navigateUp: () => void): void {
    if (entry.path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) {
      navigateUp();
      return;
    }

    if (host.currentView === 'tree' && entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      if (entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE || isArchive(entry.name)) {
        void host.openRootArchive(entry.path);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.lnk') || entry.type === FileType.SYMLINK) {
        this.resolveAndOpen(host, entry.path);
        return;
      }
      void this.openDetectedArchiveOrFile(host, entry.path);
      return;
    }

    this.onNavigate(host, entry, navigateUp);
  }

  onNavigate(host: FilePaneOpenHost, entry: FileInfo, navigateUp: () => void): void {
    if (entry.path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) {
      navigateUp();
      return;
    }

    if (host.currentView === 'tree' && entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      if (host.isInArchive()) {
        host.exitArchive();
        host.clearArchiveState();
      }
      host.currentPath = entry.path;
      host.emitPathChange(entry.path);
      return;
    }

    if (host.currentView === 'tree' && (entry.type === FileType.FILE || entry.type === FileType.SYMLINK || entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE)) {
      const parent = parentPath(entry.path);
      host.currentPath = parent;
      host.emitPathChange(parent);
      return;
    }

    if (host.isInArchive()) {
      if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
        void host.archiveNavigateInto(entry.path);
      } else if (entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE) {
        const chain: string[] = (entry as any).nestedChain;
        if (chain?.length) {
          void host.openNestedArchive(chain);
        }
      } else {
        void this.openArchiveEntry(host, entry.path);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      void host.loadDirectory(entry.path);
      return;
    }
    if (entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE || isArchive(entry.name)) {
      void host.openRootArchive(entry.path);
      return;
    }
    if (entry.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.lnk') || entry.type === FileType.SYMLINK) {
      this.resolveAndOpen(host, entry.path);
      return;
    }

    void this.openDetectedArchiveOrFile(host, entry.path);
  }

  onOpenSelectedItem(host: FilePaneOpenHost, navigateUp: () => void): void {
    // Always use the entry at selectionCursorPath for keyboard navigation (Enter)
    const cursorPath = host.selectionCursorPath;
    if (!cursorPath) {
      return;
    }
    const entry = host.entries.find(candidate => candidate.path === cursorPath);
    if (entry) {
      if (host.currentView === 'tree' && entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) {
        this.onNodeDoubleClick(host, entry, navigateUp);
        return;
      }
      this.onNavigate(host, entry, navigateUp);
    }
  }

  async onOpenInNewTab(host: FilePaneOpenHost, entry: FileInfo): Promise<void> {
    if (entry.path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) {
      const up = host.isInArchive() ? host.currentPath : parentPath(host.currentPath);
      await host.openPathInNewTab(up);
      return;
    }

    if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      await host.openPathInNewTab(entry.path);
      return;
    }

    if (entry.type === FileType.ARCHIVE || isArchive(entry.name)) {
      await host.openPathInNewTab(entry.path);
      return;
    }

    if (host.isInArchive()) {
      await host.openEditorPath(entry.path);
      return;
    }

    await this.openDetectedArchiveOrFile(host, entry.path);
  }

  private resolveAndOpen(host: FilePaneOpenHost, path: string): void {
    host.apiService.resolveLink(path).then(result => {
      if (result.isDir) {
        void host.loadDirectory(result.target);
      } else {
        void this.openByPreference(host, result.target);
      }
    }).catch(err => {
      console.warn('Could not resolve link, falling back to OS open:', err);
      this.openExternalFile(host, path);
    });
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { ApiService } from '../services/api.service';
import type { ConfirmDialogService } from '../services/confirm-dialog.service';
import { OperationService } from '../services/operation.service';
import { BatchRenameDialogService, type BatchRenameItem } from '../services/batch-rename-dialog.service';
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { ViewLayout } from './file-view-container.component';
import { PARENT_ENTRY_PATH } from './file-entry.component';
import { normalizePath, parentPath, samePath } from './address-bar.utils';
import { buildArchivePath, parseArchivePath } from '../services/archive.service';

declare const window: any;

export interface FilePaneOperationsHost {
  get paneId(): 'left' | 'right';
  get currentPath(): string;
  get currentView(): ViewLayout;
  get confirmBeforeDelete(): boolean;
  get confirmDragAndDrop(): boolean;
  get entries(): FileInfo[];
  get selectedFiles(): Set<string>;
  get selectionCursorPath(): string | null;
  apiService: ApiService;
  confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService;
  isInArchive(): boolean;
  deleteSelectedFromArchive(effective: Set<string>): Promise<boolean>;
  getEffectiveSelection(): Set<string>;
  loadDirectory(path: string, opts?: { preserveUI?: boolean; focusPath?: string }): Promise<void>;
  refreshTreeNode(path: string): void;
  emitCopyToOther(paths: string[]): void;
  emitMoveToOther(paths: string[]): void;
  startRenameSelected(): void;
  startRenamePath(path: string): void;
  setPendingRenameDisplayName(path: string, displayName: string | null): void;
  getVisibleTreeNodes(): any[];
  isTreeNodeExpanded(path: string): boolean;
  suppressNextTreeAutoExpand(): void;
  focusTreeNode(path: string): void;
}

export class FilePaneOperationsController {
  constructor(
    private readonly operationService: OperationService,
    private readonly batchRenameDialog: BatchRenameDialogService,
  ) {}

  getDestinationDir(host: FilePaneOperationsHost): string {
    if (host.selectedFiles.size !== 1) return host.currentPath;
    const [selectedPath] = host.selectedFiles;

    if (host.currentView === 'tree') {
      const nodes = host.getVisibleTreeNodes() ?? [];
      const node = nodes.find((candidate: any) => candidate.path === selectedPath);
      if (node?.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
        if (host.isTreeNodeExpanded(selectedPath)) {
          return selectedPath;
        }
        return parentPath(selectedPath) || selectedPath;
      }
    }

    const entry = host.entries.find(candidate => candidate.path === selectedPath);
    if (entry?.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) return selectedPath;

    return host.currentPath;
  }

  async onCreateFolder(host: FilePaneOperationsHost): Promise<void> {
    if (host.isInArchive()) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert('Archive Limitation\nCannot create folders inside an archive.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const targetDir = this.getDestinationDir(host);
      const newPath = await this.createNewFolderForInlineRename(host, targetDir);

      if (host.currentView === 'tree' && !samePath(targetDir, host.currentPath)) {
        host.suppressNextTreeAutoExpand();
        host.refreshTreeNode(targetDir);
      } else {
        await host.loadDirectory(host.currentPath, { preserveUI: true, focusPath: newPath });
      }

      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          host.startRenamePath(newPath);
          resolve();
        });
      });
    } catch (error: any) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert(`Create Folder Failed\n${this.getErrorMessage(error, 'Unknown error')}`);
    }
  }

  async onDeleteSelected(host: FilePaneOperationsHost): Promise<void> {
    const effective = this.pruneNestedSelection(host.getEffectiveSelection());
    if (effective.size === 0) return;
    const postDeletePath = this.getPostDeletePath(host.currentPath, effective);
    const focusPath = postDeletePath ? null : this.getPostDeleteFocusPath(host, effective);
    const treeRefreshParents = host.currentView === 'tree'
      ? Array.from(new Set(
          Array.from(effective)
            .map((path) => parentPath(path))
            .filter((path) => !!path)
        ))
      : [];

    if (await host.deleteSelectedFromArchive(effective)) {
      return;
    }

    if (host.confirmBeforeDelete) {
      const deleteConfirmed = await host.confirmDialog.confirm({
        title: 'Delete Items',
        message: `Delete ${effective.size} item(s)?`,
        confirmText: 'Delete',
        danger: true,
      });
      if (!deleteConfirmed) return;
    }

    try {
      if (postDeletePath) {
        await host.loadDirectory(postDeletePath, { preserveUI: true });
      }

      const result = await host.apiService.batchDelete(Array.from(effective), true);
      if (result.failed > 0) {
        const msg = (result.errors ?? []).map((error: any) => `${error.source}: ${error.error}`).join('\n');
        host.confirmDialog.alert(`Delete Completed With Errors\n${result.failed} item(s) failed:\n${msg}`);
      }
      await host.loadDirectory(postDeletePath ?? host.currentPath, { preserveUI: true, focusPath: focusPath ?? undefined });
      for (const path of treeRefreshParents) {
        host.refreshTreeNode(path);
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert(`Delete Failed\n${error.message}`);
    }
  }

  getTreeArchiveSelectionContext(host: FilePaneOperationsHost): { archivePath: string; innerPaths: string[] } | null {
    if (host.currentView !== 'tree' || host.selectedFiles.size === 0) return null;

    const visible = host.getVisibleTreeNodes();
    const selected = visible.filter((node: any) => host.selectedFiles.has(node.path));
    if (!selected.length) return null;

    const firstArchivePath = (selected[0] as any).archivePath as string | undefined;
    if (!firstArchivePath) return null;

    const { fsPath, nestedChain } = parseArchivePath(firstArchivePath);
    const contextPath = buildArchivePath(fsPath, nestedChain, '');

    if (!selected.every((node: any) => {
      const nodePath = (node as any).archivePath as string | undefined;
      if (!nodePath) return false;
      const { fsPath: nodeFs, nestedChain: nodeChain } = parseArchivePath(nodePath);
      return buildArchivePath(nodeFs, nodeChain, '') === contextPath;
    })) {
      return null;
    }

    const innerPaths = selected.map((node: any) => {
      const nodePath = (node as any).archivePath as string | undefined;
      return nodePath ? (parseArchivePath(nodePath).innerPath || node.name) : node.name;
    }).filter(Boolean);

    return innerPaths.length ? { archivePath: contextPath, innerPaths } : null;
  }

  onCopyToOther(host: FilePaneOperationsHost): void {
    if (host.selectedFiles.size > 0) {
      host.emitCopyToOther(Array.from(host.selectedFiles));
    }
  }

  async onRenameSelected(host: FilePaneOperationsHost): Promise<void> {
    const selected = Array.from(host.selectedFiles);
    if (selected.length === 0) return;

    if (host.isInArchive()) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert('Archive Limitation\nRename is not supported inside archives.');
      return;
    }

    if (selected.length === 1) {
      const entry = host.entries.find(candidate => candidate.path === selected[0]);
      if (!entry || entry.path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) return;
      host.startRenameSelected();
      return;
    }

    // Multi-select batch rename
    const items: BatchRenameItem[] = selected
      .map(path => host.entries.find(e => e.path === path))
      .filter((e): e is FileInfo => !!e && e.path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH)
      .map(entry => ({ entry, newName: entry.name }));

    if (items.length === 0) return;

    const result = await this.batchRenameDialog.openDialog(items, host.currentPath);
    if (!result || result.length === 0) return;

    await this.applyBatchRename(host, result);
  }

  private async applyBatchRename(host: FilePaneOperationsHost, items: BatchRenameItem[]): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const moves = await Promise.all(
        items.map(async item => {
          const destination = await host.apiService.joinPaths([parentPath(item.entry.path), item.newName]);
          return { source: item.entry.path, destination, exactDestination: true };
        })
      );

      const result = await host.apiService.batchMove(moves, true);
      if (result?.failed && result.failed > 0) {
        const firstError = result.errors?.[0];
        throw new Error(firstError?.error || 'Batch rename failed');
      }

      const finalStatus = result?.operationId
        ? await this.operationService.waitForOperationSettlement(result.operationId)
        : (result?.succeeded && result.succeeded > 0 ? 'completed' : 'missing');

      if (finalStatus === 'completed') {
        if (host.currentView === 'tree') {
          host.refreshTreeNode(parentPath(items[0].entry.path));
        }
        await host.loadDirectory(host.currentPath, { preserveUI: true });
      }
    } catch (error: any) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert(`Batch Rename Failed\n${this.getErrorMessage(error, 'Unknown error')}`);
    }
  }

  async onRename(host: FilePaneOperationsHost, event: { entry: FileInfo; newName: string }): Promise<void> {
    await this.renameEntry(host, event.entry, event.newName);
  }

  async onDragDrop(host: FilePaneOperationsHost, event: { event: DragEvent; source: FileInfo[]; targetPath: string }): Promise<void> {
    if (!event.source?.length || !event.targetPath) return;

    if (host.isInArchive()) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert('Archive Drag & Drop Not Supported\nUse copy/move to other pane instead.');
      return;
    }

    const sourcePaths = event.source
      .map(entry => entry.path)
      .filter(path => path && path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH);

    if (!sourcePaths.length) return;

    try {
      const isCopy = event.event.ctrlKey || event.event.metaKey;
      const sourcePaneIdRaw = event.event.dataTransfer?.getData('application/x-wails-pane-id') || '';
      const sourcePaneId = (sourcePaneIdRaw === 'left' || sourcePaneIdRaw === 'right') ? sourcePaneIdRaw : null;
      const isCrossPane = !!sourcePaneId && sourcePaneId !== host.paneId;

      if (host.confirmDragAndDrop) {
        const confirmed = await host.confirmDialog.confirm({
          title: isCopy ? 'Confirm Copy' : 'Confirm Move',
          message: `${isCopy ? 'Copy' : 'Move'} ${sourcePaths.length} item(s) to ${event.targetPath}?`,
          confirmText: isCopy ? 'Copy' : 'Move',
          danger: !isCopy,
        });
        if (!confirmed) return;
      }

      const items = await Promise.all(sourcePaths.map(async sourcePath => ({
        source: sourcePath,
        destination: await this.buildDestinationPath(host, sourcePath, event.targetPath),
      })));

      if (!isCopy) {
        const moveItems = items.filter(item => this.normalizePath(item.source) !== this.normalizePath(item.destination));
        if (moveItems.length === 0) return;

        if (isCrossPane) {
          try {
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pane:dnd-optimistic-hide', {
              detail: { paneId: sourcePaneId, paths: moveItems.map(item => item.source) },
            }));
          } catch {
            // ignore
          }
        }

        await host.apiService.batchMove(moveItems, true);
        return;
      }

      await host.apiService.batchCopy(items, true);
    } catch (error: any) {
      try {
        const isCopy = event.event.ctrlKey || event.event.metaKey;
        const sourcePaneIdRaw = event.event.dataTransfer?.getData('application/x-wails-pane-id') || '';
        const sourcePaneId = (sourcePaneIdRaw === 'left' || sourcePaneIdRaw === 'right') ? sourcePaneIdRaw : null;
        const isCrossPane = !!sourcePaneId && sourcePaneId !== host.paneId;
        if (!isCopy && isCrossPane) {
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('pane:dnd-optimistic-restore', {
            detail: { paneId: sourcePaneId, paths: sourcePaths },
          }));
        }
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
      host.confirmDialog.alert(`Drag & Drop Failed\n${error.message}`);
    }
  }

  onMoveToOther(host: FilePaneOperationsHost): void {
    if (host.selectedFiles.size > 0) {
      host.emitMoveToOther(Array.from(host.selectedFiles));
    }
  }

  private async createNewFolderForInlineRename(host: FilePaneOperationsHost, targetDir: string): Promise<string> {
    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= 100; attempt += 1) {
      const folderName = attempt === 1 ? 'New Folder' : `New Folder (${attempt})`;
      const newPath: string = await window.go.app.App.JoinPaths([targetDir, folderName]);
      try {
        const result = await host.apiService.createDirectory(newPath, false);
        if (!result?.success) {
          throw new Error(result?.message || 'Create directory failed');
        }
        return newPath;
      } catch (error: any) {
        if (this.isAlreadyExistsError(error)) {
          continue;
        }
        throw error;
      }
    }

    throw new Error('Unable to create a unique folder name.');
  }

  private isAlreadyExistsError(error: any): boolean {
    const message = this.getErrorMessage(error).toLowerCase();
    return message.includes('already exists') || message.includes('exists');
  }

  private getErrorMessage(error: any, fallback: string = 'Operation failed'): string {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      return error.message || fallback;
    }
    if (typeof error === 'string') {
      return error || fallback;
    }
    if (typeof error?.message === 'string' && error.message) {
      return error.message;
    }
    if (typeof error?.error === 'string' && error.error) {
      return error.error;
    }
    if (typeof error?.cause?.message === 'string' && error.cause.message) {
      return error.cause.message;
    }
    return fallback;
  }

  private getPostDeletePath(currentPath: string, deletedPaths: Set<string>): string | null {
    const affectedAncestor = Array.from(deletedPaths)
      .filter((deletedPath) => this.isSameOrDescendantPath(currentPath, deletedPath))
      .sort((left, right) => normalizePath(right).length - normalizePath(left).length)[0];

    if (!affectedAncestor) {
      return null;
    }

    return parentPath(affectedAncestor);
  }

  private getPostDeleteFocusPath(host: FilePaneOperationsHost, deletedPaths: Set<string>): string | null {
    const visibleEntries = host.entries.filter((entry) => entry.path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH);
    if (visibleEntries.length === 0) return null;

    const anchorPath = this.getDeleteAnchorPath(host, visibleEntries, deletedPaths);
    const anchorIndex = visibleEntries.findIndex((entry) => samePath(entry.path, anchorPath));
    if (anchorIndex < 0) return null;

    for (let index = anchorIndex + 1; index < visibleEntries.length; index += 1) {
      const candidate = visibleEntries[index];
      if (!this.pathSetHas(deletedPaths, candidate.path)) return candidate.path;
    }

    for (let index = anchorIndex - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
      const candidate = visibleEntries[index];
      if (!this.pathSetHas(deletedPaths, candidate.path)) return candidate.path;
    }

    return null;
  }

  private getDeleteAnchorPath(host: FilePaneOperationsHost, visibleEntries: FileInfo[], deletedPaths: Set<string>): string {
    const cursorPath = host.selectionCursorPath;
    if (cursorPath && this.pathSetHas(deletedPaths, cursorPath)) {
      return cursorPath;
    }

    for (const entry of visibleEntries) {
      if (this.pathSetHas(deletedPaths, entry.path)) {
        return entry.path;
      }
    }

    return visibleEntries[0].path;
  }

  private pathSetHas(paths: Set<string>, candidate: string): boolean {
    for (const path of paths) {
      if (samePath(path, candidate)) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  private isSameOrDescendantPath(targetPath: string, candidateAncestorPath: string): boolean {
    if (samePath(targetPath, candidateAncestorPath)) {
      return true;
    }

    const target = normalizePath(targetPath);
    const ancestor = normalizePath(candidateAncestorPath);
    const prefix = ancestor.endsWith('/') ? ancestor : `${ancestor}/`;
    return target.startsWith(prefix);
  }

  private async renameEntry(host: FilePaneOperationsHost, entry: FileInfo, forcedName?: string): Promise<void> {
    if (host.isInArchive()) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert('Archive Limitation\nRename is not supported inside archives.');
      return;
    }

    if (entry.path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) return;

    const nextName = (forcedName ?? '').trim();
    if (!nextName || nextName === entry.name) return;

    try {
      host.setPendingRenameDisplayName(entry.path, nextName);
      const destination = await host.apiService.joinPaths([parentPath(entry.path), nextName]);

      if (samePath(entry.path, destination)) {
        return;
      }

      const result = await host.apiService.batchMove([{ source: entry.path, destination, exactDestination: true }], true);
      if (result?.failed && result.failed > 0) {
        const firstError = result.errors?.[0];
        throw new Error(firstError?.error || 'Rename failed');
      }

      const finalStatus = result?.operationId
        ? await this.operationService.waitForOperationSettlement(result.operationId)
        : (result?.succeeded && result.succeeded > 0 ? 'completed' : 'missing');

      if (finalStatus === 'completed') {
        if (host.currentView === 'tree') {
          host.refreshTreeNode(parentPath(entry.path));
        }
        await host.loadDirectory(host.currentPath, { preserveUI: true, focusPath: destination });
        return;
      }

      host.setPendingRenameDisplayName(entry.path, null);
      if (host.currentView === 'tree') {
        host.focusTreeNode(entry.path);
        return;
      }
      await host.loadDirectory(host.currentPath, { preserveUI: true, focusPath: entry.path });
    } catch (error: any) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert(`Rename Failed\n${this.getErrorMessage(error, 'Unknown error')}`);
    } finally {
      host.setPendingRenameDisplayName(entry.path, null);
    }
  }

  private async buildDestinationPath(host: FilePaneOperationsHost, sourcePath: string, targetDir: string): Promise<string> {
    const split = await host.apiService.splitPath(sourcePath);
    const base = split.base || this.normalizePath(sourcePath).split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() || '';
    return await host.apiService.joinPaths([targetDir, base]);
  }

  private normalizePath(path: string): string {
    return normalizePath(path);
  }

  private pruneNestedSelection(paths: Set<string>): Set<string> {
    const ordered = Array.from(paths)
      .filter(Boolean)
      .sort((left, right) => normalizePath(left).length - normalizePath(right).length);

    const kept: string[] = [];
    for (const candidate of ordered) {
      if (kept.some((existing) => this.isSameOrDescendantPath(candidate, existing))) {
        continue;
      }
      kept.push(candidate);
    }

    return new Set(kept);
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { ApiService } from '../services/api.service';
import type { WorkspaceService } from '../services/workspace.service';
import type { ConfirmDialogService } from '../services/confirm-dialog.service';
import type { FileInfo } from '../shared/protocol';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { ViewerFileListItem } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import type { ArchiveFrame } from '../services/archive.service';
import type { ViewerArchiveContext } from '../viewers/viewer-archive-context';
import { PARENT_ENTRY_PATH } from './file-entry.component';
import type { SurfaceCapability } from '../surfaces/surface-contribution';
import { tabSurfaceId } from '../surfaces/tab-surface';

export interface FilePanePreviewHost {
  get paneId(): 'left' | 'right';
  get activeSurfaceCapabilities(): ReadonlySet<SurfaceCapability>;
  get currentTabId(): string;
  get entries(): FileInfo[];
  get sortedEntries(): FileInfo[];
  get currentPath(): string;
  get selectionCursorPath(): string | null;
  get archiveStack(): ArchiveFrame[];
  get tabs(): any[];
  set tabs(value: any[]);
  apiService: ApiService;
  workspaceService: WorkspaceService;
  confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService;
  isInArchive(): boolean;
  openRootArchive(path: string): Promise<void>;
  getEffectiveSelection(): Set<string>;
  onTabChange(tab: any): Promise<void>;
}

export interface FilePanePreviewRequest {
	path: string;
	fileList: ViewerFileListItem[];
	archiveContext: ViewerArchiveContext | null;
}

export class FilePanePreviewController {
  async openPreviewPath(host: FilePanePreviewHost, path: string): Promise<void> {
    const nextPath = (path || '').trim();
    if (!nextPath) {
      return;
    }

    if (host.isInArchive()) {
      await this.openViewerTab(host, nextPath, {
        activate: true,
        closable: true,
        autoFollow: true,
      });
      return;
    }

    const existingPreviewTab = host.tabs.find(tab =>
      tabSurfaceId(tab) === 'viewer' && tab.viewer?.autoFollow,
    );
    const fileList = this.buildViewerFileList(host);

    if (existingPreviewTab) {
      host.workspaceService.updateViewerTabTargetPath(host.paneId, existingPreviewTab.id, nextPath, {
        sourcePane: host.paneId,
        sourceTabId: host.currentTabId,
        sourceDir: host.currentPath,
        fileList,
      });
      host.workspaceService.switchTab(host.paneId, existingPreviewTab.id);
      host.tabs = host.workspaceService.getTabs(host.paneId);

      const activeTab = host.workspaceService.getActiveTab(host.paneId);
      if (activeTab) {
        await host.onTabChange(activeTab);
      }
      return;
    }

    const tab = host.workspaceService.addViewerTab(host.paneId, nextPath, {
      activate: true,
      closable: true,
      autoFollow: true,
      title: 'Preview',
      fileList,
      sourcePane: host.paneId,
      sourceDir: host.currentPath,
    });
    if (!tab) {
      return;
    }

    host.tabs = host.workspaceService.getTabs(host.paneId);
    await host.onTabChange(tab);
  }

  async openEditorPath(host: FilePanePreviewHost, path: string): Promise<void> {
    const nextPath = (path || '').trim();
    if (!nextPath) {
      return;
    }

    await this.openViewerTab(host, nextPath, {
      activate: true,
      closable: true,
      fileList: host.isInArchive() ? [] : this.buildViewerFileList(host),
    });
  }

  getPreviewRequest(host: FilePanePreviewHost): FilePanePreviewRequest | null {
    if (!host.activeSurfaceCapabilities.has('preview')) return null;

    const cursorPath = host.selectionCursorPath;
    const selected = Array.from(host.getEffectiveSelection()).filter(path => path && path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH);
    const path = cursorPath && cursorPath !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH
      ? cursorPath
      : (selected.length === 1 ? selected[0] : '');
    if (!path) return null;

    if (host.isInArchive()) {
      const archiveContext = this.buildArchiveViewerContext(host, path);
      if (!archiveContext) return null;
      return { path, fileList: [], archiveContext };
    }

    const entry = host.entries.find(candidate => candidate.path === path);
    if (!entry || (entry.type !== FileType.FILE && entry.type !== FileType.SYMLINK)) return null;
    return { path, fileList: this.buildViewerFileList(host), archiveContext: null };
  }

  async openQuickView(host: FilePanePreviewHost): Promise<void> {
    const request = this.getPreviewRequest(host);
    if (!request) return;

    await this.openEditorPath(host, request.path);
  }

  async openFrozenPreviewTab(
    host: FilePanePreviewHost,
    targetPath: string,
    opts?: { sourcePane: 'left' | 'right'; sourceTabId: string; sourceDir: string; autoFollow?: boolean; fileList?: ViewerFileListItem[]; archiveContext?: ViewerArchiveContext | null },
  ): Promise<void> {
    const path = (targetPath || '').trim();
    if (!path) return;

    await this.openViewerTab(host, path, {
      activate: true,
      closable: true,
      autoFollow: !!opts?.autoFollow,
      sourcePane: opts?.sourcePane,
      sourceTabId: opts?.sourceTabId,
      sourceDir: opts?.sourceDir,
      fileList: opts?.fileList ?? [],
      archiveContext: opts?.archiveContext ?? null,
    });
  }

  private async openViewerTab(
    host: FilePanePreviewHost,
    path: string,
    opts: { activate: boolean; closable: boolean; autoFollow?: boolean; sourcePane?: 'left' | 'right'; sourceTabId?: string; sourceDir?: string; fileList?: ViewerFileListItem[]; archiveContext?: ViewerArchiveContext | null },
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      if (host.isInArchive() || opts.archiveContext) {
        const archiveContext = opts.archiveContext ?? this.buildArchiveViewerContext(host, path);
        if (!archiveContext) return;

        const tab = host.workspaceService.addViewerTab(host.paneId, path, {
          activate: opts.activate,
          closable: opts.closable,
          fileList: [],
          archiveContext,
        });
        if (!tab) return;
        host.tabs = host.workspaceService.getTabs(host.paneId);
        await host.onTabChange(tab);
        return;
      }

      const probe = await host.apiService.probeFile(path).catch(() => null);
      if (probe?.isArchive) {
        await host.openRootArchive(path);
        return;
      }

      const isDir = await host.apiService.isDirectory(path);
      if (isDir) return;

      const tab = host.workspaceService.addViewerTab(host.paneId, path, {
        activate: opts.activate,
        closable: opts.closable,
        autoFollow: !!opts.autoFollow,
        sourcePane: opts.sourcePane,
        sourceTabId: opts.sourceTabId,
        sourceDir: opts.sourceDir,
        fileList: opts.fileList ?? [],
      });
      if (!tab) return;

      host.tabs = host.workspaceService.getTabs(host.paneId);
      await host.onTabChange(tab);
    } catch (err: any) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert(`Preview Failed\n${err?.message || String(err)}`);
    }
  }

  private buildArchiveViewerContext(host: FilePanePreviewHost, path: string): ViewerArchiveContext | null {
    const frame = host.archiveStack[host.archiveStack.length - 1];
    const entry = host.entries.find(candidate => candidate.path === path);
    if (!frame || !entry || entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      return null;
    }

    return {
      fsPath: host.archiveStack[0].fsPath,
      nestedChain: frame.nestedChain ?? [],
      entryPath: entry.path,
    };
  }

  private buildViewerFileList(host: FilePanePreviewHost): ViewerFileListItem[] {
    const orderedEntries = host.sortedEntries?.length ? host.sortedEntries : host.entries;
    return orderedEntries
      .filter(entry => entry.path && (entry.type === FileType.FILE || entry.type === FileType.SYMLINK))
      .map(entry => ({
        path: entry.path,
        name: entry.name || entry.path.split(/[/\\]/).pop() || entry.path,
      }));
  }
}
````

## File: frontend/src/app/components/file-pane-tabs.controller.ts
````typescript
import { samePath } from './address-bar.utils';

import type { ArchiveFrame } from '../services/archive.service';
import type { WorkspaceService } from '../services/workspace.service';
import type { TabInfo, WorkspaceConfig } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import type { TabDropEvent } from './tab-bar.component';
import { tabLocation } from '../surfaces/tab-surface';

export interface FilePaneTabsHost {
  get paneId(): 'left' | 'right';
  get currentTabId(): string;
  set currentTabId(value: string);
  get currentPath(): string;
  get tabs(): TabInfo[];
  set tabs(value: TabInfo[]);
  get activeDirTabId(): string | null;
  set activeDirTabId(value: string | null);
  get archiveStack(): ArchiveFrame[];
  get fsParentDir(): string;
  get lastSeenActiveTabId(): string | null;
  set lastSeenActiveTabId(value: string | null);
  get lastSeenActiveTabPath(): string | null;
  set lastSeenActiveTabPath(value: string | null);
  workspaceService: WorkspaceService;
  isInArchive(): boolean;
  deleteDirSession(tabId: string): void;
  deleteDirTabState(tabId: string): void;
  loadPaneState(): Promise<void>;
  onTabChange(tab: TabInfo): Promise<void>;
  onTabClose(tab: TabInfo): void;
  onTabPin(tab: TabInfo): void;
}

export class FilePaneTabsController {
  onWorkspaceUpdate(host: FilePaneTabsHost, ws: WorkspaceConfig): void {
    const pane = host.paneId === 'left' ? ws.leftPane : ws.rightPane;
    const nextActiveId = pane.activeTabId;
    const activeTab = pane.tabs.find(tab => tab.id === nextActiveId);
    const nextActivePath = activeTab ? tabLocation(activeTab) : '';

    if (host.lastSeenActiveTabId === null) {
      host.lastSeenActiveTabId = nextActiveId;
      host.lastSeenActiveTabPath = nextActivePath;
      host.tabs = host.workspaceService.getTabs(host.paneId);
      host.currentTabId = nextActiveId;
      return;
    }

    const activeChanged = nextActiveId !== host.lastSeenActiveTabId || !samePath(nextActivePath, host.lastSeenActiveTabPath);
    host.lastSeenActiveTabId = nextActiveId;
    host.lastSeenActiveTabPath = nextActivePath;

    if (!activeChanged) {
      host.tabs = host.workspaceService.getTabs(host.paneId);
      return;
    }

    // Local tab switches already ran through onTabChange/loadPaneState.
    // When workspace state echoes back through the subscription, avoid a second
    // load cycle for the same active tab because it causes a visible redraw,
    // especially for viewer tabs whose tab path differs from the pane dir path.
    if (host.currentTabId === nextActiveId) {
      host.tabs = host.workspaceService.getTabs(host.paneId);
      return;
    }

    if (host.currentTabId === nextActiveId && samePath(host.currentPath, nextActivePath)) {
      host.tabs = host.workspaceService.getTabs(host.paneId);
      return;
    }

    void host.loadPaneState();
  }

  onTabDrop(host: FilePaneTabsHost, event: TabDropEvent): void {
    if (!event) return;

    host.workspaceService.moveTab(event.fromPaneId, event.toPaneId, event.tabId, event.toIndex);

    if (event.toPaneId !== host.paneId) {
      return;
    }

    host.tabs = host.workspaceService.getTabs(host.paneId);
    const active = host.workspaceService.getActiveTab(host.paneId);
    if (active?.id !== event.tabId) {
      return;
    }

    const droppedTab = host.tabs.find(tab => tab.id === event.tabId);
    if (droppedTab) {
      void host.onTabChange(droppedTab);
    }
  }

  onTabDragStart(host: FilePaneTabsHost, tab: TabInfo): void {
    if (!tab || tab.id !== host.currentTabId) return;
    if (!host.currentTabId || !host.currentPath) return;

    if (host.isInArchive()) {
      host.workspaceService.saveArchiveState(host.paneId, host.currentTabId, {
        path: host.currentPath,
        archiveStack: host.archiveStack,
        fsDirPath: host.archiveStack[0]?.fsPath ?? '',
        fsParentDir: host.fsParentDir,
      });
      return;
    }

    host.workspaceService.updateTabPath(host.paneId, host.currentTabId, host.currentPath);
  }

  onTabClose(host: FilePaneTabsHost, tab: TabInfo): void {
    host.deleteDirSession(tab.id);
    host.deleteDirTabState(tab.id);
    if (host.activeDirTabId === tab.id) {
      host.activeDirTabId = null;
    }
    host.workspaceService.clearArchiveState(host.paneId, tab.id);
    host.workspaceService.closeTab(host.paneId, tab.id);
    void host.loadPaneState();
  }

  onTabPin(host: FilePaneTabsHost, tab: TabInfo): void {
    host.workspaceService.toggleTabPin(host.paneId, tab.id);
    void host.loadPaneState();
  }

  onNewTab(host: FilePaneTabsHost): void {
    const newTab = host.workspaceService.addTab(host.paneId, host.currentPath, true);
    if (!newTab) return;
    host.currentTabId = newTab.id;
    host.tabs = host.workspaceService.getTabs(host.paneId);
    host.workspaceService.switchTab(host.paneId, newTab.id);
    host.tabs = host.workspaceService.getTabs(host.paneId);
  }

  async openPathInNewTab(host: FilePaneTabsHost, path: string): Promise<void> {
    const newTab = host.workspaceService.addTab(host.paneId, path, true);
    if (!newTab) return;
    host.tabs = host.workspaceService.getTabs(host.paneId);
    await host.onTabChange(newTab);
  }

  closeCurrentTab(host: FilePaneTabsHost): void {
    const tab = this.getActiveTab(host);
    if (tab) host.onTabClose(tab);
  }

  nextTab(host: FilePaneTabsHost): void {
    const index = host.tabs.findIndex(tab => tab.isActive);
    if (index >= 0) {
      void host.onTabChange(host.tabs[(index + 1) % host.tabs.length]);
    }
  }

  previousTab(host: FilePaneTabsHost): void {
    const index = host.tabs.findIndex(tab => tab.isActive);
    if (index >= 0) {
      void host.onTabChange(host.tabs[index === 0 ? host.tabs.length - 1 : index - 1]);
    }
  }

  jumpToTab(host: FilePaneTabsHost, position: number): void {
    if (position > 0 && position <= host.tabs.length) {
      void host.onTabChange(host.tabs[position - 1]);
    }
  }

  togglePinCurrentTab(host: FilePaneTabsHost): void {
    const tab = this.getActiveTab(host);
    if (tab) host.onTabPin(tab);
  }

  private getActiveTab(host: FilePaneTabsHost): TabInfo | undefined {
    return host.tabs.find(tab => tab.isActive);
  }
}
````

## File: frontend/src/app/components/pane-sync-review.component.spec.ts
````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import type { PaneComparisonResult } from '../services/pane-comparison.service';
import { PaneSyncReviewComponent } from './pane-sync-review.component';

function result(): PaneComparisonResult {
  const file = (name: string, path: string) => ({
    name, path, type: FileType.FILE, size: 1, modified: 1, created: 1, accessed: 1, permissions: '', isHidden: false,
  });
  return {
    items: [
      { key: 'a', name: 'a.txt', status: 'only-left', left: file('a.txt', '/left/a.txt'), right: null },
      { key: 'b', name: 'b.txt', status: 'only-right', left: null, right: file('b.txt', '/right/b.txt') },
      { key: 'c', name: 'c.txt', status: 'left-newer', left: file('c.txt', '/left/c.txt'), right: file('c.txt', '/right/c.txt') },
    ],
    summary: { total: 3, same: 0, onlyLeft: 1, onlyRight: 1, leftNewer: 1, rightNewer: 0, sizeDifferent: 0, typeDifferent: 0, different: 3 },
  };
}

describe('PaneSyncReviewComponent plan defaults', () => {
  it('auto-approves missing items but skips overwrite candidates', () => {
    const component = new PaneSyncReviewComponent();
    component.result = result();
    component.ngOnChanges();

    expect(component.items.map(item => item.direction)).toEqual(['left-to-right', 'right-to-left', 'skip']);
  });

  it('emits only explicitly approved directions', () => {
    const component = new PaneSyncReviewComponent();
    component.result = result();
    component.ngOnChanges();
    component.setDirection(component.items[2], 'left-to-right');
    const emit = spyOnFn(component.execute, 'emit');

    component.executePlan();

    expect(emit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      leftToRight: ['/left/a.txt', '/left/c.txt'],
      rightToLeft: ['/right/b.txt'],
    }));
  });
});
````

````typescript
  template: `
    <div class="path-history-overlay" *ngIf="isVisible" (click)="hide()">
      <div class="path-history-modal" [appTrapFocus]="true" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" tabindex="-1" (click)="$event.stopPropagation()">

            <h2>Location History</h2>
            <p>Recently visited locations. Click to navigate.</p>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="dialog-close-btn" aria-label="Close" (click)="hide()" title="Close (Esc)">
            <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M8 7.293l3.536-3.536.707.707L8.707 8l3.536 3.536-.707.707L8 8.707l-3.536 3.536-.707-.707L7.293 8 3.757 4.464l.707-.707L8 7.293z"/></svg>
          </button>

          </div>
          <div class="stat-item">

          </div>
          <button (click)="clearHistory()" class="btn-clear-history">
            Clear All
          </button>
        </div>

        <div class="search-bar">

                <span class="entry-count">{{ entry.accessCount }} visit{{ entry.accessCount > 1 ? 's' : '' }}</span>
                <span class="entry-time">{{ formatTime(entry.timestamp) }}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button
              (click)="removePath(entry, $event)"
              class="btn-remove"
              title="Remove from history"
            >
              ✕
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Footer -->
        <div class="modal-footer">
          <div class="footer-info">
            Showing {{ filteredEntries.length }} of {{ historyEntries.length }} locations
          </div>
          <div class="footer-actions">
            <button (click)="exportHistory()" class="btn-secondary">
              Export
            </button>
            <button (click)="hide()" class="btn-primary">
              Close
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `,

export class PathHistoryViewerComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  @ViewChild('filterInput') filterInput?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;

  isVisible = false;
  historyEntries: PathHistoryEntry[] = [];
  filteredEntries: PathHistoryEntry[] = [];
  filterText = '';
  selectedIndex = 0;

  private destroy$ = createSubject<void>();
  private releaseDialogContext: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor(
    private pathHistoryService: PathHistoryService,
    private confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService,
    private inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
    private overlayFreeze: NativeOverlayFreezeService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.registerInputCommands();
    // Subscribe to history changes
    this.pathHistoryService.history$
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(entries => {
        this.historyEntries = entries;
        this.applyFilter();
      });

    // Load initial history
    this.historyEntries = this.pathHistoryService.getAllHistory();
    this.applyFilter();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.overlayFreeze.release('dialog.pathHistory');
    this.releaseDialogContext?.();
    this.releaseDialogContext = null;
    this.unregisterInputCommands();
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  show(): void {
    this.isVisible = true;
    this.releaseDialogContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('dialog.pathHistory');
    this.overlayFreeze.acquire('dialog.pathHistory');
    this.filterText = '';
    this.historyEntries = this.pathHistoryService.getAllHistory();
    this.applyFilter();
    this.selectedIndex = 0;
  }

  hide(): void {
    this.isVisible = false;
    this.releaseDialogContext?.();
    this.releaseDialogContext = null;
    this.overlayFreeze.release('dialog.pathHistory');
  }

  normalizeEntryPath(location: string | null | undefined): string {
    return location ?? '';
  }

  entryLabel(entry: PathHistoryEntry): string {
    return locationLabel(entry.location);
  }

  entryIcon(entry: PathHistoryEntry): string {
    return locationIcon(entry.scheme);
  }

  applyFilter(): void {
    if (!this.filterText || this.filterText.trim() === '') {
      this.filteredEntries = [...this.historyEntries];
    } else {
      const filter = this.normalizeEntryPath(this.filterText).toLowerCase();
      this.filteredEntries = this.historyEntries.filter(entry =>
        this.normalizeEntryPath(entry.location).toLowerCase().includes(filter)
      );
    }

    if (this.filteredEntries.length === 0) {
      this.selectedIndex = 0;
      return;
    }

    this.selectedIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.selectedIndex, this.filteredEntries.length - 1));
  }

  selectPath(entry: PathHistoryEntry): void {
    console.log('Selected path:', this.normalizeEntryPath(entry.location));
    // Emit event to navigate to this path
    // This would need to be wired up to the main component
  }

  async removePath(entry: PathHistoryEntry, event: Event): Promise<void> {
    event.stopPropagation();
    const normalizedPath = this.normalizeEntryPath(entry.location);
    const confirmed = await this.confirmDialog.confirm({
      title: 'Remove History Entry',
      message: `Remove "${normalizedPath}" from history?`,
      confirmText: 'Remove',
      danger: true,
    });
    if (confirmed) {
      this.pathHistoryService.removeLocation(normalizedPath);
    }
  }

  async clearHistory(): Promise<void> {
    const confirmed = await this.confirmDialog.confirm({
      title: 'Clear Location History',
      message: 'Clear all path history?',
      confirmText: 'Clear',
      danger: true,
    });
    if (confirmed) {
      this.pathHistoryService.clearHistory();
    }
  }

  getMostVisited(): PathHistoryEntry | null {
    if (this.historyEntries.length === 0) return null;
    return this.historyEntries.reduce((max, entry) =>
      entry.accessCount > max.accessCount ? entry : max
    );
  }

  isRecent(entry: PathHistoryEntry): boolean {
    const oneHourAgo = Date.now() - (60 * 60 * 1000);
    return entry.timestamp > oneHourAgo;
  }

  formatTime(timestamp: number): string {
    const now = Date.now();
    const diff = now - timestamp;
    const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
    const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
    const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);

    if (minutes < 1) return 'just now';
    if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m ago`;
    if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h ago`;
    if (days < 7) return `${days}d ago`;
    return new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString();
  }

  exportHistory(): void {
    const normalizedEntries = this.historyEntries.map(entry => ({
      ...entry,
      path: this.normalizeEntryPath(entry.location),
    }));
    const data = JSON.stringify(normalizedEntries, null, 2);
    const blob = new Blob([data], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `path-history-${Date.now()}.json`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }

  selectPathAt(index: number): void {
    if (index < 0 || index >= this.filteredEntries.length) return;
    this.selectedIndex = index;
    this.selectPath(this.filteredEntries[index]);
  }

  async removeSelectedPath(): Promise<void> {
    const entry = this.filteredEntries[this.selectedIndex];
    if (!entry) return;

    const normalizedPath = this.normalizeEntryPath(entry.location);
    const confirmed = await this.confirmDialog.confirm({
      title: 'Remove History Entry',
      message: `Remove "${normalizedPath}" from history?`,
      confirmText: 'Remove',
      danger: true,
    });
    if (confirmed) {
      this.pathHistoryService.removeLocation(normalizedPath);
    }
  }

  private moveSelection(delta: number): void {
    if (!this.isVisible || this.filteredEntries.length === 0) return;
    this.selectedIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.selectedIndex + delta, this.filteredEntries.length - 1));
  }

  private registerInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.pathHistory.close', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible) return;
      this.hide();
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.pathHistory.focusFilter', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible) return;
      this.filterInput?.nativeElement.focus();
      this.filterInput?.nativeElement.select();
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.pathHistory.prevItem', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible) return;
      this.moveSelection(-1);
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.pathHistory.nextItem', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible) return;
      this.moveSelection(1);
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.pathHistory.openSelected', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible) return;
      this.selectPathAt(this.selectedIndex);
    });

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.pathHistory.removeSelected', () => {
      if (!this.isVisible) return;
      return this.removeSelectedPath();
    });
  }

  private unregisterInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.pathHistory.close');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.pathHistory.focusFilter');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.pathHistory.prevItem');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.pathHistory.nextItem');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.pathHistory.openSelected');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.pathHistory.removeSelected');
  }
}
````
