````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import type { CommandState } from '../services/input-system.types';
import { presentPluginCommand, type PluginCommandPresentationHost } from './plugin-command-presentation';

function host(state?: CommandState): PluginCommandPresentationHost & { dispatch: ReturnType<typeof fn> } {
  const dispatch = fn(() => true);
  return {
    dispatch,
    getCommandState: () => state,
    dispatchCommandById: dispatch,
  };
}

describe('presentPluginCommand', () => {
  it('inherits title and availability from a registered command', async () => {
    const commandHost = host({
      id: 'plugin.demo.compress',
      title: 'Compress Selection',
      category: 'Plugins',
      registered: true,
      enabled: true,
    });

    const item = presentPluginCommand({
      id: 'compress-toolbar',
      commandId: 'plugin.demo.compress',
    }, {}, commandHost);

    expect(item.label).toBe('Compress Selection');
    expect(item.enabled).toBe(true);
    expect(item.commandId).toBe('plugin.demo.compress');

    await item.execute();
    expect(commandHost.dispatch).toHaveBeenCalledWith('plugin.demo.compress');
  });

  it('disables a contribution whose command is missing or disabled', async () => {
    const missingHost = host(undefined);
    const missing = presentPluginCommand({ id: 'missing', commandId: 'plugin.demo.missing' }, {}, missingHost);
    expect(missing.enabled).toBe(false);
    await missing.execute();
    expect(missingHost.dispatch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    const disabledHost = host({
      id: 'plugin.demo.disabled',
      title: 'Disabled Command',
      registered: true,
      enabled: false,
    });
    const disabled = presentPluginCommand({ id: 'disabled', commandId: 'plugin.demo.disabled' }, {}, disabledHost);
    expect(disabled.enabled).toBe(false);
  });

  it('keeps legacy callback contributions working', async () => {
    const execute = fn();
    const item = presentPluginCommand({ id: 'legacy', label: 'Legacy Action', execute }, { selected: 1 }, host());

    expect(item.label).toBe('Legacy Action');
    expect(item.enabled).toBe(true);
    expect(item.commandId).toBeUndefined();

    await item.execute();
    expect(execute).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ selected: 1 });
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { bindCommandPresentation, type CommandPresentation } from './presented-command';

describe('PresentedCommand', () => {
  it('binds execution without changing renderer-neutral metadata', async () => {
    const execute = fn();
    const presentation: CommandPresentation<'delete'> = {
      id: 'delete',
      label: 'Delete',
      shortcut: 'Del',
      enabled: false,
      source: 'builtin',
      commandId: 'pane.files.delete',
    };

    const command = bindCommandPresentation(presentation, execute);

    expect(command).toMatchObject(presentation);
    await command.execute();
    expect(execute).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});
````

````typescript
                [attr.aria-label]="tab.isPinned ? 'Unpin tab' : 'Pin tab'">
          <span class="pin-icon">📌</span>
        </button>
        <!-- Pinned tabs are protected from accidental close. -->
        <button *ngIf="isClosable && !tab.isPinned" class="tab-action close" (click)="onClose($event)"

export class TabComponent {
  @Input() tab!: TabInfo;
  @Input() isActive = false;
  /** Set to true when this tab is currently browsing inside an archive. */
  /** True when this specific tab's saved path is inside an archive virtual path.
   *  Derived from tab.path so each tab carries its own icon independently. */
  get isArchiveTab(): boolean {
    const p = this.tab?.path ?? '';
    // Archive virtual paths contain a known archive extension followed by a slash.
    // e.g. "filesystem://c/foo/bar.zip/src" or "/home/user/backup.tar.gz/etc"
    return /\.(zip|tar|gz|bz2|xz|7z|rar|iso|dmg|tgz|tbz2)([\/\\]|$)/i.test(p);
  }

  @Output() tabClick = new EventEmitter<TabInfo>();
  @Output() tabClose = new EventEmitter<TabInfo>();
  @Output() tabPin = new EventEmitter<TabInfo>();

  isHovered = false;

  get isClosable(): boolean {
    return this.tab?.isClosable !== false;
  }

  onClick(): void { this.tabClick.emit(this.tab); }

  onMouseUp(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (event.button === 1) {
      this.onClose(event);
    }
  }

  onClose(event: Event): void {
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.tabClose.emit(this.tab);
  }

  onPin(event: Event): void {
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.tabPin.emit(this.tab);
  }
  
  get shortTitle(): string {
    const t = this.tab?.title ?? '';
    if (!t) return '';
    if ((this.tab?.kind ?? 'dir') === 'size-manager') return 'Storage Footprint';
    const parts = t.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter(Boolean);
    if (parts.length === 0) return t;
    // Drive root: "C:" or "/"
    if (parts.length === 1) return t;
    return parts[parts.length - 1];
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';

export interface DuplicateScanOptions {
  includeHidden?: boolean;
  minSize?: number;
  maxFiles?: number;
  maxDepth?: number;
}

export interface DuplicateScanProgress {
  phase: 'enumerating' | 'hashing';
  discoveredFiles: number;
  candidateFiles: number;
  hashedFiles: number;
}

export interface DuplicateGroup {
  hash: string;
  size: number;
  files: FileInfo[];
  reclaimableBytes: number;
  suggestedKeeperPath: string;
}

export type DuplicateKeeperPolicy = 'oldest' | 'newest' | 'shortest-path';

export interface DuplicateScanResult {
  root: string;
  groups: DuplicateGroup[];
  scannedFiles: number;
  hashedFiles: number;
  reclaimableBytes: number;
  truncated: boolean;
  warnings: string[];
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class DuplicateFinderService {
  constructor(private readonly api: ApiService) {}

  async scan(
    root: string,
    options: DuplicateScanOptions = {},
    onProgress?: (progress: DuplicateScanProgress) => void,
  ): Promise<DuplicateScanResult> {
    const includeHidden = !!options.includeHidden;
    const minSize = Math.max(0, options.minSize ?? 1);
    const maxFiles = Math.max(1, options.maxFiles ?? 20_000);
    const maxDepth = Math.max(0, options.maxDepth ?? 64);
    const files: FileInfo[] = [];
    const warnings: string[] = [];
    let truncated = false;

    const walk = async (path: string, depth: number): Promise<void> => {
      if (files.length >= maxFiles) { truncated = true; return; }
      if (depth > maxDepth) { truncated = true; return; }
      let listing;
      try {
        listing = await this.api.listDirectory(path, includeHidden);
      } catch (error) {
        warnings.push(`${path}: ${this.messageOf(error)}`);
        return;
      }
      for (const entry of listing.entries ?? []) {
        if (files.length >= maxFiles) { truncated = true; return; }
        if (!includeHidden && entry.isHidden) continue;
        if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY && !entry.isSymlink) {
          await walk(entry.path, depth + 1);
          continue;
        }
        if (entry.type !== FileType.FILE || entry.isSymlink || entry.size < minSize) continue;
        files.push(entry);
        onProgress?.({ phase: 'enumerating', discoveredFiles: files.length, candidateFiles: 0, hashedFiles: 0 });
      }
    };

    await walk(root, 0);

    const bySize = new Map<number, FileInfo[]>();
    for (const file of files) {
      const bucket = bySize.get(file.size) ?? [];
      bucket.push(file);
      bySize.set(file.size, bucket);
    }
    const candidates = Array.from(bySize.values()).filter(group => group.length > 1).flat();
    const byHash = new Map<string, FileInfo[]>();
    let hashedFiles = 0;
    for (const file of candidates) {
      try {
        const hash = await this.api.hashFile(file.path);
        const key = `${file.size}:${hash}`;
        const bucket = byHash.get(key) ?? [];
        bucket.push(file);
        byHash.set(key, bucket);
      } catch (error) {
        warnings.push(`${file.path}: ${this.messageOf(error)}`);
      } finally {
        hashedFiles++;
        onProgress?.({ phase: 'hashing', discoveredFiles: files.length, candidateFiles: candidates.length, hashedFiles });
      }
    }

    const groups = Array.from(byHash.entries())
      .filter(([, group]) => group.length > 1)
      .map(([key, group]) => {
        const [sizeText, hash] = key.split(':', 2);
        const size = Number(sizeText) || group[0]?.size || 0;
        const sorted = [...group].sort((a, b) =>
          (a.modified - b.modified) || a.path.length - b.path.length || a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
        return {
          hash,
          size,
          files: sorted,
          reclaimableBytes: size * (sorted.length - 1),
          suggestedKeeperPath: sorted[0].path,
        } satisfies DuplicateGroup;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => b.reclaimableBytes - a.reclaimableBytes || a.files[0].path.localeCompare(b.files[0].path));

    return {
      root,
      groups,
      scannedFiles: files.length,
      hashedFiles,
      reclaimableBytes: groups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.reclaimableBytes, 0),
      truncated,
      warnings,
    };
  }

  keeperPath(group: DuplicateGroup, policy: DuplicateKeeperPolicy = 'oldest'): string {
    if (!group.files.length) return '';
    const files = [...group.files];
    if (policy === 'newest') {
      files.sort((a, b) => (b.modified - a.modified) || a.path.length - b.path.length || a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
      return files[0].path;
    }
    if (policy === 'shortest-path') {
      files.sort((a, b) => a.path.length - b.path.length || (a.modified - b.modified) || a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
      return files[0].path;
    }
    files.sort((a, b) => (a.modified - b.modified) || a.path.length - b.path.length || a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
    return files[0].path;
  }

  redundantPaths(groups: readonly DuplicateGroup[], policy: DuplicateKeeperPolicy = 'oldest'): string[] {
    return groups.flatMap(group => {
      const keeper = this.keeperPath(group, policy);
      return group.files.filter(file => file.path !== keeper).map(file => file.path);
    });
  }

  suggestedRedundantPaths(groups: readonly DuplicateGroup[]): string[] {
    return this.redundantPaths(groups, 'oldest');
  }

  private messageOf(error: unknown): string {
    return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error ?? 'Unknown error');
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { InputTrigger, InputBindingDefinition } from './input-system.types';
import { BROWSER_BINDINGS } from '../components/file-browser-command-registry';
import { DIALOG_INPUT_CATALOG } from './dialog-input-catalog';

export interface KeybindingOverride {
  id: string;
  trigger?: InputTrigger;
  enabled?: boolean;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'keybinding-overrides-v1';

function buildDefaultCatalog(): Map<string, InputBindingDefinition> {
  const map = new Map<string, InputBindingDefinition>();
  for (const binding of BROWSER_BINDINGS) {
    map.set(binding.id, binding);
  }
  for (const entry of DIALOG_INPUT_CATALOG) {
    for (const binding of entry.bindings) {
      map.set(binding.id, binding);
    }
  }
  return map;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class KeybindingStorageService {
  private readonly defaults = buildDefaultCatalog();
  private overrides: KeybindingOverride[] = [];

  constructor() {
    this.load();
  }

  getOverrides(): KeybindingOverride[] {
    return [...this.overrides];
  }

  getDefaultBinding(bindingId: string): InputBindingDefinition | undefined {
    return this.defaults.get(bindingId);
  }

  getDefaultBindings(): InputBindingDefinition[] {
    return Array.from(this.defaults.values()).map(binding => ({ ...binding }));
  }

  mergeWithDefaults(snapshot: InputBindingDefinition[]): InputBindingDefinition[] {
    const merged = new Map<string, InputBindingDefinition>();

    for (const binding of this.defaults.values()) {
      merged.set(binding.id, { ...binding, enabled: true });
    }

    for (const binding of snapshot) {
      merged.set(binding.id, binding);
    }

    return Array.from(merged.values());
  }

  setOverride(override: KeybindingOverride): void {
    const idx = this.overrides.findIndex(o => o.id === override.id);
    if (idx >= 0) {
      this.overrides[idx] = { ...this.overrides[idx], ...override };
    } else {
      this.overrides.push(override);
    }
    this.save();
  }

  removeOverride(bindingId: string): void {
    this.overrides = this.overrides.filter(o => o.id !== bindingId);
    this.save();
  }

  resetAll(): void {
    this.overrides = [];
    this.save();
  }

  applyOverrides(engine: {
    registerBinding(binding: InputBindingDefinition): void;
    updateBindingTrigger(bindingId: string, trigger: InputTrigger): boolean;
    setBindingEnabled(bindingId: string, enabled: boolean): void;
  }): void {
    for (const override of this.overrides) {
      const def = this.defaults.get(override.id);
      if (!def) continue;

      if (override.trigger) {
        engine.updateBindingTrigger(override.id, override.trigger);
      }
      if (typeof override.enabled === 'boolean') {
        engine.setBindingEnabled(override.id, override.enabled);
      }
    }
  }

  private load(): void {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as KeybindingOverride[];
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
          this.overrides = parsed;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore parse errors
    }
  }

  private save(): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(this.overrides));
    } catch {
      // ignore storage errors
    }
  }
}
````

````typescript
  });

  });
````

````typescript
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { PaneComparisonService } from './pane-comparison.service';

function file(name: string, side: 'left' | 'right', overrides: Partial<FileInfo> = {}): FileInfo {
  return {
    name,
    path: `/${side}/${name}`,
    type: FileType.FILE,
    size: 10,
    created: 1,
    modified: 100,
    accessed: 1,
    permissions: '',
    isHidden: false,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe('PaneComparisonService', () => {
  const service = new PaneComparisonService();

  it('classifies missing, newer and size-different files by name', () => {
    const result = service.compare(
      [file('same.txt', 'left'), file('left.txt', 'left'), file('newer.txt', 'left', { modified: 200 }), file('size.txt', 'left', { size: 20 })],
      [file('same.txt', 'right'), file('right.txt', 'right'), file('newer.txt', 'right', { modified: 100 }), file('size.txt', 'right', { size: 10 })],
    );

    expect(result.summary).toMatchObject({ same: 1, onlyLeft: 1, onlyRight: 1, leftNewer: 1, sizeDifferent: 1, different: 4 });
  });

  it('treats timestamp differences within the tolerance as equal', () => {
    const result = service.compare([file('a.txt', 'left', { modified: 100 })], [file('a.txt', 'right', { modified: 101 })]);
    expect(result.items[0].status).toBe('same');
  });

  it('does not recursively compare directories', () => {
    const result = service.compare(
      [file('folder', 'left', { type: FileType.DIRECTORY, modified: 200 })],
      [file('folder', 'right', { type: FileType.DIRECTORY, modified: 100 })],
    );
    expect(result.items[0].status).toBe('same');
  });

  it('returns safe missing-only copy sets', () => {
    const result = service.compare([file('left.txt', 'left')], [file('right.txt', 'right')]);
    expect(service.missingOnRightPaths(result)).toEqual(['/left/left.txt']);
    expect(service.missingOnLeftPaths(result)).toEqual(['/right/right.txt']);
  });
});
````

## File: frontend/src/app/services/pane-comparison.service.ts
````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { FileInfo, FileType } from '../shared/protocol';

export type PaneComparisonStatus =
  | 'only-left'
  | 'only-right'
  | 'left-newer'
  | 'right-newer'
  | 'size-different'
  | 'type-different'
  | 'same';

export interface PaneComparisonItem {
  key: string;
  name: string;
  status: PaneComparisonStatus;
  left: FileInfo | null;
  right: FileInfo | null;
}

export interface PaneComparisonSummary {
  total: number;
  same: number;
  onlyLeft: number;
  onlyRight: number;
  leftNewer: number;
  rightNewer: number;
  sizeDifferent: number;
  typeDifferent: number;
  different: number;
}

export interface PaneComparisonResult {
  items: PaneComparisonItem[];
  summary: PaneComparisonSummary;
}

export interface PaneComparisonOptions {
  caseSensitive?: boolean;
  modifiedToleranceSeconds?: number;
}

const DEFAULT_MODIFIED_TOLERANCE_SECONDS = 2;

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PaneComparisonService {
  compare(
    leftEntries: readonly FileInfo[],
    rightEntries: readonly FileInfo[],
    options: PaneComparisonOptions = {},
  ): PaneComparisonResult {
    const caseSensitive = options.caseSensitive ?? false;
    const tolerance = Math.max(0, options.modifiedToleranceSeconds ?? DEFAULT_MODIFIED_TOLERANCE_SECONDS);
    const left = this.index(leftEntries, caseSensitive);
    const right = this.index(rightEntries, caseSensitive);
    const keys = new Set([...left.keys(), ...right.keys()]);
    const items: PaneComparisonItem[] = [];

    for (const key of keys) {
      const leftEntry = left.get(key) ?? null;
      const rightEntry = right.get(key) ?? null;
      const entry = leftEntry ?? rightEntry;
      if (!entry) continue;

      items.push({
        key,
        name: entry.name,
        left: leftEntry,
        right: rightEntry,
        status: this.status(leftEntry, rightEntry, tolerance),
      });
    }

    items.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }));

    return this.fromItems(items);
  }

  fromItems(items: readonly PaneComparisonItem[]): PaneComparisonResult {
    const normalized = [...items];
    const summary: PaneComparisonSummary = {
      total: normalized.length, same: 0, onlyLeft: 0, onlyRight: 0,
      leftNewer: 0, rightNewer: 0, sizeDifferent: 0, typeDifferent: 0, different: 0,
    };
    for (const item of normalized) {
      switch (item.status) {
        case 'same': summary.same++; break;
        case 'only-left': summary.onlyLeft++; break;
        case 'only-right': summary.onlyRight++; break;
        case 'left-newer': summary.leftNewer++; break;
        case 'right-newer': summary.rightNewer++; break;
        case 'size-different': summary.sizeDifferent++; break;
        case 'type-different': summary.typeDifferent++; break;
      }
    }
    summary.different = summary.total - summary.same;
    return { items: normalized, summary };
  }

  leftDifferencePaths(result: PaneComparisonResult): string[] {
    return result.items
      .filter(item => item.left && item.status !== 'same' && item.status !== 'only-right')
      .map(item => item.left!.path);
  }

  rightDifferencePaths(result: PaneComparisonResult): string[] {
    return result.items
      .filter(item => item.right && item.status !== 'same' && item.status !== 'only-left')
      .map(item => item.right!.path);
  }

  missingOnRightPaths(result: PaneComparisonResult): string[] {
    return result.items
      .filter(item => item.status === 'only-left' && item.left)
      .map(item => item.left!.path);
  }

  missingOnLeftPaths(result: PaneComparisonResult): string[] {
    return result.items
      .filter(item => item.status === 'only-right' && item.right)
      .map(item => item.right!.path);
  }

  private index(entries: readonly FileInfo[], caseSensitive: boolean): Map<string, FileInfo> {
    const result = new Map<string, FileInfo>();
    for (const entry of entries ?? []) {
      if (!entry?.name || entry.path === '..') continue;
      const key = caseSensitive ? entry.name : entry.name.toLocaleLowerCase();
      if (!result.has(key)) result.set(key, entry);
    }
    return result;
  }

  private status(left: FileInfo | null, right: FileInfo | null, tolerance: number): PaneComparisonStatus {
    if (!left) return 'only-right';
    if (!right) return 'only-left';
    if (left.type !== right.type) return 'type-different';

    // Directory contents are intentionally not recursively compared in the
    // shallow pane comparison. Presence/type parity is enough for this level.
    if (left.type === FileType.DIRECTORY && right.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      return 'same';
    }

    if (left.size !== right.size) return 'size-different';

    const delta = (left.modified || 0) - (right.modified || 0);
    if (Math.abs(delta) <= tolerance) return 'same';
    return delta > 0 ? 'left-newer' : 'right-newer';
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';

import { PaneComparisonService } from './pane-comparison.service';
import { PaneRecursiveComparisonService } from './pane-recursive-comparison.service';
import type { ApiService } from './api.service';

function entry(path: string, type = FileType.FILE, size = 1, modified = 1, isSymlink = false): FileInfo {
  return { name: path.split('/').pop()!, path, type, size, modified, created: modified, accessed: modified, permissions: '', isHidden: false, isSymlink };
}
function listing(path: string, entries: FileInfo[]): DirectoryListing { return { path, entries, totalSize: 0 }; }

describe('PaneRecursiveComparisonService', () => {
  it('descends matched directories and compares by relative path', async () => {
    const dirs = new Map<string, DirectoryListing>([
      ['L', listing('L', [entry('L/src', FileType.DIRECTORY)])],
      ['R', listing('R', [entry('R/src', FileType.DIRECTORY)])],
      ['L/src', listing('L/src', [entry('L/src/app.ts', FileType.FILE, 10, 5)])],
      ['R/src', listing('R/src', [entry('R/src/app.ts', FileType.FILE, 10, 1)])],
    ]);
    const api = { listDirectory: fn(async (path: string) => dirs.get(path)!) } as unknown as ApiService;
    const result = await new PaneRecursiveComparisonService(new PaneComparisonService()).compare(api, 'L', 'R');
    expect(result.comparison.items.find(item => item.key === 'src/app.ts')?.status).toBe('left-newer');
  });

  it('collapses a missing directory subtree into one copyable item', async () => {
    const api = { listDirectory: fn(async (path: string) => {
      if (path === 'L') return listing('L', [entry('L/photos', FileType.DIRECTORY)]);
      if (path === 'R') return listing('R', []);

    }) } as unknown as ApiService;
    const result = await new PaneRecursiveComparisonService(new PaneComparisonService()).compare(api, 'L', 'R');
    expect(result.comparison.items.map(item => [item.key, item.status])).toEqual([['photos', 'only-left']]);
    expect(api.listDirectory).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it('does not follow symlink directories', async () => {
    const api = { listDirectory: fn(async (path: string) => listing(path, [entry(`${path}/link`, FileType.DIRECTORY, 0, 0, true)])) } as unknown as ApiService;
    await new PaneRecursiveComparisonService(new PaneComparisonService()).compare(api, 'L', 'R');
    expect(api.listDirectory).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });
````

````typescript
import { Injectable, Optional } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import {
  PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService,
  type ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot,
  type PluginActivationEventResult,
} from './plugin-lifecycle-coordinator.service';
import { BackendPluginCommandBridgeService } from './backend-plugin-command-bridge.service';

export type PluginBootstrapStatus =
  | 'idle'
  | 'initializing'
  | 'ready'
  | 'degraded'
  | 'shutting-down'
  | 'stopped';

export interface PluginBootstrapSnapshot {
  status: PluginBootstrapStatus;
  runtimes: readonly ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot[];
  startupActivations: readonly PluginActivationEventResult[];
  errors: readonly string[];
}

const INITIAL_SNAPSHOT: PluginBootstrapSnapshot = {
  status: 'idle',
  runtimes: [],
  startupActivations: [],
  errors: [],
};

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PluginBootstrapService {
  readonly state$ = createBehaviorSubject<PluginBootstrapSnapshot>(INITIAL_SNAPSHOT);

  private current: PluginBootstrapSnapshot = INITIAL_SNAPSHOT;
  private initializePromise: Promise<PluginBootstrapSnapshot> | null = null;
  private shutdownPromise: Promise<void> | null = null;

  constructor(
    private readonly lifecycle: PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService,
    @Optional() private readonly backendCommands?: BackendPluginCommandBridgeService,
  ) {}

  get snapshot(): PluginBootstrapSnapshot {
    return this.current;
  }

  /**
   * Discovers and reconciles plugins once, then activates packages that opted
   * into onStartup. Individual plugin activation failures degrade plugin
   * health but never prevent the file manager itself from starting.
   */
  initialize(selectionProvider: () => string[] = () => []): Promise<PluginBootstrapSnapshot> {
    if (this.current.status === 'ready' || this.current.status === 'degraded') {
      return Promise.resolve(this.current);
    }
    if (this.initializePromise) return this.initializePromise;

    this.publish({ ...INITIAL_SNAPSHOT, status: 'initializing' });
    this.initializePromise = this.runInitialize(selectionProvider).finally(() => {
      this.initializePromise = null;
    });
    return this.initializePromise;
  }

  /**
   * Application teardown is best-effort. We wait for an in-flight bootstrap
   * before deactivating so activation and cleanup cannot race each other.
   */
  shutdown(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.current.status === 'stopped') return Promise.resolve();
    if (this.shutdownPromise) return this.shutdownPromise;

    this.shutdownPromise = this.runShutdown().finally(() => {
      this.shutdownPromise = null;
    });
    return this.shutdownPromise;
  }

  private async runInitialize(selectionProvider: () => string[]): Promise<PluginBootstrapSnapshot> {
    const bootstrapErrors: string[] = [];
    if (this.backendCommands) {
      try {
        await this.backendCommands.start(selectionProvider);
      } catch (error) {
        bootstrapErrors.push(`backend commands: ${errorMessage(error)}`);
      }
    }

    try {
      const runtimes = await this.lifecycle.sync();
      const startupActivations = await this.lifecycle.activateStartup();
      const errors = [
        ...bootstrapErrors,
        ...startupActivations
          .filter(result => !result.activated && result.error)
          .map(result => `${result.pluginId}: ${result.error}`),
      ];

      const status: PluginBootstrapStatus = errors.length ? 'degraded' : 'ready';
      const snapshot: PluginBootstrapSnapshot = {
        status,
        runtimes,
        startupActivations,
        errors,
      };
      this.publish(snapshot);
      return snapshot;
    } catch (error) {
      const message = errorMessage(error);
      const snapshot: PluginBootstrapSnapshot = {
        status: 'degraded',
        runtimes: [],
        startupActivations: [],
        errors: [...bootstrapErrors, message],
      };
      this.publish(snapshot);
      return snapshot;
    }
  }

  private async runShutdown(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.initializePromise) {
      await this.initializePromise.catch(() => undefined);
    }

    this.publish({ ...this.current, status: 'shutting-down' });
    let results: Awaited<ReturnType<PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService['shutdown']>> = [];
    try {
      results = await this.lifecycle.shutdown();
    } finally {
      this.backendCommands?.stop();
    }
    const shutdownErrors = results
      .filter(result => result.error)
      .map(result => `${result.pluginId}: ${result.error}`);

    this.publish({
      ...this.current,
      status: 'stopped',
      errors: [...this.current.errors, ...shutdownErrors],
    });
  }

  private publish(snapshot: PluginBootstrapSnapshot): void {
    this.current = snapshot;
    this.state$.next(snapshot);
  }
}

function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}
````

## File: frontend/src/app/services/plugin-installation-state.service.ts
````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import type { PluginManifest, PluginPermission } from '../plugin/plugin-manifest';
import {
  PluginDiscoveryService,
  type DiscoveredPluginPackage,
} from './plugin-discovery.service';

export type PluginActivationHealth = 'never' | 'success' | 'failed';

export interface PluginPackageState {
  pluginId: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  trusted: boolean;
  trustedVersion?: string;
  grantedPermissions: PluginPermission[];
  quarantined: boolean;
  quarantineReason?: string;
  lastActivationStatus: PluginActivationHealth;
  lastActivationError?: string;
  lastActivatedAt?: number;
  consecutiveActivationFailures: number;
  lastSeenVersion?: string;
  updatedAt: number;
}

export interface ManagedPluginPackage {
  discovered: DiscoveredPluginPackage;
  state: PluginPackageState;
  requestedPermissions: PluginPermission[];
  effectiveGrantedPermissions: PluginPermission[];
  missingPermissions: PluginPermission[];
  readyToActivate: boolean;
}

export interface PluginPackageStatePatch {
  enabled?: boolean;
  trusted?: boolean;
  grantedPermissions?: PluginPermission[];
  clearQuarantine?: boolean;
}

interface PluginStateBindings {
  GetPluginPackageStates(): Promise<unknown[]>;
  GetPluginPackageState(pluginId: string): Promise<unknown>;
  UpdatePluginPackageState(pluginId: string, patch: PluginPackageStatePatch): Promise<unknown>;
  QuarantinePluginPackage(pluginId: string, reason: string): Promise<unknown>;
  RecordPluginActivation(pluginId: string, success: boolean, activationError: string): Promise<unknown>;
}

function appBindings(): PluginStateBindings {
  const bindings = (window as any)?.go?.app?.App as PluginStateBindings | undefined;
  if (!bindings?.GetPluginPackageStates || !bindings?.UpdatePluginPackageState) {
    throw new Error('Plugin state bindings are unavailable. Regenerate Wails bindings and restart the application.');
  }
  return bindings;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PluginInstallationStateService {
  constructor(private readonly discovery: PluginDiscoveryService) {}

  async refresh(): Promise<ManagedPluginPackage[]> {
    const discovered = await this.discovery.discover();
    const states = (await appBindings().GetPluginPackageStates()).map(normalizePluginPackageState);
    const byId = new Map(states.map(state => [state.pluginId, state]));

    return discovered.map(pkg => {
      const state = byId.get(pkg.manifest.id) ?? defaultPluginPackageState(pkg.manifest.id, pkg.manifest.version);
      return buildManagedPluginPackage(pkg, state);
    });
  }

  async getState(pluginId: string): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return normalizePluginPackageState(await appBindings().GetPluginPackageState(pluginId));
  }

  async setEnabled(pluginId: string, enabled: boolean): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return this.update(pluginId, { enabled });
  }

  async setTrusted(pluginId: string, trusted: boolean): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return this.update(pluginId, { trusted });
  }

  async setGrantedPermissions(pluginId: string, permissions: readonly PluginPermission[]): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return this.update(pluginId, { grantedPermissions: [...permissions] });
  }

  async clearQuarantine(pluginId: string): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return this.update(pluginId, { clearQuarantine: true });
  }

  async quarantine(pluginId: string, reason: string): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return normalizePluginPackageState(await appBindings().QuarantinePluginPackage(pluginId, reason));
  }

  async recordActivation(pluginId: string, success: boolean, error = ''): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return normalizePluginPackageState(await appBindings().RecordPluginActivation(pluginId, success, error));
  }

  private async update(pluginId: string, patch: PluginPackageStatePatch): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    return normalizePluginPackageState(await appBindings().UpdatePluginPackageState(pluginId, patch));
  }
}

export function buildManagedPluginPackage(
  discovered: DiscoveredPluginPackage,
  state: PluginPackageState,
): ManagedPluginPackage {
  const requestedPermissions = [...(discovered.manifest.permissions ?? [])];
  const trustedForCurrentVersion = state.trusted && state.trustedVersion === discovered.manifest.version;
  const effectiveGrantedPermissions = trustedForCurrentVersion
    ? requestedPermissions
    : requestedPermissions.filter(permission => state.grantedPermissions.includes(permission));
  const granted = new Set(effectiveGrantedPermissions);
  const missingPermissions = requestedPermissions.filter(permission => !granted.has(permission));

  return {
    discovered,
    state,
    requestedPermissions,
    effectiveGrantedPermissions,
    missingPermissions,
    readyToActivate:
      discovered.valid &&
      state.enabled &&
      !state.quarantined &&
      missingPermissions.length === 0,
  };
}

export function normalizePluginPackageState(value: unknown): PluginPackageState {
  const raw = (value ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
  return {
    pluginId: stringValue(raw['pluginId']),
    enabled: raw['enabled'] === true,
    trusted: raw['trusted'] === true,
    trustedVersion: optionalString(raw['trustedVersion']),
    grantedPermissions: stringArray(raw['grantedPermissions']) as PluginPermission[],
    quarantined: raw['quarantined'] === true,
    quarantineReason: optionalString(raw['quarantineReason']),
    lastActivationStatus: activationStatus(raw['lastActivationStatus']),
    lastActivationError: optionalString(raw['lastActivationError']),
    lastActivatedAt: optionalNumber(raw['lastActivatedAt']),
    consecutiveActivationFailures: numberValue(raw['consecutiveActivationFailures']),
    lastSeenVersion: optionalString(raw['lastSeenVersion']),
    updatedAt: numberValue(raw['updatedAt']),
  };
}

function defaultPluginPackageState(pluginId: string, version?: string): PluginPackageState {
  return {
    pluginId,
    enabled: false,
    trusted: false,
    trustedVersion: undefined,
    grantedPermissions: [],
    quarantined: false,
    lastActivationStatus: 'never',
    consecutiveActivationFailures: 0,
    lastSeenVersion: version,
    updatedAt: 0,
  };
}

function activationStatus(value: unknown): PluginActivationHealth {
  return value === 'success' || value === 'failed' ? value : 'never';
}
function stringValue(value: unknown): string { return typeof value === 'string' ? value : ''; }
function optionalString(value: unknown): string | undefined { return typeof value === 'string' && value ? value : undefined; }
function numberValue(value: unknown): number { return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0; }
function optionalNumber(value: unknown): number | undefined { return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : undefined; }
function stringArray(value: unknown): string[] { return Array.isArray(value) ? value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === 'string') : []; }
````

````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService } from './plugin-lifecycle-coordinator.service';
import type { ManagedPluginPackage, PluginPackageState } from './plugin-installation-state.service';
import type { PluginRuntimeSnapshot } from './plugin-platform.service';

function state(overrides: Partial<PluginPackageState> = {}): PluginPackageState {
  return {
    pluginId: 'example',
    enabled: true,
    trusted: false,
    grantedPermissions: ['commands'],
    quarantined: false,
    lastActivationStatus: 'never',
    consecutiveActivationFailures: 0,
    updatedAt: 1,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function managed(overrides: Partial<ManagedPluginPackage> = {}): ManagedPluginPackage {
  const base: ManagedPluginPackage = {
    discovered: {
      manifest: {
        schemaVersion: 1,
        id: 'example',
        name: 'Example',
        version: '1.0.0',
        permissions: ['commands'],
        activationEvents: ['onStartup'],
      },
      path: '/plugins/example',
      manifestPath: '/plugins/example/plugin.json',
      valid: true,
      errors: [],
      warnings: [],
    },
    state: state(),
    requestedPermissions: ['commands'],
    effectiveGrantedPermissions: ['commands'],
    missingPermissions: [],
    readyToActivate: true,
  };
  return { ...base, ...overrides };
}

function createPlatform(hasLoader = false) {
  const runtimes = new Map<string, PluginRuntimeSnapshot>();
  return {
    list: fn(() => Array.from(runtimes.values())),
    get: fn((id: string) => runtimes.get(id)),
    isInstalled: fn((id: string) => runtimes.has(id)),
    hasLoader: fn(() => hasLoader),
    installFromSource: fn(async (source: any, options: any) => {
      runtimes.set('example', {
        manifest: managed().discovered.manifest,
        state: 'installed',
        grantedPermissions: [...options.grantedPermissions],
        missingPermissions: [],
        source,
      });
    }),
    activate: fn(async (id: string) => {
      const runtime = runtimes.get(id);
      if (runtime) runtimes.set(id, { ...runtime, state: 'active' });
    }),
    deactivate: fn(async () => undefined),
    uninstall: fn(async (id: string) => { runtimes.delete(id); }),
  };
}

describe('PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService', () => {
  it('keeps policy-ready packages inert when no safe loader exists', async () => {
    const pkg = managed();
    const installation = { refresh: fn(async () => [pkg]) } as any;
    const platform = createPlatform(false);
    const coordinator = new PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService(installation, platform as any);

    const [snapshot] = await coordinator.sync();
    expect(snapshot.status).toBe('loader-unavailable');
    expect(platform.installFromSource).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('installs eligible packages without activating them during sync', async () => {
    const pkg = managed();
    const installation = { refresh: fn(async () => [pkg]) } as any;
    const platform = createPlatform(true);
    const coordinator = new PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService(installation, platform as any);

    const [snapshot] = await coordinator.sync();
    expect(snapshot.status).toBe('installed');
    expect(platform.installFromSource).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(platform.activate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('removes managed runtimes when persisted policy disables the plugin', async () => {
    const enabledPkg = managed();
    const disabledPkg = managed({
      state: state({ enabled: false }),
      readyToActivate: false,
    });
    let current = [enabledPkg];
    const installation = { refresh: fn(async () => current) } as any;
    const platform = createPlatform(true);
    const coordinator = new PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService(installation, platform as any);

    await coordinator.sync();
    current = [disabledPkg];
    const [snapshot] = await coordinator.sync();
    expect(snapshot.status).toBe('disabled');
    expect(platform.uninstall).toHaveBeenCalledWith('example');
  });

  it('records successful activation health', async () => {
    const pkg = managed();
    const installation = {
      refresh: fn(async () => [pkg]),
      recordActivation: fn(async () => state({ lastActivationStatus: 'success' })),
    } as any;
    const platform = createPlatform(true);
    const coordinator = new PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService(installation, platform as any);

    await coordinator.activate('example');
    expect(platform.activate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('example');
    expect(installation.recordActivation).toHaveBeenCalledWith('example', true);
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { PluginManagerService } from './plugin-manager.service';
import {
  PLUGIN_API_VERSION,
  type PluginActivationEvent,
  type PluginManifest,
  type PluginPermission,
  validatePluginManifest,
} from '../plugin/plugin-manifest';
import type {
  PluginActivationContext,
  PluginPackage,
  PluginPackageLoader,
  PluginPackageSource,
} from '../plugin/plugin-package';
import { ScopedPluginRegistry } from '../plugin/scoped-plugin-registry';

export type PluginLifecycleState =
  | 'installed'
  | 'activating'
  | 'active'
  | 'deactivating'
  | 'inactive'
  | 'failed'
  | 'incompatible';

export interface PluginRuntimeSnapshot {
  manifest: PluginManifest;
  state: PluginLifecycleState;
  grantedPermissions: readonly PluginPermission[];
  missingPermissions: readonly PluginPermission[];
  error?: string;
  source?: PluginPackageSource;
}

export interface InstallPluginOptions {
  trusted?: boolean;
  grantedPermissions?: readonly PluginPermission[];
  source?: PluginPackageSource;
  activate?: boolean;
}

interface PluginRuntime {
  pkg: PluginPackage;
  state: PluginLifecycleState;
  granted: Set<PluginPermission>;
  scope?: ScopedPluginRegistry;
  context?: PluginActivationContext;
  error?: string;
  source?: PluginPackageSource;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PluginPlatformService {
  private readonly runtimes = new Map<string, PluginRuntime>();
  private readonly loaders = new Map<string, PluginPackageLoader>();

  constructor(private readonly contributions: PluginManagerService) {}

  async install(pkg: PluginPackage, options: InstallPluginOptions = {}): Promise<void> {
    const manifest = pkg.manifest;
    if (this.runtimes.has(manifest.id)) {
      throw new Error(`Plugin ${manifest.id} is already installed.`);
    }

    const validation = validatePluginManifest(manifest, PLUGIN_API_VERSION);
    const requested = new Set(manifest.permissions ?? []);
    const granted = options.trusted
      ? new Set(requested)
      : new Set(options.grantedPermissions ?? []);

    const runtime: PluginRuntime = {
      pkg,
      state: validation.valid ? 'installed' : 'incompatible',
      granted,
      source: options.source,
      error: validation.valid ? undefined : validation.errors.join(' '),
    };
    this.runtimes.set(manifest.id, runtime);

    if (!validation.valid) return;
    if (options.activate) await this.activate(manifest.id);
  }

  async uninstall(pluginId: string): Promise<void> {
    const runtime = this.mustGet(pluginId);
    if (runtime.state === 'active' || runtime.state === 'failed') {
      await this.deactivate(pluginId);
    }
    this.runtimes.delete(pluginId);
  }

  async activate(pluginId: string): Promise<void> {
    const runtime = this.mustGet(pluginId);
    if (runtime.state === 'active') return;
    if (runtime.state === 'incompatible') {
      throw new Error(runtime.error ?? `Plugin ${pluginId} is incompatible.`);
    }

    const missing = this.missingPermissions(runtime);
    if (missing.length) {
      throw new Error(`Plugin ${pluginId} is missing permissions: ${missing.join(', ')}.`);
    }

    runtime.state = 'activating';
    runtime.error = undefined;
    const scope = new ScopedPluginRegistry(pluginId, this.contributions, runtime.granted);
    const context: PluginActivationContext = {
      pluginId,
      manifest: runtime.pkg.manifest,
      api: scope,
      permissions: runtime.granted,
      host: { pluginApiVersion: PLUGIN_API_VERSION },
      hasPermission: permission => runtime.granted.has(permission),
    };
    runtime.scope = scope;
    runtime.context = context;

    try {
      await runtime.pkg.activate(context);
      runtime.state = 'active';
    } catch (error) {
      scope.dispose();
      runtime.scope = undefined;
      runtime.context = undefined;
      runtime.state = 'failed';
      runtime.error = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async deactivate(pluginId: string): Promise<void> {
    const runtime = this.mustGet(pluginId);
    if (runtime.state !== 'active' && runtime.state !== 'failed') return;

    runtime.state = 'deactivating';
    let deactivateError: unknown;
    try {
      if (runtime.context) await runtime.pkg.deactivate?.(runtime.context);
    } catch (error) {
      deactivateError = error;
    } finally {
      runtime.scope?.dispose();
      runtime.scope = undefined;
      runtime.context = undefined;
      runtime.state = 'inactive';
    }

    if (deactivateError) throw deactivateError;
  }

  async activateByEvent(event: PluginActivationEvent): Promise<string[]> {
    const activated: string[] = [];
    for (const [id, runtime] of this.runtimes) {
      if (runtime.state !== 'installed' && runtime.state !== 'inactive') continue;
      const events = runtime.pkg.manifest.activationEvents ?? ['onStartup'];
      if (!events.includes(event)) continue;
      await this.activate(id);
      activated.push(id);
    }
    return activated;
  }

  setGrantedPermissions(pluginId: string, permissions: readonly PluginPermission[]): void {
    const runtime = this.mustGet(pluginId);
    if (runtime.state === 'active' || runtime.state === 'activating') {
      throw new Error(`Deactivate plugin ${pluginId} before changing permissions.`);
    }
    runtime.granted = new Set(permissions);
  }

  list(): PluginRuntimeSnapshot[] {
    return Array.from(this.runtimes.values()).map(runtime => this.snapshot(runtime));
  }

  get(pluginId: string): PluginRuntimeSnapshot | undefined {
    const runtime = this.runtimes.get(pluginId);
    return runtime ? this.snapshot(runtime) : undefined;
  }

  registerLoader(loader: PluginPackageLoader): void {
    if (this.loaders.has(loader.kind)) throw new Error(`Plugin loader ${loader.kind} is already registered.`);
    this.loaders.set(loader.kind, loader);
  }

  unregisterLoader(kind: string): void { this.loaders.delete(kind); }

  hasLoader(kind: string): boolean { return this.loaders.has(kind); }

  isInstalled(pluginId: string): boolean { return this.runtimes.has(pluginId); }

  async installFromSource(source: PluginPackageSource, options: Omit<InstallPluginOptions, 'source'> = {}): Promise<void> {
    const loader = this.loaders.get(source.kind);
    if (!loader) throw new Error(`No plugin package loader registered for ${source.kind}.`);
    const pkg = await loader.load(source);
    await this.install(pkg, { ...options, source });
  }

  private mustGet(pluginId: string): PluginRuntime {
    const runtime = this.runtimes.get(pluginId);
    if (!runtime) throw new Error(`Plugin ${pluginId} is not installed.`);
    return runtime;
  }

  private missingPermissions(runtime: PluginRuntime): PluginPermission[] {
    return (runtime.pkg.manifest.permissions ?? []).filter(permission => !runtime.granted.has(permission));
  }

  private snapshot(runtime: PluginRuntime): PluginRuntimeSnapshot {
    return {
      manifest: runtime.pkg.manifest,
      state: runtime.state,
      grantedPermissions: Array.from(runtime.granted),
      missingPermissions: this.missingPermissions(runtime),
      error: runtime.error,
      source: runtime.source,
    };
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { PinnedLocationService } from './pinned-location.service';
import { RelatedLocationService } from './related-location.service';

function pin(service: PinnedLocationService, location: string, surfaceId?: string) {
  const value = service.create(location, undefined, undefined, Date.now(), surfaceId);
  if (!value) throw new Error('pin creation failed');
  return value;
}

describe('RelatedLocationService', () => {
  let pins: PinnedLocationService;
  let related: RelatedLocationService;

  beforeEach(() => {
    pins = new PinnedLocationService();
    related = new RelatedLocationService(pins);
  });

  it('ranks saved searches by exact, child, then ancestor context', () => {
    const exact = pin(pins, 'search://?path=C%3A%2Fwork%2Fapp&pattern=TODO');
    const child = pin(pins, 'search://?path=C%3A%2Fwork%2Fapp%2Fsrc&pattern=spec');
    const ancestor = pin(pins, 'search://?path=C%3A%2Fwork&pattern=FIXME');
    const unrelated = pin(pins, 'search://?path=D%3A%2Fother&pattern=x');

    expect(related.resolve([ancestor, unrelated, child, exact], 'C:/work/app').map(x => x.id))
      .toEqual([exact.id, child.id, ancestor.id]);
  });

  it('does not include the current pinned surface in Related', () => {
    const current = pin(pins, 'search://?path=C%3A%2Fwork&pattern=TODO', 'search-results');
    expect(related.resolve([current], current.location, 'search-results')).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('lets extensions contribute their own relationship score', () => {
    const git = pin(pins, 'surface://git/repo?root=C%3A%2Fwork', 'git');
    related.register({
      id: 'test.git-related',
      score: (candidate, context) => candidate.surfaceId === 'git' && context.contextLocation === 'C:/work' ? 950 : 0,
    });

    expect(related.resolve([git], 'C:/work')).toEqual([git]);
  });

  it('isolates a failing relationship provider', () => {
    const search = pin(pins, 'search://?path=C%3A%2Fwork&pattern=TODO');
    const spy = spyOnFn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});
    related.register({ id: 'broken', score: () => { throw new Error('boom'); } });

    expect(related.resolve([search], 'C:/work')).toEqual([search]);
    expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalled();
    spy.mockRestore();
  });
});
````

````typescript
import '@angular/compiler';
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';
import { SelectionBasketService } from './selection-basket.service';

function makeStorage() {
  const data = new Map<string, string>();
  return {
    getItem: fn((key: string) => data.get(key) ?? null),
    setItem: fn((key: string, value: string) => data.set(key, value)),
    removeItem: fn((key: string) => data.delete(key)),
    clear: fn(() => data.clear()),
  };
}

function makeService() {
  const api = {
    getFileInfo: fn(async (path: string) => ({
      name: path.split('/').pop() || path,
      path,
      type: FileType.FILE,
      size: 12,
      modified: 10,
    })),
  };
  return { service: new SelectionBasketService(api as never), api };
}

describe('SelectionBasketService', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    stubGlobal('sessionStorage', makeStorage());
  });

  it('deduplicates canonical paths while preserving insertion order', () => {
    const { service } = makeService();
    expect(service.add(['filesystem://c/work/a.txt', 'filesystem://c/work/a.txt'], 'pane:left')).toBe(1);
    expect(service.add(['filesystem://c/work/b.txt'], 'search')).toBe(1);
    expect(service.paths).toEqual(['filesystem://c/work/a.txt', 'filesystem://c/work/b.txt']);
  });

  it('removes successful paths without clearing failed basket entries', () => {
    const { service } = makeService();
    service.add(['filesystem://c/a.txt', 'filesystem://c/b.txt']);
    expect(service.removePaths(['filesystem://c/a.txt'])).toBe(1);
    expect(service.paths).toEqual(['filesystem://c/b.txt']);
  });

  it('persists only durable basket identity to session storage', () => {
    const { service } = makeService();
    service.add(['s3://bucket/report.csv'], 'search-results');
    const stored = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('filemanager:selection-basket-v1') ?? '[]');
    expect(stored).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(stored[0]).toMatchObject({ path: 's3://bucket/report.csv', source: 'search-results' });
    expect(stored[0].size).toBeUndefined();
  });
});
````

## File: frontend/src/app/services/transfer-capabilities.ts
````typescript
import type { SourceCapabilities } from './source-capabilities';

export type TransferOperation = 'copy' | 'move';

export interface TransferCapabilityDecision {
  readonly allowed: boolean;
  readonly reason?: 'source-unreadable' | 'source-not-removable' | 'destination-read-only';
}

export function canReceiveTransfer(destination: SourceCapabilities): TransferCapabilityDecision {
  return destination.create
    ? { allowed: true }
    : { allowed: false, reason: 'destination-read-only' };
}

export function canTransferBetween(operation: TransferOperation, source: SourceCapabilities, destination: SourceCapabilities): TransferCapabilityDecision {
  if (!source.read) return { allowed: false, reason: 'source-unreadable' };
  const receive = canReceiveTransfer(destination);
  if (!receive.allowed) return receive;
  if (operation === 'move' && !source.delete) return { allowed: false, reason: 'source-not-removable' };
  return { allowed: true };
}

export function transferBlockedMessage(operation: TransferOperation, decision: TransferCapabilityDecision): string {
  const action = operation === 'copy' ? 'Copy' : 'Move';
  switch (decision.reason) {
    case 'source-unreadable': return `${action} Not Available\nThe source cannot be read.`;
    case 'source-not-removable': return `${action} Not Available\nThe source is read-only and cannot be moved. You can copy it instead.`;
    case 'destination-read-only': return `${action} Not Available\nThe destination is read-only.`;
    default: return `${action} Not Available`;
  }
}
````

````typescript
type ViewerKind =
  | 'image' | 'video' | 'audio' | 'pdf' | 'svg'
  | 'json' | 'markdown' | 'html' | 'text'
  | 'directory' | 'toobig' | 'unsupported' | 'error' | 'empty' | 'loading';

interface ImageMeta { width: number; height: number }

interface VideoPlaybackPlan {
  mode: 'direct' | 'segmented' | 'remux' | 'transcode';
  format: string;
  videoCodec?: string;
  audioCodec?: string;
  durationSeconds: number;
  zeroDelay: boolean;
  seekable: boolean;
  useNativePlayer: boolean;
  url: string;
}

function normalizeMime(mime: string | null | undefined): string {
  return (mime ?? '').split(';', 1)[0].trim().toLowerCase();
}

function probeLooksText(probe: FileProbe | null | undefined): boolean {
  const mime = normalizeMime(probe?.mimeType);
  if (mime.startsWith('text/')) return true;
  if (mime.endsWith('+json') || mime.endsWith('+xml')) return true;
  return !!probe?.encoding;
}

function probeLooksTransportStream(probe: FileProbe | null | undefined): boolean {
  const mime = normalizeMime(probe?.mimeType);
  return mime === 'video/mp2t' || mime === 'application/mp2t';
}
````
