````go
package app

import (
	"fmt"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

// GetConvertedImageURL returns a stream URL that serves a converted preview image.
func (a *App) GetConvertedImageURL(path string, targetFormat string) (string, error) {
	if pathref.IsWeb(pathref.Normalize(path)) {
		return a.GetStreamURL(path), nil
	}
	info, err := a.State.GetFileInfo(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("cannot access file: %w", err)
	}

	if info.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("cannot convert directory")
	}

	ext := strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.Ext(path), ".")
	ext = strings.ToLower(ext)
	if !a.State.Converter.IsSupportedSourceFormat(ext) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("unsupported source format: .%s", ext)
	}

	targetFormat = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimPrefix(targetFormat, "."))
	return ConvertedStreamURLForFile(a.StreamBaseURL(), path, targetFormat), nil
}

// GetImageThumbnailURL returns a stream URL that serves a bounded thumbnail image.
func (a *App) GetImageThumbnailURL(path string, maxWidth int, maxHeight int) (string, error) {
	if pathref.IsWeb(pathref.Normalize(path)) {
		return a.GetStreamURL(path), nil
	}
	info, err := a.State.GetFileInfo(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("cannot access file: %w", err)
	}

	if info.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("cannot thumbnail directory")
	}

	ext := strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.Ext(path), ".")
	ext = strings.ToLower(ext)
	if !a.State.Converter.IsSupportedSourceFormat(ext) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("unsupported source format: .%s", ext)
	}

	return ThumbnailStreamURLForFile(a.StreamBaseURL(), path, "jpeg", maxWidth, maxHeight), nil
}

// GetArchiveImageThumbnailURL returns a thumbnail stream URL for an archive entry.
func (a *App) GetArchiveImageThumbnailURL(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string, maxWidth int, maxHeight int) (string, error) {
	ext := strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.Ext(entryPath), ".")
	ext = strings.ToLower(ext)
	if !a.State.Converter.IsSupportedSourceFormat(ext) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("unsupported source format: .%s", ext)
	}

	return ThumbnailStreamURLForEntry(a.StreamBaseURL(), fsPath, nestedChain, entryPath, "jpeg", maxWidth, maxHeight), nil
}

// GetConversionCapabilities returns what formats are supported for a given source format.
func (a *App) GetConversionCapabilities(sourceFileExt string) map[string]interface{} {
	ext := strings.ToLower(sourceFileExt)
	ext = strings.TrimPrefix(ext, ".")

	available := a.State.Converter.GetAvailableConversionFormats(ext)

	return map[string]interface{}{
		"sourceFormat":      ext,
		"supported":         a.State.Converter.IsSupportedSourceFormat(ext),
		"availableFormats":  available,
		"recommendedFormat": "webp", // WebP provides best compression/quality balance for previews
	}
}

// CanConvertImage checks if an image format can be converted for preview.
func (a *App) CanConvertImage(fileExt string) bool {
	ext := strings.ToLower(fileExt)
	ext = strings.TrimPrefix(ext, ".")
	return a.State.Converter.IsSupportedSourceFormat(ext)
}

// ConvertOfficeDocument converts an office document to PDF and returns the PDF file path.
// This is used by the office viewer component to convert documents before display.
func (a *App) ConvertOfficeDocument(path string) (map[string]interface{}, error) {
	if a.State.OfficeConverter == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("office converter not available")
	}

	info, err := a.State.GetFileInfo(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot access file: %w", err)
	}

	if info.Type == contracts.FileTypeDirectory {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot convert directory")
	}

	ext := strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.Ext(path), ".")
	ext = strings.ToLower(ext)

	if !a.State.OfficeConverter.IsSupportedFormat(ext) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported document format: .%s", ext)
	}

	if !a.State.OfficeConverter.IsAvailableForFormat(ext) {
		return map[string]interface{}{
			"success":      false,
			"error":        "Document converter not available",
			"availability": false,
			"instructions": a.State.OfficeConverter.AvailabilityInstructions(ext),
		}, nil
	}

	// Resolve VFS path to a real filesystem path for the selected converter.
	realPath, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return map[string]interface{}{
			"success": false,
			"error":   fmt.Sprintf("cannot resolve file path: %v", err),
		}, nil
	}

	pdfPath, err := a.State.OfficeConverter.ConvertToPDF(realPath)
	if err != nil {
		return map[string]interface{}{
			"success": false,
			"error":   err.Error(),
		}, nil
	}

	return map[string]interface{}{
		"success": true,
		"pdfPath": pdfPath,
	}, nil
}

// IsOfficeDocumentAvailable checks if any document conversion backend is available.
func (a *App) IsOfficeDocumentAvailable() bool {
	if a.State.OfficeConverter == nil {
		return false
	}
	return a.State.OfficeConverter.IsAvailable()
}
````

## File: internal/app/bindings_plugin_packages.go
````go
package app

import (
	"fmt"

	pluginpackage "wails-app/internal/pluginpackage"
)

const pluginPackageAppName = "wails-file-manager"

func pluginPackageStateStore() (*pluginpackage.StateStore, error) {
	return pluginpackage.NewStateStore(pluginPackageAppName)
}

// GetPluginDirectory returns the trusted per-user directory scanned for plugin packages.
// Discovery is metadata-only; no code is executed from this directory.
func (a *App) GetPluginDirectory() (string, error) {
	return pluginpackage.DefaultDirectory(pluginPackageAppName)
}

// DiscoverPluginPackages scans immediate child directories containing plugin.json.
// It validates package metadata and returns diagnostics without loading executable code.
// Valid packages are reconciled with the separate persisted state store so observational
// metadata such as lastSeenVersion stays current without changing user trust decisions.
func (a *App) DiscoverPluginPackages() ([]pluginpackage.DiscoveredPackage, error) {
	root, err := a.GetPluginDirectory()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	packages, err := pluginpackage.Discover(root)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	store, err := pluginPackageStateStore()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := store.Reconcile(packages); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return packages, nil
}

// GetPluginPackageStates returns persisted user decisions and runtime health.
func (a *App) GetPluginPackageStates() ([]pluginpackage.PackageState, error) {
	store, err := pluginPackageStateStore()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return store.List()
}

// GetPluginPackageState returns persisted state for one plugin. Unknown plugins
// receive conservative defaults without being persisted until changed/reconciled.
func (a *App) GetPluginPackageState(pluginID string) (pluginpackage.PackageState, error) {
	store, err := pluginPackageStateStore()
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.PackageState{}, err
	}
	return store.Get(pluginID)
}

// UpdatePluginPackageState persists explicit user decisions: enablement, trust,
// granted permissions, and clearing an existing quarantine.
func (a *App) UpdatePluginPackageState(pluginID string, patch pluginpackage.PackageStatePatch) (pluginpackage.PackageState, error) {
	pkg, err := a.findDiscoveredPluginPackage(pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.PackageState{}, err
	}
	if patch.GrantedPermissions != nil {
		if err := pluginpackage.ValidateGrantedPermissions(pkg.Manifest, *patch.GrantedPermissions); err != nil {
			return pluginpackage.PackageState{}, err
		}
	}
	if patch.Trusted != nil && *patch.Trusted {
		version := pkg.Manifest.Version
		patch.TrustedVersion = &version
	}

	store, err := pluginPackageStateStore()
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.PackageState{}, err
	}
	return store.Update(pluginID, patch)
}

func (a *App) findDiscoveredPluginPackage(pluginID string) (pluginpackage.DiscoveredPackage, error) {
	root, err := a.GetPluginDirectory()
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.DiscoveredPackage{}, err
	}
	packages, err := pluginpackage.Discover(root)
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.DiscoveredPackage{}, err
	}
	for _, pkg := range packages {
		if pkg.Manifest.ID != pluginID {
			continue
		}
		if !pkg.Valid {
			return pluginpackage.DiscoveredPackage{}, fmt.Errorf("plugin %s is not a valid discovered package", pluginID)
		}
		return pkg, nil
	}
	return pluginpackage.DiscoveredPackage{}, fmt.Errorf("plugin %s is not installed", pluginID)
}

// QuarantinePluginPackage prevents automatic activation until explicitly cleared.
func (a *App) QuarantinePluginPackage(pluginID, reason string) (pluginpackage.PackageState, error) {
	store, err := pluginPackageStateStore()
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.PackageState{}, err
	}
	return store.Quarantine(pluginID, reason)
}

// RecordPluginActivation records activation health independently from package discovery.
func (a *App) RecordPluginActivation(pluginID string, success bool, activationError string) (pluginpackage.PackageState, error) {
	store, err := pluginPackageStateStore()
	if err != nil {
		return pluginpackage.PackageState{}, err
	}
	return store.RecordActivation(pluginID, success, activationError)
}
````

## File: internal/app/bootstrap.go
````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"sync"

	internalarchive "wails-app/internal/archive"
	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	internalelevation "wails-app/internal/elevation"
	internalfilesystem "wails-app/internal/filesystem"
	internalops "wails-app/internal/ops"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	internalplatform "wails-app/internal/platform"
	internalruntime "wails-app/internal/runtime"
	vfslib "wails-app/vfs"
	vfsarchive "wails-app/vfs/archive"
	vfsmemory "wails-app/vfs/memory"
)

type filesystemElevation interface {
	Client() internalelevation.Client
}

type FilesystemService = internalfilesystem.Service

var rawFilesystemOps = internalfilesystem.NewRawService(internalfilesystem.RawCallbacks{
	Metadata: rawFilesystemMetadataCallbacks(),
	MoveToTrash: func(path string) error {
		return internalplatform.MoveToTrash(path)
	},
})

const memoryAppName = "wails-file-manager"

// bootstrapProviders holds lazily-initialized singletons for the elevated
// helper and normal app paths. Using a struct instead of package-level vars
// makes the dependencies explicit and testable.
type bootstrapProviders struct {
	memoryRootFn func() string

	memoryFSOnce sync.Once
	memoryFS     *vfsmemory.FS
	memoryFSErr  error

	elevatedVFSOnce sync.Once
	elevatedVFS     *vfslib.Unified
	elevatedVFSErr  error
}

func newBootstrapProviders() *bootstrapProviders {
	return &bootstrapProviders{memoryRootFn: vfsmemory.DefaultRootProvider}
}

// defaultProviders is the package-level singleton used by elevated helpers and
// normal app bootstrap.  It is mutable so tests can swap it out.
var defaultProviders = newBootstrapProviders()

func getMemoryFS() (*vfsmemory.FS, error) {
	return defaultProviders.getMemoryFS()
}

func getElevatedVFS() (*vfslib.Unified, error) {
	return defaultProviders.getElevatedVFS()
}

func resolveMemoryAlias(path string) (string, error) {
	return defaultProviders.resolveMemoryAlias(path)
}

func toPublicMemoryPath(path string) string {
	return defaultProviders.toPublicMemoryPath(path)
}

func configureMemoryRootProvider(provider func() string) {
	defaultProviders.configureMemoryRoot(provider)
}

func (p *bootstrapProviders) configureMemoryRoot(provider func() string) {
	if provider == nil {
		p.memoryRootFn = vfsmemory.DefaultRootProvider
		return
	}
	p.memoryRootFn = provider
}

func (p *bootstrapProviders) getMemoryFS() (*vfsmemory.FS, error) {
	p.memoryFSOnce.Do(func() {
		p.memoryFS, p.memoryFSErr = vfsmemory.New(memoryAppName, p.memoryRootFn)
	})
	return p.memoryFS, p.memoryFSErr
}

func (p *bootstrapProviders) getElevatedVFS() (*vfslib.Unified, error) {
	p.elevatedVFSOnce.Do(func() {
		memoryPlugin, err := p.getMemoryFS()
		if err != nil {
			p.elevatedVFSErr = err
			return
		}
		p.elevatedVFS, p.elevatedVFSErr = internalruntime.InitVFS(memoryPlugin)
	})
	return p.elevatedVFS, p.elevatedVFSErr
}

func (p *bootstrapProviders) resolveMemoryAlias(path string) (string, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(normalized)
	if !pathref.IsMemory(normalized) {
		return nativePath, nil
	}
	memoryPlugin, err := p.getMemoryFS()
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	resolved, _, err := memoryPlugin.ResolvePublicPath(nativePath)
	return resolved, err
}

func (p *bootstrapProviders) toPublicMemoryPath(path string) string {
	memoryPlugin, err := p.getMemoryFS()
	if err != nil || memoryPlugin == nil {
		return pathref.FromNativePath(path)
	}
	return pathref.FromNativePath(memoryPlugin.ToPublicPath(path))
}

func mapMemoryListing(listing *contracts.DirectoryListing, requestedPath string) *contracts.DirectoryListing {
	if listing == nil {
		return nil
	}
	listing.Path = pathref.Normalize(requestedPath)
	for index := range listing.Entries {
		listing.Entries[index].Path = toPublicMemoryPath(listing.Entries[index].Path)
	}
	return listing
}

func mapMemoryFile(file *contracts.FileContent, requestedPath string) *contracts.FileContent {
	if file == nil {
		return nil
	}
	file.Path = pathref.Normalize(requestedPath)
	return file
}

func mapMemoryOperation(op *contracts.OperationResult) *contracts.OperationResult {
	if op == nil {
		return nil
	}
	for index := range op.AffectedPaths {
		op.AffectedPaths[index] = toPublicMemoryPath(op.AffectedPaths[index])
	}
	return op
}

var elevatedRawHandler = internalfilesystem.NewElevatedHandler(internalfilesystem.RawOperations{
	ListDirectory: func(path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
		if pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
			vfs, err := getElevatedVFS()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return internalruntime.VFSListDir(context.Background(), vfs, path)
		}
		resolvedPath, err := resolveMemoryAlias(path)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		listing, err := rawFilesystemOps.ListDirectory(resolvedPath, showHidden)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return mapMemoryListing(listing, path), nil
	},
	ReadFile: func(path string, encoding string) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
		if pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
			vfs, err := getElevatedVFS()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return internalruntime.VFSReadFile(context.Background(), vfs, path, encoding)
		}
		resolvedPath, err := resolveMemoryAlias(path)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		file, err := rawFilesystemOps.ReadFile(resolvedPath, encoding)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return mapMemoryFile(file, path), nil
	},
	WriteFile: func(path string, content string, encoding string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
		if pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
			vfs, err := getElevatedVFS()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return internalruntime.VFSWriteFile(context.Background(), vfs, path, content, encoding)
		}
		resolvedPath, err := resolveMemoryAlias(path)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		op, err := rawFilesystemOps.WriteFile(resolvedPath, content, encoding)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return mapMemoryOperation(op), nil
	},
	DeleteFile: func(path string, recursive bool, useTrash *bool) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
		if pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
			vfs, err := getElevatedVFS()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return internalruntime.VFSRemove(context.Background(), vfs, path)
		}
		resolvedPath, err := resolveMemoryAlias(path)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		op, err := rawFilesystemOps.DeleteFile(resolvedPath, recursive, useTrash)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return mapMemoryOperation(op), nil
	},
	CreateDirectory: func(path string, recursive bool) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
		if pathref.IsRegistry(path) {
			vfs, err := getElevatedVFS()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return internalruntime.VFSMkdir(context.Background(), vfs, path)
		}
		resolvedPath, err := resolveMemoryAlias(path)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		op, err := rawFilesystemOps.CreateDirectory(resolvedPath, recursive)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return mapMemoryOperation(op), nil
	},
	MoveFile: func(source, destination string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
		resolvedSource, err := resolveMemoryAlias(source)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		resolvedDestination, err := resolveMemoryAlias(destination)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		op, err := rawFilesystemOps.MoveFile(resolvedSource, resolvedDestination)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return mapMemoryOperation(op), nil
	},
	CopyFile: func(source, destination string, recursive bool) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
		resolvedSource, err := resolveMemoryAlias(source)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		resolvedDestination, err := resolveMemoryAlias(destination)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		op, err := rawFilesystemOps.CopyFile(resolvedSource, resolvedDestination, recursive)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return mapMemoryOperation(op), nil
	},
})

func MaybeRunElevatedService(args []string) (bool, error) {
	return internalelevation.MaybeRunService(args, elevatedRawHandler)
}

func MaybeRunElevatedHelper(args []string) (bool, error) {
	return internalelevation.MaybeRunHelper(args, elevatedRawHandler)
}

func rawFilesystemMetadataCallbacks() internalfilesystem.MetadataCallbacks {
	return internalfilesystem.MetadataCallbacks{
		ToSlash:                      internalplatform.ToSlash,
		IsHiddenFile:                 internalplatform.CheckHidden,
		IsArchive:                    vfsarchive.IsArchiveExt,
		SymlinkPointsToDir:           internalplatform.SymlinkPointsToDir,
		IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction: internalplatform.IsUntrackedDirectoryJunction,
		GetCreatedTime:               internalplatform.GetCreatedTime,
		GetAccessedTime:              internalplatform.GetAccessedTime,
		FormatPermissions:            formatPermissions,
	}
}

func formatPermissions(info os.FileInfo) string {
	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
		if info.Mode()&0200 != 0 {
			return "rw-"
		}
		return "r--"
	}
	return info.Mode().Perm().String()
}

func newFilesystemService(
	elevation filesystemElevation,
	emitEvent func(string, interface{}),
	startElevatedSession func() (*internalelevation.SessionStatus, error),
) *FilesystemService {
	memoryPlugin, _ := getMemoryFS()
	return internalfilesystem.NewService(internalfilesystem.ServiceConfig{
		Elevation:                      elevation,
		EmitEvent:                      emitEvent,
		StartElevatedSession:           startElevatedSession,
		Raw:                            rawFilesystemOps,
		Metadata:                       rawFilesystemMetadataCallbacks(),
		IsProcessElevated:              internalelevation.IsProcessElevated,
		ExecuteElevatedRequest:         executeElevatedRequest,
		RunElevatedRequest:             runElevatedRequest,
		IsPermissionDenied:             internalelevation.IsPermissionDenied,
		ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation: internalelevation.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation,
		MemoryResolver:                 memoryPlugin,
	})
}

func executeElevatedRequest(req internalelevation.Request) internalelevation.Response {
	return elevatedRawHandler(req)
}

func runElevatedRequest(req internalelevation.Request) (internalelevation.Response, error) {
	return internalelevation.RunRequest(req, os.Executable, internalelevation.LaunchProcess)
}

func startElevatedClient(exePath string) (internalelevation.Client, error) {
	return internalelevation.StartClient(exePath, internalelevation.LaunchService)
}

func newBuildConfig(app *App) BuildConfig {
	return BuildConfig{
		SetContext:     func(ctx context.Context) { app.Ctx = ctx },
		InitVFS:        app.InitVFS,
		HandleFileDrop: app.HandleFileDrop,
		BuildFileInfo: func(name, fullPath string, info os.FileInfo, hidden bool) contracts.FileInfo {
			return internalfilesystem.BuildFileInfoWithHidden(rawFilesystemMetadataCallbacks(), name, fullPath, info, hidden)
		},
		IsHidden: func(name, path string) bool {
			return internalplatform.CheckHidden(name, path)
		},
		ClassifyError:                  contracts.ClassifyError,
		IsPermissionDenied:             internalelevation.IsPermissionDenied,
		ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation: internalelevation.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation,
		CalculateSize:                  internalops.CalculateSize,
		Normalize:                      internalplatform.Normalize,
		ArchiveEntryPath:               internalarchive.ArchiveEntryPath,
		IsArchive:                      vfsarchive.IsArchiveExt,
	}
}

func BuildApp() *App {
	core, err := NewCore()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("Warning: could not initialize workspace manager: %v\n", err)
	}

	configureMemoryRootProvider(func() string {
		if root := vfsmemory.DefaultRootProvider(); root != "" {
			return root
		}
		if core != nil && core.WorkspaceManager != nil {
			return strings.TrimSpace(core.WorkspaceManager.GetPreferences().MemoryRoot)
		}
		return ""
	})

	app := NewApp(internalelevation.IsProcessElevated)
	elevation := internalelevation.NewService(app.EmitEvent, startElevatedClient)
	filesystem := newFilesystemService(elevation, app.EmitEvent, app.StartElevatedSession)
	app.bindState(BuildState(core, filesystem, elevation, newBuildConfig(app)))
	return app
}
````

## File: internal/app/remote_oauth.go
````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

const (
	remoteOAuthStatusPending   = "pending"
	remoteOAuthStatusComplete  = "complete"
	remoteOAuthStatusFailed    = "failed"
	remoteOAuthStatusCancelled = "cancelled"
)

type remoteOAuthSession struct {
	id           string
	protocol     contracts.RemoteProtocol
	clientID     string
	tenant       string
	redirectURI  string
	state        string
	codeVerifier string
	scopes       []string

	mu           sync.Mutex
	status       string
	err          string
	accountName  string
	accountEmail string
	accessToken  string
	refreshToken string
	expiry       time.Time
	refCount     int

	server *http.Server
}

type remoteOAuthProviderConfig struct {
	authURL       string
	tokenURL      string
	defaultScopes []string
}

type remoteOAuthTokenResponse struct {
	AccessToken  string `json:"access_token"`
	RefreshToken string `json:"refresh_token"`
	ExpiresIn    int64  `json:"expires_in"`
	TokenType    string `json:"token_type"`
	Scope        string `json:"scope"`
	Error        string `json:"error"`
	Description  string `json:"error_description"`
}

func (s *State) RemoteOAuthBegin(req contracts.RemoteOAuthBeginRequest) (*contracts.RemoteOAuthBeginResponse, error) {
	protocol := req.Protocol
	if !isRemoteOAuthProtocol(protocol) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth is not supported for protocol: %s", protocol)
	}

	clientID := strings.TrimSpace(req.ClientID)
	if clientID == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("client ID is required")
	}

	sessionID, err := randomToken(24)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth: generate session id: %w", err)
	}
	stateToken, err := randomToken(24)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth: generate state: %w", err)
	}
	codeVerifier, err := randomToken(48)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth: generate verifier: %w", err)
	}

	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth: start callback listener: %w", err)
	}

	redirectURI := fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d", listener.Addr().(*net.TCPAddr).Port)
	session := &remoteOAuthSession{
		id:           sessionID,
		protocol:     protocol,
		clientID:     clientID,
		tenant:       normalizeRemoteOAuthTenant(protocol, req.Tenant),
		redirectURI:  redirectURI,
		state:        stateToken,
		codeVerifier: codeVerifier,
		scopes:       normalizeRemoteOAuthScopes(protocol, req.Scopes),
		status:       remoteOAuthStatusPending,
	}

	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	callbackHandler := func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		s.handleRemoteOAuthCallback(session, w, r)
	}
	mux.HandleFunc("/", callbackHandler)
	mux.HandleFunc("/oauth/callback", callbackHandler)
	session.server = &http.Server{
		Handler:           mux,
		ReadHeaderTimeout: 15 * time.Second,
	}

	s.remoteOAuthMu.Lock()
	if existing := s.remoteOAuth[sessionID]; existing != nil {
		s.remoteOAuthMu.Unlock()
		listener.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth: duplicate session id")
	}
	s.remoteOAuth[sessionID] = session
	s.remoteOAuthMu.Unlock()

	go func() {
		if err := session.server.Serve(listener); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
			session.setFailure(fmt.Sprintf("callback listener failed: %v", err))
		}
	}()

	authURL, err := buildRemoteOAuthAuthURL(session)
	if err != nil {
		_ = session.shutdownCallbackServer(context.Background())
		s.remoteOAuthMu.Lock()
		delete(s.remoteOAuth, sessionID)
		s.remoteOAuthMu.Unlock()
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.RemoteOAuthBeginResponse{
		SessionID:   session.id,
		Protocol:    session.protocol,
		AuthURL:     authURL,
		RedirectURI: session.redirectURI,
	}, nil
}

func (s *State) RemoteOAuthStatus(sessionID string) (*contracts.RemoteOAuthStatus, error) {
	session := s.getRemoteOAuthSession(sessionID)
	if session == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth session not found")
	}
	return session.snapshot(), nil
}

func (s *State) RemoteOAuthCancel(sessionID string) error {
	session := s.getRemoteOAuthSession(sessionID)
	if session == nil {
		return nil
	}

	session.mu.Lock()
	if session.status == remoteOAuthStatusPending {
		session.status = remoteOAuthStatusCancelled
	}
	session.mu.Unlock()

	if session.mountRefs() == 0 {
		s.remoteOAuthMu.Lock()
		delete(s.remoteOAuth, sessionID)
		s.remoteOAuthMu.Unlock()
	}
	return session.shutdownCallbackServer(context.Background())
}

func (s *State) RemoteConnectOAuth(req contracts.RemoteOAuthConnectRequest) (*contracts.RemoteMount, error) {
	session := s.getRemoteOAuthSession(req.SessionID)
	if session == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth session not found")
	}
	status := session.snapshot()
	if status.Status != remoteOAuthStatusComplete {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth session is not ready")
	}

	mountName := strings.TrimSpace(req.Name)
	if mountName == "" {
		switch session.protocol {
		case contracts.ProtocolGDrive:
			mountName = "Google Drive"
		case contracts.ProtocolDropbox:
			mountName = "Dropbox"
		case contracts.ProtocolOneDrive:
			mountName = "OneDrive"
		}
	}

	mount, err := s.remoteConnect(contracts.RemoteConfig{
		Protocol: session.protocol,
		Name:     mountName,
	}, session)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	s.remoteOAuthMu.Lock()
	if current := s.remoteOAuth[session.id]; current != nil {
		current.mu.Lock()
		current.refCount++
		current.mu.Unlock()
		s.remoteOAuthRefs[mount.MountPoint] = session.id
	}
	s.remoteOAuthMu.Unlock()

	return mount, nil
}

func (s *State) handleRemoteOAuthCallback(session *remoteOAuthSession, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	query := r.URL.Query()
	if !strings.EqualFold(query.Get("state"), session.state) {
		session.setFailure("state mismatch")
		writeRemoteOAuthHTML(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Authentication failed", "The OAuth state token did not match. Close this page and try again.")
		_ = session.shutdownCallbackServer(context.Background())
		return
	}

	if authErr := strings.TrimSpace(query.Get("error")); authErr != "" {
		description := strings.TrimSpace(query.Get("error_description"))
		if description != "" {
			session.setFailure(description)
		} else {
			session.setFailure(authErr)
		}
		writeRemoteOAuthHTML(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Authentication failed", session.errString())
		_ = session.shutdownCallbackServer(context.Background())
		return
	}

	code := strings.TrimSpace(query.Get("code"))
	if code == "" {
		session.setFailure("authorization code was not returned")
		writeRemoteOAuthHTML(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Authentication failed", "No authorization code was returned by the provider.")
		_ = session.shutdownCallbackServer(context.Background())
		return
	}

	if err := session.exchangeCode(r.Context(), code); err != nil {
		session.setFailure(err.Error())
		writeRemoteOAuthHTML(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Authentication failed", session.errString())
		_ = session.shutdownCallbackServer(context.Background())
		return
	}

	_ = session.loadAccountProfile(r.Context())
	writeRemoteOAuthHTML(w, http.StatusOK, "Authentication complete", "You can close this tab and return to the app.")
	_ = session.shutdownCallbackServer(context.Background())
}

func (s *State) getRemoteOAuthSession(sessionID string) *remoteOAuthSession {
	s.remoteOAuthMu.Lock()
	defer s.remoteOAuthMu.Unlock()
	return s.remoteOAuth[strings.TrimSpace(sessionID)]
}

func (s *State) releaseRemoteOAuthMount(mountPoint string) {
	s.remoteOAuthMu.Lock()
	sessionID := s.remoteOAuthRefs[mountPoint]
	if sessionID != "" {
		delete(s.remoteOAuthRefs, mountPoint)
	}
	session := s.remoteOAuth[sessionID]
	if session != nil {
		session.mu.Lock()
		if session.refCount > 0 {
			session.refCount--
		}
		refs := session.refCount
		status := session.status
		session.mu.Unlock()
		if refs == 0 && status != remoteOAuthStatusPending {
			delete(s.remoteOAuth, sessionID)
		}
	}
	s.remoteOAuthMu.Unlock()
}

func (s *State) shutdownRemoteOAuthSessions() {
	s.remoteOAuthMu.Lock()
	sessions := make([]*remoteOAuthSession, 0, len(s.remoteOAuth))
	for id, session := range s.remoteOAuth {
		delete(s.remoteOAuth, id)
		sessions = append(sessions, session)
	}
	clear(s.remoteOAuthRefs)
	s.remoteOAuthMu.Unlock()

	for _, session := range sessions {
		_ = session.shutdownCallbackServer(context.Background())
	}
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) snapshot() *contracts.RemoteOAuthStatus {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	status := &contracts.RemoteOAuthStatus{
		SessionID:    s.id,
		Protocol:     s.protocol,
		Status:       s.status,
		Error:        s.err,
		AccountName:  s.accountName,
		AccountEmail: s.accountEmail,
	}
	if !s.expiry.IsZero() {
		status.ExpiresAt = s.expiry.Unix()
	}
	return status
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) setFailure(message string) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if s.status == remoteOAuthStatusComplete {
		return
	}
	s.status = remoteOAuthStatusFailed
	s.err = strings.TrimSpace(message)
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) errString() string {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if strings.TrimSpace(s.err) == "" {
		return "Authentication failed."
	}
	return s.err
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) shutdownCallbackServer(ctx context.Context) error {
	if s.server == nil {
		return nil
	}
	shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	return s.server.Shutdown(shutdownCtx)
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) mountRefs() int {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.refCount
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) AccessToken(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	if strings.TrimSpace(s.accessToken) == "" {
		err := s.err
		s.mu.Unlock()
		if err == "" {
			err = "oauth access token is not available"
		}
		return "", fmt.Errorf("%s", err)
	}
	if s.refreshToken == "" || time.Until(s.expiry) > 90*time.Second {
		token := s.accessToken
		s.mu.Unlock()
		return token, nil
	}
	s.mu.Unlock()

	if err := s.refresh(ctx); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if strings.TrimSpace(s.accessToken) == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("oauth access token is not available")
	}
	return s.accessToken, nil
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) exchangeCode(ctx context.Context, code string) error {
	token, err := s.exchange(ctx, url.Values{
		"grant_type":    {"authorization_code"},
		"code":          {code},
		"client_id":     {s.clientID},
		"redirect_uri":  {s.redirectURI},
		"code_verifier": {s.codeVerifier},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.status = remoteOAuthStatusComplete
	s.err = ""
	s.accessToken = token.AccessToken
	if token.RefreshToken != "" {
		s.refreshToken = token.RefreshToken
	}
	s.expiry = time.Now().Add(time.Duration(token.ExpiresIn) * time.Second)
	return nil
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) refresh(ctx context.Context) error {
	s.mu.Lock()
	refreshToken := s.refreshToken
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if strings.TrimSpace(refreshToken) == "" {
		return nil
	}

	token, err := s.exchange(ctx, url.Values{
		"grant_type":    {"refresh_token"},
		"refresh_token": {refreshToken},
		"client_id":     {s.clientID},
		"scope":         {strings.Join(s.scopes, " ")},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.accessToken = token.AccessToken
	if token.RefreshToken != "" {
		s.refreshToken = token.RefreshToken
	}
	if token.ExpiresIn > 0 {
		s.expiry = time.Now().Add(time.Duration(token.ExpiresIn) * time.Second)
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) exchange(ctx context.Context, values url.Values) (*remoteOAuthTokenResponse, error) {
	config := remoteOAuthProvider(s.protocol, s.tenant)
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, config.tokenURL, strings.NewReader(values.Encode()))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded")

	response, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()

	var token remoteOAuthTokenResponse
	if err := json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(&token); err != nil {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 2048))
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("oauth token response decode failed: %v %s", err, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}

	if response.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		message := strings.TrimSpace(token.Description)
		if message == "" {
			message = strings.TrimSpace(token.Error)
		}
		if message == "" {
			message = fmt.Sprintf("token exchange failed with HTTP %d", response.StatusCode)
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s", message)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(token.AccessToken) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provider did not return an access token")
	}
	return &token, nil
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) loadAccountProfile(ctx context.Context) error {
	type profile struct {
		Name  string
		Email string
	}

	result := profile{}
	switch s.protocol {
	case contracts.ProtocolGDrive:
		var response struct {
			User struct {
				DisplayName  string `json:"displayName"`
				EmailAddress string `json:"emailAddress"`
			} `json:"user"`
		}
		if err := s.getJSON(ctx, "https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/about?fields=user(displayName,emailAddress)", &response); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		result.Name = response.User.DisplayName
		result.Email = response.User.EmailAddress
	case contracts.ProtocolDropbox:
		var response struct {
			Name struct {
				DisplayName string `json:"display_name"`
			} `json:"name"`
			Email string `json:"email"`
		}
		if err := s.postJSON(ctx, "https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/users/get_current_account", "null", &response); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		result.Name = response.Name.DisplayName
		result.Email = response.Email
	case contracts.ProtocolOneDrive:
		var response struct {
			DisplayName       string `json:"displayName"`
			UserPrincipalName string `json:"userPrincipalName"`
			Mail              string `json:"mail"`
		}
		if err := s.getJSON(ctx, "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me?$select=displayName,userPrincipalName,mail", &response); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		result.Name = response.DisplayName
		result.Email = strings.TrimSpace(response.Mail)
		if result.Email == "" {
			result.Email = response.UserPrincipalName
		}
	}

	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if strings.TrimSpace(result.Name) != "" {
		s.accountName = result.Name
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(result.Email) != "" {
		s.accountEmail = result.Email
	}
	return nil
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) getJSON(ctx context.Context, endpoint string, target any) error {
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	token, err := s.AccessToken(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)

	response, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	if response.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 2048))
		return fmt.Errorf("profile request failed: HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}
	return json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(target)
}

func (s *remoteOAuthSession) postJSON(ctx context.Context, endpoint string, body string, target any) error {
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, strings.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	token, err := s.AccessToken(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	response, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	if response.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 2048))
		return fmt.Errorf("profile request failed: HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}
	return json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(target)
}

func buildRemoteOAuthAuthURL(session *remoteOAuthSession) (string, error) {
	config := remoteOAuthProvider(session.protocol, session.tenant)
	values := url.Values{
		"client_id":             {session.clientID},
		"redirect_uri":          {session.redirectURI},
		"response_type":         {"code"},
		"state":                 {session.state},
		"code_challenge":        {pkceChallenge(session.codeVerifier)},
		"code_challenge_method": {"S256"},
	}

	scope := strings.Join(session.scopes, " ")
	if scope != "" {
		values.Set("scope", scope)
	}

	switch session.protocol {
	case contracts.ProtocolGDrive:
		values.Set("access_type", "offline")
		values.Set("include_granted_scopes", "true")
		values.Set("prompt", "consent")
	case contracts.ProtocolDropbox:
		values.Set("token_access_type", "offline")
	case contracts.ProtocolOneDrive:
		values.Set("response_mode", "query")
	}

	authURL, err := url.Parse(config.authURL)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	authURL.RawQuery = values.Encode()
	return authURL.String(), nil
}

func remoteOAuthProvider(protocol contracts.RemoteProtocol, tenant string) remoteOAuthProviderConfig {
	switch protocol {
	case contracts.ProtocolGDrive:
		return remoteOAuthProviderConfig{
			authURL:       "https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth",
			tokenURL:      "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
			defaultScopes: []string{"https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly"},
		}
	case contracts.ProtocolDropbox:
		return remoteOAuthProviderConfig{
			authURL:       "https://www.dropbox.com/oauth2/authorize",
			tokenURL:      "https://api.dropboxapi.com/oauth2/token",
			defaultScopes: []string{"files.metadata.read", "files.content.read"},
		}
	case contracts.ProtocolOneDrive:
		base := "https://login.microsoftonline.com/" + normalizeRemoteOAuthTenant(protocol, tenant) + "/oauth2/v2.0"
		return remoteOAuthProviderConfig{
			authURL:       base + "/authorize",
			tokenURL:      base + "/token",
			defaultScopes: []string{"offline_access", "openid", "profile", "Files.Read"},
		}
	default:
		return remoteOAuthProviderConfig{}
	}
}

func normalizeRemoteOAuthScopes(protocol contracts.RemoteProtocol, scopes []string) []string {
	if len(scopes) == 0 {
		return append([]string(nil), remoteOAuthProvider(protocol, "").defaultScopes...)
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(scopes))
	for _, scope := range scopes {
		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(scope)
		if trimmed != "" {
			result = append(result, trimmed)
		}
	}
	if len(result) == 0 {
		return append([]string(nil), remoteOAuthProvider(protocol, "").defaultScopes...)
	}
	return result
}

func normalizeRemoteOAuthTenant(protocol contracts.RemoteProtocol, tenant string) string {
	if protocol != contracts.ProtocolOneDrive {
		return ""
	}
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(tenant)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return "common"
	}
	return trimmed
}

func isRemoteOAuthProtocol(protocol contracts.RemoteProtocol) bool {
	return protocol == contracts.ProtocolGDrive ||
		protocol == contracts.ProtocolDropbox ||
		protocol == contracts.ProtocolOneDrive
}

func randomToken(length int) (string, error) {
	buf := make([]byte, length)
	if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(buf), nil
}

func pkceChallenge(verifier string) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(verifier))
	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func writeRemoteOAuthHTML(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, title string, message string) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_, _ = io.WriteString(w, "<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><title>"+htmlEscape(title)+"</title><style>body{font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;background:#10161f;color:#f3f6fb;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:100vh;margin:0;padding:24px}main{max-width:560px;background:#182130;border:1px solid #2c394b;border-radius:14px;padding:24px;box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}h1{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:22px}p{margin:0;color:#d1d9e6;line-height:1.5}</style></head><body><main><h1>"+htmlEscape(title)+"</h1><p>"+htmlEscape(message)+"</p></main></body></html>")
}

func htmlEscape(value string) string {
	replacer := strings.NewReplacer(
		"&", "&amp;",
		"<", "&lt;",
		">", "&gt;",
		"\"", "&quot;",
		"'", "&#39;",
	)
	return replacer.Replace(value)
}
````

````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive/cache"
)

type VideoPlaybackMode string

const (
	VideoPlaybackModeDirect    VideoPlaybackMode = "direct"
	VideoPlaybackModeSegmented VideoPlaybackMode = "segmented"
	VideoPlaybackModeRemux     VideoPlaybackMode = "remux"
	VideoPlaybackModeTranscode VideoPlaybackMode = "transcode"
)

type VideoPlaybackPlan struct {
	Mode            VideoPlaybackMode `json:"mode"`
	Format          string            `json:"format"`
	VideoCodec      string            `json:"videoCodec,omitempty"`
	AudioCodec      string            `json:"audioCodec,omitempty"`
	DurationSeconds float64           `json:"durationSeconds"`
	ZeroDelay       bool              `json:"zeroDelay"`
	Seekable        bool              `json:"seekable"`
	UseNativePlayer bool              `json:"useNativePlayer"`
	URL             string            `json:"url"`
}

var directPreviewExtensions = map[string]bool{
	".mp4":  true,
	".m4v":  true,
	".mkv":  true,
	".webm": true,
	".ogv":  true,
	".mxf":  true,
}

var remuxableVideoCodecs = map[string]bool{
	"h264": true,
	"hevc": true,
	"h265": true,
	"av1":  true,
}

var remuxableAudioCodecs = map[string]bool{
	"":    true,
	"aac": true,
}

var transcodePreferredVideoCodecs = map[string]bool{
	"mpeg2video": true,
	"vc1":        true,
	"mjpeg":      true,
	"mpeg4":      true,
	"msmpeg4v3":  true,
	"wmv3":       true,
	"vp6":        true,
	"vp6f":       true,
}

func (a *App) GetVideoPlaybackPlan(publicPath string) VideoPlaybackPlan {
	return buildDiskVideoPlaybackPlan(a.StreamBaseURL(), publicPath)
}

func (a *App) GetArchiveVideoPlaybackPlan(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string) VideoPlaybackPlan {
	return buildArchiveVideoPlaybackPlan(a.StreamBaseURL(), a.ArchCache(), fsPath, nestedChain, entryPath)
}

func buildDiskVideoPlaybackPlan(baseURL, publicPath string) VideoPlaybackPlan {
	if pathref.IsWeb(pathref.Normalize(publicPath)) {
		return VideoPlaybackPlan{
			Mode:            VideoPlaybackModeDirect,
			Format:          strings.TrimPrefix(strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(publicPath)), "."),
			Seekable:        true,
			UseNativePlayer: false,
			URL:             StreamURLForFile(baseURL, publicPath),
		}
	}

	probe, _ := probeVideo(pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(publicPath)))
	format := strings.TrimPrefix(strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(publicPath)), ".")
	var videoCodec, audioCodec string
	var durationSeconds float64
	if probe != nil {
		format = firstNonEmpty(format, primaryFormatName(probe.Format.FormatName))
		videoCodec, audioCodec = extractProbeCodecs(probe)
		durationSeconds = resolveVideoDurationSeconds(context.Background(), pathref.ToNativePath(pathref.Normalize(publicPath)), probe)
	}

	return VideoPlaybackPlan{
		Mode:            VideoPlaybackModeDirect,
		Format:          format,
		VideoCodec:      videoCodec,
		AudioCodec:      audioCodec,
		DurationSeconds: durationSeconds,
		Seekable:        true,
		UseNativePlayer: false,
		URL:             StreamURLForFile(baseURL, publicPath),
	}
}

func buildArchiveVideoPlaybackPlan(baseURL string, archCache *cache.Cache, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string) VideoPlaybackPlan {
	_ = archCache

	return VideoPlaybackPlan{
		Mode:            VideoPlaybackModeDirect,
		Format:          strings.TrimPrefix(strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(entryPath)), "."),
		Seekable:        false,
		UseNativePlayer: false,
		URL:             StreamURLForEntry(baseURL, fsPath, nestedChain, entryPath),
	}
}

func decidePlaybackMode(name, videoCodec, audioCodec string) VideoPlaybackMode {
	ext := strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(name))
	if directPreviewExtensions[ext] && supportsDirectVideoCodec(videoCodec) {
		return VideoPlaybackModeDirect
	}
	if remuxableVideoCodecs[strings.ToLower(videoCodec)] && remuxableAudioCodecs[strings.ToLower(audioCodec)] {
		switch ext {
		case ".mov", ".qt", ".flv", ".ts", ".mts", ".m2ts":
			return VideoPlaybackModeRemux
		}
	}
	if transcodePreferredVideoCodecs[strings.ToLower(videoCodec)] {
		return VideoPlaybackModeTranscode
	}
	if shouldTranscodeVideoPreview(name) {
		return VideoPlaybackModeTranscode
	}
	return VideoPlaybackModeDirect
}

func decideDiskPlaybackMode(name, videoCodec, audioCodec string) VideoPlaybackMode {
	vc := strings.ToLower(videoCodec)
	ac := strings.ToLower(audioCodec)
	if remuxableVideoCodecs[vc] && remuxableAudioCodecs[ac] {
		return VideoPlaybackModeRemux
	}
	if transcodePreferredVideoCodecs[vc] || shouldTranscodeVideoPreview(name) {
		return VideoPlaybackModeTranscode
	}
	return VideoPlaybackModeRemux
}

func shouldAttemptSegmentedDiskPlayback(name, videoCodec, audioCodec string) bool {
	switch strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(name)) {
	case ".mp4", ".m4v", ".mkv", ".webm", ".mov", ".qt",
		".avi", ".divx", ".xvid",
		".flv", ".ts", ".mts", ".m2ts",
		".mpg", ".mpeg", ".vob", ".m2v", ".m2p",
		".wmv", ".asf", ".ogv", ".mxf",
		".mjpeg", ".mjpg":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func supportsDirectVideoCodec(videoCodec string) bool {
	return !transcodePreferredVideoCodecs[strings.ToLower(videoCodec)]
}

func supportsSegmentedVideoCodec(videoCodec string) bool {
	return supportsDirectVideoCodec(videoCodec)
}

func shouldPreferDirectDiskPlayback(name, videoCodec string) bool {
	if !supportsDirectVideoCodec(videoCodec) {
		return false
	}

	switch strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(name)) {
	case ".mp4", ".m4v":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func shouldTranscodeVideoPreview(name string) bool {
	switch strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(name)) {
	case ".avi", ".divx", ".xvid", ".flv", ".mov", ".qt", ".mpg", ".mpeg", ".vob", ".m2v", ".m2p", ".ts", ".mts", ".m2ts", ".mjpeg", ".mjpg":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
````

## File: internal/archive/extract_path_test.go
````go
package archive

import (
	"archive/zip"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	vfsarchive "wails-app/vfs/archive"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive/cache"
)

// makeTestZip creates a zip file with a single entry returning the native path.
func makeTestZip(t *testing.T, dir string, name string, entryName string, content string) string {
	t.Helper()
	zipPath := filepath.Join(dir, name)
	f, err := os.Create(zipPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create zip: %v", err)
	}
	w := zip.NewWriter(f)
	fw, err := w.Create(entryName)
	if err != nil {
		f.Close()
		t.Fatalf("zip.Create entry: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := fw.Write([]byte(content)); err != nil {
		f.Close()
		t.Fatalf("zip.Write: %v", err)
	}
	if err := w.Close(); err != nil {
		f.Close()
		t.Fatalf("zip.Close: %v", err)
	}
	f.Close()
	return zipPath
}

func newNoopOperation() Operation {
	return &noopOp{}
}

type noopOp struct{}

func (n *noopOp) ID() string                                 { return "test-op" }
func (n *noopOp) Complete()                                  {}
func (n *noopOp) SetError(error)                             {}
func (n *noopOp) SetTotal(int64, int64)                      {}
func (n *noopOp) UpdateProgress(int64, int64, string, int64) {}
func (n *noopOp) IsCancelled() bool                          { return false }

func newTestService() *Service {
	// ExtractEntries/ExtractNestedArchive don't use the cache; provide a no-op opener.
	c := cache.New(func(_ context.Context, fsPath string, nestedChain []string, password string) (vfsarchive.Archive, error) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("cache not used in these tests")
	})
	return NewService(c, func(_ contracts.OperationType, _, _, _ string) Operation {
		return newNoopOperation()
	})
}

// TestExtractEntriesAcceptsPublicFsPath verifies that CopyEntries correctly
// converts a filesystem:// scheme path to a native OS path before accessing
// the archive on disk.
func TestExtractEntriesAcceptsPublicFsPath(t *testing.T) {
	tmp := t.TempDir()
	const entryName = "hello.txt"
	const content = "hello from archive"
	nativeZip := makeTestZip(t, tmp, "test.zip", entryName, content)

	// Build a public filesystem:// path as the frontend would send
	publicZipPath := pathref.FromNativePath(nativeZip)

	destDir := filepath.Join(tmp, "output")
	publicDestDir := pathref.FromNativePath(destDir)

	svc := newTestService()
	req := contracts.ArchiveEntriesRequest{
		FsPath:         publicZipPath,
		NestedChain:    nil,
		Entries:        []string{entryName},
		StripPrefix:    "",
		DestinationDir: publicDestDir,
	}

	succeeded, failed, errs, fatalErr := svc.ExtractEntries(req, newNoopOperation())
	if fatalErr != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ExtractEntries fatal error: %v", fatalErr)
	}
	if len(errs) > 0 {
		t.Fatalf("ExtractEntries errors: %v", errs)
	}
	if failed != 0 || succeeded != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected result: succeeded=%d failed=%d", succeeded, failed)
	}

	extractedPath := filepath.Join(destDir, entryName)
	data, err := os.ReadFile(extractedPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read extracted file: %v", err)
	}
	if string(data) != content {
		t.Fatalf("content mismatch: want %q got %q", content, string(data))
	}
}

// TestCopyEntriesAcceptsPublicFsPath verifies the full CopyEntries path with
// public filesystem:// paths, matching what the frontend sends to ArchiveCopyEntries.
func TestCopyEntriesAcceptsPublicFsPath(t *testing.T) {
	tmp := t.TempDir()
	const entryName = "doc/readme.txt"
	const content = "copy entries test"
	nativeZip := makeTestZip(t, tmp, "archive.zip", entryName, content)

	publicZipPath := pathref.FromNativePath(nativeZip)
	destDir := filepath.Join(tmp, "dest")
	publicDestDir := pathref.FromNativePath(destDir)

	svc := newTestService()
	req := contracts.ArchiveEntriesRequest{
		FsPath:         publicZipPath,
		Entries:        []string{entryName},
		DestinationDir: publicDestDir,
	}

	result, err := svc.CopyEntries(req)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("CopyEntries error: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Failed != 0 || result.Succeeded != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected result: %+v", result)
	}

	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(destDir, filepath.FromSlash(entryName)))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read extracted file: %v", err)
	}
	if string(data) != content {
		t.Fatalf("content mismatch: want %q got %q", content, string(data))
	}
}

// TestExtractNestedArchiveAcceptsPublicFsPath verifies that ExtractNestedArchive
// converts the filesystem:// path before opening the outer archive.
func TestExtractNestedArchiveAcceptsPublicFsPath(t *testing.T) {
	tmp := t.TempDir()
	const innerEntry = "inner.txt"
	const content = "nested content"

	// Create inner zip (bytes)
	innerZipPath := makeTestZip(t, tmp, "inner.zip", innerEntry, content)
	innerZipBytes, err := os.ReadFile(innerZipPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read inner zip: %v", err)
	}

	// Create outer zip containing inner.zip
	outerZipPath := filepath.Join(tmp, "outer.zip")
	f, err := os.Create(outerZipPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("create outer zip: %v", err)
	}
	w := zip.NewWriter(f)
	fw, err := w.Create("inner.zip")
	if err != nil {
		f.Close()
		t.Fatalf("create inner.zip in outer: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := fw.Write(innerZipBytes); err != nil {
		f.Close()
		t.Fatalf("write inner.zip data: %v", err)
	}
	w.Close()
	f.Close()

	publicOuterPath := pathref.FromNativePath(outerZipPath)

	svc := newTestService()
	data, err := svc.ExtractNestedArchive(publicOuterPath, []string{"inner.zip"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ExtractNestedArchive error: %v", err)
	}
	if len(data) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("ExtractNestedArchive returned empty data")
	}
	// Verify the returned bytes are a valid zip containing innerEntry
	r, err := zip.NewReader(readerAt(data), int64(len(data)))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse returned data as zip: %v", err)
	}
	if len(r.File) == 0 || r.File[0].Name != innerEntry {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected inner zip contents: %v", r.File)
	}
}

// readerAt wraps a byte slice to implement io.ReaderAt.
type byteReaderAt []byte

func readerAt(b []byte) byteReaderAt { return byteReaderAt(b) }

func (b byteReaderAt) ReadAt(p []byte, off int64) (int, error) {
	if off >= int64(len(b)) {
		return 0, nil
	}
	n := copy(p, b[off:])
	return n, nil
}
````

````go
package archive

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"wails-app/internal/contentprobe"
	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	vfslib "wails-app/vfs"
	vfsarchive "wails-app/vfs/archive"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive/cache"
)

// Service owns the archive-facing orchestration boundary while delegating
// concrete archive work to injected application closures.
type Service struct {
	archCache      *cache.Cache
	startOperation func(opType contracts.OperationType, title, source, dest string) Operation
	streamsMu      sync.RWMutex
	streamsCancel  map[string]context.CancelFunc
}

type Operation interface {
	ID() string
	Complete()
	SetError(error)
	SetTotal(totalItems, totalBytes int64)
	UpdateProgress(processedItems, processedBytes int64, currentFile string, currentFileSize int64)
	IsCancelled() bool
}

func NewService(
	archCache *cache.Cache,
	startOperation func(opType contracts.OperationType, title, source, dest string) Operation,
) *Service {
	return &Service{
		archCache:      archCache,
		startOperation: startOperation,
		streamsCancel:  make(map[string]context.CancelFunc),
	}
}

func (s *Service) Browse(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, innerPath string) (contracts.ArchiveListing, error) {
	ctx := context.Background()

	// Convert filesystem:// scheme paths to native OS paths
	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)

	arch, err := s.archCache.Get(ctx, nativePath, nestedChain, "")
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.ArchiveListing{}, fmt.Errorf("vfs: open %q: %w", nativePath, err)
	}

	vfsEntries, err := arch.ReadDir(ctx, normalizePath(innerPath))
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.ArchiveListing{}, fmt.Errorf("vfs: readdir %q in %q: %w", innerPath, fsPath, err)
	}

	entries := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(vfsEntries))
	for _, entry := range vfsEntries {
		entries = append(entries, vfsEntryToFileInfo(entry, nestedChain))
	}

	return contracts.ArchiveListing{
		ArchivePath: fsPath,
		InnerPath:   innerPath,
		NestedChain: nestedChain,
		Entries:     entries,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Service) ReadFile(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string, encoding string) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	entryPath = normalizePath(entryPath)

	ctx := context.Background()
	// Convert filesystem:// scheme paths to native OS paths
	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)

	arch, err := s.archCache.Get(ctx, nativePath, nestedChain, "")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive read: open %q: %w", nativePath, err)
	}

	f, err := arch.Open(ctx, entryPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive read: open entry %q: %w", entryPath, err)
	}
	defer f.Close()

	data, err := io.ReadAll(f)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	probe := contentprobe.ProbeBytes(data)
	if encoding == "" {
		encoding = "utf8"
		if probe.IsText && probe.Encoding != "" {
			encoding = probe.Encoding
		}
	}

	content, err := contentprobe.Decode(data, encoding)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.FileContent{
		Path:     entryPath,
		Content:  content,
		Encoding: encoding,
		Size:     int64(len(data)),
	}, nil
}

func (s *Service) ProbeFile(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string) (*contracts.FileProbe, error) {
	entryPath = normalizePath(entryPath)

	ctx := context.Background()
	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)

	arch, err := s.archCache.Get(ctx, nativePath, nestedChain, "")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive probe: open %q: %w", nativePath, err)
	}

	f, err := arch.Open(ctx, entryPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive probe: open entry %q: %w", entryPath, err)
	}
	defer f.Close()

	_, probe, err := contentprobe.ProbeReader(f)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.FileProbe{
		MimeType:  probe.MimeType,
		Encoding:  probe.Encoding,
		IsText:    probe.IsText,
		IsArchive: probe.IsArchive,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Service) ReadFileStream(fsPath string, nestedChain []string, entryPath string, chunkSize int, emitEvent func(string, interface{})) (string, error) {
	entryPath = normalizePath(entryPath)

	if chunkSize <= 0 {
		chunkSize = 64 * 1024 // 64KB default chunk size
	}

	// Generate streamID
	streamID := fmt.Sprintf("archive-read-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())

	// Create cancellation context
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	s.streamsMu.Lock()
	s.streamsCancel[streamID] = cancel
	s.streamsMu.Unlock()

	// Start streaming in background goroutine
	go func() {
		defer func() {
			s.streamsMu.Lock()
			delete(s.streamsCancel, streamID)
			s.streamsMu.Unlock()
		}()

		// Convert filesystem:// scheme paths to native OS paths
		nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(fsPath)

		arch, err := s.archCache.Get(ctx, nativePath, nestedChain, "")
		if err != nil {
			emitEvent("archive:read:error", map[string]interface{}{
				"streamID": streamID,
				"error":    fmt.Sprintf("archive read: open %q: %v", nativePath, err),
			})
			return
		}

		f, err := arch.Open(ctx, entryPath)
		if err != nil {
			emitEvent("archive:read:error", map[string]interface{}{
				"streamID": streamID,
				"error":    fmt.Sprintf("archive read: open entry %q: %v", entryPath, err),
			})
			return
		}
		defer f.Close()

		// Stream file in chunks
		bytesRead := int64(0)
		for {
			select {
			case <-ctx.Done():
				emitEvent("archive:read:cancelled", map[string]interface{}{
					"streamID": streamID,
				})
				return
			default:
			}

			chunk := make([]byte, chunkSize)
			n, err := f.Read(chunk)
			if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
				emitEvent("archive:read:error", map[string]interface{}{
					"streamID": streamID,
					"error":    fmt.Sprintf("archive read: failed to read chunk: %v", err),
				})
				return
			}

			if n > 0 {
				bytesRead += int64(n)
				emitEvent("archive:read:chunk", map[string]interface{}{
					"streamID":  streamID,
					"data":      chunk[:n],
					"bytesRead": bytesRead,
				})
			}

			if err == io.EOF {
				emitEvent("archive:read:done", map[string]interface{}{
					"streamID":   streamID,
					"totalBytes": bytesRead,
				})
				return
			}
		}
	}()

	return streamID, nil
}

func (s *Service) CancelReadStream(streamID string) {
	s.streamsMu.Lock()
	defer s.streamsMu.Unlock()

	if cancel, exists := s.streamsCancel[streamID]; exists {
		cancel()
		delete(s.streamsCancel, streamID)
	}
}

func (s *Service) CopyEntries(req contracts.ArchiveEntriesRequest) (*contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult, error) {
	req.FsPath = pathref.ToNativePath(req.FsPath)
	req.DestinationDir = pathref.ToNativePath(req.DestinationDir)
	if req.DestinationDir == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("destinationDir is required")
	}

	op := s.startOperation(contracts.OpCopy, "Copy from archive", req.FsPath, req.DestinationDir)
	succeeded, failed, errs, err := s.ExtractEntries(req, op)
	if err != nil {
		op.SetError(err)
		return nil, err
	}

	op.Complete()
	return &contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult{
		OperationID: op.ID(),
		Total:       succeeded + failed,
		Succeeded:   succeeded,
		Failed:      failed,
		Errors:      errs,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Service) MoveEntries(req contracts.ArchiveEntriesRequest) (*contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult, error) {
	req.FsPath = pathref.ToNativePath(req.FsPath)
	req.DestinationDir = pathref.ToNativePath(req.DestinationDir)
	if req.DestinationDir == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("destinationDir is required")
	}
	if len(req.Entries) == 0 {
		return &contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult{}, nil
	}

	op := s.startOperation(contracts.OpMove, "Move from archive", req.FsPath, req.DestinationDir)
	succeeded, failed, errs, err := s.ExtractEntries(req, op)
	if err != nil {
		op.SetError(err)
		return nil, err
	}

	result := &contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult{
		OperationID: op.ID(),
		Total:       succeeded + failed,
		Succeeded:   succeeded,
		Failed:      failed,
		Errors:      errs,
	}

	if failed > 0 {
		op.SetError(fmt.Errorf("%d file(s) failed to extract; archive not modified", failed))
		return result, nil
	}

	if len(req.NestedChain) > 0 {
		result.SourceRemoved = false
		result.Errors = append(result.Errors, contracts.BatchItemError{
			Source: req.FsPath,
			Error:  "entries copied but NOT removed: deleting from nested archives is not supported",
		})
		op.Complete()
		return result, nil
	}

	deleteReq := contracts.ArchiveEntriesRequest{FsPath: req.FsPath, Entries: req.Entries}
	delResult, delErr := s.DeleteEntries(deleteReq)
	if delErr != nil {
		result.SourceRemoved = false
		result.Errors = append(result.Errors, contracts.BatchItemError{
			Source: req.FsPath,
			Error:  "entries extracted but NOT removed from archive: " + delErr.Error(),
		})
		op.Complete()
		return result, nil
	}

	result.SourceRemoved = true
	if delResult.Failed > 0 {
		result.Errors = append(result.Errors, delResult.Errors...)
	}
	op.Complete()
	return result, nil
}

func (s *Service) ExtractEntries(req contracts.ArchiveEntriesRequest, op Operation) (succeeded, failed int, errs []contracts.BatchItemError, fatalErr error) {
	req.FsPath = pathref.ToNativePath(req.FsPath)
	req.DestinationDir = pathref.ToNativePath(req.DestinationDir)

	if err := os.MkdirAll(req.DestinationDir, 0755); err != nil {
		return 0, 0, nil, fmt.Errorf("create destination: %w", err)
	}

	if len(req.NestedChain) > 0 {
		data, err := s.ExtractNestedArchive(req.FsPath, req.NestedChain)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, 0, nil, err
		}
		return s.extractEntriesFromBytes(data, req.NestedChain[len(req.NestedChain)-1], req.Entries, req.StripPrefix, req.DestinationDir, req.FlattenPaths, op)
	}

	handler, ok := vfsarchive.ForPath(req.FsPath)
	if !ok {
		return s.extractArchiveReaderSync(req.FsPath, req.Entries, req.StripPrefix, req.DestinationDir, req.FlattenPaths, op)
	}
	switch handler.Name() {
	case "zip":
		return s.extractZipSync(req.FsPath, req.Entries, req.StripPrefix, req.DestinationDir, req.FlattenPaths, op)
	case "tar":
		return s.extractTarSync(req.FsPath, req.Entries, req.StripPrefix, req.DestinationDir, req.FlattenPaths, op)
	default:
		return s.extractArchiveReaderSync(req.FsPath, req.Entries, req.StripPrefix, req.DestinationDir, req.FlattenPaths, op)
	}
}

func (s *Service) DeleteEntries(req contracts.ArchiveEntriesRequest) (*contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult, error) {
	req.FsPath = pathref.ToNativePath(req.FsPath)
	if len(req.NestedChain) > 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("deleting entries from nested archives is not supported")
	}
	if len(req.Entries) == 0 {
		return &contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult{}, nil
	}

	op := s.startOperation(contracts.OpDelete, "Delete from archive", req.FsPath, "")
	op.SetTotal(0, 0)

	removed, kept, rewriteErr := s.rewriteEntries(req.FsPath, req.Entries, op)
	if rewriteErr != nil {
		op.SetError(rewriteErr)
	}

	result := &contracts.ArchiveEntriesResult{
		OperationID:   op.ID(),
		Total:         removed + kept,
		Succeeded:     removed,
		SourceRemoved: rewriteErr == nil,
	}

	if rewriteErr != nil {
		result.Failed = 1
		result.Errors = []contracts.BatchItemError{{Source: req.FsPath, Error: rewriteErr.Error()}}
		return result, rewriteErr
	}

	op.Complete()
	return result, nil
}

func (s *Service) rewriteEntries(fsPath string, entries []string, op Operation) (removed, kept int, err error) {
	handler, ok := vfsarchive.ForPath(fsPath)
	if !ok {
		return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("unsupported archive format: %q", fsPath)
	}
	switch handler.Name() {
	case "zip":
		return rewriteZip(fsPath, entries, op)
	case "tar":
		lower := strings.ToLower(fsPath)
		switch {
		case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.gz"), strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tgz"):
			return rewriteTar(fsPath, entries, "gz", op)
		case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.bz2"):
			return rewriteTar(fsPath, entries, "bz2", op)
		case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.xz"):
			return rewriteTar(fsPath, entries, "xz", op)
		default:
			return rewriteTar(fsPath, entries, "", op)
		}
	default:
		return 0, 0, unsupportedRewriteFormatError(fsPath)
	}
}

func unsupportedRewriteFormatError(fsPath string) error {
	ext := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.Ext(strings.ToLower(fsPath)), "."))
	if ext == "" {
		ext = "UNKNOWN"
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("deleting entries from %s archives is not supported (format is read-only)", ext)
}

func normalizePath(path string) string {
	return strings.Trim(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"), "/")
}

func vfsEntryToFileInfo(entry vfslib.FileInfo, parentChain []string) contracts.FileInfo {
	entryType := contracts.FileTypeFile
	switch {
	case entry.IsDir():
		entryType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	case entry.IsArchive():
		entryType = contracts.FileTypeArchive
	case entry.IsSymlink():
		entryType = contracts.FileTypeSymlink
	}

	var nestedChain []string
	if entryType == contracts.FileTypeArchive {
		nestedChain = append(append([]string{}, parentChain...), entry.Path())
	}

	return contracts.FileInfo{
		Name:        entry.Name(),
		Path:        entry.Path(),
		Type:        entryType,
		MimeType:    mime.TypeByExtension(filepath.Ext(entry.Name())),
		Size:        entry.Size(),
		Modified:    entry.ModTime().Unix(),
		IsHidden:    entry.IsHidden(),
		IsSymlink:   entry.IsSymlink(),
		IsNested:    entryType == contracts.FileTypeArchive,
		NestedChain: nestedChain,
	}
}
````

## File: internal/browserpane/service_test.go
````go
package browserpane

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestHandlePaneMessageEmitsLifecycleEvents(t *testing.T) {
	var eventName string
	var eventData map[string]string
	s := NewService(func(name string, data interface{}) {
		eventName = name
		eventData, _ = data.(map[string]string)
	})

	s.handlePaneMessage("surface-1", `{"type":"lifecycle","state":"completed","url":"https://example.com"}`)

	if eventName != "browser-pane:lifecycle" {
		t.Fatalf("expected event %q, got %q", "browser-pane:lifecycle", eventName)
	}
	if eventData["surfaceId"] != "surface-1" {
		t.Fatalf("expected surfaceId %q, got %q", "surface-1", eventData["surfaceId"])
	}
	if eventData["state"] != "completed" {
		t.Fatalf("expected state %q, got %q", "completed", eventData["state"])
	}
	if eventData["url"] != "https://example.com" {
		t.Fatalf("expected url %q, got %q", "https://example.com", eventData["url"])
	}
}

func TestHandlePaneMessageForwardsGenericMessages(t *testing.T) {
	var eventName string
	var eventData map[string]string
	s := NewService(func(name string, data interface{}) {
		eventName = name
		eventData, _ = data.(map[string]string)
	})

	s.handlePaneMessage("surface-2", `{"type":"viewer-command","command":"refresh"}`)

	if eventName != "browser-pane:message" {
		t.Fatalf("expected event %q, got %q", "browser-pane:message", eventName)
	}
	if eventData["surfaceId"] != "surface-2" {
		t.Fatalf("expected surfaceId %q, got %q", "surface-2", eventData["surfaceId"])
	}
	if eventData["message"] != `{"type":"viewer-command","command":"refresh"}` {
		t.Fatalf("expected message %q, got %q", `{"type":"viewer-command","command":"refresh"}`, eventData["message"])
	}
}

func TestHandlePaneMessageIgnoresEmptyMessages(t *testing.T) {
	var called bool
	s := NewService(func(name string, data interface{}) {
		called = true
	})

	s.handlePaneMessage("surface-3", "")
	s.handlePaneMessage("surface-3", "   ")

	if called {
		t.Fatalf("expected no events for empty messages")
	}
}

func TestSyncEmitsStartedLifecycleEventOnURLChange(t *testing.T) {
	var events []map[string]string
	s := NewService(func(name string, data interface{}) {
		if name == "browser-pane:lifecycle" {
			events = append(events, data.(map[string]string))
		}
	})

	// First sync with a URL should emit started
	err := s.Sync(Update{
		SurfaceID: "surface-a",
		URL:       "https://example.com",
		Visible:   true,
		Width:     100,
		Height:    100,
	})
	if err == nil {
		// pane creation will fail because there's no main window in tests,
		// but the lifecycle event should still be emitted before that
	}

	if len(events) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 lifecycle event, got %d", len(events))
	}
	if events[0]["state"] != "started" {
		t.Fatalf("expected state %q, got %q", "started", events[0]["state"])
	}
}

func TestHandlePaneMessageRoutesRpcResponses(t *testing.T) {
	var eventName string
	var eventData map[string]string
	s := NewService(func(name string, data interface{}) {
		eventName = name
		eventData, _ = data.(map[string]string)
	})

	s.handlePaneMessage("surface-rpc", `{"_rpc":true,"id":"42","result":{"x":1}}`)

	if eventName != "browser-pane:rpc" {
		t.Fatalf("expected event %q, got %q", "browser-pane:rpc", eventName)
	}
	if eventData["surfaceId"] != "surface-rpc" {
		t.Fatalf("expected surfaceId %q, got %q", "surface-rpc", eventData["surfaceId"])
	}
	if !strings.Contains(eventData["message"], `"id":"42"`) {
		t.Fatalf("expected message to contain rpc id, got %q", eventData["message"])
	}
}

func TestHandlePaneMessageRoutesGenericMessagesAfterRpcFilter(t *testing.T) {
	var eventName string
	s := NewService(func(name string, data interface{}) {
		eventName = name
		_, _ = data.(map[string]string)
	})

	// Missing 'id' → not an RPC envelope → forwarded as generic message
	s.handlePaneMessage("surface-3", `{"_rpc":true,"result":123}`)

	if eventName != "browser-pane:message" {
		t.Fatalf("expected event %q, got %q", "browser-pane:message", eventName)
	}
}
````

````go
package converter

import (
	"bytes"
	"image"
	"image/color"
	_ "image/jpeg"
	"image/png"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func TestClassifyDocumentFormat(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		ext  string
		want documentFormatKind
	}{
		{ext: ".docx", want: documentFormatOffice},
		{ext: "epub", want: documentFormatEpub},
		{ext: "djvu", want: documentFormatDjvu},
		{ext: "txt", want: documentFormatUnknown},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		if got := classifyDocumentFormat(tt.ext); got != tt.want {
			t.Fatalf("classifyDocumentFormat(%q) = %q, want %q", tt.ext, got, tt.want)
		}
	}
}

func TestNormalizeOutputExtension(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		format string
		want   string
	}{
		{format: "jpeg", want: "jpg"},
		{format: "tiff", want: "tif"},
		{format: "PNG", want: "png"},
		{format: "webp", want: "webp"},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		if got := normalizeOutputExtension(tt.format); got != tt.want {
			t.Fatalf("normalizeOutputExtension(%q) = %q, want %q", tt.format, got, tt.want)
		}
	}
}

func TestConvertFormatFallsBackToJPEG(t *testing.T) {
	service := &Service{}
	service.detectOnce.Do(func() {})

	inputPath := writePNGFixture(t)
	converted, err := service.ConvertFormat(inputPath, "jpeg")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ConvertFormat returned error: %v", err)
	}

	_, format, err := image.Decode(bytes.NewReader(converted))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("image.Decode returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if format != "jpeg" {
		t.Fatalf("decoded format = %q, want %q", format, "jpeg")
	}
}

func TestCreateThumbnailFallsBackToJPEG(t *testing.T) {
	service := &Service{}
	service.detectOnce.Do(func() {})

	inputPath := writePNGFixture(t)
	thumbnail, err := service.CreateThumbnail(inputPath, "jpeg", 8, 8)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("CreateThumbnail returned error: %v", err)
	}

	img, format, err := image.Decode(bytes.NewReader(thumbnail))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("image.Decode returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if format != "jpeg" {
		t.Fatalf("decoded format = %q, want %q", format, "jpeg")
	}
	if img.Bounds().Dx() > 8 || img.Bounds().Dy() > 8 {
		t.Fatalf("thumbnail bounds = %v, want max 8x8", img.Bounds())
	}
}

func writePNGFixture(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()

	dir := t.TempDir()
	path := filepath.Join(dir, "fixture.png")
	img := image.NewRGBA(image.Rect(0, 0, 16, 12))
	for y := 0; y < 12; y++ {
		for x := 0; x < 16; x++ {
			img.Set(x, y, color.RGBA{R: uint8(x * 10), G: uint8(y * 20), B: 180, A: 255})
		}
	}

	file, err := os.Create(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("os.Create returned error: %v", err)
	}
	defer file.Close()

	if err := png.Encode(file, img); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("png.Encode returned error: %v", err)
	}

	return path
}
````
