````go
package filesystem

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"
	"time"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	elevation "wails-app/internal/elevation"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	internalruntime "wails-app/internal/runtime"
	vfslib "wails-app/vfs"
)

type elevationClientProvider interface {
	Client() elevation.Client
}

type memoryPathResolver interface {
	ResolvePublicPath(path string) (string, bool, error)
	ToPublicPath(path string) string
}

type ServiceConfig struct {
	Elevation            elevationClientProvider
	EmitEvent            func(string, interface{})
	StartElevatedSession func() (*elevation.SessionStatus, error)

	Raw      *RawService
	Metadata MetadataCallbacks

	IsProcessElevated              func() bool
	ExecuteElevatedRequest         func(elevation.Request) elevation.Response
	RunElevatedRequest             func(elevation.Request) (elevation.Response, error)
	IsPermissionDenied             func(error) bool
	ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation func(error) bool
	MemoryResolver                 memoryPathResolver
}

type Service struct {
	elevation            elevationClientProvider
	emitEvent            func(string, interface{})
	startElevatedSession func() (*elevation.SessionStatus, error)
	raw                  *RawService
	metadata             MetadataCallbacks
	web                  *webAliasService
	vfs                  *vfslib.Unified
	duStreams            *duStreamRegistry
	duCache              *DiskUsageCache
	streamsMu            sync.RWMutex
	streamsCancel        map[string]context.CancelFunc

	isProcessElevated              func() bool
	executeElevatedRequest         func(elevation.Request) elevation.Response
	runElevatedRequest             func(elevation.Request) (elevation.Response, error)
	isPermissionDenied             func(error) bool
	shouldRetryDeleteWithElevation func(error) bool
	memoryResolver                 memoryPathResolver
}

func NewService(config ServiceConfig) *Service {
	return &Service{
		elevation:                      config.Elevation,
		emitEvent:                      config.EmitEvent,
		startElevatedSession:           config.StartElevatedSession,
		raw:                            config.Raw,
		metadata:                       config.Metadata,
		web:                            newWebAliasService(),
		duStreams:                      newDuStreamRegistry(),
		duCache:                        NewDiskUsageCache(DefaultDiskUsageCacheCapacity),
		streamsCancel:                  make(map[string]context.CancelFunc),
		isProcessElevated:              config.IsProcessElevated,
		executeElevatedRequest:         config.ExecuteElevatedRequest,
		runElevatedRequest:             config.RunElevatedRequest,
		isPermissionDenied:             config.IsPermissionDenied,
		shouldRetryDeleteWithElevation: config.ShouldRetryDeleteWithElevation,
		memoryResolver:                 config.MemoryResolver,
	}
}

func (s *Service) resolvePublicPath(path string) (string, error) {
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(normalized) {
		return normalized, nil
	}
	if resolved, ok := pathref.ResolveLocalCloudPath(normalized); ok {
		return resolved, nil
	}
	nativePath := pathref.ToNativePath(normalized)
	if s.memoryResolver == nil || !pathref.IsMemory(normalized) {
		return nativePath, nil
	}
	resolved, _, err := s.memoryResolver.ResolvePublicPath(nativePath)
	return resolved, err
}

func (s *Service) handlesWebAliasPath(path string) bool {
	return s.web != nil && s.web.handles(pathref.Normalize(path))
}

func (s *Service) webAliasUnsupported(operation string) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%s not supported for web aliases", operation)
}

func (s *Service) toPublicPath(path string) string {
	if s.memoryResolver == nil {
		return pathref.FromNativePath(filepath.ToSlash(path))
	}
	return pathref.FromNativePath(s.memoryResolver.ToPublicPath(path))
}

func (s *Service) toRequestedPublicPath(path string, requestedPath string) string {
	if pathref.IsLocalCloud(requestedPath) {
		if mapped, ok := pathref.LocalCloudAliasFromNativePath(path); ok {
			return mapped
		}
	}
	return s.toPublicPath(path)
}

func (s *Service) mapFileInfo(info contracts.FileInfo) contracts.FileInfo {
	info.Path = s.toPublicPath(info.Path)
	if info.SearchBasePath != "" {
		info.SearchBasePath = s.toPublicPath(info.SearchBasePath)
	}
	if info.SearchParentPath != "" {
		info.SearchParentPath = s.toPublicPath(info.SearchParentPath)
	}
	return info
}

func (s *Service) mapListing(listing *contracts.DirectoryListing, requestedPath string) *contracts.DirectoryListing {
	if listing == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if requestedPath != "" {
		listing.Path = pathref.Normalize(requestedPath)
	} else {
		listing.Path = s.toPublicPath(listing.Path)
	}
	for index := range listing.Entries {
		info := listing.Entries[index]
		info.Path = s.toRequestedPublicPath(info.Path, requestedPath)
		if info.SearchBasePath != "" {
			if pathref.IsLocalCloud(requestedPath) {
				info.SearchBasePath = pathref.Normalize(requestedPath)
			} else {
				info.SearchBasePath = s.toPublicPath(info.SearchBasePath)
			}
		}
		if info.SearchParentPath != "" {
			info.SearchParentPath = s.toRequestedPublicPath(info.SearchParentPath, requestedPath)
		}
		listing.Entries[index] = info
	}
	return listing
}

func (s *Service) mapFileContent(file *contracts.FileContent, requestedPath string) *contracts.FileContent {
	if file == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if requestedPath != "" {
		file.Path = pathref.Normalize(requestedPath)
	} else {
		file.Path = s.toPublicPath(file.Path)
	}
	return file
}

func (s *Service) mapOperation(op *contracts.OperationResult) *contracts.OperationResult {
	if op == nil {
		return nil
	}
	for index := range op.AffectedPaths {
		op.AffectedPaths[index] = s.toPublicPath(op.AffectedPaths[index])
	}
	return op
}

func (s *Service) SetVFS(v *vfslib.Unified) {
	s.vfs = v
}

// RealPath resolves a public path to the underlying real filesystem path.

// Uses the same resolution chain as resolvePublicPath for consistency.
func (s *Service) RealPath(path string) (string, error) {
	if path == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("empty path")
	}
	return s.resolvePublicPath(path)
}

func (s *Service) handlesVFSPath(path string) bool {
	if s.vfs == nil {
		return false
	}
	normalized := pathref.Normalize(path)
	if pathref.IsAlias(normalized) {
		return s.vfs.IsMounted(pathref.ToVFS(normalized))
	}
	return s.vfs.IsMounted(normalized)
}

func (s *Service) emit(name string, data interface{}) {
	if s.emitEvent != nil {
		s.emitEvent(name, data)
	}
}

func (s *Service) elevationTargetSingle(path string) string {
	return path
}

func (s *Service) elevationTargetPair(source, destination string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s -> %s", source, destination)
}

func (s *Service) ListDirectory(path string, showHidden bool) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if pathref.IsSearch(path) {
		return s.listSearchAlias(path)
	}
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return s.web.listDirectory(path)
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		listing, err := internalruntime.VFSListDir(context.Background(), s.vfs, path)
		if err == nil {
			return listing, nil
		}
		if !pathref.IsRegistry(path) || !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
			return nil, err
		}

		resp, elevErr := s.runElevatedWithEvents("list", s.elevationTargetSingle(path), elevation.Request{
			Op:         "list",
			Path:       path,
			ShowHidden: showHidden,
		})
		if elevErr != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return resp.DirListing, nil
	}
	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	listing, err := s.raw.ListDirectory(resolvedPath, showHidden)
	if err == nil {
		return s.mapListing(listing, path), nil
	}
	if !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
		return nil, err
	}

	resp, elevErr := s.runElevatedWithEvents("list", s.elevationTargetSingle(path), elevation.Request{
		Op:         "list",
		Path:       resolvedPath,
		ShowHidden: showHidden,
	})
	if elevErr != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.mapListing(resp.DirListing, path), nil
}

func (s *Service) listSearchAlias(path string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	if path == pathref.SearchScheme {
		return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
			Path:      pathref.SearchScheme,
			Entries:   []contracts.FileInfo{},
			TotalSize: 0,
		}, nil
	}

	query, ok := pathref.ParseSearch(path)
	if !ok {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid search alias path")
	}

	result, err := s.SearchFiles(query.BasePath, query.Pattern, query.Recursive)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	entries := append([]contracts.FileInfo{}, result.Matches...)
	var total int64
	for _, entry := range entries {
		total += entry.Size
	}

	return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
		Path:      path,
		Entries:   entries,
		TotalSize: total,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Service) ElevatedList(path string, showHidden bool) ([]contracts.FileInfo, error) {
	resp, err := s.runElevatedWithEvents("list", path, elevation.Request{
		Op:         "list",
		Path:       path,
		ShowHidden: showHidden,
	})
	if err != nil || resp.DirListing == nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return resp.DirListing.Entries, nil
}

func (s *Service) DirSizeRecursive(path string) (int64, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return 0, s.webAliasUnsupported("directory size")
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("directory size not supported for remote paths")
	}
	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	var total int64
	queue := []string{resolvedPath}
	for len(queue) > 0 {
		current := queue[0]
		queue = queue[1:]
		entries, err := os.ReadDir(current)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		for _, entry := range entries {
			full := filepath.Join(current, entry.Name())
			if entry.IsDir() {
				queue = append(queue, full)
			} else {
				info, err := entry.Info()
				if err == nil {
					total += info.Size()
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return total, nil
}

func (s *Service) GetFileInfo(path string) (*contracts.FileInfo, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return s.web.getFileInfo(path)
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		return internalruntime.VFSGetFileInfo(context.Background(), s.vfs, path)
	}
	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(resolvedPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	name := filepath.Base(resolvedPath)
	fi := BuildFileInfo(s.metadata, name, filepath.ToSlash(resolvedPath), info)
	fi.Path = path
	return &fi, nil
}

func (s *Service) ReadFile(path string, encoding string) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return s.web.readFile(path, encoding)
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		file, err := internalruntime.VFSReadFile(context.Background(), s.vfs, path, encoding)
		if err == nil {
			return file, nil
		}
		if !pathref.IsRegistry(path) || !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
			return nil, err
		}

		resp, elevErr := s.runElevatedWithEvents("read", s.elevationTargetSingle(path), elevation.Request{
			Op:       "read",
			Path:     path,
			Encoding: encoding,
		})
		if elevErr != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return resp.File, nil
	}

	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	file, err := s.raw.ReadFile(resolvedPath, encoding)
	if err == nil {
		return s.mapFileContent(file, path), nil
	}
	if !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
		return nil, err
	}

	resp, elevErr := s.runElevatedWithEvents("read", s.elevationTargetSingle(path), elevation.Request{
		Op:       "read",
		Path:     resolvedPath,
		Encoding: encoding,
	})
	if elevErr != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.mapFileContent(resp.File, path), nil
}

func (s *Service) ReadFileRange(path string, offset int64, length int) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return s.web.readFileRange(path, offset, length)
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		return internalruntime.VFSReadFileRange(context.Background(), s.vfs, path, offset, length)
	}

	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	file, err := s.raw.ReadFileRange(resolvedPath, offset, length)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.mapFileContent(file, path), nil
}

func (s *Service) ProbeFile(path string) (*contracts.FileProbe, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return s.web.probeFile(path)
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		probe, err := internalruntime.VFSProbeFile(context.Background(), s.vfs, path)
		if err == nil {
			return probe, nil
		}
		if !pathref.IsRegistry(path) || !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
			return nil, err
		}
		return nil, err
	}

	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.raw.ProbeFile(resolvedPath)
}

func (s *Service) ReadFileStream(path string, chunkSize int, emitEvent func(string, interface{})) (string, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return "", s.webAliasUnsupported("file stream")
	}

	if chunkSize <= 0 {
		chunkSize = 64 * 1024 // 64KB default chunk size
	}

	// Generate streamID
	streamID := fmt.Sprintf("file-read-%d", time.Now().UnixNano())

	// Create cancellation context
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	s.streamsMu.Lock()
	s.streamsCancel[streamID] = cancel
	s.streamsMu.Unlock()

	// Start streaming in background goroutine
	go func() {
		defer func() {
			s.streamsMu.Lock()
			delete(s.streamsCancel, streamID)
			s.streamsMu.Unlock()
		}()

		var reader io.ReadCloser

		if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
			internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
			vfsFile, vfsErr := s.vfs.Open(ctx, internalPath)
			if vfsErr != nil {
				emitEvent("file:read:error", map[string]interface{}{
					"streamID": streamID,
					"error":    fmt.Sprintf("open vfs file: %v", vfsErr),
				})
				return
			}
			reader = vfsFile
		} else {
			// Resolve path
			resolvedPath, resolveErr := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
			if resolveErr != nil {
				emitEvent("file:read:error", map[string]interface{}{
					"streamID": streamID,
					"error":    fmt.Sprintf("resolve path: %v", resolveErr),
				})
				return
			}

			// Open file
			file, err := os.Open(resolvedPath)
			if err != nil {
				emitEvent("file:read:error", map[string]interface{}{
					"streamID": streamID,
					"error":    fmt.Sprintf("open file: %v", err),
				})
				return
			}
			reader = file
		}
		defer reader.Close()

		// Stream file in chunks
		bytesRead := int64(0)
		for {
			select {
			case <-ctx.Done():
				emitEvent("file:read:cancelled", map[string]interface{}{
					"streamID": streamID,
				})
				return
			default:
			}

			chunk := make([]byte, chunkSize)
			n, err := reader.Read(chunk)
			if err != nil && err != io.EOF {
				emitEvent("file:read:error", map[string]interface{}{
					"streamID": streamID,
					"error":    fmt.Sprintf("read chunk: %v", err),
				})
				return
			}

			if n > 0 {
				bytesRead += int64(n)
				emitEvent("file:read:chunk", map[string]interface{}{
					"streamID":  streamID,
					"data":      chunk[:n],
					"bytesRead": bytesRead,
				})
			}

			if err == io.EOF {
				emitEvent("file:read:done", map[string]interface{}{
					"streamID":   streamID,
					"totalBytes": bytesRead,
				})
				return
			}
		}
	}()

	return streamID, nil
}

func (s *Service) CancelReadStream(streamID string) {
	s.streamsMu.Lock()
	defer s.streamsMu.Unlock()

	if cancel, exists := s.streamsCancel[streamID]; exists {
		cancel()
		delete(s.streamsCancel, streamID)
	}
}

func (s *Service) WriteFile(path string, content string, encoding string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return nil, s.webAliasUnsupported("write")
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		op, err := internalruntime.VFSWriteFile(context.Background(), s.vfs, path, content, encoding)
		if err == nil {
			return op, nil
		}
		if !pathref.IsRegistry(path) || !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
			return nil, err
		}

		resp, elevErr := s.runElevatedWithEvents("write", s.elevationTargetSingle(path), elevation.Request{
			Op:       "write",
			Path:     path,
			Content:  content,
			Encoding: encoding,
		})
		if elevErr != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return resp.Operation, nil
	}

	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	op, err := s.raw.WriteFile(resolvedPath, content, encoding)
	if err == nil {
		return s.mapOperation(op), nil
	}
	if !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
		return nil, err
	}

	resp, elevErr := s.runElevatedWithEvents("write", s.elevationTargetSingle(path), elevation.Request{
		Op:       "write",
		Path:     resolvedPath,
		Content:  content,
		Encoding: encoding,
	})
	if elevErr != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.mapOperation(resp.Operation), nil
}

func (s *Service) DeleteFile(path string, recursive bool, useTrash *bool) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return nil, s.webAliasUnsupported("delete")
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		op, err := internalruntime.VFSRemove(context.Background(), s.vfs, path)
		if err == nil {
			return op, nil
		}
		if !pathref.IsRegistry(path) || !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
			return nil, err
		}

		resp, elevErr := s.runElevatedWithEvents("delete", s.elevationTargetSingle(path), elevation.Request{
			Op:        "delete",
			Path:      path,
			Recursive: recursive,
			UseTrash:  useTrash,
		})
		if elevErr != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return resp.Operation, nil
	}

	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	op, err := s.raw.DeleteFile(resolvedPath, recursive, useTrash)
	if err == nil {
		return s.mapOperation(op), nil
	}
	if !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
		return nil, err
	}

	resp, elevErr := s.runElevatedWithEvents("delete", s.elevationTargetSingle(path), elevation.Request{
		Op:        "delete",
		Path:      resolvedPath,
		Recursive: recursive,
		UseTrash:  useTrash,
	})
	if elevErr != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.mapOperation(resp.Operation), nil
}

func (s *Service) MoveFile(source, destination string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	source = pathref.Normalize(source)
	destination = pathref.Normalize(destination)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(source) || s.handlesWebAliasPath(destination) {
		return nil, s.webAliasUnsupported("move")
	}
	resolvedSource, err := s.resolvePublicPath(source)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	resolvedDestination, err := s.resolvePublicPath(destination)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	op, err := s.raw.MoveFile(resolvedSource, resolvedDestination)
	if err == nil {
		return s.mapOperation(op), nil
	}
	if !s.isPermissionDenied(err) {
		return nil, err
	}

	resp, elevErr := s.runElevatedWithEvents("move", s.elevationTargetPair(source, destination), elevation.Request{
		Op:          "move",
		Source:      resolvedSource,
		Destination: resolvedDestination,
	})
	if elevErr != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.mapOperation(resp.Operation), nil
}

func (s *Service) RunElevatedCopy(src, dst string, recursive bool) (bool, error) {
	resp, err := s.runElevatedWithEvents("copy", s.elevationTargetPair(src, dst), elevation.Request{
		Op:          "copy",
		Source:      src,
		Destination: dst,
		Recursive:   recursive,

func (s *Service) SearchFiles(path, pattern string, recursive bool) (*contracts.SearchResult, error) {
	path = pathref.Normalize(path)
	if s.handlesWebAliasPath(path) {
		return nil, s.webAliasUnsupported("search")
	}
	if s.handlesVFSPath(path) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("search not supported for remote paths")
	}
	var matches []contracts.FileInfo
	basePath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	resolvedPath, err := s.resolvePublicPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	walkFn := func(p string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return nil
		}
		if p == resolvedPath {
			return nil
		}
		if !recursive && d.IsDir() && p != resolvedPath {
			return filepath.SkipDir
		}

		name := d.Name()
		matched, err := pathref.MatchSearchPattern(pattern, name)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if !matched {
			return nil
		}

		info, err := d.Info()
		if err != nil {
			return nil
		}
		entry := BuildFileInfo(s.metadata, name, filepath.ToSlash(p), info)
		entry.Path = s.toRequestedPublicPath(entry.Path, path)
		entry.SearchBasePath = basePath
		entry.SearchPattern = pattern
		entry.SearchParentPath = s.toRequestedPublicPath(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Dir(p)), path)
		matches = append(matches, entry)
		return nil
	}

	if err := filepath.WalkDir(resolvedPath, walkFn); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	if matches == nil {
		matches = []contracts.FileInfo{}
	}

	return &contracts.SearchResult{
		Path:         basePath,
		Matches:      matches,
		TotalMatches: len(matches),
	}, nil
}

type elevationEvent struct {
	RequestID string `json:"requestId,omitempty"`
	Phase     string `json:"phase"`
	Operation string `json:"operation"`
	Target    string `json:"target"`
	Message   string `json:"message,omitempty"`
	Success   bool   `json:"success,omitempty"`
	Error     string `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

func (s *Service) emitElevationRequested(requestID, op, target string) {
	s.emit("elevation:requested", elevationEvent{
		RequestID: requestID,
		Phase:     "requested",
		Operation: op,
		Target:    target,
		Message:   "Administrative privileges required. Confirm to show OS elevation prompt.",
	})
}

func (s *Service) emitElevationResult(requestID, op, target string, success bool, err error) {
	evt := elevationEvent{
		RequestID: requestID,
		Phase:     "result",
		Operation: op,
		Target:    target,
		Success:   success,
	}
	if err != nil {
		evt.Error = err.Error()
		evt.Message = "Elevation failed or was cancelled."
	} else {
		evt.Message = "Elevated operation completed."
	}
	s.emit("elevation:result", evt)
}

func (s *Service) runElevatedWithEvents(op, target string, req elevation.Request) (elevation.Response, error) {
	if s.isProcessElevated != nil && s.isProcessElevated() {
		return s.executeElevatedRequest(req), nil
	}

	var svc elevation.Client
	if s.elevation != nil {
		svc = s.elevation.Client()
	}

	if (svc == nil || !svc.Alive()) && s.startElevatedSession != nil {
		s.emit("elevation:session-starting", map[string]string{"op": op, "target": target})
		if status, startErr := s.startElevatedSession(); startErr == nil {
			s.emit("elevation:session-started", status)
			if s.elevation != nil {
				svc = s.elevation.Client()
			}
		}
	}

	if svc != nil && svc.Alive() {
		resp, err := svc.Dispatch(req)
		if err != nil {
			s.emit("elevation:auto-failed", map[string]interface{}{"op": op, "target": target, "error": err.Error()})
			return elevation.Response{}, err
		}
		s.emit("elevation:auto-started", map[string]string{"op": op, "target": target})
		return resp, nil
	}

	s.emit("elevation:uac-requested", map[string]string{
		"phase":     "requested",
		"operation": op,
		"target":    target,
	})
	resp, err := s.runElevatedRequest(req)
	if err != nil {
		s.emit("elevation:auto-failed", map[string]interface{}{"op": op, "target": target, "error": err.Error()})
		return elevation.Response{}, err
	}
	s.emit("elevation:auto-started", map[string]string{"op": op, "target": target})
	return resp, nil
}
````

````go
	if op.Progress.TotalItems != 10 || op.Progress.TotalBytes != 1024 {
		t.Fatalf("expected total 10 items / 1024 bytes, got %d / %d", op.Progress.TotalItems, op.Progress.TotalBytes)
	}
	// SetTotal re-emits start
	if len(*events) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 2 events (initial start + re-start), got %d", len(*events))
	}
	se := (*events)[1].data.(startEvent)
	if se.TotalItems != 10 || se.TotalBytes != 1024 {

func TestUpdateProgressCalculatesPercentAndSpeed(t *testing.T) {
	m, events := newTestManager()
	op := m.StartOperation(contracts.OpCopy, "", "", "")
	op.SetTotal(10, 1000)

	// First update establishes baseline
	op.UpdateProgress(1, 100, "file1.txt", 50)
	if op.Progress.PercentComplete != 10 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 10%%, got %f", op.Progress.PercentComplete)
	}

	// Sleep so duration > 0.1s for speed calculation
	time.Sleep(150 * time.Millisecond)
	op.UpdateProgress(2, 300, "file2.txt", 60)

	if op.Progress.ProcessedItems != 2 || op.Progress.ProcessedBytes != 300 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected progress values")
	}
	if op.Progress.CurrentFile != "file2.txt" {
		t.Fatalf("expected current file 'file2.txt', got %s", op.Progress.CurrentFile)
	}
	if op.Progress.SpeedBytesPerSec == 0 {
		t.Fatal("expected non-zero instant speed after 0.1s+ gap")
	}
	if op.Progress.AvgSpeedBytesPerSec == 0 {
		t.Fatal("expected non-zero avg speed")
	}

	// Events: start + start (SetTotal) + progress + progress
	if len(*events) < 4 {
		t.Fatalf("expected at least 4 events, got %d", len(*events))
	}
}

	m, events := newTestManager()
	op := m.StartOperation(contracts.OpCopy, "", "", "")
	op.Complete()

	if op.Progress.Status != contracts.StatusCompleted {
		t.Fatalf("expected status COMPLETED, got %s", op.Progress.Status)
	}
	if op.Progress.PercentComplete != 100 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 100%%, got %f", op.Progress.PercentComplete)
	}
	if op.Progress.EndTime == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected EndTime to be set")
	}
	if (*events)[1].name != "operation:complete" {
		t.Fatalf("expected complete event, got %s", (*events)[1].name)
	}

func TestSetErrorSetsFinalState(t *testing.T) {
	m, events := newTestManager()
	op := m.StartOperation(contracts.OpCopy, "", "", "")
	op.SetError(os.ErrPermission)

	if op.Progress.Status != contracts.StatusError {
		t.Fatalf("expected status ERROR, got %s", op.Progress.Status)
	}
	if op.Progress.Error == nil || *op.Progress.Error != os.ErrPermission.Error() {
		t.Fatalf("expected error string to be set")
	}
	if op.Progress.EndTime == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected EndTime to be set")
	}
	ce := (*events)[1].data.(completeEvent)
	if ce.Status != "error" {
		t.Fatalf("expected complete status 'error', got %s", ce.Status)
	}
	if ce.Error != os.ErrPermission.Error() {
		t.Fatalf("expected error message in complete event")
	}
}

func TestOperationKindMapping(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		input    contracts.OperationType
		expected string
	}{
		{contracts.OpCopy, "copy"},
		{contracts.OpMove, "move"},
		{contracts.OpDelete, "delete"},
		{contracts.OpArchive, "archive"},
		{contracts.OpExtract, "extract"},
		{contracts.OpSearch, "search"},
		{contracts.OpCalculate, "calculate"},
	}
	for _, tc := range tests {
		if got := operationKind(tc.input); got != tc.expected {
			t.Fatalf("operationKind(%s) = %s, want %s", tc.input, got, tc.expected)
		}
	}
}

// CalculateSize
// в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

func TestCalculateSize(t *testing.T) {
	tmp := t.TempDir()
	// Create nested structure
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(tmp, "a.txt"), []byte("hello"), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sub := filepath.Join(tmp, "sub")
	if err := os.Mkdir(sub, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(sub, "b.txt"), []byte("world!!"), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	items, bytes := CalculateSize(tmp)
	if items != 4 { // a.txt, sub, sub/b.txt, tmp root counted by walk
		t.Fatalf("expected 4 items, got %d", items)
	}
	if bytes != 12 { // "hello" (5) + "world!!" (7)
		t.Fatalf("expected 12 bytes, got %d", bytes)
	}
}

func TestCalculateSizeMissingPath(t *testing.T) {
	items, bytes := CalculateSize("/nonexistent/path/12345")
	if items != 0 || bytes != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 0 items and 0 bytes for missing path, got %d / %d", items, bytes)
	}
}

// в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ
// SetEmitter retroactive wiring
// в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

func TestSetEmitterWiresExistingOperations(t *testing.T) {
	m := NewManager()
	op := m.StartOperation(contracts.OpCopy, "", "", "")

	var events []eventRecord
	m.SetEmitter(func(name string, data interface{}) {
		events = append(events, eventRecord{name, data})
	})

	// Trigger an event via the operation to verify wiring
	op.Complete()

	if len(events) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 event after SetEmitter wiring, got %d", len(events))
	}
}
````

## File: internal/ops/manager.go
````go
package ops

import (
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"math"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"
	"time"

	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
)

type startEvent struct {
	ID          string   `json:"id"`
	Kind        string   `json:"kind"`
	Title       string   `json:"title"`
	Sources     []string `json:"sources"`
	Destination string   `json:"destination,omitempty"`
	TotalBytes  int64    `json:"totalBytes"`
	TotalItems  int64    `json:"totalItems"`
}

type progressEvent struct {
	ID              string  `json:"id"`
	ProcessedBytes  int64   `json:"processedBytes"`
	ProcessedItems  int64   `json:"processedItems"`
	CurrentFile     string  `json:"currentFile,omitempty"`
	CurrentFileSize int64   `json:"currentFileSize,omitempty"`
	SpeedBps        float64 `json:"speedBps"`
	ElapsedMs       int64   `json:"elapsedMs"`
	RemainingMs     int64   `json:"remainingMs"`
}

type completeEvent struct {
	ID           string       `json:"id"`
	Status       string       `json:"status"`
	Error        string       `json:"error,omitempty"`
	FinalMetrics finalMetrics `json:"finalMetrics"`
	Timing       finalTiming  `json:"timing"`
}

type finalMetrics struct {
	TotalBytes     int64 `json:"totalBytes"`
	ProcessedBytes int64 `json:"processedBytes"`
	TotalItems     int64 `json:"totalItems"`
	ProcessedItems int64 `json:"processedItems"`
}

type finalTiming struct {
	StartedAt            int64   `json:"startedAt"`
	ElapsedMs            int64   `json:"elapsedMs"`
	EstimatedRemainingMs int64   `json:"estimatedRemainingMs"`
	SpeedBytesPerSecond  float64 `json:"speedBytesPerSecond"`
}

const maxSpeedSamples = 10

type speedRingBuffer struct {
	buf  [maxSpeedSamples]float64
	head int
	len  int
}

func (r *speedRingBuffer) push(v float64) {
	r.buf[r.head] = v
	r.head = (r.head + 1) % maxSpeedSamples
	if r.len < maxSpeedSamples {
		r.len++
	}
}

func (r *speedRingBuffer) avg() float64 {
	if r.len == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	var sum float64
	for i := 0; i < r.len; i++ {
		idx := (r.head - r.len + i) % maxSpeedSamples
		if idx < 0 {
			idx += maxSpeedSamples
		}
		sum += r.buf[idx]
	}
	return sum / float64(r.len)
}

type progressSnapshot struct {
	timeAtStart     time.Time
	lastUpdateTime  time.Time
	lastUpdateBytes int64
	speedSamples    speedRingBuffer
}

type ActiveOperation struct {
	ID        string
	Type      contracts.OperationType
	Progress  contracts.OperationProgress
	snapshot  progressSnapshot
	cancel    chan struct{}
	mu        sync.RWMutex
	emitEvent func(string, interface{})
}

type Manager struct {
	operations map[string]*ActiveOperation
	mu         sync.RWMutex
	nextID     int
	emitEvent  func(string, interface{})
}

func NewManager() *Manager {
	return &Manager{operations: make(map[string]*ActiveOperation), nextID: 1}
}

func (om *Manager) SetEmitter(emitEvent func(string, interface{})) {
	om.mu.Lock()
	defer om.mu.Unlock()
	om.emitEvent = emitEvent
	for _, op := range om.operations {
		op.emitEvent = emitEvent
	}
}

func (om *Manager) StartOperation(opType contracts.OperationType, title, source, dest string) *ActiveOperation {
	om.mu.Lock()
	defer om.mu.Unlock()

	id := fmt.Sprintf("op-%d-%d", time.Now().Unix(), om.nextID)
	om.nextID++
	now := time.Now()
	op := &ActiveOperation{
		ID:        id,
		Type:      opType,
		emitEvent: om.emitEvent,
		Progress: contracts.OperationProgress{
			ID:              id,
			Type:            opType,
			Status:          contracts.StatusRunning,
			Title:           title,
			SourcePath:      source,
			DestinationPath: dest,
			StartTime:       now.UnixMilli(),
		},
		snapshot: progressSnapshot{timeAtStart: now, lastUpdateTime: now},
		cancel:   make(chan struct{}),
	}
	om.operations[id] = op
	op.emitStart(source, dest)
	return op
}

func (om *Manager) GetOperation(id string) *ActiveOperation {
	om.mu.RLock()
	defer om.mu.RUnlock()
	return om.operations[id]
}

func (om *Manager) ListActiveOperations() []contracts.OperationProgress {
	om.mu.RLock()
	defer om.mu.RUnlock()
	result := make([]contracts.OperationProgress, 0)
	for _, op := range om.operations {
		op.mu.RLock()
		prog := op.Progress
		op.mu.RUnlock()
		if prog.Status == contracts.StatusRunning || prog.Status == contracts.StatusPaused {
			result = append(result, prog)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func (om *Manager) CancelOperation(id string) bool {
	om.mu.Lock()
	op, exists := om.operations[id]
	if !exists {
		om.mu.Unlock()
		return false
	}
	op.mu.Lock()
	om.mu.Unlock()
	defer op.mu.Unlock()
	if op.Progress.Status == contracts.StatusRunning {
		close(op.cancel)
		op.Progress.Status = contracts.StatusCancelled
		op.emitComplete("cancelled", "")
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func (om *Manager) RemoveOperation(id string) {
	om.mu.Lock()
	delete(om.operations, id)
	om.mu.Unlock()
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) SetTotal(totalItems, totalBytes int64) {
	op.mu.Lock()
	defer op.mu.Unlock()
	op.Progress.TotalItems = totalItems
	op.Progress.TotalBytes = totalBytes
	op.emitStart(op.Progress.SourcePath, op.Progress.DestinationPath)
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) UpdateProgress(processedItems, processedBytes int64, currentFile string, currentFileSize int64) {
	op.mu.Lock()
	defer op.mu.Unlock()
	now := time.Now()
	op.Progress.ProcessedItems = processedItems
	op.Progress.ProcessedBytes = processedBytes
	op.Progress.CurrentFile = currentFile
	op.Progress.CurrentFileSize = currentFileSize
	if op.Progress.TotalBytes > 0 {
		op.Progress.PercentComplete = math.Min(100, float64(processedBytes)/float64(op.Progress.TotalBytes)*100)
	} else if op.Progress.TotalItems > 0 {
		op.Progress.PercentComplete = math.Min(100, float64(processedItems)/float64(op.Progress.TotalItems)*100)
	}
	duration := now.Sub(op.snapshot.lastUpdateTime).Seconds()
	if duration > 0.1 {
		bytesDelta := processedBytes - op.snapshot.lastUpdateBytes
		instantSpeed := float64(bytesDelta) / duration
		op.snapshot.speedSamples.push(instantSpeed)
		op.Progress.AvgSpeedBytesPerSec = op.snapshot.speedSamples.avg()
		op.Progress.SpeedBytesPerSec = instantSpeed
		op.snapshot.lastUpdateTime = now
		op.snapshot.lastUpdateBytes = processedBytes
	}
	elapsed := now.Sub(op.snapshot.timeAtStart)
	op.Progress.ElapsedSeconds = int64(elapsed.Seconds())
	var etaMs int64
	if op.Progress.AvgSpeedBytesPerSec > 0 && op.Progress.TotalBytes > 0 {
		remainingBytes := op.Progress.TotalBytes - processedBytes
		etaMs = int64(float64(remainingBytes) / op.Progress.AvgSpeedBytesPerSec * 1000)
		op.Progress.ETASeconds = etaMs / 1000
	}
	op.emitProgress(elapsed.Milliseconds(), etaMs)
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) Complete() {
	op.mu.Lock()
	defer op.mu.Unlock()
	now := time.Now().UnixMilli()
	op.Progress.Status = contracts.StatusCompleted
	op.Progress.EndTime = &now
	op.Progress.PercentComplete = 100
	op.Progress.ETASeconds = 0
	op.emitComplete("completed", "")
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) SetError(err error) {
	op.mu.Lock()
	defer op.mu.Unlock()
	now := time.Now().UnixMilli()
	msg := err.Error()
	op.Progress.Status = contracts.StatusError
	op.Progress.EndTime = &now
	op.Progress.Error = &msg
	op.emitComplete("error", msg)
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) IsCancelled() bool {
	select {
	case <-op.cancel:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) CancelSignal() <-chan struct{} {
	return op.cancel
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) AddTotalBytes(delta int64) {
	op.mu.Lock()
	defer op.mu.Unlock()
	op.Progress.TotalBytes += delta
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) emitStart(source, dest string) {
	if op.emitEvent == nil {
		return
	}
	op.emitEvent("operation:start", startEvent{ID: op.ID, Kind: operationKind(op.Type), Title: op.Progress.Title, Sources: []string{source}, Destination: dest, TotalBytes: op.Progress.TotalBytes, TotalItems: op.Progress.TotalItems})
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) emitProgress(elapsedMs, remainingMs int64) {
	if op.emitEvent == nil {
		return
	}
	op.emitEvent("operation:progress", progressEvent{ID: op.ID, ProcessedBytes: op.Progress.ProcessedBytes, ProcessedItems: op.Progress.ProcessedItems, CurrentFile: op.Progress.CurrentFile, CurrentFileSize: op.Progress.CurrentFileSize, SpeedBps: op.Progress.AvgSpeedBytesPerSec, ElapsedMs: elapsedMs, RemainingMs: remainingMs})
}

func (op *ActiveOperation) emitComplete(status, errMsg string) {
	if op.emitEvent == nil {
		return
	}
	elapsed := time.Since(op.snapshot.timeAtStart)
	op.emitEvent("operation:complete", completeEvent{ID: op.ID, Status: status, Error: errMsg, FinalMetrics: finalMetrics{TotalBytes: op.Progress.TotalBytes, ProcessedBytes: op.Progress.ProcessedBytes, TotalItems: op.Progress.TotalItems, ProcessedItems: op.Progress.ProcessedItems}, Timing: finalTiming{StartedAt: op.Progress.StartTime, ElapsedMs: elapsed.Milliseconds(), EstimatedRemainingMs: 0, SpeedBytesPerSecond: op.Progress.AvgSpeedBytesPerSec}})
}

func CalculateSize(path string) (items, bytes int64) {
	filepath.WalkDir(path, func(_ string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return nil
		}
		items++
		if !d.IsDir() {
			if info, infoErr := d.Info(); infoErr == nil {
				bytes += info.Size()
			}
		}
		return nil
	})
	return
}

func operationKind(t contracts.OperationType) string {
	switch t {
	case contracts.OpCopy:
		return "copy"
	case contracts.OpMove:
		return "move"
	case contracts.OpDelete:
		return "delete"
	case contracts.OpArchive:
		return "archive"
	case contracts.OpExtract:
		return "extract"
	case contracts.OpSearch:
		return "search"
	case contracts.OpCalculate:
		return "calculate"
	default:
		return "copy"
	}
}
````

````go
// Package plugin defines the extension points and registry for the file manager.
//
// Plugins are host-driven: the file manager defines narrow interfaces, and
// plugins register implementations at startup. There is no dynamic code loading
// (DLLs, WASM, etc.) in the initial design — plugins are either compiled into
// the binary or loaded from a trusted plugin directory.
//
// Lifecycle
//
//  1. Backend starts.
//  2. Plugin descriptors are discovered (built-in or from plugin directory).
//  3. Plugin.Init(config) is called for each plugin.
//  4. Plugin registers contributions via the Registry.
//  5. Host uses registered contributions during normal operation.
//  6. On shutdown, Plugin.Shutdown() is called.
package plugin

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
)

// Info describes a plugin for discovery and diagnostics.
type Info struct {
	ID          string            `json:"id"`
	Name        string            `json:"name"`
	Version     string            `json:"version"`
	Description string            `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Author      string            `json:"author,omitempty"`
	Schemes     []string          `json:"schemes,omitempty"`
	Extensions  []string          `json:"extensions,omitempty"`
	Commands    []CommandInfo     `json:"commands,omitempty"`
	Config      map[string]string `json:"config,omitempty"`
}

// CommandInfo describes a command exposed by a plugin.
type CommandInfo struct {
	ID        string   `json:"id"`
	Label     string   `json:"label"`
	Icon      string   `json:"icon,omitempty"`
	Hotkey    string   `json:"hotkey,omitempty"`
	AppliesTo []string `json:"appliesTo,omitempty"` // file types / extensions
}

// Plugin is the top-level interface every plugin must implement.
type Plugin interface {
	Info() Info
	Init(config map[string]any) error
	Shutdown() error
}

// Registry is the central place where plugins register their contributions.
// It is safe for concurrent use.
type Registry struct {
	plugins  map[string]Plugin
	vfs      map[string]VFSPlugin
	hooks    []OperationHook
	previews []PreviewPlugin
	commands map[string]CommandPlugin
}

// NewRegistry creates an empty plugin registry.
func NewRegistry() *Registry {
	return &Registry{
		plugins:  make(map[string]Plugin),
		vfs:      make(map[string]VFSPlugin),
		commands: make(map[string]CommandPlugin),
	}
}

// Register adds a plugin and all of its contributed interfaces to the registry.
func (r *Registry) Register(p Plugin) error {
	info := p.Info()
	if info.ID == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("plugin ID is required")
	}
	if _, exists := r.plugins[info.ID]; exists {
		return fmt.Errorf("plugin %q already registered", info.ID)
	}
	r.plugins[info.ID] = p

	// Discover contributed interfaces.
	if vp, ok := p.(VFSPlugin); ok {
		r.vfs[info.ID] = vp
	}
	if h, ok := p.(OperationHook); ok {
		r.hooks = append(r.hooks, h)
	}
	if pp, ok := p.(PreviewPlugin); ok {
		r.previews = append(r.previews, pp)
	}
	if cp, ok := p.(CommandPlugin); ok {
		r.commands[info.ID] = cp
	}

	return nil
}

// List returns metadata for all registered plugins.
func (r *Registry) List() []Info {
	out := make([]Info, 0, len(r.plugins))
	for _, p := range r.plugins {
		out = append(out, p.Info())
	}
	return out
}

// Get returns the plugin with the given ID, or nil if not found.
func (r *Registry) Get(id string) Plugin {
	return r.plugins[id]
}

// Shutdown calls Shutdown on all registered plugins.
func (r *Registry) Shutdown() {
	for _, p := range r.plugins {
		_ = p.Shutdown()
	}
}

// VFSPlugins returns all registered VFS provider plugins.
func (r *Registry) VFSPlugins() map[string]VFSPlugin {
	// Return a shallow copy to prevent external mutation.
	out := make(map[string]VFSPlugin, len(r.vfs))
	for k, v := range r.vfs {
		out[k] = v
	}
	return out
}

// OperationHooks returns all registered operation hooks.
func (r *Registry) OperationHooks() []OperationHook {
	out := make([]OperationHook, len(r.hooks))
	copy(out, r.hooks)
	return out
}

// PreviewPlugins returns all registered preview plugins.
func (r *Registry) PreviewPlugins() []PreviewPlugin {
	out := make([]PreviewPlugin, len(r.previews))
	copy(out, r.previews)
	return out
}

// CommandPlugins returns all registered command plugins.
func (r *Registry) CommandPlugins() map[string]CommandPlugin {
	out := make(map[string]CommandPlugin, len(r.commands))
	for k, v := range r.commands {
		out[k] = v
	}
	return out
}

// InvokeCommand executes a command from a plugin.
func (r *Registry) InvokeCommand(ctx context.Context, pluginID, commandID string, paths []string) error {
	p, ok := r.commands[pluginID]
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("command plugin %q not found", pluginID)
	}
	if !p.IsApplicable(commandID, paths) {
		return fmt.Errorf("plugin command %q is not applicable to the current selection", commandID)
	}
	return p.Execute(ctx, commandID, paths)
}
````

## File: internal/pluginpackage/discovery.go
````go
package pluginpackage

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

const (
	ManifestFileName = "plugin.json"
	MaxManifestBytes = 1 << 20
)

var pluginIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9._-]*[a-z0-9])?$`)
var semverPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^\d+(?:\.\d+){0,2}(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$`)

type Manifest struct {
	SchemaVersion    int                    `json:"schemaVersion"`
	ID               string                 `json:"id"`
	Name             string                 `json:"name"`
	Version          string                 `json:"version"`
	Description      string                 `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Author           string                 `json:"author,omitempty"`
	Homepage         string                 `json:"homepage,omitempty"`
	License          string                 `json:"license,omitempty"`
	APIVersion       string                 `json:"apiVersion,omitempty"`
	Permissions      []string               `json:"permissions,omitempty"`
	ActivationEvents []string               `json:"activationEvents,omitempty"`
	Contributes      map[string]interface{} `json:"contributes,omitempty"`
}

type DiscoveredPackage struct {
	Manifest     Manifest `json:"manifest"`
	Path         string   `json:"path"`
	ManifestPath string   `json:"manifestPath"`
	Valid        bool     `json:"valid"`
	Errors       []string `json:"errors,omitempty"`
	Warnings     []string `json:"warnings,omitempty"`
}

func DefaultDirectory(appName string) (string, error) {
	base, err := os.UserConfigDir()
	if err != nil {
		base, err = os.UserHomeDir()
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
	}
	return filepath.Join(base, appName, "plugins"), nil
}

func EnsureDirectory(root string) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(root) == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("plugin directory is empty")
	}
	return os.MkdirAll(root, 0o755)
}

func Discover(root string) ([]DiscoveredPackage, error) {
	if err := EnsureDirectory(root); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	rootAbs, err := filepath.Abs(root)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	entries, err := os.ReadDir(rootAbs)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	out := make([]DiscoveredPackage, 0)
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if !entry.IsDir() || entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
			continue
		}
		pkgDir := filepath.Join(rootAbs, entry.Name())
		manifestPath := filepath.Join(pkgDir, ManifestFileName)
		info, err := os.Lstat(manifestPath)
		if err != nil {
			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
				continue
			}
			out = append(out, invalidPackage(pkgDir, manifestPath, err))
			continue
		}
		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
			out = append(out, invalidPackage(pkgDir, manifestPath, fmt.Errorf("manifest must be a regular file")))
			continue
		}
		if !withinRoot(rootAbs, manifestPath) {
			out = append(out, invalidPackage(pkgDir, manifestPath, fmt.Errorf("manifest escapes plugin directory")))
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, readPackage(pkgDir, manifestPath))
	}

	markDuplicatePluginIDs(out)

	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {
		left := out[i].Manifest.ID
		if left == "" {
			left = filepath.Base(out[i].Path)
		}
		right := out[j].Manifest.ID
		if right == "" {
			right = filepath.Base(out[j].Path)
		}
		return left < right
	})
	return out, nil
}

func markDuplicatePluginIDs(packages []DiscoveredPackage) {
	counts := make(map[string]int)
	for _, pkg := range packages {
		if pkg.Manifest.ID != "" {
			counts[pkg.Manifest.ID]++
		}
	}
	for i := range packages {
		id := packages[i].Manifest.ID
		if id == "" || counts[id] < 2 {
			continue
		}
		packages[i].Errors = append(packages[i].Errors, fmt.Sprintf("duplicate plugin id %q", id))
		packages[i].Valid = false
	}
}

func readPackage(pkgDir, manifestPath string) DiscoveredPackage {
	result := DiscoveredPackage{Path: pkgDir, ManifestPath: manifestPath}
	file, err := os.Open(manifestPath)
	if err != nil {
		result.Errors = []string{err.Error()}
		return result
	}
	defer file.Close()

	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, MaxManifestBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		result.Errors = []string{err.Error()}
		return result
	}
	if len(data) > MaxManifestBytes {
		result.Errors = []string{fmt.Sprintf("manifest exceeds %d bytes", MaxManifestBytes)}
		return result
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &result.Manifest); err != nil {
		result.Errors = []string{fmt.Sprintf("invalid JSON: %v", err)}
		return result
	}

	result.Errors, result.Warnings = validateManifest(result.Manifest, filepath.Base(pkgDir))
	result.Valid = len(result.Errors) == 0
	return result
}

func validateManifest(m Manifest, directoryName string) ([]string, []string) {
	var errors []string
	var warnings []string
	if m.SchemaVersion != 1 {
		errors = append(errors, fmt.Sprintf("unsupported manifest schema %d", m.SchemaVersion))
	}
	if !pluginIDPattern.MatchString(m.ID) {
		errors = append(errors, "invalid plugin id")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(m.Name) == "" {
		errors = append(errors, "plugin name is required")
	}
	if !semverPattern.MatchString(m.Version) {
		errors = append(errors, "invalid plugin version")
	}
	if m.ID != "" && directoryName != m.ID {
		warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf("directory %q does not match plugin id %q", directoryName, m.ID))
	}
	if hasDuplicates(m.Permissions) {
		warnings = append(warnings, "duplicate permissions")
	}
	if hasDuplicates(m.ActivationEvents) {
		warnings = append(warnings, "duplicate activation events")
	}
	return errors, warnings
}

func hasDuplicates(values []string) bool {
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
			return true
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
	}
	return false
}

func withinRoot(root, path string) bool {
	rel, err := filepath.Rel(root, path)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return rel != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) && !filepath.IsAbs(rel)
}

func invalidPackage(pkgDir, manifestPath string, err error) DiscoveredPackage {
	return DiscoveredPackage{Path: pkgDir, ManifestPath: manifestPath, Errors: []string{err.Error()}}
}
````

````go
package pluginpackage

import (
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func TestStateStoreDefaultsAreConservative(t *testing.T) {
	store, err := NewStateStoreAt(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "state.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	state, err := store.Get("example")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if state.Enabled || state.Trusted || state.Quarantined {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected permissive default: %+v", state)
	}
	if len(state.GrantedPermissions) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("expected no permissions: %+v", state.GrantedPermissions)
	}
	if state.LastActivationStatus != ActivationNever {
		t.Fatalf("status = %q", state.LastActivationStatus)
	}
}

func TestStateStorePersistsUserDecisions(t *testing.T) {
	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "state.json")
	store, _ := NewStateStoreAt(path)
	enabled, trusted := true, true
	permissions := []string{"network", "commands", "commands"}
	state, err := store.Update("example", PackageStatePatch{Enabled: &enabled, Trusted: &trusted, GrantedPermissions: &permissions})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !state.Enabled || !state.Trusted {
		t.Fatalf("state not updated: %+v", state)
	}
	if len(state.GrantedPermissions) != 2 || state.GrantedPermissions[0] != "commands" || state.GrantedPermissions[1] != "network" {
		t.Fatalf("permissions = %#v", state.GrantedPermissions)
	}
	reopened, _ := NewStateStoreAt(path)
	persisted, err := reopened.Get("example")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !persisted.Enabled || !persisted.Trusted || len(persisted.GrantedPermissions) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("not persisted: %+v", persisted)
	}
}

func TestReconcileNeverBroadensTrustOrPermissions(t *testing.T) {
	store, _ := NewStateStoreAt(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "state.json"))
	enabled, trusted := true, false
	permissions := []string{"commands"}
	_, _ = store.Update("example", PackageStatePatch{Enabled: &enabled, Trusted: &trusted, GrantedPermissions: &permissions})
	if err := store.Reconcile([]DiscoveredPackage{{Valid: true, Manifest: Manifest{ID: "example", Version: "2.0.0"}}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	state, _ := store.Get("example")
	if !state.Enabled || state.Trusted {
		t.Fatalf("decisions changed: %+v", state)
	}
	if len(state.GrantedPermissions) != 1 || state.GrantedPermissions[0] != "commands" {
		t.Fatalf("permissions changed: %#v", state.GrantedPermissions)
	}
	if state.LastSeenVersion != "2.0.0" {
		t.Fatalf("version = %q", state.LastSeenVersion)
	}
}

func TestQuarantineAndActivationHealth(t *testing.T) {
	store, _ := NewStateStoreAt(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "state.json"))
	state, err := store.Quarantine("example", "activation panic")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !state.Quarantined || state.LastActivationStatus != ActivationFailed {
		t.Fatalf("bad quarantine state: %+v", state)
	}
	state, err = store.Update("example", PackageStatePatch{ClearQuarantine: true})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if state.Quarantined {
		t.Fatalf("quarantine not cleared: %+v", state)
	}
	state, err = store.RecordActivation("example", true, "ignored")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if state.LastActivationStatus != ActivationSuccess || state.LastActivationError != "" || state.LastActivatedAt == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("bad activation state: %+v", state)
	}
}

func TestReconcileDropsTrustWhenPackageVersionChanges(t *testing.T) {
	store, _ := NewStateStoreAt(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "state.json"))
	enabled, trusted := true, true
	version := "1.0.0"
	_, err := store.Update("example", PackageStatePatch{Enabled: &enabled, Trusted: &trusted, TrustedVersion: &version})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := store.Reconcile([]DiscoveredPackage{{Valid: true, Manifest: Manifest{ID: "example", Version: "2.0.0"}}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	state, err := store.Get("example")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if state.ConsecutiveActivationFailures != i {
			t.Fatalf("failure count = %d, want %d", state.ConsecutiveActivationFailures, i)
		}
	}
	if !state.Quarantined {
		t.Fatalf("expected automatic quarantine: %+v", state)
	}
	if state.QuarantineReason == "" {
		t.Fatal("expected quarantine reason")
	}
}

func TestSuccessfulActivationResetsFailureCounter(t *testing.T) {
	store, _ := NewStateStoreAt(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "state.json"))
	_, _ = store.RecordActivation("example", false, "first")
	state, err := store.RecordActivation("example", true, "")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if state.ConsecutiveActivationFailures != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("failure count = %d", state.ConsecutiveActivationFailures)
	}
	if state.Quarantined {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected quarantine: %+v", state)
	}
}

func TestClearQuarantineResetsFailureCounter(t *testing.T) {
	store, _ := NewStateStoreAt(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "state.json"))
	for i := 0; i < AutoQuarantineFailureThreshold; i++ {
		_, _ = store.RecordActivation("example", false, "boom")
	}
	state, err := store.Update("example", PackageStatePatch{ClearQuarantine: true})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if state.Quarantined || state.ConsecutiveActivationFailures != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("clear quarantine did not reset health: %+v", state)
	}
}
````

````go
package pluginpackage

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

const StateFileName = "plugin-state.json"
const AutoQuarantineFailureThreshold = 3

type ActivationStatus string

const (
	ActivationNever   ActivationStatus = "never"
	ActivationSuccess ActivationStatus = "success"
	ActivationFailed  ActivationStatus = "failed"
)

type PackageState struct {
	PluginID                      string           `json:"pluginId"`
	Enabled                       bool             `json:"enabled"`
	Trusted                       bool             `json:"trusted"`
	TrustedVersion                string           `json:"trustedVersion,omitempty"`
	GrantedPermissions            []string         `json:"grantedPermissions,omitempty"`
	Quarantined                   bool             `json:"quarantined"`
	QuarantineReason              string           `json:"quarantineReason,omitempty"`
	LastActivationStatus          ActivationStatus `json:"lastActivationStatus"`
	LastActivationError           string           `json:"lastActivationError,omitempty"`
	LastActivatedAt               int64            `json:"lastActivatedAt,omitempty"`
	ConsecutiveActivationFailures int              `json:"consecutiveActivationFailures,omitempty"`
	LastSeenVersion               string           `json:"lastSeenVersion,omitempty"`
	UpdatedAt                     int64            `json:"updatedAt"`
}

type PackageStatePatch struct {
	Enabled            *bool     `json:"enabled,omitempty"`
	Trusted            *bool     `json:"trusted,omitempty"`
	TrustedVersion     *string   `json:"-"`
	GrantedPermissions *[]string `json:"grantedPermissions,omitempty"`
	ClearQuarantine    bool      `json:"clearQuarantine,omitempty"`
}

type stateFile struct {
	Version int                     `json:"version"`
	Plugins map[string]PackageState `json:"plugins"`
}

var stateFileMu sync.Mutex

type StateStore struct {
	path string
}

func DefaultStatePath(appName string) (string, error) {
	base, err := os.UserConfigDir()
	if err != nil {
		base, err = os.UserHomeDir()
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
	}
	return filepath.Join(base, appName, StateFileName), nil
}

func NewStateStore(appName string) (*StateStore, error) {
	path, err := DefaultStatePath(appName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return NewStateStoreAt(path)
}

func NewStateStoreAt(path string) (*StateStore, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(path) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugin state path is empty")
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o700); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &StateStore{path: path}, nil
}

func (s *StateStore) List() ([]PackageState, error) {
	stateFileMu.Lock()
	defer stateFileMu.Unlock()
	data, err := s.loadLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := make([]PackageState, 0, len(data.Plugins))
	for _, state := range data.Plugins {
		state.GrantedPermissions = copyStrings(state.GrantedPermissions)
		out = append(out, state)
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].PluginID < out[j].PluginID })
	return out, nil
}

func (s *StateStore) Get(pluginID string) (PackageState, error) {
	stateFileMu.Lock()
	defer stateFileMu.Unlock()
	data, err := s.loadLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return PackageState{}, err
	}
	state, ok := data.Plugins[pluginID]
	if !ok {
		state = defaultPackageState(pluginID)
	}
	state.GrantedPermissions = copyStrings(state.GrantedPermissions)
	return state, nil
}

func (s *StateStore) Update(pluginID string, patch PackageStatePatch) (PackageState, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(pluginID) == "" {
		return PackageState{}, fmt.Errorf("plugin id is required")
	}
	stateFileMu.Lock()
	defer stateFileMu.Unlock()
	data, err := s.loadLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return PackageState{}, err
	}
	state, ok := data.Plugins[pluginID]
	if !ok {
		state = defaultPackageState(pluginID)
	}
	if patch.Enabled != nil {
		state.Enabled = *patch.Enabled
	}
	if patch.Trusted != nil {
		state.Trusted = *patch.Trusted
		if state.Trusted && patch.TrustedVersion != nil {
			state.TrustedVersion = strings.TrimSpace(*patch.TrustedVersion)
		} else if !state.Trusted {
			state.TrustedVersion = ""
		}
	}
	if patch.GrantedPermissions != nil {
		state.GrantedPermissions = uniqueSorted(*patch.GrantedPermissions)
	}
	if patch.ClearQuarantine {
		state.Quarantined = false
		state.QuarantineReason = ""
		state.ConsecutiveActivationFailures = 0
	}
	state.UpdatedAt = nowMillis()
	data.Plugins[pluginID] = state
	if err := s.saveLocked(data); err != nil {
		return PackageState{}, err
	}
	state.GrantedPermissions = copyStrings(state.GrantedPermissions)
	return state, nil
}

func (s *StateStore) Quarantine(pluginID, reason string) (PackageState, error) {
	stateFileMu.Lock()
	defer stateFileMu.Unlock()
	data, err := s.loadLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return PackageState{}, err
	}
	state, ok := data.Plugins[pluginID]
	if !ok {
		state = defaultPackageState(pluginID)
	}
	state.Quarantined = true
	state.QuarantineReason = strings.TrimSpace(reason)
	state.LastActivationStatus = ActivationFailed
	state.LastActivationError = state.QuarantineReason
	state.UpdatedAt = nowMillis()
	data.Plugins[pluginID] = state
	if err := s.saveLocked(data); err != nil {
		return PackageState{}, err
	}
	return state, nil
}

func (s *StateStore) RecordActivation(pluginID string, success bool, activationErr string) (PackageState, error) {
	stateFileMu.Lock()
	defer stateFileMu.Unlock()
	data, err := s.loadLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return PackageState{}, err
	}
	state, ok := data.Plugins[pluginID]
	if !ok {
		state = defaultPackageState(pluginID)
	}
	state.LastActivatedAt = nowMillis()
	state.LastActivationError = strings.TrimSpace(activationErr)
	if success {
		state.LastActivationStatus = ActivationSuccess
		state.LastActivationError = ""
		state.ConsecutiveActivationFailures = 0
	} else {
		state.LastActivationStatus = ActivationFailed
		state.ConsecutiveActivationFailures++
		if state.ConsecutiveActivationFailures >= AutoQuarantineFailureThreshold {
			state.Quarantined = true
			if state.LastActivationError != "" {
				state.QuarantineReason = fmt.Sprintf("Automatically quarantined after %d consecutive activation failures: %s", AutoQuarantineFailureThreshold, state.LastActivationError)
			} else {
				state.QuarantineReason = fmt.Sprintf("Automatically quarantined after %d consecutive activation failures.", AutoQuarantineFailureThreshold)
			}
		}
	}
	state.UpdatedAt = nowMillis()
	data.Plugins[pluginID] = state
	if err := s.saveLocked(data); err != nil {
		return PackageState{}, err
	}
	return state, nil
}

// Reconcile updates observational metadata for packages currently visible on disk.
// It never broadens enabled/permission decisions. Trust is version-bound: a package
// update remains enabled but must be explicitly trusted again before activation.
func (s *StateStore) Reconcile(packages []DiscoveredPackage) error {
	stateFileMu.Lock()
	defer stateFileMu.Unlock()
	data, err := s.loadLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	changedAny := false
	now := nowMillis()
	for _, pkg := range packages {
		if !pkg.Valid || strings.TrimSpace(pkg.Manifest.ID) == "" {
			continue
		}
		state, ok := data.Plugins[pkg.Manifest.ID]
		changed := false
		if !ok {
			state = defaultPackageState(pkg.Manifest.ID)
			changed = true
		}
		if state.LastSeenVersion != pkg.Manifest.Version {
			state.LastSeenVersion = pkg.Manifest.Version
			changed = true
		}
		if state.Trusted && state.TrustedVersion != "" && state.TrustedVersion != pkg.Manifest.Version {
			state.Trusted = false
			state.TrustedVersion = ""
			changed = true
		}
		if changed {
			state.UpdatedAt = now
			data.Plugins[pkg.Manifest.ID] = state
			changedAny = true
		}
	}
	if !changedAny {
		return nil
	}
	return s.saveLocked(data)
}

func defaultPackageState(pluginID string) PackageState {
	return PackageState{
		PluginID:             pluginID,
		Enabled:              false,
		Trusted:              false,
		GrantedPermissions:   []string{},
		LastActivationStatus: ActivationNever,
		UpdatedAt:            nowMillis(),
	}
}

func (s *StateStore) loadLocked() (stateFile, error) {
	data := stateFile{Version: 1, Plugins: map[string]PackageState{}}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(s.path)
	if err != nil {
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			return data, nil
		}
		return data, err
	}
	if len(raw) == 0 {
		return data, nil
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &data); err != nil {
		return stateFile{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid plugin state file: %w", err)
	}
	if data.Version != 1 {
		return stateFile{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported plugin state version %d", data.Version)
	}
	if data.Plugins == nil {
		data.Plugins = map[string]PackageState{}
	}
	return data, nil
}

func (s *StateStore) saveLocked(data stateFile) error {
	data.Version = 1
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(data, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	tmp := s.path + ".tmp"
	if err := os.WriteFile(tmp, raw, 0o600); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.Rename(tmp, s.path); err != nil {
		_ = os.Remove(tmp)
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func uniqueSorted(values []string) []string {
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
	out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
		if value == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
			continue
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
		out = append(out, value)
	}
	sort.Strings(out)
	return out
}

func copyStrings(values []string) []string { return append([]string(nil), values...) }
func nowMillis() int64                     { return time.Now().UnixMilli() }

// ValidateGrantedPermissions ensures persisted grants cannot exceed the permissions
// requested by the package manifest. Unknown grants are rejected at the backend boundary.
func ValidateGrantedPermissions(manifest Manifest, granted []string) error {
	requested := make(map[string]struct{}, len(manifest.Permissions))
	for _, permission := range manifest.Permissions {
		requested[permission] = struct{}{}
	}
	for _, permission := range granted {
		if _, ok := requested[permission]; !ok {
			return fmt.Errorf("plugin %s did not request permission %q", manifest.ID, permission)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
````

````go
package runtime

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"path/filepath"

	internalarchive "wails-app/internal/archive"
	"wails-app/internal/contentprobe"
	contracts "wails-app/internal/contracts"
	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
	vfslib "wails-app/vfs"
	"wails-app/vfs/memory"
	"wails-app/vfs/mount"
	"wails-app/vfs/osfs"
	"wails-app/vfs/registry"

	_ "wails-app/vfs/archive/7z"
	_ "wails-app/vfs/archive/rar"
	_ "wails-app/vfs/archive/tar"
	_ "wails-app/vfs/archive/zip"
)

func InitVFS(memoryFS *memory.FS) (*vfslib.Unified, error) {
	manager := mount.NewManager(osfs.New("/"))
	vfs := vfslib.NewUnified(manager)

	if memoryFS != nil {
		if _, err := vfs.Mount("/memory", memoryFS, false, "Memory", vfslib.VolumeMemory); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	if regFS, err := registry.New(); err == nil {
		if _, err := vfs.Mount("/registry", regFS, true, "Registry", vfslib.VolumeRegistry); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	return vfs, nil
}

func VFSListDir(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string) (*contracts.DirectoryListing, error) {
	publicPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
	entries, err := vfs.ReadDir(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	files := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(entries))
	var total int64
	for _, entry := range entries {
		file := convertVFSInfo(entry)
		file.Path = pathref.FromVFSEntry(publicPath, file.Path)
		if len(file.NestedChain) > 0 {
			for index, nested := range file.NestedChain {
				file.NestedChain[index] = pathref.FromVFSEntry(publicPath, nested)
			}
		}
		files = append(files, file)
		total += file.Size
	}

	return &contracts.DirectoryListing{
		Path:      publicPath,
		Entries:   files,
		TotalSize: total,
	}, nil
}

func VFSOpenArchive(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string, nested []string) (contracts.ArchiveListing, error) {
	mountPoint, err := mountArchive(ctx, vfs, path, nested)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.ArchiveListing{}, err
	}

	entries, err := vfs.ReadDir(ctx, mountPoint)
	if err != nil {
		return contracts.ArchiveListing{}, err
	}

	files := make([]contracts.FileInfo, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		files = append(files, convertVFSInfoWithChain(entry, nested))
	}

	return contracts.ArchiveListing{
		ArchivePath: path,
		InnerPath:   mountPoint,
		NestedChain: nested,
		Entries:     files,
	}, nil
}

func VFSReadFileRange(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string, offset int64, length int) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	publicPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
	file, err := vfs.Open(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	info, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	fileSize := info.Size()

	if offset < 0 {
		offset = 0
	}
	if offset > fileSize {
		offset = fileSize
	}
	available := fileSize - offset
	if int64(length) > available {
		length = int(available)
	}
	if length <= 0 {
		return &contracts.FileContent{
			Path:     publicPath,
			Content:  "",
			Encoding: "base64",
			Size:     fileSize,
		}, nil
	}

	if _, seekErr := file.Seek(offset, io.SeekStart); seekErr != nil {
		return nil, seekErr
	}

	buf := make([]byte, length)
	n, err := io.ReadFull(file, buf)
	if err != nil && err != io.ErrUnexpectedEOF {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.FileContent{
		Path:     publicPath,
		Content:  base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(buf[:n]),
		Encoding: "base64",
		Size:     fileSize,
	}, nil
}

func VFSReadFile(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string, encoding string) (*contracts.FileContent, error) {
	publicPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
	file, err := vfs.Open(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	data, err := io.ReadAll(file)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	probe := contentprobe.ProbeBytes(data)
	if encoding == "" {
		encoding = "utf8"
		if probe.IsText && probe.Encoding != "" {
			encoding = probe.Encoding
		}
	}

	content, err := contentprobe.Decode(data, encoding)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.FileContent{
		Path:     publicPath,
		Content:  content,
		Encoding: encoding,
		Size:     int64(len(data)),
	}, nil
}

func VFSGetFileInfo(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string) (*contracts.FileInfo, error) {
	publicPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
	info, err := vfs.Stat(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	fi := convertVFSInfo(info)
	fi.Path = publicPath
	return &fi, nil
}

func VFSProbeFile(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string) (*contracts.FileProbe, error) {
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
	file, err := vfs.Open(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	_, probe, err := contentprobe.ProbeReader(file)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &contracts.FileProbe{
		MimeType:  probe.MimeType,
		Encoding:  probe.Encoding,
		IsText:    probe.IsText,
		IsArchive: probe.IsArchive,
	}, nil
}

func VFSWriteFile(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string, content string, encoding string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	publicPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)

	var data []byte
	var err error
	if encoding == "base64" {
		data, err = base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(content)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	} else {
		data = []byte(content)
	}

	file, err := vfs.Create(ctx, internalPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer file.Close()

	if _, err := file.Write(data); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := file.Sync(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "File written successfully",
		AffectedPaths: []string{publicPath},
	}, nil
}

func VFSMkdir(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	publicPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
	if err := vfs.Mkdir(ctx, internalPath, 0755); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "Directory created successfully",
		AffectedPaths: []string{publicPath},
	}, nil
}

func VFSRemove(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string) (*contracts.OperationResult, error) {
	publicPath := pathref.Normalize(path)
	internalPath := pathref.ToVFS(path)
	if err := vfs.Remove(ctx, internalPath); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &contracts.OperationResult{
		Success:       true,
		Message:       "Deleted successfully",
		AffectedPaths: []string{publicPath},
	}, nil
}

func VFSMountArchive(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, path string) (string, error) {
	return mountArchive(ctx, vfs, path, nil)
}

func VFSUnmount(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, mountPoint string) error {
	return vfs.Unmount(mountPoint)
}

func mountArchive(ctx context.Context, vfs *vfslib.Unified, osPath string, nested []string) (string, error) {
	osPath = pathref.ToNativePath(osPath)
	arch, err := internalarchive.ResolveChain(ctx, osPath, nested, "")
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("vfs: open archive %q (chain %v): %w", osPath, nested, err)
	}

	mountPoint := archiveMountPoint(osPath, nested)
	if _, err := vfs.Mount(mountPoint, arch, true, filepath.Base(osPath), vfslib.VolumeArchive); err != nil {
		_ = arch.Close()
		return "", fmt.Errorf("vfs: mount %q -> %q: %w", osPath, mountPoint, err)
	}
	return mountPoint, nil
}

func archiveMountPoint(osPath string, nested []string) string {
	base := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean("/archives/" + osPath))
	for _, nestedPath := range nested {
		base += "/" + filepath.ToSlash(nestedPath)
	}
	return base
}

func convertVFSInfo(entry vfslib.FileInfo) contracts.FileInfo {
	return convertVFSInfoWithChain(entry, nil)
}

func convertVFSInfoWithChain(entry vfslib.FileInfo, parentChain []string) contracts.FileInfo {
	fileType := contracts.FileTypeFile
	switch {
	case entry.IsDir():
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeDirectory
	case entry.IsArchive():
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeArchive
	case entry.IsSymlink():
		fileType = contracts.FileTypeSymlink
	}

	var nestedChain []string
	if fileType == contracts.FileTypeArchive {
		nestedChain = append(append([]string{}, parentChain...), entry.Path())
	}

	file := contracts.FileInfo{
		Name:        entry.Name(),
		Path:        entry.Path(),
		Type:        fileType,
		MimeType:    mime.TypeByExtension(filepath.Ext(entry.Name())),
		Size:        entry.Size(),
		Modified:    entry.ModTime().Unix(),
		IsHidden:    entry.IsHidden(),
		IsSymlink:   entry.IsSymlink(),
		IsNested:    fileType == contracts.FileTypeArchive,
		NestedChain: nestedChain,
	}

	registry.ApplyFileInfoMetadata(&file, entry)

	return file
}
````

````go
package workspace

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

// Store owns byte-level persistence for workspace state without depending on
// app wire types or Wails-facing contracts.
type Store struct {
	statePath string
}

func NewStore(appName string) (*Store, error) {
	base, err := os.UserConfigDir()
	if err != nil {
		base, err = os.UserHomeDir()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	dir := filepath.Join(base, appName)
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &Store{statePath: filepath.Join(dir, "state.json")}, nil
}

func (s *Store) ReadState() ([]byte, error) {
	return os.ReadFile(s.statePath)
}

func (s *Store) WriteState(data []byte) error {
	return os.WriteFile(s.statePath, data, 0644)
}

func (s *Store) StatePath() string {
	return s.statePath
}
````

````go
package cloudutil

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"path"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"wails-app/vfs"
	vfsarchive "wails-app/vfs/archive"
)

// CleanPath normalizes a VFS-relative remote path into slash-separated form.
func CleanPath(p string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimLeft(strings.ReplaceAll(p, `\`, `/`), "/")
	if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "." {
		return ""
	}
	cleaned := path.Clean(trimmed)
	if cleaned == "." {
		return ""
	}
	return cleaned
}

// Info is a small read-only VFS file info implementation for cloud adapters.
type Info struct {
	NameValue    string
	SizeValue    int64
	ModifiedTime time.Time
	Dir          bool
}

func (fi *Info) Name() string { return fi.NameValue }
func (fi *Info) Size() int64  { return fi.SizeValue }
func (fi *Info) Mode() fs.FileMode {
	if fi.Dir {
		return fs.ModeDir | 0o555
	}
	return 0o444
}
func (fi *Info) ModTime() time.Time   { return fi.ModifiedTime }
func (fi *Info) IsDir() bool          { return fi.Dir }
func (fi *Info) Sys() any             { return nil }
func (fi *Info) Path() string         { return fi.NameValue }
func (fi *Info) RealPath() string     { return "" }
func (fi *Info) Volume() vfs.Volume   { return nil }
func (fi *Info) IsArchive() bool      { return !fi.Dir && isArchiveExt(fi.NameValue) }
func (fi *Info) IsHidden() bool       { return strings.HasPrefix(fi.NameValue, ".") }
func (fi *Info) IsSymlink() bool      { return false }
func (fi *Info) IsNested() bool       { return false }
func (fi *Info) MountChain() []string { return nil }

var _ vfs.FileInfo = (*Info)(nil)

// Loader downloads file content on first access.
type Loader func(context.Context) ([]byte, error)

// ReadOnlyFile is a small in-memory, read-only file handle for cloud adapters.
type ReadOnlyFile struct {
	ctx      context.Context
	info     vfs.FileInfo
	loader   Loader
	loadOnce sync.Once
	loadErr  error
	data     []byte
	pos      int64
}

// NewReadOnlyFile returns a lazily-loaded in-memory file handle.
func NewReadOnlyFile(ctx context.Context, info vfs.FileInfo, loader Loader) *ReadOnlyFile {
	return &ReadOnlyFile{
		ctx:    ctx,
		info:   info,
		loader: loader,
	}
}

func (f *ReadOnlyFile) ensureLoaded() error {
	f.loadOnce.Do(func() {
		f.data, f.loadErr = f.loader(f.ctx)
	})
	return f.loadErr
}

func (f *ReadOnlyFile) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
	if len(p) == 0 {
		return 0, nil
	}
	if err := f.ensureLoaded(); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if f.pos >= int64(len(f.data)) {
		return 0, io.EOF
	}
	n := copy(p, f.data[f.pos:])
	f.pos += int64(n)
	return n, nil
}

func (f *ReadOnlyFile) Write(_ []byte) (int, error) {
	return 0, vfs.ErrReadOnly
}

func (f *ReadOnlyFile) Seek(offset int64, whence int) (int64, error) {
	if err := f.ensureLoaded(); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}

	next := offset
	switch whence {
	case io.SeekStart:
	case io.SeekCurrent:
		next = f.pos + offset
	case io.SeekEnd:
		next = int64(len(f.data)) + offset
	default:
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("cloudutil: invalid seek whence %d", whence)
	}
	if next < 0 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("cloudutil: negative seek position")
	}
	f.pos = next
	return f.pos, nil
}

func (f *ReadOnlyFile) Close() error {
	return nil
}

func (f *ReadOnlyFile) Stat() (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	return f.info, nil
}

func (f *ReadOnlyFile) Sync() error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}

var _ vfs.File = (*ReadOnlyFile)(nil)

func isArchiveExt(name string) bool {
	return vfsarchive.IsArchiveExt(name)
}
````

````go
// Package dropbox provides a read-only vfs.FileSystem backed by the Dropbox API.
package dropbox

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"

	"io/fs"

	"path"
	"strings"
````
