````go
	"wails-app/vfs"
	"wails-app/vfs/cloudutil"
)

const (
	apiBaseURL     = "https://api.dropboxapi.com/2"
	contentBaseURL = "https://content.dropboxapi.com/2"
)

// Config holds Dropbox connection parameters.
type Config struct {
	AccessToken string
	TokenSource cloudutil.AccessTokenSource
}

// FS implements vfs.FileSystem over the Dropbox file API.
type FS struct {
	client      *http.Client
	tokenSource cloudutil.AccessTokenSource
}

var _ vfs.FileSystem = (*FS)(nil)

type metadata struct {
	Tag            string `json:".tag"`
	Name           string `json:"name"`
	Size           int64  `json:"size,omitempty"`
	ClientModified string `json:"client_modified,omitempty"`
	ServerModified string `json:"server_modified,omitempty"`
}

type listFolderResponse struct {
	Entries []metadata `json:"entries"`
	Cursor  string     `json:"cursor"`
	HasMore bool       `json:"has_more"`
}

func New(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*FS, error) {
	source := cfg.TokenSource
	if source == nil {
		var err error
		source, err = cloudutil.NewStaticAccessTokenSource(cfg.AccessToken)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("dropbox: %w", err)
		}
	}

	fs := &FS{
		client:      &http.Client{Timeout: 60 * time.Second},
		tokenSource: source,
	}
	if _, err := fs.listFolder(ctx, ""); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return fs, nil
}

func (f *FS) Open(ctx context.Context, p string) (vfs.File, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	if cleaned == "" {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFile
	}

	info, err := f.statMetadata(ctx, cleaned)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if info.IsDir() {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFile
	}

	return cloudutil.NewReadOnlyFile(ctx, info, func(ctx context.Context) ([]byte, error) {
		return f.download(ctx, cleaned)
	}), nil
}

func (f *FS) Stat(ctx context.Context, p string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	if cleaned == "" {
		return &cloudutil.Info{NameValue: "Dropbox", Dir: true}, nil
	}
	return f.statMetadata(ctx, cleaned)
}

func (f *FS) ReadDir(ctx context.Context, p string) ([]vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	if cleaned != "" {
		info, err := f.statMetadata(ctx, cleaned)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if !info.IsDir() {
			return nil, vfs.ErrNotDir
		}
	}

	entries, err := f.listFolder(ctx, cleaned)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	result := make([]vfs.FileInfo, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		result = append(result, toInfo(entry))
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (f *FS) Exists(ctx context.Context, p string) bool {
	_, err := f.Stat(ctx, p)
	return err == nil
}

func (f *FS) Create(_ context.Context, _ string) (vfs.File, error) { return nil, vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (f *FS) Mkdir(_ context.Context, _ string, _ fs.FileMode) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}
func (f *FS) Remove(_ context.Context, _ string) error { return vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (f *FS) Rename(_ context.Context, _, _ string) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}
func (f *FS) Join(elem ...string) string        { return path.Join(elem...) }
func (f *FS) Split(p string) (string, string)   { return path.Split(p) }
func (f *FS) IsAbs(p string) bool               { return strings.HasPrefix(p, "/") }
func (f *FS) RealPath(_ string) (string, error) { return "", nil }

func (f *FS) statMetadata(ctx context.Context, cleaned string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	var meta metadata
	if err := f.postJSON(ctx, apiBaseURL+"/files/get_metadata", map[string]string{
		"path": dropboxPath(cleaned),
	}, &meta, nil); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return toInfo(meta), nil
}

func (f *FS) listFolder(ctx context.Context, cleaned string) ([]metadata, error) {
	var response listFolderResponse
	if err := f.postJSON(ctx, apiBaseURL+"/files/list_folder", map[string]any{
		"path": dropboxPath(cleaned),
	}, &response, nil); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	entries := append([]metadata{}, response.Entries...)
	cursor := response.Cursor
	for response.HasMore {
		response = listFolderResponse{}
		if err := f.postJSON(ctx, apiBaseURL+"/files/list_folder/continue", map[string]string{
			"cursor": cursor,
		}, &response, nil); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		entries = append(entries, response.Entries...)
		cursor = response.Cursor
	}

	return entries, nil
}

func (f *FS) download(ctx context.Context, cleaned string) ([]byte, error) {
	headers := map[string]string{
		"Dropbox-API-Arg": mustJSON(map[string]string{"path": dropboxPath(cleaned)}),
	}
	request, err := f.newRequest(ctx, http.MethodPost, contentBaseURL+"/files/download", nil, headers)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	response, err := f.client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()

	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
	}
	if response.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 4*1024))
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("dropbox: download failed: HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}
	return io.ReadAll(response.Body)
}

func (f *FS) postJSON(ctx context.Context, endpoint string, body any, target any, headers map[string]string) error {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(body)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	request, err := f.newRequest(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload), headers)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	response, err := f.client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()

	switch response.StatusCode {
	case http.StatusOK:
	case http.StatusNotFound:
		return vfs.ErrNotFound
	default:
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 4*1024))
		return fmt.Errorf("dropbox: request failed: HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}

	return json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(target)
}

func (f *FS) newRequest(ctx context.Context, method string, endpoint string, body io.Reader, headers map[string]string) (*http.Request, error) {
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, endpoint, body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	token, err := f.tokenSource.AccessToken(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	for key, value := range headers {
		request.Header.Set(key, value)
	}
	return request, nil
}

func dropboxPath(cleaned string) string {
	if cleaned == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return "/" + cleaned
}

func toInfo(meta metadata) *cloudutil.Info {
	modified := parseTime(meta.ServerModified)
	if modified.IsZero() {
		modified = parseTime(meta.ClientModified)
	}
	return &cloudutil.Info{
		NameValue:    meta.Name,
		SizeValue:    meta.Size,
		ModifiedTime: modified,
		Dir:          meta.Tag == "folder",
	}
}

func parseTime(value string) time.Time {
	if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
		return time.Time{}
	}
	parsed, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, value)
	return parsed
}

func mustJSON(value any) string {
	data, _ := json.Marshal(value)
	return string(data)
}
````

````go
// Package gdrive provides a read-only vfs.FileSystem backed by the Google Drive API.
package gdrive

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"path"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"wails-app/vfs"
	"wails-app/vfs/cloudutil"
)

const apiBaseURL = "https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3"

// Config holds Google Drive connection parameters.
type Config struct {
	AccessToken string
	TokenSource cloudutil.AccessTokenSource
}

// FS implements vfs.FileSystem over the Google Drive API.
type FS struct {
	client        *http.Client
	tokenSource   cloudutil.AccessTokenSource
	rootName      string
	childrenMu    sync.RWMutex
	childrenCache map[string][]fileMetadata
}

var _ vfs.FileSystem = (*FS)(nil)

type fileMetadata struct {
	ID              string          `json:"id"`
	Name            string          `json:"name"`
	MimeType        string          `json:"mimeType"`
	Size            string          `json:"size,omitempty"`
	ModifiedTime    string          `json:"modifiedTime,omitempty"`
	ShortcutDetails shortcutDetails `json:"shortcutDetails,omitempty"`
}

type shortcutDetails struct {
	TargetID       string `json:"targetId,omitempty"`
	TargetMimeType string `json:"targetMimeType,omitempty"`
}

type listResponse struct {
	Files         []fileMetadata `json:"files"`
	NextPageToken string         `json:"nextPageToken"`
}

func New(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*FS, error) {
	source := cfg.TokenSource
	if source == nil {
		var err error
		source, err = cloudutil.NewStaticAccessTokenSource(cfg.AccessToken)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("gdrive: %w", err)
		}
	}

	fs := &FS{
		client:        &http.Client{Timeout: 60 * time.Second},
		tokenSource:   source,
		childrenCache: make(map[string][]fileMetadata),
	}

	root, err := fs.fetchMetadataByID(ctx, "root")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	fs.rootName = root.Name
	return fs, nil
}

func (f *FS) Open(ctx context.Context, p string) (vfs.File, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	if cleaned == "" {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFile
	}

	meta, err := f.resolvePath(ctx, cleaned)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	info := toInfo(meta)
	if info.IsDir() {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFile
	}
	if isGoogleWorkspaceFile(meta) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("gdrive: native Google Workspace files are not downloadable yet")
	}

	id := resolvedID(meta)
	return cloudutil.NewReadOnlyFile(ctx, info, func(ctx context.Context) ([]byte, error) {
		return f.download(ctx, id)
	}), nil
}

func (f *FS) Stat(ctx context.Context, p string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	if cleaned == "" {
		name := f.rootName
		if name == "" {
			name = "Google Drive"
		}
		return &cloudutil.Info{NameValue: name, Dir: true}, nil
	}

	meta, err := f.resolvePath(ctx, cleaned)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return toInfo(meta), nil
}

func (f *FS) ReadDir(ctx context.Context, p string) ([]vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	parentID := "root"
	if cleaned != "" {
		meta, err := f.resolvePath(ctx, cleaned)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if resolvedMimeType(meta) != folderMimeType {
			return nil, vfs.ErrNotDir
		}
		parentID = resolvedID(meta)
	}

	children, err := f.listChildren(ctx, parentID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	result := make([]vfs.FileInfo, 0, len(children))
	for _, child := range children {
		result = append(result, toInfo(child))
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (f *FS) Exists(ctx context.Context, p string) bool {
	_, err := f.Stat(ctx, p)
	return err == nil
}

func (f *FS) Create(_ context.Context, _ string) (vfs.File, error) { return nil, vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (f *FS) Mkdir(_ context.Context, _ string, _ fs.FileMode) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}
func (f *FS) Remove(_ context.Context, _ string) error { return vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (f *FS) Rename(_ context.Context, _, _ string) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}
func (f *FS) Join(elem ...string) string        { return path.Join(elem...) }
func (f *FS) Split(p string) (string, string)   { return path.Split(p) }
func (f *FS) IsAbs(p string) bool               { return strings.HasPrefix(p, "/") }
func (f *FS) RealPath(_ string) (string, error) { return "", nil }

func (f *FS) resolvePath(ctx context.Context, cleaned string) (fileMetadata, error) {
	currentID := "root"
	segments := strings.Split(cleaned, "/")
	for index, segment := range segments {
		children, err := f.listChildren(ctx, currentID)
		if err != nil {
			return fileMetadata{}, err
		}

		candidate, ok := chooseByName(children, segment, index < len(segments)-1)
		if !ok {
			return fileMetadata{}, vfs.ErrNotFound
		}

		if index < len(segments)-1 && resolvedMimeType(candidate) != folderMimeType {
			return fileMetadata{}, vfs.ErrNotFound
		}

		currentID = resolvedID(candidate)
		if index == len(segments)-1 {
			return candidate, nil
		}
	}
	return fileMetadata{}, vfs.ErrNotFound
}

func (f *FS) listChildren(ctx context.Context, parentID string) ([]fileMetadata, error) {
	f.childrenMu.RLock()
	if cached, ok := f.childrenCache[parentID]; ok {
		f.childrenMu.RUnlock()
		return append([]fileMetadata(nil), cached...), nil
	}
	f.childrenMu.RUnlock()

	query := url.Values{}
	query.Set("q", fmt.Sprintf("'%s' in parents and trashed = false", strings.ReplaceAll(parentID, "'", "\\'")))
	query.Set("fields", "nextPageToken,files(id,name,mimeType,size,modifiedTime,shortcutDetails(targetId,targetMimeType))")
	query.Set("pageSize", "1000")
	query.Set("supportsAllDrives", "true")
	query.Set("includeItemsFromAllDrives", "true")

	nextToken := ""
	files := make([]fileMetadata, 0)
	for {
		pageQuery := cloneValues(query)
		if nextToken != "" {
			pageQuery.Set("pageToken", nextToken)
		}
		var response listResponse
		if err := f.getJSON(ctx, apiBaseURL+"/files?"+pageQuery.Encode(), &response); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		files = append(files, response.Files...)
		if response.NextPageToken == "" {
			break
		}
		nextToken = response.NextPageToken
	}

	f.childrenMu.Lock()
	f.childrenCache[parentID] = append([]fileMetadata(nil), files...)
	f.childrenMu.Unlock()
	return files, nil
}

func (f *FS) fetchMetadataByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (fileMetadata, error) {
	query := url.Values{}
	query.Set("fields", "id,name,mimeType,size,modifiedTime,shortcutDetails(targetId,targetMimeType)")
	query.Set("supportsAllDrives", "true")

	var meta fileMetadata
	if err := f.getJSON(ctx, apiBaseURL+"/files/"+url.PathEscape(id)+"?"+query.Encode(), &meta); err != nil {
		return fileMetadata{}, err
	}
	return meta, nil
}

func (f *FS) download(ctx context.Context, id string) ([]byte, error) {
	query := url.Values{}
	query.Set("alt", "media")
	query.Set("supportsAllDrives", "true")

	request, err := f.newRequest(ctx, http.MethodGet, apiBaseURL+"/files/"+url.PathEscape(id)+"?"+query.Encode())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	response, err := f.client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()

	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
	}
	if response.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 4*1024))
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("gdrive: download failed: HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}
	return io.ReadAll(response.Body)
}

func (f *FS) getJSON(ctx context.Context, endpoint string, target any) error {
	request, err := f.newRequest(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	response, err := f.client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()

	switch response.StatusCode {
	case http.StatusOK:
	case http.StatusNotFound:
		return vfs.ErrNotFound
	default:
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 4*1024))
		return fmt.Errorf("gdrive: request failed: HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}
	return json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(target)
}

func (f *FS) newRequest(ctx context.Context, method string, endpoint string) (*http.Request, error) {
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	token, err := f.tokenSource.AccessToken(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	return request, nil
}

func chooseByName(children []fileMetadata, name string, wantDir bool) (fileMetadata, bool) {
	for _, child := range children {
		if child.Name == name && resolvedMimeType(child) == folderMimeType && wantDir {
			return child, true
		}
	}
	for _, child := range children {
		if child.Name == name {
			return child, true
		}
	}
	return fileMetadata{}, false
}

func toInfo(meta fileMetadata) *cloudutil.Info {
	return &cloudutil.Info{
		NameValue:    meta.Name,
		SizeValue:    parseSize(meta.Size),
		ModifiedTime: parseTime(meta.ModifiedTime),
		Dir:          resolvedMimeType(meta) == folderMimeType,
	}
}

func resolvedID(meta fileMetadata) string {
	if meta.ShortcutDetails.TargetID != "" {
		return meta.ShortcutDetails.TargetID
	}
	return meta.ID
}

func resolvedMimeType(meta fileMetadata) string {
	if meta.ShortcutDetails.TargetMimeType != "" {
		return meta.ShortcutDetails.TargetMimeType
	}
	return meta.MimeType
}

func parseSize(value string) int64 {
	if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
		return 0
	}
	parsed, _ := strconv.ParseInt(value, 10, 64)
	return parsed
}

func parseTime(value string) time.Time {
	if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
		return time.Time{}
	}
	parsed, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, value)
	return parsed
}

func cloneValues(source url.Values) url.Values {
	target := make(url.Values, len(source))
	for key, values := range source {
		target[key] = append([]string(nil), values...)
	}
	return target
}

const folderMimeType = "application/vnd.google-apps.folder"

func isGoogleWorkspaceFile(meta fileMetadata) bool {
	mimeType := resolvedMimeType(meta)
	return strings.HasPrefix(mimeType, "application/vnd.google-apps.") && mimeType != folderMimeType
}
````

````go
// Package onedrive provides a read-only vfs.FileSystem backed by the Microsoft Graph OneDrive API.
package onedrive

import (

	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"

	"path"

const graphBaseURL = "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0"

// Config holds OneDrive connection parameters.

// FS implements vfs.FileSystem over the OneDrive API.
type FS struct {

	tokenSource cloudutil.AccessTokenSource

var _ vfs.FileSystem = (*FS)(nil)

type item struct {
	Name                 string          `json:"name"`
	Size                 int64           `json:"size"`
	LastModifiedDateTime string          `json:"lastModifiedDateTime"`
	File                 json.RawMessage `json:"file"`
	Folder               json.RawMessage `json:"folder"`
}

type childrenResponse struct {
	Value    []item `json:"value"`
	NextLink string `json:"@odata.nextLink"`
}

func New(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*FS, error) {
	source := cfg.TokenSource
	if source == nil {
		var err error
		source, err = cloudutil.NewStaticAccessTokenSource(cfg.AccessToken)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("onedrive: %w", err)
		}
	}

	fs := &FS{
		client:      &http.Client{Timeout: 60 * time.Second},
		tokenSource: source,
	}
	if _, err := fs.fetchItem(ctx, ""); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return fs, nil
}

func (f *FS) Open(ctx context.Context, p string) (vfs.File, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	if cleaned == "" {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFile
	}

	meta, err := f.fetchItem(ctx, cleaned)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	info := toInfo(meta)
	if info.IsDir() {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFile
	}

	return cloudutil.NewReadOnlyFile(ctx, info, func(ctx context.Context) ([]byte, error) {
		return f.download(ctx, cleaned)
	}), nil
}

func (f *FS) Stat(ctx context.Context, p string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	meta, err := f.fetchItem(ctx, cleaned)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	info := toInfo(meta)
	if cleaned == "" && info.Name() == "" {
		info.NameValue = "OneDrive"
	}
	return info, nil
}

func (f *FS) ReadDir(ctx context.Context, p string) ([]vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	cleaned := cloudutil.CleanPath(p)
	if cleaned != "" {
		meta, err := f.fetchItem(ctx, cleaned)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if len(meta.Folder) == 0 {
			return nil, vfs.ErrNotDir
		}
	}

	nextURL := graphBaseURL + childrenEndpoint(cleaned) + "?$select=name,size,lastModifiedDateTime,file,folder"
	result := make([]vfs.FileInfo, 0)
	for nextURL != "" {
		var response childrenResponse
		if err := f.getJSON(ctx, nextURL, &response); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		for _, entry := range response.Value {
			result = append(result, toInfo(entry))
		}
		nextURL = response.NextLink
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (f *FS) Exists(ctx context.Context, p string) bool {
	_, err := f.Stat(ctx, p)
	return err == nil
}

func (f *FS) Create(_ context.Context, _ string) (vfs.File, error) { return nil, vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (f *FS) Mkdir(_ context.Context, _ string, _ fs.FileMode) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}
func (f *FS) Remove(_ context.Context, _ string) error { return vfs.ErrReadOnly }
func (f *FS) Rename(_ context.Context, _, _ string) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}
func (f *FS) Join(elem ...string) string        { return path.Join(elem...) }
func (f *FS) Split(p string) (string, string)   { return path.Split(p) }
func (f *FS) IsAbs(p string) bool               { return strings.HasPrefix(p, "/") }
func (f *FS) RealPath(_ string) (string, error) { return "", nil }

func (f *FS) fetchItem(ctx context.Context, cleaned string) (item, error) {
	endpoint := graphBaseURL + itemEndpoint(cleaned)
	query := "?$select=name,size,lastModifiedDateTime,file,folder"
	var response item
	if err := f.getJSON(ctx, endpoint+query, &response); err != nil {
		return item{}, err
	}
	return response, nil
}

func (f *FS) download(ctx context.Context, cleaned string) ([]byte, error) {
	request, err := f.newRequest(ctx, http.MethodGet, graphBaseURL+contentEndpoint(cleaned), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	response, err := f.client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()

	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
	}
	if response.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 4*1024))
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("onedrive: download failed: HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}
	return io.ReadAll(response.Body)
}

func (f *FS) getJSON(ctx context.Context, endpoint string, target any) error {
	request, err := f.newRequest(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	response, err := f.client.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()

	switch response.StatusCode {
	case http.StatusOK:
	case http.StatusNotFound:
		return vfs.ErrNotFound
	default:
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 4*1024))
		return fmt.Errorf("onedrive: request failed: HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, strings.TrimSpace(string(body)))
	}
	return json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(target)
}

func (f *FS) newRequest(ctx context.Context, method string, endpoint string, body io.Reader) (*http.Request, error) {
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, endpoint, body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	token, err := f.tokenSource.AccessToken(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
	return request, nil
}

func itemEndpoint(cleaned string) string {
	if cleaned == "" {
		return "/me/drive/root"
	}
	return "/me/drive/root:/" + escapePath(cleaned) + ":"
}

func childrenEndpoint(cleaned string) string {
	if cleaned == "" {
		return "/me/drive/root/children"
	}
	return itemEndpoint(cleaned) + "/children"
}

func contentEndpoint(cleaned string) string {
	return itemEndpoint(cleaned) + "/content"
}

func escapePath(cleaned string) string {
	parts := strings.Split(cleaned, "/")
	for index, part := range parts {
		parts[index] = url.PathEscape(part)
	}
	return strings.Join(parts, "/")
}

func toInfo(meta item) *cloudutil.Info {
	return &cloudutil.Info{
		NameValue:    meta.Name,
		SizeValue:    meta.Size,
		ModifiedTime: parseTime(meta.LastModifiedDateTime),
		Dir:          len(meta.Folder) > 0,
	}
}

func parseTime(value string) time.Time {
	if strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
		return time.Time{}
	}
	parsed, _ := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, value)
	return parsed
}
````

````go
func TestNewAnonymousPublicBucket(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("WAILS_APP_RUN_NETWORK_TESTS") != "1" {
		t.Skip("set WAILS_APP_RUN_NETWORK_TESTS=1 to run network-backed S3 tests")
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	fs, err := New(ctx, Config{

		Bucket:    "colorado-public-imagery",
		Prefix:    "DRAPP",
		Anonymous: true,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("New returned error: %v", err)
	}
	defer fs.Close()

	entries, err := fs.ReadDir(ctx, "")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ReadDir returned error: %v", err)
	}
````

````go
package vfs

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	vpath "path"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"wails-app/internal/pathref"
)

// Mounter is the interface Unified requires from a mount manager.
// mount.Manager satisfies this via the adapter in vfs/mount.
type Mounter interface {
	Mount(mountPoint string, fs FileSystem, readOnly bool, name string, vtype VolumeType) (Volume, error)
	Unmount(mountPoint string) error
	Resolve(path string) (FileSystem, string, Volume, error)
	ListMounts() []MountedEntry
}

// MountedEntry describes one active mount point.
type MountedEntry struct {
	MountPoint string
	FS         FileSystem
	Volume     Volume
	ReadOnly   bool
}

// Unified is the top-level VFS the application uses.
// Construct it with NewUnified, then call Open/Stat/ReadDir/etc. on it.
//
// To support archive formats, blank-import their packages in main.go:
//
//	import _ "wails-app/vfs/archive/zip"
//	import _ "wails-app/vfs/archive/tar"
type Unified struct {
	mounts Mounter
}

const (
	registryScheme = "registry://"
	memoryScheme   = "memory://"
	httpScheme     = "http://"
	httpsScheme    = "https://"
	smbScheme      = "smb://"
	s3Scheme       = "s3://"
	oneDriveScheme = "onedrive://"
	gDriveScheme   = "gdrive://"
	dropboxScheme  = "dropbox://"

	registryVFSRoot = "/registry"
	memoryVFSRoot   = "/memory"
	smbVFSRoot      = "/remote/smb"
	s3VFSRoot       = "/remote/s3"
	oneDriveVFSRoot = "/remote/onedrive"
	gDriveVFSRoot   = "/remote/gdrive"
	dropboxVFSRoot  = "/remote/dropbox"
)

// NewUnified creates a Unified VFS backed by the given Mounter.
func NewUnified(mounts Mounter) *Unified {
	return &Unified{mounts: mounts}
}

func (u *Unified) Mount(mountPoint string, fs FileSystem, readOnly bool, name string, vtype VolumeType) (Volume, error) {
	return u.mounts.Mount(mountPoint, fs, readOnly, name, vtype)
}

func (u *Unified) Unmount(mountPoint string) error {
	return u.mounts.Unmount(mountPoint)
}

func (u *Unified) Open(ctx context.Context, path string) (File, error) {
	fsys, rel, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return fsys.Open(ctx, rel)
}

func (u *Unified) Stat(ctx context.Context, path string) (FileInfo, error) {
	fsys, rel, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return fsys.Stat(ctx, rel)
}

func (u *Unified) ReadDir(ctx context.Context, path string) ([]FileInfo, error) {
	fsys, rel, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	entries, err := fsys.ReadDir(ctx, rel)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	writeIdx := 0
	for _, e := range entries {
		name := e.Name()
		if name == "." || name == ".." {
			continue
		}
		entries[writeIdx] = e
		writeIdx++
	}
	entries = entries[:writeIdx]

	// Inject synthetic directory entries for sub-mounts under path.
	cleanPath := cleanVFSPath(path)
	for _, m := range u.mounts.ListMounts() {
		if cleanVFSPath(vpath.Dir(m.MountPoint)) == cleanPath {
			name := vpath.Base(m.MountPoint)
			if name == "." || name == ".." {
				continue
			}
			entries = append(entries, &mountPointInfo{
				name: name,
				path: m.MountPoint,
				vol:  m.Volume,
			})
		}
	}
	return entries, nil
}

func (u *Unified) Exists(ctx context.Context, path string) bool {
	_, err := u.Stat(ctx, path)
	return err == nil
}

func (u *Unified) Create(ctx context.Context, path string) (File, error) {
	fsys, rel, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return fsys.Create(ctx, rel)
}

func (u *Unified) Mkdir(ctx context.Context, path string, perm fs.FileMode) error {
	fsys, rel, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return fsys.Mkdir(ctx, rel, perm)
}

func (u *Unified) Remove(ctx context.Context, path string) error {
	fsys, rel, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return fsys.Remove(ctx, rel)
}

func (u *Unified) Rename(ctx context.Context, oldPath, newPath string) error {
	fsOld, relOld, volOld, err := u.mounts.Resolve(oldPath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, relNew, volNew, err := u.mounts.Resolve(newPath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if volOld != volNew {
		return fmt.Errorf("vfs: cannot rename across filesystems")
	}
	return fsOld.Rename(ctx, relOld, relNew)
}

// IsMounted reports whether path is currently served by a non-root (non-osfs)
// mount — i.e. the path resolves inside an archive or other special FS.
// Returns false for plain OS paths that resolve through the root osfs.
func (u *Unified) IsMounted(path string) bool {
	_, _, vol, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	return err == nil && vol != nil
}

func (u *Unified) Join(elem ...string) string { return strings.Join(elem, "/") }
func (u *Unified) Split(path string) (string, string) {
	i := strings.LastIndex(path, "/")
	if i < 0 {
		return "", path
	}
	return path[:i], path[i+1:]
}
func (u *Unified) IsAbs(path string) bool { return strings.HasPrefix(path, "/") }

// ResolvePublicPath converts a public/scheme path (e.g., "filesystem://c/Users/...") to a real filesystem path.
// This handles the conversion from user-facing paths to actual filesystem paths.
func (u *Unified) ResolvePublicPath(path string) (string, error) {
	if path == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("empty path")
	}

	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))

	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(trimmed), httpScheme) || strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(trimmed), httpsScheme) {
		return trimmed, nil
	}

	// Special handling for filesystem:// scheme paths
	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(trimmed), "filesystem://") {
		rest := strings.TrimLeft(trimmed[len("filesystem://"):], "/")
		if len(rest) > 0 && isWindowsDriveLetter(rune(rest[0])) {
			// Convert filesystem://c/Users/... to C:\Users\...
			drive := strings.ToUpper(rest[:1])
			remainder := strings.TrimPrefix(rest[1:], "/")
			if remainder == "" {
				return drive + ":/", nil
			}
			return filepath.FromSlash(drive + ":/" + remainder), nil
		}
	}

	// For other paths, use normal VFS mount resolution
	vfsPath := u.pathrefToVFS(trimmed)
	if isVirtualAliasPath(trimmed) {
		_, _, vol, err := u.mounts.Resolve(vfsPath)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		if vol == nil {
			return "", nil
		}
	}
	return u.RealPath(vfsPath)
}

func isVirtualAliasPath(path string) bool {
	trimmed := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/")))
	return strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, registryScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, memoryScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, httpScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, httpsScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, smbScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, s3Scheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, oneDriveScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, gDriveScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, dropboxScheme)
}

// isWindowsDriveLetter checks if a rune is a valid Windows drive letter.
func isWindowsDriveLetter(r rune) bool {
	return (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z')
}

// pathrefToVFS converts a path using pathref semantics.
// We can't import pathref here due to circular deps, so we handle filesystem:// locally.
func (u *Unified) pathrefToVFS(path string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))

	// Handle filesystem://c/ scheme paths
	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(trimmed), "filesystem://") {
		rest := strings.TrimLeft(trimmed[len("filesystem://"):], "/")
		if len(rest) > 0 {
			// filesystem://c/Users/... -> /c/Users/...
			return "/" + rest
		}
	}

	if converted, ok := publicAliasToVFS(trimmed, registryScheme, registryVFSRoot); ok {
		return converted
	}
	if converted, ok := publicAliasToVFS(trimmed, memoryScheme, memoryVFSRoot); ok {
		return converted
	}
	if converted, ok := publicAliasToVFS(trimmed, smbScheme, smbVFSRoot); ok {
		return converted
	}
	if converted, ok := publicAliasToVFS(trimmed, s3Scheme, s3VFSRoot); ok {
		return converted
	}
	if converted, ok := publicAliasToVFS(trimmed, oneDriveScheme, oneDriveVFSRoot); ok {
		return converted
	}
	if converted, ok := publicAliasToVFS(trimmed, gDriveScheme, gDriveVFSRoot); ok {
		return converted
	}
	if converted, ok := publicAliasToVFS(trimmed, dropboxScheme, dropboxVFSRoot); ok {
		return converted
	}

	return trimmed
}

func publicAliasToVFS(path string, scheme string, vfsRoot string) (string, bool) {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(path), scheme) {
		return "", false
	}

	switch scheme {
	case smbScheme:
		if converted, ok := pathref.RemoteURLToVFS(path, scheme, vfsRoot); ok {
			return converted, true
		}
	}

	rest := strings.Trim(strings.TrimPrefix(path, scheme), "/")
	if rest == "" {
		return vfsRoot, true
	}
	return vfsRoot + "/" + rest, true
}

func (u *Unified) RealPath(path string) (string, error) {
	fsys, rel, _, err := u.mounts.Resolve(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return fsys.RealPath(rel)
}

func cleanVFSPath(p string) string {
	if p == "" {
		return "/"
	}
	return vpath.Clean("/" + strings.TrimPrefix(p, "/"))
}

// mountPointInfo is a synthetic FileInfo injected for each active sub-mount.
type mountPointInfo struct {
	name string
	path string
	vol  Volume
}

func (m *mountPointInfo) Name() string         { return m.name }
func (m *mountPointInfo) Size() int64          { return 0 }
func (m *mountPointInfo) Mode() fs.FileMode    { return fs.ModeDir | 0555 }
func (m *mountPointInfo) ModTime() time.Time   { return time.Time{} }
func (m *mountPointInfo) IsDir() bool          { return true }
func (m *mountPointInfo) Sys() any             { return nil }
func (m *mountPointInfo) Path() string         { return m.path }
func (m *mountPointInfo) RealPath() string     { return "" }
func (m *mountPointInfo) Volume() Volume       { return m.vol }
func (m *mountPointInfo) IsArchive() bool      { return false }
func (m *mountPointInfo) IsHidden() bool       { return false }
func (m *mountPointInfo) IsSymlink() bool      { return false }
func (m *mountPointInfo) IsNested() bool       { return false }
func (m *mountPointInfo) MountChain() []string { return nil }

var _ FileInfo = (*mountPointInfo)(nil)
````

````typescript
export class ActionBarComponent {
  @Input() actions: PresentedCommand[] = [];

  // View inputs
  @Input() currentView: ViewMode = 'list';
  @Input() currentSort: string = 'name';
  @Input() sortDirection: 'asc' | 'desc' = 'asc';
  @Input() directoriesFirst = true;
  @Input() colorizeByMime = false;

  // Outputs: view/sort
  @Output() viewChange = new EventEmitter<ViewMode>();
  @Output() sortChange = new EventEmitter<{ field: string; direction: 'asc' | 'desc' }>();
  @Output() directoriesFirstChange = new EventEmitter<boolean>();
  @Output() colorizeByMimeChange = new EventEmitter<boolean>();

  arrangeMenuOpen = false;

  viewOptions = [
    { mode: 'list' as ViewMode, label: 'List View', shortcut: 'Ctrl+1' },
    { mode: 'grid' as ViewMode, label: 'Grid View', shortcut: 'Ctrl+2' },
    { mode: 'tree' as ViewMode, label: 'Tree View', shortcut: 'Ctrl+3' },
    { mode: 'details' as ViewMode, label: 'Details View', shortcut: 'Ctrl+4' },
  ];

  arrangeSortOptions = [
    { value: 'name',     label: 'Name' },
    { value: 'size',     label: 'Size' },
    { value: 'modified', label: 'Date Modified' },
    { value: 'type',     label: 'Type' },
  ];

  // View/sort handlers
  onViewChange(mode: ViewMode): void {
    if (this.currentView !== mode) {
      this.currentView = mode;
      this.viewChange.emit(mode);
    }
  }

  toggleArrangeMenu(event: Event): void {
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.arrangeMenuOpen = !this.arrangeMenuOpen;
    if (this.arrangeMenuOpen) {
      setTimeout(() => document.addEventListener('click', this.closeArrangeMenu, { once: true }));
    }
  }

  private closeArrangeMenu = (): void => { this.arrangeMenuOpen = false; };

  onSortChange(field: string): void {
    this.sortChange.emit({ field, direction: this.sortDirection });
    this.arrangeMenuOpen = false;
  }

  toggleSortDirection(): void {
    const newDir = this.sortDirection === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
    this.sortChange.emit({ field: this.currentSort, direction: newDir });
    this.arrangeMenuOpen = false;
  }

  toggleDirectoriesFirst(): void {
    this.directoriesFirst = !this.directoriesFirst;
    this.directoriesFirstChange.emit(this.directoriesFirst);
    // Keep menu open (checkbox-style)
  }

  toggleColorizeByMime(): void {
    this.colorizeByMime = !this.colorizeByMime;
    this.colorizeByMimeChange.emit(this.colorizeByMime);
  }


  trackAction(_index: number, action: PresentedCommand): string { return action.id; }

  invokeAction(action: PresentedCommand): void {
    if (!action.enabled) return;
    void Promise.resolve(action.execute()).catch(error => {
      console.error(`Toolbar action failed: ${action.id}`, error);
    });
  }

}
````

````typescript
import '@angular/compiler';

import { canonicalizePathReference, normalizePath } from './address-bar.utils';

describe('address-bar alias normalization', () => {
  it('keeps s3 aliases in alias form', () => {
    expect(canonicalizePathReference('s3://minio-dev/photos/2026')).toBe('s3://minio-dev/photos/2026');
    expect(normalizePath('s3://minio-dev/photos/2026')).toBe('s3://minio-dev/photos/2026');
  });

  it('keeps smb aliases in alias form', () => {
    expect(canonicalizePathReference('smb://fileserver/share/docs')).toBe('smb://fileserver/share/docs');
    expect(normalizePath('smb://fileserver/share/docs')).toBe('smb://fileserver/share/docs');
  });

  it('keeps cloud aliases in alias form', () => {
    expect(canonicalizePathReference('onedrive://Projects/2026')).toBe('onedrive://Projects/2026');
    expect(normalizePath('gdrive://Shared/team')).toBe('gdrive://Shared/team');
    expect(normalizePath('dropbox://Photos/raw')).toBe('dropbox://Photos/raw');
  });

  it('keeps web aliases in alias form', () => {
    expect(canonicalizePathReference('https://example.com/assets/main.js')).toBe('https://example.com/assets/main.js');
    expect(normalizePath('https://example.com/assets/main.js')).toBe('https://example.com/assets/main.js');
  });

  it('converts unc paths to smb aliases without collapsing the scheme', () => {
    const uncPath = String.raw`\\fileserver\share\docs`;

    expect(canonicalizePathReference(uncPath)).toBe('smb://fileserver/share/docs');
    expect(normalizePath(uncPath)).toBe('smb://fileserver/share/docs');
  });
});
````

````typescript
export class ConfirmDialogComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialogPanel') private dialogPanel?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  private readonly destroy$ = createSubject<void>();
  private releaseDialogContext: (() => void) | null = null;
  draftValue = '';
  readonly request$: Stream<ConfirmDialogRequest | null> = this.confirmDialogService.activeRequest$;

  constructor(
    private confirmDialogService: ConfirmDialogService,
    private inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
    private overlayFreeze: NativeOverlayFreezeService,
    private inputHistory: InputHistoryService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.confirm.accept', () => this.onKeyboardAccept());
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.confirm.cancel', () => this.onCancel());
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.confirm.focusNext', () => this.moveDialogFocus(1));
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.confirm.focusPrev', () => this.moveDialogFocus(-1));
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.confirm.focusNextArrow', () => this.moveDialogFocusWithArrows(1));
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.confirm.focusPrevArrow', () => this.moveDialogFocusWithArrows(-1));

    this.confirmDialogService.activeRequest$
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(request => {
        if (request) {
          this.draftValue = request.options.defaultValue ?? '';
          this.releaseDialogContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('dialog.confirm');
          this.overlayFreeze.acquire('dialog.confirm');
          return;
        }
        this.draftValue = '';
        this.releaseDialogContext?.();
        this.releaseDialogContext = null;
        this.overlayFreeze.release('dialog.confirm');
      });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.overlayFreeze.release('dialog.confirm');
    this.releaseDialogContext?.();
    this.releaseDialogContext = null;
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.confirm.accept');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.confirm.cancel');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.confirm.focusNext');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.confirm.focusPrev');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.confirm.focusNextArrow');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.confirm.focusPrevArrow');
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  onCancel(): void {
    const active = this.confirmDialogService.activeRequest$.value;
    // Clicking overlay on alert should close it
    if (active?.options.isAlert) {
      this.onConfirm();
    } else if (active?.options.isPrompt) {
      this.confirmDialogService.resolveActive(null);
    } else {
      this.confirmDialogService.resolveActive(false);
    }
  }

  onConfirm(): void {
    const active = this.confirmDialogService.activeRequest$.value;
    if (active?.options.isPrompt) {
      const value = this.draftValue;
      if (active.options.historyKey && value.trim()) {
        this.inputHistory.push(active.options.historyKey, value);
      }
      this.confirmDialogService.resolveActive(value);
      return;
    }
    this.confirmDialogService.resolveActive(true);
  }

  private onKeyboardAccept(): void {
    const active = this.confirmDialogService.activeRequest$.value;
    if (!active) {
      return;
    }

    if (active.options.isPrompt) {
      this.onConfirm();
      return;
    }

    const focusedAction = this.getFocusedDialogAction();
    if (focusedAction === 'cancel') {
      this.onCancel();
      return;
    }

    this.onConfirm();
  }

  private getFocusedDialogAction(): 'confirm' | 'cancel' | null {
    const activeElement = document.activeElement;
    if (!(activeElement instanceof HTMLElement)) {
      return null;
    }

    const actionElement = activeElement.closest('[data-dialog-action]');
    if (!(actionElement instanceof HTMLElement)) {
      return null;
    }

    const action = actionElement.dataset['dialogAction'];
    return action === 'cancel' || action === 'confirm' ? action : null;
  }

  onPromptKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (event.key === 'Enter') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.onConfirm();
      return;
    }

    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.onCancel();
    }
  }

  getAlertTitle(options: any): string {
    if (options.title) {
      return options.title;
    }
    const lines = options.message.split('\n');
    return lines[0] || 'Alert';
  }

  getAlertSubtitle(options: any): string {
    if (options.title) {
      return options.message;
    }
    const lines = options.message.split('\n');
    return lines.slice(1).join('\n');
  }

  private moveDialogFocus(delta: number): void {
    const panel = this.dialogPanel?.nativeElement;
    if (!panel) {
      return;
    }

    moveFocusWithin(panel, delta);
  }

  private moveDialogFocusWithArrows(delta: number): void {
    if (!this.shouldUseActionArrowNavigation()) {
      return;
    }

    this.moveActionFocus(delta);
  }

  private moveActionFocus(delta: number): void {
    const panel = this.dialogPanel?.nativeElement;
    if (!panel) {
      return;
    }

    moveFocusWithin(panel, delta, '[data-dialog-action]');
  }

  private shouldUseActionArrowNavigation(): boolean {
    const panel = this.dialogPanel?.nativeElement;
    const activeElement = document.activeElement;
    if (!panel || !(activeElement instanceof HTMLElement) || !panel.contains(activeElement)) {
      return false;
    }

    return !!activeElement.closest('[data-dialog-action]');
  }
}
````

````typescript
  get showSelectionRect(): boolean {

  get virtualEnabled(): boolean {
    return !this.loading && !this.error && this.cachedVirtualEntries.length >= this.VIRTUAL_THRESHOLD;
  }

  get parentEntry(): FileInfo | null {
    const first = this.entries[0];
    return first && this.isParentEntry(first) ? first : null;

    return this.cachedVirtualEntries.length * this.rowHeight;

    this.refreshDerivedEntries();

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['entries'] || changes['loading'] || changes['error'] || changes['colorizeByMime']) {
      this.prewarmCollisionResolutions();
      if (changes['entries'] && !changes['entries'].firstChange) {
        const prevLen = changes['entries'].previousValue?.length || 0;
        const currLen = changes['entries'].currentValue?.length || 0;
        if (Math.abs(prevLen - currLen) > 1000) {
          this.resetScroll();
        }
      }
      this.refreshDerivedEntries();
      queueMicrotask(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => this.measureHeights()));
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;

    if (
      changes['selectedFiles'] ||
      changes['pendingDirectorySizePaths'] ||
      changes['cursorPath']

      this.rebuildVisibleRowVms();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  private prewarmCollisionResolutions(): void {
    if (!this.colorizeByMime) {
      return;
    }
    for (const entry of this.entries) {
      this.categoryResolver.ensureResolved(entry);

  ngOnDestroy(): void {

    this.cleanupResizeObserver();
    this.cleanupScrollListener();
    if (this.scrollRAF) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.scrollRAF);
    }
  }

  private setupResizeObserver(): void {
    const element = this.paneContentRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!element) return;

    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      this.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
        let changed = false;
        for (const entry of entries) {
          if (entry.contentRect.height !== this.viewportHeight) {
            this.viewportHeight = entry.contentRect.height;
            changed = this.updateVirtualWindow() || changed;
          }
        }

        if (changed) {
          this.zone.run(() => this.cdr.markForCheck());
        }
      });
    });

    this.resizeObserver?.observe(element);
  }

  private cleanupResizeObserver(): void {
    this.resizeObserver?.disconnect();
  }

  private setupScrollListener(): void {
    const element = this.paneContentRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!element) return;
    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      this.boundScrollListener = () => this.onScroll();
      element.addEventListener('scroll', this.boundScrollListener, { passive: true });
    });
  }

  private cleanupScrollListener(): void {
    const element = this.paneContentRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!element || !this.boundScrollListener) return;
    element.removeEventListener('scroll', this.boundScrollListener);
    this.boundScrollListener = undefined;
  }

  private onScroll(): void {
    if (this.scrollRAF) return;
    this.scrollRAF = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      this.scrollRAF = null;
      if (this.updateVirtualWindow()) {
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      }
    });
  }

  private resetScroll(): void {
    const element = this.paneContentRef?.nativeElement;
    if (element) {
      element.scrollTop = 0;
    }
    this.virtualStart = 0;
    this.virtualEnd = 0;
  }

  private refreshDerivedEntries(): void {
    this.cachedVirtualEntries = this.parentEntry ? this.entries.slice(1) : this.entries;
    this.pathToVirtualIndex.clear();
    const pathSet = new Set<string>();
    this.cachedVirtualEntries.forEach((entry, index) => {
      this.pathToVirtualIndex.set(entry.path, index);
      pathSet.add(entry.path);
    });
    for (const key of this.rowVmCache.keys()) {
      if (!pathSet.has(key)) {
        this.rowVmCache.delete(key);
      }
    }
    this.updateVirtualWindow(true);
  }

  private rebuildVisibleEntries(): void {
    this.visibleEntries = this.virtualEnabled
      ? this.cachedVirtualEntries.slice(this.virtualStart, this.virtualEnd)
      : this.entries;
    this.rebuildVisibleRowVms();
  }

  private rebuildVisibleRowVms(): void {
    this.visibleRowVms = this.visibleEntries.map((entry) => this.buildRowVm(entry));
  }

  private buildRowVm(entry: FileInfo): VisibleRowVm {
    const path = entry.path;
    const selected = this.selectedFiles.has(path);
    const cursor = path === this.cursorPath;
    const displayNameOverride = this.pendingRenameDisplayNames.get(path) ?? null;
    const directorySizePending = this.pendingDirectorySizePaths.has(path);
    const dragOverInside = this.dragOverPath === path && this.dragOverPosition === 'inside';
    const dragOverBefore = this.dragOverPath === path && this.dragOverPosition === 'before';
    const dragOverAfter = this.dragOverPath === path && this.dragOverPosition === 'after';
    const existing = this.rowVmCache.get(path);
    if (
      existing &&
      existing.entry === entry &&
      existing.selected === selected &&
      existing.cursor === cursor &&
      existing.displayNameOverride === displayNameOverride &&
      existing.directorySizePending === directorySizePending &&
      existing.dragOverInside === dragOverInside &&
      existing.dragOverBefore === dragOverBefore &&
      existing.dragOverAfter === dragOverAfter
    ) {
      return existing;
    }

    const vm: VisibleRowVm = {
      entry,
      selected,
      cursor,
      displayNameOverride,
      directorySizePending,
      dragOverInside,
      dragOverBefore,
      dragOverAfter,
    };
    this.rowVmCache.set(path, vm);
    return vm;
  }

  private updateVirtualWindow(forceRebuild = false): boolean {
    if (!this.virtualEnabled) {
      const changed = this.virtualStart !== 0 || this.virtualEnd !== this.entries.length;
      this.virtualStart = 0;
      this.virtualEnd = this.entries.length;
      if (changed || forceRebuild) {
        this.rebuildVisibleEntries();
      }
      return changed || forceRebuild;
    }

    const element = this.paneContentRef?.nativeElement;
    const scrollTop = element?.scrollTop ?? 0;
    const parentOffset = this.parentEntry ? this.parentRowHeight : 0;
    const contentScrollTop = Math.max(0, scrollTop - parentOffset);
    const visibleParentPart = this.parentEntry ? Math.max(0, parentOffset - scrollTop) : 0;

    const viewportHeight = Math.max(
      1,
      (this.viewportHeight || element?.clientHeight || 0) - visibleParentPart
    );
    const visibleCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(viewportHeight / this.rowHeight));
    
    const start = Math.max(0, Math.floor(contentScrollTop / this.rowHeight) - this.overscan);
    const end = Math.min(this.cachedVirtualEntries.length, start + visibleCount + this.overscan * 2);

    const changed = start !== this.virtualStart || end !== this.virtualEnd;
    if (changed) {
      this.virtualStart = start;
      this.virtualEnd = end;
    }
    if (changed || forceRebuild) {
      this.rebuildVisibleEntries();
    }
    return changed || forceRebuild;
  }

  private measureHeights(): void {
    const host = this.paneContentRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!host) return;
    const row = host.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
      `.file-list-row[data-path]:not([data-path="${PARENT_ENTRY_PATH}"]) .file-entry`
    ) ?? host.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.file-list-row .file-entry');
    if (!row) return;
    const measured = Math.ceil(row.getBoundingClientRect().height);
    if (!Number.isFinite(measured) || measured <= 0) return;
    const nextRowHeight = Math.max(this.DEFAULT_ROW_HEIGHT, measured);
    let changed = false;
    if (Math.abs(nextRowHeight - this.rowHeight) >= 1) {
      this.rowHeight = nextRowHeight;
      changed = true;
    }

    const parentEl = this.parentRowRef?.nativeElement?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.file-entry');
    if (parentEl) {
      const nextParentHeight = Math.ceil(parentEl.getBoundingClientRect().height);
      if (Number.isFinite(nextParentHeight) && nextParentHeight > 0 && Math.abs(nextParentHeight - this.parentRowHeight) >= 1) {
        this.parentRowHeight = nextParentHeight;
        changed = true;
      }
    } else if (this.parentRowHeight !== 0) {
      this.parentRowHeight = 0;
      changed = true;
    }

    if (changed) {
      this.updateVirtualWindow();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  trackByPath(_index: number, entry: FileInfo): string {
    return entry.path;
  }

  trackByRowPath(_index: number, row: VisibleRowVm): string {
    return row.entry.path;
  }

  isParentEntry(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    return entry.path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH;
  }

  isDropTarget(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    return this.dragOverPath === entry.path && this.dragOverPosition === 'inside';
  }

  isDragOverBefore(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    return this.dragOverPath === entry.path && this.dragOverPosition === 'before';
  }

  isDragOverAfter(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    return this.dragOverPath === entry.path && this.dragOverPosition === 'after';
  }

  isDragOverInside(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    return this.dragOverPath === entry.path && this.dragOverPosition === 'inside';
  }

  isSelected(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    return this.selectedFiles.has(entry.path);
  }

  isDirectorySizePending(path: string): boolean {
    return this.pendingDirectorySizePaths.has(path);
  }

  onSelect(event: FileEntrySelectEvent): void {
    const entry = event.entry;
    if (this.isParentEntry(entry)) {
      this.anchorPath = entry.path;
      this.selectionChange.emit([entry]);
      if (this.singleClickToOpen) {
        this.navigate.emit(entry);
      }
      return;
    }

    const mouseEvent = event.mouseEvent;
    const isToggle = mouseEvent.ctrlKey || mouseEvent.metaKey;
    const isRange = mouseEvent.shiftKey && this.anchorPath !== null;

    if (isRange) {
      this.selectionChange.emit(this.buildRangeSelection(entry));
    } else if (isToggle) {
      this.selectionChange.emit(this.buildToggledSelection(entry));
      this.anchorPath = entry.path;
    } else {
      this.anchorPath = entry.path;
      this.selectionChange.emit([entry]);
      if (this.singleClickToOpen) {
        this.navigate.emit(entry);
      }
    }
  }

  onNavigate(entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (this.singleClickToOpen) {
      return;
    }
    this.navigate.emit(entry);
  }

  onRename(event: { entry: FileInfo; newName: string }): void {
    this.rename.emit(event);
  }

  /** Called by parent (eg. on F2) to begin in-place rename for the current selection. */
  startRenameSelected(): void {
    const selectedPath = this.getFirstSelectedPathInOrder();
    if (!selectedPath) return;
    this.startRenameByPath(selectedPath);
  }

  startRenamePath(path: string): void {
    this.startRenameByPath(path);
  }

  setPendingRenameDisplayName(path: string, displayName: string | null): void {
    if (!path || path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) return;
    if (displayName && displayName.trim()) {
      this.pendingRenameDisplayNames.set(path, displayName.trim());
    } else {
      this.pendingRenameDisplayNames.delete(path);
    }
    this.rebuildVisibleRowVms();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  getDisplayNameOverride(path: string): string | null {
    return this.pendingRenameDisplayNames.get(path) ?? null;
  }

  private getFirstSelectedPathInOrder(): string | null {
    if (!this.selectedFiles?.size) return null;
    for (const entry of this.entries) {
      if (!entry || this.isParentEntry(entry)) continue;
      if (this.selectedFiles.has(entry.path)) return entry.path;
    }
    return null;
  }

  private startRenameByPath(path: string): void {
    if (!path || path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) return;

    const host = this.paneContentRef?.nativeElement;
    if (host) {
      if (this.virtualEnabled) {
        const idx = this.pathToVirtualIndex.get(path);
        if (idx !== undefined) {
          const parentOffset = this.parentEntry ? this.parentRowHeight : 0;
          const targetTop = idx * this.rowHeight;
          const centerOffset = host.clientHeight / 2 - this.rowHeight / 2;
          host.scrollTop = Math.max(0, parentOffset + targetTop - centerOffset);
          this.updateVirtualWindow();
          this.cdr.markForCheck();
        }
      } else {
        const el = host.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`.file-list-row[data-path="${CSS.escape(path)}"]`);
        el?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' });
      }
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const comp = this.fileEntryComponents?.find(c => c.entry?.path === path);
      comp?.beginRename();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
  }

  /** Scroll the list to bring the given path into view. */
  scrollToPath(path: string): void {
    if (!path || path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) return;
    const host = this.paneContentRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!host) return;
    if (this.virtualEnabled) {
      const idx = this.pathToVirtualIndex.get(path);
      if (idx !== undefined) {
        const parentOffset = this.parentEntry ? this.parentRowHeight : 0;
        const itemTop = parentOffset + idx * this.rowHeight;
        const itemBottom = itemTop + this.rowHeight;
        if (itemTop < host.scrollTop || itemBottom > host.scrollTop + host.clientHeight) {
          const centerOffset = host.clientHeight / 2 - this.rowHeight / 2;
          host.scrollTop = Math.max(0, parentOffset + idx * this.rowHeight - centerOffset);
        }
        this.updateVirtualWindow();
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      }
    } else {
      const el = host.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`.file-list-row[data-path="${CSS.escape(path)}"]`);
      el?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' });
    }
  }

  getScrollTop(): number {
    return this.paneContentRef?.nativeElement?.scrollTop ?? 0;
  }

  setScrollTop(top: number): void {
    const element = this.paneContentRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!element) return;
    element.scrollTop = Math.max(0, top);
  }

  /** Approximate number of rows visible in the viewport. */
  getApproxPageSize(): number {
    const host = this.paneContentRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!host) return 10;
    return Math.max(1, Math.floor(host.clientHeight / this.rowHeight) - 1);
  }

  onBackgroundClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (this.suppressBackgroundClick) {
      this.suppressBackgroundClick = false;
      return;
    }
    // Background click just focuses the pane (handled by parent wrapper).
    // Never clear selection here — the pane-inactive CSS dims the cursor automatically.
  }

  onBackgroundContextMenu(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (this.suppressBackgroundContextMenu) {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.suppressBackgroundContextMenu = false;
      return;
    }

    const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
    if (event.target === event.currentTarget || target.classList.contains('file-list-container')) {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.backgroundContextMenu.emit(event);
    }
  }

  onContextMenu(event: MouseEvent, entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (this.suppressItemContextMenu) {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.suppressItemContextMenu = false;
      return;
    }

    event.preventDefault();
    if (this.isParentEntry(entry)) return;

    if (this.isSelected(entry)) {
      const nextSelection = this.entries.filter(e => 
        this.selectedFiles.has(e.path) && e.path !== entry.path && !this.isParentEntry(e)
      );
      this.selectionChange.emit(nextSelection);
    } else {
      const selected = new Set(this.selectedFiles);
      selected.add(entry.path);
      this.selectionChange.emit(this.entries.filter(e => 
        selected.has(e.path) && !this.isParentEntry(e)
      ));
      this.anchorPath = entry.path;
    }
    this.contextMenu.emit({ event, entry });
  }

  onItemAuxClick(event: MouseEvent, entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (event.button !== 1 || this.isParentEntry(entry)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.openInNewTab.emit(entry);
  }

  onListMouseDown(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (event.button !== 0 && event.button !== 2) return;

    // Left button on a draggable file row → let HTML5 drag-and-drop handle it
    if (event.button === 0) {
      const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
      if (target.closest('[draggable="true"]')) return;
    }

    const container = event.currentTarget as HTMLElement;
    if (!container) return;

    this.marqueeContainer = container;
    this.marqueeAppend = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;
    this.selectionMode = 'marquee';
    this.marqueeButton = event.button as 0 | 2;
    this.hasMarqueeMoved = false;
    // Defer selection clear until the marquee actually moves — a plain background
    // click keeps selection so the cursor stays visible in both active and inactive panes.
    this.pendingClearOnMove = !this.marqueeAppend;
    this.paintedPaths.clear();
    
    const { x, y } = this.getRelativePoint(event, container);
    this.marqueeStartX = x;
    this.marqueeStartY = y;
    this.selectionRect = { active: true, left: x, top: y, width: 0, height: 0 };

    this.suppressBackgroundClick = true;
    this.suppressItemContextMenu = false;

    this.windowMouseMove = (moveEvent: MouseEvent) => this.zone.run(() => this.onListMouseMove(moveEvent));
    this.windowMouseUp = () => this.zone.run(() => this.finishMarqueeSelection());
    this.windowContextMenu = (contextEvent: MouseEvent) => {
      if (this.selectionMode !== 'none' && this.hasMarqueeMoved) {
        contextEvent.preventDefault();
        contextEvent.stopPropagation();
      }
    };
    
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', this.windowMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', this.windowMouseUp);
    window.addEventListener('contextmenu', this.windowContextMenu, true);
    this.suppressBackgroundContextMenu = event.button === 2;
    
    if (event.button === 0) {
      event.preventDefault();
    }
  }

  private onListMouseMove(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (!this.marqueeContainer) return;

    if (this.selectionMode === 'paint') {
      this.updatePaintSelection(event);
      return;
    }

    if (this.selectionMode !== 'marquee' || !this.selectionRect.active) return;

    const { x, y } = this.getRelativePoint(event, this.marqueeContainer);
    const left = Math.min(this.marqueeStartX, x);
    const top = Math.min(this.marqueeStartY, y);
    const width = Math.abs(x - this.marqueeStartX);
    const height = Math.abs(y - this.marqueeStartY);
    
    if (width > 10 || height > 10) {
      this.hasMarqueeMoved = true;
      if (this.pendingClearOnMove) {
        this.selectionChange.emit([]);
        this.pendingClearOnMove = false;
      }
      if (this.marqueeButton === 2) {
        this.suppressItemContextMenu = true;
      }
    }
    
    this.selectionRect = { active: true, left, top, width, height };
    if (this.hasMarqueeMoved) {
      this.emitMarqueeSelection();
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private updatePaintSelection(event: MouseEvent): void {
    const element = document.elementFromPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY) as HTMLElement | null;
    const row = element?.closest('.file-list-row') as HTMLElement | null;
    const path = row?.dataset['path'];
    
    if (!path || path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH || this.paintedPaths.has(path)) return;

    this.paintedPaths.add(path);

    const selectionPaths = new Set<string>(this.paintedPaths);
    if (this.marqueeAppend) {
      for (const existingPath of this.selectedFiles) {
        if (existingPath !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) {
          selectionPaths.add(existingPath);
        }
      }
    }

    const selectedEntries = this.entries.filter(entry => selectionPaths.has(entry.path));
    this.selectionChange.emit(selectedEntries);
  }

  private emitMarqueeSelection(): void {
    if (!this.marqueeContainer) return;
    const selectionPaths = new Set<string>();
    const selectionBottom = this.selectionRect.top + this.selectionRect.height;

    if (this.virtualEnabled) {
      const parentOffset = this.parentEntry ? this.parentRowHeight : 0;
      const contentTop = Math.max(0, this.selectionRect.top - parentOffset);
      const contentBottom = Math.max(0, selectionBottom - parentOffset);
      const startIndex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(contentTop / this.rowHeight));
      const endIndex = Math.min(this.cachedVirtualEntries.length - 1, Math.floor(Math.max(0, contentBottom - 1) / this.rowHeight));
      for (let i = startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++) {
        const entry = this.cachedVirtualEntries[i];
        if (entry && entry.path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) {
          selectionPaths.add(entry.path);
        }
      }
    } else {
      const startIndex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(this.selectionRect.top / this.rowHeight));
      const endIndex = Math.min(this.entries.length - 1, Math.floor(Math.max(0, selectionBottom - 1) / this.rowHeight));
      for (let i = startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++) {
        const entry = this.entries[i];
        if (entry && entry.path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) {
          selectionPaths.add(entry.path);
        }
      }
    }

    if (this.marqueeAppend) {
      for (const path of this.selectedFiles) {
        if (path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) {
          selectionPaths.add(path);
        }
      }
    }

    const selectedEntries = this.entries.filter(entry => selectionPaths.has(entry.path));
    this.selectionChange.emit(selectedEntries);
  }

  private finishMarqueeSelection(): void {
    this.detachMarqueeListeners();
    this.marqueeContainer = null;
    this.selectionMode = 'none';
    this.marqueeButton = null;
    this.hasMarqueeMoved = false;
    this.pendingClearOnMove = false;
    this.lastMarqueeSelectionSignature = null;
    this.paintedPaths.clear();
    this.selectionRect = { active: false, left: 0, top: 0, width: 0, height: 0 };
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private detachMarqueeListeners(): void {
    if (this.windowMouseMove) {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', this.windowMouseMove);
      this.windowMouseMove = undefined;
    }
    if (this.windowMouseUp) {
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', this.windowMouseUp);
      this.windowMouseUp = undefined;
    }
    if (this.windowContextMenu) {
      window.removeEventListener('contextmenu', this.windowContextMenu, true);
      this.windowContextMenu = undefined;
    }
  }

  private getRelativePoint(event: MouseEvent, container: HTMLElement): { x: number; y: number } {
    const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: event.clientX - rect.left + container.scrollLeft,
      y: event.clientY - rect.top + container.scrollTop,
    };
  }

  onDragStart(event: DragEvent, entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (event.button !== 0) {
      event.preventDefault();
      return;
    }

    if (this.selectionMode !== 'none') {
      event.preventDefault();
      return;
    }

    if (this.isParentEntry(entry)) {
      event.preventDefault();
      return;
    }

    const entries = this.isSelected(entry)
      ? this.entries.filter(e => this.selectedFiles.has(e.path) && !this.isParentEntry(e))
      : [entry];

    if (event.dataTransfer) {
      event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'copyMove';
      event.dataTransfer.setData('application/json', JSON.stringify({
        source: 'list',
        entries: entries.map(e => ({ path: e.path, type: e.type, name: e.name })),
      }));
    }

    this.dragStart.emit({ event, entries });
  }

  onDragOver(event: DragEvent, entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (this.isParentEntry(entry)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    if (event.dataTransfer) {
      event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey ? 'copy' : 'move';
    }
    const el = event.currentTarget as HTMLElement;
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const fraction = rect.height > 0 ? (event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height : 0.5;
    let position: 'before' | 'after' | 'inside';
    if (fraction < 0.3) {
      position = 'before';
    } else if (fraction > 0.7) {
      position = 'after';
    } else {
      position = entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY ? 'inside' : (fraction < 0.5 ? 'before' : 'after');
    }
    if (this.dragOverPath === entry.path && this.dragOverPosition === position) {
      return;
    }
    this.dragOverPath = entry.path;
    this.dragOverPosition = position;
    this.rebuildVisibleRowVms();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onDragLeave(entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (this.dragOverPath === entry.path) {
      this.dragOverPath = null;
      this.dragOverPosition = null;
      this.rebuildVisibleRowVms();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  onDrop(event: DragEvent, entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (this.isParentEntry(entry)) return;
    event.preventDefault();

    // For external OS drops, don't stopPropagation - let Wails' window handler fire wails:file-drop
    if (this.hasExternalFiles(event)) {
      this.dragOverPath = null;
      this.dragOverPosition = null;
      this.rebuildVisibleRowVms();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    event.stopPropagation();
    const capturedPosition = this.dragOverPosition;
    this.dragOverPath = null;
    this.dragOverPosition = null;
    this.rebuildVisibleRowVms();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    const draggedEntries = this.readDraggedEntries(event);
    if (!draggedEntries.length) return;

    const source = this.buildSourceFromEntries(draggedEntries);
    if (!source.length) return;

    const goInto = capturedPosition === 'inside' && entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY;
    const target = goInto
      ? entry
      : ({ ...entry, path: parentPath(entry.path), type: FileType.DIRECTORY } as FileInfo);

    this.dragDrop.emit({ event, source, target });
  }

  onBackgroundDragOver(event: DragEvent): void {
    // Prevent default to stop browser from opening files
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    
    if (event.dataTransfer) {
      event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey ? 'copy' : 'move';
    }
    
    this.isBackgroundDropTarget = true;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onBackgroundDragLeave(event: DragEvent): void {
    const target = event.relatedTarget as HTMLElement;
    const container = this.paneContentRef?.nativeElement;
    
    if (container && !container.contains(target)) {
      this.isBackgroundDropTarget = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  onBackgroundDrop(event: DragEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();

    // For external OS drops, don't stopPropagation - let Wails' window handler fire wails:file-drop
    if (this.hasExternalFiles(event)) {
      this.isBackgroundDropTarget = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    event.stopPropagation();
    this.isBackgroundDropTarget = false;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();

    // Internal drag to background
    const draggedEntries = this.readDraggedEntries(event);
    if (!draggedEntries.length) return;

    const source = this.buildSourceFromEntries(draggedEntries);
    if (!source.length) return;

    const currentDir = this.entries.length > 0 && !this.isParentEntry(this.entries[0])
      ? parentPath(this.entries[0].path)
      : '';
    
    const target: FileInfo = {
      name: '',
      path: currentDir,
      type: FileType.DIRECTORY,
      size: 0,
      created: 0,
      modified: 0,
      accessed: 0,
      permissions: '',
      isHidden: false,
    };

    this.dragDrop.emit({ event, source, target });
  }

  private hasExternalFiles(event: DragEvent): boolean {
    const types = event.dataTransfer?.types;
    if (!types) return false;
    if (types.includes('application/json')) return false;
    return types.includes('Files') || (event.dataTransfer?.files?.length ?? 0) > 0;
  }

  private extractExternalPaths(event: DragEvent): string[] {
    const dataTransfer = event.dataTransfer;
    if (!dataTransfer) return [];

    const paths = new Set<string>();

    const files = dataTransfer.files;
    for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
      const file = files[i];
      const filePath = (file as any).path as string | undefined;
      if (filePath) {
        paths.add(filePath);
      }
    }

    const uriPayload = dataTransfer.getData('text/uri-list') || dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
    if (uriPayload) {
      for (const rawLine of uriPayload.split(/\r?\n/)) {
        const line = rawLine.trim();
        if (!line || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
        const parsedPath = this.fileUriToPath(line);
        if (parsedPath) paths.add(parsedPath);
      }
    }

    return Array.from(paths);
  }

  private fileUriToPath(value: string): string | null {
    if (!value) return null;
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    if (!/^file:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) {
      if (/^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]/.test(trimmed)) return trimmed;
      if (/^\\\\/.test(trimmed)) return trimmed;
      if (trimmed.startsWith('/')) return trimmed;
      return null;
    }

    try {
      let decoded = decodeURIComponent(trimmed).replace(/^file:\/\//i, '');

      if (/^\/[A-Za-z]:\//.test(decoded)) {
        decoded = decoded.slice(1);
      }

      if (/^[A-Za-z]:\//.test(decoded)) {
        return decoded.replace(/\//g, '\\');
      }

      if (!decoded.startsWith('/')) {
        return ('//' + decoded).replace(/\//g, '\\');
      }

      return decoded;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  private buildRangeSelection(entry: FileInfo): FileInfo[] {
    const selectable = this.entries.filter(e => !this.isParentEntry(e));
    const anchorIndex = selectable.findIndex(e => e.path === this.anchorPath);
    const currentIndex = selectable.findIndex(e => e.path === entry.path);

    if (anchorIndex === -1 || currentIndex === -1) {
      return [entry];
    }

    const [start, end] = [Math.min(anchorIndex, currentIndex), Math.max(anchorIndex, currentIndex)];
    return selectable.slice(start, end + 1);
  }

  private buildToggledSelection(entry: FileInfo): FileInfo[] {
    const selected = new Set(this.selectedFiles);
    if (selected.has(entry.path)) {
      selected.delete(entry.path);
    } else {
      selected.add(entry.path);
    }
    return this.entries.filter(e => selected.has(e.path) && !this.isParentEntry(e));
  }

  /** Build source entries from dragged paths; uses pane entries when available (same-pane drag) or constructs minimal FileInfo for cross-pane drags. */
  private buildSourceFromEntries(dragged: { path: string; type: FileType; name: string }[]): FileInfo[] {
    const pathSet = new Set(dragged.map(d => d.path));
    const fromEntries = this.entries.filter(e => pathSet.has(e.path) && !this.isParentEntry(e));
    if (fromEntries.length > 0) return fromEntries;
    // Cross-pane drag: reconstruct minimal FileInfo using actual types from payload
    return dragged.filter(d => d.path && d.path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH).map(d => ({
      name: d.name,
      path: d.path,
      type: d.type,
      size: 0,
      created: 0,
      modified: 0,
      accessed: 0,
      permissions: '',
      isHidden: false,
    } as FileInfo));
  }

  private readDraggedEntries(event: DragEvent): { path: string; type: FileType; name: string }[] {
    try {
      const payload = event.dataTransfer?.getData('application/json');
      if (!payload) return [];
      const parsed = JSON.parse(payload);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed?.entries)) return parsed.entries;
      // backward compat: old payload used 'paths' without type
      if (Array.isArray(parsed?.paths)) return parsed.paths.map((p: string) => ({ path: p, type: FileType.FILE, name: p.split(/[\/\\]/).pop() || p }));
      return [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { ArchiveFrame } from '../services/archive.service';
import { isDirectoryBackedSurfaceId } from '../surfaces/tab-surface';

export interface FilePaneRuntimeStateHost {
  get archiveStack(): ArchiveFrame[];
  set archiveStack(value: ArchiveFrame[]);
  get fsParentDir(): string;
  set fsParentDir(value: string);
  get activeDirTabId(): string | null;
  get currentTabId(): string;
  get activeSurfaceId(): string;
  isInArchive(): boolean;
  restoreActiveDirTabState(): void;
  saveDirTabState(tabId: string): void;
}

export class FilePaneRuntimeStateController {
  afterNavigationMutation(host: FilePaneRuntimeStateHost): void {
    host.restoreActiveDirTabState();
  }

  clearArchiveState(host: FilePaneRuntimeStateHost): void {
    host.archiveStack = [];
    host.fsParentDir = '';
  }

  persistDirTabState(host: FilePaneRuntimeStateHost): void {
    const tabId = host.activeDirTabId ?? host.currentTabId;
    if (!tabId || !isDirectoryBackedSurfaceId(host.activeSurfaceId)) {
      return;
    }

    host.saveDirTabState(tabId);
  }
}
````

````typescript
        <span class="metric different" *ngIf="result.summary.typeDifferent">{{ result.summary.typeDifferent }} type diff</span>

        <button type="button" class="btn" (click)="copyMissingRightToLeft.emit()" [disabled]="result.summary.onlyRight === 0" title="Copy items that exist only on the right to the left pane">← Missing</button>
        <button type="button" class="btn" (click)="review.emit()" [disabled]="result.summary.different === 0" title="Review and approve a synchronization plan">Review…</button>

})
export class PaneComparisonBarComponent implements OnChanges {

  @Input() leftEntries: readonly FileInfo[] = [];
  @Input() rightEntries: readonly FileInfo[] = [];
  @Input() leftPath = '';
  @Input() rightPath = '';
  @Input() recursive = false;
  @Input() scanning = false;
  @Input() error = '';
  @Input() comparisonResult: PaneComparisonResult | null = null;

  @Output() toggleRecursive = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() refreshRecursive = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() selectLeft = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() selectRight = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() copyMissingLeftToRight = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() copyMissingRightToLeft = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() review = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() close = new EventEmitter<void>();

  result: PaneComparisonResult = this.comparison.compare([], []);

  constructor(private readonly comparison: PaneComparisonService) {}

  ngOnChanges(): void {
    this.result = this.comparisonResult ?? this.comparison.compare(this.leftEntries, this.rightEntries);
  }

  get leftDifferenceCount(): number {
    return this.comparison.leftDifferencePaths(this.result).length;
  }

  get rightDifferenceCount(): number {
    return this.comparison.rightDifferencePaths(this.result).length;
````

````typescript
import type { ActionAvailability } from '../services/action-availability';
````

````typescript
): PresentedCommand[] {

      label: 'Copy to other pane',
      icon: 'copy',
      shortcut: 'F5',
      enabled: availability.copyToOther,
      source: 'builtin',
      commandId: 'pane.ctrl.copyToOther',
      execute: handlers.copyToOther,
    },
    {

      label: 'Move to other pane',
      icon: 'move',

    },

}

export function adaptPluginToolbarActions(
  contributions: readonly ToolbarActionContribution[],
  context: ToolbarContext,
````
