## File: frontend/src/app/components/presented-command.ts
````typescript
/**
 * Renderer-agnostic command presentation.
 *
 * Command metadata is intentionally separate from execution so the same
 * presentation vocabulary can be used by toolbars, menus, palettes and future
 * surfaces such as Console without coupling those renderers to one another.
 */
export type CommandPresentationSource = 'builtin' | 'plugin' | 'registry';

export interface CommandPresentation<TId extends string = string> {
  readonly id: TId;
  readonly label: string;
  readonly icon?: string;
  readonly iconText?: string;
  readonly shortcut?: string;
  readonly enabled: boolean;
  readonly separatorBefore?: boolean;
  readonly source: CommandPresentationSource;
  /** Stable application command ID when this presentation maps to one. */
  readonly commandId?: string;
  /** Canonical human-facing command name, when the command exposes one. */
  readonly commandName?: string;
  /** Additional human-facing names used by discovery surfaces. */
  readonly aliases?: readonly string[];
}

export interface PresentedCommand<TId extends string = string> extends CommandPresentation<TId> {
  execute(): void | Promise<void>;
}

export function bindCommandPresentation<TId extends string>(
  presentation: CommandPresentation<TId>,
  execute: () => void | Promise<void>,
): PresentedCommand<TId> {
  return { ...presentation, execute };
}
````

## File: frontend/src/app/plugin/plugin-manifest.ts
````typescript
export const PLUGIN_API_VERSION = '1.0.0';
export const PLUGIN_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1 as const;

export type PluginPermission =
  | 'commands'
  | 'keybindings'
  | 'viewers'
  | 'surfaces'
  | 'toolbar'
  | 'contextMenu'
  | 'fileCategories'
  | 'relatedLocations'
  | 'filesystem.read'
  | 'filesystem.write'
  | 'network'
  | 'process'
  | 'clipboard';

export type PluginActivationEvent =
  | 'onStartup'
  | 'onDemand'
  | `onCommand:${string}`
  | `onScheme:${string}`
  | `onSurface:${string}`;

export interface PluginManifest {
  schemaVersion: typeof PLUGIN_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION;
  id: string;
  name: string;
  version: string;
  description?: string;
  author?: string;
  homepage?: string;
  license?: string;
  /** Compatibility range for the host plugin API, e.g. ^1.0.0 or 1.x. */
  apiVersion?: string;
  permissions?: readonly PluginPermission[];
  activationEvents?: readonly PluginActivationEvent[];
  contributes?: {
    schemes?: readonly string[];
    extensions?: readonly string[];
    commands?: readonly string[];
    surfaces?: readonly string[];
    viewers?: readonly string[];
    relatedLocations?: readonly string[];
  };
}

export interface PluginManifestValidationResult {
  valid: boolean;
  errors: string[];
  warnings: string[];
}

const PLUGIN_ID = /^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9._-]*[a-z0-9])?$/;
const SEMVER = /^(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?(?:\.(\d+))?(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$/;

export function validatePluginManifest(
  manifest: PluginManifest,
  hostApiVersion = PLUGIN_API_VERSION,
): PluginManifestValidationResult {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];

  if (manifest.schemaVersion !== PLUGIN_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
    errors.push(`Unsupported plugin manifest schema ${manifest.schemaVersion}.`);
  }
  if (!manifest.id?.trim() || !PLUGIN_ID.test(manifest.id)) {
    errors.push('Plugin id must be a lowercase identifier containing letters, digits, dot, dash, or underscore.');
  }
  if (!manifest.name?.trim()) errors.push('Plugin name is required.');
  if (!manifest.version?.trim() || !SEMVER.test(manifest.version)) {
    errors.push(`Plugin ${manifest.id || '<unknown>'} has an invalid semantic version.`);
  }
  if (manifest.apiVersion && !isPluginApiCompatible(manifest.apiVersion, hostApiVersion)) {
    errors.push(
      `Plugin ${manifest.id || '<unknown>'} requires plugin API ${manifest.apiVersion}, host provides ${hostApiVersion}.`,
    );
  }

  const permissions = manifest.permissions ?? [];
  if (new Set(permissions).size !== permissions.length) {
    warnings.push('Plugin manifest contains duplicate permissions.');
  }

  return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors, warnings };
}

/**
 * Intentionally small compatibility matcher for the plugin API contract.
 * Supported forms: *, 1, 1.x, 1.2, 1.2.x, 1.2.3, ^1.2.3.
 * We can swap this for a full semver implementation later without changing manifests.
 */
export function isPluginApiCompatible(range: string, current: string): boolean {
  const wanted = range.trim();
  if (!wanted || wanted === '*') return true;

  const currentVersion = parseVersion(current);
  if (!currentVersion) return false;

  if (wanted.startsWith('^')) {
    const base = parseVersion(wanted.slice(1));
    if (!base) return false;
    if (base.major !== currentVersion.major) return false;
    return compareVersion(currentVersion, base) >= 0;
  }

  const wildcard = wanted.match(/^(\d+)(?:\.(\d+|x|\*))?(?:\.(\d+|x|\*))?$/i);
  if (wildcard) {
    const major = Number(wildcard[1]);
    if (currentVersion.major !== major) return false;
    const minor = wildcard[2];
    if (minor && minor !== 'x' && minor !== '*' && currentVersion.minor !== Number(minor)) return false;
    const patch = wildcard[3];
    if (patch && patch !== 'x' && patch !== '*' && currentVersion.patch !== Number(patch)) return false;
    return true;
  }

  const exact = parseVersion(wanted);
  return !!exact && compareVersion(currentVersion, exact) === 0;
}

interface ParsedVersion { major: number; minor: number; patch: number }

function parseVersion(value: string): ParsedVersion | null {
  const match = value.trim().match(SEMVER);
  if (!match) return null;
  return {
    major: Number(match[1]),
    minor: Number(match[2] ?? 0),
    patch: Number(match[3] ?? 0),
  };
}

function compareVersion(a: ParsedVersion, b: ParsedVersion): number {
  return a.major - b.major || a.minor - b.minor || a.patch - b.patch;
}
````

````typescript
import type {
  ContextMenuContribution,
  FileCategoryResolver,
  PluginRegistryAPI,
  ToolbarActionContribution,
} from './plugin-registry-api';
import type { PluginPermission } from './plugin-manifest';
import type { CommandDescriptor, PluginInputContribution } from '../services/input-system.types';
import type { ViewerContribution } from '../viewers/viewer-contribution';
import type { SurfaceContribution } from '../surfaces/surface-contribution';
import type { RelatedLocationContribution } from '../services/related-location.types';

/**
 * Plugin-facing registry wrapper. Every successful contribution is recorded and
 * removed in reverse order when the scope is disposed.
 */
export class ScopedPluginRegistry implements PluginRegistryAPI {
  private readonly cleanups: Array<() => void> = [];
  private disposed = false;

  constructor(
    private readonly pluginId: string,
    private readonly host: PluginRegistryAPI,
    private readonly permissions: ReadonlySet<PluginPermission>,
  ) {}

  dispose(): void {
    if (this.disposed) return;
    this.disposed = true;
    for (let i = this.cleanups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      try { this.cleanups[i](); } catch (error) { console.error(`Plugin ${this.pluginId} cleanup failed:`, error); }
    }
    this.cleanups.length = 0;
  }

  registerInput(contribution: PluginInputContribution): void {
    this.assertActive();
    this.require('commands');
    this.require('keybindings');
    const owned = { ...contribution, pluginId: this.pluginId };
    this.host.registerInput(owned);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterInput(this.pluginId));
  }

  unregisterInput(pluginId: string): void {
    this.assertOwnId(pluginId);
    this.host.unregisterInput(pluginId);
  }

  registerCommand(command: CommandDescriptor): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('commands');
    this.host.registerCommand(command);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterCommand(command.id));
  }
  unregisterCommand(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterCommand(id); }

  registerViewer(contribution: ViewerContribution): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('viewers');
    this.host.registerViewer(contribution);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterViewer(contribution.id));
  }
  unregisterViewer(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterViewer(id); }

  registerSurface(contribution: SurfaceContribution): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('surfaces');
    this.host.registerSurface(contribution);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterSurface(contribution.id));
  }
  unregisterSurface(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterSurface(id); }

  registerToolbarAction(action: ToolbarActionContribution): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('toolbar');
    this.host.registerToolbarAction(action);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterToolbarAction(action.id));
  }
  unregisterToolbarAction(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterToolbarAction(id); }

  registerContextMenuItem(item: ContextMenuContribution): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('contextMenu');
    this.host.registerContextMenuItem(item);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterContextMenuItem(item.id));
  }
  unregisterContextMenuItem(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterContextMenuItem(id); }


  registerFileCategory(resolver: FileCategoryResolver): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('fileCategories');
    this.host.registerFileCategory(resolver);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterFileCategory(resolver.id));
  }
  unregisterFileCategory(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterFileCategory(id); }

  registerRelatedLocation(contribution: RelatedLocationContribution): void {
    this.assertActive(); this.require('relatedLocations');
    this.host.registerRelatedLocation(contribution);
    this.cleanups.push(() => this.host.unregisterRelatedLocation(contribution.id));
  }
  unregisterRelatedLocation(id: string): void { this.host.unregisterRelatedLocation(id); }

  private require(permission: PluginPermission): void {
    if (!this.permissions.has(permission)) {
      throw new Error(`Plugin ${this.pluginId} is not granted permission ${permission}.`);
    }
  }

  private assertActive(): void {
    if (this.disposed) throw new Error(`Plugin ${this.pluginId} contribution scope is already disposed.`);
  }

  private assertOwnId(pluginId: string): void {
    if (pluginId !== this.pluginId) {
      throw new Error(`Plugin ${this.pluginId} cannot unregister input owned by ${pluginId}.`);
    }
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { plugin } from '../../../wailsjs/go/models';
import type { CommandDescriptor, CommandInvocation, InputBindingDefinition, KeyStroke, PluginInputContribution } from './input-system.types';
import { ApiService } from './api.service';
import { InputEngineService } from './input-engine.service';

export type PluginSelectionProvider = () => readonly string[];

const OWNER_PREFIX = 'backend-plugin:';

export function backendPluginCommandId(pluginId: string, commandId: string): string {
  return `plugin.backend.${pluginId}.${commandId}`;
}

export function backendPluginCommandName(pluginId: string, commandId: string): string {
  return `${pluginId}.${commandId}`.toLowerCase();
}

function ownedPluginId(pluginId: string): string {
  return `${OWNER_PREFIX}${pluginId}`;
}

type KeyModifier = NonNullable<KeyStroke['modifiers']>[number];

function normalizeModifier(token: string): KeyModifier | null {
  switch (token.trim().toLowerCase()) {
    case 'ctrl':
    case 'control': return 'ctrl';
    case 'shift': return 'shift';
    case 'alt':
    case 'option': return 'alt';
    case 'cmd':
    case 'command':
    case 'meta':
    case 'win':
    case 'windows': return 'meta';
    default: return null;
  }
}

export function parsePluginHotkey(hotkey: string | null | undefined): KeyStroke | null {
  const raw = (hotkey ?? '').trim();
  if (!raw || /\s/.test(raw)) return null; // Multi-stroke chords are not encoded by backend metadata yet.

  const parts = raw.split('+').map(part => part.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length === 0) return null;

  const key = parts.pop()!.toLowerCase();
  if (!key) return null;

  const modifiers: KeyModifier[] = [];
  for (const part of parts) {
    const modifier = normalizeModifier(part);
    if (!modifier) return null;
    if (!modifiers.includes(modifier)) modifiers.push(modifier);
  }

  return { key, modifiers };
}

function commandNeedsSelection(command: plugin.CommandInfo): boolean {
  return !!command.appliesTo?.length;
}

function invocationPaths(invocation: CommandInvocation | undefined, fallback: readonly string[]): string[] {
  const candidate = invocation?.args?.['paths'];
  if (Array.isArray(candidate) && candidate.every(path => typeof path === 'string')) {
    return [...candidate];
  }
  return [...fallback];
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class BackendPluginCommandBridgeService {
  private readonly registeredPluginIds = new Set<string>();
  private selectionProvider: PluginSelectionProvider = () => [];

  constructor(
    private readonly api: ApiService,
    private readonly inputEngine: InputEngineService,
  ) {}

  async start(selectionProvider: PluginSelectionProvider): Promise<void> {
    this.selectionProvider = selectionProvider;
    await this.refresh();
  }

  async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    const plugins = await this.api.listBackendPlugins();
    this.clearRegisteredCommands();

    try {
      for (const info of plugins ?? []) {
        const contribution = this.toInputContribution(info);
        if (contribution.commands.length === 0) continue;

        this.inputEngine.registerPluginInput(contribution);
        this.registeredPluginIds.add(contribution.pluginId);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      this.clearRegisteredCommands();
      throw error;
    }
  }

  stop(): void {
    this.clearRegisteredCommands();
    this.selectionProvider = () => [];
  }

  private toInputContribution(info: plugin.Info): PluginInputContribution {
    const pluginId = ownedPluginId(info.id);
    const commands: CommandDescriptor[] = [];
    const bindings: InputBindingDefinition[] = [];

    for (const command of info.commands ?? []) {
      const id = backendPluginCommandId(info.id, command.id);
      commands.push({
        id,
        title: command.label || command.id,
        description: info.name ? `${info.name} plugin command` : 'Backend plugin command',
        category: 'Plugins',
        icon: command.icon,
        name: backendPluginCommandName(info.id, command.id),
        execute: (invocation) => this.api.invokeBackendPluginCommand(
          info.id,
          command.id,
          invocationPaths(invocation, this.selectionProvider()),
        ),
        isEnabled: (invocation) => !commandNeedsSelection(command)
          || invocationPaths(invocation, this.selectionProvider()).length > 0,
      });

      const stroke = parsePluginHotkey(command.hotkey);
      if (stroke) {
        bindings.push({
          id: `${id}.defaultHotkey`,
          commandId: id,
          contextId: 'global',
          source: 'plugin',
          description: command.label || command.id,
          category: 'Plugins',
          when: '!typing && !quickAccess && hasActivePane',
          preventDefault: true,
          trigger: { device: 'keyboard', chord: { steps: [stroke] } },
        });
      }
    }

    return { pluginId, commands, bindings };
  }

  private clearRegisteredCommands(): void {
    for (const pluginId of this.registeredPluginIds) {
      this.inputEngine.unregisterPluginInput(pluginId);
    }
    this.registeredPluginIds.clear();
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { DuplicateFinderService } from './duplicate-finder.service';
import { FileType } from '../shared/protocol';

function f(path: string, size: number, modified = 1) {
  return { name: path.split('/').pop()!, path, type: FileType.FILE, size, modified, created: 0, accessed: 0, permissions: '', isHidden: false };
}
function d(path: string) {
  return { ...f(path, 0), type: FileType.DIRECTORY };
}

describe('DuplicateFinderService', () => {
  it('hashes only size-collision candidates and groups verified matches', async () => {
    const api = {
      listDirectory: fn(async (path: string) => path === '/root'
        ? { entries: [f('/root/a.txt', 10), f('/root/b.txt', 10), f('/root/c.txt', 20), d('/root/nested')] }
        : { entries: [f('/root/nested/d.txt', 10)] }),
      hashFile: fn(async (path: string) => path.endsWith('b.txt') ? 'other' : 'same'),
    };
    const result = await new DuplicateFinderService(api as any).scan('/root');
    expect(api.hashFile).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
    expect(result.groups).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(result.groups[0].files.map(x => x.path)).toEqual(['/root/a.txt', '/root/nested/d.txt']);
    expect(result.reclaimableBytes).toBe(10);
  });

  it('does not descend through directory symlinks', async () => {
    const linked = { ...d('/root/link'), isSymlink: true };
    const api = { listDirectory: fn(async () => ({ entries: [linked] })), hashFile: fn() };
    await new DuplicateFinderService(api as any).scan('/root');
    expect(api.listDirectory).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('returns suggested redundant paths while preserving one keeper', () => {
    const service = new DuplicateFinderService({} as any);
    const group = { hash: 'x', size: 3, files: [f('/a', 3), f('/b', 3), f('/c', 3)], reclaimableBytes: 6, suggestedKeeperPath: '/a' };
    expect(service.suggestedRedundantPaths([group])).toEqual(['/b', '/c']);
  });
});

describe('DuplicateFinderService keeper policies', () => {
  const service = new DuplicateFinderService({} as any);
  const group = {
    hash: 'same', size: 10, reclaimableBytes: 20,
    files: [f('/very/long/path/a.txt', 10, 2), f('/b.txt', 10, 3), f('/mid/c.txt', 10, 1)],
    suggestedKeeperPath: '/mid/c.txt',
  };

  it('supports oldest, newest and shortest-path keepers', () => {
    expect(service.keeperPath(group, 'oldest')).toBe('/mid/c.txt');
    expect(service.keeperPath(group, 'newest')).toBe('/b.txt');
    expect(service.keeperPath(group, 'shortest-path')).toBe('/b.txt');
  });

  it('builds redundant selections from the chosen policy', () => {
    expect(service.redundantPaths([group], 'newest')).toEqual(['/very/long/path/a.txt', '/mid/c.txt']);
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { NgZone } from '@angular/core';
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { InputEngineService } from './input-engine.service';
import type { CommandInvocation } from './input-system.types';

function createEngine(): InputEngineService {
  return new InputEngineService(new NgZone({ enableLongStackTrace: false }));
}
````

````typescript
import { buildSegments, isWindowsPath, normalizePath, shortenPath } from '../components/address-bar.utils';

import type { LocationKind, LocationReference } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
export type { LocationKind, LocationReference } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

const LOCATION_ICONS: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  search: '🔎',
  archive: '🗜️',
  s3: '☁️',
  smb: '🖧',
  gdrive: '☁️',
  onedrive: '☁️',
  dropbox: '☁️',
  registry: '🧩',
  memory: '🧠',
  http: '🌐',
  https: '🔒',
  surface: '◫',
};

export function schemeOfLocation(location: string): string {
  const match = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec((location ?? '').trim());
  return match ? match[1].toLowerCase() : 'filesystem';
}

export function kindOfLocation(locationOrScheme: string): LocationKind {
  const scheme = locationOrScheme.includes('://')
    ? schemeOfLocation(locationOrScheme)
    : locationOrScheme.toLowerCase();
  if (scheme === 'search') return 'query';
  if (scheme === 'surface') return 'surface';
  return 'location';
}

export function canonicalizeLocation(location: string): string {
  const trimmed = (location ?? '').trim();
  if (!trimmed) return '';
  return schemeOfLocation(trimmed) === 'filesystem' ? normalizePath(trimmed) : trimmed;
}

export function locationIdentity(location: string): string {
  const canonical = canonicalizeLocation(location);
  if (!canonical) return '';
  const scheme = schemeOfLocation(canonical);
  const value = scheme === 'filesystem' ? canonical.toLowerCase() : canonical;
  return `${scheme}:${value}`;
}

export function locationLabel(location: string): string {
  const canonical = canonicalizeLocation(location);
  if (!canonical) return '';
  const scheme = schemeOfLocation(canonical);

  if (scheme !== 'filesystem') {
    try {
      const url = new URL(canonical);
      const query = url.searchParams.get('pattern') || url.searchParams.get('q');
      if (query) return query;
      const tail = url.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean).at(-1);
      return tail || `${scheme} location`;
    } catch {
      const withoutScheme = canonical.replace(/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//i, '');
      return withoutScheme.split('/').filter(Boolean).at(-1) || `${scheme} location`;
    }
  }

  const segments = buildSegments(canonical);
  return segments.at(-1)?.label || (isWindowsPath(canonical) ? shortenPath(canonical) : '/');
}

export function locationIcon(locationOrScheme: string): string {
  const scheme = locationOrScheme.includes('://')
    ? schemeOfLocation(locationOrScheme)
    : locationOrScheme.toLowerCase();
  return LOCATION_ICONS[scheme] ?? '📁';
}

export function describeLocation(location: string): LocationReference | null {
  const canonical = canonicalizeLocation(location);
  if (!canonical) return null;
  const scheme = schemeOfLocation(canonical);
  return { location: canonical, scheme, kind: kindOfLocation(scheme) };
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { EventsOn } from 'wailsjs/runtime';

declare const window: any;

export interface NativeBrowserPaneSyncRequest {
  surfaceId: string;
  url: string;
  theme: 'dark' | 'light';
  backgroundColor: string;
  visible: boolean;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

export interface NativeBrowserPaneIncomingMessage<T = unknown> {
  surfaceId: string;
  message: string;
  data: T;
}

export interface NativeBrowserPaneLifecycleEvent {
  surfaceId: string;
  state: 'started' | 'completed' | 'failed';
  url: string;
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root',
})
export class NativeBrowserPaneService {
  /** True once the Wails Go runtime has confirmed it's handling calls. */
  private _ready = false;
  private pendingRpcs = new Map<string, { resolve: (value: unknown) => void; reject: (reason: Error) => void; timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> }>();

  get runtimeReady(): boolean {
    return this._ready;
  }

  constructor() {
    // Always listen for RPC responses so pending promises can resolve
    EventsOn('browser-pane:rpc', (event: { surfaceId?: string; message?: string } | null) => {
      const message = typeof event?.message === 'string' ? event.message : '';
      if (!message) return;
      try {
        const data = JSON.parse(message) as { id?: string; result?: unknown; error?: string } | null;
        if (!data?.id) return;
        this.handleRpcResponse(data.id, data.result, data.error);
      } catch {
        // ignore non-JSON
      }
    });
  }

  async sync(request: NativeBrowserPaneSyncRequest): Promise<boolean> {
    const api = window.go?.app?.App;
    if (!api?.BrowserPaneSync) {
      return false;
    }
    if (!this._ready) {
      // Probe readiness: call a binding that returns a value.
      // If Wails callbacks aren't registered yet, the call resolves undefined.
      if (!await this.probeReady()) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    try {
      await api.BrowserPaneSync(request);
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  /** Check if Go bindings are responsive by calling a function that returns a known value. */
  private async probeReady(): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      // BrowserPaneCaptureScreenshot with empty surfaceId should return '' from Go.
      // If Wails isn't ready, it resolves undefined.
      const api = window.go?.app?.App;
      if (!api?.BrowserPaneCaptureScreenshot) {
        return false;
      }
      const result = await api.BrowserPaneCaptureScreenshot('');
      // Go returns '' for empty surfaceId. If Wails isn't ready, result is undefined.
      if (result !== undefined) {
        this._ready = true;
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch {
      // Go returns an error for empty surfaceId — but at least it responded!
      this._ready = true;
      return true;
    }
  }

  async dispose(surfaceId: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!surfaceId) {
      return;
    }
    const api = window.go?.app?.App;
    if (!api?.BrowserPaneDispose) {
      return;
    }
    await api.BrowserPaneDispose(surfaceId);
  }

  async captureScreenshot(surfaceId: string): Promise<string> {
    if (!surfaceId) {
      return '';
    }
    const api = window.go?.app?.App;
    if (!api?.BrowserPaneCaptureScreenshot) {
      return '';
    }
    return await api.BrowserPaneCaptureScreenshot(surfaceId);
  }

  async getDocumentBackground(surfaceId: string): Promise<string> {
    if (!surfaceId) {
      return '';
    }
    const api = window.go?.app?.App;
    if (!api?.BrowserPaneGetDocumentBackground) {
      return '';
    }
    try {
      return await api.BrowserPaneGetDocumentBackground(surfaceId);
    } catch {
      return '';
    }
  }

  async postMessage(surfaceId: string, message: unknown): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!surfaceId) {
      return false;
    }
    const api = window.go?.app?.App;
    if (!api?.BrowserPanePostMessage) {
      return false;
    }
    if (!this._ready && !await this.probeReady()) {
      return false;
    }
    try {
      await api.BrowserPanePostMessage(surfaceId, this.serializeMessage(message));
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  onMessage(handler: (event: NativeBrowserPaneIncomingMessage) => void): (() => void) {
    return EventsOn('browser-pane:message', (event: { surfaceId?: string; message?: string } | null) => {
      const surfaceId = typeof event?.surfaceId === 'string' ? event.surfaceId : '';
      const message = typeof event?.message === 'string' ? event.message : '';
      if (!surfaceId) {
        return;
      }
      handler({
        surfaceId,
        message,
        data: this.parseMessage(message),
      });
    });
  }

  onSurfaceMessage(surfaceId: string, handler: (event: NativeBrowserPaneIncomingMessage) => void): (() => void) {
    return this.onMessage((event) => {
      if (event.surfaceId !== surfaceId) {
        return;
      }
      handler(event);
    });
  }

  onLifecycleEvent(handler: (event: NativeBrowserPaneLifecycleEvent) => void): (() => void) {
    return EventsOn('browser-pane:lifecycle', (event: { surfaceId?: string; state?: string; url?: string } | null) => {
      const surfaceId = typeof event?.surfaceId === 'string' ? event.surfaceId : '';
      const state = typeof event?.state === 'string' ? event.state : '';
      const url = typeof event?.url === 'string' ? event.url : '';
      if (!surfaceId || !state) {
        return;
      }
      handler({
        surfaceId,
        state: state as NativeBrowserPaneLifecycleEvent['state'],
        url,
      });
    });
  }

  onSurfaceLifecycleEvent(surfaceId: string, handler: (event: NativeBrowserPaneLifecycleEvent) => void): (() => void) {
    return this.onLifecycleEvent((event) => {
      if (event.surfaceId !== surfaceId) {
        return;
      }
      handler(event);
    });
  }

  async whenNavigationCompleted(surfaceId: string, timeoutMs = 30000): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const unsubscribe = this.onSurfaceLifecycleEvent(surfaceId, (event) => {
        if (event.state === 'completed') {
          unsubscribe();
          resolve();
        }
      });
      setTimeout(() => {
        unsubscribe();
        reject(new Error(`Navigation completion timed out for ${surfaceId}`));
      }, timeoutMs);
    });
  }

  async rpcCall<T = unknown>(
    surfaceId: string,
    type: string,
    payload?: unknown,
    timeoutMs = 5000,
  ): Promise<T> {
    if (!surfaceId) {
      return Promise.reject(new Error('surfaceId is required'));
    }
    const id = this.generateRpcId();
    const request = { _rpc: true, id, v: 1, type, payload };

    const success = await this.postMessage(surfaceId, request);
    if (!success) {
      return Promise.reject(new Error(`Failed to send RPC request to ${surfaceId}`));
    }

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.pendingRpcs.delete(id);
        reject(new Error(`RPC '${type}' timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`));
      }, timeoutMs);
      this.pendingRpcs.set(id, {
        resolve: resolve as (value: unknown) => void,
        reject,
        timer,
      });
    });
  }

  private generateRpcId(): string {
    return `rpc_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)}`;
  }

  private handleRpcResponse(id: string, result: unknown, error: string | undefined): void {
    const pending = this.pendingRpcs.get(id);
    if (!pending) return;
    clearTimeout(pending.timer);
    this.pendingRpcs.delete(id);
    if (error) {
      pending.reject(new Error(error));
    } else {
      pending.resolve(result);
    }
  }

  private serializeMessage(message: unknown): string {
    const serialized = JSON.stringify(message);
    return serialized === undefined ? 'null' : serialized;
  }

  private parseMessage(message: string): unknown {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(message);
    } catch {
      return message;
    }
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { PluginBootstrapService } from './plugin-bootstrap.service';
import type { PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService } from './plugin-lifecycle-coordinator.service';

function coordinator(overrides: Partial<PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService> = {}): PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService {
  return {
    sync: fn(async () => []),
    activateStartup: fn(async () => []),
    shutdown: fn(async () => []),
    ...overrides,
  } as unknown as PluginLifecycleCoordinatorService;
}

describe('PluginBootstrapService', () => {
  it('initializes only once and activates startup plugins after reconciliation', async () => {
    const lifecycle = coordinator();
    const service = new PluginBootstrapService(lifecycle);

    const [a, b] = await Promise.all([service.initialize(), service.initialize()]);

    expect(a.status).toBe('ready');
    expect(b.status).toBe('ready');
    expect(lifecycle.sync).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(lifecycle.activateStartup).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('degrades without throwing when one startup plugin fails', async () => {
    const lifecycle = coordinator({
      activateStartup: fn(async () => [
        { pluginId: 'good', activated: true },
        { pluginId: 'bad', activated: false, error: 'boom' },
      ]),
    });
    const service = new PluginBootstrapService(lifecycle);

    const snapshot = await service.initialize();

    expect(snapshot.status).toBe('degraded');
    expect(snapshot.errors).toEqual(['bad: boom']);
  });

  it('keeps the host usable when discovery itself fails', async () => {
    const lifecycle = coordinator({ sync: fn(async () => { throw new Error('discovery failed'); }) });
    const service = new PluginBootstrapService(lifecycle);

    const result = await service.initialize();
    expect(result).toEqual(jasmine.objectContaining({ status: 'degraded' }));
    expect(service.snapshot.errors).toEqual(['discovery failed']);
  });

  it('records shutdown errors but continues teardown', async () => {
    const lifecycle = coordinator({
      shutdown: fn(async () => [
        { pluginId: 'bad', error: 'deactivate failed' },
        { pluginId: 'good' },
      ]),
    });
    const service = new PluginBootstrapService(lifecycle);
    await service.initialize();

    await service.shutdown();

    expect(service.snapshot.status).toBe('stopped');
    expect(service.snapshot.errors).toContain('bad: deactivate failed');
  });
  it('starts backend command discovery before package reconciliation and stops it at shutdown', async () => {
    const order: string[] = [];
    const lifecycle = coordinator({
      sync: fn(async () => { order.push('sync'); return []; }),
      shutdown: fn(async () => { order.push('shutdown'); return []; }),
    });
    const backend = {
      start: fn(async (selection: () => string[]) => { order.push(`backend:${selection().join(',')}`); }),
      stop: fn(() => { order.push('backend-stop'); }),
    };
    const service = new PluginBootstrapService(lifecycle, backend as any);

    await service.initialize(() => ['C:/work/a.txt']);
    await service.shutdown();

    expect(order.slice(0, 2)).toEqual(['backend:C:/work/a.txt', 'sync']);
    expect(order.slice(-2)).toEqual(['shutdown', 'backend-stop']);
  });

});
````

````typescript
    directoryLoader: DirectoryPluginPackageLoaderService,
  ) {
    if (!this.platform.hasLoader(directoryLoader.kind)) {
      this.platform.registerLoader(directoryLoader);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Reconciles disk discovery + persisted user policy with the executable
   * plugin platform. This method never broadens permissions and never activates
   * packages by itself.
   */
  async sync(): Promise<ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot[]> {
    const packages = await this.installation.refresh();
    this.managed = new Map(packages.map(pkg => [pkg.discovered.manifest.id, pkg]));

    await this.removeIneligibleManagedRuntimes();

    const snapshots: ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot[] = [];
    for (const pkg of packages) {
      snapshots.push(await this.reconcilePackage(pkg));
    }
    return snapshots;
  }

  async activate(pluginId: string): Promise<void> {
    const synced = await this.sync();
    const managed = this.mustGetManaged(pluginId);
    const status = synced.find(item => item.plugin.discovered.manifest.id === pluginId);
    if (!managed.readyToActivate) {
      throw new Error(status?.reason ?? `Plugin ${pluginId} is not eligible for activation.`);
    }
    if (!this.platform.isInstalled(pluginId)) {
      throw new Error(status?.reason ?? `Plugin ${pluginId} has no executable package loader.`);
    }

    try {
      await this.platform.activate(pluginId);
      await this.installation.recordActivation(pluginId, true);
    } catch (error) {
      const message = errorMessage(error);
      const state = await this.installation.recordActivation(pluginId, false, message);
      if (state.quarantined) {
        await this.removeRuntime(pluginId);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async deactivate(pluginId: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.platform.isInstalled(pluginId)) return;
    await this.platform.deactivate(pluginId);
  }

  async activateByEvent(event: PluginActivationEvent): Promise<PluginActivationEventResult[]> {
    await this.sync();
    const results: PluginActivationEventResult[] = [];

    for (const pkg of this.managed.values()) {
      if (!pkg.readyToActivate) continue;
      const events = pkg.discovered.manifest.activationEvents ?? ['onStartup'];
      if (!events.includes(event)) continue;
      if (!this.platform.isInstalled(pkg.discovered.manifest.id)) continue;

      try {
        await this.activate(pkg.discovered.manifest.id);
        results.push({ pluginId: pkg.discovered.manifest.id, activated: true });
      } catch (error) {
        results.push({
          pluginId: pkg.discovered.manifest.id,
          activated: false,
          error: errorMessage(error),
        });
      }
    }
    return results;
  }

  activateStartup(): Promise<PluginActivationEventResult[]> {
    return this.activateByEvent('onStartup');
  }

  /**
   * Best-effort lifecycle shutdown for application teardown. Every installed
   * plugin gets a chance to deactivate; one failing hook never blocks cleanup
   * of the remaining plugin scopes.
   */
  async shutdown(): Promise<readonly { pluginId: string; error?: string }[]> {
    const results: Array<{ pluginId: string; error?: string }> = [];
    const runtimes = [...this.platform.list()].reverse();

    for (const runtime of runtimes) {
      try {
        await this.platform.deactivate(runtime.manifest.id);
        results.push({ pluginId: runtime.manifest.id });
      } catch (error) {
        results.push({ pluginId: runtime.manifest.id, error: errorMessage(error) });
      }
    }

    return results;
  }

  async setEnabled(pluginId: string, enabled: boolean): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    const state = await this.installation.setEnabled(pluginId, enabled);
    await this.sync();
    return state;
  }

  async setTrusted(pluginId: string, trusted: boolean): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    const state = await this.installation.setTrusted(pluginId, trusted);
    await this.sync();
    return state;
  }

  async setGrantedPermissions(
    pluginId: string,
    permissions: readonly PluginPermission[],
  ): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    const state = await this.installation.setGrantedPermissions(pluginId, permissions);
    await this.sync();
    return state;
  }

  async clearQuarantine(pluginId: string): Promise<PluginPackageState> {
    const state = await this.installation.clearQuarantine(pluginId);
    await this.sync();
    return state;
  }

  private async reconcilePackage(pkg: ManagedPluginPackage): Promise<ManagedPluginRuntimeSnapshot> {
    const id = pkg.discovered.manifest.id;

    if (!pkg.discovered.valid) {
      return { plugin: pkg, status: 'invalid', reason: pkg.discovered.errors.join(' ') || 'Invalid plugin package.' };
    }
    if (!pkg.state.enabled) {
      return { plugin: pkg, status: 'disabled', reason: 'Plugin is disabled.' };
    }
    if (pkg.state.quarantined) {
      return { plugin: pkg, status: 'quarantined', reason: pkg.state.quarantineReason || 'Plugin is quarantined.' };
    }
    if (pkg.missingPermissions.length) {
      return {
        plugin: pkg,
        status: 'permissions-required',
        reason: `Missing permissions: ${pkg.missingPermissions.join(', ')}.`,
      };
    }

    const source = this.sourceFor(pkg);
    let runtime = this.platform.get(id);
    const staleRuntime = runtime && (
      runtime.manifest.version !== pkg.discovered.manifest.version ||
      runtime.source?.uri !== source.uri ||
      !samePermissions(runtime.grantedPermissions, pkg.effectiveGrantedPermissions)
    );

    if (staleRuntime) {
      await this.removeRuntime(id);
      runtime = undefined;
    }

    if (!runtime) {
      if (!this.platform.hasLoader(source.kind)) {
        return {
          plugin: pkg,
          status: 'loader-unavailable',
          reason: `No safe ${source.kind} plugin loader is registered.`,
        };
      }
      await this.platform.installFromSource(source, {
        trusted: false,
        grantedPermissions: pkg.effectiveGrantedPermissions,
        activate: false,
      });
      runtime = this.platform.get(id);
    }

    return {
      plugin: pkg,
      runtime,
      status: runtime?.state === 'active'
        ? 'active'
        : runtime?.state === 'failed'
          ? 'failed'
          : 'installed',
      reason: runtime?.error,
    };
  }

  private async removeIneligibleManagedRuntimes(): Promise<void> {
    for (const runtime of this.platform.list()) {
      if (runtime.source?.metadata?.['managedBy'] !== POLICY_SOURCE_OWNER) continue;
      const pkg = this.managed.get(runtime.manifest.id);
      if (!pkg || !pkg.readyToActivate) {
        await this.removeRuntime(runtime.manifest.id);
      }
    }
  }

  private async removeRuntime(pluginId: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.platform.isInstalled(pluginId)) return;
    await this.platform.uninstall(pluginId);
  }

  private sourceFor(pkg: ManagedPluginPackage): PluginPackageSource {
    return {
      kind: 'directory',
      uri: pkg.discovered.path,
      metadata: {
        managedBy: POLICY_SOURCE_OWNER,
        pluginId: pkg.discovered.manifest.id,
        manifestPath: pkg.discovered.manifestPath,
        version: pkg.discovered.manifest.version,
      },
    };
  }

  private mustGetManaged(pluginId: string): ManagedPluginPackage {
    const pkg = this.managed.get(pluginId);
    if (!pkg) throw new Error(`Plugin ${pluginId} is not a discovered package.`);
    return pkg;
  }
}

function samePermissions(a: readonly PluginPermission[], b: readonly PluginPermission[]): boolean {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false;
  const left = new Set(a);
  return b.every(permission => left.has(permission));
}

function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
}
````

````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { PluginPlatformService } from './plugin-platform.service';
import type { PluginRegistryAPI } from '../plugin/plugin-registry-api';
import type { PluginPackage } from '../plugin/plugin-package';

function registry(): PluginRegistryAPI {
  return {
    registerInput: fn(), unregisterInput: fn(),
    registerCommand: fn(), unregisterCommand: fn(),
    registerViewer: fn(), unregisterViewer: fn(),
    registerSurface: fn(), unregisterSurface: fn(),
    registerToolbarAction: fn(), unregisterToolbarAction: fn(),
    registerContextMenuItem: fn(), unregisterContextMenuItem: fn(),
    registerFileCategory: fn(), unregisterFileCategory: fn(),
  };
}

function pkg(activate = fn()): PluginPackage {
  return {
    manifest: {
      schemaVersion: 1,
      id: 'demo.tools',
      name: 'Demo Tools',
      version: '1.0.0',
      apiVersion: '^1.0.0',
      permissions: ['commands'],
    },
    activate,
  };
}

describe('PluginPlatformService', () => {
  it('installs and activates trusted packages', async () => {
    const activate = fn();
    const platform = new PluginPlatformService(registry() as any);
    await platform.install(pkg(activate), { trusted: true, activate: true });

    expect(activate).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(platform.get('demo.tools')?.state).toBe('active');
  });

  it('refuses activation until requested permissions are granted', async () => {
    const platform = new PluginPlatformService(registry() as any);
    await platform.install(pkg());
    await expectAsync(platform.activate('demo.tools')).toBeRejectedWithError(/missing permissions/);
  });

  it('disposes all scoped contributions if activation fails', async () => {
    const target = registry();
    const platform = new PluginPlatformService(target as any);
    const broken = pkg(({ api }: any) => {
      api.registerCommand({ id: 'plugin.demo.run', title: 'Run', execute: () => undefined });
      throw new Error('boom');
    });
    await platform.install(broken, { trusted: true });

    await expectAsync(platform.activate('demo.tools')).toBeRejectedWithError(/boom/);
    expect(target.unregisterCommand).toHaveBeenCalledWith('plugin.demo.run');
    expect(platform.get('demo.tools')?.state).toBe('failed');
  });

  it('activates packages by declared activation event', async () => {
    const activate = fn();
    const p = pkg(activate);
    p.manifest = { ...p.manifest, activationEvents: ['onCommand:hash.sha256'] };
    const platform = new PluginPlatformService(registry() as any);
    await platform.install(p, { trusted: true });

    expect(await platform.activateByEvent('onStartup')).toEqual([]);
    expect(await platform.activateByEvent('onCommand:hash.sha256')).toEqual(['demo.tools']);
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { contracts } from '../../../wailsjs/go/models';

interface RemoteConnectDialogRequest {
  resolve: (value: contracts.RemoteMount | null) => void;
  initialName?: string;
  initialProtocol?: string;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class RemoteConnectDialogService {
  public readonly activeRequest$ = createBehaviorSubject<RemoteConnectDialogRequest | null>(null);

  private readonly queue: RemoteConnectDialogRequest[] = [];

  openDialog(options?: { name?: string; protocol?: string }): Promise<contracts.RemoteMount | null> {
    return new Promise<contracts.RemoteMount | null>((resolve) => {
      this.queue.push({
        resolve,
        initialName: options?.name?.trim() || undefined,
        initialProtocol: options?.protocol?.trim() || undefined,
      });
      this.tryOpenNext();
    });
  }

  openS3Dialog(options?: { name?: string }): Promise<contracts.RemoteMount | null> {
    return this.openDialog({ ...options, protocol: 's3' });
  }

  resolveActive(result: contracts.RemoteMount | null): void {
    const active = this.activeRequest$.value;
    if (!active) {
      return;
    }

    active.resolve(result);
    this.activeRequest$.next(null);
    this.tryOpenNext();
  }

  private tryOpenNext(): void {
    if (this.activeRequest$.value) {
      return;
    }
    this.activeRequest$.next(this.queue.shift() ?? null);
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { SourceCapabilities } from './source-capabilities';
import { canReceiveTransfer, canTransferBetween } from './transfer-capabilities';
const mutable: SourceCapabilities = { read: true, create: true, delete: true, rename: true, trash: false };
const readOnly: SourceCapabilities = { read: true, create: false, delete: false, rename: false, trash: false };
describe('transfer capabilities', () => {
  it('requires create capability on any transfer destination', () => {
    expect(canReceiveTransfer(mutable).allowed).toBe(true);
    expect(canReceiveTransfer(readOnly)).toEqual({ allowed: false, reason: 'destination-read-only' });
  });

  it('allows copying from a read-only source into a writable destination', () => expect(canTransferBetween('copy', readOnly, mutable)).toEqual({ allowed: true }));
  it('blocks copying into a read-only destination', () => expect(canTransferBetween('copy', mutable, readOnly)).toEqual({ allowed: false, reason: 'destination-read-only' }));
  it('blocks moving from a read-only source', () => expect(canTransferBetween('move', readOnly, mutable)).toEqual({ allowed: false, reason: 'source-not-removable' }));
  it('allows moving between mutable sources', () => expect(canTransferBetween('move', mutable, mutable)).toEqual({ allowed: true }));
});
````

## File: frontend/src/app/services/window-state.service.ts
````typescript
import { Injectable, NgZone, OnDestroy } from '@angular/core';
import { GetPreferences, SavePreferences } from 'wailsjs/go/app/App';
import {
  WindowGetSize,
  WindowGetPosition,
  WindowIsMaximised,
} from 'wailsjs/runtime';
import type { WindowState } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

interface BackendUserPreferences {
  windowState?: WindowState;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

/**
 * Captures window geometry (size, position, maximised state) and persists it
 * via backend `UserPreferences`. Debounced so resize/move drags don't flood IPC.
 *
 * Restoration of size+maximised happens at backend bootstrap before wails.Run().
 * Restoration of position happens in the Wails OnStartup hook (also backend).
 * This service only handles the *capture* side from the frontend.
 */
@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class WindowStateService implements OnDestroy {
  private debounceTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private cachedPreferences: BackendUserPreferences | null = null;
  private readonly captureHandler = () => this.scheduleCapture();
  private started = false;

  constructor(private readonly ngZone: NgZone) {}

  /** Start listening for resize / visibility changes. Idempotent. */
  start(): void {
    if (this.started) return;
    this.started = true;
    this.ngZone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      window.addEventListener('resize', this.captureHandler, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener('beforeunload', this.captureHandler);
    });
    // Seed normal-mode bounds before the user can maximise, so the first
    // maximise transition has a prior rect to preserve.
    this.scheduleCapture();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    window.removeEventListener('resize', this.captureHandler);
    window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', this.captureHandler);
    if (this.debounceTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.debounceTimer);
      this.debounceTimer = null;
    }
  }

  /** Force an immediate capture (e.g. before close). */
  async captureNow(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.debounceTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.debounceTimer);
      this.debounceTimer = null;
    }
    await this.captureAndPersist();
  }

  private scheduleCapture(): void {
    if (this.debounceTimer) clearTimeout(this.debounceTimer);
    this.debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.debounceTimer = null;
      void this.captureAndPersist();
    }, 400);
  }

  private async captureAndPersist(): Promise<void> {
    let observed: WindowState;
    try {
      const [size, position, maximised] = await Promise.all([
        WindowGetSize(),
        WindowGetPosition(),
        WindowIsMaximised(),
      ]);
      observed = {
        width: Math.round(size.w),
        height: Math.round(size.h),
        x: Math.round(position.x),
        y: Math.round(position.y),
        maximised: !!maximised,
        hasPosition: true,
      };
    } catch {
      return; // Wails runtime not yet attached.
    }

    if (observed.width <= 0 || observed.height <= 0) return;

    // Ignore minimised windows: Windows reports x/y = -32000 and a tiny size.
    // Keep the previously persisted normal bounds instead.
    if (this.isMinimised(observed)) {
      if (!observed.maximised) return;
      // If somehow maximised and minimised at the same time, drop the bogus bounds.
      observed = { ...observed, width: 0, height: 0, x: 0, y: 0, hasPosition: false };
    }

    try {
      const current = this.cachedPreferences ?? (await GetPreferences() as unknown as BackendUserPreferences);
      this.cachedPreferences = current;

      const snapshot = this.mergeNormalBounds(current.windowState, observed);

      if (this.isSameWindowState(current.windowState, snapshot)) return;

      await SavePreferences({
        ...current,
        windowState: snapshot,
      } as any);
      this.cachedPreferences = { ...current, windowState: snapshot };
    } catch {
      // Ignore backend errors during early startup or shutdown races.
    }
  }

  /**
   * Width/height/x/y always represent the last *normal* (non-maximised) bounds
   * so that un-maximising restores the user's prior geometry. When the observed
   * window is maximised, keep the previously persisted normal bounds and only
   * flip the maximised flag.
   */
  private mergeNormalBounds(prev: WindowState | undefined, observed: WindowState): WindowState {
    if (!observed.maximised) {
      return observed;
    }
    if (!prev || prev.width <= 0 || prev.height <= 0) {
      return observed;
    }
    return {
      width: prev.width,
      height: prev.height,
      x: prev.x,
      y: prev.y,
      maximised: true,
      hasPosition: prev.hasPosition ?? observed.hasPosition,
    };
  }

  private isMinimised(state: WindowState): boolean {
    // Windows uses -32000 for minimised window coordinates.
    const minimisedCoord = -32000;
    const minVisibleSize = 50;
    return (
      state.x <= minimisedCoord ||
      state.y <= minimisedCoord ||
      state.width < minVisibleSize ||
      state.height < minVisibleSize
    );
  }

  private isSameWindowState(a: WindowState | undefined, b: WindowState): boolean {
    if (!a) return false;
    return (
      a.width === b.width &&
      a.height === b.height &&
      a.x === b.x &&
      a.y === b.y &&
      a.maximised === b.maximised &&
      !!a.hasPosition === !!b.hasPosition
    );
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { DirTabState } from './dir-tab-state';
import { FilterQuery } from '../../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import { FileInfo } from '../../shared/protocol';

export interface PendingRestoreSlot {
  selectedPaths: string[];
  cursorPath: string | null;
  anchorPath: string | null;
  scrollTop: number | null;
  expandedPaths: string[];
}

export interface DirTabSessionState {
  getEntriesPaths(): string[];
  getOptimisticHiddenPaths(): string[];
  setOptimisticHiddenPaths(paths: string[]): void;

  currentPath: string;
  showHidden: boolean;
  entries: FileInfo[];
  currentView: DirTabState['currentView'];
  sortField: string;
  sortDirection: 'asc' | 'desc';
  directoriesFirst: boolean;
  colorizeByMime: boolean;
  filterQuery: FilterQuery;
  selectedFiles: Set<string>;
  selectionCursorPath: string | null;
  selectionAnchorPath: string | null;
  pendingRestore: PendingRestoreSlot | null;
  userInteractedSinceLoad: boolean;
}

export interface DirTabUiRuntime {
  isInArchive(): boolean;
  getSelectableEntriesPaths(): string[];
  applyFilter(): void;
  scrollToCursorPath(path: string): void;
  emitPreviewTargetFromState(): void;
  getExpandedPaths?(): string[];
  setExpandedPaths?(paths: string[]): void;
  /** Current scroll offset of the file list, or 0 if not measurable. */
  getScrollTop?(): number;
  /** Restore the file list scroll offset (best-effort). */
  setScrollTop?(top: number): void;
}

export interface DirTabRestoreTarget {
  session: DirTabSessionState;
  ui: DirTabUiRuntime;
}

/** Slice of DirTabState that is JSON-serialized for cross-restart persistence. */
export interface PersistedDirTabState {
  /**
   * Bumped whenever the persisted shape changes incompatibly. Older blobs run
   * through DIR_TAB_STATE_MIGRATIONS to upgrade to the current version on load.
   * Missing field is treated as version 0 (the original unversioned shape).
   */
  schemaVersion: number;
  path: string;
  showHidden: boolean;
  currentView: DirTabState['currentView'];
  sortField: string;
  sortDirection: 'asc' | 'desc';
  directoriesFirst: boolean;
  colorizeByMime: boolean;
  filterQuery: DirTabState['filterQuery'];
  selectedPaths: string[];
  cursorPath: string | null;
  anchorPath: string | null;
  scrollTop: number;
  expandedPaths?: string[];
  entries?: FileInfo[];
  optimisticHiddenPaths: string[];
}

export const CURRENT_DIR_TAB_STATE_VERSION = 1;

/**
 * Migrations from version N to N+1. Each entry takes the raw (parsed-JSON)
 * blob produced under version N and returns a blob shaped like version N+1.
 * Add a new entry here whenever the persisted shape changes incompatibly.
 */
export const DIR_TAB_STATE_MIGRATIONS: Record<number, (raw: any) => any> = {
  // 0 → 1: original shape — no field reshapes; just stamp the version.
  0: (raw) => ({ ...raw, schemaVersion: 1 }),
};

function migrateDirTabState(raw: any): Partial<PersistedDirTabState> | null {
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return null;
  let working: any = raw;
  let version = typeof working.schemaVersion === 'number' ? working.schemaVersion : 0;
  while (version < CURRENT_DIR_TAB_STATE_VERSION) {
    const migrate = DIR_TAB_STATE_MIGRATIONS[version];
    if (!migrate) {
      // No migration registered — refuse rather than silently mis-interpret.
      return null;
    }
    working = migrate(working);
    version += 1;
  }
  return working as Partial<PersistedDirTabState>;
}

export type DirTabStatePersistCallback = (tabId: string, json: string) => void;

export class DirTabStateController {
  private readonly stateByTabId = new Map<string, DirTabState>();
  private persistCallback: DirTabStatePersistCallback | null = null;

  /** Register a callback invoked whenever a tab's persistable state changes. */
  setPersistCallback(callback: DirTabStatePersistCallback | null): void {
    this.persistCallback = callback;
  }

  save(tabId: string, target: DirTabRestoreTarget): void {
    if (!tabId) return;
    const state: DirTabState = {
      path: target.session.currentPath || '',
      showHidden: !!target.session.showHidden,
      currentView: target.session.currentView,
      sortField: target.session.sortField,
      sortDirection: target.session.sortDirection,
      directoriesFirst: target.session.directoriesFirst,
      colorizeByMime: target.session.colorizeByMime,
      filterQuery: target.session.filterQuery ?? { text: '', criteria: [] },
      selectedPaths: Array.from(target.session.selectedFiles ?? new Set<string>()),
      cursorPath: target.session.selectionCursorPath,
      anchorPath: target.session.selectionAnchorPath,
      scrollTop: Math.max(0, Math.round(target.ui.getScrollTop?.() ?? 0)),
      expandedPaths: Array.isArray(target.ui.getExpandedPaths?.()) ? target.ui.getExpandedPaths?.() ?? [] : [],
      entries: Array.isArray(target.session.entries) ? [...target.session.entries] : [],
      optimisticHiddenPaths: target.session.getOptimisticHiddenPaths(),
    };
    this.stateByTabId.set(tabId, state);

    if (this.persistCallback) {
      try {
        this.persistCallback(tabId, JSON.stringify(this.toPersisted(state)));
      } catch {
        // Persist callbacks must never throw out of save().
      }
    }
  }

  load(tabId: string): DirTabState | null {
    if (!tabId) return null;
    return this.stateByTabId.get(tabId) ?? null;
  }

  /** Seed the in-memory map from a persisted JSON blob (one-shot, on workspace load). */
  hydrateFromJson(tabId: string, json: string | null | undefined): void {
    if (!tabId || !json) return;
    if (this.stateByTabId.has(tabId)) return;
    let parsed: Partial<PersistedDirTabState> | null = null;
    try {
      const raw = JSON.parse(json) as Record<string, unknown>;
      const source = raw && typeof raw === 'object' && 'dir' in raw
        ? raw['dir']
        : raw;
      parsed = migrateDirTabState(source);
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') return;

    this.stateByTabId.set(tabId, {
      path: parsed.path ?? '',
      showHidden: !!parsed.showHidden,
      currentView: parsed.currentView ?? 'list',
      sortField: parsed.sortField ?? 'name',
      sortDirection: parsed.sortDirection === 'desc' ? 'desc' : 'asc',
      directoriesFirst: !!parsed.directoriesFirst,
      colorizeByMime: !!parsed.colorizeByMime,
      filterQuery: parsed.filterQuery ?? { text: '', criteria: [] },
      selectedPaths: Array.isArray(parsed.selectedPaths) ? parsed.selectedPaths : [],
      cursorPath: parsed.cursorPath ?? null,
      anchorPath: parsed.anchorPath ?? null,
      scrollTop: typeof parsed.scrollTop === 'number' && parsed.scrollTop >= 0 ? parsed.scrollTop : 0,
      expandedPaths: Array.isArray(parsed.expandedPaths) ? parsed.expandedPaths.filter((path): path is string => typeof path === 'string') : [],
      entries: Array.isArray(parsed.entries) ? parsed.entries.map(entry => ({ ...entry })) : [],
      optimisticHiddenPaths: Array.isArray(parsed.optimisticHiddenPaths) ? parsed.optimisticHiddenPaths : [],
    });
  }

  delete(tabId: string): void {
    if (!tabId) return;
    this.stateByTabId.delete(tabId);
    this.persistCallback?.(tabId, '');
  }

  private toPersisted(state: DirTabState): PersistedDirTabState {
    return {
      schemaVersion: CURRENT_DIR_TAB_STATE_VERSION,
      path: state.path,
      showHidden: state.showHidden,
      currentView: state.currentView,
      sortField: state.sortField,
      sortDirection: state.sortDirection,
      directoriesFirst: state.directoriesFirst,
      colorizeByMime: state.colorizeByMime,
      filterQuery: state.filterQuery,
      selectedPaths: state.selectedPaths,
      cursorPath: state.cursorPath,
      anchorPath: state.anchorPath,
      scrollTop: state.scrollTop,
      expandedPaths: [...state.expandedPaths],
      entries: state.entries.map(entry => ({ ...entry })),
      optimisticHiddenPaths: state.optimisticHiddenPaths,
    };
  }

  applyBeforeLoad(state: DirTabState, session: DirTabSessionState): void {
    session.currentPath = state.path;
    session.currentView = state.currentView;
    session.sortField = state.sortField;
    session.sortDirection = state.sortDirection;
    session.directoriesFirst = state.directoriesFirst;
    session.colorizeByMime = state.colorizeByMime ?? false;
    session.filterQuery = state.filterQuery ?? { text: '', criteria: [] };
    session.entries = Array.isArray(state.entries) ? state.entries.map(entry => ({ ...entry })) : [];
  }

  finalizeAfterLoad(state: DirTabState, target: DirTabRestoreTarget): void {
    target.session.setOptimisticHiddenPaths(state.optimisticHiddenPaths ?? []);

    target.session.pendingRestore = {
      selectedPaths: [...(state.selectedPaths ?? [])],
      cursorPath: state.cursorPath ?? null,
      anchorPath: state.anchorPath ?? null,
      scrollTop: typeof state.scrollTop === 'number' ? state.scrollTop : null,
      expandedPaths: [...(state.expandedPaths ?? [])],
    };
    target.session.userInteractedSinceLoad = false;

    target.ui.applyFilter();
    this.applyPendingRestore(target);
  }

  /**
   * Re-attempt restoration of selection, cursor, anchor, scroll position, and
   * tree expansion against whatever entries are currently available. Safe to
   * call multiple times — each pass resolves whichever pending paths are now
   * present and leaves the rest pending for the next call. Bails out if the
   * user has touched the UI since the last load.
   */
  applyPendingRestore(target: DirTabRestoreTarget): void {
    const pending = target.session.pendingRestore;
    if (!pending || target.session.userInteractedSinceLoad) {
      return;
    }

    const present = new Set(target.session.getEntriesPaths());

    const resolvedSelected = pending.selectedPaths.filter(p => present.has(p));
    const stillPendingSelected = pending.selectedPaths.filter(p => !present.has(p));
    // Only seed selection while the user hasn't manually selected anything.
    // Once the user clicks a row, selectedFiles is non-empty and we leave it.
    if (target.session.selectedFiles.size === 0 && resolvedSelected.length > 0) {
      target.session.selectedFiles = new Set(resolvedSelected);
    }

    if (!target.session.selectionCursorPath) {
      if (pending.cursorPath && present.has(pending.cursorPath)) {
        target.session.selectionCursorPath = pending.cursorPath;
      } else if (resolvedSelected.length > 0) {
        target.session.selectionCursorPath = resolvedSelected[resolvedSelected.length - 1];
      } else {
        const selectable = target.ui.getSelectableEntriesPaths();
        if (selectable.length) target.session.selectionCursorPath = selectable[0];
      }
    }

    if (!target.session.selectionAnchorPath) {
      if (pending.anchorPath && present.has(pending.anchorPath)) {
        target.session.selectionAnchorPath = pending.anchorPath;
      } else {
        target.session.selectionAnchorPath = target.session.selectionCursorPath;
      }
    }

    target.ui.setExpandedPaths?.(pending.expandedPaths);

    if (pending.scrollTop !== null && target.ui.setScrollTop) {
      this.deferredApplyScrollTop(target.ui, pending.scrollTop);
    } else if (pending.scrollTop === null && target.session.selectionCursorPath) {
      target.ui.scrollToCursorPath(target.session.selectionCursorPath);
    }

    target.ui.emitPreviewTargetFromState();

    const cursorResolved = !pending.cursorPath || present.has(pending.cursorPath);
    const anchorResolved = !pending.anchorPath || present.has(pending.anchorPath);

    if (stillPendingSelected.length === 0 && cursorResolved && anchorResolved) {
      target.session.pendingRestore = null;
    } else {
      target.session.pendingRestore = {
        selectedPaths: stillPendingSelected,
        cursorPath: cursorResolved ? null : pending.cursorPath,
        anchorPath: anchorResolved ? null : pending.anchorPath,
        // Scroll only applies once; clear after first attempt so future entry
        // changes don't yank the user back to the persisted offset.
        scrollTop: null,
        // Same for expanded paths — set once.
        expandedPaths: [],
      };
    }
  }

  /**
   * setScrollTop runs before Angular has reconciled the new entries, so the
   * scrollable container's content height is often still stale. Try once
   * synchronously, then again on the next frame, then once more after layout
   * has likely settled — drop the attempt if the user has scrolled in between.
   */
  private deferredApplyScrollTop(ui: DirTabUiRuntime, target: number): void {
    if (!ui.setScrollTop) return;
    ui.setScrollTop(target);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (!ui.setScrollTop) return;
      const current = ui.getScrollTop?.() ?? 0;
      if (Math.abs(current - target) > 4) {
        ui.setScrollTop(target);
      }
    });
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { SurfaceRegistryService } from './surface-registry.service';

describe('SurfaceRegistryService capabilities', () => {
  it('exposes directory command capabilities', () => {
    const registry = new SurfaceRegistryService();
    const capabilities = registry.getCapabilities({
      tab: { id: 'dir', title: 'Dir', path: '/', kind: 'dir', surfaceId: 'dir', isActive: true, isPinned: false, createdAt: 1 },
    });

    expect(capabilities.has('navigate')).toBe(true);
    expect(capabilities.has('selection')).toBe(true);
    expect(capabilities.has('fileOperations')).toBe(true);
    expect(capabilities.has('preview')).toBe(true);
    expect(capabilities.has('viewerControls')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('lets a foreign surface define its own command capabilities', () => {
    const registry = new SurfaceRegistryService();
    registry.register({
      id: 'console',
      capabilities: [],
      score: () => 0,
      load: () => class ConsoleSurface {},
    });

    const capabilities = registry.getCapabilities({
      tab: { id: 'console', title: 'Console', path: '', kind: 'dir', surfaceId: 'console', isActive: true, isPinned: false, createdAt: 1 },
    });

    expect(capabilities.size).toBe(0);
  });

  it('prefers surfaceId capabilities over legacy kind', () => {
    const registry = new SurfaceRegistryService();
    registry.register({
      id: 'search-results',
      capabilities: ['selection', 'preview'],
      score: () => 0,
      load: () => class SearchResultsSurface {},
    });

    const capabilities = registry.getCapabilities({
      tab: { id: 'search', title: 'Search', path: 'search://', kind: 'viewer', surfaceId: 'search-results', isActive: true, isPinned: false, createdAt: 1 },
    });

    expect(capabilities.has('selection')).toBe(true);
    expect(capabilities.has('preview')).toBe(true);
    expect(capabilities.has('viewerControls')).toBe(false);
  });
});
````

````typescript
import type { TabInfo } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';

export const BUILTIN_SURFACE_IDS = {
  dir: 'dir',
  viewer: 'viewer',
  sizeManager: 'size-manager',
  searchResults: 'search-results',
} as const;

export function legacyKindSurfaceId(kind: TabInfo['kind']): string {
  if (kind === 'viewer') return BUILTIN_SURFACE_IDS.viewer;
  if (kind === 'size-manager') return BUILTIN_SURFACE_IDS.sizeManager;
  return BUILTIN_SURFACE_IDS.dir;
}

export function tabSurfaceId(tab: Pick<TabInfo, 'surfaceId' | 'kind'>): string {
  return tab.surfaceId?.trim() || legacyKindSurfaceId(tab.kind);
}

export function tabLocation(tab: Pick<TabInfo, 'location' | 'path'>): string {
  return tab.location?.location?.trim() || tab.path?.trim() || '';
}
export function isDirectoryBackedSurfaceId(surfaceId: string): boolean {
  return surfaceId === BUILTIN_SURFACE_IDS.dir || surfaceId === BUILTIN_SURFACE_IDS.searchResults;
}
````

````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"sync"

	internalbrowserpane "wails-app/internal/browserpane"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive/cache"

	wailsruntime "github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/pkg/runtime"
)

// App is the Wails binding surface and thin wrapper around internal state.
type App struct {
	*State
	isProcessElevated func() bool
	streamBaseURL     string
	streamBaseURLMu   sync.RWMutex
	browserPanes      *internalbrowserpane.Service
	browserPanesMu    sync.Mutex
}

func NewApp(isProcessElevated func() bool) *App {
	return &App{
		isProcessElevated: isProcessElevated,
	}
}

func (a *App) bindState(state *State) {
	a.State = state
}

func (a *App) Startup(ctx context.Context) {
	if a.State != nil {
		a.State.Startup(ctx)
	}
}

func (a *App) Shutdown() {
	a.browserPanesMu.Lock()
	service := a.browserPanes
	a.browserPanesMu.Unlock()
	if service != nil {
		_ = service.Shutdown()
	}
	if a.State != nil {
		a.State.Shutdown()
	}
	if a.State != nil && a.State.PluginRegistry != nil {
		a.State.PluginRegistry.Shutdown()
	}
	cleanupSegmentedVideoPlaybackCache()
}

func (a *App) BeforeClose(ctx context.Context) bool {
	if a.State == nil || a.State.Workspace == nil {
		return false
	}

	prefs := a.State.Workspace.GetPreferences()
	if !prefs.ConfirmOnClose {
		return false
	}

	choice, err := wailsruntime.MessageDialog(ctx, wailsruntime.MessageDialogOptions{
		Type:          wailsruntime.QuestionDialog,
		Title:         "Close File Manager?",
		Message:       "Are you sure you want to close the application?",
		Buttons:       []string{"Cancel", "Close"},
		DefaultButton: "Close",
		CancelButton:  "Cancel",
	})
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}

	return choice != "Close"
}

func (a *App) EmitEvent(name string, data interface{}) {
	if a.State != nil {
		a.State.EmitEvent(name, data)
	}
}

func (a *App) InitVFS() {
	if a.State != nil {
		a.State.InitVFS()
	}
}

func (a *App) IsProcessElevated() bool {
	return a.isProcessElevated != nil && a.isProcessElevated()
}

func (a *App) SetStreamBaseURL(baseURL string) {
	a.streamBaseURLMu.Lock()
	a.streamBaseURL = baseURL
	a.streamBaseURLMu.Unlock()
}

func (a *App) StreamBaseURL() string {
	a.streamBaseURLMu.RLock()
	defer a.streamBaseURLMu.RUnlock()
	return a.streamBaseURL
}

// ArchCache returns the shared archive LRU cache so the stream middleware
// can open archive entries without buffering them in JS.
func (a *App) ArchCache() *cache.Cache {
	if a.State == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return a.State.archCache
}

func (a *App) browserPaneService() *internalbrowserpane.Service {
	a.browserPanesMu.Lock()
	defer a.browserPanesMu.Unlock()
	if a.browserPanes == nil {
		a.browserPanes = internalbrowserpane.NewService(a.EmitEvent)
	}
	return a.browserPanes
}
````

````go
	if err != nil {

	}

}

	return a.State.ProbeFile(path)
}

// HashFile returns a SHA-256 digest for a file resolved through the normal public-path chain.
func (a *App) HashFile(path string) (string, error) {
	resolved, err := a.State.Filesystem.RealPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	f, err := os.Open(resolved)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	h := sha256.New()
	if _, err := io.Copy(h, f); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil)), nil
}
````

## File: internal/browserpane/service.go
````go
package browserpane

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"sync"
)

type Update struct {
	SurfaceID       string
	URL             string
	Theme           string
	BackgroundColor string
	Visible         bool
	X               int
	Y               int
	Width           int
	Height          int
}

type pane interface {
	Sync(Update) error
	CaptureScreenshot() (string, error)
	GetDocumentBackground() (string, error)
	PostMessage(string) error
	Dispose() error
}

type Service struct {
	mu        sync.Mutex
	panes     map[string]pane
	emitEvent func(string, interface{})
	lastURL   map[string]string
}

func NewService(emitEvent func(string, interface{})) *Service {
	return &Service{
		panes:     make(map[string]pane),
		emitEvent: emitEvent,
		lastURL:   make(map[string]string),
	}
}

func (s *Service) Sync(update Update) error {
	update.SurfaceID = strings.TrimSpace(update.SurfaceID)
	update.URL = strings.TrimSpace(update.URL)
	if update.SurfaceID == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("browser pane surface id is required")
	}

	if !isSupportedBrowserPaneURL(update.URL) {
		update.URL = ""
		update.Visible = false
		update.Width = 0
		update.Height = 0
	}

	if !update.Visible {
		s.mu.Lock()
		target := s.panes[update.SurfaceID]
		s.mu.Unlock()
		if target == nil {
			return nil
		}
		return target.Sync(update)
	}

	if update.URL == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("browser pane url is required when visible")
	}
	if update.Width <= 0 || update.Height <= 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("browser pane bounds must be positive")
	}

	s.mu.Lock()
	target := s.panes[update.SurfaceID]
	if target == nil {
		var err error
		target, err = newPlatformPane(update, s.emitResourceUpdate, func(message string) {
			s.handlePaneMessage(update.SurfaceID, message)
		})
		if err != nil {
			s.mu.Unlock()
			return err
		}
		s.panes[update.SurfaceID] = target
	}
	urlChanged := update.URL != "" && s.lastURL[update.SurfaceID] != update.URL
	if urlChanged {
		s.lastURL[update.SurfaceID] = update.URL
	}
	s.mu.Unlock()

	if urlChanged {
		s.emitLifecycleEvent(update.SurfaceID, "started", update.URL)
	}

	return target.Sync(update)
}

func isSupportedBrowserPaneURL(raw string) bool {
	raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
	if raw == "" {
		return false
	}

	parsed, err := url.Parse(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}

	if !strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "http") && !strings.EqualFold(parsed.Scheme, "https") {
		return false
	}

	return strings.TrimSpace(parsed.Host) != ""
}

func (s *Service) emitResourceUpdate(path string) {
	if s.emitEvent == nil || strings.TrimSpace(path) == "" {
		return
	}
	s.emitEvent("web:resourcesChanged", map[string]string{"path": strings.TrimSpace(path)})
}

func (s *Service) handlePaneMessage(surfaceID string, message string) {
	message = strings.TrimSpace(message)
	if message == "" {
		return
	}

	var envelope struct {
		Type  string `json:"type"`
		State string `json:"state"`
		URL   string `json:"url"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(message), &envelope); err == nil && envelope.Type == "lifecycle" {
		s.emitLifecycleEvent(surfaceID, envelope.State, envelope.URL)
		return
	}

	var rpcEnvelope struct {
		Rpc bool   `json:"_rpc"`
		ID  string `json:"id"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(message), &rpcEnvelope); err == nil && rpcEnvelope.Rpc && rpcEnvelope.ID != "" {
		s.emitRpcResponse(surfaceID, message)
		return
	}

	s.emitPaneMessage(surfaceID, message)
}

func (s *Service) emitPaneMessage(surfaceID string, message string) {
	if s.emitEvent == nil || strings.TrimSpace(surfaceID) == "" {
		return
	}
	s.emitEvent("browser-pane:message", map[string]string{
		"surfaceId": strings.TrimSpace(surfaceID),
		"message":   message,
	})
}

func (s *Service) emitLifecycleEvent(surfaceID string, state string, url string) {
	if s.emitEvent == nil || strings.TrimSpace(surfaceID) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(state) == "" {
		return
	}
	s.emitEvent("browser-pane:lifecycle", map[string]string{
		"surfaceId": strings.TrimSpace(surfaceID),
		"state":     strings.TrimSpace(state),
		"url":       strings.TrimSpace(url),
	})
}

func (s *Service) emitRpcResponse(surfaceID string, message string) {
	if s.emitEvent == nil || strings.TrimSpace(surfaceID) == "" {
		return
	}
	s.emitEvent("browser-pane:rpc", map[string]string{
		"surfaceId": strings.TrimSpace(surfaceID),
		"message":   message,
	})
}

func (s *Service) Dispose(surfaceID string) error {
	surfaceID = strings.TrimSpace(surfaceID)
	if surfaceID == "" {
		return nil
	}

	s.mu.Lock()
	target := s.panes[surfaceID]
	delete(s.panes, surfaceID)
	delete(s.lastURL, surfaceID)
	s.mu.Unlock()

	if target == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return target.Dispose()
}

// CaptureScreenshot returns a base64-encoded PNG screenshot of the browser pane.
func (s *Service) CaptureScreenshot(surfaceID string) (string, error) {
	surfaceID = strings.TrimSpace(surfaceID)
	if surfaceID == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("browser pane surface id is required")
	}

	s.mu.Lock()
	target := s.panes[surfaceID]
	s.mu.Unlock()

	if target == nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("browser pane %q not found", surfaceID)
	}
	return target.CaptureScreenshot()
}

func (s *Service) GetDocumentBackground(surfaceID string) (string, error) {
	surfaceID = strings.TrimSpace(surfaceID)
	if surfaceID == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("browser pane surface id is required")
	}

	s.mu.Lock()
	target := s.panes[surfaceID]
	s.mu.Unlock()

	if target == nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("browser pane %q not found", surfaceID)
	}
	return target.GetDocumentBackground()
}

func (s *Service) PostMessage(surfaceID string, message string) error {
	surfaceID = strings.TrimSpace(surfaceID)
	if surfaceID == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("browser pane surface id is required")
	}

	s.mu.Lock()
	target := s.panes[surfaceID]
	s.mu.Unlock()

	if target == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("browser pane %q not found", surfaceID)
	}
	return target.PostMessage(message)
}

func (s *Service) Shutdown() error {
	s.mu.Lock()
	panes := make([]pane, 0, len(s.panes))
	for key, target := range s.panes {
		delete(s.panes, key)
		delete(s.lastURL, key)
		panes = append(panes, target)
	}
	s.mu.Unlock()

	var firstErr error
	for _, target := range panes {
		if err := target.Dispose(); err != nil && firstErr == nil {
			firstErr = err
		}
	}
	return firstErr
}
````
