````go
package contracts

// RemoteProtocol identifies the transport for a remote connection.
type RemoteProtocol string

const (
	ProtocolSMB      RemoteProtocol = "smb"
	ProtocolS3       RemoteProtocol = "s3"
	ProtocolGDrive   RemoteProtocol = "gdrive"
	ProtocolDropbox  RemoteProtocol = "dropbox"
	ProtocolOneDrive RemoteProtocol = "onedrive"
)

// RemoteConfig describes how to connect to a remote server.
// Credentials are never persisted to disk — they are held only for the
// lifetime of the application session.
type RemoteConfig struct {
	Protocol RemoteProtocol `json:"protocol"`
	Name     string         `json:"name,omitempty"`
	Host     string         `json:"host"`
	Port     int            `json:"port,omitempty"`
	Username string         `json:"username,omitempty"`
	Password string         `json:"password,omitempty"`

	// SMB-specific
	Domain string `json:"domain,omitempty"`
	Share  string `json:"share,omitempty"` // e.g. "Documents"

	// S3-compatible specific
	Endpoint        string `json:"endpoint,omitempty"`
	Region          string `json:"region,omitempty"`
	Bucket          string `json:"bucket,omitempty"`
	Prefix          string `json:"prefix,omitempty"`
	AccessKeyID     string `json:"accessKeyId,omitempty"`
	SecretAccessKey string `json:"secretAccessKey,omitempty"`
	SessionToken    string `json:"sessionToken,omitempty"`
	Anonymous       bool   `json:"anonymous,omitempty"`
	UsePathStyle    bool   `json:"usePathStyle,omitempty"`
	Insecure        bool   `json:"insecure,omitempty"`

	// Token-based cloud API access.
	AccessToken string `json:"accessToken,omitempty"`
}

// RemoteOAuthBeginRequest starts an interactive browser-based OAuth flow for a
// cloud provider. Client credentials remain session-only and are never written
// to disk.
type RemoteOAuthBeginRequest struct {
	Protocol RemoteProtocol `json:"protocol"`
	ClientID string         `json:"clientId"`
	Tenant   string         `json:"tenant,omitempty"`
	Scopes   []string       `json:"scopes,omitempty"`
}

// RemoteOAuthBeginResponse describes the browser flow that should be opened by
// the frontend.
type RemoteOAuthBeginResponse struct {
	SessionID   string         `json:"sessionId"`
	Protocol    RemoteProtocol `json:"protocol"`
	AuthURL     string         `json:"authUrl"`
	RedirectURI string         `json:"redirectUri"`
}

// RemoteOAuthStatus reports the current state of a browser-based OAuth
// session.
type RemoteOAuthStatus struct {
	SessionID    string         `json:"sessionId"`
	Protocol     RemoteProtocol `json:"protocol"`
	Status       string         `json:"status"`
	Error        string         `json:"error,omitempty"`
	AccountName  string         `json:"accountName,omitempty"`
	AccountEmail string         `json:"accountEmail,omitempty"`
	ExpiresAt    int64          `json:"expiresAt,omitempty"`
}

// RemoteOAuthConnectRequest mounts a previously authorized OAuth session.
type RemoteOAuthConnectRequest struct {
	SessionID string `json:"sessionId"`
	Name      string `json:"name,omitempty"`
}

// RemoteMount describes an active remote filesystem mount.
type RemoteMount struct {
	Protocol   RemoteProtocol `json:"protocol"`
	Host       string         `json:"host"`
	Name       string         `json:"name"`       // human-readable display name
	PublicPath string         `json:"publicPath"` // e.g. "smb://host/share"
	MountPoint string         `json:"mountPoint"` // internal VFS path, e.g. "/remote/smb/host:445/share"
	ReadOnly   bool           `json:"readOnly"`
}
````

````go
package converter

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"image"
	_ "image/gif"
	"image/jpeg"
	"image/png"
	_ "image/png"
	"math"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"

	"wails-app/internal/utility"
)

// Service handles image format conversion for preview.
type Service struct {
	vipsPath          string
	vipsThumbnailPath string
	hasVips           bool
	hasVipsThumbnail  bool
	detectOnce        sync.Once
}

// NewService creates a new image converter service.
func NewService() *Service {
	return &Service{}
}

func (s *Service) detectVips() {
	vipsPaths := []string{
		"vips",
		"vips.exe",
		`C:\Program Files\libvips\bin\vips.exe`,
		`C:\Program Files\vips-dev-8.17\bin\vips.exe`,
		`C:\vips-dev-8.17\bin\vips.exe`,
		"/usr/bin/vips",
		"/usr/local/bin/vips",
	}
	if path, ok := utility.ResolveExecutable(vipsPaths...); ok {
		s.vipsPath = path
		s.hasVips = true
	}

	thumbnailPaths := []string{
		"vipsthumbnail",
		"vipsthumbnail.exe",
		`C:\Program Files\libvips\bin\vipsthumbnail.exe`,
		`C:\Program Files\vips-dev-8.17\bin\vipsthumbnail.exe`,
		`C:\vips-dev-8.17\bin\vipsthumbnail.exe`,
		"/usr/bin/vipsthumbnail",
		"/usr/local/bin/vipsthumbnail",
	}
	if path, ok := utility.ResolveExecutable(thumbnailPaths...); ok {
		s.vipsThumbnailPath = path
		s.hasVipsThumbnail = true
	}
}

func (s *Service) ensureDetected() {
	s.detectOnce.Do(s.detectVips)
}

// ConvertFormat converts image from one format to another.
// Supported output formats: webp, png, jpg, jpeg, bmp, gif, avif (webp recommended for previews)
func (s *Service) ConvertFormat(inputPath string, outputFormat string) ([]byte, error) {
	outputFormat = strings.ToLower(outputFormat)

	// Validate output format
	if !isSupportedOutputFormat(outputFormat) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported output format: %s", outputFormat)
	}

	// Try libvips first for broader format coverage.
	s.ensureDetected()
	if s.hasVips {
		return s.convertWithVips(inputPath, outputFormat)
	}

	// Fallback to Go native decoders for basic formats
	return s.convertWithGoImage(inputPath, outputFormat)
}

// CreateThumbnail converts and resizes an image to fit within the provided bounds.
func (s *Service) CreateThumbnail(inputPath string, outputFormat string, maxWidth int, maxHeight int) ([]byte, error) {
	outputFormat = strings.ToLower(outputFormat)
	maxWidth, maxHeight = normalizeThumbnailBounds(maxWidth, maxHeight)

	if !isSupportedOutputFormat(outputFormat) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported output format: %s", outputFormat)
	}

	s.ensureDetected()
	if s.hasVipsThumbnail {
		return s.thumbnailWithVips(inputPath, outputFormat, maxWidth, maxHeight)
	}

	return s.thumbnailWithGoImage(inputPath, outputFormat, maxWidth, maxHeight)
}

func (s *Service) convertWithVips(inputPath string, outputFormat string) ([]byte, error) {
	outputPath, cleanup, err := createConvertedOutputPath(outputFormat)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer cleanup()

	cmd := exec.Command(s.vipsPath, "copy", inputPath, outputPath)
	hideWindow(cmd)

	var errOut bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stderr = &errOut

	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("libvips conversion failed: %v - %s", err, strings.TrimSpace(errOut.String()))
	}

	converted, err := os.ReadFile(outputPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read converted image: %w", err)
	}
	return converted, nil
}

func (s *Service) thumbnailWithVips(inputPath string, outputFormat string, maxWidth int, maxHeight int) ([]byte, error) {
	outputPath, cleanup, err := createConvertedOutputPath(outputFormat)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer cleanup()

	size := fmt.Sprintf("%dx%d", maxWidth, maxHeight)
	cmd := exec.Command(s.vipsThumbnailPath, inputPath, "--size", size, "-o", outputPath)
	hideWindow(cmd)

	var errOut bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stderr = &errOut

	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("libvips thumbnail failed: %v - %s", err, strings.TrimSpace(errOut.String()))
	}

	thumbnail, err := os.ReadFile(outputPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read converted thumbnail: %w", err)
	}
	return thumbnail, nil
}

// convertWithGoImage uses Go's native image decoders (PNG, JPEG, GIF).
func (s *Service) convertWithGoImage(inputPath string, outputFormat string) ([]byte, error) {
	// Read the source image
	file, err := os.Open(inputPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open source image: %w", err)
	}
	defer file.Close()

	img, _, err := image.Decode(file)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode image: %w", err)
	}

	// Encode to target format
	var out bytes.Buffer
	switch outputFormat {
	case "png":
		if err := png.Encode(&out, img); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to encode PNG: %w", err)
		}
	case "jpg", "jpeg":
		if err := jpeg.Encode(&out, img, &jpeg.Options{Quality: 90}); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to encode JPEG: %w", err)
		}
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("go native conversion: unsupported format %s (install libvips for broader format support)", outputFormat)
	}

	return out.Bytes(), nil
}

func (s *Service) thumbnailWithGoImage(inputPath string, outputFormat string, maxWidth int, maxHeight int) ([]byte, error) {
	file, err := os.Open(inputPath)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open source image: %w", err)
	}
	defer file.Close()

	img, _, err := image.Decode(file)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to decode image: %w", err)
	}

	thumb := resizeToFit(img, maxWidth, maxHeight)

	var out bytes.Buffer
	switch outputFormat {
	case "png":
		if err := png.Encode(&out, thumb); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to encode PNG: %w", err)
		}
	case "jpg", "jpeg":
		if err := jpeg.Encode(&out, thumb, &jpeg.Options{Quality: 90}); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to encode JPEG: %w", err)
		}
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("go native thumbnail: unsupported format %s (install libvips for broader format support)", outputFormat)
	}

	return out.Bytes(), nil
}

func normalizeThumbnailBounds(maxWidth int, maxHeight int) (int, int) {
	if maxWidth <= 0 {
		maxWidth = 256
	}
	if maxHeight <= 0 {
		maxHeight = 256
	}
	if maxWidth > 2048 {
		maxWidth = 2048
	}
	if maxHeight > 2048 {
		maxHeight = 2048
	}
	return maxWidth, maxHeight
}

func resizeToFit(src image.Image, maxWidth int, maxHeight int) image.Image {
	bounds := src.Bounds()
	srcWidth := bounds.Dx()
	srcHeight := bounds.Dy()
	if srcWidth <= 0 || srcHeight <= 0 {
		return src
	}

	scale := math.Min(float64(maxWidth)/float64(srcWidth), float64(maxHeight)/float64(srcHeight))
	if scale >= 1 {
		return src
	}

	dstWidth := int(math.Max(1, math.Round(float64(srcWidth)*scale)))
	dstHeight := int(math.Max(1, math.Round(float64(srcHeight)*scale)))
	dst := image.NewRGBA(image.Rect(0, 0, dstWidth, dstHeight))

	for y := 0; y < dstHeight; y++ {
		srcY := bounds.Min.Y + (y*srcHeight)/dstHeight
		for x := 0; x < dstWidth; x++ {
			srcX := bounds.Min.X + (x*srcWidth)/dstWidth
			dst.Set(x, y, src.At(srcX, srcY))
		}
	}

	return dst
}

func createConvertedOutputPath(outputFormat string) (string, func(), error) {
	dir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "wails-image-converter-*")
	if err != nil {
		return "", func() {}, fmt.Errorf("failed to create temp output directory: %w", err)
	}
	outputPath := filepath.Join(dir, "output."+normalizeOutputExtension(outputFormat))
	cleanup := func() {
		_ = os.RemoveAll(dir)
	}
	return outputPath, cleanup, nil
}

func normalizeOutputExtension(format string) string {
	switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(format)) {
	case "jpeg":
		return "jpg"
	case "tiff":
		return "tif"
	default:
		return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(format))
	}
}

// isSupportedOutputFormat checks if the format can be converted to.
func isSupportedOutputFormat(format string) bool {
	supported := map[string]bool{
		"png":  true,
		"jpg":  true,
		"jpeg": true,
		"gif":  true,
		"webp": true,
		"bmp":  true,
		"avif": true,
		"tiff": true,
		"tif":  true,
	}
	return supported[format]
}

// IsSupportedSourceFormat checks if the source format can be converted.
func (s *Service) IsSupportedSourceFormat(extension string) bool {
	extension = strings.ToLower(extension)

	// Basic Go support
	goSupported := map[string]bool{
		"png":  true,
		"jpg":  true,
		"jpeg": true,
		"gif":  true,
		"bmp":  true,
	}

	if goSupported[extension] {
		return true
	}

	// Extended support with libvips.
	s.ensureDetected()
	if s.hasVips {
		extended := map[string]bool{
			"webp": true,
			"tiff": true,
			"tif":  true,
			"exr":  true, // OpenEXR
			"heif": true,
			"heic": true,
			"jp2":  true, // JPEG 2000
			"j2k":  true, // JPEG 2000
			"avif": true,
			"jxl":  true, // JPEG XL
			"fits": true,
			"hdr":  true,
			"pfm":  true,
		}
		return extended[extension]
	}

	return false
}

// GetAvailableConversionFormats returns the list of formats this source can be converted to.
// Depends on libvips availability.
func (s *Service) GetAvailableConversionFormats(sourceExt string) []string {
	// Always available if we can convert at all
	if s.IsSupportedSourceFormat(sourceExt) {
		return []string{"png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "webp", "bmp"}
	}
	return []string{}
}
````

## File: internal/pathref/cloud.go
````go
package pathref

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

type LocalCloudProvider struct {
	Name     string
	Scheme   string
	RootPath string
}

type localCloudSpec struct {
	name       string
	scheme     string
	candidates func(home string) []string
}

var (
	userHomeDirFn = os.UserHomeDir
	pathExistsFn  = func(path string) bool {
		info, err := os.Stat(path)
		return err == nil && info.IsDir()
	}
)

var (
	cloudCacheMu     sync.RWMutex
	cloudCache       []LocalCloudProvider
	cloudCacheHome   string
	cloudCacheTime   time.Time
	cloudCacheTTL    = 60 * time.Second
)

var localCloudSpecs = []localCloudSpec{
	{
		name:   "OneDrive",
		scheme: OneDriveScheme,
		candidates: func(home string) []string {
			return []string{
				filepath.Join(home, "OneDrive"),
				filepath.Join(home, "OneDrive - Personal"),
				filepath.Join(home, "Library", "CloudStorage", "OneDrive*"),
			}
		},
	},
	{
		name:   "Google Drive",
		scheme: GDriveScheme,
		candidates: func(home string) []string {
			return []string{
				filepath.Join(home, "Google Drive", "My Drive"),
				filepath.Join(home, "Google Drive"),
				filepath.Join(home, "My Drive"),
				filepath.Join(home, "Library", "CloudStorage", "GoogleDrive*"),
			}
		},
	},
	{
		name:   "Dropbox",
		scheme: DropboxScheme,
		candidates: func(home string) []string {
			return []string{
				filepath.Join(home, "Dropbox"),
				filepath.Join(home, "Library", "CloudStorage", "Dropbox*"),
			}
		},
	},
}

func AvailableLocalCloudProviders() []LocalCloudProvider {
	home, err := userHomeDirFn()
	if err != nil || strings.TrimSpace(home) == "" {
		cloudCacheMu.Lock()
		cloudCache = nil
		cloudCacheHome = ""
		cloudCacheTime = time.Now()
		cloudCacheMu.Unlock()
		return nil
	}

	cloudCacheMu.RLock()
	if time.Since(cloudCacheTime) < cloudCacheTTL && cloudCache != nil && filepath.Clean(home) == cloudCacheHome {
		result := make([]LocalCloudProvider, len(cloudCache))
		copy(result, cloudCache)
		cloudCacheMu.RUnlock()
		return result
	}
	cloudCacheMu.RUnlock()

	cloudCacheMu.Lock()
	defer cloudCacheMu.Unlock()
	// Double-check after acquiring write lock.
	if time.Since(cloudCacheTime) < cloudCacheTTL && cloudCache != nil && filepath.Clean(home) == cloudCacheHome {
		result := make([]LocalCloudProvider, len(cloudCache))
		copy(result, cloudCache)
		return result
	}

	providers := make([]LocalCloudProvider, 0, len(localCloudSpecs))
	for _, spec := range localCloudSpecs {
		root := resolveExistingCloudRoot(home, spec.candidates(home))
		if root == "" {
			continue
		}
		providers = append(providers, LocalCloudProvider{
			Name:     spec.name,
			Scheme:   spec.scheme,
			RootPath: root,
		})
	}

	cloudCache = providers
	cloudCacheHome = filepath.Clean(home)
	cloudCacheTime = time.Now()
	result := make([]LocalCloudProvider, len(providers))
	copy(result, providers)
	return result
}

func ResolveLocalCloudPath(path string) (string, bool) {
	normalized := Normalize(path)
	for _, provider := range AvailableLocalCloudProviders() {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(normalized), provider.Scheme) {
			continue
		}

		suffix := strings.TrimPrefix(normalized, provider.Scheme)
		if suffix == "" {
			return filepath.Clean(provider.RootPath), true
		}
		return filepath.Join(provider.RootPath, filepath.FromSlash(suffix)), true
	}
	return "", false
}

func LocalCloudAliasFromNativePath(path string) (string, bool) {
	native := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(path))
	for _, provider := range AvailableLocalCloudProviders() {
		root := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(provider.RootPath))
		if !pathHasPrefix(native, root) {
			continue
		}

		suffix := strings.TrimPrefix(native, root)
		suffix = strings.TrimPrefix(suffix, "/")
		if suffix == "" {
			return provider.Scheme, true
		}
		return provider.Scheme + suffix, true
	}
	return "", false
}

func IsLocalCloud(path string) bool {
	normalized := strings.ToLower(Normalize(path))
	return strings.HasPrefix(normalized, OneDriveScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(normalized, GDriveScheme) ||
		strings.HasPrefix(normalized, DropboxScheme)
}

func resolveExistingCloudRoot(home string, candidates []string) string {
	for _, candidate := range candidates {
		for _, expanded := range expandCloudCandidate(candidate) {
			if !pathExistsFn(expanded) {
				continue
			}
			return filepath.Clean(expanded)
		}
	}
	return ""
}

func expandCloudCandidate(pattern string) []string {
	if strings.ContainsAny(pattern, "*?[") {
		matches, err := filepath.Glob(pattern)
		if err != nil {
			return nil
		}
		return matches
	}
	return []string{pattern}
}

func pathHasPrefix(path string, prefix string) bool {
	if filepath.Separator == '\\' {
		path = strings.ToLower(path)
		prefix = strings.ToLower(prefix)
	}

	if path == prefix {
		return true
	}

	return strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix+"/")
}
````

````go
package pathref

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func TestToNativePathDriveRootUsesPlatformSeparator(t *testing.T) {
	got := ToNativePath("filesystem://c")
	want := filepath.FromSlash("C:/")
	if got != want {
		t.Fatalf("ToNativePath(drive root) mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", want, got)
	}
}

func TestToNativePathDriveChildUsesPlatformSeparator(t *testing.T) {
	got := ToNativePath("filesystem://c/New Folder")
	want := filepath.FromSlash("C:/New Folder")
	if got != want {
		t.Fatalf("ToNativePath(drive child) mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", want, got)
	}
}

func TestToVFSAddsDefaultSMBPort(t *testing.T) {
	got := ToVFS("smb://fileserver/share/docs")
	want := "/remote/smb/fileserver:445/share/docs"
	if got != want {
		t.Fatalf("ToVFS(smb) mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", want, got)
	}
}

func TestToVFSKeepsS3AliasSegments(t *testing.T) {
	got := ToVFS("s3://minio-dev/photos/2026")
	want := "/remote/s3/minio-dev/photos/2026"
	if got != want {
		t.Fatalf("ToVFS(s3) mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", want, got)
	}
}

		name string
		path string
		want string
	}{
		{name: "gdrive", path: "gdrive://team-drive/designs", want: "/remote/gdrive/team-drive/designs"},
		{name: "dropbox", path: "dropbox://workspace/contracts", want: "/remote/dropbox/workspace/contracts"},
		{name: "onedrive", path: "onedrive://personal/docs", want: "/remote/onedrive/personal/docs"},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			got := ToVFS(tt.path)

				t.Fatalf("ToVFS(cloud alias) mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", tt.want, got)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestNormalizeKeepsAliasSchemes(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name string
		path string
		want string
	}{
		{name: "s3", path: "s3://minio-dev/photos/2026", want: "s3://minio-dev/photos/2026"},
		{name: "smb", path: "smb://fileserver/share/docs", want: "smb://fileserver/share/docs"},
		{name: "http", path: "https://example.com/assets/main.js", want: "https://example.com/assets/main.js"},
		{name: "onedrive", path: "onedrive://Projects/2026", want: "onedrive://Projects/2026"},
		{name: "gdrive", path: "gdrive://Shared/team", want: "gdrive://Shared/team"},

			}

func TestToNativePathLeavesAliasesUntouched(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []string{
		"s3://minio-dev/photos/2026",
		"smb://fileserver/share/docs",
		"https://example.com/assets/main.js",
	}

	for _, input := range tests {
		if got := ToNativePath(input); got != input {
			t.Fatalf("ToNativePath(alias) should be unchanged\nwant: %q\n got: %q", input, got)
		}
	}
}

func TestToNativePathResolvesLocalCloudAliases(t *testing.T) {
	tempHome := t.TempDir()
	cloudRoot := filepath.Join(tempHome, "OneDrive")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(cloudRoot, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("mkdir cloud root: %v", err)
	}

	prevHomeFn := userHomeDirFn
	prevExistsFn := pathExistsFn
	userHomeDirFn = func() (string, error) { return tempHome, nil }
	pathExistsFn = func(path string) bool {
		info, err := os.Stat(path)
		return err == nil && info.IsDir()
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		userHomeDirFn = prevHomeFn
		pathExistsFn = prevExistsFn
	})

	got := ToNativePath("onedrive://Projects/2026")
	want := filepath.Join(cloudRoot, filepath.FromSlash("Projects/2026"))
	if got != want {
		t.Fatalf("ToNativePath(cloud alias) mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", want, got)
	}
}

func TestLocalCloudAliasFromNativePathUsesInstalledRoot(t *testing.T) {
	tempHome := t.TempDir()
	cloudRoot := filepath.Join(tempHome, "Dropbox")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(cloudRoot, "Photos"), 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("mkdir cloud child: %v", err)
	}

	prevHomeFn := userHomeDirFn
	prevExistsFn := pathExistsFn
	userHomeDirFn = func() (string, error) { return tempHome, nil }
	pathExistsFn = func(path string) bool {
		info, err := os.Stat(path)
		return err == nil && info.IsDir()
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		userHomeDirFn = prevHomeFn
		pathExistsFn = prevExistsFn
	})

	got, ok := LocalCloudAliasFromNativePath(filepath.Join(cloudRoot, "Photos"))
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("LocalCloudAliasFromNativePath did not match")
	}

	want := "dropbox://Photos"
	if got != want {
		t.Fatalf("LocalCloudAliasFromNativePath mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", want, got)
	}
}

func TestParentKeepsHTTPAliasesNavigable(t *testing.T) {
	got, ok := Parent("https://example.com/app/assets/main.js")
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("Parent(http alias) did not match")
	}

	want := "https://example.com/app/assets"
	if got != want {
		t.Fatalf("Parent(http alias) mismatch\nwant: %q\n got: %q", want, got)
	}
}

func TestIsWebRecognizesHTTPAliases(t *testing.T) {
	if !IsWeb("http://example.com") {
		t.Fatalf("expected http alias to be recognized as web")
	}
	if !IsWeb("https://example.com") {
		t.Fatalf("expected https alias to be recognized as web")
	}
	if IsWeb("smb://example.com/share") {
		t.Fatalf("did not expect smb alias to be recognized as web")
	}
}
````

````go
package pathref

import (
	"net/url"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

const (
	DriveScheme      = "filesystem://"
	RegistryScheme   = "registry://"
	SearchScheme     = "search://"
	MemoryScheme     = "memory://"
	HTTPAliasScheme  = "http://"
	HTTPSAliasScheme = "https://"
	SMBScheme        = "smb://"
	S3Scheme         = "s3://"
	OneDriveScheme   = "onedrive://"
	GDriveScheme     = "gdrive://"
	DropboxScheme    = "dropbox://"
	memoryVFSRoot    = "/memory"
	registryVFSRoot  = "/registry"
	smbVFSRoot       = "/remote/smb"
	s3VFSRoot        = "/remote/s3"
	oneDriveVFSRoot  = "/remote/onedrive"
	gDriveVFSRoot    = "/remote/gdrive"
	dropboxVFSRoot   = "/remote/dropbox"
)

type aliasSpec struct {
	scheme  string
	vfsRoot string
}

type SearchQuery struct {
	BasePath  string `json:"basePath"`
	Pattern   string `json:"pattern"`
	Recursive bool   `json:"recursive"`
}

var aliasSpecs = []aliasSpec{
	{scheme: RegistryScheme, vfsRoot: registryVFSRoot},
	{scheme: SearchScheme},
	{scheme: MemoryScheme, vfsRoot: memoryVFSRoot},
	{scheme: HTTPSAliasScheme},
	{scheme: HTTPAliasScheme},
	{scheme: SMBScheme, vfsRoot: smbVFSRoot},
	{scheme: S3Scheme, vfsRoot: s3VFSRoot},
	{scheme: OneDriveScheme, vfsRoot: oneDriveVFSRoot},
	{scheme: GDriveScheme, vfsRoot: gDriveVFSRoot},
	{scheme: DropboxScheme, vfsRoot: dropboxVFSRoot},
}

var registryHivePrefixes = []string{
	"HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE",
	"HKEY_CURRENT_USER",
	"HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT",
	"HKEY_USERS",
	"HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG",
	"HKLM",
	"HKCU",
	"HKCR",
	"HKU",
	"HKCC",
}

func aliasSpecFor(path string) (aliasSpec, bool) {
	normalized := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
	for _, spec := range aliasSpecs {
		if len(normalized) >= len(spec.scheme) && strings.EqualFold(normalized[:len(spec.scheme)], spec.scheme) {
			return spec, true
		}
	}
	return aliasSpec{}, false
}

func normalizeAliasPath(path string, spec aliasSpec) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
	rest := trimmed[len(spec.scheme):]
	rest = strings.Trim(rest, "/")
	if rest == "" {
		return spec.scheme
	}
	return spec.scheme + rest
}

func aliasRoot(path string) (string, bool) {
	if spec, ok := aliasSpecFor(path); ok {
		return spec.scheme, true
	}
	return "", false
}

func Normalize(path string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
	if trimmed == "" {
		return ""
	}
	// Convert UNC paths (//host/share/...) to smb:// scheme
	if len(trimmed) > 2 && trimmed[:2] == "//" && trimmed[2] != '/' {
		trimmed = SMBScheme + trimmed[2:]
	}
	if drivePath, ok := normalizeDrivePath(trimmed); ok {
		return drivePath
	}
	if spec, ok := aliasSpecFor(trimmed); ok {
		return normalizeAliasPath(trimmed, spec)
	}
	if !IsRegistry(trimmed) {
		return trimmed
	}
	return normalizeAliasPath(trimmed, aliasSpec{scheme: RegistryScheme, vfsRoot: registryVFSRoot})
}

func normalizeDrivePath(path string) (string, bool) {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
	if len(trimmed) >= len(DriveScheme) && strings.EqualFold(trimmed[:len(DriveScheme)], DriveScheme) {
		// If the character immediately following the scheme is a slash,
		// treat this as a unix-style absolute path (filesystem:///...) and
		// do not normalize as a Windows drive reference.
		if len(trimmed) > len(DriveScheme) && trimmed[len(DriveScheme)] == '/' {
			return "", false
		}
		// drive form: filesystem://c or filesystem://c/...
		if len(trimmed) >= len(DriveScheme)+1 {
			rest := trimmed[len(DriveScheme):]
			if len(rest) == 0 || !isAlpha(rest[0]) {
				return "", false
			}
			drive := strings.ToLower(rest[:1])
			remainder := strings.Trim(rest[1:], "/")
			if remainder == "" {
				return DriveScheme + drive, true
			}
			return DriveScheme + drive + "/" + strings.ReplaceAll(remainder, "//", "/"), true
		}
	}
	if len(trimmed) >= 2 && isAlpha(trimmed[0]) && trimmed[1] == ':' {
		drive := strings.ToLower(trimmed[:1])
		remainder := strings.Trim(trimmed[2:], "/")
		if remainder == "" {
			return DriveScheme + drive, true
		}
		remainder = strings.Join(strings.FieldsFunc(remainder, func(r rune) bool { return r == '/' }), "/")
		if remainder == "" {
			return DriveScheme + drive, true
		}
		return DriveScheme + drive + "/" + remainder, true
	}
	return "", false
}

func isAlpha(b byte) bool {
	return (b >= 'a' && b <= 'z') || (b >= 'A' && b <= 'Z')
}

func IsDrive(path string) bool {
	_, ok := normalizeDrivePath(path)
	return ok
}

func ToNativePath(path string) string {
	normalized := Normalize(path)
	if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(normalized), DriveScheme) {
		if resolved, ok := ResolveLocalCloudPath(normalized); ok {
			return resolved
		}
		return normalized
	}
	rest := normalized[len(DriveScheme):]
	if len(rest) == 0 {
		return normalized
	}
	drive := strings.ToUpper(rest[:1])
	remainder := strings.TrimPrefix(rest[1:], "/")
	if remainder == "" {
		return filepath.FromSlash(drive + ":/")
	}
	return filepath.FromSlash(drive + ":/" + remainder)
}

func FromNativePath(path string) string {
	if drivePath, ok := normalizeDrivePath(path); ok {
		return drivePath
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
}

func IsRegistry(path string) bool {
	spec, ok := aliasSpecFor(path)
	return ok && spec.scheme == RegistryScheme
}

func IsAlias(path string) bool {
	_, ok := aliasSpecFor(path)
	return ok
}

func IsSearch(path string) bool {
	spec, ok := aliasSpecFor(path)
	return ok && spec.scheme == SearchScheme
}

func IsMemory(path string) bool {
	spec, ok := aliasSpecFor(path)
	return ok && spec.scheme == MemoryScheme
}

func IsWeb(path string) bool {
	spec, ok := aliasSpecFor(path)
	return ok && (spec.scheme == HTTPAliasScheme || spec.scheme == HTTPSAliasScheme)
}

func BuildSearch(basePath, pattern string, recursive bool) (string, error) {
	basePath = Normalize(basePath)
	if basePath == "" || pattern == "" {
		return "", nil
	}
	parts := []string{
		"path=" + readableSearchValue(basePath),
		"pattern=" + readableSearchValue(pattern),
		"recursive=" + strconv.FormatBool(recursive),
	}
	return SearchScheme + "?" + strings.Join(parts, "&"), nil
}

func readableSearchValue(value string) string {
	escaped := url.QueryEscape(value)
	replacer := strings.NewReplacer(
		"%2F", "/",
		"%3A", ":",
		"%2A", "*",
	)
	return replacer.Replace(escaped)
}

func ParseSearch(path string) (SearchQuery, bool) {
	normalized := Normalize(path)
	if !IsSearch(normalized) || normalized == SearchScheme {
		return SearchQuery{}, false
	}
	raw := strings.TrimPrefix(normalized, SearchScheme)
	if !strings.HasPrefix(raw, "?") {
		return SearchQuery{}, false
	}
	values, err := url.ParseQuery(strings.TrimPrefix(raw, "?"))
	if err != nil {
		return SearchQuery{}, false
	}
	query := SearchQuery{
		BasePath:  Normalize(values.Get("path")),
		Pattern:   values.Get("pattern"),
		Recursive: strings.EqualFold(values.Get("recursive"), "true") || values.Get("recursive") == "1",
	}
	query.BasePath = Normalize(query.BasePath)
	if query.BasePath == "" || query.Pattern == "" {
		return SearchQuery{}, false
	}
	return query, true
}

func NormalizeSearchPattern(pattern string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(pattern)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return ""
	}
	if strings.ContainsAny(trimmed, "*?[") {
		return trimmed
	}
	return "*" + trimmed + "*"
}

func MatchSearchPattern(pattern, name string) (bool, error) {
	normalizedPattern := NormalizeSearchPattern(pattern)
	if normalizedPattern == "" {
		return false, nil
	}
	return filepath.Match(strings.ToLower(normalizedPattern), strings.ToLower(name))
}

func ToVFS(path string) string {
	normalized := Normalize(path)
	spec, ok := aliasSpecFor(normalized)
	if !ok || spec.vfsRoot == "" {
		return normalized
	}
	if converted, ok := remoteAliasToVFS(normalized, spec); ok {
		return converted
	}
	rest := strings.TrimPrefix(normalized, spec.scheme)
	if rest == "" {
		return spec.vfsRoot
	}
	return spec.vfsRoot + "/" + rest
}

func remoteAliasToVFS(path string, spec aliasSpec) (string, bool) {
	return RemoteURLToVFS(path, spec.scheme, spec.vfsRoot)
}

// RemoteURLToVFS converts a public remote URL (e.g. smb://host/share) into a
// VFS path (e.g. /remote/smb/host:445/share).  It handles default ports for
// known schemes and returns (_, false) for unsupported schemes or malformed
// URLs.  This is the canonical implementation shared by pathref and the VFS
// layer.
func RemoteURLToVFS(path, scheme, vfsRoot string) (string, bool) {
	defaultPort := ""
	switch scheme {
	case SMBScheme:
		defaultPort = "445"
	default:
		return "", false
	}

	parsed, err := url.Parse(path)
	if err != nil || parsed.Host == "" {
		return "", false
	}

	host := parsed.Hostname()
	if host == "" {
		return "", false
	}

	port := parsed.Port()
	if port == "" {
		port = defaultPort
	}

	base := vfsRoot + "/" + host + ":" + port
	rest := strings.Trim(parsed.Path, "/")
	if rest == "" {
		return base, true
	}

	return base + "/" + rest, true
}

func FromVFS(path string) string {
	normalized := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(path, "\\", "/"))
	for _, spec := range aliasSpecs {
		if spec.vfsRoot == "" {
			continue
		}
		if normalized == spec.vfsRoot {
			return spec.scheme
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(normalized, spec.vfsRoot+"/") {
			return spec.scheme + strings.TrimPrefix(normalized, spec.vfsRoot+"/")
		}
	}
	return normalized
}

func FromVFSEntry(basePublicPath, entryPath string) string {
	basePublicPath = Normalize(basePublicPath)
	entryPath = strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(entryPath, "\\", "/"))
	if !IsAlias(basePublicPath) {
		return FromVFS(entryPath)
	}
	if IsAlias(entryPath) || strings.HasPrefix(entryPath, registryVFSRoot) {
		return FromVFS(entryPath)
	}
	if !IsRegistry(basePublicPath) {
		if root, ok := aliasRoot(basePublicPath); ok {
			if basePublicPath == root {
				return Normalize(root + strings.TrimPrefix(entryPath, "/"))
			}
			trimmedBase := strings.TrimSuffix(basePublicPath, "/")
			return Normalize(trimmedBase + "/" + strings.TrimPrefix(entryPath, "/"))
		}
		return FromVFS(entryPath)
	}
	for _, prefix := range registryHivePrefixes {
		if strings.EqualFold(entryPath, prefix) || strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToUpper(entryPath), prefix+"/") {
			return Normalize(RegistryScheme + entryPath)
		}
	}
	if basePublicPath == RegistryScheme {
		return Normalize(RegistryScheme + entryPath)
	}
	trimmedBase := strings.TrimSuffix(basePublicPath, "/")
	return Normalize(trimmedBase + "/" + strings.TrimPrefix(entryPath, "/"))
}

func Parent(path string) (string, bool) {
	normalized := Normalize(path)
	root, ok := aliasRoot(normalized)
	if !ok {
		return "", false
	}
	rest := strings.TrimPrefix(normalized, root)
	if rest == "" {
		return "", false
	}
	idx := strings.LastIndex(rest, "/")
	if idx < 0 {
		return root, true
	}
	return root + rest[:idx], true
}
````

````go
	}
}

func TestWindowStateConversion(t *testing.T) {
	original := &contracts.WindowState{Width: 1920, Height: 1080, X: 100, Y: 200, Maximised: true, HasPosition: true}
	stored := toStorageWindowState(original)
	if stored == nil || stored.Width != 1920 {
		t.Fatal("toStorageWindowState failed")
	}
	back := fromStorageWindowState(stored)
	if back == nil || back.Width != 1920 || !back.Maximised || !back.HasPosition {
		t.Fatal("fromStorageWindowState failed")
	}
	if fromStorageWindowState(nil) != nil {
		t.Fatal("expected nil for nil input")
	}
}

func TestConversionRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	original := contracts.WorkspaceConfig{
		ID:           "abc",
		Name:         "My Workspace",
		Icon:         "folder",
		Color:        "#ff00ff",
		ShowHidden:   true,
		ActivePaneID: "right",
		SplitRatio:   0.6,
		LeftPane: contracts.PaneState{
			ID: "left",
			Tabs: []contracts.TabInfo{
				{
					ID: "tab1", Title: "Tab 1", Path: "/a", SurfaceID: "dir",
					Location: &contracts.LocationRef{Location: "search://?path=/a&pattern=todo", Scheme: "search", Kind: "query"},
					Viewer: &contracts.ViewerTab{
						TargetPath: "/a/file.txt",
						ViewerID:   "text",
						AutoFollow: true,
					},
					IsClosable: &[]bool{true}[0],
					IsActive:   true,
					IsPinned:   false,
				},
			},
			ActiveTabID: "tab1",
		},
		RightPane: contracts.PaneState{
			ID:          "right",
			Tabs:        []contracts.TabInfo{},
			ActiveTabID: "",
		},
		CreatedAt:      1000,
		LastAccessedAt: 2000,
	}

	stored := toStorageWorkspaceConfig(original)
	back := fromStorageWorkspaceConfig(stored)

	if back.ID != original.ID || back.Name != original.Name {
		t.Fatal("basic fields mismatch")
	}
	if back.ActivePaneID != original.ActivePaneID {
		t.Fatalf("active pane id mismatch: %s vs %s", back.ActivePaneID, original.ActivePaneID)
	}
	if back.SplitRatio != original.SplitRatio {
		t.Fatalf("split ratio mismatch")
	}
	if back.LeftPane.ActiveTabID != original.LeftPane.ActiveTabID {
		t.Fatal("left pane mismatch")
	}
	if back.LeftPane.Tabs[0].Location == nil || back.LeftPane.Tabs[0].Location.Scheme != "search" || back.LeftPane.Tabs[0].Location.Kind != "query" {
		t.Fatal("tab location lost in round-trip")
	}
	if back.LeftPane.Tabs[0].SurfaceID != "dir" {
		t.Fatalf("surface id lost in round-trip: %q", back.LeftPane.Tabs[0].SurfaceID)
	}
	if back.LeftPane.Tabs[0].Viewer == nil {
		t.Fatal("viewer lost in round-trip")
	}
	if back.LeftPane.Tabs[0].Viewer.TargetPath != "/a/file.txt" {
		t.Fatal("viewer target path mismatch")
	}
	if back.LeftPane.Tabs[0].IsClosable == nil || !*back.LeftPane.Tabs[0].IsClosable {
		t.Fatal("isClosable lost in round-trip")
	}
}

func TestServiceDelegation(t *testing.T) {
	m := newTestManager(t)
	svc := NewService(m)

	w1 := sampleWorkspaceConfig("w1")
	if err := svc.SaveWorkspace(w1); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("save failed: %v", err)
	}

	list := svc.GetWorkspaces()
	if len(list.Workspaces) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 workspace, got %d", len(list.Workspaces))
	}

	loaded, err := svc.LoadWorkspace("w1")
	if err != nil || loaded.ID != "w1" {
		t.Fatalf("load failed: %v", err)
	}

	if err := svc.DeleteWorkspace("w1"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("delete failed: %v", err)
	}
	if len(svc.GetWorkspaces().Workspaces) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("expected 0 workspaces after delete")
	}

	prefs := contracts.UserPreferences{Theme: "dark", UIZoom: 125}
	if err := svc.SavePreferences(prefs); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("save preferences failed: %v", err)
	}
	if svc.GetPreferences().Theme != "dark" {
		t.Fatal("preferences delegation failed")
	}
}

func TestStoreReadWrite(t *testing.T) {
	tmp := t.TempDir()
	store := &Store{statePath: filepath.Join(tmp, "test.json")}

	data := []byte(`{"hello":"world"}`)
	if err := store.WriteState(data); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("write failed: %v", err)
	}

	read, err := store.ReadState()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read failed: %v", err)
	}
	if string(read) != string(data) {
		t.Fatalf("read mismatch: %s vs %s", string(read), string(data))
	}

	if store.StatePath() != filepath.Join(tmp, "test.json") {
		t.Fatal("state path mismatch")
	}
}

func TestStoreReadMissing(t *testing.T) {
	tmp := t.TempDir()
	store := &Store{statePath: filepath.Join(tmp, "missing.json")}
	if _, err := store.ReadState(); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Fatalf("expected not-exist error, got %v", err)
	}
}
````

````powershell
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$projectRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$toolsRoot = Join-Path $projectRoot 'tools'

function Resolve-FirstSourcePath {
  param(
    [string[]]$Candidates
  )

  foreach ($candidate in $Candidates) {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($candidate)) {
      continue
    }

    $matches = @(Get-Item -Path $candidate -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    $match = $matches | Where-Object { $_.PSIsContainer } | Select-Object -First 1
    if ($match) {
      return $match.FullName
    }
  }

  return $null
}

$toolSpecs = @(
  @{
    Name = 'libvips'
    Sources = @(
      'C:\Program Files\libvips\bin',
      'C:\Program Files\vips-dev-8.17\bin',
      'C:\vips-dev-8.17\bin',
      (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\libvips.libvips_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\vips-dev-*\bin')
    )
  },
  @{
    Name = 'mupdf'
    Sources = @(
      'C:\Program Files\MuPDF',
      (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\ArtifexSoftware.mutool_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe\mupdf-*-windows')
    )
  },
  @{
    Name = 'libreoffice'
    Sources = @(
      'C:\Program Files\LibreOffice',
      'C:\Program Files (x86)\LibreOffice'
    )
  },
  @{
    Name = 'djvulibre'
    Sources = @(
      (Join-Path $projectRoot 'DjVuLibre'),
      (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $projectRoot) 'DjVuLibre')
    )
  }
)

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $toolsRoot | Out-Null

foreach ($tool in $toolSpecs) {
  $destination = Join-Path $toolsRoot $tool.Name
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $destination | Out-Null

  $source = Resolve-FirstSourcePath -Candidates $tool.Sources
  if (-not $source) {
    Write-Warning "$($tool.Name): source not found"
    continue
  }

  Write-Host "Copying $($tool.Name) from $source"
  Copy-Item (Join-Path $source '*') $destination -Recurse -Force
}

Write-Host "Portable tool collection complete: $toolsRoot"
````

````go
// Package s3 provides a read-only vfs.FileSystem backed by an S3-compatible
// object store such as AWS S3 or MinIO.
package s3

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/tls"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"net/http"
	"path"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/aws"
	awsconfig "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/config"
	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/credentials"
	s3sdk "github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3"
	"github.com/aws/smithy-go"

	"wails-app/vfs"
	vfsarchive "wails-app/vfs/archive"
)

const readChunkSize = 8 * 1024 * 1024

// Config holds S3-compatible connection parameters.
type Config struct {
	Region          string
	Bucket          string
	Prefix          string
	Endpoint        string
	AccessKeyID     string
	SecretAccessKey string
	SessionToken    string
	Anonymous       bool
	UsePathStyle    bool
	Insecure        bool
}

// FS implements vfs.FileSystem over one bucket and optional prefix.
type FS struct {
	client *s3sdk.Client
	bucket string
	prefix string
}

var _ vfs.FileSystem = (*FS)(nil)

// New creates an S3-backed filesystem rooted at cfg.Bucket/cfg.Prefix.
func New(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*FS, error) {
	bucket := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.Bucket)
	if bucket == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("s3: bucket is required")
	}

	region := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.Region)
	if region == "" {
		region = "us-east-1"
	}

	loadOptions := []func(*awsconfig.LoadOptions) error{
		awsconfig.WithRegion(region),
	}

	if cfg.Anonymous {
		loadOptions = append(loadOptions, awsconfig.WithCredentialsProvider(aws.AnonymousCredentials{}))
	} else if cfg.AccessKeyID != "" || cfg.SecretAccessKey != "" || cfg.SessionToken != "" {
		loadOptions = append(loadOptions,
			awsconfig.WithCredentialsProvider(credentials.NewStaticCredentialsProvider(
				cfg.AccessKeyID,
				cfg.SecretAccessKey,
				cfg.SessionToken,
			)),
		)
	}

	if endpoint := normalizeEndpoint(cfg.Endpoint, cfg.Insecure); endpoint != "" {
		loadOptions = append(loadOptions, awsconfig.WithBaseEndpoint(endpoint))
	}

	if cfg.Insecure {
		transport := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
		transport.TLSClientConfig = &tls.Config{InsecureSkipVerify: true} //nolint:gosec
		loadOptions = append(loadOptions, awsconfig.WithHTTPClient(&http.Client{Transport: transport}))
	}

	awsCfg, err := awsconfig.LoadDefaultConfig(ctx, loadOptions...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("s3: load config: %w", err)
	}
	if cfg.Anonymous {
		awsCfg.Credentials = aws.AnonymousCredentials{}
	}

	client := s3sdk.NewFromConfig(awsCfg, func(o *s3sdk.Options) {
		if cfg.Anonymous {
			o.Credentials = aws.AnonymousCredentials{}
		}
		o.UsePathStyle = cfg.UsePathStyle
	})

	if _, err := client.ListObjectsV2(ctx, &s3sdk.ListObjectsV2Input{
		Bucket:  aws.String(bucket),
		Prefix:  listProbePrefix(cleanPrefix(cfg.Prefix)),
		MaxKeys: aws.Int32(1),
	}); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("s3: head bucket %s: %w", bucket, mapErr(err))
	}

	return &FS{
		client: client,
		bucket: bucket,
		prefix: cleanPrefix(cfg.Prefix),
	}, nil
}

func listProbePrefix(prefix string) *string {
	if prefix == "" {
		return nil
	}
	return aws.String(prefix)
}

// Close releases idle HTTP connections held by the AWS client.
func (f *FS) Close() error {
	if transport, ok := f.client.Options().HTTPClient.(*http.Client); ok {
		if httpTransport, ok := transport.Transport.(*http.Transport); ok {
			httpTransport.CloseIdleConnections()
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (f *FS) Open(ctx context.Context, p string) (vfs.File, error) {
	cleaned := cleanPath(p)
	if cleaned == "" {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFile
	}

	info, err := f.statObject(ctx, cleaned)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &readFile{
		ctx:    ctx,
		client: f.client,
		bucket: f.bucket,
		key:    f.objectKey(cleaned),
		size:   info.size,
		info:   info,
	}, nil
}

func (f *FS) Stat(ctx context.Context, p string) (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	cleaned := cleanPath(p)
	if cleaned == "" {
		return &fileInfo{name: f.rootName(), isDir: true}, nil
	}

	if info, err := f.statObject(ctx, cleaned); err == nil {
		return info, nil
	} else if !errors.Is(err, vfs.ErrNotFound) {
		return nil, err
	}

	exists, err := f.directoryExists(ctx, cleaned)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !exists {
		return nil, vfs.ErrNotFound
	}

	return &fileInfo{name: path.Base(cleaned), isDir: true}, nil
}

// ReadDir lists one pseudo-directory level using common prefixes and direct objects.
func (f *FS) ReadDir(ctx context.Context, p string) ([]vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	cleaned := cleanPath(p)
	if cleaned != "" {
		info, err := f.Stat(ctx, cleaned)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if !info.IsDir() {
			return nil, vfs.ErrNotDir
		}
	}

	prefix := f.directoryKey(cleaned)
	input := &s3sdk.ListObjectsV2Input{
		Bucket:    aws.String(f.bucket),
		Delimiter: aws.String("/"),
	}
	if prefix != "" {
		input.Prefix = aws.String(prefix)
	}

	paginator := s3sdk.NewListObjectsV2Paginator(f.client, input)
	entries := make([]vfs.FileInfo, 0)
	seen := make(map[string]struct{})

	for paginator.HasMorePages() {
		page, err := paginator.NextPage(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, mapErr(err)
		}

		for _, commonPrefix := range page.CommonPrefixes {
			name := childName(prefix, aws.ToString(commonPrefix.Prefix))
			if name == "" {
				continue
			}
			if _, ok := seen[name]; ok {
				continue
			}
			seen[name] = struct{}{}
			entries = append(entries, &fileInfo{name: name, isDir: true})
		}

		for _, object := range page.Contents {
			key := aws.ToString(object.Key)
			name := childName(prefix, key)
			if name == "" || strings.Contains(name, "/") {
				continue
			}
			if _, ok := seen[name]; ok {
				continue
			}
			seen[name] = struct{}{}
			entries = append(entries, &fileInfo{
				name:    name,
				size:    aws.ToInt64(object.Size),
				modTime: timeValue(object.LastModified),
				isDir:   false,
			})
		}
	}

	return entries, nil
}

func (f *FS) Exists(ctx context.Context, p string) bool {
	_, err := f.Stat(ctx, p)
	return err == nil
}

func (f *FS) Create(_ context.Context, _ string) (vfs.File, error) {
	return nil, vfs.ErrReadOnly
}

func (f *FS) Mkdir(_ context.Context, _ string, _ fs.FileMode) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}

func (f *FS) Remove(_ context.Context, _ string) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}

func (f *FS) Rename(_ context.Context, _, _ string) error {
	return vfs.ErrReadOnly
}

func (f *FS) Join(elem ...string) string      { return path.Join(elem...) }
func (f *FS) Split(p string) (string, string) { return path.Split(p) }
func (f *FS) IsAbs(p string) bool             { return strings.HasPrefix(p, "/") }
func (f *FS) RealPath(_ string) (string, error) {
	return "", nil
}

func (f *FS) statObject(ctx context.Context, p string) (*fileInfo, error) {
	output, err := f.client.HeadObject(ctx, &s3sdk.HeadObjectInput{
		Bucket: aws.String(f.bucket),
		Key:    aws.String(f.objectKey(p)),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, mapErr(err)
	}

	return &fileInfo{
		name:    path.Base(p),
		size:    aws.ToInt64(output.ContentLength),
		modTime: timeValue(output.LastModified),
		isDir:   false,
	}, nil
}

func (f *FS) directoryExists(ctx context.Context, p string) (bool, error) {
	prefix := f.directoryKey(p)
	if prefix == "" {
		return true, nil
	}

	page, err := f.client.ListObjectsV2(ctx, &s3sdk.ListObjectsV2Input{
		Bucket:    aws.String(f.bucket),
		Prefix:    aws.String(prefix),
		Delimiter: aws.String("/"),
		MaxKeys:   aws.Int32(1),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return false, mapErr(err)
	}

	return len(page.CommonPrefixes) > 0 || len(page.Contents) > 0, nil
}

func (f *FS) rootName() string {
	if f.prefix != "" {
		return path.Base(f.prefix)
	}
	return f.bucket
}

func (f *FS) objectKey(p string) string {
	cleaned := cleanPath(p)
	if f.prefix == "" {
		return cleaned
	}
	if cleaned == "" {
		return f.prefix
	}
	return f.prefix + "/" + cleaned
}

func (f *FS) directoryKey(p string) string {
	combined := f.objectKey(p)
	if combined == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return strings.TrimSuffix(combined, "/") + "/"
}

type fileInfo struct {
	name    string
	size    int64
	modTime time.Time
	isDir   bool
}

func (fi *fileInfo) Name() string { return fi.name }
func (fi *fileInfo) Size() int64  { return fi.size }
func (fi *fileInfo) Mode() fs.FileMode {
	if fi.isDir {
		return fs.ModeDir | 0555
	}
	return 0444
}
func (fi *fileInfo) ModTime() time.Time   { return fi.modTime }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsDir() bool          { return fi.isDir }
func (fi *fileInfo) Sys() any             { return nil }
func (fi *fileInfo) Path() string         { return fi.name }
func (fi *fileInfo) RealPath() string     { return "" }
func (fi *fileInfo) Volume() vfs.Volume   { return nil }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsArchive() bool      { return !fi.isDir && isArchiveExt(fi.name) }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsHidden() bool       { return strings.HasPrefix(fi.name, ".") }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsSymlink() bool      { return false }
func (fi *fileInfo) IsNested() bool       { return false }
func (fi *fileInfo) MountChain() []string { return nil }

var _ vfs.FileInfo = (*fileInfo)(nil)

type readFile struct {
	ctx       context.Context
	client    *s3sdk.Client
	bucket    string
	key       string
	size      int64
	position  int64
	body      io.ReadCloser
	bodyStart int64
	bodyEnd   int64
	info      *fileInfo
}

func (f *readFile) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
	if len(p) == 0 {
		return 0, nil
	}
	if f.position >= f.size {
		return 0, io.EOF
	}
	if err := f.ensureBody(); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}

	n, err := f.body.Read(p)
	f.position += int64(n)
	if err == io.EOF {
		_ = f.closeBody()
		if f.position < f.size && n > 0 {
			return n, nil
		}
	}
	return n, err
}

func (f *readFile) Write(_ []byte) (int, error) {
	return 0, vfs.ErrReadOnly
}

func (f *readFile) Seek(offset int64, whence int) (int64, error) {
	var base int64
	switch whence {
	case io.SeekStart:
		base = 0
	case io.SeekCurrent:
		base = f.position
	case io.SeekEnd:
		base = f.size
	default:
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("s3: invalid seek whence %d", whence)
	}

	next := base + offset
	if next < 0 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("s3: negative seek position")
	}
	f.position = next
	_ = f.closeBody()
	return next, nil
}

func (f *readFile) Close() error {
	return f.closeBody()
}

func (f *readFile) Stat() (vfs.FileInfo, error) {
	return f.info, nil
}

func (f *readFile) Sync() error { return nil }

var _ vfs.File = (*readFile)(nil)

func (f *readFile) ensureBody() error {
	if f.body != nil && f.position >= f.bodyStart && f.position <= f.bodyEnd {
		return nil
	}
	_ = f.closeBody()

	end := minInt64(f.size-1, f.position+readChunkSize-1)
	output, err := f.client.GetObject(f.ctx, &s3sdk.GetObjectInput{
		Bucket: aws.String(f.bucket),
		Key:    aws.String(f.key),
		Range:  aws.String(fmt.Sprintf("bytes=%d-%d", f.position, end)),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return mapErr(err)
	}

	f.body = output.Body
	f.bodyStart = f.position
	f.bodyEnd = end
	return nil
}

func (f *readFile) closeBody() error {
	if f.body == nil {
		return nil
	}
	err := f.body.Close()
	f.body = nil
	return err
}

func cleanPrefix(prefix string) string {
	cleaned := cleanPath(prefix)
	if cleaned == "." {
		return ""
	}
	return cleaned
}

func cleanPath(p string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(p, "\\", "/"))
	trimmed = strings.Trim(trimmed, "/")
	if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "." {
		return ""
	}
	cleaned := path.Clean(trimmed)
	if cleaned == "." {
		return ""
	}
	return strings.TrimPrefix(cleaned, "/")
}

func childName(basePrefix, key string) string {
	if key == "" {
		return ""
	}
	relative := strings.TrimPrefix(key, basePrefix)
	relative = strings.Trim(relative, "/")
	if relative == "" {
		return ""
	}
	parts := strings.Split(relative, "/")
	if len(parts) == 0 {
		return ""
	}
	return parts[0]
}

func normalizeEndpoint(endpoint string, insecure bool) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(endpoint)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return ""
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "http://") || strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "https://") {
		return trimmed
	}
	if insecure {
		return "http://" + trimmed
	}
	return "https://" + trimmed
}

func timeValue(value *time.Time) time.Time {
	if value == nil {
		return time.Time{}
	}
	return *value
}

func minInt64(a, b int64) int64 {
	if a < b {
		return a
	}
	return b
}

func isArchiveExt(name string) bool {
	return vfsarchive.IsArchiveExt(name)
}

func mapErr(err error) error {
	if err == nil {
		return nil
	}

	var apiErr smithy.APIError
	if errors.As(err, &apiErr) {
		switch apiErr.ErrorCode() {
		case "NotFound", "NoSuchBucket", "NoSuchKey", "NoSuchUpload":
			return vfs.ErrNotFound
		}
	}

	lower := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
	if strings.Contains(lower, "not found") || strings.Contains(lower, "no such key") || strings.Contains(lower, "status code: 404") {
		return vfs.ErrNotFound
	}
	if strings.Contains(lower, "forbidden") || strings.Contains(lower, "access denied") {
		return vfs.ErrReadOnly
	}
	return err
}
````

## File: docs/README.md
````markdown
# Wails File Manager

## About

This repository is a Wails desktop file manager with an Angular frontend and a Go backend. It supports dual-pane browsing, multiple file views, archive browsing and mutation, batch operations, workspace persistence, and Windows-aware elevation fallbacks.

Frontend implementation notes, including view-operation parity expectations and pane/surface architecture, are documented in [frontend/README.md](frontend/README.md).

The staged refactor history and current architectural checkpoints are documented in [REFACTOR_ROADMAP.md](REFACTOR_ROADMAP.md).

The next-step backend packaging and layout proposal is documented in [BACKEND_REORGANIZATION_PLAN.md](BACKEND_REORGANIZATION_PLAN.md).

Recent feature-specific documentation:

- Image preview format coverage and conversion behavior: [SUPPORTED_FILES_BY_VIEWER.md](SUPPORTED_FILES_BY_VIEWER.md)
- Backend image conversion pipeline and streamed preview transport: [IMAGE_CONVERTER_PIPELINE.md](IMAGE_CONVERTER_PIPELINE.md)
- AVI preview behavior and current fallback settings: [AVI_PLAYBACK_SETTINGS.md](AVI_PLAYBACK_SETTINGS.md)
- Native child webview bidirectional messaging and bridge contract: [BROWSER_PANE_BRIDGE.md](BROWSER_PANE_BRIDGE.md)
- Navigation, editable address bar, and search scheme behavior: [NAVIGATION_FEATURE_STATUS.md](NAVIGATION_FEATURE_STATUS.md)
- Keyboard and address-bar edit behavior: [SHORTCUTS_AND_HANDLERS.md](SHORTCUTS_AND_HANDLERS.md)
- Remote cloud mount OAuth flow and browser-based localhost callback design: [REMOTE_OAUTH_FLOW.md](REMOTE_OAUTH_FLOW.md)

## Architecture

The current backend structure is organized around explicit internal package boundaries, while `App` remains the Wails binding wrapper exposed to Wails.

- Wails-facing app wrapper: [app.go](app.go)
- Internal app state/runtime/service assembly: [internal/app](internal/app)
- Archive domain facade: [internal/archive/service.go](internal/archive/service.go)
- Filesystem orchestration: [filesystem_service.go](filesystem_service.go)
- Batch orchestration: [internal/batch/service.go](internal/batch/service.go)
- Navigation orchestration: [internal/navigation/service.go](internal/navigation/service.go)
- Workspace/preferences orchestration: [internal/workspace/service.go](internal/workspace/service.go)
- Elevated session lifecycle and IPC: [internal/elevation](internal/elevation)
- Directory stream and pane watch runtime: [internal/runtime](internal/runtime)
- Platform/path helpers: [internal/platform](internal/platform)
- Small cross-domain utilities: [internal/utility/service.go](internal/utility/service.go)

The frontend is organized around a thin pane host plus controller/factory layers rather than a single large smart component.

- Pane host/facade: [frontend/src/app/components/file-pane.component.ts](frontend/src/app/components/file-pane.component.ts)
- Surface/view host: [frontend/src/app/components/file-view-container.component.ts](frontend/src/app/components/file-view-container.component.ts)
- Dynamic surface runtime: [frontend/src/app/surfaces](frontend/src/app/surfaces)
- Viewer host/runtime: [frontend/src/app/viewers](frontend/src/app/viewers)

## Configuration

Project-level Wails configuration lives in [wails.json](wails.json). Wails project setting details are documented at https://wails.io/docs/reference/project-config.

## Bundled External Tools

The app resolves external executables from a bundled tools directory relative to the shipped executable before checking the system `PATH`.

Supported root discovery order:

1. `WAILS_TOOLS_DIR`
2. `WAILS_EXTERNAL_TOOLS_DIR`
3. `tools` next to the built executable
4. `portable-tools` next to the built executable
5. `tools` one level above the built executable
6. `tools` in the current working directory

Recommended layout:

```text
tools/
	libvips/
		vips.exe
		vipsthumbnail.exe
		libvips*.dll
		...runtime DLLs / loaders...
	mupdf/
		mutool.exe
		...runtime files...
	libreoffice/
		soffice.exe
		...runtime files...
	djvulibre/
		ddjvu.exe
		...runtime files...
```

For packaged builds, `tools/` next to the executable is the intended delivery layout. The resolver checks the root directly and then each first-level subdirectory, so the executables can live either directly under `tools/` or inside per-tool folders.

For portable delivery on Windows, copy each tool's full install/runtime directory, not just the `.exe`, because tools such as libvips, MuPDF, and LibreOffice depend on adjacent DLLs and support files.

To refresh the bundled tool directory from the current machine, run [scripts/collect-portable-tools.ps1](scripts/collect-portable-tools.ps1).

## File View Operations Matrix

All file views share the same operation pipeline and are treated as equivalent interaction surfaces.

| Operation | List | Grid | Details | Tree |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Single select | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Multi-select (Ctrl/Cmd toggle) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Range select (Shift) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Select all / Deselect all | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Open item (Enter / double click) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Rename selected (F2 / Shift+F6) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Copy to other pane (F5) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Move to other pane (F6) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| New folder (F7) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Delete selected (F8 / Delete) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Drag & drop copy/move (Ctrl/Cmd = copy) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

### Shortcut Notes

- `F5` copy to other pane
- `F6` move to other pane
- `Shift+F6` rename selected item
- `F7` create folder
- `F8` delete selected items
- `Ctrl+R` refresh current pane
- `Ctrl+A` select all
- `Ctrl+D` clear selection

Tree view participates in the same operation flow as the other views (selection, keyboard actions, and drag/drop routing).

## Memory Filesystem (VFS sidecar)

The app uses an out-of-process sidecar (`in-memory-fs`) to host a persistent in-memory filesystem that is mounted into the app's virtual filesystem at the path `/memory`.

The sidecar is intended to outlive the Wails UI process. When the app starts again, it reconnects to an already running memfs instance through the control IPC channel and reuses the existing hidden backing path instead of starting with a fresh store.

The sidecar is launched by `ProcessManager` ([vfs/memory/process_unix.go](../vfs/memory/process_unix.go) / Windows equivalent) and communicates with the app via a platform-specific IPC channel:

| Platform | IPC channel | Details |
|---|---|---|
| Windows | Named pipe `\\\\.\\ pipe\\memfs-control` | Restricted to the current user via a Windows security descriptor |
| Linux | Unix socket `/tmp/memfs-control-<uid>.sock` | `chmod 0600`; removed on clean exit |
| macOS | Unix socket `/tmp/memfs-control-<uid>.sock` | `chmod 0600`; removed on clean exit |

Both Unix platforms rely on macFUSE (macOS) or the kernel FUSE driver (Linux) and require the sidecar binary to be present on `PATH` or at the path configured in preferences.

**Startup and reconnect sequence (all platforms)**:

1. `DefaultRootProvider` ([vfs/memory/fs.go](../vfs/memory/fs.go)) checks `WAILS_MEMFS_ROOT` and `MEMFS_HIDDEN_PATH` first.
2. If neither env override is set, it connects to the sidecar IPC channel and calls `get-connection-info`.
3. If memfs is already running, the returned `hiddenPath` is reused, so restarting the Wails app reconnects to the same memfs instance.
4. If the sidecar is not running, startup code can launch it and wait for the mount to become visible.
5. The resolved root path is wrapped as `osfs.FS` and registered at VFS path `/memory` by `InitVFS` ([internal/runtime/vfs.go](../internal/runtime/vfs.go)).

**macOS prerequisites**: macFUSE must be installed (`/Library/Filesystems/macfuse.fs`). The preflight check in [vfs/memory/preflight_unix.go](../vfs/memory/preflight_unix.go) will return a user-friendly error if it is absent.

## Live Development

To run in live development mode, run `wails dev` in the project directory. This launches the Angular frontend in Wails live-reload mode together with the Go backend so frontend and backend changes can be iterated together.

## Building

To build a redistributable, production mode package, use `wails build`.
````

````typescript
import type { ApiService } from '../services/api.service';
import type { ArchiveService, ArchiveFrame } from '../services/archive.service';
import type { ConfirmDialogService } from '../services/confirm-dialog.service';
import type { FilePaneBrowserCommands } from './file-pane-browser-commands.factory';
import { BatchItemError, operationErrorMessage } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import type { SourceCapabilities } from '../services/source-capabilities';
import { canTransferBetween, transferBlockedMessage } from '../services/transfer-capabilities';

export interface FileBrowserTransferPane {
  currentPath: string;
  selectedFiles: Set<string>;
  archiveStack: ArchiveFrame[];
  sourceCapabilities: SourceCapabilities;
  getDestinationDir(): string;
  getTreeArchiveSelectionContext(): { archivePath: string; innerPaths: string[] } | null;
  initiatePendingMove(entries: string[], destDir: string): void;
  isInArchive(): boolean;
  browserCommands: Pick<FilePaneBrowserCommands, 'navigation'>;
}

export interface FileBrowserTransferHost {
  leftPane?: FileBrowserTransferPane;
  rightPane?: FileBrowserTransferPane;
  get confirmBeforeCopy(): boolean;
  get confirmBeforeMove(): boolean;
  apiService: ApiService;
  archiveService: ArchiveService;
  confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService;
  buildDestinationPath(sourcePath: string, targetDir: string): Promise<string>;
}

export interface FileBrowserTransferOptions {
  skipConfirmation?: boolean;
}

export class FileBrowserTransferController {
  async copy(host: FileBrowserTransferHost, sourceSide: 'left' | 'right', paths: string[], options: FileBrowserTransferOptions = {}): Promise<void> {
    const { src, dst } = this.resolvePanes(host, sourceSide);
    if (!src || !dst || paths.length === 0) return;
    const destDir = this.resolveCrossPaneDestination(dst);
    const decision = canTransferBetween('copy', src.sourceCapabilities, dst.sourceCapabilities);
    if (!decision.allowed) { host.confirmDialog.alert(transferBlockedMessage('copy', decision)); return; }

    if (host.confirmBeforeCopy && !options.skipConfirmation) {
      const confirmed = await host.confirmDialog.confirm({
        title: 'Copy to Other Pane',
        message: `Copy ${paths.length} item(s) to ${destDir}?`,
        confirmText: 'Copy',
      });
      if (!confirmed) return;
    }

    if (src.isInArchive()) {
      if (this.bothArchive(src, dst)) {
        host.confirmDialog.alert('Cannot copy between two archive panes\nOpen a real folder in one pane first.');
        return;
      }
      const frame = src.archiveStack[src.archiveStack.length - 1];
      const result = await host.archiveService.copy(frame, paths, destDir);
      const err = this.archiveError(result);
      if (err) host.confirmDialog.alert(`Copy Completed with Errors\n${err}`);
      await dst.browserCommands.navigation.refresh();
      return;
    }

    const treeArchive = src.getTreeArchiveSelectionContext();
    if (treeArchive) {
      const result = await host.archiveService.copyByContext(treeArchive.archivePath, treeArchive.innerPaths, destDir);
      const err = this.archiveError(result);
      if (err) host.confirmDialog.alert(`Copy Errors\n${err}`);
      await dst.browserCommands.navigation.refresh();
      return;
    }

    const items = await Promise.all(
      paths.map(async srcPath => ({
        source: srcPath,
        destination: await host.buildDestinationPath(srcPath, destDir),
      }))
    );
    const result = await host.apiService.batchCopy(items, true);
    const err = this.archiveError(result);
    if (err) host.confirmDialog.alert(`Copy Errors\n${err}`);
    await dst.browserCommands.navigation.refresh();
  }

  async copyRelative(
    host: FileBrowserTransferHost,
    sourceSide: 'left' | 'right',
    items: readonly { source: string; relativePath: string }[],
  ): Promise<void> {
    const { src, dst } = this.resolvePanes(host, sourceSide);
    if (!src || !dst || items.length === 0) return;
    const destDir = this.resolveCrossPaneDestination(dst);
    const decision = canTransferBetween('copy', src.sourceCapabilities, dst.sourceCapabilities);
    if (!decision.allowed) { host.confirmDialog.alert(transferBlockedMessage('copy', decision)); return; }
    if (src.isInArchive() || dst.isInArchive()) {
      host.confirmDialog.alert('Recursive synchronization is available only between regular folder panes.');
      return;
    }

    const batch = await Promise.all(items.map(async item => ({
      source: item.source,
      destination: await host.apiService.joinPaths([destDir, ...item.relativePath.split('/').filter(Boolean)]),
    })));
    const result = await host.apiService.batchCopy(batch, true);
    const err = this.archiveError(result);
    if (err) host.confirmDialog.alert(`Copy Errors\n${err}`);
    await dst.browserCommands.navigation.refresh();
  }

  async move(host: FileBrowserTransferHost, sourceSide: 'left' | 'right', paths: string[]): Promise<void> {
    const { src, dst } = this.resolvePanes(host, sourceSide);
    if (!src || !dst || paths.length === 0) return;
    const destDir = this.resolveCrossPaneDestination(dst);
    const decision = canTransferBetween('move', src.sourceCapabilities, dst.sourceCapabilities);
    if (!decision.allowed) { host.confirmDialog.alert(transferBlockedMessage('move', decision)); return; }

    if (host.confirmBeforeMove) {
      const confirmed = await host.confirmDialog.confirm({
        title: 'Move to Other Pane',
        message: `Move ${paths.length} item(s) to ${destDir}?`,
        confirmText: 'Move',
      });
      if (!confirmed) return;
    }

    if (src.isInArchive()) {
      if (this.bothArchive(src, dst)) {
        host.confirmDialog.alert('Cannot move between two archive panes\nOpen a real folder in one pane first.');
        return;
      }
      src.initiatePendingMove(paths, destDir);
      return;
    }

    const treeArchive = src.getTreeArchiveSelectionContext();
    if (treeArchive) {
      const result = await host.archiveService.moveByContext(treeArchive.archivePath, treeArchive.innerPaths, destDir);
      const err = this.archiveError(result);
      if (err) host.confirmDialog.alert(`Move Errors\n${err}`);
      await src.browserCommands.navigation.refresh();
      await dst.browserCommands.navigation.refresh();
      return;
    }

    const items = await Promise.all(
      paths.map(async srcPath => ({
        source: srcPath,
        destination: await host.buildDestinationPath(srcPath, destDir),
      }))
    );
    const result = await host.apiService.batchMove(items, true);
    const err = this.archiveError(result);
    if (err) host.confirmDialog.alert(`Move Errors\n${err}`);
    await src.browserCommands.navigation.refresh();
    await dst.browserCommands.navigation.refresh();
  }

  private resolvePanes(host: FileBrowserTransferHost, sourceSide: 'left' | 'right'): { src?: FileBrowserTransferPane; dst?: FileBrowserTransferPane } {
    return sourceSide === 'left'
      ? { src: host.leftPane, dst: host.rightPane }
      : { src: host.rightPane, dst: host.leftPane };
  }

  private resolveCrossPaneDestination(pane: FileBrowserTransferPane): string {
    return pane.currentPath || pane.getDestinationDir();
  }

  private archiveError(result: any): string | null {
    if (!result?.failed) return null;
    return (result.errors as BatchItemError[] ?? []).map(e => {
      const label = operationErrorMessage(e.code);
      const detail = e.code === 'unknown' && e.error ? ` (${e.error})` : '';
      return `${e.source}: ${label}${detail}`;
    }).join('\n');
  }

  private bothArchive(src?: FileBrowserTransferPane, dst?: FileBrowserTransferPane): boolean {
    return !!src?.isInArchive() && !!dst?.isInArchive();
  }
}
````
