````typescript
export class FileGridComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy, OnChanges, AfterViewInit {
  constructor(
    private zone: NgZone,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private categoryResolver: FileCategoryResolverService,
  ) {}

  @ViewChild('gridContainer') gridContainerRef?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;
  @ViewChildren(FileEntryComponent) fileEntryComponents?: QueryList<FileEntryComponent>;

  @Input() entries: FileInfo[] = [];
  @Input() pendingDirectorySizePaths: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set();
  @Input() selectedFiles: Set<string> = new Set();
  @Input() cursorPath: string | null = null;
  @Input() paneActive = true;
  @Input() singleClickToOpen = false;
  @Input() colorizeByMime = false;
  
  @Output() selectionChange = new EventEmitter<FileInfo[]>();
  @Output() cursorPathChange = new EventEmitter<string | null>();
  @Output() navigate = new EventEmitter<FileInfo>();
  @Output() openInNewTab = new EventEmitter<FileInfo>();
  @Output() contextMenu = new EventEmitter<{ event: MouseEvent; entry: FileInfo }>();
  @Output() backgroundContextMenu = new EventEmitter<MouseEvent>();
  @Output() dragStart = new EventEmitter<{ event: DragEvent; entries: FileInfo[] }>();
  @Output() dragDrop = new EventEmitter<{ event: DragEvent; source: FileInfo[]; target: FileInfo }>();
  @Output() rename = new EventEmitter<{ entry: FileInfo; newName: string }>();

  FileType = FileType;
  
  // OPTIMIZED: Lower threshold for earlier virtualization activation
  private readonly VIRTUAL_THRESHOLD = 200;
  private readonly rowHeight = 124;
  private readonly overscanRows = 5; // Increased for smoother scrolling in large folders
  private scrollRAF: number | null = null;
  private boundScrollListener?: () => void;
  private resizeObserver?: ResizeObserver;

  private virtualStart = 0;
  private virtualEnd = 0;
  private cachedVirtualColumns = 1; // Cache column count to avoid repeated getComputedStyle
  private lastScrollTop = 0;
  private lastScrollTime = 0;
  private viewportHeight = 0;
  private visibleEntriesCache: FileInfo[] = [];
  private pathToEntryIndex = new Map<string, number>();
  private columnsMeasureRAF: number | null = null; // Coalesce column measurements

  private anchorPath: string | null = null;

  private setCursor(path: string | null): void {
    this.anchorPath = path;
    this.cursorPathChange.emit(path);
  }
  dragPreviewEntry: FileInfo | null = null;
  dragOverPath: string | null = null;
  dragOverPosition: 'before' | 'after' | 'inside' | null = null;
  isBackgroundDropTarget = false;
  draggingPaths = new Set<string>();
  private dragImageEl: HTMLElement | null = null;
  private reflowRaf: number | null = null;
  private pendingReflowBefore: Map<string, { el: HTMLElement; rect: DOMRect }> | null = null;
  private marqueeContainer: HTMLElement | null = null;
  private marqueeStartX = 0;
  private marqueeStartY = 0;
  private marqueeAppend = false;
  private suppressBackgroundContextMenu = false;
  private suppressBackgroundClick = false;
  private suppressItemContextMenu = false;
  private selectionMode: 'none' | 'marquee' | 'paint' = 'none';
  private paintedPaths = new Set<string>();
  private marqueeButton: 0 | 2 | null = null;
  private hasMarqueeMoved = false;
  private pendingClearOnMove = false;
  private windowMouseMove?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
  private windowMouseUp?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
  private windowContextMenu?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
  private pendingRenameDisplayNames = new Map<string, string>();

  selectionRect = {
    active: false,
    left: 0,
    top: 0,
    width: 0,
    height: 0,
  };

  get virtualEnabled(): boolean {
    return this.entries.length >= this.VIRTUAL_THRESHOLD;
  }

  get totalContentHeight(): number {
    const rows = Math.ceil(this.entries.length / this.cachedVirtualColumns);
    return rows * this.rowHeight;
  }

  get virtualWindowTransform(): string {
    if (!this.virtualEnabled) return '';
    const startRow = Math.floor(this.virtualStart / this.cachedVirtualColumns);
    return `translateY(${startRow * this.rowHeight}px)`;
  }

  get visibleEntries(): FileInfo[] {
    return this.visibleEntriesCache;
  }

  onRename(event: { entry: FileInfo; newName: string }): void {
    this.rename.emit(event);
  }

  /** Number of columns currently visible in the grid. */
  getColumns(): number {
    return Math.max(1, this.cachedVirtualColumns);
  }

  /** Approximate number of grid items visible in the viewport. */
  getApproxPageSize(): number {
    const host = this.gridContainerRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!host) return 5;
    const rows = Math.max(1, Math.floor(host.clientHeight / this.rowHeight) - 1);
    return rows * Math.max(1, this.cachedVirtualColumns);
  }

  /** Scroll the grid to bring the given path into view. */
  scrollToPath(path: string): void {
    if (!path || path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) return;
    const host = this.gridContainerRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!host) return;
    const idx = this.pathToEntryIndex.get(path) ?? -1;
    if (idx < 0) return;
    if (this.virtualEnabled) {
      const row = Math.floor(idx / Math.max(1, this.cachedVirtualColumns));
      const itemTop = row * this.rowHeight;
      const itemBottom = itemTop + this.rowHeight;
      if (itemTop < host.scrollTop || itemBottom > host.scrollTop + host.clientHeight) {
        const centerOffset = host.clientHeight / 2 - this.rowHeight / 2;
        host.scrollTop = Math.max(0, itemTop - centerOffset);
      }
      if (this.updateVirtualWindow()) {
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      }
    } else {
      const el = host.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`.grid-item[data-path="${CSS.escape(path)}"]`);
      el?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' });
    }
  }

  getScrollTop(): number {
    return this.gridContainerRef?.nativeElement?.scrollTop ?? 0;
  }

  setScrollTop(top: number): void {
    const element = this.gridContainerRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!element) return;
    element.scrollTop = Math.max(0, top);
  }

  /** Called by parent (eg. on F2) to begin in-place rename for the current selection. */
  startRenameSelected(): void {
    const selectedPath = this.getFirstSelectedPathInOrder();
    if (!selectedPath) return;
    this.startRenameByPath(selectedPath);
  }

  startRenamePath(path: string): void {
    this.startRenameByPath(path);
  }

  setPendingRenameDisplayName(path: string, displayName: string | null): void {
    if (!path || path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) return;
    if (displayName && displayName.trim()) {
      this.pendingRenameDisplayNames.set(path, displayName.trim());
    } else {
      this.pendingRenameDisplayNames.delete(path);
    }
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  getDisplayNameOverride(path: string): string | null {
    return this.pendingRenameDisplayNames.get(path) ?? null;
  }

  isDirectorySizePending(path: string): boolean {
    return this.pendingDirectorySizePaths.has(path);
  }

  private getFirstSelectedPathInOrder(): string | null {
    if (!this.selectedFiles?.size) return null;
    for (const entry of this.entries) {
      if (!entry || this.isParentEntry(entry)) continue;
      if (this.selectedFiles.has(entry.path)) return entry.path;
    }
    return null;
  }

  private startRenameByPath(path: string): void {
    if (!path || path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) return;

    const host = this.gridContainerRef?.nativeElement;
    if (host) {
      if (this.virtualEnabled) {
        const idx = this.pathToEntryIndex.get(path) ?? -1;
        if (idx >= 0) {
          const row = Math.floor(idx / Math.max(1, this.cachedVirtualColumns));
          const targetTop = row * this.rowHeight;
          const centerOffset = host.clientHeight / 2 - this.rowHeight / 2;
          host.scrollTop = Math.max(0, targetTop - centerOffset);
          if (this.updateVirtualWindow()) {
            this.cdr.markForCheck();
          }
        }
      } else {
        const el = host.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`.grid-item[data-path="${CSS.escape(path)}"]`);
        el?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' });
      }
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const comp = this.fileEntryComponents?.find(c => c.entry?.path === path);
      comp?.beginRename();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
  }

  get displayEntries(): (FileInfo | null)[] {
    const visible = this.visibleEntries;
    if (!this.dragOverPath || this.dragOverPosition === 'inside') return visible;

    const targetIndex = visible.findIndex(entry => entry.path === this.dragOverPath);
    if (targetIndex === -1) return visible;

    const insertAt = this.dragOverPosition === 'after' ? targetIndex + 1 : targetIndex;
    const withGhost: (FileInfo | null)[] = [...visible];
    withGhost.splice(insertAt, 0, null);
    return withGhost;
  }

  trackByDisplayPath(index: number, entry: FileInfo | null): string {
    if (entry) return entry.path;
    return '__grid_ghost__';
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    // Seed anchor from parent-provided cursor on first load (e.g. tab restore).
    if (this.cursorPath && !this.anchorPath) {
      this.anchorPath = this.cursorPath;
    }
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    const host = this.gridContainerRef?.nativeElement;
    if (host) {
      // Initialize cached columns from actual render
      this.cachedVirtualColumns = this.measureGridColumns(host);
    }
    this.setupResizeObserver();
    this.setupScrollListener();
    this.rebuildDerivedEntries();
    this.updateVirtualWindow(true);
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    // Parent can restore cursor position (e.g. after tab switch / navigation).
    // Only sync if parent explicitly changed it; internal clicks update anchorPath directly.
    if (changes['cursorPath'] && this.cursorPath !== undefined) {
      this.anchorPath = this.cursorPath;
    }
    if (changes['entries'] || changes['colorizeByMime']) {
      this.prewarmCollisionResolutions();
      if (changes['entries']) {
        const prevLen = changes['entries'].previousValue?.length || 0;
        const currLen = changes['entries'].currentValue?.length || 0;
        if (Math.abs(prevLen - currLen) > 1000) {
          this.resetScroll();
        }
      }
      this.rebuildDerivedEntries();
      this.updateVirtualWindow(true);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    } else if (changes['pendingDirectorySizePaths'] || changes['selectedFiles'] || changes['cursorPath']) {
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  private prewarmCollisionResolutions(): void {
    if (!this.colorizeByMime) {
      return;
    }
    for (const entry of this.entries) {
      this.categoryResolver.ensureResolved(entry);
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.detachMarqueeListeners();
    this.cleanupDragImage();
    this.cleanupResizeObserver();
    this.cleanupScrollListener();
    if (this.scrollRAF) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.scrollRAF);
    }
    if (this.reflowRaf) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.reflowRaf);
      this.reflowRaf = null;
    }
    this.pendingReflowBefore = null;
  }

  private cleanupDragImage(): void {
    if (!this.dragImageEl) return;
    try {
      this.dragImageEl.remove();
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    this.dragImageEl = null;
  }

  private prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
    try {
      return window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')?.matches ?? false;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  private captureGridItemRects(): Map<string, { el: HTMLElement; rect: DOMRect }> {
    const container = this.gridContainerRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!container) return new Map();

    const map = new Map<string, { el: HTMLElement; rect: DOMRect }>();
    const items = container.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.grid-item[data-path]');
    for (const el of Array.from(items)) {
      if (el.classList.contains('dragging-source')) continue;
      const path = el.dataset['path'];
      if (!path) continue;
      map.set(path, { el, rect: el.getBoundingClientRect() });
    }
    return map;
  }

  /** Animate grid reflow using FLIP (First-Last-Invert-Play). */
  private animateGridReflowFrom(before: Map<string, { el: HTMLElement; rect: DOMRect }>): void {
    if (this.prefersReducedMotion()) return;
    if (before.size === 0) return;

    // Coalesce: if dragover fires rapidly, keep only the latest reflow.
    this.pendingReflowBefore = before;
    if (this.reflowRaf) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.reflowRaf);
      this.reflowRaf = null;
    }

    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      this.reflowRaf = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        this.reflowRaf = null;

        const beforeSnapshot = this.pendingReflowBefore;
        this.pendingReflowBefore = null;
        if (!beforeSnapshot || beforeSnapshot.size === 0) return;

        const after = this.captureGridItemRects();
        if (after.size === 0) return;

        for (const [path, next] of after) {
          const prev = beforeSnapshot.get(path);
          if (!prev) continue;

          const dx = prev.rect.left - next.rect.left;
          const dy = prev.rect.top - next.rect.top;
          if (Math.abs(dx) < 0.5 && Math.abs(dy) < 0.5) continue;

          // Avoid fighting the folder hover transform while dragging over folders.
          if (next.el.classList.contains('drag-over-folder')) continue;

          try {
            next.el.animate(
              [
                { transform: `translate(${dx}px, ${dy}px)` },
                { transform: 'translate(0px, 0px)' },
              ],
              {
                duration: 110,
                easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1)',
              }
            );
          } catch {
            // ignore (WAAPI not available)
          }
        }
      });
    });
  }

  private setupResizeObserver(): void {
    const element = this.gridContainerRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!element) return;

    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      this.resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
        let shouldMark = false;
        for (const entry of entries) {
          if (this.viewportHeight !== entry.contentRect.height) {
            this.viewportHeight = entry.contentRect.height;
            shouldMark = this.updateVirtualWindow() || shouldMark;
          }
          // Also remeasure columns on width changes (more efficient)
          if (entry.contentRect.width > 0) {
            const cols = this.measureGridColumns(element);
            if (cols !== this.cachedVirtualColumns) {
              this.cachedVirtualColumns = cols;
              shouldMark = this.updateVirtualWindow(true) || shouldMark;
            }
          }
        }
        if (shouldMark) {
          this.cdr.markForCheck();
        }
      });

      this.resizeObserver.observe(element);
    });
  }

  private cleanupResizeObserver(): void {
    this.resizeObserver?.disconnect();
  }

  private setupScrollListener(): void {
    const element = this.gridContainerRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!element) return;
    this.boundScrollListener = () => this.onScroll();
    this.zone.runOutsideAngular(() => {
      element.addEventListener('scroll', this.boundScrollListener!, { passive: true });
    });
  }

  private cleanupScrollListener(): void {
    const element = this.gridContainerRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!element || !this.boundScrollListener) return;
    element.removeEventListener('scroll', this.boundScrollListener);
    this.boundScrollListener = undefined;
  }

  private onScroll(): void {
    if (this.scrollRAF) return;
    this.scrollRAF = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      this.scrollRAF = null;
      const now = performance.now();
      const scrollDelta = Math.abs((this.gridContainerRef?.nativeElement?.scrollTop ?? 0) - this.lastScrollTop);
      this.lastScrollTime = now;
      if (this.updateVirtualWindow()) {
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      }
    });
  }

  private resetScroll(): void {
    const element = this.gridContainerRef?.nativeElement;
    if (element) {
      element.scrollTop = 0;
      this.lastScrollTop = 0;
    }
    this.virtualStart = 0;
    this.virtualEnd = Math.min(this.overscanRows * this.cachedVirtualColumns * 2, this.entries.length);
    this.rebuildVisibleEntries();
  }

  private updateVirtualWindow(forceRebuild = false): boolean {
    const host = this.gridContainerRef?.nativeElement;
    const viewportHeight = this.viewportHeight || host?.clientHeight || 0;
    const scrollTop = host?.scrollTop ?? 0;

    let changed = forceRebuild;

    // Coalesce column measurements - only measure on resize or force
    if (forceRebuild) {
      const cols = this.measureGridColumns(host);
      if (cols !== this.cachedVirtualColumns) {
        this.cachedVirtualColumns = cols;
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    const cols = this.cachedVirtualColumns;

    if (!this.virtualEnabled) {
      // Even without virtualization, keep the computed column count so keyboard navigation
      // (Up/Down by row) behaves correctly in grid view.
      if (this.virtualStart !== 0 || this.virtualEnd !== this.entries.length) {
        this.virtualStart = 0;
        this.virtualEnd = this.entries.length;
        changed = true;
      }
      if (changed) {
        this.rebuildVisibleEntries();
      }
      return changed;
    }

    const startRow = Math.max(0, Math.floor(scrollTop / this.rowHeight) - this.overscanRows);
    const visibleRows = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(viewportHeight / this.rowHeight));
    const endRow = startRow + visibleRows + this.overscanRows * 2;

    const start = startRow * cols;
    const end = Math.min(this.entries.length, endRow * cols);

    if (start !== this.virtualStart || end !== this.virtualEnd) {
      this.virtualStart = start;
      this.virtualEnd = end;
      this.lastScrollTop = scrollTop;
      changed = true;
    }
    if (changed) {
      this.rebuildVisibleEntries();
    }
    return changed;
  }

  private rebuildDerivedEntries(): void {
    this.pathToEntryIndex.clear();
    this.entries.forEach((entry, index) => this.pathToEntryIndex.set(entry.path, index));
    this.rebuildVisibleEntries();
  }

  private rebuildVisibleEntries(): void {
    this.visibleEntriesCache = this.virtualEnabled
      ? this.entries.slice(this.virtualStart, this.virtualEnd)
      : this.entries;
  }

  trackByPath(_i: number, entry: FileInfo): string {
    return entry.path;
  }

  isParentEntry(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    return entry.path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH;
  }

  isSelected(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    return this.selectedFiles.has(entry.path);
  }

  isCursor(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    return entry.path === this.cursorPath;
  }

  isDropTarget(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    return this.dragOverPath === entry.path && this.dragOverPosition === 'inside';
  }

  isDragOverBefore(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    return this.dragOverPath === entry.path && this.dragOverPosition === 'before';
  }

  isDragOverAfter(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    return this.dragOverPath === entry.path && this.dragOverPosition === 'after';
  }

  isDragOverInside(entry: FileInfo): boolean {
    return this.dragOverPath === entry.path && this.dragOverPosition === 'inside';
  }

  private measureGridColumns(host?: HTMLElement): number {
    if (!host) {
      return Math.max(1, this.cachedVirtualColumns);
    }

    const gridElement = this.virtualEnabled
      ? host.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.grid-window.virtual-window')
      : host;

    if (!gridElement) {
      return Math.max(1, this.cachedVirtualColumns);
    }

    // Cache style lookup - only get it once per measurement
    const template = getComputedStyle(gridElement).gridTemplateColumns;
    const resolvedColumns = template
      .split(' ')
      .map(value => value.trim())
      .filter(value => value.length > 0 && value !== 'none');

    if (resolvedColumns.length > 0) {
      return resolvedColumns.length;
    }

    // Fallback calculation for when grid-template-columns can't be parsed
    const compactMode = host.closest('.compact-mode') !== null;
    const minCellWidth = compactMode ? 80 : 100;
    const gap = compactMode ? 8 : 12;
    const horizontalPadding = 24;
    const contentWidth = Math.max(1, host.clientWidth - horizontalPadding * 2);
    return Math.max(1, Math.floor((contentWidth + gap) / (minCellWidth + gap)));
  }

  onItemClick(entry: FileInfo, event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) {
      this.selectionChange.emit(this.buildToggledSelection(entry));
      this.setCursor(entry.path);
    } else if (event.shiftKey && this.anchorPath) {
      this.selectionChange.emit(this.rangeSelect(entry));
    } else {
      if (this.isParentEntry(entry)) {
        this.anchorPath = entry.path;
        this.selectionChange.emit([entry]);
        if (this.singleClickToOpen) {
          this.navigate.emit(entry);
        }
        return;
      }
      this.setCursor(entry.path);
      this.selectionChange.emit([entry]);
      if (this.singleClickToOpen) {
        this.navigate.emit(entry);
      }
    }
  }

  onItemDoubleClick(entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (this.singleClickToOpen) {
      return;
    }
    this.navigate.emit(entry);
  }

  onContextMenu(event: MouseEvent, entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (this.suppressItemContextMenu) {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.suppressItemContextMenu = false;
      return;
    }

    event.preventDefault();
    if (this.isParentEntry(entry)) return;

    if (!this.isSelected(entry)) {
      // TC: right-click on unselected → replace selection with only this file
      this.selectionChange.emit([entry]);
      this.setCursor(entry.path);
    }
    // TC: right-click on selected → keep full selection unchanged
    this.contextMenu.emit({ event, entry });
  }

  onItemAuxClick(event: MouseEvent, entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (event.button !== 1 || this.isParentEntry(entry)) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.openInNewTab.emit(entry);
  }

  onBackgroundClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (this.suppressBackgroundClick) {
      this.suppressBackgroundClick = false;
      return;
    }

    if (event.target === event.currentTarget) {
      this.selectionChange.emit([]);
      // TC: background click clears selection but keeps cursor
    }
  }

  onBackgroundContextMenu(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (this.suppressBackgroundContextMenu) {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.suppressBackgroundContextMenu = false;
      return;
    }

    if (event.target === event.currentTarget) {
      event.preventDefault();
      this.selectionChange.emit([]);
      this.backgroundContextMenu.emit(event);
      // TC: background contextmenu clears selection but keeps cursor
    }
  }

  onGridMouseDown(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (event.button !== 0 && event.button !== 2) return;

    // Left button on a draggable file item → let HTML5 drag-and-drop handle it
    if (event.button === 0) {
      const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
      if (target.closest('[draggable="true"]')) return;
    }

    const container = event.currentTarget as HTMLElement;
    this.marqueeContainer = container;
    this.marqueeAppend = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey;
    this.selectionMode = 'marquee';
    this.marqueeButton = event.button as 0 | 2;
    this.hasMarqueeMoved = false;
    this.pendingClearOnMove = this.marqueeButton === 2 && !this.marqueeAppend;
    this.paintedPaths.clear();

    const { x, y } = this.getRelativePoint(event, container);
    this.marqueeStartX = x;
    this.marqueeStartY = y;

    this.selectionRect = {
      active: true,
      left: x,
      top: y,
      width: 0,
      height: 0,
    };

    if (!this.marqueeAppend && !this.pendingClearOnMove) {
      this.selectionChange.emit([]);
    }

    this.suppressBackgroundClick = true;
    this.suppressItemContextMenu = false;

    this.windowMouseMove = (moveEvent: MouseEvent) => this.zone.run(() => this.onGridMouseMove(moveEvent));
    this.windowMouseUp = () => this.zone.run(() => this.finishMarqueeSelection());
    this.windowContextMenu = (contextEvent: MouseEvent) => {
      if (this.selectionMode !== 'none' && this.hasMarqueeMoved) {
        contextEvent.preventDefault();
        contextEvent.stopPropagation();
      }
    };
    
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', this.windowMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', this.windowMouseUp);
    window.addEventListener('contextmenu', this.windowContextMenu, true);
    this.suppressBackgroundContextMenu = event.button === 2;
    
    if (event.button === 0) {
      event.preventDefault();
    }
  }

  private onGridMouseMove(event: MouseEvent): void {
    if (!this.marqueeContainer) return;

    if (this.selectionMode === 'paint') {
      this.updatePaintSelection(event);
      return;
    }

    if (this.selectionMode !== 'marquee' || !this.selectionRect.active) return;

    const { x, y } = this.getRelativePoint(event, this.marqueeContainer);
    const left = Math.min(this.marqueeStartX, x);
    const top = Math.min(this.marqueeStartY, y);
    const width = Math.abs(x - this.marqueeStartX);
    const height = Math.abs(y - this.marqueeStartY);
    
    if (width > 2 || height > 2) {
      this.hasMarqueeMoved = true;
      if (this.pendingClearOnMove) {
        this.selectionChange.emit([]);
        this.pendingClearOnMove = false;
      }
      if (this.marqueeButton === 2) {
        this.suppressItemContextMenu = true;
      }
    }

    this.selectionRect = { active: true, left, top, width, height };
    this.emitMarqueeSelection();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private updatePaintSelection(event: MouseEvent): void {
    const element = document.elementFromPoint(event.clientX, event.clientY) as HTMLElement | null;
    const item = element?.closest('.grid-item') as HTMLElement | null;
    const path = item?.dataset['path'];
    if (!path || path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH || this.paintedPaths.has(path)) return;

    this.paintedPaths.add(path);

    const selectionPaths = new Set<string>(this.paintedPaths);
    if (this.marqueeAppend) {
      for (const existingPath of this.selectedFiles) {
        if (existingPath !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) {
          selectionPaths.add(existingPath);
        }
      }
    }

    const selectedEntries = this.entries.filter(entry => selectionPaths.has(entry.path));
    this.selectionChange.emit(selectedEntries);
  }

  private emitMarqueeSelection(): void {
    if (!this.marqueeContainer) return;

    const selectionPaths = new Set<string>();
    const metrics = this.getGridMarqueeMetrics();

    if (metrics) {
      const selectionRight = this.selectionRect.left + this.selectionRect.width;
      const selectionBottom = this.selectionRect.top + this.selectionRect.height;
      const startColumn = Math.max(0, Math.floor((this.selectionRect.left - metrics.paddingLeft) / metrics.cellStrideX));
      const endColumn = Math.min(metrics.columns - 1, Math.floor(Math.max(0, selectionRight - metrics.paddingLeft - 1) / metrics.cellStrideX));
      const startRow = Math.max(0, Math.floor((this.selectionRect.top - metrics.paddingTop) / metrics.cellStrideY));
      const endRow = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Math.max(0, selectionBottom - metrics.paddingTop - 1) / metrics.cellStrideY));

      for (let row = startRow; row <= endRow; row++) {
        for (let column = startColumn; column <= endColumn; column++) {
          const index = row * metrics.columns + column;
          const entry = this.entries[index];
          if (entry && entry.path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) {
            selectionPaths.add(entry.path);
          }
        }
      }
    } else {
      const containerRect = this.marqueeContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
      const items = this.marqueeContainer.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.grid-item[data-path]');

      for (const item of Array.from(items)) {
        const path = item.dataset['path'];
        if (!path || path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) continue;

        const itemRect = item.getBoundingClientRect();
        const itemLeft = itemRect.left - containerRect.left + this.marqueeContainer.scrollLeft;
        const itemTop = itemRect.top - containerRect.top + this.marqueeContainer.scrollTop;
        
        const intersects =
          itemLeft < this.selectionRect.left + this.selectionRect.width &&
          itemLeft + itemRect.width > this.selectionRect.left &&
          itemTop < this.selectionRect.top + this.selectionRect.height &&
          itemTop + itemRect.height > this.selectionRect.top;

        if (intersects) {
          selectionPaths.add(path);
        }
      }
    }

    if (this.marqueeAppend) {
      for (const path of this.selectedFiles) {
        if (path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) {
          selectionPaths.add(path);
        }
      }
    }

    const selectedEntries = this.entries.filter(entry => selectionPaths.has(entry.path));
    this.selectionChange.emit(selectedEntries);
  }

  private getGridMarqueeMetrics(): { columns: number; paddingLeft: number; paddingTop: number; cellStrideX: number; cellStrideY: number } | null {
    const host = this.gridContainerRef?.nativeElement;
    if (!host) return null;

    const columns = Math.max(1, this.cachedVirtualColumns);
    const style = getComputedStyle(host);
    const paddingLeft = parseFloat(style.paddingLeft || '0') || 0;
    const paddingRight = parseFloat(style.paddingRight || '0') || 0;
    const paddingTop = parseFloat(style.paddingTop || '0') || 0;
    const columnGap = parseFloat(style.columnGap || style.gap || '0') || 0;
    const rowGap = parseFloat(style.rowGap || style.gap || '0') || 0;
    const contentWidth = Math.max(1, host.clientWidth - paddingLeft - paddingRight);
    const cellWidth = Math.max(1, (contentWidth - columnGap * (columns - 1)) / columns);

    return {
      columns,
      paddingLeft,
      paddingTop,
      cellStrideX: cellWidth + columnGap,
      cellStrideY: this.rowHeight + rowGap,
    };
  }

  private finishMarqueeSelection(): void {
    this.detachMarqueeListeners();
    this.marqueeContainer = null;
    this.selectionMode = 'none';
    this.marqueeButton = null;
    this.hasMarqueeMoved = false;
    this.pendingClearOnMove = false;
    this.paintedPaths.clear();
    this.selectionRect = {
      active: false,
      left: 0,
      top: 0,
      width: 0,
      height: 0,
    };
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private detachMarqueeListeners(): void {
    if (this.windowMouseMove) {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', this.windowMouseMove);
      this.windowMouseMove = undefined;
    }
    if (this.windowMouseUp) {
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', this.windowMouseUp);
      this.windowMouseUp = undefined;
    }
    if (this.windowContextMenu) {
      window.removeEventListener('contextmenu', this.windowContextMenu, true);
      this.windowContextMenu = undefined;
    }
  }

  private getRelativePoint(event: MouseEvent, container: HTMLElement): { x: number; y: number } {
    const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    return {
      x: event.clientX - rect.left + container.scrollLeft,
      y: event.clientY - rect.top + container.scrollTop,
    };
  }

  private toggleSelection(entry: FileInfo): void {
    this.selectionChange.emit(this.buildToggledSelection(entry));
  }

  private rangeSelect(entry: FileInfo): FileInfo[] {
    const selectable = this.entries.filter(e => !this.isParentEntry(e));
    const startIdx = selectable.findIndex(e => e.path === this.anchorPath);
    const endIdx = selectable.findIndex(e => e.path === entry.path);
    const [min, max] = [Math.min(startIdx, endIdx), Math.max(startIdx, endIdx)];

    if (startIdx === -1 || endIdx === -1) {
      return [entry];
    }

    const range: FileInfo[] = [];
    for (let i = min; i <= max; i++) {
      if (!this.isParentEntry(selectable[i])) {
        range.push(selectable[i]);
      }
    }
    return range;
  }

  onDragStart(event: DragEvent, entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (event.button !== 0) {
      event.preventDefault();
      return;
    }

    if (this.selectionMode !== 'none') {
      event.preventDefault();
      return;
    }

    if (this.isParentEntry(entry)) {
      event.preventDefault();
      return;
    }

    let entries: FileInfo[];
    if (this.isSelected(entry)) {
      entries = this.entries.filter(e => this.selectedFiles.has(e.path) && !this.isParentEntry(e));
    } else {
      // TC: dragging unselected file → replace selection with only this file
      entries = [entry];
      this.selectionChange.emit([entry]);
      this.setCursor(entry.path);
    }

    const draggingPaths = entries.map(e => e.path);

    // Snapshot positions before we hide/remove source tiles, so the remaining tiles can FLIP-animate into place.
    const reflowBefore = this.captureGridItemRects();

    if (event.dataTransfer) {
      event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'copyMove';
      event.dataTransfer.setData('application/json', JSON.stringify({
        source: 'grid',
        entries: entries.map(e => ({ path: e.path, type: e.type, name: e.name })),
      }));

      // Ensure we don't leak an old drag image node.
      this.cleanupDragImage();

      const tileEl = event.currentTarget as HTMLElement;
      const tileRect = tileEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      const ghost = tileEl.cloneNode(true) as HTMLElement;
      ghost.style.position = 'fixed';
      ghost.style.top = '-1000px';
      ghost.style.left = '0';
      ghost.style.width = `${Math.round(tileRect.width)}px`;
      ghost.style.height = `${Math.round(tileRect.height)}px`;
      ghost.style.margin = '0';
      ghost.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      ghost.style.transform = 'none';
      ghost.style.opacity = '0.98';
      ghost.style.background = 'var(--vsc-editor-background)';
      ghost.style.border = '1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-focus-border, #0078d4) 35%, transparent)';
      ghost.style.boxShadow = '0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.28)';
      ghost.style.borderRadius = 'var(--vsc-border-radius)';
      ghost.classList.remove('drag-over', 'drag-over-folder', 'drop-target', 'dragging-source');

      if (entries.length > 1) {
        const badge = document.createElement('div');
        badge.style.cssText = `
          position: absolute;
          top: 6px;
          right: 6px;
          min-width: 18px;
          height: 18px;
          padding: 0 6px;
          border-radius: 9px;
          background: var(--vsc-focus-border, #0078d4);
          color: var(--vsc-editor-background, #1e1e1e);
          font-size: 11px;
          line-height: 18px;
          text-align: center;
          box-sizing: border-box;
          border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-focus-border, #0078d4) 65%, transparent);
          z-index: 20;
        `;
        badge.textContent = `${entries.length}`;
        ghost.appendChild(badge);
      }

      document.body.appendChild(ghost);

      // Force layout/paint before using it as a drag image.
      void ghost.offsetWidth;

      event.dataTransfer.setDragImage(ghost, Math.floor(tileRect.width / 2), Math.floor(tileRect.height / 2));
      // Keep it mounted for the duration of the drag;
      // some environments (incl. embedded WebView) can lose the drag image if removed immediately.
      this.dragImageEl = ghost;
    }

    this.dragPreviewEntry = entries[0] ?? null;
    // Delay hiding the source tiles until after the drag-start snapshot.
    // This also keeps a fallback preview visible if setDragImage is flaky.
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.draggingPaths = new Set(draggingPaths);
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      this.animateGridReflowFrom(reflowBefore);
    }, 0);

    this.dragStart.emit({ event, entries });
  }

  onDragEnd(): void {
    const reflowBefore = this.captureGridItemRects();
    this.dragPreviewEntry = null;
    this.dragOverPath = null;
    this.dragOverPosition = null;
    this.draggingPaths = new Set<string>();
    this.cleanupDragImage();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.animateGridReflowFrom(reflowBefore);
  }

  onDragOver(event: DragEvent, entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (this.isParentEntry(entry)) return;

    const types = event.dataTransfer?.types;
    const hasInternalData = types?.includes('application/json') || false;
    const hasExternalFiles = !hasInternalData && ((types?.includes('Files') || false) || ((event.dataTransfer?.files?.length ?? 0) > 0));

    const rect = (event.currentTarget as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect();
    const xFraction = rect.width > 0 ? (event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width : 0.5;

    event.preventDefault();
    if (event.dataTransfer) {
      event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey ? 'copy' : 'move';
    }

    if (hasExternalFiles) {
      const nextPosition: 'before' | 'after' | 'inside' = entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY
        ? 'inside'
        : (xFraction < 0.5 ? 'before' : 'after');
      if (this.dragOverPath === entry.path && this.dragOverPosition === nextPosition) return;

      const reflowBefore = this.captureGridItemRects();
      this.dragOverPath = entry.path;
      this.dragOverPosition = nextPosition;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      this.animateGridReflowFrom(reflowBefore);
      return;
    }

    let position: 'before' | 'after' | 'inside';
    if (xFraction < 0.3) {
      position = 'before';
    } else if (xFraction > 0.7) {
      position = 'after';
    } else {
      position = entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY ? 'inside' : (xFraction < 0.5 ? 'before' : 'after');
    }

    if (this.dragOverPath === entry.path && this.dragOverPosition === position) return;

    const reflowBefore = this.captureGridItemRects();
    this.dragOverPath = entry.path;
    this.dragOverPosition = position;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.animateGridReflowFrom(reflowBefore);
  }

  onDragLeave(event: DragEvent, entry: FileInfo): void {
    // Intentionally keep current drag-over state here.
    // Clearing on per-tile dragleave causes flicker while moving across child nodes/adjacent tiles.
    // State is cleared on dragend/drop or when leaving the container.
    void event;
    void entry;
  }

  onDrop(event: DragEvent, entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (this.isParentEntry(entry)) return;
    event.preventDefault();

    const types = event.dataTransfer?.types;
    const hasExternalFiles = !(types?.includes('application/json') || false) && ((types?.includes('Files') || false) || ((event.dataTransfer?.files?.length ?? 0) > 0));
    // For external OS drops, don't stopPropagation - let Wails' window handler fire wails:file-drop
    if (hasExternalFiles) {
      this.dragPreviewEntry = null;
      this.dragOverPath = null;
      this.dragOverPosition = null;
      this.draggingPaths = new Set<string>();
      this.cleanupDragImage();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    event.stopPropagation();
    const capturedPosition = this.dragOverPosition;

    const reflowBefore = this.captureGridItemRects();
    this.dragPreviewEntry = null;
    this.dragOverPath = null;
    this.dragOverPosition = null;
    this.draggingPaths = new Set<string>();
    this.cleanupDragImage();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.animateGridReflowFrom(reflowBefore);

    const draggedEntries = this.readDraggedEntries(event);
    if (!draggedEntries.length) return;

    const source = this.buildSourceFromEntries(draggedEntries);
    if (!source.length) return;

    const goInto = capturedPosition === 'inside' && entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY;
    const target = goInto
      ? entry
      : ({ ...entry, path: parentPath(entry.path), type: FileType.DIRECTORY } as FileInfo);

    this.dragDrop.emit({ event, source, target });
  }

  onBackgroundDragOver(event: DragEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    
    if (event.dataTransfer) {
      event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey ? 'copy' : 'move';
    }
    
    this.isBackgroundDropTarget = true;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  onBackgroundDragLeave(event: DragEvent): void {
    const target = event.relatedTarget as HTMLElement;
    const container = this.gridContainerRef?.nativeElement;
    
    if (container && !container.contains(target)) {
      const reflowBefore = this.captureGridItemRects();
      this.dragPreviewEntry = null;
      this.dragOverPath = null;
      this.dragOverPosition = null;
      this.isBackgroundDropTarget = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      this.animateGridReflowFrom(reflowBefore);
    }
  }

  onBackgroundDrop(event: DragEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();

    const types = event.dataTransfer?.types;
    const hasExternalFiles = !(types?.includes('application/json') || false) && ((types?.includes('Files') || false) || ((event.dataTransfer?.files?.length ?? 0) > 0));
    // For external OS drops, don't stopPropagation - let Wails' window handler fire wails:file-drop
    if (hasExternalFiles) {
      this.dragPreviewEntry = null;
      this.dragOverPath = null;
      this.dragOverPosition = null;
      this.isBackgroundDropTarget = false;
      this.draggingPaths = new Set<string>();
      this.cleanupDragImage();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    event.stopPropagation();

    const reflowBefore = this.captureGridItemRects();
    this.dragPreviewEntry = null;
    this.dragOverPath = null;
    this.dragOverPosition = null;
    this.isBackgroundDropTarget = false;
    this.draggingPaths = new Set<string>();
    this.cleanupDragImage();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.animateGridReflowFrom(reflowBefore);

    // Internal drag and drop to current directory
    const draggedEntries = this.readDraggedEntries(event);
    if (!draggedEntries.length) return;

    const source = this.buildSourceFromEntries(draggedEntries);
    if (!source.length) return;

    const currentDir = this.entries.length > 0 && !this.isParentEntry(this.entries[0])
      ? parentPath(this.entries[0].path)
      : '';
    
    const target: FileInfo = {
      name: '',
      path: currentDir,
      type: FileType.DIRECTORY,
      size: 0,
      created: 0,
      modified: 0,
      accessed: 0,
      permissions: '',
      isHidden: false,
    };

    this.dragDrop.emit({ event, source, target });
  }

  private buildToggledSelection(entry: FileInfo): FileInfo[] {
    const selected = new Set(this.selectedFiles);
    if (selected.has(entry.path)) {
      selected.delete(entry.path);
    } else {
      selected.add(entry.path);
    }
    return this.entries.filter(e => selected.has(e.path) && !this.isParentEntry(e));
  }

  /** Build source entries; uses pane entries for same-pane drag or constructs minimal FileInfo for cross-pane drags. */
  private buildSourceFromEntries(dragged: { path: string; type: FileType; name: string }[]): FileInfo[] {
    const pathSet = new Set(dragged.map(d => d.path));
    const fromEntries = this.entries.filter(e => pathSet.has(e.path) && !this.isParentEntry(e));
    if (fromEntries.length > 0) return fromEntries;
    return dragged.filter(d => d.path && d.path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH).map(d => ({
      name: d.name,
      path: d.path,
      type: d.type,
      size: 0,
      created: 0,
      modified: 0,
      accessed: 0,
      permissions: '',
      isHidden: false,
    } as FileInfo));
  }

  private readDraggedEntries(event: DragEvent): { path: string; type: FileType; name: string }[] {
    try {
      const payload = event.dataTransfer?.getData('application/json');
      if (!payload) return [];
      const parsed = JSON.parse(payload);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed?.entries)) return parsed.entries;
      if (Array.isArray(parsed?.paths)) return parsed.paths.map((p: string) => ({ path: p, type: FileType.FILE, name: p.split(/[\/\\]/).pop() || p }));
      return [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }


  private extractExternalPaths(event: DragEvent): string[] {
    const dataTransfer = event.dataTransfer;
    if (!dataTransfer) return [];

    const paths = new Set<string>();

    const files = dataTransfer.files;
    for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
      const file = files[i];
      const filePath = (file as any).path as string | undefined;
      if (filePath) {
        paths.add(filePath);
      }
    }

    const uriPayload = dataTransfer.getData('text/uri-list') || dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
    if (uriPayload) {
      for (const rawLine of uriPayload.split(/\r?\n/)) {
        const line = rawLine.trim();
        if (!line || line.startsWith('#')) continue;
        const parsedPath = this.fileUriToPath(line);
        if (parsedPath) paths.add(parsedPath);
      }
    }

    return Array.from(paths);
  }

  private fileUriToPath(value: string): string | null {
    if (!value) return null;
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    if (!/^file:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) {
      if (/^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]/.test(trimmed)) return trimmed;
      if (/^\\\\/.test(trimmed)) return trimmed;
      if (trimmed.startsWith('/')) return trimmed;
      return null;
    }

    try {
      let decoded = decodeURIComponent(trimmed).replace(/^file:\/\//i, '');

      if (/^\/[A-Za-z]:\//.test(decoded)) {
        decoded = decoded.slice(1);
      }

      if (/^[A-Za-z]:\//.test(decoded)) {
        return decoded.replace(/\//g, '\\');
      }

      if (!decoded.startsWith('/')) {
        return ('//' + decoded).replace(/\//g, '\\');
      }

      return decoded;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  formatSize(bytes: number): string {
    if (bytes === 0) return '';
    const k = 1024;
    const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
    return `${parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(1))} ${sizes[i]}`;
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';

import { FilePaneNavigationController } from './file-pane-navigation.controller';

function remoteHost(options?: { mounted?: boolean; mountedRoot?: string | null }) {
  const promptForRemoteMount = fn(async () => options?.mountedRoot ?? null);
  return {
    apiService: {
      remoteListConnections: fn(async () => options?.mounted
        ? [{ protocol: 'gdrive', publicPath: 'gdrive://work' }]
        : []),
    },
    promptForRemoteMount,
  } as any;
}

describe('FilePaneNavigationController remote restore policy', () => {
  it('does not prompt for an unavailable cloud mount during non-interactive startup restore', async () => {
    const controller = new FilePaneNavigationController();
    const host = remoteHost();

    const resolved = await (controller as any).resolveRemotePathForLoad(
      host,
      'gdrive://work/Projects',
    );

    expect(resolved).toBeNull();
````

## File: frontend/src/app/components/file-pane-surface-context.factory.ts
````typescript
import type { ViewerArchiveContext } from '../viewers/viewer-archive-context';
import type { DirSurfaceVm } from '../surfaces/dir/dir-surface.vm';
import type {
  DirSurfaceContext,
  SearchResultsSurfaceContext,
  SizeManagerSurfaceContext,
  SurfaceContext,
  ViewerSurfaceContext,
} from '../surfaces/surface-context';
import type { SizeManagerSurfaceVm } from '../surfaces/size-manager/size-manager-surface.vm';
import type { TabInfo } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import { tabSurfaceId } from '../surfaces/tab-surface';

export interface FilePaneSurfaceContextSource {
  get paneId(): 'left' | 'right';
  get currentTabId(): string;
  get tabs(): TabInfo[];
  dirVm: DirSurfaceVm;
  sizeManagerVm: SizeManagerSurfaceVm | null;
}

export class FilePaneSurfaceContextFactory {
  getActiveTab(source: FilePaneSurfaceContextSource): TabInfo | undefined {
    return source.tabs.find((tab) => tab.id === source.currentTabId);
  }

  getSurfaceContextForTab(source: FilePaneSurfaceContextSource, tab: TabInfo): SurfaceContext {
    const surfaceId = tabSurfaceId(tab);

    if (surfaceId === 'size-manager' && source.sizeManagerVm) {
      return {
        paneId: source.paneId,
        surfaceId: 'size-manager',
        kind: 'size-manager',
        tab,
        sizeVm: source.sizeManagerVm,
      } satisfies SizeManagerSurfaceContext;
    }

    if (surfaceId === 'viewer') {
      return {
        paneId: source.paneId,
        surfaceId: 'viewer',
        kind: 'viewer',
        tab,
        viewer: {
          targetPath: tab.viewer?.targetPath ?? '',
          fileList: tab.viewer?.fileList ?? [],
          archiveContext: (tab.viewer?.archiveContext as ViewerArchiveContext) ?? null,
          viewerId: tab.viewer?.viewerId ?? null,
        },
      } satisfies ViewerSurfaceContext;
    }

    if (surfaceId === 'search-results') {
      return {
        paneId: source.paneId,
        surfaceId: 'search-results',
        kind: 'search-results',
        tab,
        dirVm: source.dirVm,
      } satisfies SearchResultsSurfaceContext;
    }

    if (surfaceId === 'dir') {
      return {
        paneId: source.paneId,
        surfaceId: 'dir',
        kind: 'dir',
        tab,
        dirVm: source.dirVm,
      } satisfies DirSurfaceContext;
    }

    // Foreign/tool surfaces receive the stable common context. Their Angular
    // component owns any additional runtime state and may inject its services.
    return {
      paneId: source.paneId,
      surfaceId,
      tab,
    };
  }

  getActiveViewerTargetPath(source: FilePaneSurfaceContextSource): string {
    const tab = this.getActiveTab(source);
    if (!tab || tabSurfaceId(tab) !== 'viewer') return '';
    return tab.viewer?.targetPath ?? '';
  }

  getActiveViewerId(source: FilePaneSurfaceContextSource): string | null {
    const tab = this.getActiveTab(source);
    if (!tab || tabSurfaceId(tab) !== 'viewer') return null;
    return tab.viewer?.viewerId ?? null;
  }

  getActiveViewerFileList(source: FilePaneSurfaceContextSource) {
    const tab = this.getActiveTab(source);
    if (!tab || tabSurfaceId(tab) !== 'viewer') return [];
    return tab.viewer?.fileList ?? [];
  }

  getActiveViewerArchiveContext(source: FilePaneSurfaceContextSource): ViewerArchiveContext | null {
    const tab = this.getActiveTab(source);
    if (!tab || tabSurfaceId(tab) !== 'viewer') return null;
    return (tab.viewer?.archiveContext as ViewerArchiveContext) ?? null;
  }

  createSurfaceContext(source: FilePaneSurfaceContextSource): SurfaceContext | null {
    const tab = this.getActiveTab(source);
    return tab ? this.getSurfaceContextForTab(source, tab) : null;
  }
}
````

````typescript
export class FileViewContainerComponent implements OnChanges, OnDestroy, AfterViewInit {
  readonly minBrowserPaneSplit = 20;
  readonly maxBrowserPaneSplit = 72;
  readonly defaultBrowserPaneSplit = 42;
  readonly browserPaneSnapPoints = [25, 42, 60];

  @ViewChild(FileListComponent) listComponent?: FileListComponent;
  @ViewChild(FileGridComponent) gridComponent?: FileGridComponent;
  @ViewChild(FileDetailsComponent) detailsComponent?: FileDetailsComponent;

  cachedBrowserPath = '';
  cachedShowBrowserPane = false;
  browserPaneSplit = this.defaultBrowserPaneSplit;

  @Input() surfaceId = '';
  @Input() surfaceActive = true;
  @Input() browserPath = '';
  @Input() persistedBrowserPaneSplit: number | null = null;

  @Input() showHidden    = false;
  @Input() entries: FileInfo[] = [];
  @Input() currentPath = '';
  @Input() selectedFiles: Set<string> = new Set();
  @Input() cursorPath: string | null = null;
  @Input() error: string | null = null;
  @Input() currentView: ViewLayout = 'list';
  @Input() singleClickToOpen = false;
  @Input() sortField     = 'name';
  @Input() sortDirection: 'asc' | 'desc' = 'asc';
  @Input() directoriesFirst = true;
  @Input() colorizeByMime = false;
  @Input() paneActive = true;

  @Output() viewChange      = new EventEmitter<ViewLayout>();
  @Output() selectionChange = new EventEmitter<FileInfo[]>();
  @Output() navigate        = new EventEmitter<FileInfo>();
  @Output() openInNewTab    = new EventEmitter<FileInfo>();
  @Output() sortChange      = new EventEmitter<{ field: string; direction: 'asc' | 'desc' }>();
  @Output() contextMenu     = new EventEmitter<{ event: MouseEvent; entry: FileInfo }>();
  @Output() backgroundContextMenu = new EventEmitter<MouseEvent>();
  @Output() nodeDoubleClick = new EventEmitter<FileInfo>();
  @Output() dragStart       = new EventEmitter<{ event: DragEvent; entries: FileInfo[] }>();
  @Output() dragDrop        = new EventEmitter<{ event: DragEvent; source: FileInfo[]; targetPath: string }>();
  @Output() rename          = new EventEmitter<{ entry: FileInfo; newName: string }>();
  @Output() browserPaneSplitChange = new EventEmitter<number>();

  sortedEntries: FileInfo[] = [];
  treeNodes: TreeNode[] = [];
  private loadRequest$ = createSubject<TreeNode>();
  private destroy$     = createSubject<void>();
  pendingDirectorySizePaths: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<string>();
  private lastTreeRefreshPath: string | null = null;
  private loadedBrowserPaneStorageKey: string | null = null;
  private readonly eventsController = new FileViewEventsController();
  private readonly interactionController = new FileViewInteractionController();
  private readonly lifecycleController = new FileViewLifecycleController();
  private readonly treeController = new FileViewTreeController();
  private readonly runtimeController = new FileViewRuntimeController();
  private readonly sortController = new FileViewSortController();

  getSortedEntries(): FileInfo[] {
    return this.sortedEntries;
  }

  constructor(
    private apiService: ApiService,
    private directorySource: DirectorySourceService,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {
    this.loadRequest$
      .pipe(
        mergeMap(node => fromPromise(this.treeController.ensureNodeChildrenLoaded(this.treeHost, node))),
        takeUntil(this.destroy$)
      )
      .subscribe();
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private get treeHost(): FileViewTreeHost {
    const thisRef = this;
    return {
      get currentPath() { return thisRef.currentPath; },
      get currentView() { return thisRef.currentView; },
      get showHidden() { return thisRef.showHidden; },
      get entries() { return thisRef.entries; },
      get treeNodes() { return thisRef.treeNodes; },
      set treeNodes(value: TreeNode[]) { thisRef.treeNodes = value; },
      directorySource: this.directorySource,
      markForCheck: () => thisRef.cdr.markForCheck(),
      sortTreeNodes: (nodes: TreeNode[]) => thisRef.sortTreeNodes(nodes),
      expandTreeNode: (path: string) => thisRef.treeComponent?.expandNode(path),
      centerTreeNode: (path: string) => thisRef.treeComponent?.centerNode(path),
    };
  }

  private get eventsHost(): FileViewEventsHost {
    const thisRef = this;
    return {
      selectionChange: this.selectionChange,
      navigate: this.navigate,
      openInNewTab: this.openInNewTab,
      contextMenu: this.contextMenu,
      nodeDoubleClick: this.nodeDoubleClick,
      rename: this.rename,
      setSelectedPaths: (paths: string[]) => {
        thisRef.selectedFiles = new Set(paths);
      },
      setCursorPath: (path: string | null) => {
        thisRef.cursorPath = path;
      },
    };
  }

  private get interactionHost(): FileViewInteractionHost {
    const thisRef = this;
    return {
      get paneId() { return thisRef.paneId; },
      get currentPath() { return thisRef.currentPath; },
      get currentView() { return thisRef.currentView; },
      set currentView(value: ViewLayout) { thisRef.currentView = value; },
      dragStart: this.dragStart,
      dragDrop: this.dragDrop,
      viewChange: this.viewChange,
      persistViewMode: (_view: ViewLayout) => {
        // Per-tab view persistence is handled by file-pane-ui.controller via
        // the per-tab DirTabState; the global localStorage default is no
        // longer rewritten on every per-tab change.
      },
      syncTreeToCurrentPath: () => {
        thisRef.treeController.buildTreeNodes(thisRef.treeHost);
        void thisRef.treeController.syncToCurrentPath(thisRef.treeHost);
      },
      enqueueTreeLoad: (node: TreeNode) => {
        thisRef.loadRequest$.next(node);
      },
    };
  }

  private get lifecycleHost(): FileViewLifecycleHost {
    const thisRef = this;
    return {
      get currentView() { return thisRef.currentView; },
      sortEntries: () => {
        thisRef.sortController.sortEntries(thisRef.sortHost, PARENT_ENTRY_PATH);
      },
      syncTreeToCurrentPath: () => {
        thisRef.lastTreeRefreshPath = thisRef.currentPath;
        thisRef.treeController.buildTreeNodes(thisRef.treeHost);
        void thisRef.treeController.syncToCurrentPath(thisRef.treeHost);
      },
      refreshCurrentTreePath: () => {
        const targetPath = thisRef.currentPath;
        if (!targetPath || thisRef.lastTreeRefreshPath === targetPath) {
          return;
        }
        thisRef.lastTreeRefreshPath = targetPath;
        thisRef.treeController.refreshTreeNode(thisRef.treeHost, targetPath);
      },
      resortTreeNodes: () => {
        thisRef.sortController.resortAllLoadedTreeNodes(thisRef.sortHost, thisRef.treeNodes);
      },
      markTreeNodesChanged: () => {
        thisRef.treeNodes = [...thisRef.treeNodes];
      },
      markForCheck: () => thisRef.cdr.markForCheck(),
    };
  }

  private get runtimeHost(): FileViewRuntimeHost {
    const thisRef = this;
    return {
      get currentView() { return thisRef.currentView; },
      get sortedEntries() { return thisRef.sortedEntries; },
      getVisibleTreeNodes: () => thisRef.getVisibleTreeNodes(),
      startRenameInList: () => thisRef.listComponent?.startRenameSelected(),
      startRenameInGrid: () => thisRef.gridComponent?.startRenameSelected(),
      startRenameInDetails: () => thisRef.detailsComponent?.startRenameSelected(),
      startRenameInTree: () => {
        try {
          (thisRef.treeComponent as any)?.startRenameFocused?.();
        } catch {
          // ignore
        }
      },
      startRenamePathInList: (path: string) => thisRef.listComponent?.startRenamePath(path),
      startRenamePathInGrid: (path: string) => thisRef.gridComponent?.startRenamePath(path),
      startRenamePathInDetails: (path: string) => thisRef.detailsComponent?.startRenamePath(path),
      startRenamePathInTree: (path: string) => thisRef.treeComponent?.startRenamePath(path),
      scrollListToPath: (path: string) => thisRef.listComponent?.scrollToPath(path),
      scrollDetailsToPath: (path: string) => thisRef.detailsComponent?.scrollToPath(path),
      scrollGridToPath: (path: string) => thisRef.gridComponent?.scrollToPath(path),
      focusTreeNode: (path: string) => thisRef.focusTreeNode(path),
      getListApproxPageSize: () => thisRef.listComponent?.getApproxPageSize() ?? 10,
      getDetailsApproxPageSize: () => thisRef.detailsComponent?.getApproxPageSize() ?? 10,
      getGridApproxPageSize: () => thisRef.gridComponent?.getApproxPageSize() ?? 5,
      getGridColumns: () => thisRef.gridComponent?.getColumns() ?? 1,
    };
  }

  private get sortHost(): FileViewSortHost {
    const thisRef = this;
    return {
      get entries() { return thisRef.entries; },
      get sortField() { return thisRef.sortField; },
      get sortDirection() { return thisRef.sortDirection; },
      get directoriesFirst() { return thisRef.directoriesFirst; },
      setSortedEntries: (entries: FileInfo[]) => {
        thisRef.sortedEntries = entries;
      },
    };
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    this.ensureBrowserPaneSplitLoaded();
    if (changes['persistedBrowserPaneSplit']) {
      const persisted = changes['persistedBrowserPaneSplit'].currentValue;
      if (typeof persisted === 'number' && Number.isFinite(persisted)) {
        this.browserPaneSplit = this.clampBrowserPaneSplit(persisted);
      } else {
        this.browserPaneSplit = this.readBrowserPaneSplit(this.getBrowserPaneStorageKey());
      }
    }

    if (changes['currentPath'] || changes['browserPath'] || changes['surfaceActive']) {
      this.cachedBrowserPath = this.resolveSurfaceBrowserPath();
      this.cachedShowBrowserPane = this.isWebBrowserPath(this.cachedBrowserPath);
    }
    if (changes['entries']) {
      this.lastTreeRefreshPath = null;
    }
    this.lifecycleController.onChanges(this.lifecycleHost, changes);
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
    this.treeController.reset();
  }

  // ── Tree specific handlers ─────────────────────────────────

  onTreeSelectionChange(nodes: TreeNode[]): void {
    this.eventsController.onTreeSelectionChange(this.eventsHost, nodes);
  }

  onTreeInlineSize(node: TreeNode): void {
    void this.calculateDirectorySize(node.path);
  }

  onTreeContextMenu(event: { event: MouseEvent; node: TreeNode }): void {
    this.eventsController.onTreeContextMenu(this.eventsHost, event);
  }

  onBackgroundContextMenu(event: MouseEvent): void {
    this.backgroundContextMenu.emit(event);
  }

  onTreeDragStart(event: { event: DragEvent; nodes: TreeNode[] }): void {
    this.interactionController.onTreeDragStart(

  onTreeRename(event: { node: TreeNode; newName: string }): void {

  /** Trigger in-place rename for the currently selected item in the active view (eg. on F2). */
  startRenameSelected(): void {
    this.runtimeController.startRenameSelected(this.runtimeHost);
  }

  startRenamePath(path: string): void {
    this.runtimeController.startRenamePath(this.runtimeHost, path);
  }

  setPendingRenameDisplayName(path: string, displayName: string | null): void {
    switch (this.currentView) {
      case 'list':
        this.listComponent?.setPendingRenameDisplayName(path, displayName);
        return;
      case 'grid':
        this.gridComponent?.setPendingRenameDisplayName(path, displayName);
        return;
      case 'details':

      case 'tree':
        this.treeComponent?.setPendingRenameDisplayName(path, displayName);

  hasPendingTreeRename(): boolean {

  }

  refreshTreeNode(path: string): void {
    if (!path) return;
    this.treeController.refreshTreeNode(this.treeHost, path);
  }

  scrollToCursorPath(path: string): void {
    this.runtimeController.scrollToCursorPath(this.runtimeHost, path);
  }

  getScrollTop(): number {
    switch (this.currentView) {
      case 'list':
        return this.listComponent?.getScrollTop() ?? 0;
      case 'grid':
        return this.gridComponent?.getScrollTop() ?? 0;
      case 'details':
        return this.detailsComponent?.getScrollTop() ?? 0;
      case 'tree':
        return this.treeComponent?.getScrollTop() ?? 0;
      default:
        return 0;
    }
  }

  setScrollTop(top: number): void {
    switch (this.currentView) {
      case 'list':
        this.listComponent?.setScrollTop(top);
        return;
      case 'grid':
        this.gridComponent?.setScrollTop(top);

      case 'details':

  suppressNextTreeAutoExpand(): void {
    this.treeComponent?.suppressNextAutoExpandToCurrentPath();
  }

  async calculateDirectorySize(path: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!path || path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) return;
    if (this.pendingDirectorySizePaths.has(path)) return;

    const entry = this.entries.find(candidate => candidate.path === path);
    if (!entry || entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) return;

    this.setDirectorySizePending(path, true);
    try {
      const size = await this.apiService.dirSizeRecursive(path);
      this.applyDirectorySize(path, size);
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('Failed to calculate directory size inline:', path, error);
    } finally {
      this.setDirectorySizePending(path, false);
    }
  }

    try {
      this.treeComponent?.focusNode(path);
    } catch {
      // best-effort only
    }

  getApproxPageSize(): number {
    return this.runtimeController.getApproxPageSize(this.runtimeHost);
  }

  /** Number of columns in grid view (1 for all other views). */
  getGridColumns(): number {
    return this.runtimeController.getGridColumns(this.runtimeHost);
  }

    this.eventsController.onTreeOpenInNewTab(this.eventsHost, node);
  }

  onLoadChildren(node: TreeNode): void {
    this.interactionController.onLoadChildren(this.interactionHost, node);
  }

  // ── View / sort ────────────────────────────────────────────

  onViewChange(view: ViewLayout): void {
    this.interactionController.onViewChange(this.interactionHost, view);
  }

  onSortChange(sort: { field: string; direction: 'asc' | 'desc' }): void {
    this.sortField     = sort.field;
    this.sortDirection = sort.direction;
    this.sortChange.emit(sort);
    this.sortController.sortEntries(this.sortHost, PARENT_ENTRY_PATH);
  }

  // ── Event passthrough ──────────────────────────────────────

  onSelectionChange(entries: FileInfo[]): void {
    this.eventsController.onSelectionChange(this.eventsHost, entries);
  }

  onNavigate(entry: FileInfo | TreeNode | Event): void {
    this.eventsController.onNavigate(this.eventsHost, entry);
  }

  onContextMenu(event: { event: MouseEvent; entry: FileInfo }): void {
    this.eventsController.onContextMenu(this.eventsHost, event);
  }

  onOpenInNewTab(entry: FileInfo): void {
    this.eventsController.onOpenInNewTab(this.eventsHost, entry);
  }

  onTreeNodeDoubleClick(node: TreeNode): void {
    this.eventsController.onTreeNodeDoubleClick(this.eventsHost, node);
  }

  onTreeToggleExpand(_node: TreeNode): void {
    // Tree manages expansion state internally
  }

  // ── Sorting ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private sortTreeNodes(nodes: TreeNode[]): TreeNode[] {
    return this.sortController.sortTreeNodes(this.sortHost, nodes);
  }

  private setDirectorySizePending(path: string, pending: boolean): void {
    const next = new Set(this.pendingDirectorySizePaths);
    if (pending) {
      next.add(path);
    } else {
      next.delete(path);
    }
    this.pendingDirectorySizePaths = next;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private applyDirectorySize(path: string, size: number): void {
    const entry = this.entries.find(candidate => candidate.path === path);
    if (entry) {
      entry.size = size;
    }

    const sortedEntry = this.sortedEntries.find(candidate => candidate.path === path);
    if (sortedEntry && sortedEntry !== entry) {
      sortedEntry.size = size;
    }

    const treeNode = this.findTreeNodeByPath(this.treeNodes, path);
    if (treeNode) {
      treeNode.size = size;
    }

    if (this.sortField === 'size') {
      this.sortController.sortEntries(this.sortHost, PARENT_ENTRY_PATH);
      this.sortController.resortAllLoadedTreeNodes(this.sortHost, this.treeNodes);
    } else {
      this.sortedEntries = [...this.sortedEntries];
    }

    this.treeNodes = [...this.treeNodes];
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private findTreeNodeByPath(nodes: TreeNode[], path: string): TreeNode | undefined {
    for (const node of nodes) {
      if (node.path === path) return node;
      const childNodes = node.children;
      if (!childNodes?.length) continue;
      const match = this.findTreeNodeByPath(childNodes, path);
      if (match) return match;
    }

    return undefined;
  }

  private isWebBrowserPath(path: string): boolean {
    const trimmed = (path ?? '').trim();
    if (!trimmed) return false;

    try {
      const parsed = new URL(trimmed);
      return (parsed.protocol === 'http:' || parsed.protocol === 'https:') && parsed.host.length > 0;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  private resolveSurfaceBrowserPath(): string {
    if (this.surfaceActive) {
      return this.currentPath || this.browserPath;
    }

    return this.browserPath || this.currentPath;
  }

  getBrowserPath(): string {
    return this.cachedBrowserPath;
  }

  showBrowserPane(): boolean {
    return this.cachedShowBrowserPane;
  }

  onBrowserPaneSplitChange(position: number): void {
    const next = this.clampBrowserPaneSplit(position);
    if (next === this.browserPaneSplit) {
      return;
    }

    this.browserPaneSplit = next;
    this.persistBrowserPaneSplit();
    this.browserPaneSplitChange.emit(next);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private ensureBrowserPaneSplitLoaded(): void {
    const storageKey = this.getBrowserPaneStorageKey();
    if (this.loadedBrowserPaneStorageKey === storageKey) {
      return;
    }

    this.loadedBrowserPaneStorageKey = storageKey;
    this.browserPaneSplit = this.readBrowserPaneSplit(storageKey);
  }

  private getBrowserPaneStorageKey(): string {
    return `fileManager_browserPaneSplit:${this.paneId}`;
  }

  private readBrowserPaneSplit(storageKey: string): number {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
      if (!raw) {
        return this.defaultBrowserPaneSplit;
      }

      const parsed = Number.parseFloat(raw);
      if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) {
        return this.defaultBrowserPaneSplit;
      }

      return this.clampBrowserPaneSplit(parsed);
    } catch {
      return this.defaultBrowserPaneSplit;
    }
  }

  private persistBrowserPaneSplit(): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(this.getBrowserPaneStorageKey(), this.browserPaneSplit.toString());
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage failures; the split still works for the current session.
    }
  }

  private clampBrowserPaneSplit(value: number): number {
    return Math.max(this.minBrowserPaneSplit, Math.min(this.maxBrowserPaneSplit, value));
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { ScopedPluginRegistry } from './scoped-plugin-registry';
import type { PluginRegistryAPI } from './plugin-registry-api';

function host(): PluginRegistryAPI {
  return {
    registerInput: fn(), unregisterInput: fn(),
    registerCommand: fn(), unregisterCommand: fn(),
    registerViewer: fn(), unregisterViewer: fn(),
    registerSurface: fn(), unregisterSurface: fn(),
    registerToolbarAction: fn(), unregisterToolbarAction: fn(),
    registerContextMenuItem: fn(), unregisterContextMenuItem: fn(),
    registerFileCategory: fn(), unregisterFileCategory: fn(),
    registerRelatedLocation: fn(), unregisterRelatedLocation: fn(),
  };
}

describe('ScopedPluginRegistry', () => {
  it('automatically unwinds registered contributions', () => {
    const target = host();
    const scope = new ScopedPluginRegistry('demo', target, new Set(['commands', 'toolbar']));
    scope.registerCommand({ id: 'plugin.demo.run', title: 'Run', execute: () => undefined });
    scope.registerToolbarAction({ id: 'run', commandId: 'plugin.demo.run', score: () => 1 });

    scope.dispose();

    expect(target.unregisterToolbarAction).toHaveBeenCalledWith('run');
    expect(target.unregisterCommand).toHaveBeenCalledWith('plugin.demo.run');
  });

  it('blocks undeclared contribution permissions', () => {
    const scope = new ScopedPluginRegistry('demo', host(), new Set(['commands']));
    expect(() => scope.registerToolbarAction({ id: 'run', score: () => 1 })).toThrow('toolbar');
  });

  it('owns related-location contributions and requires explicit permission', () => {
    const target = host();
    const scope = new ScopedPluginRegistry('demo', target, new Set(['relatedLocations']));
    scope.registerRelatedLocation({ id: 'demo.related', score: () => 42 });

    scope.dispose();

    expect(target.registerRelatedLocation).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ id: 'demo.related' }));
    expect(target.unregisterRelatedLocation).toHaveBeenCalledWith('demo.related');
  });

  it('blocks related-location contributions without permission', () => {
    const scope = new ScopedPluginRegistry('demo', host(), new Set([]));
    expect(() => scope.registerRelatedLocation({ id: 'demo.related', score: () => 1 })).toThrow('relatedLocations');
  });

  it('forces input ownership to the active plugin', () => {
    const target = host();
    const scope = new ScopedPluginRegistry('demo', target, new Set(['commands', 'keybindings']));
    scope.registerInput({ pluginId: 'somebody-else', commands: [], bindings: [] });
    expect(target.registerInput).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ pluginId: 'demo' }));
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';
import { BackendPluginCommandBridgeService, backendPluginCommandId, backendPluginCommandName, parsePluginHotkey } from './backend-plugin-command-bridge.service';

class FakeInputEngine {
  contributions: any[] = [];
  removed: string[] = [];
  registerPluginInput(value: any): void { this.contributions.push(value); }
  unregisterPluginInput(pluginId: string): void { this.removed.push(pluginId); }
}

describe('BackendPluginCommandBridgeService', () => {
  it('parses backend hotkeys into normal input strokes', () => {
    expect(parsePluginHotkey('Ctrl+Alt+H')).toEqual({ key: 'h', modifiers: ['ctrl', 'alt'] });
    expect(parsePluginHotkey('Ctrl K')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('registers backend commands as plugin-owned input contributions', async () => {
    const api = {
      listBackendPlugins: fn().mockResolvedValue([{
        id: 'hash', name: 'Hash Tools', version: '1.0.0',
        commands: [{ id: 'sha256', label: 'SHA-256', hotkey: 'Ctrl+Alt+H', appliesTo: ['file'] }],
      }]),
      invokeBackendPluginCommand: fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
    };
    const input = new FakeInputEngine();
    const bridge = new BackendPluginCommandBridgeService(api as any, input as any);

    await bridge.start(() => ['C:/work/a.txt']);

    expect(input.contributions).toHaveLength(1);
    const contribution = input.contributions[0];
    expect(contribution.pluginId).toBe('backend-plugin:hash');
    expect(contribution.commands[0].id).toBe(backendPluginCommandId('hash', 'sha256'));
    expect(contribution.commands[0].name).toBe(backendPluginCommandName('hash', 'sha256'));
    expect(contribution.commands[0].isEnabled()).toBe(true);
    expect(contribution.bindings[0].source).toBe('plugin');

    await contribution.commands[0].execute();
    expect(api.invokeBackendPluginCommand).toHaveBeenCalledWith('hash', 'sha256', ['C:/work/a.txt']);

    await contribution.commands[0].execute({
      source: 'console',
      args: { paths: ['C:/explicit/b.txt'] },
    });
    expect(api.invokeBackendPluginCommand.calls.mostRecent().args).toEqual(['hash', 'sha256', ['C:/explicit/b.txt']]);
  });

  it('disables path-scoped commands without a selection and cleans up on stop', async () => {
    const api = {
      listBackendPlugins: fn().mockResolvedValue([{
        id: 'images', name: 'Images', version: '1',
        commands: [{ id: 'convert', label: 'Convert', appliesTo: ['.png'] }],
      }]),
      invokeBackendPluginCommand: fn(),
    };
    const input = new FakeInputEngine();
    const bridge = new BackendPluginCommandBridgeService(api as any, input as any);

    await bridge.start(() => []);
    expect(input.contributions[0].commands[0].isEnabled()).toBe(false);

    bridge.stop();
    expect(input.removed).toEqual(['backend-plugin:images']);
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, ChangeDetectorRef, Component, Input, OnChanges } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { ApiService } from '../../services/api.service';
import { ConfirmDialogService } from '../../services/confirm-dialog.service';
import { DuplicateFinderService, DuplicateGroup, DuplicateKeeperPolicy, DuplicateScanProgress, DuplicateScanResult } from '../../services/duplicate-finder.service';
import { WorkspaceService } from '../../services/workspace.service';
import { SelectionBasketService } from '../../services/selection-basket.service';
import { SurfaceContext } from '../surface-context';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-duplicate-finder-surface-tab',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <div class="duplicates">
      <header>
        <div>
          <strong>Duplicate Finder</strong>
          <div class="root" [title]="rootPath">{{ rootPath }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="actions">
          <label>Min size <input type="number" min="0" [(ngModel)]="minSize" [disabled]="scanning"></label>
          <label><input type="checkbox" [(ngModel)]="includeHidden" [disabled]="scanning"> Hidden</label>
          <button (click)="scan()" [disabled]="scanning || !rootPath">{{ scanning ? 'Scanning…' : 'Scan' }}</button>
          <label>Keep
            <select [(ngModel)]="keeperPolicy" [disabled]="scanning" (ngModelChange)="onKeeperPolicyChange()">
              <option value="oldest">Oldest</option>
              <option value="newest">Newest</option>
              <option value="shortest-path">Shortest path</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <label>Sort
            <select [(ngModel)]="sortMode" [disabled]="scanning">
              <option value="wasted">Wasted space</option>
              <option value="copies">Copies</option>
              <option value="size">File size</option>
              <option value="path">Path</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <input class="filter" type="search" placeholder="Filter groups…" [(ngModel)]="filterText" [disabled]="scanning">
          <button (click)="selectSuggested()" [disabled]="!result?.groups?.length || scanning">Select Redundant</button>
          <button (click)="collectSelected()" [disabled]="selected.size === 0 || scanning">Collect {{ selected.size }}</button>
          <button (click)="deleteSelected()" [disabled]="selected.size === 0 || scanning">Delete {{ selected.size }}</button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div class="summary" *ngIf="progress || result">
        <span *ngIf="progress">{{ progress.phase }} · {{ progress.discoveredFiles }} files · {{ progress.hashedFiles }}/{{ progress.candidateFiles }} hashed</span>
        <span *ngIf="result">{{ result.groups.length }} groups · {{ result.scannedFiles }} files · {{ formatSize(result.reclaimableBytes) }} reclaimable</span>
        <span class="warning" *ngIf="result?.truncated">scan limit reached</span>
      </div>

      <div class="empty" *ngIf="!scanning && result && result.groups.length === 0">No verified duplicates found.</div>

      <section class="group" *ngFor="let group of visibleGroups; trackBy: trackGroup">
        <div class="group-head">
          <strong><span class="type">{{ groupIcon(group) }}</span>{{ group.files.length }} copies</strong>
          <span>{{ formatSize(group.size) }} each · {{ formatSize(group.reclaimableBytes) }} reclaimable</span>
          <code>{{ group.hash.slice(0, 12) }}…</code>
        </div>
        <div class="file" *ngFor="let file of group.files">
          <input type="checkbox" [checked]="selected.has(file.path)" [disabled]="file.path === keeperPath(group)" (change)="toggle(file.path)">
          <span class="keeper" *ngIf="file.path === keeperPath(group)">KEEP</span>
          <span class="path" [title]="file.path">{{ file.path }}</span>
          <span class="mtime">{{ file.modified * 1000 | date:'short' }}</span>
          <button (click)="preview(file.path, file.name)">Preview</button>

        <strong>Warnings</strong>
````
