````typescript
export class AddressBarQuickAccessComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy, OnChanges {
  @ViewChild('filterInput') filterInput?: ElementRef<HTMLInputElement>;
  @Input() currentPath = '';
  @Input() currentSurfaceId = 'dir';
  @Input() specialFolders: SpecialFolder[] = [];
  @Input() pinnedLocations: PinnedLocation[] = [];
  @Input() preferredSectionTitle: string | null = null;
  @Output() navigate = new EventEmitter<string>();
  @Output() openPin = new EventEmitter<PinnedLocation>();
  @Output() removePin = new EventEmitter<PinnedLocation>();
  @Output() renamePin = new EventEmitter<PinnedLocation>();
  @Output() closeRequested = new EventEmitter<void>();

  allSections: QuickAccessSection[] = [];
  sections: QuickAccessSection[] = [];
  activeTabIdx = 0;
  filterQuery = '';
  tabSpinDirection: TabSpinDirection = null;
  tabTransitionActive = false;
  animationFromSections: OrderedQuickAccessSection[] = [];
  animationToSections: OrderedQuickAccessSection[] = [];
  highlightedItem: { sectionIdx: number; itemIdx: number } | null = null;
  private tabSpinTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private readonly commandOwner = `overlay.quickAccess:${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
  private releaseOverlayContext: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor(
    private pathHistoryService: PathHistoryService,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private hostEl: ElementRef<HTMLElement>,
    private inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
    private pinnedLocationService: PinnedLocationService,
    private relatedLocations: RelatedLocationService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.registerInputCommands();
    this.releaseOverlayContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('overlay.quickAccess');
    this.buildSections();
    this.focusFilterField();
  }

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['specialFolders'] || changes['pinnedLocations'] || changes['currentPath']) {
      this.buildSections();
    }
    if (changes['preferredSectionTitle'] && !changes['preferredSectionTitle'].firstChange) {
      this.applyPreferredSection();
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    if (this.tabSpinTimer) clearTimeout(this.tabSpinTimer);
    this.releaseOverlayContext?.();
    this.releaseOverlayContext = null;
    this.unregisterInputCommands();
  }

  // no-op if no items
  private buildSections(): void {
    const previousSectionTitle = this.sections[this.activeTabIdx]?.title ?? this.preferredSectionTitle;
    this.allSections = [];

    // System Folders
    if (this.specialFolders.length > 0) {
      this.allSections.push({
        title: 'System',
        items: this.specialFolders.map(f => ({
          name: f.name,
          path: f.path,
          icon: this.resolveQuickAccessIcon(f.icon),
        }))
      });
    }

    const relatedPins = this.relatedLocations.resolve(this.pinnedLocations, this.currentPath, this.currentSurfaceId);

    if (relatedPins.length > 0) {
      this.allSections.push({
        title: 'Related',
        items: relatedPins.map(pin => this.pinItem(pin)),
      });
    }

    this.allSections.push({
      title: 'Pinned',
      items: this.pinnedLocations.map(pin => this.pinItem(pin)),
    });

    // Frequent Folders (top 5 by access count)
    const frequentItems = this.getFrequentLocations(5);
    if (frequentItems.length > 0) {
      this.allSections.push({
        title: 'Frequent',
        items: frequentItems
      });
    }

    // Recent Folders (last 5)
    const recentItems = this.getRecentLocations(5);
    if (recentItems.length > 0) {
      this.allSections.push({
        title: 'Recent',
        items: recentItems
      });
    }

    this.applyFilterQuery(this.filterQuery, previousSectionTitle ?? null);
  }

  private applyPreferredSection(): void {
    const preferred = (this.preferredSectionTitle || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!preferred || this.sections.length === 0) return;

    const preferredIdx = this.sections.findIndex(section => section.title.toLowerCase() === preferred);
    if (preferredIdx >= 0) {
      this.activeTabIdx = preferredIdx;
      this.updateHighlightForNewTab();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  setActiveTab(idx: number): void {
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= this.sections.length) return;
    if (this.activeTabIdx === idx) return;
    const previousIdx = this.activeTabIdx;
    this.animationFromSections = this.orderedSectionsFor(previousIdx);
    this.animationToSections = this.orderedSectionsFor(idx);
    this.activeTabIdx = idx;
    this.startTabSpin(this.getSpinDirection(previousIdx, idx));
    this.updateHighlightForNewTab();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  activeSectionEntry(): OrderedQuickAccessSection | null {
    const section = this.sections[this.activeTabIdx];
    if (!section) return null;
    return { section, originalIndex: this.activeTabIdx };
  }

  trailingSections(): OrderedQuickAccessSection[] {
    return this.trailingSectionsFrom(this.orderedSectionsFor(this.activeTabIdx));
  }

  leadingSection(sections: OrderedQuickAccessSection[]): OrderedQuickAccessSection | null {
    return sections[0] ?? null;
  }

  trailingSectionsFrom(sections: OrderedQuickAccessSection[]): OrderedQuickAccessSection[] {
    return sections.slice(1);
  }

  private orderedSectionsFor(startIdx: number): OrderedQuickAccessSection[] {
    if (this.sections.length === 0) return [];

    const ordered = this.sections.map((section, originalIndex) => ({ section, originalIndex }));
    return ordered.slice(startIdx).concat(ordered.slice(0, startIdx));
  }

  trackByOrderedSection(_index: number, orderedSection: OrderedQuickAccessSection): number {
    return orderedSection.originalIndex;
  }

  private getSpinDirection(_previousIdx: number, _nextIdx: number): TabSpinDirection {
    return 'left';
  }

  private startTabSpin(direction: TabSpinDirection): void {
    if (this.tabSpinTimer) clearTimeout(this.tabSpinTimer);
    this.tabSpinDirection = direction;
    this.tabTransitionActive = true;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.focusFilterField();

    this.tabSpinTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.tabSpinDirection = null;
      this.tabTransitionActive = false;
      this.animationFromSections = [];
      this.animationToSections = [];
      this.tabSpinTimer = null;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      this.focusFilterField();
    }, 260);
  }

  onFilterChange(query: string): void {
    this.applyFilterQuery(query, this.sections[this.activeTabIdx]?.title ?? null);
  }

  clearFilter(): void {
    this.applyFilterQuery('', this.sections[this.activeTabIdx]?.title ?? null);
    this.focusFilterField();
  }

  private focusFilterField(): void {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const input = this.filterInput?.nativeElement;
      if (input) {
        input.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        input.select();
        return;
      }

      const menu = this.hostEl.nativeElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.ab-quick-access-drop');
      menu?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    });
  }

  private applyFilterQuery(query: string, preferredTitle: string | null): void {
    this.filterQuery = query;
    const normalized = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    const nextSections = normalized
      ? this.allSections
          .map(section => ({
            title: section.title,
            items: this.rankItemsForQuery(section.items, normalized),
          }))
          .filter(section => section.items.length > 0)
      : this.allSections.map(section => ({ title: section.title, items: [...section.items] }));

    this.sections = nextSections;

    if (this.sections.length === 0) {
      this.activeTabIdx = 0;
      this.highlightedItem = null;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
      return;
    }

    const preferred = (preferredTitle || this.preferredSectionTitle || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const preferredIdx = preferred
      ? this.sections.findIndex(section => section.title.toLowerCase() === preferred)
      : -1;

    if (preferredIdx >= 0) {
      this.activeTabIdx = preferredIdx;
    } else if (this.activeTabIdx >= this.sections.length) {
      this.activeTabIdx = this.sections.length - 1;
    }

    this.updateHighlightForNewTab();
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private rankItemsForQuery(items: QuickAccessItem[], query: string): QuickAccessItem[] {
    const ranked = items
      .map((item, originalIndex): RankedQuickAccessItem => ({
        item,
        score: this.rankItemForQuery(item, query),
        originalIndex,
      }))
      .filter(entry => entry.score > 0)
      .sort((left, right) => right.score - left.score || left.originalIndex - right.originalIndex);

    return ranked.map(entry => entry.item);
  }

  private rankItemForQuery(item: QuickAccessItem, query: string): number {
    const tokens = query.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (tokens.length === 0) {
      return 1;
    }

    const fields = [
      { text: item.name, weight: 8 },
      { text: item.pin?.label, weight: 7 },
      { text: item.path, weight: 4 },
      { text: item.pin?.location, weight: 3 },
    ];

    let total = 0;
    for (const token of tokens) {
      let bestScore = 0;
      for (const field of fields) {
        bestScore = Math.max(bestScore, this.fuzzyFieldScore(field.text, token, field.weight));
      }

      if (bestScore <= 0) {
        return 0;
      }

      total += bestScore;
    }

    total += Math.min(item.accessCount ?? 0, 25);
    if (item.pin) {
      total += 10;
    }

    return total;
  }

  private fuzzyFieldScore(value: string | undefined, query: string, weight: number): number {
    if (!value) {
      return 0;
    }

    const text = value.toLowerCase();
    if (text === query) {
      return 320 * weight;
    }

    if (text.startsWith(query)) {
      return (220 - Math.min(text.length - query.length, 40)) * weight;
    }

    const containsIndex = text.indexOf(query);
    if (containsIndex >= 0) {
      const boundaryBonus = containsIndex === 0 || this.isBoundaryChar(text[containsIndex - 1]) ? 18 : 0;
      return (150 - Math.min(containsIndex, 40) + boundaryBonus) * weight;
    }

    let queryIndex = 0;
    let score = 0;
    let contiguousRun = 0;

    for (let textIndex = 0; textIndex < text.length && queryIndex < query.length; textIndex++) {
      if (text[textIndex] !== query[queryIndex]) {
        contiguousRun = 0;
        continue;
      }

      const atBoundary = textIndex === 0 || this.isBoundaryChar(text[textIndex - 1]);
      contiguousRun += 1;
      score += 14;
      score += contiguousRun * 10;
      if (atBoundary) {
        score += 18;
      }
      if (textIndex === queryIndex) {
        score += 6;
      }

      queryIndex += 1;
    }

    if (queryIndex !== query.length) {
      return 0;
    }

    return score * weight;
  }

  private isBoundaryChar(char: string | undefined): boolean {
    return !char || char === '/' || char === '\\' || char === '-' || char === '_' || char === ' ' || char === '.';
  }

  private updateHighlightForNewTab(): void {
    if (this.sections.length > 0 && this.sections[this.activeTabIdx].items.length > 0) {
      this.highlightedItem = { sectionIdx: this.activeTabIdx, itemIdx: 0 };
    } else {
      this.highlightedItem = null;
    }
  }

  isHighlighted(itemIdx: number): boolean {
    return this.highlightedItem?.sectionIdx === this.activeTabIdx && this.highlightedItem?.itemIdx === itemIdx;
  }

  highlightItem(sectionIdx: number, itemIdx: number): void {
    this.highlightedItem = { sectionIdx, itemIdx };
  }

  selectItem(sectionIdx: number, itemIdx: number): void {
    if (sectionIdx < this.sections.length && itemIdx < this.sections[sectionIdx].items.length) {
      const item = this.sections[sectionIdx].items[itemIdx];
      if (item.pin) this.openPin.emit(item.pin);
      else this.navigate.emit(item.path);
    }
  }

  private selectActiveSlot(slotIndex: number): void {
    const activeSection = this.sections[this.activeTabIdx];
    const item = activeSection?.items[slotIndex];
    if (!item) return;
    this.highlightedItem = { sectionIdx: this.activeTabIdx, itemIdx: slotIndex };
    this.selectItem(this.activeTabIdx, slotIndex);
  }


  renamePinnedItem(item: QuickAccessItem, event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (item.pin) this.renamePin.emit(item.pin);
  }

  removePinnedItem(item: QuickAccessItem, event: MouseEvent): void {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    if (item.pin) this.removePin.emit(item.pin);
  }

  private moveDown(): void {
    if (!this.highlightedItem) return;
    const { sectionIdx, itemIdx } = this.highlightedItem;
    const currentSection = this.sections[sectionIdx];

    if (itemIdx < currentSection.items.length - 1) {
      this.highlightedItem = { sectionIdx, itemIdx: itemIdx + 1 };
    }
    // No wrapping to next section; just stop at bottom of list
  }

  private moveUp(): void {
    if (!this.highlightedItem) return;
    const { sectionIdx, itemIdx } = this.highlightedItem;

    if (itemIdx > 0) {
      this.highlightedItem = { sectionIdx, itemIdx: itemIdx - 1 };
    }
    // No wrapping to prev section; just stop at top of list
  }

  private registerInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.quickAccess.close', () => {
      this.closeRequested.emit();
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.quickAccess.nextSection', () => {
      const len = this.sections.length;
      if (len <= 1) return;
      const next = (this.activeTabIdx + 1) % len;
      this.setActiveTab(next);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.quickAccess.prevSection', () => {
      const len = this.sections.length;
      if (len <= 1) return;
      const next = (this.activeTabIdx - 1 + len) % len;
      this.setActiveTab(next);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.quickAccess.prevItem', () => {
      this.moveUp();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.quickAccess.nextItem', () => {
      this.moveDown();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.quickAccess.openSelected', () => {
      if (!this.highlightedItem) return;
      this.selectItem(this.highlightedItem.sectionIdx, this.highlightedItem.itemIdx);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.quickAccess.focusFilter', () => {
      this.focusFilterField();
    }, this.commandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('overlay.quickAccess.removeSelected', () => {
      if (!this.highlightedItem) return;
      const activeSection = this.sections[this.highlightedItem.sectionIdx];
      const item = activeSection?.items[this.highlightedItem.itemIdx];
      if (!item?.pin) return;
      this.removePin.emit(item.pin);
    }, this.commandOwner);

    for (let slot = 1; slot <= 9; slot++) {
      this.inputEngine.registerCommand(`overlay.quickAccess.openSlot${slot}`, () => {
        this.selectActiveSlot(slot - 1);
      }, this.commandOwner);
    }
  }

  private unregisterInputCommands(): void {
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.quickAccess.close', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.quickAccess.nextSection', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.quickAccess.prevSection', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.quickAccess.prevItem', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.quickAccess.nextItem', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.quickAccess.openSelected', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.quickAccess.focusFilter', this.commandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('overlay.quickAccess.removeSelected', this.commandOwner);
    for (let slot = 1; slot <= 9; slot++) {
      this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand(`overlay.quickAccess.openSlot${slot}`, this.commandOwner);
    }
  }

  private getFrequentLocations(limit: number): QuickAccessItem[] {
    return this.pathHistoryService.getFrequentLocations(limit).map(entry => ({
      name: locationLabel(entry.location),
      path: entry.location,
      icon: locationIcon(entry.scheme),
      accessCount: entry.accessCount,
      timestamp: entry.timestamp,
    }));
  }

  private getRecentLocations(limit: number): QuickAccessItem[] {
    return this.pathHistoryService.getRecentLocations(limit).map(entry => ({
      name: locationLabel(entry.location),
      path: entry.location,
      icon: entry.scheme === 'filesystem' ? QUICK_ACCESS_RECENT_ICON : locationIcon(entry.scheme),
      accessCount: entry.accessCount,
      timestamp: entry.timestamp,
    }));
  }

  private resolveQuickAccessIcon(icon: string | undefined): string {
    if (!icon) {
      return QUICK_ACCESS_FOLDER_ICON;
    }

    const normalized = icon.trim();
    if (!normalized) {
      return QUICK_ACCESS_FOLDER_ICON;
    }

    const normalizedKey = normalized.toLowerCase();
    if (SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS[normalizedKey]) {
      return SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS[normalizedKey];
    }

    if (normalized === QUICK_ACCESS_FOLDER_ICON || normalized === '\u{1F4C1}\uFE0F') {
      return QUICK_ACCESS_FOLDER_ICON;
    }
    if (normalized === QUICK_ACCESS_RECENT_ICON || normalized === '\u23F2') {
      return QUICK_ACCESS_RECENT_ICON;
    }
    if (normalized === QUICK_ACCESS_PIN_ICON || normalized === '\u{1F4CC}\uFE0F') {
      return QUICK_ACCESS_PIN_ICON;
    }

    if (/[ĐđŃ]/.test(normalized)) {
      if (/downloads|download/i.test(normalizedKey)) return SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS['downloads'];
      if (/desktop/i.test(normalizedKey)) return SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS['desktop'];
      if (/document/i.test(normalizedKey)) return SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS['documents'];
      if (/picture|photo|image/i.test(normalizedKey)) return SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS['pictures'];
      if (/video|movie/i.test(normalizedKey)) return SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS['videos'];
      if (/music|audio/i.test(normalizedKey)) return SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS['music'];
      if (/home|user/i.test(normalizedKey)) return SPECIAL_FOLDER_ICONS['home'];
      return QUICK_ACCESS_FOLDER_ICON;
    }

    return normalized;
  }
  private pinItem(pin: PinnedLocation): QuickAccessItem {
    return {
      name: pin.label,
      path: pin.location,
      icon: this.resolveQuickAccessIcon(pin.icon),
      pin,
    };
  }


}
````

````typescript
import { fn, spyOnFn, stubGlobal, restoreGlobals } from '../testing/jasmine-test-helpers';

import { FileBrowserTransferController, type FileBrowserTransferHost, type FileBrowserTransferPane } from './file-browser-transfer.controller';

function createPane(overrides: Partial<FileBrowserTransferPane> = {}): FileBrowserTransferPane {
  return {
    currentPath: 'filesystem://target/current',
    selectedFiles: new Set<string>(),
    archiveStack: [],
    sourceCapabilities: { read: true, create: true, delete: true, rename: true, trash: true },
    getDestinationDir: () => 'filesystem://target/selected-folder',
    getTreeArchiveSelectionContext: () => null,
    initiatePendingMove: fn(),
    isInArchive: () => false,
    browserCommands: {
      navigation: {
        navigateUp: fn(),
        refresh: fn(),
        openSelectedItem: fn(),
      },
    },
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function createHost(overrides: Partial<FileBrowserTransferHost> = {}): FileBrowserTransferHost {
  return {
    leftPane: createPane({ currentPath: 'filesystem://source/current' }),
    rightPane: createPane(),
    apiService: {
      batchCopy: fn().mockResolvedValue({ failed: 0 }),
      batchMove: fn().mockResolvedValue({ failed: 0 }),
      joinPaths: fn(async (parts: string[]) => parts.join('/')),
    } as unknown as FileBrowserTransferHost['apiService'],
    archiveService: {
      copy: fn(),
      copyByContext: fn(),
      moveByContext: fn(),
    } as unknown as FileBrowserTransferHost['archiveService'],
    confirmDialog: {
      alert: fn(),
    } as unknown as FileBrowserTransferHost['confirmDialog'],
    get confirmBeforeCopy() { return false; },
    get confirmBeforeMove() { return false; },
    buildDestinationPath: fn(async (sourcePath: string, targetDir: string) => `${targetDir}/${sourcePath.split('/').pop()}`),
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe('FileBrowserTransferController', () => {
  it('copies into the other pane current path instead of its selected directory', async () => {
    const controller = new FileBrowserTransferController();
    const host = createHost();
    const destinationRefresh = host.rightPane?.browserCommands.navigation.refresh as ReturnType<typeof fn>;

    await controller.copy(host, 'left', ['filesystem://source/current/file.txt']);

    expect(host.buildDestinationPath).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'filesystem://source/current/file.txt',
      'filesystem://target/current',
    );
    expect((host.apiService.batchCopy as ReturnType<typeof fn>)).toHaveBeenCalledWith([
      {
        source: 'filesystem://source/current/file.txt',
        destination: 'filesystem://target/current/file.txt',
      },
    ], true);
    expect(destinationRefresh).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('moves into the other pane current path instead of its selected directory', async () => {
    const controller = new FileBrowserTransferController();
    const host = createHost();
    const sourceRefresh = host.leftPane?.browserCommands.navigation.refresh as ReturnType<typeof fn>;
    const destinationRefresh = host.rightPane?.browserCommands.navigation.refresh as ReturnType<typeof fn>;

    await controller.move(host, 'left', ['filesystem://source/current/file.txt']);

    expect(host.buildDestinationPath).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'filesystem://source/current/file.txt',
      'filesystem://target/current',
    );
    expect((host.apiService.batchMove as ReturnType<typeof fn>)).toHaveBeenCalledWith([
      {
        source: 'filesystem://source/current/file.txt',
        destination: 'filesystem://target/current/file.txt',
      },
    ], true);
    expect(sourceRefresh).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(destinationRefresh).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('allows copying from a read-only source into a writable destination', async () => {
    const host = createHost({
      leftPane: createPane({
        currentPath: 's3://bucket',
        sourceCapabilities: { read: true, create: false, delete: false, rename: false, trash: false },
      }),
    });
    await new FileBrowserTransferController().copy(host, 'left', ['s3://bucket/file.txt']);
    expect(host.apiService.batchCopy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('blocks copying into a read-only destination', async () => {
    const host = createHost({
      rightPane: createPane({
        currentPath: 's3://bucket',
        sourceCapabilities: { read: true, create: false, delete: false, rename: false, trash: false },
      }),
    });
    await new FileBrowserTransferController().copy(host, 'left', ['filesystem://source/current/file.txt']);
    expect(host.apiService.batchCopy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(host.confirmDialog.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Copy Not Available\nThe destination is read-only.');
  });

  it('blocks moving from a read-only source', async () => {
    const host = createHost({
      leftPane: createPane({
        currentPath: 's3://bucket',
        sourceCapabilities: { read: true, create: false, delete: false, rename: false, trash: false },
      }),
    });
    await new FileBrowserTransferController().move(host, 'left', ['s3://bucket/file.txt']);
    expect(host.apiService.batchMove).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(host.confirmDialog.alert).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Move Not Available\nThe source is read-only and cannot be moved. You can copy it instead.');
  });


  it('can skip the generic copy confirmation after an explicit sync-plan approval', async () => {
    const host = createHost({
      confirmBeforeCopy: true,
      confirmDialog: { confirm: fn(), alert: fn() } as unknown as FileBrowserTransferHost['confirmDialog'],
    });
    await new FileBrowserTransferController().copy(host, 'left', ['filesystem://left/file.txt'], { skipConfirmation: true });
    expect(host.confirmDialog.confirm).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(host.apiService.batchCopy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('preserves relative paths for reviewed recursive synchronization', async () => {
    const host = createHost();
    await new FileBrowserTransferController().copyRelative(host, 'left', [
      { source: 'filesystem://source/current/src/app.ts', relativePath: 'src/app.ts' },
    ]);
    expect(host.apiService.joinPaths).toHaveBeenCalledWith(['filesystem://target/current', 'src', 'app.ts']);
    expect(host.apiService.batchCopy).toHaveBeenCalledWith([
      { source: 'filesystem://source/current/src/app.ts', destination: 'filesystem://target/current/src/app.ts' },
    ], true);
  });

});
````

````scss
.about-oss-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 6px 12px;
}

.about-oss-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 5px 8px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-foreground) 4%, transparent);
  border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle);
}

.oss-name {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--vsc-foreground);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.oss-license {
  font-size: 10.5px;
  color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue) 12%, transparent);
  color: var(--vsc-accent-blue);
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* === Interactive Shortcuts === */
.shortcuts-toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.shortcut-search {
  flex: 1;
  height: 28px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  background: var(--vsc-input-background);
  border: 1px solid var(--vsc-input-border);
  border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
  color: var(--vsc-input-foreground);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color var(--vsc-transition-fast), box-shadow var(--vsc-transition-fast);
}

.shortcut-search:focus {
  border-color: var(--vsc-input-focus-border);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-input-focus-border) 20%, transparent);
}

.shortcut-search::placeholder {
  color: var(--vsc-input-placeholder);
}

.recording-banner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue) 12%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue) 30%, transparent);
  border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright);
  animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease;
}

.shortcut-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 7px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-border-subtle) 60%, transparent);
  flex-wrap: wrap;

  &:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
    padding-bottom: 0;
  }

  &:first-child {
    padding-top: 0;
  }

  &.recording {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue) 8%, transparent);
    margin: 0 -8px;
    padding: 7px 8px;
    border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
    border-bottom: none;
  }

  &.disabled .shortcut-desc {
    opacity: 0.5;
    text-decoration: line-through;
  }
}

.shortcut-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.shortcut-key-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  min-height: 24px;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  background: var(--vsc-input-background);
  border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-bright);
  border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
  color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 11px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background var(--vsc-transition-fast), border-color var(--vsc-transition-fast);
}

.shortcut-key-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-foreground) 8%, var(--vsc-input-background));
  border-color: var(--vsc-accent-blue);
}

.shortcut-key-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.4;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.shortcut-disabled-tag {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
  font-style: italic;
  margin-left: 4px;
}

.recording-hint {
  color: var(--vsc-accent-blue);
  font-weight: 600;
  animation: pulse-dot 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.recording-steps {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  margin-left: 8px;
}

.recording-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

.shortcut-conflict {
  width: 100%;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--vsc-accent-orange);
  padding-top: 2px;
}

.shortcuts-no-results {
  padding: 2rem;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
  font-size: var(--vsc-font-size);
}

.btn-icon {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  padding: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
  border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: background var(--vsc-transition-fast), color var(--vsc-transition-fast);
}

.btn-icon:hover {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-foreground) 8%, transparent);
  color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright);
}

/* === Responsive Design === */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .settings-overlay {
    padding: 12px;
  }

  .settings-panel {
    width: calc(100vw - 24px);
    max-height: calc(100vh - 24px);
    border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius);
  }

  .settings-body {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .settings-sidebar {
    border-right: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle);
    max-height: 120px;
  }

  .settings-nav {
    flex-direction: row;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .nav-item {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }

  .nav-label {
    display: none;
  }

  .settings-content {
    padding: 16px;
  }

  .field-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .settings-footer {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
    align-items: stretch;
  }

  .settings-actions {
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .settings-header {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .settings-header-actions {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }

  .settings-content {
    padding: 12px;
  }

  .section-title {
    font-size: 18px;
  }

  .settings-actions {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .settings-actions .btn {
    flex: 1;
  }
}
````

````typescript
import type { ViewerContribution, ViewerRequest } from '../viewers/viewer-contribution';
import type { SurfaceContribution, SurfaceRequest } from '../surfaces/surface-contribution';
import type { CommandDescriptor, PluginInputContribution } from '../services/input-system.types';
import type { RelatedLocationContribution } from '../services/related-location.types';

export interface PluginDescriptor {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  version: string;
  description?: string;
  author?: string;
  schemes?: string[];
  extensions?: string[];
  commands?: PluginCommandInfo[];
}

export interface PluginCommandInfo {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: string;
  hotkey?: string;
  appliesTo?: string[];
}

export interface ToolbarActionContribution {
  id: string;
  /** Optional when commandId points at a registered command descriptor. */
  label?: string;
  icon?: string;
  shortcut?: string;
  /** Preferred execution path. Command metadata and enabled state come from the command registry. */
  commandId?: string;
  /** Compatibility path for existing plugins that have not registered a command descriptor yet. */
  execute?(context: ToolbarContext): void | Promise<void>;
  /** Score: 0 = not applicable; higher wins. */
  score(context: ToolbarContext): number;
}

export interface ToolbarContext {
  selectedPaths: string[];
  currentDirectory: string;
}

export interface ContextMenuContribution {
  id: string;
  /** Optional when commandId points at a registered command descriptor. */
  label?: string;
  icon?: string;
  shortcut?: string;
  /** Preferred execution path. Command metadata and enabled state come from the command registry. */
  commandId?: string;
  /** Compatibility path for existing callback-based contributions. */
  execute?(context: MenuContext): void | Promise<void>;
  /** Score: 0 = not applicable; higher wins. */
  score(context: MenuContext): number;
}

export interface MenuContext {
  targetPath: string;
  selectedPaths: string[];
  currentDirectory: string;
}


export interface FileCategoryResolver {
  id: string;
  resolve(path: string, mimeType?: string | null): FileCategory | null;
}

export interface FileCategory {
  category: string;
  icon?: string;
  color?: string;
}

export interface PluginRegistryAPI {
  /** Preferred: register commands, contexts, and default bindings as one owned unit. */
  registerInput(contribution: PluginInputContribution): void;
  unregisterInput(pluginId: string): void;

  /** Compatibility for command-only plugins. Prefer registerInput for new plugins. */
  registerCommand(command: CommandDescriptor): void;
  unregisterCommand(id: string): void;

  registerViewer(contribution: ViewerContribution): void;
  unregisterViewer(id: string): void;

  registerSurface(contribution: SurfaceContribution): void;
  unregisterSurface(id: string): void;

  registerToolbarAction(action: ToolbarActionContribution): void;
  unregisterToolbarAction(id: string): void;

  registerContextMenuItem(item: ContextMenuContribution): void;
  unregisterContextMenuItem(id: string): void;

  registerFileCategory(resolver: FileCategoryResolver): void;
  unregisterFileCategory(id: string): void;

  registerRelatedLocation(contribution: RelatedLocationContribution): void;
  unregisterRelatedLocation(id: string): void;
}
````

````typescript
/** Mirror of Go's ElevatedSessionStatus struct. */
export interface ElevatedSessionStatus {
  /** True when the elevated helper process is connected and healthy. */
  active: boolean;
  /** OS PID of the elevated helper process, or 0 when inactive. */
  pid: number;
  /** Unix timestamp (seconds) when the session was started, or 0. */
  startedAt: number;
  /** TCP port used for the IPC channel. */
  port: number;
  /** Number of operations dispatched through this session. */
  opCount: number;
  /** Non-empty when the last operation produced an error. */
  error: string;
}

function castProtocol<T>(value: unknown): T {
  return value as T;
}

interface StreamTextResult {
  content: string;
  size: number;
}

export interface VideoInfo {
  size: number;
  format: string;
  playbackMode: string;
  manifestUrl?: string;
  streamUrl?: string;
  durationSeconds?: number;
  videoCodec?: string;
  audioCodec?: string;
  seekable?: boolean;
  useNativePlayer?: boolean;
}

function normalizeElevatedSessionStatus(status: elevation.SessionStatus): ElevatedSessionStatus {
  return {
    active: status.active,
    pid: status.pid ?? 0,
    startedAt: status.startedAt ?? 0,
    port: status.port ?? 0,
    opCount: status.opCount,
    error: status.error ?? '',
  };
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class ApiService {
    private normalizeCanonicalPath(path: string): string {
      return normalizePath(path);
    }

    private normalizeTextEncoding(encoding: string): string {
      const normalized = (encoding ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, '-');
      switch (normalized) {
        case '':
        case 'utf8':
        case 'utf-8':
          return 'utf-8';
        case 'utf16':
        case 'utf-16':
        case 'utf16le':
        case 'utf-16le':
          return 'utf-16le';
        case 'utf16be':
        case 'utf-16be':
          return 'utf-16be';
        case 'windows1252':
        case 'cp1252':
        case 'windows-1252':
          return 'windows-1252';
        case 'latin1':
        case 'latin-1':
        case 'iso8859-1':
        case 'iso-8859-1':
          return 'iso-8859-1';
        default:
          return normalized;
      }
    }

    private decodeTextBytes(bytes: ArrayBuffer, encoding: string): string {
      const decoder = new TextDecoder(this.normalizeTextEncoding(encoding));
      const decoded = decoder.decode(bytes);
      return decoded.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff ? decoded.slice(1) : decoded;
    }

    private async fetchStreamResponse(url: string): Promise<Response> {
      const response = await fetch(url);
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
      }
      return response;
    }

    private normalizeCanonicalPathList(paths: string[]): string[] {
      return paths.map((path) => this.normalizeCanonicalPath(path));

   */

  }

  /**
   * Streaming disk-usage scan.
   *
    * Returns an AsyncGenerator that yields DiskUsageEntry objects as direct
    * child snapshots update during the scan, then yields the final
    * DiskUsageResult summary as the last item.
   *
   * The generator handles its own cleanup: it cancels the Go-side scan if
   * the caller breaks out of the for-await loop early (e.g. on navigation).
   *
   * Usage in the component:
   *
   *   for await (const item of this.api.streamDiskUsage(path)) {
   *     if (isDiskUsageResult(item)) { ... } else { ... }
   *   }
   */
  async *streamDiskUsage(
    path: string,
    options?: { signal?: AbortSignal },
  ): AsyncGenerator<
    DiskUsageEntry |
    DiskUsageProgress |
    DiskUsageResult
  > {
    const signal = options?.signal;
    const normalizedPath = this.normalizeCanonicalPath(path);
    const scanId = await window.go.app.App.StartDiskUsageStream(normalizedPath);

    type Pending =
      | { kind: 'entry'; value: DiskUsageEntry }
      | { kind: 'progress'; value: DiskUsageProgress }
      | { kind: 'done'; value: DiskUsageResult }
      | { kind: 'error';  error: Error };

    const queue: Pending[] = [];
    let wake: (() => void) | null = null;
    let finished = false;
    let aborted = false;

    const notify = () => { const r = wake; wake = null; r?.(); };

    const onAbort = () => {
      aborted = true;
      finished = true;
      notify();
    };

    if (signal?.aborted) {
      onAbort();
    }

    const onEntry = (payload: { scanId: string; entry: any }) => {
      if (payload.scanId !== scanId) return;
      queue.push({ kind: 'entry', value: payload.entry });
      notify();
    };

    const onDone = (payload: { scanId: string; result: any }) => {
      if (payload.scanId !== scanId) return;
      queue.push({ kind: 'done', value: payload.result });
      finished = true;
      notify();
    };

    const onProgress = (payload: { scanId: string; progress: any }) => {
      if (payload.scanId !== scanId) return;
      queue.push({ kind: 'progress', value: payload.progress });
      notify();
    };

    const onError = (payload: { scanId: string; error: string }) => {
      if (payload.scanId !== scanId) return;
      queue.push({ kind: 'error', error: new Error(payload.error) });
      finished = true;
      notify();
    };

    window.runtime.EventsOn('disk-usage:entry', onEntry);
    window.runtime.EventsOn('disk-usage:progress', onProgress);
    window.runtime.EventsOn('disk-usage:done',  onDone);
    window.runtime.EventsOn('disk-usage:error', onError);

    signal?.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });

    const cleanup = () => {
      window.runtime.EventsOff('disk-usage:entry', 'disk-usage:progress', 'disk-usage:done', 'disk-usage:error');
    };

    try {
      while (true) {
        while (queue.length > 0) {
          const item = queue.shift()!;
          if (item.kind === 'error') throw item.error;
          yield item.value;
          if (item.kind === 'done') return;
        }

        if (finished) return;

        // Park until the next event wakes us.
        await new Promise<void>(res => { wake = res; });
      }
    } finally {
      // Runs on break, return, or throw — cancel any in-progress Go scan.
      signal?.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
      cleanup();
      window.go.app.App.CancelDiskUsageStream(scanId).catch(() => {/* best-effort */});
    }
  }

  async isDirectory(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      const info = await this.getFileInfo(path);
      return info.type === FileType.DIRECTORY;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable, inject } from '@angular/core';
import type { Type } from '@angular/core';
import type {
  PluginDescriptor,
  PluginRegistryAPI,
  ToolbarActionContribution,
  ToolbarContext,
  ContextMenuContribution,
  MenuContext,
  FileCategoryResolver,
} from '../plugin/plugin-registry-api';
import type { ViewerContribution } from '../viewers/viewer-contribution';
import type { SurfaceContribution } from '../surfaces/surface-contribution';
import { ViewerRegistryService } from '../viewers/viewer-registry.service';
import { SurfaceRegistryService } from '../surfaces/surface-registry.service';
import { InputEngineService } from './input-engine.service';
import type { CommandDescriptor, PluginInputContribution } from './input-system.types';
import { RelatedLocationService } from './related-location.service';
import type { RelatedLocationContribution } from './related-location.types';

export interface PluginBackend {
  id: string;
  onRegister(api: PluginRegistryAPI): void;
  onUnregister(api: PluginRegistryAPI): void;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PluginManagerService implements PluginRegistryAPI {
  private readonly viewerRegistry = inject(ViewerRegistryService);
  private readonly surfaceRegistry = inject(SurfaceRegistryService);
  private readonly inputEngine = inject(InputEngineService);
  private readonly relatedLocations = inject(RelatedLocationService);

  private readonly backends = new Map<string, PluginBackend>();
  private readonly descriptors = new Map<string, PluginDescriptor>();
  private registeringBackendId: string | null = null;

  readonly toolbarActions: ToolbarActionContribution[] = [];
  readonly contextMenuItems: ContextMenuContribution[] = [];
  readonly fileCategories: FileCategoryResolver[] = [];

  constructor() {}

  /** Register a plugin backend (typically called by a plugin module at init). */
  registerBackend(backend: PluginBackend, descriptor?: PluginDescriptor): void {
    if (this.backends.has(backend.id)) {
      console.warn(`Plugin backend ${backend.id} already registered; skipping.`);
      return;
    }

    this.backends.set(backend.id, backend);
    if (descriptor) this.descriptors.set(backend.id, descriptor);

    this.registeringBackendId = backend.id;
    try {
      backend.onRegister(this);
    } catch (error) {
      this.inputEngine.unregisterPluginInput(backend.id);
      this.backends.delete(backend.id);
      this.descriptors.delete(backend.id);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      this.registeringBackendId = null;
    }
  }

  /** Unregister a plugin backend and all of its contributions. */
  unregisterBackend(id: string): void {
    const backend = this.backends.get(id);
    if (!backend) return;

    try {
      backend.onUnregister(this);
    } finally {
      // Preferred plugin input bundles are host-owned: cleanup does not depend
      // on the plugin remembering to unregister every command and binding.
      this.inputEngine.unregisterPluginInput(id);
      this.backends.delete(id);
      this.descriptors.delete(id);
    }
  }

  /** List all registered plugin descriptors. */
  listPlugins(): PluginDescriptor[] {
    return Array.from(this.descriptors.values());
  }

  /** Get a single plugin descriptor. */
  getPlugin(id: string): PluginDescriptor | undefined {
    return this.descriptors.get(id);
  }

  // ── PluginRegistryAPI implementation ───────────────────────────────────────

  registerInput(contribution: PluginInputContribution): void {
    if (this.registeringBackendId && contribution.pluginId !== this.registeringBackendId) {
      throw new Error(
        `Plugin ${this.registeringBackendId} cannot register input owned by ${contribution.pluginId}.`,
      );
    }
    this.inputEngine.registerPluginInput(contribution);
  }

  unregisterInput(pluginId: string): void {
    this.inputEngine.unregisterPluginInput(pluginId);
  }

  registerCommand(command: CommandDescriptor): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommandDescriptor(command, this.commandOwner(command.id));
  }

  unregisterCommand(id: string): void {
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommandDescriptor(id, this.commandOwner(id));
  }

  registerViewer(contribution: ViewerContribution): void {
    this.viewerRegistry.register(contribution);
  }

  unregisterViewer(id: string): void {
    this.viewerRegistry.unregister(id);
  }

  registerSurface(contribution: SurfaceContribution): void {
    this.surfaceRegistry.register(contribution);
  }

  unregisterSurface(id: string): void {
    this.surfaceRegistry.unregister(id);
  }

  registerToolbarAction(action: ToolbarActionContribution): void {
    const i = this.toolbarActions.findIndex(x => x.id === action.id);
    if (i >= 0) this.toolbarActions.splice(i, 1, action);
    else this.toolbarActions.push(action);
  }

  unregisterToolbarAction(id: string): void {
    const i = this.toolbarActions.findIndex(x => x.id === id);
    if (i >= 0) this.toolbarActions.splice(i, 1);
  }

  registerContextMenuItem(item: ContextMenuContribution): void {
    const i = this.contextMenuItems.findIndex(x => x.id === item.id);
    if (i >= 0) this.contextMenuItems.splice(i, 1, item);
    else this.contextMenuItems.push(item);
  }

  unregisterContextMenuItem(id: string): void {
    const i = this.contextMenuItems.findIndex(x => x.id === id);
    if (i >= 0) this.contextMenuItems.splice(i, 1);
  }


  registerFileCategory(resolver: FileCategoryResolver): void {
    const idx = this.fileCategories.findIndex(r => r.id === resolver.id);
    if (idx >= 0) {
      this.fileCategories.splice(idx, 1, resolver);
    } else {
      this.fileCategories.push(resolver);
    }
  }

  unregisterFileCategory(id: string): void {
    const idx = this.fileCategories.findIndex(r => r.id === id);
    if (idx >= 0) {
      this.fileCategories.splice(idx, 1);
    }
  }

  registerRelatedLocation(contribution: RelatedLocationContribution): void {
    this.relatedLocations.register(contribution);
  }

  unregisterRelatedLocation(id: string): void {
    this.relatedLocations.unregister(id);
  }

  /** Resolve toolbar actions applicable to the given context. */
  resolveToolbarActions(context: ToolbarContext): ToolbarActionContribution[] {
    return this.toolbarActions
      .map(a => ({ action: a, score: a.score(context) }))
      .filter(x => x.score > 0)
      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
      .map(x => x.action);
  }

  /** Resolve context menu items applicable to the given context. */
  resolveContextMenuItems(context: MenuContext): ContextMenuContribution[] {
    return this.contextMenuItems
      .map(i => ({ item: i, score: i.score(context) }))
      .filter(x => x.score > 0)
      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
      .map(x => x.item);
  }

  /** Resolve a file category for the given path. */
  resolveFileCategory(path: string, mimeType?: string | null): import('../plugin/plugin-registry-api').FileCategory | null {
    for (const resolver of this.fileCategories) {
      const cat = resolver.resolve(path, mimeType);
      if (cat) return cat;
    }
    return null;
  }

  private commandOwner(commandId: string): string {
    return `plugin-command:${commandId}`;
  }

}
````

````typescript
import type { Type } from '@angular/core';

  | 'navigate'
  | 'selection'
  | 'fileOperations'
  | 'preview'
  | 'viewerControls';

  tab: TabInfo;
  context?: SurfaceContext;
}

export interface SurfaceContribution {
  id: string;
  /** Commands/features this surface can participate in. */
  capabilities?: readonly SurfaceCapability[];
````

````go
package browserpane

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"wails-app/internal/webresourcecache"
)

func TestHandleBrowserPaneBridgeMessageStoresResourcesAndEmitsUpdate(t *testing.T) {
	const pageURL = "https://example.com/view"
	webresourcecache.Clear(pageURL)
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		webresourcecache.Clear(pageURL)
	})

	var emitted string
	handleBrowserPaneBridgeMessage(`{
		"type":"resource-snapshot",
		"pageUrl":"https://example.com/view#fragment",
		"resources":[
			{"url":"https://example.com/app.js","size":42,"initiatorType":"script"},
			{"url":"https://example.com/view","size":99,"initiatorType":"document"}
		]
	}`, func(path string) {
		emitted = path
	}, nil)

	if emitted != pageURL {
		t.Fatalf("expected emitted path %q, got %q", pageURL, emitted)
	}

	resources := webresourcecache.Load(pageURL)
	if len(resources) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 cached resource, got %d", len(resources))
	}
	if resources[0].URL != "https://example.com/app.js" {
		t.Fatalf("expected cached resource url %q, got %q", "https://example.com/app.js", resources[0].URL)
	}
	if resources[0].Size != 42 {
		t.Fatalf("expected cached resource size 42, got %d", resources[0].Size)
	}
	if resources[0].InitiatorType != "script" {
		t.Fatalf("expected cached initiator type %q, got %q", "script", resources[0].InitiatorType)
	}
}

func TestHandleBrowserPaneBridgeMessageForwardsGenericMessages(t *testing.T) {
	var forwarded string
	handleBrowserPaneBridgeMessage(`{"type":"viewer-command","command":"refresh"}`, nil, func(message string) {
		forwarded = message
	})

	if forwarded != `{"type":"viewer-command","command":"refresh"}` {
		t.Fatalf("expected forwarded message, got %q", forwarded)
	}
}

func TestBrowserPaneInjectedBootstrapScriptSupportsWindowsAndWebKitHosts(t *testing.T) {
	script := browserPaneInjectedBootstrapScript()

	requiredFragments := []string{
		"window.__wailsBrowserPaneBridgeInit",
		"window.chrome&&window.chrome.webview&&window.chrome.webview.postMessage",
		"window.webkit&&window.webkit.messageHandlers&&window.webkit.messageHandlers.wailsBrowserPane&&window.webkit.messageHandlers.wailsBrowserPane.postMessage",
		"bridge.receiveHostMessage=function(raw){",
		"bridge.handleRequest=async function(data)",
		"window.__wailsBrowserPaneFlushResources=schedule",
		"type:'resource-snapshot'",
		"window.__wailsBrowserPaneLifecycleInit",
		"type:'lifecycle'",
		"window.__wailsBrowserPaneShortcutInit",
		"type:'shortcut'",
	}
	for _, fragment := range requiredFragments {
		if !strings.Contains(script, fragment) {
			t.Fatalf("expected script to contain %q", fragment)
		}
	}
}

func TestBrowserPaneInjectedBridgeSupportsRpcOnrequest(t *testing.T) {
	script := browserPaneInjectedMessageBridgeScript()

	requiredFragments := []string{
		"bridge.onrequest=null",
		"bridge.handleRequest=async function(data)",
		"bridge.postMessage({_rpc:true,id:data.id,result:result})",
		"bridge.postMessage({_rpc:true,id:data.id,error:",

}
````

````go
package browserpane

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"

	"wails-app/internal/webresourcecache"
)

var (
	browserPaneMessageCallbackSeq atomic.Uint64
	browserPaneMessageCallbacks   sync.Map
)

func registerBrowserPaneMessageCallback(callback func(string)) uint64 {
	if callback == nil {
		return 0
	}
	id := browserPaneMessageCallbackSeq.Add(1)
	browserPaneMessageCallbacks.Store(id, callback)
	return id
}

func unregisterBrowserPaneMessageCallback(id uint64) {
	if id == 0 {
		return
	}
	browserPaneMessageCallbacks.Delete(id)
}

func dispatchBrowserPaneMessageCallback(id uint64, message string) {
	if id == 0 {
		return
	}
	value, ok := browserPaneMessageCallbacks.Load(id)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	callback, ok := value.(func(string))
	if !ok || callback == nil {
		return
	}
	callback(message)
}

func handleBrowserPaneBridgeMessage(message string, onResourcesChanged func(string), onMessage func(string)) {
	message = strings.TrimSpace(message)
	if message == "" {
		return
	}

	var snapshot struct {
		Type      string `json:"type"`
		PageURL   string `json:"pageUrl"`
		Resources []struct {
			URL           string `json:"url"`
			Size          int64  `json:"size"`
			InitiatorType string `json:"initiatorType"`
		} `json:"resources"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(message), &snapshot); err == nil {
		normalizedPageURL := normalizeBrowserPaneMessageURL(snapshot.PageURL)
		if snapshot.Type == "resource-snapshot" && normalizedPageURL != "" {
			resources := make([]webresourcecache.Resource, 0, len(snapshot.Resources))
			for _, resource := range snapshot.Resources {
				resources = append(resources, webresourcecache.Resource{
					URL:           resource.URL,
					Size:          resource.Size,
					InitiatorType: resource.InitiatorType,
					MimeType:      "",
				})
			}
			if webresourcecache.Store(normalizedPageURL, resources) && onResourcesChanged != nil {
				onResourcesChanged(normalizedPageURL)
			}
			return
		}
	}

	if onMessage != nil {
		onMessage(message)
	}
}

func normalizeBrowserPaneMessageURL(raw string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
	if trimmed == "" {
		return ""
	}
	parsed, err := url.Parse(trimmed)
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	scheme := strings.ToLower(parsed.Scheme)
	if scheme != "http" && scheme != "https" {
		return ""
	}
	parsed.Scheme = scheme
	parsed.Host = strings.ToLower(parsed.Host)
	parsed.Fragment = ""
	parsed.Path = strings.ReplaceAll(parsed.Path, "\\", "/")
	if parsed.Path == "/" {
		parsed.Path = ""
	} else {
		parsed.Path = strings.TrimRight(parsed.Path, "/")
	}
	parsed.RawPath = ""
	return parsed.String()
}

func browserPaneInjectedMessageBridgeScript() string {
	return `(function(){
if(window.__wailsBrowserPaneBridgeInit){return;}
window.__wailsBrowserPaneBridgeInit=true;
function sendRaw(message){
	try{
		if(window.chrome&&window.chrome.webview&&window.chrome.webview.postMessage){
			window.chrome.webview.postMessage(message);
			return true;
		}
	}catch(_){}
	try{
		if(window.webkit&&window.webkit.messageHandlers&&window.webkit.messageHandlers.wailsBrowserPane&&window.webkit.messageHandlers.wailsBrowserPane.postMessage){
			window.webkit.messageHandlers.wailsBrowserPane.postMessage(message);
			return true;
		}
	}catch(_){}
	return false;
}
function serialize(payload){
	if(typeof payload==='string'){return payload;}
	try{
		var json=JSON.stringify(payload);
		return json===undefined?'null':json;
	}catch(_){}
	try{return String(payload);}catch(__){return '';}
}
function parse(raw){
	if(typeof raw!=='string'){return raw;}
	try{return JSON.parse(raw);}catch(_){return raw;}
}
function dispatch(raw){
	var payload=typeof raw==='string'?raw:serialize(raw);
	var detail=parse(payload);
	try{
		var event=null;
		if(typeof CustomEvent==='function'){
			event=new CustomEvent('wails-browser-pane-message',{detail:detail});
		}else if(document&&document.createEvent){
			event=document.createEvent('CustomEvent');
			event.initCustomEvent('wails-browser-pane-message',false,false,detail);
		}
		if(event){window.dispatchEvent(event);}
	}catch(_){}
	try{
		if(bridge&&typeof bridge.onmessage==='function'){
			bridge.onmessage({data:detail,rawData:payload});
		}
	}catch(_){}
	return detail;
}
var bridge=window.__wailsBrowserPane||{};
bridge.postMessage=function(payload){return sendRaw(serialize(payload));};
bridge.receiveHostMessage=function(raw){
	var detail=dispatch(raw);
	if(detail&&detail._rpc&&detail.id&&typeof detail.type!=='undefined'&&typeof bridge.onrequest==='function'){
		bridge.handleRequest(detail);
	}
	return detail;
};
bridge.parseMessage=parse;
if(!('onmessage' in bridge)){bridge.onmessage=null;}
if(!('onrequest' in bridge)){bridge.onrequest=null;}
bridge.handleRequest=async function(data){
	if(typeof bridge.onrequest!=='function')return;
	try{
		var result=await bridge.onrequest(data);
		bridge.postMessage({_rpc:true,id:data.id,result:result});
	}catch(err){
		bridge.postMessage({_rpc:true,id:data.id,error:(err&&err.message)?err.message:String(err)});
	}
};
window.__wailsBrowserPane=bridge;
})();`
}

func browserPaneInjectedResourceTrackerScript() string {
	return `(function(){
if(window.__wailsBrowserPaneResourceInit){return;}
window.__wailsBrowserPaneResourceInit=true;
function canonicalize(raw){
	try{
		var url=new URL(String(raw||''), location.href);
		url.hash='';
		return url.toString();
	}catch(_){return '';}
}
function collect(){
	try{
		var resources=[];
		var seen=Object.create(null);
		var entries=(performance&&performance.getEntriesByType)?performance.getEntriesByType('resource'):[];
		for(var i=0;i<entries.length;i++){
			var entry=entries[i];
			var url=canonicalize(entry&&entry.name);
			if(!url||seen[url]){continue;}
			seen[url]=true;
			var transfer=Number(entry.transferSize)||0;
			var encoded=Number(entry.encodedBodySize)||0;
			var decoded=Number(entry.decodedBodySize)||0;
			var size=Math.max(transfer,encoded,decoded,0);
			resources.push({url:url,size:size,initiatorType:String(entry.initiatorType||'')});
		}
		if(window.__wailsBrowserPane&&window.__wailsBrowserPane.postMessage){
			window.__wailsBrowserPane.postMessage({
			type:'resource-snapshot',
			pageUrl:canonicalize(location.href),
			resources:resources
			});
		}
	}catch(_){ }
}
var scheduled=false;
function schedule(){
	if(scheduled){return;}
	scheduled=true;
	setTimeout(function(){scheduled=false;collect();},150);
}
window.__wailsBrowserPaneFlushResources=schedule;
if(window.PerformanceObserver){
	try{
		var observer=new PerformanceObserver(function(){schedule();});
		observer.observe({type:'resource',buffered:true});
	}catch(_){
		try{
			var fallbackObserver=new PerformanceObserver(function(){schedule();});
			fallbackObserver.observe({entryTypes:['resource']});
		}catch(__){}
	}
}
window.addEventListener('load',schedule,{once:false});
document.addEventListener('readystatechange',function(){if(document.readyState==='complete'){schedule();}});
setTimeout(schedule,500);
})();`
}

func browserPaneInjectedLifecycleScript() string {
	return `(function(){
if(window.__wailsBrowserPaneLifecycleInit){return;}
window.__wailsBrowserPaneLifecycleInit=true;
function report(state){
	try{
		if(window.__wailsBrowserPane&&window.__wailsBrowserPane.postMessage){
			window.__wailsBrowserPane.postMessage({
				type:'lifecycle',
				state:state,
				url:location.href
			});
		}
	}catch(_){}
}
window.addEventListener('load',function(){report('completed');});
var _origPushState=history.pushState;
history.pushState=function(){
	_origPushState.apply(this,arguments);
	report('completed');
};
var _origReplaceState=history.replaceState;
history.replaceState=function(){
	_origReplaceState.apply(this,arguments);
	report('completed');
};
window.addEventListener('popstate',function(){report('completed');});
})();`
}

func browserPaneInjectedShortcutBridgeScript() string {
	return `(function(){
if(window.__wailsBrowserPaneShortcutInit){return;}
window.__wailsBrowserPaneShortcutInit=true;
function isFunctionKey(key){
	return /^F\d{1,2}$/i.test(String(key||''));
}
function shouldForward(event){
	if(!event||event.isComposing){return false;}
	if(event.ctrlKey||event.altKey||event.metaKey){return true;}
	return isFunctionKey(event.key);
}
window.addEventListener('keydown',function(event){
	if(!shouldForward(event)){return;}
	try{
		if(window.__wailsBrowserPane&&window.__wailsBrowserPane.postMessage){
			var target=event.target;
			var tagName=(target&&target.tagName)?String(target.tagName).toLowerCase():'';
			window.__wailsBrowserPane.postMessage({
				type:'shortcut',
				event:'keydown',
				key:String(event.key||''),
				code:String(event.code||''),
				ctrlKey:!!event.ctrlKey,
				shiftKey:!!event.shiftKey,
				altKey:!!event.altKey,
				metaKey:!!event.metaKey,
				context:{
					inInput:tagName==='input',
					inTextarea:tagName==='textarea',
					inSelect:tagName==='select',
					inContentEditable:!!(target&&target.isContentEditable)
				}
			});
		}
	}catch(_){}
},true);
})();`
}

func browserPaneInjectedBootstrapScript() string {
	return browserPaneInjectedMessageBridgeScript() + "\n" + browserPaneInjectedResourceTrackerScript() + "\n" + browserPaneInjectedLifecycleScript() + "\n" + browserPaneInjectedShortcutBridgeScript()
}

func browserPaneHostMessageEvalScript(message string) string {
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(message)
	if err != nil {
		encoded = []byte(`""`)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf(`(function(){
var raw=%s;
var bridge=window.__wailsBrowserPane;
if(bridge&&typeof bridge.receiveHostMessage==='function'){
	bridge.receiveHostMessage(raw);
	return true;
}
var detail=raw;
try{detail=JSON.parse(raw);}catch(_){}
try{
	var event=null;
	if(typeof CustomEvent==='function'){
		event=new CustomEvent('wails-browser-pane-message',{detail:detail});
	}else if(document&&document.createEvent){
		event=document.createEvent('CustomEvent');
		event.initCustomEvent('wails-browser-pane-message',false,false,detail);
	}
	if(event){window.dispatchEvent(event);}
	return true;
}catch(_){
	return false;
}
})();`, string(encoded))
````

````typescript
import {

import { AddressBarQuickAccessComponent } from './address-bar-quick-access.component';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-address-bar',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    DropdownContainerComponent,
    DropdownTriggerDirective,
    DropdownMenuDirective,
    AddressBarSiblingDropdownComponent,
    AddressBarSchemeDropdownComponent,
    AddressBarEditComponent,
    AddressBarQuickAccessComponent,
  ],
  template: `
<div class="ab-host" (keydown)="onHostKeyDown($event)">

  <!-- ── BREADCRUMB ROW ──────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
  <div class="ab-bar" *ngIf="!editMode" [class.ab-bar--compact]="compact">

    <!-- Left cluster: quick access + pin star -->
    <div class="ab-cluster ab-cluster--left">
      <!-- QUICK ACCESS -->
      <button
        #quickAccessTrigger
        appDropdownTrigger
        class="ab-btn ab-btn--quick-access"
        [class.ab-btn--open]="showQuickAccess"
        (click)="toggleQuickAccess()"
        title="Quick Access (Ctrl+Q)"
        aria-label="Open Quick Access"
      >
        <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
          <path d="M2 3.5a.5.5 0 0 1 .5-.5h11a.5.5 0 0 1 0 1h-11a.5.5 0 0 1-.5-.5zM2 8a.5.5 0 0 1 .5-.5h11a.5.5 0 0 1 0 1h-11A.5.5 0 0 1 2 8zm0 4.5a.5.5 0 0 1 .5-.5h6a.5.5 0 0 1 0 1h-6a.5.5 0 0 1-.5-.5z"/>
        </svg>
      </button>
      <app-dropdown-container
        class="ab-drop-anchor"
        [(isOpen)]="showQuickAccess"
        [anchorEl]="quickAccessTrigger"
      >
        <app-address-bar-quick-access
          appDropdownMenu
          *ngIf="showQuickAccess"
          [currentPath]="currentPath"
          [currentSurfaceId]="surfaceId"
          [specialFolders]="specialFolders"
          [pinnedLocations]="pinnedLocations"
          [preferredSectionTitle]="quickAccessPreferredSection"
          (navigate)="navigateTo($event); showQuickAccess = false"
          (openPin)="openPinnedLocation($event)"
          (removePin)="removePin($event)"
          (renamePin)="renamePin($event)"
          (closeRequested)="showQuickAccess = false"
        />
      </app-dropdown-container>

      <button
        class="ab-btn ab-btn--star"
        [class.ab-btn--pinned]="isPinned"
        (click)="togglePin()"
        [title]="isPinned ? 'Unpin this path' : 'Pin this path'"
        aria-label="Toggle pin"
      >{{ isPinned ? '★' : '☆' }}</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Breadcrumb trail -->
    <div class="ab-crumbs" (click)="onCrumbsClick($event)">
      <span *ngIf="!showBreadcrumbs" class="ab-path-label" [title]="currentPath">{{ currentPath || '/' }}</span>

      <ng-container *ngIf="showBreadcrumbs">
      <!-- Scheme root stays fixed, outside the scroll -->
      <ng-container *ngIf="(isWin || isSchemeRoot) && segments.length > 0">
        <span
          class="ab-seg ab-scheme"
          [class.ab-seg--last]="segments.length === 1"
          [class.ab-scheme--synthetic]="isSchemeRoot || isCurrentRootSynthetic()"
          [class.ab-scheme--open]="showSchemeMenu"
          (click)="onSchemeClick(segments[0], segments.length === 1, $event)"
          (contextmenu)="onSegRightClick(segments[0], 0, $event)"
          title="Switch schemes"
        >
          <span class="ab-scheme-text">{{ currentSchemeLabel() }}</span>
          <span *ngIf="showCurrentSchemeSeparator()" class="ab-scheme-separator">:</span>
        </span>

        <div class="ab-scheme-chevron-wrap" *ngIf="segments.length > 1">
          <button
            class="ab-chev ab-scheme-chevron"
            [class.ab-chev--open]="chevIdx === 0"
            (click)="toggleChev(0, segments[0], $event)"
            [title]="'Show contents of ' + segments[0].fullPath"
            aria-label="Show root contents"
          ><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M6 4l4 4-4 4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/></svg></button>
        </div>
      </ng-container>

      <!-- Everything else scrolls -->
      <div class="ab-crumbs-inner" #crumbsEl>
        <ng-container *ngFor="let seg of segments; let i = index; let last = last">
          <!-- skip index 0 on Windows or scheme roots (rendered above as fixed badge) -->
          <ng-container *ngIf="(!isWin && !isSchemeRoot) || i > 0">

            <!-- 
              ARCHIVE FILE (can be both root AND inner)
              - Every archive file gets isArchiveRoot=true
              - If it's inside another archive, also gets isArchiveInner=true
            -->
            <span
              *ngIf="seg.isArchiveRoot"
              class="ab-seg"
              [class.ab-seg--archive-root]="seg.isArchiveRoot"
              [class.ab-seg--archive-inner]="seg.isArchiveInner"
              [class.ab-seg--clickable]="!last"
              [class.ab-seg--last]="last"
              (click)="onArchiveRootSegClick(seg, last, $event)"
              (contextmenu)="onSegRightClick(seg, i, $event)"
              [title]="last ? 'Click to edit path' : seg.fullPath"
            >
              <ng-container *ngIf="getSegmentLabelParts(seg) as labelParts">
                <span class="ab-seg-label">
                  <span class="ab-seg-main">{{ labelParts.main }}</span>
                  <span *ngIf="labelParts.ext" class="ab-seg-ext">{{ labelParts.ext }}</span>
                </span>
              </ng-container>
            </span>

            <!-- REGULAR FOLDER INSIDE ARCHIVE (not an archive file) -->
            <span
              *ngIf="seg.isArchiveInner && !seg.isArchiveRoot"
              class="ab-seg ab-seg--archive-inner"
              [class.ab-seg--last]="last"
              [class.ab-seg--clickable]="!last"
              [title]="last ? 'Click to edit path' : seg.fullPath"
              (click)="onArchiveInnerSegClick(seg, last, $event)"
              (contextmenu)="onSegRightClick(seg, i, $event)"
            >
              <ng-container *ngIf="getSegmentLabelParts(seg) as labelParts">
                <span class="ab-seg-label">
                  <span class="ab-seg-main">{{ labelParts.main }}</span>
                  <span *ngIf="labelParts.ext" class="ab-seg-ext">{{ labelParts.ext }}</span>
                </span>
              </ng-container>
            </span>

            <!-- REGULAR FS SEGMENT (non-archive, non-Windows-root) -->
            <span
              *ngIf="(!seg.isRoot || !isWin) && !seg.isArchiveInner && !seg.isArchiveRoot"
              class="ab-seg"
              [class.ab-seg--root]="seg.isRoot"
              [class.ab-seg--last]="last"
              (click)="onSegClick(seg, $event)"
              (contextmenu)="onSegRightClick(seg, i, $event)"
              [title]="last ? 'Click to edit path' : seg.fullPath"
            >
              <ng-container *ngIf="getSegmentLabelParts(seg) as labelParts">
                <span class="ab-seg-label">
                  <span class="ab-seg-main">{{ labelParts.main }}</span>
                  <span *ngIf="labelParts.ext" class="ab-seg-ext">{{ labelParts.ext }}</span>
                </span>
              </ng-container>
            </span>

            <!-- Chevron after segment (if not last) -->
            <div class="ab-chev-wrap" *ngIf="!last">
              <button
                class="ab-chev"
                [class.ab-chev--archive]="seg.isArchiveRoot || seg.isArchiveInner"
                [class.ab-chev--open]="chevIdx === i"
                (click)="toggleChev(i, seg, $event)"
                [attr.aria-label]="(seg.isArchiveRoot || seg.isArchiveInner) ? 'Browse archive' : 'Browse siblings'"
              ><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M6 4l4 4-4 4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/></svg></button>
            </div>

          </ng-container>
        </ng-container>
      </div>
      <span class="ab-crumbs-filler" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <span
        class="ab-status"
        [class.ab-status--visible]="loading || showLoadComplete"
        [attr.aria-hidden]="!(loading || showLoadComplete)"
        [attr.aria-label]="loading ? 'Loading' : (showLoadComplete ? 'Load complete' : null)"
        [attr.title]="loading ? 'Loading' : (showLoadComplete ? 'Load complete' : null)">
        <span *ngIf="loading" class="ab-loading-spinner"></span>
        <svg *ngIf="!loading && showLoadComplete" class="ab-status-check" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M3 8.5 L6.2 11.5 L13 4.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        </svg>
      </span>
      </ng-container>
    </div>

    <!-- Right cluster: Up / Refresh / Copy -->
    <div class="ab-cluster ab-cluster--right">
      <button class="ab-btn" (click)="goUp()" title="Parent directory" aria-label="Go up">
        <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor">
          <path d="M8 1a.5.5 0 0 1 .5.5v11.793l3.146-3.147a.5.5 0 0 1 .708.708l-4 4a.5.5 0 0 1-.708 0l-4-4a.5.5 0 0 1 .708-.708L7.5 13.293V1.5A.5.5 0 0 1 8 1z" transform="rotate(180,8,8)"/>
````
