````typescript
    [anchorEl]="schemeAnchorEl"
    *ngIf="showSchemeMenu"
  >
    <app-address-bar-scheme-dropdown
      appDropdownMenu
      [schemes]="schemes"
      [loading]="schemesLoading"
      [currentPath]="currentPath"
      (schemeClick)="switchToScheme($event)"
      (closeRequested)="showSchemeMenu = false"
    />
  </app-dropdown-container>

  <!-- ── CONTEXT MENU ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
  <app-dropdown-container
    [(isOpen)]="ctxMenu.visible"
    (isOpenChange)="onCtxMenuOpenChange($event)"
    [anchorEl]="ctxAnchorEl"
  >
    <div
      class="ab-ctx-menu"
      appDropdownMenu
    >
      <div class="ab-ctx-path">{{ ctxMenu.segment?.fullPath }}</div>
      <hr class="ab-ctx-divider"/>
      <button class="ab-ctx-item" (click)="ctxNavigateTo()">
        <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M1 3.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 2.5 2h2.764c.958 0 1.76.56 2.311 1.184C7.985 3.648 8.48 4 9 4h4.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 15 5.5v7a1.5 1.5 0 0 1-1.5 1.5h-11A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 1 12.5v-9z"/></svg>
        Navigate here
      </button>
      <button class="ab-ctx-item" (click)="ctxCopyPath()">
        <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M4 1.5H3a2 2 0 0 0-2 2V14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V3.5a2 2 0 0 0-2-2h-1v1h1a1 1 0 0 1 1 1V14a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H3a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V3.5a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h1v-1z"/><path d="M9.5 1a.5.5 0 0 1 .5.5v1a.5.5 0 0 1-.5.5h-3a.5.5 0 0 1-.5-.5v-1a.5.5 0 0 1 .5-.5h3zm-3-1A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 5 1.5v1A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 6.5 4h3A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 11 2.5v-1A1.5 1.5 0 0 0 9.5 0h-3z"/></svg>
        Copy path
      </button>
      <button class="ab-ctx-item" (click)="ctxCopyName()">
        <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M14 4.5V14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H4a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V2a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h5.5L14 4.5zm-3 0A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 9.5 3V1H4a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v12a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h8a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V4.5h-2z"/></svg>
        Copy folder name
      </button>
      <hr class="ab-ctx-divider"/>
      <button class="ab-ctx-item" (click)="ctxOpenOtherPane()">
        <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M0 3a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h12a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v10a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H2a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V3zm8.5-1v12H14a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V3a1 1 0 0 0-1-1H8.5zM7.5 2H2a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h5.5V2z"/></svg>
        Open in other pane
      </button>
      <button class="ab-ctx-item" (click)="ctxPinPath()">
        <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor"><path d="M9.5 1.5a1 1 0 0 0-1.415 0L4.94 4.645a3.5 3.5 0 0 0-.871 3.547l-2.646 2.647a.5.5 0 0 0 .708.707l2.646-2.646a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 3.547-.872l3.144-3.144A1 1 0 0 0 11.5 3l-2-1.5z"/></svg>
        {{ isSegmentPinned(ctxMenu.segment) ? 'Unpin path' : 'Pin path' }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </app-dropdown-container>

</div>
  `,
  styles: [`
    :host {
      display: block;
      position: relative;
      font-family: var(--vsc-font-family);
      font-size: var(--vsc-font-size);
      color: var(--vsc-foreground);
      background: var(--vsc-sidebar-background);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vsc-border);  /* ← moved here */
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    .ab-host {
      position: relative;
      background: var(--vsc-sidebar-background);
      height: 32px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      overflow: visible;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    .ab-bar {
      /* use grid so the middle (breadcrumbs) reliably fills remaining space */
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
      align-items: center;
      /* reduced height */
      height: 32px;
      padding: 0 var(--vsc-padding-sm);
      gap: var(--vsc-padding-xs);
      width: 100%;
      overflow: visible;
      background: var(--vsc-sidebar-background);
      transition: background var(--vsc-transition-fast);
      user-select: none;
    }

    .ab-bar--compact {
      height: 28px;
      .ab-btn { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
      .ab-seg { height: 20px; line-height: 20px; font-size: var(--vsc-font-size-small); }
    }

    .ab-cluster {
      display: flex; align-items: center;
      gap: var(--vsc-padding-xs); flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .ab-cluster--left {
      padding-right: var(--vsc-padding-sm);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle);
      margin-right: var(--vsc-padding-sm);
    }

    .ab-cluster--right {
      padding-left: var(--vsc-padding-sm);
      border-left: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle);
      margin-left: var(--vsc-padding-sm);
    }

    .ab-status {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      color: var(--vsc-accent-blue);
      margin-left: var(--vsc-padding-xs);
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: color var(--vsc-transition-fast), opacity var(--vsc-transition-fast);
    }

    .ab-status--visible {
      opacity: 1;
      visibility: visible;
    }

    .ab-loading-spinner {
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      border: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue) 22%, transparent);
      border-top-color: var(--vsc-accent-blue);
      box-sizing: border-box;
      animation: ab-spin 0.9s linear infinite;
    }

    .ab-status-check {
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      color: var(--vsc-success, #4caf50);
      animation: ab-status-pop 160ms ease-out;
    }

    @keyframes ab-spin {
      from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }

    @keyframes ab-status-pop {
      from { transform: scale(0.82); opacity: 0.45; }
      to { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
    }

    .ab-btn {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0;
      background: transparent; border: none;
      border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim); cursor: pointer;
      transition: background-color var(--vsc-transition-fast), color var(--vsc-transition-fast);
      flex-shrink: 0;

      &:hover { background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background); color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright); }
      &:active { background: var(--vsc-list-active-background); color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright); }
      &:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--vsc-focusBorder, var(--vsc-accent-blue)); outline-offset: -1px; }

      svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: currentColor; opacity: 0.9; transition: opacity var(--vsc-transition-fast), filter 120ms ease; }
      &:hover svg { opacity: 1; }
      /* Soften icons when button is in an active/open state */
      &.ab-btn--open svg,
      &.ab-btn--pinned svg {
        opacity: 0.78;
        filter: saturate(0.92) brightness(0.94);
      }
    }

    .ab-btn--star { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; &:hover { color: var(--vsc-accent-yellow); } }
    .ab-btn--pinned { color: var(--vsc-accent-yellow) !important; }
    .ab-btn--open { background: var(--vsc-list-active-background); color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright); svg { opacity: 1; } }
    .ab-btn--copied { color: var(--vsc-success) !important; }

    .ab-drop-anchor { position: relative; }

    .ab-crumbs {
      /* take all remaining space between left and right clusters */
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      min-width: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      overflow: hidden;
      gap: 0;
    }

    .ab-path-label {
      min-width: 0;
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      padding: 0 var(--vsc-padding-sm);
      color: var(--vsc-foreground);
      font-size: var(--vsc-font-size);
      line-height: 20px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
      cursor: text;

      &:hover {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue) 12%, transparent);
      }
    }

    .ab-crumbs-inner {
      /* size to breadcrumb content and scroll only when content exceeds space */
      flex: 0 1 auto;
      min-width: 0;
      max-width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      height: 100%;
      overflow-x: auto;
      overflow-y: hidden;
      scroll-behavior: auto;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;

      &::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

      > * { flex-shrink: 0; }
    }

    .ab-crumbs-filler {
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      min-width: 12px;
      height: 100%;
    }

    .ab-scheme {
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .ab-seg {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
      height: 20px; padding: 0 var(--vsc-padding-sm);
      border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim); font-size: var(--vsc-font-size);
      line-height: 20px; cursor: pointer;
      transition: background-color var(--vsc-transition-fast), color var(--vsc-transition-fast);
      max-width: 260px; overflow: hidden;

      &:hover { background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background); color: var(--vsc-foreground); }
      
      &.ab-seg--root { color: var(--vsc-foreground); font-weight: 500; }
      
      /* Last segment: clicking enters edit mode rather than navigating */
      &.ab-seg--last {
        color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright); cursor: text; max-width: 320px;
        &:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-blue) 12%, transparent); }
      }

      /* ARCHIVE ROOT - any archive file in the path */
      &.ab-seg--archive-root {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-orange) 18%, transparent);
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.35);
        color: #ffb347;
        gap: 4px;
        
        .ab-seg-archive-icon { 
          opacity: 0.9; 
          flex-shrink: 0;
          font-size: 14px;
        }
        
        &.ab-seg--clickable { cursor: pointer; }
        &.ab-seg--clickable:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-orange) 34%, transparent); }
        
        /* NESTED ARCHIVE - archive inside another archive */
        &.ab-seg--archive-inner {
          background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-orange) 24%, transparent);
          
          &:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vsc-accent-orange) 40%, transparent); }
        }
      }

      /* REGULAR FOLDER INSIDE ARCHIVE (not an archive file) */
      &.ab-seg--archive-inner:not(.ab-seg--archive-root) {
        color: color-mix(in srgb, #ffb347 80%, var(--vsc-foreground));
        cursor: default;
        
        &.ab-seg--clickable { cursor: pointer; }
        &.ab-seg--clickable:hover { 
          background: color-mix(in srgb, #ffb347 15%, transparent); 
          color: #ffb347; 
        }
        &:not(.ab-seg--clickable):hover { background: transparent; }
      }
    }

    .ab-scheme {
      /* Softer scheme styling: lower opacity and subtler border */
      background: color-mix(in srgb, #007fd4 12%, transparent);
      border: 1px solid rgba(0,127,212,0.25);
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: #6fb3db; /* slightly dimmer blue */
      font-family: var(--vsc-font-family-mono); font-weight: 600;
      padding: 0 var(--vsc-padding-lg) !important; margin-right: var(--vsc-padding-md) !important;
      cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s, border-color 0.12s, color 120ms;
      &:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #007fd4 20%, transparent); border-color: rgba(0,127,212,0.38); }
      &.ab-seg--last { background: color-mix(in srgb, #007fd4 10%, transparent); cursor: pointer; }
      &.ab-scheme--open { background: color-mix(in srgb, #007fd4 22%, transparent); border-color: rgba(0,127,212,0.45); }
      &.ab-scheme--synthetic {
        gap: 0;
        max-width: 180px;
      }
    }

    .ab-scheme-text {
      display: block;
      flex: 0 1 auto;
      min-width: 0;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      padding-right: 0;
    }

    .ab-scheme-separator {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      margin-left: 0.12em;
      padding-right: 0;
      color: inherit;
      line-height: 1;
    }


    .ab-chev-wrap {
      position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; overflow: visible;
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
    }

    .ab-chev {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      width: 20px; height: 24px; padding: 0;
      background: transparent !important; border: none;
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim);
      cursor: pointer; border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius-sm);
      transition: color var(--vsc-transition-fast), transform var(--vsc-transition-normal);

      svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; }

      &:hover { color: var(--vsc-foreground); background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background) !important; }
      &:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--vsc-accent-blue); outline-offset: -1px; }
      &.ab-chev--open { transform: rotate(90deg); color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim); background: transparent !important; }

      /* Archive chevron styling */
      &.ab-chev--archive {
        color: rgba(255, 179, 71, 0.6);
        background: transparent !important;
        
        &:hover { 
          background: transparent !important; 
          color: #ffb347; 
        }
        
        &.ab-chev--open { 
          transform: rotate(90deg); 
          color: #ffb347; 
          background: transparent !important; 
        }
      }
    }

    .ab-scheme-chevron-wrap { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; margin-right: var(--vsc-padding-xs); }
    .ab-scheme-chevron {
      border-radius: 0 var(--vsc-border-radius-sm) var(--vsc-border-radius-sm) 0; margin-left: -2px;
      background: transparent !important;
      &.ab-chev--open { background: transparent !important; color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim); }
    }

    /* Context menu */
    .ab-ctx-menu {
      min-width: 200px;
      background: var(--vsc-panel-background); border: 1px solid var(--vsc-border);
      border-radius: var(--vsc-border-radius); box-shadow: var(--vsc-widget-shadow);
      padding: var(--vsc-padding-xs) 0;
      animation: ab-ctx-appear var(--vsc-transition-fast) cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    @keyframes ab-ctx-appear {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    .ab-ctx-path {
      padding: var(--vsc-padding-sm) var(--vsc-padding-lg);
      font-size: 11px; font-family: var(--vsc-font-family-mono);
      color: var(--vsc-foreground-dim); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis; max-width: 240px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle);
      margin-bottom: var(--vsc-padding-xs);
    }

    .ab-ctx-divider { margin: var(--vsc-padding-xs) 0; border: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--vsc-border-subtle); }

    .ab-ctx-item {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--vsc-padding-sm);
      width: 100%; padding: var(--vsc-padding-sm) var(--vsc-padding-lg);
      background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--vsc-foreground);
      font-size: var(--vsc-font-size); font-family: var(--vsc-font-family);
      cursor: pointer; text-align: left;
      transition: background-color var(--vsc-transition-fast);
      svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: currentColor; opacity: 0.8; flex-shrink: 0; }
      &:hover { background: var(--vsc-list-hover-background); svg { opacity: 1; } }
      &:active { background: var(--vsc-list-active-background); color: var(--vsc-foreground-bright); }
    }

    .ab-seg-label {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      min-width: 0;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .ab-seg-main {
      flex: 1 1 auto;
      min-width: 0;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .ab-seg-ext {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
    }

    /* Compact mode */
    :host-context(.compact-mode) {
      .ab-bar { height: 28px; }
      .ab-btn { width: 22px; height: 22px; svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; } }
      .ab-chev { width: 18px; height: 22px; }
      .ab-seg { height: 22px; line-height: 22px; font-size: var(--vsc-font-size-small); padding: 0 var(--vsc-padding-sm); }
    }

    /* Light theme adjustments */
    :host-context(.vscode-light) {
      .ab-scheme { background: color-mix(in srgb, #0060c0 10%, transparent); border-color: rgba(0,96,192,0.28); color: #0a6fb0;
        &.ab-scheme--open { background: color-mix(in srgb, #0060c0 18%, transparent); border-color: rgba(0,96,192,0.42); }
      }
      
      .ab-seg--archive-root {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, #ff8c00 12%, transparent);
        border-color: rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.3);
        color: #b85e00;
        
        &.ab-seg--archive-inner {
          border-color: rgba(255, 140, 0, 0.3);
          background: color-mix(in srgb, #ff8c00 18%, transparent);
        }
      }
      
      .ab-seg--archive-inner:not(.ab-seg--archive-root) {
        color: #b85e00;
      }
      
      .ab-chev--archive {
        color: rgba(184, 94, 0, 0.5);
        &:hover { color: #b85e00; }
        &.ab-chev--open { color: #b85e00; }
      }
    }
  `],
})
export class AddressBarComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy, OnChanges {
  @ViewChild('crumbsEl') crumbsEl?: ElementRef<HTMLDivElement>;

  @Input() initialPath = '/';
  @Input() loading = false;
  @Input() showBreadcrumbs = true;
  @Input() placeholder = 'Enter path…';
  @Input() paneId = 'left';
  @Input() tabId = '';
  /** Semantic surface type associated with the current location. */
  @Input() surfaceId = 'dir';

  @Output() pathChange          = new EventEmitter<string>();
  @Output() navigateUpClicked   = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() refreshClicked      = new EventEmitter<void>();
  @Output() openInOtherPane     = new EventEmitter<string>();
  @Output() archiveSegmentClick = new EventEmitter<string>();
  @Output() pinnedLocationOpen = new EventEmitter<PinnedLocation>();

  // ── Path state ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  currentPath = '/';
  segments: PathSegment[] = [];
  get isWin(): boolean { return isWindowsPath(this.currentPath); }
  /** True when the first segment is a non-Windows scheme root (memory://, s3://, Registry, etc.) */
  get isSchemeRoot(): boolean {
    if (this.isWin || this.segments.length === 0) return false;
    const seg = this.segments[0];
    return seg.isRoot === true && seg.label !== '/';
  }

  // ── Scheme switcher ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  schemes: DriveInfo[] = [];
  showSchemeMenu = false;
  schemeAnchorEl: HTMLElement | null = null;
  schemesLoading = false;

  // ── Chevron / sibling dropdown ───────────────────────────────────────────
  chevIdx     = -1;
  sibOpen     = false;
  siblings: SiblingEntry[] = [];
  sibLoading  = false;
  sibAnchorEl: HTMLElement | null = null;

  private readonly sibPaneId = 'ab-sib-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
  private activeSibStreamId: string | null = null;
  private sibStreamOff: Array<() => void> = [];

  // ── Quick Access ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  specialFolders: SpecialFolder[] = [];
  showQuickAccess = false;
  quickAccessPreferredSection: string | null = null;

  // ── Pinned paths ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  pinnedLocations: PinnedLocation[] = [];
  get isPinned(): boolean {
    return this.pinnedLocationService.isPinned(this.pinnedLocations, this.currentPath, this.surfaceId);
  }

  // ── Edit mode ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  editMode  = false;

  // ── Context menu ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ctxMenu: ContextMenuState = { ...CTX_MENU_CLOSED };
  ctxAnchorEl: HTMLElement | null = null;

  // ── Misc ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  justCopied = false;
  compact    = false;
  showLoadComplete = false;

  // ── Timers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  private copiedTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  private loadCompleteTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

  // ── Scroll ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  private scrollAnimFrame: number | null = null;
  private wheelListener?: (e: WheelEvent) => void;

  constructor(
    private apiService: ApiService,
    private directorySource: DirectorySourceService,
    private archiveService: ArchiveService,
    private pinnedLocationService: PinnedLocationService,
    private confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService,
    private elRef: ElementRef,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
  ) {}

  // ── Lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.currentPath = normalizePath(this.initialPath);
    this.rebuildSegments();
    this.pinnedLocations = this.pinnedLocationService.load();
    this.loadSpecialFolders();
    this.loadSchemes();
  }

  ngAfterViewInit(): void {
    this.setupWheelScroll();
  }

  ngAfterViewChecked(): void {}

  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['loading'] && !changes['loading'].firstChange) {
      const previous = !!changes['loading'].previousValue;
      const current = !!changes['loading'].currentValue;
      if (previous && !current) {
        this.showTransientLoadComplete();
      } else if (current) {
        this.clearTransientLoadComplete();
      }
    }

    if (changes['tabId'] && !changes['tabId'].firstChange) {
      this.closeAll();
      if (this.editMode) {
        this.editMode    = false;
      }
      const rawNext = changes['initialPath']?.currentValue ?? this.initialPath;
      this.currentPath = normalizePath(rawNext);
      this.rebuildSegments();
      this.cdr.detectChanges();
      return;
    }

    if (changes['initialPath'] && !changes['initialPath'].firstChange) {
      const next = normalizePath(changes['initialPath'].currentValue);
      if (!samePath(next, this.currentPath)) {
        this.currentPath = next;
        this.rebuildSegments();
      }
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    clearTimeout(this.copiedTimer);
    this.clearTransientLoadComplete();
    if (this.scrollAnimFrame !== null) cancelAnimationFrame(this.scrollAnimFrame);
    const el = this.crumbsEl?.nativeElement;
    if (el && this.wheelListener) el.removeEventListener('wheel', this.wheelListener);
    this.closeSiblingStream();
  }

  private showTransientLoadComplete(): void {
    this.clearTransientLoadComplete();
    this.showLoadComplete = true;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
    this.loadCompleteTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.showLoadComplete = false;
      this.loadCompleteTimer = undefined;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }, 900);
  }

  private clearTransientLoadComplete(): void {
    if (this.loadCompleteTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.loadCompleteTimer);
      this.loadCompleteTimer = undefined;
    }
    if (this.showLoadComplete) {
      this.showLoadComplete = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  // ── Segments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private rebuildSegments(): void {
    this.segments = this.directorySource.buildPathSegments(this.currentPath);
    // Animate scroll to end after segments update (next frame so DOM has rendered)
    requestAnimationFrame(() => this.animateScrollToEnd());
  }

  private currentRootPath(): string {
    const root = this.directorySource.getRootPath(this.currentPath) || this.segments[0]?.fullPath || this.currentPath;
    return normalizePath(root || '');
  }

  private findCurrentRootEntry(): DriveInfo | null {
    const rootPath = this.currentRootPath();
    if (!rootPath) return null;
    return this.schemes.find((drive) => normalizePath(drive.path) === rootPath) ?? null;
  }

  isCurrentRootSynthetic(): boolean {
    const drive = this.findCurrentRootEntry();
    if (!drive) return false;
    return /^(memory|registry|search|http|https|smb|s3)$/.test(drive.schemeType) || drive.schemeType.startsWith('cloud-');
  }

  isCurrentRootPhysical(): boolean {
    // Draw simple Windows drive letters (e.g. "C:") with blue styling
    const lbl = this.segments[0]?.label || '';
    return this.isWin && /^[A-Za-z]:$/.test(lbl);
  }

  showCurrentSchemeSeparator(): boolean {
    return this.isSchemeRoot || this.isCurrentRootSynthetic() || this.isCurrentRootPhysical();
  }

  currentSchemeLabel(): string {
    const drive = this.findCurrentRootEntry();
    if (this.showCurrentSchemeSeparator()) {
      if (this.isCurrentRootPhysical()) {
        const rawPhysical = this.segments[0]?.label || drive?.name || '';
        return rawPhysical.replace(/\s*:\s*$/, '');
      }

      const path = drive?.path || '';
      const match = /^([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*):\/\//i.exec(path);
      if (match) return match[1].toLowerCase();

      const raw = this.segments[0]?.label || drive?.name || '';
      return raw.replace(/\s*:\s*$/, '');
    }
    if (!drive) {
      return this.segments[0]?.label || '';
    }
    // For Windows drive, show drive letter (e.g. 'C:')
    return this.segments[0]?.label || drive.name;
  }

  currentSchemeIcon(): string | null {
    const drive = this.findCurrentRootEntry();
    if (!drive || !this.isCurrentRootSynthetic()) return null;

    if (drive.schemeType === 'memory') return '🧠';
    if (drive.schemeType === 'registry') return '🧩';
    if (drive.schemeType === 'search') return '🔎';
    if (drive.schemeType === 'http') return '🌐';
    if (drive.schemeType === 'https') return '🔒';
    if (drive.schemeType === 'smb') return '🖧';
    if (drive.schemeType === 's3') return '🪣';
    return null;
  }

  // ── Segment click handlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  onSegClick(seg: PathSegment, e: MouseEvent): void {
    e.stopPropagation();
    this.closeAll();
    seg.fullPath !== this.currentPath ? this.navigateTo(seg.fullPath) : this.enterEditMode();
  }

  getSegmentLabelParts(seg: PathSegment): { main: string; ext?: string } {
    if (!seg) return { main: '' };
    const cleaned  = (seg.fullPath || seg.label || '').replace(/\/+$/, '');
    const lastPart = cleaned.split('/').pop() || seg.label || '';
    const idx = lastPart.lastIndexOf('.');
    if (idx > 0 && idx < lastPart.length - 1) {
      return { main: lastPart.slice(0, idx), ext: lastPart.slice(idx) };
    }
    return { main: lastPart };
  }

  onArchiveInnerSegClick(seg: PathSegment, isLast: boolean, e: MouseEvent): void {
    if (isLast) { this.enterEditMode(); return; }
    e.stopPropagation();
    this.closeAll();
    this.navigateTo(seg.fullPath);
  }

  onArchiveRootSegClick(seg: PathSegment, isLast: boolean, e: MouseEvent): void {
    if (isLast) { this.enterEditMode(); return; }
    e.stopPropagation();
    this.closeAll();
    this.navigateTo(seg.fullPath);
  }

  onSchemeClick(seg: PathSegment, isLast: boolean, e: MouseEvent): void {
    // Scheme root always opens the scheme switcher — even when at the root.
    // Unlike regular segments, there is no useful "edit the last crumb" behaviour.
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (this.showSchemeMenu) { this.showSchemeMenu = false; return; }
    this.closeAll();
    this.schemeAnchorEl = e.currentTarget as HTMLElement;
    this.showSchemeMenu = true;
    if (this.schemes.length === 0 && !this.schemesLoading) this.loadSchemes();
  }

  onCrumbsClick(e: MouseEvent): void {
    const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
    if (target?.closest('.ab-seg, .ab-chev, .ab-scheme-chevron')) {
      return;
    }

    e.stopPropagation();
    this.enterEditMode();
  }

  private setupWheelScroll(): void {
    const el = this.crumbsEl?.nativeElement;
    if (!el) return;
    this.wheelListener = (e: WheelEvent) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const delta = e.deltaY || e.deltaX;
      this.animateScrollBy(el, delta * 1.4);
    };
    el.addEventListener('wheel', this.wheelListener, { passive: false });
  }

  onCtxMenuOpenChange(open: boolean): void {
    if (!open) {
      this.closeCtx();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Smoothly scroll the crumbs bar to its rightmost position.
   * Uses a short ease-out animation so new path segments slide into view
   * rather than snapping. Cancels any in-flight animation first.
   */
  private animateScrollToEnd(): void {
    const el = this.crumbsEl?.nativeElement;
    if (!el) return;
    const target = el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth;
    if (target <= 0) return;
    this.animateScrollTo(el, target);
  }

  /**
   * Animate scrollLeft from current position to `target` in ~120 ms (ease-out).
   */
  private animateScrollTo(el: HTMLElement, target: number): void {
    if (this.scrollAnimFrame !== null) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.scrollAnimFrame);
      this.scrollAnimFrame = null;
    }

    const start     = el.scrollLeft;
    const distance  = target - start;
    if (Math.abs(distance) < 1) return;

    const duration  = Math.min(220, Math.max(160, Math.abs(distance) * 0.3)); // 60-220 ms
    const startTime = performance.now();

    const tick = (now: number) => {
      const elapsed  = now - startTime;
      const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
      // Ease-out cubic: fast start, gentle finish
      const eased    = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
      el.scrollLeft  = start + distance * eased;

      if (progress < 1) {
        this.scrollAnimFrame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        this.scrollAnimFrame = null;
      }
    };

    this.scrollAnimFrame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  /**
   * Animate a scroll-by delta from the current position — used by wheel events
   * for a smooth, momentum-like feel without OS-level momentum scrolling.
   */
  private animateScrollBy(el: HTMLElement, delta: number): void {
    const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(el.scrollWidth - el.clientWidth, el.scrollLeft + delta));
    this.animateScrollTo(el, target);
  }

  // ── Scheme handling ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  switchToScheme(drive: DriveInfo): void {
    this.showSchemeMenu = false;
    const raw = (drive.path || drive.name || '').toString();
    const normalized = normalizePath(raw);
    let target = normalized;

    // For UNC, keep/share root form (//server/share).
    if (normalized.startsWith('//')) {
      const parts = normalized.split('/').filter(Boolean);
      target = parts.length >= 2 ? `//${parts[0]}/${parts[1]}` : normalized;
    }

    if (target && !samePath(target, this.currentPath)) this.navigateTo(target);
  }

  async loadSchemes(): Promise<void> {
    this.schemesLoading = true;
    try { 
      const schemesList = await this.apiService.getDrives();
      this.schemes = schemesList?.schemes || [];
    } catch {
      this.schemes = [];
    } finally { 
      this.schemesLoading = false; 
      this.cdr.detectChanges(); 
    }
  }

  // ── Chevron / siblings ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async toggleChev(idx: number, seg: PathSegment, e: MouseEvent): Promise<void> {
    e.stopPropagation();
    this.showSchemeMenu = false;

    if (this.chevIdx === idx) {
      this.closeSiblingStream();
      this.chevIdx = -1; this.sibOpen = false; this.siblings = [];
      return;
    }

    this.closeSiblingStream();
    this.sibAnchorEl = e.currentTarget as HTMLElement;
    this.chevIdx    = idx;
    this.siblings   = [];
    this.sibLoading = true;

    const activeChildPath = idx + 1 < this.segments.length ? this.segments[idx + 1].fullPath : null;

    if (seg.isArchiveRoot || seg.isArchiveInner) {
      try {
        await this.loadArchiveSiblings(seg, activeChildPath);
      } catch {
        this.siblings = [];
        this.sibLoading = false;
        this.cdr.detectChanges();
        this.sibOpen = true;
      }
      return;
    }

    if (!this.directorySource.supportsStreaming(seg.fullPath)) {
      try {
        const listing = await this.directorySource.listDirectory(seg.fullPath, false);
        this.siblings = (listing.entries || [])
          .filter((entry) => entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY)
          .map((entry) => ({
            name: entry.name,
            path: entry.path,
            isCurrent: samePath(entry.path, activeChildPath),
          }))
          .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
      } catch {
        this.siblings = [];
      } finally {
        this.sibLoading = false;
        this.sibOpen = true;
        this.cdr.detectChanges();
      }
      return;
    }

    // Stream directory contents progressively
    let streamId: string;
    try {
      streamId = await this.apiService.startListDirectoryStream(this.sibPaneId, seg.fullPath, false);
    } catch {
      this.siblings = [];
      this.sibLoading = false;
      this.cdr.detectChanges();
      this.sibOpen = true;
      return;
    }
    this.activeSibStreamId = streamId;

    const offBatch = EventsOn('fs:listStream:batch', (ev: any) => {
      if (ev?.streamId !== streamId) return;
      for (const entry of (ev.entries as FileInfo[] || [])) {
        if (entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) continue;
        this.siblings.push({ name: entry.name, path: entry.path, isCurrent: samePath(entry.path, activeChildPath) });
      }
      this.siblings = this.siblings.slice().sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
      if (this.sibLoading) { this.sibLoading = false; this.sibOpen = true; }
      this.cdr.detectChanges();
    });

    const offDone = EventsOn('fs:listStream:done', (ev: any) => {
      if (ev?.streamId !== streamId) return;
      offBatch(); offDone(); offError();
      this.sibStreamOff = [];
      if (this.activeSibStreamId === streamId) this.activeSibStreamId = null;
      this.sibLoading = false;
      if (!this.sibOpen) this.sibOpen = true;
      this.cdr.detectChanges();
    });

    const offError = EventsOn('fs:listStream:error', (ev: any) => {
      if (ev?.streamId !== streamId) return;
      offBatch(); offDone(); offError();
      this.sibStreamOff = [];
      if (this.activeSibStreamId === streamId) this.activeSibStreamId = null;
      this.sibLoading = false;
      if (!this.sibOpen) this.sibOpen = true;
      this.cdr.detectChanges();
    });

    this.sibStreamOff = [offBatch, offDone, offError];
  }

  private async loadArchiveSiblings(seg: PathSegment, activeChildPath: string | null): Promise<void> {
    const { fsDirPath, archiveInnerParts } = parsePathWithArchives(this.currentPath);
    if (!archiveInnerParts.length) { this.sibLoading = false; return; }

    const syntheticStack: ArchiveFrame[] = [{
      fsPath: fsDirPath, nestedChain: [],
      innerPath: archiveInnerParts.join('/'),
      listing: { archivePath: fsDirPath, innerPath: archiveInnerParts.join('/'), entries: [] },
    }];

    const target = this.directorySource.resolveArchiveBrowseTarget(
      { name: seg.label, fullPath: seg.fullPath }, syntheticStack,
    );
    if (!target) { this.sibLoading = false; return; }

    try {
      const listing = await this.directorySource.navigateArchive(
        { ...target.frame, nestedChain: target.browseChain }, target.browseInnerPath,
      );
      const activeChildVirtual = activeChildPath?.replace(/\\/g, '/') ?? null;
      const fsPath = fsDirPath.replace(/\\/g, '/');

      this.siblings = listing.listing.entries
        .filter(e => e.type === FileType.DIRECTORY || e.type === FileType.ARCHIVE || isArchive(e.name))
        .map(e => {
          const sibInnerPath = target.browseInnerPath ? `${target.browseInnerPath}/${e.name}` : e.name;
          const chainPart    = target.browseChain.length ? `/${target.browseChain.join('/')}` : '';
          const virtualPath  = `${fsPath}${chainPart}/${sibInnerPath}`.replace(/\/+/g, '/');
          return {
            name: e.name, path: virtualPath,
            isArchive: e.type === FileType.ARCHIVE || isArchive(e.name),
            isCurrent: activeChildVirtual
              ? activeChildVirtual === virtualPath ||
                activeChildVirtual.startsWith(virtualPath + '/') ||
                activeChildVirtual.endsWith('/' + e.name)
              : false,
          } as SiblingEntry;
        })
        .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    } catch {
      this.siblings = [];
    } finally {
      this.sibLoading = false;
      this.cdr.detectChanges();
    }
  }

  onSibClick(s: SiblingEntry): void {
    this.chevIdx  = -1;
    this.siblings = [];
    this.navigateTo(s.path);
  }

  onSibOpenChange(open: boolean): void {
    this.sibOpen = open;
    if (!open) {
      this.closeSiblingStream();
      this.chevIdx = -1;
      this.siblings = [];
    }
  }

  private closeSiblingStream(): void {
    this.sibStreamOff.forEach(f => f());
    this.sibStreamOff = [];
    if (this.activeSibStreamId) {
      void this.apiService.cancelListDirectoryStream(this.activeSibStreamId);
      this.activeSibStreamId = null;
    }
  }

  // ── Pins ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private async loadSpecialFolders(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.specialFolders = await this.apiService.getSpecialFolders();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load special folders:', error);
      this.specialFolders = [];
    }
  }

  togglePin(): void {
    if (this.isPinned) {
      this.pinnedLocations = this.pinnedLocationService.remove(this.pinnedLocations, this.currentPath, this.surfaceId);
    } else {
      const pin = this.pinnedLocationService.create(this.currentPath, undefined, undefined, Date.now(), this.surfaceId);
      if (pin) this.pinnedLocations = [...this.pinnedLocations, pin];
    }
    this.pinnedLocationService.save(this.pinnedLocations);
  }

  toggleQuickAccess(): void {
    this.openQuickAccess(null, !this.showQuickAccess);
  }

  private openQuickAccess(preferredSectionTitle: string | null, toggleWhenSame = false): void {
    const samePreference = this.quickAccessPreferredSection === preferredSectionTitle;
    if (toggleWhenSame && samePreference) {
      this.showQuickAccess = !this.showQuickAccess;
    } else {
      this.showQuickAccess = true;
    }

    this.quickAccessPreferredSection = preferredSectionTitle;
    if (this.showQuickAccess) {
      this.chevIdx = -1;
      this.showSchemeMenu = false;
    }
  }


  async renamePin(pin: PinnedLocation): Promise<void> {
    const nextLabel = await this.confirmDialog.prompt({
      title: pin.scheme === 'search' ? 'Rename Saved Search' : 'Rename Pinned Location',
      message: 'Choose a name for this pinned location.',
      defaultValue: pin.label,
      placeholder: pin.label,
      confirmText: 'Rename',
    });
    if (!nextLabel?.trim()) return;

    this.pinnedLocations = this.pinnedLocationService.rename(this.pinnedLocations, pin.id, nextLabel);
    this.pinnedLocationService.save(this.pinnedLocations);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  removePin(pin: PinnedLocation, e?: MouseEvent): void {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    this.pinnedLocations = this.pinnedLocationService.remove(this.pinnedLocations, pin.location, pin.surfaceId);
    this.pinnedLocationService.save(this.pinnedLocations);
  }

  openPinnedLocation(pin: PinnedLocation): void {
    this.showQuickAccess = false;
    if ((pin.surfaceId || 'dir') === this.surfaceId) {
      this.navigateTo(pin.location);
      return;
    }
    this.pinnedLocationOpen.emit(pin);
  }

  isSegmentPinned(seg: PathSegment | null): boolean {
    return !!seg && this.pinnedLocationService.isPinned(this.pinnedLocations, seg.fullPath);
  }

  // ── Edit mode ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  enterEditMode(): void {
    this.closeAll();
    this.editMode    = true;
    this.cdr.detectChanges();
  }

  exitEditMode(commit: boolean): void {
    this.editMode    = false;
    if (commit) {
      // commit is now handled by onEditCommit
    }
  }

  onEditCommit(path: string): void {
    this.exitEditMode(false);
    const np = normalizePath(path);
    if (np && !samePath(np, this.currentPath)) this.navigateTo(np);
  }

  // ── Context menu ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  onSegRightClick(seg: PathSegment, idx: number, e: MouseEvent): void {
    e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
    this.closeAll();
    this.ctxAnchorEl = e.currentTarget as HTMLElement;
    this.ctxMenu = { visible: true, segmentIndex: idx, segment: seg };
  }

  ctxNavigateTo(): void   { if (this.ctxMenu.segment) this.navigateTo(this.ctxMenu.segment.fullPath); this.closeCtx(); }
  async ctxCopyPath(): Promise<void> { if (this.ctxMenu.segment) await navigator.clipboard.writeText(this.ctxMenu.segment.fullPath).catch(() => {}); this.closeCtx(); }
  async ctxCopyName(): Promise<void> { if (this.ctxMenu.segment) await navigator.clipboard.writeText(this.ctxMenu.segment.label).catch(() => {}); this.closeCtx(); }
  ctxOpenOtherPane(): void { if (this.ctxMenu.segment) this.openInOtherPane.emit(this.ctxMenu.segment.fullPath); this.closeCtx(); }

  ctxPinPath(): void {
    const seg = this.ctxMenu.segment;
    if (!seg) { this.closeCtx(); return; }
    if (this.pinnedLocationService.isPinned(this.pinnedLocations, seg.fullPath)) {
      this.pinnedLocations = this.pinnedLocationService.remove(this.pinnedLocations, seg.fullPath);
    } else {
      const pin = this.pinnedLocationService.create(seg.fullPath, seg.label);
      if (pin) this.pinnedLocations = [...this.pinnedLocations, pin];
    }
    this.pinnedLocationService.save(this.pinnedLocations);
    this.closeCtx();
  }

  private closeCtx(): void { this.ctxMenu = { ...CTX_MENU_CLOSED }; this.ctxAnchorEl = null; }

  // ── Navigation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  goUp(): void {
    this.navigateUpClicked.emit();
  }

  refresh(): void { this.refreshClicked.emit(); }

  async copyPath(): Promise<void> {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(this.currentPath).catch(() => {});
    clearTimeout(this.copiedTimer);
    this.justCopied = true;
    this.copiedTimer = setTimeout(() => { this.justCopied = false; this.cdr.detectChanges(); }, 1800);
  }

  navigateTo(p: string): void {
    const np = normalizePath(p);
    this.closeAll();
    if (samePath(np, this.currentPath)) return;

    this.currentPath = np;
    this.rebuildSegments();
    this.pathChange.emit(np);
  }

  // ── Close all overlays ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  private closeAll(): void {
    this.chevIdx       = -1;
    this.sibOpen       = false;
    this.siblings      = [];
    this.showQuickAccess = false;
    this.quickAccessPreferredSection = null;
    this.showSchemeMenu = false;
    this.closeCtx();
  }

  // ── Outside-click / keyboard ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  onHostKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'l') { e.preventDefault(); this.enterEditMode(); }
    if (e.altKey && e.key === 'd')                  { e.preventDefault(); this.enterEditMode(); }
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'q') { e.preventDefault(); this.toggleQuickAccess(); }
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'b') { e.preventDefault(); this.openQuickAccess('Pinned'); }
  }

  @HostListener('document:keydown', ['$event'])
  onDocKey(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
    if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
    if (this.ctxMenu.visible)                                                        { this.closeCtx();         e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (this.editMode)                                                          { this.exitEditMode(false); e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (this.chevIdx >= 0 || this.showQuickAccess || this.showSchemeMenu) { this.closeAll();          e.preventDefault(); }
  }
}
````

````typescript
export type InputContextKind = 'global' | 'pane' | 'dialog' | 'overlay' | 'widget';

export type InputSourceKind = 'default' | 'workspace' | 'user' | 'plugin';

export type InputDeviceKind = 'keyboard' | 'mouse';

export interface KeyStroke {
  key: string;
  modifiers?: Array<'ctrl' | 'shift' | 'alt' | 'meta'>;
}

export interface KeyChord {
  steps: KeyStroke[];
}

export interface MouseGesture {
  type:
    | 'click'
    | 'doubleClick'
    | 'mousedown'
    | 'mouseup'
    | 'drag'
    | 'wheel';
  button?: 'left' | 'middle' | 'right';
  modifiers?: Array<'ctrl' | 'shift' | 'alt' | 'meta'>;
  direction?: 'up' | 'down' | 'left' | 'right';
}

export type InputTrigger =
  | { device: 'keyboard'; chord: KeyChord }
  | { device: 'mouse'; gesture: MouseGesture };

export interface InputContextDefinition {
  id: string;
  kind: InputContextKind;
  priority: number;
  parentId?: string;
  description: string;
}

export interface InputBindingDefinition {
  id: string;
  commandId: string;
  trigger: InputTrigger;
  contextId: string;
  source: InputSourceKind;
  priority?: number;
  when?: string;
  description: string;
  /** Display category used by the keybinding editor (e.g. 'Navigation', 'File Operations'). */
  category?: string;
  /** Runtime enable/disable state reflected in snapshots. */
  enabled?: boolean;
  preventDefault?: boolean;
  stopPropagation?: boolean;
}

export interface CommandDefinition {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  category?: string;
  icon?: string;
  /** Canonical human-facing name used by interactive invocation surfaces. */
  name?: string;
  /** Additional human-facing names. Keep aliases globally unambiguous. */
  aliases?: string[];
  /** Only show in command palette when these contexts are active. Empty = always show. */
  contextIds?: string[];
}

export type CommandInvocationSource =
  | 'keyboard'
  | 'mouse'
  | 'palette'
  | 'toolbar'
  | 'context-menu'
  | 'console'
  | 'api'
  | 'programmatic';

export type CommandArguments = Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;

/** Structured command invocation shared by every execution surface. */
export interface CommandInvocation {
  source: CommandInvocationSource;
  args?: CommandArguments;
  context?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

export type InputCommandHandler = (invocation?: CommandInvocation) => void | Promise<void>;

/**
 * Runtime command descriptor. Keeps discoverable command metadata and execution
 * together while allowing availability to stay context-driven.
 */
export interface CommandDescriptor extends CommandDefinition {
  execute: InputCommandHandler;
  isEnabled?: (invocation?: CommandInvocation) => boolean;
}

export interface CommandState extends CommandDefinition {
  enabled: boolean;
  registered: boolean;
}

/** Normalized command metadata for discovery UIs such as the palette or console. */
export interface CommandCatalogEntry extends CommandState {
  preferredBinding?: InputBindingDefinition;
}

/**
 * An owned plugin input bundle. Commands, contexts, and default bindings are
 * registered and removed together under pluginId.
 */
export interface PluginInputContribution {
  pluginId: string;
  commands: CommandDescriptor[];
  contexts?: InputContextDefinition[];
  bindings?: InputBindingDefinition[];
}


export interface DialogBindingCatalogEntry {
  context: InputContextDefinition;
  bindings: InputBindingDefinition[];
}

export interface BindingResolution {
  binding: InputBindingDefinition;
  score: {
    contextPriority: number;
    sourcePriority: number;
    bindingPriority: number;
  };
}
````

````typescript
import { LEGACY_PINNED_PATHS_KEY, PINNED_LOCATIONS_KEY } from '../components/address-bar.types';
import { PinnedLocationService } from './pinned-location.service';

describe('PinnedLocationService', () => {
  let service: PinnedLocationService;

  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
    service = new PinnedLocationService();
  });

  it('classifies searches as query locations', () => {
    const pin = service.create('search://?path=/src&pattern=TODO&contentSearch=true');
    expect(pin?.scheme).toBe('search');
    expect(pin?.kind).toBe('query');
    expect(pin?.location).toContain('pattern=TODO');
  });

  it('classifies ordinary paths as filesystem locations', () => {
    const pin = service.create('/home/user/projects');
    expect(pin?.scheme).toBe('filesystem');
    expect(pin?.kind).toBe('location');
  });

  it('migrates legacy pinned paths', () => {
    localStorage.setItem(LEGACY_PINNED_PATHS_KEY, JSON.stringify([{
      path: '/home/user/projects',
      label: 'Projects',
      icon: '📁',
      addedAt: 123,
    }]));

    const pins = service.load();
    expect(pins).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(pins[0].label).toBe('Projects');
    expect(pins[0].location).toContain('/home/user/projects');
    expect(localStorage.getItem(PINNED_LOCATIONS_KEY)).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('uses canonical identity for filesystem pins', () => {
    const pin = service.create('/home/user/projects');
    expect(pin).not.toBeNull();
    expect(service.isPinned([pin!], '/home/user/projects')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('persists semantic surface identity without storing runtime instances', () => {
    const pin = service.create('search://?path=/src&pattern=TODO', undefined, undefined, 123, 'search-results');
    expect(pin?.surfaceId).toBe('search-results');
    expect(pin?.id).toContain('|surface:search-results');

    service.save([pin!]);
    const [restored] = service.load();
    expect(restored.surfaceId).toBe('search-results');
    expect(restored.location).toBe(pin?.location);
  });

  it('allows the same durable location to be pinned for different surfaces', () => {
    const location = 'search://?path=/src&pattern=TODO';
    const dirPin = service.create(location, undefined, undefined, 1, 'dir')!;
    const resultsPin = service.create(location, undefined, undefined, 2, 'search-results')!;

    expect(dirPin.id).not.toBe(resultsPin.id);
    expect(service.isPinned([dirPin, resultsPin], location, 'dir')).toBe(true);
    expect(service.isPinned([dirPin, resultsPin], location, 'search-results')).toBe(true);
    expect(service.remove([dirPin, resultsPin], location, 'dir')).toEqual([resultsPin]);
  });

  it('infers surface identity from surface:// locations', () => {
    const pin = service.create('surface://console/session/main');
    expect(pin?.kind).toBe('surface');
    expect(pin?.surfaceId).toBe('console');
  });


  it('uses the dedicated search-results surface for search pins', () => {
    const pin = service.create('search://?path=/src&pattern=TODO');
    expect(pin?.surfaceId).toBe('search-results');
  });


  it('migrates search pins that were previously stored as dir surfaces', () => {
    localStorage.setItem(PINNED_LOCATIONS_KEY, JSON.stringify([{
      id: 'legacy-search', location: 'search://?path=/src&pattern=TODO', scheme: 'search', kind: 'query',
      surfaceId: 'dir', label: 'TODO', icon: '🔎', addedAt: 1,
    }]));
    const [pin] = service.load();
    expect(pin.surfaceId).toBe('search-results');
  });

  it('renames a saved pin without changing its durable identity', () => {
    const pin = service.create('search://?path=/src&pattern=TODO')!;
    const [renamed] = service.rename([pin], pin.id, 'TODO in source');
    expect(renamed.id).toBe(pin.id);
    expect(renamed.location).toBe(pin.location);
    expect(renamed.label).toBe('TODO in source');
  });

  it('derives search context from the query base path', () => {
    expect(service.contextLocation('search://?path=/src/features&pattern=TODO')).toContain('/src/features');
  });


});
````

````typescript
import { Injectable } from '@angular/core';
import {
  LEGACY_PINNED_PATHS_KEY,
  PINNED_LOCATIONS_KEY,
  PinnedLocation,
} from '../components/address-bar.types';
import {
  canonicalizeLocation,
  kindOfLocation,
  locationIcon,
  locationIdentity,
  locationLabel,
  schemeOfLocation,
} from './location-reference';

interface LegacyPinnedPath {
  path: string;
  label?: string;
  icon?: string;
  addedAt?: number;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class PinnedLocationService {
  load(): PinnedLocation[] {
    const current = this.read<PinnedLocation[]>(PINNED_LOCATIONS_KEY);
    if (current) return current.map(pin => this.normalizeStoredPin(pin)).filter((pin): pin is PinnedLocation => !!pin);

    const legacy = this.read<LegacyPinnedPath[]>(LEGACY_PINNED_PATHS_KEY) ?? [];
    const migrated = legacy
      .map(pin => this.create(pin.path, pin.label, pin.icon, pin.addedAt))
      .filter((pin): pin is PinnedLocation => !!pin);

    if (migrated.length > 0) this.save(migrated);
    return migrated;
  }

  save(pins: readonly PinnedLocation[]): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(PINNED_LOCATIONS_KEY, JSON.stringify(pins));
    } catch {
      // Pinning is a convenience feature; storage failures must not break navigation.
    }
  }

  create(
    location: string,
    label?: string,
    icon?: string,
    addedAt = Date.now(),
    surfaceId?: string,
  ): PinnedLocation | null {
    const canonical = this.canonicalize(location);
    if (!canonical) return null;
    const scheme = schemeOfLocation(canonical);
    const resolvedSurfaceId = this.resolveSurfaceId(canonical, surfaceId);
    return {
      id: this.identity(canonical, resolvedSurfaceId),
      location: canonical,
      scheme,
      kind: kindOfLocation(scheme),
      surfaceId: resolvedSurfaceId,
      label: label?.trim() || locationLabel(canonical),
      icon: icon?.trim() || locationIcon(scheme),
      addedAt,
    };
  }

  isPinned(pins: readonly PinnedLocation[], location: string, surfaceId?: string): boolean {
    const canonical = this.canonicalize(location);
    if (!canonical) return false;
    const id = this.identity(canonical, this.resolveSurfaceId(canonical, surfaceId));
    return pins.some(pin => pin.id === id);
  }

  remove(pins: readonly PinnedLocation[], location: string, surfaceId?: string): PinnedLocation[] {
    const canonical = this.canonicalize(location);
    if (!canonical) return [...pins];
    const id = this.identity(canonical, this.resolveSurfaceId(canonical, surfaceId));
    return pins.filter(pin => pin.id !== id);
  }

  schemeOf(location: string): string {
    return schemeOfLocation(location);
  }

  rename(pins: readonly PinnedLocation[], pinId: string, label: string): PinnedLocation[] {
    const nextLabel = label.trim();
    if (!nextLabel) return [...pins];
    return pins.map(pin => pin.id === pinId ? { ...pin, label: nextLabel } : pin);
  }

  contextLocation(location: string): string | null {
    const canonical = this.canonicalize(location);
    if (!canonical) return null;
    if (schemeOfLocation(canonical) !== 'search') return canonical;

    try {
      const query = canonical.slice('search://'.length);
      const params = new URLSearchParams(query.startsWith('?') ? query.slice(1) : query);
      const base = params.get('path')?.trim();
      return base ? this.canonicalize(base) : null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  private canonicalize(location: string): string {
    return canonicalizeLocation(location);
  }

  private normalizeStoredPin(pin: PinnedLocation): PinnedLocation | null {
    if (!pin || typeof pin.location !== 'string') return null;
    return this.create(
      pin.location,
      pin.label,
      pin.icon,
      Number(pin.addedAt) || Date.now(),
      typeof pin.surfaceId === 'string' && !(schemeOfLocation(pin.location) === 'search' && pin.surfaceId === 'dir')
        ? pin.surfaceId
        : undefined,
    );
  }


  private identity(location: string, surfaceId: string): string {
    return `${locationIdentity(location)}|surface:${surfaceId}`;
  }

  private resolveSurfaceId(location: string, surfaceId?: string): string {
    const explicit = surfaceId?.trim();
    if (explicit) return explicit;

    if (schemeOfLocation(location) === 'search') return 'search-results';
    if (kindOfLocation(location) !== 'surface') return 'dir';

    try {
      const parsed = new URL(location);
      const fromHost = parsed.hostname.trim();
      if (fromHost) return fromHost;
      const fromPath = parsed.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean)[0]?.trim();
      if (fromPath) return fromPath;
    } catch {}

    return 'dir';
  }

  private read<T>(key: string): T | null {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) as T : null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
}
````

````typescript
const STORAGE_KEY = 'project-settings-v1';

interface SettingsDialogRequest {
  resolve: (value: boolean) => void;
  initialTab?: SettingsTab;
}

interface BackendUserPreferences {
  theme?: string;
  accentColor?: string;
  uiZoom?: number;
  compactMode?: boolean;
  animationsEnabled?: boolean;
  confirmOnClose?: boolean;
  reopenLastWorkspace?: boolean;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

const APPEARANCE_CACHE_KEY = 'app-appearance-v1';

interface CachedAppearance {
  theme?: GeneralSettings['theme'];
  accentColor?: string;
  uiZoom?: number;
  compactMode?: boolean;
  animationsEnabled?: boolean;
}

function readAppearanceCache(): CachedAppearance {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(APPEARANCE_CACHE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return {};
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as CachedAppearance;
    return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function writeAppearanceCache(value: CachedAppearance): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(APPEARANCE_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(value));
  } catch {
    // Ignore storage errors
  }
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SettingsService {
  private settings$ = createBehaviorSubject<ProjectSettings>(this.loadSettings());
  private activeRequest$ = createBehaviorSubject<SettingsDialogRequest | null>(null);
  private backendPreferences: BackendUserPreferences | null = null;

  constructor() {
    void this.loadBackendPreferences();
  }

  readonly settings: Stream<ProjectSettings> = this.settings$;
  readonly currentSettings = this.settings$.value;

  getSettings$(): Stream<ProjectSettings> {
    return this.settings$;
  }

  getSettings(): ProjectSettings {
    return this.settings$.value;
  }

  updateSettings(settings: Partial<ProjectSettings>): void {
    const current = this.settings$.value;
    const merged: ProjectSettings = {
      general: { ...current.general, ...settings.general },
      files: { ...current.files, ...settings.files },
      editor: { ...current.editor, ...settings.editor },
      view: { ...current.view, ...settings.view },
      advanced: { ...current.advanced, ...settings.advanced },
    };
    this.settings$.next(merged);
    this.saveSettings(merged);
  }

  updateGeneralSettings(settings: Partial<GeneralSettings>): void {
    this.updateSettings({ general: { ...this.settings$.value.general, ...settings } });
  }

  updateFileSettings(settings: Partial<FileSettings>): void {
    this.updateSettings({ files: { ...this.settings$.value.files, ...settings } });
  }

  updateEditorSettings(settings: Partial<EditorSettings>): void {
    this.updateSettings({ editor: { ...this.settings$.value.editor, ...settings } });
  }

  updateViewSettings(settings: Partial<ViewSettings>): void {
    this.updateSettings({ view: { ...this.settings$.value.view, ...settings } });
  }

  updateAdvancedSettings(settings: Partial<AdvancedSettings>): void {
    this.updateSettings({ advanced: { ...this.settings$.value.advanced, ...settings } });
  }

  resetToDefaults(): void {
    this.settings$.next(DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
    this.saveSettings(DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
  }

  resetSection(section: keyof ProjectSettings): void {
    const current = this.settings$.value;
    const updated = { ...current, [section]: DEFAULT_SETTINGS[section] };
    this.settings$.next(updated);
    this.saveSettings(updated);
  }

  openSettings(initialTab?: SettingsTab): Promise<boolean> {
    return new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
      this.activeRequest$.next({
        resolve,
        initialTab,
      });
    });
  }

  closeSettings(confirmed: boolean): void {
    const request = this.activeRequest$.value;
    if (request) {
      request.resolve(confirmed);
      this.activeRequest$.next(null);
    }
  }

  getActiveRequest$(): Stream<SettingsDialogRequest | null> {
    return this.activeRequest$;
  }

  private loadSettings(): ProjectSettings {
    let result = DEFAULT_SETTINGS;
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (stored) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(stored) as Partial<ProjectSettings>;
        result = this.mergeWithDefaults(parsed);
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore parse errors
    }

    writeAppearanceCache({
      theme: result.general.theme,
      accentColor: result.general.accentColor,
      uiZoom: result.general.uiZoom,
      compactMode: result.view.compactMode,
      animationsEnabled: result.view.animationsEnabled,
    });
    return result;
  }

  private saveSettings(settings: ProjectSettings): void {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(settings));
    } catch {
      // Ignore storage errors
    }

    void this.syncBackendPreferences(settings);
  }

  private async loadBackendPreferences(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const preferences = await GetPreferences() as unknown as BackendUserPreferences;
      this.backendPreferences = preferences;

      const current = this.settings$.value;
      const themeValue = this.coerceTheme(preferences.theme, current.general.theme);
      const accentColor = typeof preferences.accentColor === 'string'
        ? preferences.accentColor
        : current.general.accentColor;
      const uiZoom = typeof preferences.uiZoom === 'number' && preferences.uiZoom > 0
        ? preferences.uiZoom
        : current.general.uiZoom;
      const compactMode = typeof preferences.compactMode === 'boolean'
        ? preferences.compactMode
        : current.view.compactMode;
      const animationsEnabled = typeof preferences.animationsEnabled === 'boolean'
        ? preferences.animationsEnabled
        : current.view.animationsEnabled;

      const merged: ProjectSettings = {
        ...current,
        general: {
          ...current.general,
          theme: themeValue,
          accentColor,
          uiZoom,
          confirmOnClose: typeof preferences.confirmOnClose === 'boolean'
            ? preferences.confirmOnClose
            : current.general.confirmOnClose,
          reopenLastWorkspace: typeof preferences.reopenLastWorkspace === 'boolean'
            ? preferences.reopenLastWorkspace
            : current.general.reopenLastWorkspace,
        },
        view: {
          ...current.view,
          compactMode,
          animationsEnabled,
        },
      };

      this.settings$.next(merged);
      writeAppearanceCache({
        theme: merged.general.theme,
        accentColor: merged.general.accentColor,
        uiZoom: merged.general.uiZoom,
        compactMode: merged.view.compactMode,
        animationsEnabled: merged.view.animationsEnabled,
      });
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(merged));
      } catch {
        // Ignore storage errors
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore backend availability errors during bootstrap.
    }
  }

  private async syncBackendPreferences(settings: ProjectSettings): Promise<void> {
    writeAppearanceCache({
      theme: settings.general.theme,
      accentColor: settings.general.accentColor,
      uiZoom: settings.general.uiZoom,
      compactMode: settings.view.compactMode,
      animationsEnabled: settings.view.animationsEnabled,
    });

    try {
      const current = this.backendPreferences ?? await GetPreferences() as unknown as BackendUserPreferences;
      this.backendPreferences = current;

      await SavePreferences({
        ...current,
        theme: settings.general.theme,
        accentColor: settings.general.accentColor,
        uiZoom: settings.general.uiZoom,
        compactMode: settings.view.compactMode,
        animationsEnabled: settings.view.animationsEnabled,
        confirmOnClose: settings.general.confirmOnClose,
        reopenLastWorkspace: settings.general.reopenLastWorkspace,
      } as any);
    } catch {
      // Ignore backend sync errors during early startup or tests.
    }
  }

  private coerceTheme(value: unknown, fallback: GeneralSettings['theme']): GeneralSettings['theme'] {
    return value === 'dark' || value === 'light' || value === 'system' ? value : fallback;
  }

  private mergeWithDefaults(stored: Partial<ProjectSettings>): ProjectSettings {
    const files = { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.files, ...stored.files };
    if (files.defaultOpenAction !== 'edit' && files.defaultOpenAction !== 'external') {
      files.defaultOpenAction = 'external';
    }

    return {
      general: { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.general, ...stored.general },
      files,
      editor: { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.editor, ...stored.editor },
      view: { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.view, ...stored.view },
      advanced: { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.advanced, ...stored.advanced },
    };
  }
}
````

````typescript
// Re-export everything from the base protocol so consumers only need one import.
export * from './protocol';

// Quick Access / Special Folders

export type LocationKind = 'location' | 'query' | 'surface';

  location: string;
  scheme: string;
  kind: LocationKind;
}

export interface TabInfo {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  path: string;
  /** Canonical durable navigation target. Legacy workspaces may omit this and fall back to path. */
  location?: LocationReference;
  /** Stable rendered surface id. Legacy workspaces may omit this and fall back to kind. */
  surfaceId?: string;
  /** "dir" (default), "viewer", or "size-manager". Old persisted workspaces omit this field. */
  kind?: 'dir' | 'viewer' | 'size-manager';
  /** Viewer tab payload; only meaningful when kind === 'viewer'. */
  viewer?: {
    /** Absolute filesystem path to the viewed file (initially FS-only). */
    targetPath: string;
    /** Sibling filesystem files from the source pane, used for viewer next/previous navigation. */
    fileList?: ViewerFileListItem[];
    /** Optional explicit viewer selection override. */
    viewerId?: string;
    /** When true, this tab's target auto-follows selection in dir tabs. */
    autoFollow?: boolean;
    /** Origin of this preview (used to restore cursor when switching previews). */
    sourcePane?: 'left' | 'right';
    sourceTabId?: string;
    sourceDir?: string;
    /**
     * Present when the viewed file lives inside an archive.
      * The viewer uses this to call ArchiveRead through the shared VFS-backed
      * archive path instead of ReadFile. Cleared when autoFollow changes the
      * target to a regular filesystem file.
     */
    archiveContext?: {
      /** Outermost archive on disk, e.g. "filesystem://c/foo/archive.zip" */
      fsPath: string;
      /** Nested archive chain, e.g. ["inner.tar.gz"] — empty for flat archives */
      nestedChain: string[];
      /** Entry path inside the innermost archive, e.g. "src/main.go" */
      entryPath: string;

  };

  isClosable?: boolean;
````

````typescript
import { Injectable, Type } from '@angular/core';
import { ContributionRegistry } from '../plugin/contribution-registry';
import { SurfaceCapability, SurfaceContribution, SurfaceRequest } from './surface-contribution';
import { DirSurfaceTabComponent } from './builtins/dir-surface-tab.component';
import { SearchResultsSurfaceTabComponent } from './builtins/search-results-surface-tab.component';
import { ViewerSurfaceTabComponent } from './builtins/viewer-surface-tab.component';
import { SizeManagerSurfaceTabComponent } from './size-manager/size-manager-surface-tab.component';
import { DuplicateFinderSurfaceTabComponent } from './builtins/duplicate-finder-surface-tab.component';

function tabSurfaceId(req: SurfaceRequest): string {
  return req.tab.surfaceId ?? req.tab.kind ?? 'dir';
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class SurfaceRegistryService {
  readonly registry = new ContributionRegistry<SurfaceContribution, SurfaceRequest>();

  constructor() {
    this.register({
      id: 'dir',
      capabilities: ['navigate', 'selection', 'fileOperations', 'preview'],
      score: (req) => (tabSurfaceId(req) === 'dir' ? 100 : 0),
      load: () => DirSurfaceTabComponent,
    });

    this.register({
      id: 'search-results',
      capabilities: ['selection', 'fileOperations', 'preview'],
      score: (req) => (tabSurfaceId(req) === 'search-results' ? 100 : 0),
      load: () => SearchResultsSurfaceTabComponent,
    });

    this.register({
      id: 'viewer',
      capabilities: ['viewerControls'],
      score: (req) => (tabSurfaceId(req) === 'viewer' ? 100 : 0),
      load: () => ViewerSurfaceTabComponent,
    });

    this.register({
      id: 'size-manager',
      capabilities: ['navigate'],
      score: (req) => (tabSurfaceId(req) === 'size-manager' ? 100 : 0),
      load: () => SizeManagerSurfaceTabComponent,
    });

    this.register({
      id: 'duplicates',
      capabilities: [],
      score: (req) => (tabSurfaceId(req) === 'duplicates' ? 100 : 0),
      load: () => DuplicateFinderSurfaceTabComponent,
    });
  }

  register(c: SurfaceContribution): void {
    this.registry.register(c);
  }

  unregister(id: string): void {
    this.registry.unregister(id);
  }

  async resolve(req: SurfaceRequest): Promise<{ id: string; component: Type<unknown> }> {
    const id = tabSurfaceId(req);
    const exact = this.registry.list().find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
    if (exact) {
      return { id: exact.id, component: await exact.load() };
    }
    return this.registry.resolve(req);
  }

  getCapabilities(req: SurfaceRequest): ReadonlySet<SurfaceCapability> {
    const id = tabSurfaceId(req);
    const exact = this.registry.list().find((candidate) => candidate.id === id);
    if (exact) {
      return new Set(exact.capabilities ?? []);
    }

    let best: SurfaceContribution | null = null;
    let bestScore = 0;
    for (const candidate of this.registry.list()) {
      const score = candidate.score(req);
      if (score > bestScore) {
        best = candidate;
        bestScore = score;
      }
    }
    return new Set(best?.capabilities ?? []);
  }

  list(): readonly SurfaceContribution[] {
    return this.registry.list();
  }
}
````

````go
package app

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"time"

	"wails-app/internal/workspace"
	"wails-app/vfs/archive/cache"

	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2"
	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/pkg/options"
	"github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/pkg/options/assetserver"
	wailsruntime "github.com/wailsapp/wails/v2/pkg/runtime"
)

func Run(assets embed.FS, binding interface{}, archCache *cache.Cache, onStartup func(context.Context), onBeforeClose func(context.Context) bool, onShutdown func(context.Context)) error {
	appBinding, _ := binding.(*App)
	if appBinding == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("app binding is required")
	}

	// Detect if we're in dev mode (Angular dev server is expected to be running on :4200)
	isDev := os.Getenv("WAILS_DEV") == "true"

	if isDev {
		// Development: Use reverse proxy combining stream server + Angular dev server
		streamServer, streamBaseURL, err := startUnifiedServer(appBinding, archCache)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		angularDevURL := "http://127.0.0.1:4200"
		proxyServer, proxyURL, err := StartDevProxy(streamBaseURL, angularDevURL, archCache)
		if err != nil {
			streamServer.Shutdown(context.Background())
			return err
		}

		appBinding.SetStreamBaseURL(proxyURL)

		defer func() {
			shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
			defer cancel()

			if err := proxyServer.Shutdown(shutdownCtx); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
				println("dev proxy shutdown error:", err.Error())
			}

			if err := streamServer.Shutdown(shutdownCtx); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
				println("stream server shutdown error:", err.Error())
			}
		}()
	} else {
		// Production: Use unified stream server + embedded Wails assets
		streamServer, streamBaseURL, err := startUnifiedServer(appBinding, archCache)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		appBinding.SetStreamBaseURL(streamBaseURL)

		defer func() {
			shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			if err := streamServer.Shutdown(shutdownCtx); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
				println("stream server shutdown error:", err.Error())
			}
		}()
	}

	width, height := 1280, 800
	x, y := 0, 0
	hasPosition := false
	startState := options.Normal

	if saved := workspace.LoadStoredWindowState("wails-file-manager"); saved != nil {
		// Detect a minimised/restored window that Windows reported as off-screen
		// (x/y == -32000) with a tiny size. Ignore such state and use defaults.
		const minVisibleSize = 50
		const minimisedCoord = -32000
		minimised := saved.X <= minimisedCoord || saved.Y <= minimisedCoord ||
			saved.Width < minVisibleSize || saved.Height < minVisibleSize

		if !minimised && saved.Width >= 480 && saved.Height >= 320 {
			width = saved.Width
			height = saved.Height
		}
		// Legacy records (pre-HasPosition) had no flag; infer one from non-zero
		// coords. New records always carry HasPosition explicitly so legitimate
		// (0,0) restores correctly.
		if !minimised && (saved.HasPosition || saved.X != 0 || saved.Y != 0) {
			x = saved.X
			y = saved.Y
			hasPosition = true
		}
		if saved.Maximised && !minimised {
			startState = options.Maximised
		}
	}

	wrappedStartup := onStartup
	if hasPosition && startState != options.Maximised {
		savedX, savedY, savedW, savedH := x, y, width, height
		wrappedStartup = func(ctx context.Context) {
			if onStartup != nil {
				onStartup(ctx)
			}
			wailsruntime.WindowSetPosition(ctx, savedX, savedY)
			if !rectIntersectsAnyScreen(ctx, savedX, savedY, savedW, savedH) {
				wailsruntime.WindowCenter(ctx)
			}
		}
	}

	return wails.Run(&options.App{
		Title:            "File Manager",
		Width:            width,
		Height:           height,
		Frameless:        true,
		AssetServer:      &assetserver.Options{Assets: assets},
		BackgroundColour: &options.RGBA{R: 27, G: 38, B: 54, A: 255},
		WindowStartState: startState,
		OnStartup:        wrappedStartup,
		OnBeforeClose:    onBeforeClose,
		OnShutdown:       onShutdown,
		DragAndDrop: &options.DragAndDrop{
			EnableFileDrop:     true,
			DisableWebViewDrop: false,
		},
		Bind: []interface{}{binding},
	})
}

// rectIntersectsAnyScreen reports whether the window rect is likely visible
// on a connected display. Wails v2 Screen does not expose origin coordinates,
// so we treat the primary display as starting at (0,0) and allow a reasonable
// margin for multi-monitor negative coordinates.
func rectIntersectsAnyScreen(ctx context.Context, x, y, w, h int) bool {
	screens, err := wailsruntime.ScreenGetAll(ctx)
	if err != nil || len(screens) == 0 {
		// Fail open: assume the position is fine if we cannot enumerate.
		return true
	}
	primary := screens[0]
	const margin = 200 // allow some negative coordinates for multi-monitor
	// If the window is completely outside the primary screen (with margin),
	// assume it is off-screen.
	if x+w < -margin || y+h < -margin {
		return false
	}
	if x > primary.Width+margin || y > primary.Height+margin {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

// startUnifiedServer starts a single server that handles both:
// - Video stream requests (/wails-stream)
// - Archive entry streaming
func startUnifiedServer(appBinding *App, archCache *cache.Cache) (*http.Server, string, error) {
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("start unified server: %w", err)
	}

	baseURL := "http://" + listener.Addr().String()

	server := &http.Server{
		Handler:           NewUnifiedHandler(appBinding, archCache),
		ReadHeaderTimeout: 30 * time.Second,
	}

	go func() {
		if err := server.Serve(listener); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
			println("unified server error:", err.Error())
		}
	}()

	return server, baseURL, nil
}
````
