## File: frontend/src/app/components/file-pane-navigation.controller.ts
````typescript
import type { ApiService } from '../services/api.service';
import type { ArchiveFrame } from '../services/archive.service';
import type { FileViewDirectorySource } from '../services/directory-source.service';
import type { WorkspaceService } from '../services/workspace.service';
import type { DirSurfaceSession } from '../surfaces/dir/dir-surface-session';
import type { TabInfo, WorkspaceConfig } from '../shared/protocol-enhanced';
import { normalizePath, samePath } from './address-bar.utils';
import { isDirectoryBackedSurfaceId, tabLocation, tabSurfaceId } from '../surfaces/tab-surface';

declare const window: any;

export interface FilePaneNavigationHost {
  paneId: 'left' | 'right';
  workspace: WorkspaceConfig | null;
  showHidden: boolean;
  currentTabId: string;
  currentPath: string;
  pathReady: boolean;
  tabs: TabInfo[];
  activeDirTabId: string | null;
  archiveStack: ArchiveFrame[];
  apiService: ApiService;
  directorySource: FileViewDirectorySource;
  workspaceService: WorkspaceService;
  getDirSession(): DirSurfaceSession;
  isInArchive(): boolean;
  exitArchive(): void;
  clearArchiveState(): void;
  loadPathTransparently(path: string): Promise<void>;
  loadDirectory(path: string, opts?: { preserveUI?: boolean; focusPath?: string }): Promise<void>;
  navigateArchiveUp(): Promise<void>;
  refreshCurrentPathTransparently(): Promise<void>;
  refreshTreeNode(path: string): void;
  renderArchiveFrame(frame: ArchiveFrame): void;
  applyFilter(): void;
  emitPreviewTargetFromState(): void;
  emitActiveTabChange(tab: TabInfo): void;
  promptForRemoteMount(protocol: string, alias: string): Promise<string | null>;
}

export class FilePaneNavigationController {

  async loadPaneState(host: FilePaneNavigationHost): Promise<void> {
    if (!host.workspace) return;

    host.tabs = host.workspaceService.getTabs(host.paneId);
    const activeTab = host.workspaceService.getActiveTab(host.paneId);
    const savedPath = activeTab ? tabLocation(activeTab) : '';
    const activeSurfaceId = activeTab ? tabSurfaceId(activeTab) : 'dir';

    const initialPath = await this.resolveInitialPath(host, savedPath);
    const pathToLoad = await this.resolveRemotePathForLoad(host, initialPath)
      ?? await this.resolveInitialPath(host, '');
    host.pathReady = true;
    if (activeTab) host.currentTabId = activeTab.id;

    if (activeSurfaceId !== 'dir') {
      if (!host.activeDirTabId) {
        const firstDir = host.tabs.find(tab => tabSurfaceId(tab) === 'dir');
        if (firstDir) host.activeDirTabId = firstDir.id;
      }
      if (!host.currentPath) host.currentPath = pathToLoad;
      return;
    }

    if (activeTab) host.activeDirTabId = activeTab.id;
    host.currentPath = pathToLoad;
    host.clearArchiveState();

    const archiveState = activeTab ? host.workspaceService.getArchiveState(host.paneId, activeTab.id) : null;
    if (archiveState) {
      host.currentPath = archiveState.path;
      host.archiveStack = archiveState.archiveStack;
      host.getDirSession().fsParentDir = archiveState.fsParentDir;
      if (host.archiveStack.length > 0) {
        host.renderArchiveFrame(host.archiveStack[host.archiveStack.length - 1]);
        return;
      }
    }

    const session = host.getDirSession();
    const cachedOk =
      !host.directorySource.isPathInsideArchive(pathToLoad) &&
      session.currentPath === pathToLoad &&
      session.showHiddenLoaded === host.showHidden &&
      !session.loading &&
      !session.error;

    if (cachedOk) {
      host.applyFilter();
      host.emitPreviewTargetFromState();
      return;
    }

    await host.loadPathTransparently(pathToLoad);
  }

  async onTabChange(host: FilePaneNavigationHost, tab: TabInfo): Promise<void> {
    const current = host.tabs.find(existing => existing.id === host.currentTabId);
    const currentSurfaceId = current ? tabSurfaceId(current) : 'dir';

    if (isDirectoryBackedSurfaceId(currentSurfaceId) && host.currentTabId && host.currentPath) {
      if (host.isInArchive()) {
        host.workspaceService.saveArchiveState(host.paneId, host.currentTabId, {
          path: host.currentPath,
          archiveStack: host.archiveStack,
          fsDirPath: host.archiveStack[0]?.fsPath ?? '',
          fsParentDir: host.getDirSession().fsParentDir,
        });
      } else {
        host.workspaceService.updateTabPath(host.paneId, host.currentTabId, host.currentPath);
      }
    }

    host.currentTabId = tab.id;
    host.workspaceService.switchTab(host.paneId, tab.id);
    host.clearArchiveState();

    if (!isDirectoryBackedSurfaceId(tabSurfaceId(tab))) {
      host.tabs = host.workspaceService.getTabs(host.paneId);
      host.emitActiveTabChange(tab);
      return;
    }

    host.activeDirTabId = tab.id;

    const archiveState = host.workspaceService.getArchiveState(host.paneId, tab.id);
    if (archiveState) {
      host.currentPath = archiveState.path;
      host.archiveStack = archiveState.archiveStack;
      host.getDirSession().fsParentDir = archiveState.fsParentDir;
      if (host.archiveStack.length > 0) {
        host.renderArchiveFrame(host.archiveStack[host.archiveStack.length - 1]);
      }
      return;
    }

    const restoredPath = await this.resolveRemotePathForLoad(host, tabLocation(tab), { interactive: true });
    if (!restoredPath) {
      host.emitActiveTabChange(tab);
      return;
    }
    host.currentPath = restoredPath;

    const session = host.getDirSession();
    const cachedOk =
      !host.directorySource.isPathInsideArchive(restoredPath) &&
      samePath(session.currentPath, restoredPath) &&
      session.showHiddenLoaded === host.showHidden &&
      !session.loading &&
      !session.error;

    if (cachedOk) {
      host.applyFilter();
      host.emitPreviewTargetFromState();
      host.emitActiveTabChange(tab);
      return;
    }

    await host.loadPathTransparently(restoredPath);
    host.emitActiveTabChange(tab);
  }

  onPathChange(host: FilePaneNavigationHost, path: string): void {
    if (!path || samePath(path, host.currentPath)) return;

    const previousPath = host.currentPath;
    host.currentPath = path;
    host.exitArchive();
    host.clearArchiveState();
    void this.navigateToEnteredPath(host, path, previousPath);
  }

  async onNavigateUp(host: FilePaneNavigationHost): Promise<void> {
    if (host.isInArchive()) {
      await host.navigateArchiveUp();
      return;
    }

    const fromPath = host.currentPath;
    const target = host.directorySource.getParentPath(fromPath);
    if (host.directorySource.getPathKind(fromPath) === 'registry') {
      if (target && target !== fromPath) {
        await host.loadDirectory(target, { focusPath: fromPath });
      }
      return;
    }

    try {
      const listing = await window.go.app.App.NavGoUp(host.paneId);
      await host.loadDirectory(listing.path, { focusPath: fromPath });
    } catch {
      if (target !== fromPath) {
        await host.loadDirectory(target, { focusPath: fromPath });
      }
    }
  }

  onRefresh(host: FilePaneNavigationHost): void {
    void host.refreshCurrentPathTransparently();
    host.refreshTreeNode(host.currentPath);
  }

  private async navigateToEnteredPath(host: FilePaneNavigationHost, path: string, previousPath?: string): Promise<void> {
    const resolvedRemotePath = await this.resolveRemotePathForLoad(host, path, { interactive: true });
    if (!resolvedRemotePath) {
      if (previousPath) {
        host.currentPath = previousPath;
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!samePath(resolvedRemotePath, path)) {
      host.currentPath = resolvedRemotePath;
      await host.loadPathTransparently(resolvedRemotePath);
      return;
    }

    if (host.directorySource.isPathInsideArchive(path)) {
      await host.loadPathTransparently(path);
      return;
    }

    try {
      const info = await host.apiService.getFileInfo(path);
      if (info.type !== 'DIRECTORY') {
        const parent = host.directorySource.getParentPath(path);
        if (parent && !samePath(parent, path)) {
          await host.loadDirectory(parent, { focusPath: path });
          return;
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Fall back to directory-style navigation for synthetic roots and unresolved paths.
    }

    await host.loadPathTransparently(path);
  }

  private async resolveInitialPath(host: FilePaneNavigationHost, savedPath: string): Promise<string> {
    const allPaths = host.workspaceService.getAllTabPaths();
    const windowsRoot = allPaths
      .map(path => normalizePath(path))
      .find(path => /^filesystem:\/\/[a-z](?:\/.*)?$/i.test(path));
    let platformRoot = windowsRoot
      ? windowsRoot.replace(/^(filesystem:\/\/[a-z]).*$/i, '$1')
      : '/';

    if (platformRoot === '/') {
      try {
        const osInfo = await host.apiService.getOSInfo();
        if (osInfo?.systemDrive) {
          platformRoot = normalizePath(osInfo.systemDrive as string);
        }
      } catch {
        // Keep the generic root when OS info isn't available.
      }
    }

    const isWindows = platformRoot !== '/';
    const pathIsStale = !savedPath || (isWindows && savedPath === '/');
    return pathIsStale ? platformRoot : savedPath;
  }

  private async resolveRemotePathForLoad(
    host: FilePaneNavigationHost,
    path: string,
    options?: { interactive?: boolean },
  ): Promise<string | null> {
    const normalized = normalizePath(path);
    const remoteMatch = /^(s3|gdrive|dropbox|onedrive):\/\/([^/]+)(?:\/(.*))?$/i.exec(normalized);
    if (!remoteMatch) {
      return path;
    }

    const protocol = remoteMatch[1].toLowerCase();
    const alias = remoteMatch[2];
    const aliasRoot = `${protocol}://${alias}`;

    try {
      const connections = await host.apiService.remoteListConnections();
      const mounted = connections.some((mount) => mount.protocol === protocol && samePath(mount.publicPath, aliasRoot));
      if (mounted) {
        return normalized;
      }
    } catch {
      return normalized;
    }

    if (!options?.interactive) {
      // Workspace restoration is deliberately non-interactive. Remote mounts are
      // session-only, so an old cloud/S3 tab must not trigger connection UI (or
      // attempt to load an unavailable mount) while the application is starting.
      return null;
    }

    if (samePath(normalized, `${protocol}://`)) {
      return normalized;
    }

    const mountedRoot = await host.promptForRemoteMount(protocol, alias);
    if (!mountedRoot) {
      return protocol === 's3' ? null : normalized;
    }

    const suffix = normalized.slice(aliasRoot.length).replace(/^\/+/, '');
    return suffix ? `${mountedRoot}/${suffix}` : mountedRoot;
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { Injectable, NgZone } from '@angular/core';
import { createBehaviorSubject } from '@epikodelabs/streamix';
import { DIALOG_INPUT_CATALOG } from './dialog-input-catalog';
import type {
  BindingResolution,
  InputBindingDefinition,
  InputContextDefinition,
  MouseGesture,
  InputSourceKind,
  KeyStroke,
  PluginInputContribution,
  InputTrigger,
  CommandDefinition,
  CommandDescriptor,
  CommandState,
  CommandCatalogEntry,
  InputCommandHandler,
  CommandInvocation,
} from './input-system.types';

interface RegisteredCommand {
  registrationId: string;
  handler: InputCommandHandler;
  registrationOrder: number;
}

interface RegisteredBinding extends InputBindingDefinition {
  registrationOrder: number;
  enabled: boolean;
}

type KeyboardRegisteredBinding = RegisteredBinding & {
  trigger: Extract<InputTrigger, { device: 'keyboard' }>;
};

function isKeyboardRegisteredBinding(binding: RegisteredBinding): binding is KeyboardRegisteredBinding {
  return binding.trigger.device === 'keyboard';
}

interface PendingChordState {
  startedAt: number;
  steps: KeyStroke[];
  candidateBindingIds: string[];
}

interface ActiveContextState {
  id: string;
  activatedAt: number;
}

interface KeyboardEventContext {
  inInput: boolean;
  inTextarea: boolean;
  inSelect: boolean;
  inContentEditable: boolean;
  inModal: boolean;
  inQuickAccessMenu: boolean;
  hasActivePane: boolean;
  isFilterInput: boolean;
  inFileEntry: boolean;
  inViewerSurface: boolean;
}

export interface ShortcutDebugTrace {
  stroke: string;
  stage: 'matched' | 'no-match' | 'no-command';
  bindingId?: string;
  commandId?: string;
}

export interface SyntheticKeyboardContext {
  inInput?: boolean;
  inTextarea?: boolean;
  inSelect?: boolean;
  inContentEditable?: boolean;
  inModal?: boolean;
  inQuickAccessMenu?: boolean;
  hasActivePane?: boolean;
  isFilterInput?: boolean;
  inFileEntry?: boolean;
  inViewerSurface?: boolean;
}

export interface SyntheticKeyboardEvent {
  key: string;
  code?: string;
  ctrlKey?: boolean;
  shiftKey?: boolean;
  altKey?: boolean;
  metaKey?: boolean;
}

const SOURCE_PRIORITY: Record<InputSourceKind, number> = {
  default: 10,
  plugin: 20,
  workspace: 30,
  user: 40,
};

const CHORD_TIMEOUT_MS = 1800;

function normalizeCommandReference(value: string): string {
  return value.trim().toLowerCase();
}

@Injectable({
  providedIn: 'root'
})
export class InputEngineService {
  private readonly contexts = new Map<string, InputContextDefinition>();
  private readonly bindings = new Map<string, RegisteredBinding>();
  private readonly bindingRegistrations = new Map<string, Map<string, RegisteredBinding>>();
  private readonly commands = new Map<string, Map<string, RegisteredCommand>>();
  private readonly commandDefinitions = new Map<string, CommandDefinition>();
  private readonly commandEnablement = new Map<string, Map<string, (invocation?: CommandInvocation) => boolean>>();
  private readonly pluginInputRegistrations = new Map<string, {
    commandIds: string[];
    bindingIds: string[];
    contextIds: string[];
  }>();
  private readonly activeContexts = new Map<string, ActiveContextState>();

  private pendingChord: PendingChordState | null = null;
  private pendingChordTimer: number | null = null;
  private registrationCounter = 0;
  private commandRegistrationCounter = 0;

  readonly activeContexts$ = createBehaviorSubject<InputContextDefinition[]>([]);
  readonly pendingChord$ = createBehaviorSubject<PendingChordState | null>(null);
  readonly bindings$ = createBehaviorSubject<InputBindingDefinition[]>([]);
  readonly shortcutDebug$ = createBehaviorSubject<ShortcutDebugTrace | null>(null);

  private keyboardEnabled = true;
  readonly showShortcutDebug = typeof window !== 'undefined'
    && ['localhost', '127.0.0.1'].includes(window.location.hostname);

  constructor(
    private readonly ngZone: NgZone,
  ) {
    this.registerContext({
      id: 'global',
      kind: 'global',
      priority: 0,
      description: 'Global application input context',
    });

    for (const entry of DIALOG_INPUT_CATALOG) {
      this.registerContext(entry.context);
      for (const binding of entry.bindings) {
        this.registerBinding(binding);
      }
    }

    this.initializeKeyboardListener();
    this.initializeMouseListeners();
    this.emitBindings();
  }

  registerCommand(commandId: string, handler: InputCommandHandler, ownerId = 'default'): void {
    const registrations = this.commands.get(commandId) ?? new Map<string, RegisteredCommand>();
    registrations.set(ownerId, {
      registrationId: ownerId,
      handler,
      registrationOrder: ++this.commandRegistrationCounter,
    });
    this.commands.set(commandId, registrations);
  }

  unregisterCommand(commandId: string, ownerId = 'default'): void {
    const registrations = this.commands.get(commandId);
    if (!registrations) return;

    registrations.delete(ownerId);
    if (registrations.size === 0) {
      this.commands.delete(commandId);
    }
  }

  registerCommandDescriptor(descriptor: CommandDescriptor, ownerId = 'default'): void {
    const { execute, isEnabled, ...definition } = descriptor;
    this.registerCommandDefinition(definition);
    this.registerCommand(descriptor.id, execute, ownerId);

    if (isEnabled) {
      const registrations = this.commandEnablement.get(descriptor.id) ?? new Map<string, (invocation?: CommandInvocation) => boolean>();
      registrations.set(ownerId, isEnabled);
      this.commandEnablement.set(descriptor.id, registrations);
    }
  }

  unregisterCommandDescriptor(commandId: string, ownerId = 'default'): void {
    this.unregisterCommand(commandId, ownerId);

    const enablement = this.commandEnablement.get(commandId);
    enablement?.delete(ownerId);
    if (enablement?.size === 0) this.commandEnablement.delete(commandId);

    if (!this.commands.has(commandId)) {
      this.unregisterCommandDefinition(commandId);
    }
  }

  isCommandEnabled(commandId: string, invocation?: CommandInvocation): boolean {
    const active = this.getActiveCommandRegistration(commandId);
    if (!active) return false;

    const predicates = this.commandEnablement.get(commandId);
    if (!predicates || predicates.size === 0) return true;

    // Mirror handler precedence: the most recently registered owner wins.
    const predicate = predicates.get(active.registrationId);
    if (!predicate) return true;

    try {
      return predicate(invocation);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Input command availability failed:', error);
      return false;
    }
  }

  getCommandState(commandId: string): CommandState | undefined {
    const definition = this.commandDefinitions.get(commandId);
    if (!definition) return undefined;
    return {
      ...definition,
      registered: this.commands.has(commandId),
      enabled: this.isCommandEnabled(commandId),
    };
  }

  getCommandStates(): CommandState[] {
    return Array.from(this.commandDefinitions.keys())
      .map(id => this.getCommandState(id))
      .filter((state): state is CommandState => !!state);
  }

  /**
   * Returns a normalized command catalog for discovery surfaces. The catalog
   * combines definitions, runtime state, and the preferred keyboard binding so
   * consumers do not have to join the input engine's internal registries.
   */
  getCommandCatalog(options: { activeContextsOnly?: boolean } = {}): CommandCatalogEntry[] {
    const commandIds = new Set<string>([
      ...this.commandDefinitions.keys(),
      ...this.commands.keys(),
      ...Array.from(this.bindings.values(), binding => binding.commandId),
    ]);
    const activeContextIds = options.activeContextsOnly ? this.getActiveContextIds() : null;

    return Array.from(commandIds)
      .map(commandId => this.buildCommandCatalogEntry(commandId))
      .filter((entry): entry is CommandCatalogEntry => !!entry)
      .filter(entry => {
        if (!activeContextIds || !entry.contextIds?.length) return true;
        return entry.contextIds.some(contextId => activeContextIds.has(contextId));
      });
  }

  /**
   * Resolve either a stable command ID or a human-facing command name/alias.
   * Ambiguous aliases intentionally resolve to undefined instead of guessing.
   */
  resolveCommandId(reference: string): string | undefined {
    const raw = reference.trim();
    if (!raw) return undefined;
    if (this.commandDefinitions.has(raw) || this.commands.has(raw)) return raw;

    const normalized = normalizeCommandReference(raw);
    let match: string | undefined;

    for (const definition of this.commandDefinitions.values()) {
      const names = [definition.name, ...(definition.aliases ?? [])].filter((value): value is string => !!value);
      if (!names.some(name => normalizeCommandReference(name) === normalized)) continue;
      if (match && match !== definition.id) return undefined;
      match = definition.id;
    }

    return match;
  }

  dispatchCommandByName(
    reference: string,
    invocation: CommandInvocation = { source: 'programmatic' },
  ): boolean {
    const commandId = this.resolveCommandId(reference);
    return commandId ? this.dispatchCommandById(commandId, invocation) : false;
  }

  getPreferredKeyboardBinding(commandId: string): InputBindingDefinition | undefined {
    let preferred: KeyboardRegisteredBinding | undefined;
    for (const binding of this.bindings.values()) {
      if (binding.commandId !== commandId || !isKeyboardRegisteredBinding(binding)) continue;
      if (!preferred || binding.trigger.chord.steps.length < preferred.trigger.chord.steps.length) {
        preferred = binding;
      }
    }
    if (!preferred) return undefined;
    return { ...preferred, enabled: preferred.enabled };
  }

  private buildCommandCatalogEntry(commandId: string): CommandCatalogEntry | undefined {
    const definition = this.commandDefinitions.get(commandId);
    const preferredBinding = this.getPreferredKeyboardBinding(commandId);
    if (!definition && !preferredBinding && !this.commands.has(commandId)) return undefined;

    return {
      id: commandId,
      title: definition?.title ?? preferredBinding?.description ?? commandId,
      description: definition?.description ?? preferredBinding?.description,
      category: definition?.category ?? preferredBinding?.category,
      icon: definition?.icon,
      name: definition?.name,
      aliases: definition?.aliases,
      contextIds: definition?.contextIds ?? (preferredBinding ? [preferredBinding.contextId] : undefined),
      registered: this.commands.has(commandId),
      enabled: this.isCommandEnabled(commandId),
      preferredBinding,
    };
  }

  registerContext(context: InputContextDefinition): void {
    this.contexts.set(context.id, context);
    this.emitActiveContexts();
  }

  activateContext(contextId: string): void {
    const context = this.contexts.get(contextId);
    if (!context) return;
    this.activeContexts.set(contextId, { id: contextId, activatedAt: Date.now() });
    this.emitActiveContexts();
  }

  deactivateContext(contextId: string): void {
    if (!this.activeContexts.delete(contextId)) return;
    this.emitActiveContexts();
    this.clearPendingChord();
  }

  clearTransientContexts(): void {
    for (const [contextId] of this.activeContexts) {
      if (contextId !== 'global') {
        this.activeContexts.delete(contextId);
      }
    }
    this.emitActiveContexts();
    this.clearPendingChord();
  }

  registerBinding(binding: InputBindingDefinition, ownerId = 'default'): void {
    const registrations = this.bindingRegistrations.get(binding.id) ?? new Map<string, RegisteredBinding>();
    registrations.set(ownerId, {
      ...binding,
      preventDefault: binding.preventDefault !== false,
      stopPropagation: binding.stopPropagation !== false,
      enabled: binding.enabled !== false,
      registrationOrder: ++this.registrationCounter,
    });
    this.bindingRegistrations.set(binding.id, registrations);
    this.bindings.set(binding.id, this.getActiveBindingRegistration(registrations));
    this.emitBindings();
  }

  unregisterBinding(bindingId: string, ownerId = 'default'): void {
    const registrations = this.bindingRegistrations.get(bindingId);
    if (!registrations) return;

    registrations.delete(ownerId);
    if (registrations.size === 0) {
      this.bindingRegistrations.delete(bindingId);
      this.bindings.delete(bindingId);
      this.emitBindings();
      return;
    }

    this.bindings.set(bindingId, this.getActiveBindingRegistration(registrations));
    this.emitBindings();
  }

  setBindingEnabled(bindingId: string, enabled: boolean): void {
    const binding = this.bindings.get(bindingId);
    if (!binding) return;
    binding.enabled = enabled;
    this.emitBindings();
  }

  setKeyboardEnabled(enabled: boolean): void {
    this.keyboardEnabled = enabled;
    if (!enabled) {
      this.clearPendingChord();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Register a plugin's command descriptors, contexts and default bindings as
   * one owned unit. Re-registering the same plugin replaces its previous unit.
   */
  registerPluginInput(contribution: PluginInputContribution): void {
    const pluginId = contribution.pluginId.trim();
    if (!pluginId) throw new Error('Plugin input contribution requires pluginId.');

    this.unregisterPluginInput(pluginId);

    const ownerId = this.pluginInputOwner(pluginId);
    const contextIds: string[] = [];
    const commandIds: string[] = [];
    const bindingIds: string[] = [];

    try {
      for (const context of contribution.contexts ?? []) {
        if (this.contexts.has(context.id)) {
          throw new Error(`Plugin ${pluginId} cannot replace input context ${context.id}.`);
        }
        this.registerContext(context);
        contextIds.push(context.id);
      }

      for (const command of contribution.commands) {
        if (this.commands.has(command.id)) {
          throw new Error(`Plugin ${pluginId} cannot replace command ${command.id}.`);
        }
        this.registerCommandDescriptor(command, ownerId);
        commandIds.push(command.id);
      }

      for (const binding of contribution.bindings ?? []) {
        if (this.bindings.has(binding.id)) {
          throw new Error(`Plugin ${pluginId} cannot replace input binding ${binding.id}.`);
        }
        this.registerBinding({ ...binding, source: 'plugin' }, ownerId);
        bindingIds.push(binding.id);
      }

      this.pluginInputRegistrations.set(pluginId, { commandIds, bindingIds, contextIds });
    } catch (error) {
      this.removePluginInputRegistration(ownerId, { commandIds, bindingIds, contextIds });
      throw error;
    }
  }

  unregisterPluginInput(pluginId: string): void {
    const registration = this.pluginInputRegistrations.get(pluginId);
    if (!registration) return;

    this.removePluginInputRegistration(this.pluginInputOwner(pluginId), registration);
    this.pluginInputRegistrations.delete(pluginId);
  }


  private pluginInputOwner(pluginId: string): string {
    return `plugin-input:${pluginId}`;
  }

  private removePluginInputRegistration(
    ownerId: string,
    registration: { commandIds: string[]; bindingIds: string[]; contextIds: string[] },
  ): void {
    for (const bindingId of registration.bindingIds) {
      this.unregisterBinding(bindingId, ownerId);
    }
    for (const commandId of registration.commandIds) {
      this.unregisterCommandDescriptor(commandId, ownerId);
    }
    for (const contextId of registration.contextIds) {
      this.activeContexts.delete(contextId);
      this.contexts.delete(contextId);
    }
    if (registration.contextIds.length > 0) {
      this.emitActiveContexts();
      this.clearPendingChord();
    }
  }

  getBindingSnapshot(): InputBindingDefinition[] {
    return Array.from(this.bindings.values()).map(binding => ({
      ...binding,
      enabled: binding.enabled,
    }));
  }

  getBinding(bindingId: string): InputBindingDefinition | undefined {
    const binding = this.bindings.get(bindingId);
    if (!binding) return undefined;
    return { ...binding, enabled: binding.enabled };
  }

  getRegisteredCommandIds(): string[] {
    return Array.from(this.commands.keys());
  }

  dispatchCommandById(commandId: string, invocation: CommandInvocation = { source: 'programmatic' }): boolean {
    const handler = this.getCommandHandler(commandId, invocation);
    if (!handler) return false;
    return this.executeCommand(handler, invocation);
  }

  updateBindingTrigger(bindingId: string, trigger: InputTrigger): boolean {
    const binding = this.bindings.get(bindingId);
    if (!binding) return false;
    binding.trigger = trigger;
    this.emitBindings();
    return true;
  }

  registerCommandDefinition(def: CommandDefinition): void {
    this.commandDefinitions.set(def.id, def);
  }

  unregisterCommandDefinition(commandId: string): void {
    this.commandDefinitions.delete(commandId);
  }

  getCommandDefinitions(): CommandDefinition[] {
    return Array.from(this.commandDefinitions.values());
  }

  getCommandDefinition(commandId: string): CommandDefinition | undefined {
    return this.commandDefinitions.get(commandId);
  }

  getContextSnapshot(): InputContextDefinition[] {
    return Array.from(this.contexts.values());
  }

  resolveKeyStroke(
    stroke: KeyStroke,
    context?: KeyboardEvent | KeyboardEventContext | SyntheticKeyboardContext | null,
  ): BindingResolution | null {
    const currentSequence = this.pendingChord ? [...this.pendingChord.steps, stroke] : [stroke];
    const candidates = this.matchBindings(currentSequence, this.resolveKeyboardContext(context));

    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      if (this.pendingChord) {
        this.clearPendingChord();
      }
      return null;
    }

    const completeMatches = candidates.filter(candidate =>
      candidate.trigger.device === 'keyboard' &&
      candidate.trigger.chord.steps.length === currentSequence.length,
    );

    const partialMatches = candidates.filter(candidate =>
      candidate.trigger.device === 'keyboard' &&
      candidate.trigger.chord.steps.length > currentSequence.length,
    );

    if (partialMatches.length > 0) {
      this.beginPendingChord(currentSequence, partialMatches.map(binding => binding.id));
    } else {
      this.clearPendingChord();
    }

    if (completeMatches.length === 0) {
      return null;
    }

    return this.chooseBestBinding(completeMatches);
  }

  async dispatchKeyStroke(stroke: KeyStroke, options?: { context?: SyntheticKeyboardContext | null }): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!this.keyboardEnabled) return false;

    const resolution = this.resolveKeyStroke(stroke, options?.context ?? null);
    if (!resolution) {
      this.emitShortcutDebug({
        stroke: this.formatDebugStroke(stroke),
        stage: 'no-match',
      });
      return false;
    }

    const invocation: CommandInvocation = { source: 'keyboard', context: { bindingId: resolution.binding.id } };
    const command = this.getCommandHandler(resolution.binding.commandId, invocation);
    if (!command) {
      this.emitShortcutDebug({
        stroke: this.formatDebugStroke(stroke),
        stage: 'no-command',
        bindingId: resolution.binding.id,
        commandId: resolution.binding.commandId,
      });
      return false;
    }

    this.emitShortcutDebug({
      stroke: this.formatDebugStroke(stroke),
      stage: 'matched',
      bindingId: resolution.binding.id,
      commandId: resolution.binding.commandId,
    });

    return this.executeCommandAsync(command, invocation);
  }

  async dispatchKeyboardEvent(
    event: SyntheticKeyboardEvent,
    options?: { context?: SyntheticKeyboardContext | null },
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.dispatchKeyStroke(this.normalizeKeyStroke(event), options);
  }

  async dispatchMouseGesture(gesture: MouseGesture): Promise<boolean> {
    const resolution = this.resolveMouseGesture(gesture);
    if (!resolution) return false;

    const invocation: CommandInvocation = { source: 'mouse', context: { bindingId: resolution.binding.id } };
    const command = this.getCommandHandler(resolution.binding.commandId, invocation);
    if (!command) return false;

    return this.executeCommandAsync(command, invocation);
  }

  private initializeKeyboardListener(): void {
    const listener = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (!this.keyboardEnabled || event.isComposing) return;

      const stroke = this.normalizeKeyStroke(event);
      const resolution = this.resolveKeyStroke(stroke, event);
      if (!resolution) {
        this.emitShortcutDebug({
          stroke: this.formatDebugStroke(stroke),
          stage: 'no-match',
        });
        return;
      }

      const invocation: CommandInvocation = { source: 'keyboard', context: { bindingId: resolution.binding.id } };
      const command = this.getCommandHandler(resolution.binding.commandId, invocation);
      if (!command) {
        this.emitShortcutDebug({
          stroke: this.formatDebugStroke(stroke),
          stage: 'no-command',
          bindingId: resolution.binding.id,
          commandId: resolution.binding.commandId,
        });
        return;
      }

      this.emitShortcutDebug({
        stroke: this.formatDebugStroke(stroke),
        stage: 'matched',
        bindingId: resolution.binding.id,
        commandId: resolution.binding.commandId,
      });

      if (resolution.binding.preventDefault !== false) {
        event.preventDefault();
      }
      if (resolution.binding.stopPropagation !== false) {
        event.stopPropagation();
      }

      this.executeCommand(command, invocation);
    };

    // One canonical keyboard boundary for the entire application.
    //
    // Do not register the same listener on document as well. A window capture
    // listener already observes keyboard input before application components,
    // while duplicate capture listeners make unmatched keys and chord state
    // travel through the engine twice.
    window.addEventListener('keydown', listener, { capture: true });
  }

  private initializeMouseListeners(): void {
    const listenerOptions = { capture: true } as AddEventListenerOptions;
    const wheelOptions = { capture: true, passive: false } as AddEventListenerOptions;

    document.addEventListener('click', (event) => this.handleMouseEvent('click', event), listenerOptions);
    document.addEventListener('dblclick', (event) => this.handleMouseEvent('dblclick', event), listenerOptions);
    document.addEventListener('auxclick', (event) => this.handleMouseEvent('auxclick', event), listenerOptions);
    document.addEventListener('contextmenu', (event) => this.handleMouseEvent('contextmenu', event), listenerOptions);
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', (event) => this.handleMouseEvent('mousedown', event), listenerOptions);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', (event) => this.handleMouseEvent('mouseup', event), listenerOptions);
    document.addEventListener('wheel', (event) => this.handleMouseEvent('wheel', event), wheelOptions);
  }

  private handleMouseEvent(kind: string, event: MouseEvent | WheelEvent): void {
    if (!this.keyboardEnabled) return;

    const gesture = this.normalizeMouseGesture(kind, event);
    if (!gesture) return;

    const resolution = this.resolveMouseGesture(gesture, event);
    if (!resolution) return;

    const invocation: CommandInvocation = { source: 'mouse', context: { bindingId: resolution.binding.id } };
    const command = this.getCommandHandler(resolution.binding.commandId, invocation);
    if (!command) return;

    this.clearPendingChord();

    if (resolution.binding.preventDefault !== false) {
      event.preventDefault();
    }
    if (resolution.binding.stopPropagation !== false) {
      event.stopPropagation();
    }

    this.executeCommand(command, invocation);
  }

  private resolveMouseGesture(gesture: MouseGesture, event?: MouseEvent | WheelEvent): BindingResolution | null {
    const candidates = this.matchMouseBindings(gesture, event);
    if (candidates.length === 0) {
      return null;
    }

    return this.chooseBestBinding(candidates);
  }

  private normalizeKeyStroke(event: SyntheticKeyboardEvent): KeyStroke {
    const modifiers: KeyStroke['modifiers'] = [];
    if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) modifiers.push(event.ctrlKey ? 'ctrl' : 'meta');
    if (event.shiftKey) modifiers.push('shift');
    if (event.altKey) modifiers.push('alt');

    return {
      key: this.normalizeKey(event.key, event.code),
      modifiers: modifiers.length > 0 ? modifiers.sort() : undefined,
    };
  }

  private normalizeKey(key: string, code?: string): string {
    const codeMap: Record<string, string> = {
      NumpadAdd: 'numpadadd',
      NumpadSubtract: 'numpadsubtract',
      NumpadMultiply: 'numpadmultiply',
      // Match OEM punctuation by physical key so shortcuts stay stable across
      // keyboard layouts and WebView2 hosts.
      Slash: '/',
      Comma: ',',
      Period: '.',
      Semicolon: ';',
      Quote: '\'',
      Backquote: '`',
      BracketLeft: '[',
      BracketRight: ']',
      Backslash: '\\',
      Minus: '-',
      Equal: '=',
    };

    if (code && codeMap[code]) {
      return codeMap[code];
    }

    const keyMap: Record<string, string> = {
      ' ': 'space',
      Escape: 'escape',
      Enter: 'enter',
      Tab: 'tab',
      Insert: 'insert',
      Backspace: 'backspace',
      Delete: 'delete',
      Home: 'home',
      End: 'end',
      PageUp: 'pageup',
      PageDown: 'pagedown',
      ArrowUp: 'arrowup',
      ArrowDown: 'arrowdown',
      ArrowLeft: 'arrowleft',
      ArrowRight: 'arrowright',
    };

    const normalizedKey = keyMap[key] ?? key.toLowerCase();
    if (normalizedKey && normalizedKey !== 'unidentified') {
      return normalizedKey;
    }

    // WebView2 may report accelerator combinations (for example Ctrl+Shift+P)
    // with KeyboardEvent.key === "Unidentified" while still preserving the
    // physical DOM code ("KeyP"). Recover the logical key from code only when
    // key itself is unusable. Normal browser keyboard semantics remain unchanged.
    if (code?.startsWith('Key') && code.length === 4) {
      return code.slice(3).toLowerCase();
    }
    if (code?.startsWith('Digit') && code.length === 6) {
      return code.slice(5);
    }
    if (/^F(?:[1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-4])$/.test(code ?? '')) {
      return code!.toLowerCase();
    }

    return normalizedKey;
  }

  private matchBindings(sequence: KeyStroke[], keyboardContext?: KeyboardEventContext | null): RegisteredBinding[] {
    const activeContextIds = this.getActiveContextIds();

    return Array.from(this.bindings.values()).filter(binding => {
      if (!binding.enabled || binding.trigger.device !== 'keyboard') return false;
      if (!activeContextIds.has(binding.contextId)) return false;
      if (!this.whenClauseAllows(binding.when, keyboardContext)) return false;

      const steps = binding.trigger.chord.steps;
      if (steps.length < sequence.length) return false;

      for (let i = 0; i < sequence.length; i++) {
        if (!this.sameStroke(steps[i], sequence[i])) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      return true;
    });
  }

  private matchMouseBindings(gesture: MouseGesture, event?: MouseEvent | WheelEvent): RegisteredBinding[] {
    const activeContextIds = this.getActiveContextIds();
    const mouseContext = event ? this.getKeyboardEventContext(event) : null;

    return Array.from(this.bindings.values()).filter(binding => {
      if (!binding.enabled || binding.trigger.device !== 'mouse') return false;
      if (!activeContextIds.has(binding.contextId)) return false;
      if (!this.whenClauseAllows(binding.when, mouseContext)) return false;

      return this.sameGesture(binding.trigger.gesture, gesture);
    });
  }

  private chooseBestBinding(bindings: RegisteredBinding[]): BindingResolution {
    const sorted = [...bindings].sort((left, right) => {
      const leftContextPriority = this.contexts.get(left.contextId)?.priority ?? 0;
      const rightContextPriority = this.contexts.get(right.contextId)?.priority ?? 0;
      if (leftContextPriority !== rightContextPriority) {
        return rightContextPriority - leftContextPriority;
      }

      const leftSourcePriority = SOURCE_PRIORITY[left.source];
      const rightSourcePriority = SOURCE_PRIORITY[right.source];
      if (leftSourcePriority !== rightSourcePriority) {
        return rightSourcePriority - leftSourcePriority;
      }

      const leftBindingPriority = left.priority ?? 0;
      const rightBindingPriority = right.priority ?? 0;
      if (leftBindingPriority !== rightBindingPriority) {
        return rightBindingPriority - leftBindingPriority;
      }

      return right.registrationOrder - left.registrationOrder;
    });

    const best = sorted[0];
    return {
      binding: best,
      score: {
        contextPriority: this.contexts.get(best.contextId)?.priority ?? 0,
        sourcePriority: SOURCE_PRIORITY[best.source],
        bindingPriority: best.priority ?? 0,
      },
    };
  }

  private sameStroke(left: KeyStroke, right: KeyStroke): boolean {
    const leftMods = (left.modifiers ?? []).join('+');
    const rightMods = (right.modifiers ?? []).join('+');
    return left.key === right.key && leftMods === rightMods;
  }

  private whenClauseAllows(expression?: string, context?: KeyboardEventContext | null): boolean {
    if (!expression || expression.trim() === '' || expression === 'true') {
      return true;
    }

    const terms = expression.split('&&').map(term => term.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (terms.length === 0) {
      return true;
    }

    return terms.every(term => {
      const isNegated = term.startsWith('!');
      const token = isNegated ? term.slice(1).trim() : term;
      const value = this.resolveWhenToken(token, context);
      return isNegated ? !value : value;
    });
  }

  private resolveWhenToken(token: string, context?: KeyboardEventContext | null): boolean {
    switch (token) {
      case 'typing':
        return !!context && (context.inInput || context.inTextarea || context.inSelect || context.inContentEditable);
      case 'modal':
        return !!context?.inModal;
      case 'quickAccess':
        return !!context?.inQuickAccessMenu;
      case 'activePane':
        return !!context?.hasActivePane;
      case 'filterInput':
        return !!context?.isFilterInput;
      case 'fileEntry':
        return !!context?.inFileEntry;
      case 'viewerSurface':
        return !!context?.inViewerSurface;
      default:
        return false;
    }
  }

  private resolveKeyboardContext(
    source?: KeyboardEvent | KeyboardEventContext | SyntheticKeyboardContext | null,
  ): KeyboardEventContext | null {
    if (!source) {
      return null;
    }
    if ('target' in source) {
      return this.getKeyboardEventContext(source);
    }

    return {
      inInput: !!source.inInput,
      inTextarea: !!source.inTextarea,
      inSelect: !!source.inSelect,
      inContentEditable: !!source.inContentEditable,
      inModal: !!source.inModal,
      inQuickAccessMenu: !!source.inQuickAccessMenu,
      hasActivePane: !!source.hasActivePane,
      isFilterInput: !!source.isFilterInput,
      inFileEntry: !!source.inFileEntry,
      inViewerSurface: !!source.inViewerSurface,
    };
  }

  private getKeyboardEventContext(event: { target: EventTarget | null }): KeyboardEventContext {
    const target = event.target as HTMLElement | null;
    const tagName = target?.tagName.toLowerCase() ?? '';

    return {
      inInput: tagName === 'input',
      inTextarea: tagName === 'textarea',
      inSelect: tagName === 'select',
      inContentEditable: !!target?.isContentEditable,
      inModal: !!target?.closest('.modal, [role="dialog"]'),
      inQuickAccessMenu: !!target?.closest('.ab-quick-access-drop'),
      hasActivePane: !!target?.closest('.pane'),
      isFilterInput: !!target?.classList.contains('filter-input'),
      inFileEntry: !!target?.closest('.file-entry'),
      inViewerSurface: !!target?.closest('.viewer-surface'),
    };
  }

  private normalizeMouseGesture(kind: string, event: MouseEvent | WheelEvent): MouseGesture | null {
    const modifiers: MouseGesture['modifiers'] = [];
    if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) modifiers.push(event.ctrlKey ? 'ctrl' : 'meta');
    if (event.shiftKey) modifiers.push('shift');
    if (event.altKey) modifiers.push('alt');

    switch (kind) {
      case 'click':
        return { type: 'click', button: this.normalizeMouseButton(event.button), modifiers: modifiers.length ? modifiers.sort() : undefined };
      case 'dblclick':
        return { type: 'doubleClick', button: this.normalizeMouseButton(event.button), modifiers: modifiers.length ? modifiers.sort() : undefined };
      case 'auxclick':
      case 'contextmenu':
      case 'mousedown':
      case 'mouseup':
        return {
          type: kind === 'contextmenu' ? 'click' : (kind as 'mousedown' | 'mouseup'),
          button: this.normalizeMouseButton(event.button),
          modifiers: modifiers.length ? modifiers.sort() : undefined,
        };
      case 'wheel': {
        const wheelEvent = event as WheelEvent;
        const direction = Math.abs(wheelEvent.deltaX) > Math.abs(wheelEvent.deltaY)
          ? (wheelEvent.deltaX < 0 ? 'left' : 'right')
          : (wheelEvent.deltaY < 0 ? 'up' : 'down');
        return {
          type: 'wheel',
          modifiers: modifiers.length ? modifiers.sort() : undefined,
          direction,
        };
      }
      default:
        return null;
    }
  }

  private normalizeMouseButton(button: number): MouseGesture['button'] {
    switch (button) {
      case 1:
        return 'middle';
      case 2:
        return 'right';
      case 0:
      default:
        return 'left';
    }
  }

  private sameGesture(left: MouseGesture, right: MouseGesture): boolean {
    const leftMods = (left.modifiers ?? []).join('+');
    const rightMods = (right.modifiers ?? []).join('+');
    return left.type === right.type
      && (left.button ?? null) === (right.button ?? null)
      && (left.direction ?? null) === (right.direction ?? null)
      && leftMods === rightMods;
  }

  getActiveContextIds(): Set<string> {
    const ids = new Set<string>(['global']);
    for (const contextId of this.activeContexts.keys()) {
      ids.add(contextId);
    }
    return ids;
  }

  private beginPendingChord(steps: KeyStroke[], candidateBindingIds: string[]): void {
    this.clearPendingChordTimer();
    this.pendingChord = {
      startedAt: Date.now(),
      steps,
      candidateBindingIds,
    };
    this.pendingChord$.next(this.pendingChord);
    this.pendingChordTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      this.clearPendingChord();
    }, CHORD_TIMEOUT_MS);
  }

  private clearPendingChord(): void {
    this.clearPendingChordTimer();
    this.pendingChord = null;
    this.pendingChord$.next(null);
  }

  private clearPendingChordTimer(): void {
    if (this.pendingChordTimer === null) return;
    window.clearTimeout(this.pendingChordTimer);
    this.pendingChordTimer = null;
  }

  private emitBindings(): void {
    this.bindings$.next(this.getBindingSnapshot());
  }

  private getCommandHandler(commandId: string, invocation?: CommandInvocation): InputCommandHandler | null {
    if (!this.isCommandEnabled(commandId, invocation)) return null;
    return this.getActiveCommandRegistration(commandId)?.handler ?? null;
  }

  private emitShortcutDebug(trace: ShortcutDebugTrace): void {
    if (!this.showShortcutDebug) return;
    this.ngZone.run(() => {
      this.shortcutDebug$.next(trace);
    });
  }

  private formatDebugStroke(stroke: KeyStroke): string {
    const parts: string[] = [...(stroke.modifiers ?? []).map(modifier => {
      switch (modifier) {
        case 'ctrl': return 'Ctrl';
        case 'shift': return 'Shift';
        case 'alt': return 'Alt';
        case 'meta': return 'Meta';
        default: return modifier;
      }
    })];
    parts.push(stroke.key);
    return parts.join('+');
  }

  private getActiveBindingRegistration(registrations: Map<string, RegisteredBinding>): RegisteredBinding {
    let activeRegistration: RegisteredBinding | null = null;
    for (const registration of registrations.values()) {
      if (!activeRegistration || registration.registrationOrder > activeRegistration.registrationOrder) {
        activeRegistration = registration;
      }
    }

    if (!activeRegistration) {
      throw new Error('Binding registration set is unexpectedly empty.');
    }

    return activeRegistration;
  }

  private executeCommand(command: InputCommandHandler, invocation: CommandInvocation): boolean {
    try {
      this.ngZone.run(() => {
        const result = command(invocation);
        if (result instanceof Promise) {
          result.catch(error => console.error('Input command failed:', error));
        }
      });
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Input command failed:', error);
      return false;
    }
  }

  private async executeCommandAsync(command: InputCommandHandler, invocation: CommandInvocation): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      await this.ngZone.run(async () => {
        await command(invocation);
      });
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Input command failed:', error);
      return false;
    }
  }

  private getActiveCommandRegistration(commandId: string): RegisteredCommand | null {
    const registrations = this.commands.get(commandId);
    if (!registrations || registrations.size === 0) return null;

    let activeRegistration: RegisteredCommand | null = null;
    for (const registration of registrations.values()) {
      if (!activeRegistration || registration.registrationOrder > activeRegistration.registrationOrder) {
        activeRegistration = registration;
      }
    }
    return activeRegistration;
  }

  private emitActiveContexts(): void {
    const active = Array.from(this.activeContexts.values())
      .sort((left, right) => right.activatedAt - left.activatedAt)
      .map(entry => this.contexts.get(entry.id))
      .filter((context): context is InputContextDefinition => !!context);
    this.activeContexts$.next(active);
  }
}
````

````typescript
                        [placeholder]="selectedProtocol.credentialPlaceholder"
                      />
                      <small>Stored in memory only for this app session.</small>
                    </label>
                  </ng-template>
                </ng-template>
              </div>

              <div *ngIf="isS3Protocol" class="toggle-row">
                <label class="toggle-field">
                  <input type="checkbox" [(ngModel)]="form.anonymous" (ngModelChange)="clearError()" />
                  <span>Anonymous public bucket</span>
                </label>
                <label class="toggle-field">
                  <input type="checkbox" [(ngModel)]="form.usePathStyle" (ngModelChange)="clearError()" />
                  <span>Force path-style URLs</span>
                </label>
                <label class="toggle-field">
                  <input type="checkbox" [(ngModel)]="form.insecure" (ngModelChange)="clearError()" />
                  <span>Allow insecure TLS</span>
                </label>
              </div>

              <p *ngIf="errorMessage" class="error-banner">{{ errorMessage }}</p>

              <div class="actions">
                <button type="button" class="btn secondary" (click)="onCancel()">Cancel</button>
                <button type="button" class="btn" [disabled]="isConnecting || isAuthorizing" (click)="onSubmit()">
                  {{ isConnecting ? 'Connecting...' : 'Connect' }}
                </button>
              </div>
            </section>

            <aside class="remote-connect-side">
              <div class="section-heading">
                <h3>Active Remote Mounts</h3>
                <button type="button" class="btn secondary btn-utility" [disabled]="isRefreshing" (click)="refreshConnections()">
                  {{ isRefreshing ? '...' : 'Refresh' }}
                </button>
              </div>

              <div *ngIf="connections.length === 0" class="empty-state">
                No remote mounts are active in this session.
              </div>

              <div *ngIf="connections.length > 0" class="connection-list">
                <div
                  *ngFor="let mount of connections"
                  class="connection-card"
                  role="button"
                  tabindex="0"
                  (click)="openMount(mount)"
                  (keydown.enter)="openMount(mount)"
                  (keydown.space)="openMount(mount); $event.preventDefault()"
                >
                  <div class="connection-card-main">
                    <strong>{{ mount.name }}</strong>
                    <span>{{ mount.publicPath }}</span>
                    <small>{{ formatProtocolLabel(mount.protocol) }}{{ mount.host ? ' - ' + mount.host : '' }}</small>
                  </div>
                  <div class="connection-card-actions">
                    <span *ngIf="mount.readOnly" class="read-only-badge">Read only</span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      class="btn secondary btn-utility"
                      [disabled]="disconnectingMounts.has(mount.mountPoint)"
                      (click)="disconnectMount(mount, $event)"
                    >
                      {{ disconnectingMounts.has(mount.mountPoint) ? 'Disconnecting...' : 'Disconnect' }}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </aside>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </ng-container>
  `,
})
export class RemoteConnectDialogComponent {
  @ViewChild('dialogPanel') private dialogPanel?: ElementRef<HTMLElement>;

  readonly request$: Stream<RemoteConnectDialogRequest | null> = this.remoteConnectDialog.activeRequest$;
  readonly protocolPresets = REMOTE_PROTOCOL_PRESETS;
  readonly providerPresets = S3_PROVIDER_PRESETS;

  form: RemoteConnectFormModel = this.createDefaultForm();
  connections: contracts.RemoteMount[] = [];
  errorMessage = '';
  isConnecting = false;
  isRefreshing = false;
  readonly disconnectingMounts = new Set<string>();

  oauthStatus: RemoteOAuthStatusId = 'idle';
  oauthSessionId: string | null = null;
  oauthRedirectUri = '';
  oauthAccountLabel = '';

  private readonly destroy$ = createSubject<void>();
  private releaseDialogContext: (() => void) | null = null;
  private oauthPollTimer: number | null = null;
  private oauthSessionConnected = false;

  constructor(
    private readonly apiService: ApiService,
    private readonly remoteConnectDialog: RemoteConnectDialogService,
    private readonly inputContexts: InputContextService,
    private readonly inputEngine: InputEngineService,
    private readonly overlayFreeze: NativeOverlayFreezeService,
  ) {}

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.remoteConnect.submit', () => {
      void this.onSubmit();
    });
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.remoteConnect.close', () => this.onCancel());
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.remoteConnect.focusNext', () => this.moveDialogFocus(1));
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('dialog.remoteConnect.focusPrev', () => this.moveDialogFocus(-1));

    this.remoteConnectDialog.activeRequest$
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe((request) => {
        if (request) {
          void this.cancelUnusedOAuthSession();
          this.form = this.createDefaultForm();
          if (request.initialProtocol && this.isRemoteProtocol(request.initialProtocol)) {
            this.form.protocol = request.initialProtocol;
            this.onProtocolChange(request.initialProtocol);
          }
          if (request.initialName) {
            this.form.name = request.initialName;
          }
          this.connections = [];
          this.errorMessage = '';
          this.isConnecting = false;
          this.disconnectingMounts.clear();
          this.releaseDialogContext ??= this.inputContexts.acquire('dialog.remoteConnect');
          this.overlayFreeze.acquire('dialog.remoteConnect');
          void this.refreshConnections();
          return;
        }

        if (!this.oauthSessionConnected) {
          void this.cancelUnusedOAuthSession();
        } else {
          this.stopOAuthPolling();
          this.resetOAuthState();
        }
        this.oauthSessionConnected = false;
        this.errorMessage = '';
        this.isConnecting = false;
        this.connections = [];
        this.disconnectingMounts.clear();
        this.releaseDialogContext?.();
        this.releaseDialogContext = null;
        this.overlayFreeze.release('dialog.remoteConnect');
      });
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.overlayFreeze.release('dialog.remoteConnect');
    this.releaseDialogContext?.();
    this.releaseDialogContext = null;
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.remoteConnect.submit');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.remoteConnect.close');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.remoteConnect.focusNext');
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('dialog.remoteConnect.focusPrev');
    void this.cancelUnusedOAuthSession();
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
  }

  get isS3Protocol(): boolean {
    return this.form.protocol === 's3';
  }

  get isAuthorizing(): boolean {
    return this.oauthStatus === 'pending';
  }

  get selectedProtocol(): RemoteProtocolPreset {
    return REMOTE_PROTOCOL_PRESET_MAP.get(this.form.protocol) ?? REMOTE_PROTOCOL_PRESETS[0];
  }

  get selectedProvider(): S3ProviderPreset {
    return S3_PROVIDER_PRESET_MAP.get(this.form.provider) ?? S3_PROVIDER_PRESETS[0];
  }

  get oauthActionTitle(): string {
    if (this.oauthStatus === 'complete') {
      return 'Authorization ready';
    }
    return 'Browser-based OAuth sign-in';
  }

  get oauthActionButton(): string {
    return this.oauthStatus === 'complete' ? 'Re-authorize' : 'Authorize';
  }

  clearError(): void {
    this.errorMessage = '';
  }

  onProtocolChange(protocol: RemoteProtocolId): void {
    const previousProtocol = this.form.protocol;
    this.form.protocol = protocol;
    if (protocol === 's3') {
      this.onProviderPresetChange(this.form.provider);
    } else if (previousProtocol !== protocol) {
      this.form.authMode = 'oauth';
      this.form.tenant = protocol === 'onedrive' ? 'common' : '';
      void this.cancelUnusedOAuthSession();
    }
    this.clearError();
  }

  onAuthModeChange(mode: CloudCredentialMode): void {
    this.form.authMode = mode;
    if (mode !== 'oauth') {
      void this.cancelUnusedOAuthSession();
    }
    this.clearError();
  }

  onOAuthInputChange(): void {
    if (this.oauthStatus === 'complete' || this.oauthStatus === 'failed') {
      void this.cancelUnusedOAuthSession();
    } else {
      this.clearError();
    }
  }

  onProviderPresetChange(provider: S3ProviderPresetId): void {
    const preset = S3_PROVIDER_PRESET_MAP.get(provider);
    if (!preset) {
      return;
    }

    this.form.provider = provider;
    this.form.endpoint = preset.endpoint;
    this.form.region = preset.region;
    this.form.usePathStyle = preset.usePathStyle;
    this.clearError();
  }

  onCancel(): void {
    if (this.isConnecting) {
      return;
    }
    this.remoteConnectDialog.resolveActive(null);
  }

  async authorizeInBrowser(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.isS3Protocol || this.form.authMode !== 'oauth') {
      return;
    }

    const clientId = this.form.clientId.trim();
    if (!clientId) {
      this.errorMessage = `${this.selectedProtocol.oauthClientLabel || 'Client ID'} is required before authorizing in the browser.`;
      return;
    }

    await this.cancelUnusedOAuthSession();
    this.clearError();
    this.oauthStatus = 'pending';

    try {
      const response = await this.apiService.remoteOAuthBegin(new contracts.RemoteOAuthBeginRequest({
        protocol: this.form.protocol,
        clientId,
        tenant: this.form.protocol === 'onedrive' ? this.normalizeOptionalField(this.form.tenant) : undefined,
      }));
      this.oauthSessionId = response.sessionId;
      this.oauthRedirectUri = response.redirectUri;
      this.oauthAccountLabel = '';
      BrowserOpenURL(response.authUrl);
      this.startOAuthPolling(response.sessionId);
    } catch (error) {
      this.oauthStatus = 'failed';
      this.errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    }
  }

  async onSubmit(): Promise<void> {
    const validationError = this.validateForm();
    if (validationError) {
      this.errorMessage = validationError;
      return;
    }

    this.isConnecting = true;
    this.errorMessage = '';

    try {
      let mount: contracts.RemoteMount;
      if (!this.isS3Protocol && this.form.authMode === 'oauth') {
        mount = await this.apiService.remoteConnectOAuth(new contracts.RemoteOAuthConnectRequest({
          sessionId: this.oauthSessionId!,
          name: this.form.name.trim(),
        }));
        this.oauthSessionConnected = true;
      } else {
        mount = await this.apiService.remoteConnect(new contracts.RemoteConfig({
          protocol: this.form.protocol,
          host: '',
          name: this.form.name.trim(),
          endpoint: this.isS3Protocol ? this.normalizeOptionalField(this.form.endpoint) : undefined,
          region: this.isS3Protocol ? (this.normalizeOptionalField(this.form.region) ?? 'us-east-1') : undefined,
          bucket: this.isS3Protocol ? this.form.bucket.trim() : undefined,
          prefix: this.isS3Protocol ? this.normalizeOptionalField(this.form.prefix) : undefined,
          accessKeyId: this.isS3Protocol ? this.normalizeOptionalField(this.form.accessKeyId) : undefined,
          secretAccessKey: this.isS3Protocol ? this.normalizeOptionalField(this.form.secretAccessKey) : undefined,
          sessionToken: this.isS3Protocol ? this.normalizeOptionalField(this.form.sessionToken) : undefined,
          anonymous: this.isS3Protocol ? this.form.anonymous : undefined,
          usePathStyle: this.isS3Protocol ? this.form.usePathStyle : undefined,
          insecure: this.isS3Protocol ? this.form.insecure : undefined,
          accessToken: !this.isS3Protocol ? this.normalizeOptionalField(this.form.accessToken) : undefined,
        }));
      }
      this.remoteConnectDialog.resolveActive(mount);
    } catch (error) {
      this.errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    } finally {
      this.isConnecting = false;
    }
  }

  async refreshConnections(): Promise<void> {
    this.isRefreshing = true;
    this.errorMessage = '';

    try {
      const connections = await this.apiService.remoteListConnections();
      this.connections = connections.sort((left, right) => {
        const byProtocol = left.protocol.localeCompare(right.protocol);
        return byProtocol !== 0 ? byProtocol : left.name.localeCompare(right.name);
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    } finally {
      this.isRefreshing = false;
    }
  }

  openMount(mount: contracts.RemoteMount): void {
    this.remoteConnectDialog.resolveActive(mount);
  }

  async disconnectMount(mount: contracts.RemoteMount, event: Event): Promise<void> {
    event.stopPropagation();
    this.disconnectingMounts.add(mount.mountPoint);
    this.errorMessage = '';

    try {
      await this.apiService.remoteDisconnect(mount.mountPoint);
      await this.refreshConnections();
    } catch (error) {
      this.errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    } finally {
      this.disconnectingMounts.delete(mount.mountPoint);
    }
  }

  formatProtocolLabel(protocol: string): string {
    return REMOTE_PROTOCOL_PRESET_MAP.get(protocol as RemoteProtocolId)?.label ?? protocol.toUpperCase();
  }

  private validateForm(): string | null {
    if (!/[A-Za-z0-9]/.test(this.form.name)) {
      return 'Alias is required and must contain at least one letter or number.';
    }

    if (this.isS3Protocol) {
      if (!this.form.bucket.trim()) {
        return 'Bucket is required.';
      }
      if (this.selectedProvider.endpointRequired && !this.form.endpoint.trim()) {
        return 'Endpoint is required for the selected provider preset.';
      }

      const hasAccessKey = this.form.accessKeyId.trim().length > 0;
      const hasSecretKey = this.form.secretAccessKey.trim().length > 0;
      if (hasAccessKey !== hasSecretKey) {
        return 'Access key ID and secret access key must be provided together.';
      }
      if (this.form.anonymous && (hasAccessKey || hasSecretKey || this.form.sessionToken.trim().length > 0)) {
        return 'Anonymous mode cannot be combined with access keys or a session token.';
      }
      return null;
    }

    if (this.form.authMode === 'oauth') {
      if (!this.form.clientId.trim()) {
        return `${this.selectedProtocol.oauthClientLabel || 'Client ID'} is required.`;
      }
      if (!this.oauthSessionId || this.oauthStatus !== 'complete') {
        return 'Authorize this provider in the browser before connecting.';
      }
      return null;
    }

    if (!this.form.accessToken.trim()) {
      return `${this.selectedProtocol.credentialLabel} is required.`;
    }
    return null;
  }

  private normalizeOptionalField(value: string): string | undefined {
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    return trimmed.length > 0 ? trimmed : undefined;
  }

  private createDefaultForm(): RemoteConnectFormModel {
    return {
      protocol: 's3',
      provider: 'aws',
      authMode: 'oauth',
      name: '',
      endpoint: '',
      region: 'us-east-1',
      bucket: '',
      prefix: '',
      accessKeyId: '',
      secretAccessKey: '',
      sessionToken: '',
      anonymous: false,
      usePathStyle: false,
      insecure: false,
      accessToken: '',
      clientId: '',
      tenant: 'common',
    };
  }

  private moveDialogFocus(delta: number): void {
    if (!this.dialogPanel?.nativeElement) {
      return;
    }
    moveFocusWithin(this.dialogPanel.nativeElement, delta);
  }

  private isRemoteProtocol(value: string): value is RemoteProtocolId {
    return value === 's3' || value === 'gdrive' || value === 'dropbox' || value === 'onedrive';
  }

  private startOAuthPolling(sessionId: string): void {
    this.stopOAuthPolling();
    const tick = async (): Promise<void> => {
      try {
        const status = await this.apiService.remoteOAuthStatus(sessionId);
        this.applyOAuthStatus(status);
        if (status.status === 'pending') {
          this.oauthPollTimer = window.setTimeout(() => void tick(), 1000);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        this.oauthStatus = 'failed';
        this.errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      }
    };
    void tick();
  }

  private stopOAuthPolling(): void {
    if (this.oauthPollTimer !== null) {
      window.clearTimeout(this.oauthPollTimer);
      this.oauthPollTimer = null;
    }
  }

  private applyOAuthStatus(status: contracts.RemoteOAuthStatus): void {
    this.oauthSessionId = status.sessionId;
    this.oauthStatus = this.normalizeOAuthStatus(status.status);
    if (this.oauthStatus === 'complete') {
      this.oauthAccountLabel = this.formatOAuthAccountLabel(status);
      this.errorMessage = '';
      this.stopOAuthPolling();
      return;
    }
    if (this.oauthStatus === 'failed') {
      this.errorMessage = status.error || 'OAuth authorization failed.';
      this.stopOAuthPolling();
    }
  }

  private formatOAuthAccountLabel(status: contracts.RemoteOAuthStatus): string {
    const parts = [status.accountName?.trim(), status.accountEmail?.trim()].filter((value): value is string => !!value);
    if (parts.length === 0) {
      return '';
    }
    if (parts.length === 1 || parts[0] === parts[1]) {
      return parts[0];
    }
    return `${parts[0]} (${parts[1]})`;
  }

  private normalizeOAuthStatus(value: string): RemoteOAuthStatusId {
    return value === 'pending' || value === 'complete' || value === 'failed' ? value : 'failed';
  }

  private async cancelUnusedOAuthSession(): Promise<void> {
    const sessionId = this.oauthSessionId;
    this.stopOAuthPolling();
    if (sessionId && !this.oauthSessionConnected) {
      try {
        await this.apiService.remoteOAuthCancel(sessionId);
      } catch {
        // Best-effort cleanup only.
      }
    }
    if (!this.oauthSessionConnected) {
      this.resetOAuthState();
    }
  }

  private resetOAuthState(): void {
    this.oauthStatus = 'idle';
    this.oauthSessionId = null;
    this.oauthRedirectUri = '';
    this.oauthAccountLabel = '';
  }
}
````
