}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-file-browser',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    WorkspaceSelectorComponent,
    FilePaneComponent,
    PathHistoryViewerComponent,
    GlobalSearchComponent,
    KeyboardHelpComponent,
    CommandPaletteComponent,
    SplitDividerComponent,
    StatusBarComponent,
    OperationToastStackComponent,
    OperationStatusBarComponent,
    OperationCenterComponent,
    SelectionBasketComponent,
    ElevationStatusPillComponent,
    PaneComparisonBarComponent,
    PaneSyncReviewComponent
],
  templateUrl: './file-browser.component.html',
  styleUrls: ['./file-browser.component.scss'],
})
export class FileBrowserComponent implements OnInit, OnDestroy {
  private readonly paneRowFixedWidthPx = 4;

  private static nextOwnerId = 0;
  private static readonly mouseBindingIds = [
    'global.mouse.viewer.ctrlWheelUp',
    'global.mouse.viewer.ctrlWheelDown',
  ] as const;
  private readonly browserCommandOwner = `file-browser:${++FileBrowserComponent.nextOwnerId}`;
  private readonly mouseCommandOwner = `${this.browserCommandOwner}:mouse`;

  @ViewChild(KeyboardHelpComponent) keyboardHelp?: KeyboardHelpComponent;
  @ViewChild(GlobalSearchComponent) globalSearch?: GlobalSearchComponent;
  @ViewChild(CommandPaletteComponent) commandPalette?: CommandPaletteComponent;
  @ViewChild(PathHistoryViewerComponent) pathHistoryViewer?: PathHistoryViewerComponent;
  @ViewChild('panesContainer') panesContainer?: ElementRef;

  @ViewChild('leftPane') leftPane?: FilePaneComponent;
  @ViewChild('rightPane') rightPane?: FilePaneComponent;
  @ViewChild('toastStack') toastStack?: OperationToastStackComponent;
  @ViewChild(OperationCenterComponent) operationCenter?: OperationCenterComponent;
  @ViewChild(SelectionBasketComponent) selectionBasket?: SelectionBasketComponent;

  activeWorkspace: WorkspaceConfig | null = null;
  workspaceList: WorkspaceConfig[] = [];
  showWorkspaceMenu = false;
  showHidden = false;
  activePaneId: 'left' | 'right' = 'left';
  viewSettings = this.appSettingsService.getSettings().view;

  leftPaneWidth = 50;
  rightPaneWidth = 50;
  toastCollapsed = false;
  elevationActive = false;
  elevationBusy = false;
  isMaximized = false;
  comparisonVisible = false;
  syncReviewVisible = false;
  comparisonRecursive = false;
  recursiveComparisonScanning = false;
  recursiveComparisonError = '';
  recursiveComparisonResult: PaneComparisonResult | null = null;
  readonly pendingChord$ = this.inputEngine.pendingChord$;
  readonly shortcutDebug$ = this.inputEngine.shortcutDebug$;
  readonly showShortcutDebug = this.inputEngine.showShortcutDebug;
  private resizeTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  FileType = FileType;
  private readonly clipboardController = new FileBrowserClipboardController();
  private readonly dropController = new FileBrowserDropController();
  private readonly layoutController = new FileBrowserLayoutController();
  private readonly pathHelper: FileBrowserPathHelper;
  private readonly previewController = new FileBrowserPreviewController();
  private readonly runtimeController = new FileBrowserRuntimeController();
  private readonly searchController = new FileBrowserSearchController();
  private readonly transferController = new FileBrowserTransferController();
  private readonly workspaceController = new FileBrowserWorkspaceController();

  private destroy$ = createSubject<void>();
  private clipboard: { operation: 'copy' | 'cut'; paths: string[] } | null = null;

  private browserCommandCleanup: (() => void) | null = null;
  private nativeBrowserPaneMessageCleanup: (() => void) | null = null;
  private lastNativeShortcutSignature = '';
  private lastNativeShortcutAt = 0;

  constructor(
    public apiService: ApiService,
    public workspaceService: WorkspaceService,
    public pathHistoryService: PathHistoryService,
    public theme: ThemeService,
    public archiveService: ArchiveService,
    public confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService,
    public inputEngine: InputEngineService,
    public remoteConnectDialog: RemoteConnectDialogService,
    public appSettingsService: SettingsService,
    public operationService: OperationService,
    public selectionBasketService: SelectionBasketService,
    private ngZone: NgZone,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private windowStateService: WindowStateService,
    private keybindingStorage: KeybindingStorageService,
    private paneComparison: PaneComparisonService,
    private recursivePaneComparison: PaneRecursiveComparisonService,
    private nativeBrowserPane: NativeBrowserPaneService,
  ) {
    this.pathHelper = new FileBrowserPathHelper(this.apiService);
  }

  ngOnInit(): void {
    this.workspaceService.activeWorkspace$
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(workspace => {
        // Some Wails/bridge async callbacks can land outside Angular's zone.
        // Ensure state updates trigger a render without requiring a user click.
        this.ngZone.run(() => {
          const previousId = this.activeWorkspace?.id;
          this.activeWorkspace = workspace;
          if (workspace) {
            this.showHidden = workspace.showHidden;
            if (workspace.activePaneId === 'left' || workspace.activePaneId === 'right') {
              this.activePaneId = workspace.activePaneId;
            }
            if (workspace.id !== previousId) {
              this.layoutController.loadPaneWidths(this.layoutHost);
            }
          }
          this.cdr.markForCheck();
        });
      });

    this.workspaceService.workspaces$
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(workspaces => {
        this.ngZone.run(() => {
          this.workspaceList = workspaces.workspaces;
          this.cdr.markForCheck();
        });
      });

    this.appSettingsService.getSettings$()
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe((settings) => {
        this.ngZone.run(() => {
          this.viewSettings = settings.view;
          this.cdr.markForCheck();
        });
      });

    this.browserCommandCleanup = this.setupBrowserCommands();
    this.nativeBrowserPaneMessageCleanup = this.nativeBrowserPane.onMessage((event) => {
      void this.handleNativeBrowserPaneMessage(event);
    });
    this.keybindingStorage.applyOverrides(this.inputEngine);
    this.registerMouseBindings();
    this.layoutController.loadPaneWidths(this.layoutHost);
    void this.runtimeController.initialize(this.runtimeHost);
    this.windowStateService.start();
    void this.syncMaximizedState();
    window.addEventListener('resize', this.handleResize);
  }



  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();
    this.apiService.disconnectWebSocket();

    this.browserCommandCleanup?.();
    this.nativeBrowserPaneMessageCleanup?.();
    this.unregisterMouseBindings();
    this.runtimeController.dispose();
    window.removeEventListener('resize', this.handleResize);
    if (this.resizeTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.resizeTimer);
    }
  }

  private readonly handleResize = (): void => {
    if (this.resizeTimer) clearTimeout(this.resizeTimer);
    this.resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      void this.syncMaximizedState();
    }, 300);
  };

  private async handleNativeBrowserPaneMessage(event: NativeBrowserPaneIncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    const message = this.parseNativeBrowserPaneShortcutMessage(event.data);
    if (!message) {
      return;
    }

    const shortcutSignature = [
      event.surfaceId,
      message.key,
      message.code ?? '',
      message.ctrlKey ? '1' : '0',
      message.shiftKey ? '1' : '0',
      message.altKey ? '1' : '0',
      message.metaKey ? '1' : '0',
    ].join('|');
    const now = Date.now();
    if (shortcutSignature === this.lastNativeShortcutSignature && now-this.lastNativeShortcutAt < 120) {
      return;
    }
    this.lastNativeShortcutSignature = shortcutSignature;
    this.lastNativeShortcutAt = now;

    const paneId = this.resolvePaneIdForBrowserSurface(event.surfaceId);
    if (!paneId) {
      return;
    }

    await this.ngZone.run(async () => {
      if (this.activePaneId !== paneId) {
        this.setActivePane(paneId);
      }

      await this.inputEngine.dispatchKeyboardEvent({
        key: message.key,
        code: message.code,
        ctrlKey: message.ctrlKey,
        shiftKey: message.shiftKey,
        altKey: message.altKey,
        metaKey: message.metaKey,
      }, {
        context: {
          hasActivePane: true,
          inInput: !!message.context?.inInput,
          inTextarea: !!message.context?.inTextarea,
          inSelect: !!message.context?.inSelect,
          inContentEditable: !!message.context?.inContentEditable,
        },
      });
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
  }

  private parseNativeBrowserPaneShortcutMessage(value: unknown): NativeBrowserPaneShortcutMessage | null {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
      return null;
    }

    const message = value as NativeBrowserPaneShortcutMessage;
    if (message.type !== 'shortcut' || message.event !== 'keydown') {
      return null;
    }
    if (typeof message.key !== 'string' || !message.key.trim()) {
      return null;
    }

    return message;
  }

  private resolvePaneIdForBrowserSurface(surfaceId: string): 'left' | 'right' | null {
    if (!surfaceId) {
      return null;
    }
    if (this.leftPane && this.getBrowserSurfaceId(this.leftPane) === surfaceId) {
      return 'left';
    }
    if (this.rightPane && this.getBrowserSurfaceId(this.rightPane) === surfaceId) {
      return 'right';
    }
    return null;
  }

  private getBrowserSurfaceId(pane: FilePaneComponent): string {
    if (!pane.currentTabId) {
      return '';
    }
    return `${pane.paneId}:${pane.currentTabId}`;
  }

  private async syncMaximizedState(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const m = await WindowIsMaximised();
      if (this.isMaximized !== m) {
        this.isMaximized = m;
        this.cdr.markForCheck();
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }

  minimizeWindow(): void {
    WindowMinimise();
  }

  async toggleMaximizeWindow(): Promise<void> {
    WindowToggleMaximise();
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100));
    await this.syncMaximizedState();
  }

  closeWindow(): void {
    Quit();
  }

  toggleThemePreference(): void {
    const currentTheme = this.theme.getTheme$().value;
    this.appSettingsService.updateGeneralSettings({ theme: currentTheme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark' });
  }

  toggleCompactMode(): void {
    const currentCompact = this.appSettingsService.getSettings().view.compactMode;
    this.appSettingsService.updateViewSettings({ compactMode: !currentCompact });
  }

  copyToOtherPane(source: FilePaneComponent | undefined, target: FilePaneComponent | undefined, paths?: string[]): void {
    if (!source || !target) return;
    const selected = paths ?? Array.from(source.selectedFiles);
    if (selected.length === 0) return;
    if (source === this.leftPane && target === this.rightPane) {
      this.onCopyFromLeft(selected);
    } else if (source === this.rightPane && target === this.leftPane) {
      this.onCopyFromRight(selected);
    }
  }

  moveToOtherPane(source: FilePaneComponent | undefined, target: FilePaneComponent | undefined, paths?: string[]): void {
    if (!source || !target) return;
    const selected = paths ?? Array.from(source.selectedFiles);
    if (selected.length === 0) return;
    if (source === this.leftPane && target === this.rightPane) {
      this.onMoveFromLeft(selected);
    } else if (source === this.rightPane && target === this.leftPane) {
      this.onMoveFromRight(selected);
    }
  }

  setActivePane(paneId: 'left' | 'right'): void {
    if (this.activePaneId === paneId) return;
    this.activePaneId = paneId;
    this.workspaceService.setActivePaneId(paneId);
  }

  private getActivePane(): FilePaneComponent | undefined {
    return this.activePaneId === 'left' ? this.leftPane : this.rightPane;
  }

  getActiveSelectionPaths(): string[] {
    return Array.from(this.getActivePane()?.selectedFiles ?? []);
  }

  addToSelectionBasket(invocation?: CommandInvocation): void {
    const explicit = invocation?.args?.['paths'];
    const paths = Array.isArray(explicit)
      ? explicit.filter((path): path is string => typeof path === 'string')
      : this.getActiveSelectionPaths();
    const source = typeof invocation?.context?.['sourceLabel'] === 'string'
      ? invocation.context['sourceLabel']
      : `pane:${this.activePaneId}`;
    const added = this.selectionBasketService.add(paths, source);
    if (added > 0) this.selectionBasket?.show();
  }

  async copySelectionBasketTo(targetSide: 'left' | 'right'): Promise<void> {
    const paths = this.selectionBasketService.paths;
    const target = this.getPane(targetSide);
    if (!target || paths.length === 0) return;
    if (this.getPaneTabKind(target) !== 'dir' || target.isInArchive()) {
      this.confirmDialog.alert('Selection Basket\nChoose a regular folder pane as the destination.');
      return;
    }
    const destDir = target.currentPath || target.getDestinationDir();
    const confirmed = !this.appSettingsService.getSettings().files.confirmBeforeCopy || await this.confirmDialog.confirm({
      title: 'Copy Selection Basket',
      message: `Copy ${paths.length} collected item(s) to ${destDir}?`,
      confirmText: 'Copy',
    });
    if (!confirmed) return;
    const items = await Promise.all(paths.map(async source => ({
      source,
      destination: await this.buildDestinationPath(source, destDir),
    })));
    const result = await this.apiService.batchCopy(items, true);
    if (result?.failed) this.confirmDialog.alert(`Basket Copy\n${result.failed} item(s) failed.`);
    await target.browserCommands.navigation.refresh();
  }

  async moveSelectionBasketTo(targetSide: 'left' | 'right'): Promise<void> {
    const paths = this.selectionBasketService.paths;
    const target = this.getPane(targetSide);
    if (!target || paths.length === 0) return;
    if (this.getPaneTabKind(target) !== 'dir' || target.isInArchive()) {
      this.confirmDialog.alert('Selection Basket\nChoose a regular folder pane as the destination.');
      return;
    }
    const destDir = target.currentPath || target.getDestinationDir();
    const confirmed = !this.appSettingsService.getSettings().files.confirmBeforeMove || await this.confirmDialog.confirm({
      title: 'Move Selection Basket',
      message: `Move ${paths.length} collected item(s) to ${destDir}?`,
      confirmText: 'Move',
    });
    if (!confirmed) return;
    const items = await Promise.all(paths.map(async source => ({
      source,
      destination: await this.buildDestinationPath(source, destDir),
    })));
    const result = await this.apiService.batchMove(items, true);
    const failedSources = new Set((result?.errors ?? []).map(error => error.source));
    if (!result?.failed) {
      this.selectionBasketService.removePaths(paths);
    } else if (failedSources.size > 0) {
      this.selectionBasketService.removePaths(paths.filter(path => !failedSources.has(path)));
    }
    if (result?.failed) this.confirmDialog.alert(`Basket Move\n${result.failed} item(s) failed and remain in the basket.`);
    await target.browserCommands.navigation.refresh();
    await this.leftPane?.browserCommands.navigation.refresh();
    await this.rightPane?.browserCommands.navigation.refresh();
  }

  async deleteSelectionBasket(): Promise<void> {
    const paths = this.selectionBasketService.paths;
    if (paths.length === 0) return;
    const confirmed = !this.appSettingsService.getSettings().files.confirmBeforeDelete || await this.confirmDialog.confirm({
      title: 'Delete Selection Basket',
      message: `Move ${paths.length} collected item(s) to the recycle bin / trash?`,
      confirmText: 'Delete',
      danger: true,
    });
    if (!confirmed) return;
    const result = await this.apiService.batchDelete(paths, true, true);
    const failedSources = new Set((result?.errors ?? []).map(error => error.source));
    if (!result?.failed) {
      this.selectionBasketService.removePaths(paths);
    } else if (failedSources.size > 0) {
      this.selectionBasketService.removePaths(paths.filter(path => !failedSources.has(path)));
    }
    if (result?.failed) this.confirmDialog.alert(`Basket Delete\n${result.failed} item(s) failed and remain in the basket.`);
    await this.leftPane?.browserCommands.navigation.refresh();
    await this.rightPane?.browserCommands.navigation.refresh();
  }

  private getOtherPane(): FilePaneComponent | undefined {
    return this.activePaneId === 'left' ? this.rightPane : this.leftPane;
  }

  private getPane(paneId: 'left' | 'right'): FilePaneComponent | undefined {
    return paneId === 'left' ? this.leftPane : this.rightPane;
  }

  private getOppositePaneId(paneId: 'left' | 'right'): 'left' | 'right' {
    return paneId === 'left' ? 'right' : 'left';
  }

  canComparePanes(): boolean {
    const left = this.leftPane;
    const right = this.rightPane;
    return !!left && !!right
      && left.activeSurfaceId === 'dir'
      && right.activeSurfaceId === 'dir'
      && !left.isInArchive()
      && !right.isInArchive();
  }

  togglePaneComparison(): void {
    if (this.comparisonVisible) {
      this.comparisonVisible = false;
      this.syncReviewVisible = false;
      return;
    }
    if (!this.canComparePanes()) {
      void this.confirmDialog.alert('Pane comparison is available when both panes show regular folders.');
      return;
    }
    this.comparisonVisible = true;
  }

  closePaneComparison(): void {
    this.comparisonVisible = false;
    this.syncReviewVisible = false;
    this.comparisonRecursive = false;
    this.recursiveComparisonResult = null;
    this.recursiveComparisonError = '';
  }

  openSyncReview(): void {
    if (!this.canComparePanes()) return;
    this.comparisonVisible = true;
    this.syncReviewVisible = true;
  }

  closeSyncReview(): void {
    this.syncReviewVisible = false;
  }

  get paneComparisonResult(): PaneComparisonResult {
    if (this.comparisonRecursive && this.recursiveComparisonResult) return this.recursiveComparisonResult;
    return this.paneComparison.compare(this.leftPane?.entries ?? [], this.rightPane?.entries ?? []);
  }

  async toggleRecursiveComparison(): Promise<void> {
    this.comparisonRecursive = !this.comparisonRecursive;
    this.syncReviewVisible = false;
    if (this.comparisonRecursive) await this.refreshRecursiveComparison();
  }

  async refreshRecursiveComparison(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canComparePanes() || !this.leftPane || !this.rightPane) return;
    this.recursiveComparisonScanning = true;
    this.recursiveComparisonError = '';
    try {
      const result = await this.recursivePaneComparison.compare(
        this.apiService,
        this.leftPane.currentPath,
        this.rightPane.currentPath,
        { showHidden: this.showHidden },
      );
      this.recursiveComparisonResult = result.comparison;
      if (result.truncated) this.recursiveComparisonError = 'Scan limit reached; results are partial.';
      else if (result.warnings.length) this.recursiveComparisonError = `${result.warnings.length} folder(s) could not be scanned.`;
    } catch (error) {
      this.recursiveComparisonResult = null;
      this.recursiveComparisonError = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    } finally {
      this.recursiveComparisonScanning = false;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  async executeSyncPlan(plan: PaneSyncPlan): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canComparePanes() || !plan || plan.items.length === 0) return;

    const confirmed = await this.confirmDialog.confirm({
      title: 'Execute Synchronization Plan',
      message: `Apply ${plan.items.length} approved synchronization action(s)? Existing destination items will use the normal conflict-resolution workflow.`,
      confirmText: 'Synchronize',
    });
    if (!confirmed) return;

    if (this.comparisonRecursive) {
      const leftToRight = plan.items
        .filter(item => item.direction === 'left-to-right' && item.leftPath)
        .map(item => ({ source: item.leftPath!, relativePath: item.key }));
      const rightToLeft = plan.items
        .filter(item => item.direction === 'right-to-left' && item.rightPath)
        .map(item => ({ source: item.rightPath!, relativePath: item.key }));
      if (leftToRight.length) await this.transferController.copyRelative(this.transferHost, 'left', leftToRight);
      if (rightToLeft.length) await this.transferController.copyRelative(this.transferHost, 'right', rightToLeft);
    } else {
      if (plan.leftToRight.length > 0) {
        await this.transferController.copy(this.transferHost, 'left', plan.leftToRight, { skipConfirmation: true });
      }
      if (plan.rightToLeft.length > 0) {
        await this.transferController.copy(this.transferHost, 'right', plan.rightToLeft, { skipConfirmation: true });
      }
    }

    this.syncReviewVisible = false;
    await Promise.all([
      this.leftPane?.browserCommands.navigation.refresh(),
      this.rightPane?.browserCommands.navigation.refresh(),
    ]);
  }

  selectComparisonDifferences(side: 'left' | 'right'): void {
    if (!this.canComparePanes()) return;
    const result = this.paneComparisonResult;
    const paths = side === 'left'
      ? this.paneComparison.leftDifferencePaths(result)
      : this.paneComparison.rightDifferencePaths(result);
    const pane = side === 'left' ? this.leftPane! : this.rightPane!;
    const selected = new Set(paths);
    pane.onSelectionChange(pane.entries.filter(entry => selected.has(entry.path)));
    this.setActivePane(side);
  }

  copyMissingComparison(sourceSide: 'left' | 'right'): void {
    if (!this.canComparePanes()) return;
    const result = this.paneComparisonResult;
    const missing = result.items.filter(item => sourceSide === 'left'
      ? item.status === 'only-left' && !!item.left
      : item.status === 'only-right' && !!item.right);
    if (missing.length === 0) return;
    if (this.comparisonRecursive) {
      const relative = missing.map(item => ({
        source: sourceSide === 'left' ? item.left!.path : item.right!.path,
        relativePath: item.key,
      }));
      void this.transferController.copyRelative(this.transferHost, sourceSide, relative);
      return;
    }
    const paths = missing.map(item => sourceSide === 'left' ? item.left!.path : item.right!.path);
    void this.transferController.copy(this.transferHost, sourceSide, paths);
  }

  private getPaneTabKind(pane: FilePaneComponent | undefined): 'dir' | 'viewer' | 'size-manager' {
    const tab = pane?.tabs.find((candidate) => candidate.id === pane.currentTabId);
    return (tab?.kind ?? 'dir') as 'dir' | 'viewer' | 'size-manager';
  }

  private syncSizeManagerPane(targetPaneId: 'left' | 'right', path?: string): void {
    const targetPane = this.getPane(targetPaneId);
    if (this.getPaneTabKind(targetPane) !== 'size-manager') return;
    const sourcePane = this.getPane(this.getOppositePaneId(targetPaneId));
    const targetPath = path ?? sourcePane?.currentPath;
    if (!targetPath) return;
    targetPane?.followSizeManagerNavigation(targetPath);
  }

  get leftActionAvailability(): ActionAvailability {
    return this.buildPaneActionAvailability(this.leftPane, this.rightPane);
  }

  get rightActionAvailability(): ActionAvailability {
    return this.buildPaneActionAvailability(this.rightPane, this.leftPane);
  }

  get activeActionAvailability(): ActionAvailability {
    return this.activePaneId === 'left' ? this.leftActionAvailability : this.rightActionAvailability;
  }

  private buildPaneActionAvailability(source?: FilePaneComponent, destination?: FilePaneComponent): ActionAvailability {
    if (!source) return NO_ACTIONS;
    return buildActionAvailability({
      source: source.sourceCapabilities,
      destination: destination?.sourceCapabilities ?? null,
      selectedCount: source.selectedFiles.size,
      hasClipboard: !!this.clipboard?.paths.length,
      clipboardOperation: this.clipboard?.operation ?? null,
    });
  }

  get statusFilteredEntries() { return this.getActivePane()?.filteredEntries ?? []; }
  get statusAllEntries()      { return this.getActivePane()?.entries ?? []; }
  get statusSelectedPaths()   { return this.getActivePane()?.selectedFiles ?? new Set<string>(); }

  private async copyCursorPathToClipboard(): Promise<void> {
    const pane = this.getActivePane();
    if (!pane || this.getPaneTabKind(pane) !== 'dir') {
      return;
    }

    const cursorPath = pane.selectionCursorPath;
    if (!cursorPath || cursorPath === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) {
      return;
    }

    const entry = pane.filteredEntries.find(candidate => candidate.path === cursorPath)
      ?? pane.entries.find(candidate => candidate.path === cursorPath);
    if (!entry || entry.path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) {
      return;
    }

    const friendlyPath = formatPathForDisplay(entry.path).trim();
    if (!friendlyPath) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(friendlyPath);
    } catch {
      // Ignore clipboard failures to keep shortcut handling non-blocking.
    }
  }

  private openSelectedWithExternal(): void {
    const pane = this.getActivePane();
    if (!pane || this.getPaneTabKind(pane) !== 'dir') return;

    const cursorPath = pane.selectionCursorPath;
    if (!cursorPath || cursorPath === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) return;

    const entry = pane.filteredEntries.find(candidate => candidate.path === cursorPath)
      ?? pane.entries.find(candidate => candidate.path === cursorPath);
    if (!entry || entry.path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) return;

    if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      // For directories, just open them internally
      pane.browserCommands.navigation.openSelectedItem();
      return;
    }

    this.apiService.openFile(entry.path).catch(err =>
      console.error('Failed to open file externally:', err)
    );
  }

    this.syncSizeManagerPane(this.getOppositePaneId(paneId as 'left' | 'right'), path);
  }

  private setupBrowserCommands(): () => void {
    const handlers: FileBrowserCommandHandlers = {
      openGlobalSearch:      () => this.globalSearch?.show(),
      showPathHistory:       () => this.pathHistoryViewer?.show(),
      quickPathJump:         () => console.log('Quick path jump - to be implemented'),
      navigateUp:            () => this.getActivePane()?.browserCommands.navigation.navigateUp(),
      refresh:               () => this.getActivePane()?.browserCommands.navigation.refresh(),
      showKeyboardHelp:      () => this.keyboardHelp?.show(),
      openSettings:          () => this.appSettingsService.openSettings(),
      openOperations:        () => this.operationCenter?.show(),
      openSelectionBasket:   () => this.selectionBasket?.show(),
      addToSelectionBasket:  (invocation) => this.addToSelectionBasket(invocation),
      clearSelectionBasket:  () => this.selectionBasketService.clear(),
      openCommandPalette:    () => this.commandPalette?.show(),
      cursorUp:              () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.moveCursorUp(),
      cursorDown:            () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.moveCursorDown(),
      cursorLeft:            () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.moveCursorLeft(),
      cursorRight:           () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.moveCursorRight(),
      cursorHome:            () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.moveCursorHome(),
      cursorEnd:             () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.moveCursorEnd(),
      cursorPageUp:          () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.moveCursorPageUp(),
      cursorPageDown:        () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.moveCursorPageDown(),
      newTab:                () => this.getActivePane()?.onNewTab(),
      closeTab:              () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.tabs.closeCurrentTab(),
      nextTab:               () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.tabs.nextTab(),
      prevTab:               () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.tabs.previousTab(),
      jumpToTab:             (index) => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.tabs.jumpToTab(index),
      togglePinTab:          () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.tabs.togglePinCurrentTab(),
      openItem:              () => this.getActivePane()?.browserCommands.navigation.openSelectedItem(),
      quickView:             () => this.previewController.openFrozenPreviewInOtherPane(this.previewHost),
      copyCursorPath:        () => this.copyCursorPathToClipboard(),
      copy:                  () => this.copySelectedToClipboard(),
      cut:                   () => this.cutSelectedToClipboard(),
      paste:                 () => this.pasteFromClipboard(),
      deleteSelected:        () => {
        const pane = this.getActivePane();
        if (!pane) return;
        if (this.getPaneTabKind(pane) === 'viewer') {
          pane.deleteInActiveViewer();
          return;
        }
        pane.browserCommands.selection.deleteSelected();
      },
      selectAll:             () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.selectAll(),
      deselectAll:           () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.deselectAll(),
      newFolder:             () => this.getActivePane()?.browserCommands.selection.createFolder(),
      rename:                () => this.getActivePane()?.browserCommands.selection.renameSelected(),
      toggleCurrent:         () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.toggleCurrentAndMoveDown(),
      inlineDirectorySize:   () => this.getActivePane()?.measureCurrentDirectorySizeAndMoveDown(),
      extendSelUp:           () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.extendSelection(-1),
      extendSelDown:         () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.extendSelection(1),
      selectByMask:          () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.selectByMask(),
      unselectByMask:        () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.unselectByMask(),
      invertSelection:       () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.invertSelection(),
      selectSameExt:         () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.selection.selectSameExtension(),
      focusFilter:           () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.focus.focusFilter(),
      advancedFilter:        () => console.log('Advanced filter - to be implemented'),
      clearFilter:           () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.focus.clearFilter(),
      showWorkspaceSwitcher: () => this.toggleWorkspaceMenu(),
      newWorkspace:          () => this.createNewWorkspace(),
      toggleHidden:          () => this.toggleShowHidden(),
      switchPane:            () => this.previewController.switchActivePane(this.previewHost),
      copyToOtherPane:       () => this.copyToOtherPaneCurrent(),
      moveToOtherPane:       () => this.moveToOtherPaneCurrent(),
      focusAddressBar:       () => this.getActivePane()?.shortcuts.focus.focusAddressBar(),
      comparePanes:          () => this.togglePaneComparison(),
      recursiveComparePanes: () => { if (!this.comparisonVisible) this.comparisonVisible = true; void this.toggleRecursiveComparison(); },
      reviewSyncPlan:        () => this.openSyncReview(),
      selectLeftDifferences:  () => this.selectComparisonDifferences('left'),
      selectRightDifferences: () => this.selectComparisonDifferences('right'),
      copyMissingLeftToRight: () => this.copyMissingComparison('left'),
      copyMissingRightToLeft: () => this.copyMissingComparison('right'),
      diskUsage:             () => {
        const sourcePane = this.getActivePane();
        const sourcePath = sourcePane?.currentPath;
        const targetPane = this.getOtherPane();
        targetPane?.openDiskUsageAnalyzer(sourcePath ?? undefined);
      },
      findDuplicates:        () => { const pane = this.getActivePane(); if (pane?.currentPath) void pane.openDuplicateFinder(pane.currentPath); },
      batchRename:           () => this.getActivePane()?.browserCommands.selection.renameSelected(),
      openWithExternal:      () => this.openSelectedWithExternal(),
    };
    return registerFileBrowserCommands(
      this.inputEngine,
      handlers,
      this.browserCommandOwner,
      commandId => this.isBrowserCommandEnabled(commandId),
    );
  }

  private isBrowserCommandEnabled(commandId: string): boolean {
    if (commandId === BC.comparePanes
      || commandId === BC.recursiveComparePanes
      || commandId === BC.reviewSyncPlan
      || commandId === BC.selectLeftDifferences
      || commandId === BC.selectRightDifferences
      || commandId === BC.copyMissingLeftToRight
      || commandId === BC.copyMissingRightToLeft) {
      return this.canComparePanes();
    }
    return isFileBrowserCommandAvailable(commandId, this.activeActionAvailability);
  }

  private registerMouseBindings(): void {
    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('global.mouse.viewer.zoomIn', () => {
      this.getActivePane()?.browserCommands.preview.zoomInActiveViewer();
    }, this.mouseCommandOwner);

    this.inputEngine.registerCommand('global.mouse.viewer.zoomOut', () => {
      this.getActivePane()?.browserCommands.preview.zoomOutActiveViewer();
    }, this.mouseCommandOwner);

    const bindings: InputBindingDefinition[] = [
      {
        id: 'global.mouse.viewer.ctrlWheelUp',
        contextId: 'global',
        commandId: 'global.mouse.viewer.zoomIn',
        source: 'default',
        description: 'Zoom the active viewer in with Ctrl+wheel up',
        when: 'viewerSurface',
        trigger: {
          device: 'mouse',
          gesture: { type: 'wheel', direction: 'up', modifiers: ['ctrl'] },
        },
      },
      {
        id: 'global.mouse.viewer.ctrlWheelDown',
        contextId: 'global',
        commandId: 'global.mouse.viewer.zoomOut',
        source: 'default',
        description: 'Zoom the active viewer out with Ctrl+wheel down',
        when: 'viewerSurface',
        trigger: {
          device: 'mouse',
          gesture: { type: 'wheel', direction: 'down', modifiers: ['ctrl'] },
        },
      },
    ];

    for (const binding of bindings) {
      this.inputEngine.registerBinding(binding, this.mouseCommandOwner);
    }
  }

  private unregisterMouseBindings(): void {
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('global.mouse.fileEntry.openSelected', this.mouseCommandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('global.mouse.viewer.zoomIn', this.mouseCommandOwner);
    this.inputEngine.unregisterCommand('global.mouse.viewer.zoomOut', this.mouseCommandOwner);

    for (const bindingId of FileBrowserComponent.mouseBindingIds) {
      this.inputEngine.unregisterBinding(bindingId, this.mouseCommandOwner);
    }
  }

  formatPendingChord(steps: unknown): string {
    const sequence = Array.isArray((steps as { steps?: unknown } | null | undefined)?.steps)
      ? (steps as { steps: unknown[] }).steps
      : (Array.isArray(steps) ? steps : null);

    if (!sequence) {
      return '';
    }

    return sequence.map((step) => {
      const record = (step && typeof step === 'object') ? step as { key?: unknown; modifiers?: unknown } : {};
      const key = typeof record.key === 'string' ? record.key : '';
      const modifiers = Array.isArray(record.modifiers)
        ? record.modifiers.filter((value: unknown): value is string => typeof value === 'string')
        : [];
      const parts = [...modifiers.map((modifier: string) => {
        switch (modifier) {
          case 'ctrl': return 'Ctrl';
          case 'shift': return 'Shift';
          case 'alt': return 'Alt';
          case 'meta': return 'Win';
          default: return modifier;
        }
      })];

      const keyMap: Record<string, string> = {
        arrowup: 'Up',
        arrowdown: 'Down',
        arrowleft: 'Left',
        arrowright: 'Right',
        escape: 'Esc',
        space: 'Space',
      };

      parts.push(keyMap[key] ?? key.toUpperCase());
      return parts.join('+');
    }).join(' ');
  }

  hasBinding(bindingId: string): boolean {
    return !!this.inputEngine.getBinding(bindingId);
  }

  asShortcutDebugTrace(value: unknown): ShortcutDebugTrace | null {
    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
      return null;
    }
    return value as ShortcutDebugTrace;
  }

  onPanePreviewTarget(fromPane: 'left' | 'right', targetPath: string): void {
    this.previewController.onPanePreviewTarget(this.previewHost, fromPane, targetPath);
  }

  onPaneActiveTabChanged(fromPane: 'left' | 'right', tab: TabInfo): void {
    this.previewController.onPaneActiveTabChanged(this.previewHost, fromPane, tab);
    if ((tab.kind ?? 'dir') === 'size-manager') {
      this.syncSizeManagerPane(fromPane);
      return;
    }
    this.syncSizeManagerPane(this.getOppositePaneId(fromPane));
  }

  // NOTE: we intentionally do not auto-create live preview tabs on cursor move.

  // ============================================================================
  // Resizable Panels
  // ============================================================================

  onPaneDividerPositionChange(position: number): void {
    this.layoutController.syncPaneWidths(this.layoutHost, position);
  }

  computePaneWidth(percent: number): string {
    const clamped = Number.isFinite(percent) ? percent : 50;
    const compensation = this.paneRowFixedWidthPx / 2;
    return `calc(${clamped}% - ${compensation}px)`;
  }

  @HostListener('window:keydown.arrowleft', ['$event'])
  onArrowLeft(event: any): void {
    if (!document.activeElement?.classList.contains('pane-divider')) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    this.layoutController.nudgeDividerLeft(this.layoutHost);
  }

  @HostListener('window:keydown.arrowright', ['$event'])
  onArrowRight(event: any): void {
    if (!document.activeElement?.classList.contains('pane-divider')) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    this.layoutController.nudgeDividerRight(this.layoutHost);
  }

  statusText: string = 'Ready';
}

  constructor(
    private apiService: ApiService,
    private workspaceService: WorkspaceService,
    private filterService: FilterService,
    private pathHistoryService: PathHistoryService,
    private directorySource: DirectorySourceService,
    private confirmDialog: ConfirmDialogService,
    private remoteConnectDialog: RemoteConnectDialogService,
    private operationService: OperationService,
    private batchRenameDialog: BatchRenameDialogService,
    private settingsService: SettingsService,
    private zone: NgZone,
    private cdr: ChangeDetectorRef,
    private archiveService: ArchiveService,
    private surfaceRegistry: SurfaceRegistryService,
    private pluginManager: PluginManagerService,
    private inputEngine: InputEngineService,
  ) {
    this.dirStream = new DirListStreamController(this.apiService);
    this.operationsController = new FilePaneOperationsController(this.operationService, this.batchRenameDialog);
    this.navigationController = new FilePaneNavigationController();
  }

  get allTabSurfaceCtxs(): Array<{ ctx: SurfaceContext; active: boolean }> {
    const orderedTabs = this.tabs
      .slice()
      .sort((left, right) => {
        const leftActive = left.id === this.currentTabId ? 1 : 0;
        const rightActive = right.id === this.currentTabId ? 1 : 0;
        return leftActive - rightActive;
      });

    return orderedTabs.map((tab) => ({
      ctx: this.surfaceContextFactory.getSurfaceContextForTab(this.surfaceContextSource, tab),
      active: tab.id === this.currentTabId,
    }));
  }

  trackTabSurface(_index: number, item: { ctx: SurfaceContext; active: boolean }): string {
    return item.ctx.tab.id;
  }

  ngOnInit(): void  {
    this.dirTabStateController.setPersistCallback((tabId, json) => {
      this.workspaceService.setTabViewState(this.paneId, tabId, json);
    });
    this.hydrateDirTabStatesFromWorkspace();

    this.uiController.loadViewPreference(this.uiHost);
    this.loadPaneState();
    this.directoryController.bind(this.directoryHost);
    this.uiController.bindOptimisticDnD(this.uiHost);

    // Keep panes in sync when tab state changes elsewhere (e.g. cross-pane tab drag/drop).
    this.workspaceService.activeWorkspace$
      .pipe(takeUntil(this.destroy$))
      .subscribe(ws => {
        if (!ws || !this.workspace) return;
        if (ws.id !== this.workspace.id) return;
        this.hydrateDirTabStatesFromWorkspace();
        this.tabsController.onWorkspaceUpdate(this.tabsHost, ws);
      });
  }

  private hydrateDirTabStatesFromWorkspace(): void {
    const tabs = this.workspaceService.getTabs(this.paneId);
    for (const tab of tabs) {
      if ((tab.kind ?? 'dir') !== 'dir') continue;
      if (tab.viewStateJson) {
        this.dirTabStateController.hydrateFromJson(tab.id, tab.viewStateJson);
      }
    }
  }
  
  ngOnChanges(changes: SimpleChanges): void {
    if (changes['workspace']) {
      // The input is bound to FileBrowserComponent.activeWorkspace which starts as null.
      // That means the *first* change Angular sees is often null, and the transition
      // to a real workspace would be a later change. Always load once we have a
      // non-null workspace so tabs/pane render without requiring a user click.
      if (this.workspace) {
        this.hydrateDirTabStatesFromWorkspace();
        this.uiController.loadViewPreference(this.uiHost);
        this.lastSeenActiveTabId = null;
        this.lastSeenActiveTabPath = null;
        this.loadPaneState();
      }
      return;
    }

    if (changes['showHidden'] && !changes['showHidden'].firstChange) {
      this.browserCommands.navigation.refresh();
    }

    if (changes['paneActive'] && this.paneActive && !changes['paneActive'].firstChange) {
      this.focusController.ensureCursorVisibleOnActivation(this.focusHost);
    }
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    this.destroy$.next();
    this.destroy$.complete();

    void this.directoryController.unbind(this.directoryHost);
    this.uiController.unbindOptimisticDnD();
  }

  onTabDrop(event: TabDropEvent): void {
    this.tabsController.onTabDrop(this.tabsHost, event);
  }

  onTabDragStart(tab: TabInfo): void {
    this.tabsController.onTabDragStart(this.tabsHost, tab);
  }

  get entriesForAnalysis(): FileInfo[] {
    return this.entries.filter(e => e.path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH);
  }

  // Fired when a dynamic surface notifies that first data arrived.
  onSurfaceFirstEntry(): void {
    // Trigger a change detection pass so parent UI (loaders/overlays) can update.
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ View System Methods в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  async onViewChange(view: ViewLayout): Promise<void> {
    await this.uiController.onViewChange(this.uiHost, view);
  }

  }

  onContextMenu(event: { event: MouseEvent; entry: FileInfo }): void {
    const mouse = event.event;
    const entry = event.entry;
    mouse.preventDefault();
    mouse.stopPropagation();

    if (!entry?.path || entry.path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) {
      this.closeFileContextMenu();
      return;
    }

    // Context-menu commands operate on the clicked item unless it is already
    // part of a multi-selection. This keeps right-click behavior consistent
    // across list/grid/details/tree views.
    if (!this.selectedFiles.has(entry.path)) {
      this.onSelectionChange([entry]);
    }

    const x = Math.max(4, Math.min(mouse.clientX, Math.max(4, window.innerWidth - 244)));
    const y = Math.max(4, Math.min(mouse.clientY, Math.max(4, window.innerHeight - 360)));

    // Let the parent browser recompute ActionAvailability after the selection
    // mutation before freezing the menu snapshot.
    setTimeout(() => {
      const selectedPaths = Array.from(this.selectedFiles).filter(path => path && path !== PARENT_ENTRY_PATH);
      const context: MenuContext = {
        targetPath: entry.path,
        selectedPaths,
        currentDirectory: this.currentPath,
      };
      const builtins = buildBuiltinFileContextMenu({
        availability: this.actionAvailability,
        selectedCount: selectedPaths.length,
        isDirectory: entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY,
      }).map(item => bindCommandPresentation(
        item,
        () => this.executeBuiltinContextAction(item.id, entry),
      ));

      const plugins = this.pluginManager.resolveContextMenuItems(context).map((item, index) =>
        presentPluginCommand(item, context, this.inputEngine, { separatorBefore: index === 0 }),
      );

      this.fileContextMenu = { x, y, items: [...builtins, ...plugins] };
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }, 0);
  }

  onBackgroundContextMenu(mouse: MouseEvent): void {
    mouse.preventDefault();
    mouse.stopPropagation();
    this.onSelectionChange([]);

    const x = Math.max(4, Math.min(mouse.clientX, Math.max(4, window.innerWidth - 244)));
    const y = Math.max(4, Math.min(mouse.clientY, Math.max(4, window.innerHeight - 180)));

    setTimeout(() => {
      const context: MenuContext = {
        targetPath: this.currentPath,
        selectedPaths: [],
        currentDirectory: this.currentPath,
      };
      const builtins = buildBackgroundFileContextMenu(this.actionAvailability).map(item => bindCommandPresentation(
        item,
        () => this.executeBackgroundContextAction(item.id),
      ));
      const plugins = this.pluginManager.resolveContextMenuItems(context).map((item, index) =>
        presentPluginCommand(item, context, this.inputEngine, { separatorBefore: index === 0 }),
      );
      this.fileContextMenu = { x, y, items: [...builtins, ...plugins] };
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }, 0);
  }

  private executeBackgroundContextAction(action: BackgroundFileContextAction): void {
    const commandId = {
      newFolder: BC.newFolder,
      paste: BC.paste,
      refresh: BC.refresh,
    } satisfies Record<BackgroundFileContextAction, string>;
    this.inputEngine.dispatchCommandById(commandId[action]);
  }

  closeFileContextMenu(): void {
    if (!this.fileContextMenu) return;
    this.fileContextMenu = null;
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private executeBuiltinContextAction(action: BuiltinFileContextAction, entry: FileInfo): void | Promise<void> {
    if (action === 'openInNewTab') {
      return this.openEntryInNewTab(entry);
    }

    const commandId = {
      open: BC.openItem,
      quickView: BC.quickView,
      copyPath: BC.copyCursorPath,
      openWithExternal: BC.openWithExternal,
      copy: BC.copy,
      cut: BC.cut,
      delete: BC.deleteSelected,
      rename: BC.rename,
      copyToOther: BC.copyToOtherPane,
      moveToOther: BC.moveToOtherPane,
    } satisfies Record<Exclude<BuiltinFileContextAction, 'openInNewTab'>, string>;

    this.inputEngine.dispatchCommandById(commandId[action]);
  }

  onNodeDoubleClick(entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (this.activeSurfaceId === 'search-results') {
      void this.openSearchSurfaceEntry(entry);
      return;
    }
    this.openController.onNodeDoubleClick(this.openHost, entry, () => this.browserCommands.navigation.navigateUp());
  }

  zoomActiveViewerIn(): void {
    this.viewer?.zoomIn?.();
  }

  zoomActiveViewerOut(): void {
    this.viewer?.zoomOut?.();
  }

  resetActiveViewerZoom(): void {
    this.viewer?.resetZoom?.();
  }

  deleteInActiveViewer(): void {
    this.viewer?.deleteSelected?.();
  }

  async openSearchResult(result: SearchResultItem): Promise<void> {
    const targetPath = normalizePath(result.file.path);
    const focusPath = result.file.type === FileType.DIRECTORY ? targetPath : result.file.path;
    const directoryPath = result.file.type === FileType.DIRECTORY
      ? targetPath
      : normalizePath(targetPath.replace(/[/\\][^/\\]+$/, '') || targetPath);

    await this.loadDirectory(directoryPath, { focusPath });
    this.focusController.focusCursorPath(this.focusHost, focusPath);
    this.runtimeStateController.afterNavigationMutation(this.runtimeStateHost);
  }

  private withParentEntry(raw: FileInfo[], inArchive: boolean, fsPath: string): FileInfo[] {
    return this.pathController.withParentEntry(raw, inArchive, fsPath, this.directorySource);
  }

  private async loadPathTransparently(path: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.pathController.loadPathTransparently(this.pathHost, path);
  }

  private async refreshCurrentPathTransparently(): Promise<void> {
    await this.pathController.refreshCurrentPathTransparently(this.pathHost);
  }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ Pane state в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  private async loadPaneState(): Promise<void> {
    await this.navigationController.loadPaneState(this.navigationHost);
    this.runInAngular(() => {
      this.runtimeStateController.afterNavigationMutation(this.runtimeStateHost);
    });
  }

  private clearArchiveState(): void {
    this.runtimeStateController.clearArchiveState(this.runtimeStateHost);
  }

  private async loadDirectory(path: string, opts?: { preserveUI?: boolean; focusPath?: string }): Promise<void> {
    await this.directoryController.loadDirectory(this.directoryHost, path, opts);
  }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ Tab management в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  async onTabChange(tab: TabInfo): Promise<void> {
    await this.navigationController.onTabChange(this.navigationHost, tab);
    this.runInAngular(() => {
      this.runtimeStateController.afterNavigationMutation(this.runtimeStateHost);
    });
  }

  onTabClose(tab: TabInfo): void {
    this.tabsController.onTabClose(this.tabsHost, tab);
  }

  onTabPin(tab: TabInfo): void {
    this.tabsController.onTabPin(this.tabsHost, tab);
  }

  onNewTab(): void {
    this.tabsController.onNewTab(this.tabsHost);
  }

  async openPinnedLocation(pin: PinnedLocation): Promise<void> {
    const surfaceId = pin.surfaceId?.trim() || 'dir';
    if (surfaceId === 'dir') {
      this.onPathChange(pin.location);
      return;
    }

    const tab = this.workspaceService.addSurfaceTab(this.paneId, pin.location, surfaceId, {
      title: pin.label,
      activate: true,
    });
    if (!tab) return;

    this.tabs = this.workspaceService.getTabs(this.paneId);
    await this.onTabChange(tab);
  }

  async openDuplicateFinder(rootPath: string = this.currentPath): Promise<void> {
    const root = (rootPath || '').trim();
    if (!root) return;
    const location = `surface://duplicates?path=${encodeURIComponent(root)}`;
    const tab = this.workspaceService.addSurfaceTab(this.paneId, location, 'duplicates', {
      title: 'Duplicates',
      activate: true,
    });
    if (!tab) return;
    this.tabs = this.workspaceService.getTabs(this.paneId);
    await this.onTabChange(tab);
  }

  async openSearchSurface(location: string, query: string): Promise<void> {
    const tab = this.workspaceService.addSurfaceTab(this.paneId, location, 'search-results', {
      title: query.trim() || 'Search',
      activate: true,
    });
    if (!tab) return;

    this.tabs = this.workspaceService.getTabs(this.paneId);
    await this.onTabChange(tab);
  }

  async openPathInNewTab(path: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const probe = await this.apiService.probeFile(path);
      if (probe?.isArchive) {
        await this.archiveController.openRootArchive(this.archiveHost, path);
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      // fall back to the standard tab path
    }

    await this.tabsController.openPathInNewTab(this.tabsHost, path);
  }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ Address bar / path в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  onPathChange(path: string): void {
    this.navigationController.onPathChange(this.navigationHost, path);
  }

  private runInAngular(update: () => void): void {
    this.zone.run(() => {
      update();
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    });
  }

  /**
   * Returns the effective destination directory for a copy/move operation.
   * If exactly one directory is selected in this pane, operations are directed
   * into that folder rather than the generic currentPath.
   */
  getDestinationDir(): string {
    return this.operationsController.getDestinationDir(this.operationsHost);
  }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ Archive segment click в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  private async handleArchiveSegmentClick(virtualPath: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.archiveController.onArchiveSegmentClick(this.archiveHost, virtualPath);
  }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ Navigation в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  private async openSearchSurfaceEntry(entry: FileInfo): Promise<void> {
    if (!entry?.path || entry.path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) return;
    if (entry.type === FileType.DIRECTORY) {
      await this.openPathInNewTab(entry.path);
      return;
    }
    await this.previewController.openPreviewPath(this.previewHost, entry.path);
  }

  onNavigate(entry: FileInfo): void {
    if (this.activeSurfaceId === 'search-results') {
      void this.openSearchSurfaceEntry(entry);
      return;
    }
    this.openController.onNavigate(this.openHost, entry, () => this.browserCommands.navigation.navigateUp());
  }

  private async openEntryInNewTab(entry: FileInfo): Promise<void> {
    await this.openController.onOpenInNewTab(this.openHost, entry);
  }

  private async renameEntry(event: { entry: FileInfo; newName: string }): Promise<void> {
    await this.operationsController.onRename(this.operationsHost, event);
  }

  private async handleDragDrop(event: { event: DragEvent; source: FileInfo[]; targetPath: string }): Promise<void> {
    await this.operationsController.onDragDrop(this.operationsHost, event);
  }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ Archive navigation в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  isInArchive(): boolean { return this.archiveController.isInArchive(this.archiveHost); }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ Find widget в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  onFindStateChange(state: FindWidgetState | null): void {
    this.stateController.onFindStateChange(this.stateHost, state);
  }

  onFindNext(): void {
    this.stateController.onFindNext(this.stateHost);
  }

  onFindPrev(): void {
    this.stateController.onFindPrev(this.stateHost);
  }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ Filtering в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  applyFilter(): void {
    this.stateController.applyFilter(this.stateHost);
  }

  private persistDirTabState(): void {
    this.runtimeStateController.persistDirTabState(this.runtimeStateHost);
  }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ Selection в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  onSelectionChange(entries: FileInfo[]): void {
    this.stateController.onSelectionChange(this.stateHost, entries);
  }

  measureCurrentDirectorySize(): void {
    if (this.activeSurfaceId !== 'dir' || this.isInArchive()) return;

    const path = this.selectionCursorPath ?? (this.selectedFiles.size === 1 ? Array.from(this.selectedFiles)[0] : null);
    if (!path || path === PARENT_ENTRY_PATH) return;

    const entry = this.entries.find(candidate => candidate.path === path);
    if (!entry || entry.type !== FileType.DIRECTORY) return;

    void this.fileViewContainer?.calculateDirectorySize(path);
  }

  measureCurrentDirectorySizeAndMoveDown(): void {
    this.measureCurrentDirectorySize();
    this.shortcuts.selection.toggleCurrentAndMoveDown();
  }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ File operations в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  /**
   * Returns archive metadata for the current tree-view selection when the
   * selected nodes are inside an expanded archive node (not in archive-pane
   * mode). All selected nodes must share the same archive FS path and nested
   * chain; otherwise returns null.
   */
  getTreeArchiveSelectionContext(): { archivePath: string; innerPaths: string[] } | null {
    return this.operationsController.getTreeArchiveSelectionContext(this.operationsHost);
  }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ Archive move operations в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ

  /**
   * Called by FileBrowserComponent after it has resolved destDir.
   * Shows the confirmation dialog; executePendingMove runs when user confirms.
   */
  initiatePendingMove(entries: string[], destDir: string): void {
    this.archiveController.initiatePendingMove(this.archiveHost, entries, destDir);
  }

  /**
   * Bound to (confirmed) on the ArchiveMoveWarningDialogComponent.
   */
  async executePendingMove(): Promise<void> {
    await this.archiveController.executePendingMove(this.archiveHost);
  }

  // в”Ђв”Ђ Tab shortcuts в”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђв”Ђ


  // ── Disk Usage Analyzer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

  openDiskUsageAnalyzer(path?: string): void {
    const analysisPath = this.resolveDiskUsageAnalysisPath(path);
    const tab = this.workspaceService.addSizeManagerTab(this.paneId, analysisPath, { activate: true });
    if (tab) {
      this.tabs = this.workspaceService.getTabs(this.paneId);
      this.currentTabId = tab.id;
      this.cdr.markForCheck();
    }
  }

  /** Called by the other pane to sync the active size-manager tab to a new path. */
  followSizeManagerNavigation(path: string): void {
    const tab = this.tabs.find(t => t.id === this.currentTabId);
    if (!tab || (tab.kind ?? 'dir') !== 'size-manager') return;
    if (tab.path === path) return;
    tab.path = path;
    this.workspaceService.updateTabPathAndTitle(this.paneId, tab.id, path, tab.title || 'Storage Footprint');
    this.tabs = this.workspaceService.getTabs(this.paneId);
    this.cdr.markForCheck();
  }

  private resolveDiskUsageAnalysisPath(path?: string): string {
    if (path) return path;
    return this.currentPath || '/';
  }

  private buildSizeManagerVm(): SizeManagerSurfaceVm | null {
    const tab = this.tabs.find(t => t.id === this.currentTabId);
    if (!tab || (tab.kind ?? 'dir') !== 'size-manager') return null;
    const thisRef = this;
    return {
      paneId: this.paneId,
      analysisPath: tab.path || this.currentPath || '/',
      onAnalyse(p: string) {
        tab.path = p;
        thisRef.cdr.markForCheck();
      },
      onClose() {
        thisRef.workspaceService.closeTab(thisRef.paneId, tab.id);
        thisRef.tabs = thisRef.workspaceService.getTabs(thisRef.paneId);
        thisRef.currentTabId = thisRef.workspaceService.getActiveTab(thisRef.paneId)?.id ?? thisRef.tabs[0]?.id ?? '';
        thisRef.cdr.markForCheck();
      },
    };
  }

}
